Masaai: Neing'uaa Nebusaradan olkitok le rripore tiatua enkop e Yuda o embata oo ltung'ana aisinak lemeeta toki, neisho ninche nkurman oo sabibu o nkurman teina kata ake.

English: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

English: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

English: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

English: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
Masaai: ore Yehoiakin olaiguanani le Yuda, neitarasaki kewan olaiguanani le Babilon, kewan enye, o ng'otonye o sinkan lenyena, o lkituaak lenyena, o sinkan le nkaji enye e nkitoo. Neen olaiguanani le Babilon ninye, neya ninye, to lari le isiet le nkitoria enye.

English: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

English: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

English: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

English: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei, te neaku keirrashaki oltung'ani te nkitarruorroto naje, ore intae ile nkiyang'et nitemiteme aasaru te nkiyang'et e mborron; naa entodol ate, pooki ng'ae; mikitemi sii ninye iyie.

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Enchoo Kaisari ine Kaisari, ninchosho Enkai ine Nkai.” Neing'asiae te ninye oleng.

English: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
Masaai: Nejo, “Inosa olmumai te nanu.” Neinos ninye olmumai. Ina pee eirrug Israel endukuya enye te ndukuya e ndapash enye.

English: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
Masaai: Naa keikenari ilo asar linyi anaa entapa o soit oituutishoreki aashu anaa enaisho naing'uaa enkironyet.

English: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
Masaai: Eeta sii apa ilayiok ootoiuo Hushim enkitok enye: Abitub o Elpaal.

English: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi alotu Mahanaim. Nelang Absalom Yordan te nebo iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli.

English: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninye ilo oing'oni kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo dukuya Olaitoriani, neiteleiki enkaina enye endukuya eilo oing'oni, neyieng ilo oing'oni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani, o lororani lenyena pooki lelo aisiaayiak lenyena oas eyieunoto enye!

English: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani oboitare te loloito enkitok e papaai lenye netaboluo nkilani e papaai lenye, ore ninche pokira are neari metuata, ore osarge lenye neaku shumata ninche etii.

English: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
Masaai: neitoki Musa airorie ilo orere ina olong ake, ejo,

English: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
Masaai: Nedamu ninye to ltau lenye ajo, “Maaigusugusieki nanu; ore ti atua iishoritin pooki matum nanu batisho.”

English: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
Masaai: Ore naa etiu neijia, lalashera laainei, eitu alotu enitii te nkarriyiano oo nkirorot aashu te ng'eno, apa pee alotu aliki intae ina sipata naisudoro e Nkai.

English: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, apa aa Saul olaiguanani te shumata iyiook, iyie apa otorikoyie aipang'ie niriku aitijing'u Israel; nikijoki Olaitoriani iyie, ‘Iaku iyie olchekut loo ltung'ana laainei, Israel, niaku kitok te shumata Israel.’ ”

English: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
Masaai: Kake ore doi intae, lalashera laainei itiuwu anaa Isaak, irara nkera e nkisiligata e Nkai.

English: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa iyie ing'oru irorei? Tujurru, ina peyie kiro.

English: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
Masaai: nejoki oloti menye, ‘Papa, nchooki nanu masaa naaku inaainei.’ Neoriki pokira masaa enyena.

English: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore ilo lee pooki oidongoki aashu ilo otudung'ori elewaisho nemejing atua eumata o Laitoriani.

English: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Goshen, o Holon, o Gilo: nkanas tomon o obo te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metayiolo nchere enkaina ino ena; iyie, Olaitoriani otaasa ena!

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu eisupat ninye; ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi!

English: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
Masaai: Aneeijo mpirrirri apa aaitobirari; ainyoo nanyaaka aibooyo intae pee mining'ining'i esipata?

English: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
Masaai: Neilepaki Yesu endoinyo neton te ine te nebo ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
Masaai: Te ne mara olkipaaret te kulikae, nara ake ninye te intae; naa intae olmishire le kipaaretisho ai ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
Masaai: Etawuapayioki ninche aaiwuang'ie eng'or enkata enye; etooroyioki aaiwuang'ie olkitamanyunoto lenye.

English: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo ootegeluaki to lturrur, lelo arikok loo loshon lenye, aa ninche ilukuny oo loshon le Israel.

English: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
Masaai: Nelo Olaitoriani dukuya ninche dama te nkatampoi naikununo anaa eng'ape pee erikoo ninche te nkoitoi, ore te nkewarie naa te nkima naikununo anaa eng'ape pee eitawang'aki ninche, pee etum aashom dama o kewarie.

English: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.
Masaai: Ore enasirie neipot Samuel Saul te nchumata e nkaji ajoki, “Inyo, pee aatum airriwai iyie te nkoitoi ino.” Neinyototo Saul, ore ninye o Samuel neipang aapuo enkoitoi.

English: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
Masaai: Aime sapuk enkarruoisho ino? Meeta intorrok inono enkiting'oto.

English: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
Masaai: Entadamu intae ilo oting'iria enkiba naba neijia oo laing'okok eiba kewan enye, pee minaururu intae nemidukenyanya ti atua iltauja linyi.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii; naajoki:

English: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
Masaai: Kitediaki iyie tenijing'u, nikitediaki tenimpung.

English: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
Masaai: Ore oloitirrish enkolong nabo neitirrish aa Olaitoriani eyanyit. Ore sii ilo onya nenya aa Olaitoriani eyanyit; amu Enkai eisho enashe; naa ore sii ilo lemenya, nemenya te nkaraki naa Olaitoriani eyanyit neisho Enkai enashe.

English: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
Masaai: Mianyu iyie enkewarie, ina kata nadung'ori iltung'ana aaiwuang'ie te wueji enye.

English: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
Masaai: Neaku entadamu inchere ore apa ae kata intae Iloreren ti alo osesen, ooji ilmemurata lelo kulikae ooji iloomurata naa entoki naitobiri to sesen too nkaik

English: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
Masaai: Neipotu Barak Sebulon o Naftali meetu Kedesh; neilep iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon aasujaa ninye, nelo sii Debora te nebo ninye.

English: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
Masaai: o layiok aare le Yosef ootoikioki ninye te Misiri; neaku ore olorere pooki le nkaji e Yakobo oetuo atua Misiri naa iltung'ana intomoni naapishana.

English: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
Masaai: Ore ilo omoni eitu eirrag enkoitoi nalala e nkanas; ataboloko nchomito aainei lelo apuayak);

English: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
Masaai: Nejoki entito e Farao ninye, “Shomo.” Nelo entito aipotu ng'otonye ina kerai.

English: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
Masaai: ore iwuejitin neeika e Isaak naa keitomijooni ore iwuejitin e Israel neeseremishoreki neitomijooni, naa kadumakino nanu enkaji e Yeroboam to lalem.”

English: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
Masaai: nintayu ti atua ntutuan oo mukateni neitu eisuijieki natii dukuya Olaitoriani, emukate nabo namelok natii o enkaukau nabo eilata,

English: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
Masaai: pee etumi aatayiolo enkoitoi ino te nkop pooki, neyiolouni ina golon ino naitajeusho too loshon pooki.

English: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
Masaai: “Etii olalem auluo, netii olmeitai o lameyu atua boo. Ore pooki ng'ae otii atua enkurma neye to lalem, ore pooki ng'ae otii atua enkanasa nemuat olameyu o lmeitai.

English: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilkirragarien loo ltung'ana le Israel, ina kata apa pee eipung aapuo aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri, too lororani lenye erikito Musa o Aron.

English: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku enkiting'oto e nkolong e isiet, nemurati neipoti aajo Yesu, ina arna apa natudung'oko olmalaika eton eitu enutaini.

English: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Naftali: Yahasiel, o Guni, o Yeser, o Shalum, ilo le ishoi e Bilhal.

English: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
Masaai: “Entadamu ororei apa oitanapa intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa keisho intae ewueji e nkiyeng'iyeng, naa keisho ninye intae ena kop.’

English: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.
Masaai: Inosa iyie o lmarei lino, te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino to lari ake ninye pooki teine wueji negelu Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
Masaai: Ning'oring'oro intae elde oishopito inkilani sidain, nishilaa aajoki, “Totona te ne,” nijokiki elde aisinani, “intasho te nde,” aashu, “Isukudoyu te mbata oo nkejek aainei.”

English: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
Masaai: “Nchoo iltung'ana le Israel emanyisho tembata e nanka enye, to lmonekie loo nkajijik oo loo menye, nchoo eun ilng'oborri aaipirie ilo ng'obor le ntumo te pooki shoto.

English: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
Masaai: Pee etumi aishoo eng'eno sidai olmodai netum ilbarnot eng'eno naiyiolounye eneikunari te nkishon.

English: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
Masaai: naiteleiki nanu oloililai lenye olbolet le nkaji e Daudi; nebol ninye nemeetae oloiken. Neiken nemeetae olobol.

English: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu, Olaitoriani, nchere nkiguanat inono naasipa, nayiolo nchere te sipata iyie kintamio nanu.

English: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
Masaai: Nening Enkai oltoilo le Manoa, neigil ilo malaika le Nkai alotu enetii ina kitok etonita te nkurma; kake metii apa Manoa olmoruo lenye te nebo ninye.

English: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
Masaai: Neye pooki toki naata osesen naloolo te shumata enkop. Imotonyi, o nkishu, o ng'uesi, o pooki toki naishu te nkop, o pooki tung'ani,

English: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto, eitayio Pasaka neisuaaya osarge, pee, mear ninche ilo Arani loo lkikaunot.

English: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
Masaai: Eisikong'a ninye Enaiposha Nanyokie, netoyu; nerikoo ninye ninche aimie enguton etotiuo anaa olpurkel.

English: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki; ore eyia; iyanyitaki taata te dukuya ilpayiani loo ltung'ana laainei o te dukuya Israel, nirrinyo te nebo nanu, pee atum nanu ateserema Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”

English: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
Masaai: Neliki ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani ninye, ejo, “Etii Haman idie, eitashe to lodung'oro.” Nejo olaiguanani, “Enchoo elotu atua aji.”

English: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
Masaai: “Entoduaaki empisai. Ai ng'ae esirakino naa kole ng'ae olkigeroto oata?” Nejoki, “Ole Kaisari.”

English: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
Masaai: Amaa teneimaa ninye enkop, neenaa olorere, neipotu adung'oki enkiguana aing'ae oidim aibooi ninye?

English: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
Masaai: Aitayio nanu enkitanapata neitobiraki enjurrunoto, nenotoki nchere ore ena anasa ebaiki apa moitie netudumakine ilaiguanak agilunore, netii enkiser o enkarruoisho atua ninye.

English: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
Masaai: “Teniming'or iyie pee ias kulo rorei pooki lena kitanapata ooigero tena buku pee itum aturia ena arna kitok naitureisho, o Laitoriani Enkai ino,

English: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana Lot, “Ae yata kulikae tung'ana tene?” Aa ilaputak linono, o ntoyie, anaa tung'ani ake ninye liata te nkanasa, intupuku ninche tiatua ene wueji.

English: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
Masaai: Ore enkiteng olng'arurumi ng'iro nedaa te nebo; ore lasho lenye neirrag te nebo, ore olng'atuny neaku nkujit einos anaa olkiteng.

English: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
Masaai: Neisho Yonatan imasaa enyena olarrabal ina ayioni nejoki ninye, “Shomo iwa ninche enkanasa.”

English: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
Masaai: “Te nelo olmalaika lai dukuya intae, neyau intae atua Ilamori, o Ilhiti, o Ilperesi, o Ilkanaani, o Ilhifi, o Ilyebusi, te najutu nanu ninche, (aishu),

English: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee epuonu ninche, ilng'oborri le Israel, nedumunye Israeli nerasaki Ilmoabu, o metaba anaa neipirri aailanyisho te dukuya ninche. Nepuo ninche dukuya ear Ilmoabu too lalema epuoito.

English: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaidur aapuo te Betel; ore eton elakuaniki Efrat, nesaisayu Raheli, near enkop oleng.

English: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
Masaai: Ore pee eiturrur ninye ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat le ilo orere, neipar ajoki, “Kaji eiunyeki Kristo?”

English: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
Masaai: Ore oloitook obo le kulo ooti, enkikompe e nkare nairobi enkaraki naa oloiteng'eni lai, esipa ajok intae, meimin olerrinyore lenye.”

English: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
Masaai: Nejoki Farao ilalashera lenyena. “Ainyoo oshi esaiai inyi niasiasa?” Nejoki ninche Farao, “Ore isinkan linono naa ilaramatak, anaa enatiu apa iloo papa lang.”

English: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
Masaai: Neng'amaa ina kata ltung'ana le Nkai aajoki, ‘Lo kitok, kanu kitaduaa iyie iata esumash nikintoti iyie? Aashu iata enkure nikintook iyie?

English: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
Masaai: Metoning'ori olkiyioi eing'uaa nkajijik enye, tiniyau iyie lelo ooarr ninche metuata te luamata! Amu etuturutuo ninche engumoto pee aaya nanu, neirragakinye nkejek aainei irresheta.

English: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani airorie Ahas,

English: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
Masaai: Aimiyiolo aajo ore te nkesha naa keitukuja pooki, kake obo ake lenye otum enchunet? Neaku enkuet pee itumutumu.

English: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
Masaai: Neaku ena aji olchala le nkidaata, ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo neiputukuny, neisulisho, nejo ninche, ‘Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena kop o tena aji?

English: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
Masaai: Nji naa ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkoitoi pooki kituaak naa keaku enkishirata; ore too nkoitoi pooki nejo ninche, ‘Aha, aha!’ Naa keipotu ninche ilaturok le nkurma meetu aaishir, neyietu lelo arriyiak te nkishirata,

English: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
Masaai: Ore apa iloibonok ooiturukutuo te dukuya iyie o nanu ebaiki apa neibonutuo olarrabal, o lameyu o lmeitai tialo nkuapi kumok o nkitoriak kituaak.

English: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
Masaai: Neyau ninye atua enkaji e Nkai nena tokitin apa naaitisinya menye o nkishorot naaitisinya ninye makewan, enkosholai o sahabu o masaa,

English: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
Masaai: Eishiraki ninche noo ng'otonye ejo, “Koree endaa enaisho oo sabibu?” eiterriaa anaa iltung'ana oata ilbaa, too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, eishunye enkishui enye too lgooitie loo noo ng'otonye.

English: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu kulo rorei, neing'asia siamon te nkiteng'enare enye;

English: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni, aa enkolong apa natoinyieki Farao, neitaiki ilaisiaayiak lenyena pooki o sirua nedumu endukuya olaitookoni kitok tenebo endukuya olayierani kitok tiatua ilaisiaayiak lenyena.

English: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
Masaai: Enapa Mariamu naelie Olaitoriani eilata narropil nejut nkejek too lpapit lenyena, ninye emuei olalashe lenye Lasaro.

English: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
Masaai: O Arabu, o Duma, o Eshan,

English: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto etalang'a lelo tung'ana enaiposha nanyokie anaa enkop natoyio; kake ore Ilmisiri pee etem aajo maikuna neijia, neya enkare.

English: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
Masaai: Ore too lmonek ooishooki metaasa te ine netii ina ng'ues neitapong'oo lelo ootii enkop. Neitanap lelo oomanya enkop meitobira ninche enkitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues naata endung'oto o lalem neton ake eishu.

English: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
Masaai: Aata nanu esile too Lyunani o too leme Lyunani, too looiteng'enaki o leitu.

English: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
Masaai: Neshutu obo le lelo ooboitare Yesu olalem, neosh osinka lo lapolosani nedung'u enkiok.

English: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
Masaai: Kake te neitobiru Olaitoriani entoki ng'ejuk, nebol enkop enkutuk enye, neijoo ninche tenebo imasaa enye pooki aapuo enemeneng'a aishu, niyiolouu taa nchere Olaitoriani etemenaitie kulo tung'ana.”

English: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye enkidimata enye naiteng'enishore, ninye te nebo o Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak lo losho le Dan.

English: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo pee iro oleng mbaa inono? Atudung'o nanu; ore iyie o Siba naa iorioro enkop.”

English: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
Masaai: Neaku eiteng'enisho apa ninye te nkaji nabo te nkolong e sabato.

English: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
Masaai: Amu iyie etii enkong'u e nkishui; te wang'an ino iyiook kidol ewang'an.

English: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
Masaai: Iyiolo ajo ore oltung'ani oikununo inji netapong'ori naa aing'okoni netudung'oko kewan enkiguana.

English: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
Masaai: Meishoo Olaitoriani engolon iltung'ana lenyena! Metamayiana Olaitoriani kulo tung'ana lenyena aisho eseriani!

English: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
Masaai: Ore isiaaitin inono pooki naa eikincho iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, ore isinyat pooki nikiisis iyie!

English: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
Masaai: Neitoki Musa o Aron o larikok lo lturrur aaiken ilayiok le Kohat, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
Masaai: Ore te ilo lemeiduruk nintodol ajo minduruk iyie; ore te ilo otolo nintodol entoloi ino.

English: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia eitu eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika; neton ake epej iltung'ana enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani Solomon o lturrurr pooki le Israel apa oiturrurre te dukuya ninye, netii dukuya ilo sanduku, nepolos nkerra kumok o lmong'i lemeikenayu.

English: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
Masaai: Ilo osinya nkaik neeta oltau owang, ilo lemedumaki oltau lenye entorroni, nemeinos olmumai le lejare.

English: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
Masaai: Nchoo enkomono ai elotu dukuya iyie; tokorduaki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Masaai: ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o sitiman imiet le kineji, o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Abidan olayioni le Gideon.

English: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata neitayunye iltung'ana le Amon olarrabal Israel.

English: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
Masaai: Amu te neitaaki iyiook nabo o ninye te nkeeya naaijo enenye, nesipa pae keyookini aaitaa iyiook nabo o ninye te mpiunoto naaijo enenye.

English: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
Masaai: Kake eiponyayie ilo oinyal olikae nejoki, ‘Ai ng'ae doi likinchoo iyie ntoria nirish iyiook?

English: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olorika lo lng'ur le sahabu nasila, intemat are o lpisiai enkadoro enye naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho enye.

English: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
Masaai: Te ishoi e ilo tung'ani eitaikia Enkai Siraeli, Olaitajeunoni, Yesu anaa apa enaisiligie.

English: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
Masaai: “Neaku airrabalakine nanu enkop te dukuya Olaitoriani te kuna olong'i artam e nkewarieitin artam, naatejo Olaitoriani keidaikie intae.

English: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
Masaai: Neosh lelo turrurri okuni intarumopetani nedany lelo tooi; neibung too nkaik enye e kedienye inkilang'ilang'eta; ore too nkaik enye e tatene neibung'ita intarumpetani pee eosh; nebuaku ninche aajo, “Olalem lo Laitoriani o Gideon!”

English: How hast thou counseled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
Masaai: Inkoo ilo lemeeta engeno nagut, nincho ninye te lengon engeno sapuk.

English: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
Masaai: Mayieu niking'or nanu to lmena enkaraki emua ai, amu aainosa enkolong. Ore ilayiok le yieyio naatagorokinote nanu, aaitaa ninche nanu olaramatani loo sabibu; kake ore osabibu lai makewan neitu aramat!

English: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Ore nanu, Olaitoriani, naa kaaku Enkai enye, ore osinka lai Daudi neaku olkitok tiatua ninche; nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
Masaai: Newal aajo, “Ore ilo tung'ani, eikilikuanishore iyiook te nkarriyiano aikilikuanu imbaa naaipirta iyiook olmarei lang ejoki iyiook, ‘Keton eishu papaai linyi? Iyatata likae alashe?’ Ore nena nikitiakita naa iwalat e nena kikilikuanat; ijo duoo aikinteiki aajo kejoki iyiook, ‘Eayau olalashe linyi ene?’ ”

English: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche Yoshua ejo, “Ore nena pooki nintanapa iyiook naa eikiaas, ore eneba anaa enirriwaa iyiook naa eikipuo.

English: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
Masaai: Eitu eibelekenya iltauja lang, neitu elam iroruat ang enkoitoi ino,

English: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
Masaai: Naa keya olapolosani oloti sarge lo lasar le ng'oki nepik ninye intaloishin e kutuk aji eina aji e Nkai, nepik sii inkedeta pokira ong'uan o lperere lo lasar, o ng'apeta e kishomi e ine wueji olgoriet liatua.

English: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu, “Tooko naa kaokoki sii intamesin inono,” inchoo metaa ninye enkitok nategeleka Olaitoriani olayioni lo olkitok lai.’

English: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
Masaai: ilemeishiakino enkop te netii nepuaya too lpurkel o too ldoinyo, o too ldoinyio, o too rrumati o too nkapuniaa e nkop.

English: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
Masaai: Nejoki Hushai Absalom, “A-a; amu ore ilo otegelua Olaitoriani o kulo tung'ana o lewa pooki le Israel, olenye aaku nanu, naa te nebo ninye nanu abik.

English: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
Masaai: Kake ore tiatua iloibonok le Yerusalem atoduaa nanu entoki suuji: eas ninche eloloito nepuo te lejare; eitagol ninche inkaik oo laasak loo ntorrok, metaa meetae hoo obo oibelekenya aing'uaa nkiaasin enyena torrok; etotiutuo ninche pooki anaa Sodom te nanu, neikununo anaa lelo oomanya Gomora.”

English: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Haman aponaa ajo, “Ore ninye Esta enkitok o laiguanani eitu eisho hoo ng'ae meeu te nebo olaiguanani ilo sirua oitobira ninye meteleku nanu ake. Naa ore sii taisere aaitoomono ninye te nebo olaiguanani.

English: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
Masaai: Amu mme intae ooiro, Enkiyang'et e Papa linyi nairo ti atua intae.

English: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
Masaai: Naa te neetae nena naaji nkaitin, te keper aashu te nkop, amu esipa eetae nkaitin kumok, o laitoriak kumok,

English: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo oomanya Yebus Daudi, “Milotu iye ine.” Ore ake eyia neibung Daudi ina ang nagol e Sion, aa taa, enkanasa e Daudi.

English: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
Masaai: “Tadamu taata Olaitoriani, aatasayia inchere ashomo nanu te dukuya iyie te nkisiligata pooki o to ltau pooki nataasa nanu ina sidai too nkonyek inono.” Neishir Hesekia oleng.

English: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
Masaai: kake enaisudoro ti atua oltau, nememuta o emborron o engira, neeta tipat oleng too nkonyek e Enkai.

English: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Neibung Agag ilo aiguanani loo Lamaleki eishu, nemut tukul iltung'ana pooki te nepi o lalem.

English: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
Masaai: Ore nabo kata pee eilepu ninye te nkare, nedol pee ebolo shumata nedou Enkiyang'et Sinyati eikununo anaa enturkulu adoiki ninye;

English: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
Masaai: Nchoo meitukurruni lelo lemeure Enkai, amu aaiteenikitia ninche elejare; ore nanu, naa nkitanapat inono ninche aibirribir.

English: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
Masaai: “Nikintoki aaibelekenya nikipuo ong'ata, enkalo Enaiposha Nanyokie, anaa apa enaatiaka Olaitoriani; ore too nkolong'i kumok nikipuo aamanaa te Seir.

English: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;
Masaai: Neitayu Ilyahudi enkitanapata neibung ninche maate o nkera enye o pooki ooibung'are ninche, nchere keibung kuna olong'i pokira are eitu eitadiak te risioroto e nena apa naaigeroki o te nkata naba anaa enageluni te pooki ari

English: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: Neyauni ilayiok le Aron, nepik Musa oloti sarge nkitipeti oo nkiyiaa enye e tatene, o lmogirrani loo nkaik enye e tatene olmogirrani lenye le tene; neitoki Musa aisuaki osarge olperere lo lasar aitaman.

English: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
Masaai: Ore hoo duoo nayiolo ajo iyiolo ajo maata entioto, nemeetae hoo obo oidim aitajeu too nkaik inono?

English: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Hushai, lo losho le Akito ilo shore le Daudi, enetii Absalom, nejoki Hushai Absalom, “Tobikoi olaiguanani! Tobikoi olaiguanani!”

English: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
Masaai: amaa apa enkibatisa e Yohana ai shumata eing'uaa, anaa ltung'ana?”

English: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
Masaai: Nemeeta kata ake nemelaaki Pilato ninche oltung'ani obo te ilo sirua.

English: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gibar, naa ntomoni naaudo o imiet.

English: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
Masaai: “Ore pooki ong'amu enkerai anaa ena te nkarna ai, nanu eng'amu; ore olaang'amu, neme nanu ake eng'amu kake ilo laairriwua.”

English: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu ninche ening ilarishak lenye, amu eiborrie onyek esujaa kulie aitin neirrugokino ninche; eibelekenyate apa nabo kata aapong ina oitoi naa ninye apa eima loo menye, lelo apa oibung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani, neitu ninche eas ina.

English: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
Masaai: Neaku irorie ninche, nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore pooki tung'ani le nkaji e Israel opik inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena nemeishu oltau, nepik entoki narror oo ntorrok dukuya enkomom enye, neitoki ake alotu enetii ilo oiboni le Nkai, kawaliki nanu ninye makewan ara Olaitoriani, te nkaraki olorora loo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena nemeishu,

English: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
Masaai: Eishiraka sii apa Yeremia Yosia, ore ilewa pooki o nkituaak pooki aranyak neranyu aalimu Yosia o metabaiki ena olong. Neitobir ninche enkitanapata te Israel, ng'ura eigero te mbuku oo nkishirat.

English: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
Masaai: Amu ore lkumok lenye te neeta loiriruani torrok, nepuku aaing'uaa eishir to ltoilo sapuk: ore lkumok ooilenyate o lmaiman, neishiunyeki.

English: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Solomon aajoki eshomo Shimei te Yerusalem nelo Gaat neitoki arrinyunye,

English: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
Masaai: naa kepuo ninche aaliki kulo oomanya ena kop. Etoning'o apa ninche nchere, ore iyie Olaitoriani itii atua ele orere; amu ore iyie Olaitoriani nitoduare ninche too nkonyek, neitashe enkatampoi ino te shumata ninche nilo iyie te dukuya ninche, te ng'ape e nkatampoi dama o te ng'ape e nkima kewarie.

English: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “Inchoo enkop meyau ing'uesi naaishu te risioroto oo mpukunot enye; inkishu o ng'uesi naaiserpepiari te nkop o ng'uesi e nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye.” Neaku neija.

English: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
Masaai: ajoki, “Kitutukunyakita apa intae nikintanap intae pee mintokiki ake aiteng'enisho te na arna: naa ng'ura! noolo intae ooibulunye Yerusalem pooki ena kiteng'enare inyi, ijojo pee iyauwu osarge le le tung'ani shumata iyiook.”

English: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
Masaai: Neing'uaa enkeeya oo lbolot nabo kata, nesika.

English: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
Masaai: ore ilo openy enkaji nelotu ajoki olapolosani, ‘Etii enkeeya nemayiolo atua enkaji ai.’

English: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
Masaai: Ntagolo iyie enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye; ntishipa iyie ilmang'ati lenyena pooki.

English: Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:
Masaai: Nejoki isinkan lo laiguanani ooisiaita ninye, “Nchoo meing'orakini olaiguanani ntoyie sidain.

English: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
Masaai: Tikikos olotu aliki intae mbaa aainei; olalashe lai lanyor naa olaisiaayiani oisiligayu naa osinka le ncholiek ai ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enteipa neipung te ina anasa.

English: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.
Masaai: Neyau olayierani emuro o enkiring'o naibung'are neirragie ninche te dukuya Saul; nejo Samuel, “Toduaa ajo ore ina duoo natushumaki neirragieki te dukuya iyie. Inosa amu iyie duoo etushumakaki o metabau esaa natudung'uoki, pee itum ainosa te nebo ilomon.”

English: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
Masaai: O pooki ng'ues e nkop, o pooki motonyi o loing'ang'e, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, o pooki toki naata enkiyang'et e nkishui aaishoo enkaitubului pooki nanyori peyie intaa endaa.” Neaku neija.

English: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
Masaai: o Yeus, o Sakia, o Mimra. Kulo apa ilayiok lenyena, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
Masaai: Eing'oru ninye enkurma neinyang'u; ore too lng'anayio loo nkaik enyena neun enkurma oo sabibu.

English: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
Masaai: Neaku eitobirua Musa olasurai lo suyai nepik shumata e ng'ape; naa te nelo neony olasurai likae tung'ani, neing'or ninye ilo asurai lo suyai nepok.

English: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
Masaai: Etoiuo sii Shaaf menye le Madmana, o Shefa menye le Makbena o menye le Gibea; ore apa entito e Kaleb naa keji Aksa.

English: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nkajijik enye neibelekenyakini ilkulikae, inkurman enye o nkituaak enye tenebo; amu kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aarare lelo omanya ena kop.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
Masaai: Kake emipolos ake entoki naata entioto, amu meng'amaroyu ina tialo intae.

English: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
Masaai: Kake keisiaai ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye o Daudi olaiguanani lenye laa ninye nanu aput tenkaraki ninche.

English: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
Masaai: “Kerishata nabaa, intae iloo moda inyorraa aaku ilmoda? Kerishata nabaaa enyor iloo lderrat torrok aimaki ilderrat torrok. Neiba ilmoda eng'eno?

English: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa kulo aiguanak pooki neitutum njorin enye, nepuonu aaitayu ilng'oborri te nebo too nkariak e Merom, pee earare Israel.

English: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

Masaai: Enchololoto naa amu miyiololo aajo kanu elotu olopeny enkaji, anaa ae te nteipa, anaa ae te nasirie

English: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
Masaai: Nejoki Yakobo Farao, “Ore inkolong'i oo larin laainei lenkidurrudur ai naa ilarin iip o tomoni uni; kuti naa torrok inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui ai, neitu ebaiki inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui oo loo papa too nkolong'i enkidurrudur enye.”

English: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
Masaai: Neme iyiook oopuo aagiroo nena kiririkinot kiwuasare enaa kulikae ootaasa kake kisilig nchere ore nkiririkinot ang naa pee eponari enkirukoto inyi, neponari murruna ang ti atua intae.

English: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou esiamo kitok oo Lyahudi aajo etii ninye ine nepuonu kake mme te nkaraki Yesu ake, kake eetuo sii aadol Lasaro, oitopiwuo aitung'uaa keeya.

English: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiro aomon aashu elimu olkilikuai le Nkai eitoipito endukuya enye naa Kristo elaiki enkanyit, laa ninye elukunya enye.

English: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
Masaai: Meaku olkirutoto te nanu; ira iyie esarunoto ai te nkolong entorroni.

English: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ilo apa oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, pee mintokiki aaku irrindiki lenye, natigila nanu isekenke e rrindikisho enye, naisho intae enchom ntorioriri.

English: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa o lelo apolosak le Lawi Israel pooki, “Entigirata entoning, intae Israel: ore ena Olong itaa intae olorere lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
Masaai: Amu etoning'oki oltoilo lo lkiyioi te Sion. ‘Eneikunakaki iyiook enkidaata! Eitukurruaki iyiook oleng, enkaraki nikitung'uaitie iyiook ina kop, enkaraki naturoitie ninche imanyishoritin ang.’ ”

English: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
Masaai: Embolunoto e Yesu Kristo, naishoo Enkai ninye meitaduaa isinkan lenyena, imbaa nemeeta nchere meaku aasioki; neisho metayiolouni te nkirriwakinoto nairriwaka olmalaika osinka lenye Yohana,

English: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo ilo otii shumata osinya, enye Sinyati: “Aamanya nanu ewueji e shumata sinyati te nebo ilo oata oltau supat obor, pee etum aitopiu enkiyang'et e ilo obor, neitopiu oltau le ilo supat nebor.

English: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
Masaai: Kaji eiko oltung'ani obo tenemir enkalifu, naa kaji eiko oare tenedumu nkalifuni tomon mekueta, teneme Endapidapoi enye natimira ninche, netapalayie ninche Olaitoriani?

English: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
Masaai: Nejoki entito e Farao ninye, “Iwa ina kerai, pee kintubulaki nanu, naa kaaisho nanu olekoisiaayio lino.” Neya ina kitok enkerai aitubulu.

English: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
Masaai: Neaku ainyang'ua nanu ninye te shekeli tomon o imiet e nkosholai o ntemet nabo e shairi olpisiai lo ntemet e shairi.

English: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
Masaai: Ore pee edoiki enkop natoyio nenang'are oltung'ani obo le ina anasa oota iloiriruani; oshomo nkolong'i kumok meishopo, nemejing ang, too nkuraren eton.

English: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Inap iyie enkitamioto eloloito ino, tenebo olminong lino, ejo Olaitoriani.

English: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam adumunye nelo ewueji enye; nelo sii Balak te nkoitoi enye.

English: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
Masaai: Kake ore pee adol nanu ajo meiriamari olkuaak lenye o esipata e kulo Omon Supati, najoki Kefa te dukuya ninche pooki, “Ira iyie Olyahudi inoti, naa nele iyie olotie olkuaak loo Loreren, nimitiu anaa Olyahudi. Oo naa pee ijo aaraki Loreren metotiutu anaa Lyahudi?”

English: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
Masaai: Nashal nanu ena olong, hoo naatubukokoki eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani; ore kulo tung'ana, ayiok le Seruiya naa kegolong'u oleng te nanu. Nchoo elaaki Olaitoriani olarruoni te risioroto enkarruoisho enye!”

English: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kelakuaniki iyiook esipata, nemeinepu ae kata iyiook esupatisho; king'oru iyiook ewang'an, naa ng'ura, enaimin kitum, king'oru ewang'an kake te misimisi kipuo.

English: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
Masaai: Esipa nchere keetae apa nkolia kumok ti atua Siraeli te nkata o loiboni Eliya, pee elai enchan too larin okuni o lapaitin ile, neibulu olameyu ina kop pooki;

English: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;
Masaai: Nejoki Natan Daudi, “Iyie ilo tung'ani. Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ‘Aatubukoko iyie eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani te shumata Israel naatokordua iyie aitayu te nkaina e Saul;

English: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
Masaai: ore osina o emion neiture ninye; nebaiki ninye anaa olaiguanani otanape pee elo olarrabal.

English: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
Masaai: Kiliki sii iyie nchere meishiaakino pee eitalaki olapolosani kodi e arakinoto, anaa mpisai o lpolosie, anaa mpisai e nkoitoi, nemeitalaki Ilawi o laranyak, o laitasheikinok loo nkutukie oo nkajijik, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, anaa kulikae aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
Masaai: naa kaisho ninche enkishui nemeish, nemeimin ninche ntarasi, nemetii olaaidim aikonyarie ninche aitung'uaa enkaina ai.

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Musa Olaitoriani, “Olaitoriani lai, mara nanu oltung'ani arriyia te nkiguana, arashu ebaiki ena kata pee irorie osinka lino; kake kaimalees te nkiroroto na kaasha sii olng'ejep.”

English: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
Masaai: Nerresh isinkan le Amon ninye, near ilo aiguanani metua te nkaji enye.

English: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
Masaai: Nedumunye ilooiteng'eni lenyena nepuo ina anasa, neinepu etiu anaa enatiaakaki neitobiraki Pasaka.

English: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
Masaai: Naa kemany iltung'ana ninye amu meitokini aata oldeket, keton Yerusalem te seriani.

English: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
Masaai: Netii apa ilkuti tung'ana lemesinya ooiseyie osesen lo ltung'ani otua, neaku meidim ninche aaibung'a sabato teina olong; nepuonu ninche dukuya Musa o Aron teina olong.

English: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, nebuak ninye to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Lasaro tupuku boo.”

English: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
Masaai: nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, ira iyie moruo, ore layiok linono nemepuo too nkoitoi inono; ore naa taata tegelaki iyiook olaiguanani pee eitore iyiook anaa nkuapi pooki.”

English: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
Masaai: Ore osororua lino netiu anaa olcharaa, ilo lemelau aekata enaisho oo sabibu naitushula, ore enkoshoke ino netiu anaa osototi le nkano omanita intapuka.

English: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
Masaai: Nainyal nanu isabibu lenyena o lkeek loo lng'anayio, laa ninche ejo ninye, ‘Elaakinoto ai kulo, laa ninche aaishoo isanchan laainei.’ Kaitaa nanu ninche entim, naa keinos ninche ing'uesi e ntim.

English: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore Solomon, oina umata pooki natii tenebo ninye, nepuo ine wueji e shumata natii Gibeon; amu ine apa etii olng'obor le Nkai oitobira Musa osinka lo Laitoriani.

English: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
Masaai: Metaa atoduaa ajo metii toki naikash alang teneshipakino oltung'ani esiaai enye, amu ina doi esiaai enye; aing'ae oidim ayau ninye metoduaa imbaa naasuju ninye eidipa atua?

English: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Teyietu nchira, ‘Woi ina olong!’

English: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Entudung ilkeek lenyena; nimuatimuata aaman Yerusalem. Enkanasa ena nemeeta nchere pee meitamei; metii ae toki neme enkibookinoto enkop atua ninye.

English: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
Masaai: Kake shomo enkoitoi ino o metabau enkiting'oto; amu ilo ayeng'iyeng'a, nilo aitashe te wueji ino negeluno te nkiting'oto e nena olong'i.”

English: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
Masaai: Tenebo enkaji pooki e menye, o Yosef, o lalashera lenyena, o lmarei pooki le papaai lenye, nkera enye ake etung'uayioki o ntare, o nkishu te nkop e Goshen.

English: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
Masaai: Kuna ninche imanyishoritin enye terisioroto oo wuejitin neetamanya ninche too lpolosien lenye. Ore too layiok le Aron loo lmareita le Kohat, naa ena erubata enye.

English: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
Masaai: entoning, ilarripok linyi eilepie iltoiloishi lenye, eranyisho ninche te nebo te ng'ida; amu etoduaa ninche too nkonyek ina rrinyunoto o Laitoriani elotu Sion.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Amaa naaji tenaa ketonotaka menye miriam enkomom enye, aimekurru ninye nkolong'i naapishana? Nchoo ninye eikenori ti auluo ilng'oborri nkolong'i naapishana, ore te siadi ina neidimi aanyaaki aaitijing'u.”

English: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
Masaai: ilo apa otoosho iltung'ana te ngoro te nena oshot nemeish, ilo apa oitoria iloshon te ngoro o to losilisili metii olng'ur.

English: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
Masaai: nedol ilayiok le Nkai intoyie oo ltung'ana ajo aisidain, neyaki ate inkituaak anaa enagelu tenena, anaa enayieu.

English: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye nchere kinyor nkera e Nkai te nikinyor Enkai nikimbung nkitanapat enyena.

English: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
Masaai: te lelo ooibung olning'o lenye nedamu aaibung nkitanapat enyena.

English: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
Masaai: Nabatata too nkejek enyena aserem ninye, kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Mintoki aiko neijia! Amu kara ake osinka oasisho te nebo iyie o lalashera linono ooibung'ita enchakenisho e Yesu. Teserema Enkai!” Amu ore enchakenisho e Yesu ninye enkiyang'et e naibon.

English: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:
Masaai: Neeta apa olayioni le Saul iltung'ana oare laa ilkituaak loo Ltimito le njore; ore enkarna e obo naa Baana, ore enkarna o likae naa Rekab, ilayiok le Rimon oltung'ani le Benchamen oing'uaa Be-erot (amu keyioloi sii apa ninye Be-erot aajo ematua e Benchamen;

English: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
Masaai: Emikintoki naa aadung'okino enkiguana ae kata olikae o likae, kake ematumut aajo mikipikaki aekata iyiook likae alashe entoki narror anaa ae bae narruesh ninye.

English: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
Masaai: “Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura kagilunore nena tasimi inyi nirreshieshie iltauja, naa kapolosu aiwuang'ie too nkaik inyi; naa kaisho lelo tauja litarresho epuo etalaayioki anaa imotonyi.

English: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
Masaai: Pee ebaya osirata ojo, “Eiruko Abraham Enkai, ore te nkaraki enkirukoto neikenaki Enkai ninye esupatisho,” neipoti aajo olchore le Enkai.

English: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiteru aitoreisho, ore ake enatonie to lorika lenye le nkitoo, near enkaji e Baasha pooki metuata. Eitu ninye eing'uaa olee obo lo lmarei lenye anaa ilchoreta lenyena.

English: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Masaai: O nkitotoneta enye tikitam e nkosholai, nkitotoneta are ti abori erubata nabo o nkitotoneta are ti abori enkae rubata.

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.
Masaai: naa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida apa otii shumata lelo Kereti o lelo le Peleti ore ilayiok le Daudi naa ilapolosak.

English: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
Masaai: Ore olomor Enkerai e Tung'ani, kepalakini, kake ore pooki ng'ae omor Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nemepalakini tele porror o to lolporor olotu.

English: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
Masaai: Kake ti nikiji ira Olyahudi naa Nkitanapat ingarakino niwuasare osotua lino o Enkai,

English: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
Masaai: iyie apa oibung'a te papaai Daudi ina nimbalunye te ninye; ee iroro iyie te nkutuk ino, te nkarna ino nintabaya ina ena olong.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Entoosh inkaik inyi, nioshieshie nkejek inyi enkop nijojo, Aha! ore enkaraki ina bae olminong le nkaji e Israel; amu kebatata ninche to lalem, o lameyu, o lmeitai.

English: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.
Masaai: Neaku etejo Saul, “Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, kainyoo pee eitu iwaliki osinka lino ena olong? Tenaa atua nanu etii ena torroni arashu atua Yonatan, olayioni lai, Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, nchoru Urim; kake tenaa atua iltung'ana linono Israel etii ena torroni, nchoru Tummin.” Neyae Yonatan o Saul, nepok iltung'ana.

English: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
Masaai: Metaa, ng'ura, edede kaadumu nanu iyie aing'atie enkop naanang'aa aitung'uaa enaatii nanu, iyie o ina anasa apa naaishoo nanu iyie o loo papaai lino.

English: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
Masaai: Kake eitu ejo ninye nena te ngolon enye makewan; kake te nkaraki nara ninye Olapolosani Kitok te ilo ari nelimu ajo kenang Yesu ilo orere,

English: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
Masaai: Ore enjung'ore nanotoki aasioki te nkiterunoto, neaku te siadi ene memayiana.

English: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: te ina olong o Laitoriani Yesu, niyookiki ina kata aadol aajo iatata esipata niwuasarere te iyiook anaa enikiaata iyiook te intae.

English: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
Masaai: Nirragie ninche aitatash maare, neaku ile etatashaki te nchumata eina misa e sahabu nasila.

English: For the LORD'S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
Masaai: Amu ore erubata o Laitoriani naa iltung'ana lenyena Yakobo ninye erubata enye najung.

English: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
Masaai: nchoo iyie iltung'ana meitunyoi ilukuny ang; kishomo iyiook aaim atua enkima o atua enkare; kake iyaua ake iyie iyiook enkop nalala.

English: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
Masaai: Nejo maing'ura, nedol aajo eidipaki aaibeleleng'oi osoit aaiwuang'ie amu ae sapuk apa oleng.

English: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
Masaai: Entoning, olkiyioi loo lairritak, o eyiolounoto oo laitoriak lo lturrur! Amu einyalita Olaitoriani eneirritishoreki enye,

English: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
Masaai: Ore osinka oasisho te ng'eno netum omom to laiguanani, kake ore engoro enye nedoiki ilo oas inenkurruna.

English: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
Masaai: “Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te nkisisa, amu etaasa ninye ine nkitoo; nchoo eyiolouni kuna ti atua enkop pooki.

English: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
Masaai: Ore ororei otolimuoki aaitobiru netiu anaa olng'anayioi le sahabu oikodokino enkosholai.

English: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
Masaai: Entagoroto kake emiaas ng'ok; emincho edoyio enkolong itagorote.

English: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
Masaai: Kaji nanu aiko openy te nanap enkiroishi o lola linyi, o loo larrabali linyi?’

English: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
Masaai: Ore too ile Merari naa olmarei loo le Mahili o lmarei loo le Mushi: kulo ninche ilmareita le Merari.

English: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
Masaai: Tudumunye Olaitoriani! Mincho oltung'ani meisula; nchoo iloreren eiguanareki te dukuya iyie!

English: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore olikae kuoo shomo topolosa teipa, anaa ilo asar le ntapa le tadekenya, o anaa ilo asar ooki, shomo nchooi anaa olasar le nkima, esong'ouna nerropil te nkaraki Olaitoriani.

English: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
Masaai: Amu aata apa esumash nikinchosho endaa; naata enkure nikinchosho enaok; nara omoni nikirikiriki ang;

English: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ira naa iyie ng'ae onyaanyuke te nkisisa o te nkitoo tiatua lelo kejek le Eden? Aikintadoiyiori iyie tenebo lelo keek le Eden aaya olodo le nkop; nirrag iyie tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem. “Ore ele naa Farao tenebo olorora lenye pooki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
Masaai: “Nintanap iltung'ana loo Siraeli pee kiyaki ninche eilata naironyuno nasila oo loirienito te nkaraki ewang'an, pee eiki oltaa meiyupuyupo enkata pooki.

English: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
Masaai: Keori ina jung'ore enye te risioroto e nkukuo to losho sapuk o to loti.”

English: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:
Masaai: “Teneara ilewa maate, nelotu enkitok e obo amitu olmoruo teilo oarita ninye, neitorioo enkaina enye aibung elewaisho,

English: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
Masaai: Tuuno tadekenya ilanterera linono, ore teipa niun ake aitoki; amu miyiolo ajo kakua oobulu, kulo ashu kuldo, arashu eidim pokira aatisidana.

English: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye Yerusalem to lapa le imiet, aa olari liopishana le nkitoria eilo aiguanani;

English: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
Masaai: Mintoki aing'or ninye, tapala ninye inchoo ninye eshipakino enkishui enye nagol, tenaa keidim.

English: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
Masaai: Te neitu nanu alimu eng'oki ai aibalunye, neibiitiari osesen lai te nkaraki enkishirata ai e mion endama pooki.

English: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
Masaai: A'a, eng'eno e Nkai naisudoro kilimu, eng'eno naisudoro apake, naa Enkai naiguanua eton eitu eiteruni aata enkata naa te nkaraki enkitoo ang.

English: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
Masaai: Nenya Daudi ele mumai te nkaraki Saul. Nelo Saul ang; kake eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena atua olnukata.

English: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ina umata, “Ewuang'a, atoomono intae enchom, entung'uai ilng'oborri le kulo tung'ana arruok, nimimbung'ubung'u hoo ae toki enye pooki pee memuti ake intae tenebo nena ng'ok enye pooki.”

English: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
Masaai: Neiteru aiteng'en ajoki meeta nchere pee meisilisili Enkerai e Tung'ani too mbaa kumok neanyi ilpayiani o lapolosak kituaak o lasirak, neari metua, ore pee elusoo nkolong'i uni neitoki apiu.

English: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
Masaai: Amu itaa iyie osempewuet le ilo aisinani, aitaa osempewuet le ilo onyamal te nyamali enye; olchurie to lkutati naa oloip te nkirowuaj, amu ore eoshoto e ilo lemeeta olng'ur neikununo anaa olkutati oipony esuntai

English: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki naishu nalo keaku endaa te intae anaa enaishoo intae endiati nanyori, aaishoo intae pooki toki.

English: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
Masaai: Naibelekenya ajo pee adol ilo toilo laairorie, ore ake pee aibelekenya nadol ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le sahabu,

English: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Etii apa atua oltau le Daudi papaai lai pee eshet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli.

English: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
Masaai: “Meeta inchere irara iltung'ana, naa keish eng'eno nagut te intae tiniyeye.

English: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
Masaai: Ore ilo olakua oleng naa keye to lmeitai; ore ilo otaana nebatatakino olalem; ore ilo otelekua neitajeuoki naa keye to lameyu. Neaku neijia aikunaki engoro ai napi ninche.

English: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
Masaai: Naomon nanu najo, “Toning'o na Ai ang, amu etemenaki iyiook; mbelekenya iyie esurdaanyata enye meeu shumata ilukuny enye maate, naa nchoo ninche meitoroki teina kop enye e yararoto.

English: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilkerubi aare ooidong'uno te sahabu, neitayu ninche too matuan pokira are e ilo orika lo lng'ur,

English: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
Masaai: Neidang ninche amu eeta apa osiligi sapuk. Epuonu ninche ine neidang.

English: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
Masaai: Iyie oyaua isabibu aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; iyie otarayie iloshon niun ilo sabibu.

English: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
Masaai: Ore tioriong e ilo ng'obor le Nkai te nkalo o loontoluo neitobir irubat ile.

English: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?
Masaai: Neshurtu sii ninye nkilani enyena, neibonisho sii ninye te dukuya Samuel, neirrag meeta enkila ina olong pooki o ina kewarie pooki. Neaku etejoki, “Ketii sii ninye Saul atua iloibonok le Nkai?”

English: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Etisiraki sii aajo, ‘Mitem iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.’ ”

English: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo kituaak leina aiposha tenedou aaing'uaa ilorikan lenye le nkitoo, neitayu ilkilani lenye, nekinyaa nena kilani enye naaikodo; naa keishopoki ate enkuretisho; Eketoni ninche te nkop neikirikira anaa adake, neureyu intae oleng.

English: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
Masaai: Meishaakino tinijing' enkoriong oltung'ani arruoni, arashu imitiki oltung'ani supat esipata.

English: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
Masaai: ootapong'o enkoitoi nasipa, eji ejo eidipa empiunoto oo lootuata atulusoi, neibelekeny enkirukoto e kulikae.

English: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
