Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani olmalaika otara metuata lelo morran pooki magil, o larikok le njore o lkituaak loo lng'oborri lo laiguanani le Asiria. Neaku etorrinye ninye te nkurruna e nkomom enye alo enkop enye makewan. Ore pee elotu atua enkaji e nkai enye, near kulikae ayiok lenyena ninye metua.

English: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
Masaai: Metaa eminyamalaki ine taaisere amu enyamalaki taaisere kewan. Eidip enkolong intorrok enyena.

English: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
Masaai: “Ai sidai emunyan; kake amaa te netuyiatuyu emunyan kerrinyokinoyu enkisukut enye?

English: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, tininkok ilo tung'ani supat peyie meas eng'oki, neitu eas eng'oki, nemeeta nchere meton eishu, amu etang'amayie ninye enkikoo; nintajeu iyie enkishui ino.”

English: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
Masaai: Neibung iltung'ana le Yuda kulikae nkalifuni tomon eishu, neya ninche enchumata endapidapoi nesulaa ninche teine; nepurda pooki aaku mpurdat.

English: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
Masaai: nepejoo olapolosani ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar anaa nkishorot naapejokini te nkima Olaitoriani; olasar le nkitarruorroto ninye.

English: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
Masaai: Nchoo metujuti nkarn enye aaiwuang'ie ti atua embuku oo looishu; nchoo metaa meigeri ninche te nebo lelo supati.

English: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki neing'oling'ola ti atua iloshon pooki loo Siraeli ejo, “Etokordua iyiook olaiguanani aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lang, neitajeuo iyiook aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; ore taata neisika alo te nkop aing'uaa Absalom.

English: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki ninye, “Ena kop apa ina nainosie olmumai o Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, nchere, ‘Kalo nanu aisho eishoi enye!’ Aaishoo nanu iyie toduaa too nkonyek inono, kake milo iyie ine.”

English: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki liking'or iyie, nikilam ejo, “Etumute Ninawi; kaing'ae naishiraki ninye? Kaji nanu atumie iltung'ana ooitagol ninye?”

English: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
Masaai: Nedumunye Manoa nelo asuj enkitok enye, nelotu enetii ilo tung'ani nejoki ninye, “Kaiyie apa ilo tung'ani oirorie ena kitok?” Nejoki ninye, “Nanu ilo.”

English: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
Masaai: Nelotu Obed-edom enkalo e kopikop ore ilayiok lenyena neishori enkaji nashumishoreki.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aisho nanu olkiyioi lo larrabal metoning'oyu te nkaraki Raba oo Lamoni; naa keaku olmuaate mijooni, ore nkang'itie enyena nepejori te nkima; netum taa Israel aawa lelo apa oowaita ninye, Olaitorianiojo.

English: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
Masaai: Enting'idata nishipapa oleng; amu kitok olerrinyore linyi te shumata; amu eisilisilo ninche aaiko neijia iloibonok le Nkai ootii apa te dukuya intae.

English: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
Masaai: Naa ore pee elakuni intae too ng'ok niakuku rrindiki le supatisho.

English: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
Masaai: Ore taata neishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi enkiyeng'iyeng too lalashera linyi, anaa apa enaitanapa ninche; ore naa embelekenyata enchom nkang'itie inyi ti atua ina kop inyi, apa naa ninye eishoo intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te lido kekun le Yordan.

English: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
Masaai: Tenesulaki enkop, nemeetae oloidim atesheta; teneikenoo oltung'ani tiatua, meetae oloidim atabolo.

English: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ilo turrur “Embae ena naitanapishe Olaitoriani metaasi.”

English: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
Masaai: Ore apa pee ejing Elisha emuoyian naa ninye naawa, nelo Yoash olaiguanani le Israel enetii ninye neishir ninye te dukuya Elisha ejo, “Papaai lai, papaai lai! Ngarrin oo mbartan e Israel o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan!”

English: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
Masaai: Nipik atua ilo sanduku le nchakenisho, nidung'oo ilo sanduku to lkarasha loliaatua.

English: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
Masaai: Amu etii apa enkitanapata naing'uaa olaiguanani naipirta ninche, o enkitobirata oo laranyak anaa enaiyieuni te pooki olong.

English: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
Masaai: Neikilikuan sii ninche sikarini aajoki, “Oo iyiook, kaa kiaas?” Nejoki ninche, “Emisim oltung'ani anaa nteenikiki elejare, ninchosho sii ebaiki intae olekoisiayio linyi.”

English: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
Masaai: Nenyiku osirua loo Mukateni neitu oji Pasaka.

English: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
Masaai: Nintoki adung'udung ilo meregesh, metaa nkutiti kiri, nintuku enkoshoke enye o loilelek nipik ninche te nebo irubat enyena o endukuya enye,

English: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
Masaai: A-a, kake too ltung'ana ooiro nkutukie nemeyioloi, neiro too lng'ejepa loo loreren, kelo Olaitoriani airorie iltung'ana lenyena,

English: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku nena bartan naagol, neenyiyenyu eyieu nepuo aarrip enkop. Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Enchom, entorrip enkop.” Metaa eshomo aarip enkop.

English: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
Masaai: Itoponayie iyie eishoi enye aitaba anaa ilakir le keper, nitorikuo ninche atua ina kop apa nitolikio loo menye pee ejing aamany.

English: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
Masaai: Lo moda modook; kaa nalusoo, ai sahabu ana kenkaji e Nkai naitisiny ina sahabu?

English: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:
Masaai: Neijia etiu inkoitoi e lelo pooki oorikino Enkai amu ore osiligi le lelo tung'ana lemeeta Enkai naa keidak.

English: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa keaku enterit napuyiapui te nkop pooki e Misiri, neaku iltuduta ooiwotiota aaku mpaldakani te tung'ani o te ng'ues te nkop pooki e Misiri.”

English: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Masaai: O enkimeita naitobiruno te nkarriyiano te nena tokitin, pee eenieki; te sahabu o too usin pusi o sinteti o naanyokie, o naaibor sidain.

English: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, mincho olkitok lai olaiguanani epik oltau adamu ajo etuata ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani; amu Amnon ake otua.”

English: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
Masaai: Ebaiki olpurkel o ena Lebanon o metabaiki olkeju kitok, ilo keju le Frati, enkop pooki oo Lhiti o metabaiki enaiposha kitok te nkalo e ndoyioroto e nkolong, naa keaku enkop inyi.

English: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
Masaai: Nerany osinkolio le Musa ilo sinka le Enkai o sinkolio lo Lkuoo le ker, ejo, “Eikituaak naa ine nking'asia nkiaasin inono, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai Magilani, keitoriori nesipa inkoitoi inono, Olaiguanani loo lporori.

English: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ojo agolie enkishui enye neiminie, kake ore pooki oiturraa enkishui enye neitopoki.

English: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
Masaai: Tiatua indamunot naaing'uaa induaat enkewarie, ina kata etijing'a injo naairoishi iltung'ana.

English: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
Masaai: Midek ake olaiguanani, too ndamunot inono, nimidek to lgilata lirrag ilo karsis, amu ore imotonyi oloing'ang'e neya oltoilo lino, arashu eboloo kulie nyaun oo naipuko ina bae.

English: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
Masaai: Kake etanya Amasia ening, amu enkitobirata e Nkai apa ina, pee etum atipika ninye atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, enkaraki nateserema ninche nkaitin e Edom.

English: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
Masaai: nemeitayu mpisai enyena te nkaraki dupoto, nemeng'amaa ninye entoki e ropare pee einyal esipata. Ore ilo oas kuna baa nemeigusugusieki ae kata.

English: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
Masaai: amu eidipaki apa aaitobira ewueji neyupuyup; ee te nkaraki ilo aiguanani, eitobiraki endapasho o enguton, netii ilkeek kumok o enkima kitok. Naa enkiyang'et o Laitoriani naikununo anaa enkima nakutu isoito.

English: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani aigil alotu enatii ejo:

English: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
Masaai: Kake aikok intai aliki olonare niurere; entureita ilo laa ore eidipa atara metua, neitoki aata engolon nanang'akinye Yehanum; ee ajoki ntae, ilo enturiata!

English: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir Ilawi aaram: Reham olayioni le Bani; ore te siadi ninye naa Shashabia, ilo aitoriani lo lpisiaai lo lkerenket le Keila, neram aitobir olkerenket lenye.

English: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lmatofali apa naitayu enchoo eaku lelo ake, emintong'oriki ninche, amu aiturua ninche; neaku keishir, ‘Nchoo iyiook maape aaitaiki Enkai ang olasar.’

English: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Masaai: Tishipakinoyu Olaitoriani, naa aikincho ninye iyieunot o ltau lino.

English: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
Masaai: Intokitin are ake inchooki nanu, nemaitoki aisudoo kewan te nkomom ino:

English: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
Masaai: Neng'amaa ajoki, ‘Malo’ ore te siadi neirridu nelo.

English: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
Masaai: Kake etii apa oltalet ogol atua ina anasa, ore iltung'ana pooki le nkanasa neisik aapuo ine, ilewa pooki o nkituaak, neikenoo ate ti atua ine; nepuo ninche enchumata o ltalet.

English: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
Masaai: Enteshetu nkanas te nkaraki nkera inyi kutiti, o muatat te nkaraki nkerrai inyi; niasiasa ina nisiligishore.”

English: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
Masaai: Tanapayu tadekenya, nilepu tadekenya alotu oldoinyo le Sinai, niyau kewan enatii te ine te nchumata o ldoinyo.

English: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
Masaai: Neing'asia Pilato pee eji eidipa Yesu atua, ore pee eipotu osajini, neikilikuan te naa keidipa atua.

English: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
Masaai: Naa keitashe ninche anaake tadekenya aaisho enashe neisis Olaitoriani, naa neijia sii etiu teipa.

English: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Entaa ilemeeta entioto te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
Masaai: Naawaliki nanu olmalaika ajoki, “Ore kuna naa inaapuo ilkutat oong'uan le nkijape e keper, eidipa aaitayu ate te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

English: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Kayau sii ashuku ene wueji Yekonia olayioni le Yehoiakim, olaiguanani le Yuda, o lelo yararot pooki ooing'uaa Yuda apa ooshomo Babilon, Olaitoriani ojo, amu kagil nanu enchata e murt o laiguanani le Babilon.”

English: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
Masaai: Kake eisiligayu Olaitoriani naa keitagol ninye intae nerrip intae te ntorroni.

English: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
Masaai: endapidapoi ai naa osempewuet lai, enkisudoroto ai naa olakordunoni lai, elong'o ai naa ninye ilo lasaru nanu, laa ninye opik iloreren abori ninye.

English: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
Masaai: Neilepaki ninye oldoinyo, neipotu lelo ooyieu ninye openy nepuonu enetii ninye.

English: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
Masaai: Neipung alo nesujaa sii ninye: neton meyiolo ajo kesipa ina naasita olmalaika, kejo kenduaata ake.

English: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.
Masaai: Kake eipoto Eli Samuel nejoki, “Samuel, enkayioni ai.” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
Masaai: Ore tiatua, ine nemanita lelo gorieti pokira oong'uan, netii isoito oo gueta netii ewueji neinokieki enkima namanita.

English: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
Masaai: Ole ishoi e Peres apa ninye, naa ninye olkitok too larikok pooki le njore to lapa le dukuya.

English: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
Masaai: Emayiana oltung'ani oitaa Olaitoriani osiligi lenye, ilo tung'ani lemeibelekenyakino lelo oowuasa, alo enetii lelo oopong'ori esujaa nkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot!

English: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aipotu olkitok oji Yehoida, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee eitu nkilikuanu too Lawi, meyauni te Yuda o te Yerusalem kodi apa natejo Musa, osinka lo Laitoriani, te umata oo Siraeli tenkaraki olng'obor le nchakenisho?”

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli metushukoto siadi aapik ilng'oborri dukuya e Pi-ha-hirot, erishata e Migdol o enaiposha, dukuya e Baal-sefon; enteshet ilng'oborri empirakinye embata e naiposha.

English: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
Masaai: Nedol olaiguanani aa sidai ina kitobirata, nedol sii ina umata aajo aisidai.

English: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
Masaai: paa ore too mbaa pooki nejukaa enkiteng'enare e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang.

English: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
Masaai: Nejo ina nchere mme nena kera o sesen naara nne Nkai, kake nkera e nkisiligata enye eikenakini aajo eishoi enye.

English: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
Masaai: Neitoki airriwaa kulikae sinkan ajoki, ‘Entiaki lelo ooipotoki, Eng'ura aidipa aitobira endaa osirua, eyiang'a ilmong'i o lasho oopir eidipate intokitin pooki, wootu osirua le nkiyama.’

English: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
Masaai: Entinyiku intae looreren, pee ining'ining'i, entoning intae lo tung'ana! Nchoo metoning'o enkop o nena pooki naatii atua Nchoo metoning'o enkop o nena pooki naapuku tiatua enkop.

English: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
Masaai: “Teneyau akenya intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi atua ina kop nijing'itata aapuo aaya, neiwuang'ie ninye lelo oreren ootii dukuya intae, Ilhiti, o Ilgashi, o Ilamori, o Ilkanaani, o Ilperesi o Ilhafi, o Lyebusi, lelo oshon pokira oopishana kituaak naa magil aalang intae,

English: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
Masaai: Nesujita Petero ninye elakuaniki, o metijing'a abaiki olgoriet lo lapolosani kitok; neton te nebo ilarripok aij enkima.

English: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
Masaai: ore ina ae ilata natii enkaina o lapolosani nepik ninye endukuya eilo oitisinyi. Neitobir taa olapolosani o lasar olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Masaai: nejoki Isaya ninche, “Entiaaki olkitok linyi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Emiureishoyu te nkaraki lelo rorei litoning'o, laa ninche aaisikong'ie osinka lo laiguanani le Asiria.

English: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
Masaai: Aaipoto nanu iyie, amu eikiwaliki iyie, Olaitoriani; irrugokoki enkiok ino, toning'o irorei laainei.

English: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
Masaai: Amu ore olojo aitopok enkishui enye neiminie; ore oloiturraa enkishui enye te nkaraki ele rorei supat, neitajeu.

English: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
Masaai: Eikilikuanishore iltung'ana nkitanyaanyukot o laitumusumusok kake ore iwalat naatum naa elejare o emodai. Eibelekeny kulikae nkidetidetat neitapong'oo intae. Enepesho enkikoo enye. Neaku kelimana iltung'ana anaa ntare naaimina. Etii ninche atua enyamali amu meeta olarikoni.

English: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
Masaai: Maata nanu engoro. Tenaa naaji kaata nanu ilkiku o entiaati pee airragakinye ninche, anaata apejoo ninche pooki.

English: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
Masaai: Nejokini, “Te Betlehem e Yudea; amu inji etisiraki aajo to loiboni le Nkai:

English: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino; amu kitishipakine ninye iyie, nikipik iyie olorika le nkitoo le Israel! Ore enkaraki natonyorra Olaitoriani Israel ntarasi, kintaaninye iyie olaiguanani, pee itum atudung'o enkiguana niaas isupati.”

English: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
Masaai: Oi duoo tenaa intirring'a agira, naa keaku ina eng'eno ino nagut!

English: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
Masaai: naiwuang'ie naa nanu Isiraeli teina kop apa naishoo ninche; ore ina aji apa naitisinya nanu tenkaraki enkarna ai naiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, neaku Isirael endung'et e rashe o entoki naimakini too loreren.

English: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
Masaai: Nejing aiput enkuretisho pooki ng'ae; neasi inenking'asia, olmonek too lkipaareta.

English: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ilooiteng'eni meituruko dukuya ninye aajing ang oo Samaria, pee eitobiraki enejing.

English: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
Masaai: Neitoki Samuel alo Rama; nelo Saul enkaji enye te Gibea e Saul.

English: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
Masaai: olayioni le Reu, olayioni le Peleg, olayioni le Eber, olayioni le Shela,

English: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ninche aaigil aabuaku aajo, “Haleluya eijukujuk empuruo enye ailep alo shumata ntarasi o ntarasi.”

English: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu olorika lo lng'ur le sahabu nasila; laa intemat are o lpisiai enkadoro naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho.

English: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
Masaai: Netiu inkera enye anaa enatiu apake ore irumat enye neitasheyieki te dukuya nanu, naa kaitame nanu lelo pooki ooibooki ninche enkop.

English: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
Masaai: Amu keaku elotu ina kata entaboi sapuk neitu ae kata etumi, anaa pee eiteruni enkop o taata, nemeitoki aaku katukul.

English: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
Masaai: Naitoki aning oltoilo laaijo olo lorora kitok oikununo anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok netiu sii anaa indarat oo nkikurrukurrot sapuki ebuaku aajo, “Haleluya! Amu Olaitoriani Enkai ang Magilani oitoreisho.

English: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
Masaai: Eikiaata iyiook olperere lo lasar lemeng'arie iyiook lelo ooisiaaisho teilo ng'obor.

English: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
Masaai: iyie oisho ilaiguanak meisula, iyie otokordua Daudi osinka lino.

English: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
Masaai: o Lhifi, o Larki, Olsini,

English: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani ninye olasipani; amu atogolong'ua nanu apaash ororei lenye; kake entoning intae iloreren nidolidolo isinaitin laainei; ore ntoyie aainei o lbarnot laainei eshomo eyararoto.

English: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.
Masaai: Nejo: “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai olkitok lai Abraham, leitu eing'uaa enyorrata enye nauno o enchunet enye to Laitoriani lai. Ore nanu, aatorikuo Olaitoriani te nkoitoi arikoki enkaji oo lalashera lo lkitok lai.”

English: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
Masaai: Neeta ninche nkinantani o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o ndulen, o naishi too siruai lenye; kake meshilaa ninche nkiaasin o Laitoriani, anaa edol ina siaai oo nkaik enyena.

English: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
Masaai: Etoduaa nkonyek aainei embatatata oo lmang'ati laainei, etoning'o nkiyiaa aainei entorroni e lelo mang'ati laainei.

English: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
Masaai: Nening iltung'ana pooki oomanya Yerusalem ina, nedung'oki ina kurma enkarna te nkutuk enye aajo Akeldama, (eji ‘Enkurma osarge’).

English: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
Masaai: oonya aamut nkajijik oo nkolia neitaakuno neitoodor enkomono e Nkai. Etum ninche enkiguana narrish oleng.”

English: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie nanu ilarishak linyi anaa apake, o lelo arikok linyi anaa apake te nkiterunoto. Ore te siadi ina neaku eikiji, enkanasa e supatisho, ina anasa naisiligayu.”

English: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
Masaai: Ara apa nanu esuntai, netiu apa ilki laainei anaa iltaleta; neaku atii atua nkonyek enyena, anaa ilo oyau eseriani.

English: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Idol taata iyie ina naitaas Farao; amu te nkaina nagol eisho ninche meshomo, ee te nkaina nagol earaa ninche meshomo aaing'uaa enkop enye.”

English: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa kelo Olaitoriani abarnisho to lmurunya oisilenuoki te lido kekun o lkeju - to laiguanani le Asiria. Nebarn endukuya o lpapit loo nkejek enye, nebarn sii olmunyei tukul.

English: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
Masaai: Ore te pooki kata tenaibalunye tialo olosho aashu enkitoria, nchere kadotu nagil nainyal,

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kaishooyo nanu ena anasa apik nkaik oo Lkaldayo o atua nkaik e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon; naa keya ninye.

English: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
Masaai: Nelo Ahab enkaji enye eeta osina netagore enkaraki ina natiaka Nabot le Yesreel ninye. Amu etejo ninye, “Maaisho nanu iyie enjung'ore oo loo papa.” Neirrag ninye te ndapash enye, neibelekeny ninye endukuya enye aing'or idia alo neany einos endaa.

English: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
Masaai: Aimedoiki ingolikinot lelo torrok, netum emutata lelo aasak loo ntorrok?

English: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
Masaai: Eibelekenye olchoni lai aroku naaitoki aing'uaa, ore iloik laainei neyupuyup te nkirouaj.

English: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
Masaai: Amu meitieu apa ninche aating'iria enkitoria naishooki, “Te neiseyie ninye eng'ues ele doinyio, neari too soito.”

English: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
Masaai: Koree ilo tung'ani ng'en? Koree ilo asirani. Koree olaiguanani le na kata? Keitu eitomod Enkai eng'eno ena kop?

English: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
Masaai: Ore apa pee esheti ina aji naa too soito ooitobiraki te wueji neguetishoreki; pee mening'i ake enyuntu anaa entolu anaa ae toki e sekenkei tiatua enkaji e Nkai, ina kata eshetitae.

English: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
Masaai: Eliesa apa menye le Finehas, naa Finehas menye le Abishua

English: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aibelekenya aing'or olorere, nemayian ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli. Neitashe ina kata eumata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: If any man take a wife, and go in unto her, and hate her,
Masaai: “Teneyam oltung'ani enkitok nelo ayiolou neitoki asukeny ninye,

English: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
Masaai: Meeta apa Sheshem ilayiok, ntoyie ake eeta. Neeta apa Sheshem Olmisiri rrindik oji enkarna enye Yerha.

English: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
Masaai: Ina peyie eipotu Yakobo ilayiok lenyena nejoki, “Enturrurroto tenebo, pee atum atoliki intae imbaa naatiu too nkolong'i naapuonu.

English: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
Masaai: Ore pee edol Musa neing'asiayie ina, nejo anyikaki adol, nelotu oltoilo lo Laitoriani ojo,

English: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
Masaai: Ore etii ninye Yerusalem, to sirua oji Pasaka, neiruk ilkumok enkarna enye etoduaa nkitoduaat naasita.

English: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee iyieuu neoshi intae, eji metaa ipuopuo dukuya aagolong'u? Kemuei endukuya pooki, neiterre oltau pooki.

English: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
Masaai: kake neshumaki kewan ematua oo mpesai, neyiolo enkitok enye, neyaki ilkipaareta nkulie naatelekutua.

English: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
Masaai: Neton Solomon to lorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani anaa olaiguanani te rishata e Daudi papaai lenye; nebul ninye, nening Israel pooki ninye.

English: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;
Masaai: Nejoki Yehu Bidkar olaretoni lenye, “Ilepie ninye nilo aiturraa te wueji e Nabot le Yesreel. Amu idamu iyie enapa kata kiriamari kikedito mbartan te siadi Ahab papaai lenye, nchere eiroro Olaitoriani ena kitanapata tialo ninye:

English: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
Masaai: Neboreyu olkeju le Nail te nena tuaan naapuonu tiatua enkaji ino, o atua olgilata lino oirragi o enchumata endapash ino, o atua nkajijik oo laisiaayiak linono o noo ltung'ana linono, o ine wueji neyierishoreki o ngirran inono naaipurjishoreki.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Tipika ninche atua olbene le nkaji Enkai.” Ina laata sapuk natejo ninche ekaaishaakino. Meeta atudumua nena shekeli tomoni uni enkosholai napik atua olchumati otii atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
Masaai: Neaku etejoki apa enkarna e ine wueji Kibrot-hatafa. Enkaraki naa te ine apa etunukayioki lelo tung'ana lo lorok.

English: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
Masaai: Eng'ura, aata intoyie are nemeyiolo olee, entasho matorikoki intae peyie ipuopuo aitaas eniyieuu ore kulo tung'ana emintaas ae amu eetuo aajing oloip le nkaji ai.”

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore amu etaa intare aainei entoki nainosi, netaa intare aainei endaa nanya ing'uesi pooki entim, anaa ae metii olairritani; neaku ore amu eitu eing'oru ilairritak laainei intare aainei, kake eitotito ate ilairritak, neitu eitoti intare aainei;

English: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kaarare nanu iyie, lo tawuasai, Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani ojo; amu eetuo nkolong'i inono, e nkata naaitameyie nanu iyie.

English: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
Masaai: Metotiuo ninye anaa olkujita otii shumata e nkaji, ilo otoyu eton eitu ebulu,

English: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee isudoo enkomom ino? Kainyoo iyie pee kitorikine osina lang o enkitorogonyata ang?

English: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
Masaai: Nejoki Abimelek Isaak, “Shomo tung'uai iyiook, amu ira magilani aleng iyiook.”

English: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
Masaai: Ore enchipai enye naa euriata o Laitoriani. Nemedung ninye enkiguana too naadol nkonyek enyena, aashu edung too naaning too nkiyiaa enyena;

English: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oas isupati neisho isipat lelo ooitorogonyi.

English: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.
Masaai: Ore te lelo kiliku linono nitamoro Olaitoriani, nitejo iyie, ‘Ore te nkumoi oo ngarrin aainei oo mbartan, ailepa nanu alo nchumat oo ldoinyo, o mashomo atua Lebanon, atuuroyie nanu iltarakua lenyena adoru aaisul, o lelo keek lenyena gelunot; atijing'a nanu atua nalo atua ina tim enye nagol.

English: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Metaa kaitodolu nanu enkitoo ai tenebo esinyatisho ai, naitayiolo kewan te dukuya inkonyek oo loreren kumok. Ina peyie eyilou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
Masaai: Nejoki Nikedemo ninche, olapa taa otang'asa alotu enetii Yesu, laa obo te lelo,

English: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
Masaai: Kake eitu eirriwaa Yakobo Benchamen, olalashe le Yosef tenebo ilalashera lenyena, amu keure ajo ketum enyamali.

English: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
Masaai: Enterretenata entashololoto. Amu emanimanaa olmang'atinta linyi, sheitani, anaa olng'atuny, oikurrukuru eing'oru olonya.

English: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Hor-hagidgad, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Yotbata.

English: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: nitumoki taa atishipakinoyu ina olong o Laitoriani, naaisho nanu iyie shomo too wuejitin e shumata e nkop; naaitoti nanu iyie te ina jung'ore e Yakobo papaai lino, amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro kuna.”

English: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.
Masaai: Neaku etejo iltung'ana le Yabesh, “Ore taisere naa eikipalari iyiook te ntae, naa indimidimi aaitaasa iyiook enaba anaa enidolidolo aa sidai te ntae.”

English: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
Masaai: Ore te siadi, ina kata pee ening Daudi ina, nejo ninye, “Ore nanu o enkitoria ai mikiata entioto ntarasi te dukuya o Laitoriani te nkaraki osarge le Abna ilo ayioni le Ner.

English: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Harada nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Makelot.

English: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
Masaai: Ore engolon enye apa, netaa taata olameyu te ninye, netinyikaka ninye engolikinoto pee error.

English: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
Masaai: Neeta enkanashe naji Mariamu, nelotu ina aton too nkejek e Yesu, aton aainining inkiteng'enat.

English: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
Masaai: Neitayu iltung'ana le Yuda embuakunoto o larrabal. Ore ake pee ebuaku iltung'ana le Yuda nemir Enkai Yeroboam o Siraeli pooki ootii dukuya Abija o Yuda.

English: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
Masaai: Eisidai tenenap oltung'ani enchata e murt nanapishoreki te kitisho enye.

English: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Ore ilewa pooki o nkituaak, lelo tung'ana loo Siraeli, ootupututuo iltauja lenye eyau pooki toki te nkaraki ina siaai naitanapishe Olaitoriani te Musa metaasi neyau nkishorot enye olpela aaisho o Laitoriani.

English: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa too larin okuni netoni iltung'ana le Israel o le Siria te seriani.

English: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
Masaai: Ore taata ilo laa te ngolon naisiaaisho ti atua iyiook eidim ninye ataasa neitulusoo oleng alang nena pooki nikinkilikuanu aashu kidamu,

English: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
Masaai: Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani, toduaa iyie ina king'odia enye, nincho isinkan linono meiroro te ororei lino mpijan pooki;

English: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
Masaai: Naaitokini aaisho entemet naikununo anaa eng'udi, naajokini nanu, “Inyo tetema enkaji e Enkai o ewueji o lperere lo lasar o lelo ooserem te ine.

English: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
Masaai: Ore iyia naatuuno nanu anaa osabibu gelunoti, entipat nadupa tukul kaji naa iyie nkuna pee mbelekenye niaku osabibu liong'ata?

English: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yuda o lalashera lenyena enkaji e Yosef, eton ake etii Yosef ine; nebatata te dukuya ninye aabatatakino enkop.

English: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
Masaai: nedumu nena mukateni naapishana o lelo sinkir, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe, nebelibel neisho ilooiteng'eni lenyena pee eisho ilooiteng'eni esiamo.

English: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
Masaai: Nilo iyie dukuya o metabaiki olchani onyanyukie olng'aboli otii Tabor; nikinang'are iyie te ine iltung'ana okuni ooilep aapuo enetii Enkai te Betel, enapita obo ilkuoo okuni le kineji, nenapita olikae imukateni uni, ore olikae nenapita olbene lo lchoni le naisho oo sabibu.

English: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Ng'ura aeuo; ore to lpiyayati le mbuku nesira inaaipirare nanu:

English: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Mikaia olayioni le Gemaria, olayioni le Shefan lelo rorei pooki lo Laitoriani eing'uaa olpiyayati,

English: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Etijing'a ninye entaboi; meekure ae kata edumunye te ine neirragie.”

English: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
Masaai: Meetae hoo enkisiligata nabo e nena kisiligat apa sidain naaisiligie Olaitoriani enkaji e Israel neitu ebaya; etabaitie pooki.

English: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
Masaai: Ore pee elau ninye, neshuko Yerusalem aapuo aaing'oru.

English: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
Masaai: Olalashe lenye Simon etang'asa atum nejoki ninye, “Kinoto Mesia,” laa ninye eji Kristo.

English: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the LORD your God.
Masaai: pee meiteng'en ake ninche intae entaas olminong lenye otaasa te nkisiayiare oo nkaitin enye, niasiasa eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
Masaai: Ore enkaitubului nanyaanyukie enchiliwa neitayio olng'usil orropil ore ilng'anayio pooki sidain netii embata e kutukaji, ilng'ejuko tenebo ilmusan, lelo laatushumaka nanu iyie, iyie olanyor lai.

English: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Atoduaa nanu Isiraeli pooki eidapashakinote ildoinyio anaa nkerra nemeeta olchekut; netejo Olaitoriani, ‘Meeta kulo olaitasheikinoni; nchoo pooki ng'ae errinyo alo enkang enye te seriani.’ ”

English: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
Masaai: Ninye apa ilo otoosho nkuapi kumok nesesekuan ilaiguanak magil,

English: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
Masaai: Keishiaakino na taata nindipidipi ina apa ninterutua. Iyiewu apa oleng niretishosho ina kata, neaku entabai naa eririki anaa e niaatata.

English: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
Masaai: Kake ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani laa ninye oyawua iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa enkop e moikuape o nkuapi apa pooki naaterewa ninche.’ Amu kayau nanu ninche ashuku meetu enkop enye ate apa naishoo loo papaai lenye.

English: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
Masaai: Naa ore te ina kop etii ilchekuti ootoni aarrip intare kewarie.

English: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ina kikurrukur neiturrurro olorora kitok. Neiputukuny neing'asia pooki amu meetae ake oleitu ening ninche eiro enkutuk naikini ninye.

English: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
Masaai: Kake meetae olasar le ng'oki onyae nkiri eyauaki osarge lenye atua olng'obor le ntumo pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua tiatua ine wueji sinyati, kepejori ninye te nkima.

English: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
Masaai: o Tahat olayioni lenye, o Uriel olayioni lenye, o Usia olayioni lenye, o Shaul olayioni lenye.

English: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
Masaai: Anaa kalo aiguanani oyieu nerasaki likae aiguanani to larrabal, eitu eng'as aiguana te naa keirish ilenyena iip tomon, iip tikitam le lido oarare?

English: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
Masaai: Eing'or ninye pooki toki natii shumata; naa ninye olaiguanani oitore nkera pooki olwuasa.

English: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
Masaai: ilo lemeitodolu oloshomitore too lkituaak, nemeshilaa ilo karsis aitalang ilo aisinani, amu ore ninche pooki naa esiaai oo nkaik enyena?

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;

English: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkoitoi elo Yerusalem neim erishata e Samaria o Galilaya.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yotam, o larrabali lenyena pooki, o nkoitoi enyena, ng'ura neigeroki tiatua embuku oo laiguanak loo Siraeli o Yuda.

English: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore apa Selofehad olayioni le Hefer, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Makir, olayioni le Manase, nemeeta apa ilayiok, kake ntoyie apake eeta; naa kuna nkarn e nena toyie enyena: o Mahala, o Noa, o Hogla, o Milka, o Tinsa.

English: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
Masaai: menoto nkishu ang oloing'oni, nemetum olkibiroto anaa ae torroni; metaa metumi olkiyioi lo sina too nkoitoi ang!

English: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo oonoto ninye esotu ilkeek, neyau ninye enetii Musa o Aron, o ilo turrur pooki.

English: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
Masaai: Neitoki Belshasa aitanapisho neishopokini Daniel olkila sintet o lpisiai le sahabu oitamanaki emurt enye, nelimuni aaibalunye naaipirta ninye, nchere keaku ninye o liokuni oitoreisho te nkitoria.

English: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
Masaai: Ore olotang'asunye naa kenyokie, naa keju osesen lenye pooki anaa ilpapit le nkila, neipot ninye aajo enkarna Esau.

English: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
Masaai: Neipotu olaiguanani Siba, ilo sinka le Saul, nejoki ninye, “Ore nena pooki apa naara ine Saul o ne nkaji enye pooki aishoo nanu olayioni lo lkitok lino.

English: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
Masaai: Tabolokoki nanu nchomito oo sipat, pee atum nanu aima ninche nalo aisho Olaitoriani enashe.

English: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
Masaai: Ore olokuet pooki naa keenu kewan too mbaa pooki. Neiko ninche neijia ejo pee eishori olmarisian omuta, kake ole memuta kitum iyiook.

English: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le naaudo to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: And the famine was sore in the land.
Masaai: Etaa apa olameyu sapuk oleng te nkop.

English: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
Masaai: Kake eitu iyanyititi intae ilo tung'ani aisinani. Aime ilkarsisi doi ooibooki intae enkop?

English: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
Masaai: Ore imbaa pooki naajoki ninche intae entaas, niaasiasa; amu eiro ninche nemeas.

English: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
Masaai: Neaku eibelekenyate lelo barnot le Daudi aapuo, neshuko neliki ninye ina.

English: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
Masaai: nalo sii nanu apaashare ntae te ngoro napi, naitame nanu intae makewan katitin naapishana te nkaraki ing'ok inyi.

English: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
Masaai: Ore ti alo nanu, atejo, “Olaitoriani, ing'urrieki nanu; nchiunyeki nanu, amu ataasa nanu eng'oki ti alo iyie!”

English: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, irorie iltung'ana linono nijoki ninche, tenelo nayau olalem shumata enkop, negelu iltung'ana oltung'ani obo tiatua ate, neitaa ninye olarriponi lenye;

English: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
Masaai: Nchoo aagolie nanu esupatisho o emborron, amu iyie nanu aanyu.

English: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.
Masaai: Negoro apa Daudi enkaraki natara Olaitoriani Usa; ore ine wueji naa keji Peres-usa, o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.
Masaai: Nejo Saul, “Metaasa Enkai ena te nanu neitulus; meeta nchere pee miye iyie, Yonatan.”

English: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
Masaai: “Ai mme elai are ake enya ntiitiini miet? Nemelang ninye Enkai hoo nabo e nena.

English: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
Masaai: Kake ore iyie nteng'enisho nena naaishiaakino enkiteng'enare sidai.

English: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
Masaai: nejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, meetae Enkai natiu anaa iyie, te keper o te nkop, naibung osotua neitodolu enyorrata nauno too sinkan lenyena oopuo te dukuya iyie too ltauja lenye pooki.

English: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
Masaai: Ore pee eikok Enkai ninche te nkidetidet pee meshukokino Herode nerrinyo ti ae oitoi aapuo enkop enye.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel keitokini aainyiang'u nkajijik o nkurman.’

English: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
Masaai: Amu ore olchekut oigeroki nemeetayie tipat inkerra.

English: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i uni, netum te nkaji e Nkai, eton te rishata ilaiteng'enak, einining'ito neikilikuanishore.

English: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
Masaai: Enyaakita sii aaikilikuan ninche ena, “Kakua nkarn e kulo tung'ana ooshetita ena aji?”

English: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
Masaai: Ele ninye ororei lo Laitoriani oipirta Israel. Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oisalaasha keper neitobir enkop, neisho tung'ani enkishui natii atua ninye,

English: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
Masaai: Ti nikituunokito intae ilng'anayio lo ltau kenyaaka aaku embae sapuk ti nikitumie intae ntokitin e sotore?

English: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore sii ilkulikae lenye, naya aitaa ilapolosak o Lawi, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
Masaai: Airraga nanu nairura; naitoki ainyototo, amu Olaitoriani laarripito.

English: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
Masaai: Nediding'unye oloirirua aiterreyie, nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk, nepuku aing'uaa.

English: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
Masaai: Neitoki alotu likae sinka ejo. ‘Olaitoriani, nena empisai ina e sahabu naisudoyie apa te nkarasha;

English: And if the man like not to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband's brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband's brother.
Masaai: Naa tenemeyieu ilo lee neyam enkitok o lalashe lenye, nelo ina kitok o lalashe lenye auluo enetii ilpayiani, nejoki, ‘Etanya olalashe lo lmoruo lai eun enkarna o lalashe lenye te Israel; meas ninye esiaai o lalashe lenye te nanu.’

English: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki Efraim nepuonu ninche aaipang'u nejing oerata, kisujita iyie Benchamen tenebo iltung'ana linono; ore te Makir neruko ilkituaak aapuo, ore te Sebulon neruko aapuo lelo oonap esiare o larikoni.

English: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Aira iyie ng'ae?” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Anaa ake ina natolikio intae te nkiterunoto.

English: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
Masaai: Ore pee elau eneimu te nkumoi o lorere, nebol aadede shumata enkaji, ine neipirare. Ore pee eidip aatabol neitadou erruat napetita ilo oilenye.

English: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
Masaai: Etii oltoilo lo Larrabal atua enkop, o enkidaata kitok!

English: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
Masaai: Tenaa naaji kaabori enkaina ai etii ele orere anaata aiwuang'ie Abimelek. Anaata ajoki Abimelek, ‘Toponai enjore ino, nimpang'u alotu.’ ”

English: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
Masaai: Miure olkirutoto likiluam, arashu emutata oo larruok te nelotu.

English: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Atalaia ng'otonye Ahasia ajo etua olayioni lenye, nedumunye ninye aidaikie enkaji pooki e nkitoo.

English: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.
Masaai: Nejo Hushai, “Ore ake, iyiolo nchere ore papaai lino o ltungana lenyena naa ltung'ana magil netarasutua sii, anaa olng'arurumi otooruoki nkera enyena ti ong'ata. Ore etii ina, kaarriyia papaai lino to larrabal; meirura ninye kewarie te nebo iltung'ana.

English: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
Masaai: Metaa etudumunye aapuo aaing'uaa Misiri nebau Kanaan enetii papaai lenye, Yakobo.

English: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
Masaai: amu kererioo Olaitoriani ilo onyor anaa olpayian orerioo enkerai enye nanyor.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Atoduaa kulo tung'ana, naa ng'ura, iltung'ana oosho murto

English: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
Masaai: Naa ti nikijo, ‘Iltung'ana eing'uaa’ nikiure olorere, amu kejo ltung'ana pooki oloiboni le Nkai Yohana.”

English: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD:
Masaai: “Asai naa taata intae, entadamu ina nayooki aaku ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo. Amaa eton eitu eiteleikini osoit olikae soit ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, kainyoo intae inotito?

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nelotu enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Enkai nejing atua Saul, neiyiang'iyiang ninye ti atua enkaji enye, eoshito Daudi enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, anaa ake. Neeta apa Saul empere te nkaina enye;

English: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,
Masaai: Ore ti atua olari li are le nkitoria e Darias ilo aiguanani, to lapa li opishana, te nkolong e tikitam o obo o lapa, eeuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai

English: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer: go up before me unto the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thine heart.
Masaai: Newaliki Samuel Saul, “Ara nanu oladuani; ilepa shomo te dukuya nanu ine wueji e shumata, amu ore taata ninya iyie endaa te nebo nanu, ore tadekenya naayooki aisho iyie shomo naaliki iyie nena pooki naatii ndamunot inono.

English: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
Masaai: Neishopoki ate ilkuniyiani, neitoipoo ate to lkirutoto; netii enkurruna inkomomi enye pooki, nemetii ilpapit ilukuny enye pooki.

English: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
Masaai: Entalamaki nanu intae ilarruok, pee atum aibung'a nkitanapat e Nkai ai.

English: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
Masaai: Ore teina kidaaroto enye netonie imotonyi pooki oloing'ang'e, ore atua ilng'osil lenyena, netonie ing'uesi pooki oo nkong'at.

English: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
Masaai: Ore anaa enayieu enkoilii enkare naruko neijia etiu oltau lai, kiyieu iyie, Enkai.

English: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
Masaai: te nkaraki enanai o lng'ur le Nkai ang, laa te ninye ekenyiki iyiook enjeunoto eing'uaa shumata,

English: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
Masaai: entonyor ilmang'ati linyi; entaasa isupati ilooiba intae; entamayian iloodek intae; ore iloosukeny intae neinyial, entoomonoki.

English: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
Masaai: Nepik olaiguanani Benaia olayioni le Yehoida aitaa olkitok le njore te rishata e Yoab, nepik olaiguanani Sadok metaa olapolosani terishata e Abiatar.

English: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Yuda, “Mateshet iyiook kuna anas, nikintaman isunta o ltaleta, nikipik nchomito oo sekenke; eton aa enaang ena kop, amu king'orutua iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang; king'orutua iyiook ninye, neishoo ninye iyiook eseriani too nkaloli pooki.” Neaku eteshetishote ninche nedupoyu.

English: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
Masaai: Ewaita intae Sakuti olaiguanani linyi, o Kaiwana ina ai inyi o lakira o nkitanyaanyukot inyi apa nintobirakita ate;

English: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong te siadi esesekuanata e Gedalia, eton eitu eyiolou hoo ng'ae,

English: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
Masaai: Ituuno iyie enanka te nkaraki lelo likiure, pee etumi aaitoduaai te nkaraki esipata.

English: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu Yerusalem, neng'amu ina sirit o lkipaareta o lpayiani, neinosaki mbaa pooki naataasie Enkai ninche.

English: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oboitare enkitok e menye enkaraki eiwuang'ie ninye ilkilani leina nara ene papaai lenye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
Masaai: Ore ake anaa te nanu, metalakuana te nanu malo ake naas eng'oki to Laitoriani te mpalata napal aomonoki intae naa kaiteng'en nanu intae te nkoitoi sidai naitoriori.

English: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
Masaai: Ore enkaina nashal neyau aisinanisho kake ore enkaina olarriyia neyau enkarsisisho.

English: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
Masaai: Kaji iyie inko pee ijo ‘Eitu aaisarkionieki nanu, eitu nanu alo asujaa noo Baal?’ Ng'ura enkoitoi ino to eyarata; tayiolo ina nitaasa itiu iyie anaa entames lipong, naipirri nkaloli pooki,

English: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
Masaai: Neipirri Abraham alo enetii inkishu enyena, nereu olashe onana sidai, neisho olaisiaayiani lenye, meisiosiono aitobir.

English: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
Masaai: Neisimu ejo oleng, “Te naa kaye te nebo o iyie, maamiki nanu iyie.” Nejo ninche pooki neijia.

English: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.
Masaai: Neitajeu Olaitoriani Hesekia, o lelo oomanya Yerusalem te nkaina e Senakerib, olaiguanani le Asiria, o te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena pooki. Neisho ninche enkiyeng'iyeng te pooki shoto.

English: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
Masaai: Naa kaitadooyo osarge lino te nkop o too ldoinyo; nimput iyie lelo shorroi.

English: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore olasar lenye to Laitoriani naa olasar opejori loo motonyi, neyau ninye olasar lenye loo nturkuluoni aashu ntukurluoni kutiti.

English: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
Masaai: Naaikilikuan sii iyie encholuek ai nadede, taretu kuna kituaak amu aatang'arie ninche enyamali te enkaraki ororei supat, te nebo Klement o lelo kulikae ootaasishote te nebo nanu, ootii nkarn enye atua embuku e mpuaan.

English: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
Masaai: Ing'uraki nanu, nikiwaliki, iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai ai; ntawang'a nkonyek aainei, pee mairura ake too njo e keeya;

English: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
Masaai: Mme ake ninye mbaa e Enkai naipoto intae eiroro ilo oewuo aitapong'oo intae.

English: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
Masaai: Ngila torrinyu iyiook, Iyie Enkai e njeunoto ang, niwuang'ie engoro ino te iyiook!

English: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
Masaai: Ore apa enjung'ore o losho le Simeon neitayu ematua e nkop e Yuda; amu ore apa erubata o losho le Yuda; naa eidapash oleng te ninche, netum olosho le Simeon enjung'ore te mpolos e njung'ore enye.

English: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
Masaai: Neiko neijia iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, neas ninche.

English: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
Masaai: Ng'ura, iltung'ana torrok kulo; neisikarra ninche anaake, neponari ninche te karsisisho.

English: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
Masaai: Tadamu naa ina apa natang'amua nitoning'o torripo ina nirridu. Te nimiputunye nalotu anaa olapurroni, nimiyiolou ajo kaa saa alotunyie enitii iyie.

English: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Yared etoiwuoki Enok ilarin iip isiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana Betel netoni teine te dukuya Enkai ometaa teipa, neyietu aaishir te mion.

English: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
Masaai: Newal Abraham ajo, “Ing'ura ajo, ayaua kewan peyie airorie Olaitoriani, nara nanu enterit o nkuruon.

English: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: ore lelo oibonok le Israel lelo ooibonoki Yerusalem nedol induaat eseriani te nkaraki ninye, ina kata meetae eseriani ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
Masaai: “Pee etum aairuko nchere Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isaak o Enkai e Yakobo nikimpang'aka iyie.”

English: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
Masaai: Kara nanu ng'ae oiguanare lelo leme le sirit ang? Aime intae ooiguanare lelo ootii atua esirit?

English: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Naajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, tujurru oleng, toduaa too nkonyek inono, nining too nkiyiaa inono nena pooki naaliki iyie naaipirta inkitanapat pooki e nkaji o Laitoriani tenebo nkitanapat enyena pooki; nijurru oleng ayiolou lelo pooki ooishori metijing'a enkaji e Nkai o lelo pooki oodung'ori tewueji sinyati.

English: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto kiyiolo aajo eitayioki enkop te nkiroroto e Enkai, neaku ore kuna naadolitai naa too nemelioo eitobiraki.

English: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
Masaai: Netinyikua osirua oji Pasaka loo Lyahudi, neilep Yesu alo Yerusalem.

English: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
Masaai: Kake mesidanu te lelo arruok, nemeitoodor inkolong'i enyena anaa oloip, amu meeta enkuretisho te dukuya Enkai.

English: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i artam apa eewuo ilo Filisti dukuya neitashe te nkitashoto enye, tadekenya o teipa.

English: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
Masaai: Nepuo imelin te ine, o enkukuu naji Lefiatam nintobira iyie pee eiguran teine.

English: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
Masaai: o Me-yarkon o Rakon o ina kop apa naipirakinore Yopa.

English: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
Masaai: Nepuo indamunot inyi aaing'asia te ilo kirutoto, nijojo, “Koree ninye ilo apa oikenisho, Koree ninye ilo apa oineneng atem kodi? Koree ninye ilo apa oiken iltaleta?”

English: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo payiani le Gilead Yepta, “Ena pee kimbelekenyakinote taata iyiook iyie, pee itum ashomo te nebo iyiook niarare Ilamoni, niaku olarikoni lang te lelo pooki oomanya Gilead.”

English: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
Masaai: Naa keaku Olaitoriani Olaiguanani le nkop pooki, ore kenya te ina olong neaku Olaitoriani obo o enkarna enye nabo.

English: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD; for ye have compassion on me.
Masaai: Nejo Saul, “Metamayiana intae Olaitoriani; amu inotito intae olng'ur te nanu.

English: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu ina, newaliki ajoki ninye, “Miureishoyu: iruko ake iyie, naa keitaae biyoto.”

English: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
Masaai: Neitoki ashukokino ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Keton doi ake irurara aayeng'iyeng'a! Eng'ura etinyikua esaa napikieki Enkerai e Tung'ani inkaik oo looata ng'ok.

English: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
Masaai: Neing'asia lelo pooki ootoduaa engolon magilani e Nkai. Ore eton eing'asia pooki too mbaa naataasa, nejoki ninye ilooiteng'eni lenyena,

English: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
Masaai: Amu kinoto aajo serseri ele tung'ani naa oltang'oroi too Lyahudi pooki te nkop pooki, naa ninye obo loo larikok le na kiteng'enare kilaut naji eno Lnasarayoi.

English: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
Masaai: Neilepie ninche iltoiloishi lenye, neranyisho te ng'ida; ore te nkitoo o Laitoriani kebuaku ninche te nkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye Saul nedoyio alo ong'ata e Sif, te nebo iltung'ana nkalifuni uni oogeluno le Israel, pee eing'oru Daudi ti ong'ata e Sif.

English: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
Masaai: Eiro pooki ng'ae elejare tialo ole latia enye; to lkoroj o te nkilelemare eiro ninche.

English: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
Masaai: “Kaiba nanu namen isiruai linyi nemashipakino lelo turrurri linyi.

English: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
Masaai: Elimana ninye te nkop pooki eing'oru endaa ejo, ‘Kaji etii?’ Eyiolo ajo etabawua enkolong enaimin, etabaikia ninye;

English: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
Masaai: Ore ilo oleng too laisinak, nemeng'oriki toki, kake ore ilo oisudoo inkonyek enyena netum ildeketa kumok.

English: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
Masaai: o Bela olayioni le Asas, olayioni le Shema, olayioni le Yoel, apa omanya Aroer ometabaiki Nebo o Baalmeon.

English: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Nijojo intae kara ng'ae?” Nejoki Petero, “Iyie Kristo le Nkai.”

English: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
