Masaai: too laiguanak o lelo pooki ootii iwuejitin e nkitoo pee kitoni te mborron o te nkishon naserian, neure Enkai neyanyitisho too nkoitoi pooki.

English: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
Masaai: Neliki taa ninche nena baa naatotiwuo te nkoitoi, o eneikuna pee eitayiolo kewan ninche ebelaki emukate.

English: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae oora ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo aapik olchumati le siaai sahabu nkiloi iip o ntomoni ile, o imiet, o enkosholai nkiloi enkalifu nabo o iip are o onomm.

English: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol Olaitoriani ajo keibai Lea, nebol eng'uset enye, kake ore apa Raheli naa koolupi.

English: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
Masaai: Kake te neibalunye orrindik ajo, ‘Kanyor olkitok lai, o enkitok ai, o nkera aainei; malo nanu alakunoyu,’

English: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye meishuro emowuo oo ltung'ana lenyena, esisa te nkaraki isinyat lenyena pooki, te nkaraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ootaaniki ninye. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
Masaai: Ore atua enkaina enye e tatene nepuku enkukuo e Yerusalem pee ebol enkutuk enye te nkishirata, peyie eilepie oltoilo te mbuaata, pee eitorioki isekenke naagilieki nkishomin neitasheyie nenen neesheta te ng'olon neshetu iltaleta ooibung'ishore.

English: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
Masaai: Metaasa sii Enkai ena te Abna, neitulusoo sii, te neitu nanu aitabaya te Daudi ina apa nainosakinye Olaitoriani ninye olmumai,

English: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
Masaai: Enaikash emborei enkaina nabo etii emborron atua alang inkaik are naabore eekenyata emirata e nkijape.

English: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliesa olayioni le Dodawahu le Maresha, aibonisho tialo Yehoshafat, ejo, “Ore enkaraki nimbung'are Ahasia, keidaikie Olaitoriani ina nitaasa.” Nemuta nena melin neitu ninche epuo Tarshish.

English: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
Masaai: Kake ntagoluoyu iyie! Mincho elepori nkaik inono, amu eikilaakini esiaai ino.”

English: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
Masaai: Anaa entapukai natii atua ilkiku, neija etiu enyorrata ai too ntoyie.

English: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
Masaai: Ore to lari le iip ile le nkishui e Noa, to lapa li are enkolong e tomon o naapishana olapa, nedanya inkonyek oo nkariak naagut aaruko, nebolo sii ilusien e keper.

English: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
Masaai: Ena naaku enjeunoto ai, inchere melotu oltung'ani lemeeta Enkai dukuya ninye.

English: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
Masaai: Neya nkolong'i uni aa modooni nemedaa nemeok toki.

English: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
Masaai: Neeta apa Hesekia enkarsisisho sapuk o enkanyit, neitobiraki kewan ilchumat le nkosholai o le sahabu, o soito oogol enkinyang'a, o sonkoyoni, o long'oi o masaa pooki naagol enkinyang'a.

English: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore to losho le Gad neyai, Ramot te Gilead tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Mahanaim tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo

English: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
Masaai: Kake te neotiki oltung'ani aitirraki olikae pee ear metua, ewaita intae ninye aaitung'uaa olperere lai pee eye.

English: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani loo lororani, na Ai e Israel, niton to lorika lino le nkitoo te shumata ilkerubi, naa iyie Enkai, iyie ake, ore too nkitoriat pooki e nkop nintobira iyie shumata o enkop.

English: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
Masaai: Entalaaki ninye anaa enaitalakishe sii ninye makewan. Entalaaki katitin are te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena. Eng'oling'olaki ninye mboreitin are te ina kikompe naing'ola sii ninye.

English: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
Masaai: Ina pee etejoki, “Ore pee eilep ninye alo shumata nerik olorora loo looena, neisho ltung'ana nkishorot.”

English: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ehud (ninche apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye le lelo oomanya Geba, neewaki apa ninche eyararoto nepuo Mahat.)

English: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina mikiureisho hoo duoo ninye tenaa keibelekenya enkop, hoo duoo ninye tenaa keikirikira ildoinyo te mpolos e naiposha;

English: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
Masaai: o Heleb olayioni le Baana le Netofa, Itai olayioni le Ribai le Gibea loo Lbenchamen,

English: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
Masaai: Ore eton edamu Petero ina natamanikia, nejoki Enkiyang'et ninye, “Ng'ura, nelelo ltung'ana okuni liking'oru.

English: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
Masaai: neaku kebolori intae metamori te dukuya olorere neisilisili intae, nitaa ti ae kata encholiek e lelo ooikunaki neijia.

English: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
Masaai: Ore isupati neing'or enkaji eilo torrono; enang'akini iltorrok enkidaaroto.

English: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Elisha, ilo tung'ani le Nkai ajo etopolosa olaiguanani loo Siraeli nkilani, neirriwaki olaiguanani olkilikuai, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee itopolosa nkilani inono? Nchoo ninye elotu enatii pee eyiolou ajo etii oloiboni le Nkai Israel.”

English: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keyauni oltaa nepising'ari to ltoo, aashu epiki orunku le erruat? Mme eneiperere epiki?

English: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
Masaai: Etaa enkosholai ino isuut, netushulare enaisho ino enkare.

English: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
Masaai: Ekaitaa Patros mitil, naisuroki enkima Soan nayau inkiaasin enkiguana shumata Tebes.

English: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: “Oloata nkiyiaa toning'o.”

English: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
Masaai: Ore pee enyikaa peno, nedol Yakobo le Sebedayo o Yohana olalashe lenye, etii atua empeut eripita irresheta.

English: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
Masaai: Tubuku intayu ina goro ino nadooyo, ning'or pooki ngae owuasa, nintadoyio ninye.

English: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
Masaai: te wueji netejia aashu teneiwotiote aashu oltipoti

English: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kelepori nkaik pooki, neiropijaa empijan e pooki tung'ani.

English: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
Masaai: Nepik lelo tung'ana le Shekem iltung'ana olnukata pee ear ninye te nchumata o ldoinyo, neoru ninche ntokitin lelo pooki apa ootogiroitie ninche te nkoitoi, nelikini Abimelek.

English: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
Masaai: Neaku pesho enkisiaayiare e ngolon inyi, amu meitoki enkop inyi aiu entoki naponari, ore ilkeek leina kop nemeitoki aaiu ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
Masaai: Newaliki iltung'ana loo Siraeli iltung'ana le Yuda nejo, “Kiata iyiook irubat tomon to laiguanani, ore sii te Daudi nikiata iyiook nkumok aitulusoo intae. Kainyoo naa pee itemena intae iyiook? Aimikira iyiook ile dukuya ooiroro pee eshukuni olaiguanani?” Kake ore apa rorei loo ltung'ana le Yuda naa kepe alang irorei loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Masaai: Aimiso nanu ti atua esarng'ab te ine nemetii ewueji napik enkeju; atijing'a nanu nkariak naagut, naaya nanu olairrag le nkare.

English: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye ilasarri nepejoo enkorropil too wuejitin neeika; o too nchumat oo ldoinyo, o tiabori pooki shani onyori.

English: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
Masaai: Amu, ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani aipang'u te wueji enye pee elotu aitame lelo oomanya enkop te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye. Ore enkop nelo aibalunye ilo sarge apa oibukoyioki ti oriong ninye, nemeigil ae kata aitemoo lelo apa ootaraki metuata.

English: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim aitayu olkila lenye lioriong? Aing'ae oidim ataremo ina kila enye nagol.

English: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
Masaai: Eisika! Entajeu ate! kueta anaa oloitiko to lpurkel!

English: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
Masaai: nipik emanata amuat Yerusalem, nishetu esuntai aitaman, nituru olong'elu aitaman ninye, intasheyie sii ilng'oborri te mbata, niun ilkedeta aitaman ninye.

English: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
Masaai: Keidong'i entapa oo mukateni? A-a, meidong'i o akenya; te nereu oltung'ani enkeju e ngarri enye te shumata e nkano eyiataa embarta, nemeidong ninye nagut.

English: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata etumi enkolong naaijo ena too nkolong'i naatulusoitie o too naatusujutua, eji nening Enkai oltoilo lo ltung'ani; amu etijing'a apa Olaitoriani olarrabal te nkaraki Israel.

English: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai ajo ai sidai ewang'an. Nerishu Enkai ewang'an aitung'uaa enaimin.

English: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
Masaai: Ainyoo peyie eikenari iyiook anaa nkishu? Ainyoo peyie kira iyiook lmoda te dukuya iyie?

English: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
Masaai: Kelo sii anap aya Misiri nkaitin enye te nebo nkitanyaanyukot naaipurjuno te sarng'ab te nebo imasaa e tipat e nkosholai o ne sahabu; naa ore too larin oora esiana nepal ninye eitu eitainye olarrabal olaiguanani le moikuape.

English: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
Masaai: Neiruk iltung'ana; ore ake pee ening nchere etumutana Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli netoduaa osina lenye, neirrug ninche ilukuny enye aaserem.

English: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
Masaai: Metaa imbonoki ninche nijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kabol inkuraren inyi, naitopiu intae too nkuraren inyi, intae lo tung'ana laainei; naa kayau intae ang atua ina kop e Israel.

English: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche eimaki empiunoto oo lootuata neikordod kulikae; kake etii kulikae lenye ootejo, “Kintoki ake aainining iyie te likae kekun.”

English: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
Masaai: Neitu eyiolou ninye inchere nanu apa ilo oishoo ninye entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata, naiputaki ninye enkosholai o sahabu naa ninche etaasishore te Baal.

English: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
Masaai: Eiputa enkop enye enkosholai o sahabu, nemeeta ilchumat lenye eneiting'ie; neiputa nkop enye mbartan, nemeeta eneiting'ie ngarrin enye oo mbartan te nkumoi.

English: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: Meitoki aata tipat te nkurma nemeeta to lchala; keiturrarri ake. Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ie inchoo ening.”

English: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
Masaai: Neikilikuan ninche aajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo iro iyie ninteng'enisho too sipat, metii enyorrakino, kake iutu iyie enkoitoi e Nkai te sipata.

English: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
Masaai: Naa Enkiyang'et shakeni, amu ore Enkiyang'et naa esipata.

English: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
Masaai: neishiraki ninye ilo tung'ani le Nkai apa oing'uaa Yuda, ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki neitu imbung ororei lo Laitoriani, neitu imbung nkitanapat Olaitoriani Enkai, kake itorrinyunye,

English: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
Masaai: Nilimu aibalunye ina olong nintayuyu eumata sinyati, nimiasiasa esiaai nagol enkitanapata ena ntarasi tiatua imanyishoreitin inyi pooki, tiatua iishoritin inyi.

English: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: Ore ilarripok le kishomi naa: Akub, o Talmon o lalashera lenye, laa ninche apa oorrip nchomito, naa iip nabo o ntomoni napishana o are.

English: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
Masaai: Kake etiakita ninche ninye, “Wuang'a iyie,” nejo sii, “Eewuo ele tung'ani aa olomoni naa ninye olotu aiguanare iyiook! Etaa kintaas iyie entorroni nalang enikintaas ninche.” Nerrumokino pooki aairony Lot, nenyikaki enkaji peyie egil kutuk aji.

English: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Simeon naa: Nemuel, o Yamin, o Yarib, o Serak o Shaul;

English: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
Masaai: Amu ninye apa eiririkino, olaa nkunenyena naa ninye pee eetae ntokitin pooki, ore pee etumoki ninye atorikoki inkera kumok enkitoo neiteraka emion neitaa bayarot ilo oipirua enjeunoto enye te mion o larikoni.

English: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
Masaai: Nelotu Daudi enkaji enye te Yerusalem; neya olaiguanani nkapiak tomon apa naatung'uayie meing'ura enkaji, nepik ninche atua enkaji narripitoi, neitoti ninche, kake eitu elo atua enetii ninche. Neaku eikenoyioki ninche o metabaiki enkolong e keeya enye, etoni anaa nkolia.

English: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
Masaai: “Emijo kaewuo aitarruoo Nkitanapat aashu loibonok le Nkai, eitu alotu aitarruoo kake pee aitabaya.

English: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
Masaai: Nedumu lasuriaa, naa te neok entoki ake pooki nayaisho nemeeta enaiko ninche; neiteleiki ltamueyia nkaik, neishiu.”

English: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.
Masaai: Nediding Absalom isinkan le Daudi. Nekedito apa Absalom enyumpu enye, nelo enyumpu aim abori ilng'osil sapuki lo lchani neng'amari endukuya too lng'osil, neing'uari ninye eililio to lgam; ore ina nyumpu apa natii abori ninye nelo.

English: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
Masaai: Aisilig ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu ajo airriu Timoteo meeu enitii asieku, pee aaitiship ilomon linyi.

English: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee ing'or to lom, lo doinyo loo rruka kumok, ilo doinyo oyieu Enkai neitaa emanyisho enye, ee, ine nelo Olaitoriani abikie ntarasi?

English: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam ajoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki, amu eitu nanu ayiolou ajo itii enkoitoi pee kimbooyo nanu. Ore naa taata, tenaa embae torrono ena too nkonyek inono, karrinyo nanu alo.”

English: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
Masaai: natiu anaa aimaatae apa aekata. Aatanapaki te ng'uset aaya enkurare.

English: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
Masaai: Ina Ai naaitalaaka nanu elap neitadou iltung'ana apik abori nanu,

English: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
Masaai: Kaitayu nanu endaa ai o enkare ai o enkiring'o ai nateyieng'uo te nkaraki ilabarnok laainei, aisho iltung'ana ooing'uaa ewueji nemayiolo nanu ajo kaji eing'uaa?”

English: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nanoto nanu omom te iyie, Olaitoriani, nikintagolo iyie nanu anaa oldoinyo; kisudorie iyie nanu enkomom ino, natum osina.

English: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
Masaai: Nesuju olosho le Sebulon, naa Eliab olayioni le Helon olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Sebulon,

English: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
Masaai: Emaibung'a aakurraki elimunoto o siligi lang mikingusugus, amu keisiligayu ilo oishorua ina kisiligata;

English: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
Masaai: ore te nkaina e kedienye naing'oru ninye kake madol ninye; naibelekenyakino enkalo e tatene, kake madol nanu ninye.

English: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
Masaai: Nejo, “Kincho iyie enashe, Olaitoriani Enkai, olopeny enkidimata pooki, otii taata, netii apa amu iwa te ngolon ino sapuk, ninterua aitoreisho.

English: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ele naa ororei lo Laitoriani ogilunore ina kop e Hadrak, tenebo ina anasa e Dameski. Amu ino Laitoriani inkanas e Aram anaa enatiu iloshon le Israel;

English: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
Masaai: Ai meinosieki ntiitiini are esenti nabo, kake mesulunye nabo aosh enkop, meyiolo Papa linyi.

English: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
Masaai: Ekajoki nanu Enkai, mikidung'oki nanu enkiguana; intayioloki nanu nchere ainyoo peyie kiarare nanu.

English: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
Masaai: Enturrurrokoki nanu ilpayiani pooki loo loshon linyi, o larikok linyi pee atumoki airoro kulo rorei too nkiyiaa enye naipotu shumata o enkop meishakenoki ninche.

English: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
Masaai: amu keaku nena utarot enkishili te ndukuya ino, neaku olpisiai te murt ino.

English: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
Masaai: Etabawua enkiting'oto, eewuo enkiting'oto; kitudumakine ninye iyie agilunore. Ing'ura elotu.

English: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Masaai: Ore hoo neidim oltung'ani atigilu olikae laa ninye ake, eidim aare aairisha ninye. Ore enkopito natasha uni, nemelelek edung'i.

English: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
Masaai: Neing'uaa siamon nejing aji, nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Imbalakinye iyiook enkitanyaanyukoto o ndiati e nkurma.”

English: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Hebron naa Yeria aa ninye olkitok, naa Amaria oliare, naa Yahasiel oliokuni, naa Yekameam oliong'uan.

English: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
Masaai: Nelo ninye neinepu ninye eirrag te nkoitoi, neitashe osikiria o lng'atuny te mbata ilo sesen Neitu einos olng'atuny ilo sesen neitu eony ilo sikiria.

English: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.
Masaai: Ajoki naa taata intae, entagoluoto; amu meetae hoo obo oye ti atua intae, kake eye emeli.

English: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki Beta ometabaiki Berotai, nkanas e Hadadesa, neya olaiguanani Daudi isuyan kumok.

English: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
Masaai: Ore ti alo ororei supat ilmang'ati le Nkai ninche, naa enkaraki intae; kake ore te nkalo e ngelunoto nenyorri te nkaraki lekua loo menye.

English: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi oo ltorrok netiu anaa enaimin nagut; meyiolo ninche aajo aitenyoo etarrorrote.

English: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
Masaai: Ore peyie aajutoo iyie, naa kaitoip keper o loing'ang'e lenye, naitomisimis ilakir lenye; naa kaitoip enkolong te nkatampoi, nemeitoki olapa aitayu ewang'an enye.

English: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
Masaai: Neijia ake sii etiu ilaisiaayiak, inchoo emut nabo nemeitoki aaing'ashing'ash too nkirorot, neme ilooitabaitie enaisho, nemeeta olorok le dupoto,

English: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
Masaai: Ore Yafan o Tubal o Meshek netimirishote tenebo iyie; eitawalunye ninche iltung'ana nena masaa o suyai aawalunye imasaa inyi.

English: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

English: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

English: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

English: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
Masaai: kake ore embae pooki nabolokini ewang'an naa keliooyu, amu ewang'an pooki toki nalioo.

English: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

English: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

English: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

English: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

English: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le tomon oare, to lapa le tomon oare naa Hildai le Netofat loo le Otiniel; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

English: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
Masaai: lelo tung'ana apa laitobiraka kewan, pee etum ninche aaibalunye enkisisa ai.

English: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
Masaai: Aing'ae nayiolo naatii oltau lo ltung'ani neme enkiyang'et natii atua ilo tung'ani? Neijia naa etiu, Enkiyang'et e Nkai ake nayiolo naatii oltau le Nkai.

English: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

English: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
Masaai: Neureyu Adonija Solomon, nedumunye ninye, neibung imouarak olperere lo lasar.

English: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
Masaai: Inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Simion, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Lawi,

English: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Mara nepuonu Elim; ore apa te Elim netii nchorroi tomon o are oo nkariak o ltuka ntomoni naapishana, neun ninche ilng'oborri te ine.

English: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
Masaai: eibung'are sii Asiria ninche; ninche engolon oo nkera e Lutu.

English: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
Masaai: Naajokini, “Meeta nchere pee mintoki aibonisho too ltung'ana kumok, o too lng'ejepa o laiguanak.”

English: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Ilo likitoduaa nikitoningo kinosaki sii ninche intae pee itumutumu enchula te nebo iyiook; naa ene Papa enchula ang te nebo Oinoti lenye Yesu Kristo.

English: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
Masaai: Eikurrukurro ilmang'ati linono te mpolos e ine wueji sinyati; neun ninche inankan enye pee eaku olmonekie lenye le nkisulata.

English: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninche te wueji neji te nkutuk oo Lhebrania Har-Magedon.

English: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto eshomo aing'uaa Misiri, neitu eiureyu engoro e ilo aiguanani; amu eting'iria anaa olodolita ilo lemelioo.

English: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
Masaai: Enchoo ejur pooki tung'ani esiaai enye, paa te netonyorrayioki netum aisisa kewan neme to le latia enye;

English: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

English: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, neitodol ninche inkaik enyena o ematua enye. Neng'ida lelo ooiteng'eni pee edol Olaitoriani.

English: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
Masaai: “Ainyoo pee ejo ele tung'ani inji? Eijo kemorisho! Ai ng'ae oidim atapalaki ng'ok, leme Enkai ake?”

English: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
Masaai: Iwa te ninche enkosholai o sahabu, nintobiru enkopiyia e nkitoo, nipik ninye endukuya e Yoshua, olayioni le Yehosadak olapolosani kitok;

English: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
Masaai: Entuburukushu enkewan inyi musana, e napa kishon inyi musana narruoyo enkaraki ng'uarrat naalejisho,

English: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aasujaa ninche ometabaiki olkeju le Yordan; naa ng'ura, ore te nkoitoi pooki, naa mpurdat oo nkilani o ntokitin naaiturraitie iltung'ana le Siria te nkisarrisar. Nerrinyunye lelo tung'ana ooirriwayioki, neliki olaiguanani.

English: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eitu isikong abuaaki Yeremia le Anatot likimbonoki iyie?

English: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
Masaai: Kaitobir nanu tenebo ninche osotua loo ntarasi, nchere maibelekenya nanu eitu aitaas ninche esidai; naa kapik nanu olturiaki lai atua oltau lenye, pee maaitoki ninche aaibelekenya aaing'uaa.

English: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.
Masaai: Ore pee eshukunye Saul eing'uaa esujata oo Lfilisti, nejokini, “Ng'ura, etii Daudi ong'ata e En-gedi.”

English: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
Masaai: Teng'ena miar kewan amutakino ing'oru enkarsisisho, teng'ena pee imbooyo.

English: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one
Masaai: Ore teilo orora lo lorere naa Efraim eing'uaa ilkumok lenye, o Manase, o Isaakar, o Sebulon, neitu eitisiny ate, eji neinosa ake pasaka kake mme te nkoitoi natolimuoki. Amu etoomonoko Hesekia ninche ejo, “Metapalaki Olaitoriani supat pooki tung'ani,

English: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
Masaai: o ng'apeta enyena pokira imiet te nebo ilala lenyena oololo, nemuraa enchumata enye o nkeek enye te sahabu, kake ore nkitotoneta enye pokira imiet naa ino suyai.

English: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.
Masaai: Nepej ninche nkiri eilo kuo le pasaka te nkima terisioroto oo nkoon. Neyier lelo asarri oosinya too motio o too ng'irran, o too saanini dapashi, nenap ninche nabo kata aayaki olorere.

English: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
Masaai: Kake ashe te Nkai naishoo Tito enyuaata metaa keyieu neret intae anaa enikitiu iyiook.

English: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
Masaai: Nebol Olaitoriani nkonyek e Balaam, nedol ninye ilo malaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te nkoitoi eeta enchutati o lalem te nkaina enye; neirrug Balaam endukuya enye, nebatata te nkomom.

English: Then shall they know that I am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye amu aterewa ninche eararoto tiatua iloreren, naitoki aiturrurroki ninche enkop enye maate. Maing'uaa hoo obo lenye eton tiatua iloreren aitoki;

English: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
Masaai: Amu etijing'akita ninche ninye, anaa enajing'aki ilewa enkitok naibor onyek. Neaku neijia eikunakinote ninche Ohila o Oholiba peyie eas inenkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

Masaai: Neitabari olkigeroto ojo, “Eikenayioki ninye te nebo ilarruok.”

English: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Nkena lewa kikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel, ebaiki olapa obo neilep, niya esiana enye anaa too nkarn.

Masaai: Kake eirure Uria te kutukaji e nkaji o laiguanani te nebo isinkan pooki lo lkitok lenye, neitu elo enkaji enye.

English: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia eitu eshipakino Enkai ilkumok lenye neidapashaki impopoki enye ilo kees.

English: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

English: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

English: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

English: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

Masaai: Negil ninye asulu oltapeet le Penuel, nesesekuan iltung'ana le ina anasa.

English: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Reia, lelo ayiok le Resin, lelo ayiok le Nekoda,

English: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

English: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Abishai, “Ore taata keitaas iyiook Sheba olayioni le Bikiri entorrono alang Absalom; iwa isinkan lo lkitok lino tusujai ninye, meisho ake kewan nkanas naasheta isunta too soito nepik iyiook enyamali.”

English: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
Masaai: Ore ina ilata sidai aisul, o ina aisho pooki sidai o entapa, lelo ng'anayio le dukuya ooisho ninche Olaitoriani, aaishoo nanu iyie.

English: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
Masaai: Naa ore te nebo iyie toshoru sii ilalashera linono, ilo osho le Lawi, ilo osho le papaai lino, pee kitum ninche aatushulare, nikisiaai iyie ina kata itii iyie o layiok linono dukuya ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho.

English: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.
Masaai: Neibung ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel anaa apa enataasa Ahab. Amu entito apa e Ahab enkitok enye. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?
Masaai: Neipot ina jore, o Abna olayioni le Ner, ejo, “Aimiwal iyie, Abna?” Newal Abna, “Ira ng'ae ilo oipot olaiguanani?”

English: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
Masaai: Ore olng'ejep lo lng'en neitubulaa eng'eno, kake ore inkutukie oo lmoda nebuku ine modai.

English: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
Masaai: “Eng'ura eneikunayioki Babilon, ewaki ina naikasie enkop pooki eng'ura aajo etaa Babilon entoki naitureisho too loreren!

English: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeroboam o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli aapuonu enetii Rehoboam te nkolong e uni, anaa enatejo olaiguanani, “Enyaaki wootu enatii nanu te nkolong e uni.”

English: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
Masaai: Naaitoki aitodol nanu olkeju le nkare e mpuaan, owang anaa oltotoi orukunye aing'uaa olorika le nkitoo le Enkai o lo Kuoo le Ker.

English: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
Masaai: Kake enyaaka Yehoshafat ajo, “Aimeekure etii ene likae oiboni lo Laitoriani likinkilikuanishore?”

English: He shall send from heaven, and save from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
Masaai: Ninye oirriu olkilikuai te keper naaitajeu nanu; keitukurru ninye lelo laaitunyoki nanu enkop. Keirriu Enkai ina nyorrata enye nauno o esupatisho enye!

English: So Paul departed from among them.
Masaai: Metaa nepuku Paulo alo aing'uaa.

English: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i pooki naaiteng'elaka ninye kewan Olaitoriani naa kesinya ninye to Laitoriani.

English: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
Masaai: Naning sii oltoilo laajoki, ‘Inyo, Petero, teyiang'a naa nosa.’

English: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
Masaai: o enaisho oo sabibu naing'uaa Usal newalunye ninche too ntokitin inyi; isekenke naasika, o enkaitubului naji mdalasini, o enkaitubului naji mchai naatii apa atua imasaa inono e biashara.

English: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
Masaai: Neitoki Yepta airriwaa ilkiliku enetii olaiguanani le Amon nejoki, “Kainyoo iyie kiatakinore nanu, pee iewuo enatii nanu, pee iarare enkop ai?”

English: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
Masaai: Eenaro emodai tiatua oltau le nkerai, kake ore eng'udi enkitamioto nearaa ninye aitalamaa.

English: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
Masaai: ore ake pee eiteru aaitayu mbenek, niduaakiki ate nchere etinyikua olodalu.

English: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
Masaai: Eing'or ninye aramat imbaa pooki o lmarei lenye, nemenya ninye endaa neitu eisiayu.

English: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
Masaai: Nepuo aaimaa Amfipoli o Apolonia o meetu Sesalonike, netii ine enkaji oo Lyahudi e ntumo.

English: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
Masaai: Neng'idayu Misiri ina kata pee edumunye ninche aapuo, amu etijing'a enkuretisho te nkaraki ninche.

English: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
Masaai: “Tadamisho sii iyie, kalo ae kata ilo loo supati oidaayie? Anaa aitiaji ae kata etudung'oyioki, lelo ooitashe too sipat?

English: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
Masaai: Ninye apa otara ilkikaunot le Misiri metuata, o lenkiteng o le ng'ues;

English: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Minchosho ilo tung'ani ng'en eng'idare eng'eno enye, minchosho ilo tung'ani magilani eng'idare emagilanisho enye, minchosho ilo tung'ani karsis eng'idare karsisisho enye;

English: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
Masaai: Amu ore aloito, nadol olperere lo lasar oigero ajo nji, ‘ENE ENKAI NEMEYIOLOI.’ Ore naa ina Ai niserememe miyiololo ninye ena naliki nanu intae.

English: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
Masaai: Neaku eipoto Saul iltung'ana neiken ninche te Telaim, netii apa iltung'ana oopuo too nkejek nkalifuni iip are, o nkalifuni tomon oo ltung'ana le Yuda.

English: And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:
Masaai: Kake tenemeitobir ninche eseriani tenebo iyie, kake olarrabal kintayunye, nimuatu iyie ninye;

English: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninye enkarasha endukuya enye, ore ina arasha te nkalo enkomom nepik enkishili e sahabu, ina ilo marisian sinyati le nkitoo anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ajo, “Toning'o naa, na aji e Daudi! Kentoki nalelek ena pee intanaururu intae iltung'ana, nintokiki sii aaitanaur Enkai ai?

English: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
Masaai: Newal eumata pooki to ltoilo sapuk aajo, “Neijia etiu, meeta nchere keitu iyiook kiaas anaa enitejo.

English: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
Masaai: Eipang'aka Olaitoriani ninye tenelakua ajoki. Aatonyorra nanu iyie te nyorrata oo ntarasi. Neaku atobiko nanu aisiligayu te intae,

English: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
Masaai: Kepik ninye iltaai aitobiraki aiteleiki lelo iketa loo ltaai le sahabu nasila te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake.

English: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kaitanapisho nanu, pee aipirripir asilu nanu enkaji e Israel tiatua loreren pooki anaa enasil oltung'ani te silet, kake meetae olantererai odoiki enkop.

English: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
Masaai: amu kekutaa osiwuo nedung'ori alo, ore ewueji enye nemeitoki ayiolou.

English: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
Masaai: Amu eidipa kulie aatapong'ori aasuj shetani.

English: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninche, “Kalo nanu, naa eiking'oruru intae, kake niyeye ti atua ing'ok inyi. Ore enalo mindimidimi aaetu.”

English: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adonikam naa iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.

English: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
Masaai: Anaa keng'as ake ajoki, ‘Tang'asa taa ntobirakaki endaa, nirretena nikiyaki, ore aidipa atadaayu naokisho; nilo sii iyie adaa niokisho?’

English: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
Masaai: Neng'amaa papaai lenye Isaak ajoki ninye, “Ira doi ng'ae?” Newal ajoki, “Nanu doi olayioni lino, olkikau lino Esau.”

English: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
Masaai: “Etudung'oki iwikii ntomoni naapishana oo larin te nkaraki iltung'ana linono o ina anasa ino sinyati, pee eiting'ieki enkitarruorroto, pee eishieki easata oo ng'ok, pee eitaikinyeki osotua ilaing'okok, pee eyauni esupatisho oo ntarasi, nemishiri enduaata o loiboni, nebukokini eilata ine wueji sinyati aisul.

English: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
Masaai: Neing'asia lelo tung'ana nejo, “Kaa pukunoto o ltung'ani ele oning olkutati o enaiposha?”

English: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Shetani, “Itoduaa osinka lai Yoab, olaa meetae olonyaanyukie ninye te nkop, o lemeeta entioto naa oltung'ani oitashe too sipat, oltung'ani oure Enkai neibelekenye aing'uaa intorrok? Eton ake eibung'ita enkirukoto enye anaa apake, hoo nikiewuo arrumoki ninye mataarare, meeta ninye enataasa.”

English: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.
Masaai: A-a! Enchom ilewa ake, esiaayia Olaitoriani, amu ina iyieuu.” Nerumori ninche aaitung'uaa ine netii Farao.

English: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
Masaai: Neishooki pooki tung'ani ewang'an naretie lkulikae tung'ana pooki.

English: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
Masaai: Eitomisimisoki ewang'an ino pee midolisho, nikimulumula iyie olairrag le nkare.

English: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
Masaai: Naa atua kuna apa kitii sii iyiook pooki too ng'uarrat oo seseni lang, nikisuj iyieunot o sesen o enoo ndamunot, nikiaku iyiook maate te ikinet inkera e ngoro, anaa ina natiu ilkulikae tung'ana pooki.

English: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo oong'uar esupatisho ai metabuaku te ng'ida, neshipa, nejo ntarasi moitie, “Eikitok Olaitoriani, neshipakino ninye eseriani o sinka lenye!”

English: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
Masaai: Meetae oloany ilo Inoti oitoki ninye aata Papa. Ore oloibalunye ilo Inoti keeta sii ninye Papa.

English: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neisho iltung'ana meshomo, nemayian lelo tung'ana olaiguanani, nepuo taa nkang'itie enye eng'ida neshipa too ltauja tenkaraki esupatisho pooki naitoduaa Olaitoriani Daudi osinka lenye o Siraeli lelo tung'ana lenyena.

English: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
Masaai: nikijo, ‘Mikipuo katukul. Tenaa keiriamariyie iyiook olalashe lang oti naa aikipuo; amu mikindim katukul aatodol enkomom eilo tung'ani arashu ake kiata olalashe lang oti tenebo iyiook.’

English: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitayu ti atua isinaitin lenye;

English: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
Masaai: Ore iltorrok naa kenang'ari nemeitokini aata, kake ore enkaji o supat naa keitashe.

English: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooidipa ninye ategelu, neiteng'el; ore lelo ooiteng'ela ninye neipot, ore lelo ooipoto neikenaki esipata, ore lelo ooikenaka esipata neisho ake sii enkitoo.

English: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
Masaai: nchere, eitarasari ake Enkerai e Tung'ani aaitarasaki nkaik oo looas ing'ok, neshei, nepiu te nkolong e uni.”

English: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
Masaai: “Eirorita enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te nanu, etii ororei lenye olng'ejep lai.

English: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
Masaai: Ore ninye te naamuat olorora aaman nemeureishoyu oltau lai; te naadumakino ninye nanu enjore, ore ake etiu neijia naisiliga nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore to lapa lo loirujuruj leilo ari, neirriu olaiguanani Nebukadnesa olkilikuai meyauni ninye Babilon, tenebo nena tokitin e tipat apa naati atua enkaji o Laitoriani neitaa olalashe lenye Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Masaai: Enting'idata to siligi linyi enting'iria to sina, entasheikinoto enkomono.

English: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
Masaai: Eitadou oltung'ani supat isupati naaitung'uaa olchumati supat otii oltau lenye, neitadou oltung'ani torrono ntorrok naaitung'uaa olchumati torrono otii oltau lenye, amu inaabore oltau lo ltung'ani eiro te nkutuk enye.

English: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
Masaai: “Simon, Simon, ng'ura, kitoomonu iyie Shetani neishooki pee kitum ninye aipiripiro, anaa enkano,

English: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
Masaai: Naa te nalo aitobiraki intae ewueji, naitoki ashukunye, naa karikoki intae kewan paa ore enatii nitii sii intae.

English: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, neinyototo olang'eni obo aikilikuanishore, eyieu netem, nejoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, kaji aiko pee ajung enkishui nemeish?”

English: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
Masaai: Ore ilo payian leitu eiruk naa ole Nkai te nkaraki ina kitok enye, naa ene Nkai enkitok te nkaraki ilo oiruko. Naa te neme neijia neaku mme ne Nkai nkera inyi; kake ore enatiu, ine Nkai ninche.

English: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
Masaai: Nintisiny oloikulu lo lasar oyuki, o ena muro aa ninye erubata o lapolosani, nayukoki, naa ninye eishoruaki teilo meregesh oputishoreki amu te nkaraki Aron o te nkaraki layiok lenyena.

English: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gad naa: Sifion, o Haggi, o Shuni, o Esbon, o Eri, o Arod, o Areli.

English: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
Masaai: Nekurraki areiki ajoki pee melikioo.

English: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
Masaai: Teena ina shakenisho, entimishir ina kiteng'enare ti atua ilooiteng'eni laainei.

English: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore mbaa oo layiok lenyena o mbaa kumok naaibarieki ninye, o ne nchetata e nkaji e Nkai neigeroki too limunot tiatua embuku oo laiguanak. Neitoreisho Amasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
Masaai: Nenapuni seseni lenye aayau Shekem nenukari te nkurare apa nainyiang'ua Abraham ainyiang to layiok le Hamor te Shekem te nkosholai.

English: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eitobiru ninye enkop tenebo nkong'at enyena arashu enterit e dukuya e nkop.

English: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
Masaai: Eibalunye Olaitoriani enkisulata enye, eibalunye ninye enkitoo te dukuya iloreren pooki.

English: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king's house, and spake to the king, saying,
Masaai: Nelo Ebedmelek te nkaji o laiguanani nejoki olaiguanani,

English: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanapat naajo, “Miloloito, miaar metua, mipurrisho, ming'uar” o kulie ake kitanapat, naa kulo rorei ooitululung. “Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.”

English: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
Masaai: “Tinirrinyunye iyie, Israel, Olaitoriani ojo, naa nanu irrinyokino. Tiniwuang'ie iyie ilo minong lino, aitung'uaa enatii, nimintoki aing'aing'ai,

English: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
Masaai: Ekapik olomang'ati erishata ino o enkitok. Neijia sii etiu erishata e ishoi ino o eishoi enye. Ekepurd ninye elukunya ino, ore iyie niony entutunyo enye.”

English: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
Masaai: naa ore akenya ina olong nilang'ilang'a olkeju le Yordan aapuo ina kop naisho Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, intae, nintasheyieyie isoito sapuki nimurumuru ninche te nturoto;

English: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
Masaai: Ore eton irorie olaiguanani, najing'u sii nanu te siadi iyie naitisip irorei linono.”

English: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
Masaai: neyau ninche endukuya e Ishboshet, enetii Daudi te Hebron. Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Nena endukuya e Ishboshet, olayioni le Saul, olmang'atinta lino oing'orua apa enkishui ino; eitalaku Olaitoriani elap o lkitok lai olaiguanani ena olong te Saul te ishoi enye.”

English: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
Masaai: Nejoki olaisiaayiani ninye, “Eidimayu metanya enkitok aasuju alotu ena kop, karik olayioni lino arriny ina kop apa ning'uaa?”

English: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD'S.
Masaai: Ninteng'el iyie te nkaraki Olaitoriani nena pooki naatang'asa aabol enkoshoke. Ore ilkikaunot pooki loo nkishu inono oora ilbung'aiko, neaku ilo Laitoriani.

English: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
Masaai: Kake entureita Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa kekordu ninye intae aitupuku too nkaik oo lmang'ati linyi.”

English: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche iyie Olaitoriani, kainyoo incho iyie? Nchoo ninche olkibiroto le ng'uset o lki oo toito.

English: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
Masaai: Te nelaku intae ina Kerai, ilakunono aaitorioki.

English: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
Masaai: Ore nkonyek enyena neikununo anaa olng'ejep le nkima neeta te lukunya enye nkaradan e nkitoria kumok, neeta enkarna nasirakino nemeyiolo likae tung'ani kake ninye ake oyiolo.

English: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
Masaai: Naa ena enkiguana, eewuo ewang'an enkop, kake etonyorra iltung'ana enaimin aaitalang ewang'an amu ai torrok iasat enye.

English: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
