Masaai: Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Miureisho, shomo taasa anaa enitejo; kake tang'asa ntobirakaki enkiti mukate nikiyaki, ore tesiadi ina nintoki taa aitobiraki kewan o enkayioni ino.

English: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
Masaai: nelimana ninche too loshon pooki, nepuo te nkitoria o metabaiki likae orere,

English: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat le shumata naa aironkeni, amu ewaita iltapeeti le shumata erishata sapuk aalang ilgilat liabori o le mpolos le nkaji.

English: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
Masaai: Taanyu Olaitoriani nimbung nkoitoi enyena, amu eikincho ninye esipata nilo ajungie enkop; naa ilo iyie aing'or enkidaata e ilo torrono.

English: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
Masaai: Newalu olaiguanani ajo, “Ayiolo aitisip nchere, erishata intae ing'oruru, enkaraki nitoduaa intae aajo aauno nanu olomoni,

English: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
Masaai: Tenining iyie oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, aibung nkitanapat enyena o nkikoot enyena naaigero tena buku oo nkitanapat, tenirrinyokino iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki.

English: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
Masaai: Naa ti nikintaikiki intae nanu olperere lo lasar loo soito, mishetutu too soito oogueta, amu ti niguetiguete te ntolu nisarkionienie.

English: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
Masaai: Neton ake iatata nkuti arn ti atua Sardis, iltung'ana leitu epik oloirerio nkilani enye, naa kaairiamariyie ninche nanu eishopo nkilani naaibor amu keiririkino ninche.

English: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
Masaai: niking'amaa nena te nashe too nkoitoi pooki o te pooki wueji.

English: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche enetii Hilkia olapolosani kitok, neisho nena pisai apa naayawuaki enkaji e Nkai, apa naatasotutuo Ilawi, ebaiki Manase o Efraim o metabaiki ilo pisiai pooki le Israel o Yuda pooki, o Benchamen, o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche enetii Yoshua too lng'oborri te Gilgal, nejoki ninye o ltung'ana le Israel, “Kietuo iyiook king'ua enkop nalakua; neaku ntobira taata iyie olning'o o iyiook.”

English: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie te keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo sinkan linono, Isiraeli, te nintengen iyie ninche enkoitoi napuo aaim, nincho iyie ninche enchan, naa ninye inchoo iltung'ana linono metaa ninye enjungore.

English: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye enkurriny pooki enkoshoke olkina le moinyua o lairrakuj pokira oare tenebo enkurriny enye, nepejoo Musa ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
Masaai: Eeuo enyamali o sina shumata nanu, kake inkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu.

English: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana naa ilairritak, amu ilaramatak loo nkishu, neyautua intare enye, o nkishu enye o pooki toki naata.’

English: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
Masaai: Ng'ura, king'orutua kuna aajurru, naa kesipa. Toning'o, naa tayiolo ninye te nkaraki esidano nikiyaki.”

English: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.
Masaai: Nebatata Saul nabo kata te nkop aitorriori eiputa enkuretisho te nkaraki irorei le Samuel; nemeekure apa etii engolon atua ninye, amu eitu ninye enya toki endama pooki o enkewarie pooki.

English: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana oota indamunot naapaashaa naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore lelo le meeta entioto too nkoitoi enye naa enchipai te ninye.

English: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Shomo te seriani.” Neaku etudumunye ninye nelo Hebron.

English: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
Masaai: Nejo Samuel, “Amaa keeta Olaitoriani enchipai sapuk too lasarri oopejori o nkishorot, anaa te nening'i oltoilo lo Laitoriani? Ng'ura eisidai ening'oto alang olasar, o enkinining'oto alang ilmeregeshi oopir.

English: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
Masaai: Kuna baa oshi iasita natigirakine nanu; itejo apa iyie kara obo otiu anaa iyie, kake kaaisikong taata nanu iyie, naibalunye mbaa te dukuya iyie.

English: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
Masaai: Etaasate kuna baa te Betania te lido kekun le Yordan, teine apa naibatisishore Yohana.

English: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
Masaai: (Etii sii enkanasa e Hamona netii sii ninye ine). Neaku neijia eiko teneipok ina kop.

English: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
Masaai: neimis ewang'an e nkolong; nepolosa olkarasha orish enkaji e Nkai aaku are.

English: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
Masaai: “Enkena ina umata pooki, oo ltung'ana le Israel, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, too nkajijik oo loo menye, pooki ti atua Siraeli ooidim aashom enjore.”

English: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
Masaai: Eitobiruaki kuna pooki too soito oogol enkinyiang'a, ootaguetaki te risioroto naba anaa enairirikino, neiriri te musumeno, oriong o atua, ebaiki olkitamanyunoto o metabaiki shumata. Ore ebaiki endung'oroto e nkaji o Laitoriani o metabaiki endung'oroto kitok.

English: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Enosh eidipaki aatoiu Kanan ilarin iip isiet o tomon o imiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie,

English: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
Masaai: Etimira sii apa Ilmoabu ootaa isinkan lenyena nelak kodi.

English: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
Masaai: Ore Hesekia o ltung'ana pooki neshipayu tenkaraki ina naitaasa Olaitoriani iltung'ana; amu eewuo ina bae nabo kata.

English: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
Masaai: Ore ti atua empalai neiger ajo, “Tipika Uria enkomom o larrabal ogol, paa intokiki aaitiakunye aaing'uaa ninye, pee etumi aatar metua.

English: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.
Masaai: “Ekaitagol iltung'ana le Yuda; naa kaitajeu enkaji e Yosef. Ekashuku ninche amu aata olng'ur te ninche, naa ketiu ninche anaa keitu aekata ang'as aany ninche: Amu are nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, naa kawaliki ninche.

English: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
Masaai: Neisarkionie ninche ate oleng anaa too nkolong'i e Gibea: keyooki ninye adamu entorroni enye nelo aitame ingok enye.

English: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
Masaai: Amu aibung'a nkoitoi o Laitoriani, neitu nanu te ntorroni aing'uaa Enkai ai.

English: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
Masaai: Eyau ematua e tomon pooki atua enkaji ai nashumishoreki pee eaku ketii endaa atua enkaji ai; entetemaki sii iyie, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani tenemaboloki intae ilusien e shumata, nabuku abori imayianat naadooyo.

English: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
Masaai: Ore inaipuko e lelo kerubi pokira oare naa ntemat e nkaina are enkadoro.

English: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
Masaai: Tinindong ninye te ng'udi, naa intajeu enkishui enye te nemeneng'a.

English: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
Masaai: nemeiture intae ae toki e lelo mang'ati ookesh intae. Ele olmonekie oibala le mutata te ninche kake ole njeunoto te intae, naa Enkai eing'uaa ina.

English: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
Masaai: Nemeitoki aaisarkionie ate aaigil too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye o ntokitin enye torrok, arashu te pooki ake ninye ng'oki enye nabo; kake kaitajeu ninche te pooki rrinyoto enye narrinyo siadi teina ng'oki nataasa ninche, naa kaituku ninche; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.

English: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
Masaai: Nedumu ninche ina kitanyaanyukoto aaiteleiki iloilila lenye, nenap ninye, nepuo aapik ewueji enye, neitasheyie te ine, nemeidim ninye ashomo te ine. Naa te neishiraki oltung'ani ninye, nemeidim atawaliki, aashu eitajeu ninye te nyamali enye.

English: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
Masaai: Aashu doi lapa oora tomon o isiet ootuurokine enkaji naado te Siloam near metuata, ijojo pasa ninche larruok aalang ilkulikae pooki oomanya apa Yerusalem?

English: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
Masaai: Najoki nanu ilo tung'ani oishopo too nkilani naapuyiapui, ilo otii shumata eilo keju, “Kenkata nabaa pee ebau enkiting'oto e kuna baa e nking'asia?”

English: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Masaai: Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha o pooki toki natii atua; o enkop o pooki oomanya!

English: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
Masaai: Neaku etiakitia lalashera ninye, “Tung'uai ene shomo Yudea, pee edol sii ninche looiteng'eni linono isiaaitin niasita.

English: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aitanap iltung'ana lenyena pooki ajo, “Ore pooki ayioni naini too Lhebrania ninang'akiki olkeju oji Nail, kake enchoo intoyie eishu.”

English: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enemetii eng'eno nagut, nemetii ening'unoto nemetii enkikoo, keidim ayau eanyata Olaitoriani.

English: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
Masaai: Kitaasa iyiook entorroni oleng tialo iyie, neitu kimbung nkitanapat, o nkiguanat, o nkikoot apa nintanapa osinka lino Musa.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, te neitu edoiki enkantererai e nkano enkop neye, nebik aa ninye ake openy; kake te neye, neiu ilng'anayio kumok.

English: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Daudi enataasa Rispa entito e Aia ina apiani e Saul,

English: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
Masaai: Ore too Lawi apa naa Shemaia olayioni le Hashub, olayioni le Asrikam, olayioni le Hasabia, loo layiok le Merari;

English: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
Masaai: Kepurd Enkai ilukuny oo lmang'ati lenyena, o enkopiyia naju e nkitoo e ilo olo too nkoitoi enyena torrok.

English: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, til the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
Masaai: Ng'ura ina kop oo Lkaldayo! Ilo orere apa, mme ile Asiria, oopuo aaishooyo Turo metaa enoo lowuarak le ntim. Neirrag ninche aang'adu ninye, nerasaki nena ajijik enyena e nkitoo, neing'uaa ina anasa etaa enkidaata.

English: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
Masaai: nelo sii ilo polosie aikop Tabor, o Shahasuma, o Bet-shemesh, nelo ilo polosie lenye aiting te Yordan - nkanas tomon o ile te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitadou apa Midian Israel oleng,

English: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Kain, “Koree olalashe lino Abel?” Nejo, “Mayiolo, ainanu oshi olairritani lo la lashe lai?”

English: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Yuda oata ilong'oi o remeta naa nkalifuni ile o iip isiet ilturrurri ootanapate.

English: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo Filisti Daudi, “Kara nanu oldia, pee ilotu enatii too ng'udisin?” Nedek ilo Filisti Daudi too nkaitin enyena.

English: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
Masaai: Amu eitu aekata nanu abik te nkaji ebaiki apa ina olong natorikoyie Isirael ometabaiki ena olong, kake ashomo nanu arukoo ilng'oborri, naimaa emanyisho o emanyisho.

English: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
Masaai: Amu ketejo ninche, “Oloirirua oiduruk eeta ninye.”

English: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
Masaai: Neimulumul nkariak ilmang'ati lenye; eitu ninye elo obo.

English: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
Masaai: Neaku mincho esupat te iyie eimakini aajo torrono.

English: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
Masaai: Ore olayioni omoda naa osomit te menye, naa emion nadua te ina kitok natoiwuo ninye.

English: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
Masaai: neitoki olapolosani ajur ninye, ore ake pee eibulayie ilo pepedoi osesen lenye, nemeeta tipat pee eitoki olapolosani aing'oru ilpapit sikitok; amu keiduruk ninye

English: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore ele erata otoyio kaiput nanu enkare.’

English: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie otejo; kake ajoki intae, ore ebaiki taata idolidolo Enkerai e Tung'ani eton te nkaina e tatene naata engolon edou too nkatampo e shumata!”

English: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
Masaai: Enino endama naa enino enkewarie; iyie oitobira ewang'an o enkolong.

English: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lang, kebaa enkitoo e nkarna ino te nkop pooki! Ore enkisisa e nkitoo ino nebaiki keper

English: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
Masaai: Naa kear ninye osempewuet ogol oleng te retoto e nkai omoni. Ore lelo oonyorraa ninye nerup ninye ninche aisho enkanyit. Neitaa ninche ilkituaak te shumata ilkumok naa keor ninye enkop te nkinyiang'a.

English: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
Masaai: Ng'ura etii ilayiok lenye pokira oare te nebo ninche te ine, Ahima-as, olayioni le Sadok, o Yonatan, olayioni le Abiata; naa te ninche kirriwaki nanu pooki toki nining.”

English: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu enkirukoto enye, nejoki ilo oilenye, “Enkerai ai, kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”

English: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
Masaai: neme anaa ilaitoriak ooimagarraki lelo ooishooki intae entaramat, kake aaku enkitanyaanyukoto naduaaya intare.

English: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
Masaai: Neitoki Mikaia ajo, “Entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eton to lorika lenye le nkitoo. Ore olorora pooki le shumata neitashe te mbata enye te nkalo e tatene o te kedienye.

English: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana ng'eni naa keitukurruni, keidang'ieki ninche neyae; Oi, etanyaita ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, naa kaa ng'eno natii atua ninche?

English: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
Masaai: ebaiki iishoritin enye, apa ootelekutua teina kop leitu eidaikie iltung'ana loo Siraeli - neitaa Solomon lelo ilenkisiaayiare nagol, naa neijia etiu o taata.

English: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
Masaai: Mikitamayiana Enkai Magilani, nikintubul aponaa, metaa iaku olorere kumok too ltung'ana.

English: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.
Masaai: o enaisho, o engorno, o nkerra naaitung'uari eluaata te nkaraki Daudi o ltung'ana ootii te nebo ninye pee enya; amu etejo ninche, “Eeta iltung'ana esumash nenaura nenoto enkure ti ong'ata.”

English: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
Masaai: naa shakeni lai olapolosani kitok naa neijia etiu olkiaama pooki loo lpaiyiani. Ninche laaishoo mpala nayaki lalashera, pee adumunye alo Dameski aibung lelo ootii ine ayau Yerusalem eena pee eitamei.

English: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ayiok le Eli naa iltung'ana le pesho; meshilaa apa ninche Olaitoriani.

English: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
Masaai: Maaishiraki ninche nanu too ltauja, kake keyietu ninche aaishir too ndapashi enye; ore te nkaraki enkurma o enaisho nedung ate, naagolong'aki ninche aapaashare nanu.

English: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
Masaai: Neaku meyieu apa Daudi neya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani atua enkanasa e Daudi; kake eiteng'ela Daudi aya enkaji e Obed-e-dom ilo Giti.

English: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu, aatoomono iyie, te nkaina olalashe lai, te nkaina e Esau, amu kaure nanu ninye melotu ake aar iyiook pooki matuata, nkera o noo ngotonye.

English: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
Masaai: “Ng'ura etaa nanu kajo pee ashet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ai, naitisinya nanu ninye apejoki enkorropil, o sonkoyoni naarropil te dukuya ninye. Naishoru nanu anaake emukate enkitoduaarato, naishoru nanu ilasarri oopejori tadekenya o teipa, too sabatoni o too lapaitin ng'ejuko, o too siruai gelunot lo Laitoriani Enkai ang, anaa apa enaiteng'elaki ntarasi te Israel.

English: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

English: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

English: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
Masaai: Neitoki Pilato aipot ilapolosak kituaak o laitoriak lo lorere

English: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

English: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia ore tiatua nena naainyaku ingamura aashu esasha iloisotok niminosinoso kuna: entames amu keinyaku ninye eng'amurai kake mesasha loisotok, mesinya te intae.

English: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
Masaai: Nipik nena bokishi atua lelo giso too mbat o sanduku pee enapieki ilo sanduku.

English: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
Masaai: Nebik Abraham te nkop oo Lfilisti inkolong'i kumok.

English: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.

English: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

English: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

English: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.
Masaai: Nawaliki ajoki ninche, mme olkerreti lang Iroma ilo oishoori oltung'ani eitu etumo nkomomi e lelo ooitang'oro, ooisitaare, netum oloitang'oroki erishata namitunye kewan newalu nena naaisitaarieki.

English: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
Masaai: Ore epuo te nkoitoi, nejoki oltung'ani obo Yesu, “Ekaasuj nanu iyie pooki wueji nilo.”

English: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

English: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

English: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
Masaai: Kake meetae osina te ina apa naata emion. Ore too nkatitin e dukuya neishoo ninye metemenare enkop e Sebulon o enkop e Naftali, kake ore too nkolong'i e siadi naa keisho ninye meitaai kitok ina oitoi e naiposha, ina kop natii lido kekun le Yordan, Galilaya oo loreren.

English: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

English: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

English: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
Masaai: Na kera kutiti, irara intae ine Nkai, nindipa aatimir ninche; amu ore ilo otii atua intae naa kitok alang ilo otii atua ena kop.

English: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
Masaai: Nchoo naa ninche eibung nkitanapat aainei, pee menap ing'ok te nkaraki ninye, neye ninche teine neisarkionie nkitanapat aainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.

English: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa enatiu enaisho oo sabibu te nkimarrimarrati nejo ninche, Minyal ninye, amu etii emayianata atua ninye’, neijia alo aas te nkaraki osinka lai, nemaidaikie ninche pooki.

English: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
Masaai: Neya Eliesa, olayioni le Aron, ayam entito nabo oo ntoyie e Putiel; neiki ninye Finihas. Kuna ninche lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo Lawi too lmareita lenye.

English: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
Masaai: “Atolikio intae kuna baa pooki pee merrorri intae.

English: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku meekure eisudoroyu, neshetaki ninye enkikapu naitobiraki too seyia nemur te ntoki naji laam; nepik ninye enkerai atua paa kepik ina kikapu atua iseyia te mbata o lkeju.

English: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

English: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

Masaai: Ore ina ululu oo ldoinyo laainei nemeitoki aponari agutu neaku keibung'are isunta pokira oldoinyo, nitumutumu aaisika anaa apa ina kata nisikisiki aailany olokirikiri too nkolong'i e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda. Ina pee elotu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo lelo pooki sinyat eboitare ninye.

English: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

English: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

English: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
Masaai: Keaku ina kerai olikirrinyoki enkishui nikintagol te moruao ino; amu ore ina tito o layioni lino nikinyor iyie, nelang ninye ilayiok oopishana, netoiuo ninye.”

English: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
Masaai: Toning'o taata, aatoomono iyie, olkitok lai olaiguanani nchoo esayiata ai enkanyit elotu dukuya iyie, nimikingil nanu areu enkaji e Yonatan olaigeroni, maye ake nanu teine.”

English: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

English: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
Masaai: Naa inosinoso nena pooki naapir o entaraposhoto, niokioko osarge o entemerata, teina masho olasar naitobiraki intae.

English: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
Masaai: Keishunye enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi? Keeuo enkiting'oto oo nkisiligat enyena nkatitin pooki?

English: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

English: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
Masaai: Ore apa nena kikompeni naatii ilukuny e nena ng'apeta neitobiruaki anaa ntapuka, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina.

English: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
Masaai: Nepuo ilkipaareta enkop e Israel pooki o Yuda eeta mpala naaing'uaa olaiguanani o ltung'ana lenyena kituaak, anaa enaitanapishe olaiguanani, ejo, “Lo tung'ana le Israel, entorrinyokinoto Olaitoriani, Enkai e Abraham, o Isaak, o Israel, pee eitoki sii ninye arrinyokino ilo pisiai linyi, apa otelekua too nkaik oo laiguanak le Asiria.

English: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
Masaai: “Aimitiuu intae anaa Olosho le Etiopia te nanu, intae lo tung'ana le Israel?” Olaitoriani ojo. “Keitu nanu aitayu ailepunye Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri naitung'uaa Ilfilisti Kafta naitung'uaa Siria Kir?

English: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
Masaai: Meeta tipat niarishore iyie tele arrabal; ntasho ake duoo, ntirring'ayu pee idol enkisulata o Laitoriani, te rishata ino. Iyie Yuda o Yerusalem.’ Miureishoyu nimilepori. Ore taisere tadoi shomo tigilunore ninche, naa keaku Olaitoriani tenebo intae.”

English: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
Masaai: Neitoki ninye adamu nkolong'i e apa moitie, e Musa ilo sinka lenye. Koree ilo apa oyaua ailepunye te naiposha lelo shekuti loo nkerrai enyena? Koree ilo opik atua ninche enkiyang'et enye sinyati,

English: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bigfai, Utai o Sakur, netii tenebo ninche ilewa ntomoni naapishana.

English: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
Masaai: Misiri, o Yuda, o Edom, lelo ayiok le Amon, o Moab o lelo pooki, oomanya olpurkel oiriri ilpapit lenye! Amu ore kulo oshon pooki nememurata, ore enkaji pooki e Israel nememurata iltauja.”

English: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
Masaai: Nemir Abimelek ninye, neisik ninye te dukuya Abimelek, nebatata ilkumok ootipikaki ilbaa, o metabaiki enejing'ieki kishomi.

English: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
Masaai: Neitu ninche eidaikie iltung'ana, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninche,

English: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye o nena toyie oo layiok lenyena pee errinyo te ina kop e Moab, amu etoning'o apa ninye te ina kop e Moab nchere etumutana Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena neisho ninche endaa.

English: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore sii nena nintoipiepie ate naa kapolos aiwuang'ie, naitajeu iltung'ana laainei aitung'uaa nkaik inyi, nemeitoki aekata aatii nkaik inyi anaa eng'ues naibung'aki aanya; niyiolouu ina kata aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
Masaai: Kake ore eitashe ilooiteng'eni aamanita, neinyototo, nejing ina anasa: ore pee ekenyu nepuku o Barnaba aapuo Derbe.

English: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
Masaai: Nemeing'unung'unieki hoo enkawuo enye, neitaariyiani inkaik enyena, inkaik Olmagilani le Yakobo (Te nkarna e ilo Shekut, Endapidapoi e Israel)

English: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
Masaai: Ntalaa katitin naapishana lelo le latia ang too lgooitie lenye nena kilapat apa nikilapa ninche iyie, Olaitoriani!

English: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye ear nkera e lelo tung'ana oata iloikop, te risioroto e nena naaigeroki te mbuku oo nkitanapat e Musa. Teine apa neitanapishe Olaitoriani ajo, “Meari iloo menye metuata te nkaraki nkera, nemeari nkera metuata te nkaraki loo menye; kake keye ake pooki ng'ae te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.”

English: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
Masaai: pee masul ake aoru ilkilani naitotiu ninye anaa ina olong apa naini, naitotiu ninye anaa ong'ata, naitotiu ninye anaa enkop natoyio, naar ninye te nkure.

English: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
Masaai: nena dapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o noo nkineji naaitushurieki o lkarash lo liatua oodung'ieki;

English: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
Masaai: “Ore olong'amaa intae, nanu etang'amayie, ore olaang'amaa nanu naa ilo lairriwua etang'amayie.

English: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
Masaai: Enetii Papa aing'uaa, nalotu enkop; naa kaitoki aing'uaa enkop alo enetii Papa.”

English: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
Masaai: Embalunye enkitoo enye ti atua loshon, embalunye isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia ti atua iloreren!

English: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel ore pooki tung'ani loo ltung'ana le Israel aashu o le lelo omon ooidurrakita aamany atua Israel, oishooyo nabo oo nkera enyena aaisho Molek neari metua; ore iltung'ana lena kop near ninye too soito.

English: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
Masaai: teng'eno ino nagut e biashara itoponayie imasaa inono, netawuase oltau lino too masaa inono,

English: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
Masaai: A-a, ore ti atua iltauja linyi nidamumu ntorrok; niasiasa ntorrok too nkaik inyi te nkop.

English: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
Masaai: ebaiki Edom, o Moab, o Ilamoni, o Ilfilisti, o Amaleki, o naaing'uaa iyarunot e Hadadesa olayioni le Rehob, olaiguanani le Soba.

English: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
Masaai: Kaaidapash nanu iyie anaa suut, naayaita olkutati oing'uaa olpurkel.

English: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
Masaai: Neaku, intae ooinyalisho, ninyal sii lalashera!

English: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
Masaai: Nejo, “Kelak.” Ore pee ejing aji nemurutoki Yesu aikilikuan ajoki, “Ijo aa Simon? Ai ng'ae eitalak ilkituaak le na kop kodi oo masaa arashu enoo ltung'ana, ai nkera enye ana ineeiking'a.”

English: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
Masaai: Ore egira aapuonu ang, ina kata pee eshukunye Daudi eing'uaa esesekuanata e ilo Filisti, neipang'u nkituaak aapuonu too nkanas pooki e Israel, eranyisho neiguran pee enang'are olaiguanani Saul, too ntampurini, o too sinkolioitin le ng'ida, o too nkinantani oo sinkolioitin.

English: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ilo rorei nejo, “Oi intae ilooti enkirukoto, ainyoo pee ijokinono maate mukateni miaatata?

English: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ's servant.
Masaai: Ore oloipot Olaitoriani aa orrindik netaa ilo ololakuno lo Laitoriani; ore sii ninye ilo oipotoki elakuno netaa orrindik le Kristo.

English: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
Masaai: Nejo, “Ainosa nanu olmumai te nkewan ai ejo Olaitoriani, ore amu itaasa ena neitu imit enkayioni ino aa ninye ake iata,

English: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani aipotisho nejo, “Samuel!” Nedumunye Samuel nelo enetii Eli, nejo, “Nele nanu, amu kimpoto.” Kake etejo ninye, “Eitu nanu aipotisho, Enkayioni ai, nyaaki irraga.

English: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Saul naa Yonatan, o Ishfi, o Malkishua; ore nkarn oo ntoyie enyena pokira are ninche kuna; eji ina kikau Merab, neji ina kiti Mikal;

English: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
Masaai: Ore isunta eina aji neikodi aaguetaki ilkerubi oltuka o ntapuka naalaa, neikodi too lgilat o tioriong o too liatuani.

English: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.
Masaai: nintaasiasa ninye ina duoo nayieu ninye neitaas olalashe lenye, pee itum aaibooi entorroni te mpolos inyi,

English: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye atem olgoriet le kishomi, intemat enkaina isiet;

English: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
Masaai: Ore osesen lai naairuja ilkuru o loirerio, negolu olchoni lo sesen lai, neitoki adanya.

English: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninche atua ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, neirragie ninye te wueji enye, ti atua olng'obor otuuno Daudi te nkaraki ninye; neishoru Daudi ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
Masaai: Mebik osinka te nkaji o kenya; nebik enkerai o kenya.

English: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
Masaai: Te nchakenisho oo lchakenini oare aashu ilchakenini okuni eari ilo oye metua; meari oltung'ani metua te nchakenisho oltung'ani obo.

English: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
Masaai: Etubulua emowuo nabo teina kiti mouo, natubulua oleng aipir enkalo e kopikop, neipir enkalo o loo saen neipir ina kop kitok.

English: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i naapishana, enosa imukateni neitu eisuijieki, ore te nkolong e naapishana neaku osirua to Laitoriani.

English: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, tapalakaki entorroni ai, amu ai sapuk.

English: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
Masaai: Keidim aatabatata iltung'ana enkalifu nabo te mbata ino, nebatata nkalifuni tomon te nkalo ino e tatene, kake mikinyikaki iyie.

English: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance,with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ilo asar opejori kitok, netii eilata o lasar le seriani, netii ilasarri oopikuni tenkaraki ilasarri oopejori. Neikoni neijia aarrinyu enkisiaayiare e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
Masaai: Anyok aas anaa enaidim, paa ore ninye aidipa ashomo, nindimidimi aatadamu kuna baa inkatitin pooki.

English: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
Masaai: amu keyiolo apa olokaldaa. Ina pee etejo, “Mirara tuani intae pooki.”

English: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
Masaai: Kake ajoki intae, etii ene entoki kitok alang enkaji e Nkai.

English: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
Masaai: Kaa naa kijo te na? Amaa te netii Enkai enkalo ang, kalo oidim atigilunore iyiook?

English: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
Masaai: Neme keitoki ninye aigiligil aishooyo kewan, anaa enaiko ilo apolosani kitok ejing atua ine Wueji Sinyati anaake to lari eeta osarge leme o lenye;

English: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
Masaai: Nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki oljurum lo ldoinyo te nkalo e kopikop e Ekron, neitoki ilo polosie aloja nemanaa o meshomo Shikeron, negiroo alo o metabaiki Yabneel; nelo ilo polosie o meiting'oki enaiposha.

English: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
Masaai: Naa ore iyie, ena nara mijooni, kainyoo intodolu nchere, eji nchopo iyie too nkilani sinteti, nchere inkod iyie kewan too masaa e sahabu, nchere isir iyie nkonyek inono? Te mpesho iyie ikus kewan kimen iyie isanchan linono; eing'oru ninche enkishui ino.

English: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Kake eipotuo Yesu enetii nejoki, Enchoo nkera epuonu enatii emimitiki; amu enoo naatiu anaa kuna enkitoria e Nkai.

English: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo ilayiok o ntoyie naaini tene wueji, o tiaalo ntomonok naatoiwutuo ninche o lpayian ooiu ninche tiatua ena kop:

English: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
Masaai: Enaikash ti niata oltau obor te nebo ilaisinak alang tiniorioro iyarunot te nebo iloowuasa.

English: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
Masaai: Ore tadekenya pee eipang ninye alo boo, neitashe ajoki iltung'ana pooki, “Miatata intae entioto. Nanu apa otarresho olkitok lai, naar ninye metua; kake aing'ae natara metuata kulo pooki?

English: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oitoreisho; nchoo meikirikirata loreren! Etonita ninye to lorika le nkitoo too lkerubi; nchoo meikirikirayu enkop!

English: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani Daudi olkilikuai lenye enetii Sadok o Abiata lelo apolosak nejo, “Entiaaki ilpayiani le Yuda, ‘Kainyoo pee iakuku ile bayie te nchukokinoto o laiguanani enkaji enye, eidipa ororei le Israel pooki aeu enetii olaiguanani?

English: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
Masaai: Ore obo oilanyishe, eewuo ainosaki Abram Olheburaniai omanya ina kata embata oo lkeek oonyanyukie ilng'abolo te Mamre o Lamori, olalashe le Eshkol o Aner, laa ilootoning'ore ninche Abram.

English: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
Masaai: Ilo iyie airo nena pooki naaitanapa; ore Aron olalashe lino nejoki Farao meishoo iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo aaing'uaa enkop enye.

English: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
Masaai: ore pee edol ajo metii enkayioni tenebo iyiook, neye ninye, neyau isinkan linono ilpapit ooibor lo sinka lino papaai lang to sina enemeneng'a.

English: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, maata nanu enchipai te keeya e ilo torrono, kake peyie eibelekenya ilo torrono te nkoitoi enye peyie eishu; imbelekenyunye, imbelekenyunye too nkoitoi inono torrok; ainyoo doi peyie iye iyie, oi naaji e Israel?

English: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.
Masaai: Neipang'unye ninye ilo ayioni lo laiguanani neishopoki enkopiyia e nkitoo, neisho ninye enchakenisho, neibalunyeki ninye aaitaa olaiguanani nebukokini eilata aaput. Neosh ninche nkaik ejo, “Metobikoi olaiguanani.”

English: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
Masaai: Kake ore endaa nagol naa enoo ltung'ana botoro, ene lelo ooiteng'enaki to lmoo metayiolo aatirishu isupati o ntorrok.

English: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
Masaai: Neinyototo Yakobo too njo enyena nejo, “Esipa etii Olaitoriani ene wueji, neitu duoo ayiolou.”

English: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
Masaai: Nejoki Esau Yakobo; “Etaa kaye te sumash, inchooki mainosa ina toki nayiera natii emoti. Ore enkaraki ina, neji enkarna enye Edom.”

English: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
Masaai: Ore pooki tung'ani oishoo Enkai masaa o enkarsisisho o engolon pee eshipakino ninche, neng'amaa erubata enye netum enchipai tesiai enye. Ore ena naa enkishoroto e Nkai.

English: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
Masaai: Neigilie aaosh elukunya te ntiyani, nenotaki, negilaki kung aaitaakuno keserem.

English: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
Masaai: Ore apa easayu kuna, nematii nanu Yerusalem, amu ore to lari le tomoni uni oare le nkitoria e Artaserses olaiguanani le Babilon, nashomo nanu enetii olaiguanani. Ore etulusoyie enkiti rishata naomon nanu olaiguanani maaisho mashomo,

English: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
Masaai: “Kake teneirridu ninche ntorrok enye o ntorrok oo loo menye teina suujisho naaitaasa ninche nanu, o teina sii naashomo ninche aapaashare nanu

English: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
Masaai: “Entorrip ate too loibonok le lejare oopuonu enitii eishopito inkilani oo ntare, kake ore atua ninche, naa isuyian ooata enkarri.

English: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
Masaai: Ore ake te nena, katitin nedumunye oloilole leme oti ti alo ena Oitoi.

English: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
Masaai: Etaasa ninche entorroni tialo ninye, meekure ninche aa nkera enyena tenkaraki olminong lenye; eishoi ninche nagolong'u netapong'ori ninche.

English: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
Masaai: Ore ejing'ita empeut, neomon ilo apa otang'asa aata iloiriruani eji pee eisiritore.

English: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
Masaai: Ore apa ara enkerai, nairo, nadamisho anaa enkerai nawalu ana enkerai, ore taata ara oltung'ani botor, naiting'ie mbaa e keraisho.

English: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
Masaai: Ng'ura, neinyototo olkutati kitok te naiposha, metaa keimisie ilopir le nkare empeut; kake keirura ninye.

English: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
Masaai: Amu ore nkiguanat enyena pooki netii dukuya nanu, ore nkikoot enyena neitu nanu aiwuang'ie aitalam kewan.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meetae olomoni olememurata oltau o sesen lenye, o pooki omoni lelo ootii atua iltung'ana le Israel, oojing ewueji ai sinyati.

English: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which shall take it.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Esipa keishoori ena anasa aapik atua enkaina e njore o laiguanani le Babilon neyai ninye.”

English: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
Masaai: “Enkashe sidai Misiri, kake eewuo olojong'ani torrono ooing'uaa moikuape shumata ninye.

English: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
Masaai: Oi naaji tenaa keigeroki te mbuku! nedamuni pooki aiger te mbuku.

English: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
Masaai: Ore apa pee alo enkaji e Shemaia olayioni le Delaia, olayioni le Mehatabel, apa oikenoyioki, nejo ninye, “Manototo iyiook tenebo tiatua enkaji e Nkai, tiatua ewueji sinyati, nikinken nkikeneta e nkaji e Nkai; amu aikipuonu ninche aar iyie tua, kewarie kipuonu ninche aar iyie tua.”

English: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
Masaai: Nepuku anaa enaiko apake, nelo oldoinyo loo Loirienito, nesuj ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
Masaai: Ore anaa enkishorunoto oo lng'anayio le dukuya indimidimi intae aayaki ninche Olaitoriani, kake meishoori ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar aaitaa esong'ouna narropil.

English: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
Masaai: Neiseyie enkutuk ai, nejo, “Ng'ura, eiseyie ena enkutuk ino; eiwuang'ieki entorroni ino, nikitapalakaki ing'ok inono.”

English: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya olapa li okuni anaa pee epuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te nkop e Misiri, ore ina olong nepuonu olpurkel le Sinai.

English: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, oobaya iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “kalo nanu olarrabal aarare Ramot-gilead anaa aimalo?” Nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik o laiguanani.”

English: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
Masaai: Metaa emiureishoyu; kaisho intae eretoto tenebo o nkera inyi.” Neijia eikuna aitisipaki ninche neitagol ninche.

English: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
Masaai: Ore kulo kigerot sapuki lisomama ilatisira te nkaina ai makewan.

English: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
Masaai: Ore lelo lanyor naa kaisikong naitame metaa, tonyuaa naa irridu.

English: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu enkarna ino metoning'oyu too ishoritin pooki, metaa eikisis iyie iloreren ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
Masaai: Nintijing'u emesa, nipik ntokitin enyena aitobiraki; niyau nkitasheta oo ltaai nipik iltaai lenyena.

English: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa keitagol ninche intae, tinidolidolo inkoitoi enye o yasat enye; niyiolouu aajo eitu aas ina meeta enataasie pooki nataasa te ninye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
Masaai: nilo aitayu lelo asarri linono oopejori, nkiri o sarge, te nchumata olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino; ore ilo sarge loo lasarri linono nepuoi aabukoki enchumata olperere lo lasar lo laitoriani Enkai ino, kake indim ainosa nkiri.

English: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
Masaai: kake ore pee euni nebulu, aisul inkeek e ntim, neitayu lng'osil, o metaa kepuonu ntaritik e shumata aapik sinkin oloip lenye.”

English: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
Masaai: pee etum aitadedeyie makewan neitusupat sii ilo oota enkirukoto ti atua Yesu.

English: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
Masaai: Naa kakua etagorokine ninye too larin artam? Aime lelo ootaasa ng'ok, ooitanang'a seseni lenye ilo purkel?

English: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
Masaai: Itejo apa iyie, “Kaaku nanu enkaiguanani ntarasi,” ore enkaraki ina eitu iyie ipik kuna baa atua oltau lino, aashu idamu nkiting'ot enye.

English: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
Masaai: nchoo ilo torrono epaash nkoitoi enyena torrok, ore ilo lemeas isipat nepal ndamunot enyena; nchoo ninye errinyokino Olaitoriani, pee etum Olaitoriani aing'urrie ninye, nchoo errinyokino Enkai ang, amu kepalaki ninye oleng.

English: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
Masaai: nejoki obo linyi ninche. “Enchom te seriani, erowuaja, niraposhosho,” neitu eisho ninche nkolati o sesen, kaa dupoto eata?

English: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
Masaai: Embung'a ake intae entukurraki ina niaatata, o metaba anaa nalotu.

English: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Efrit neitayu Nibas o Tarka; ore iltung'ana le Sefafit nenukaa nkera enye tenkaraki Adramalek o Anamelek nena aitin e Shefafaim.

English: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
Masaai: Ore doi ninye too laisiaayiak lenyena mepik ninye osiligi, ore ilmalaika lenyena neikenaki enkitadiata.

English: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
Masaai: Kake ti niatata olom odua o enyorrata e ate ti atua iltauja linyi, eminya kutukie nimilejishosho aaibooyo esipata.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
Masaai: ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o sitiman imiet le kineji, o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel.

English: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
Masaai: “Ilalashera laainei, enchooki maibalakinye intae ashirraki too mbaa e papa lang Daudi, Etua ninye, nenukari, netii enkurare enye atua iyiook o tene.

English: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him that thou makest thy ways perfect?
Masaai: Ke sikar to Lmagilani tenira asipani anaa ke dupoto te ninye tenira olemeeta eleyiata too nkoitoi inono.

English: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
Masaai: Eirriwua Enkai ai olmalaika neiken nkutukie oo lng'atunyo, neitu ninche aainyal, amu aatoduaki aajo maata entioto te dukuya ninye, o te dukuya iyie sii, laaiguanani, eitu aas entorrono.”

English: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
Masaai: Nedumu olmalaika ogol osoit kitok laaijo oloiwutuutishoreki nenang aki atua enaiposha nejo, “Neijia eikunakini Babilon kitok ina ang kitok esuluni enkop te ngolon, meitokini ae kata aatum;

English: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae apa ooshomo aaipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura ore irorei loo loibonok le Nkai pooki neimaki embae nabo supat tialo olaiguanani; nchoo orerei lino etiu anaa orerei le obo lenye, niro te supatisho.”

English: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
Masaai: Atiripaka ilkuniyiani osesen lai, neirragie engolon ai tiatua enterit.

English: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
Masaai: Amu etaasa ninche inenkiborra oo nkonyek, netii osarge atua inkaik enye; ore too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu netaasa eloloito; neishoo doi ninye endaa lelo ayiok laa nanu etoikitio.

English: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.
Masaai: Ore naa tadekenya keyauni intae aaitinyiku anaa too loshon linyi; ore ilo osho oya Olaitoriani nelotu anyiku anaa too lmareita; ore ilo marei oya Olaitoriani neyauni aaitinyiku anaa too nkajijik; ore ina aji naya Olaitoriani nelotu anyiku oltung'ani ake oltung'ani.

English: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
Masaai: Ae metii sii nkanashera enyena pooki atua iyiook? Kaji enotie ele tung'ani kuna baa pooki?”

English: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
Masaai: Ore enkinyala oo ltorrok naa keoroo ninche aishu, amu etanyaita eas ina nasipa.

English: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
Masaai: “Kake ee kake aiyia ntae lo Farisayo! amu nchoruru ematua e tomon oo ntasimi oo mbenek pooki nipalaa enkiguana oo sipat o enyorrata e Nkai, naa eishiaakino nitaasa nimipalaa nena kulie.

English: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Palu naa: Eliab.

English: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana apa ooipotoki nkarn nedumunye aaya lelo yarunot, o masaa naatarayioki, neishopoki nkilani lelo lemeishopo. Neishopoki ninche nkilani, neisho ninche inamuka, neisho endaa o entoki naok, neyel ninche te ilata. Ore lelo lemeidimari nenapi too sirkon. Neyau ninche enkop enye maate, Yeriko enkanasa oo ltuka. Neitoki ninche aarrinyo aapuo Samaria.

English: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
Masaai: Neton Daniel o metabau olari le dukuya lo laiguanani Sairos.

English: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
Masaai: neitu einepu ilo sesen; neshukunye aajoki iyiook eji etoduaa ilmalaika, ootiaakita keishu.

English: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.
Masaai: Metaa mme nanu, neme lalashera laainei, neme isinkan laainei, neme larripok laasujita nanu, meetae hoo obo oitayio nkilani enyena; neibung'ita ake oltung'ani imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkainaenye.

English: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
Masaai: Eikiyieu niyiolouu intae ilalashera, enataasa empiris e Nkai naishooki sirito e Makedonia.

English: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Kain, o Gibea, o Timna: nkanas tomon te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii Yesu, nedol oladuoo oata oloirrirua eton te ine, eishopo naa biyoto enkorrok enye, oladuoo otang'asa aata empuoto loo loiriruani: neureishoyu ninche.

English: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
Masaai: Ore nena naashal neitu intagoligolo, ore nena naamuoi neitu inchiunyenye, ore nena ng'ojiniaa neitu iruburubu, ore nena naatapong'ori neitu irrinyunyu, ore inaaimina neitu ing'oruru, neaku te ngolon o te nking'odia intoria ninche.

English: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
Masaai: Eisiligishore Enkai te wueji enye sinyati: ejo, “Ore te nkisisa kaor nanu Shekem, naorrior o yerata le Sukot.

English: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
Masaai: Kenyor ninye esupatisho o esipata; ebore enkop pooki enyorrata nauno o Laitoriani.

English: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Mikiaata iyiook mpala nikitang'amaitie eing'uaa Yudea nikimpirta iyie, nimikiaata too lalashera lang ooetuo ene oloinosua aashu eliki iyiook ae torroni ti alo iyie.

English: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
Masaai: Ore te keper te shumata endukuya ino neaku osuyai ore enkop tiabori iyie neaku esekenkei.

English: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
Masaai: naa te ninye eoruni ntiyot pooki ng'ae oiruk ninye, neikenakini esupatisho te Nkai nemetum too nkitanapat e Musa.

English: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
Masaai: Eitu ninche eitobor ate ometabaiki ninye ena olong, aashu eureishoyu, aashu epuo te nkitanapata ai o nkiguanat aainei apa natipika dukuya intae o dukuya loo papaai linyi.

English: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
Masaai: Ening'o oltoilo oishirita: “Ore ti ong'ata ntobira enkoitoi o Laitoriani, Ntorioi to lpurkel enkoitoi tenkaraki Enkai ang.

English: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae olotu anyikaki olng'obor lo Laitoriani neye. Eikindaaya iyiook pooki?”

English: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
Masaai: osinka te neaku olaiguanani, olmodai oota pooki nanya naraposh;

English: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
Masaai: Ore teina kitisinyata e suntai e Yerusalem, neyauni Ilawi too wuejitin pooki meetu Yerusalem aaraposhoki ina kitisinyata te nchipai, o te nkishooroto e nashe o te ranyata e oshoto oo nkinantani, o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, o lwululi loo usin.

English: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
Masaai: Kaarrinyoki nanu iyie, ilarin apa ooinosie emus olmaati enkop, o ntargeet, o enamutisho, o enadung'isho ina jore ai kitok nairriwua nanu atua intae.

English: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
Masaai: Kake kemayian Olaitoriani olaiguanani Solomon, ore olorika le nkitoo le Daudi neitasheyieki te dukuya Olaitoriani ntarasi.”

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare aisiaaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
Masaai: Kake etudumua Barnabas ninye, nerikoki lkipaareta, neinosaki ninche eneikuna pee edol Olaitoriani te nkoitoi, neirorie ninye, o naataasa te Dameski alikioo enkarna e Yesu te mpijan.

English: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
Masaai: Kasuj nanu nkitanapat inono; mikinturraa nanu tukul!

English: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
Masaai: Kake etuno Enkai olkitamanyunoto le nkirukoto, nepik ele mishire ojo, “Eyiolo Olaitoriani lelo oora ilenyena,” neitoki ajo, “Ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani nchoo eing'uaa entorroni.”

English: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
Masaai: Naa tenaa keinining'u arashu eany ening (amu enkaji kiserut ninche) ekeyiolou aajo etii oshi oloiboni atua ninche.

English: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
Masaai: nelotu olkipaaret enetii Saul, ejo, “Isarisaru wou; amu etaara Ilfilisti enkop.”

English: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
Masaai: “Entoning'oki nanu intae ilooing'oru enkordunoto, intae kulo oolilitu Olaitoriani; eng'ura intae ina dapidapoi apa naa ninye etaguetunyeki intae, o ina gumoto oo soito apa natuturunyeki intae.

English: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
Masaai: Newaliki olorere aajoki, “Aiata oloirirua. Aing'ae liking'oru aar?”

English: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
Masaai: Entoning endarata e oshoto enkeene, o ltoilo loo nkejek oo ngarrin enkuetata oo mbartan o elototo oo ngarrin oo mbartan!

English: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
Masaai: Kake te nintodolulu intae ina kidetidet o empukunoto enye, niyookiki aang'amu te nanu nkishorot, o nchuneti o enkanyit kitok. Metaa entoduaaki nanu ina kidetidet o enkibalakinoto enye.”

English: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
Masaai: Ore aitanap intae kuna baa, kaata enamen te intae naa nchere, keinyalisho ntumoritin inyi meretisho.

English: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
Masaai: Eishunye iloing'ok te Israel, eishunye ninche o metaba anaa nilotu iyie Debora alotu anaa ng'otonye te Israel.

English: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
Masaai: o Yesreel, o Yokdeam, o Sanoa,

English: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: nayiolo ajo ore pee alotu enitii intae naa kalotu te mborei e mayianata e Kristo.

English: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
Masaai: Neaku neijia aiko tenaiting'ie enkiborra enye oo nkonyek te nkop peyie etum ing'oruo pooki aaibung'ie ina inkiyiaa nemeitoki aas inenkiborra oo nkonyek anaa enitaasa iyie.

English: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
Masaai: Kake etanya apa Fashiti ina kitok o laiguanani, elotu te ina kitanapata o laiguanani anaa enatolimutuo lelo sunaishi oogelema. Neitagor ina olaiguanani oleng, netiu engoro enye anaa enkima nayupuyup ti atua ninye.

English: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
Masaai: Nintoki sii abukoki eilata ilo moti oitukuoreki o eneitotonieki, nintisiny ninye.

English: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
Masaai: Amu, pasa taa eikoni nji olchani onyori, kaji eikoni olotoyio?”

English: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
Masaai: Neibelekeny ninye inkariak enye aitaa osarge, near isinkir lenye metuata.

English: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: entuala o long'u, o entuala o long'u emanaa te ripata e abori olkila te nkaraki enkisiaayiare; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
Masaai: ilayiok lenyena, o layiok loo layiok lenyena tenebo ninye, o ntoyie enyena, o ntoyie oo layiok lenyena, o eishoi enye pooki eyaua ninye pooki tenebo ninye Misiri.

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
Masaai: nijo inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, oi iyie Sidon, naa kaibalie enkitoo ai tiatua iyie, naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nayau inkiguanat shumata ninye, naibalunye esinyatisho ai tiatua ninye;

English: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
Masaai: netii ake nkikompeni uni naikunuaki anaa intapuka o lgulului, eeta ake nabo eneigululu o entapukai, to lng'osila obo, o nkikompeni uni naikunuaki anaa ntapuka o lgulului, meetae ake ene meeta eneigululu o entapukai, to likae ng'osila, netiu neijia pokira ile ooipang'u te ina kibung'et.

English: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
Masaai: oltoto barrikon, o ltoto pee epiki enkila dorrop o embene o lgoo.

English: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
Masaai: Maata esumash endaa naaijo ina, naa ore pooki toki nanya naaitamuoi.

English: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
Masaai: pee meisarkionie ake eishoi tiatua olorere lenye; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninye.”
