English: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
Masaai: Enaikash oltung'ani oning enkisikong'ata eilo ng'en, alang tenening osinkolio loo lmoda.

English: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eitiship ena bae Olaitoriani, neosh ninye Israel.

English: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
Masaai: Nejoki Isaak papaai lenye Abraham, “Papaai!” Nejo Abraham “Nele nanu enkayioni ai.” Nejo Isaak, “Ing'ura ajo kiata enkima o lkeek paa koree doi olkuo le ker likintainye olasar opejori?”

English: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
Masaai: ore ilalashera lenye oaas esiaai eina aji naa, iip isiet o tikitam o are; ore Adai olayioni le Yeroham, olayioni le Pelalia, olayioni le Amsi, olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Pashur, olayioni le Malkija,

English: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
Masaai: Neaku etubukoko shumata ninye engoro enye, o larrabal kitok; nepik ninye enkima aitaman kake eitu ninye emuso ayiolou; nepej ina kima ninye, kake eitu edamu to ltau lenye.

English: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
Masaai: Metaa ninche ootudumutua nerik olkiu te wueji neji Areopago, ejoito, “Kaa kiteng'enare ng'ejuk ena nilimu amu eikiyieu nikiyiolou?

English: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
Masaai: Ore akenya te nena olong'i o teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, neing'oruni entorroni te Israel, nelai, neing'oruni ng'ok tiatua Yuda, nemetumi hoo nabo; amu kapalaki nanu lelo laleku metaa olpisiai.

English: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Yoshua atua ilo ng'obor le ng'ape e nkatampoi, ore ina ng'ape e nkatampoi neitashe te mbata e kutukaji eilo ng'obor.

English: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
Masaai: Amu te naa keidim anaata apa meekure eitaini. Te naa keitukuoki lelo aseremak, anaata meitoki aayioloiki ate ng'ok.

English: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
Masaai: Ore ina kata earr Laban ilng'oborri naa Raheli apa naawa inkaitin enkaji e Papaai lenye nepik abori olorika otonieki te ntames, netonie ninche. Near Laban olng'obor pooki, kake eitu etum ninche.

English: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
Masaai: Ina apa eitaasa Musa o Aron o lturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel ile Lawi; ore te risioroto e ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa too naaipirta ile Lawi neitaas ninche iltung'ana le Israel ina.

English: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
Masaai: Kakordu nanu ninche te ng'olon e nemeneng'a? Kainyang'u nanu ninche aitung'uaa keeya? Nakeeya, koree ilmeita linono? Nemeneng'a koree enkidaata ino? Eiwuang'ieki olng'ur too nkonyek aainei.

English: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ootii enkop neserem ninye, pooki ngae apa leitu eigeri enkarna enye apa eton eitu eitamanyuni enkop, ti atua embuku e mpuaan e ilo Kuoo le Ker apa otaraki.

English: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enaata Papa enkishui makewan, neijia sii eikuna aisho Enkerai metaa keeta enkishui makewan;

English: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
Masaai: “Olosho le Lawi ake ninye minken, nimisir ninche aiken te nebo iltung'ana le Israel;

English: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, kairriu nanu enkerai, ajoki, ‘Shomo, ing'oru mbaa.’ Ore ake pee ajoki enkerai, ‘Ng'ura ena shoto ino etii mbaa, iyau ninche’; nilotu iyie, amu, ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, keserian te iyie nemetii embatisho.

English: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa keyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, atii nanu tenebo ninche, naa ore ninche, ina aji e Israel naa iltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
Masaai: naa Natan menye le Sabad. Sabad apa menye le Efla naa Efla menye le Obed.

English: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
Masaai: Nejo Yehoshafat, “Aimeetae oloiboni le Nkai tene pee kitum iyiook aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani?” Neitoki obo osinka loo lelo sinkan lo laiguanani loo Siraeli awal ajo, “Etii Elisha olayioni le Shefat ene, laa ninye apa otubukoko enkare nkaik e Eliya.”

English: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
Masaai: Atishipe naleng etabawua Stefana, o Fortunatu o Akaika, amu erishata inyi nimitii etijing'a ninche

English: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
Masaai: Enkerai ai inining'u tukurraki eng'eno ai, irrugu enkiok ino inining'u eng'eno ai.

English: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ilo barnoti apa otiaaka ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Newaliki, “Ara nanu olayioni leilo omoni lo Lmaleki.”

English: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
Masaai: Amu iatata laisinak anaake, naa te niyieuu, indimidimi ake aaitaasa ninche isupati; kake mikiaatata nanu anaake.

English: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
Masaai: Kaibung nanu ti alo ninye ina nyorrata ai nauno ntarasi, ore olning'o lai nemeigusugus ti alo ninye.

English: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
Masaai: Kake ore pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere keeta Enkerai e Tung'ani enkidimata te nkop napalakinye ng'ok.” Nejoki ilo oilenye,

English: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
Masaai: Ipurisho iyie, nintayu loikop, niloloito, ninya olmumai te lejare, nipejoki Baal enkorropil, nirubare kulie aitin neitu iyiolou,

English: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nepik ilkarash oodung'oo kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le manyisho e Nkai.

English: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Yehoiakim etua anaa apa loo menye, neitoreisho Yehoiakim olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
Masaai: Eewa apa Rehoboam aitaa enkitok enye Mahalat entito e Yerimot olayioni le Daudi, apa ole Abigail entito e Eliab olayioni le Yese.

English: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Tanang'aki enkop.” Nenang'aki enkop, neaku ina ng'udi olasurai; neipirri Musa ailany.

English: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
Masaai: Amu kebik nkera oo Israeli nkolong'i kumok meeta olaiguanani aashu olkitok, meeta olasar aashu eng'ape, meeta enkila o lgoo aashu enkitanyaanyukoto.

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, ilo asar lenye le ntapa o lelo asarri lenye ooki.

English: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
Masaai: Neaku kaisho nanu nkituaak enye ilkulikae naisho nkurman enye lelo ooisulu, enkaraki naa ore ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok eeta pooki ng'ae olorok le dupoto te nkoitoi elejare. Eiteru to loiboni le Nkai o metabaiki olapolosani ometabaiki olapolosani meetae ake ole measisho te lejare.

English: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
Masaai: Adamu nanu enkarna ino kewarie, Olaitoriani, naibung nkitanapat inono.

English: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
Masaai: Ore pee etejo Yesu kuna baa, neing'orie nkonyek enyena keper, ajo, “Papa etabawua esaa; intaa kitok Enkerai ino pee kintaa sii Enkerai ino iyie kitok.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Intayu intokitin naarropil, naaji natafi, o shekeli o kelbena; o ntokitin naarropil te nebo olbani osila nerisioroyu pooki.

English: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
Masaai: Newaliki Natanael ajoki, “Rabbi, ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai, Iyie Olaiguanani le Israel.”

English: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
Masaai: Amu itapong'ori anaa intare naaimina, kake itorrinyokinote taata Olchekut naa Olaing'urani loo ltauja linyi.

English: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
Masaai: “Mijo iyie nena kitobirat torrok, nena pooki naajo kulo tung'ana nkitobirat torrok, nimiureyu iyie ina naure ninche, nimimputukuny.

English: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Milo iyie idie o idie anaa olaitang'oroni tiatua iltung'ana linono, nimintashe iyie aitang'or enkishui o lelatia ino: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua te nebo Israel pooki aagiroo Eglon nepuo Hebron; neibung ninche ninye,

English: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
Masaai: Amu keyookini aaiput enkop, te ng'eno e nkitoo o Laitoriani, anaa enaibulua enkare enaiposha.

English: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
Masaai: o lelo kilani ootiripuaki aaikod le Aron olapolosani, o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, te nkisiaayiare enye anaa ilapolosak,

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok, nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’

English: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
Masaai: pee meaku eng'eno e tung'ani eitasheyie enkirukoto inyi kake te ngolon e Nkai eitashe.

English: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
Masaai: Esipa nkitanapat inono eishiaakino esinyatisho enkaji ino iyie Olaitoriani, ntarasi.

English: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul Ilkeni, “Entudumunye, enchom entadoi enchom entung'uai Ilmaleki, mamut ake nanu intae te nebo ninche; amu intodolutua apa intae esupatisho too ltung'ana pooki le Israel apa pee epuonu aailepu aapuku aaing'uaa Misiri.” Neaku etudumunye Ilkeni aapuku ti atua Ilameleki.

English: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
Masaai: Adol ajo eitoriori, eton atii ele ng'obor te nkop, te nainyeiyie intae te nkoitoi e nkitadamunoto,

English: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
Masaai: Amu ilalashera oonyor Enkai kiyiolo aajo etegelua ninye intae,

English: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
Masaai: Kitoning'oitie iyiook ilo wuasa le Moab, enetiu apa olwuasa lenye; ore enkilashilash enye, o lwuasa lenye o ina goro enye - ore enkitokoos enye naa elejare.

English: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo ooure Olaitoriani ejo, “Ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
Masaai: oltung'ani taa otanang'akaki korokoroni, te nkaraki enkitarrikinoto natijing'a ina anasa, o te nkaraki natarishe.

English: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
Masaai: te ninye sii eshomo ainosaki ilomon nkiyang'eta naaena.

English: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie eyieunoto ai pooki, nemeisudoro emion ai te dukuya iyie.

English: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo aiguanani le Amon eitu eshilaa ilo kilikuai le Yepta apa oirriwaka ninye.

English: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
Masaai: Ore Peka ilo kitok lenye le enjore, olayioni le Remalia, nerresh ninye tenebo iltung'ana onom le Gilead ilo aiguanani, near ninye metua te Samaria, too lgilat le nkaji e nkitoo. Neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.

English: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
Masaai: Metaa, te nalotu, nabolu nena naasita, nanu esukeny too rorei le nkarrueisho. Neitu doi eidip ina, etanya ninye makewan eng'amu lalashera, nemitiki sii lelo ooyieu neitoomon nearaa ninche te sirit.

English: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Etoning'o ilapolosak o loibonok o ltung'ana pooki Yeremia eirorita kulo rorei tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
Masaai: O Bakbukia, o Uno, neitashe ilalashera lenye aaipirakinore ninche te nkisiaayiare.

English: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
Masaai: Kake tinimining kulo rorei, ainosa olmumai te kewan ai, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere ore ena aji naa keaku mijooni.

English: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
Masaai: Ore ake pee emutu neisikie nabo kata lelo alashera Paulo o Silas kewarie meshomo Berea. Ore pee ebaya ninche ine nepuo aajing enkaji oo Lyahudi e ntumo.

English: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
Masaai: amu ore enkordunoto e nkishui enye naa kegol, nemeidimi ae kata aainyiang'u,

English: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
Masaai: Iyiolouu intae nchere atii nanu atua Israel, naa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi nemetii likae. Nemeigili aekata aaitukurru iltung'ana laainei.

English: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
Masaai: Neiko sii neijia ilo sarge eisuaaki kunda pokira are, ilo ng'obor o ntokitin pooki naasishoreki te seremare.

English: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
Masaai: Neya ilo apolosani oitayu olasar opejori lo ltung'ani ake ninye olchoni leilo asar opejori oitayio ninye.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu enkuretisho te kewan ino o too lchoreta linono pooki. Kebatata ninche to lalem loo lmang'ati lenye ing'orita iyie. Naa kaishooyo Yuda pooki apik atua enkaina o laiguanani le Babilon; neya ninye ninche eyararoto te Babilon near ninche to lalem.

English: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Miyauu intae lelo yarunot ene, amu ijojo intae pee iyauu shumata iyiook enkitarruroto to Laitoriani aaponiki ing'ok ang o nkitarrurot ang maate. Amu aikitok enkitarruoroto ang maate, netii engoro napi tenkaraki Israel.”

English: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
Masaai: Amaa apa enkibatisare e Yohana ae keper eing'uaa anaa ei ltung'ana? Entawalikiaki.”

English: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
Masaai: Nejo Harbona obo loo sunaishi oogelema ooisiaai olaiguanani, “Ore ninye ilo shata ogorishoreki ooitobiraka Haman Mordekai, laa ororei lenye oitajeuo olaiguanani, neitasheyieki te nkaji e Haman naa intemat onom enkadoro.”

English: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
Masaai: Teneya oltung'ani enkitok olalashe lenye naa embae nemesinya ina netaboluo ninye nkilani olalashe lenye nemetum ninche nkera.

English: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
Masaai: Etiu ninye anaa oltung'ani oshet enkaji, neng'as atur enkop aitugut, neunoki osoit olkitamanyunoto. Ore pee enang'unye enkare nenang'akino ina aji, kake eitu eidim aigusugusie amu enotokoki olkitamanyunoto.

English: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eishu inkirorot, nemaniki Rabeka entito e Betuel olayioni le Milka, enkitok e Nahor olalashe le Abraham elotu eeta emoti to loililai lenye.

English: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
Masaai: kake eshomo kulikae enetii Lfarisayo neliki enataasa Yesu.

English: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
Masaai: Ore intae lelo pooki ooibatisaki aapik atua Kristo ninchopo Kristo.

English: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e are nintayu oloro lemeeta entioto te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki; naa keipoki olperere lo lasar, anaa apa peyie eipoki te ilo oing'oni.

English: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto e nkitoria e Yohoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, ele rorei oewuo eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
Masaai: Kake itaana iyie, Olaitoriani, nesipa nkitanapat inono pooki.

English: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
Masaai: Esipa etii ewueji neturunyeki enkosholai, netii ewueji nesilieki sahabu.

English: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aaku emaupe enkitoo, neaku enkishili e nkishiaa te ilo pisiai loo ltung'ana lenyena;

English: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
Masaai: Inchooki inkituaak aainei tenebo nkera aainei nena naisiaayua te iyie nikincho mashomo amu iyiolo esiaai naataasaka.”

English: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
Masaai: Ore enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, keitoreisho te ngolon, ore enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, kegiligili olmang'atinta.

English: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
Masaai: “Negolu ilo aiguanani le kopikop, kake ore obo loo lkituaak lenyena naa kegolu alang ninye ore enkitoria enye naa keaku enkitoria kitok.

English: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
Masaai: Netum taa ilo pisiai le Yakobo atijing'a empolos oo ltung'ana kumok, anaa enkoiliolio naing'uaa Olaitoriani, anaa enchan nashaiki nkujit nemeanyu iltung'ana anaa nkera e tung'ana.

English: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo nkolong'i uni neipotu Paulo larikok loo Lyahudi te nebo; ore pee eiturrurro nejoki ninye ninche, “Ilalashera laainei, ore hoo nemaata enaitaasa iltung'ana lang, aashu ilkerreti loo loo papa, kake aaishooyioki aena te Yerusalem aaisho nkaik oo Roma.

English: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina natoiwuo nkera naapishana neiterre; etadoyie enkolong enye eton aa dama; eitukurruaki netusulaki. Ore inkera naatelekutua, naisho metaari to lalem te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
Masaai: Amaa ninye nanu, lalashera laainei te naa napaji kemuratare eton alikioo ajo emuratishoi ake, oo naa doi pee eton ake aainosieki nanu osina? Te naa napaji keton aa emuratare alikioo, nemeitoki elikioroto nalikioo nanu osalaba aitagor likae.

English: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
Masaai: Neitoki aye Abdon ilo ayioni le Hilel le Piraton, nenukari te Piraton te nkop e Efraim, te ina kop oo ndoinyo oo Lmaleki.

English: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
Masaai: Ninye oishoo nkatampo meilepa too neeiting'ie enkop, ninye oitobira nkiwuang'at te nkata e nchan neyau olkutati aitung'uaa nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki.

English: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
Masaai: Nepuo te ine neimaa Galilaya. Nemeyieu Yesu neyiolou hoo oltung'ani:

English: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
Masaai: Amu ore ilakir le keper, nemeitoki aaishoru ewang'an enye; nemisimisu enkolong eilepu nemeitoki olapa aitawang'isho te wang'an enye.

English: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
Masaai: Mipon ake ororei lenyena anaa kisikong iyie, nikiyookini aatum aajo ira olalejani.

English: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
Masaai: ore sii ninye ena naa eng'oki naitame ilarishak amu ataa olalejani te Nkai e shumata.

English: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
Masaai: Ore olkeju li okuni naa Tigris, nerukokino enkalo oloosaen te Asiria. Ore olkeju liong'uan naa Frati.

English: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki nepejoo te nchumata o lperere lo lasar, anaa enkurriny olasar loo nkishorot e seriani; neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye too ng'ok enyena, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
Masaai: Te neetae enkiroroto oo lng'ejepa, enchoo aare eiro aairukuruko anaa okuni nimintogiroo ine, naa enchoo eirukuruko, ninchosho oltung'ani obo ewalu, alimu enajo;

English: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
Masaai: Enkanyit telde tung'ani oibooyo kewan aitalam enchankar; kake ore pooki modai nenyor enchankar.

English: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
Masaai: Ore enkerai ng'en nening'u enkiteng'enare e menye kake ore elde asukenyani nemening'u enkisikong'ata.

English: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
Masaai: Ina pee ajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Kaji doi eyaita ina kikapu?”

English: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
Masaai: Ore te nchumata e nkitotonet netii entoki napurupurana aa olpisiai le ntemata e nkaina enkadoro nailep; ore enchumata eina kitotonet, irishinani enyena o nkeek enyena naa entoki nabo o ninye.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Torrinyoyu shomo te nkoitoi ino enkalo e ong'ata e Dameski; ore ake pee ibaya, nilo abukoki eilata Hasael, aput metaa olaiguanani le Siria.

English: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
Masaai: Tining'oru ninye anaa enkosholai, nijurru aing'oru ninye oleng anaa enoshi toki e tipat naisudoro.

English: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
Masaai: inchere maya hoo pito ebaiki enkeene enamuke, anaa toki ino pooki, peyie mijo ake aitaa nanu Abram karsis.

English: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
Masaai: Kake etoduaa ninye Sila ajo keishiakino neton te ine.

English: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
Masaai: Te ng'eno enye eitayio ineegut, ore inkatampo neitadou enkoileelio.

English: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
Masaai: Eidaikieki olng'obor lai, ore nkeenta aainei pooki netudung'ote; naashomo aaing'uaa nkera ainei metii ninche; metii hoo obo oigil akas olng'obor lai, nepik ilkarash laainei.

English: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
Masaai: Emelok injo olaisiaayiani, oi teneinosa enkiti arashu esapuk; kake ore enkuretisho e ilo karsis nemeisho eirura.

English: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
Masaai: neitanap iltung'ana aajo, “Ti nidolidolo intae osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi enapita ilapolosak le Lawi, nipuopuo aaing'uaa iwuejitin inyi aasuj ninye,

English: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
Masaai: Torrinyokinoyioki Olaitoriani, niking'urrie nanu, amu kaliyio naata osina.

English: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena aajoki, “Ainyoo naa pee ejo ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eji eng'as Eliya alotu?”

English: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
Masaai: Newaliki Efron Abraham ajoki,

English: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
Masaai: ina kata aitashe nanu te rishata Olaitoriani o intae teina kata, pee eibalakinye intae ororei lo Laitoriani; amu itureishote apa te nkaraki ina kima, neitu ilepilepe aapuo enchumata oldoinyo. Nejo ninye:

English: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
Masaai: Nepuonu Betsaida. Nerikokini olmodooni, aaomon meiseyie.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
Masaai: Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani, laa ninye apa otokordua Abraham ti alo enkaji e Yakobo: “Meigil ae kata Yakobo adol enkurruna, nemeigil ae kata enkomom enye aipusu.

English: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
Masaai: Neirukoki Ilyahudi ina kitang'oro, neitisip aajo neijia etiu.

English: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
Masaai: Neisik Adoni-besek; kake etimira, neibung ninye, nedung'oo ninche ilmogirrani lenyena loo nkaik o loo nkejek.

English: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
Masaai: Nelo aing'uaa lelo, nejing enkaji o ltung'ani oji Tito Yusto, oserem ninye Enkai, otashare enkaji enye ene ntumo.

English: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Daudi apa ootoikioki ninye te Hebron: Ore olkikau naa Amon, otoiwuo Ahinoam oo Lyesreel; ore oliare naa Daniel, otoiwuo Abigail e Karmel.

English: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
Masaai: Ore peyie elotu ena, naa kelotu ninye, ina peyie eyiolou aajo etii apa oloiboni atua ninche.”

English: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
Masaai: Ore too naaipirta lelo leitu eyamisho nemaata nkitanapat naaing'uaa Olaitoriani kake aliki intae enajo nanu anaa ina naaitaa olng'ur lo Laitoriani oloisiligayu.

English: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou Mordekai nena pooki naataasaki, nepolos Mordekai nkilani enyena neishop ilkuniyiani neelare nkuruon, neipang alo empolos e nkanasa, eyietu to ltoilo sapuk o te mion aishir;

English: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
Masaai: toshoru tenebo iyie pooki toki naishu natii tenebo iyie e pooki sesen, imotonyi, o ng'uesi, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, peyie etum aatoisho aatubul aaiputa enkop.”

English: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
Masaai: Ina peyie aaitijing'u nanu te wueji najing'ieki, ina apa naatii embata eina kishomi, te nkalo e moikuape oo lgilat sinyat tenkaraki ilapolosak; ore teine nadol ewueji te bayie o loontoluo te nkiting'oto enye.

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lasarri ooki te lelo oing'ok, o too lmeregeshi, o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
Masaai: pee aarishieki lelo lemeiruk ootii atua Yudea, neaku sii esiaai ai naisiaai lelo sinyat te Yerusalem enang'amu te lelo sinyat

English: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
Masaai: Taranyisho, iyie shumata, amu etaasa Olaitoriani ina; Entabuaku intae ineegut e nkop; entang'amai entaranyisho intae ildoinyo, o iyie natim o pooki shani otii atua! Amu etokordua Olaitoriani Yakobo, naa kepuoi aaitaa ninye kitok te Israel.

English: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani te nkop, o iyie enaiposha o ntokitin pooki naatii atua,

English: And God spake all these words, saying,
Masaai: Neiro Olaitoriani kulo rorei pooki ajo,

English: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
Masaai: Nebulaki ilkiku lelo sempewueti lenyena nebulaki olkurushashi o suut lelo sempewueti lenyena o nkang'itie enyena naagol. Nelo ine aaku emanyisho oo mbariak ewueji nemany isidan.

English: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yoshua,

English: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo oogolong'u o laing'okok, neidaikieki te nebo, ore lelo ootanyaita Olaitoriani nemuti.

English: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nadol ilmalaika oong'uan eitashe too lubot pokira ong'uan e nkop, eibooyo isiwuon pokira oong'uan le nkop, pee meitoki olkutati akutu te nkop aashu te naiposha aashu akutaki olchani ake pooki.

English: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Pilato ajo meeta ae naidim ataasa, kake keponari ake oloilole nedumu enkare, neisuj inkaik te dukuya olorere nejo, “Maata taa nanu entiyoto to sarge lele tung'ani eng'urai maate ena bae.”

English: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
Masaai: Ore eim Yesu ine nedol oltung'ani oji Matayo, eton te neitainyeki kodi nejoki, “Tusujuaki,” neinyototo asuj.

English: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
Masaai: Torikoki nanu ti atua esipata ino, nikinteng'en nanu, amu ira iyie Enkai e njeunoto ai; amu iyie nanu aanyita endama pooki.

English: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
Masaai: Ore enkomono ai naa nchere pee eponari enyorrata inyi oleng ti atua eyiolounoto o erishunoto oo mbaa.

English: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kadumu nanu nayau metaarare Babilon olorora kitok loo loreren oogol, ooing'uaa enkop e moikuape; naa keitobirakino ninche olarrabal pee earare ninche; ore teine neyae ninye. Eikununo mbaa enye anaa olmurrani arriyia lemeshukunye ninye too nkaik naarook.

English: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
Masaai: Entegelu iltung'ana ng'eni, oodamisho neeta eyiolounoto, te risioroto oo loshon linyi, pee agelu nanu ninche metaa ilaitasheikinok linyi.

English: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
Masaai: Neiputukuny neing'asia nejo, “Amaa kulo tung'ana aime Lgalilaya pooki!

English: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia te nena pooki, ina kata etii ninche atua enkop oo lmang'ati lenye nemamenaa nanu ninche, nemaibayu nanu ninche ometaa kaidaikie nanu ninche katukul nagil osotua o ninche, amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye;

English: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
Masaai: Neriku sikarini ninye atua enkaji e nkitoo naji praitorio; neipotu esikari e sirit nalulung'a.

English: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
Masaai: Nejo kulikae le Yerusalem, “Aime ele doi eing'oruni aar metua?

English: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
Masaai: etaa Yuda ewueji enye sinyati, neaku Israel enkitoria enye.

English: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
Masaai: Nemeleku enkong'u ai, nemaata nanu olng'ur, ekaitame intae te risioroto oo inkoitoi inyi, ina kata etii olminong linyi pooki atua intae. Ina pee iyiolouu aajo ara Olaitoriani ooshisho.

English: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
Masaai: “Nintobir oliaatua too ntokitin pusi o sinteti o mpilei o nkarash e katani napuiyiapui. Neitobir te siaai e nkarriayiano neripakini ilkerubi.

English: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
Masaai: Ore ina bae naa sidai apa oleng te Farao o too laisiaayiak lenyena pooki.

English: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
Masaai: Amu meyiolo ninye ina nayooki aaku, anaa aing'ae oidim atoliki ninye enayooki aaku?

English: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
Masaai: Amu etonyorra Enkai enkop aiko nji o meishoru Enkerai enye nabo, paa ore pooki ng'ae oiruk nemeimin kake netum enkishui nemeish.

English: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche aajoki ninye, “Abraham papa lang.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Te naa irara nkera e Abraham, anaata iasiasa nena naataasa Abraham;

English: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
Masaai: neyuk olapolosani ninche metaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, neaku kuna daiki erubata nasinya to lapolosani te nebo oloikulu oyoki o ina muro naishoruaki; ore te siadi ina neidim ilo lo lmumai atooko enaisho oo sabibu.

English: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau olkurroto oidong'ishoreki le Kidon, neiteleiki Usa enkaina enye ilo sanduku, amu etarrorre apa ilo kiteng,

English: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: kake te neyae aailepie, nedumunye ninche aaidur. Te nkitanapata o Laitoriani eun ninche ilng'oborri, naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani edumunye ninche aapuo; eibung'a apa ninche enkitanapata o Laitoriani, ina kitanapata o Laitoriani naimu Musa.

English: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
Masaai: olng'obor lenye o entoki naitushurieki o enkitushurata enye, o lala oo lolo lenyena, o rubat enyena, o loom lenyena, ing'apeta enyena o neeitotonieki enyena;

English: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
Masaai: Neisiong'a enkishui ino te dukuya iyie ore dama o kewarie iaku ole batisho nimiata osiligi le nkishui, nemeidim aitadedeyie osiligi le nkishui ino.

English: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
Masaai: naa ninye enkisudoroto naisudoyioki too nkatitin o too lajijik kake etabolokoki taata isinyat lenyena.

English: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa oltung'ani ake eng'irra enye, nepik nkimaitie atua neiteleiki enkorropil shumata, neitashe te kutuk aji ilo ng'obor le ntumo te nebo Musa o Aron.

English: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
Masaai: Neaku, ore ninye te moruao o te naaiborru endukuya, na Ai, mikintorraa nanu, o metaba anaa naibalunye enkidimata ino, too ishoritin pooki naapuonu.

English: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Olaitoriani aitaasa olkitok lai te risioroto e nena pooki sidain naairoro ninye ti alo iyie, nikitegelua ninye taa olkitok te shumata Israel,

English: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa etipika Daudi meitasheiki esiaai e Ranyare tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, eidipaki aairragie osanduku lo sotua teine.

English: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
Masaai: Amu enaimin nagut entadekenya enye pooki; amu ilchoreta ninche lo lkirutoto le naimin nagut.

English: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ijo iyie Yakobo, niro iyie Israel ajo, “Eisudoyie Olaitoriani enkoitoi ai, ore esipata ai neitu eshilaa Enkai ai?”

English: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
Masaai: Neitashe Yesu neipot ninche nejoki, “Kaa iyieuu naitaas intae?”

English: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
Masaai: Nesujaa Barak nena garrin o mbartan o enjore o meshomo Haroshet-ha-goiim, ore ina jore pooki e Sisera nebatata te nepi olalem; eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani.

English: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
Masaai: Neitoki ake sii olaiguanani ajoki Sadok olapolosani, “Ng'ura, tushukoyu shomo enkanasa te seriani, iyie o Abiata, te nebo ilayiok linyi pokira oare, Ahimasi olayioni lino, o Yonatan olayioni le Abiata.

English: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
Masaai: Ore te rishata enjing'et o lperere lo lasar, nchoo lapolosak lelo aisiaayiak lo Laitoriani eishir, nejo, “Teleku iltung'ana linono, Olaitoriani, nimintaa enjung'ore ino enkurruna, entoki naimakini tiatua iloreren. Kainyoo pee ejo ninche tiatua iloreren, ‘Koree Enkai enye?’ ”

English: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
Masaai: Eikisilenoki ninye kake misilenoki iyie ninye; keaku ninye endukuya niaku iyie olkidong'oe.

English: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Kingeroki isinyat o lalashera ooisiligayu ti atua Kristo ootii Kolosai. Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang.

English: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
Masaai: paa ore ilo sarge loo loibonok le Nkai, oibukoyioki ebaiki apa pee eitamanyuni enkop, neitalakuni ltung'ana le na ishoi;

English: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: nindim iyie ainosa te pooki wueji, iyie o enkaji ino, amu enkishoroto ino te nkaraki enkisiaayiare ino ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ee kindim.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Iokioko taa ninye enkikompe naok nanu, neibatisae intae te nkibatisa naaibatisai nanu;

English: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
Masaai: “Kaaing'unyung'unyaki akenya ena umata torrono o anu? Atoning'o nanu enking'unyung'uny oo ltung'ana le Israel aaing'unyung'unyaki nanu.

English: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani torrono neing'oru ake inenkarruoisho, keirriwakini ninye olkilikuai otolo metigilunore ninye.

English: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
Masaai: Neoro ina anasa kitok aaku matuan uni, neurori nkanas kituaak oo loreren. Nedamu Enkai Babilon kitok, pee eitook ninye metimita enkikompe e mpijan e ngoro enye.

English: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
Masaai: “Amaa kedung'oki nkitanapat ang oltung'ani enkiguana eton eitu eng'asi aainining neyiolouni enaasita?”

English: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
Masaai: Naa ore anaa enitoduaa lelo kimojik loo nkejek aa esekenkei nashula o enterit neijia etiu ina kitoria kegol ti ae alo neshal ti ae alo.

English: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
Masaai: Kuna ninche inkera e Ana, Dishon o Oholibama entito e Ana.

English: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
Masaai: Naa ore olgoriet otii enkalo najing'ieki enkaji naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam, nerisioro endapasho e nkaji, naa ntemat tomon e nkaina eng'uton te dukuya ina aji.

English: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
Masaai: Eidim pooki lee too layiok le Aron ainosa ninye, anaa enaibalunyeki ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, tialo ilasarri lo Laitoriani oopejori te nkima; ore oloba anaa oloiseyie ninche neaku sinyati.”

English: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
Masaai: netunukayioki ninye, neitopiwuoki te nkolong e uni anaa enajo Lkigerot,

English: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche tadekenya enasirie, nepuo ong'ata e Tekoa; ore epuito ninche neitashe Yehoshafat nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu Yuda o intae iloomanya Yerusalem! Eruko Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee eitasheyieki intae; entoning iloibonok lenyena pee idupoyuyu.”

English: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
Masaai: Naa keshukunye ninche ene te ishoi e ong'uan, amu eton eitu elulung'ayu ing'ok oo Lamori.”

English: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
Masaai: Kepuonu lkumok te nkarna ai, ejo, ‘Nanu ilo!’ neitapong'oo lkumok.

English: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
Masaai: Nereiki aitore ajoki meliki hoo likae tung'ani ena bae nejoki ninche meishoo ninye endaa nanya.

English: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
Masaai: neaku ore pooki ng'ae otoning'o ilo toilo leina tarumpeta neitaa parmetii, nelotu olalem aar ninye, ore osarge lenye naa shumata endukuya enye eaku etii.

English: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
Masaai: Ajo ashe amu maata nanu lkulinyi laibatisa leme Krispo o Gaio,

English: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees that I may also have children by her.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejo Raheli, “Neina enkaisiaayiani ai Bilha; shomo enetii peyie aaiki nanu nkera.”

English: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninche too iishoritin enye, terisioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, naa iltimito le njore, nkalifuni tomoni uni oile, amu eeta apa ninche nkituaak kumok o layiok.

English: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
Masaai: Newaliki Daniel olaiguanani ajoki, “Meetae iltung'ana ang'eni, anaa iloontaleng'o, anaa ilkuyantik, aashu laaing'urak loo lakir ooidim aaitoduaa olaiguanani ina kisudoroto naikilikuanua,

English: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kelo olkuoo le ker o osuyiani aadaa te nebo, neinos olng'atuny nkujit anaa olkiteng; neaku enterit endaa o lasurai. Nemeitoki ninche aata batisho anaa einyalisho te ilo doinyo lai sinyati, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
Masaai: nena baa sapuki nitoduaa iyie too nkonyek inono, nena kitoduaat o nena enking'asia, ina aina magilani, oina aina naitoriori naa ninye kintupukunye Olaitoriani Enkai ino; naa neijia elo Olaitoriani Enkai ino aiko te lelo oreren pooki liure.

English: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu atua olodung'oro li atua te nkalo e kishomi e kopikop, netem ninye ina kishomi e kopikop; naa erisio apa o nkulie.

English: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.
Masaai: Amu einosa apa osinka lino olmumai atii Geshur natii Aram, najo, ‘Esipa te naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ashuku Yerusalem, naitayu nanu eseremata to Laitoriani.’ ”

English: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metaluama enkidaata! Naa nchoo ilo rreshet oisudoitie ninche meibung'a ninche; nchoo ninche metadoiki enkidaata!

English: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Masaai: Wou naa matoning'oto te nebo, Olaitoriani ojo; ore hoo neyia ing'ok inono anaa enkarasha nanyokie, keyooki aaiboru netiu anaa enkatampoi naibor oleng ore hoo nedo anaa osarge, keyooki aaiborru anaa ilpapit loo ntare naaibor.

English: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
Masaai: Naa tenikirikino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nilo arubare kulie aitin nisiaai ninche niserem ninche, kaaunoki nanu aikok ena olong nchere ilo ake aidak.

English: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
Masaai: Keibor onyek ninche pooki; eikununo ninche anaa ewueji nepejieki imukateni nainuaaki, ore ilo oasishore nepal eitu ekut ebaiki ina kata naipurji o metabaiki ina kata naisuijieki.

English: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye olmodai tenelo te nkoitoi, nemeeta endamunoto, neliki pooki ng'ae ajo olmodai.

English: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
Masaai: nelo olapolosani ajur, ore lelo tipot lo lchoni lo sesen lenye nemeibor oleng, naa ilgeet ootijing'a osesen lenye; meeta ninye olduruk.

English: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie aboina aing'or enkalo o loo ntoluo o meshomo Asnot-tabor, nelo te ine o metabaiki Hukok, nelo aikob Sebulon te nkalo e kopikop, neikob, Asheri te nkalo o loo ntoluo; neikob Yuda te nkalo o loo saen le Yordan.

English: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile easi esiaai inyi, kake ore te nkolong e naapishana nitumutumu sabato sinyati e nkiyeng'iyeng to Laitoriani; ore pooki ng'ae oas esiaai te ina olong neari metua.

English: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Nebik Yehoshafat te Yerusalem; nelo ninye tiatua olorere, ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki ina kop oo ndoinyio e Efraim, neyau ninche aarrinyoki Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
Masaai: Tenijing'ijing'i intae atua osina, nepuonu kuna baa pooki shumata intae too nkolong'i e siadi, nirrinyokinono intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye,

English: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
Masaai: Te nedol oltung'ani ajo keitanyamalita entito shoruet enye nemeyiolo likae lee, naa te nerrish naleng eyieunoto, nchoo eyama; eitu eas eng'oki.

English: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
Masaai: Ore oltau le ilo opuny netum mbarakinot, ore olng'ejep le ilo oiramiram neiro aitorioki.

English: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?
Masaai: Keitu ninye eiwang'ie Hesekia iwuejitin o lperereni loo lasarri neitanap Yuda o Yerusalem ejo, “To lperere obo lo lasar intae enteserem naa te nchumata enye intae entayutu ilasarri?”

English: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
Masaai: nchere ore ina torroni apa naitaasaki lelo ayiok pokira ntomoni naapishana le Yerubaal naa kelotu osarge lenye shumata Abimelek olalashe lenye, laa ninye apa otasesekuana ninche, o shumata lelo tung'ana le Shekem laa ninche apa ooitagolo nkaik enyena metesesekuana ilalashera lenyena.

English: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?
Masaai: Newaliki Ahimelek olaiguanani ajo, “Naa kaing'ae ti atua isinkan linono pooki oisiligayu oleng alang Daudi, kaing'ae olaputani lo laiguanani, olkitok oitasheiki lelo likirrip iyie, neyanyiti ti atua enkaji ino?

English: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
Masaai: Nenyor apa Yesu Marisa o enkanashe o Lasaro.

English: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Boas ninye ajoki, “Ore nena pooki nintaasa enkaputani ino ebaiki keeya o lmoruo lino aatolikioki nanu aaitobiraki, o ina apa nitung'uayie papaai lino o yieyioo lino o enkop inyi nilotu enkop oo ltung'ana apa limiyiolo.

English: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
Masaai: Neitanap ninye Gehasi ajoki, “Mpotu ena kitok e Shunam.” Neipotu Gehasi ninye. Ore ake pee elotu ina kitok enetii Elisha, nejoki ninye, “Tudumu enkayioni ino.”

English: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
Masaai: “Nening Olaitoriani irorei linyi ina kata apa pee kirorierie nanu; naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Atoning'o nanu irorei le kulo tung'ana likitiakitia ninche; eiroro ninche te sipata nena pooki naatejo.

English: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
Masaai: Benkeber, apa te nkop e Ramot-gilead (eeta apa ninye nkang'itie e Yair olayioni le Manase apa naatii Gilead; neeta sii olkerenket le Argob, otii enkalo e Argob, tiatua enkop e Basham, nkanas ntomoni ile kituaak naasheta sunta o nchomito o suyai);

English: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
Masaai: Toning'o esipata, iyie Olaitoriani; toning'o enkishirata ai! Nchoo enkiok ino enkomono ai naing'uaa enkutuk nemetii elejare!

English: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
Masaai: Neiro ninche entorroni ti alo Enkai, ejo, “Keidim Enkai aisalaashaki iyiook emesa tene tiong'ota.

English: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye to ldoinyo le Hor nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Salmona.

English: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata nebau lelo sinkan le Daudi te nebo Yoab eing'uaa enjore, neyau iyarunot kumok te nebo ninche. Kake metii apa Abna te nebo Daudi te Hebron, amu eishoo ninye meshomo, nelo ninye te seriani.

English: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitaa parmetii enkikoo naa kewan emen, kake ore ilo oning'u enkikoo netum ening'unoto.

English: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
Masaai: Lo payiani, entonyor inkituaak inyi, anaa enatonyorra Kristo esirit neishooyo kewan te nkaraki ninye,

English: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
Masaai: ore pooki oishu laairuk nanu nemeye ntarasi Iruko iyie kuna?”

English: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Enkai olasurai, “Ore amu itaasa ena, kitediaaki iyie aaitulus too nkishu pooki o ng'uesi pooki entim, keaku iserpepiari te nkop, naa enterit ninye endaa ino, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino.

English: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
Masaai: Ore te sipata Olaitoriani, eitomijoono laiguanak le Asiria iloshon pooki o nkuapi pooki.

English: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki, “Ng'ura, kaaipang alo aing'uaa naa kaaomonoki to Laitoriani peyie elo emus oo lojong'a aing'uaa Farao, neing'uaa ilaisiaayiak lenyena, neing'uaa iltung'ana lenyena taisere; enyor ake nemeitoki Farao alej iyiook, amitiki iltung'ana meshomo aapolosaki Olaitoriani.”

English: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, lelo pooki ooidim aatijing enkisiaayiare, pee easisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
Masaai: Ore lelo ootunokoki atua lkiku; naa lelo ooning ilo rorei,

English: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kaja mukateni niatata intae? enchom eng'urai.” Ore pee eing'oraa neyiolou, nejoki, “Imiet o sinkir aare.”

English: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
Masaai: Keaku iorro mbat o lkeju le Nail, ore nena tokitin apa naatuunoki te mbata olkeju netoyu, nekutaa osiwuo.

English: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
Masaai: Itii apa iyie Eden, ina kurma e Nkai; ore apa pooki soit ogol enkinyang'a naa ninye intoipore, isoito ooji Karnelian o Topas o Yaspa o Krisolit o Beril, o Oniks, o Safire, o Karbunkol, o emerald; ore sahabu nasiluno naa ninche apa ininono, ninche apa isoito liguetiguete, ore teina olong apa nikintobiruaki iyie ina kata eitobiruaki sii ninche.

English: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Aajoki, Petero, meru olkuku ade taata, eitu kimiki iyie, katitin uni ajo mikiyiolo.”

English: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
Masaai: Ore ina natii, naa kelakua oleng negut, egut oleng; aing'ae oidim anoto?

English: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilooiteng'eni lenyena neirut oleng nebatata aairrabalakino enkop.

English: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Annas ninye eena enetii Olapolosani Kitok Kaiafas.

English: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
Masaai: Nedol Ham laa ninye menye le Kanaan emasipaisho e menye. Neliki ilalashera lenyena aare te boo.

English: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: neitaa iyiook kituaak, o lapolosak le Enkai Menye lenye, metaa enenye enkisisa o enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
Masaai: Keaku Hasor emanyisho oo mbariak, olmuaate loo ntarasi. Meetae oltung'ani olo aton tiatua ninye.”

English: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
Masaai: Naapik olgisoi enkume ino, naapik imuna nkiyiaa inono, napik emaupe enkitoo sidai endukuya ino.

English: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
Masaai: Magirakino nanu eitu alimu irubat oo nkejek enyena, arashu engolon enye, arashu ilo ning'o lenye.

English: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
Masaai: Naa te nelotu oltung'ani omoni aton te nebo ntae neyieu neitaiki Olaitoriani osirua le ng'iroroto, nchoo metumurati ilewa lenyena pooki. Kake meetae oltung'ani le memurata onya.

English: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
Masaai: Enkidaata, enkidaata, kaitobiru nanu enkidaata; metumi ninye eneima ninye o meeu ninye aa enenye esipata; naa ninye aisho nanu.

English: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak o Lawi neitisiny ate; neitisiny olorere, o nchomito o esuntai.

English: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
Masaai: Ore ilo oar eng'ues metua, nelak enkishui ake o te nkishui.

English: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kebaa enkumoi oo siaitin inono! Te ng'eno iyie intobira pooki; ebore enkop seuseu oo ntokitin inono.

English: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
Masaai: Mias iyie ina to Laitoriani Enkai ino; amu ore pooki toki nara olminong naiba Olaitoriani eitaasa apa ninche nkaitin enye; amu kepejoo doi ninye ilayiok o ntoyie enye te nkima aapejoki nkaitin enye.

English: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
Masaai: peyie etum aashomie nkitanapat aainei, neibung inkitanapat aainei neyanyit ninche; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.

English: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
Masaai: Naa keaku olkiyioi sapuk ti atua enkop pooki e Misiri, leitu ae kata eaku nemeitoki ae kata aaku.

English: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
Masaai: Nenap isinkan lenyena te ngarri oo mbartan neya Yerusalem, nepuo aanukaa ninye te nkurare enye, tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi.

English: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
Masaai: Nejoki Sarai Abram, “Ng'ura sii ake, aatudung'o Olaitoriani eishoi, shomo enetii enkaisiaayiani ai, amu ebaiki natum inkera te ninye.” Neiruk Abram oltoilo le Sarai.

English: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Marisa nchere elotu Yesu nelo anang'are; kake etotona Mariamu ti aji.

English: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ing'ura, atamorua nemayiolo enkolong naye.

English: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
Masaai: Nedol ilkituaak le Farao ninye, nepejoo te Farao, neriki ninye enkaji e Farao.

English: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
Masaai: Eng'urrie olikae olikae entaa loonana oishuaa, entapalakinoto olikae o likae anaa enatapalaka Enkai intae ti atua Kristo.

English: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
Masaai: Neirriwaa metolikioi enkitoria e Nkai, neishiunye iloomueyiaa.

English: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
Masaai: ‘Ore enkosholai ino o sahabu ino naa nkunainei. Inaainei nkituaak inono o nkera inono.’ ”

English: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
Masaai: Neaku etalaaka Daudi Onan shekeli iip ile e sahabu te nkiroishi, tenkaraki ine wueji.

English: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
Masaai: Tenaa oloitarruoyie oltung'ani tiae nabo e kuna, neibalunye ninye ina ng'oki nataasa,

English: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
Masaai: Kake etung'uayie apa ilo kitok le rripore embata oo ltung'ana aisinak oleng leina kop, pee eaku ilooitobir isabibu, o laturok.

English: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
Masaai: “Ee, te ina kata kenya aibelekeny nanu nkirorot oo ltung'ana, aitaa nkirorot sidain, pee etum ninche pooki aaipoto enkarna o Laitoriani, neisiaai ninye to ltau obo.

English: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
Masaai: neitanap Musa lelo tung'ana loo Lawi apa oonap osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani ejoki,

English: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
Masaai: Netii apa ilaiguanak magil Yerusalem, ooitoreishote to lkerenket pooki le lido kekun olkeju, laa ninche apa elaakini kodi o mpisai o lpolosie, o mpisai oo nkoitoi.

English: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
Masaai: Osarge lenye ake minos; tubukoki enkop anaa enkare.

English: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
Masaai: Neitashe te dukuya ninche iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana loo lpayiani le nkaji e Israel, tenebo Yaasania olayioni le Shafan eitashe tenebo ninche. Neeta ake pooki ng'ae lenye entoki napejieki enkorropil te nkaina enye, neilep empuruo enkorropil shumata.

English: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baaltamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli too wuejitin enye, neitobirakino olarrabal te Baal-tamar; ore lelo tung'ana loo Siraeli ootii olnukata neisarrisar too wuejitin enye aapuo enkalo o loo ntoluo le Geba.

English: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
Masaai: Irridu naa. Naa te neitu, nalotu enetii asieku naitainyie ninche olarrabal to lalem le nkutuk ai.

English: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
Masaai: nejur olapolosani ine, ore pee eibelekenyate ilpapit leine aaiborru netugumo ine alang olchoni lo sesen, naa enkeeya o lbolot, ninye nayopua ina kinosata enkima, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo olo lduruk; enkeeya oo lbolot ena.

English: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
Masaai: Naa keibung kenya nkituaak naapishana olee obo te ina olong ejo, “Eikinya iyiook endaa ang maate nikinchop nkilani ang maate, nchoo ake duoo eipotieki iyiook enkarna ino, iwuang'ie enkurruna ang.”

English: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
Masaai: Nepuku likae malaika eing'uaa atua enkaji e Enkai, eipotito to ltoilo sapuk ilo otonita te nkatampoi amu ejo, “Tudung'ishore ilo alem lino oololo nisampisho amu enkata e nkisampuare, eo abaya enkisampuare e nkop.”

English: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
Masaai: Neyakini Yesu nkera kutiti pee etum aiteleiki nkaik nebuaaki ilooiteng'eni lenyena lelo ooriku.

English: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
Masaai: Neitoki Gaal airo nejo, “Ng'ura, edou iltung'ana aaing'uaa empolos e nkop, ore oltim obo nelotu aimu enkalo o lchani loo lamusok onyaanyukie olng'aboli.”

English: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa, amaa apa pee alotu, keitu ninye ainepu oltung'ani obo? Amaa, pee aipotisho, aimeetae ninye oltung'ani oirukisho? Keitodorropaki enkaina ai eji metaa meidim atokordu likae? Anaa aimaata nanu engolon naitajeunye? Ng'ura, ore te nkisikong'are ai, naitoi nanu enaiposha, naitaa nanu ilkejek e nkop natoyio; neng'ueyu isinkir lenye etalaita enkare, neye te nkure.

English: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
Masaai: Naa tinikijoki ninche, “Wou tenebo iyiook mairraga aanyu osarge likimbukoo. Matarresh kisudori aaluam ilo le meeta entioto;

English: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
Masaai: Neaku eyakitia apa ninche iltung'ana le Israel olomoni torrono le ina kop nashomo aaikitalan, ejo, “Ore ina kop nikishomo iyiook aaikitalan naa enkop nainos lelo oomanya, ore lelo tung'ana pooki likitoduaa te ina kop naa adoru naa iltung'ana sapuki oleng.

English: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
Masaai: Eitobiraki enkaji enye ilkarash le rruat; ore inkilani enyena naa ine kitani napuiyiapuy pilei.

English: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
Masaai: Iwa lelo soito ooyutuutishoreki, ndong'u entapa, iwuang'ie ilo karasha limulumulare, intayu ilo kila lino, ting'ishai too nkejek inono, iima atua lkejek talang'a.

English: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
Masaai: Nemayian Olaitoriani nkolong'i e siadi e Yoab oleng alang ine dukuya; neeta apa ninye intare nkalifuni tomon oong'uan, o ntamesin nkalifuni ile, o lmong'i ooturishore enkalifu nabo, osirkon enkalifu nabo.
