English: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
Masaai: Ore ina kata eton etii nena kiri irishat oo lala lenye eton eitu einos aamut, neyupuyupoki engoro o Laitoriani iltung'ana, near Olaitoriani olorere to lmeitai kitok.

English: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
Masaai: Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata e long'o enye, to lgoo. Ore enkaraki ina nejoki olaiguanani ilo arewani le ngarri enye oo mbartan, “Mbelekenyayu, iwaki matung'uai olarrabal, amu aatipikaki olbae.”

English: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
Masaai: Ore olotii shumata enkaji nemedou alo aitayu intokitin te nkaji enye.

English: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.
Masaai: Eitalakua Olaitoriani te iyie osarge pooki le nkaji e Saul, laa te wueji enye intoreishe; neishooyie Olaitoriani enkitoria apik atua enkaina o layioni Absalom. Toduaa ajo etii emutata ino shumata ino; amu ira oltung'ani lo sarge.”

English: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
Masaai: Naa keaku enenye anaa erubata e tipat naing'uaa ine wueji sinyati eina kop, e wueji neisul te sinyatisho eiteru to lpolosie le Lawi.

English: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
Masaai: o Sulu, o Amok, o Hilkia o Yedaia. Kulo ninche apa ilkituaak loo lapolosak o lalashera lenye too nkolong'i e Yeshua.

English: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
Masaai: Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Rehoboam neilepu Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri alotu agilunore Yerusalem;

English: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oikulu oyuki oina muro naishoori aawa nanu too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, aitayu tiatua ilasarri lenye loo nkishorot e seriani, naisho nanu ninche Aron ilo apolosani o layiok lenyena, anaa erubata e anaake naitayu iltung'ana le Israel.

English: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
Masaai: o Amaria, o Maluk, o Hatush,

English: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
Masaai: Amu iyiook ilooiruko oojing ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaa ina natejo ninye eji, “Anaa enainosa olmumai ti atua engoro ai nchere, ‘Mejing aekata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai ntarasi.’ ” Hoo neidipate isiaaitin enyena ebaiki apake pee eitamanyu enkop.

English: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
Masaai: Ore eluamisho nelotu ninye atua nene wuejitin sidain e ina kop; nelo ninye aas ina neitu ae kata eas iloomenye anaa iloo nkakuyiaa lenye, eidapash ti atua ninche imasaa o nena naataarua ninye te njore. Keipiru ninye nkiguanat pee ear isempewueti, kake te nkiti kata ake.

English: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani naa Nabal, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Abigail. Naa ng'en apa ina kitok neikishiaan kake kemoda apa olee naa torrono olkuaak; naa ole ntipat e Kaleb apa.

English: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
Masaai: Nedou Paulo, nepetaa nedumu amuataki nkaik nejo, “Emimputukuny amu eton eishu.”

English: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
Masaai: “Kinotito enkare.” Neisho enkarna ine aajo shiba, metaa ore enkarna eina anasa naa keji Beer-sheba o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And, lo, he hath given occasions of speech against her, saying, I found not thy daughter a maid; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
Masaai: naa ng'ura eitobira ninye enkitang'oroto e sulare tialo ninye, ejo, “Eitu nanu atum te ntito ino olmonekie oitodolu ajo eselenkei!” Naa noolo ilmonek le ntito ai le titoisho.’ Neisalaash nincheilo kila te dukuya lelo payiani leina anasa.

English: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
Masaai: Neipotisho abuaku to ltoilo sapuk, anaa olo lng'atuny oipur. Ore ake pee eipotisho nedaru nena kikurrukurrot naapishana.

English: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo tung'ana pokira imiet, nepuonu Laish, nedol iltung'ana apa ootii ine, eneikununo oltonei lenye te seriani, te mpukunoto oo le Sidon, eitirring'a nememuso, meeta entoki nabo e nkop nang'or, neeta karsisisho, o eneba elakuaniki ile Sidon nemeeta enaporokinore likae tung'ani.

English: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
Masaai: Eimbooyo iyie kewan te kuna baa, Olaitoriani? Eigira iyie nintame iyiook aitulus?

English: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche Betlehem nejoki, “Enchom, emparu imbaa e ina kerai, ore pee itumutumu ninye nikiyakiki olomoni pee alotu sii nanu aserem ninye.”

English: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
Masaai: “Ore pooki ng'ae olotu enatii lemeibayu menye o ng'otonye, o enkitok enye o nkera, o lalashera o nkanashera, ee o ebaiki enkorrok enye, nemeidim ataa oloiteng'eni lai.

English: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ina neitobiraki iltung'ana ate endaa, o lapolosak amu ore apa lelo apolosak ayiok le Aron netanyamala, eitayu ilasarri oopejori, o nkiri naapir, o metaa kewarie. Neaku eitobirakita ate Ilawi o lapolosak lelo ayiok le Aron endaa.

English: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
Masaai: ile Asiriel, olmarei loo le Asiriel; o le Shekem, olmarei loo le Shekem,

English: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
Masaai: niunokinono neshetuni intae, niponana inchosho ninye enashe.

English: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
Masaai: Neme enking'asia naa, te neitaakuno isinkan lenyena eitaa ate isinkan le supatisho; eyooki aaiting'oki enaishiaakino nena naataasa ninche.

English: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
Masaai: Aishua nanu ninche; ataremo nanu ninche aipang'ie, metaa eitu ninche edumunye; etabatatate ti abori nkejek aainei.

English: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eroro ndapi oo nkejek e lelo apolosak oo napita osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani le nkop pooki nkariak e Yordan, neitasheyieki nkariak e Yordan meitoki aaruko, ore nena ariak naadou eing'uaa shumata neitashe aarupa to lturrur obo.”

English: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana pooki aalang Yordan, nelo olaiguanani alang; neng'utut olaiguanani Barsilai nemayian ninye, neshuko ninye alo enkang enye kewan.

English: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
Masaai: Toning'o enkishirata, iyie Enkai, inining'o enkomono ai;

English: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
Masaai: Neing'uaa sii Sadok ilo apolosani o lalashera lenyena lelo apolosak te dukuya ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, teine wueji neika te Gibeon.

English: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Ketii enkaina e Yoab te nebo iyie te kuna pooki?” Newal ina kitok nejo, “Esipa ore anaa eninchu iyie, olkitok lai olaiguanani, meidim oltung'ani aibelekenyayu enkaina e tatene arashu enkaina e kedienye te pooki bae natejo olkitok lai olaiguanani. Osinka lino Yoab laaiguanaka nanu; ninye otipika kulo rorei pooki enkutuk e sinka ino.

English: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
Masaai: Eeta apa Rebeka olalashe oji enkarna enye Laban. Nepuku Laban akuet alo enetii ilo tung'ani te nchorro.

English: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
Masaai: o Malkiram, o Pedaia, o Shenasa, o Yekania, o Hoshama, o Nedabisha.

English: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
Masaai: Ore nena mowuarak pooki e ilo torrono naa kedung'oo ninye, ore mowuarak e ilo supat naa keilepieki.

English: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

English: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
Masaai: Ngura, ore kuna naa nkuti ake oo nkoitoi naa kebaa enkitisho enking'oming'om oo mbaa enyena nikitoning'o! Naa amaa endarata engolon enye, aing'ae oidim atoning'u?”

English: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
Masaai: Nelotu Yesu o ninche ewueji neji Getsemane nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Entotoni te ne mashomo ende aomon.”

English: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Ena apa ninye esiana oo lmareita loo le Kohat, lelo pooki ooisiaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
Masaai: Nadol ina kitok etemere to sarge loo sinyat le Enkai o to sarge loo lchakenini le Yesu. Ore pee adol nanu ninye naing'asia oleng.

English: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
Masaai: Ng'ura, eigeroki te dukuya nanu aajo, “Magira nanu, kake kaitalaku nanu, ee, kaitalaku nanu too lgooitie lenye,

English: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
Masaai: Nejing enkoitoi kitok ine, naji Enkoitoi Sinyati; nemepuo aaim ine iltung'ana lemesinya, ore ilmoda nemepong'okino ine.

English: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
Masaai: anaa enatiaaka iloo papa, Abraham o eishoi enye intarasi.”

English: Now the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,
Masaai: Ore apa eton eitu elotu Saul, netaboloko Olaitoriani Samuel:

English: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
Masaai: Ejo Lkigerot, “Enkai eiruko Abraham; ore enkaraki ina neikenaki Enkai ninye ajo eeta esipata.”

English: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
Masaai: nedou Enkiyang'et Sinyati etiu anaa enturkulu adoiki ninye. Nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa shumata ojo, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai lanyor, kaashipakino iyie.”

English: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
Masaai: Nepuonu ina kata ilooiteng'eni enetii Yesu nejoki, “Kaing'ae olkitok te nkitoria e shumata?”

English: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
Masaai: Kake aira ng'ae lo tung'ani owaliki Enkai? Kejoki entoki naitobiruni ilo oitobirita, “Oo pee kintayio aikunu inji?

English: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

English: Therefore David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
Masaai: Neaku eikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Kalo nanu aar kulo Filisti?” Nejoki Olaitoriani Daudi, “Shomo taara pee intajeu Keila.”

English: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
Masaai: Neipang'aki ninye olmalaika oing'uaa shumata, aitagol.

Masaai: Metaa neijia apa atiu aanya enkolong naa neijia etiu enkewarie, nemeekure apa atumoki aimula nkonyek airurayu.

English: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

English: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

English: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
Masaai: Neiteru aaomon Yesu metung'uai ina latia enye.

English: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Toning'o enkomono ai, iyie Enkai; tipika enkiok ino kulo rorei le nkutuk ai.

English: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

English: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake eitu sii etiu anaa ilaiguanak le Israel apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Kenkaraki naatiaaka aatoduaa te ntonata o lng'aboli pee iruko? Iyooki adol imbaa kituaak naalang kuna.”

English: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

English: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

English: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol enkaisiaayiani eton te newang neunoki enkong'u nejo, “Ore ele tung'ani eboitare oshi ninye.”

English: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

English: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
Masaai: Nintobir olchumati le nkare te rishata e nena sunta pokira are. Kake eitu ing'or ilo apa oitobira ilo shorro, neitu ishilaa ilo oipirua kuna pooki apa moitie, laa ninye oishoo metaa.

English: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki Yosef iltung'ana, “Ing'ura ainyiang'ua intae ena olong tenebo enkop inyi aitaa ene Farao. Ore naa, noolo ilanterera linyi, naa entuun enkop.

English: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

English: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

Masaai: Etii ilkumok oojo, “Oi naaji tenaa eikidol iyiook embae sidai. Ntorioki iyiook ewang'an e nkomom ino, Olaitoriani!”

English: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo,I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
Masaai: Neitoki Onan ajoki Daudi, “Iwa iyie; naa nchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani eas ina naishiakino te ninye, ng'ura kaishoru nanu ilmong'i pee eitaae olasar opejori, ore kuna keek naaidong'ishoreki neaku ilkeek, neaku enkano olasar le ntapa. Kaishoru nanu pooki.”

English: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
Masaai: Neibulu olning'o lenye enkop pooki e Siria; neyakini ninye iltung'ana pooki oomueyiaa ooibung'a nkeyaitin oo mpukunot kumok o looata loiriruani o looata emuoyian e nkiterria o lmaiman o looidimua emion; neishiunye ninye ninche.

English: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
Masaai: Eraposho oltung'ani too lng'anayio le nkutuk enye, eitaraposhi too naing'uaa enkutuk enye.

English: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
Masaai: Etunuka ninye inkoitoi aainei too soito, nelojiloj ninye inkoitoi aainei aboiboin.

English: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Nchoo ninye eton openy ti atua enkaji enye makewan; melotu ninye enatii nanu.” Neaku etotona Absalom openy te enkaji enye makewan, neitu elotu enetii Olaiguanani.

English: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
Masaai: Nipik ilo orika lo lng'ur shumata ilo sanduku le nchakenisho ine wueji nesinya oleng.

English: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
Masaai: Ore te nkata enkirowuaj neimin. Ore teneirowuaju, neish te wueji enye.

English: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
Masaai: Te netumi ina ng'ues natupurroyie ninye ti atua imasaa enyena, aa enkiteng, osikiria arashu enker nelak ninye are te nabo.

English: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
Masaai: Ing'ura, ena apa entorroni naata enkanashe ino Sodom: ore ninye tenebo ntoyie enyena neeta olwuasa, o endaa sapuk, o embularoto metii engoloto, kake eitu eretu lelo aisinak o lemeeta toki.

English: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
Masaai: Ore nkishu pooki o lasar le seriani naa iloingok tikitam o ng'uan, o lmeregeshi ntomoni ile, o sitiman le kineji ntomoni ile, ore sitiman le kerra lo lari obo naa ntomoni ile. Ele apa ninye olasar le nkitisinyata lo lperere lo lasar eidipaki aatubukoki eilata aaitisinya.

English: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
Masaai: ng'ura, nedoiki intae enkaina o Laitoriani olmeitai torrono nkishu inyi naatii ong'ata, mbartan, isirkon, ntamesin, iluaat oo nkishu o luaat oo ntare.

English: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.
Masaai: “Inkaik e Serubabel naaitasheyie olkitamanyunoto lena aji; naa inkaik enyena ake sii naaidip ninye. Ina pee iyiolouu aajo aairriwua nanu Olaitoriani loo lororani enitii.

English: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
Masaai: Nejo ilo payian kitok, “Meeu eseriani enitii; kagolie nanu iyieunot inono pooki; kake mirrag ena kewarie to losinko.”

English: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
Masaai: Kake nchoo lelo supati meting'idata; nchoo ninche meting'idata te dukuya Enkai; nchoo ninche metishipata oleng!

English: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
Masaai: Amu etaa osinka lino oloitasheiki enkishui enkayioni, te papaai lang ejoki. ‘Teneitu ashuku ninye enitii, naaku oloota entorroni te dukuya papaai te nkishui ai pooki,’

English: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
Masaai: tenebo ina Araba pooki te nkalo o loo saen le Yordan o metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, tiabori nena kishong'ishong'at e Pisga.

English: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
Masaai: Ore ake teina oitoi neirriu Sanbalat olkilikuai lenye te nkata e imiet, nereu olaisiaayiani lenye eeta empalai nabolo te nkaina enye.

English: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
Masaai: “Amu etaasa ilaiyiok le Yuda entorroni too nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani ojo; etipika ninche ilo minong lenye atua enkaji naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, pee eisarkionie ninye.

English: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
Masaai: Ena apa empukunoto e lototo oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te risioroto oo lororani lenye, te nedumunye aaidur.

English: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana torrok nemening'u esipata, kake ore lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani naa kening'u katukul.

English: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Wootu, erukurukoreki, naa kaitaa intae ilarreshok loo ltung'ana.”

English: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
Masaai: Nejoki, ng'otonye, “Mme neijia, keipoti aajo, Yohana.”

English: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
Masaai: Kake ore shakenisho naata nanu kitok alang ina e Yohana; amu ore isiaaitin naaishoo Papa maitabai, nena siaaitin naasita ninche maate naishakenoki nchere, Papa laairriwua.

English: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
Masaai: O Elkana olayioni lenye, o Ebiasaf olayioni lenye o Asir olayioni lenye

English: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
Masaai: Te neme Olaitoriani oitodorropa nena olong'i, anaata meetae hoo oltung'ani obo opok. Kake ore te nkaraki ilgelunot lenyana ootegelua ninye, neitodorropa ninye nena olong'i.

English: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
Masaai: Kake etejo Paulo, “To lorika le Kaisari le nkiguana aitashe, naa te ne eishaakino naaiguanareki; maata doi entorrono naitaasa Ilyahudi, naa esipata ina niyiolo iyie aitorioki.

English: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
Masaai: Kaa Ai natiu anaa iyie, apalaki ntorrok, negiroo nkitarruorrot te nkaraki olpisiai le njung'ore enye? Meibung ninye engoro enye ntarasi amu keshipakino ninye enyorrata nauno.

English: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aitukuo nkejek enye neishopo nkilani neitoki aton, nejoki ninche, “Aiyiololo enaitaasa intae?

English: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
Masaai: Ina kata nalaku agilunore intae too imbaa aainei esayiet olameyu, imbaa emutata, nena nalaku meidaikie intae; ina kata naitasapuk olameyu oleng te intae, nadung'oo ineeimu indaiki inyi.

English: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
Masaai: Ina doi pee ejo Lkigerot, “Neaku ilo tung'ani oiturukuo, Adam, osesen oishu,” ore Adam obayie, neaku oloishoru enkiyang'et enkishui.

English: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
Masaai: Kaa nanu ajo tialo iyie, kainyoo aaitanyaanyukie iyie, na tito e Yerusalem? Kainyoo nanu aaitanyaanyukie te iyie pee aatum aitagolo, na tito e Sion? Amu elala anaa enaiposha enkidaata ino; kaing'ae likinchiunye iyie?

English: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nipik olperere lo lasar le sahabu o enkorropil dukuya ilo sanduku le nchakenisho, nintoki apik enkarasha e kutuk aji o lng'obor le Nkai.

English: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
Masaai: Naa tenaaorore nanu iyie nikiya iyie enkiyang'et o Laitoriani ewueji nemayiolo, niaaku tenalo nanu ajoki Ahab ina, nikilau ninye, naar nanu matua, hoo nayanyita nanu osinka lino Olaitoriani ebaiki telelero ai.

English: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Embung'a intae enkitanapata nabo to lomoni o to inoti; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
Masaai: Kake etune ororei lo laiguanani te Yoab o too lkituaak le njore. Neaku eshomo Yoab o lkituaak le njore te ine netii olaiguanani aapuo aaiken iltung'ana.

English: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
Masaai: Keiterre doi ninye elelero nenauru nebatata iltung'ana ooti te nauri;

English: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
Masaai: Neitoki Mordekai apuku alo te ine netii olaiguanani eishopito inkilani e nkitoo pusi o naaibor o lmarisian sapuk le nkitoo le sahabu, olkila sidai sintet, ina kata ebuaku enkang e Susa neng'ida.

English: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
Masaai: Atipika olokirrai lai atua enkatampoi naa keaku olmonekie lo sotua lai o enkop.

English: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
Masaai: Metur oltashalai enkurma enye te nkata e nkirobi, keing'oru te nkata enkisampuare nemetum hoo pito.

English: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
Masaai: Keuno apa oltau lenye tialo nkoitoi o Laitoriani; neiwuang'ie sii iwuejitin neeika e Asherim te Yuda.

English: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
Masaai: Ore pooki naewuo aaku neidipaki apa aipoto, neyioloi enatiu tung'ani, neyioloi aajo meidim ataarare obo ogol alang ninye.

English: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
Masaai: Ore too shekeli enkalifu o iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o imiet neitobir ilala oo lolo te nkaraki ing'apeta nemur ilukuny enye neitobiraki ninche irubat.

English: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
Masaai: Ore anaa enainosa olmumai te ngoro ai, ‘Mejing ae kata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.’ ”

English: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo naishiakino enkarna enye; eyau enkishoroto nipuonunu dukuya ninye! Enteserem Olaitoriani te seremata sinyati;

English: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
Masaai: Ilepa iyie shomo enchumata o ldoinyo oado, Iyie Sion, ntadarai lelo omon supati; ilepunye oltoilo lino te ngolon, Oo Yerusalem, ntadarai lelo omon supati, ilepie oleng, miureshoyu; tiaaki nena anas e Yuda, “Eng'ura Enkai inyi!”

English: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
Masaai: Etawalikia apa ilo kitok le njore oltung'ani le Nkai ajoki, “Amaa napaji tenaa kebol Olaitoriani ilusien te keper, keitabari ena bae?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, “Ilo iyie adol too nkonyek inono, kake miinos iyie ina daa.”

English: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
Masaai: Eiturrurro apa Benhadad iltung'ana lenyena tenebo. Netii ilaiguanak tomoni uni oare tenebo ninye, neeta mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan. Nelo ninye aman Samaria neitayunye olarrabal.

English: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
Masaai: Eng'ora nkaik aainei o nkejek nchere kewan ai nanu kewan ele; embung'aki pee idolidolo; amu meeta enkiyang'et nkiri o loik anaa kulo lidolitata aata.”

English: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.
Masaai: Neitanapisho Nebukadnesa te ngoro napi meyauni Shadrak o Meshak o Abednego. Neyauni kulo tung'ana dukuya olaiguanani.

English: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
Masaai: Ore te nena kikeneta e ilo gilata neguetakino ilkerubi o ltuka, anaa lelo ooguetakino nena sunta; netii ilkeek kumok oonukita ilo gilata lioriong.

English: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
Masaai: Ore pee ening eimakini Yesu, neirriwaki lpayiani loo Lyahudi meeu ninye aishiunye ilo sinka lenye.

English: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
Masaai: ilo rorei ilo liyiololo intae maate, oitadarayioki te Yudea pooki, aaiteru te Galilaya, eidipe enkibatisa apa nalikioo Yohana.

English: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
Masaai: Neitupukuni Aleksanta ti atua olorere, naa Lyahudi ooturrumoitie. Neyuk Aleksanta ninche te nkaina, eyieu newaliki olorere.

English: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
Masaai: “Teneponaa Olaitoriani Enkai ino enkop ino, anaa enikisiligie ninye, nijo iyie, ‘Kainos nanu nkiri,’ amu itang'uarra nkiri, indim ainosa nkiri naaba anaa iniyieu.

English: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadumunye. Nelo ake oltung'ani olosho lenye, o lmarei lenye, neipang aapuo teine, nelo ake pooki ng'ae enjung'ore enye.

English: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
Masaai: Ae ng'ae oitoki aitang'or ilgelunot le Nkai? Mme Enkai, amu ninye makewan naishoo ninche isipat.

English: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
Masaai: Paa kaji naa eiko pee eitabari ilkigerot nemeeta nchere pee eitu ebaya?”

English: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua te nebo Israel pooki aagiroo Lakish nepuo Eglon; neng'adu ninche ninye, neibung ninye;

English: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
Masaai: Amu eitasho olaiguanani le Babilon teine neorore inkoitoi te rishata e nena oitoi are, easishore enaibon; neikirikirie mbaa, neikilikuanishore enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Terafi, neing'or emonyua eina ngues naibonishore.

English: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
Masaai: neitayu ake oltung'ani te nebo ilo oing'oni olasar le ntapa loo mboreitin uni e matua e tomon e efa entapa napuyiapui, naipurjaki te ilata naitorit empirbil.

English: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
Masaai: Kake eitu eiruk Yesu aisho makewan ninche, amu keyiolo ltung'ana pooki,

English: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
Masaai: neiu Salmon Boas, neiu Boas Obed,

English: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
Masaai: Ore pee eishankarrarre Paulo o Barnaba ninche neirish aaiguanare too mbaa neme kuti, negelu lalashera Paulo o Barnaba o kulikae ake lenye, meshomo Yerusalem eitarioo esirit ninche, neimaa Foenike o meshomo Yerusalem enetii lkipaareta o lpayiani te ina bae.

English: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
Masaai: Neaku eyautua iltung'ana le Israel pooki osanduku le lning'o lo Laitoriani too mbuakunot, o to ltoilo le mouo, o ntarumpetani, o nkinantani dapashi, nebuaku aaranyisho too nkai oo sinkoliotin, o lwululi loo usin.

English: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: amu metii ae kata enaibon naishoruaki te yieunoto o ltung'ani, kake eiroro iltung'ana sinyat ilomon le Enkai anaa enautaki Enkiyang'et Sinyati eing'uaa Enkai.

English: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
Masaai: Neirorie Daudi Olaitoriani ina kata pee edol ilo malaika apa oarita iltung'ana, nejo, “Oi, ataasa nanu eng'oki, nataasa entorroni; kake amaa kuna kerra, kaa etaasa ninche? Nchoo enkaina ino, aatoomono, aar nanu near enkaji e papa.”

English: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli aarare ile Benchamen te nkolong e uni, neitobirakino olarrabal pee earare Gibea, anaa enaikuna too nkulie katitin.

English: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
Masaai: Aikintobiraki iyiook iyie imasaa e sahabu, naaripakino enkosholai.

English: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, neirriwaki ninche ilkiliku aimunye isinkan lenyena, enkaraki naing'urrie ninye iltung'ana lenyena, o tenkaraki emanyisho enye.

English: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana pooki iwuejitin enye aadaa neokisho, neirriwaa irubat, neitobir osirua kitok le nchipai. amu etoning'utuo ninche lelo rorei ooibalakinyeki ninche.

English: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
Masaai: neji pee elimuni aaibalie too nkang'itie enye pooki o te Yerusalem, entejo, “Empang'a enchom ndoinyo niyauu ilng'osil lo loirien, oloirien le ntim olng'osil o ltuka, okulikae keek eeta mbenek pee eitainyeki ilng'oborri, anaa enaingeroki.”

English: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
Masaai: Amaa te naa ketolikioyioki Kristo aajo eitopiwuoki too lootuata, kaji enyaaka atiu pee emanaa kulikae ti atua intae ejo meetae empiunoto oo lootuata?

English: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
Masaai: Neitayu ilidat oolgoso onom te manaroto e nkalo e oriong olkarasha le ntukus nabo, olgoso onom te manaroto olikae eitutum ilkarash.

English: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
Masaai: Ore enemetii erikore, naa kebatata olorere; kake ore enetii ilaikook kumok netii eseriani.

English: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
Masaai: Shomo turia Olaitoriani Enkai ino; shomo isiayia ninye, ninos olmumai te nkarna enye.

English: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.
Masaai: Enchom, enyaaki entisipa oleng; entayiolo nidolidolo eneisudoriyie, naa kaing'ae otodua ninye te ine; amu aatiaakaki nchere eikalamas ninye oleng.

English: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
Masaai: Naa dolita enaimaka Yesu, enkeeya enye. Kake nejo ninche enkirurata oo njo eimaka.

English: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche ina, neing'asia oleng nepuo aaing'uaa ninye.

English: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
Masaai: Ore apa Yepta ilo le Gilead naa olmurrani magilani, kake olayioni apa le mulayoi ninye. Gilead apa menye le Yepta.

English: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

English: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
Masaai: Ore sii intae iatata taata osina; kake kaitoki ake adol intae, neng'ida iltauja linyi, nemetii oltung'ani ooru intae eng'ida inyi.

English: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
Masaai: Nejoki oltung'ani obo, “Olaitoriani, ai kuti pasa lelo oojeu?” Nejoki ninche,

English: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
Masaai: Etediaki ilng'anayio lo sesen lino o lng'anayio le nkop ino, oina ponaroto oo nkishu inono, o lelelo loo ntare inono.

English: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
Masaai: Teneomon te nkomono ake pooki, o te sayiata ake pooki nasaisho pooki tung'ani arashu iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli pooki, eyiolo ake oltung'ani emion oltau lenye makewan, neilepie nkaik enyena aipirie ena aji,

English: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
Masaai: Meitoki aaigil ae kata aaku eng'ues nainosi iloreren, nemeitoki ilowuarak le ina kop aapolol ninche; eketoni ninche te seriani, nemeeta entoki naitoki aiture ninche.

English: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
Masaai: Aisilig nanu ajo iyiolouu ake ninye aajo mikitii iyiook lelo ootabatatate.

English: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
Masaai: To loo saen le Mamre, te nkurma nainyiang'ua apa Abraham too Lhiti. Metaa te ine apa etunukayioki Abraham tenebo enkitok enye Sara.

English: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

English: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
Masaai: Neibelekenya aing'uaa ninye alo enetii olikae, neiro te ina oitoi; neitoki iltung'ana aawaliki ninye anaa duoo ake te dukuya.

English: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
Masaai: Neya nkituaak o pooki ootii atua, ilooti o lkituaak; eitu ear hoo ng'ae metua, kake etanapa ninche aaya, nepuo enkoitoi enye.

English: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
Masaai: Aitorrok apa nkonyek e Lea ore Raheli naa aisidai neikishiaan.

English: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
Masaai: Te naalau nanu papaai lino tukul, nijoki, ‘Etasaishe Daudi aomonu pee ekuet alo Betlehem, enkanasa enye; amu etii ine olasar anaake to lari to lmarei pooki.’

English: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
Masaai: o Sabad olayioni lenye, o Shutela olayioni lenye, o Eser o Elead laa ninche apa ootasesekuana iltung'ana le Gat apa ootoiwuoki teina kop, enkaraki naetuo ninche aaibung nkishu enye.

English: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
Masaai: Amu te nanu eponari inkolong'i inono, aikiponikini iyie ilarin le nkishui.

English: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
Masaai: Ore olkutati oing'uaa moikuape naa keyau enchan; ore olng'ejep okurrisho neyau engoro.

English: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
Masaai: Ore ake sii kedumu Olaitoriani tenkaraki kewan enye olaiguanani olotu shumata Isiraeli, laa ninye olo aiwuang'ie enkaji e Yeroboam.

English: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
Masaai: enkinosata e nkima te nkinosata e nkima, olbae to lbae, olkordata to lkordata.

English: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
Masaai: Neiter aliki olorere ena kitanyaanyukoto, “Etuno oltung'ani enkurma oo lng'anayio, neisho laramatak meisilenoi nelo ai kop nebik enkata naado.

English: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
Masaai: Amu eidaikie ninche Yakobo, neitomijoon emanyisho enye.

English: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
Masaai: Nearakini ilbarnot meidong'isho te wueji neidong'ishoreki neitaari inkayiok ilolan loo lkeek.

English: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Nayiolo aitisip nchere ore ilo oiterua esiaai sidai ti atua intae naa keitabaya te ina olong e Yesu Kristo.

English: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
Masaai: Newaliki ilooiteng'eni lenyena aajoki, “Kaji eiko oltung'ani te neitoti kulo tung'ana too mukateni te ne ti ong'ata?”

English: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
Masaai: ore oloyieu neituruk neaku osinka le pooki.

English: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
Masaai: Naa kairo nanu endung'okinoto ai enkiguana tialo ninche, teina torroni enye pooki aatung'uaitie nanu; etapejokito ninche enkorropil kulie aitin, neserem esiaai oo nkaik enye maate.

English: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
Masaai: Neitoki ake aapuonu Yerusalem. Ore eloolo ninye te nkaji e Nkai, nepuonu aayiaya ninye ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak o lpayiani,

English: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
Masaai: Kake ore osinka lai Kalebu, enkaraki naata ninye oltau opaashaa naatusuja ninye nanu tukul, kayau nanu ninye atua ina kop apa nashomo,

English: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
Masaai: Nepik Olaitoriani Enkai ino kulo deketa pooki shumata ilmang'ati linono o lelo apa likisilisilo.

English: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldst reveal this secret.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Daniel, “Esipa ore Enkai ino naa Enkai oo nkaitin naa Olaitoriani loo laiguanak, naa olaitodolunoni loo nkisudorot, amu indima iyie atabolu ena kisudoroto.”

English: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
Masaai: Neitijing'u ninye ilapolosak o Lawi, neiturrur ninche to lgoriet le nkalo oloo saen, nejoki ninye ninche, “Entoning'oki nanu lo Lawi!

English: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
Masaai: Ore ilo balusui, pee edol ina nataasaki, neiruk, eing'asie te nkaraki enkiteng'enare o Laitoriani.

English: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
Masaai: Naa tenaa duoo enkiteng ng'otonye aashu enker nimiyieng ninye tenebo olashe o ngotonye aashu olkuo o ngotonye te nkolong nabo.

English: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae sirito e Asia. Ore Akuila o Priska, te nebo esirit natii enkaji enye neirriwaki intae enkirorokino ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
Masaai: Kake ore too ltung'ana loo Isiraeli eitu eitaa Solomon irrindiki. Isikarini apa ninche, iltung'ana lenyena kituaak apa ninche. Ilkituaak le njore, ilarikok le njore, o lkituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan.

English: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oisiligayu naa ketum imayianat kumok. Kake ore ilo osioki aaku olkarsis nemelo eitu eitamei.

English: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
Masaai: Eng'ura eneba olkiyioi loo ng'uesi! Ore iluaat oo nchoo neidang'a enkaraki nemeetae ndaat oo nchoo tenkaraki ninche. Ore sii iluaat oo nkerrai neiputukunyo.

English: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
Masaai: “Nele osotua laitayu nanu o ninche te siadi nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kapik inkitanapat aainei iltauja lenye, naiger ninche too ndamunot enye.”

English: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
Masaai: Naa enkolong e sabato ina olong pee eipurj Yesu esarng'ab, abol inkonyek enyena.

English: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
Masaai: Ore isoito oogol enkinyiang'a ooji Topas le Etiopia, nemeitanyaanyukieki ninye, nemeitanyaanyukieki ninye sahabu nasila.

English: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
Masaai: “Kajo apa nanu makewan keishiaakino te naas mbaa kumok agilunore enkarna e Yesu le Nasaret.

English: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Isaakar naa: Tola, o Pufa, o Yob, o Shimron.

English: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
Masaai: nejo, ‘Kashukokino enkaji ai natung'uayie’; ore pee elotu nedol ajo mijooni etooroki enkaji neikodi.

English: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
Masaai: Neikirikira ilarripok te nkaraki ninye, netiu anaa ilootuata.

English: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
Masaai: Eibung ninye osotua lenye ntarasi; teilo rorei apa otejo ninye too iishoritin enkalifu nabo.

English: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

English: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
Masaai: Neitobiraki Usia enjore pooki ilong'oi, o remeta, o maupen oo sekenke, o ruparen; o nkai o mbaa, o soito oo nang'ari le nkopito.

Masaai: ‘Ore iyie Betlehem te nkop e Yuda, mira hoo kini tiatua ilaitoriak le Yuda; amu iyie epukunye olarikoni oyooki aitore ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.’ ”

English: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
Masaai: Nedamu looiteng'eni lenyena enatisiraki nchere, “Kaanya olom le nkaji ino amut.”

English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
Masaai: Nearare apa Ilfilisti Israel; neipirri iltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Ilfilisti neidaikieki to Ldoinyo le Gilboa.

English: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
Masaai: Amu ore ele oji Melkisedek, olaiguanani le Salem, naa olapolosani le Enkai, netii shumata te pooki, netanang'are ninye Abraham eshukunye aing'uaa enjore natimirie laiguanak, nemayian ninye;

Masaai: Kake etaremo osikari obo ematua te remet, nepuku osarge o enkare.

Masaai: Tadamu kuna tokitin, iyie Yakobo, o Israel, amu ira iyie osinka lai; aaitobira iyie, ira iyie osinka lai Oo Israel, maarikino aikata nanu iyie.

English: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

English: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

English: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

English: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

English: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

English: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

English: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

English: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

Masaai: Enkolong e ngoro napi ina olong, enkolong o sina o emion, enkolong e nkidaata o emutata, enkolong e naimin o enkimuntut, enkolong oo nkatampo o enaimin nagut,

Masaai: Neeta Simon Petero, olalem, neshutu, neoshie osinka lo Lapolosani Kitok nedung'u enkiok e tatene. Keji enkarna e ilo sinka Malkus.

Masaai: Kulo apa ninche ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too le Lawi, te risioroto oo iishoritin enye, lelo arikok apa oomanya Yerusalem.

English: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
Masaai: Naa keosh Olaitoriani Isirael neitotiu anaa oseyiai oikirikira tiatua enkare, naitayu isiraeli aiwuang'ie tena kop sidai apa naishoo loo menye, neidapashaki ninche teidia alo Frati, enkaraki naitobira ninche Asherim enye neitagor Olaitoriani.

English: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
Masaai: Nepuonu Sadukayo enetii, lelo apa oojo meetae empiunoto,

English: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
Masaai: “Itejo, ‘Eitasiooyioki ninche aaya shumata nkariak; etediaaki erubata enye te nkop; meetae ololo nkurman enye oo sabibu.

English: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
Masaai: Itimira oltung'ani nitii shumata ninye ntarasi. Itumuguta enkomom enye nireu ninye aitalamaa.

English: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
Masaai: Keitasheyie ninche iltung'ana ooim atua ina kop inkatitin pooki peyie epuo aanukaa lelo ootelekutua ti oriong e nkop, peyie etum aaipoo ninye; ore te nkiting'oto o lapaitin oopishana neitoki aaingoru impopoki aajurru.

English: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
Masaai: Te nemeton oltung'ani ti atua nanu nenang'ari boo anaa olng'osila, netoyu, nesotu iltung'ana ninche nenang'akini enkima, metapejo.

English: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
Masaai: “Teyietu, iyie Heshbon, amu eitomijoonoki enkang e Ai! Nchira iyie, natito e Raba! Nchopoki kewan ilkuniyiani, nchira, nikuet alimana tiatua nkang'itie! Amu kelo Milko atua eyararoto, tenebo ilapolosak lenyena o lkituaak lenyena.

English: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
Masaai: Torripo naa kewan te ninye amu etishirraka aany olkilikuai lang.

English: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninche ine wueji ino sinyati, nepik olduruk ine wueji ino sinyati o metabaiki enkop.

English: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
Masaai: Ore tiatua ilo goriet le kishomi netii enkishomi natii imisai are too nkaloli pokira, naa ninche eyieng'ieki ilasarri oopejori, o lasarri le ngoki, o lasarri le nkitarruorroto.

English: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Aram naa Usi, o Hul, o Geter, o Mash.

English: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Elepa enchom ildoinyo niyauu ilkeek lishetietie ena aji, pee atum atishipakinoyu natum sii ataliooyu te nkitoo ai, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
Masaai: Nkooyu, iyie Yerusalem, pee maaorieki ake iyie; pee maaitaa ake olmuaate enkop, nememanya.”

English: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

English: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
Masaai: Ore ina kata ake, neibulu olning'o lenye pooki wueji te nene neemanita Galilaya.

English: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

English: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
Masaai: Ore te nebo ilo kuoo le ker le dukuya irrantilini aare le nkano nasila naipurjare, emborei o ltulet leilata sidai, o emborei o ltulet le naisho oo sabibu pee eaku olasar.

English: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
Masaai: Ore te sipata meas Enkai entorroni, nemeboin Olmagilani esipata.

English: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
Masaai: Amu te neidimua sii ninche iyiook emion e Kristo, neijia sii ninye eikuna ina kilejilej nikitang'amutua te nkaraki Kristo.

English: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
Masaai: Amu kesioki ninche aaishunye anaa nkujit, netiu anaa mbenek naatoito.

English: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
Masaai: Ore emayianata e ilo letaa keidak nelotu shumata nanu, naretu nkolia menoto eseriani.

English: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Midian o le Amaleki o iltung'ana le nkalo o loo saen aaipotuno te nebo, nelang'u Yordan neshet ilng'oborri to oerata le Yesereel.

English: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
Masaai: Meetae entoki naikash te tung'ani alang te nenya neok netum enchipai te ekenyata enye. Atoduaa sii ena ajo nkaik Enkai eing'uaa;

English: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee iyaua ena umata o Laitoriani atua ena ongata, pee kipuonu aaye tene, iyiook o nkishu ang.

English: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Kepuonu ilarin oopishana ootumieki endaa sapuk te nkop pooki e Misiri,

Masaai: Neiutuutisho nkituaak are te nebo to soit obo; neyai nabo neing'uari enkae.

English: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
Masaai: ekaitajeu nanu intare aainei, meitoki ae kata aaku inaainos ing'uesi; naa kaiguanare erishata e nker o enker.

English: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
Masaai: Naitoki aikilikuan ninye ajoki: ‘Ira entito e ng'ae?’ nejo, ‘Entito e Betuel olayioni le Nahor otoikio ninye Milka.’ Napik olgisoi enkume enye olkataarri inkaik enyena.

English: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Libna nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Risa.

English: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
Masaai: Maata apa nanu eleyiata te dukuya ninye, naitalam nanu kewan nkitadiaat.

English: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

English: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.

English: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

English: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

English: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

English: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

English: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
Masaai: Eeta ilkarsisi linono olarrabal; neiro lelo le nkop ino elejare, neeta ilng'ejepa lenye elejare.

English: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

English: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
Masaai: ninye likipalaki nkitarruorrot inono pooki, ninye likinchiunye imueyiaritin inono pooki,

English: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

English: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

English: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

English: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

English: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
