English: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani, ina kata apa pee eirriwaki ninye olaiguanani Sedekia Pashur olayioni le Malkia o Sefania olapolosani, Maasia, ejo,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoiakim, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel, tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore olasar lai, endaa ai too lasarri laainei le nkima, esong'ouna ai narropil, embung'a pee kintarasakiki nanu te rishata enye.’

English: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
Masaai: Metaa nerewaki inkishu enye Yosef; neisho Yosef ninche endaa awalunye imbartan enye, o intare, o nkishu, o sirkon: neisho ninye ninche endaa awalunye nkishu enye pooki teilo ari.

English: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
Masaai: Nedaa ninche te nena naabore enkaji ino, nincho iyie ninche entoki naok te ilo keju lino le ng'ida.

English: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ajo ole nkalo naitore Herode, neirriwaki Herode etii ninye Yerusalem ina kata.

English: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
Masaai: Nemetii te lelo ooinosita endaa, oloyiolo ajo aainyo pee etiaka neijia.

English: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
Masaai: Ekeaku ina daa enashumi te nkaraki enkop te lelo arin oopishana lo lameyu oopuonu ena kop e Misiri, pee meidak enkop teina rishata o lameyu.”

English: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
Masaai: Inyo tudumu enkerai imbung'a tukurraki nkaik inono, amu kaitaa ninye olosho kitok.”

English: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
Masaai: Tejo, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: kebulaa ninye? Aimedotu ninye ntona enyena nedung'oo ilng'osil lenyena, neaku ore nena pilipil enyena ng'ejuko oo mbenek netoyu? Meya enkaina nagol oo ltung'ana kumok peyie edotuni ninye too ntona enyena.

English: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.
Masaai: Neitanap taa Yoshua lelo apolosak ejo, “Elepu entupuku te Yordan.”

English: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu aas eyieunoto ino, Na Ai; etii enkitanapata ino atua oltau lai.”

English: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
Masaai: Ore dama o kewarie, nemanaa ninche too sunta enyena; netii enkaruoisho o enyamali atua ninye.

English: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
Masaai: Teneyam oltung'ani leeiking'a entito o lapolosani nemeinos ina tito nena kishorot oo ntokitin sinyat.

English: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
Masaai: Ore pee eitorito ilo sirua, neilep Yesu ajing enkaji e Nkai, neiteru aiteng'enisho.

English: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.
Masaai: Ore pee eitokini aiturrur nena toyie eniare, etonita Mordekai te nkishomi o laiguanani.

English: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
Masaai: nintajeuu pee meye papa o yieyio, o lalashera laainei o nkanashera, o lelo pooki oora ilkulenye, nikordudu enkishui ang aaitung'uaa keeya.”

English: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
Masaai: Ore lelo likiure iyie naadol nanu neng'idayu, enkaraki naisiliga nanu ororei lino.

English: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
Masaai: Ina peyie edumakino ninye iloreren aarare ninye, nepik irresheta pooki alo; neisalaashaki orreshet lenye shumata enye; neyae ninye atua engumoto enye.

English: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
Masaai: laa ore ti atua empolos ino, iyie Misiri, neirriu nkitoduaat e nking'asia, agilunore Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki,

English: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
Masaai: Nelotu sii ninye Simon Petero, esujita, nejing atua enkurare; nedol nena arash e kitani napuyiapui teine, kake eitu ejing atua,

English: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
Masaai: Ore nena naatijinga, oloing'oni o elipong e pooki toki naata osesen, nejing atua, anaa enaitanapa Enkai Noa. Neikenoo Olaitoriani ninye tiatua.

English: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
Masaai: nening pooki ninye oloti o lbotor, ejo, “Ore ele tung'ani, ele taa oshi enoshi naji ‘Engolon Kitok Enkai.’ ”

English: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
Masaai: pee etum olaiguanani atishipakinoyu enkishiaa ino. Ore amu olkitok lino ninye, irrugokinoyu ninye;

English: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aya embata eina ilata naputishoreki o embata eilo sarge otii enchumata olperere lo lasar, neisuaaki Aron o lkilani lenyena, o layiok lenyena sii o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, neaku eitisinya ninye Aron o lkilani lenyena, o layiok lenyena o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, tenebo ninye.

English: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo oorup ate te neokieki enaisho, lelo arriyiak te nkitushulata oo naishi naapi,

English: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
Masaai: Ore lelo lemeure Enkai naaiteenikitia ninche elejare, kake aibung'a nanu to ltau lai pooki nkitanapat inono;

English: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
Masaai: neisho ninye endaa sidai namelok tenebo emukate naitobiraka epik inkaik o layioni lenye Yakobo.

English: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana Yoshua, “A-a; eikisiai iyiook Olaitoriani.”

English: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye isinkan le Akish, “Aime Daudi ele olaiguanani le nkop? Keitu ninche eranyakino maate ti alo ninye too sinkolioitin ejo: ‘Etasesekuana Saul nkalifuni enyena, Ore Daudi naa nkalifuni tomon enyena?’ ”

English: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina nelo aibung'are olkarsis obo le ina kop, neirriwaa ilo shoo meshomo airrita lbitiro.

English: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
Masaai: Amu ore kenya te ina olong, naa kenang'aa pooki ng'ae nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin e nkosholai, o nkitanyaanyukot e sahabu, apa naaitobirutua nkaik inyi too ng'ok, te nkaraki intae.

English: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
Masaai: Imbelekenya inkonyek inono intung'uayioki, amu kaaitanyamal ninche nanu, ore ilpapit linono netiu anaa iluaat oo nkineji, naadou to loshong'ishong'i le Gilead.

English: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Eikirik enetii ilo wuampa?” Nejo ninye, “Inosakaki nanu olmumai te Nkai, nchere mikiar matua, arashu kiya nanu apik atua nkaik o lkitok lai, naa kaarik enetii ele wuampa.”

English: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
Masaai: Ore pee edou Musa to ldoinyo le Sinai, eeta mbaoi are dapashi e nchakenisho te nkaina enye elotu adou aing'uaa oldoinyo, neitu eyiolou Musa ajo etawang'a enkomom enye te nkaraki natigire airo te nebo Enkai.

English: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
Masaai: Amu keikoroj ninye kewan nchere meyiolouni entorroni enye neibayuni.

English: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
Masaai: newaliki sii ninye enkop ilpaek o sabibu o eilata, naa kewaliki sii ninche Yesreel;

English: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Penuel, “Ore te naitoki ashukunye te seriani nagil ele talet asulu.”

English: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
Masaai: Ng'ura elaaki ninche iyiook epuonu aaraa iyiook aaipang'ie te nkop ino, apa ninchoo iyiook matujung.

English: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
Masaai: Imayianana intae lelo oounisho te mbata oo nkariak pooki, lelo ooisho ilmong'i o sirkon eidapashari aapuo.

English: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Asheri naa iltung'ana nkalifuni artam o iip ile arriyiak te pooki arrabal.

English: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
Masaai: Nejoki Saul ninye, “Kainyoo pee kitarresho nanu, iyie o layioni le Yese, te ina ninchoo ninye imukateni o olalem, ninkilikuanishore Enkai te nkaraki ninye, neaku aatudumakine ninye nanu naairrag arresh, anaa enatiu ena olong?”

English: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
Masaai: Ntukuoyu naa niyela te ilata ninchop ilkilani sidain nidoyio alo ewueji neidong'ishoreki; kake mincho kidol ilo tung'ani o metaba anaa neidip ainosa endaa neokisho.

English: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
Masaai: Neisilenu ninche ngarrin oo mbartan nkalifuni tomoni uni oare, o laiguanani le Maaka tenebo enjore enye, apa naewuo aun ilng'oborri te Madeba. Neipotuni Ilamori metupuku too nkanas aapuonu olarrabal.

English: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye nena silan enyena, “Paa kaji etii ninye? Kainyoo pee itung'uaitie ilo tung'ani? Empoto ninye pee elotu ainos endaa.”

English: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
Masaai: Ore ilo opalaki enkitarruorroto neing'oru enyorrata, kake ore ilo oigil embae tiae kata, neorore olchore oning'ore.

English: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
Masaai: Ore te sipata maata nanu eretoto te kewan, naa ore pooki wueji natumie eretoto neterewaki aaitung'uaa enatii.

English: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
Masaai: nedumunye taa oltau lino, nikirikino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, laa ninye likiyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitupuku te nkaji e sinkaisho,

English: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
Masaai: Ore olpolosie le nkalo o loo saen naa Enaiposha e Munyan naisukut, o metabaiki enkutuk o lkeju le Yordan. Ore olpolosie le nkalo e kopikop neiteru te mbata e naiposha te nkutuk o lkeju le Yordan;

English: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: nemeyau kutukaji olng'obor le ntumo, pee epolosaki ninye Olaitoriani; ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kegol alang oltung'ani ogol, naa neijia etiu ilo oota eng'eno elang ilo oota eng'olon.

English: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
Masaai: Newal ninye ajo, “Olkitok lai, olaiguanani, aateleja apa nanu osinka lai; amu etiaka osinka lino ninye, ‘Irotokoki nanu osikiria, pee atum atakedo nalo te nebo olaiguanani.’ Amu olmaima osinka lino.

English: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
Masaai: Ore etii Petero olgoriet ti abori ine, nelotu enkaisiaayiani nabo o lapolosani kitok;

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, ng'ura, kairriwaki nanu ninche olalem, o lameyu, o lmeitai, naa kaitotiu nanu ninche anaa ilng'abolo ootarruoitie lemeinosayu.

English: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
Masaai: Kaairriwaki nanu iyie olduruk naaitaas iyie mbaa e sulare, naitaa entoki torrono naing'asiakinoi.

English: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel's father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.
Masaai: Netoni lelo lewa pokira oare aadaa neokisho te nebo; nejoki menye ina tito ilo tung'ani, “Tobiko tishipayu niyeng'iyeng'a.”

English: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
Masaai: Kaing'ae apa natara Abimelek olayioni le Yerubeshet metua? Aime enkitok natanang'ua osoit oidong'ishoreki aitadoiki te suntai, neaku etua ninye te Tebes. Kainyoo intae pee ishomo oleng aanyikaki esuntai?’ Nijo iyie, ‘Ore sii osinka lino Uria Olhiti etua sii ninye.’ ”

English: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
Masaai: Kening Enkai, neitobor ninche, ilo apa ototonie olorika le nkitoo ebaiki moitie, enkaraki nemeibung ninche nkitanapat, nemeure ninche Enkai.

English: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Emimitiki, amu ore olemekes intae, naa ole nkalo inyi.”

English: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani o ltung'ana lenyena Yerusalem aarare Ilyebusi, lelo oomanya ina kop, apa ootiaakitia Daudi, “Milotu iyie ajing'u atua ene, kake eikimbooyo ninye ilmodook o lmaiman” - ejo, “Meidim ae kata Daudi aeu atua ine.”

English: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
Masaai: natejo nanu te siokinoto ai, “Ilepesho iltung'ana pooki.”

English: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
Masaai: Amu ena eyieunoto e Papa inchere, ore pooki odol Enkerai neiruk ninye, netum enkishui nemeish; naa kaitopiu nanu ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto.”

English: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipang'u Yehu alotu enetii isinkan lo lkitok lenye, nejoki ninche ninye, “Aisidain mbaa? Kainyoo pee eewuo ele tung'ani omoda enitii?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Iyiololo intae ele tung'ani o enkiroroto enye.”

English: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
Masaai: Nimpotipoto enkarna e nkai inyi, naipot sii nanu enkarna Olaitoriani. Ore Enkai nawalu te nkima naa ninye Enkai.” Newalu iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Enkiroroto sidai.”

English: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
Masaai: Naa te netii olopeny te nebo ina kiteng nemelak. Tenaa entoki apa naisilenuoki aasishore nelakieki enatoning'oteki.

English: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
Masaai: Neibooki ilmang'ati lenye ninche enkop, neyauni ninche aapik abori engolon enye.

English: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
Masaai: neaku eeta enkitoria naararie iloiriruani;

English: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin neidong'i aaitaa mbelibelat, ore nena tokitin e marmalisho nepejori te nkima. Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin neirrag te mijoonisho. Amu too mpisai e mulayoi etasotuo ninye ninche, naa nena pisai e mulayoi errinyokino ninye.

English: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana pooki aarrinyo nelo ake oltung'ani enkaji enye nelo Daudi pee emayian olmarei lenye.

English: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
Masaai: Ore oloinosie olmumai olperere lo lasar, einosie olperere lo lasar o pooki toki natii enchumata enye.

English: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
Masaai: Emijo ake eji intae atem ajo aiture too mpala.

English: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
Masaai: ore ropiyiani inyi naa ina tapa e Shihor, ina kisampuare o lkeju le Nail; iyie apa olbiasharai loo loreren.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkitok o layioni lino, amu entito ino ninye, mintalioo emasipaisho enye.

English: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e kopikop tolikioi ororei tigilunore kopikop,

English: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
Masaai: Ketii apa aekata iltung'ana oo toning'o oltoilo le Nkai eiro te mpolos enkima, anaa enitoning'o intae neton ake inchushu?

English: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
Masaai: Naing'orisho nanu, nadumunye, najoki lelo kituaak, o larikok, o lkulikae tung'ana, “Emiureyu ninche. Entadamu Olaitoriani, laa ninye olkitok neitureisho, naa ninye omitu ilalashera linyi, o layiok linyi, o ntoyie inyi, o nkituaak inyi, o nkang'itie inyi.”

English: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki ng'ae leitu etumi enkarna enye eigero ti atua ina buku e mpuaan, nenang'akini ninye atua olbalbal le nkima.

English: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Eeta mbariak ngumot enye, neeta motonyi sinkin. Kake meeta Enkerai e Tung'ani eneirishaki elukunya enye.”

English: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
Masaai: Eishiunye ninche olbae loo ltung'ana laainei te nkitaakunoto, ejo, ‘Eseriani, eseriani’ nemetii eseriani.

English: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
Masaai: Nelo ang, neinepu enkerai eirrag te rruat, neshomo oloirirua.

English: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.
Masaai: “Tenilotu iyie ataaniki enkanasa aarare, tang'asa nchoo ninche erishata eseriani.

English: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
Masaai: Nchoo metukurru lelo laaisilisil nanu, kake mikincho nanu aaitukurruni. Nchoo ninche eirut, kake mikincho nanu airut! Intadoiki ninche enkolong entorroni; ingilie ninche kat are enkidaata.

English: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
Masaai: laa ninye ilo olotu te siadi nanu, lemaaishiakino nalak enkeene e namuke enye.”

English: And this will we do, if God permit.
Masaai: Naa aikiaas kuna pooki eishorua Enkai.

English: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
Masaai: Tudung'o oleng tatene o kedienye ine wueji netuutakaki enepi olalem.

Masaai: Ore enkata ebaiki pee kipuo iyiook te Kadesh-Barnea omatalang olkeju le Seredi naa ilarin tomoni uni o isiet, o metaba anaa neaku ore olporror pooki, aa taa lelo tung'ana lo larrabal neidaaya ninche too lng'oborri, anaa apa enainosie Olaitoriani ninche olmumai.

English: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki Israel Yosef, “Ng'ura, etataana enkata pee aye, kake keaku Enkai tenebo iyie, naa aikintoki ayau iyie ina kop o loo papaai lino.

English: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Entaas intae nkiguanat aainei nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei nipuoyieyie ninche. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
Masaai: nitudumakinote intae enkaji e papa aarare ena olong, nitasesekuana intae ilayiok lenyena, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana te nchumata osoit obo, nintaa Abimelek olayioni le nkapiani, olaiguanani oitore lelo oomanya Shekem, enkaraki naa olalashe linyi.

English: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
Masaai: Ore pooki temata e nkinyiang'a naa te risioroto e shekeli e wueji sinyati, ore ngerrai tikitam naa shekeli nabo.

English: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
Masaai: Entoosh entarumpeta te Sion. Entisinya eenata e mpukoroto; empotu eumata nasinya;

English: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
Masaai: Negoro Farao te nkaraki lelo aitasheikinok lenyena pokira, olaitasheikimoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu tenebo olapejoni kitok loo mukateni.

English: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
Masaai: Aikijo aa naa? Aikienikino atua ng'ok pee eponari empiris?

English: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
Masaai: Itegelua iyie enchakenisho ino too sipat o te supatisho pooki.

English: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
Masaai: Neiger ninye te nena pala ajo, “Embalie enkolong naeni aapukoo, neishori Nabot enkitoo aaitulusoo too ltung'ana.

English: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
Masaai: Amu iyiololo aajo ore te siadi, pee eitoki aayieu nejung ina mayianata, netanyaki ninye, amu eitu etum erishata pee eirridu, hoo neing'orua too lkiyio.

English: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
Masaai: Metii apa toki atua ilo sanduku meteleku ake nena baoi dapashi oo soito apa naatipika Musa te Horeb, teine apa naitobirie Olaitoriani olning'o lo sotua o ltung'ana loo Siraeli, apa pee eipang'u te nkop e Misiri.

English: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
Masaai: “Emayiana ilooishir; amu ninche eilejileji.

English: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
Masaai: Ena ninye eyookini aaitaas intae, iyie na aji e Israel, te nkaraki ina torroni ino kitok. Ore enasirie neishieki ilo aiguanani le Israel katukul.

English: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
Masaai: Atuputuo nanu ilo obo te nkalo e moikuape, neewuo ninye, eewuo ninye eing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, naa kelotu ninye aipot enkarna ai; naa kelotu ninye aituny lelo aitoriak anaa esarng'ab, anaa enaipurj olaitobirani loo motioo oo nkulupuok e sarng'ab.

English: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
Masaai: ejo, ‘Eiterua ele tung'ani ashetisho, neitu eidip.’

English: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua ilapolosak, “Entudumu osanduku lo sotua enchom dukuya iltung'ana.” Nedumu ninche ilo sanduku lo sotua nepuo dukuya iltung'ana.

English: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
Masaai: Ore sii kuna neitisiny olaiguanani Daudi to Laitoriani, te nebo ina osholai o sahabu apa naaitisinya naaing'uaa iloreren pooki apa ootimira ninye,

English: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Ore peyie edol Farao ninche, neilejilej kewan to lorora lenye pooki, ore Farao tenebo enjore enye pooki, naaraa to lalem ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
Masaai: kake metii oltung'ani oidim aidondorra olng'ejep, entorroni nemeitirring'a, ebore esayiet nayaisho.

English: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
Masaai: Metaa einyiang'ua Yosef enkop pooki e Misiri ainyang'aki Farao, amu etimira Ilmisiri inkurman enye amu ketarasua olameyu oleng te ninche. Neaku enkop pooki ene Farao;

English: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
Masaai: nikindetidet pokira ina kewarie, ore iyiook pokira meeta oleitu eidetidet enkidetidet enye naata e utunoto enye.

English: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
Masaai: Nchoo nkonyek inono metoduaa esayiata o sinka lino o esayiata oo sinkan linono Isiraeli, nining ninche enkata naba anaa enikimpot iyie.

English: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
Masaai: Nchoo elamari oltau lo lwuasa te nanu; maata nanu enaporoki enkarruoisho.

English: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
Masaai: Amu etua sii Kristo nabo kata ake too ng'ok nemeigil, osupat too leme supati, pee etum atoriku iyiook enetii Enkai. Amu etaraki metua to sesen neitopiwuoki te Nkiyang'et

English: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
Masaai: Nanu enkorrok ai oarare intae te nkaina naitoriori o enkaina nagol, te ngoro, o te mpushuna, o te ngoro kitok.

English: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
Masaai: Ore emanyisho enye epuku aing'uaa Mesha te nkalo e Sefar o metabaiki enkop oo ldoinyo te nkilepunoto enkolong.

English: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
Masaai: Neirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel neisho lelo arikok lenye pooki ninye ing'udisin, nabo ake to larikoni, ore te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ng'udisin tomon oare, ore eng'udi e Aron naa nabo e nena ng'udisin enye.

English: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
Masaai: Neirrugo arum nedol inkarash e kitani napuyiapui eirrag teine, kake eitu ejing atua.

English: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
Masaai: Amaa taa te naa inji eikoni kuna tokitin pooki aaidaikie keishiaakino intae niaakuku iltung'ana ooikununo aja, to rrekie le sinyatisho o esidano e nkishiaa inyi too naaishiaakinore e Enkai?

English: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
Masaai: olayioni le Metusela, olayioni le Enok, olayioni le Yared, olayioni le Mahalalel, olayioni le Kainan,

English: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
Masaai: Ninye ake openy endapidapoi ai naa enjeunoto ai, ninye osempewuet lai, nemaaigusugusieki.

English: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
Masaai: Ti nitayioloito ilo aajo oloo sipat ninye, ina naitadedeyie te intae nchere ore ake pooki ng'ae oas esupat keino te Nkai.

English: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
Masaai: Etamio oltau lai ti atua nanu, neewuo olkirutoto le keeya shumata nanu.

English: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
Masaai: neitanap Olaitoriani ilo malaika, nerrinyoki olalem atua enchashur.

English: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
Masaai: Ore ilo oas ing'ok naa ole sheitani, amu etaasa apa sheitani ing'ok ebaiki enkiterunoto. Ina pee etaliee Oinoti le Nkai pee eidaikie isiaaitin e Sheitani.

English: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
Masaai: Te naitobor nanu oltau lai te mpukoroto, neaku ina enkurruna.

English: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Naa kelotu ninye Sion anaa olalakunoni too lelo le nkaji e Yakobo ooibelekenya aaing'uaa enkitarruoroto, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
Masaai: Keitu iyie iyany iyiook Iyie Enkai? Milo iyie, Olaitoriani, te nebo ilmang'ati lang.

English: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ina kitok, “Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”

English: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
Masaai: Ore pooki lee lememurata esuate o sesen lenye, nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena amu etigila osotua lai.”

English: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
Masaai: Naayau nanu kutuk aji e ilo odung'oro; ore peyie aing'or, ng'ura etii enaudoto natii esuntai.

English: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
Masaai: “Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, ‘Atoduaa nanu kulo tung'ana, naa ng'ura iltung'ana oogolong'u ninche;

English: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
Masaai: Amu ore indamunot enye neipiru olarrabal neiro too nkutukie enye imbaa enkarruoisho.

English: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
Masaai: Nebik ninye aa oltung'ani oata olduruk enkata pooki naba anaa enaata ina keeya; neaku ninye olaata entioto; neton ninye openy te wueji enye tiauluo ilng'borri.

English: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
Masaai: Nepuku oltoilo te nkatampoi nejo, “Ena Enkerai ai Gelunoti, entoning ninye.”

English: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
Masaai: Ore apa ina dung'oroto kitok neeta ilkererin okuni too soito oogueta oomanita o lkereri loo loom to ltarakuai, neeta sii nena ina dung'oroto e atua e nkaji o Laitoriani, o lodung'oro ojing'ieki enkaji.

English: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka ninye, “Eikibaiki iyie empiris ai, amu te wueji neshal eitabari engolon ai katukul.” Neaku kang'idakino oleng awuasare enchalan ai, pe eparnat engolon e Kristo atua nanu.

English: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
Masaai: Kake etii nkuti baa naigeroko intae te mpijan pee aitadamu intae, te nkaraki empiris naaishoo Enkai

English: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Embung'a sabatoni aainei niyanyititi enkaji ai Sinyati. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Ilfilisti aaigil aailepu aapuonu, neidapashakino oerata le Refaim.

English: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
Masaai: Naa keshukunye ninye alotu enkop enye eeta masaa kumok; kake ore oltau lenye eibelekenye aibayu ilo sotua sinyati. Naa keas ninye anaa enayieu, nerrinyo alo enkop enye makewan.

English: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
Masaai: ‘Ekeiro Yoab meeta eng'eno, ore irorei lenyena nemetii eng'eno nagut.’

English: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
Masaai: Wootu entodol inaataasa Enkai: keitureisho nkiaasin enyena ti atua iltung'ana.

English: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
Masaai: Neipotu Ahab Obadiah nejoki, “Shomo atua enkop pooki, o nchorroi pooki oo nkariak o erat pooki, amu ebaiki nikitum nkujit nikincho mbartan o nyumpui meye, pee mikintiany ake embata oo ng'uesi.”

English: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
Masaai: “Kake ti nining asipu oltoilo lenye nias nena pooki najo, naaku nanu olmang'atinta loo lmang'ati linono nagilunore lelo likigilunore iyie.

English: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie enkuretisho too ndamunot inono, niwuang'ie aitalamaa emion to sesen lino; amu ore kitisho o enkakenya enkishui naa empesho.

English: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
Masaai: “ ‘Aiyiolo nkiaasin inono. Ng'ura, atipika dukuya iyie kutukaji nabolo nemeidim hoo ng'ae aikeno; aiyiolo ajo enkiti golon iata, kake imbung'a ororei lai neitu imiki enkarna ai.

English: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki, “Milotu anyiku, intayu inamuka inono too nkejek inono, amu ore ine wueji nintasheyie naa ewueji nesinya.”

English: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.
Masaai: Ore kulo pokira neyam ntoyie oo Lmoabu; ore apa enkarna e nabo naa Orpa ore enkarna e nkae naa Rusi. Etobiko apa ninche te ine ilarin oobaya tomon.

English: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
Masaai: Einosaka Yesu olorora mbaa pooki too nkitanyaanyukot, neitu hoo einosaki likae rorei metii enkitanyaanyukoto.

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,

English: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
Masaai: ore ilo oirrag tiatua ina aji neituku ilkilani lenyena, ore oloinos endaa tiatua ina o aji neituku ilkilani lenyena.

English: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aitashe te kutukaji naoshiosh, ore ake pooki ng'ae oning oltoilo lai nebol kutukaji, naa kajing'aki nanu;

English: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
Masaai: Enturrai elap pooki, o losek, o esunkureisho o esukeny pooki, nitiuwu anaa inkera naanana,

English: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
Masaai: neibukoo ninche osarge lemeeta eleyiata, ilo sarge loo layiok lenye o ntoyie enye, apa naatopolosakitia nkitanyaanyukot e Kanaan, neisarkionieki ina kop te nkaraki ilo sarge.

English: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.
Masaai: Neibung enkaina e tatene aitasheyie. Negolu nabo kata ndapi o rubat oo nkejek e ilo tung'ani;

English: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
Masaai: Ore pee eishunye lelo arin iip tomon, nelakuni sheitani te korokoroni enye.

English: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, aaitaa iyie olarriponi te nkaji e Israel; ore ake pooki kata nining ororei eing'uaa enkutuk ai, nincho ninche enkikoo naing'uaa enatii.

English: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
Masaai: Ore ti aji neitoki ake ilooiteng'eni lenyena aaikilikuan ena bae.

English: And it shall be, if it make thee answer of peace, and open unto thee, then it shall be, that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee.
Masaai: Naa tenaa eseriani ewalata enye, nikibolu ninye, ore lelo tung'ana pooki ootumi tiatua ninye neas esiai nagol nikisai iyie.

English: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
Masaai: Ore eitayu ntokitin too lbenia lenye, ng'ura, meeta ake oltung'ani lemeeta orridati loo mpisai enyena to lbene; ore pee edol ninche tenebo menye irridat loo mpisai, neirut oleng.

English: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa kepuonu iloshon kumok nejo: “Wootu mailepa aapuo oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, maape enkaji e Nkai e Yakobo; pee etum ninye aiteng'ena iyiook nkoitoi enyena, nikipuo iyiook too rrekiei lenyena.” Amu Sion epukunye enkitanapata, neing'uaa ororei lo Laitoriani Yerusalem.

English: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neaku eiguane olaiguanani, neitobir ilasho oare le sahabu. Nejoki olorere, “Ishomo intae Yerusalem enkata naado. Eng'ura nkaitin inyi intae Israel, naa ninche apa naaitayutuo intae te nkop e Misiri.”

English: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
Masaai: Kake kadamu osotua lai tenebo iyie too nkolong'i e kitisho ino, naa kaitasheyie te iyie olning'o lai lo sotua loo ntarasi.

English: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
Masaai: amu ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i naaku keji, ‘Emayiana nkolupeno, nemayiana nkoishuaa neitu eisho, nemayiana ilki leitu enaki!’

English: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
Masaai: Ore amu inkeno indamunot enye peyie mening'u, mincho naa ninche meisula.

English: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
Masaai: nishet olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino te nchumata o sempewuet tene, nirragie isoito aitobiraki, niyau ilo oing'oni li are nintaa olasar opejori te nena keek e ina Ashera nidung meirraga te nkop.”

English: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, toning'o oltoilo lenye; nabo ake, nkoo ninche tuunoki, nintodol ninche nkoitoi e ilo aiguanani ooyooki aitore ninche.”

English: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
Masaai: naa ore enkaraki enkumoi e kule naata ninche, keinos ninye eng'orno; amu ore pooki ng'ae otelekua te ina kop naa keinos eng'orno o enaisho.

English: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
Masaai: Aaibelekenyakita ninche nanu enkoriong enye, neitu aaitorioki inkomomi enye; naa ore hoo naiteng'ena nanu ninche aitirrishaki eitu ninche ening'isho aang'amu nkiteng'enat.

English: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
Masaai: Neaku ena bae eng'oki te nkaji e Yeroboam, o metaa eiwuang'ieki neidaikieki aaishie te nkop.

English: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
Masaai: Kerriny ninye aaishooyo ilng'anayio le siaai enye, nemeitoki aekata ninye aijoo aitadoyio; ore dupoto e biashara enye nemetum ninye murruna.

English: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
Masaai: Eisidai teneitirring'a oltung'ani aanyu enjeunoto o Laitoriani.

English: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
Masaai: Ilkiintani onom intayu te ntukus nabo oo lkarash, nintoki aitayu ilkiintani onom te matua e oriong e ina tukus e are oo lkarash; ore lelo goso nchoo eipira.

English: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
Masaai: Na enkoliai oo larin ntomoni isiet o oong'uan. Nemepuku ti atua enkaji e Nkai, neen kewan aitupukoo.

English: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
Masaai: Elimu pooki tung'ani aisis kewan aibalie esupatisho o enkisiligata enye, kake tetema sii iyie tujurro ilo tung'ani enaikununo!

English: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
Masaai: Nejo Samuel, “Kaa iyie itaasa?” Nejo Saul, “Ore ake pee adol nchere kaaidapashari iltung'ana aaing'uaa, neitu sii ilotu too nkolong'i nikitudung'okinote neiturrurrote sii Lfilisti te Mikmash,

English: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
Masaai: Keshet ninye enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai, naa kaitasheyie nanu olorika le nkitoo enye ntarasi.

English: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
Masaai: Amu eiborrie ng'otonye onyek; ore ina natunute ninche netaasa embae enkurruna. Amu etejo ninye, ‘Kalo arubare isintan laainei, laa ninche laaisho nanu emukate ai o enkare ai, o enkila ai napuyiapui, o kitani ai, o eilata ai o enaisho.’

English: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o Benchamen, neiturrurro te Yerusalem too nkolong'i uni, naa olapa lioudo apa ilo e nkolong e tikitam o lapa. Netoni iltung'ana pooki to lkurroto otumoreki te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, eikirikira te nkaraki ena bae o tenkaraki enchan sapuk.

English: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
Masaai: Keiwuang'ieki njorin aaishie tukul te dukuya ninye, te nebo ilo kitok lo sotua.

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Edom o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu etimira ninye olalashe lenye to lalem, neiturraa olng'ur pooki, neibung ninye engoro anaake, neshum engoro napi ntarasi.

English: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo too lmareita pooki loo loreren, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon!

English: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Kaitaas nanu ine supatisho Hanan olayioni le Nahash, amu aaitaasa apa menye ine supatisho.” Neaku eirriwayie Daudi ilkiliku pee epuoi aaitagol ninye tenkaraki keeya e menye. Nepuonu isinkan le Daudi enetii Hanan teina kop oo Lamori, pee eitagol ninye,

English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
Masaai: Etaarare apa Ilfilisti Isiraeli neilanyisho iltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Ilfilisti, neari ninche meirragai etuata to ldoinyio le Gilboa.

English: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
Masaai: kenapi ninche aaya Babilon netoni teine ometabau ina olong naing'or nanu ninche ashukoki ene wueji.

English: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ladan, lelo ayiok le Gershom ooara ile Ladan, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa ile Ladan le Gershom: Yehiel.

English: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;
Masaai: Newalaki olaiguanani iltung'ana te nkitarrikinoto, neany ina utaroto naishoo ilpayiani kituaak.

English: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
Masaai: Ore eyieunoto eilo supat neiting'oki esidano; ore enkisiligata oo ltorrok neiting'oki e ngoro.

English: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
Masaai: Aidapasha ninche tiatua iloreren, neidapashari ninche tiatua inkuapi, te risioroto oo lkuaaki lenye ore too siaitin enye naiguanare nanu ninche.

English: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
Masaai: Eishori iltung'ana oomoda ilorikan le shumata; netoni lelo karsisi too wuejitin e abori.

English: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
Masaai: Ore ina kop apa nememanyae neturi, alang enaitoki aaku mitil te lelo pooki oogiroo ninye.

English: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
Masaai: Nejo ninche to ltoilo sapuk, “Eishiakino ilo Kuoo le ker apa oteyiang'aki, te neng'amu engolon, o enkarsisisho, o eng'eno nagut, o enkidimata, o enkanyit, o enkitoo, o emayianata.”

English: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
Masaai: Nanu Yohana ilo otoning'o nadol kuna baa, Ore ake pee aning nadol ninche, nabatata too nkejek e ilo malaika laaitoduaa ninche aserem ninye.

English: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
Masaai: Netii apa olarrabal erishata e Asa o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli too nkolong'i enye pooki.

English: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
Masaai: Kiomon Enkai pee miaasiasa ntorrok, neme pee eji kitudupote iyiook, ti niaasiasa intae isupati, hoo naa keing'or kulikae iyiook nejo eturua iyiook.

English: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
Masaai: Idol taa ajo eikenakini oltung'ani sipat too siaitin mme to lbae le nkirukoto ake.

English: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaraki nikiruko inchere etua Yesu neitoki apiu neijia sii etiu ti atua Yesu, kerrinyu Enkai te nebo ninye lelo ooirurate.

English: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
Masaai: Kake etiaakita ninche Serubabel, o Yeshua o kulie lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te Israel, “Miatata eniporokiki iyiook te nchetata e nkaji e Nkai ang; kake iyiook ake oopeny ooshetaki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, anaa enaitanapa iyiook Olaiguanani Sairos, ilo aiguanani le Parsia.”

English: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
Masaai: Keipotoki oltung'ani eidipaki aatumurat? Emincho etem ajo aisudoo lmonek le murata. Keipotoki oltung'ani memurata? Emijo metumurati.

English: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
Masaai: Neaku eitu ening olaiguanani olorere, amu embae ena nayaua Olaitoriani pee etum aitabai ororei lenye, apa oiroro Olaitoriani aimunye Ahija le Shilon aliki Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

English: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejo, “Keitu agelu intae, pokira tomon oare, ore obo linyi naa oloirirua?”

English: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
Masaai: “Naton nanu to ldoinyo anaa apa te nkata e dukuya, nkolong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam, naatoning'o sii apa Olaitoriani ina kata; neany Olaitoriani eidaikie intae.

English: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa tinikinkilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Ainyoo peyie iyagie?’ naa ijoki, ‘Te nkaraki lelo kiliku oopuonu. Ore peyie ebau, naa kelepori pooki tau ore nkaik pooki naa keshalu, ore pooki tau neiterre neshalu nkung pooki anaa enkare. Ing'ura, ajo elotu naa keitabari ninye.’ ” Ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
Masaai: Peyie edumu engoro ai napi, peyie aitalaku, atipika ninye shumata endapidapoi nasipa ilo sarge oibukoyie ninye peyie meitoipori ake.

English: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
Masaai: Neitoki Natan ajoki Betsheba ngotonye Solomon, “Keitu iyie ining ajo etaa Adonija olayioni le Hagit olaiguanani nemeyiolo Daudi olkitok lang?

English: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
Masaai: Enchoo lelo lang ootubulutua aabaya metadamu ena, naa te nepaashari intae indamunot ti ae toki, naa keibalakinye sii ninche intae Enkai.

English: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa osina lenye;

English: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
Masaai: Ore empukunoto enye, eeta nena ong'uan emua nabo, anaa enkeju eng'arri natii atua enkeju eng'arri.

English: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
Masaai: nejoki ninche meing'oru olng'ur le Nkai e shumata ti alo ena kisudoroto, pee meidaaya ake Daniel o lelo le ncholiek enye te nebo lelo ang'eni le Babilon.

English: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
Masaai: Nejo, ‘Iltuleta iip le ilata.’ Nejoki ninye ilo, ‘Tudumu empalai ino e sile, totona tasioki ngero onom.’

English: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie ntasho anaake, ting'iria osina taasa esiaai o lalikioroni, ntabai enkisiaayiare ino.

English: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Te ine nanu aalotu atumore, naa te shumata olorika lo lng'ur o te rishata e lelo kerubi ootii enchumata o sanduku le nchakenisho, aairorie nanu iyie ti alo nena pooki naaisho nanu iyie too nkitanapat te nkaraki itung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Mariamu!” Neibelekenya nejoki te nkutuk oo Lhebrania, “Rabboni!” Eji Olaiteng'enani.

English: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
Masaai: Torrinyu iyiook, Na Ai oo lororani; nchoo enkomom ino metawang'a, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!

English: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Simon Petero ina nebatata too nkejek e Yesu, ejoki, “Olaitoriani, tung'uayioki nanu amu, kara oltung'ani loo ng'ok.”

English: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entabai intae; amu eitanapa Olaitoriani Daudi, ejo, ‘Te nkaina o sinka lai Daudi aitajeu nanu iltung'ana laainei Israel aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; naitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye pooki.’ ”

English: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, amu etaasa ninye mbaa e nking'asia! Ore ina aina enye e tatene, o ina aina enye sinyati, netimirishe.

English: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
Masaai: iyie ele oning enkomono! Enitii elotu pooki toki naishu,

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Tudumu eng'udi ino nintorioo enkaina ino ti oriong nkariak e Misiri, ti oriong ilkejek lenye, o erat lenye, o mugurri enye o lchorroi lenye, pooki loo nkariak, pee etum aataa osarge, neaku osarge te nkop pooki e Misiri too oketa oo nkeek o too oketa oo soito.’ ”

English: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
Masaai: Eipang'aki ninye oloputukunyi anaa olairrag le nkare; ore kewarie nenap ninye osiwuo sapuk.

English: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
Masaai: Amu, lalashera laainei ayieu niyiolouwu, nchere, ore lelo Omon Supati latolikio intae mme oltung'ani otang'asua.

English: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Daudi ninye, “Nena enkolong naa ninye kitiaaka iyie Olaitoriani, ‘Ng'ura, kapik nanu olmang'atinta lino atua enkaina ino, naa intaas ninye anaa enidol aa sidai.’ ” Neinyototo Daudi neiseleejari alo adung'oo olcholoi lo lkila le Saul.

English: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
Masaai: Amu eiro Enkai te nkoitoi nabo, o tiare hoo nememusu tung'ani ninye.

English: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
Masaai: Ore eishoi e Yehoiakim naa: Yekonia olayioni lenye o Sedekia olayioni lenye.

English: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
Masaai: Amu ainyoo edupore oltung'ani, te netum enkop pooki neiturraa enkishui enye?

English: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
Masaai: Iata iyie enkaina magilani; kegol enkaina ino, neado enkaina ino e tatene.

English: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
Masaai: ilarin ile intae iunuunu nkurman inyi, naa ilarin ile intobiriri ilng'anayio linyi, nisotisoto ilng'anayio lenye;

English: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche ilkiliku neiturrur te nebo ilkituaak pooki loo Lfilisti, nejo, “Kaa kintaas osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli?” Newal ninche, ejo “Nchoo osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli eyauni aaitamanu Gas.” Neyau ninche osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli ine.

English: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani: “Enkaraki natung'uaitie ninche enkitanapata ai apa natipika nanu dukuya ninche, neitu ening oltoilo lai, arashu epuo te risioroto enye,

English: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
Masaai: Enting'idata o lelo oong'ida ninchirishiri o lelo ooishir.

English: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
Masaai: Newal Ruben ajo, “Ekeitu apa ajoki intae emintaas entorrono enkayioni? Neitu kinining'ining'i. Metaa ore taata etabawua naa elaata osarge lenye.”

English: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie itii keper, nias, ninguanare isinkan linono, aitalaku entorroni ayau entorroni enye shumata endukuya enye makewan, nimbalunye ilo supat alaaki ninye te risioroto e supatisho enye.

English: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
Masaai: Niminyorraa intae aapuonu enatii pee itumutumu enkishui.

English: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
Masaai: Toduaa eneba enyorrata nanyor nanu inkiguanat inono! Tagolie enkishui ai te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno.

English: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina olong neito idia alo, ore olpisiaai loo laisiaayiak laainei neas esiaai e nchetare, neibung likae pisiaai iremeta, o long'oi o nkai, o nkilani oo lgooitie, neitashe ilarikok tioriong enkaji pooki e Yuda,

English: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua ninche, “Te nirara intae olosho loo ltung'ana kumok, elepa enchom entim, ore te ine, nisiajakinyenye ate enkop te ina kop oo Lperisi o ene Rafaim, amu ore ena kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim naa eironkai te intae.”

English: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
Masaai: Ore Hosa loo layiok le Merari neeta ilayiok: Shimri aa ninye olkitok, (amu ore duoo ninye neme olkikau ninye, neitaa menye kitok).

English: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
Masaai: “Artaseses olaiguanani loo laiguanak oirriwaki Esra olapolosani, ilo aigeroni loo nkitanapat e Nkai e keper. Ore taata,

English: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:
Masaai: Nejoki ilo sinka aitasheikinoni, “Entito oo Lmoabu apa nairiamunore Naomi te nkop e Moab.

English: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
Masaai: Ing'ura ituutayie lkumok, nintagolo inkaik nemeeta engolon.

English: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
Masaai: Nelo ilo tung'ani, neliki Ilyahudi nchere Yesu oishiunye.

English: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
Masaai: Nintayu imotioo enyena naaiwouo nkuruon, o ilkijikoni o ngirran o ntokitin naaitobirieki enkima; ore ntokitin enyena pooki naasishoreki nintobir to suyai.

English: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
Masaai: neshukunye taa Yoshua, o Israel pooki te nebo ninye, aapuonu ilng'oborri te Gilgal.

English: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
Masaai: ntayu shekeli imiet ake te pooki tungani, neitorisiokini shekeli e wueji sinyati; ina shekeli gera tikitam

English: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eisum Yehudi imatuan uni aashu ong'uan, nedung olaiguanani te nkalem nenang'aki atua ina kima nayupuyup ometaba anaa nemut enkima nayupuyup ilo piyayati.

English: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
Masaai: Nejoki Hilkia Shafan olaigeroni, “Anoto nanu embuku oo nkitanapat tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.” Neisho Hilkia ina buku Shafan.

English: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
Masaai: Aime ena kikompe oshi eokishore olkitok lai, naa te ninye eibonisho? Itaasa entorroni teina nitaasa.’ ”

English: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
Masaai: o Noga, o Negef, o Yafia,

English: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
Masaai: Nchoo ninche meitukurruni, neidang ntarasi; nchoo ninche meidaa te sulare.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, tuturo atua esuntai”, ore peyie atur esuntai, ng'ura netii kutuk aji.

English: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
Masaai: Iyie likitorikoyie nanu te nkiguana ino, ore te siadi niking'amaa nanu te nkitoo ino.

English: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
Masaai: nepuonu ilairritak loontare aaraa ninche, kake eitasho Musa aretu ninche, neitook ntare enye.

English: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
Masaai: “Amu tenimbelekenyanya intae te dede aaing'uaa nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, tinimbung'ubung'u te dede esipata o ltung'ani ake olikae,

English: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki kila o pooki shoni oitashala enkare e lewaisho neitukui te nkare, neton ninye eiduruk o metaa teipa.

Masaai: Ntaasa isupati, Olaitoriani, lelo oonyor isupati, o lelo supati too ltauja lenye!

English: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
Masaai: Esipata naisho olosho meisisi, kake ore eng'oki naa enkurruna te pooki orere.

Masaai: Indurrudurra tena kop, naa kaaku nanu tenebo iyie, naa kaamayian, amu iyie tenebo iishoritin inono aisho kuna kuapi pooki, naitabaya olmumai lainosie papaai lino Abraham.

English: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

English: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

Masaai: Neiturrur Yepta iltung'ana pooki le Gilead nearare Efraim, nesesekuan iltung'ana le Gilead Efraim, enkaraki natejo, “Irara intae ilaisikak le Efraim, intae ile Gilead, te mpolos e Efraim o Manase.”
