English: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
Masaai: Metaa ajo nanu, ‘Toning'oki; nchooki sii nanu maibalie enduaata ai.’

English: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu olgisoi le sahabu arashu e masaai e sahabu neija etiu ilo ng'en oisikong enkiok naning'isho.

English: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
Masaai: Neyieng Musa ninye, neitayu embata eilo sarge lenye nepik enkitipet enkiok e Aron e tatene o lmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene o le nkeju enye e tatene.

English: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani ogol netiu anaa suut, ore esiaai enye netiu anaa suut naapiki enkima neyupuyup te nebo, nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aibooi ina kima.

English: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.
Masaai: tenaa kanoto nanu omom too nkonyek o laiguanani, naa tenaa keitiship olaiguanani meishoru enkolat neitabaya eomonunoto ai, nchoo olaiguanani o Haman epuonu taisere osirua layooki aitobiraki ninche, ore taisere naas anaa enatejo olaiguanani.”

English: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
Masaai: Neya ninye ematua e tomon oo ntapan inyi oe noo sabibu neisho ninche ilkituaak lenyena o isinkan lenyena.

English: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
Masaai: Ore Enkai apa naitamanya enkarna enye ine wueji, metusulai pooki aiguanani o ltung'ana ooitorioo nkaik enye aaibelekeny ena, anaa einyal ena aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem. Nanu Darias oitayio ena kitanapata nchoo metaasi neibung'i aakurraki.”

English: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
Masaai: Etaasaki apa ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia tiatua iltung'ana too nkaik oo lkipaareta. Netii apa pooki tenebo to lgoriet le Solomon.

English: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
Masaai: Miaata ake kulie aitin te dukuya nanu.

English: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
Masaai: Neirorie intae Olaitoriani tiatua empolos eina kima; nining'ining'i oltoilo loo rorei lenyena, kake eitu idolidolo ilo oiro; oltoilo ake itoning'o.

English: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
Masaai: Ara nanu ole ncholuek e lelo likiure iyie, ole lelo ooibung nkitanapat inono.

English: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
Masaai: Kake aikibor apa ti atua intae anaa enkaibung'ani naing'or inkera enyena.

English: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, kira taata iyiook inkera Enkai neton eitu elioyu enikiyooki aatiu, kake kiyiolo aajo ore pee elioyu ninye nikitiu anaa ninye amu aikidol ninye eneikununo.

English: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
Masaai: Nepuo olorere pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te ine netii Musa.

English: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
Masaai: Naa ore too layiok laainei pooki (amu aaishoo Olaitoriani ilayiok kumok) netegelua Solomon olayioni lai, pee eton to lorika le nkitoo le nkitoria o Laitoriani te Israel.

English: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
Masaai: Neitoki aipotu olorere nejoki, “Entoning'oki intae pooki, naa enchoo ejing'aa intae.

English: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
Masaai: Neiu Sila Tubalkain, laa ninye olkunoni oidong'u inkinantani too suyan, o sekenke. Neji enkanashe e Tubalkain Naama.

English: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore enkiroroto enye naa kemelok oleng, naa ore ninye pooki naa keng'uarrayu, olanyor lai ele naa olchore lai ele, natoyie e Yerusalem.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ekake ayia intae lelo oibonok oomoda lelo oosuj enkiyang'et enye maate, nemeeta toki natoduaa!

English: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
Masaai: Ng'ura, atoorikia nanu intae metaa enjung'ore too loshon linyi nena kuapi naang'or, te nebo nkuapi pooki naidipa nanu aiwuang'ie, ebaiki Yordan o metabaiki enaiposha kitok te nkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Masaai: Keisho ninye engolon ilo oiterria, ore ilo lemeeta enkidimata neponiki engolon.

English: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
Masaai: Amaa naa, kataa olmang'atinta linyi, amu atolikio intae isipat?

English: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo, to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e naapishana o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
Masaai: Aashu tenelo neiro oltung'ani te nkutuk enye ainos olmumai pee eas entorroni aashu eas esidai olmumai ake duoo ninye oinos iltung'ana, naa tenaa embae ena naisudoro te ninye, ore ake pee elotu ayiolou neaku ninye te pooki e kuna oloitarruoyie.

English: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye ayau eseriani. Pee kitum iyiook aatudumakinoto ninye ilchekuti oopishana, o ltung'ana isiet kituaak loo ltung'ana.

English: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye enkerai enye, “Kueta ing'oru nena baa natang'oroyie nanu.” Ore ekuet enkayioni nengoroo embae te idia alo ninye.

English: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
Masaai: Kegilunore Olaitoriani ninche; keishie ninye nkaitin pooki e nkop, neaku ninye eirrugokinoi, pooki ake te wueji enye, nkuapi pooki oo loreren.

English: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu Mara, neitu eidim aatook enkare e Mara amu kedua, neaku etejoki ine Mara.

English: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
Masaai: Entudupa ilkulikae leton eing'ashing'ash.

English: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
Masaai: Ore Israel pooki, oldokunoti o inoti, te nebo ilpayiani lenye o lkituaak o larishak lenye, neitashe too nkipirakinot e ilo sanduku te dukuya lapolosak le Lawi apa oonap ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo Laitoriani, etii olpisiai lenye dukuya oldoinyo le Geresim netii olpisiai lenye dukuya oldoinyo le Ebal, anaa apa enaitanapishe Musa ilo sinka lo Laitoriani te dukuya, nchere pee emayian ninche iltung'ana le Israel.

English: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
Masaai: Ore endukuya enye naa Sahabu nasila; ore lpapit lenyena naa sidain, kerook anaa olkurruk.

English: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
Masaai: Etorikoyie ilapolosak meeta toki nenang'aa lelo magil.

English: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
Masaai: Kake ore tialo iltung'ana loo Siraeli, eitu eitaa Solomom irrindiki le siaai enye. Isikarini apa ninche, o ltung'ana le nkitoo, o lkituaak le njore loo ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan.

English: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
Masaai: Amu meeta enkiguana olng'ur, te ilo leitu eitodolu olng'ur, kake emir olng'ur enkiguana.

English: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
Masaai: Nepuku sii iloiriruani ooiduruk kumok, aaing'uaa ltung'ana ebuaaya aajo, “Ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai.” Neing'ode amitiki eiro, amu keyiolo ninche aajo Kristo ninye.

English: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
Masaai: Tiaaki iltung'ana pooki leina kop tenebo ilapolosak, “Amaa ina kata nipukoo pee iomon, ninchir sii to lapa le imiet, o to liopishana, te kulo arin intomoni naapishana, itupukoyie apa te nkaraki nanu kiomon?

English: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
Masaai: nedumunye alo aning'ore lapolosak kituaak o sikarini, aitoriak eneiko pee ekaldaa Yesu te ninche.

English: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Gad, ilo aduani le Daudi ejo,

English: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
Masaai: Ore too Lawi: naa Shemaia olayioni le Hashub, olayioni le Asrikam, olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Buni;

English: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
Masaai: Ore too le Isharit, naa Shelemot; ore too layiok le Shelemot naa Yahat.

English: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
Masaai: Enyeito intae ilamerak; enchira intae ilaokok le naisho, te nkaraki ina aisho namelok, amu eiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa nkutukie inyi.

English: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
Masaai: o nkanas pooki e Sihon olaiguanani loo Lamori, apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Heshbon, o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lamoni;

English: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel's father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e imiet nedumunye ninye tadekenya enasirie pee elo; nejoki menye ina tito, “Ntagolo kewan, totona o metigilayu enkolong.” Nedaa ninche pokira oare.

English: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
Masaai: Ore ake pee errinyunye ninche aaliki ninye, nejo ninye, “Ororei lo Laitoriani ele, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Elisha le Tishbi, ejo, ‘Ore to lpolosie le Yesreel naa keinos ildiain nkiri o sesen le Yesebel;

English: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Musa, nelo adoyio to ldoinyo eeta mbaoi are e nchakenisho too nkaik enyena, mbaoi naaigero too nkaloli pokira are; eigero te nkalo nabo neigero te nkae alo.

English: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.
Masaai: Neiger ninye mpala amor Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli neiro asukeny ninye ejo, “Anaa nkaitin oo loshon neitu eidim aatokordu iltung'ana lenye too nkaik aainei, neijia etiu Enkai e Hesekia, mekordu ninye iltung'ana te nkaina ai.”

English: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
Masaai: Enkiyang'et naishoru enkishui; meeta osesen dupoto. Ore lelo rorei latiaaka intae, enkiyang'et naa enkishui.

English: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: “Enkena iltung'ana, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep,” anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa. Ore lelo tung'ana le Israel ooetuo aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri, naa:

English: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neitoki enkatampoi aitoip ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neiput enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.

English: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
Masaai: Eminchosho ake oltung'ani elej intae te pooki oitoi, amu melotu ina olong te neme eserserisho nalotu te dukuya, neibalunyieki ilo tung'ani le ngogong'i, enkerai e nkiminata,

English: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
Masaai: Netiu iloibonok anaa enkijape; metii ororei atua ninche. Neijia eitaasi ninche!’ ”

English: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
Masaai: Na aji e Lawi, isisa Olaitoriani! Intae kulo ooure Olaitoriani, esisa Olaitoriani!

English: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena meitobirakini empeut te nkaraki olorere, pee merratanyi ninye;

English: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
Masaai: nerup kewan te modai nemeyiolo toki. Eeta ninye enkure oe nchankar o empong'o, naa ine epukunye olom o lolepilepi, o emorore, o nkiteenikinot torrok,

English: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
Masaai: Neeta apa Saul enkapiani naji enkarna Rispa, entito e Aia; nejoki Ishboshet Abna, “Kainyoo pee ishomo iyie ajing'aki enkapiani e papaai lai?”

English: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
Masaai: Naa kaidaikie nanu iwuejitin inyi e shumata nasulaki e nkop ilperereni linyi loo lasarri le nkorropil, nanang'aki mpopoki inyi nchumat enena kitanyaanyukot inyi nemeishu; neibelekenya oltau lai aibayu intae.

English: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
Masaai: Neitoki ake anutayu neiu enkayioni nejo, “Ore taata naa kaibung'are olpayian lai, amu atoikio ninye ilayiok okuni.” Ina peyie eipot enkarna enye ajo Lawi.

English: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
Masaai: Ore taata ena kishoroto naa ninye eyaka esinka ino olkitok lai inchoo meishori lelo barnot oosuj olkitok lai.

English: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
Masaai: Koree taata olaiguanani lino pee kintajeu; koree lelo kituaak linono pooki pee kimitu lelo apa litejo iyie, “Inchooki nanu olaiguanani o ilkituaak?”

English: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
Masaai: Ina pee atejo malotu aigilie, intae ai baikinoto name.

English: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
Masaai: meteleku ake Kalebu olayioni le Yefune ilo loo Lkenise o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni amu etusuja ninche Olaitoriani katukul.’

English: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
Masaai: neiken sii inkonyek oo nkariak e ng'uton o lusien e keper. Neguarra enchan e keper.

English: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
Masaai: kake ore eyia, eitu eirriwakini Eliya hoo nabo e nena, enkoliai e Sarepta ake eirriwakaki te nkop e Sidon.

English: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
Masaai: Naa te nemeeta lalashera, nincho naa enjung'ore enye ilalashera le menye.

English: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
Masaai: Ore nkera enyena neing'oru omom teilo aisinani, ore inkaik enyena nerriny aaishooyo enkarsisisho enye.

English: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Neishooyo ninche teina kitisinyata ena aji e Nkai iloing'ok iip nabo, o lmeregeshi iip are, o lkuo le kerra iip ong'uan, neitayu anaa olasar le ng'oki too Siraeli pooki ilkineji tomon oare, terisioroto e siana oo loshon loo Siraeli.

English: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
Masaai: Ore pee etum ninche ninye te lido kekun le naiposha, nejoki ninye, “Rabii kanu ilotu ene?”

English: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
Masaai: naa kaisho nanu mikitemenuni nikintadouni te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, anaa ina neitu iyie imbung nkoitoi aainei, kake intodolua olkep too nkiteng'enat inono.”

English: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
Masaai: kulo ninche ilayiok le Yuda. Eer, o Onan, o Shela, ore kulo pokira okuni apa etoikio Betshua oo Lkanaani ninye. Ore apa Eer ilo kikau le Yuda naa oltung'ani arruoni te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku etara Olaitoriani ninye metua.

English: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
Masaai: Kuna ninche njung'oreitin apa naatoorikitia Eliesa olapolosani, o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo ltung'ana le Israel, iltung'ana te oshoto e nkukuo te Shilo, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te kutukaji o lng'obor le ntumo. Neaku eidipa apa ninche aatudung enkop.

English: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eibelekenyate kulo tung'ana aapuo aashuko siadi anaake? Neibung ninche aakurraki elejare, neany ninche eshukunye.

English: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
Masaai: Kake ataasishe te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki ninye te dukuya iloreren, laa ninche aitupukunye ninche edolita.

English: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ilukuny oo loshon loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, “Ena ninye eitanapishe Olaitoriani.

English: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
Masaai: nerrinyo aapuo ang, nepuo aaitobir sonkoyoni o ila narropil. Neyeng'iyeng'a te nkolong e sabato anaa enajo inkitanapat.

English: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
Masaai: Kinchopo nanu to lchoni o to sesen nikirip nanu aitutum iloik omorlooishi.

English: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
Masaai: eitu ninye eisho likae tung'ani meibooki ninche enkop; neisikong ninye ilaiguanak tenkaraki ninche,

English: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Isiraeli pooki aajo eitu ening olaiguanani ninche, newaliki iltung'ana olaiguanani aajoki, “Kaa rubata iyiook kiata te Daudi? Mikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese. Shomo pooki ng'ae olng'obor lino, intae Israel! Ing'ura taata enkaji ino makewan Daudi.” Nedumunye Isiraeli pooki aapuo ilng'oborri lenye.

English: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoash olayioni le Yehoahas aya te Benhadad olayioni le Hasael nena anas apa naatooruo ninye Yehoas papaai lenye to larrabal. Katitin uni etimira Yoash ninye nerrinyu nena anas oo Siraeli.

English: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
Masaai: Etosholate ildoinyo netiu anaa nkapo te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

English: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
Masaai: lelo ooitotiu ilng'ejepa lenye anaa lalema, lelo ooing'oru irorei oopi anaa mbaa,

English: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening arashu eishoru enkiok enye, kake eshomo ninche too ndamunot enye o engolon oo ltauja lenye torrok, nepuo siadi neitu epuo dukuya.

English: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
Masaai: Nebatata lelo payiani tikitam o oong'uan te dukuya ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, neserem ilo oishu ntarasi o intarasi, neirragie nkopiyiani enye e nkitoo te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo, neranyisho aajo,

English: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
Masaai: Keidim inkiri osesen lai o ltau lai aaishunye, kake Enkai e ngolon oltau lai naa erubata ai ntarasi.

English: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
Masaai: Neaku eitobiraki apa esiaai pooki o Laitoriani ina olong, pee eibung'i pasaka neitayuni olasar opejori, tenchumata olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, terisioroto enkitanapata o laiguanani Yosia.

English: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
Masaai: Entotoni te ina aji ninosinoso, niokioko entoki naba anaa enaishori intae, amu enare olaasani le siaai olekoisiaayio lenye; emipuo aarukurukoo nkajijik.

English: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
Masaai: Ore ena ng'eno eitu edou eing'uaa shumata, kake ene nkop, o enoo ltung'ana, o enoo loiriruani.

English: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Musa osinka le Nkai teine te nkop e Moab, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani,

English: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tejo enkarna enye Yesreel; amu enkiti kata ake nang'or, pee aitame nanu enkaji e Yehu te nkaraki osarge le Yesreel, naa kaishie nanu enkitoria e nkaji e Israel.

English: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
Masaai: Ore pee egela ninche maate, nepuo pee eidip Paulo atejo ena bae: “Etisipa apa Enkiyang'et Sinyati pee ejoki iloo minyi to loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya,

English: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
Masaai: nejoki olaiguanani, “Mincho olkitok lai aaibung nanu te ntorroni arashu edamu eneikuna osinka lino pee eas entorrono ina olong apa naing'uaa olkitok lai olaiguanani Yerusalem; mincho olaiguanani enap too ndamunot enyena.

English: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Koree doi Sara enkitok ino?” Neng'amaaa ajoki,

English: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Amu kepuoi aaibalunye enkitoo o Laitoriani, nedol iltung'ana pooki te nebo, amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro kuna.”

English: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip atushukunye eisulie olarrabal le Kedorloamer tenebo ilaiguanak ooboitare, etupukuo olaiguanani le Sodom alo anang'are to erata le Shafe, (aa ninye o erata lo laiguanani.)

English: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, kaing'ae nanu aisiaai? Aime ilo ayioni lenye? Ore apa anaa enaisiaayia papaai lino, kaaisiaai sii nanu iyie.”

English: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
Masaai: Ng'ura, aitashe nanu te mbata enchorro e nkare, ore intoyie oo ltung'ana lena anasa egira aapuku aaipang'u aoku enkare.

English: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
Masaai: Amu atua ninye etonyorra aitamany emborei pooki e Enkai,

English: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu Olaitoriani, ntajeu enkishui ai; tokorduaki nanu te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino nauno.

English: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
Masaai: amu etasioko apa Enkai adol embae naikash te iyiook, inchere ore mikitii iyiook nemeitabari ninche.

English: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kejing olarrabal atua iltung'ana linono, ore lelo sempewueti linono neidaikieki, anaa apa enaidaikie Shalaman Bet-arbelon teina olong o larrabal; nedung'udung'i nkera o noo ng'otonye.

English: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani ilasuriaa oopi atua iltung'ana, neony ninche iltung'ana, o metaa etuata iltung'ana kumok le Israel.

English: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
Masaai: Kake ore teine ning'oruru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa eitumutumu intae ninye, tenililitutu aaing'oru ninye too ltauja linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki.

English: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
Masaai: Aimidol ajo ore enkirukoto o nkiaasin enyena easisho te nebo? Neitabayioki enkirukoto enye too nkiaasin.

English: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki ti atua Israel ooidim aashom enjore enkena intae o Aron ninche, anaa ilturrurri.

English: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?
Masaai: Newaliki Abishai olayioni le Seruiya ajoki, “Aimeari Shimei metua tena, enkaraki netediaa ninye ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata?”

English: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika ninye, “Terretenayu, nchopo namuka.” Neiko neijia. Nejoki, “Nchopo olkila tusujuaki.”

English: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
Masaai: Naa ena eisiligie iyiook, enkishui oo ntarasi.

English: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
Masaai: kalo otuutayie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani, aashu anaa olaikooni lenye neiteng'en ninye?

English: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
Masaai: Ilo iyie aaku emaupe e nkishiaa te nkaina o Laitoriani, niaku enkishili e nkitoo te nkaina e Nkai ino.

English: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
Masaai: Neitashe ninye nebuaaki enjore oo Siraeli ejo, “Kainyoo pee impang'utua intae aapuonu aataaniki olarrabal? Ae mara nanu Olfilisti, nirara intae isinkan le Saul? Entegelaki ate oltung'ani, ninchosho ninye edou alotu ene natii.

English: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
Masaai: amu kenyor olorere lang, neteshetaka ninye iyiook enkaji e ntumo.”

English: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
Masaai: Keitu ejing'aa intae? Aimidamumu mukateni imiet naainosa iltung'ana nkalifuni imiet, kaja nkikapuni ninturrurrutuo?

English: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina emikirura naa anaa enairura kulikae, kake matashololoto nikinteng'enuo.

English: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
Masaai: Etabaitie ina kata inkolong'i e Isaak ilarin iip o ntomoni isiet.

English: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
Masaai: Ore pee eya te Yason o te lelo kulikae mpesai naaisiligieki, neishori meshomo.

English: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Metaa etua apa ilo sotua ina olong. Ore lelo amirak o lainyang'ak le nena tare naagira aaing'or, neyiolou aajo ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
Masaai: Aitunyoyie nanu olorere te ngoro ai, naitemer nanu ninche te ngoro ai napi, nabukoki nanu osarge lenye enkop.”

English: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo aaishankarrarre ninye, aayie olmonekei oing'uaa keper aatem.

English: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Iyie otorikoyie iltung'ana linono anaa eluaata oo ntare, te nkaina e Musa o Aron.

English: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:
Masaai: anaa naaji tenelo oltung'ani entim tenebo olelatia enye adung'u ilkeek, neyuk te nkaina enye entolu adung'u olchata, neshurtunye endukuya e ntolu near ilo le latia enye metua, eidim ninye atasaru nabo e kuna anas neitajeu enkishui enye;

English: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
Masaai: Ore enkiroroto o lmodai naa eng'udi te nkoriong enye, kake ore inkutukie oo lng'eni naa kerrip ninche.

English: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
Masaai: Keishu Olaitoriani; meisisi ina dapidapoi ai, meitaae kitok Enkai e njeunoto ai,

English: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa ninche aapuo to ldoinyo le Nkai elototo oo nkolong'i uni; ore ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani nelo te dukuya ninche te ina lototo oo nkolong'i uni, pee etum aing'uraki ninche ewueji nepuo aayeng'iyeng'are.

English: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
Masaai: naa ore pooki niomonunu te nkarna ai, ina aas, pee etumi aaterrep Papa te nkaraki Enkerai.

English: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
Masaai: Ore etii ninche osoit sapuk otii Gibeon, nelotu Amasa anang'are ninche. Neishopito apa Yoab olkila lo ltung'ani le njore, ore ti oriong ninye netii enkimeita te nebo olalem ti atua enchashur eteenaki aakurraki te mpolos enye; ore eloito ninye dukuya nedoyio.

English: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: neriu ilng'ejepa lenye anaa enkawuo; elejare neme esipata natubulayie tiatua ena kop; amu kepuo ninche dukuya te ntorroni o te ntorroni, nemaayiolo ninche nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
Masaai: Neyau Abraham nkerra o lmong'i neisho ninche Abimelek, neitayu pokira olning'o.

English: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Betlehem o Netofa naa iip ontomoni isiet o isiet.

English: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Farao olkilikuai, naa ng'ura, eitu ninye eye hoo nabo oo nkishu oo Siraeli. Kake eitagoloki oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho iltung'ana meshomo.

English: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
Masaai: Yehoshefat olayioni le Parua te nkop e Isaakar;

English: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
Masaai: Ore hoo nemaata entioto, naa keiguanareki enkutuk ai; ore hoo nemaata entioto, naa kaaitaa nanu olopaashari.

English: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa enkop mitil, amu etaa ninche ilemeeta enkirukoto, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
Masaai: kake enkuretisho e anyunoto e ndung'okinoto e nkiguana, o engoro e nkima namut lelo mang'ati.

English: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
Masaai: Newal ninche aajo, “Eikinchoru iyiook te nyorrata.” Neisalaash ninche olkila, nenang'aki ine pooki tung'ani lelo giso loo nkiyiaa apa ooyaua.

English: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
Masaai: Eeta oltung'ani oota eng'eno nagut nkonyek enyena tiatua elukunya enye, kake ore olmodai nelo te naimin; nayiolou ake ajo etum pooki olbuket obo.

English: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
Masaai: Kake, ore meino eton eitu eas ninche ae supat aashu entorrono, ore eji peyie eitobirari eyieunoto e Nkai o engelunoto enye, neme te nkaraki isiaaitin kake te nkaraki e nkipototo enye,

English: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
Masaai: Nekuet obo, neiput osuguroi enaisho naisuisho naji siki, nepik oloomi neisho metooko, ejo, “Ntasho matodol te naa kelotu Eliya aitadou.”

English: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilooiteng'eni lenyena neing'asia oleng nejo, “Aing'ae naa oidim atajeu?”

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Miureishoyu niming'aing'ai; iwa lelo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal te nebo iyie, naa tudumunye, ilepa shomo Ai; toduaa ajo aishorua nanu apik atua enkaina ino olaiguanani le Ai, o ltung'ana lenyena, enkanasa enye o enkop enye.

English: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
Masaai: “Enchom enkilikuanishore Olaitoriani te nkaraki nanu, o te nkaraki olorere, o te nkaraki Yuda pooki, tialo rorei ootii ena buku nanotoki, amu aikitok engoro o Laitoriani nayupuyupo te nkaraki iyiook, enkaraki neitu eibung iloo papa irorei lena buku, pee eas nena pooki naaigeroki, naaipirta iyiook.”

English: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
Masaai: neitore olgilata le Yakobo intarasi, nemeiting enkitoria enye.”

English: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kelo ororei lo Laitoriani aaku te ninche, enkiteng'enata te shumata nkiteng'enat, enkiteng'enata te shumata enkiteng'enata, olkereri te shumata olkereri, olkereri te shumata olkereri, enkiti tene, o enkiti te idie; pee etum ninche aashom, nebatatakino siadi, negila, nerreshi, neibung'i aaya.

English: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
Masaai: Etii olkeju oitiship nchorroi enyena enkanasa o Laitoriani, ina manyisho sinyati e ilo Otii Shumata Aisul.

English: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye kewan ninche anaa emulayoi lelo gelunot pooki le Asiria; neidurukie kewan too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e pooki ng'ae otaasie ine nkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
Masaai: Neing'or Yesu ninye nejo, “Egol taa duoo to ltung'ani oata imasaa pee ejing enkitoria e Nkai!

English: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
Masaai: anaa enaayiolo Papa, nayiolo sii nanu Papa; naa kaitayu nanu enkishui ai te nkaraki oo nkerra.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
Masaai: “Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore enkaraki neitu ining'ining'i irorei laainei,

English: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki ootegeluaki metaa larripok loo njing'eta olng'obor, naa iip are o tomon oare. Neigeroki ninche too iishoritin tiatua nkang'itie enye. Ore Daudi o Samuel ilo aduaani nepik ninche esiaai enye enkaraki naisiligayu ninche.

English: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa enkima nanyaisho, Enkai olom.

English: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
Masaai: Keipiripiroo ninye lelo sabibu lenyena leitu eku, anaa ilo shani lenye, neiturraa adung'oo esidano enye anaa oloirien.

English: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
Masaai: Kake kiyiolo ake iyiook aajo mme te nkitabaroto oo Nkitanapat meitoki Enkai aatakinore oltung'ani, kake enkirukoto eimu ina ti atua Yesu Kristo; naa ore iyiook ate enkaraki enkirukoto ti atua Kristo Yesu meekure eetakinore Enkai iyiook, mme nkitanapat kintabaitie. Anaa enajo Lkigerot, “Meetae hoo obo laa enkitabaroto oo Nkitanapat eimua pee meekure eetakinore Enkai ninye.”

English: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilo barnoti ilo rorei, nelo eisinanuo amu eata masaa kumok.

English: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
Masaai: nemeas mbaa e nkinyala, neme naaret kewan ake eing'oru, neme ng'arng'arri, nemeiken ntorrok,

English: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
Masaai: Eetuo ninche shumata nanu te ina olong o sina lai, kake Olaitoriani ninye entonata ai.

English: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
Masaai: “Hoo naa” anaa enatejo Lkigerot ti alo Musa, “ore ake pee eibelekenyakino Olaitoriani neiwuang'ieki ina kimulata.”

English: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
Masaai: Etalakua iyiook Kristo pee kibik kilakuno, Entasheito naa oleng, emincho eitokini aaibooki intae abori enchata e sinkaisho.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai enye. Eitu ninye eitobor kewan te dukuya Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai, oiroro apa alimu ilomon lo Laitoriani.

English: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
Masaai: aashu tenaa ae kuti anaa aikumok o aashu sii tenaa eisidai ina kop namanya ninche anaa torrono, o aashu sii tenaa ore nena anas naamanya ninche naa ilng'oborri tenaa isempewueti,

English: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
Masaai: Naning nanu oltoilo lo ltung'ani te rishata oo ngilat o lkeju le Ulai, neipotisho ilo toilo ajo, “Gabriel, nchoo ele tung'ani ening'u neyiolou enduaata.”

English: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
Masaai: Ore ina mouo apa natigile te ine netubulunye kulie ong'uan naa keyooki aadumunye nkitoriat ong'uan te nkop enye, kake mme te ngolon enye.

English: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
Masaai: Kake eisero ninye eirriwaki ilbalusuni le Misiri, peyie etum ninche ninche aaishoo mbartan o enjore kitok. Keidim ninye aisula? Keidim oltung'ani ailanyisho oas nena baa? Keidim atigila olning'o neitoki ake ailanyisho?

English: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

English: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.

English: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

English: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

English: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

English: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Yared ilarin iip o ntomoni ile oare, neaku menye Enok.

English: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Raheli, enkitok e Yakobo naa: Yosef o Benchamen.

English: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
Masaai: Ore nkejek enyena netiu anaa ing'apeta e Alabata naaikodoki te sahabu. Ore teningor ninye netiu anaa iltarakua le Lebanon.

Masaai: Neipang'unye ninye ashera aitung'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani, neya auluo Yerusalem, neya oerata le Kedron, nelo apejoo to erata le Kedron, neidong aitaa empunyua neisuaki ina punyua nkuraren oo ltung'ana le setia.

English: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

English: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
Masaai: Neibala nchere meetae hoo obo lemeetakinore Enkai enkaraki naitabayie ninye Nkitanapat, amu ejo Lkigerot, “Ore pooki ng'ae lemeetakinore Enkai ninye enkaraki enkirukoto nepok.”

English: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
Masaai: kake ore eng'ida enye naa enkitanapata o Laitoriani, naa enkitanapata eibirribir ninye dama o kewarie.

English: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
Masaai: Kake etogolong'okita ninche Enkai oo loomenye, neiborrie onyek aarubare nkaitin oo ltung'ana leina kop apa naaidaikie Enkai te dukuya ninche.

English: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.
Masaai: Ti atua enkop e Goshen ake, ine apa netii iltung'ana loo Siraeli metii enchan oo soito.

English: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai lo losho le Manase naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oisiet, laa ninche apa etegeluaki pee epuonu aaitaa Daudi olaiguanani.

English: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
Masaai: “Nintayu iyie olkila li oriong pus muj le ina kila dorrop.

English: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
Masaai: Ore enkiroishi eyieunoto oltau lo ltung'ani naa kepetaa ninye, kake ore ororei sidai neitiship ninye.

English: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
Masaai: Nikintoki iyiook aaikilikuan lelo payiani nikirorie iyiook ninche aajoki nji, ‘Kaing'ae oishoo intae enkitanapata pee ishetishete ena aji, nindipidipi olchetei lenye?’

English: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
Masaai: Kuna naaisarkionie oltung'ani, kake te nedaa meisuja inkaik, nemeisarkinonie oltung'ani.”

English: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ketukurrutua ninche ina kata pee eas olminong A-a, eitu ninche ekurru tukul; menya ninche orere. Neaku kebatata ninche tiatua lelo ootabatatate; ore ake pee aitame nanu ninche, nenang'ari ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
Masaai: Neilep Eliya alo enchumata oldoinyo le Karmel, neirrugo abaiki enkop, nepik enkomom enye erishata oo nkung enyena.

English: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Meetae hoo oloidim anyaaki aitamanyu ae kitamanyunoto neme enapake naidipaki aatipik, naa ninye Yesu Kristo.

English: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
Masaai: Ore ti oriong o lng'obor te nkalo o loo ntoluo nintayu irubat ile oo sunta.

English: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
Masaai: Ina ninye eitaas ilo oing'oni; anaa enaitaasa ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, neijia sii eiko tele. Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche, naa kepalakini ninche.

English: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
Masaai: ore ine neimieki endukuya te ilo kila oodo neikununo anaa enenkila, neeta erripata namanaa pee mepolosa.

English: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.
Masaai: Ore pooki ootoduaa ina nejo, “Eitu ae kata easayu embae neeijo ena aashu edoli ebaiki enkolong apa naileputua iltung'ana le Israel aapuku te nkop e Misiri o metabaiki ena olong; embirribirra enguanare niwaliwala.”

English: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Masaai: “Kake teneibelekenyunye ilo torrono too ntorrok enyena pooki naataasa neibung inkitanapat aainei neas ina naishiaakino nesipa, meeta nchere pee meton eishu; nemee ninye.

English: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
Masaai: kake enchoo ilo ong'ida eng'idare ena, nchere kaayiolo nanu, nchere ara Olaitoriani ilo oibung enyorrata nauno, esipata, o enkitorioroto tiatua enkop; amu te kuna tokitin ashipa nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
Masaai: Naa ore ake enkata naba anaa enadumuni ilo sanduku aaya, nejo Musa, “Tudumunye, iyie Olaitoriani, naa nchoo ilmang'ati linono eisardak naa nchoo lelo likimba iyie eilanyisho te dukuya iyie.”

English: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
Masaai: Teneboitare oltung'ani enkitok olenkapu lenye, naa kenap ninche eng'oki enye, neye eitu etum nkera.

English: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
Masaai: Entoosh entarumpeta te nduaata o lapa, te nepurupuranayu olapa, te ina olong ang o sirua.

English: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o supat neyau eng'eno nagut, kake ore olng'ejep olejisho naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Aimining'ung'u ena kitanyaanyukoto? Kaji naa inkoko pee ining'ung'u nkulie kitanyaanyukot pooki?

English: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

English: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

English: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

English: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
Masaai: Meaku ena anasa emoti ino nayierishoreki nimiaku iyie nkiri tiatua ninye; ekaaiguanare iyie to lpolosie le Israel;

English: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
Masaai: Nelo apa Gaal olayioni le Ebed Shekem te nebo ilalashera lenyena, neisilig apa iltung'ana le Shekem ninye.

English: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

English: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

English: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

English: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

English: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

English: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

Masaai: Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani: ng'ura, eitobirita ninye olmaati te nkiterunoto embulunoto e ndaa natuunoki to loirujuruj, naa ng'ura embulunoto e are eidipa olaiguanani atudung'o.

English: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

English: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

English: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

English: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

Masaai: Ore ilo ng'atuny ogol neish te nkaraki natala entoki nanya, ore inkera e ng'atuny neidapashari.

English: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

English: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

English: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

English: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

English: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
