English: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
Masaai: Kake inji ejo esupatisho naa enkirukoto eimu, Nimijo to ltau lino, “Ae ng'ae oilep alo keper?” eji, alo aitadou Kristo enkop,

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
Masaai: Neyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, oyaua ninche aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, pee atum nanu atotona ti atua ninche. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
Masaai: (Inchoo maineneng'i te ntemet naineneng'ishoreki nemeeta emonkoi naa inchoo Enkai eyiolou enkitashoto ai!)

English: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
Masaai: apa lairoro nanu te nkutuk ai, naisiligishore apa nanu te nkutuk ai atii enyamali.

English: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
Masaai: Kuna apa ntemeta e Solomon te nchetata e nkaji e Nkai: ore enkadoro naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam oopishana, naa ntemat e nkaina naaudo endapasho.

English: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
Masaai: Eiroro sii ndung'eta e rashe nkalifuni uni; ore isinkoliotin lenyena naa enkalifu nabo o imiet.

English: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
Masaai: Neikilikuan lelo ororani ninye aajoki, “Kaa naa kiaas?”

English: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
Masaai: Neiruk lelo Yahudi aas anaa ina naiterutua aas, anaa sii ina naigeroko Mordekai ninche.

English: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
Masaai: Neishooyo Sedekia nkitanapat, nepik ninche Yeremia enkaji erripore; neishori ninye emukate anaake eing'uaa enepejunyeki te nkoitoi, ometaba anaa neishunye imukateni eina anasa. Neaku etobiko apa Yeremia tiatua enkaji e rripore.

English: Let all things be done decently and in order.
Masaai: kake enchoo ebarakini aas pooki toki too nkiririkinot.

English: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
Masaai: Keshal ninche te nchan oo ldoinyio, nepetikino endapidapoi eyieu eneshurie.

English: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
Masaai: Ore pee elau, neikurtutaa Yason o kulikae le lelo alashera aayaki ilaitoriak le ina anasa, ebuakita aajo, ore “Kulo tung'ana ooijulujulo enkop aing'orie shumata abori neetuo sii ene;

English: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
Masaai: Ore ilo Lawi, ilo moruo apa le ina kitok nataraki metua, newal ajo, “Aewuo apa nanu Gibea, ina nara ene Benchamen, nanu o enkapiani ai, pee kirrag ina kewarie.

English: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
Masaai: Neaku kira lkiliku le Kristo, Enkai makewan, nasaisho te iyiook. Kitasayia intae te Kristo entoning'ore Enkai.

English: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.
Masaai: Neipirri Daudi neitashe te nchumata e ilo Filisti, neya olalem lenye, neyietu ashurtu te nchashur enye, near ninye metua, nedung'orie endukuya enye. Ore ake pee edol Ilfilisti aajo etua oloing'oni lenye neisik.

English: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
Masaai: Etiu iloshon pooki anaa pesho te dukuya ninye, eikenayie ninye ninche anaa pesho, aashu olng'am.

English: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ilfilisti nchere etubukokoki Daudi eilata aaitaa olaiguanani te Israel, neilepu Ilfilisti pooki eing'oru Daudi; kake etoning'o Daudi ina nelo aisudori to sempewuet.

English: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
Masaai: Neaku naa tiaaki enkaji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Indurukiekie ate anaa enaikuna iloo papaai linyi nipong'oriri aasuj nena tokitin enye naaiduruk?

English: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
Masaai: Naa ena eniare, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.’ Meetae ae kitanapata kitok nalang kuna.”

English: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Gideon enkaji enye neyieng olkuoo, neitobir imukateni neitu eisuijieki e nkurma; nepik nkiri atua enkikapu, nepik imotori atua emoti, neyaki ninye ti abori olchani, neitarasaki ninche.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ainchirishiri niyietutu to sina, kake keng'ida enkop; keinosieki intae osina, kake keibelekenya osina linyi aaku eng'ida.

English: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
Masaai: Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo le Gershon, te nkisiayare o te napata oo lolan:

English: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ara nanu emukate e nkishui; ore ololotu enatii metum esumash, naa ore olaairuk nanu meitoki ai kata atir enkure.

English: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enatiu enkiwuang'ata naing'uaa eneilepunye enkolong nelioyu te nedoyiorie; neijia etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.

English: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nadol likae malaika edou aing'uaa shumata neeta enkidimata sapuk, neitawang'i enkop te ina sikar enye.

English: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Enkaraki naa kiti enkirukoto inyi, amu esipa ajoki intae, ti niaatata enkirukoto naba anaa ene kantererai naji karadali, naa indimidimi aatiaaki ele doinyo ‘Tadotunye te ne, shomo idie;’ nedotunye; nemetii embae nemeidimayu te intae.

English: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
Masaai: Ore te ina kewarie neitu eirura olaiguanani; neitanapisho ninye pee eyauni embuku natii mbaa naadamuni, neisumi te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
Masaai: Aigero te embuku naitera, Oloyanyiti Teofilo, mbaa pooki aaitera Yesu aas o naaiteng'enishe,

English: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD'S anointed, and be guiltless?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Daudi Abishai, “Minyal ninye, amu kaing'ae oidim aitorioi enkaina enye metaarare ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aaput, neaku meeta entioto?”

English: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
Masaai: Naairriu apa Enkai ene pee aituruku te ntae, pee alotu aitajeu ilekunot te nkop naitasheyie tenkaraki intae pee meye ilkumok.

English: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
Masaai: Eming'or ninye anaa olmang'atinta, kake enkoo anaa olalashe.

English: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena ajoki intae, epalakini ltung'ana ng'ok pooki o emoroto namor Enkai, kake ore emoroto namor Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nemepalakini.

English: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
Masaai: “Ara olomoni o lalotoni tiatua intae, enchooki ewueji tiatua intae metaa ewueji enkurare pee atum atuturoi entang'atang'a ai aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei.”

English: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
Masaai: “Neitoki Aron alotu atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitayu ninye lelo kilani le kitani apa ooishopo ina kata pee elo ewueji sinyati, neing'uaa ninche teine;

English: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
Masaai: Ore enkaji pooki nijing'ijing'i entang'as entejo, ‘Metijing'a eseriani ena aji.’

English: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Sebulon te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Sered, olmarei loo le Sered, ile Elon, olmarei loo le Elon; ile Yaleel, olmarei loo le Yaleel.

English: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing Yesu enkaji e Petero, nedol enkaputani enye eirrag emuei oloirobi.

English: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
Masaai: o Ibneaia olayioni le Yeroham, o Elak olayioni le Usi olayioni le Mikri, o Meshulam olayioni le Shefatia olayioni le Reul, olayioni le Ibnija,

English: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ake ina sii pee ilakilaka kodi, amu ore lelo ooitoreisho naa laisiaayiak le Nkai ooirrita ina bae.

English: Thou shalt not steal.
Masaai: “Mipurrisho.

English: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu apa ninche ening'isho neitu eishoru enkiok enye, kake etogolong'utua, pee mening nemeng'amu inkiteng'enat.

English: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
Masaai: Atang'amayie eretoto e kulie sirito naasishore nena pesai aisiaai intae. Kempurrorre ina?

English: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: Kake ore ele sotua laitobiru nanu tenebo enkaji e Israel te siadi nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, kapik nanu e nkitanapata ai atua ninche nasir nanu too ltauja lenye; naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye neaku sii ninche iltung'ana laainei.

English: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
Masaai: Eitu apa epolosa nkilani inyi, neitu ejeyu nkejek inyi, te kulo arin artam.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Ena enkitanapata o sirua le Ng'iroroto: meetae oltung'ani omoni oinos ilo sirua.

English: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
Masaai: Neitayu Abimelek intare, o lmong'i o lewa o ng'oruo irrindiki, neisho pooki Abraham nerrinyoki ninye enkitok enye Sara.

English: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
Masaai: Neitayu Yehoiakim nena kilani enyena apa e korokoroni. Ore nkolong'i pooki te nkishui enye nedaa ninye anaake te misa o laiguanani;

English: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
Masaai: “Ore iyie miomonoki kulo tung'ana, arashu ilepiepie olkiyioi arashu enkomono te nkaraki ninche nimiomonoki te nanu, amu maaning nanu iyie.

English: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
Masaai: Ekaanyu enjeunoto ino, iyie Olaitoriani.

English: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.
Masaai: Neya Mikal enkitanyaanyukoto neirragie ninye te ndapash nepik entoki nairishunyeki endukuya oo lpapit loo ntare elukunya enye, neimulumul too nkarash.

English: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
Masaai: Ore embolokinoto o rorei lino neyau ewang'an, neitaarriyian ilo lemeeta eng'eno.

English: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
Masaai: Ore nkitanyaanyukot enye naa enkosholai o sahabu, esiaai oo nkaik e tung'ana.

English: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
Masaai: ore ake pee eitayioloi ninye ina ng'oki nataasa neyau ninye aitaa enkishoroto enye enkine, esupen nemeeta entioto, te nkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa.

English: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eilepu enkolong nepuo ninche, neirrag ninche too rrumati lenye.

English: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
Masaai: Mimitiki isidain ilooishaakino ina kata aa iyie oota enkidimata pee ias.

English: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
Masaai: einosa apa ina pasaka iltung'ana loo Siraeli ootorrinyunye te yararoto, o pooki ng'ae oibung'are ninche, neitalam kewan olduruk loo ltung'ana leina kop, neserem Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ele ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
Masaai: ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai o eng'esherrie enye o suyai, o mbokishi o ntokitin enyena pooki; o ilo moti oitukuoreki o enkitotonet enye;

English: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
Masaai: Ena entashati e mpalai naishoo olaiguanani Artaseses Esra ilo apolosani, naa olaigeroni, ang'eni loo mbaa oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani o nkiguanat enyena tialo Isiraeli:

English: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
Masaai: Nelaaki te ina kata Barabas; neari Yesu too nkeenta, neishori metashei.

English: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
Masaai: Iyie eing'uaa enkisisa ai ti atua eumata kitok; naa kalak nanu olmumai lai te dukuya lelo ooure ninye.

English: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God,I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
Masaai: ‘Kaas ena bae te nena olong'i naabayie, Enkai najo, kabukoki ltung'ana pooki Enkiyang'et ai. Keyooki aaibonisho layiok linyi o ntoyie inyi; nedol ilbarnot linyi nduaat, netum ilpayiani linyi nkidetidetat.

English: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
Masaai: Kake ti niure iyie ashomo, tadoi shomo ina ang oo lng'oborri te nebo Pura, osinka lino;

English: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye Rusi alo asotisho ti atua enkurma asuj lelo ooisampu, nelotu apa ninye ewueji enkurma e Boas laa olo lmarei le Elimelek.

English: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nelo Hasael olaiguanani le Siria aarare Gaat, neya ninye. Kake ore ake pee eibelekenya Hasael aing'or Yerusalem,

English: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
Masaai: Nejoki oloiboni le Nkai Daudi, “Mintoki aton to lnukata, shomo enkop e Yuda.” Neaku etudumunye Daudi nelo atua entim e Heres.

English: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilo kitok le njore laa ninye apa eigarakino o laiguanani, nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Amaa napaji tenaa kebol Olaitoriani ilusien e keper, keitabari ena bae?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, “Ilo iyie adol too nkonyek inono, kake minos iyie.”

English: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
Masaai: Kake ore ilaisiaayiak le Nkaji e Nkai nemanya Ofel; naa Siha, o Gispa apa ooitasheiki ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

English: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
Masaai: Amu etejo Musa, ‘Keirriwaki intae Olaitoriani oloiboni anaa apa pee aairriu nanu, olaa ololorere linyi. Entoning ake mbaa pooki naaliki ninye intae.

English: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
Masaai: Kake eitu hoo eng'amaa. Nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena aasai aajoki, “Inchoo ena kitok elo amu, esujita iyiook eishirita.”

English: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le isiet to lapa le isiet naa Sibekia le Hushat le Serahit, ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
Masaai: Tenaii nanu olalem lai neibung enkaina ai enkiguana naitalaku nanu too lmang'ati laainei, naitalaku nanu te lelo laaiba nanu.

English: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
Masaai: Ekaata engolon naitameyie kake aairorie Enkai e papaai lino ena kewarie aajoki, ‘Toduaa kewan ake mijoki Yakobo ororei hoo obo sidai arashu oltorrono.’

English: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
Masaai: Neiturrurroki ninye kewan Ilamori o Lmaleki nelo amir Israel neya ninche ina anasa oo ltuka aaitaa enenye.

English: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
Masaai: Neitoomon Daudi ninye, nedaa ninye te dukuya ninye neokisho, neaku eitemera ninye; ore te nteipa neipang ninye alo airrag te ndapash enye te nebo isinkan lo lkitok lenye, kake eitu ninye edoyio alo enkaji enye.

English: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
Masaai: Ore te supatisho ino tokorduaki nanu nikintajeu; irrugokoki enkiok ino, nikintajeu nanu!

English: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
Masaai: Amu eteena apa Olaitoriani ng'ueseti enkaji pooki e Abimelek tenkaraki Sara enkitok e Abraham.

English: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
Masaai: Neyau olosho le Benchamen enetaana too lmareita lenyena, nedoiki enkukuo olmarei le Matrit; ore te siadi neyau olmarei le Matri enetaana olee o lee, nedoiki enkukuo Saul ole Kish. Kake ore ake pee eing'oru ninche ninye, neitu etumi ninye.

English: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo kuna baa, neitoki ajoki ninche, “Eirure olchore lang Lasaro; kake kalo pee alo ainyeyie ninye.”

English: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
Masaai: Mikuetiki airo te nkutuk ino, nimincho oltau lino ekuetiki airo irorei te dukuya Enkai, amu etii Enkai keper, nitii iyie oriong enkop; metaa inchoo irorei linono eaku kuti.

English: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
Masaai: Naa kalo nanu tiatua intae naaku Enkai inyi, niakuku intae iltung'ana laainei.

English: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
Masaai: Naa keitaas Olaitoriani ninche anaa enaitaasa Sihon o Oog, lelo aiguanak le Amori, o enkop enye, ina kata apa pee eidaikie ninche.

English: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
Masaai: Irara intae iltung'ana laainei, irara intae o loito lai o sesen lai; kainyoo pee iakuku ile siadi te nchukunoto o laiguanani?’

English: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
Masaai: otua te nkaraki iyiook paa te naa aikinchu aashu kirura nikinchu te nebo ninye.

English: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
Masaai: Neyieng Musa ninye, neitayu osarge, ore to lkimojino lenye nepik enchumata oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar aitaman, neitisiny ilo perere lo lasar, neibukoo ilo likae sarge te ntonata olpererelo lasar, neitisiny ninye, pee eitobiru olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki ninye.

English: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
Masaai: “Irara intae emunyan e nkop; kake te netuyiatuyu emunyan, ainyoo eshukokinyeki enkisuisho? Meitoki aata tipat katukul, kake kenang'ari boo meitunyoi iltung'ana too nkejek.

English: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
Masaai: Amu enyaakita iltung'ana le Edom aarasaki nemir Yuda, neya ninye nkanas e Betshemesh o Aijalon, o Gederot, o Soko tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti,

English: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, aidolidolo keper etabole neilep nedou ilmalaika le Nkai te aadoiki Enkerai e Tung'ani.”

English: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
Masaai: “Nanu, nanu ilo oitagol intae ira iyie ng'ae eji metaa iure oltung'ani laa keye, ina kerai e tung'ani naitayioki anaa nkujit,

English: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore enkosholai pooki o sahabu, o masaa o suyai o esekenkei, naa eisinyat to Laitoriani keyae ninche atua olchumati lo Laitoriani.”

English: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
Masaai: Kake ore pooki kitok neomon ene latia enye, oina naboitare tiaji, imasaa e nkosholai o sahabu, o nkilani, nipik ninche ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono, ore teina niyaya karsisisho e Misiri.”

English: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
Masaai: Newal Solomon nkikilikuanat enyena pooki. Meetae entoki hoo nabo naisudoro to laiguanani Solomon neitu eibalakinye ninye.

English: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
Masaai: Niyau Aron o layiok lenyena kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo, nintuku ninche te nkare.

English: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki natonieki te mbarta tenetonie ilo oata osupetai neiduruku.

English: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
Masaai: kake too iasat sidain, anaa enaishiaakino inkituuak naajo keeta enkirukoto.

English: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
Masaai: ore kuna pooki naa esiaai e ina Kiyang'et nabo ake, naa ninye naoriki nerishaki iltung'ana aiko anaa enayieu ninye.

English: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
Masaai: Ore apa Mesha olaiguanani le Moab naa olaramatani loo nkerra. Naa ore ake to lari neisho olaiguanani le Israel ilkuoo le kerra nkalifuni iip nabo. O lpapit loo nkerra loo lmeregeshi nkalifuni iip nabo.

English: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
Masaai: Olchani loo sabibu Israel oiu ilng'anayio lenyena. Ore anaa enaponari ilng'anayio lenyena neponaa ashet ilperereni loo lasarri kumok; ore anaa enaponari enkop enye asidanu, neponaa ing'apeta enyena.

English: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
Masaai: iyiololo aajo enkaraki emueyian o sesen pee anoto erishata nalikinye intae Lomon Supati te nkiterunoto,

English: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
Masaai: Nedol ilkipaareta o lpayiani o ina sirit pooki aajo sidai te negeluni ltung'ana le ina sirit enye, neirriwari Antiokia te nebo Paulo o Barnaba. Negelu Yudas oji Barnaba o Sila, laa larikok too lalashera.

English: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
Masaai: Ore intorrok inono naa oltung'ani laaijo iyie eipirta ore esupatisho ino naa enkerai e tung'ani.

English: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
Masaai: aewuo nanu pee aaku ewang'an e nkop paa ore pooki laairuk nanu nemeton ti atua enaimin.

English: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
Masaai: amaa naa iyie oloiteng'en ilkulikae, oo pee minteng'en kewan? Amaa ilikioo ajo mipurrisho, ipurrisho pasa iyie?

English: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
Masaai: “Shomo tena kata taleenoi tenaa keserian ilalashera linono, o ntare, nikintoki ayaki olomoni.” Neaku eirriwayie ninye to erata le Hebron, nelo Shekem.

English: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
Masaai: Itinyikua iyie ina kata peyie aaipot nanu iyie, itejo iyie, ‘Miureishoyu!’

English: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
Masaai: Kayiolo ajo irara eishoi e Abraham; kake king'oruru intae nanu aar, amu metii atua intae ororei lai.

English: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
Masaai: Keitagol Olaitoriani ninye te ndapash enye; ore te muoyian enye ninchiunye iyie pooki leyiata.

English: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata, te nkaraki nena, nerrinyo ilkumok loo looiteng'eni lenyena neitu eitoki aairiamariyie ninye.

English: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki enkop e Israel: Enkiting'oto! Eewuo enkiting'oto shumata ilpijat pokira oong'uan le nkop.

English: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
Masaai: Lo tung'ana modook, kaa nalusoo, e ina kishorunoto ana kolperere lo lasar oitisiny ina kishorunoto?

English: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
Masaai: Nejo Saul, “Toning'o taata, olayioni le Ahitab.” Newalu ninye, “Nele nanu, olkitok lai.”

English: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee emoruau Daudi, neitaa Solomon olayioni lenye metaa olaiguanani le Israel.

English: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki ninche, “Ainyoo pee inyalinyala intae inkitanapat e Nkai enkaraki e nena koon inyi?

English: And charged them that they should not make him known:
Masaai: Neitanap ajoki, pee melikioo,

English: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajo, “Ejo ake nabo, ‘Enaai ena kerai naishu, netua enkayioni ino’; nejo enkae; ‘A'a; amu enkayioni ino natua naa enkayioni ai ena naishu.’ ”

English: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: neitayu ninye to lasar lenye e saani nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni, o engirra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa.

English: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
Masaai: olayioni le Matatias, olayioni le Amos, olayioni le Nahum, olayioni le Elsi, olayioni le Nagai,

English: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
Masaai: Asipani Olaitoriani too nkoitoi enyena pooki, naa supat too iasat enyena pooki.

English: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.
Masaai: Nejoki enkaputani enye ninye, “Kaji duo taata ishomo asotishore? Naa kaji itaasishore? Metamayiani ilo tung'ani likitisirua iyie.” Neaku etolikio ninye enkaputani oltung'ani duo oshomo aaisiaai, nejoki, “Ore enkarna e ilo tung'ani duo lashomo aaisiaai naa keji Boas.”

English: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.
Masaai: Neitu aekata eitoki Yeroboam arrinyu engolon enye too nkolong'i e Abija. Neosh Olaitoriani ninye neye ninye.

English: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk nairo isipat nebik intarasi, kake ore olng'ejep le lejare naa ole nkiti kata.

English: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
Masaai: te nkanyit pooki o te mborron, te nebo eng'iriata iretokinono olikae o likae ti atua enyorrata,

English: Of Dan, PrAzareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: ore too le Dan, naa Asarel olayioni le Yeroham, kulo apa lelo arikok loo loshon le Israel.

English: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
Masaai: Ee, ore o taata, te neisomai mbukui e Musa, netiu anaa keimulumula lukuny e lelo ooning;

English: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
Masaai: Nchoru enkiok Lo Airritani le Israel, iyie ilo orikoo Yosef anaa eluaata oo ntare! Iyie ilo otii olorika le nkitoo te nchumata oo lkerubi,

English: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki toki nadoiki ninche etuata neaku enaiduruk, oi aa enchata, aashu enkila aashu olchoni, aashu olbene; pooki masaai ake ninye naasishoreki te pooki pukunoto; meeta nchere meitadoikini atua enkare, neton ninye aa olminong o metaa teipa; neitoki taa asidanu.

English: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
Masaai: Eeta apa Asel ilayiok ile naa kuna nkarn enye: Askrikam, o Bokeru, o Ishmael, o Shearia, o Obadia, o Hanan; kulo apa ninche ilayiok le Asel.

English: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
Masaai: neirriwaki Balak ilkiliku Balaam olayioni le Beor te Peter, apa aa ninye nataaniki Olkeju, ti atua enkop e Amawa pee eipotu ninye, ajoki, “Ng'ura, eileputua olorere te Misiri; oitoipo oriong olchoni le nkop, naaetuo aatalakinore te manyisho.

English: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
Masaai: O Ahio o Shashak o Yeremot.

English: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
Masaai: Etii enkishui naado atua enkaina enye e tatene, ore atua enkaina enye e kedienye netii enkarsisisho o enkanyit.

English: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
Masaai: Pee eyau arrinyu oltau lenye aitung'uaa enemeneng'a, pee etum ninye atoduaa ewang'an e nkishui.

English: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
Masaai: Ore te lelo soito neshetu olperere lo lasar te nkarna Olaitoriani. Netur ninye engumoto aitaman emanaroto olperer lo lasar, oba tendapasho anaa ilanterera oare.

English: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
Masaai: Netii embata iloirienito aare, obo te nkalo e tatene ilo bakuli netii olikae kedienye enye.”

English: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
Masaai: Nejo ninye: “Eikurrukur Olaitoriani te Sion, neitayu oltoilo lenye te Yerusalem; eishir ndaat oo lairritak loo ntare, netoyu enchumata e Karmel.”

English: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
Masaai: Amu kebaa enashe nikindim aaishoo Enkai te nkaraki intae, te ng'ida pooki nikiaata te nkaraki intae te dukuya e Nkai.

English: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
Masaai: o Yerusalem o Ldumea o lido kekun le Yordan o lorora kitok oing'uaa Turo o Sidon; etoning'o nena pooki naataasa, nepuonu enetii ninye.

English: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Iyiololo intae pooki aajo kemito ena amu meshulare oltung'ani loo Lyahudi ole likae orere, nemejing enkaji enye; paa Enkai naatiaaka nanu mijo ake enturuj likae tung'ani nimijo mesinya;

English: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aatalang', nejoki Eliya Elisha, “Tolimu embae niyieu naaitaas eton eitu aayae aaitung'uaa iyie.” Nejo Elisha, “Aatoomono, ntujung'oki nanu enkiyanget inokat are oltau lino.”

English: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
Masaai: Netii apa oloiboni moruo Betel. Nepuonu ilayiok lenyena aaliki nena pooki naataasa oltung'ani le Nkai ina olong te Betel; o lelo rorei sii ootiaaka olaiguanani, neliki ninche papaai lenye.

English: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
Masaai: Nayiolou ajo mbaa oo nkitanapat enye eisitaarieki, kake meeta enataasa nairirikino keeya anaa eenata.

English: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
Masaai: amu eitu apa ninche enang'are nkera e Israel aaisho endaa o enkare, kake eishoo ninche Balaam mpisai metigilunore ninche nedek ninche - ore ake eyia eibelekenya Olaitoriani oldeket aitaa emayianata.

English: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
Masaai: Aasulaki ninche engumoto naanang too soito;

English: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
Masaai: “Majing nanu atua enkaji ai nemajing endapash ai;

English: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
Masaai: neitu nanu aitasim aela te ilata te nena wikii uni naalulung'a.

English: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
Masaai: Ore sii ti alo nkera enyena maing'urrie nanu amu inkera e nkibor oo nkonyek ninche.

English: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
Masaai: Mimenaa ninye, naa aikirrip ninye iyie; tonyora ninye naa aikirrip ninye iyie.

English: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
Masaai: Neitoki Laban ajoki Yakobo, “Ore amu ira ole sotua, aikisiaai iyie nanu pesho? Tolikioki ajo ainyoo elaata niyieu naalaaki?”

English: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu lelo omon, neinyototo ajing empeut alo ewueji neliyio, ore pee ening olorere, nesuj too nkejek eing'uaa nkang'itie enye.

English: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
Masaai: Naitoki adol likae malaika eipirri te mpolos o loing'ang'e, neeta lomon supati loo ntarasi olo aliki lelo oomanya enkop, pooki kop, o pooki osho o pooki lng'ejep o ltung'ana.

English: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
Masaai: neitoki ninche aaya nena masaa pooki e nkisiayiare naasishoreki ti atua ine wueji sinyati; nepik ninche atua enkila pus, neitoki aaimulumul ninche te ndapana e nkine, neiteleiki ninche nkeek enyena naanapieki.

English: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
Masaai: Eipila ninche aamanaa te utaroto enye, pee etum aaitabai nena pooki naaitanapa ninche, tioriong eina kop namanyayu.

English: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
Masaai: Ainosie nanu ena Oitoi osina o metuata naen anang'aki korokoroni ilewa o nkituaak,

English: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
Masaai: Ore kulo pokira okuni naa ilayiok le Noa, naa ninche ooibulaitie enkop pooki.

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo, o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;

English: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
Masaai: Misudoo enkomom ino to sinka lino; amu atii nanu atua osina, tasioki tawalikiaki nanu.

English: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii teina sashati natudung'uoki aitaa enkop nasinya, nidung'u aitaa ewueji e nkanasa, enkop oo ntemat nkalifuni imiet te ndapasho naa ntemat enkaina inkalifuni imiet te nkadoro neaku ene nkaji pooki e Israel.

English: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
Masaai: Amu eidim iltung'ana aaidondorra neidipa aidondorra pooki pukunoto oo ng'uesi o motonyi o noo ng'uesi naaiserpepiari oo noo ng'uesi e naiposha,

English: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
Masaai: Eponaa olmodai irorei oleng, hoo nemeeta oltung'ani oyiolo ajo ainyoo naaku, naa aing'ae oidim atoliki ninye ina naaku te siadi ninye?

English: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
Masaai: kake teneshuma olantererai tiatua enkare, nedoiki ake ninye pooki rubata enchumata e nena popoki e ilo antererai neaku keiduruk te intae.

English: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
Masaai: nenyuaakino mbaa pooki, neeta enkirukoto te pooki toki, neeta osiligi le pooki toki, neng'iriakino pooki toki.

English: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
Masaai: Ore enjing'et enye naa enchumata enye etii neilep enkadoro e ntemata nabo e nkaina, ore ina jing'et enye naa kepurupurana naa entemata nabo olpisiai enguton. Ore ina jing'et enye neeta imolinkaishi ore irubat enyena naa kerisioro nchot pooki, mepurupurana.

English: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gershom naa Shebuel aa ninye olkitok,

English: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Nchoo eyanyit pooki ng'ae te intae ng'otonye o menye, nimbung'ubung'u sabatoni aainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
Masaai: Kepolol Olaitoriani auroo enkaji eilo owuasa, kake keitashayie lelo polosien le nkoliai.

English: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
Masaai: Ore tinimbok ninye netiu anaa tinimbok osiwuo arashu imbung emborei e ilata, te nkaina enye e tatene.

English: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
Masaai: Kake kaing'urrie nanu enkaji e Yuda naa kakordu ninche to Laitoriani e Nkai enye; makordu nanu ninche te nkauo aashu to lalem, nemakordu to larrabal, aashu too mbartan aashu too lakedok loo mbartan.”

English: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu iyie Olaitoriani. Amu etumuta enkima ndaat e ong'ata, neinos olng'ejep le nkima ilkeek pooki liong'ata.

English: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
Masaai: Neing'oru Simon o lelo ooboitare.

English: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
Masaai: neijoo ninche, o lmareita lenye, o lelo tung'ana pooki le Kora o masaa enye.

English: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
Masaai: Ore ina jore pooki oo Lkaldayo apa natii tenebo ilo kitok le rripore negil isunta pooki naamanita Yerusalem.

English: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
Masaai: Ore ilo aigeroni oji Shemaia olayioni le Nataniel, loo Lawi, neiger ninche pooki te dukuya olaiguanani, olkituaak, o Sadok olapolosani, o Ahimelek olayioni le Abiata, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo lapolosak o Lawi; negeluni enkaji nabo too le Eliesa negeluni nabo too le Itamar.

English: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ninche neing'unyung'uny pooki ejo, “Eshomo meitoomoni te nkaji o ltung'ani aing'okoni.”

English: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
Masaai: “Ng'ura ajo Enkai naas kuna pooki, kat are, kat uni tenebo tung'ani.

English: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
Masaai: Kaji eshomo ilo lino linyor, iyie enaisul inkituaak? Kaji eibelekenyakine olinyor lino alo, pee kitum iyiook aaing'oru ninye tenebo iyie?

English: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
Masaai: keishoori ninche aapik engolon o lalem, keaku ninche endaa oo mbariak.

English: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore amu Enkai etipika osiligi lenye inchoo naa eitajeu taa Enkai ninye tenaa keetayie tipat; amu etejo naa, “Ara Enkerai e Nkai!”

English: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
Masaai: Nepuonu Israeli aashukunye te mirata oo Lfilisti neya intokitin too lng'oborri lenye.

English: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
Masaai: Ntorioi enkaina ino te keper, tokorduaki nanu nikintayu nanu ti atua nkariak kumok, ntung'uayioki nkaik oo leeiking'a,

English: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
Masaai: natiu anaa oltung'ani oishiraki olchore anaa olalashe; namanimanaa anaa oltung'ani oishiraki ng'otonye, nairrugo te nkishirata o sina.

English: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
Masaai: “Itoning'o aajo etejoki, ‘Enkong'u o te nkong'u, o olalae to lalae.’

English: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
Masaai: Naisho nanu ing'uesi e ntim meetu atua intae, naa ninche naapuonu aapur intae aaya nkera inyi, neinyal nchoo inyi, neitaa intae kuti, pee eitoliyioi nkoitoi inyi.

English: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naabaya tomon te siadi neosh Olaitoriani Nabal; neye ninye.

English: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
Masaai: Amu ena eyeiunoto e Enkai te intae, enkitisinyata inyi, entalam eloloito,

English: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
Masaai: Ore kulo tung'ana torrok, oany ening irorei laainei, oosuj te ngolon enkong'u iltauja lenye maate neshomo aasujaa kulie aitin pee eisiaai ninche neserem ninche ketiu anaa ena arasha empolos naidaaie, nemeeta tipat.

English: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
Masaai: Nejokino ninche maate, “Kaing'ae otaasa ena?” Ore ake pee eidip aatakekenu neikilikuanu, nejo ninche, “Gideon olayioni le Yoash otaasa ena.”

English: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
Masaai: nejing'u Simiri neosh ninye anang'ie enkop, near metua to lari le tikitam oopishana le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.

English: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
Masaai: Kake Barak olayioni le Neria ninye likimbayunye iyiook, pee iyau iyiook matuata aashu eya iyiook te yararoto Babilon.”

English: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
Masaai: Ore apa olkitok lenye naa Ahiesa, nesujaki Yoash, naa ilayiok le Shemaa pokira, le Gibea; o Yesiel sii o Pelet ilayiok le Asmafet; o Beraka, o Yehu le Anatot,

English: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oitisinyi o lelo ooitisinyi nebo eing'uaa pooki. Naa ina pee mekurru ninye ejo ninche ilalashera

English: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.
Masaai: Neliki Haman enkitok enye Seresh o lchoreta lenyena pooki nena baa pooki naanoto ninye. Nejoki ninye ilang'eni lenyena o enkitok enye Seresh, “Tenaa ko Lyahudi Mordekai ilo apa litang'asa adumakino mindim naa iyie ninye kake meeta nchere mibatata iyie te dukuya ninye.”

English: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
Masaai: Isakar o Sebulon o Benchamen,

English: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ilo asar lenye le seriani le nkishoroto e nashe neyau ninye enkishoroto enye tenebo imukateni naaisuishieki.

English: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
Masaai: enkop ina nagolie Olaitoriani te nkaraki intae; eing'orita nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai ino shumata ninye anaake, ebaiki enkiterunoto o lari o metabaiki enkiting'oto o lari.

English: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
Masaai: Neng'amu ile Gershon te oshoto e nkukuo too lmareita to losho le Isaakar, o to losho le Asheri, o to losho le Naftali, o to lpisiai lo losho le Manase nkanas tomon o okuni.

English: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Dan naa nkalifuni iip nabo o onom o opishana o iip ile. Ninche oobayie anaa too nankan.”

English: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki Hesekia, Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Daudi papaai lino: Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino, natoduaa nanu ilkiyio linono; ng'ura kaponiki nanu enkishui ino ilarin tomon o imiet.

English: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
Masaai: Heshbon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Yasar te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan te umata.

English: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
Masaai: Ore lelo lenye oogol tauja, netooruoki pooki naata, neirragaitie ninche aaye; ore lelo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal, meidim aataasishore nkaik enye.

English: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
Masaai: Ore pee egiroo larripok le dukuya o li aare, nepuonu kishomi e sekenkei naipang'aki ina anasa; nebolo openy neipung aapuo, negiroo neng'eliki ai oitoi nabo nelo nabo kata olmalaika, ainguaa ninye.

English: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki, ee enkaraki naitapong'oitie iltung'ana laainei, ejo, ‘Eseriani,’ ina kata meetae eseriani; te nkaraki, ina kata nashet iltung'ana esuntai, nepuonu iloibonok aamur te nturoto;

English: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
Masaai: Entipik ilmonek isunta e Babilon; Entagolo ilarripok. Entipik ilarripok; Entobira ilnukat. Amu eitobira Olaitoriani neitabayie ina apa nairoro tialo lelo oomanya Babilon.

English: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
Masaai: Kake ore taata ejo Olaitoriani, “Too larin okuni, anaa larin le nkigeroto o ltung'ani, keitaae ina kitoo e Moab pesho, hoo duoo naa olorora kitok ninche. Ore lelo ooleku naa lkuti oleng leme toki.”

English: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
Masaai: Ore ilo omoda neiruk pooki toki, kake ore olng'en neing'or enkoitoi enye.

English: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
Masaai: Etaboloki nkishomin o lkeju neiputa enkaji e nkitoo enkuretisho.

English: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninye netii Heman o Yedutum, o lelo kulikae ootegeluaki neipoti nkarn meishoo enashe o Laitoriani, amu ebik enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
Masaai: Amu keilepunye Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena neing'urrie isinkan lenyena, tenedol ninye ajo eishunye engolon enye, neitu elakuni hoo obo, oloena aashu ololakuno.

English: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
Masaai: Enchoo lalashera laainei ootii Laodikea enkirorokino ai, ninchosho Nimfa o ina sirit natii enkaji enye.

English: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
Masaai: Nchoo naa duoo Kristo. Olaiguanani le Siraeli, edou to salaba matodol pee kiruk.” Ore lelo ootashoki te nebo ninye nemor sii ninche.

English: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
Masaai: Amu adol ajo kibore enduaran o lodua, niteenikine atua ng'ok.”

English: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
Masaai: Etesheta apa ninye Elat nerrinyoki Yuda, ina kata eidipa olaiguanani atua tenebo loo menye.

English: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
Masaai: Neomon Manoa Olaitoriani, nejo, “Olaitoriani lai, aatoomono iyie, nchoo ilo tung'ani le Nkai lirriua menyaaki alotu enikitii iyiook, aiteng'en iyiook enikintaas ina ayioni naini.”

English: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
Masaai: Eiterreyie Enkai oltau lai; aaituria Olmagilani nanu;

English: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
Masaai: Ore ina kata nening'oo olaiguanani Herode olning'o le Yesu

English: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
Masaai: Netii atua ina aji e ntumo oltung'ani oata oloirirua oiduruk. Nebuak aishir to ltoilo sapuk ejo,

English: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
Masaai: Eimaka sii ilkeek, ebaiki lelo tarakua otii Lebanon ometabaiki ina hisopu nabulu too sunta neimaki sii ing'uesi, o ntaritik o ntokitin naaiserpepiari o sinkir.

English: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki oltung'ani, “Eitashe ng'utunyi te boo, o lalashera linono, kiyieu nikirorie,”

English: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
Masaai: Aing'ae lido olotu to lpurkel, eirishakino olanyor lenye? Tiabori olchani onyaanyukie olamai aatuputuo iyie. Te ine apa earita ng'utunyi enkop kiini iyie, te ine apa earita enkop ina nikitoiwuo.

English: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Yesu menye enkerai ajoki, “Kebaya aa nkat eeta ena pukunoto?” Nejo, “Te kereisho eiterua.

English: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.
Masaai: Kadol nanu aa kemakua te nairriwaa oloena nemaitoduaaya mbaa naaitang'orieki.”

English: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
Masaai: Tudumunye, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie Enkai, tudumu enkaina ino; mincho kirikino ilo oata osina.

English: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
Masaai: “Ore iyie enkerai e tung'ani, aiminguanare iyie, aiminguanare iyie enkanasa osarge? Nimbalakinye ninye nena baa pooki olminong enyena.

English: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
Masaai: Toponiki ninche nkitamiot te shumata nkitamiot; metaa metum ae kata ninche elaaroto te iyie.

English: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
Masaai: Nepuku teina kop alo Asiria neshet Ninawi o Rehobosuira, o Kala;

English: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo pooki oas mbaa naijo kuna, lelo pooki oasisho te lejare naa entoki olminong to Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oiboni omusu airo irorei te nkarna ai leitu nanu aitanap ninye meiroro, aashu ilo oiro te nkarna e kulie aitin, ore ilo oiboni keye ake.’

English: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee kisujaa nanu anaa Enkai? Kainyoo iyie pee mikindip enkisilisiloto o sesen lai?

English: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king's house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.
Masaai: Neitiship ina tito ninye nenyorru ninye neisho ninye asioki ntokitin naakusore, o eoroti enye e ndaa, o sinkan naapishana gelunot naaing'ua enkaji o laiguanani, neisho ninye o nena sinkan enyena ewueji sidai te nkaji oo nkituaak.

English: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
Masaai: Kairriu nanu ilainyalak likiarare iyie, oltung'ani ake o masaa enyena o larrabal naa kedung ninche iltarakua inono gelunot nenang'aki ninche atua enkima.

English: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos enye nepuku enkitanyaanyukoto oo ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu. Naa nji apa eikununo eliooto enye: eeta apa pooki enyaanyukie e tung'ana,

English: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
Masaai: Netii apa enkop olameyu oleng. Nedou Abram alotu enkop e Misiri, aparan, amu etagolo olameyu asapuku te nkop.

English: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
Masaai: Ore iyie olowuasare nena kitanapat, intukurru pasa Enkai apaashare nkitanapat?

English: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki olaiguanani le Israel, “Teyietu enkawuo,” neyietu ninye, neiteleiki Elisha nkaik enyena endukuya o laiguanani.

English: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat negolie enkishui enkiteng enye, kake ore olng'ur lo ltorrono naa entoloi.

English: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
Masaai: amu ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya neiteru ninye alo te Babilon, ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le imiet nelotu ninye Yerusalem, amu etii enkaina supat e Nkai enye shumata ninye.

English: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
Masaai: meitoki ninche aaisilig ilperereni loo lasarri, ina siai oo nkaik lenye, nemeitoki ninche aaing'or ina naitobira ilkimojik lenye, aa Asherim aashu ilperereni le nkorropil.

English: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Enchom entodol enetii ninye, pee airriwaa nanu iltung'ana meshomo aayau ninye.” Nejokini ninye, “Ng'ura etii ninye Dotan.”

English: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Daudi, neirriwaa iltung'ana metanang'are ninche, amu etukurrutua apa lelo tung'ana oleng. Nejo olaiguanani, “Entotoni te Yeriko o metaba anaa nebulu ilmunyo linyi, pee intokiki aashukunye.”

English: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
Masaai: Kaa taa iyieuu? Kalotu enitii te ng'udi; ana ei te nyorrata o te nkiyang'et e mborron?

English: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.
Masaai: Neipirri alo enetii Eli nejo, “Nele nanu, amu kimpoto iyie nanu.” Kake etejo ninye, “Eitu nanu aipot; nyaaki irraga.” Nelo ninye airura.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore taata ene wueji naa olmuaate, metii oltung'ani aashu eng'ues, o tiatua nkanas enyena pooki keitoki aaigil aajing imanyishoritin oo lairritak loo ntare eing'or nkerrai enye.

English: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
Masaai: Esipa taata aatalepuo Enkai tukul; eitomijoono ninye encholiek ai pooki.

English: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo olameyu Misiri, o Kanaan, nelotu osina sapuk; nelau lelo loo papa entoki nanya.

English: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
Masaai: Kake etiaka olasurai enkitok, “Miyeye ntae;

English: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
Masaai: “Woi ninche nena kera kiseruti,” Olaitoriani ojo, “lelo ooitobir enkitobirata neme enaai; lelo ooitayu mbaa enye nemetii oltau lai, pee etum ninche aatoponai eng'oki te shumata eng'oki;

English: And see, if it goeth up by the way of his own coast to Bethshemesh, then he hath done us this great evil: but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that smote us: it was a chance that happened to us.
Masaai: Ning'oring'oro; te neilep ninye aibung' enkoitoi nalo enkop enye kewan, alo Bet-shemesh, naa ninye ilo oitaasa iyiook ena taboi; Kake te neme neijia, nikiyiolou iyiook nchere mme enkaina enye natoosho iyiook, ketotiuo ake duoo neijia te iyiook tolbuket.”

English: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

English: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong naa kepuonu atua iyie indamunot atua endamunoto ino, naa intobiruru endamunoto torrono.

English: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
