English: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
Masaai: Amu eitu kirriwari iyie aairriwaki iltung'ana le likae ng'ejep o enkutuk nagol enkiroroto, kake enkaji e Israel

English: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
Masaai: Eikumok isinaitin le ilo supat, kake kekordu Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa te pooki.

English: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
Masaai: Nilo enetii iltung'ana linono ootii eararoto nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; toliki ninche ening o meyieu nening.”

English: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
Masaai: Amu kesipa tukul ajo kapurruno te nkop oo Lhebrania; ore sii tene natii maata enataasa peyie aatipikaki atua ewueji e korokoroni.”

English: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.
Masaai: Nejo Daniel, “Atoduaa nanu te nduaata ai kewarie, naa ng'ura, ore lelo kutat oong'uan le shumata nekut te ngolon enaiposha kitok.

English: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
Masaai: Naa te nepuonu eing'uaa ineemirishoreki; menya endaa eitu eng'as aaisuj ate. Naa keeta kulie koon naaitabaya ninche, anaa enkisujata oo nkikompeni o motioo o ntokitin oo suyan.)

English: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
Masaai: Amu eimaka enkolong e naapishana te dikae nejo nji, “Neyeng'iyeng'a Enkai te nkolong e naapishana eidipa isiaaitin enyena pooki.”

English: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
Masaai: Ng'ura eneba enkitoo enye! Eishoo papa lang Abraham ninye ematua e tomon oo yarunot.

English: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
Masaai: Neilanyisho aaisik pooki lemankale, neitu eitokini aadol ildoinyo.

English: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Masaai: Enkai osempewuet lang naa engolon ang, eretoto nataana ninye te nkata e nyamali.

English: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
Masaai: Ore te Sion, te ine neiting'ie e nkishiaa, Enkai naitawang.

English: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aisho olaiguanani shekeli iip o tikitam e sahabu, o sonkoyoni kumok, o soito oogol enkinyang'a: ooishoo enkaiguanani e Sheba olaiguanani Solomon.

English: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
Masaai: Eton ake ijo, ‘Ara nanu Enkai! te dukuya lelo likiyieng iyie, hoo nira tung'ani neme Enkai, tiatua inkaik e lelo likipik iyie ilbaa?

English: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho naa ketum ena jung'ore naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye neaku ninye enkerai ai.

English: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
Masaai: “Aitunyo nanu enkironyet oo sabibu openy, ore too ltung'ana nemetii hoo obo otaa te nebo nanu; naitunyoo nanu ninche te ngoro ai naitame nanu ninche te mpushuna ai; ore ilo sarge lenye neisuakino ilkilani laainei, naidurukie nanu ilkilani laainei pooki.

English: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
Masaai: Entoduaa naa enyorrata inyi o ina nikiwuasare intae te kulo tung'ana, ina edol isirito.

English: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
Masaai: “Kadumunye nanu taata,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Ore taata kaitashe nanu; naa kaayiolouni nanu taata.

English: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
Masaai: Aishirita nanu to ltau lai pooki; tawalikiaki nanu Olaitoriani! Kaibung nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
Masaai: Imbooi iyie osinka lino too ng'ok o lwuasa, mincho ninche etum engolon ti atua nanu! Pee atum ataa maata entioto nasinyayu too nkitarruorot sapuki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiasin e Yoram, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
Masaai: Eisiligie ninche lelo elakunoto, ore ninche maate naa isinkan le ntorroni; amu ore pooki naidimu oltung'ani neaku ninye osinka le ina naidimua ninye.

English: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Tonyorrai tang'ara osina anaa osikari odupa le Kristo Yesu.

English: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
Masaai: Ntoduaa iyiook enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, nincho iyiook enjeunoto ino.

English: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: naisarkionie nanu ninche te nena kishorot enye, aisho ninche meishooi to lasar le nkima lelo ilkikaunot lenye, pee atum aituria ninche; ataasa nanu ina pee etum ninche aatayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eidip Aron o layiok lenyena aaimulumula ine wueji sinyati o nena masaa pooki e wueji sinyati, ina kata edumuni ilng'oborri, neitoki ilayiok le Kohat aapuonu aanap kuna, kake meibung ninche nena tokitin sinyat, pee meye ake. Kuna ninche intokitin e ilo ng'obor le ntumo naa ninche enap ilayiok le Kohat.

English: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
Masaai: Ore hoo te naa kayieu nanya kutuk nemaaku olmodai, nanu, amu keaku sipat airo; kake mawuasa, amu ebaiki nejo likae kara kitok alang enaba, negiroo ina mbaa aainei naadolita ninye te nanu o nena naaning aa nanu eing'uaa.

English: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
Masaai: Ore eitupukuni boo, neirriwaa olkilikuai airriwaki olaputani lenye ejo, “Olopeny kuna tokitin anotie enkerai.” Nejo, “Ing'ura tujurru, aatasayia, ainkuneng'ae, kuna tokitin o lgisoi, o enkeene, o eng'udi.”

English: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
Masaai: “Neme ninche ake aomonoki, kake o lelo pooki laairuk nanu enkaraki ororei lenye;

English: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
Masaai: ore apa olpisiai le nena teina umata naa nkerra nkalifuni iip uni o tomoni uni o opishana o iip imiet,

English: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
Masaai: Ore ina kata egira Yoshua aitashe te dukuya ilo Malaika, eishopokoki inkilani naaiduruk naang'u.

English: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
Masaai: Meekure aa kitok tena aji pee aalang nanu; nemeeta hoo ae toki naatirishie nanu meteleku iyie ake, amu ira iyie enkitok enye; kaji taa pasa aiko peyie aas enkarrueisho naba inji, naas eng'oki te dukuya Enkai?”

English: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
Masaai: Ele ororei lo Laitoriani apa oewuo enetii Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai eipirta Ilfilisti, eton eitu ear Farao Gasa ejo,

English: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages,
Masaai: Ore sii ninche iltung'ana le Benchamen nemany ebaiki Geba neito idia alo, te mbata e Mikmash, o Aija, o Betel o nkang'itie enyena,

English: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oramat olng'aboli naa keinos ilng'anayio lenyena, naa ore ilo orrip olkitok lenye naa keyanyituni.

English: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
Masaai: o Enrimon o Sora o Yemut,

English: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
Masaai: Neitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye neiseyie enkutuk ai; naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura atipika nanu irorei laainei atua enkutuk ino.

English: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo neijia, nekurru lelo pooki ooing'orunore; neshipa olorere pooki too mbaa pooki e nkisisa naataasa ninye.

English: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
Masaai: Neas ilooiteng'eni ina natiaka Yesu, neitobiraki Pasaka.

English: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
Masaai: o Ater, o Hesekia, o Asur,

English: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
Masaai: Neipotu Saul iltung'ana pooki meetu olarrabal, metadoi aapuo Keila, pee eng'adu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena.

English: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
Masaai: “Tiaki Aron, ti nindip atipika iltaai nkitasheta, ore lelo taai oopishana neitawang'isho te dukuya ina kitashet oo ltaai.”

English: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
Masaai: Ana aimenaa iyie enkitoo o lng'ur lenye o eanyunoto o eng'iriata enye? Aimiyiololo aajo kejo Enkai pee kirikoki olng'ur lenye enkirridunoto?

English: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, intobiraki iyie iyiook eseriani, iyie oishoo iyiook nena siaitin ang pooki.

English: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
Masaai: Kake ore intae, ilchorueta laainei, emincho elang intae ena bae nabo, inchere ore enkolong nabo to Laitoriani netiu anaa ilarin enkalifu, ore ilarin enkalifu netiu anaa enkolong nabo.

English: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
Masaai: Nesuj ilororani kituaak ooing'uaa Galilaya o Dekapoli o Yerusalem o Yudea o lido kekun le Yordan.

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori,

English: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
Masaai: Meetae osinka oidim aisiaayia lkituaak aare; eibayu ake obo nenyorru olikae, aashu eibung'are obo nemenaa olikae. Mindimidimi sii intae aaisiaayia Enkai o masaa.”

English: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
Masaai: Naa ore entito pooki ake naata enjung'ore te pooki ake ninye osho loo ltung'ana le Israel naa kelo aaku enkitok e obo lo losho lolmarei le menye, pee aa ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana le Israel netum anoto enjung'ore oo loomenye.

English: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nemayian apa iltung'ana lelo pooki ootonyorraitie aatoni te Yerusalem.

English: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
Masaai: Ore ninye te neitubulu ninche nkera, naoru nanu ninche o metaba anaa metii enaleku. Woi ninche te nalo nanu aing'uaa ninche!

English: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: kake ore enkurriny o lairakuj o lkina le monyua o ilo asar le ng'oki etapejoyie ninye te nchumata olperere lo lasar, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
Masaai: naa ore te neitorit lelo kilang'ilang'eta netii ilo obo laaijo Enkerai e Tung'ani, eishopokoki olkila oado neenita enkimeita e sahabu to lgoo lenye;

English: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.
Masaai: Neranyakino nkituaak maate eraposhoki ejo, “Etasesekuana Saul nkalifuni enyena, nesesekuan Daudi nkalifuni tomon enyena.”

English: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye ilayiok oopishana o ntoyie uni.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore ene wueji naa ewueji olorika lai le nkitoo, naa ewueji oo ndapi oo nkejek aainei, ewueji namany tiatua iltung'ana le Israel intarasi. Nemeitoki ae kata enkaji e Israel aaisarkionie enkarna ai Sinyati, nemeitoki ninche, arashu ilaiguanak lenye, teina kiborra enye oo nkonyek, o too mpopoki oo laiguanak lenye ootuata

English: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
Masaai: eton eitu eitir ina opito e nkosholai arashu ebela olbakuli le sahabu ore emoti naokunyeki enkare nebela te nkong'u enkare arashu egila ina keju engarri te nchoto naokunyeki enkare nerrinyo enterit alo atua enkop anaa enatiu apa tedukuya,

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Naftali nkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.

English: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
Masaai: Ninye oitaa intae karsisi oleng pee itumutumu aataleng too nkoitoi pooki, nedumaki ina lkulikae meishoo Enkai enchunet too nikitaasa iyiook.

English: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.
Masaai: Amu ore kulo oshon letaa ilo aiwuang'ie naa kening lelo ooibonisho te ntorroni o oloomusu; kake ore iyie eitu kinyorraki Olaitoriani Enkai ino taasa ina.

English: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak lang, o lkituaak lang, o lapolosak lang, o loo papa, neitu eibung nkitanapat inono, o nkikoot inono ninchoo iyie ninche.

English: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
Masaai: Ore oloata nkitanapat aainei, neibung ninche, ninye laanyor; naa ore olaanyor kenyorru Papa ninye, naa kanyorru nanu ninye. Naa kaibalakinye kewan ninye.”

English: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
Masaai: Enkai oo loo papa naitopiwuo Yesu, lishomo intae aar, aashe to lchani.

English: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
Masaai: Ore pooki nimanyimanya naa keaku nkanas inyi mijoonto nemuti iwuejitin inyi neeika, metaa ore ilpereren linyi loo lasarri neaku ile pesho netumutaki, negili aabelibel inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu, nedung'i ilpereren linyi le nkorropil aauroo, nejutori isiaaitin inyi.

English: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
Masaai: neishoruni sii imapala naayakini Asaf ilo aing'urani le ntim o laiguanani, pee aatum nanu aishoo mbaoi naitobirie iloom te nkaraki nena shomito o sempewuet le nkaji e Nkai, o esuntai pooki e nkanasa, o ina aji nalo nanu amany.” Naaisho nanu olaiguanani nena pooki naatoomonuo, amu etii apa enkaina supat o laitoriani shumata nanu.

English: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
Masaai: Ore enkinyiang'a e nkordunoto enye (aa te mbotoro o lapa obo ikordu ninche) tipika shekeli imiet e nkosholai, te risioroto e shekeli e ine wueji sinyati.

English: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
Masaai: Neing'oru taa Solomon pee ear Yeroboam metua: kake etudumunye Yeroboam, neisikaki Misiri, nelo enetii Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri, neton ninye te Misiri ometabau keeya e Solomon.

English: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
Masaai: Amaa, ilo oitobira enkiok, ae mening'isho ninye? Amaa, ilo oitibira enkong'u, ae medolisho ninye?

English: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
Masaai: Nemeitokini ai kata aata enkewarie nemeetayie ninche tipat ewang'an o ltaa aashu ene nkolong, amu Olaitoriani Enkai oaku ewang'an, naa keitoreisho ninche intarasi ontarasi.

English: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
Masaai: Neitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani pee kiaas kuna kikoot pooki, pee kiureyu Olaitoriani Enkai ang, te nkaraki eseriani ang maate e anaake, pee etum ninye atagolie iyiook metaa eikinchu anaa enikitiu ena olong.

English: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
Masaai: Metaa aeuo apa nanu Yerusalem naton teine nkolong'i uni.

English: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Masaai: Na aji e Aron, tipika osiligi lino Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto enye naa ninye elong'o enye.

English: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.
Masaai: Kake etiaka ilo tung'ani Yoab, “Ore naaji ninye hoo te naning nanu te nkaina ai enkiroishi oo mpisai nkalifuni tomon e nkosholai, maitorioo nanu enkaina ai aar olayioni lo laiguanani; amu ore te ning'oto ang nikintanapa iyie olaiguanani o Abishai o Itai, ejo, ‘Ore te nkaraki nanu entomitu ilo barnoti Absalom.’

English: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
Masaai: Kelo Olaitoriani anaa oltung'ani magilani, nepush anaa oltung'ani lo larrabal; neyietu aishir, nebuaku, neitoduaaya kewan ajo ai magilani alang ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
Masaai: Teine eishu ilarruok te nyamali, naa teine eyeng'iyeng'ieki iloonaurate.

English: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
Masaai: Iyie eigarakino oltau lai, enkaina ino e tatene naairishu nanu.

English: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo layiok le Gershon ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ore esiaai enye naa keaku abori enkitasheikinoto e Itamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki Aron o Eliesa o Itamar, lelo ayiok lenyena, “Emincho ake olpapita loo lukuny inyi eisiong'a, nimipolososo ilkilani linyi, pee miyeye ake, pee melotu engoro shumata ele turrur pooki; kake ore lelo alashera linyi, ina aji pooki e Israel neidim aaishira teina kinosata enkima nainuaa Olaitoriani.

English: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
Masaai: Ore eoshoto enkukuo neiting'ie enchankar nerishu autu iloogol ooishankarra.

English: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
Masaai: Neitubul Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, neitagol ninche aitalang ilmang'ati lenye.

English: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
Masaai: “Embelekenyata wootu enatii pee eitajeuni intae; intae ilubot pooki e nkop! Amu ara nanu Enkai, nemeetae ae.

English: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

Masaai: Kake ore pee edol ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat imbaa e nking'sia naataasa ninye o nkera eilepie iltoiloishi lenye te nkaji e Nkai ejo, “Hosana, Enkerai e Daudi.” Negoro ninche,

English: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon o imiet Bilga, nedoiki ene tomon o ile Imer,

English: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
Masaai: Irorei le Nehemia kulo olayioni le Hekalia. Ore apa to lapa oji ole Kislep, to lari le tikitam, atii nanu Susa ina ang kitok,

English: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
Masaai: Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha, o nena pooki naabore atua ninye, nchoo eosh enkop olkerempe o pooki toki natii atua.

English: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
Masaai: etijing'a ninye nabo kata Ewueji Sinyati, neme osarge loo lkineji o lasho etoshoroyie kake osarge lenye makewan, neitadedeyie te ina elakunoto oo ntarasi.

English: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
Masaai: Te naa kalikioo napaji enkaraki naa nanu oyieu, keaku olekoisiaayio aanyu maatalaakini; kake teneme eyieunoto ai, naa enkaraki naa Enkai naaisiliga aitanap ena siai.

English: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
Masaai: Tenelo neitoming'an oltung'ani enkiok enye pee mening ina kitanapata, neaku ore ninye enkomono enye naa olminong to Laitoriani.

English: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
Masaai: Kake te neitaa olmoruo lenye parmetii neitaa pesho ina olong apa pee ening, neaku naa, ore embae pooki naimu enkutuk enye naipirta olmumai lenye aashu naipirta ina enata e kewan nemelo aunoyu; eitaa olmoruo lenye pesho, naa kepalaki Olaitoriani ninye.

English: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i etamueyia Hesekia eyieu eye. Nelo ilo oiboni le Nkai Isaya olayioni le Amos enetii ninye, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani; Ntobira enkaji ino, amu iye iyie, minchiu.”

English: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
Masaai: Enkaraki e na pee mikidukenya. Ore hoo naa kemusanu ake ele tung'ani li oriong amuta, kake ore ilo tung'ani lang li atua neitang'ejuki nkolong'i pooki.

English: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
Masaai: neshetu isikarini olmarisian loo lkiku, nepik elukunya enye, neishopoki olkila onyokie.

English: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee inchir abuaku? Aimetii olaiguanani atua iyie keidaa olautaroni lino, eji metaa kitijing'a emion anaa enkitok nasaisai?

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
Masaai: Niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nabol inkuraren inyi, naitopiu intae too nkuraren inyi, intae iltung'ana laainei.

English: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat, o ng'apeta enyena, tenebo ilgorieti lenyena nerisioro o lkulikae; neeta ilusien naamanita, ore enkadori enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet.

English: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie ilo meitai nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Eliesa olayioni le Aron olapolosani,

English: But Job answered and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoab awal ajo,

English: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.
Masaai: Pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai. Meetae likae.

English: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
Masaai: Ore te mion kitok oleng, naishorua nanu tenkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani ntalantani nkalifuni iip nabo e sahabu, o ntalantani milion nabo e nkosholai o suyai, o esekenkei nemetemayu, amu aikumok apa oleng. Aishorua sii mbaoi o soito. Ore te kuna nemeeta nchere pee miponaa.

English: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoab awaliki Olaitoriani ejo,

English: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
Masaai: Eirriwua ninye iltimito lenyena maataarare netur ninche iloong'elu, naarresh ninche eman olng'obor lai.

English: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
Masaai: Ore Ilmaleki nemanya enkop e Negeb, ore ile Hiti o Iyebusi o le Amori nemanya ina kop oo ndoinyo, netii ile Kanaan embata e naiposha, olkeju le Yordan.”

English: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu enkikurrukur o lng'atuny, arashu olng'arurumi okuetu, neijia etiu oloitoreisho torrono too ltung'ana aisinak.

English: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aibelekenyakino Olaitoriani nejo, “Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee kintasima airriu nanu?

English: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo enkishui ino. Metaa empiris te nebo intae.

English: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki papaai lenye, amu eitamoo kewan imbaa enkiba, neikony olalashe lenye, neas ina neme sidai ti atua iltung'ana lenyena, ing'ura, keye ninye te nkaraki ing'ok enye.

English: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
Masaai: “Ore olemaaning'ore naa olmang'atinta lai ore olemeiturrur te nebo nanu, keisardaikie.

English: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
Masaai: Amu itoning'o, Enkai, ilmuma laainei, kinchoo iyie nanu enjung'ore e lelo ooure enkarna ino.

English: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
Masaai: te ng'oki amu maairuk nanu.

English: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
Masaai: Miureishoyu iyie na kop tishipayu iyie ning'ida, amu etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
Masaai: nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meitashe ina, nemeaku ae kata.

English: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata newang'u isupati anaa enkolong te nkitoria e Menye. Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ie, toning'o.

English: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
Masaai: Etarruoitie sii lekua te naisho, neyukuyukori te merai e naisho napi, ore olapolosani o laiboni netarruoitie te naisho; etomilote ninche te naisho neyukuyukori ninche te merai e naisho napi, etapaashari ninche te nduaata, nerrorro ninche edung enkiguana.

English: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
Masaai: Kake teneton ilo tipoti te wueji nebo nemeibulaa to sesen, kake etunukunye kake enetejia ake teina kinosata enkima neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo meeta entioto; amu enkiporoi enkima ake.

English: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku olaiguanani nesesekuan enkaji e Yeroboam pooki, eitu ninye eing'uaa olaishirani te nkaji e Yeroboam. Eidakie pooki te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye oji Ahija le Shilo.

English: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
Masaai: Entigirata, pooki toki naishu te dukuya Olaitoriani; amu etudumunye ninye tiatua ina manyisho enye sinyati.

English: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
Masaai: Iltung'ana le Sion! Entabuaku te nchipai sapuk, intae iltung'ana le Yerusalem! Eng'ura, elotu olaiguanani linyi atua intae, elotu eisula etimirishe, nelotu te mborron ekedito enkurrarru e sikiria.

English: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
Masaai: Kinyaakita sii aaikilikuan ninche nkarn enye, pee itum atayiolo, nikitum aaigero nkarn e lelo tung'ana too lukuny enye.

English: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
Masaai: Anoto apa Israel eikununo anaa isabibu ti ong'ata. Nadol iloo papaai linyi eikununo anaa ilng'anayio lo lng'aboli le nkiterata. Kake eetuo apa ninche enetii Baal-peor, neitisinyaki ate Baal, neaku ninche enkitagoroto anaa nena tokitin naatonyorra ninche.

English: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
Masaai: Amu eisarkionieki nkaik inyi to sarge neisarkionieki ilkimojik linyi te ntorroni; eiroro nkutukie inyi elejare, neitobiru ilng'ejepa linyi entorroni.

English: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Enkai ai nchoo eing'or nkonyek inono nening nkiyiaa inono enkomono ene wueji.

English: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Hesekia etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari ninye te wueji neika oo nkuraren oo layiok le Daudi. Ore Yuda pooki o lelo oomanya Yerusalem neisho ninye enkanyit te keeya enye. Neitoreisho olayioni lenye Manase te rishata enye.

English: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
Masaai: Neisiong'a too mbat o lng'obor enkikenet oo ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o noo nkineji.

English: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nening iltung'ana le Israel eji, “Ng'ura etesheta ile Ruben ole Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase olperere lo lasar te dukuya enkop e Kanaan, ti atua ina kop nataaniki Yordan, te ina shoto apa nara enoo ltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
Masaai: Nelo ninye enetii te mbata enkoitoi nalala nejoki ninye, “Wou inchooki maatayiolo,” amu eitu eyiolou ninye ajo entito olayioni lenye. Nejo ninye, “Ainyoo naa kincho peyie kitum atayiolo?”

English: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
Masaai: Ore elaakinoto o supat naa ketum enkishui, ore intumot oo ltorrok naa ing'ok.

English: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
Masaai: Ore ina Ai naitobira enkop o ntokitin pooki, aa ninye taa Olaitoriani le shumata enkop, mme nkajijik naaitobiri too nkaik emany ninye.

English: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
Masaai: Nepejoo ninye enkaji o Laitoriani, o enkaji o laiguanani, o nkajijik pooki e Yerusalem; ore pooki aji kitok nepejoo ninye.

English: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo oreren: Ilkituaak imiet loo Lfilisti, o Lkanaani pooki, le Sidon, o Lhafi apa oomanya oldoinyo le Lebanon, ebaiki oldoinyo le Baalhermon ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat.

English: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Moserot, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Bene-yakan.

English: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
Masaai: “Ore naa iyie, shomo imbonisho tigilunore ninche te kulo rorei pooki, nijoki ninche, ‘Keikurrukur Olaitoriani te shumata, tiatua ina manyisho sinyati neitayu oltoilo lenye; keikurrukur ninye te ngolon aarare iltung'ana lenyena, nebuaku, anaa iltung'ana ooitunyoo isabibu, tenkaraki lelo pooki oomanya enkop.

English: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina katiu nanu te ninche anaa olng'atuny, karresh ninche te mbata e nkoitoi anaa olowuaru keri.

English: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
Masaai: Neirot ninye esikiria, nejoki osinka lenye, “Isiosionie osikiria, nimilo akiti ometaba anaa naajoki.”

English: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
Masaai: Ore to lari li are le nkitoria e Nebukadnesa, neidetidet Nebukadnesa nenyamalu oltau lenye, neimin ninye njo.

English: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
Masaai: ore pee ebau enkata e ilo sirua neirriwaa olaisiaayiani lenye metiaaki lelo ooipotoki, ‘Wootu; amu eirrag pooki toki!’

English: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
Masaai: Ore too le Sebulon naa iltung'ana nkalifuni onom, ootanapate to larrabal neeta masaa pooki e njore o larrabal, pee eretu Daudi to ltau obo metii olng'ash.

English: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie Isiraeli iltung'ana meshomo aajing ilnukat aaman Gibea.

English: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
Masaai: Neigil ake oltoilo alotu enetii nejoki, “Ore entoki naa Enkai naitukuo, nimintaa iyie enturuj.”

English: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
Masaai: Ore anaa enairrag ilapurrok aanyu oltung'ani, neijia eikununo ilapolosak eibung'ate te nebo; neitayu iloikop te nkoitoi e Shekem, ee, neas mbaa torrok oleng.

English: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
Masaai: Aimeishiaakino teneyiolou nchere, eishoo o Laitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, enkitoria oo Siraeli pooki Daudi ntarasi to lmumai le munyan?

English: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
Masaai: “Aipoto nanu enkarna ino iyie Olaitoriani atii enguton e ngumoto.

English: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
Masaai: Amaa te nemeishopo anaa te nemeeta endaa olalashe anaa enkanashe,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, ‘Kaitame nanu ina naitaasa Ilamaleki Israel te ina naibooitie ninche te nkoitoi, apa eilepu aaing'uaa Misiri.

English: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
Masaai: amu eiroshiutuo ltauja le kulo tung'ana, netiripate nkiyiaa mening, neikeno nkonyek enye, pee medolisho ake too nkonyek enye, nening'ishoyu too nkiyiaa enye, neyiolou ltauja lenye, naaibelekenyakino nanu pee aishiunye ninche.’

English: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
Masaai: naa kejut ninye pooki kiyioi too nkonyek enye, ore keeya nemeitokini ae kata aata aashu eitokini aata olkiyioi, aashu enkishirata aashu emion ae kata. Amu etulusoitie intokitin pooki e dukuya.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, embelekenya nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, naa kaisho nanu intae ibikibiki teine wueji.

English: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
Masaai: Aime Enkai nabo naitaa neitopok enkiyang'et e nkishui te iyiook? Naa kainyoo ninye eyieu? Eyieu ninye eishoi naure Enkai. Metaa ng'ura entagolie ate emincho obo linyi eaku olemeisiligayu teina kitok e kitisho enye.

English: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
Masaai: Kake eitu ening, naa ore amu ninye ogol alang ninye, nearaki ninye, neirag ninye te nebo ninye.

English: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae loo Lkohat neng'amu te oshoto e nkukuo too lmareita lo losho le Efraim o to losho le Dan o to lpisiai lo losho le Manase nkanas tomon.

English: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
Masaai: Lo sunkuro! Kulo iyiololo intae aatolimu eliooto enkop o loing'ang'e; kake kaji nkoko pee miyiololo aaing'ura nilimumu enatiu ena kata?

English: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
Masaai: Ore hoo tenemusanu intona enyena tiatua enkop, netoyu aye olchani lenye tiatua enkop.

English: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
Masaai: Enguanata te nebo, kake meaku ina toki; eimaki ororei kake melo auno, amu etii Enkai te nebo iyiook.

English: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
Masaai: Ilopir le naiposha ootarasutua ooitokitoku labur le nkurruna enye, lakir oopuaya laa ninche eitaanyitai emisimisi e naimin o lodo le nkop ntarasi.

English: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
Masaai: ore te ina olong naa keiro ninye ajo, “Maaku nanu olabaani, ore atua enkaji ai metii endaa nemetii olkila; mikintaa intae nanu olarikoni loo ltung'ana.”

English: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
Masaai: Neipotuni Iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neishori ninche imasaa o larrabal, nepuo aarare ninche. Neun iltung'ana loo Siraeli ilng'oborri te dukuya ninche netiu anaa iluaat are kutiti oo nkineji, kake eiputa iltung'ana le Siria enkop.

English: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
Masaai: neitoki Musa aitashe te nkishomi e ina ang oo lng'oborri, nejo, “Kaing'ae ole nkalo o Laitoriani? Wou enatii.” Neiturrurro ilayiok le Lawi maate te ine netii ninye.

English: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Iruko iyie te nkaraki nikitoduaa nanu? Emayiani lelo leitu edol neiruko.”

English: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
Masaai: Kaae neisho iltung'ana le Israel ile Lawi nkanas tenebo ndaat enye oo nchoo.

English: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
Masaai: Eishooki ninche Hebron tiatua enkop e Yuda o nena daat oo nchoo naamanita,

English: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
Masaai: Te najo nanu, “Ncho maaitemoi nanu enaimin, ore ewang'an naamanita nanu neaku enkewarie,”

English: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
Masaai: amu eewuo olainyalani shumata ninye, shumata Babilon; ewaki ilmurran lenyena etigilaki nkai enyena aaitaa ngiligilat amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai e lap, esipa keitalaku ninye.

English: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.
