English: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Nimikileku iyie enkong'u ai, nemaata olng'ur; kake kaaitame iyie tenkaraki nkoitoi inono, ina kata etii olminong lino atua iyie. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
Masaai: Ewaita enkosholai ewaita sahabu, meeta olchumati eneiting'ie anaa karsisisho e pooki toki e tipat.

English: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
Masaai: Nedumu Musa olpisiai lo sarge nepik ingirran, ore olikae pisiai lo sarge nebukoki olperere.

English: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
Masaai: Naa imirimiri intae ilmang'ati linyi, naa kebatata ninche te dukuya intae to lalem.

English: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
Masaai: neaku kaboloo inkanas oo lpolosien le Moab eiteru too nkanas naatii ilpolosien lenyena, o ina kop e Beteshimot o Baalmeon o Kiriatai.

English: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
Masaai: Ore pee edol lchekuti le lelo bitiro inaatotiwuo, eisik aapuo aalikioo te ina anasa o te ina kop.

English: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
Masaai: Erikoo esipata ilo laa ore enkoitoi enye naa esipata, kake ore eng'oki nenang'aa ilo torrono.

English: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
Masaai: Tegelu oltung'ani torrono metigilunore ninye, nchoo eiguanare ninye olaitang'oroni.

English: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
Masaai: ekaisho nanu ninye imbaa aainei pooki oo roruat aainei; ekalo nanu enetii ninye te nkanyit naishori oltung'ani kitok.

English: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore enkaji e Israel netupuruko oleng te nanu, ninche pooki, ore enkosholai o suyiai o empirbil o esekenkei o risasi otii atua olkokuet, netupuruko pooki.

English: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
Masaai: Keisiaai ninye iloreren pooki o layioni lenye o layioni lo layioni lenye ometaba anaa nelotu enkata enkop enye makewan; netum taa nkuapi kumok o laiguanak kituaak aaitaa ninye orrindik.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel ore lelo siruai gelunot lo Laitoriani, lilimunyenye aaibalunye nchere iumat sinyat lelo siruai laainei kulo ninche isiruai gelunot naa ninche kulo.

English: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
Masaai: Amu ore iyiook, hoo nikinchu keishoori ake iyiook pooki kata aaisho keeya te nkaraki Yesu, peyie eitoduaari sii enkishui e Yesu te kulo seseni lang ooye kenyake.

English: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
Masaai: Ore ilo onyor inkitadiat nenyor enchankar; ore ilo oilepie kutuk aji enye oleng, neing'oru enkidaaroto.

English: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
Masaai: Tipika ninche atua enkuretisho, Olaitoriani! Nchoo iloreren eyiolou aajo iltung'ana ake ninche!

English: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro olkerubi obo naa ntemat tomon e nkaina, naa neijia ake sii etiu ilo likae.

English: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
Masaai: Etii apa te nkata o laiguanani Herode, le Yudea, olapolosani oji Sakaria, lo lkekun le Abija; ore enkitok enye naa ene ntalipa e Aaron, neji enkarna enye Elisabet.

English: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.
Masaai: Neaku emuei menye Pubilio eeta oloirobi nerotu sii osarge; nelo Paulo abaiki neomon, neiteleiki nkaik neishiunye ninye.

English: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, nakera aainei, entoning'oki nanu niakuku ilooning'u lelo rorei le nkutuk ai.

English: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
Masaai: Aaishooyie nanu Enkai aitarasaki lelo lemeure Enkai, naanang'aki nanu nkaik e lelo arruok.

English: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
Masaai: Eetuo apa ninche tenebo Serubabel, o Yoshua, o Nehemia, o Asaria, o Raamia o Nahamani, o Mordekai, o Bilshan o Misparet o Bigfai, o Nehum o Baana. Ore esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel:

English: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kelotu enaimin aiput enkop, neiput enaimin kitok olorere; kake kedumunye Olaitoriani ti alo intae, nedoli enkitoo enye te shumata intae.

English: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie aipirripir ninche neya osiwuo, neidapash olkutati ninche. Nilo iyie ang'ida ti atua Olaitoriani; ti atua ilo Obo Osinya le Israel ilo iyie ang'ida.

English: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
Masaai: nepuo ninche enetii Serubabel, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye nejoki ninche, “Nchoo iyiook mateshet tenebo ntae; amu kiserem sii iyiook Enkai inyi anaa eninkoko intae, naa aikipolosaki apa iyiook ninye ebaiki nkolong'i e Esarhadon olaiguanani le Asiria, laa ninye apa oyaua iyiook ene.”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kaikilikuan intae embae nabo; entawalikiaki pee, aliki intae engolon naasie kuna baa.

English: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oopishana, nedoiki Yashbekasha, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
Masaai: Ore teina kewarie neitalio Olaitoriani kewan te Solomon, nejoki ninye, “Toomonu entoki niyieu naaisho.”

English: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
Masaai: neng'amu ninye Yesu too nkaik enyena, neisis Enkai nejo,

English: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
Masaai: Ore too le Gad nepuo enetii Daudi to sempewuet otii ong'ata ilmurran magil oogol, arriyiak too long'oi o remeta, ootiu nkomomi enye anaa iloo ng'atunyo, neneneng anaa ntarakueti too nchumat oo ldoinyio:

English: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato ninche, “Ewaita intae ninye eng'uanare too nkitanapat inyi.” Nejoki Lyahudi ninye, “Meishoro iyiook matar oltung'ani metua.”

English: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
Masaai: Inji eikuna Enkai pee eibalie enyorrata enye ti atua iyiook, nchere eirriwua Enkai Enkerai enye meeu enkop, metaa ninye kinchuyie.

English: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore taisere tena saa naitasha enchan oo soito neitu ae kata etumi te Misiri ebaiki apa peyie eiteruni o metabaiki taata.

English: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
Masaai: Ore eirorie Petero o Yohana olorere nepuonu ilapolosak o lkitok loo larripok le nkaji e Nkai o Sadukayo enetii ninche.

English: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
Masaai: Naa te nebaiki ele rorei nkiyiaa o lbalusui, nikirorie iyiook pee kintung'uaa intae enyamali.”

English: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
Masaai: Woi iyie ora olainyalani, leton eitu kinyali iyie, niaata enkeleekisho, neitu iyie kintaasi embae e nkeleekisho! Ore ake pee indip ainyalisho nikinyali sii ninye iyie; ore pee indip mbaa inono e nkeleekisho nikintaasi iyie inenkeleekisho.

English: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
Masaai: kemitu Olaitoriani ninye neitopok; keji olomayiana te nkop; minchooyo iyie ninye apik eyieunoto oo lmang'ati lenyena.

English: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
Masaai: Mpiraka iyie enkaji ino enkurruna, ore teine niwuang'ie iloreren kumok ninturrayie enkishui ino makewan.

English: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
Masaai: metopona intae Olaitoriani, intae o nkera inyi!

English: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
Masaai: neaku ore te nkarna e Yesu naa kegil pooki ng'ae kung, te shumata o te nkop o ti abori enkop,

English: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Neeta apa Asa enjore oo ltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni le Yuda, oata ilong'oi o remeta. O ltung'ana nkalifuni iip are o ntomoni isiet oo ltung'ana le Benchamen, oata ilong'oi o nkai; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana magil yiolot.

English: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
Masaai: Neing'or Yesu nkaloli pooki, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Egol atiu aja to lkarsis pee ejing enkitoria e Nkai!”

English: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
Masaai: “Ilepa shomo Lebanon, niyietu aishir, ailepunye oltoilo lino tiatua Bashan; nchira te Abarim, amu ore lelo sanchan linono pooki neidaikieki.

English: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
Masaai: Iyie, Olaitoriani, kiteleja iyie nanu; nateleje nanu; igol iyie alang nanu, isula iyie. Ataa nanu entoki nakueniyieki endama pooki; naamor nanu pooki ng'ae.

English: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ekadumu aitasheyie tena kop olchekut lemeret lelo ooye, arashu eing'oru nena naaidapashari, arashu eishiunye nena ng'ojiniaa, arashu eitoti nena naatelekutua, kake nenya nkiri e nena naapir nepolol o metabaiki iloisotok lenye.

English: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
Masaai: O lelo gululu iip ong'uan le nena sosin pokira are, ilkererin oare loo lgululu ake te sos nabo, pee eimulumul lelo bakulini oare loo nchumat oo ng'apeta;

English: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.
Masaai: Neyietu olaiguanani abuaku pee eyakini iloibonok, o Lkaldayo o laduaak. Nejoki olaiguanani lelo tung'ana ang'eni le Babilon, “Ore oloba anaa oloisoma ele sirata nelimu enajo ninye, naaitodol nanu enkibalakinoto enye neishopokini olkila sintet nepiki olpisiai le sahabu aaitaman emurt enye, nelo ninye aaku oloitoreisho liokuni te nkitoria.”

English: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
Masaai: Neyiolou Daudi nchere eitasheyie Olaitoriani ninye aitaa olaiguanani le Israel, o nchere eilepunye ninye enkitoo enye te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena Israel.

English: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Asgad naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o tikitam oare.

English: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
Masaai: Nkiwuang'at enyena naaitawang enkop; nedol enkop neikirikira.

English: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche enetii Musa o Aron o ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel ti ong'ata e Paran, te Kadesh; neyaki ninche olomoni o ina umata pooki, neitodol ninche ilng'anayio le ina kop.

English: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
Masaai: emiarare ninche, amu maisho nanu intae hoo enkop enye, a-a hoo ninye eneba endap e nkeju amu aishoo nanu Esau oldoinyo le Seir metaa olenye.

English: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
Masaai: Ore pee aajur ninche nanu, neyieu naalaku mashomo, amu maata apa ae naaitanang'i pookata.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
Masaai: neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu idol kewan anaa olotiu anaa Enkai te ng'eno,

English: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
Masaai: Nindaikie iyie eishoi enye te nkop, niwuang'ie nkera enye aishie ti atua ltung'ana.

English: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Eilepa olng'atuny alo to sanag lenye, etii ilo oidakie nkuapi enkoitoi enye eshomo ninye teine wueji enye pee eitaa enkop ino mitil; neidaikieki inkanas inyi metaa meetae olomanya.

English: And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nena neipotu Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria enjore enye pooki, neilep alo aman ang'adu Samaria.

English: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
Masaai: Naa tiaaki iyie ninche, Olasar le nkima ele linchosho intae Olaitoriani: isitiman oare le kerra lo lari obo, lemeeta entibili, anaake, pee eaku olasar loo nkolong'i pooki.

English: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.
Masaai: Eetae apa enkolong naetuo ilayiok le Nkai aaitayu ate te dukuya Olaitoriani, nelotu sii ninye Shetani te nebo ni nche.

English: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilaranyak: lelo ayiok le Asaf, naa iip nabo o tikitam o isiet.

English: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
Masaai: Ore naa taata nji shomo tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, aaitayio apa nanu te nkirrita oo ntare, te sujata oo nkerra, pee itum ataa olkitok loo ltung'ana laainei Israel;

English: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Metamayiana intae Olaitoriani, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop!

English: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
Masaai: Naa keitashe iltung'ana leeiking'a aairrita nkerrai inyi, naa iltung'ana loo loreren oopuo aaku ilaturok linyi o laitobirak loo sabibu;

English: And it shall be, that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead, that his name be not put out of Israel.
Masaai: Ore olayioni ong'as aiu neya enkarna eilo alashe lenye otua, pee meiwuang'ieki enkarna enye tiatua Israel.

English: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
Masaai: Te naa iruko Musa, anaata kirukuruku sii nanu, amu imbaa aainei etisira ninye.

English: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
Masaai: Einyala ilpisia le enata nkejek enyena, nepiki emurt enye engotoo e sekenkei;

English: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
Masaai: “Teneas olturrur pooki loo Siraeli eng'oki eitu eotiki ore ina toki naisudoro too nkonyek eumata, neas ninche nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi neaku ilooitarruoitie;

English: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro, e pooki karasha nchoo eaku intemat tikitam o isiet enkadoro, ore endapasho e pooki karasha naa intemat ong'uan endapasho. Nerisioroyu ilkarash pooki.

English: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
Masaai: Ina nainosa ineepir oo lasarri lenye neok enaisho oo lasarri lenye ooki? Nchoo ninche edumunye pee kiretu iyie, nchoo ninche mikitomitu iyie!

English: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
Masaai: Ore te nkata naado natigire nanu, aitirring'e nanu naibooyo kewan, ore taata kaishir nanu anaa enkitok nasaisai, kaipang'ipang nanu naiyiogiyiog.

English: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki napetaa ninye te nena olong'i enyena e nkiduruk neiduruku; ore sii pooki toki natonie ninye naa keiduruku.

English: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.
Masaai: Nebatata Yoab te nkomom enye abaiki enkop, nesai, nemayian olaiguanani, nejo Yoab, “Ore taata etayiolo osinka lino nchere anoto omom too nkonyek inono, olkitok lai olaiguanani, te ina naishorua olaiguanani eomonunoto osinka lenye.”

English: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
Masaai: Ore pee eitabaya nena pooki naasirakino ninye, neitadou ninye to lchani neirragie te nkurare.

English: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Masaai: Entoning naa Enkai, erisha oloirirua, naa keipirri ninye ailany intae.

English: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
Masaai: Nedumunye Daudi neisik ina olong ailany Saul, nelo enetii Akish olaiguanani le Gas.

English: For this is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Ore idia olong naa enkolong o Laitoriani loo lororani, enkolong e lap, pee eitalaaki kewan too lmang'ati lenyena. Keinos olalem ometaraposhoyu, neok osarge ometirikayu. Amu Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani oibung'ita olasar, teina kop e moikuape te mbata olkeju le Farite.

English: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
Masaai: Neng'idayu ninche enkaraki naitirring'ieki, neyau ninye ninche ewueji enye neyieu.

English: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
Masaai: Eikununo ilkituaak linono anaa ntargeeti neikununo ilaigerok linono pooki anaa emus o lmaati, neirragita too lpaashen te nkolong e nkirobi ore ake pee eilepu enkolong, nelaari aapuo; meetae oltung'ani oyiolo enetii ninche.

English: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ena apa pee etudumakine olaiguanani. Etesheta apa Solomon Milo, neram esuntai apa natigile te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye.

English: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Ekairriwaki intae olameyu ong'uesi entim metigilunore intae, naa keoru intae inkera inyi, neim olmeitai o sarge atua intae naa kayau olalem shumata intae. Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
Masaai: Ore eidipa lalashera lenyena aailepa aashom ilo sirua, neitoki sii ninye alo, neitu eitalio kewan, kake etiu anaa keisudori.

English: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
Masaai: Te nikinyala apa ninye ti ae bae aashu te neeta esile ino e ae toki, nchoo eaku esile ai.

English: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
Masaai: Naa Yoab apa olkitok le njore pooki e Israel; ore Benaia olayioni le Yehoida naa ninye olkitok loo Lkereti o Lpelesi;

English: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
Masaai: Enoto intae olkuaak sidai, emienikino ng'ok. Etii kulikae linyi lemeeta eyiolounoto e Nkai. Najo neijia pee aitukurru intae.

English: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu, nejoki ninche, “Meyieu ilememuei olabaani, iloomuei ake ooyieu neitu alotu aipot isupati, kake looata ng'ok aewuo aipot.”

English: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
Masaai: Medamuni ninche too lkurrot ootumoreki le nkanasa, meekure edamuni nkarn enye, neaku etigilaki entorroni anaa olchani.’

English: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
Masaai: Anaa olkurragos oitobir enkaji enye, negolie nkera enyena, nelak inaipuko enyena aibung ninche, too naipuko enyena.

English: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.
Masaai: Nesesekuan sii Ishmael Ilyahudi pooki apa ootii tenebo Gedalia te Mispa, o sikarini loo Lkaldayo apa otii ine.

English: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
Masaai: Nebik Abimelek te Aruma; nearaa Sebul Gaal o lalashera lenyena, pee meitoki ninche aatoni te Shekem.

English: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
Masaai: Kake ajoki nanu intae minos ilmuma katukul hoo te shumata, amu olorika le nkitoria e Nkai;

English: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
Masaai: Ore te pooki doinyo oado, o pooki doinyo naikarere, naa kejing nkonyek oo nkariak ina olong kenya eyiang'are kitok te neurori iltaleta.

English: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena “elo aing'uaa olee menye o ng'otonye neibung'are enkitok enye, neaku pokira are nabo.”

English: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
Masaai: ore to losho le Dan naa Amiel olayioni le Gemali;

English: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
Masaai: Eitaaki ninche ngiligilat. Negilunore olosho olosho, negilunore enkanasa enkanasa, amu eitanyamala Enkai ninche te pooki pukunoto o sina.

English: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
Masaai: Ina pee aawaliki nanu ilo malaika laairorie ejo, “Aimiyiolo doi ajo ainyoo kuna?” Najo, “A'a, olkitok lai.”

English: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
Masaai: Atubukuo nanu osina lai te dukuya ninye, nalimu nanu enyamali ai te dukuya ninye.

English: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Asaf, naa, Sekur, o Yosef, o Natania, o Aharela, lelo ayiok le Asaf te utaroto e Asaf, laa ninye apa oibonisho te utaroto o laiguanani.

English: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Masaai: Metaa okishin nkera enyena, neaku enkoliai enkitok enye!

English: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Shafan ilo aigeroni ajoki olaiguanani, “Aaishoo nanu Hilkia olapolosani embuku.” Neisum Shafan ina buku te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
Masaai: Ore ake peyie ekenyu neas Olaitoriani ena bae; neye nkishu pooki oo Lmisiri, kake ore nkishu oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli eitu ninye eye nabo.

English: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;
Masaai: nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong apa nategelua Israel, nanya olmumai teina ishoi e nkaji e Yakobo, naitayiolo kewan ninche te ina kop e Misiri, ainosa apa olmumai teninche ajo, Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
Masaai: Ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keisudori te nchumata oldoinyo oji Karmel naa kaing'oru nanu ninche naitayu ninche; naa ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keisudori too nkonyek aainei aapuo abori enaiposha naa kairriwaa nanu olasurai ine metoonyo ninche.

English: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ng'ae otemenayie ina olong oo ntokitin kutiti naa keshipa, naa kedol ina temet te nkaina e Serubabel. Ore kuna naapishana naa nena onyek o Laitoriani, nena naapuo tiatua enkop pooki.

English: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo ng'aboli ninche, ‘Kalo nanu aing'uaa emeloni ai o lng'anayio ilai sidai nalo alimana too lkeek?’

English: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
Masaai: Nanu, Paulo oigero ena kirorokino te nkaina ai makewan. Entadamu ilpisia laainei. Metaa empiris te nebo intae.

English: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
Masaai: Nejoki Efron ening'ito olorere le ina kop, “Kake tenaa aikining', aatasayia inchooki matalaa iropiani olokeri, tang'amai elaata te nanu peyie atum atuturoi entang'atang'a ai te ine.”

English: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
Masaai: Neitoki aapuonu enetii ninye ilalashera lenyena pooki o nkanashera o lelo pooki apa ooyiolo ninye te dukuya, nenya ninche endaa tenebo ninye te nkaji enye; neing'urrie ninche ninye neitagol too ntorrok pooki apa naayaka Olaitoriani ninye; ore pooki lenye neisho ninye mpisai tenebo olpisiai le sahabu.

English: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo e moikuape neiteru olpolosie lenye te Yordan, neilep ilo polosie alo enkilepakinoto e Yeriko te nkalo e moikuape, neitoki ailep aim ina kop oo ldoinyo te nkalo o loo ntoluo; nelo aiting to lpurkel le Bet-hafen.

English: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
Masaai: Nelo ariku kulikae oiriruani oopishana torrok aalang ninye, nejing aatoni, neaku mbaa e ilo tung'ani torrok aalang enkiterata; neijia sii etiu te kulo tung'ana le na ishoi torrono.”

English: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
Masaai: tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki, o te nkishui ino pooki, o te nkidimata ino pooki.

English: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
Masaai: Ira iyie asipani, Olaitoriani, nesipa nkiguanat inono.

English: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
Masaai: kainyoo pee enyokioo ilkilani linono, neikununo ilkilani linono anaa ile, ilo olo aim eneironyieki isabibu?

English: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: Nipik lelo pisia aare le sahabu ooipila atua lelo giso ootii ile mowuarak le mbene o lgoo.

English: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche eikirikira anaa ntaritik naaing'uaa Misiri, o anaa nturkuluni eing'uaa enkop e Asiria; naa karriny nanu ninche meshomo inkang'itie enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ham naa Kushi o Misiri o Puti o Kanaan.

English: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
Masaai: Ore te ina kop oo ldoinyo, naa Shamir, Yatir, Soko,

English: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Kainyoo pee kintanyamal ailepunye nanu?” Newal Saul ajo, “Atii nanu atua osina sapuk, amu aaitirrishakitia nanu Ilfilisti aarare, naaibelekenye Enkai aing'uaa nemeekure aawaliki, aa too loibonok arashu te nkidetidet, neaku aaipoto iyie pee kiliki enaas.”

English: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, teyietu olkiyioi intorioki olaiguanani le Turo, nijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ira apa iyie enkitanyaanyukoto bayaroti, kibore apa eng'eno nagut, nitimitunye te nkishiaa.

English: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
Masaai: Kake ore intae, entonyor ilmang'ati linyi niaasiasa isupati; enchooi te sile misiligugu toki naitu; naa itumutumu enkishorunoto kitok; niaakuku nkera o lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki, amu ore ninye eing'urrie ilarruok o lemeeta enashe.

English: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
Masaai: Atoduaa ina siaai naishorua Enkai aisho nena kera e tung'ana metanyamaliki ninye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Irriwai iltung'ana meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan, naisho nanu iltung'ana loo Siraeli;

English: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
Masaai: Etii apa ilgululu oopurupurana ntomoni naaudo o ile mbat enye, ore lelo gululu oopurupurana naa iip nabo neikodokino te manarato.

English: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
Masaai: Neitobiraki apa nena kejek anaa nkejek oo ngarrin oo mbartan; ore nkeek enye o enkamanaa o ltidii o eneibungare, naa ino suyai.

English: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
Masaai: Eibung'aki iwuejitin neelang'ieki too lkejek netapejoki iwuejitin neeisudoriyieki te nkima neiputukunyo isikarini lo larrabal.

English: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
Masaai: Neilep apa olmalaika lo Laitoriani te Gilgal alo Bokim. Nejo ninye, “Ayaua apa nanu intae ailepunye te Misiri, nayau intae atua ina kop apa nainosa olmumai pee aisho loo papaai linyi. Atejo apa, ‘Magil ae kata olning'o lai o intae,

English: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
Masaai: Neitoki Naomi enkaputani enye ajoki ninye, “Entito ai, aimaaing'uraki nanu iyie ang, pee itum aitirring'ayu?

English: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Enkai aipang'aki Yakobo aigil, ina kata pee elotu aing'uaa Padan-aram, nemayian ninye.

English: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
Masaai: Ore te rishata o lorika le nkitoo ore ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, o tiatua ilpayiani, nadol olkuoo le ker eitashe, etiu anaa keteyiang'aki apa, neeta mowuarak naapishana o nkonyek naapishana, naa ninche nkiyang'eta naapishana e Nkai, naairriwayioki meshomo enkop pooki.

English: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
Masaai: Kuna inkarn oo layiok le Yakobo ooetuo apa Misiri te nebo ninye, oltung'ani ake o lmarei lenye:

English: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
Masaai: Kake etanang'a enkitok e Lot silig esujita ninye, neaku ninye eng'ape e Munyan.

English: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
Masaai: Iyie oipirua nkonyek oo nkariak o erat; iyie oitoyio nkonyek oo nkariak naaruko.

English: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
Masaai: Nenuk Ilfilisti nchorroi pooki te nterit apa naatuturo ilaisiaayiak le menye aa Abraham.

English: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Ninchopoki Aron ilkilani oosinya, nibukoki ninye eilata aput, nikinteng'elaki ninye, peyie aatum aisiaya anaa olapolosani.

English: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
Masaai: naatoduaa nanu ena sikiria, naaibelekenya apaash nanu kuna katitin pokira uni. Te neme kaaibelekenye ninye apaash, esipa, anaata aatara iyie tua napal ninye eishu.”

English: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
Masaai: Neosh ilo malaika le dukuya entarumpeta enye, neshau enchan oo soito o enkima, nashulare osarge; nedoiki enkop; nepejori ematua e uni e nkop, nepejori ematua e uni oo lkeek, nepejori nkujit pooki naanyori.

English: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
Masaai: Harim, o Meremot, o Obadia,

English: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
Masaai: Nebik apa ninche te Beersheba, o te Moloda, o te Hasar-shual,

English: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki neshipa, neyau kodi enye aaitadoiki ilo sanduku o metaba anaa neidipayu.

English: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
Masaai: Neitoki aitu neinepu eirurate, amu eiroshiutuo nkonyek oleng; nelau ninche enawaliki ninye.

English: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
Masaai: Neisho olpayian enkitok ina naaishiaakino; neiko sii ninye enkitok neijia olpayian lenye.

English: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
Masaai: Naa kaisalaash orreshet lai aitoipoki ninye, naa keyae ninye tiatua orreshet lai; naa kayau ninye Babilon ina natii enkop oo Lkaldayo, nemedol ake sii ninye; naa keye ninye te ine.

English: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
Masaai: olayioni le Simeon, olayioni le Yuda, olayioni le Yosef, olayioni le Yonam, olayioni le Eliakim,

English: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
Masaai: “Toning'o iyiook olkitok lai, ira iyie olkitok magilani tiatua iyiook. Tuturoi entang'atang'a ino te nkurare naba anaa enigelu too nkuraren ang', meetae hoo obo lang Likimitiki enkurare enye anaa kimitiki iturorie entang'atang'a ino.”

English: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.
Masaai: Entagoluoto naa mataa lewa to losho lang, o nkanas e Nkai ang; naa metaasa Olaitoriani ina naishiakino te ninye.”

English: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Yoash etua anaa loo menye, netonie Yeroboam olorika lenye le nkitoo; nenukari Yoash te Samaria tenebo ilaiguanak le Israel.

English: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
Masaai: Kaing'ae onyaanyukie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, natonita te shumata,

English: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
Masaai: Neaku etimira apa iltung'ana le Israel Midian, neitu ae kata eigil aairish ninche. Netum apa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam too nkolong'i e Gideon.

English: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
Masaai: Kake ore nkituaak inyi, o nkera inyi kutiti, o nkishu inyi (ayiolo nanu ajo iatata nkishu kumok) netoni ninche te nena anas naishoo nanu intae,

English: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atiaki ninche neijia, nebik te Galilaya.

English: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Masaai: Neitoki entukus oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Efraim adumunye too lturrurri lenye; ore olarikoni lenye naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud.

English: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani, eidipa olaiguanani Sedekia aitobira olning'o tenebo iltung'ana pooki tiatua Yerusalem pee eibalie elakunoto te ninche,

English: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
Masaai: Eewuo ele rorei enetii Yeremia oipirta iltung'ana pooki le Yuda, tiatua olari liong'uan le Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda (ilo apa olari le dukuya le Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon),

English: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ina umata pooki aajo etua Aron neishiraki enkaji pooki e Israel Aron nkolong'i tomoni uni.

English: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o Siraeli pooki neshipa te dukuya Enkai te nkidimata enye pooki, to sinkolio, o to lwulul loo usin, o too nkai oo sinkolioitin, o too ndulen o too nkinantani dapashi o too ntarumpetani.

English: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
Masaai: Enyor apa neitu ishipakino ina olong o lalashe lino te ina olong apa natijing'a ninye olbuket; enyor apa neitu ing'idakino ina olong e lelo tung'ana le Yuda, te ina olong e nkidaata enye; enyor apa neitu iwuasayu te ina olong o sina.

English: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
Masaai: Ore einosaa lomon eiguana pokira aare, neinepu Yesu openy airiamariyie ninche.

English: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
Masaai: Nejoki Yonatan Daudi, “Wou, maipang'a aapuo ong'ota.” Neaku eipang'a pokira oare aapuo ong'ota.

English: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
Masaai: naajoki naa iyie, “Nchoo olayioni lai elo pee aatum aisiaayia nanu.” Ti nimitiki ninye elo naar nanu ilo kikau lino metua.’ ”

English: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
Masaai: o Yetur o Nafish o Kedema. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ishmael.

English: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki le Israel apa ootii atua oerata aajo eilanyishe enjore, netua sii Saul o layiok lenyena, neing'uaa ninche nkang'itie enye, neisik; nepuonu Ilfilisti aamany ninche.

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Dameski, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; Amu eironya ninche Gilead too nkironyeta e sekenkei.

English: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
Masaai: Naa tenaa olapa obo embotoro oltung'ani neilep o metabaiki ilarin imiet ore entemata ino to lee naa keaku shekeli imiet e nkosholai, ore te ng'oruoi naa keaku shekeli uni e nkosholai.

English: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
Masaai: Naitoki adol olmalaika eitashe ti atua enkolong. Nebuaku aipotisho to ltoilo sapuk aipot imotonyi pooki naapuoto te mpolos o loing'ang'e, nejoki, “Wootu enturrurrunye osirua kitok le Enkai,

English: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.
Masaai: Ore ntukusi inyi are naapuonu enkisiaayiare te nkolong e sabato, nerrip enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
Masaai: Entoomonoki iyiook, amu king'idare ena nchere mikiaata ileeni ti atua iltauja lang, eikiyieu nikiaasisho to rrekie sidai too mbaa pooki.

English: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
Masaai: Neiki ninye enkayioni, nejo ninye enkarna enye Gershom, amu etejo ninye, “Ara olomoni te nkop neme enaai.”

English: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa kaaya nanu iyie, Serubabel osinka lai, olayioni le Shealtiel, ejo Olaitoriani naaitotiu nanu iyie anaa olgisoi oata olmishire; amu aategelua nanu iyie, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.”

English: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: pee edung'oki ninche enkiguana naigero! Enkitoo ena te lelo pooki lenyena supati. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.
Masaai: Neyau ninche nena masaa e sahabu o nenkosholai apa naaitayioki ti atua enkaji e Nkai, te ina aji e Nkai te Yerusalem. Neokishore olaiguanani ninche, o lkituaak lenyena, o nkituaak enyena o nkapiak enyena.

English: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
Masaai: Olaigeroni apa ninye arriyia too nkitanapat e Musa, apa naaishorua Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, neisho olaiguanani ninye nena pooki naatoomonuo, amu etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai enye shumata ninye.

English: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
Masaai: “Keeta enchan papaai lenye, naa aing'ae ilo oitobirua ilkitong'at le nkoileelio?

English: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie agiroo alo o meshomo moikuape o segel le Bet-hogla; nelo ilo polosie aiting te moikuape olomanaa le Enaiposha e Munyan, te kopikop e Yordan; ele ninye olpolosie le kopikop.

English: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
Masaai: Toning'o ena, na aji e Yakobo, intae ilooipotieki e nkarna e Israel, lelo oora ile ishoi e Yuda; ooinos olmumai te nkarna o Laitoriani, nelimu aaibalunye Enkai e Israel, kake mme te sipata neme te nkitorioroto.

English: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
Masaai: Nejo Paulo, “Enkaraki naa ai mayiolo lalashera laainei, ajo ninye olapolosani kitok, amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Mijo ake ine nkarrueisho ti alo oloitore olorere linyi.’ ”

English: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
Masaai: Nesipayu katukul ina kata nchere idumu enkomom ino metii entioto; iyaku oloserian, nimiureishoyu.

English: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?
Masaai: Ore pee elotu ninye ataaniki ina ululu natii Daniel neyietu aishir to ltoilo lo sina nejoki Daniel, “Oo Daniel, osinka le Nkai naishu, eikindima duoo Enkai ino ina nisiaai anaake atokordu too lng'atunyo?”

English: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
Masaai: Naa ore ina nalo atiu too ltung'ana, naa neijia etiu to lapolosani; ore enatiu to rrindik, neijia etiu to lkitok lenye; ore enatiu te nkaisiaayiani, neijia etiu te ina naigero ninye; ore enatiu te ilo oinyang'isho, neijia etiu te ilo omirisho; ore enatiu te ilo oisilenisho neijia etiu te ilo oisilenokini; ore enatiu te ilo oishooyo esile, neijia etiu te ilo oisilenokini.

English: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
Masaai: Naa te neyioloi aajo etamoo oshi ilo kiteng earisho neitu eing'or olopeny, nelak ninye olkiteng to lkiteng neaku ina ng'ues natua enenye.

English: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Israel, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Ayaua nanu Israel ailepunye aitung'uaa Misiri, nalaku nanu intae aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lmisiri naitung'ua enkaina oo nkitoriat apa pooki naaisomita intae.’

English: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Masaai: enchoo enashe te pooki pukunoto, amu ena doi eyieunoto e Enkai te intae ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Kalo pasa abarani ilo supat naa ng'en otung'eikia olopeny enkaji, meitotio lootii too rishat enye?

English: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
Masaai: Neyieu Yohana neany eibatisa, nejoki, “Keishiaakino naa iyie likimbatisa nanu, pa nilotu iyie enatii?”

English: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
Masaai: “Naa kelo ena aaku olmonekie te iyie: ore tele ari inosa pooki toki nabulu openy. Ore to lari li are inosa ina nabulu aikununye neijia; ore to lari li okuni tuunisho, nisampisho, niun isabibu, ninos ilng'anayio lenye.

English: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
Masaai: indim sii te lelo omon likindurrakita iyie o te lelo mareita lenye ootii tenebo iyie, te lelo ootoiwuoki tiatua enkop ino; neaku ninche imasaa inono.

English: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
Masaai: o layiok le Asna, o layiok le Meumin, o layiok le Nefisim,

English: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?
Masaai: Kebaa na eikash tenaa keinosa iltung'ana ena olong nena yarunot oo lmang'ati lenye naaineputua ninche. Amu ore taata earata olalem too Lfilisti neme kitok.

English: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
Masaai: Etoduaa ninye ajo metii oltung'ani, neing'asia pee edol ajo meetae oltung'ani omitu ilo oitorogonyitae, neaku enkaina enye kewan nayaka ninye enkisulata, ore esipata enye neitasheyie ninye.

English: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
Masaai: Keitu doi ninye alo Yerusalem enetii lelo apa oora lkipaareta eitu aaku nanu. A'a, Arabia atang'asa alo naitoki ashukunye alotu Dameski.

English: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eikenari ile Lawi aaitusuj iloshon loo loomenye te nebo ninche.

English: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
Masaai: Nelotu Yesero, olaputani le Musa, o layiok lenyena o enkitok enye enetii Musa to lpurkel te ine apa netipika ilng'oborri to ldoinyo.

English: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
Masaai: Ore teina kurma nedung'uni ewueji nerisioro inkaloli pooki oo ntemat enkaina iip imiet naaku ine wueji sinyati neeta intemat onom enkaina e wueji nemetii toki namanita ninye.

English: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Masaai: Neme kulie kiyang'eta o loing'ang'e, aashu naatii olodo le nkop, neme hoo ae toki natii enkop o loing'ang'e pooki naidim atirishie iyiook enyorrata e Nkai natii Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oile, nedoiki Hanania, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Mahali naa: Eliesa ilo apa lemeeta ilayiok.

English: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
Masaai: Nejoki ina kitok, “Kintajewuo enkirukoto ino; shomo te seriani!”

English: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
Masaai: “Ilo ninye oitayio enkop te ngolon enye, laa ninye oitobira enkop te ng'eno enye nagut, ore te yiolounoto enye neitorioo shumata.

English: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
Masaai: aashu “Ae ng'ae odoyio alo olodo le nkop?” eji, ailepunye Kristo too lootuata.

English: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
Masaai: “Kaing'ae ninye elo aiteng'en aitaarriyian, naa kaing'ae elo ninye ainosaki ilo kilikuai? Lelo ooereki, lelo lemeekure enakita?

English: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ai: “Taa olchekut le nena tare naapuoi aayieng.

English: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani, nemeetae likae, meetae ae Ai neme nanu; aarripito nanu hoo nimikiyiolo iyie nanu,

English: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
Masaai: Etaasa ine ngolon te nkaina enye; neisardakie iloowuasa o nkiguanat oo ltauja lenye.

English: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yater: Yefune o Pispa o Ara.

English: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Oo Daniel lo tung'ani onyorri oleng, toning'o kulo rorei laajoki nanu, nintashe too nkejek amu ore taata aairriwuaki nanu enitii.” Ore ina kata aaliki ninye ele rorei, naitashe nanu aikirikira.

English: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
Masaai: Keyieng'i olkiteng lino te dukuya inkonyek inono, niminos iyie nkiri enyena; ore osikiria neisimari aaya te dukuya enkomom ino, nimikirrinyokini iyie; ore nkerra inono neishori ilmang'ati linono, nemetii hoo obo likiretu iyie.

English: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
Masaai: “Neaku ore ake pee eidak lelo tung'ana pooki to larrabal neye ninche tiatua olorere,

English: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
Masaai: Aikiyieu sa iyiook nikintagor nikipik Olaitoriani olom? Aiyiook oogol te ninye?

English: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
Masaai: Metaa eidipaki keper o enkop o lorora pooki lenye.

English: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
Masaai: Ore amu etoning'o Abraham oltoilo lai, neibung enkikoo ai, o nkitanapat aainei pooki.”

English: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
Masaai: Neitayuo apa Yoshua olarrabal te nkata naado o lelo aiguanak pooki.

English: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Haman ajo eitu eirrugo Mordekai arashu eitodolu enkanyit negoro oleng.

English: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Ore Olaitoriani lalo te dukuya ninye naa keirriu olmalaika lenye tenebo iyie neitumunyan enkoitoi ino, nirikoki enkitok olayioni lai too ltung'ana lang le nkaji e papa.

English: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
Masaai: Ore naa taata ina ano o shairi, o eilata o enaisho oo sabibu, naa ninche eimaka olkitok lai, nchoo ninye meirriwaki isinkan linono;

English: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aatoomono nchoo olaiguanani eipot Olaitoriani Enkai ino, paa ore ilo oitalaku elap to sarge nemeitoki ae kata asesekuanisho, ore olayioni lai nemeari metua.” Nejo ninye, “Anaaenaishu Olaitoriani, medoiki ninye olpapita obo lo layioni lino enkop.”

English: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
Masaai: Neshei te ina kata te nebo ninye ilapurrok aare, obo te nkaina e tatene, o likae te nkaina e kedienye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa too nkisiajat e Moab, te mbata o lkeyu le Yordan, etalita Yeriko,

English: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
Masaai: Neilepilep aaigil aajo, “Tasho ninye.”

English: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
Masaai: Negil ninche ilperereni loo lasarri le Baal eitasheiki ninye. Neuroo ilperereni loo lasarri le nkorropil apa ootii shumata ninche. Nebel asherim aitaa mbelibelat, o nena kitanyaanyukot naaguetuno o naasholuno. Neitaa empunyua neisuaaki nkuraren e lelo apa ooitayu ilasarri too nchumat enye.

English: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
Masaai: Neirriwaki taa nkanashera olkilikuai ejo, “Lo Kitok, ng'urai, emuei oloshi linyor.”

English: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Yesu, “Emimitiki, amu meetae hoo oloas embae sapuk te nkarna ai, laa ore aa enaidipie ina, naaitoki aidim atusukenya.

English: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
Masaai: Etiakita ninche ninche, “Mikiindim iyiook aataas ena bae, aaisho enkanashe ang oltung'ani lememurata, amu keaku ina esulare te iyiook.

English: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
Masaai: Najoki nanu kewan, “Wou taata, ekatem esidano o lkar; ntumurru, ndipakinoyu.” Kake ng'ura, ore sii ninye apa ena naa ene pesho.

English: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
Masaai: Etijing'a ninche olkirutoto kitok, olkirutoto leitu ae kata etumi! Amu keidapash Enkai iloik le lelo lemeure Enkai, keitukurruni ninche, amu etanya Enkai ninche.

English: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
Masaai: Ekelepori nkaik e pooki ng'ae, neshalu nkung enye anaa enkare.

English: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Neyau lelo o yarunot o masaa naaruno enetii Musa, o Eliesa ilo apolosani, o ina umata oo ltung'ana le Israel, te lelo ng'oborri ootii enkisiajata e Moab te mbata o lkeju le Yordan te netaaniki Yeriko.

English: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
Masaai: Kake kemanyi Yuda ntarasi nememanyi Yerusalem too iishoritin pooki.

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, o lkuo obo le ker sitima le ker lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar opejori;

English: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
Masaai: Ore ilala linono neibor anaa isupeni e kerra naabarno, nena naaetuo eing'uaa enkisujata, neeta pooki ilmao, nemeetae hoo nabo natua olkuoo.

English: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Ae ng'ae naatoshoroyie?” Neitolilo olorere, nejoki Petero, “Lo Kitok, kironyita olorere likinturrurrokinote!”

English: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kadumaki nanu intae olosho, lo tung'ana le Israel,” Olaitoriani ojo, Enkai oo lororani; naa keibooki ninche intae enkop ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat o metabaiki Ereyiet e Araba.”

English: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
Masaai: Newaliki Baruk ninche, “Aatolikio ninye nanu kulo rorei pooki, ina kata apa aigerito nanu ninche to ranki to lpiyayati.”

English: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
Masaai: Neaku intaasa osinka lino te supatisho, amu iyaua osinka lino atua olmumai osinya lo sotua te nebo iyie. Kake te netii entorroni atua nanu, taaraki iyie nanu; amu kainyoo paa papaai lino kiyaki?”

English: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
Masaai: Ashomo apa nanu auluo kewarie aim kishomi enkalo o Erata nalo olchorro loo mbariak, o kishomi e Modioi. Naing'or nanu asipu isunta e Yerusalem apa naaturori, tenebo o nchomito enyena apa naatumuta e nkima.

English: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:
Masaai: Neiguanakini Abna te nebo ilpayiani le Israel, ejo, “Ore te nkata naje natulusoyie ning'oruru intae Daudi aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata intae.

English: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
Masaai: Atiaaka sii apa iltung'ana, “Nchoo pooki tung'ani o sinka lenye eirrag Yerusalem, pee etum aatorrip iyiook kewarie, neidim aataasisho dama.”

English: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee emoruau Samuel neitaa ilayiok lenyena ilarishak te Israel.

English: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
Masaai: Ore ilo oro naa olaiguanani loo Lyunani; ore ina mouo kitok natii erishata oo nkonyek enyena naa ilo aiguanani oituruku.

English: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Hesekia ina palai too nkaik e lelo kiliku, neisuma; neilep Hesekia alo enkaji o Laitoriani, neisalaash ina palai te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
Masaai: “Ore pee kirrinyo enetii osinka lino, aa papa, nikiliki irorei lo lkitok lang.

English: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
Masaai: Neinosi ina olong ake nintarasaitie, aashu taisere, ore pooki toki naleku ometaa enkolong e uni nepuoi aapejoo te nkima.

Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Kaa oitoi iyiook kipuo aaim?” Newal Yehoram ajo, “Enkoitoi e ong'ata e Edom.”

English: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki Lfarisayo o lasirak ilooiteng'eni lenyena ajo, “Oo pee ing'arierie endaa niokishosho te nebo iloosotu kodi o laing'okok?”

Masaai: Kake ore nabo kata netii enkitok, naibung'a entito enye kiti oloirirua oiduruk, nening ajo etii ine, nelotu, nebatata too nkejek enyena aserem.

Masaai: Ore taa ina kata, nebolo nkonyek aainei neinining nkiyiaa aainei enkomono naomoni tene wueji.

English: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
Masaai: newaliki Yohana ninche pooki ajoki, “Esipa aibatisa nanu intae te nkare, kake kelotu ologol te nanu lemeishiaakino nalak enkeene e namuke enye. Ilo oibatisa intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o te nkima;

English: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
Masaai: Naa ore hoo neisho intae Olaitoriani endaa e nyamali o enkare o sina, meigil Olaiteng'enani linyi aisudoo kewan, kake kedol nkonyek inyi Olaiteng'enani linyi.

English: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Yakobo Sukot, neshetaki kewan enkaji neitayu ninye ilngoborri loo nkishu enyena, metaa keji enkarna e ine wueji Sukot!

English: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
Masaai: Neriku ilo turrur lelo aarikoki Lkipaareta; ore pee eomon, neiteleikini nkaik.

English: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Kake ore nchere epiu ilootuata, ketuutua ninye Musa, te ine neigerore mbaa osanag teine neipotie ninye Olaitoriani ajo Enkai e Abraham naa Enkai e Isaak, naa Enkai e Yakobo.

English: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
Masaai: Mintemoo iyie enkitarruorroto enye, nimincho metujuti eng'oki enye metujuti aaiwuang'ie too nkonyek inono. Amu kintagoro ninche iyie te dukuya ilashetak.”

English: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
Masaai: Ore pee kitum emeli nalang alo Foenike, nikiked aapuo.

English: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye ilayiok tomoni uni ooked isirkon tomoni uni; neeta apa ninche nkanas tomoni uni, naaji Hoyot-yair o metabaiki ena olong, apa naatii enkop e Gilead.

English: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Heserot, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Ritma.

English: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
Masaai: Netii apa osinka le nkaji e Saul oji Siba, neipotu ninche ninye enetii Daudi; nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Ira iyie Siba?” Nejo ninye, “Ore osinka lino naa ninye ilo.”

English: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
Masaai: Amaa te neishop Enkai inkujit e ong'ata aiko neijia, naatai taata neyookini aanang'aki enkima taaisere, ai meitulusoo oleng aishop intae, lo tung'ana ooti enkirukoto?

English: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
Masaai: kake ore lelo ooisampu ninche ooinos neisis Enkai, ore lelo oosotu ilng'anayio ninche ook ti atua ilgorien le nkaji ai.”

English: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani (amu ore apa osanduku lo sotua le Nkai naa ine apa etii te nena olong'i,

English: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
Masaai: Kake mme taa doi keetae enaturua ororei le Nkai. Amu mme Siraeli ate lelo pooki le ishoi e Siraeli,

English: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
Masaai: Netii ina kata oltung'ani obo yioloti te nkarruisho oena oji Barabas.

English: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
Masaai: Ore sii Balaam, olayioni le Beor, ilo asakutoni, near iltung'ana le Israel ninye metua to lalem te nebo lelo apa lenye ootasesekuanaki.

English: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
Masaai: anaa olasar le ntapa neitayu e efa tenebo oloing'oni tenebo e efa tenebo olmeregesh, tenebo olkuoo le kerra anaa enaidim aitayu, tenebo hini e ilata te pooki efa.

English: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilapaitin tomon o are neloito ninye te nchumata e nkaji e nkitoo e Babilon,

English: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
Masaai: Neaku te nemayiolo enejo ina kutuk, naaku nanu oleeiking'a te ina kutuk, neaku sii ninye olomoni te nanu.

English: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
Masaai: Ashukoki oshi ake Enkai ai enashe te nkaraki intae. Ashukoki ninye enashe te mpiris enye naishooki intae ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nepik Saul lelo tung'ana ilturrurri okuni; nepuonu ninche atua empolos oo lng'oborri tadekenya enasirie, nedung lelo Amoni o meipira enkolong; ore lelo ooimishote neidapasha, o metaba anaa neaku meetae ninye oare lenye ootoni te nebo.

English: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu ina kitok e Tekoa enetii olaiguanani, nebatata te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, nesai, nejo, “Taretuoki, Olaiguanani.”

English: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
Masaai: Mikintawang'aki Olaitoriani enkomom enye, niking'urrie:

English: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
Masaai: kake tenebo sii ilo lemetii ene tenebo iyiook ena olong tenebo ilo oitashe tenebo iyiook ena olong te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
Masaai: ilo laa ninye ake openy oisalaash keper, neroruaa apurd ilopir le naiposha;

English: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Amu elelek te ntames pee eim enaudoto o ltidu alang oltung'ani karsis te nejing enkitoria e Nkai.”

English: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
Masaai: Nkera aainei kutiti, aigeroki intae, amu, etapalakaki intae ng'ok inyi te nkaraki ninye.

English: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
Masaai: Neitanap Yesu ninye pee meliki likae tung'ani; nejoki, “Kake inyo, intoduaai kewan mikitisipu olapolosani ninchooyo olasar le nkishiunoto naaitanapishe Musa pee eitadedeyie ina sikata ino te ninche.”

English: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
Masaai: neetae enkata e nyorrata, neetae enkata e nkiba; neetae enkata o larrabal, neetae enkata e seriani.

English: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani eimunye lelo sinkan lenyena, lelo oibonok le Nkai,

English: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
Masaai: Nikintoki iyiook aadumunye to lkeju le Ahafa te nkolong e tomon oare o lapa le dukuya, aapuo Yerusalem. Netii enkaina e Nkai ang shumata iyiook, nekordu ninye iyiook te nkaina o lmang'atinta lang o too rresheta te nkoitoi.

English: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
Masaai: Nejo Lea, “Atumunyana!” metaa eishoo enkarna enye ajo Gad.

English: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki taata naatushumakaki nanu emaupe e nkitoo e supatisho, naa Olaitoriani, ilo arishani asipani laayooki aisho, te ina olong, neme nanu ake eishori, kake keishori sii lelo ootonyorra enkata naliooyu ninye.

English: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
Masaai: Enapa nataasishore ti atua Kristo pee eitopiu aitung'uaa enkeeya neisho metotona te nkaina enye e tatene too wuejitin e shumata.

English: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
