Masaai: Neitoki Yona aipang alo auluo enkanasa neton te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e ina anasa neitobiraki kewan olng'obor te ine. Neton ninye ti abori oloip o metaba anaa nedol enapukoki ina anasa.

English: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
Masaai: Naa te neewuo te rripore e are, aashu te ne uni, neinepu etiu neijia, nemayian ake lelo aisiaayiak!

English: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
Masaai: Neing'unyung'uny ninche too lng'oborri lenye, neitu ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani.

English: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua lelo tung'ana pooki, “Ng'ura, ore ele soit naa keaku shakenisho ti alo iyiook; amu etoning'o ninye irorei pooki lo Laitoriani ootiaka ninye iyiook; metaa keaku shakeni ti alo intae, pee mintaasiasa ake entorroni Enkai inyi.”

English: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
Masaai: Amu keyookini aaitalak oloas intorrok nena torrok naataasa, nemeetae enyorrakinoto.

English: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tikitam nedoiki Eliata, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
Masaai: Te naidim ninye ataarare nanu naar nanu matua, nikiaku iyiook isinkan linyi; kake te naisulu nanu te ninye naar ninye metua, niakuku intae isinkan lang, nisiaayiayia iyiook.”

English: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, atang'amua nanu enkitanapata pee amayianisho; etamayianishe ninye, nemalak nanu.

English: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
Masaai: Entang'amu naa ti atua Olaitoriani te nchipai pooki niyanyititi iltung'ana ootiu inji.

English: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
Masaai: Ore nena anas ninchooyoyo naa nena anas inyi ile naasaruni.

English: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
Masaai: o metabaiki pooki naboisho naimu enkirukoto o eyiolounoto e ilo Inoti le Nkai, nikiaku iltung'ana ootubulutua aamitunye, aabaiki entemet e mbotoro nalulung'a e Kristo;

English: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
Masaai: Naa ore tiatua ina pooki nitii entipik enkinyang'a e lakunoto.

English: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
Masaai: Embata enye etipika ntaritik emanyisho enye; neranyisho ninche ti atua ilng'osil lenyena.

English: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
Masaai: Ore ilo laany nanu, nemeng'amu irorei laainei, neeta oloiguanare. Ilo rorei lairoro oiguanare ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto;

English: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
Masaai: Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare ilo odung'oro li oriong, neeta apa iltuka too ng'apeta enyena, obo ake te pooki shoto; ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.

English: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
Masaai: Intae ilalashera kintanap taata te nkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo inchere entalam olalashe pooki oton te nturuaisho lemesuj ilo kerreti litang'amutua te iyiook.

English: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilamori neluakino olarrabal etanapate te nejing'ieki enkanasa, ore lelo aiguanak apa ooetuo netii ninche iwuejitin enye maate te wueji neisiaja.

English: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
Masaai: Idumumu ate nipuonunu aaing'uaa ewueji inyi aaing'uaa nenen wuejitin neelakua e moikuape, ntae tenebo olorora loo ltung'ana kumok tenebo iyie, ekedito ninche pooki mbartan enye, o lorora kitok, enjore sapuk;

English: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
Masaai: O lpisia oare le sahabu nasila, ooirina anaa empito nipik nimbung'ie ina sahabu naikodore enkila.

English: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
Masaai: Neaku ketumo ninche anaa ake te nkiteng'enare oo lkipaareta, neshulare aaisiritore, neng'arie endaa, neshulare te nkomono.

English: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
Masaai: Mintaa olchore oltung'ani oman nang'u, aashu iriamariyie oltung'ani osioki agoro.

English: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
Masaai: Entadamu ena nchere ore ilo oun te nkutisho nesotu te nkutisho, ore ilo oun te nkumoi nesotu sii te nkumoi.

English: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.
Masaai: Neaku etii apa Olaitoriani tenebo Yoshua; ore olning'o lenye neibulu enkop pooki.

English: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore naa te kuna pisai ilo iyie ainyiang'u iloing'ok, o lmeregeshi, o lkuo le kerra, tenebo ilasarri lenye le ntapa, o lasarri lenye ooki, nilo aishooyo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar le nkaji e Nkai ino natii Yerusalem.

English: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
Masaai: Enkerai ai turia Olaitoriani o laiguanani, nimigolong'aki hoo obo lenye.

English: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
Masaai: Eisikong ninye enaiposha neitoi, eitoi ninye ilkejek pooki neitoi Bashan o Karmel, ore ina kishiaa e sikar e Lebanon netoyu.

English: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
Masaai: “Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Laodikea, ingeroki, ‘Irorei le ilo oji Esai, Oloisiligayu naa olchakeni osipa, naa ninye enkiterunoto e nkitobirata naitobira Enkai seuseu.

English: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook iltung'ana le rrindikisho; ore ake eyia eitu eiturraa iyiook Enkai ang te rrindikisho ang. Kake eitabaikia iyiook enyorrata enye nauno, te dukuya le Parsia pee eisho iyiook enkiti kiyagata maitasheyie enkaji e Nkai ang, nikiram iwuejitinneeidaaitie, neisho iyiook emitunoto te Yudea o te Yerusalem.

English: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
Masaai: Amu etipika apa Yuda Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda ninye korokoroni, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee imbonisho nijo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kaishooyo nanu ena anasa apik nkaik o laiguanani le Babilon, naa keya ninye.

English: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
Masaai: Kaaitaiki nanu iyie olasar opejori loo ntokitin naapir, te nebo empuruo o lasar loo lkerra; kaitobir nanu olasar loo loing'ok o nkineji.

English: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
Masaai: Etoduaa ajo ore eneyeng'iyeng'areki naa aisidai, naa ekeitishipisho enkop, metaa eirruguo oloililae lenye anap, neaku orrindik te siaai naarakini.

English: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: “Aatiaka ninye nanu, Iwa iyie te nkaina ai ena kikompe e naisho e ngoro, nincho nena kuapi pooki naairriwaki iyie metooko.

English: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
Masaai: Kake mikiwuasa iyiook aaitulus inaairirikino iyiook. Neidipa Enkai makewan aishoru nena kiririkinot, nebaiki sii intae.

English: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
Masaai: o Elusai, o Yerimot, o Bealia, o Shemaria, o Shefatia, le Harufi,

English: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
Masaai: Nelo Yudas Iskariot laa obo le lelo tomon o aare enetii ilapolosak kituaak pee etum atakaldai ninye te ninche.

English: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore teneitokini aaun kebulaa ninye? Aimetoyu katukul teneosh enkijape oo loo saen ninye, netoyu teine netuunieki ninye?”

English: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
Masaai: Ore teneibelekenya osupat aing'uaa esipata enye makewan, neas enkarruoisho, naa keye ninye te nkaraki ina.

English: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Uria, “Tadoi shomo enkaji ino, pee intuku nkejek inono.” Neipang Uria alo te nkaji o laiguanani, nesujaa ninye enkishooroto naing'uaa olaiguanani.

English: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
Masaai: Enchoru nkanas uni te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, o nkanas uni te nkop e Kanaan naaku nkanas naasaruni.

English: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
Masaai: Newaliki Ilhiti Abraham aajoki,

English: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
Masaai: Pee etumi atokordu ilo lino linyor, nchoru enkisulata te nkaina ino e tatene, niwaliki iyiook!

English: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:
Masaai: Nejoki Agripa Paulo, “Kinchoro iroro te kewan ino.” Neitorioo Paulo enkaina neiteru airishisho nejo:

English: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Shetani, “Ng'ura, ore pooki naata ninye etii atua engolon ino; ninye ake enkorrok enye mintorioki enkaina ino.” Neaku eshomo Shetani aing'uaa ine netii Olaitoriani.

English: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
Masaai: “Airorie intae too nkitanyaanyukot te kuna baa. Kelotu enkata nemaitoki airorie intae too nkitanyaanyukot, kake kaibalakinye intae aliki imbaa e Papa.

English: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
Masaai: Tukurru iyie Sidon, amu eiroro enaiposha, ine nerripieki enaiposha ejo, “Eitu nanu atum emion e saisai neitu aisho, neitu nanu aitubulu layiok aashu ntoyie.”

English: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
Masaai: o Ifdeia o Penuel, naa ilayiok le Shashak.

English: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
Masaai: Ore epuoito ninche aaim oerata le Baka, neitotiu ninche ine anaa nkonyek oo nkariak; ore ilkisirat le dukuya le nchan neiput ine ilchorroi.

English: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
Masaai: Amu ore enkata pooki ninosinoso ena mukate niokioko ena kikompe, naa nkeeya o Laitoriani ilikioo, o meeu.

English: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
Masaai: Neshumu nkonyek nejo, “Kadol iltung'ana; kake etiu anaa lkeek, epuoito.”

English: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eyau ene ematua oo sinkir limbung'a te na kata.”

English: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Menoto ilalashera eseriani o enyorrata te nebo enkirukoto naing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
Masaai: Ketaa ate kinteru aaitadaraa aaigil? Eikiaatayie iyiook tipat, enaatayie kulikae, eikiaatayie tipat mpala naarrepakini iyiook intae aashu nirrepiepie intae iyiook?

English: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
Masaai: Neimaki olng'ejep lai ina retoto ino e supatisho, endama pooki, amu eitukurruaki ninche nesuli, lelo apa ooing'oru pee aainyal.

English: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Musa, “Ilepu wou enetii Olaitoriani, iyie o Aron, o Nadabu, o Abihu o lpayiani ntomoni naapishana loo Siraeli, enteserem te nelakua.

English: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naapishana enchoo metaa metumi enkisuijo too nkajijik inyi; amu te nenya oltung'ani emukate naisuijo, nekepari ilo tung'ani aitung'uaa olturrur loo Siraeli, enyor naa oldokunoti arashu oino teina kop.

English: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
Masaai: Neishakenoki Yohana ninye nebuak ajo, “Ele taa atolimuo ajo, ‘Ore ololotu te siadi nanu ninye oituruk te nanu, amu etii apa ninye te dukuya nanu.’ ”

English: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
Masaai: ilo ojo, ‘Kashetaki nanu kewan enkaji sapuk tenebo inkajijik e shumata naalala’ naguetaki ilusien ninye neikod ninye too ltarakua, nael toranki onyokie.

English: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
Masaai: Eeta olchutai intoyie are, naaishir aajo: “Nchooki, nchooki.” Eetae intokitin uni nemeitaraposhoyu aekata, ong'uan nemejo aekata, “Ataraposhe.”

English: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.
Masaai: Neitu eing'uaa Daudi olee arashu enkitok eishu, pee etum ayau olomoni Gas, ejo, “Pee melikioo ake ninche iyiook, nejo, ‘Ena etaasa Daudi.’ ” Ele apa olkuaak lenye ina kata pooki apa ebikito te nkop oo Lfilisti.

English: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
Masaai: Milo iyie aing'uaa ene, aatoomono, o metaba anaa nalotu nanu enitii, pee ayau enkishoroto ai, nairragie te dukuya iyie.” Nejo ninye, “Katon nanu o metaba anaa nishukunye.”

English: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
Masaai: Entirring'ata entoning'oki nanu na kuapi, kuna o lmanie le naiposha; nchoo iltung'ana eitang'ejuk engolon enye; nchoo ninche enyiku, netum taa aairoro; maigutu pooki te nebo aanyikaki enkiguana.

English: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ilkuti tung'ana ake le Asheri o le Manase o le Sebulon ooitoborruote nepuonu Yerusalem.

English: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
Masaai: Isudoi enkomom ino too ng'ok aainei, nijutoo ntorrok aainei pooki.

English: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
Masaai: Neinyototo Sakayo nejoki Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, Olaitoriani, aitorit aor imasaa aainei naisho laisinak naa te neetae hoo oltung'ani latooruo toki enye, te nkeleekisho, nalaaki katitin ong'uan.”

English: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Masaai: Entaranyaki ninye, entaranyaki ninye enkisisa, embalunye nkiaasin enyena pooki e nking'asia.

English: For it is the day of the LORD'S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
Masaai: Amu eeta Olaitoriani enkolong e lap, ina olong nalo aitalaku elap te nkaraki Sion.

English: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
Masaai: Ore naa enaituruk, aitirrish, esayiata o enkomono o eomonokinoto e enkishooroto e nashe metaasi too ltung'ana pooki,

English: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
Masaai: Metobikoi ninye eishu, nchoo meyakini ninye sahabu e Sheba! Nchoo metoomonokini ninye anaake, meetu imayianat shumata ninye nkatitin pooki!

English: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
Masaai: Naigeroki intae iloo papa amu, iyiololo ilo otii apake te nkiterunoto. Naigeroki intae lo murran, amu itimira ilo torrono. Naigeroki intae, nakera, amu iyiololo Papa.

English: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters' clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
Masaai: Naa ore anaa enitoduaa ndapi enyena oo nkejek o lkimojik aa esarng'ab, o laitobirani eshula o esekenkei keaku enkitoria naoro; kake ore embata ndapai e sekenkei keaku ketii atua ninye, anaa ake enitoduaa esekenkei eshula o enterit.

English: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo o Sadukayo enetii aatem eyieu neitodol olmonekie ooing'uaa shumata.

English: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
Masaai: Ore apa enkop e Tapua naa ene Manase, kake ore enkang e Tapua apa natii olpolosie le Manase naa enoo layiok le Efraim.

English: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
Masaai: Neiturrurru Laban iltung'ana pooki leine, neitayu osirua

English: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
Masaai: “Naa kebatata ile Asiria to lalem, leme olayioni le tung'ani; ore ilo alem leme olayioni le tung'ani neinos ninye; naa kelo ninye ailany ilo alem, ore elelero enye nepuoi aapik esinkaisho.

English: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaitobir ilgiso aare le sahabu, nepik ninche ilcholo pokira aare le ina kila o lgoo te nkalo enye e atua te mbata e ina kila dorrop.

English: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
Masaai: Neipotuni apa iltung'ana le Efraim metanapata, nelang ninche aapuo Sapon nejoki Yepta, “Kainyoo iyie pee italang'a alo aarare Ilamoni, neitu impotu iyiook pee kipuo te nebo iyie? Eikipejoo iyiook enkaji ino itii atua te nkima.”

English: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku enetii Abimelek te Aruma, ejo, “Ng'ura, ore Gaal olayioni le Ebed o lalashera lenyena eetuo Shekem, neingolingola ninche enkanasa pee kiarare iyie.

English: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oikenayioki te nkikenare neishoru ena: olpisiai loo mpisai naaji shekeli te risioroto e shekeli eine wueji sinyati. Neitayu olpisiai le shekeli anaa olasar to Laitoriani.

English: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
Masaai: Naa enchomie enyorrata, anaa enatonyorra iyiook Kristo neishooyo kewan to lbae lang, neaku enkishooroto o lasar orropil oishooki Enkai.

English: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
Masaai: Nerik Balak Balaam enchumata o ldoinyo le Peor ine netalita olpurkel.

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Ena esiaai e Nkai, pee irukuruku ilo oirriwua ninye.”

English: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
Masaai: nilo iyie aye teilo doinyo liked enchumata, nikinturrurrokini iltung'ana linono, anaa apa enatua Aron olalashe lino to ldoinyo le Hori neiturrurrokini iltung'ana lenyena:

English: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
Masaai: Ore Mikal ina tito e Saul neitu ae kata etum enkerai o metua.

English: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Isaakar Natanel olayioni le Saur;

English: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nepuonu Ilmoabu, o le Amon o kulikae ooing'uaa Meani, nepuonu aarasaki Yehoshafat to larrabal.

English: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
Masaai: Mincho lelo likisilig iyie meitukurruni te nkaraki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani; mincho lelo liking'oru iyie etum enkurruna te nkaraki nanu, iyie Enkai e Israel.

English: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
Masaai: Ore olasar lenye ooki naa keaku olpisiai le hini le naisho oo sabibu to loing'oni ake obo o entemata e uni e hini to lmeregesh, naa entemata e uni e ong'uan e hini to lkuoo le ker; ele ninye olasar opejori te pooki apa too lapaitin pooki lo lari

English: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
Masaai: “Enker narreshitoi Israel namirta ilng'atunyo etang'asa olaiguanani te Asiria ainos ninye, ore taata te siadi neguenyita Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon iloik lenyena.

English: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
Masaai: (anaa ake enayae to lkiteng lo lasar le seriani), nepejoo olapolosani tenchumata olperere lo lasar opejori.

English: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
Masaai: Neaku te naa kendaa narror olalashe lai, nemaitoki ai kata anya nkiri, pee marror olalashe lai.

English: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
Masaai: olayioni le Melki, olayioni le Adi, olayioni le Kosam, olayioni le Elmadam, olayioni le Er,

English: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Adam, “Ore amu itoning'o oltoilo le nkitok ino, ninosa, ilo ng'anayioi lo lchani laaitanapa ajoki ‘Minya,’ etediaki enkop tenkaraki iyie, ekeaku enenkinyinyiret ake inya te nkishui ino pooki.

English: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
Masaai: Ore naa enkeeya oo lbolot e Naaman naa eikimbung iyie, o eishoi ino ntarasi.” Nelo Gehasi teine netii ninye etaa ole nkeeya oo lbolot. Neibor anaa soito le nchan.

English: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.
Masaai: Entushukunye intae ilayiok lemeisiligayu kaishiunye nanu ina nimisiligayuyu intae ng'ura kiyetuo iyiook enitii iyie, amu ira iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
Masaai: nememera, nemearisho, kake oltung'ani supat, neme olaishankarrani, nemenyor impesai.

English: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
Masaai: Amu ore encholiek e lelo lemeeta Enkai naa koolupi. Naa keidaikie enkima ilo ng'obor lo loropisho.

English: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
Masaai: Amu tenimbelekenyakinono intae Olaitoriani, ore ilalashera linyi o nkera inyi netum olng'ur te lelo apa ootaraitie ninche, nerrinyunye ninche aapuonu ena kop. Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa kenana oshoke neeta olng'ur, nemeboin enkomom enye aitapaash intae, te nimbelekenyakinono ninye.”

English: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Yoshobeam olayioni le Sabdiel apa oitasheiki olturrur le dukuya, to lapa le dukuya; ore ilo turrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
Masaai: niyiolo iyie eyieunoto enye ninyor ina naikishiaan, amu kituutakaki ti atua nkitanapat,

English: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, etii nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai shumata enkitoria oo ng'ok, naa kaidaikie nanu aitung'uaa oriong e nkop; Meteleku ake nchere maidaikie nanu tukul enkaji e Yakobo,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
Masaai: Ina pee eitanap olaitasheikinoni lenye le nkaji enye ajoki, “Imputa ilbenia le lelo tung'ana endaa, tipika enaba anaa enaidim ake ninche aatanap, nipik impisai e pooki tungani enkutuk olbene lenye.

English: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
Masaai: “Neaku ena nanu aaitaas, iyie Israel, ore enkaraki naa kaas nanu ena terretenayu pee itumore Enkai ino iyie Israel!”

English: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Efraim te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni tomoni uni oare o iip imiet. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yosef te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
Masaai: Nadol sii nanu, Oloyanyiti Teofilo, ajo keishiaakino, natisipua mbaa pooki te rishata naado, naaigeroki mbaa naaitobirakino aitisipaki,

English: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
Masaai: Ore ilbarnot le On o Pibeset, nebatatakino ilo alem; ore inkituaak nepuo e araroto.

English: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
Masaai: Amu tene meeta apa ilo sotua ntiyot, naa anaata meetae ae nayaunyeki likae liaare.

English: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
Masaai: “Metaa aatawalikitia indamunot aainei nanu, tenkaraki nakuetiki imbaa te nkewan ai.

English: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
Masaai: Ore apa Absalom o ltung'ana pooki, ilewa le Israel nepuonu Yerusalem, o Ahitofel te nebo ninye.

English: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
Masaai: Ore amu eitu een ina olong eng'uset e yieyio, neitu eisudoo enyamali too nkonyek aainei.

English: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
Masaai: Eibelekenyate ninche aashukokino ntorrok oo loo nkakuyiaa lenye, apa ootanyaita ening irorei laainei; eshomo ninche aasujaa kulie aitin pee eisiaai ninche; etudung'o enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda osotua lai apa laitobira nanu tenebo loo papaai lenye.

English: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
Masaai: Neaku atureishe nanu nalo aturoo aisudoo ina talanta ino ti atua enkop, ing'ura, nena enino inko.’

English: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
Masaai: Imbelekenyenye intae mbaa e atua aayau oriong! Amaa olaitobirani loo motioo oo nkulukuok, keitanyaanyukieki nkulukuok; eji metaa kejoki entoki naitayioki ilo oitayu, “Eitu ninye aitayu nanu,” aashu ejoki entoki naitobiraki ilo oitobira, “Meeta ninye ening'unoto”?

English: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
Masaai: Naa ore ina najoki intae, neijia ajoki pooki: enchololoto.”

English: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
Masaai: Esipa ore lelo pooki ooyieu neibung orrekie le Enkai ti atua Kristo Yesu, nemeeta nchere pee meisilisili;

English: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
Masaai: Amu eikunari Enkerai e Tung'ani anaa enatejoki apake; kake ee kake aiyia ilo laa ninye oitarasaa!”

English: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa Ahas pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem. Neitu ninye eas mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa apa papaai lenye Daudi.

English: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
Masaai: Kalotu ina alo atang'asa aimaa Makedonia amu kayieu naimaa Makedonia;

English: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.
Masaai: Eiterritia ilayiok linono, eirragaa te dukuya pooki eitoi anaa entarakuet natijing'a orreshet; ebore ninche engoro o Laitoriani, ina kisikong'ata e Nkai ino

English: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
Masaai: Nejoki Nikodemo ninye, “Kaji eiko pee eidimi aatoiu oltung'ani etaa moruo? Keidim ninye atushukokinoyu eniare enkoshoke e ng'otonye metoini?”

English: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye: Efer, o Ishi, o Eliel, o Esriel, o Yeremia, o Hadafia, o Yadiel, lelo murran magil, ooning'o, laa lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
Masaai: Amu kimpoto iyie Olaitoriani, itiu anaa enkitok nataarayioki netum osina to ltau, anaa esiankiki naiturrayioki, Enkai ino najo.

English: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
Masaai: Aing'ae oibalie ntemat enyena - esipa iyiolo iyie! Arashu aing'ae oyietaa ilo gosoi aitaman ninye?

English: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
Masaai: Ore ena pooki naa te nkaraki enkitapong'oto e Yakobo, o ng'ok e nkaji e Israel. Kainyoo enkitapong'oto e Yakobo? Aime Samaria? Naa kainyoo eng'oki e nkaji e Yuda? Aime Yerusalem?

English: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
Masaai: Ore ilo kuo le ker linyi enchoo metaa meeta entioto, ositima lo lari obo, nintayuyu ti atua nkerra arashu ti atua nkineji;

English: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
Masaai: Ti nikijo eitu kias ng'ok, ninye kintaa olalejani, nemetii ororei lenye atua iyiook.

English: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.
Masaai: neaku kaya nanu intae enchom eyararoto te idia alo Dameski,” Olaitoriani ojo, laa ore enkarna enye naa Enkai oo Lororani.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa kaipotu nanu osinka lai Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia,

English: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
Masaai: “Ing'ura sii iyie ina kukuu naji Behemot ina naitobirua nanu anaa pee aaitobirua iyie; enya ninye olkujita anaa olkiteng.

English: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
Masaai: Newal Daniel te dukuya olaiguanani ajo, “Nchoo nkishorot inono eaku nkuninono, naa nchoo nena kishorot inono likae; ore ake eyia kaisomaki nanu olaiguanani ilo kigeroto naitayiolo ninye enkibalakinoto e ilo kigeroto.

English: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Ilamoni aajo eilanyishote Isiria, neiko sii ninche neijia aailanyisho te dukuya Abishai, nejing atua enkanasa. Kaae neshukunye Yoab aing'uaa olarrabal loo Lamoni, nelotu Yerusalem.

English: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
Masaai: Imiet linyi oopuo aamir iip, ore iip linyi nepuo aamir nkalifuni tomon; ore ilmang'ati linyi naa kepuo aabatata te dukuya intae to lalem.

English: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
Masaai: ilayiok pokira tomon le Haman ole Hamedata, olmang'atinta loo Lyahudi; Kake eitu epik nkaik enye nena naataarutua.

English: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
Masaai: Nepik ninye olperere lo lasar le sahabu atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo te dukuya ilo karasha lo liatua,

English: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
Masaai: (Amu iltung'ana linono ninche, naa enjung'ore ino ninche apa niyaua iyie aitung'uaa Misiri, aitung'uaa atua olmoti le nkima loo senkenke).

English: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
Masaai: “Tenaa supat oltung'ani neas ina supat naishiaakino

English: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
Masaai: Neibalunye iltung'ana enkidimata oo nkiasin inono, naibalunye nanu enkitoo ino.

English: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu enkirukoto naata ninche, nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Olchore, kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”

English: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
Masaai: Amu kepuo apa imelin o laiguanani Tarshishi tenebo isinkan le Huram kata nabo te rishata oo larin okuni ore nena melin e Tarshish naa kepuonu apa enapita sahabu, o enkosholai, o lala loo lkanchaoni, o yekenyi o motonyi sidain naaijo ilukunkuni.

English: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
Masaai: Ore nena wuejitin apa oo lpereren naatii iwuejitin neeika too nkanas e Samaria, naaitobira ilaiguanak loo Siraeli, neitagor Olaitoriani, neiwuang'ie Yosia. Eitaasa ninye ninche anaa ina pooki nataasa te Betel.

English: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Masaai: Kake ilo obor olo ajung enkop, neshipakino ninche ina kumoi e dupoto.

English: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
Masaai: Ore apa nena soito naagueta, nena soito dapashi o lning'o lo sotua apa naaitobira Olaitoriani tenebo intae, natobiko nanu to ldoinyo nkolong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam; neitu nanu anya endaa anaa aok enkare.

English: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
Masaai: Naa kerrorrokino ilkumok enchumata enye, nebatata negila, nerreshi ninche neyae.”

English: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
Masaai: Neeta nena kikeneta imatuan are imatuan are naamanaa too yeneta te pooki kikenet.

English: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
Masaai: Mincho olkitok lai eshilaa ele tung'ani le ntorroni, Nabal; amu ore anaa enatiu enkarna enye, neijia etiu ninye, Nabal enkarna enye, netii emodai te nebo ninye; kake ore nanu esinka ino eitu adol lelo barnot lo lkitok lai, laa ninche iyie irriwua,

English: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
Masaai: Nkai enye naar ilbarnot metuata; nemeing'urrie ninche ina natii enkoshoke e ng'otonye; ore nkonyek enye nemeeta olng'ur too nkera kutiti.

English: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Near ninye metuata ilapolosak loo wuejitin neeika apa ootii ine, too nchumat oo lpereren loo lasarri, nepejoo iloik loo ltung'ana te shumata ninche. Nerrinyo ninye alo Yerusalem.

English: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Kainyoo enyamali ino?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Aatiaaka nanu ena kitok, ‘Iyau enkerai ino pee kinos ninye taata, ore taisere nikinos enkerai ai.’

English: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
Masaai: neimulumul ninye te sahabu nasinya, nepik enkamanaa e sahabu aitaman.

English: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Kedemot te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Mefaat te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Shomo, ekeishiu olayioni lino.” Neiruk ilo tung'ani ororei otiaaka Yesu, nelo.

English: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
Masaai: Esipa imanyishoritin kuna e lelo lemeure Enkai, ewueji ene eilo lemeyiolo Enkai.

English: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo laamiki te dukuya ltung'ana nemikini sii ninye te dukuya lmalaika le Nkai.

English: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
Masaai: Ina kata edamu nkera enye ilperereni lenye loo lasarri o enkai enye naji Asherim, te mbata e pooki shani onyori, o te nchumata e pooki doinyo adoru,

English: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
Masaai: Kake etaaraitie apa Geshur o Aram nkanas e Hofotajir, o Kenat, o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, nkang'itie ntomoni ile. Ore kuna pooki naa inoo le ishoi oo le Makir, menye le Gilead.

English: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
Masaai: Kake etoorote olorere le ina anasa neibung'are kulikae Ilyahudi, neibung'are kulikae lkipaareta.

English: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
Masaai: Neaku te nebo intae oltung'ani ake te pooki osho ore ake ilo tung'ani naa ninye endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye.

English: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
Masaai: Meshohab, o Yamlek, o Yosha, apa ilayiok le Amasai.

English: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
Masaai: Eikira doi iyiook iinot loo Lyahudi mikira, “Loreren aasak loo ng'ok.”

English: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, nchoo enkiok ino metoning'o enkomono o sinka lino, o enkomono oo sinkan linono, ooshipakino euriata e nkarna ino. Nchoo enkishuroto osinka lino ena olong, nincho ninye olng'ur too nkonyek ele tung'ani.” Ara apa nanu olanapani le nkikompe o laiguanani.

English: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninche nena aitin omon apa naatii atua ninche, neisiaai Olaitoriani, netum ninye emion oleng te nkaraki osina le Israel.

English: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
Masaai: Ore kuna naa ing'uesi naaishu nena natoduaa tiabori ina Ai e Israel te nkiyopata olkeju le Keba; nayiolou ajo ilkerubi apa ninche.

English: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
Masaai: “Etisipa nena toyie e Selofehad; nchoo ninche erubata e njung'ore ti atua ilalashera le menye, nincho ina jung'ore e menye lenye meshomo aaku enenye,

English: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i kumok, nelotu ororei le Nkai enetii Eliya, to lari liokuni, ejo, “Shomo ntoduaai kewan te Ahab, amu kairriwaki nanu enchan enkop.”

English: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
Masaai: pee eisho intae Enkai o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, iloo papa le nkitoo enkiyang'et nagut e ng'eno o ene mbolokinoto, entayiolo ninye.

English: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Neitoki oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia airorie Hanania ilo oiboni te dukuya ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki apa ooitashe tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani;

English: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
Masaai: Etoduaa ajo emoroto namori te nkaraki Kristo naikash alang enkarsisisho o masaa kiroteti e Misiri, amu keanyita idia kishorunoto.

English: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
Masaai: enyaaka sii aisho enkitoria aiguanayu, amu Enkerai e Tung'ani ninye.

English: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
Masaai: Kake ore peyie eidip ilaisiaayiak le Isaak aatuturisho te yarrata netum teine enchorro e nkare naijirrijirru,

English: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
Masaai: Ore ake teina olong eetuo ilaisiaayiak le Isaak aaliki ninye enchorro e nkare natuturo ejoki ninye,

English: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Ebatata nkituaak te Sion, o selenken too nkang'itie e Yuda.

English: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
Masaai: Neaku ejo Enkiyang'et Sinyati aibalunye nchere, ore too nkatitin e nkiting'oto, naa keing'uaa kulikae enkirukoto nerubare lelo tauja le lejare o nkiteng'enat oo loiriruani

English: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
Masaai: Ime lelo moruak oata engeno nagut, neme ilkituaak ooning'u esipata.

English: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neaku eirorie apa Musa iltung'ana le Israel, neyaki ninche ninye ilo otedekishe te nkang oo lng'oborri, nenang ninche ninye too soito. Neiko neijia iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
Masaai: Nkera aainei kutiti, kame asaisai ajo pee eigili aaiu intae, o metaba anaa nepurupuranayu Kristo ti atua intae.

English: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
Masaai: Ore enkarna e ntito e Asheri naa Sera.

English: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
Masaai: Ore pee eibatisai ninye o enkaji enye, nesai iyiook, ajoki, “Te nikitoduaa intae aajo kaisiligayu to Laitoriani, wootu entijing enkaji ai, entotoni.” Neidimu iyiook.

English: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
Masaai: Nejo Laban, “Ore ele sototi loo soito naa shakeni terishata ino o nanu tena olong.”

English: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
Masaai: Kuna ninche inkarn e ishoi e Israel, naaetuo atua Misiri, Yakobo o layiok lenyena, Ruben, olkikau le Yakobo.

English: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani alo aitashe to lgos le nkoitoi napirik, terishata oo sabibu, netii ake esuntai pooki shoto.

English: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
Masaai: Nidamumu ina oitoi pooki natorikunye intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te kulo arin artam tiong'ata, pee etum ninye aitoborro intae, netem intae, pee etum atayiolo ina natii iltauja linyi, tenaa imbung'ubung'u,

English: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
Masaai: Engolon e aisho Nkai naishoo iyiook intokitin pooki naaishiaakino te nkishon o te sinyatisho e Nkai, te yiolounoto enye ilo oipotoko iyiook enkitoo o enkikishiaan enye.

English: And, behold Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, eewuo Boas eing'uaa Betlehem, nejoki lelo ooisampu enkurma, “Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo intae!” Newal ninche aajo, “Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani.”

English: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
Masaai: “Imayianana te neibayu intae iltung'ana, nekepaa intae nemor, nemit eipoti nkarn inyi ejo torrok, te nkaraki Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
Masaai: Incho ninye eipid alo anaa olmaati? Ore enkitoo enye o ltoilo oitayu neitureisho.

English: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumunye ilo Filisti nelotu pee enang'are Daudi, neipirri Daudi asiooyo alo ilo kereri lo larrabal anang'are ilo Filisti.

English: The men of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Rama o Geb, naa iip ile o tikitam o obo.

English: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
Masaai: peyie aaisho enkapune e Makpela naata to lpijata lo lokeri lenye. Inchoo maaishoo te nkinyang'a enye pooki idolitata metaa ewueji ai oo nkuraren.”

English: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aiwuang'ie Isiraeli te nkaji e Daudi, neitaa ninche Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat olaiguanani. Nerikoo Yeroboam Isiraeli aitapaash esujata o Laitoriani, nerikoki ninche metaasa eng'oki sapuk.

English: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
Masaai: naa ng'ura; eewuo osiwuo sapuk odung'u olpurkel, neosh ilpijat pokira oong'uan leina aji, nesulakino lelo tung'ana lelerue, netuata pooki, metaa nanu ake openy oisikua peyie aalotu aliki.”

English: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
Masaai: Eshal apa ninye pee eshei, kake enyaaka engolon e Enkai aisho ninye enkishui. King'arie sii iyiook ninye ina shalan, kake engolon e Enkai naisho iyiook enkishui enye, pee kitumoki aaipirare intae.

English: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
Masaai: Neaku etang'aduaki enkanasa ometaa olari le tomon oobo le nkitoria olaiguanani Sedekia.

English: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
Masaai: Etulusoyie entaboi e are. Ng'ura, kelotu entaboi e uni asioku.

English: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, irorie ilpayiani le Israel nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ainanu ipuonunu aaikilikuanishore pee ietuo? Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, mikinkilikuanishorere nanu.

English: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei, enkenai inchere eng'ida, te nitumutumu intemat oo mpukunot kumok,

English: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
Masaai: Tushukunye, tushukunye iyie lo Shulami, tushukunye tushukunye pee kitum aing'ura iyie. Ainyoo peyie ing'or iyie ilo Shulami, anaa oloipidipid aiguran te dukuya injorin are?

English: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
Masaai: “Eitaa Olaitoriani pesho iltung'ana laainei pooki magil, tiatua empolos ai; eipotuo ninye olturrur maatigilunore nanu. Pee epurdipurdi ilbarnot laainei; eitunyo Olaitoriani anaa enkironyet ina selenkei e Yuda.

English: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kohat anaa too lmareita lenye naa: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron o Usiel.

English: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
Masaai: Ore ina kata enukari oltung'ani otua, ng'ura nedoli entukus eilo wuampa nenang'akini ilo tung'ani otua atua enkurare e Elisha; eji ore ake pee eiseyie ilo tung'ani iloik le Elisha, nepiu neitashe too nkejek enyena.

English: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
Masaai: nejoki, “Enchom enda ang naipirare intae, ore ake pee ijing'ijing'i nitumutumu olkurrarru oena, leitu ae kata eked likae tung'ani. Entalaku entereu ene.

English: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
Masaai: Etegelua apa ninye iyiook te nyorrata mataa nkera enyena tiatua Yesu Kristo, te risioroto enkipirta nyor laainei, ninye otonyorra iyiook, negelaki iyiook kewan neel iyiook mataa nkera enyena kiimutua Kristo Yesu. Neijia apa eikununo enyorrata e yieunoto enye.

English: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: neidapashi ninche te dukuya enkolong o lapa, o lorora pooki le keper, naa ninche apa etonyorra ninche neisiaai, aa ninche apa etusujaitie, aa ninche eing'orutua neserem; nemeiturrurri ninche arashu enukari; netiu ninche anaa modiok ti oriong enkop.

English: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
Masaai: Shomo inosa endaa ino te nchipai, niok enaisho ino oo sabibu te nchipai oltau; amu eidipa Enkai atonyorrai pooki nias.

English: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
Masaai: Nilo aisho ina ashe Eliesa olapolosani, neipang'ieki ninye aaya auluo nepuoi aayieng te dukuya ninye.

English: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aitanap Benaia olayioni le Yehoida; neipang ninye alo aosh ninye anang'ie enkop, neye ninye. Neaku eitasheyieki apa enkitoo te nkitoria e Solomon.

English: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: Ainyoo eng'arie enkaji e Nkai enoo nkitanyaanyukot naaitaai nkaitin? Amu kira iyiook enkaji e Nkai naishu. Anaa enatejo Enkai, “Kamany atua ninche nairiamariyie ninche; naaku Enkai enye, neaku ninche ltung'ana laainei.

English: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
Masaai: Pee meaku ake te nairiamunore kulikae le Makedonia nikinepu intae, eitu ianyishosho, neme iyiook ake ookurru, kake neijia itiuu sii intae, amu keaku kintuluso olwuasa.

English: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
Masaai: Neiturrurro pooki anaa ake aasaisho te nebo, netii nkituaak naaisiritore, inaatii Mariamu ng'otonye Yesu o lalashera lenyena.

English: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata naa Yosef olbalusui leina kop naa ninye enkorrok apa omiraki ilpaek olorere pooki le nkop. Nepuonu ilalashera le Yosef, neirrugo ninche te dukuya ninye aaitabaiki inkomomi enye enkop.

English: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaya neosh entarumpeta te ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, nepuo iltung'ana le Israel te nebo ninye aadoyio te ina kop oo ndoinyo, etii ninye dukuya ninche.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Wooi iyie ina anasa osarge! Kaitaa sii nanu olchala osototi.

English: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooun ilng'oborri aasujaki ninche naa olosho le Simeon, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Simeon naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai

English: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
Masaai: Metaa shomo mbung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, alo too nkoitoi enyena niureyu ninye.

English: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
Masaai: Ore pooki tenebo naa keaku iltung'ana magil to larrabal, eitunyoki ilmang'ati lenye atua esarng'ab oo nkoitoi naalala; naa kearisho ninche amu etii Olaitoriani tenebo ninche, naa kemir ninche lelo akedok loo mbartan.

English: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
Masaai: Ore ilalashera pooki lo laisinani naa keibayu ninye, kebaa pasa elakuani nepuo ilchoreta lenyena aalam ninye! Esuj ninye ninche too rorei, nemetum ninye ninche.

English: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
Masaai: Kake etiaka Barsilai olaiguanani, “Kailarin aja nanu eton aishu, metaa kailep nanu alo te nebo olaiguanani Yerusalem?

English: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani eisilig olaiguanani; naa ore te nkaraki ina nyorrata nauno e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul, nemeigusugusuieki ninye.

English: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
Masaai: Keitasheikinore iltung'ana le Ninawi te nkiguana ltung'ana le na ishoi, naa keiguanaki ninche nchere, eitarruoitie amu eirridutua ninche to lkilikuai le Yona; netii ene olkitok olang Yona.

English: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
Masaai: Neaku iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni ake ooilepa aapuo ti atua iltung'ana le Israel; nepuo aaisik te dukuya iltung'ana le Ai,

English: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki le Israel, pee edol ilo tung'ani, neipirri aailany ninye, neirut ninche oleng.

English: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
Masaai: o Ira olayioni le Ilkedesh le Tekoa, o Abiesa le Anatot,

English: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
Masaai: Newaliki olaiguanani Ilkaldayo ajoki, “Ore ilo rorei opuku ti atua nanu naa kedede; te nimikintayiololo intae nanu enkidetidet o empukunoto enye, nedung'udung'i intae aaitaa ndung'udung'ot, neidaikieki nkajijik inyi.

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
Masaai: tiaaki inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Eewuo olkurragos sapuk oota naipuko sapuki o nkopir naado too naipuko, nebore esidano oomuain kumok, nelotu Lebanon negil ilukuny ooltarakua;

English: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests'.
Masaai: Ore mpisai o lasar le nkitarruorroto o no lasar le ng'oki, neitu eyauni atua enkaji o Laitoriani; inoo lapolosak nena.

English: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop, neisho ena kishooroto ilo kitok otii atua Israel.

English: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
Masaai: Te neeta Demetrus, aashu kulo kunono ooiriamunore embae naatakinore likae tung'ani, ebolo nkajijik e nkiguana neetae ilbalusuni: enchoo epuonu aaiguana olikae o likae.

English: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
Masaai: Naa keanyita ake lekua tung'ana Sakaria neing'asia te nkimutioto naimutie ti atua Enkaji e Nkai.

English: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: ore duoo ninye tenaa endapash aashu pooki toki natonie, teneiseyie neiduruku ninye ometaa teipa.

English: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
Masaai: Ore indamunot oo ltorrok naa olminong to Laitoriani, ore irorei leilo le meeta entioto naa keitiship ninye.

English: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
Masaai: Naipotuo nanu olameyu meeu shumata enkop o ldoinyo, meeu shumata nkurman, o sabibu, o eilata, te nena pooki naabulu te nkop, too ltung'ana o nkishu, o too siaaitin enye pooki.”

English: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
Masaai: Ore lelo rresheta ooshetu ninche nemeaku inkilani, meimulumul iltung'ana ate te nena naaitobiru ninche. Ore esiai enye naa esiaai e ntorroni, netii nkiasin o larrabal nkaik enye.

English: But he spake of the temple of his body.
Masaai: Kake enkaji e Nkai o lo sesen lenye eimaka ninye.

English: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' sope:
Masaai: “Kake aing'ae oidim ating'iria ina olong elotunoto enye? Naa aing'ae oidim aitasho tenelioyu ninye? Amu etiu ninye anaa enkima o lasikani, netiu sii anaa osabuni oishu oloirerio.

English: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
Masaai: Ainyoo ina nailepu to lpurkel, natiu anaa empuruo naitorropiloki te manoo o te nkorropil, te rropili pooki e nena sonkoyoni oo lbiasharani?

English: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
Masaai: Ekaaidapash iyie tiatua iloreren naisardakie iyie too nkuapi, namut ilduruki linono te iyie.

English: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu olchani loo lng'anayio tiatua entim, neija etiu olanyor lai tiatua iltung'ana ooti. Atotona te nchipai sapuk tiatua oloip lenye, nemelok olng'anayioi lenye te nkutuk ai.

English: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
Masaai: “Ntanapa lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku ilo sanduku le nchakenisho meilepu aapuku te Yordan.”

English: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
Masaai: amu meetae entoki naiputakine te nkaraki nkitanapat, ore te nkae alo, eyawuaki osiligi oikash, laa te ninye kinyikaki iyiook Enkai.

English: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
Masaai: Neitoki errindik e Raheli anutayu neiki Yakobo olayioni le are.

English: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Masaai: Kaaisis nanu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, amu kitudumua iyie nanu ailepunye, neitu ncho ilmang'ati laainei aang'idakino.

English: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
Masaai: Nejoki Yohana ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, kitoduaa oltung'ani earaa iloiriruani te nkarna ino, nikimitiki, amu mme ole ncholiek ang.”

English: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eya oloti oing'oni o lasar lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, nintoki aya likae oti oing'oni oaku olasar le ngoki.

English: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
Masaai: Iya sii ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, nepeji ninye te ine wueji negeluno e nkaji e Nkai, tiauluo ine wueji nesinya.

English: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
Masaai: Te naiken nanu ninche, nelang osinyai. Te nainyototo nanu, natii ake te nebo iyie.

English: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
Masaai: Ore doi kitii ele ng'obor eikinchir kiyieu erripoto e ina ang e keper,

English: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
Masaai: Entoning'oto maate te nkaraki naa Kristo iyanyititi.

English: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
Masaai: Kake ajoki nanu intae, migilunore olikintaas entorrono kake ore olikiosh eseder e tatene, imbelekenyaki sii enkae.

English: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
Masaai: Nedol Olaitoriani enkarrueisho e tung'ani ajo etaa sapuk te nkop oleng, naa ore emusunoto endamunoto enye pooki e atua oltau naa entorroni ake eponaa.

English: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
Masaai: Ore enkop e njung'ore enye neitushulu o Sora, o Eshtaol, o Ir-shemesh,

English: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
Masaai: Ore apa te sabato nabo nelo ninye ainos endaa te nkaji o Lfarisayoi obo kitok, te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, neing'or ninche aajur.

English: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
Masaai: “Enchoo ake pee ejoki ntae Farao, ‘Entisipa ate te asata o lbulabuli,’ nijoki Aron, ‘Tudumu ina ng'udi ino tanang'aki enkop te dukuya Farao, pee etum ataa olasurai.’ ”

English: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people how is she become as a widow she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary
Masaai: Ebaa ena liyio natii enkanasa e Yerusalem, nabore apa iltung'ana! Ina apa naa ninye enkitok alang nkuapi! Ina apa naata enkitoo too loreren, netotiwuo taata anaa enkoliai.

English: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
Masaai: “Ore hoo ning'ida, ore hoo nirup kewan, intae ilararok le njung'ore ai, ore hoo nintigiran anaa enkashe too nkujit, ninchirishiri anaa oloing'oni le mbarta,

English: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
Masaai: Naa kabik nanu tiatua nkera e Israel nemaing'uaa nanu iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.”

English: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
Masaai: Ore apa ina olong nerany Debora o Barak olayioni le Abinoam.

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani ti alo ninche, nelo aing'uaa;

English: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
Masaai: Kake etoduaa Paulo ajo mme sidai te nerik oltung'ani apa otorrinye aing'uaa ninche te Pamfilia, leitu erubare ninche te siaai.

English: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
Masaai: Ng'ura, osiwuo lo Laitoriani! eipang'ua engoro napi enye o lkutati ogol kedanyakino ninye elukunya e ilo torrono.

English: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkorrok ai kewan nashipakino aning'ore nkitanapat e Nkai.

English: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
Masaai: neitu king'oru enkisisa too ltung'ana, aa te intae, arashu te kulikae, hoo naa anaata kinkuna neijia anaa ilkipaareta le Kristo.

English: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
Masaai: nejing enkaji e Sakaria, neiroroki Elisabet.

English: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
Masaai: “Nintoki iyie ajoki ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Tooko, temerayu nilopisho, tabatatayu niming'il ae kata adumunye, tenkaraki ilo alem lairriu nanu atua intae.’

English: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
Masaai: Intayu ilgoso le nkopito pusi loo nkarash te matua e oriong e lelo karash te ntukus e dukuya. Nintoki ake aiko neijia, aitayu ilkiintani pusi loo nkarash te matua e oriong e ina tukus e are.

English: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
Masaai: Ore ematua e nabo te uni nipejoo te nkima te mpolos e nkanasa, ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i emanata e nkanasa; ore e matua e nabo te uni niya adung'udung to lalem aitaman enkanasa; ore ematua nabo te uni nindapashaki enkijape, naa kashurtu olalem asujaa ninche.

English: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
Masaai: Naa Sadok apa olayioni le Ahitab o Ahimelek olayioni le Abiata ninche ilapolosak; naa Seraia apa olasirani;

English: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
Masaai: “Ore aidipa aishoo ina palai e nkinyang'unoto Barak olayioni le Neria, naomon nanu Olaitoriani ajo,

English: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
Masaai: Esipa meeta enaas Olaitoriani Enkai, eitu eibalunye enkisudoroto enye too sinkan lenyena, lelo oibonok lenyena.

English: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
Masaai: Eeta oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkimerlel olng'ejep le nkima.

English: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
Masaai: Ore enkisikong'ata nejing'aa oleng oltung'ani ooata ening'unoto, alang ioshot iip naaoshi olmodai.

English: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
Masaai: Nemaany nanu empiris e Nkai. Te neaku te nkitabaroto oo nkitanapat eikenakini oltung'ani esipata nemeitoki naa enkeeya e Kristo aata tipat.

English: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
Masaai: Kaji eikunakaki ninche enkidaaroto nabo kata, eishieki ninche tukul te nkiputukuny.

English: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
Masaai: “Naa ore iyie Solomon enkerai ai, tayiolo Enkai e papaai lino, nisiaai ninye to ltau pooki o te ndamunoto e yieunoto amu kejur Olaitoriani iltauja pooki, neyiolo pooki kitobirat o endamunoto. Tening'oru iyie ninye, naa eitum iyie ninye, kake tenilam ninye, naa eikinturraa ninye iyie ntarasi.

English: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
Masaai: Neipotisho olarriponi neliki olaiguanani. Nejo olaiguanani, “Tenaa ninye ake, netii ilomon sidain enkutuk enye.” Nelotu ninye anyiku netaanu.

English: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
Masaai: “Esisa iltung'ana lenyena, lo oreren amu keitalaku ninye osarge loo sinkan lenyena, neitalaku elap too lmang'ati lenyena neitobir olkipoket te nkop oo ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
Masaai: Kebaa enking'asia oo nkishorot inono te nanu, kebaa esidano enye!

English: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
Masaai: o Hesbon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo o Yaser tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
Masaai: Ore te rishata e nkurruna inyi naa itumutumu intae erubata katitin are, ore te rishata e sulare nipuopuo intae aang'idakino ewueji enye; metaa ore ti atua ina kop inyi naa ipuopuo aatum erubata katitin are, nitumutumu eng'ida oo ntarasi.

English: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana oopidilare enkitoria ooena te korokoroni, neitayutuo loikop ina kata, netii oltung'ani oji Barabas.

English: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
Masaai: Ore lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo neitanapishe paa tenetii oltung'ani oyiolo enetii, neitayiolo ninche, pee etum aaibung'a ninye.

English: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
Masaai: Ore pee ekutu maa kutiti olkutati le moikuape, nejo ninche kenoto ina nayieu, nedotu eenet e meli neporoo aashep Krete, enyikita embata e ina kop.

English: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
Masaai: Meitoreisho iltung'ana lemeure Enkai, pee mepik iltung'ana orreshet.

English: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
