Masaai: Nening Benhadad olaiguanani Asa, neirriwaa ninye ilarikok le njore enye meshomo aagilunore nkanas oo Siraeli, neibung ninche aaisulie Iyon, o Dan, o Abelnaim o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki e Naftali.

English: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
Masaai: Neidapashakino olarrabal oriong enkop pooki; neinos entim iltung'ana kumok ina olong alang olalem.

English: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
Masaai: Hesro le Karmel, Paarai Olabi,

English: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
Masaai: teine ning'amaa ilomon ile memurata too ltauja o seseni, peyie ejing ewueji ai sinyati, neisarkionie ninye, ina kata nikinchosho nanu endaa ai, nena naapir o ilo sarge. Itigila intae olning'o lai lo sotua, tenebo ilo minong linyi pooki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Rehoboam o pooki apa naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
Masaai: nejoki, “Toduaa ake miliki likae tung'ani; kake shomo intoduaai kewan to lapolosani; ninchooyo entoki apa naitanapishe Musa te nkisujata, pee intadedeyie to lorere.”

English: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
Masaai: enkaraki ena apa pee etum iishoritin oo ltung'ana le Israel aatayioloito olarrabal, pee etum ninye aiteng'ena ninche olarrabal, amu eitu apa eyiolou.

English: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
Masaai: Ore te Dameski naa olbalosi otii ti abori Olaiguanani Aretas otorripo enkanasa e Dameski ejo pee aaibung nanu

English: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
Masaai: Eshomo ninye aitayunye Ilfilisti olarrabal, neuroo esuntai e Gat o e suntai e Yabne, o esuntai e Ashdod; neshetu ninye nkanas too lpolosien le Ashdod, te kulie wuejitin tiatua Ilfilisti.

English: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
Masaai: Neitu ayiolou nanu ninye, kake te nkaraki ena pee aeuo nanu aibatisisho te nkare, pee aataboloki ninye Israel.”

English: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
Masaai: Nerik lelo tomon o aare enkilepata, nejoki, “Ng'ura, Yerusalem kilep aapuo, naa ore mbaa pooki naatisiraki naaipirta Enkerai e Tung'ani too loibonok le Nkai naa keitabari.

English: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
Masaai: Ore eokito enaisho oo sabibu, nejoki olaiguanani Esta, “Kainyoo olkiyioi lino? Eikinchori iyie. Naa kainyoo eomonunoto ino? Tenaa duoo ninye kolpisiai le nkitoria ai, naa keitabari ake.”

English: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
Masaai: Nepik isoito tomon o are o nkarn enye anaa inkarn oo layiok le Israel. Netiu ninche anaa olmishire, meetae ake olemeguetuno enkarna enye, too loshon tomon aare.

English: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
Masaai: nedung'oki ninye enkop enkiguana te sipata, nedung'oki loreren enkiguana too nkiririkinot.

English: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
Masaai: “Etejoki sii, ‘Ore oloorore enkitok enye, inchoo eisho ninye empalai naorore.’

English: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
Masaai: Neyau sii Sairos ilo aiguanani nena masaa enkaji o Laitoriani apa naawa Nebukadnesa te Yerusalem nelo apik atua enkaji oo nkaitin enyena.

English: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche ntemat olperere lo lasar too ntemat (entemata enkaina nalulung'a o ndapasho enkaina.) Ore entonata enye naa keaku entemata enkaina nabo eilep naa entemata enkaina nabo endapasho, tenebo enkamanaa nabo namanita osegel lenye. Naa ena ninye naaku enkadori olperere lo lasar.

English: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
Masaai: Olaitoriani eing'uaa ena, naa ene nking'asia too nkonyek ang’?”

English: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
Masaai: Esiligieki intae natoyie e Yerusalem, enosa olmumai too ntarakueti naaten inchere mipututu enyorrata ang.

English: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
Masaai: Naakus iyie too masaa, naishopoki iyie ilgiso inkaik inono, o olpisiai emurt ino.

English: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
Masaai: Kake ng'ura, ekeya Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie nena pooki naata ninye, nenang'aki enkarsisisho enye atua enaiposha naa kepejori ninye aamut te nkima.

English: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
Masaai: kake edaa te kulo doinyo, neisarkionie enkitok olelatia enye,

English: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
Masaai: Kake etayiolo Yesu ina nejoki, “Aainyo pee intanyamalala ena kitok? Naa esupat aaitaasa.

English: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
Masaai: iyiook taa lelo laa ninye oitopiwuo, neme too Lyahudi ake kake too Loreren sii?”

English: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
Masaai: ninteng'en ninche nkitanapat o naatejo, nintayiolo ninche enkoitoi napuoyie o enaishiaakino neas.

English: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
Masaai: Inchoo ilkilani linono eiborru anaake; nimincho eilata elai te ndukuya ino.

English: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
Masaai: Etalaa apa Ilamoni kodi aaisho Usia, ore olning'o lenye nelo o metabaiki ilpolosien le Misiri, amu etaa apa ninye oltung'ani ogol oleng.

English: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi oshi laa ninye orikoo intae, ninye makewan olo aarisho amitu intae, anaa apa enaitaasa ninye intae te Misiri te dukuya nkonyek inyi,

English: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
Masaai: Ore taata, naa kera kutiti, entotoni ti atua ninye, paa ore pee elioyu nikintieu aaing'ura mikikurru te lotunoto enye.

English: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
Masaai: Kenukari te menatisho, neitopiuni te nkishiaa. Keshal enukari, neitopiuni eiputa engolon.

English: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
Masaai: Natanel oliong'uan,

English: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
Masaai: Nimiaaku iyie olkob too Lyahudi aashu to Lyunani aashu te sirit e Nkai,

English: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
Masaai: Aikintoki ninye aigil aiput enkutuk ino enkuenia nepik enkutuk ino embuakunoto.

English: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
Masaai: Keiteng'en ninche Yakobo nkiguanat inono; neiteng'en Israel nkitanapat inono kepik ninche enkorropil dukuya iyie o lasar opejori enchumata olperere lino lo lasar.

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
Masaai: naa Benaia olayioni le Yehoiada oitasheiki Ilkeriti o lpeleti. Ore ilayiok le Daudi naa ninche ilkituaak te nkisiayiare o laiguanani.

English: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
Masaai: ore naa ilo oyau nkishorot enyena neisho sii Olaitoriani olasar le ntapa le matua e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui eipurjaki te rubata e ong'uan e ilata,

English: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
Masaai: Kulo irorei le Amos, apa laa obo loo lairritak loo ntare le Tekoa. Etoduaa apa ninye kuna naaipirta Israel too nkolong'i e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel ilarin oare eng'or enkikirikirata e nkop.

English: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
Masaai: Ore ilo aisiaayiani apa oyiolo enayieu olkitok lenye, neitu eas aitabaya aashu ina nanyor, neidong'i oleng.

English: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
Masaai: Etabolokoki ninche metayiolo, inchere imme ate eisiaayiaki te nena kake intae, nena baa naainosakaki intae taata lelo oolikioo ilomon supati te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati nairriwuaki eing'uaa shumata naa imbaa naang'uar apa ilmalaika pee edol.

English: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
Masaai: Ainyoo peyie isudoo enkomom ino, nikinkenaa nanu anaa olmang'atinta lino?

English: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
Masaai: Ntonyorra oltau lai enchakenisho ino, nimintonyor dupoto.

English: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
Masaai: Neitoki aliooyu enkae toki sapuk e nking'asia te shumata, ng'ura enkito, tiamasi nanyokie, naata lukuny naapishana, o mowuarak tomon, neishopokino nkishiliaa e nkitoria naapishana ilukuny enyena.

English: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, Aimagilani Enkai, nemeeta ninye olomenaa, magilani ninye te ngolon eyiolounoto.

English: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
Masaai: natum naa atadamu osotua lai o Yakobo nadamu nanu osotua lai o Isaak o sotua lai o Abraham, nadamu nanu ina kop.

English: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
Masaai: Neikununo ilpapit lenye anaa ilpapit loo nkituaak, neikununo ilala lenye anaa ilala loo lng'atunyo.

English: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
Masaai: Ore ilarikok pooki loo njorin, o Yohanan olayioni le Karea o Asaria olayioni le Hoshaia, o ltung'ana pooki ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok, nepuonu aanyiku.

English: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
Masaai: Aiba nanu iltung'ana ooing'ashing'ash, kake anyor nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Naariku nanu atua olgilata le polos, netem ninye ing'apeta enyena, ore ake te nchoto nabo naa intemat enkaina ile apa endapasho oo ntoneta eng'ape.

English: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
Masaai: Amu itokordua iyie enkishui ai te keeya, ee, nintajeu nkejek aainei te mbatatata, pee atum nanu ashomo te dukuya Enkai ti atua ewang'an e nkishui ai.

English: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
Masaai: Neitashe olapolosani kitok ajoki ninye. “Aimeeta eniwalu? Kakua baa kuna nikinteeniki kulo tung'ana?”

English: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
Masaai: neing'or ninye enkop elakuaniki ore etii keper neing'or enkop.

English: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
Masaai: Ore enkanashe ino botor naa Samaria, ina naboitare intoyie enyena te nkalo ino e moikuape; ore enkanashe ino kiti, ina namanya enkalo ino e kopikop naa Sodom tenebo intoyie enyena.

English: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
Masaai: Amu nji apa etejo Amos, ‘Keye Yeroboam to lalem nemeeta nchere pee melo Israel eyararoto aing'uaa enkop enye.’ ”

English: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
Masaai: Etadotuoki emanyisho ai neiwuang'ieki te nanu, eikunaki anaa olng'obor lo lchekut; atununuko nanu enkishui ai anaa endapana, aaikuna nanu anaa enkila naitobiri te wueji neripishoreki; ore dama o kewarie nikiyau iyie nanu enkiting'oto.

English: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.
Masaai: Neibelekeny Saul kewan nepika kulikae kilani, nelo, ninye o ltung'ana oare te nebo ninye; nepuonu ninche enetii ina kitok kewarie. Nejo ninye, “Mbonokoki nanu te nkiyang'et, nikilepakinye nanu oltung'ani abo laaipotoki enkarna enye.”

English: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.
Masaai: Kake ore te ina olong naoru enkop e Goshen, naa ninye etonie iltung'ana laainei, metaa mejing emus oo lojong'a ine, peyie iyiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani otii empolos e nkop.

English: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.
Masaai: ore lelo tung'ana imiet apa ooshomo aaikeern enkop neilep aapuo, nejing atua nepuo aaitayu ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, ina kila o lgoo oolapolosak, o enkitanyaanyukoto o Terafim, o ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno, ina kata eitashe olapolosani te mbata ewueji nejing'ieki kishomi te nebo lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootanapate too masaa enye o larrabal.

English: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
Masaai: Neikunari neijia to lari ake, o to lari. Ore anaake te nelo ninye enkaji o Laitoriani neitagor apa ina aini enye ninye. Ore enkaraki ina neishir Hana ometaa menya endaa.

English: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejing ninye enkaji enye, neyau enkalem, neibung ina apiani enye neorrior ninye erubata o erubata aitaa irubat tomon o are, neirriwaa ninye nkuapi pooki e Israel.

English: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ninye, neipot, nejoki, “Na kitok, kitooruoki entasato ino.”

English: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
Masaai: Airriwaka nanu intae isinkan laainei pooki iloibonok, airriu ninche aitirrishaki, ajoito, ‘Mbelekenyayu taata pooki ng'ae te intae aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, nintobir nkiaasin inono, nimilo asujaa kulie aitin pee isiaai ninche, pee itum taa atobiko tiatua ina kop apa naaishoo iyie o loo papaai linono!’ Kake eitu iyie kincho nanu enkiok.

English: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
Masaai: Kake eibalunyeki taata esupatisho e Nkai neitu eimu nena kitanapat, hoo neishakenokito inkitanapat o loibonok le Nkai,

English: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ine nepuo ile Lawi atua aaisiaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nindip iyie aitukuo ninche ninchooyo ninche anaa olasar oyuki.

English: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;
Masaai: Neaku eipang'a enjore alo ong'ata aarare Israel; neitayuni olarrabal tiaatua entim e Efraim.

English: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Pilato ajoki, “Ira doi iyie Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Newaliki ajoki, “Iyie otejo neijia.”

English: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
Masaai: “Ijoki iyie ninche, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Amaa tenebatata oltung'ani aimeitoki ninye adumunye? Amaa teneibelekenya oltung'ani alo, aimeitoki ninye ashukunye?

English: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
Masaai: te nabo kata, te nkirriapata e nkong'u; amu keru ontarumpeta, neitopiuni ilootuata nelakuni aaoru keeya ntarasi, neibelekenyi iyiook.

English: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
Masaai: eninkuna apa ina olong pee intashe te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino te Horeb, pee aajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Inturrurrokoki nanu kulo tung'ana, pee aitoning nanu ninche irorei laainei, pee aayiolou ninche naaureyu nanu nkolong'i pooki naaishu ninche tioriong enkop, netum sii aaiteng'ena nkera enye nena baa.’

English: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
Masaai: Tishilai olning'o lino; amu ore iwuejitin neemisimis e nkop nebore imanyishoritin e nkarruoisho.

English: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
Masaai: Netamanya inkanas mijoonto, atua nkajijik nememanya, apa naatudung'okoki enkiguana metaa osototi loo suut;

English: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
Masaai: Amu ore apa pee alotu te Padan-aram aainepua osina etua Raheli te nkop e Kanaan te nkoitoi, eton elakua elototo pee ebau Efrat. Naturoo ninye teine te nkotoi alotito Efrat (aa ninye Betlehem).”

English: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
Masaai: Pee etum atabai enatolimuo oloiboni le Nkai ejo, “Too nkitanyaanyukot abol enkutuk ai, alimu mbaa naaisudoro apa moitie pee eitamanyuni enkop.”

English: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
Masaai: Amu ore ina aji pooki e Ahab naa keidaaya; naa kaiwuang'ie nanu olee pooki aishie, o rrindik o lolakuno tiatua Israel.

English: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
Masaai: Keetae osikari oisiai likae neitoki alaaki kewan olekoisiayio? Keetae oltung'ani oun enkurma oo lng'anayio nemenya lelo ng'anayio? Keetae oltung'ani oirrita eluaata oo masaa nemeok kule enye?

English: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
Masaai: Neisik ilchekuti lenye, nepuo aalikioo te ina anasa o te ina kop. Nepuonu ltung'ana aadol enatotiwuo.

English: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
Masaai: Metaa, itaa shakeni, nitonyorraitie nkiasin oo loo minyi, amu ninche ootaara metuata, nishetakiki ntae nkuraren.

English: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
Masaai: Kake etejo Daudi, “Minkoko neijia, ilalashera laainei, te ina naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani; etagolie ninye iyiook neishoru apik atua enkaina ang ilo wuampa apa oewuo aar iyiook.

English: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
Masaai: Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani; Entadamu eninkunariri intae.

English: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
Masaai: Amu ore nekua naamoda ewaita iltaai lenye neitu eya eilata

English: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
Masaai: Ore pee etum, neriku Antiokia. Neya olari olulung'a etumore ake ina sirit, neiteng'en esiamo kitok e ilo orere; naa te Antiokia eiteraki aajo ilooiteng'eni Ilkristiano.

English: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
Masaai: Elifelet olayioni le Ahasbai le Maaka, Eliam olayioni le Ahitofel le Gilo,

English: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ashukunye o Israel pooki te nebo ninye aapuonu ilng'oborri te Gilgal.

English: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
Masaai: naa kaaibelekeny iyie naareu iyie dukuya, naayau iyie shumata aitung'uaa inkiting'ot pooki e moikuape, naarik iyie taarare lelo doinyo le Israel;

English: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore Israeli pooki ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beersheba neyiolo nchere etudupe Samuel aaku oloiboni lo Laitoriani.

English: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
Masaai: Nejo Hasael, “Kainyoo pee eishir olkitok lai?” Newaliki ajoki, “Enkaraki naiyolo entorroni nilo aitaas iltung'ana loo Siraeli; ilo iyie apejoo isempewueti lenye, nilo aar metuata ilbarnot lenye to lalem, nidung'udung' nkera enye aitaa ndung'udung'ot, niaar metuata nena kituaak enye naairoshiutuo.”

English: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
Masaai: Aateshetaka nanu iyie ewueji e shumata. Ewueji nimany iyie ntarasi.”

English: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ilo aiguanani le Yeriko iltung'ana enkaji e Rahabu, ejo, “Ntayu lelo tung'ana ooetuo enkaji ino, lelo ootijing'a enkaji ino; amu enkop pooki eetuo ninche aajur.”

English: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
Masaai: Ina ake etoning'o Lyahudi le Sesalonike nchere etolikioyie Paulo ororei le Nkai te Berea, neitoki ake aapuonu ine, neing'oling'ol olorere aaitanyamal.

English: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
Masaai: nkarn enye ile to soit obo, ore nkulie ile naaleku ning'eroki olikae soit, too inot enye.

English: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
Masaai: Nening ilo Paulo eiro, ore Paulo, nekurraki nkonyek nedol ajo keeta enkirukoto pee eishiunyeki,

English: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the coast of Israel: and the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
Masaai: Nemiri Ilfilisti neitu eigil aajing enkop oo Siraeli. Nearare enkaina o Laitoriani Ilfilisti too nkolong'i pooki e Samuel.

English: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni o imiet apa Yehoshafat pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Asuba entito e Shilhi.

English: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
Masaai: enkop oo Lkanaan, o Lkeniti, o Lkenisi, o Lkadmoni,

English: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
Masaai: Amu kepirik kishomi naa ronkai enkoitoi nalo enkishon, naa ilkuti ootum ina.

English: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Masaai: Neitoki enkereri oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Dan aa ninche ootii siadi ilng'oborri pooki, aadumunye too lturrurri lenye; ore olarikoni lo lorora lenye naa Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai.

English: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
Masaai: Neitoki aigil airrugo, asir enkop to lkimojino.

English: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
Masaai: Ore pee eton Pilato to lorika le nkiguana neirriwaki enkitok enye olkilikuai ajoki, “Toduaa miaas ae te ilo tung'ani lemeeta entiyoto amu atanyamala duoo too mbaa kumok te nkidetidet te nkaraki ninye.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keari ilo tung'ani metua; naa kenang' ilo turrur pooki ninye too soito o metua ti auluo ilng'oborri.”

English: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
Masaai: Ira ilo Tiriti; Gareb ilo Tiriti; Uria ilo Hiti:

English: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eton eitu ebau enkata ai, kake etii enkata inyi oshi ake.

English: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
Masaai: Kulo apa ilaiguanak le ina kop, ootimira iltung'ana le Israel, neya ina kop enye te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong ebaiki oerata le Arnon o metabaiki oldoinyo le Hermon, o Araba pooki te nkalo o loosaen:

English: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
Masaai: Ore olasar ooki naa erubata nabo e ong'uan e hini to sitima ake obo; te ine wueji sinyati shomo tipika ilo asar ooki oirrusha nchoo Olaitoriani.

English: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Wou maape ang pee ilo ainos endaa.”

English: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
Masaai: Naa kakua kulie naitoki aajo? Amu maata enkata naimakinye Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yepta, Daudi o Samuel o lelo oibonok le Enkai

English: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.
Masaai: Te neas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo oltung'ani neitobiraki Enkai osotua, kake amaa teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo Enkai, kaing'ae namitu ninye. Kake mening ninche oltoilo le papaai lenye; amu eyieunoto apa o Laitoriani pee ear ninche metuata.

English: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
Masaai: ore olgilata oipirare moikuape olgilata loo lapolosak ooing'or olperere lo lasar; naa kulo ninche ilayiok le Sadok, laa ninye openy tiatua ilayiok le Lawi eishoro enyikaki Olaitoriani aaisiyiai ninye.

English: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
Masaai: Nitaa intae shakeni nchere irara inkera e lelo ootara lelo oibonok le Nkai.

English: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
Masaai: Keibalunyeki ina nyorrata ino nauno ti atua enkurare, anaa esupatisho ino te Abadon?

English: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
Masaai: Nimiwuang alo tatene arashu kedienye; tushuku enkeju ino intung'uai e ntorroni.

English: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
Masaai: naa kaitobir osotua lai te rishata ai o iyie, naa kaaponaa oleng.”

English: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilkulikae ooboitare te siaai enatotiwuo, neisinanuo oleng nepuo aaliki olkitok lenye inaataasate pooki.

English: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Enosai too sempewueti te Asiria, o too sempewueti tiatua enkop e Misiri, nijojo, “Enturrurroto maate te nchumata oldoinyo le Samaria, eng'ura embuakunoto o lkiyioi tiatua ninye o enkitorogonyare tiatua ninye.”

English: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
Masaai: Tusulaki enkop ilperereni loo lasarri lenye, nigil ing'apeta enye, nidung auroki enkop nena kitanyaanyukot naaji Asherim.

English: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
Masaai: Ore eyia eibung'a Daudi eng'ape e Sion, aa taa, enkanasa e Daudi.

English: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo olotu aarare ninye naa keas anaa enayieu ninye makewan, nemeetae oloidim aitasho te dukuya ninye; naa kelo ninye aitashe te ina kop e nkishiaa, ore pooki e ina kop naa keaku atua enkitoria enye etii.

English: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
Masaai: Oloo larin oopishana apa Yehoash pee eiteru aitoreisho.

English: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ilaiguanak nesukenyisho ninche. Ore ilaitoriak neiguranie ninche. Ekueniyie ninche pooki sempewuet, amu kerup ninche enterit neya ine.

English: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
Masaai: Ore amu kadung'oo te iyie lelo supati o lelo torrok, neaku kepuku olalem lai aing'uaa enchashur enye aarare iltung'ana pooki eiteru te kopikop o meshomo moikuape;

English: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
Masaai: Neboluni taa ina kisudoroto aaitodol Daniel te nduaata e kewarie. Neisis Daniel Enkai e shumata.

English: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
Masaai: Nelotu ng'otonye o lalashera lenyena; ore eeitashe ninche te boo neirriwaa enkutuk meipoti.

English: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: ore enkaraki nairridua oltau lino, nintoborro kewan te dukuya Olaitoriani, ina kata pee ining ajo airoro inaaipirta ene wueji, o lelo oomanya, nchere keaku ninche olmuaate o ldeket, nitopolosa iye nkilani inono ninchir te dukuya nanu. Aatoning'o sii nanu iye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
Masaai: Eiputa enkutuk ai enkisisa ino, o enkitoo ino endama pooki.

English: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
Masaai: Neitashe Ilfilisti te nchumata oldoinyo te nkalo nabo, neitashe Isiraeli te nchumata oldoinyo te nkae shoto, etii oerata erishata ninche.

English: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
Masaai: Naa ketiu enkitok ino anaa olchani loo lng'anayio ti atua enkaji ino; netiu nkera inono anaa nkaitubulu oo loirienito emanita emesa ino.

English: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the valley:
Masaai: Neyau lelo payiani leina anasa ina ashe aaitadou oerata onang'ari enkare, leitu aekata eturi aashu euni, negili emurt eina ashe teine to erata.

English: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoab awaliki Olaitoriani, ejo:

English: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
Masaai: Eishira ninche eing'oru eretoto, kake meetae oloitajeu ninche, eishirakitia ninche Olaitoriani kake eitu ninye ewaliki ninche.

English: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
Masaai: Ore elaku olkurrarru, nejoki lopeny, “Kaji etiu pee ilakuku olkurrarru?”

English: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
Masaai: ilo ng'obor le ntumo, o ilo sanduku le nchakenisho, o ilo orika lo lng'ur otii enchumata enye, o masaa pooki e ilo ng'obor,

English: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
Masaai: Airriwaka nanu ninche ilkiliku ajoki, “Aasita esiaai kitok nemaidim aeu. Kainyoo pee eitashe esiaai eji pee alotu enitii?”

English: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
Masaai: Kake eitaituo lelo tung'ana inkaik neyietaki Lot atua enkaji natii neiken kutuk aji.

English: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
Masaai: Kaiture nanu Elam te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, o te dukuya lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye; kayau nanu entorroni shumata ninche, o engoro ai napi, Olaitoriani ojo. Kairriwaa nanu olalem metusujaininche, ometaba anaa namut nanu ninche;

English: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia itaa iyie asipani te nena pooki naaetuo shumata iyiook, amu itaasishe iyie te sipata nikitaasishote iyiook te ntorroni.

English: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oshal nemeibung toki naing'oru, kake ore oltung'ani onyok aing'oru, ninye otum imasaa naagol enkinyiang'a.

English: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
Masaai: Naa kaaisho iyie ilboleta le nkitoria e shumata ore eniyooki aen te nkop, neaku eidipaki aateen te shumata; ore enilak te nkop eidipaki aatalak te shumata.”

English: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
Masaai: Kake eitu hoo ewaliki Yesu, metaba anaa neing'asia Pilato.

English: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
Masaai: Neaku ore too wuejitin neegum oorishat e oriong e suntai, too loingengen, atipika nanu iltung'ana te risioroto oo lmareita lenye, eeta ilalema, o remeta enye o nkai enye.

English: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo ltimito ookedito mbartan netasha are naa nkalifuni tomon katitin nkalifuni tomon. Atoning'o nanu esiana enye.

English: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
Masaai: “Metaa, entoning'oki, intae iltung'ana oota ening'unoto, metalamari ina te Nkai, tenaa keas ninye enkarruoisho, metalamari to Lmagilani tenaa keas ninye entorroni.

English: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani, amu aisupat Olaitoriani; enterrep enkarna enye, amu ninye aipirisioni!

English: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,
Masaai: kake Lisia olkitok loo sikarini oewuo newuapaa aoru iyiook te ngolon oleng.

English: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
Masaai: Neye apa Samuel, neiturrurro Israel pooki aaishiraki ninye, nenukaa ninche ninye te nkaji enye te Rama. Nedumunye Daudi nedoyio alo ong'ata e Paran.

English: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake pee einyototo Daudi tadekenya, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii oloiboni oji Gad, ilo aduani le Daudi, ejo,

English: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
Masaai: Ore too le Benchamen, ilo le ntalipa oo Saul, netii iltung'ana nkalifuni uni, ore ilkumok lenye neibung'are enkaji e Saul.

English: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
Masaai: aainyo naa pee maserian saai pooki?

English: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho ino nebaiki iishoritin pooki; iyie oitayio enkop nintasheyie ninye.

English: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
Masaai: Osotua lai ele, limbung iyie, te rishata ai o iyie o eishoi nikisuju iyie: ore pooki lee tiatua intae, naa kemurati.

English: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.
Masaai: Nejo olarriponi, “Amen ajo ore enkuetata ole dukuya naa kenyaanyukie enkuetata e Ahimaas olayioni le Sadok.” Nejo olaiguanani, “Oltung'ani supat ninye naa kelotu ayau ilomon sidain.”

English: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi aipotu ilapolosak, Sadok o Abiata o Lawi, o Uriel, o Asaia, o Yoel, o Shemaia, o Eliel, o Aminadab,

English: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
Masaai: Ore kulo naa iltung'ana kituaak ooitasheiki esiaai e Solomon iip imiet ninche o onom, laa ninche ooitasheiki iltung'ana aasak le siaai.

English: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
Masaai: Amu kitayieutua nikiponu enitii intae, atetema nanu Paulo enkata neme nabo kake eibooyie iyiook shetani.

English: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
Masaai: Kake etiu ilo torrono anaa enaiposha nailugo, ore enkare enye neilugu isuut o esarng'ab.

English: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
Masaai: Ee kake ayia! Amu ishetishete nkuraren oo iloibonok le Nkai laa papaai linyi ootaara metuata.

English: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo sabibu ninche,

English: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
Masaai: “Na aji e Israel, aimaidim nanu aikuna te intae anaa enaikuna ele aitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok? Olaitoriani ojo: ng'ura, ore anaa esarng'ab te nkaina o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok neijia itiuu intae te nkaina ai, na aji e Israel.

English: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
Masaai: Neibung ninche aapik jela o mekenyu, amu emuto ina kata.

English: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oitobir enkoitoi ti atua enaiposha, nepik enkoitoi atua nkariak kumok,

English: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
Masaai: Nepik ninye lelo kerubi ewueji e atua eina aji; ore inaipuko e lelo kerubi nelaki aaisalaash ometaa kebaiki enaipukoi e obo e suntai nebaiki enaipukoi o likae e suntai; ore nkulie aipuko enye nebaikino te mpolos e nkaji.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ediaa oltung'ani oisilig iltung'ana neitaa osesen le tung'ani emasaai o larrabal. Ilo oibelekeny oltau lenye aitung'uaa Olaitoriani.

English: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
Masaai: nining naa iyie te keper, niaas embae nguanare iyie isinkan linono, nidung'oki enkiguana ilo arruoni, ayau enkarruoisho enye shumata endukuya enye makewan, nimbalunye ilo asipani alaaki ninye te risioroto e supatisho enye.

English: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
Masaai: Neponari enkare oleng neiput enkop, nepor esafina shumata nkariak.

English: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
Masaai: Ore emanita Yoab enkanasa neisho ninye Uria ewueji neyiolo ajo ketii iltung'ana oopi.

English: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
Masaai: Ore pee esing ninye neidapashaa ewang'an, ore nkonyek enyena netiu anaa entadekenya nawang'u.

English: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
Masaai: Iyie oitubulu nkujit te nkaraki nkishu, o nkaitubulu te nkaraki iltung'ana, pee etum ninye aitayu endaa te nkop,

English: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
Masaai: Itabolo iyie emootian ino, nipik mbaa empito e nkawuo. Imperra iyie enkop apik ilkejek.

English: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
Masaai: Ore peyie indip ena, nintoki airrag eniare, kake ore te nkalo ino e tatene, ninap enkitamioto enkaji e Yuda; inkolong'i artam aatipika ena, enkolong ake to lari pooki.

English: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
Masaai: Ilo oas isiaitin sapuki nena naagiroo ening'unoto, o ntokitin enking'asia nemeeta esiana.

English: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
Masaai: Neyam Abram o Nahor inkituaak, neji enkitok e Abram Sarai, neji ene Nahor Milka, entito e Haran aa menye Milka o Iska.

English: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
Masaai: Neaku aatung'uayioki aa nanu ake nadol ina duaata kitok, nemeetae engolon natelekua ti atua nanu; ore emua o sesen lai neibelekenya oleng, nashalu oleng.

English: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
Masaai: Enyor apa neitu intashe te rishata oo nkoitoi pee imbung lelo ooisik; enyor apa neitu iyau ilo pisiai lenye te ina olong o sina.

English: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
Masaai: Naa tenijo iyie to ltau lino, kainyoo pee eetuo kuna baa shumata nanu? Tenkaraki esapuko e ntorroni ino pee engishari ilkilani linono, nikisomiti iyie.

English: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
Masaai: nerany ninche eirukokino, eisis neisho enashe Olaitoriani, ejo, “Amu aisupat ninye amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi tialo Isiraeli.” Nebuaku iltung'ana pooki te mbuakunoto sapuk, ina kata eisis Olaitoriani enkaraki naiteruaki olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.

Masaai: Ore ina kata eirriwaitie iltung'ana le Betel Sharese o Regemelek oltung'ana lenye pee epuo aomonu omom to Laitoriani.

English: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipotu olaiguanani neipang'aki ninche Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia, laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, o Shebna laa ninye apa olasirani, o Yoa olayioni le Asaf ilo aigeroni.

English: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
Masaai: Ara apa nanu menye ilo aisinani, naturu aing'oru aretu ilo lemaayiolo.

English: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninye nena aitin oo loreren, o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin aitung'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani, o lelo pereren loo lasarri apa ootesheta to ldoinyio le nkaji o Laitoriani o te Yerusalem, nenang'aki ninche auluo enkanasa.

English: And Penuel the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
Masaai: Naa Panuel apa menye le Gedor, naa Eser menye le Hushash. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Huri, ilo kikau le Efrata, menye le Betlehem.

English: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, lo tung'ani le Enkai, ilanya kuna pooki, ing'oru esupatisho, o rrekie le Enkai, o enkirukoto, o enyorrata o enkitashoto, o emborron.

English: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
Masaai: Ore peyie edol ina kitok ajo etung'uayie enkila enye te nkaina enye eibung'ita, neisik alo aing'uaa enkaji,

English: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
Masaai: Eton eitu alo ine nemashukunore ina kop engoro natii enaimin nagut,

English: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'ueikini ninche, nepuonu enetii lchoreta lenye, nelikioo nena pooki naatiaakita ninche ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani.

English: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ilkiliku Gibea e Saul, nelikioo ninche olomoni too nkiyiaa oo ltung'ana; neishir iltung'ana pooki aayietu.

English: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
Masaai: Tudumunye lo tau lai! Tudumunye na awuo oo sinkolioitin o lwulul loo usin! Kainyeyie nanu entadekenya!

English: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
Masaai: Neitayu olapolosani orony le ilo meregesh eidipaki aaitokitokie, neitayu emukate nabo neitu eisuishieki ti atua enkikapu o emukate nabo napejo neitu eisuishieki nepik ninche aiteleiki nkaik e ilo lo lmumai. Ore ake pee eidip ninye atabarnoi ilpapit le nkitisinyata enye,

English: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
Masaai: Etubulakita ninche, ore lelo kiyiaa sasin lo lpaek etoijoitie lelo kiyiaa oopishana sidan. Natolikio nanu nena kidetidetat ilasakutok kake metii hoo obo laaidima atoliki ina kidetidet.”

English: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkolong e naapishana nimbung'ubung'u eumata nasinya; nimiasiasa esiaai nagol.

English: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
Masaai: “Nchooki matijing'a atua intare inono ena olong aitayu tiatua pooki ker naata oltipoto anaa nairimo o pooki kuo le ker orok, tenebo pooki kine oirimo tiatua inkineji; neaku nena elaakinoto ai.

English: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
Masaai: Neosh ninche enkukuo anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye, neitorisi nkutiti o sapuki, tenkaraki nchomito enye.

English: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu ilomon supati ooing'uaa Olaitoriani, neirriwakaki olkilikuai atua nkuapi pooki: “Enturrurroto maate tenebo, nipuonunu aarare ninye, nidumakinono olarrabal!”

English: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: tenkaraki lelo turrurri loo lapolosak o Lawi, o esiaai pooki enkisiaayiare tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o masaa pooki e nkisiaayiare tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
Masaai: Entodol ake emiaany ele olimu kuna. Amu amaa te neitu eilanyisho lelo ootanyaita ninye te nkop, mikiaata sii iyiook enikilanyie ilo oirorie iyiook etii shumata.

English: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
Masaai: ejo, esipa etudung'oyioki aaiwuang'ie ilmang'ati lang, ore ilekunot netumuta enkima.

English: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
Masaai: Ore te ng'ape e nkatampoi nirikoo iyie ninche dama, ore te ng'ape e nkima nirikoo ninche te nkewarie, pee ilang'ilang'aki ninche ina oitoi naaim.

English: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
Masaai: Ore mbenek enyena naa eisidain naa kumok ilng'anayio lenyena, ore ilo shani netii endaa e pooki toki. Netum ing'uesi e ong'ata oloip ti abori ninye ore ntaritik o loing'ang'e nemany ilng'osil lenyena, ore pooki toki naishu neitoti te ilo shani.

English: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
Masaai: “Amaa ai ng'ae oishoo ninye enkishorunoto metaa keyookini aalaaki?”

English: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
Masaai: Eyooki ltung'ana le Ninawi aaitasheiki neitang'or ltung'ana le na ishoi, te nkolong e nkiguana, nedung'oki enkiguana, amu eirridutua ninche etolikio Yona ororei le Nkai, naa ng'ora, etii taa ene olkitok olang Yona.

English: And the officers shall speak unto the people, saying, What man is there that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak aairorie iltung'ana ejo, ‘Kalo tung'ani tene otesheta enkaji ng'ejuk neton eitu eitisiny? Nchoo ninye errinyo alo enkaji enye, melo ake aye to larrabal nelotu likae tung'ani aitisiny.

English: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
Masaai: Tadamu, Olaitoriani, te nkaraki Daudi, ilo sina pooki apa onoto ninye;

English: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
Masaai: Ore mpopong'i inyi neaku endaa too ntaritik oloing'ang'e o too lowuarak lentim; nemeitokini aata hoo obo oiture ninche meshomo.

English: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Masaai: Meetae likae laaijo iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, nemeetae ae Ai neme iyie, te risioroto e nena pooki nikitoning'o too nkiyiaa ang.

English: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
Masaai: Metaa tejo, ‘Ng'ura, kaisho nanu ninye osotua lai le seriani;

English: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
Masaai: o Rehum, o Hashabana, o Maaseia,

English: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Masaai: amu ming'uaa iyie oltau lai te nemeneng'a, nimincho osinka lino sinyati metupurdayu ang'uoyu.

English: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
Masaai: nchere kaara sapuk oleng osina o emion ti atua oltau lai.

English: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorie ninche ninye, nebau lelo sunaishi oogelema lo laiguanani eisosion pee eya Haman ilo sirua oitobira Esta.

English: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
Masaai: Ore hoo tenaa kebikoo ninye ilarin enkalifu aigil are, neitu ake eshipakino toki aime ewueji nebo epuo ninche pooki.

English: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai ilo oiboni oji Hanania, “Toning'o Hanania: eitu iyie kirriu Olaitoriani ninchoo iyie kulo tung'ana meisiliga elejare.

English: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
Masaai: Ore ilpayiani leina tito e Sion, netoni te nkop aagira; etipika ninche enterit ilukuny enye neishop ilkuniyiani; ore nena toyie e Yerusalem neirrug ilukuny enye aaitabaiki enkop.

English: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Keton etii oltung'ani obo otelekua te nkaji e Saul, pee atum nanu aitoduaa ninye esupatisho te nkaraki Yonatan?”

English: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipi aaitabai kuna kitobirat, neaku kejing ilapolosak anaake atua ilo ng'obor aaitabaya empolosare enye;

English: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eitayu ninche eoshoto naado te nena mouarak oo lmeregeshi, ore ake pee ining'ining'i oltoilo le mouo, nebuaku iltung'ana pooki te mbuakunoto kitok; neurunye esuntai e nkanasa abaiki enkop, nepuo iltung'ana dukuya, oltung'ani ake neiulokino dukuya ninye.”

English: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
Masaai: nemening oltoilo loo lasakutok anaa oltoilo loo laitobirak loo ntaleng'o ng'eni hoo neibonisho ninche te nkarriyiano.

English: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:
Masaai: neaku ina kitanapata tenebo ninye, neisum ninye nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye, pee eyiolou aturia Olaitoriani Enkai enye, te nkibung'ata oo rorei pooki lena kitanapata, o kuna kiguanat, neas ninche;

English: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD'S servant?
Masaai: Kalo modooni leme ilo sinka lai, aashu kalo ming'ani anaa ol kipaaret lairriwaa nanu?

English: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
Masaai: Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye nejoki, “Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie, iyie oloing'oni magilani.”

English: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou olorora, nesujaa; neitoomon neirorie aliki ninche mbaa e nkitoria e Nkai, neishiunye ilooyieu neishiunyeki.

English: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
Masaai: Eisidai apa ina siankiki oleng te nkishiaa, neaku ninye enkaing'urani o laiguanani neisiaai ninye; kake eitu eboitare olaiguanani ninye.

English: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Reu ilarin tomoni uni o aare, etaa ninye menye le Serug.

English: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people, that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip lelo kituaak aairorie iltung'ana, neitokini aagelu ilarikok le njore metijing'a dukuya iltung'ana.

English: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ntarasi o ntarasi! Esai o Esai.

English: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
Masaai: Ore ena olong eikipik iyie Olaitoriani atua enkaina ai, naar abatat, nadung'oo endukuya ino, naisho nanu impopong'i oo lororani oo tuata loo Lfilisti ena olong imotonyi o loing'ang'e o ilowuarak le ntim pee etum enkop pooki atayiolo nchere etii Enkai atua israel,

English: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
Masaai: Neishir ninye te dukuya ninye nena olong'i naapishana apa osirua lenye; ore te nkolong e naapishana neliki ina kitok enye, amu eitirrishaka apa ninye oleng. Neliki ina kitok oloyiote lelo tung'ana lenye.

English: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye imuatat oo nkerra e mbata e nkoitoi, ine apa netii enkapune, nelo Saul atua pee eyeng'iyeng'ie kewan. Ore apa Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena netonita teneiting'ie enkapune ti atua.

English: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
Masaai: Nerikoki ninye lasirak o Lfarisayo enkitok nairrashaki eloloito. Neitasheyie ninye te mpolos.

English: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
Masaai: Elepie osinkolio, nioshiosho enkinanta, ina kinanta e nkopito sidai enkorui o endule.

English: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Solomon etua anaa loo menye. Nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Rehoboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Masaai: Ore too nkoitoi inono pooki imbalie ninye naa keitorioo ninye inkoitoi inono pooki.

English: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
Masaai: Neshetu Daudi teine olperere lo lasar, lo Laitoriani, neitarasaa olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani, neipot enkarna o Laitoriani, newaliki Olaitoriani ninye te nkima, naing'uaa keper naewuo shumata ilo perere lo lasar opejori.

English: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
Masaai: Naa kulo ile ishoi e Tera. Ore apa Tera naa menye le Abram, o Nahor, o Haran. Ore apa Haran naa menye le Lot.

English: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
Masaai: Neiturrurroki ninye kewan iltung'ana neaku olarikoni loo larruok, ina kata apa eidipa Daudi atasesekuanisho; nepuo ninche Dameski nebik teine, neitaa ninche ninye olaiguanani le Dameski.

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Gad nkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile o onom.

English: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
Masaai: Nimpotisho iyie, nikiwaliki Olaitoriani; ore pee nchir iyie, nejo ninye, Nele nanu. “Tiniwuang'ieng'ie ti atua ate ina shata e murt. o ina utata o lkimojino, o enkiroroto torrono,

English: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
Masaai: Nedumu Yudas empikas oo sikarini o larripok ooing'uaa lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo, nepuonu ine eeta ltaai o lkilang'ilang'eta o masaa o larrabal.

English: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
Masaai: Ore esiana e lelo apa ooasishore ilosekin le naibon neyau mbukui enye aaiturrur: nepejoo edolita pooki ng'ae: neikeni esiana oo mpesai naainosieki neaku ropiyiani naaibor naabaya nkalisuni onom.

English: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
Masaai: Enaikash enkiting'oto entoki alang enkiterunoto enye; neikash ilo ongiri to ltau alang ilo owuasa to ltau.

English: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
Masaai: Tenaa aime Enkai duoo e papaai lai Enkai e Abraham tenebo olturiaki le Isaak ootii enkalo ai, esipa katukul inchere anaata kinchoo mashomo too nkaik naarook. Etoduaa Enkai osina lai tenebo esiaai oo nkaik aainei, nikisikong ng'ole kewarie.”

English: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninye olperere lo lasar opejori kutuk aji eilo ng'obor le Nkai oilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitayu te nchumata enye olasar opejori o lasar le nkurma naidong'o; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
Masaai: Neitashe ilmalaika pooki aaman olorika le nkitoo o lelo payiani o nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, nebatata too nkomomi enye te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo neserem Enkai.

English: I am that bread of life.
Masaai: Ara nanu emukate e nkishui.

English: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
Masaai: Epuku te nkutuk enye ilkilang'ilang'eta le wang'an neng'orunye iltiil le nkima teine.

English: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

English: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin enyena o nkoitoi enyena pooki, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, ng'ura eigeroki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Yuda o Israel.

English: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
Masaai: Aikirrita iyie eyiolounoto; nikirrip eyiolounoto iyie.

English: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
Masaai: o Lyebusi o Lamori o Lgirgashi,

English: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
Masaai: ilmurran ooishopo inkilani naata emua morijoi, ilaitoriak o laitasheikinok, laa ore pooki naa ilbarnot oo ng'uarri oleng, nekedito ninche imbartan.

English: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
Masaai: Ore ake pee kining ina, nikilepori, nemeetae empijan natelekua te likae lee hoo obo, te nkaraki intae; amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninye ilo ora Enkai te shumata o ti abori te nkop.

English: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death: for as when a man riseth against his neighbour, and slayeth him, even so is this matter:
Masaai: Kake ore ina kitok meitaasi ae; ore tialo ina kitok metii entorroni nairirikino keeya, amu ore ena kiguana nenyaanyukie enoltung'ani orasaki nesesekuan ilo lelatia enye.

English: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
Masaai: “Ore iyie enkerai e tung'ani imbonoki lelo doinyo le Israel, nijoki, intae ildoinyo le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Wou tusujaki pee idol enyuaata naata to Laitoriani.” Kae neked ninye tenebo ninye engarri enye oo mbartan.

English: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
Masaai: Neaku ore ina sekenkei, o ina sarng'ab o ilo suyai, o ina osholai o ina sahabu nerrarra pooki aaku mbelibelat netiu anaa suut ewueji neidong'ieki enkurma te nkata e nkirowuaj, neya ninche olkutati o metaa medoli ninye enkiti enye. Kake ore ilo soit otoosho ina kitanyaanyukoto neaku oldoinyo sapuk neiput enkop pooki.

English: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
