Masaai: Nchumat oo ldoinyo ninche ndaat enyena, nelimana aaing'oru pooki toki nanyori.

English: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ekairriu nanu olkilikuai lai pee eitobir enkoitoi te dukuya nanu ore ilo Aitoriani ling'oruru, nelotu nabo kata atua enkaji enye. Ore olkilikuai leilo ning'o lishipakinono, ng'ura elotu ninye, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pahatmoab, aa taa ilayiok le Yoshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon o isiet.

English: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
Masaai: kake te neitadiaki te nkaraki meyiolo eumata neitayu naa ina umata pooki oloti oing'oni oaku olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, te nebo olasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki te risioroto e nkitanapata, o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki.

English: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
Masaai: Teneiro oloiboni te nkarna o Laitoriani, tenemelotu ilo rorei asipayu aashu aaku, ore ilo rorei mme Olaitoriani oiroro; oloiboni ake oiroro to lwuasa, nemiureyuyu intae ninye.

English: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
Masaai: Ore pee emita enaisho oo sabibu nejoki ng'otonye Yesu, “Meetae enaisho o sabibu.”

English: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
Masaai: Kake ore o taata, ayiolo ajo ore embae pooki niomonu te Nkai, aikincho iyie.”

English: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
Masaai: Ng'ura, eitu edorropu enkaina o Laitoriani, eji metaa meekure meidim aitajeu, anaa eitoming'anaki enkiok enye, eji metaa meekure ening'isho;

English: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
Masaai: Elepa enchom ina kop naruko kule o naishi; kake malo nanu ti atua intae, maidaikie ake intae te nkoitoi, amu irara iltung'ana oosho murto.”

English: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
Masaai: Emintoki aairo aabuaku to lwuasa, emincho enkitokoos eimu nkutukie inyi; amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai e ng'eno, naa te ninye eineneng'i iasat.

English: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
Masaai: Ainyoo apa pee eitu aaisudori anaa olkibiroto anaa nkiyiotin neitu ae kata edol ewang'an?

English: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enatiu ewueji nepejieki imukateni, neijia eikununo iltauja lenye eyupuyup erreshisho; ore kewarie pooki etiu engoro enye anaa olang'at ore tadekenya neyupuyup anaa ilng'ejepa le nkima.

English: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
Masaai: Aijo iyie eimaidim atasayia Papa maairriwaki nabo kata mpuot tomon o aare oo lmalaika?

English: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
Masaai: Nejoki Yeroboam enkitok enye, “Tudumunye nimbelekenya, pee meyiolouni ake ajo ira enkitok e Yeroboam, nilo Shilo; ng'ura etii oloiboni oji Ahija ine laa ninye apa oibonuo tialo nanu nchere kaaku olaiguanani le kulo tung'ana.

English: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
Masaai: “Tenelo neaku olomoni aashu ilo oidurrua karsis, ore olalashe lino otashare neaku aisinani nemiraki kewan ilo omoni aashu ilo oidurrua otii tenebo iyie, aashu obo lo lmarei leilo tung'ani omoni,

English: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
Masaai: Keitobir ninye ina ninyorraa iyie, amu itanya iyie ninye? Amu meeta nchere pee meyie ogelu; neme nanu ogelu metaa imbalie ina niyiolo.

English: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
Masaai: metaa, ore naa taata, inchoo osinka lino, aatasayia, ejing erishata enkayioni aaku orrindik lo lkitok lai; nincho enkayioni eshuko tenebo ilalashera.

English: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.
Masaai: Neishoo apa Saul Mikal, entito enye, ina kitok e Daudi, Palti olayioni le Laish, laa olayioni le Galim apa ninye.

English: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
Masaai: Nemuti aaya olng'obor lenye aimemuta ninche aaye, neton ake meeta engeno nagut?’

English: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu aisinanuo, nebaiki enkurare. Enkapune ina kurare, neigarakino osoit.

English: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
Masaai: Ore mbartan enye naa iip naapishana o tomoni uni o ile. Ore inyumpui enye naa iip are o artam o imiet.

English: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
Masaai: neitoki olpolosie aibelekenya te Asmon o meshomo Ereyiet e Misiri, ore enkitingoto enye naa te naiposha.

English: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaya nena olong'i, neisho olaiguanani lelo tung'ana pooki ootii Susa, ina ang kitok, ilkituaak o looti osirua too nkolong'i naapishana, ti atua enkaji e ntumo natii atua olgoriet le nkurma e ina manyisho o laiguanani.

English: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
Masaai: Ore te ina rishata ake nesai ilooiteng'eni lenyena aajoki, “Rabbi, tadaayu.”

English: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
Masaai: Kake teneinyang'u olapolosani orrindik too mpisai aitaa emasaai enye makewan, neidim ilo rrindik ainosa ina toki; ore lelo ootoiwuoki tiatua enkaji enye neidim aainosa ina daa enye.

English: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aishira, neituku enkomom enye nepuku; neitagol kewan nejo, “Enchoo endaa eyauni.”

English: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari naa Mahali o Mushi. Ore ilayiok le Yaasia naa Beno.

English: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
Masaai: Nejoki Saul lelo sinkan lenyena oomanita ninye, “Entoning taata, intae ile Benchamen; amaa keisho ole Yese pooki ng'ae te intae inkurman o nkurman oo sabibu, keitaa ninye intae pooki ilkituaak loo nkalifuni o ilkituaak le maaip,

English: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.
Masaai: pee eyau Fashiti dukuya olaiguanani eishopito emaupe enye e nkitoo pee eitodol iltung'ana pooki o lkituaak pooki e nkishiaa enye, amu eisidai apa oleng te nking'urata.

English: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Hela: Seret, o Ishar, o Etanan.

English: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ining iyie eyieunoto eilo obor; nintagol iyie ninye oshoke nirrugoki enkiok ino

English: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
Masaai: Naa teneton etii ilarin kumok, ore te risioroto enye nerriny alak ninche teina kinyang'a apa natalaaki te nkaraki ninye, enkinyang'a e lakunoto enye.

English: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
Masaai: Etaa nanu kasioki amir ilmang'ati lenye, naibelekenyaki nanu enkaina ai ilmang'ati lenye.

English: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
Masaai: Tudumu ilepie eng'udi ino, nintorioo enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha tooro, pee etum iltung'ana loo Siraeli aashom te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha.

English: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
Masaai: Nejoki Aron Musa, “Oi lo kitok lai, mintame iyiook amu kitaasa iyiook te modai, nikitaasa eng'oki.

English: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
Masaai: Te nelo niya olkila le ilo le latia ino pee intalakunye esile tushukoki ninye eitu edoyio enkolong,

English: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
Masaai: Ore apa pee eidipayu nena pooki, ore lelo Siraeli pooki apa ootii ine, neipang aapuo nkanas e Yuda nebel aaitaa mbelibelat ing'apeta neuroki Asherim enkop, nesulaa iwuejitin neeika, o lperereni loo lasarri te Yuda pooki, o te Benchamen, o te Efraim o te Manase, ometaba anaa neidaikie pooki. Neitoki iltung'ana pooki le Israel aarrinyo aapuo nkanas enye, nelo ake oltung'ani ewueji enye.

English: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
Masaai: Ng'ura etiu ninche anaa isirkon le ntim to lpurkel epuo te nkisiayiare enye nagol eing'oru eng'ues naibung tiong'ota, pee enya inkera enye.

English: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia kaleku nanu nkalifuni naapishana tiatua Isiraeli, lelo pooki leitu egilaki kung neitu eirrugokino Baal, o pooki leitu eng'utut Baal.”

English: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Nedanya sii olperere lo lasar neibukori nkuruon teilo perere lo lasar, te risioroto eilo monekie oishorua ilo tung'ani le Nkai to rorei lo Laitoriani.

English: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Masaai: Keiguanare ninye iloreren kumok nedung'oki enkiguana iloshon oogol oo lakua; neidong ninche ilalema lenye aaitaa ntokitin naaturishoreki neitaa iremeta enye ntokitin naasilieki enkurma; nemeitoki olosho adumaki olosho olalem, nemeigil aekata aaitamok ate olarrabal.

English: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
Masaai: Nejoki ilapolosak o loibonok lelo kituaak o lelo tung'ana pooki, “Eishaakino ele endung'okinoto e nkiguana e keeya, enkaraki naibonoko te ntorroni ena anasa, anaa enitoning'o too nkiyiaa inyi.”

English: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Lawi te risioroto oo ishoritin enye: Gershon, Kohas, o Merari, ore larin le nkishui e Lawi naa ilarin iip o tomoni uni o oopishana.

English: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
Masaai: Neitashe Solomon te dukuya ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki neilepie nkaik enyena aitorioo.

English: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Aira iyie oleng'ae? Naa kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejo ninye, “Ara nanu olbarnoti le Misiri, osinka lo Lamaleki; naatung'uayie nanu olkitok enkaraki natamueyia too nkolong'i uni naatulusoitie.

English: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
Masaai: kake mejing ninche atua aapuo aaing'or nena tokitin naasinya hoo te nkata ninye nabo, pee meye ake.”

English: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.
Masaai: Keure apa Saul Daudi, amu etii Olaitoriani te nebo ninye kake etung'uayie Saul.

English: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Binui, naa iip ile o artam o isiet.

English: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Kaa eitanapa intae Musa?”

English: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
Masaai: Amu etisiraki ti atua Ilkigerot aajo, “Ng'ura airragie te Sion Osoit kitok lo lmairroto, ogeluno negol enkinyiang'a, ore pooki oiruk nemeitukurruni.”

English: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Te seriani iyie ilo aye.’ Naa ore apa anaa enatapejoki enkorropil too loo papaai lino, lelo aiguanak apa ootii te dukuya iyie, neijia kipuoi aaiko aapejoki enkorropil, nikinchiraki iyie, ejo, “Aha, Olaitoriani!” ’ Amu airoro nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
Masaai: Aishoo nanu intae enkop neitu iekarere, o nkanas neitu ishetishete, nibikitoto intae ti atua ninche ninyanya ilng'anayio le nkurma o sabibu leitu iunuunu.’

English: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
Masaai: Ore ninche naa iltipot ooiduruk ti atua isiruai linyi le nyorrata epeipeeno te nebo meeta osul negolie ate meeta isura. Inkatampo nemeeta enkare, naaya osiwuo, o lkeek lemeeta ilng'anayio te siadi ari ootuata katitin are, ootadotuoki.

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
Masaai: eiteleiki enkaina enye endukuya eilo asar lenye, neyieng ninye te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo; ore lelo ayiok le Aron neisuaaki osarge ilo perere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
Masaai: Neaku eipang'a apa ninche aaing'uaa emanyisho e Kora, o Datan o Abiram; neipang'u Datan o Abiram nepuonu aaitashe te kutukaji oo lng'oborri lenye, te nebo nkituaak enye, o layiok lenye, o nkera enye kutiti.

English: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
Masaai: Kake eitu eitiship ena Yona tukul, etagore ninye oleng.

English: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
Masaai: Naishooyie nanu ile Lawi anaa enkishoroto aisho Aron o layiok lenyena, aitung'uaa iltung'ana le Israel, pee eas enkisiaayiare te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitobir osotua lo lningo te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, pee mejing ake olmeitai atua iltung'ana le Israel te nelo nenyikaki iltung'ana le Israel enkaji e Nkai.”

English: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
Masaai: Neimaa Pisidia, nepuonu Pamfilia.

English: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
Masaai: etiaaka olbalusui ninche pee mejing ninche enkinosata eina daa sinyati aisul, ometaba anaa nedumunye olapolosani oata Urim o Tummim.

English: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo obo le lelo apolosak apa ootaarayioki te Samaria nelotu abik te Betel, neiteng'en ninche eneiko teneureyu Olaitoriani.

English: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
Masaai: Nchoo metukurru nemilo lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai! Nchoo meibelekenyi ninche nesuli, lelo ooyieu naainyal!

English: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
Masaai: Ore pee etumo esiamo kitok aaiturrurro, nesotokino lelo le nena ang'itie pooki, neiro alimu enkitanyaanyukoto,

English: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
Masaai: Naaku nanu papaai lenye, neaku ninye olayioni lai. Te neas ninye entorroni, naitame nanu ninye te ng'udi e tung'ana, o too oshot e tung'ana;

English: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD'S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
Masaai: Impotuo iyie ninche anaa iloopuonu osirua otegeluaki, neimu olkirutoto lai pooki shoto; naa ore teina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani meetae oloimishe arashu oloshomo eishu. Ore lelo apa latanapa naitubulu eidaikie olmang'atinta lai.

English: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
Masaai: Nedoyio Petero alo enetii lelo tung'ana, nejoki, “Ng'ura, nanu ele doi ling'oruru; ainyoo nayawua intae?”

English: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
Masaai: Naitoki taa aiturrur olpisiai le luaata ai aitung'uaa nena kuapi apa naterewa ninche naa kepuo neponari.

English: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
Masaai: Kulo apa ilayiok le Abihail olayioni le Huri olayioni le Yaroa, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Mikael, olayioni le Yeshishai, olayioni le Yohado, olayioni le Buus;

English: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata etaa nanu kalo anaa enapuo iltung'ana pooki, niyiololo intae too ltauja linyi o te nkishui inyi, intae pooki, nchere, meetae embae hoo nabo neitu ebaya te nena baa pooki sidain naaisiligishore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ti alo intae, eetuo pooki aabaya te nkaraki intae, meetae hoo nabo neitu ebaya.

English: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
Masaai: Eetae osesen obo o Enkiyang'et nabo anaa ina ake naipotokoki intae ilo siligi obo le ina kipototo inyi,

English: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Meeu empiris enitii o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron te naipuk, nejo “Ataasa eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi o te ntae.

English: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
Masaai: Atua lelo soito oopuyiapui lo earata ninye erubata ino; ninche, eluata ino; amu ninche iyie itubukoko olasar ooki, iyaua iyie olasar le ntapa. Kaaitiship nanu kuna tokitin?

English: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
Masaai: Kake etejo Daudi, “Kaa nanu aaporoki intae, intae ilayiok le Seruiya, nchere itiuu intae ena olong anaa ilmang'ati te nanu? Keari pooki ng'ae metua te Israel ena olong? Amu aimayiolo nanu nchere ara nanu ena olong olaiguanani le Israel?”

English: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
Masaai: Paa aijojo memitu ninye Enkai ilgelunot lenyena, ooishiraki dama o kewarie? Ijojo keimutie ti alo ninche?

English: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
Masaai: Eikisiaai ninche iyie neas enkisiaayiare pooki e ilo ng'obor; kake menyikaki ninche nena masaa e ine wueji sinyati aashu enyiku aapuonu olperere lo lasar, meye ake ninche aashu iye iyie.

English: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
Masaai: o ematua nabo e tomon te pooki sitima le lelo sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan;

English: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

English: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, emiruk enkiyang'et ake pooki, kake entetem nkiyang'eta pee idolidolo te naa eine Nkai; amu etijing'a enkop iloibonok kumok le lejare.

English: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
Masaai: airrugo nanu aing'or enkaji ino sinyati naisho enashe enkarna ino te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino; amu ilepie aitulus te pooki enkarna ino o rorei lino.

English: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Petero amiki, ore ina kata neru olkuku.

English: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
Masaai: nintawang'isho te dukuya Efraim o Benchamen o Manase, tuputu enkidimata ino, nilotu aitajeu iyiook!

English: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
Masaai: Aibung nanu inkiguanat inono o enchakenisho ino, amu etii nkoitoi aainei pooki dukuya iyie.

English: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
Masaai: Te nadamu nanu nkiguanat inono ebaiki apa moitie, naitagoluo nanu, Olaitoriani.

English: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong, nepuo Petero o Yohana enkaji e Nkai saa naaudo etushuke enkolong, te nkata e nkomono.

English: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
Masaai: Nainyiang'u nanu ina kurma natii Anatot te Hanamel olayioni lo lenkapu lai, naipimoki ninye mpisai naaji shekeli tomon oopishana enkosholai.

English: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip neyau nena pisai naatelekutua dukuya olaiguanani o Yehoida. Neitobiraki nena pisai imasaa e nkaji o Laitoriani, tenkaraki enkisiaayiare o lasarri oopejori, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ntokitin e sahabu o enkosholai. Neitayu ninche ilasarri oopejori tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani anaake too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoida.

English: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eisis enkarna o Laitoriani amu enkarna enye ake kitok; etii enkitoo enye shumata keper o enkop.

English: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priest and the scribes and the elders.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata, eton eirorita, nelotu Yudas, obo le lelo tomon o aare, neiriamunore ninye empuoto neeta lalema o siaren, eirriutua ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak o lpayiani.

English: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
Masaai: Megiroo oloiteng'eni oloiteng'en; kake ore eidipaki aaiteng'ena netiu anaa oloiteng'ena ninye.

English: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
Masaai: Neriku Musa Aron o layiok lenyena neituku ninche te nkare.

English: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
Masaai: o Yahas, o Kedemot o Mefaat,

English: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
Masaai: Ore nena wuejitin e shumata e Afen, ina ng'oki e Israel, naa keidaikieki. Kebulu ilkiku o laimerrerruani te nchumata lelo perereni lenye loo lasarri; naa kepuo ninche aajoki ildoinyo, Entemoi iyiook, nejoki indoinyo, enturokinoto iyiook.

English: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i naapishana iyie mbung'a osirua lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, teine wueji negelu Olaitoriani Enkai ino; amu eikimayian Olaitoriani Enkai ino te pooki nintayu o te siaai pooki oo nkaik inono, pee itumoki ating'idayu tukul.

English: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en nedolu batisho neisudoo kewan; kake ore ilo omoda nelo adoiki netum enkitamioto.

English: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel tadekenya nepuo aaitayu ilng'oborri te nkipirakinoto e Gibea.

English: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
Masaai: Miasiasa intae terisioroto e kuna pooki nikiaasita iyiook tene taata, easita ake pooki tung'ani enaba anaa enaishiakino too nkonyek enyena makewan,

English: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
Masaai: Nelikioo ninye ejo, “Elotu te siadi nanu ologol laalang nanu olaa kaamakua te nairrugokino alak enkeene e namuke enye.

English: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, neisho Olaitoriani olakordunoni te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, laa ninye apa otokordua ninche Otiniel olayioni le Kenas, olalashe oti le Kaleb.

English: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
Masaai: Aainosita nanu olom, enkaraki narikino ilmang'ati laainei irorei linono.

English: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD.
Masaai: Amu etii apa ilkumok teina umata leitu eitisiny ate. Ore enkaraki ina eteyiang'a Ilawi ilkuoo le kera te pooki ng'ae leitu eitisinyi, pee eitaae sinyati to Laitoriani.

English: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
Masaai: Ore olosho le Benchamen neishori Geba tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Alemet tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Anatot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo. Ore nkanas enye pooki too lmareita lenye naa tomon oo kuni.

English: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
Masaai: Neitorioo enkaina enye neiseyie nejoki, “Ekayieu, ninchiu tisikayu.” Neishiu asika nabo kata ina keeya oo lbolot.

English: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
Masaai: Iwa enkila eilo tung'ani otonyorrayie aitasheiki esile olomoni, nimbung ninye tena nyorrata natonyorrayie aitasheiki esile oo lomon.

English: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
Masaai: Neibalunye ninche enkolong naeni aapukoo, neisho Nabot enkitoo aaitulusoo too ltung'ana.

English: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa Balaam tadekenya, neirot esikiria enye, nelo te nebo lelo kituaak le Moab.

English: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
Masaai: niya iyie intoyie enye ayamaki ilayiok linono, neas intoyie enkiborra oo nkonyek esujaa nkaitin enye neitasuroki ilayiok linono enkibor oo nkonyek esujaa nkaitin enye.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaarare nanu Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, naa kagil inkaik enyena, pokira are, aa ina nagol o ina natigile; naa kaisho olalem lenye epuku te nkaina enye.

English: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
Masaai: Nemurat Abraham enkayioni enye Isaak etaa oloo nkolong'i isiet, te inoto, anaa enaitanapa Enkai ninye.

English: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Aron anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; ore te dukuya Farao o te dukuya ilaisiaayiak lenyena, neilepie ninye eng'udi neosh ina are apa natii atua olkeju le Nail; ore ina are pooki apa natii atua olkeju le Nail newala ina are pooki apa natii atua olkeju le Nail aaku osarge.

English: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
Masaai: ore too le Sebulon, naa Ishmaia olayioni le Obadia, ore too le Naftali, naa Yeremot olayioni le Asriel;

English: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.
Masaai: Naa keirriwari empalai e ilo kigeroto iloshon pooki pee eitanapi metolikini iltung'ana pooki meterretenata te ina olong.

English: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
Masaai: Ore too nkitanapat inono natum nanu eyiolounoto; ore enkaraki ina kaiba nanu pooki oitoi torrono.

English: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
Masaai: Neirrugo Betsheba aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop, neisho olaiguanani enkanyit, nejo, “Metobikoi olkitok lai olaiguanani Daudi ntarasi!”

English: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Olaitoriani ninye neing'urrie nejoki, “Minchir.”

English: And Saul sware to her by the LORD, saying, As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.
Masaai: Kake einosaka Saul ninye olmumai to Laitoriani ejo, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, melotu enkitamioto shumata iyie tena bae.”

English: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki oilepie kewan neitadouni, ore oloitadou kewan neilepieki.”

English: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau Festo, ina kop naitore, nkolong'i uni ake naatulusoitie, nedumunye te Kaisaria ailep alo Yerusalem.

English: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
Masaai: ilo arikoni te wueji neji Kasifia, neliki ninche enapuo aajoki Ido o lalashera lenyena lelo sinkan le nkaji e Nkai, te wueji neji Kasifia, aa taa, pee eirriwakini iyiook ilaisiaayiak te nkaraki e nkaji e Nkai.

English: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
Masaai: Ore ejo neijia, nelotu oltung'ani oing'uaa enkaji e ilo kitok le nkaji e ntumo, nejoki, “Etua esila ino; mintoki aintanyamal olaiteng'enani.”

English: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani ke nkata nabaa aishir nanu te nkaraki eretoto, nimining iyie? Aishir nanu ajo olarrabal! neitu iyie kintajeu?

English: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ira iyie sinyati, niton iyie te nkitoo e nkisisa e Israel.

English: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana Saul, “Keye Yonatan laa ninye oisula te nkisulata sapuk e Israel? Ekelakua ina! Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, meetae ninye olpapita le ndukuya enye odoiki enkop; amu etaasishe ninye te nebo Enkai ena olong.” Neaku eitopuaa iltung'ana Yonatan, metaa eitu eye.

English: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
Masaai: Meeta nchere mikiye pooki, kitiu iyiook anaa enkare naisuaakaki enkop, nemeitoki asotunoyu; kake meitayu Enkai enkishui e ilo oing'oru nkoitoi pee mepal ilo lenye oararo metaa oloiturrayioki.

English: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore ntokitin pooki naaokishoreki o laiguanani Solomon naa ine sahabu, ore imasaa pooki eina aji entim e Lebanon naa ine sahabu nasila. Meikenari apa enkosholai aajo toki too nkolong'i e Solomon.

English: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
Masaai: Nejing ninye atua empeut te nebo ninche negira osiwuo. Neirriang pooki,

English: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
Masaai: naisho nanu intae enchan inyi too rishat enye, netum enkop atoisho ore ilkeek le nkurma neiu ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
Masaai: Ore pee eriku ilo tung'ani lelo tung'ana atua enkaji e Yosef, neishoo ninche enkare, neisuja inkejek enye, neidipa sii aishoo isirkon lenye olkujita onya.

English: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
Masaai: Mikilam iyie nanu, amu etataana enyamali nemeeta likae laaretu.

English: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
Masaai: Nejo ilo arriponi: “Kelotu enkakenya nelotu sii enkewarie. Te naa e ilo aikilikuanisho, nkilikuanisho; nyaaki torrinyunye.”

English: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
Masaai: Teneishoru ninye olkuoo le ker aitaa olasar lenye, neishoru ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
Masaai: Ore pee eshukunye Ruben enaduoo gumoto nedol ajo meekure etii ine, nepolos inkilani enyena tosina sapuk,

English: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
Masaai: (Kejo apa lelo le Sidon oldoinyo le Hermon Sirioni, nejo ile Amori Senir).

English: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
Masaai: Neya Abraham ilkeek ooinokieki olasar opejori, neiteleiki oloililai le Isaak enkayioni enye. Nenap te nkaina enye enkima o enkalem. Nepuo pokira are aairiamari.

English: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana le Israel te Beerot Beneyaakan ometabaiki Mosera. Neye Aron teine naa teine etunukayioki; Neisiaisho olayioni lenye Eliesa anaa olapolosani te rishata enye.

English: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
Masaai: Ore olmodai naa keiro alimu engoro enye pooki, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en neitirring'a aibooyo.

English: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore te ina olong ake epuo aare lenye enkang naji Emmaus, naa mael naapishana ing'uaa Yerusalem,

English: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
Masaai: Naa Ilyunani kulikae ooetuo aaseremisho te ilo sirua.

English: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
Masaai: Ore kitung'uaitie ninche nikiked emeli, nikintoriounye aapuonu Kos, ore te nkolong nasuju nikibau Rodos, nikidumunye te ine nikipuonu Patara.

English: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
Masaai: Ore too lotot aainei nemayeng'iyeng'a, nanoto batisho too lkejek, batisho too laisimak, batisho to lorere lang, batisho too ltung'ana loo Loreren, batisho ti atua enkanasa, batisho ti ong'ata, batisho ti atua enaiposha, batisho ti atua lelo ooitaakuno lalashera.

English: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
Masaai: Ore iila inono naaputishoreki naa kerropil oleng, ore enkarna ino naa eilata nabukuno; metaa aikinyor iyie intoyie.

English: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
Masaai: Kake te naishu to sesen, neaku ina lng'anayio le siaai ai kake mayiolo ajo kaa adutaa.

English: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie iyie eng'udi e nkitoria te nkaina enye, ninang'aki olorika lenye le nkitoo enkop.

English: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
Masaai: ore lelo ooinyang enkop netiu anaa lemeeta eneinyang; amu kelusoo empukunoto ena kop o mbaa enyena pooki.

English: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
Masaai: Kake ore anaa enatonyorrayie iyiook Enkai neisiligaki too Lomon Supati, neijia kijo iyiook neme pee kintiship iltung'ana, kake pee kintiship Enkai naineneng iltauja lang.

English: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
Masaai: ilo oyau ngarrin o mbartan, o lakedok o enjore; neirragie te nkop, nemeitoki aadumunye, neiliilaa ninche anaa oltaa:

English: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
Masaai: Etii apa Kaisaria, oltung'ani oji Kornelio, laa osajini kitok te sikari oo Roma naji, “Esirit oo Ltalian.”

English: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Naa tenenotaki ilo oata osupetai oltung'ani lemeiduruk, nelo ninye aituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare neton ninye eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
Masaai: Metaa etijing'ua ilo tung'ani atua aji, nelaku Laban ilolan too ntamesin, neisho ninye ninche endaa oo ntamesin. Neisho sii ninye enkare naisujie inkejek enyena o tenebo lelo oiriamunore.

English: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ina peyie aaitadamu nchere nyaaki ntopiu enkishoroto e Enkai natii atua iyie ninoto apa te nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik aainei.

English: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee mejing'aa intae nchere mme mukateni aimaka? Kake entorrip ate te nkisuijo oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.”

English: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
Masaai: naa iyie sii, Olaitoriani, ina nyorrata nauno. Amu ilaaki iyie oltung'ani te risioroto e siaai enye.

English: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
Masaai: Errumoo ninche ilo aisinani aaiwuang'ie te nkoitoi ore ilaisinak pooki le nkop neisudoo ate.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ing'ura ajo kaarare lelo airritak; naa kayieu nanu intare aainei too nkaik enye, naiting'ie te ninche ina kitotio enye oo ntare; meigil ae kata ilairritak aaitoti ate. Ekaitajeu nanu intare aainei too nkutukie enye, peyie meitoki aaku endaa te ninche.

English: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
Masaai: Ejoki, “Kristo, imbonoki yiook, ai ng'ae likitoosho?”

English: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
Masaai: Nimiatata olkep te ndung'okinoto e nkiguana; entoning oltung'ani oti o lkitok, tenkitorisiokinoto; miureyu enkomom o ltung'ani amu ore endung'okinoto enkiguana naa ene Nkai, ore ilo rorei ogol te iyie niyau enatii nanu, naa kaning nanu,’

English: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
Masaai: Ore ina taboi enye nerrinyokino enkorrok enye makewan, naa endukuya enye makewan edoiki entaboi enye.

English: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia ajoki Isaya, “Ore ilo rorei lo Laitoriani liroro naa aisidai. Neijia etiu, eetae eseriani o enkitirring'a too nkolong'i aainei.”

English: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
Masaai: Nilo taa aas anaa enikimbalakinye ninche teine wueji negelu Olaitoriani; ning'or pee ias nena pooki nikiutaki ninche;

English: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aya emborei e nkaina e ilo asar le ntapa anaa erubata enye nadamuni, nepej ninye te nchumata o lperere lo lasar; ore te siadi neitoki aitook ina kitok enkare.

Masaai: Ore enkurriny pooki eilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki neitayu ninye, ina kurriny naimulumul isorri e nkoshoke o ina kurriny pooki e nkoshoke,

English: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
Masaai: amu eidipa aishiunye lkumok, metaa keiding'akino lelo pooki oomueiaa ejo maiseyie.

English: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
Masaai: Naa aitum empijan amu etii osiligi; naa aikirripi nilo ayeng'iyeng'a te seriani.

English: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
Masaai: o Yoel olalashe le Natan, o Mibar olayioni le Hagri,

English: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
Masaai: Neikilikuan ajoki, “Eira ng'ae, Olaitoriani.” Nejoki, “Ara Yesu linosie osina;

English: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye aajo kira iyiook ile sipata, nikintadedeyie ltauja lang te dukuya ninye,

English: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
Masaai: Etaa apa Abraham olpayian kitok otobikoyie ilarin kumok oleng', netamayiana Olaitoriani Abraham te pooki toki.

English: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
Masaai: Eiking'oruru intae nanu nikitumutumu; teniking'oruru to ltauja linyi pooki,

English: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Onan, “Nchooki nanu olkurroto oiutuutishoreki pee ashetie olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani timirakaki nanu te nkinyiang'a nalulung'a, pee etumi aaiwuang'ie olmeitai too ltung'ana.”

English: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
Masaai: Ng'ura lelo oing'ok, eishirita ninche ti auluo; ore lelo balusuni le seriani, neishirita te mion.

English: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
Masaai: Ore peyie ebau enkata najing aji neiu ilmao te ishoi.

English: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
Masaai: Irukoki inchere atii nanu atua Papa, netii Papa atua nanu: aashu naa kiruk te nkaraki oo siaaitin ate.

English: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
Masaai: Wooi ninche lelo ooruk nkajijik, lelo ooponiki ate ilchampai, o metaba anaa neishunye pooki wueji, nikintaae iyie oloton openy te mpolos e nkop.

English: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie iyiook maibelekenyata aailany ilmang'ati lang; ore lelo mang'ati lang neibung aaraya masaa ang.

English: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
Masaai: “pee eitobirari mbaa inono nibik inkolong'i kumok te nkop.”

English: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana loo loreren ootii atua ninche netum kuuru oleng, neitoki sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaishir nejo, “Oi napaji kitum nkiri nikinos!

English: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
Masaai: “Intanapa ae olong entadekenya anaa ninteru nkolong'i inono, nincho entadekenya metayiolo ewueji enye.

English: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
Masaai: Iyaua apa iyie iltung'ana linono Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri too lmonek o too nenking'asia, te nkaina nagol naitoriori, o to lkirutoto sapuk;

English: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan nejoki ninche ina kitok e Samson, “Ilejileja olmoruo lino metoliki iyiook nchere kainyoo ilo oyiote mikipejoo ake iyie o enkaji e papaai lino te nkima. Ntoomono apa iyiook pee itumutumu aawaita imasaa ang?”

English: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Aidipa nanu aibatisa intae te nkare kake te Nkiyang'et Sinyati eibatisa ninye intae.”

English: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
Masaai: Neeta apa Delila iltung'ana ooisudori ti atua olgilata ti aji. Nejoki Delila Samson, “Kipuonu Lfilisti aaibung, Samson!” Nedung ninye nena pi anaa usin naaibung'a enkima. Neaku meyioloi apa enkisudoroto e ngolon enye.

English: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
Masaai: Etii keeya o enkishui atua engolon olng'ejep, ore lelo oonyor ninye naa keinos ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
Masaai: Eyukuyukori enkop anaa olamerani, etotiuo anaa enkaji nakutita osiuo; etii nkitarruorot enyena shumata ninye, naa kenang'aa ninye nemeigil adumunye.

English: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani nkolong'i naaba anaa naishu; arany nanu enkisisa e Nkai ai eton aishu.

English: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
Masaai: Ore Asa o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninche, nesujaa ninche o meitabaiki Gerar. Nebatata ile Etiopia o metaa meetae obo otelekua eishu; amu etigilaki ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani o enjore enye. Nenap iltung'ana le Yuda intokitin kumok oleng naatarutua.

English: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kairriu nanu tiatua intae ilasuriaa o nturbubuani naata esayiet nemeibooyo intalengo, naa keony ninche intae.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
Masaai: Ore tioriong ilo karasha le nchakenisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nepik Aron ine aitobiraki ebaiki teipa ometaa tadekenya dukuya Olaitoriani anaake; keaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
Masaai: Ina pee epuo ing'uesi entim irrumati lenye, neitirring'a too lkutot lenye.

English: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
Masaai: Olaitoriani otii shumata alus too nkuapi pooki, nelusoo enkitoo enye te keper!

English: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i naapishana, neiput olairrag sapuk le nkare shumata enkop.

English: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
Masaai: neiu Solomon Rehoboam; neiu Rehoboam Abiya; neiu Abiya Asa;

English: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Masaai: Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna baa? Olaitoriani ojo; naa aimaitalaku nanu to losho laaijo ele?

English: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
Masaai: Naa kaitupuku ninche too loreren, naiturrurru ninche too nkuapi naa kayau ninche enkop enye maate; naa kaitoti ninche too ldoinyo le Israel, too nkiyopat e nena shorroi, o too wuejitin pooki neemanyae eina kop.

English: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
Masaai: Ore apa pee ening Adoni-sedek olaiguanani le Yerusalem eneikuna Yoshua pee eibung Ai, neidaikie ninye katukul, aitaas Ai o laiguanani lenye anaa apa enaitaasa Yeriko o laiguanani lenye, o ina naitobira lelo oomanya Gibeon eseriani o Israel netii atua ninche.

English: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu lelo rorei pooki, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena,

English: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
Masaai: ntanapa ninye tabaraki too ntare inono, te wueji neidong'ishoreki, o te neironyishoreki, ore anaa enikitamayiana Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nchoo iyie ninye.

English: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
Masaai: Anaa nchoo ninche eibung esarunoto ai, nchoo ninche eitobir osotua o nanu, nchoo ninche eitobir osotua o nanu.”

English: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
Masaai: Ore olkitok le nkitoria e Parsia aaibooyie nanu nkolong'i tikitam o obo; kake aaweuo Mikael aretu, ilo obo kitok loo lkituaak, neaku atung'uayie nanu ninye te ine te nebo ilo kitok le nkitoriae Parsia,

English: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
Masaai: Ina apa etaasa loo papaai linyi ina kata pee airriwaa nanu ninche te Kadesh-Barnea meshomo aadol ina kop.

English: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
Masaai: pee etum oltung'ani ataa keishu ntarasi, nemejing ae kata Engumoto.

English: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
Masaai: Neishori pooki te lelo olkila oibor, nejokini meyeng'iyeng'ata te nkiti kata, o metaba anaa neiputayu esiana e lelo ooisiaaishote te nebo ninche leton eitokini aar anaa apa ninche maate.

English: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
Masaai: Eeta apa Solomon iltung'ana tomon oare kituaak te Israel pooki, laa ninche ooisho olaiguanani endaa o lmarei lenye pooki; ore ake oltung'ani neishoru endaa to lapa obo to lari.

English: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
Masaai: Ekeipid ninye alo too naipuko anaa enkidetidet, nemetumoyu; kearari ninye aitalamaa anaa enduaata e nkewarie.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
Masaai: ore naa, nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Kairragie nanu te Sion osoit oaku olkitamanyunoto, osoit otujurruoki aatem, osoit ogol e nkinyiang'a lo lmairroto: ‘Ore ilo oiruk ninye nemeisarrisar.’

English: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
Masaai: Amu aatiaakita ninche nanu, ‘Ntobiraki iyiook nkaitin, naapuo te dukuya iyiook; amu ore ele Musa, ilo tung'ani oyaua iyiook ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo iyiook enatotiwuo te ninye.’

English: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
Masaai: Metaa meetae enjung'ore naibelekenyi aaitung'uaa olosho obo aaya olikae; amu ore ake pooki osho loo tung'ana le Israel neibung'are enjung'ore enye.’ ”

English: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
Masaai: olayioni le ntito e Dan, ore apa menye naa oltung'ani le Turo. Eiteng'enaki ninye pee easishore sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o esekenkei, o soito o nkeek, o muain pooki pilei o mpusi, o nkilani naanyokie o kitani napuyiapui. Neas mpukunot pooki e nguetare nedamu enkipirunoto ake ninye naishooki ninye meipiru. Keaku lelo tung'ana linono arriyiak tenebo iltung'ana arriyiak lo lkitok lai Daudi papaai lino.

English: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
Masaai: Ti nintorioo nkaik inyi, naisudoo nkonyek aainei te ntae; ore hoo niomonono katitin kumok, mainining nanu; ebore nkaik inyi osarge.

English: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Masaai: Ore etaa Noa oloo larin iip imiet, neaku menye le Shem, o Ham, o Shafet.

English: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
Masaai: “Shomo naa tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nimbung enkitanapata enye, o nkikoot enyena o nkiguanat enyena, o nkitanapat enyena anaake.

English: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
Masaai: Nejokino Lyahudi maate, “Kaji ejo pee elo, nimikitumie? Kejo pee elo enetii Lyahudi ooidapashakinote Ilyunani, nelo aiteng'en Ilyunani?

English: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
Masaai: kang'idakino nanu Yerusalem, nashipakino iltung'ana laainei; meigili ae kata aaning ti atua ninye oltoilo le nkishirata, anaa olkiyioi lo sina.

English: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
Masaai: Neitu easi ina metii olmumai.

English: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening, nejo, “Meyieu ilememuei olabaani, kake iloomuoi ooyieu.

English: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
Masaai: Naa ele kigeroto otisiraki: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, o PARSIN.

English: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
Masaai: Ore ena kata edung'o tau (amu etua), neipot enkarna enye ajo Benoni; kake eipoto menye enkarna enye ajo Benchamen.

English: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
Masaai: Nejoki Ilyahudi ninye, “Kitisiputua taata aajo iata oloirirua. Etua Abraham neijia sii etiu iloibonok le Nkai, eji nijo iyie, ‘Ore pooki ng'ae oibung ororei lai meishamisham ai kata keeya?’

English: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
Masaai: Nedol Elisha ina bae, neishir ajo, “Papaai lai! Papaai lai! ngarrin oo mbartan e Israel o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan!” Neitu ninye eitoki adol Eliya. Neitoki ninye aibung ilkilani lenyena, nepolos aitaa are.

English: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
Masaai: Ore eyia, iyiolo iyie Olaitoriani ilnukat lenye laarieki nanu matua. Mipalaki ninche entorroni enye, nimijut eng'oki enye too nkonyek inono. Nchoo ninche metanang'ari te dukuya iyie; ntaasa ninche te nkata engoro ino.

English: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i naaitoreisho ilarishak, netii olameyu enkop, ore oltung'ani obo le Betlehem ti atua enkop e Yuda nelo amany enkop e Moab. Eshomo ninye te nebo enkitok enye o layiok lenyena oare.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
Masaai: Ore te ina te neiwuang'a ilo ola lenye to loililai lino, negili ina shata enye emurt nanapishoreki te murt ino.”

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Imeyieu iltung'ana biyot olabaani, iloomuoi ooyieu.

English: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy, whether he be of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates:
Masaai: “Mimbooki enkop olaisiaayiani aisinani oigeroki aa obo loo lalashera linono aashu aa obo loo lomon ootii enkop inyi, atua nkang'itie inyi;

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Masaai: ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o sitiman imiet le kineji, o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Elishama olayioni le Amihud.

English: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
Masaai: Kake ore hoo neyau osina, ketum ninye olng'ur, te risioroto e sapuko e nyorrata enye nauno;

English: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
Masaai: Kake etirishie Elimas, (amu nejia eji ewalunoto e nkarna enye), ilo taa kuyantiki ejo pee eng'adie ilo balusui enkirukoto.

English: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
Masaai: Amaa tinira iyie asipani ainyoo inchoo ninye; arashu ainyoo doi eng'amu ninye te nkaina ino?

English: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, atotiuo nanu anaa olasai to Efraim natiu anaa oltiapurusi te nkaji e Yuda.

English: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
Masaai: Eyaua Efraim embae naitagorisho oleng; neaku ore Olaitoriani lenye, keing'uaa ina kitarrurroto o sarge te shumata ninye, nerrinyoki ninye ina kurruna enye.

English: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
Masaai: Metaa mira doi olanaarri Misiri oirrikia olorere meitarrikinore sirkali nerik ilapa tung'ana asesesekuanak nkalifuni ong'uan ong'ata?”

English: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
Masaai: Naa Hikia osuju, naa Tebalia oliokuni naa Sekaria oliong'uan; ore ilayiok pooki o lalashera le Hosa naa tomon oo kuni.

English: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
Masaai: Neaku toning'o enkitobirata naitobira Olaitoriani agilunore Babilon, o yieunot naaipirua ninye agilunore enkop oo Lkaldayo. Esipa ore lelo ooti le luaata enye naa keingirtitori aaya; esipa ore eluaata enye naa keiputukuny.

English: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
Masaai: Ore apa te ilo ari oewunye ilo kitok le njore, oirriwua Sargon ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu Ashdod, neitainye olarrabal neya ninye

English: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooyanyit nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e pesho neituraa enkisiligata enye nasipa.

English: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
Masaai: Netum ninye oltagiligili oshal lo sikiria, neitorioo enkaina adumu, ore te ilo tagiligili nesesekuan iltung'ana enkalifu.

English: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Tera ilarin ntomoni naapishana etaa ninye menye le Abram, o Nahor o Haran.

English: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
Masaai: Ore taata mbaa nikidol netiu anaa naairupurup ti atua kiok, kake ore te idia kata nikiduaa nkomomi; melulung'a taata eng'eno ai, kake ore idia kata naitululung ayiolou, anaa ena aaitululung'a Enkai ayiolou nanu.

English: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
Masaai: Etung'uayie ninye orrumat linyi anaa olng'atuny, amu etaa enkop enye mitil tenkaraki ilo alem leilo oitorogonyisho, o tenkaraki engoro enye napi.”

English: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
Masaai: anaa enasira te mbuku e Isaya oloiboni le Nkai ajo, “Oltoilo lo lobuakita ti ong'ata, entobiraki Olaitoriani enkoitoi, entorioi irrekiei lenyena

English: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eibelekenya Yehu apaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa te ninche apa aitapong'oyie Isiraeli, meteserema ilasho le sahabu te Betel o te Dan.

English: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
Masaai: Neitayu enaiposha ilootuata ootii atua ninye. Neitayu keeya o ene meneng'a ninche neiguanareki ninche too naataasa.

English: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
Masaai: kake to sarge ogol enkinyiang'a le Kristo, otiu anaa olkuoo lemeeta entiyoto anaa entibili.

English: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
Masaai: Ore te ine ninchirishiri nionyionyo lala, idolidolo Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo o loibonok le Nkai pooki etii enkitoria e Nkai nimanikiki ate etanang'ayioki ntae auluo.

English: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
Masaai: Mme olmang'atinta laatusukenya nanu, amu anaata nanu airisha; ime ilo laaiba oitokoos ti alo nanu - amu anaata nanu ashomo aisudori.

English: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
Masaai: “Erridutu, amu etinyikua enkitoria e shumata.”

English: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
Masaai: Nenap ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai te ngarri ng'ejuk, aaitung'uaa enkaji e Aminadab, naa Usa, o Ahio apa ooreu ina garri.

English: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
Masaai: Kake euno Lkigerot nchere eena pooki toki too ng'ok, paa ina kisiligata, naa te nkirukoto ti atua Yesu Kristo eitashe, eishori lelo ake ooiruk.

English: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
Masaai: Ore naa taata emimenaa, pee meitirrishi ake ienat inyi, amu atoning'oyie nanu endung'okinoto e nkiguana e mutai, eing'uaa Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, eipirta enkop pooki.

English: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
Masaai: intae lelo ooitashe ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, too lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai ang!

English: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yakobo menye, “Nanu doi Esau olkikau lino. Aidipa ataasa anaa enikitiaka. Inyo totona inosa inkiri oo ng'uesi aainei peyie kitum atamayiana.”

English: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
Masaai: nelo aning mbaa nemelimunoyu, nemeishoro oltung'ani meiroro.

English: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:
Masaai: Ore iyie, laaiguanani, intobira enkitanapata, nchere ore pooki tung'ani oning oltoilo le mowuo, o endule, o lwulul loo usin, o enkinanta nanyaanyukie olwulul, o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, o lbene okuti te ndule, o pooki pukunoto o sinkolio naa kebatata aserem ina kitanyaanyukoto e sahabu;

English: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
Masaai: Ti atua iyiook etupukutuo aapuo, kake mme ilkulalang apake, amu te naa eilkulalang apa, anaata etotona aaisiritore iyiook; kake etupukutuo aapuo, pee eibalayu nchere mme lkulalang lelo pooki.

English: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Maarat, o Bet-anot, o Eltekon: nkanas ile te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entapalakaki eng'oki ai, atoomono ntae, ena kata ake, nikiomonokiki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi peyie eiwuang'ie ake ninye ena keeya te nanu.”

English: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
Masaai: Ore pee etum, neiteleiki oloililai, eshipa.

English: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
Masaai: Neaku eikena apa Musa ninche te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, anaa enaitanapaki.

English: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
Masaai: Inchoo ake obo lang too sinkan linono otumi eeta, enchoo eye, nikiaku sii iyiook pooki irrindiki lo lkitok lang.”

English: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
Masaai: Nepuku enkitoo Olaitoriani aing'uaa atua ina anasa, neitashe te nchumata oldoinyio otii enkalo oloo saen eina anasa.

English: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
Masaai: Kake kisilig apa iyiook aajo ninye olaku Siraeli. Ee pae naa ore etii nena pooki, enkolong e uni duoo taata anaa netiu nena baa.

English: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Natan olaiguanani, “Shomo, taasa ina pooki natii atua oltau lino; amu etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie.”

English: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
Masaai: Ore ake peyie edol Farao ajo eishunye enchan, o enchan oo soito o enkikurrukur neigil aas eng'oki, neitagol oltau lenye, ninye o laisiaayiak lenyena.

English: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
Masaai: Nejoki taa Petero, “Kaji etiu pee itoning'okinote intae aatem Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani? Ng'ura nenena nkejek oo laduoo ooshomo aanukaa olpayian lino naatii kutuk aji, naa iyie sii epuonu aaipung'ie aaya.”

English: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
Masaai: Ore inaaing'uaa ilo pisiai te nkalo oo ltung'ana le Israel apa naategelayie Musa aitung'uaa ine lelo tung'ana apa ooshomo enjore

English: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eilepie ninye enkaina enye neiro olmumai ti alo ninche nchere keisho ninche metabatatata ti ong'ata,

English: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
Masaai: neikilikuanishore ninye Olaitoriani te nkaraki ninye, neisho ninye ndaiki, neisho ninye olalem le Goliat ilo Filisti.”

English: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
Masaai: Neyau ninche ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, oilo ng'obor, o nena tokitin pooki naasinya apa naatii atua ilo ng'obor, neyau ilapolosak o Lawi nena pooki.

English: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
Masaai: Newaliki aajoki ninye, “Aa Galilaya sii yie ing'uaa? Ing'oru tisipu: inchere meetae oloiboni opuku eing'uaa Galilaya.”

English: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
Masaai: Naa kalo nanu aitorioo te shumata Yerusalem olkereri le ntemat le Samaria, o latemani lo nkitorioroto le nkaji e Ahab, naa kajut nanu Yerusalem anaa enajut oltung'ani engirra najutu ninche aiwuang'ie naibelekenyu atua aing'orie oriong,

English: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Miureishoyu Yakobo, hoo niba anaa olkurto, lo tung'ana le Israel! Karetu nanu intae, Olaitoriani ojo; ilo Osinya le Israel ninye okordu intae.

English: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
Masaai: Tuutaki intamoo enkerai enkoitoi naim, ore pee eaku moruo nemeing'uaa ina oitoi.

English: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
Masaai: Kalo oiboni eitu einyal iloo minyi? Netara metuata lelo apa ooitera aalimu elotunoto e ilo obo supat, lietuo intae aaitarasaa niariaara metua;

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ilo Osinya le Israel, “Ti nishukunye ayeng'iyeng'a nikintajeuni; te nkitirring'ata o te nkisiligata elotu engolon ino.” Nimiyieuu intae.

English: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.
Masaai: “Olkitok lai olaiguanani, etaasa kulo tung'ana entorroni teina pooki naitaasa ninche Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai tesulakinoto natusulakitia ninye atua olchorro: naa keye ninye te sumash, amu meetae emukate natelekua tiatua ena anasa.”

English: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
Masaai: o Lamori, o Lkanaani, o Lgirgashi, o Lyebusi.”
