English: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
Masaai: naa kaponaa iltung'ana te iyie, enkaji pooki e Israel, ninye pooki; ore nena anas naa kemanyi ore iwuejitin mijoonto nesheti;

English: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
Masaai: Ore to lapa obo, naidaikie lelo shekuti okuni. Ataa nanu olemeeta eng'iriata te ninche, naaibayie sii.

English: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
Masaai: “Ore ilng'anayio ooituruku le lelo le dukuya le nkop ino iyau enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ino. Miyierie, olkuoo kule e ng'otonye.

English: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le onom oare le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Pekahia olayioni le Menahem aitore Isiraeli te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam.

English: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
Masaai: Ore ina kop e Yuda naa keaku entoki naiture ile Misiri; ore pooki tung'ani oba anaa ololikini neureishoyu, enkaraki ina naiguanua Olaitoriani pee egilunore ninche.

English: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
Masaai: Nedumu Daudi nkonyek enyena nedol olmalaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te rishata e nkop o shumata, neeta te nkaina enye olalem otushutuaki te nchashur neitoriokini shumata Yerusalem. Neishop Daudi olpayiani ilkuniyiani, nebatata too nkomomi enye.

English: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
Masaai: Ing'ura enda anasa nataana naa kiti sii, nchooki makuetiki ine aime kiti ninye? Naa keitajeuni enkishui ai.”

English: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Arabia. Too sanagi le Arabia intae ipuopuo aairrag, na tamesin oo le Dedan.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake mme sii anaa apa Daudi papaai lenye. Etaasa ninye too mbaa pooki anaa enataasa papaai lenye Yoash.

English: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
Masaai: maaibung ake anaa olng'atuny, naaing'irtitoo aanya, metii hoo obo laamitu.

English: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
Masaai: o Hodia, o Hashum, o Besai,

English: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae osukeny ilo aisinani, naa olaitobirani lenye etusukenya; ore ilo oshipa te ng'olikinoto nemelo eitu eitamei.

English: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
Masaai: Aata enaigeroko esirit; kake ore Diotrefes, ilo oyieu neiturukie kewan, meyieu naaning maitoria nanu.

English: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
Masaai: Kake te nkata apa nataa keishori Merab, entito e Saul, Daudi, neishori ninye Adriel ilo Meholati meitaa enkitok.

English: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
Masaai: Ore pee eitang'or ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani, neitu hoo ewaliki.

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: olkine obo oaku olasar loo ngok;

English: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
Masaai: Ore tininterre te nkolong e nyamali, naa aikiti eng'olon ino.

English: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Atoduaa osomit loo ltung'ana laainei ootii Misiri, natoning'o olkiyioi lenye te nkaraki ilaitasheikinok lenye; ayiolo olosilisili lenye,

English: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
Masaai: Neitanap ninye ilo kilikuai, ejo, “Ore ake pee indip ainosaki ilomon pooki lo larrabal olaiguanani,

English: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, “Aimiyiololo intae aajo olayioni lo laiguanani naa oltung'ani o Turori ena olong te Israel?

English: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
Masaai: Neyieng ninye ilo asar opejori nedung'udung aitaa rubat,

English: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
Masaai: Kaae, entoomon naa Olaitoriani le nkisampuare meirriu ilaisiaayiak atua enkisampuare enye.”

English: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king's decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aapuonu aanyiku nejo te dukuya olaiguanani, “Amaa, ti alo enkitanapata, la aiguanani! Keitu iyie ipik olmishire ina natoning'okinoteki; nchere ore pooki tung'ani osaisho tiae ai aashu te tung'ani ti atua nkolong'i tomoni uni meteleku ake te iyie, la aiguanani, nenang'akini atua eululu oo lng'atunyo?” Newal olaiguanani ajo, “Keuno ina bae, anaa enatiu enkitanapata oo Lmedi o enoo Lpasi, nena nemeidimi aaibelekenya.”

English: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
Masaai: Ore pee ilo iyie, nemetum enkeju ino olkob, naa tinikuet nimirrorro.

English: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani te nkima, ore ngarrin enyena nepuonu anaa olkutati, pee eitalaku engoro enye te mpijan, neisikong'isho too lng'ejepa le nkima.

English: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
Masaai: Netoduaa Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yosef eneirragieki ninye.

English: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia iyie Korasin! Ee kake ayia iyie Betsaida! Amu te naa ketaasaki apa te Tiro o Sidon nena e nking'asia naatasaki tiaatua intae, anaata eirridutua apa moitie, neishop lkuniyiani, neelare nkuruon.

English: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou ilalashera, neitadou aariku Kaisari, neirriwaa meshomo Tarso.

English: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitagoloto ai te nkata o sina, nchere kaaisho nanu enkisiligata ino enkishui.

English: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok lenyena nelakuaniki eseriani, etumutaki ninche aaidaikie te kishomi, nemetii hoo obo oitajeu ninche.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
Masaai: Eirorie apa Olaitoriani Musa tiong'ata e Sinai, ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa li are, to lari li are ina kata eidipa aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri

English: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
Masaai: Neipang'u Yael alotu anang'are Sisera, nejoki ninye, “Wou, olkitok lai, wou enkaji ai, miureishoyu.” Neaku eibelekenyunye ninye ajing atua olng'obor lenye neimulumul ninye to lmukeka.

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
Masaai: nijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki Yerusalem: Ore entipat ino o einoto ino netii enkop oo Lkanaan; ore apa papaai lino naa Olamori, ore yieyio lino naa e Hiti.

English: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
Masaai: amu eitu ninche ening ilomon laainei, Olaitoriani ojo, lelo laitirrishaka nanu airriwaki intae too sinkan laainei lelo oibonok, kake mining'ining'i intae, Olaitoriani ojo!’

English: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
Masaai: Ore tung'ani otoiwuo enkitok naa oloo nkolong'i kuti, nebore enyamali.

English: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
Masaai: Yatir te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Eshtemoa te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
Masaai: Ng'ura, iyeniyene intae ate pee itumokiki aailepilepa nintayuyu olarrabal. Ore eenata neeijo ena inyi ena olong, nemeisho iltoiloishi linyi metoning'i te shumata.

English: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
Masaai: Kake keng'idakino olaiguanani Enkai; ore lelo ooinos olmumai te ninye neaku kituaak; amu ore nkutukie e lelo alejak naa keitigiri.

English: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
Masaai: Ninye oisho ing'uesi e ntim ndaiki enye, neisho nkiyoitin oo motonyi naaishir endaa.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ilmeneng'a linono lirragie ti atua ninye, naa nkiri ake, naa emoti nayierishoreki ena anasa, kake aikintaini iyie tiatua ninye.

English: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
Masaai: Metobikoi ninye anaa enkolong, metobikoi ninye nkolong'i nabaa anaa ino lapa, ti atua iishoritin pooki.

English: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.
Masaai: Ore enkaji e Israel naa keyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, eiteru ina olong nelo dukuya.

English: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
Masaai: Amaa taata iyiook emeitaa iyiook ilomon? Amu etimira iyiook, netaasishore impisai naaishoruaki te nkaraki iyiook.

English: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?
Masaai: Kake ore Absalom, laa ninye kitubukokitio eilata aaput meitoria iyiook, netua to larrabal. Ore naa taata kainyoo pee mijojo intae ae ti alo enchukunoto o laiguanani?”

English: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
Masaai: Meeta ninche enyamali anaa enaata iltung'ana, nemeitamei ninche anaa ilkulikae tung'ana.

English: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.
Masaai: Nelo ninye teine Naios te Rama; nelotu enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata ninye, ore eloito neibonisho ninye, o metaba anaa nelotu ninye Naios e Rama.

English: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ai midolitata kuna pooki? Esipa ajoki intae meing'uari te ne wueji osoit obo te shumata olikae, lemesulakini enkop.”

English: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kenas naa: Otiniel, o Seraia. Ore ilayiok le Otimiel naa: Hanat o Meonotai.

English: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
Masaai: Netii apa irubat oo lusien olkereri ake obo, netii apa ilusien aaipira too nkaloli pokira, katitin uni.

English: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
Masaai: Neibung olbarnoti le Sukot, neikilikuanishore ninye, neigeroki ilo barnoti ninye ilkituaak loo lpayiani le Sukot, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana o opishana.

English: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.
Masaai: Negelu Hesekia ntukusi oo lapolosak o noo Lawi. Entukus ake o enkae tukus, negelu ake entukus te risioroto esiaai enye, ilapolosak o Lawi tenkaraki ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani. Pee eisiaaisho too nchomito oo lng'oborri lo Laitoriani neishooyo enashe o enkisisa.

English: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
Masaai: Kake etanya ninye nejoki enkitok olkitok lenye, “Ing'ura, ore atii ene meekure enyamalaki olkitok lai ae toki tena aji, netipika pooki toki naata atua enkaina ai;

English: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
Masaai: Itoponayie iyie olorere itoponikia iyie eng'ida enye; neng'ida ninche te dukuya iyie te ng'ida neeijo ene nkisampuare, neikununo anaa tene ng'ida lewa eor nena naataarutua.

English: And he smote the men of Bethshemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the LORD, even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men: and the people lamented, because the LORD had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter.
Masaai: Near ninye metuata embata oo ltung'ana le Bet-shemesh, enkaraki naing'ura ninche atua ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani; near ninye metuata iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana te ninche, neishir iltung'ana enkaraki naitayio Olaitoriani emutata kitok ti atua iltung'ana.

English: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
Masaai: Nietuo apa intae aanyiku nintasheshe te ntonata o ldoinyo, ina kata eyupuyup ilo doinyo te nkima nebaiki olng'ejep keper, neimulumul enkatampoi kitok o empuruo.

English: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
Masaai: etipika ate batisho te nkaraki nanu, neme nanu ake oisho ninche enashe, keishorita sii ninche sirito pooki oo Loreren;

English: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ntarasi, amu itaasa iyie ena. Kaibalunye nanu enkarna ino amu eisidai, to dukuya lelo ooure Enkai.

English: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
Masaai: Ore lelo ayiok okuni botoro le Yese netusuja apa Saul aapuo enjore; ore nkarn e lelo ayiok lenyena ooshomo enjore naa Eliab ilo kikau, ore olosujita ninye naa Abinadab, ore oliokuni naa Shama.

English: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
Masaai: neisho ninche Yesu enaisho oo sabibu naitushulakaki olodua metooko. Ore pee eishamisham neany eok.

English: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
Masaai: pee etum nkonyek inono aaing'ura ena aji dama o kewarie, ene wueji apa nisiligishore pee ipik enkarna ino, pee itum atoning'o enkomono naomon osinka lino tene wueji.

English: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
Masaai: Olemeitirring'a anaa enkare, miaku iyie ololus te pooki, amu itijing'aka endapash e papaai lino; ina peyie isarkionie ninye ishomo endapash ai ainyal.

English: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
Masaai: Meitajeu iyiook Asiria, mikipuo iyiook aaked mbartan; nimiking'il ae kata aajo, ‘Enkai ang, too siaaitin oo nkaik ang. Ti atua iyie etum enkerai okishi olng'ur.’ ”

English: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
Masaai: Nejo olaing'urani ti atua kewan, ‘Kaji aiko, netaa aaoru olkitok lai enking'urata e siaai? Nemaata engolon naturishore, nemaaisho isura aomonisho.

English: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
Masaai: Ore kitalang'a enaiposha naipirare Kilikia o Pamfilia, nikibau Mira, enkanasa e Likia.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
Masaai: Kake keye oltung'ani, neirragieki aaitadoyio tiabori; eyang oltung'ani enabayie, naa koree ninye?

English: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
Masaai: Neipok ina aji teilo sarge le motonyi, o te nkare naruko o teina motonyi naishu, o too nkeek oo ntarakua, o te hisopo oina arasha nanyokie.

English: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni apa Yosef peyie ejing enkisiaayiare e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri. Nelo Yosef aing'uaa Farao, nelo aman enkop pooki e Misiri.

English: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
Masaai: Nemepik kewan olduruk tenaa kitok tiatua iltung'ana lenyena, metaa keidurukie kewan.

English: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le tomon oobo, to lapa oji ole Buul, laa ninye olapa le imiet neidipayu ina aji too nkaloli pooki, terisioroto oo nkitobirat enyena pooki apa naaitobirakaki ninye. Ilarin oopishana etesheta ninye ina aji.

English: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
Masaai: Nejoki taa ninche ninye, “Anaa eijo keen ate aapukoo oshi ilooiteng'eni le Yohana neomon Enkai naleng sii, naa neijia eiko ilooiteng'eni loo Lfarisayo, nedaa ninche linono neokisho?”

English: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
Masaai: Eilepaka enaiposha Babilon, eitemoyioki ninye te lelo apir le naiposha kumok.

English: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
Masaai: Etii inkonyek o Laitoriani pooki wueji, eing'orita lelo torrok o lelo supati.

English: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
Masaai: Ena ninye kishomi o Laitoriani; ninye eimu ilo asipani.

English: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ng'ura, atoning'o ajo keetae ilpaek te Misiri; enchom ina kop enyang'u ilpaek einyiang'aki iyiook teine, peyie kibikoo eitu kiye.”

English: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
Masaai: Ming'ida iyie Israel! Nimishipa te ng'ida anaa loreren; amu imborrie iyie onyek, ning'uaa Enkai ino. Itonyorra iyie olekoisiaayio le nkiborra oo nkonyek too wuejitin pooki neeiutuutishoreki.

English: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
Masaai: Ore ilo tiatua ilayiok le Aron oishooyo osarge lo lasar le seriani o eilata neishori emuro enkalo e tatene metaa erubata enye.

English: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
Masaai: Kake eipoto ninye olmalaika lo Laitoriani eing'uaa keper ejoki, “Abraham! Abraham!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
Masaai: Neitoki Samuel ajoki Saul, “Tigirayu! Ekaaliki nanu enaatiaaka Olaitoriani ena kewarie.” Nejoki Saul ninye “Tolimu.”

English: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
Masaai: Eeta tipat naleng too rrekiei pooki. Neituruk inchere, Ilyahudi eitanapa Enkai ilkiliku lenyena.

English: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
Masaai: Ore te ina enkaraki ilmalaika, keishiaakino ake neeta eng'oruoi enkitoduaata nautu enkitoria te lukunya enye.

English: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
Masaai: enetii eselenkei natisira oltung'ani oji Yosef, lo lgilata le Daudi; naa keji ina selenkei Mariamu.

English: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
Masaai: Neisarrisar aapuo neinepu Mariamu o Yosef, neirrag elooyo te mpeut.

English: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Nchoo Israel ejo, “Ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita loo layiok le Kohat neun ilng'oborri lenye te nkalo e kopikop o lng'obor le Nkai,

English: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
Masaai: Neureyu apa Daudi Olaitoriani ina olong; nejo ninye, “Kaji eiko te nelotu osanduku lo Laitoriani enatii nanu?”

English: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
Masaai: Eirriwayioki apa ina palai te nkaina e Elesa olayioni le Shafan o Gemaria olayioni le Hilkia, laa ninche eirriwayie Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda Babilon enetii Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon. Nejo apa ina palai,

English: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina entobira pee elikini kulo tung'ana metapala esiaai, nemeitoki aashet ena anasa, ometaba anaa naitobir enkitanapata.

English: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
Masaai: nimpang alo oyarata lo layioni le Hinom tenejing'ieki enkishomi e Poshed, nimbalunye teine lelo rorei laaliki nanu.

English: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
Masaai: “Ore pee eaku teipa nejoki olopeny enkurma oo lng'anayio olaitasheikinoni lenye, ‘Impoto laisiaayiak, inchoo olmushaara, tang'asu to lobayie o mpung'ie to loiturukuo.’

English: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
Masaai: Neitoki Musa o Aron, o Nadabu o Abihu o lpayiani ntomoni naapishana loo Siraeli aailep,

English: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
Masaai: naajoki nanu, ‘Ng'ura kaaisho iyie tubula, naa kaaponaa iyie, naaitaa iyie olorora loo ltung'ana kumok, naa kaisho ena kop eishoi ino nikisuju metaa enenye intarasi.’

English: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
Masaai: Nejoki olkitok lenye, ‘Ai sidai enitaasa iyie osinka supat oisiligayu; tijing'a eng'ida o lkitok lino.’

English: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
Masaai: Meishaakino oltung'ani te nemeeta eng'eno, naa ore ilo oitasiooyo nkejek enyena, nepong enkoitoi enye.

English: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam ina sikiria, “Enkaraki nikigira iyie aiguranie nanu. Enyor napaji naa kaata olalem, pee aatum atara iyie tua.”

English: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, o lelo arikok pooki le leina umata, neipung aapuo aanang'are ina jore ti auluo.

English: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
Masaai: Ewaita sii ninye Lot, olayioni lo lalashe le Abram omanya Sodom tenebo imasaa enyena nepuo.

English: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
Masaai: Eibelekenyaki esipata, ore esupatisho netalakuana; amu eimina esipata too umat oo ltung'ana, ore enkitoriori nemetumi.

English: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
Masaai: Kake ore ebaiki taata keton Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkaina e tatene e ngolon e Nkai.”

English: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
Masaai: Nedumunye olaiguanani, nepolos ilkilani lenyena, neirrag te nkop; ore isinkan lenyena pooki apa ooitashe te mbata nepolos ilkilani lenye.

English: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
Masaai: Minyanya pooki toki naisuijo; ore too manyishoritin inyi pooki enosa imukateni neitu eisuijieki.”

English: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
Masaai: Ara nanu olomoni te nkop, mikisudoriyie nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
Masaai: Neishankarra ejo maate, “Ti nikijo, ‘Keper eing'uaa,’ naa taata nejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?’

English: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
Masaai: Ore Maaka ina apiani e Kaleb neiu Sheber o Tirhana.

English: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Baruk enkae rishata ebaiki elojata e suntai o meitabaiki kutukaji e nkaji e Eliaship ilo apolosani kitok.

English: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
Masaai: Nanu Paulo, oigero ena te nkaina ai makewan, ekalak nemaimaki esile nikiaatayie nanu ebaiki kewan ino.

English: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ore kuna supeni naapishana e kerra ining'amaa too nkaik aainei metaa iyaku iyie olchakeni lai inchere atuturo ena shorro.”

English: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
Masaai: Eitu ajo meiteneneng'i ilolan le kulikae neponari olinyi. Enchoo easi anaa nkiririkinot.

English: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Lo lewa le Israel, entodol ake ate te kulo tung'ana, te na bae niyieuu nintaasiasa.

English: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Saul olkilikuai Yese, ejo, “Nchoo Daudi eton te nkisiaayiare ai, amu enoto ninye omom too nkonyek aainei.”

English: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Toi le Hamat nchere etimira Daudi enjore pooki e Hadadesa, ilo aiguanani le Soba,

English: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu, “Enkop e Shimor, aa te ine epuo aashetaki ninye enkaji, naa ore pee eidip aitobira, nepik ina kikapu pee ebik teine.”

English: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata, etiaakita Abimelek tenebo Fiko aa olkitok le njore, Abraham,

English: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
Masaai: Kake eitasho ninye te mpolos eina kurma neisulie, nesesekuan Ilfilisti, neitajeu Olaitoriani ninche te nkisulata kitok.

English: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
Masaai: laa Enkiyang'et e sipata, lemeng'amu enkop amu medol ninye nemeyiolo ninye. Iyiololo intae ninye amu keton ti atua intae, netii atua intae.

English: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
Masaai: naa Annas o Kaiafas ilapolosak kituaak, nebaiki ororei le Nkai Yohana olayioni le Sakaria ti ong'ata.

English: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
Masaai: Emaimariria Yesu olaa ninye olaiturukoni naa oloitabaya enkirukoto ang, olaa ore enkaraki eng'ida natipikaki dukuya ninye neting'iria osalaba, nemenu ina kurruna, neton taata te nkaina e tatene o lorika le nkitoo e Enkai.

English: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
Masaai: “Nji naa taata ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, tialo ena anasa nijojo intae, ‘Eishooyioki aapik atua enkaina o laiguanani le Babilon to lalem, o to lameyu, o to lmeitai’:

English: Even as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
Masaai: Anaa enatoning'o Sara Abraham pee eipot ninye ajo laaitore lai. Nitaa intae inkera enyena, ti niaasiasa esidai, niminchosho toki meituria intae.

English: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
Masaai: naibayu Esau, naitomijoono nanu enkop enye oo ldoinyo, naing'ueiki enjung'ore enye imbariak o lpurkel.”

English: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo oiboni Isaya alotu enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo etejo kulo tung'ana? Naa kaji eing'uaa pee epuonu enitii?” Nejo Hesekia, “Eetuo ninche eing'uaa enkop nalakua, Babilon eing'uaa.”

English: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Embung'a intae nena pooki apa naaitanapa intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, nitoning'o intae oltoilo lai te nena pooki naitanapa nanu intae;

English: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
Masaai: Enkerai ai nchooki nanu oltau lino, naa inchoo inkonyek inono eing'or inkoitoi aainei.

English: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
Masaai: pee etum ninche aaishooi ilasarri ooitishipisho te Nkai e keper, neomonoki enkishui o laiguanani o layiok lenyena.

English: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.
Masaai: “Mme esiaai ino Usia, pee ipejoki Olaitoriani enkorropil, kake esiaai oo lapolosak, lelo ayiok le Aron, laa ninche apa eiteng'elaki pee epej enkorropil. Tupuku mpang'a te wueji sinyati, amu itaasa embae torrono, amu mikiyaki ina enkanyit to Laitoriani, Enkai.”

English: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena bae, ore nanu Paulo, oloena le Kristo Yesu te rishata inyi intae Iloreren

English: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
Masaai: Olmonekie eikilikuanu Lyahudi neing'oru Lyunani eng'eno,

English: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
Masaai: ‘Kainyoo pee kiteena iyiook ate, aaitupukoo? nimidol iyie. Kainyoo pee kintoborro iyiook ate, neitu iyie ishilaa ina?’ Ng'ura, ore te nkolong e enata ino, ning'oru iyie murruna ino makewan, nintorogony ilaisiaayiak linono pooki.

English: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
Masaai: Amu esipa ajoki intae, keikashieki enkang e Sodom te nkolong e nkiguana aaitulusoo te iyie.”

English: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
Masaai: Etemi enkosholai te moti, netemi sahabu to lkokuet, netemi oltung'ani te nkisisa enye.

English: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
Masaai: Nedumunye olpolosie lenye te Helef o te Saananim o Adaminekok, o Yabneel, o meshomo Lakum; nelo aiting te Yordan;

English: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee, and the interpretation thereof to thine enemies.
Masaai: Neitoki Daniel, apa oji enkarna enye Belteshesa, aing'asia te nkiti rishata neitanyamal ndamunot enyena ninye. Nejo olaiguanani, “Belteshesa, mincho kintanyamal ina kidetidet aashu enkibalakinoto.” Newalu Belteshasa ajo, “Olkitok lai, metaa ina kidetidet ene lelo likimba iyie ore enkibalakinoto enye neaku enoo lmang'ati linono!

English: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
Masaai: Ore ake pooki ng'ae oarari, nelo eyaroto; ore ake pooki ng'ae oarisho to lalem meeta nchere meari sii ninye to lalem. Ene taa etii enkipototo te nkaraki eng'iriata o enkirukoto oo sinyat.

English: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
Masaai: Meisho ninye lelo torrok ebikoo, kake eisho lelo ooitanyamali esipata enye.

English: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
Masaai: Neiitanapisho Yosef meiputi ilbenia lenye te ntapa, neshukokini pooki bene impisai nayautua ninche, neishori sii endaa nainosaa te nkoitoi. Neitaasi ninche ina.

English: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
Masaai: Tadamu ena ninguanare, tadamu nkitarruorot inono,

English: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
Masaai: Etumi te nkutuk eilo oota ening'unoto eng'eno, kake ore eng'udi neishaakino enkoriong e ilo le meeta endamunoto sidai.

English: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
Masaai: Keirrita olkutati ilchekuti linono pooki, ore isanchan linono pooki nepuo eyararoto; nitum taa atukurru nindang te nkaraki entorroni ino pooki.

English: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Simion: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar, o Shaul, olayioni le nkitok oo Lkanaani; kulo ninche ilmareita le Simion.

English: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
Masaai: Lelo ooshipa te nchipai sapuk oleng, neshipa tenetum ninche enkurare?

English: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
Masaai: Amu Enkai naasisho ti atua intae, te pokira are, te yieunoto o te asata inyi te nkaraki murruna enye sidai.

English: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
Masaai: Neilanyisho ilchekuti aapuo inkang'itie enye nelikioo imbaa pooki o nena naatotiwuo te lelo ooata iloiriruani.

English: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi e kuna baa, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Abram te nduaata ejo, “Miureishoyu Abram, ara nanu elong'o ino, kesapuku oleng enkishooroto nikinchori iyie.”

English: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Ela o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
Masaai: Entoomon inkatitin pooki te Nkiyang'et te nkomono pooki o eomonokinoto. Ore te ina enchololoto te ncheikinoto iomonokiki isinyat pooki,

English: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie nkonyek oo nkariak meturukunye too erat; nenang'ari aaim irishat oo ldoinyo,

English: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tomon o are naa Ahira olayioni le Enan, ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Naftali:

English: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Kaun nanu ninche te nkop enye, nemeigili ae kata aadotu ninche, aaitayu tiatua ina kop naishoo nanu ninche,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

English: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
Masaai: Amu ore ake enkata pooki naun Isiraeli ilanterera, nepuonu Ilmidian o Ilmaleki o iltung'ana lo loo saen aarasaki ninche;

English: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
Masaai: Aatuturokitio lelo lemeure Enkai ngumot, lelo tung'ana lemeibung nkitanapat inono.

English: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
Masaai: kake ore enkaraki natasapuka oleng enkiborra oo nkonyek, enchoo ake olee eeta enkitok enye, neeta enkitok olpayian lenye.

English: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “A-a, iyetuo aajur enchalan oo ltung'ana lena kop.”

English: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, entisinya naa ate, pee iakuku sinyat amu kara nanu sinyati. Emindurukie ake ate tiae toki naikurtutari neiserpepiari ti oriong enkop.

English: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
Masaai: Netipika Enkai atua ina sirit neiturukie lkipaareta, ile aare iloibonok le Nkai, li okuni laiteng'enak neitoki lelo ooas nkiasin e nking'asia, ilabaak, ilaretok, ilarikok o lelo ooiro lng'ejepa oopaasha.

English: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
Masaai: Ore elo ninye nedol oltung'ani otoiwuoki aa modooni.

English: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae onyor enkitamioto e utaroto, naa kenyor eng'eno, kake ore ilo oiba enkisikong'ata naa olmodai.

English: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
Masaai: Kelotu olalem shumata Misiri, nejing oloputukunyi sapuk Etiopia, ina kata nabatata lelo oo yieng'i te Misiri, nenapi arsisisho enye aaya, ore ilkitamanyunot nepolosi aauroo.

English: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli aibung mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan, near iltung'ana le Siria oleng.

English: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
Masaai: eneitu apa elikini nkera oo ltung'ana te kulikae porori anaa ena taata naibalakinyeki ilkipaareta lenyena sinyat o loibonok le Enkai te ina Kiyang'et,

English: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
Masaai: Nipik olperere lo lasar opejori dukuya kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le Nkai ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
Masaai: Nchoo eng'amuni aaiger enkoliai nemeitong'or ilarin ntomoni ile, naa enkitok apa o lpayian obo,

English: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
Masaai: Ntasho mataranyaki nanu olanyor lai osinkolio le nyorrata oipirta enkurma enye oo sabibu: eeta apa ilo lanyor enkurma oo sabibu te ndoinyo sidai enterit.

English: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
Masaai: “Ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Tiatira, tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei lo Inoti le Enkai, otiu nkonyek enyena anaa lng'ejepa le nkima, netiu nkejek enyena anaa suya ootisirakaki.

English: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
Masaai: Yoel olayioni le Sikri apa olaitasheikinoni lenye, naa Yuda olayioni le Hasenua oliare te nkitoria ena anasa.

English: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
Masaai: Ore eton engor enkolong osirua oji le Pasaka, etayiolo Yesu ajo etabawua esaa enye nalotie aing'uaa ena kop, alo enetii Papa. Netonyorra lelo lenyena ootii enkop, netonyorra ninche metabaiki enkiting'oto.

English: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
Masaai: Kake etasayia Lot ninche oleng, o meibelekenyakinoto enkaji enye, neitaiki ninche osirua, nepejoki ninche imukateni neitu eisuisheki neinos ninche.

English: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Masaai: “Nji enchom entiaaki Hesekia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, ‘Mincho kilej ina Ai ino naa ninye isiligita, ejo esiligie olorere ajo meishoori Yerusalem aapik atua nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron tiatua enkop e Misiri,

English: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.
Masaai: neibelekenya ninche te ine, aapuo aairrag ina kewarie Gibea. Nelo ninye aton te nkoitoi kitok e ina anasa; amu meetae oltung'ani otoriko ninche atua enkaji enye meirraga ina kewarie.

English: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
Masaai: Amu ore olodol anyit te nanu o too rorei laainei, neduaaki sii ninye Enkerai e Tung'ani ninye anyit te nelotu te nkitoo enye o ene menye o enoo lmalaika sinyat.

English: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tigirayu, tipika enkaina ino enkutuk ino, nilotu te nebo iyiook, niaku te iyiook papa o lapolosani. Kenaikash iyie ti niaku olapolosani te nkaji o ltung'ani obo, anaa ei ti niaku olapolosani to losho to lmarei le Israel?”

English: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa enkop e Misiri enkop mitil tiatua nkuapi mitili; ore inkanas enyena neaku mijoonto ilarin artam tiatua nena anas naaidaikieki. Ekaidapashaki Ilmisiri iloreren, naidapash ninche toonkuapi.

English: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
Masaai: Ore pee edaa aaraposho, neiteneneng emeli, nenang'aki enkano atua enaiposha.

English: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
Masaai: Amu kepuo taata ninche aajo: “Mikiaata iyiook olaiguanani, amu mikiure iyiook Olaitoriani, amaa olaiguanani, kaa eidim ninye aitaasa iyiook?”

English: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
Masaai: kake ore lelo oanyu Olaitoriani naa keitang'ejuk engolon enye, keilep ninche too naipuko anaa lkurragoso, nepuo aakuet nemenauru, nepuo ninche kake meiterre te nauri.

English: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.
Masaai: Ore lelo gilat mbat nepuo alalau te nkaji e shumata o enkae e shumata, eipirare ine neirishakino te nkaji ake e shumata o te nkae te manaroto pooki enkaji e Nkai; Ore te matua enkaji e Nkai netii inkedeta naailep shumata, neaku neija eikunari oltung'ani teneilep eiteru te nkaji e abori o metabaiki enkaji e shumata eimaa enkaji e polos.

English: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
Masaai: Kaji naa iyie inko pee intukurru ilo arikoni obo le njore ti atua lelo kulikae aisiaayiak ti abori, eji isiligita Misiri, mikirriwaki mbartan oo ngarrin o lakedok lenye.

English: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye imbokishi o lerai nemuraa ninche te sahabu.

English: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
Masaai: nejoki ninye Aron, “Iwa iyie oloti oing'oni intayunye olasar le ng'oki o lmeregesh ntayunye olasar opejori, ore te pokira meetae oloota entioto, nintarasaa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorita, ng'ura, nelotu Yonatan olayioni le Abiata; nejo Adonija, “Tijing'u, amu ira iyie oltung'ani le tipat oyau ilomon.”

English: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
Masaai: anaa pee ejo te dikae wueji, “Ira iyie olapolosani ntarasi, to lkerreti le Melkisedek.”

English: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
Masaai: Ing'ura atua iloshon, pee idol; ning'asia nimputukuny. Amu aasita nanu esiaai too nkolong'i inyi, nimindimidimi intae aairuko tenelikini intae.

English: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Afek, obo; olaiguanani le Lasharon, obo;

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkitok o lalashe lino, amu emasipaisho o lalashe lino.

English: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
Masaai: Irrorrorro intae dama, nerrorro sii oloiboni te nebo intae kewarie, naa kaar nanu ng'utunyi.

English: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
Masaai: kailep nanu alo te idia alo nkatampo, kaitotiu nanu kewan anaa Ilo Otii Shumata aisul.’

English: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
Masaai: Nedumakino esiamo pooki te nebo nepololoki lkilani lenye aaoru, neitanapisho meidong'i too ng'udisin.

English: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;
Masaai: “Naitoki ayieu nayiolou esipata naipirta ina ng'ues e ong'uan napaashari ninye too nkulie, naitureisho oleng, neeta ilala lenyena le sekenkei o loisotok lo suyai; nenyaisho negiligilisho neituny ilekunot too nkejek enyena;

English: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
Masaai: nedol olkitok lenye ajo etii Olaitoriani tenebo ninye, ore pooki naata neisho Olaitoriani metubula too nkaik enyena.

English: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
Masaai: Kebaa esidano too nchumat oo ldoinyo nkejek e lelo ooyau ilomon supati, lelo oolimu aaibalunye eseriani, lelo ooyau ilomon supati le seriani, lelo oolimu aaibalunye enjeunoto, lelo oojoki Sion, “Enkai ino naitoreisho.”

English: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Rehoboam Yerusalem, neiturrurru enkaji e Yuda pooki o losho le Benchamen, iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet, gelunot ooked ngarrin oo mbartan, pee earare enkaji e Israel, pee errinyoki enkitoria Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon.

English: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
Masaai: “Intobira endung'oroto olng'obor le Nkai. Ore te nkalo e kopikop nepiki endung'oroto olkarasha oisiong'a sidai oshetuno too usin naapiyaya loo intemat iip enkadoro te nkalo nabo.

English: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
Masaai: Nejo ninye te dukuya ilalashera lenyena, o te dukuya enjore e Samaria, “Kainyoo easita kulo Yahudi tashala? Keigil ninche aaitobir ntokitin? Keigil ninche aapolosisho? Keidip ninche te nkolong nabo? Keigil ninche aaiturrur isoito, aaitayu teilo sototi loo suut naapejore.

English: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
Masaai: Ore too nteipan nerrinyunye ninche, nebuak anaa ildiein neman enkanasa.

English: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
Masaai: naa ore ebaiki ilarin onom neing'uaa ninche enkisiaayiare nemeitoki aaisiaaisho,

English: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu olgoriet le nkaji e nkai, netem ing'apeta olgoriet, naa intemat imiet enkaina too nkaloli pokira; ore endapasho eina kishomi naa intemat e nkaina tomon oo ng'uan ore isunta enchoto naa intemat e nkaina uni te pooki shoto.

English: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
Masaai: Tagolie enkishui ai, amu ara nanu olaseremani le Nkai; ntajeu osinka lino likisilig iyie.

English: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
Masaai: Minosie osina enkoliai arashu enkerai okishi.

English: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
Masaai: “Toliki iyiook, kanu ebau kuna baa, naa kalo olmonekie oitodolu enkata nataanu kuna baa pee eitabari?”

English: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
Masaai: Neya olapolosani obo le lelo sitiman le kerra, nepolos ninye metaa olasar le ngoki tenebo ilo tulet le ilata, neyuk ninche anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
Masaai: Yese apa menye le Eliab naa ninye olkikau. Aminadab oliare, o Shimea aa ninye oliokuni.

English: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki nena, ninye olaidikidikoni lo sotua ng'ejuk, paa ore lelo ooipotoki netum inkisiligat e njung'ore oo ntarasi, amu enotoki enkeeya ng'ejuk nalaku too nkitarruorrot lelo ootii abori lido sotua le dukuya.

English: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore oloirirua laa ninye apa oteleja ninche nenang'akini atua olbalbal le nkima o enkibiriti ine netii ina ng'ues o ilo oiboni le lejare, nepuoi aaitame ninche dama o kewarie intarasi o ntarasi.

English: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
Masaai: Nepuonu lelo kituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli aaishiraki Farao, “Kainyoo pee intaas iyiook, isinkan linono, ena?

English: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
Masaai: Ng'ura kayau nanu enkuretisho shumata iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, aitung'uaa lelo pooki likimanita iyie, naa kearari intae aaipang'ie, neilanyisho pooki ng'ae, nemeetae hoo ng'ae oiturrur lelo ooimin.

English: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
Masaai: Ore anaa entuaa natashala, neyietu aishir te mion e saisai, neijia iyiook kitiu te nkaraki iyie, Olaitoriani;

English: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
Masaai: Ore taata, intae Iloreren airorie. Naa enkaraki nara nanu olkipaaret oirriwakaki Iloreren, esiaai ai aitasapuk

English: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
Masaai: Ayieu nimiaatata osina. Ore oltung'ani leitu eyamisho naa mbaa o Laitoriani enyamaliki, neyieu neitiship Olaitoriani.

English: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
Masaai: Nepuo, neinepu etiu anaa enatiaaka; neitobiraki Pasaka.

English: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
Masaai: Eminyorru enkop anaa ntokitin naatii enkop. Ore oltung'ani ake pooki onyor enkop, nemetii enyorrata nanyor Papa atua ninye.

English: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i e Enok naa ilarin iip uni o ntomoni ile o imiet.

English: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
Masaai: Nchooki naa taata nanu eng'eno nagut o yiolounoto pee alo najing'u naitashe te dukuya kulo tung'ana, amu aing'ae oidim aitoria ele orere lino kitok?”

English: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai neirragie aaitolok irresheta lenye, ore lelo ooing'oru enkitamioto ai neiro ine nkidaata, neibirribir ninche elejare endama pooki.

English: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
Masaai: Nejoki Abna Daudi, “Kadumunye nanu alo, naa kaiturrurroki Israel pooki olkitok lai olaiguanani, pee etum ninche aaitobira olning'o o iyie, pee itum iyie aitoreisho te shumata nena pooki naayieu oltau lino.” Neaku eishoo Daudi Abna meshomo; nelo ninye te serian.

English: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
Masaai: nesha enchan nenang'unye enkare, nekutu olkutati, neosh ina aji, neurori neaku kitok euroroto enye.”

English: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
Masaai: Neetae sii kulikae ang'eni te ine, ooji ile Epikureo looji ile Stoiko oonotore ninye. Nejo kulikae lenye, “Kejo aa ele shoshoroi?” Nejo kulikae, “Ketiu anaa nkaitin eeiking'a elimu;” naa enkaraki natolimuo Yesu o empiunoto.

English: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
Masaai: Ore irorei le mborron naa olchani le nkishui, kake ore irorei le ntorroni negil oltau.

English: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
Masaai: Ore olkereri liaare naa iltoto oonyori, iltoto pusi ooitiil o ltoto sidain ooji almasi;

English: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Asgat, Yohanan olayioni le Hakatan, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip o tomon.

English: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
Masaai: Eimiso iloshon tiatua ina gumoto natuturo ninche; ore te ilo rreshet oisudoitie ninche nerruesh nkejek enye maate.

English: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
Masaai: Kake ore ‘Olola lo Laitoriani’ mingil aekata aimaki, amu ore ilo ola naa ororei le pooki ng'ae makewan, nimbelekenyenye irorei le Nkai naishu, Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai ang.

English: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
Masaai: Neaku etoning'o apa ninye ninche tena bae, nejur ninche nkolong'i tomon.

English: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
Masaai: Ore eing'oru lelo arewak le meli eneiko pee eluaya aaing'uaa emeli neidipa doi ninye aaitadoiki empeut enaiposha, eitaakuno keeta kulikae eenata ooitadooyo te dukuya e meli,

English: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
Masaai: Amu kegili nkaik e ilo torrono; kake egolie Olaitoriani ilo supat.

English: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo kulikae ooiteng'eni, “Kitoduaa Olaitoriani.” Nejoki, “Te neitu adol nanu inkiporo oo lmushumaani too nkaik enyena napik olkimojino lai ine wueji oo lmushumaani napik enkaina ai ematua enye, mairuk nanu katukul.”

English: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
Masaai: Mikinturraa nanu te nkata e moruao; mikinturaa nanu te neishunye engolon ai.

English: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
Masaai: Kake kelotu esaa, netaa taata, naserem ilaseremak oosipa Papa te nkiyang'et o te sipata; amu ileeijo lelo eing'oru Papa pee eserem ninye.

English: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Meleku toki, meteleku ake pee isukudo te nebo lelo ooena, aashu ibatata te nebo lelo ootasesekuanaki. Amu ore te kuna pooki eitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neton ake etudumuaki enkaina enye pee eoshisho.

English: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
Masaai: Ntalala ewueji o lng'obor lino, nincho lelo karash le manyisho ino elaari; minunuk, ntoodoro nkeenta inono nintagol ncheito inono

English: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
Masaai: Taarisho te ilo arrabal sidai le nkirukoto; imbung'a ina kishui nemeiting, nikimpotokoki apa pee imbalie te dukuya ilchakenini kumok.

English: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
Masaai: Naa kagelu nanu ewueji tenkaraki iltung'ana laainei le Isirael, naun nanu ninche, pee etum ninche aatobik te wueji enye maate, nemeitokini aekata aaitanyamal; nemeitoki aekata ilarruok aaisilisil ninche anaa apa.

English: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:
Masaai: nikintanaur ate kiaasisho too nkaik ang. Ore pee emori iyiook, nikimayianisho, ore pee eisilisili iyiook niking'iri.

English: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
Masaai: Etotiutuo ilkituaak le Yuda anaa iltung'ana ooiwuang'ie ilpolosien; ore shumata ninche, kabukoki nanu ninche engoro ai anaa enkare.

English: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni le njore le imiet, to lapa le imiet naa Shumhut, le Israhit; Ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan. Ore olayioni le ile to lapa le ile

English: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii aya osuyai kitok le Tibha o te Kun, nena anas apa naaitore Hadadesa (ilo suyai apa enyaaka Solomon aasishore te siadi aitayunye ilmotioo, o ng'apeta, o masaa o suyai.)

English: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
Masaai: Amu ore ti atua keeya nimikintokini aadamu iyie; amaa, ti atua enemeneng'a kaing'ae likisis iyie?

English: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
Masaai: nearaa Olaitoriani kulo oshon pooki ootii dukuya ino, niyaya iloshon kituaak naa magil aalang intae.

English: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
Masaai: Kaa naa ae? Eikias ng'ok amu meekure kitii abori nkitanapat kake abori empiris kitii? Mme neijia pae!

English: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
Masaai: peyie eshipakino Enkai aapurd nanu, pee eitorioo enkaina enye, pee aadung'oo nanu aiwuang'ie.

English: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
Masaai: Kake etanapa ninye enkiborra enye oo nkonyek aitulus; etoduaa ninye ilewa, ootaguetakaki inkitanyaanyukot enye isunta nena kitanyaanyukoto oo Ilkaldayo oo yela to ranki onyokie,

English: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
Masaai: Naa kerrinyoki Siraeli kumok Olaitoriani Enkai enye,

English: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Dameski. Ng'ura, meitoki Dameski aaku enkanasa, naa keaku ninye osototi loo suut.

English: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
Masaai: Mewalie ninye ae toki aashu eibelekenyie ninye, esidai te ntorrono, aashu entorrono te sidai; naa teneitobir ninye ae kibelekenyata e ng'ues o eng'ues, neaku naa ore pokira ina o idia naibelekenyaki neaku sinyati.

English: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
Masaai: Enkai eing'uaa nena pooki, naa ninye oitoning'o iyiook o kewan te Kristo neisho iyiook esiaai maitoning'o ilkulikae,

English: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
Masaai: Kake kaata ening'unoto anaa intae; madou sii doi nanu te ntae. Aing'ae lemeyiolo intokitin naaijo kuna?

English: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.
Masaai: Newal ninye ajo, “Ore pooki nijo kalo nanu aas.”

English: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
Masaai: oishorua kewan enye pee eaku elakunoto te pooki, neitakiaki enchakenisho te nkata enye naishiaakino.

English: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
Masaai: kake ore apa pee edaa ninche aaraposho, neiputakino ninche, ore iltauja lenye nedumunye; neaku aatorikinote ninche nanu.

English: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
Masaai: Amu etii iltung'ana torrok atua iltung'ana laainei; nerreshisho anaa larreshok ooirrag aarreshisho neitayu ninche orreshet; neibung ninche iltung'ana.

English: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
Masaai: “Neitayu Aron oloing'oni metaa olasar le ngoki te nkaraki kewan enye, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan enye o enkaji enye.

English: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
Masaai: Ikordu iyie iltung'ana oobor, kake etii nkonyek inono shumata iloowuasa pee intadou ninche.

English: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
Masaai: Nedumu Musa osarge neisuaaki iltung'ana nejo, “Eng'ura osarge lo sotua oitobira Olaitoriani o ntae te risioroto e kulo rorei pooki.”

English: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
Masaai: Ore anaa osinka lo lmushaara to lari ake o to lari neijia ninye etiu tenebo ilo; nemeitore ninye ninye te nkisikong'ata te dukuya iyie.

English: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
Masaai: Kake ore olaiguanani le Ai neya ninche eishu, neyau ninye enetii Yoshua.

English: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
Masaai: Kake ore pee eitanap ninche meipung'o te nkaji e nkiguana, neiteru lpayiani aaiguana oopeny,

English: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
Masaai: Naajoki Enkiyang'et maturubare, nemapik olng'ash. Naairiamariyie kulo alashera pokira ile; nikijing enkaji e ilo tung'ani.

English: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani ojo, ‘Ore ina nitejo intae too nkiyiaa aainei kaitaas nanu intae.

English: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
Masaai: o Kabon, o Laham, o Kitilish,

English: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
Masaai: Neing'asia te nedol intae mishularere ninche te nena baa e nkiminchalisho, nemor intae;

English: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.
Masaai: Negira apa olaiguanani airorie Gehasi osinka lo ltung'ani le Nkai, ajoki, “Tolikioki nanu kuna mbaa pooki sapuki naataasa Elisha.”

English: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
Masaai: Neitoki e rubata eare alotu o losho le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena; netii apa enjung'ore enye empolos e njung'ore o losho le Yuda.

English: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “ira iyie osinka lai, Israel, laa te ninye aitaae nanu kitok.”

English: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
Masaai: Nelotu Olaitoriani adoiki oldoinyo le Sinai, entopij o ldoinyo; neipot Olaitoriani Musa meshomo entopij o ldoinyo, neilep Musa alo.

English: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
Masaai: Nintaiki Aron olalashe lino ilkilani oosinya, te nkitoo o te sidano.

English: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,
Masaai: Ore ina kata pee eshuko enjore oo Lkaldayo aing'uaa Yerusalem etataana enjore e Farao,

English: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
Masaai: Lo aitoriak, nena ake entaasa sii intae ninche, naa embooi olbuaa, iyiololo aajo etii shumata Olaitoriani lenye naa olinyi sii intae, nemeetae olkep te ninye.

English: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
Masaai: nintanap ninche ajoki, ‘Entayu isoito tomon oare tene te mpolos olkeju le Yordan, te ine wueji neitasheyie nkejek oo lapolosak, ninapinapa aaya te nebo intae, nirragiegie ninche te wueji ade nirragirraga kewarie.’ ”

English: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
Masaai: Ore nena daat oo nchoo e nena anas nipuopuo intae aaisho ile Lawi, nchoo ebaiki esuntai e nkanasa neito idia alo nelo iroruat iip ong'uan o onom too nkaloli pooki.

English: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
Masaai: Ore kulo barnot pokira oong'uan, neisho Enkai ninche enkiteng'enata o enkarriyiano too sirat pooki o te ng'eno; neeta apa Daniel eyiolounoto too nduaat pooki o te ng'eno nagut.

English: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore nena ariak nitoduaa te ine netonie emulayoi naa iltung'ana o lororani o nkuapi o lng'ejepa.

English: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
Masaai: Kake atiaaka nanu ninye, “Kaisik ailanyisho toltung'ani laaijo nanu? Ijo iyie kaitajeu enkishui ai tenalo aisudori tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Maas nanu ina.”

English: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu oltung'ani kitok nejoki, “Toriku ntasieku Mikaia olayioni le Imla.”

English: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
Masaai: Near Daudi enkop, neitu eing'uaa olee arashu enkitok eishu, kake eewa nkerra, o lmong'i, o isirkon, o intamesin, o nkilani, neshukunye alotu enetii Akish.

English: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ilo asurai ajo etanang'aki enkop, nemir ina kitok natoiwuo enkayioni.

English: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah:
Masaai: O Araba o metabaiki enaiposha e Kineret te nkalo o loo saen, o te nkalo e Bet-yeshimot, o metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, ina aiposha naisukut, enkalo e kopikop o metabaiki abori lelo jurumi le Pisga;

English: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
Masaai: Iimaki olomoni liyieu te nebo olelatia makewan, nimilo aboloo imbaa naaisudoro e likae;

English: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;
Masaai: Neitoki Esta airorie Hatak neisho ninye olkilikuai oyaki Mordekai ejo,

English: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, Olaitoriani ojo, Olaitoriani loo lororani, ilo magilani le Israel: “Ee kaitalaku nanu engoro ai too lmang'ati laainei, kaitalaku nanu makewan te lelo laaiba.

English: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
Masaai: Toning'o enkikoo pee ing'enu, nimiorore ninye.

English: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
Masaai: pee metumi ake eleyiata napiki intae niaakuku nkera e Enkai nemeeta eleyiata ti atua ena kishon torrono niwang'ung'u aaku ewang'an te na kop;

English: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
Masaai: Netem enkalo oloo saen te ntiyani natemishoreki intemat enkaina iip imiet te ntiyani natemishoreki.

English: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
Masaai: Naa teneigil aliooyu to lkila, oripuno too usin, anaa oloo ntokitin naapiyaya, anaa naaripuno o pooki toki oo ndapan, naa kegira adaari. Nilo apejoo te nkima ina natii enkeeya.

English: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya enkang enye, neiteng'enisho te nkaji e ntumo, neing'asia ninche oleng, nejo, “Kaji enotie ele tung'ani eng'eno o enkidimata naasie kuna naas e nking'asia?

English: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
Masaai: Etii sii likae tung'ani oibonishe te nkarna o Laitoriani, Uria olayioni le Shemia eing'uaa Kiriat-Yearim. Eibonuo entorroni tialo ena anasa o ena kop too rorei ooikununo anaa kuldo le Yeremia.

English: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
Masaai: Amu eitabayie Kristo enajo nkitanapat, peyie aa ore pooki ng'ae oata enkirukoto neisho Enkai ninye esipata.
