English: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enaenikino enkarasha empolos o ltung'ani, neijia aikuna enkaji pooki e Israel o enkaji pooki e Yuda maateenikinoto ninche nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, pee etum ninche aataa te nanu iltung'ana, o enkarna, o enkisisa o enkitoo te nanu, kake mening'isho ninche.

English: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
Masaai: Musa ake olotu ataaniki Olaitoriani, kake mepuonu ilkulikae aanyiku, nemeilepu iltung'ana te nebo ninye.”

English: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
Masaai: “Ore olapolosani ora kitok tiatua ilalashera lenyena, otubukokoki endukuya enye eilata aaput neitisinyaki meishopo ilkilani nemeisho olpapita le ndukuya enye meisiong'ayu aashu epolos ilkilani lenyena.

English: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
Masaai: Naa iya iyie embata osarge lenye, nipik ninye nena mowuarak ong'uan o lperere lo lasar, nipik ilpijat oong'uan le nkedet, nipik ina amanaa aitaman neaku neijia inko tinimpok olperere lo lasar aitisiny, nintayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye.

English: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
Masaai: Ore etii ninye atua osina, neomonu omom to Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitobir kewan oleng, te dukuya Enkai oo loo menye.

English: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
Masaai: Ilo olo meeta entioto, neas isupati, neiro esipata to ltau lenye;

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
Masaai: neiteleiki enkaina enye endukuya enye neyieng ninye te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ore lelo ayiok le Aron neisuaaki osarge olperere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
Masaai: o ebaiki Heshbon o metabaiki Ramat-mispe o Betonim, o ebaiki Mahanaim o metabaiki enkop e Debir,

English: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
Masaai: Nerasaa ninche anaa ilmurran, neked isunta anaa sikarini, nepuo ninche dukuya oltung'ani ake te nkoitoi enye, meibelekenya ninche aapaash nkoitoi enye.

English: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
Masaai: Ore enyaanyukie oo nkomomi enye, eeta ake nabo te ninche enkomom o ltung'ani te dukuya; ore pokira ong'uan neeta enkomom olng'atuny te matua e tatene, ore pokira ong'uan neeta enkomom olkitengte nkalo e kedienye, neeta pokira ong'uan enkomom olkurragos tesiadi.

English: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
Masaai: Inchoo mikintishipa inkibirribirrat aainei amu Olaitoriani nanu ang'idakino.

English: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
Masaai: Naa keitodol intae enkaji e shumata nalala naitobira; te ine entobiraki iyiook.”

English: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
Masaai: amu ti nikira apa Lyahudi anaa kira Lgiriki, nikira rrindiki aashu kira ltung'ana oolakuno, ore te nkibatisa te ina Kiyang'et nabo nikitaa pooki osesen obo neitamataki iyiook ina Kiyang'et nabo.

English: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku inji nkuna teniwuang'ie entorroni o sarge tiatua intae, tenias enaishiakino too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
Masaai: Ore anaa pee eisiligayu Enkai, mme ake ninye ororei lang te intae ole “Ee” o “A'a.”

English: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Yonatan ajoki Daudi, “Ore pooki nijo, naaitaas nanu iyie.”

English: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
Masaai: Aishira nanu o mekenyu aing'oru eretoto; negiligil ninye iloik laainei pooki anaa olng'atuny; ore dama o kewarie nikiyau iyie nanu enkiting'oto.

English: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
Masaai: o ltau le sipata te ilo oton te nkiguana, o engolon te ilo oibelekeny olarrabal te kishomi.

English: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii, teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa esupatisho enye neas intorrok, napik entoki narror dukuya enye, naa keye ninye; amu eitu inkok iyie ninye, keye ninye too ng'ok enyena, ore isiaaitin enyena sidain nena naataasa nemeitokini aadamu; kake ore osarge lenye nayieu too nkaik inono.

English: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo enetii ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani; nejo, “Kiteena ate katukul to lmumai nchere mikinchamisham endaa o metaba anaa nikiaar Paulo metua.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, aajoki, ore elde laairuk nanu, ore kuna siaaitin naas neas ninye, naa keas isapuki naalang kuna amu kalo enetii Papa;

English: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
Masaai: Tapaasha nena kirorot e pesho nemetii euriata e Enkai, amu iltung'ana ake erikoo oleng oleng metalama euriata e Enkai.

English: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-Havothjair, unto this day.
Masaai: Ore Yair ilo le Manase neya ina kop pooki e Argob, aa taa Bashan, o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lgeshuri - oloo Lmakaati neipotie nena ang'itie kutiti kewan ajo, Hofot-Yair, anaa enatiu o taata.

English: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
Masaai: “Naa ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Smirna tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo le Nkiterunoto o le nkiting'oto, otua apa, nenyaaka apiu.

English: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband, then they shall both of them die, both the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away evil from Israel.
Masaai: “Teneinepuni olee eshomo enetii enkitok e likae lee neari pokira are metuata. Ilo lee oshomo enetii ina kitok o ina kitok, neaku impooitie entorroni tiatua ate.

English: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
Masaai: Eibung'a apa Yosia osirua lo Laitoriani le pasaka te Yerusalem. Neyieng ninche olkuoo le pasaka te nkolong e tomon oong'uan o lapa le dukuya.

English: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
Masaai: Entonyok eng'oru osotua too ltung'ana pooki, o esinyatisho naa ore te nemeetae nemetumi hoo olodol Olaitoriani.

English: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
Masaai: Naa te neiturraa enkitok olmoruo lenye, nelo meyama likae, keloloito.”

English: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
Masaai: Aing'ae oishoo ninye metaa olaitasheikinoni le nkop? naa aing'ae otipika ninye meitasheiki enkop pooki?

English: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
Masaai: eitu sii atumie Herode amu etorrinyoko iyiook. Ng'ura, eitu hoo eas ai nairirikino keeya;

English: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Masaai: Tenajoki ilo torrono, ‘Meeta nchere aimiye,’ neitu inkok ninye aliki, neitu iro aikok ilo torrono metung'uai enkoitoi enye torrono, peyie etum aitajeu enkishui enye, keye oltung'ani torrono too ntorrok enyena; kake ore osarge lenye naa kaing'oru te nkaina ino.

English: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
Masaai: Ore olkila lino netii osarge le nkishui e lelo aisinak lemeeta entioto; eitu iyie inepu ninche egilita nkajijik, kake ore etii kuna tokitin pooki

English: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Iwa enkawuo o mbaa;” neya ninye enkawuo o mbaa.

English: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
Masaai: Nejokini, “Meetae oltung'ani lo lmarei linyi oji neijia.”

English: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
Masaai: “Ore ilo oiseyie olmeneng'ani le likae tung'ani ake ninye, nesarkionu nkolong'i naapishana.

English: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
Masaai: Shumata iyie apa aatanang'akaki ebaiki pee aaini, ore anaa naaiu yieyio lai ira iyie Enkai ai.

English: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.
Masaai: Neibelekenya ninche neisikaki enkalo e ong'ata aapuo endapidapoi e Rimon; neari metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni imiet too nkoitoi kituaak, neitirrishakini aasujaa o meitabaikini Gibom, nesesekuani iltung'ana nkalifuni are te ine.

English: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
Masaai: Eikash endaa oo mbenek naanyori etii enyorrata atua, alang olkiteng opir otii enkiba atua.

English: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
Masaai: Enyor papa Enkerai, neishoo intokitin pooki metijing'a atua enkaina enye.

English: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eyupuyupo engoro o Laitoriani ti alo iltung'ana lenyena, neitorioyie ninye enkaina enye, aarare ninche neosh ninche, neikirikira oldoinyo; netiu mpopoki enye anaa suut too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa. Amu ore te kuna pooki meibooroyu engoro enye, neton ake eitoriori enkaina enye.

English: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
Masaai: “Esipa, iroro iyie aning'ito, natoning'o nanu oltoilo loo rorei linono.

English: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Amasia, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
Masaai: Amu aaibitakinote nanu mbaa inono, naatadoikio nanu enkaina ino.

English: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto e nkitoria e Sedekia olayioni le Yosia olaiguanani le Yuda, ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani ejo.

English: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
Masaai: ore hoo netii apa kulo tung'ana pokira okuni atua, ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, meitajeu hoo nkayiok arashu intoyie, kake ninche ake inkorroki enye eitajeuni.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Miureyu ninche, amu aishooyie nanu ninche apik atua nkaik inono; meitashe hoo oltung'ani lenye te dukuya intae.”

English: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki likiyiolo iyie too loreren neing'asia te iyie, itabaikia iyie enkiting'oto torrono, nimintoki atii intarasi.”

English: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai iltungana le Israel, neyiolou Enkai empukunoto enye.

English: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
Masaai: Ore enkisisa oo lbarnot naa engolon enye, kake ore enkishiaa oo lpayiani kituaak naa ilpapit lenye ooibor.

English: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani airorie Aron, ajoki,

English: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
Masaai: Etiu anaa enkantererai e karadali natuuno oltung'ani te nkurma enye; nebulu aaku olchani, nemany intaritik ilng'osil lenyena aapik isinkin.”

English: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
Masaai: Nemayiana olemetum olkob te nanu.”

English: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilarin oata esiana, neitobir ninche enchula, ore ina tito o laiguanani le kopikop nelotu enetii olaiguanani le moikuape aitayu osotua; kake mebikie engolon enkaina enye, ore ninye o eishoi enye nemebik; kake keishieki ninye, te nebo lelo ooisiai ninye, o enkerai enye o ilo ora olkitok lenye.

English: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
Masaai: Entoning ena intae iltung'ana moruak, nining'ining'i intae iloomanya ena kop! Ketaase aekata embae naikununo nji too nkolong'i inyi, anaa too nkolong'i oo loo papaai linyi?

English: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
Masaai: neitoki Lea tenebo inkera enyena aabau aanyiku neirrugo aabaiki enkop; ore te bayie e pooki nenyiku Yosef o Raheli, neirrugokino aabaiki enkop.

English: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
Masaai: Kideki iyie te nkanasa nikideki tiong'ata.

English: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
Masaai: Ore ina adori natelekua ina natashare ine wueji sinyati naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo oloosaen, naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo o loontoluo, naa keaku enatashare ina rubata sinyati. Ore ina naiu ninye naa keaku endaa e lelo aisiaayiak lenkanasa.

English: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
Masaai: Meigili ae kata aaning olarrabal te nkop ino, nemening'i eliyio aashu enkinyala too lpolosien linyi; impotipoto intae isunta inyi aajo Enjeunoto, nijojo nchomito inyi Enkisisa.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Mining iyie, irorei leilo oiboni likimbonoki iyie nikimput iyie inkisilagat e pesho; eiro ninche induaat oo ndamunot enye, mme naaing'uaa enkutuk o Laitoriani.

English: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
Masaai: ore intorrok aainei neripari aaikenoo to lbene, naa aintemoo aimulumulaa ingok aainei.

English: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
Masaai: nitiuu anaa ltung'ana ooanyita olkitok lenye elotu eing'uaa osirua le nkiyama, pee te nebau neipotisho nesioki aabolu nabo kata.

English: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
Masaai: Ore pee apik endamunoto ai aitayiolo kewan eng'eno nagut, nadol esiaai naasitae tioriong enkop, nadol ajo metum oltung'ani injo dama arashu kewarie;

English: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
Masaai: Ore tinintayuyu inkishorot inyi nintayuyu inkera inyi too lasarri le nkima, nindurukiekie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu pooki o ena olong. Naa aikindimidimi intae aaikilikuanishore nanu, na aji e Israel? Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, mikinkilikuanishorere intae nanu.

English: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nadol nanu too nduaat e nkewarie, naa ng'ura eng'ues e ong'uan, torrono neitureisho negol oleng; neeta ilala sapuki le sekenkei; kenyaisho ninye negiligilisho, neituny ilekunottoo nkejek enyena. Nepaashare ninye nena ng'uesi pooki apa naatii dukuya ninye, neeta mowuarak tomon.

English: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Aron ina, neas anaa enaitanapa ninche Olaitoriani.

English: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
Masaai: Nekepu ate iltung'ana le Israel aalam iltung'ana leeiking'a, neitashe aaibalie ing'ok enye o entorroni oo loo menye.

English: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eyaka ninche Olaitoriani ilarikok le njore e Asiria, lelo ooibung'a Manase too lala oololo neen ninye too lpisia lo suyai, nenap ninche aaya Babilon.

English: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:
Masaai: nintarasaki ilapolosak le Lawi, oilo arishani otii olorika nena olong'i nkilikuanishore ninche, amu eikimbalakinye ninche endung'oto enkiguana.

English: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
Masaai: Nedumu lng'osil loo ltuka nepuo aanang'are ninye. Nebuakita aajo, “Hosana! Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani. Laa Olaiguanani le Israel!”

English: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
Masaai: Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani: ng'ura, enkikapu nabore ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj.

English: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
Masaai: Olaitoriani ewang'an ai naa enjeunoto ai; kaing'ae nanu aure? Olaitoriani osempewuet le nkishui ai; kaing'ae naa aure?

English: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
Masaai: Nerik Isaak ninye atua olng'obor. Neya Rebeka neaku ninye enkitok enye, nenyorru ninye. Neaku eitagoloki apa Isaak te nkeeya e ng'otonye.

English: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
Masaai: “Toning'o irorei lele ning'o lo sotua, nirorie iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
Masaai: Etesheta eng'eno enkaji enye, eitasheyie ing'apeta enyena pokira naapishana.

English: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
Masaai: Ore taata pee iyiolouwu sii intae enikinkununo, o enaasita, Tikikos olalashe lang onyorri naa olaisiaayiani oisiligayu ti atua Olaitoriani olotu ainosaki intae imbaa pooki.

English: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa li opishana, ninturrurrorro aaibung eumata nasinya; miasiasa esiaai nagol embung'a osirua lo Laitoriani nkolong'i naapishana;

English: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
Masaai: Maye nanu, kake kalo aishu, naiken nkiasin o Laitoriani.

English: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
Masaai: Negorokino apa Olaitoriani Solomon enkaraki naibelekenye oltau lenye aing'uaa Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, naipang'aka ninye katitin are

English: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
Masaai: Neaku eirure apa Abija etua anaa loo menye nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi; neitoreisho Asa olayioni lenye te rishata enye. Ore too nkolong'i enyena netum enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin tomon.

English: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
Masaai: Neyau ninche aaitijing'u ilo sanduku le Nkai, nepik atua ilo ng'obor otuuno Daudi tenkaraki ninye; neitayu ninche olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani te dukuya Enkai.

English: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nedumunye iltung'ana aapuo te Haserot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri ti ong'ata e Paran.

English: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Amaa teneok, lelo lemeishiaakino teneok enkikompe enye enkitamioto ijo iyie ilo mintamio? Milo iyie mintamio, kake meeta nchere pee miok iyie.

English: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
Masaai: Amu eitu elo Daudi makewan keper; kake etejo ninye kewan, ‘Etiaka Olaitoriani Olaitoriani lai: Totona te tatene ai,

English: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Toriko olayioni lino Isaak ilo laa ninye ake iata, ilo linyor, nipuopuo enkop e Moria, nintayu ninye te ine metaa olasar o pejori te nchumata o ldoinyo obo laaliki.”

English: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.
Masaai: Neitoki kulo tung'ana aapuonu te nkiguanakinoto enetii olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani, “Tayiolo, laaiguanani, nchere enkitanapata ena oo Lmede o Lpasi naa nchere meetae enatudung'o olaiguanani aashu enkitanapata naidimi aaibelekenya.”

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni neilep o metabaiki ilarin onom. Nkena ninche pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye nkituaak are; ore enkarna e ina e dukuya naa Hana, ore enkarna e nkae naa Penina. Neeta apa Penina nkera kake meeta apa Hana nkera.

English: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nepuonu aanyiku iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, neisho ninye ninche te nkitanapata nena pooki naairoro Olaitoriani te nebo ninye to ldoinyo le Sinai.

English: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
Masaai: Ore Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, olkituaak lenyena kaishooyo nanu ninche apik atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye o atua enkaina oo lmang'ati ooing'oru enkishui enye, atua ena jore o laiguanani le Babilon nikitorrinye aaing'uaa iyie.

English: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
Masaai: Nearisho te mpijan nemir Ilmaleki, nekordu Israel aitung'uaa nkaik e lelo apa ooibung'a ninche.

English: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
Masaai: Eewuo Enkerai e Tung'ani nedaa neokisho; nijojo, ‘Eng'ura oltung'ani olubo, naa olamerani, naa olchore loo loosotu kodi o laing'okok!’

English: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yesu, “Etii oltung'ani laatoshoroyie, amu atayiolo ajo etii engolon natupukuo te nanu.”

English: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, etoning'o osinka lino asipu nchere keing'oru Saul pee elotu Keila pee eidaikie enkang te nkaraki nanu.

English: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
Masaai: Mme Enkai oo lootuata ninye, kake enoo looishu, itapong'ori oleng.”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

English: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
Masaai: Nchoo nkop natoyio o nkanas enye eilepunye iltoiloishi lenye, o nena ang'itie naamanya Kedar; nchoo lelo oomanya Sela eranyisho te ng'ida, nchoo ninche ebuaku too nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
Masaai: Etii obo laa ore irorei oitasieku netiu anaa enang'unoto olalem. Kake ore olng'ejep lo lng'en neyau enkishiunoto.

English: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
Masaai: Ore inkishu sasin naaikinyoot naapishana, naaetuo aasuju ninche naa ilarin oopishana, ore ilkiyiaa lemeeta toki oopishana ooitoyio olkutati lo loo saen naa ilarin lo lameyu oopishana.

English: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

English: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
Masaai: Naa ore naaji tenaa kepuo ninche eyararoto te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, naitanap nanu olalem teine pee ear ninche naa kaing'or nanu ninche te ntorroni neme te sidai.”

English: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

English: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

English: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

English: And take the ark of the LORD, and lay it upon the cart; and put the jewels of gold, which ye return him for a trespass offering, in a coffer by the side thereof; and send it away, that it may go.
Masaai: Niyaya ilo sanduku le Nkai ninteleikiki ina garri, nepiki atua ilo sanduku enchoto enye nabo nena kitanyaanyukot e sahabu, naa ninche ishukoki ninye anaa olasar le nkitarruorroto. Nireureu ninye, nipalaa meshomo openy.

English: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
Masaai: Emincho ake oltung'ani te netemi, ejo, “Enkai naatetema;” amu metem Enkai too ntorrok, nemetem sii ninye Enkai oltung'ani.

English: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
Masaai: Neeta inkeenta are ooronyi too lpijat lenyena pee eitutumieki te nebo.

English: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
Masaai: natoponikia ninye iyiook,

English: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
Masaai: Neitoomon Hesekia ninche, neitodol ninche ilchumat pooki le nkaji enye, ina osholai, o sahabu o enkorropil, o eilata nagol enkinyiang'a o ewueji enye oo masaa o larrabal, o nena pooki apa naatii nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki. Meetae apa entoki natii atua enkaji enye, anaa pooki toki e nkitoria enye neitu eitodol Hesekia ninche.

English: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.
Masaai: Ekepuo sii nkishu ang te nebo iyiook; meing'uari ninye oloisotoo, amu eikiya ninche peyie kipuo aaisiai Olaitoriani Enkai ang, nimikiyiolo aajo kainyoo kisiaayie Olaitoriani o metaba anaa nikibaya ine.”

English: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
Masaai: Kake tenimbelekenya apaash esujata ai, iyie anaa nkera inono, nimimbung nkitanapat aainei, o nkiguanat aainei natipika nanu dukuya intae, nipuopuo aaisiaai kulie aitin niserememe ninche,

English: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajoki Siba, “Ng'ura, ore nena apa pooki naara ine Mefiboshet naa nkuninono taata.” Nejo Siba, “Kaasai nanu; nchooki nanu manoto omom too nkonyek inono, olkitok lai olaiguanani.”

English: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa ilaitasheikinok loo masaa o laiguanani Daudi.

English: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
Masaai: Etiu ninye anaa melin o lamirani, eyau ninye endaa enye te nelakua.

English: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
Masaai: Etii Olaitoriani enkalo ai pee aaretu nanu, kaing'or nanu te nkisulata lelo laaiba nanu.

English: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yesu Petero o Yohana, ajoki, “Enchom entobiraki iyiook Pasaka pee kitum aainosa.”

English: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak aajoki Baruk, “Shomo isudori, iyie o Yeremia niminchosho ake oltung'ani eyiolou enitii.”

English: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
Masaai: Nemeidim doi ninye aaitadedeyie kuna naapuonu aaitang'orie.

English: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: neishooyo enkop enye metaa enjung'ore, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
Masaai: Ore nena motioo, o nena kurteta, o ngirran, ore kuna masaa pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naaitobiraka Hiram olaiguanani Solomon, naa ino suyai otisikaki.

English: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
Masaai: Neipotu nabo kata ilo barnoti apa onapaki ruparen, nejoki ninye, “Tushutu olalem lino taaraki nanu matua, mejo ake ilewa ti alo nanu, ‘Enkitok natara ninye metua.’ ” Nerem ilo barnoti aipang'ie olalem, neye ninye.

English: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
Masaai: Naa enchom entasiooi entoliki ilooiteng'eni lenyena entiaaki, ‘Etopiwuo aing'uaa lootuata; neituruko alo Galilaya, naa te ine idolidolo.’ Eng'ura aidipa atoliki intae.”

English: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
Masaai: Ore pee eyuk olbalusui meiroro, newal Paulo nejo: “Ore amu kayiolo ajo kumok ilarin intore ele orere, kashipa amitu kewan.

English: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
Masaai: kake maiwuang'ie nanu te ninye ina nyorrata ai nauno, aashu ariat esupatisho ai.

English: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.
Masaai: Naitoki sii aipirripir enkila ai, najo, “Meikuna neijia Enkai aipiripiroo pooki tung'ani te nkaji enye, o te siaai enye tenemeitabaya ena kisiligata. Meipiripiri ninye neitoroki.” Nejo eumata pooki, “Esai” Neisis Olaitoriani. Neas lelo tung'ana aanaa enaisiligishore ninche.

English: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
Masaai: Near Yehu metuata lelo pooki apa ootelekutua te nkaji e Ahab te Yesreel, o ltung'ana lenyena kituaak, o lchoreta lenyena yiolot, o lapolosak lenyena, ometaba anaa neishu pooki.

English: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

English: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
Masaai: Ore eton eetae enkop, meishunye enkata eunore o enkata enkisampuare oo ndaiki, o enkirobi o enkirowuaj, olodalu, oloirujuruj, o endama o enkewarie.”

English: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
Masaai: Neitaa olaiguanani enkosholai entoki nalelek tumoto te Yerusalem, neitotiu anaa isoito, ore iltarakua nebayu anaa ilkeek lo lpurkel.

English: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
Masaai: Ore intae, iloora apa ae kata ileeiking'a ti alo Enkai nirara ilmang'ati ti atua ndamunot inyi, to lbae loo iasat inyi torrok,

Masaai: Aliki ltung'ana lenyena enjeunoto, te mpalakinoto oo ng'ok enye,

Masaai: Tonyuaa kewan o nena kiteng'enat inono, imbung'a, amu te niaas ina nintajeu kewan o lelo likinining.

English: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olmalaika Yerusalem pee eidakie ninye; kake ore etaa keidaikie, neing'or Olaitoriani neirridu ina torroni; nejoki ninye ilo malaika le nkidaata, “Eidip ina; torrinyo taata enkaina ino.” Neitashe apa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani tembata e wuejineiutuutishoreki e Onan le Yebusi.

English: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu intorikino kewan nanu, nikinyaaya oriong ino, neaku tanapa naa enyamali ino olng'uarra lino o enkiborra ino oo nkonyek.”

English: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni, aa enamuratieki neton emueyiaa, nedumunye ilayiok aare le Yakobo, Simon o Lawi oong'arie kina Dina, neya ilalema lenye aarasaki e nkanasa meyiolo, near lelo lewa pooki metuata.

Masaai: Ina peyie atem ina kishomi tioriong enkalo olgilata obo ometabaiki oriong olikae, neeta endapasho o ntemat imiet o ntemat tikitam eiteru te kutuk aji ometabaiki enkae kutuk aji.

English: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kapik nanu ilchekuti shumata ninche laa ninche ooing'or ninche, nemeitoki aikata aaureisho, arashu aaiputukuny, nemeitoki hoo nabo aimin, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

English: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
