English: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
Masaai: Nejo Yehoshafat, “Etii ororei lo Laitoriani tenebo ninye.” Nedoyio olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat o laiguanani le Edom aapuo enetii ninye.

English: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Kake nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa lelo ng'abolo torrok oleng lemeinosayu neijia nanu aiko Sedekia olaiguanani le le Yuda, o ilkituaak lenyena, ilo pisiai le Yerusalem otelekua tiatua ena kop, o lelo ootonita tiatua enkop e Misiri.

English: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia entagoluoto, iyie Serubabel, Olaitoriani ojo, ntagoluoyu, iyie Yoshua, olayioni le Yehosadak, ele olapolosani kitok, intagoluoyu intae lo tung'ana pooki lena kop, Olaitoriani ojo; entaasisho, amu atii nanu te nebo intae; Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo,

English: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
Masaai: Ore te nkesha inyi iararere ing'ok neton eitu igilunorere o meibukori osarge.

English: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
Masaai: Newal olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo, “Ore anaa enitejo olkitok lai, lo aiguanani, ara nanu olino, o nena pooki naata nanu.”

English: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
Masaai: Nepuo mbariak aashulare ilng'ojiniaa, neipotu oloirirua le ntim olikae, nejokino, ee, eisidai enkewarie tene, neing'uraki kewan ewueji neyeng'iyeng'are.

English: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, hoo neitu etiu anaa menye o ng'otonye, amu eiwuang'ie ninye eng'ape e Baal apa naitobira papaai lenye.

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Te naa kaishakenoki duoo ninye kewan, kesipa shakenisho ai, amu kayiolo enaing'uaa nayiolo enalo; kake miyiololo intae enaing'uaa, aashu enalo.

English: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Aron naa, “Ng'ura, aaishoo nanu iyie pooki toki naba anaa enatushumaki too nkishorot naaitakiaiki nanu, o nena tokitin pooki naaitisinyaki oo ltung'ana le Israel; aaisho nanu iyie ninche metaa erubata oo layiok linono metaa erubata enye e anaake.

English: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
Masaai: Kirriwaki enkirorokino Epafras, ilo o ena te nebo nanu te nkaraki Kristo Yesu.

English: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
Masaai: Keitu iyie, Na Ai ang, iaraa lelo apa oomanya ena kop te dukuya iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli; ninchooyie ntarasi aisho eishoi e Abram ilo shore lino?

English: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e kulo rorei, o te risioroto ena duata pooki, neirorie Natan Daudi.

English: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
Masaai: Kepuoi kenya aajo te ina olong, “Ng'ura, Enkai ang ena; kitaanyutua apa iyiook ninye, pee elotu aitajeu iyiook. Olaitoriani ele, kitaanyutua iyiook ninye, mating'idata iyiook nikishipakino enjeunoto enye.”

English: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
Masaai: Neitoki ake apuku olarrabal te Gat, teine netii oltung'ani sapuk oleng neado, neeta ilkimojik ile loo nkaik, o lkimojik ile loo nkejek te pooki aina o te pooki keju, neaku tikitam oong'uan ilkimojik lenyena pooki. Naa oleishoi sii ninye e lelo tung'ana sapuki.

English: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
Masaai: Ore teine nikitoduaa ile Nefilim, (lelo ayiok le Anak apa ooing'uaa Nefilim,) nikitiu iyiook anaa ntargeet, neijia iyiook kitotiutuo te ninche.”

English: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eikintieusho iyiook oshi ake, amu aikiyiolo aajo ore eton kitii ang te le sesen, nikilamita Olaitoriani.

English: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo lemeeta ileyiat too nkoitoi enye, lelo oopuo too nkitanapat o Laitoriani!

English: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.
Masaai: Ore te ine netum ilo sikari kitok emeli e Aleksantria nalang alo Italia neitaked iyiook ina.

English: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn e lelo ootoikioki ninye te Yerusalem: o Shamua, o Shobab, o Natan, o Solomon,

English: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ituria iyie olalem; naa kayau shumata iyie olalem, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
Masaai: Kake etanyaita ninche Lfarisayo o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat enayiewuaki Enkai amu etanyaita ninche maate eibatisa Yohana.

English: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: Nenang'akini ninche atua olmoti le nkima, neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.”

English: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
Masaai: olmokua: laa imbung too nkaik inono, kake etii ninye atua iwuejitin enkitoo oo laiguanak.

English: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
Masaai: Ore endukuya e Efraim naa Samaria, ore endukuya e Samaria naa olayioni le Remalia. Ti nimirukuruku, intae, meeta nchere pee ntasheito.’ ”

English: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
Masaai: Omaa te nelotu likae aliki intae likae Yesu leme olikitolikitio intae aashu ti nitang'amutua ai kiyang'et neme enapa nitang'amutua, itasiokito pae aang'amu!

English: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
Masaai: Etiu anaa te neeniki nkitanapat enkitok olpayian lenye eton eishu. Kake ore pee eye olpayian nelakuni enkitok te nena kitanapat te nkaraki enkeeya o lpayian lenye.

English: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
Masaai: Kake ore enkoitoi oo supati netiu anaa ewang'an e nkakenya ina naponari awang'u newang'u o metaa dama.

English: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
Masaai: Ruben, ira iyie olkikau lai, engolon ai, naa olng'anayioi le dukuya lai le ngolon ai. Oloituruk lo lwuasa naa oloituruk te ngolon.

English: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
Masaai: amu ayiolo ajo, asioki airragie osesen lai le nkop, anaa enaitoduaa Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
Masaai: Ore tialo Sebulon nejo ninye, “Ting'idayu iyie Sebulon, te nimpang auluo, ning'idayu Isaakar tiatua ilng'obori linono.

English: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
Masaai: Neipotu Ahab Obadiah laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji enye. Naa keyanyit apa Obadiah Olaitoriani oleng.

English: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye ear nkera enye metuata terisioroto e nena naaigeroki too nkitanapat, tiatua embuku e Musa, teina apa naitanapishe Olaitoriani ajo, “Meari loo menye metuata tenkaraki nkera, anaa meari nkera metuata tenkaraki iloo menye. Kake keye ake pooki tung'ani te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.”

English: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aing'orita nanu ninche te ntorroni neme te sidai, ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda ootii atua enkop e Yuda naa keidaikieki to lalem o to lameyu, ometabau enkiting'oto enye.

English: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye too ldoinyo le Abarim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri too nkisiajat e Moab te mbata e Yordan eipirare Yeriko.

English: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
Masaai: Amaa naaji te naa ketorikine iyiook enkarna e Nkai ang, anaa eikintoriokitio nkaik ang enkai omoni,

English: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
Masaai: amu atii nanu te nebo iyie. Nemeetae oltung'ani likibaiki aitaas entorrono: amu kumok iltung'ana laainei te na anasa.”

English: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
Masaai: Ore apa olaitasheikinoni loo Lawi te Yerusalem naa Usi olayioni le Bani, Olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Matania, olayioni le Mika loo layiok le Asaf, lelo aranyak, ooitasheiki esiaai e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
Masaai: Neisho ilo tung'ani inkarn inkishu pooki, o nena motonyi oloing'ange o pooki ng'ues e ong'ata; kake ore ilo tung'ani eitu etumi enkaretoni naishaakino ninye.

English: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
Masaai: Neya ninche impesai neas anaa enatiaakaki. Neibulunyeki ele rorei Ilyahudi o metabaiki taata.

English: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
Masaai: Toning'o endarata oltoilo lenye o endarata napuku te nkutuk enye.

English: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
Masaai: “Keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, intokitin aainei kiroteti teina olong naasisho nanu naa kaleku nanu ninche anaa oltung'ani opalaki enkerai enye naisiaaita.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Toduaaki maaitotiu anaa Enkai te Farao neaku Aron olalashe lino oloiboni lino.

English: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;

English: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
Masaai: Mme taa apa ltung'ana le nkop ooibor onyek aimaka, aashu lelo loo ng'uarrat torrok o laisimak, aashu iloomon nkitanyaanyukot naaitae nkaitin, aashu te naa ipuopuo tena kop tukul aaing'uaa!

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
Masaai: Neitoki araposhoki ajo, “Amaa, kaing'ae kenya elekuni te neas Enkai ena?

English: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
Masaai: Neanyisho ninye nkolong'i naapishana, enkata apa natudung'o Samuel; kake eitu elotu Samuel Gilgal, naa kegira iltung'ana aaidapasha aaing'uaa ninye.

English: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
Masaai: Woi ninye Ariel, Ariel, ina anasa apa natamanya Daudi Toponai ake to lari to lari; nchoo siruai emanikino.

English: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
Masaai: Ore ilo ning'o linyi o keeya neaku parmetii, ore ina nitoning'okinote o enemeneng'a nemeitoki auno; te nelotu enkidaata, naa eikiosh iyie.

English: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
Masaai: Neirriwaa Daudi olkilikuai aikilikuanu ina kitok. Nejo obo, “Aime Betsheba ena, entito e Eliam, enkitok e Uria Olhiti?”

English: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
Masaai: Amu kiterretena iyie nanu te ngolon, te nkaraki olarrabal; ninchoo ilmang'ati laainei meimiso tiabori nanu.

English: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
Masaai: Kake eikoroja ninche ninye too nkutukie enye, nelej ninche ninye too lng'ejepa lenye.

English: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, neipang'aki lelo tomon oobo etoni aadaa; neisikong ninche te nkaraki engolon oo lukuny enye o te nkaraki nemeeta enkirukoto amu eitu eiruk lelo ootoduaa ninye eidipa atopiu.

English: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: naa kaponaa te iyie iltung'ana o ng'uesi; naa keponari ninche neisho oleng; naa kaaitaa iyie enamanyae anaa apa inkolong'i naatulusoitie, naa kaaitaas iyie esidai eneitu apa ae kata aaitaas. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
Masaai: Etiu oltung'ani anaa enkiyang'et, etiu nkolong'i enyena anaa oloip oloito.

English: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
Masaai: Nepuonu Yeriko; ore epuo aaing'uaa Yeriko eiriamariyie ilooiteng'eni lenyena o lorora kitok, netii olmodooni oomonisho oji Bartimayo ole Timayo, oton te mbata e nkoitoi.

English: And give occasions of speech against her, and bring up an evil name upon her, and say, I took this woman, and when I came to her, I found her not a maid:
Masaai: neitagor ninye te nkoitoi e sulare, neyau enkarna torrono shumata ninye, ejo, ‘Aawa nanu ena kitok ore ake pee alo aboitare neitu atum te ninye olmonekie oitodolu ajo eselenkei’,

English: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
Masaai: Nanu Tertio, olaigeroni le na palai, oiroroki intae ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
Masaai: Irrugu enkiok, iyie Yoab, toning'oki; tigirayu peyie atum airoro.

English: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ang, ekaing'oru nanu esupatisho ino.

English: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Nelotu Hanamel olenkapu lai enatii tiatua olgoriet le rripore, terisioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, naajoki nanu, ‘Inyiang'u enkurma ai natii Anatot tiatua enkop e Benchamen, amu iyie eishiaakino te niya ainyiang'u; inyiang'aki iyie kewan.’ Nayiolou taa nchere ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki eniong'uan Isri, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
Masaai: Nemetii oltung'ani hoo obo atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ina kata ejing olapolosani atua alo aitobir olning'o lo sotua tiatua ine wueji sinyati ometaba anaa neipang'u ninye alotu boo neidipa aitobira olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan enye o enkaji enye oeumata pooki oo Siraeli.

English: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.
Masaai: Tadamu iyie nchere ira apa orrindik te nkop e Misiri, nikinyang'u Olaitoriani Enkai ino alaku neaku, kaaitanap nanu iyie ena olong.

English: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
Masaai: Ore ina ashe nepejori, te dukuya ninye, nepejori olchoni lenye, o nkiri enyena, o sarge lenye nepejori sii imoyok enyena;

English: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
Masaai: Naa kelo eishoi enye aisiaai ninye, nepuo iltung'ana aaimaki Olaitoriani too ishoritin naapuonu,

English: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie olaiguanani Solomon Benaia olayioni le Yehoida; neosh ninye anang'ie enkop, neye ninye.

English: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
Masaai: Kake etigire neitu ewaliki. Neitoki ake olapolosani kitok aikilikuan ajoki. “Ira iyie Kristo, Oinoti lo Lomayiana?”

English: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
Masaai: Ore hoo neyiolo enatundung'o Enkai ajo ore lelo ooas nena neiririkino keeya, neme ake duoo keas ninche kake kening'okino o lelo ooas.

English: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
Masaai: Enchoo iyiook erishata ti atua ltauja linyi. Mikiaata iyiook olikintaasa enemesipa, nimikiaata olikiminie nimikiaata olikimaga.

English: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
Masaai: Neisho Solomon ina aiguanani e Sheba nena pooki naayieu ninye. Entoki ake ninye natoomonuo metii nena naaishooki ninye tialo karsisisho o laiguanani Solomon. Neaku etorrinye apa ninye nelo enkop enye, tenebo isinkan lenyena.

English: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Shomo enkoitoi ino Daniel, amu eikenoyioki lelo rorei nemishiri o metabau enkata e nkiting'oto.

English: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
Masaai: Naitanap apa nanu ilarishak linyi te ina kata, ajoki ‘Entoning nkiguanat oo lalashera linyi entirish ninche, nidung'udung'u enkiguana te sipata te rishata o ltung'ani o lalashe lenye, aashu ilo likae otii te nebo ninye.

English: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
Masaai: Kake etejo apa ninye, “Mipuopuo intae aaim.” Nelotu Edom aarare ninche eeta iltung'ana kumok, o enjore nagol.

English: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
Masaai: Nitum taa atiaki olayioni lino, ‘Eikira apa irrindiki le Farao te Misiri; neyau iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri te nkaina magilani;

English: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
Masaai: Ore aingorisho netii ninche imorlooishi, neetuo nkiri osesen aaibung'are ninche, neitoip olchoni ninche; kake metii apa enkiyang'et atua ninche.

English: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
Masaai: Naa tenebo eipang aapuo olodung'oro lioriong enetii iltung'ana, naa keitayu nena kilani nena apa naaisiaaishore, neirragie ninche too lgilat sinyat; neishop ninche kulie kilani, pee mepik ake esinyatisho iltung'ana too nkilani enye.

English: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
Masaai: kepuonu ake aakurru pooki ti alo ilo orere lemeidim aataret ninche, nemeyau eretoto aashu dupoto, kake enkurruna ake o esulare.”

English: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye near Ilfilisti o meteekunye enkaina enye, neibung'are enkaina enye o lalem lenye; neyau Olaitoriani enkisulata kitok ina olong; nerrinyunye iltung'ana aasujaa ninye pee epur lelo ootasesekuanaki.

English: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.
Masaai: Ore endama pooki, ntobirita iyie enkidaata. Eikununo olng'ejep lino anaa olmurunya opi, iyie olaitobirani le nkeleekisho.

English: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
Masaai: Naa kepuonu nkolong'i te siadi ena, naa kabukoki nanu enkiyang'et ai pooki tung'ani; ore ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi neibonisho, ore ilpayiani linyi neidetidet ore ilbarnot linyi neidetidet nedol ilbarnot linyi nduaat.

English: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
Masaai: Kake inchoo ninye eikilikuanu te nkirukoto meeta olng'ash katukul; amu ore oltung'ani oing'ash netiu anaa ilopir le naiposha ooreu osiwuo nekutaa.

English: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
Masaai: pee aaitobiraki nanu mbaoi kumok, amu ore ina aji nalo nanu ashet naa keaku kitok naa enenking'asia.

English: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
Masaai: ilo oishorua Enkai metaa olkipoket to sarge lenye, ongamaroyu te nkoitoi e nkirukoto. Ore apa ena naa enaitodolu esipata e Nkai, amu ore teng'iriata e Aisho enye, netogiroyie ninye ing'ok naatulusoitie;

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Nkilikuana lelo apolosak metolimu ewalata ena kikilikuanata,

English: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
Masaai: Eikilikuanutua olorere endaa neirriwaki ninche nkurleen, neisho ninche imukateni naaing'uaa keper te nkumoi.

English: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
Masaai: “Naa amaa, taata, Olaitoriani, Kainyoo nanu aanyu? Atua iyie etii osiligi lai.

English: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
Masaai: Ore tenebo lelo etii sii iltung'ana kituaak le Solomon nkalifuni uni o iip uni ooitasheiki esiaai, ninche ooitasheiki lelo tung'ana oonapisho te siai.

English: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu neiguana Lyahudi nenya olmumai pee menya endaa nemeok ae toki o metaba anaa near Paulo metua.

English: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Esipa aajoki iyie, ore ade te na kewarie, eton eitu eru olkuku katitin are nikimiki iyie katitin uni.”

English: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
Masaai: Newaliki obo loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, te nijo nji, iyiook sii iyiet.”

English: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.
Masaai: Newalu Naomi ajo, “Taanyisho entito ai o metaba anaa niyiolou enetiu ena bae, amu meitirring'a ilo tung'ani, kake kelo taata aitabaya ena bae.”

English: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
Masaai: Neiguana maate ejo, “Amaa tenikijo, ‘Shumata eing'uaa’, nejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?'

English: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
Masaai: Eketiu anaa enatiaaka Farao, eitoduaa Enkai Farao enataa kejo pee eas.

English: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
Masaai: Neiput olmilo ina anasa; nekuet pooki te nebo aapuo eor e nkiguran eikurtutaa Gayo o Aristako, oora ninche ltung'ana le Makedonia, ooiriamunore Paulo pee elotu.

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan o iip ile.

English: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repaid.
Masaai: Kesuj ilbuketa ilaing'okok, kake elaaki karsisisho lelo supati.

English: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
Masaai: Ore to lapa le ile, neirriwaa Enkai olmalaika oji Gabriel, meshomo enkang e Galilaya naji Nasaret,

English: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
Masaai: Neitu apa eikilikuani metolimu enkikenakinoto te lelo tung'ana ooishooitie nena pisai too nkaik enye, aalaaki lelo aisiaayiak, amu etaasishote apa ninche te nkoitoi naisiligayu.

English: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana pooki le Israel, Teneitayu ake oltung'ani le nkaji e Siraeli aashu oloeuo amanyisho tiatua Israel olasar lenye, tenaa entoki olmumai lenye aashu tenaa enkishorunoto to ltau lo lpela naitarasakini Olaitoriani anaa olasar opejori,

English: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
Masaai: Te nedumakino intae likae tung'ani neme nanu eing'uaa ina; ore ilo oba anaa olodumakino intae nebatata te nkaraki intae.

English: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
Masaai: o Kenania olarikoni lo sinkolio too Lawi, ninye orikoo osinkolio, amu keyiolo apa.

English: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lemeiruk nkitanapat e Nkai ino o nkitanapat o laiguanani, nchoo edung'okini ninye enkiguana narrish, aa te keeya, anaa erewe eyararoto anaa, eoruni imasaa enyena, anaa eeni te korokoroni.”

English: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
Masaai: Ilo odotu ildoinyo, nemeyiolo ninche ina, tenenang'aa ninye ninche te ng'oro enye,

English: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
Masaai: Totona ntirring'ayu, nilo atua enaimin, na tito oo Lkaldayo; amu mikingili ae kata aajo enkaiguanani oo nkitoriat

English: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon ookuni Hupa, nedoiki ene tomon oong'uan Yeshebeab,

English: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol Yakobo ninche, etejo, “Enjore e Nkai ena!” Neipot enkarna eine ajo Mahanaim.

English: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
Masaai: Kiyiolo iyiook aajo kira ile Nkai, ore enkop pooki naa atua eng'olon eilo torrono etii.

English: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore too nkolong'i e siadi nashuku nanu lelo ooena le Elam, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD'S flock is carried away captive.
Masaai: Kake tenimining iyie, neishir oltau lai te nkisudoroto tenkaraki olwuasa lino; neishir nkonyek aainei te mion nerukunye ilkiyio, enkaraki nataraiyioki eluaata Olaitoriani.

English: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;
Masaai: Naa esiaai apa oo lakutak loo ntarumpetani, o laranyak pee eitoning'oo ate te nkirukoto o sinkolio eisis neisho enashe Olaitoriani. Naa teneilepieki osinkolio too ntarumpetani o too nkinantani dapashi, o kulie ake kinantani naaranyishoreki eisisi Olaitoriani, aajo, “Eisupat ninye nebik enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi” ore ina aji, ina aji o Laitoriani neiput enkatampoi;

English: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
Masaai: Nejo Yoshua, “Emperiperaki isoito sapuki enkutuk e ina apune, nipikipiki iltung'ana embata enye pee errip ninche;

English: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
Masaai: ninye ilo oitadou ilkituaak, aitaa pesho ore lelo aitoriak le nkop neitaa pesho.

English: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
Masaai: Nintoki ajoki isinkan linono, ‘Eyau ninye ene natii, pee adol ninye too nkonyek aainei.’

English: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
Masaai: ore peyie edol Shekem olayioni le Hamor le Hifi ilo kitok leina kop, neibung ninye te ng'olon aikony nesul ninye.

English: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
Masaai: Mbung'a tukurraki nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino o shakenisho enye, o nkikoot enyena apa nikintanapa ninye.

English: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
Masaai: Neitokini aayau lelo kineji anaa olasar loo ng'ok, dukuya olaiguanani o eumata, neiteleiki ninche nkaik enye shumata ninche.

English: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
Masaai: Maata apa nanu eleyiata te dukuya ninye, narrip nanu kewan te ntorroni.

English: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
Masaai: Nepuku olkutati te wueji enye, o enkijape to lkutati le nkidapash.

English: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
Masaai: Nening'i oltoilo loo naipuko oo lkerubi to lodung'oro liong'ota, etiu anaa oltoilo le Nkai Magilani teneiro.

English: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
Masaai: Kake eitu sii epal kewan meeta ake shakeni enye, amu etaasa supati, neisho intae enchan eing'uaa shumata neisho intae larin oosinyunye, neitaraposh iltauja linyi te ndaa o te ng'ida.”

English: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki, “Kaa naa eitaasi ninye?” Newal Gehasi ajo, “Meeta ninye olayioni, netamorua olpayian lenye.”

English: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
Masaai: “Naa te neye oltung'ani nabo kata etashare ninye, nepik eleyiata ina dukuya enye naiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani, nelo ninye abarn endukuya enye te nkolong e nkitukuo; te nkolong e naapishana elo ninye abarn.

English: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
Masaai: Irriwaki olkilikuai olaiguanani le Edom, o laiguanani le Moab, o laiguanani le lelo ayiok le Amon, o laiguanani le Turo, o laiguanani le Sidon too nkaik elelo kiliku ooetuo Yerusalem enetii Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
Masaai: amu ore olosho loo layiok le Ruben too nkajijik oo loo menye, o losho loo le Gad too nkajijik oo loo menye, netang'amutua enjung'ore enye, o lpisiai sii lo losho le Manase;

English: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e Yerusalem niliki ororei aarare nena wuejitin sinyat; imbonoki tigilunore enkop e Israel

English: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
Masaai: Ore naa entirrisha ndamunot inyi, eririki mbaa nipikipiki osiligi linyi pooki shumata empiris nayakini intae te mbolunoto e Yesu Kristo.

English: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
Masaai: oilo moti obo, o lelo oing'ok tomon oare ootii abori ilo moti.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yeroboam, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o enkidimata enye, o larrabali lenyena, oina natorrinyoko Israel Dameski o Hamat, naa ene Yuda apa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Benhadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
Masaai: Nelo Hasael anagare ninye, neshoroo enkishooroto, mpukunot pooki oo ntokitin sidain e Dameski, ilolan loo ntamesin onom, ore pee aitashe te dukuya ninye, nejoki, “Aairiwua nanu olayioni lino Benhadad, olaiguanani le Asiria maeu enitii ejo, ‘Kaishiu nanu tena muoyian?’

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
Masaai: Ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani to lari le tomon le Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, laa ninye apa olari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria e Nebukadresa.

English: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia ajoki ninche:

English: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
Masaai: Inchoo enaisho napi ilo oye, o lelo ootii emion sapuk atua iltauja.

English: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu iyie, Olaitoriani; najo, Ira iyie esarunoto ai, ira erubata ai te nkop oo looishu.

English: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
Masaai: Neitoki Hagai ajo, “Neijia sii etiu kulo tung'ana, o kulo oshon ootii dukuya nanu ejo Olaitoriani; naa neijia sii etiu pooki siaai oo nkaik enye; ore ina kishorunoto naishoru ninche teine keiduruk naa.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda: “Meishiraki ninche ninye ejo, oi olalashe lai! aashu ejo oi enkanashe ai!

English: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Ore israel o Absalom neitayu ilng'oborri te nkop o Gilead.

English: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
Masaai: netujuto enkiguana; ninye oiwuang'ie kuna, neshe to salaba.

English: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.
Masaai: O tenkaraki sii ilo sarge lemeeta entioto apa oibukoyie ninye, amu eiputa apa ninye Yerusalem, osarge lemeeta entioto, neaku meidim Olaitoriani ataapalaki ninye.

English: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
Masaai: Eisuijie enkini aisuijoi entapa naipurji pooki.

English: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oitayu ae nanyaanyukie pee easishore anaa esonkoyo neiwuang'ieki ti atua iltung'ana lenyena.”

English: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu ina Ai natejo, “Inchoo metawang'a ewang'an te naimin,” ninye natawang'a ti atua ltauja, lang ayaki iyiook ewang'an e yiolounoto e nkitoo e Nkai te nkomom e Kristo.

English: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
Masaai: Kaainyo pee inchang'itie iropiyiani te ina neme endaa? Kaainyo pee inchang'itie ole koisiayio te ina nemeraposhisho? Toning'oki nanu nias ina naajoki, pee itum ina daa sidai aisul, nishipakino nena naapir.

English: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
Masaai: Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Sefania olayioni le Kushi, olayioni le Gedalia, olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Hesekia, too nkolongi e Yosia ilo ayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana lenye ootii ilmareita le Isaakar naa nkalifuni ntomoni isiet oopishana pooki, ilmurran magil, eigeroki nkarn enye anaa iishoritin.

English: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Tenaa keidimi napaji aatetem shumata keper, neyiolouni ilkitamanyunot le nkop tiabori, natum taa aiturrai iishoritin pooki e Israel te nena pooki naataasa, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa kaitomijoon intae, niakuku entoki enkurruna tiatua lelo oshon oomanita intae, o te dukuya lelo pooki oodol intae egiroo.

English: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu te intae. Ajo naa sii ake idolidolo aajo lelo ooata enkirukoto oora nkera e Abraham.

English: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
Masaai: Nepuo Ilsifi enetii Saul te Gibea, ejo, “Aimeisudori Daudi ti atua iyiook too lnukat te Horesh, ldoinyo le Hakila, le kopikop e Yesimon?

English: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: kake te nemelang ninche te nebo intae; etanapate, nepuo naa aatum enkop te nebo intae te nkop e Kanaan.”

English: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
Masaai: Neishiraki Isaya ilo oiboni le Nkai Olaitoriani, nerrinyunye oloip siadi iroruat tomon, nerrinyo enkolong aipirakinore enkoitoi o sagam le Ahas.

English: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.
Masaai: Ore naa taata nchoo kintiship iyie pee imayian enkaji o sinka lino, pee elo ninye dukuya anaake ntarasi te dukuya iyie; amu ore entoki nitamayiana iyie Olaitoriani nemayiana ntarasi.”

English: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu esipa kaaitajeu nanu iyie, nimibatata iyie to lalem, kake itum iyie enkishui ino anaa enkishoroto o larrabal, enkaraki nitipika osiligi lino atua nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.’ ”

English: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
Masaai: Ore lelo ashetak lemeli, le Gebal o ltung'ana arriyiak netii atua iyie, kinukaki ilbaat loo melin inono. Ore nena melin pooki e naiposha tenebo isikarini le naiposha netii atua iyie, eitawalaa imasaa inono e biashara.

English: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
Masaai: Kayieu naaji nanu niroro pooki te lelo ng'ejepa, kake eisul ayieu oleng nilimumu olkilikuai le Nkai; ore ololimu olkilikuai le Nkai ninye olkitok alang ilo oiro too lng'ejepa, aashu naa te neetae olowalu neretu esirit metang'amu enkiti toki nashetu.

English: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
Masaai: Metaa neitayu Olaitoriani Enkai pooki ng'ues e ong'ota o motonyi pooki oloing'ang'e neyau ninche enetii oltung'ani, pee edol eneiko teneisho ninche nkarn; naa ore enkarna ake ninye naba anaa enaishoo pooki toki neaku ina.

English: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
Masaai: Atuturuo nanu ilchorroi naok nena ariak, natunuka too ndapi oo nkejek aainei nena onyek oo nkariak pooki e Misiri.

English: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.

English: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;

Masaai: Ore pee elo Yesu enkalo e Kaisari e Filipi neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena ajoki, “Kejo iltung'ana ae ng'ae Enkerai e Tung'ani?”

English: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

English: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

English: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.

English: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

English: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
Masaai: elimana ninche to losho o to losho, te nkitoria nabo ometabaiki likae orere,

Masaai: Neitoki taa ajoki, “Kaji eikununo enkitoria e Nkai? Naa ainyoo pasa eitanyaanyukieki?

Masaai: Eitadoyioki enkishiaa ino aaya enemeneng'a, ina orui oo nkinantani inono; eisalaashaki aatadoyio abori iyie, ore ilkuru nikimulumul iyie.

English: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
Masaai: Iyata iyie enkaina natiu anaa ene Nkai? Naa indim iyie atadara to ltoilo laaijo olenye?

English: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
Masaai: Naliki nanu ninche ina aina e Nkai ai oshi natii shumata nanu, naliki sii lelo rorei laairorie nanu olaiguanani. Nejo ninche, “Matudumunye iyiook aashet.” Neaku eitagolo ninche nkaik enye tenkaraki ina siaai sidai.

English: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

English: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
Masaai: naa kaitisiny kewan te nkaraki ninche pee esinyayu sii ninche te sipata.

English: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
Masaai: ore pee eaku etapejoyioki; nemetum olekoisiayio lenye kake keitajeuni ninye enkorrok, kake ketiu anaa oloimunyeki enkima.

English: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore tiatua nkanas eina kop oo ldoinyo, tiatua nkanas e Shefala, o tiatua nkanas e Negeb tiatua enkop e Benchamen, nene wuejitin neemanita Yerusalem, o tiatua nkanas e Yuda, keitoki nkerrai aaim abori nkaik eilo oiken ninche; Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

English: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
Masaai: Amu eisika ninche aaing'uaa ilalema, aailany ina shutati o lalem, neilany ina awuo nakurruno, neilany ilo arrabal otirrisha.

English: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
Masaai: Iyie Papa sinyati, eitu kiyiolou enkop, kake aatayiolo nanu netayioloito kulo nchere iyie likirriwua nanu.

English: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
Masaai: Ore enduaata ena pooki netotiwuo te iyie anaa irorei le mbuku natimishiraki aaiken neishooyo oltung'ani meisuma ilo oyiolo aisuma, ejo, “Isuma ena,” nejo ninye, “Maidim nanu, amu etimishiraki aaiken.”

English: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo lemeyiolo, netaasa enaishiaakino enkidong'oto, eari penyo. Ore pooki oishooki nkumok, neyieki ninye nkumok; ore ilo laa ninye eitanap iltung'ana nkumok neyieki ninye nkumok oleng.

English: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata near Manahem Tipua o pooki ootii atua, o lpolosien lenyena ebaiki Tirsa neito idia alo. Etaara apa tenkaraki neitu ninche ebolu ninye, nedanyaa nkoishua nkituaak pooki naairoishi.

English: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki Yonatan, “Kaing'ae laaliki nanu tenaa eikiwaliki papaai lino te nkisikong'ota?”

English: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
Masaai: Iyiook apa ootiaakita meeu enitii nenyorraa, kake eyieu apake ninye openy nelotu abaiki intae.

English: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo sinyat le ilo Otii Shumata Aisul naa keng'amu enkitoria, neaku enkitoria enenye ntarasi, o ntarasi o ntarasi.’

English: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

English: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani osinkirri, nelopu Yona te nkop natoyio.

English: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa eshuk Yoshua enkaina enye, naa ninye apa eitorioriyie ina pere, o metaba anaa neidaikie tukul lelo pooki apa oomanya Ai.

English: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
Masaai: Ore tenebo lelo aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai iip are o tikitam, apa ooiteng'ela Daudi, pee etum aaisiaayia Ilawi, neipotoki kulo pooki too nkarn.

English: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
Masaai: Nesuj olorora kitok le lelo tung'ana, o nkituaak naaishiraki eoshiosh ilgooitie.

English: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

English: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

English: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

English: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol ninye ninche neiborrie onyek te ninche neirriwaki ilkiliku ninche te Ilkaldayo.

English: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

English: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.

English: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

English: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

English: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
Masaai: Nji aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Shomo inyiang'u enkarasha e kitani, nipik empolos ino nimintadoiki ake atua enkare.”

English: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
Masaai: Neitoki sii aagil nkanas naamanita Gerar, amu etijing'a euriata o Laitoriani shumata ninche, neya ninche imasaa kumok te nena anas.

English: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
Masaai: Naa tenipuopuo enjore te nkop inyi aagilunore ilo mang'atinta linyi oibooki intae enkop, nitumokiki taa aaitadara ntarumpetani, pee edamuni intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, neitajeuni intae too lmang'ati linyi.

English: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
Masaai: Neman Ilyahudi ninye nejoki, “O anu kenya ing'ashing'ashieshie iyiook? Te naa iyie Kristo toliki iyiook imbalakinye.”

English: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
Masaai: Nedou Musa to ldoinyo alotu enetii iltung'ana, neitisiny ninye iltung'ana neisuj ninche inkilani enye.

English: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
Masaai: “Nintayu oloikulu le ilo meregesh otuputieki Aron aapik esiaai sinyati, niyuk pee eaku olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; neaku erubata ino.

English: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

English: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

English: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

English: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

English: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

English: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

English: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Masaai: Hasor, o Rama, o Gitaim,

English: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

English: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

Masaai: Neya ninye ilo ashe oitobirutua ninche, nepejoo ninye te nkima, neidong aitaa empunyua, neidapashaki oriong enkare, neitook iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina are.

English: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

Masaai: Ataa naa enkikordo te lelo laaitang'or; te naadol ninche nanu neipirripir ilukuny enye.

English: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
Masaai: Amu inchoo meitoria pooki tung'ani pee eisho enkishui nemeish lelo pooki linchoo iyie ninye.
