Masaai: Kake etiaaka Musa, “Meishiaakino ti nikiaas ina; amu eikipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang ilasarri ooitagor Ilmisiri. Amaa ti nikipolos ilasarri ooitagor Ilmisiri te dukuya nkonyek enye, aimear iyiook too soito?

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Tudumu eng'irra tipika emborei e omer e mana atua nirragie te dukuya o Laitoriani, neshumi tiatua iishoritin inyi.”

English: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Neaku kepuo ilbarnot lenyena aabatata too lkurrot ootumoreki le nkanasa, ore isikarini lenyena pooki nemuti teina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
Masaai: “Ming'uar enkaji e ilo le latia ino; ming'uar enkitok e ilo le latia ino, arashu osinka lenye, arashu esinka enye, arashu olkiteng lenye, arashu osikiria lenye, arashu hoo ae toki ole latia ino.”

English: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee kitoni iyiook aaitirring'a enturrurroto tenebo, maape iyiook atua nena anas naasheta, pee kindak teine; amu etudung'oko iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang enkidaata, neishoo iyiook enkare natii esayiet matook, enkaraki nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki to Laitoriani.

English: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
Masaai: etinyikayie enkewarie, etaa ekenyu. Ematuburukushu naa isiaaitin e naimin emaishopo masaa e wang'an;

English: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.
Masaai: Ore inkutukie oo nkajijik e lelo gilat le nchoto oobolo embata eine neika netung'uayioki metii toki te kutuk aji e nkalo e moikuape, ore enkae kutuk aji netii e nkalo e kopikop; ore endapasho eine wueji natung'uayioki metii toki naa intemat imiet emanita.

English: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani irorei leina buku oo nkitanapat, nepolos nkilani enyena.

English: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
Masaai: Naitaar nanu ninche oltung'ani ake o likae, iloo menye o layiok lenye tenebo, Olaitoriani ojo. Maing'urrie nanu arashu aleku, arashu aitananaki enkoshoke pee mainyal nanu ninche.’ ”

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eijojo mme nji taa doi etiu pee ipong'oriri, mme ilkigerot miyiololo nimiyiololo sii engolon e Nkai?

English: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Entooku enkiti, eyaki olaitasheikinoni lele sirua.” Neyaki.

English: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Manase: ile Makir, olmarei loo le Makir, naa Makir apa ninye menye le Gilead. Ile Gilead, olmarei loo le Gilead.

English: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninche ina anasa te nkima o pooki naatii atua ninche; enkosholai ake o sahabu, o masaa o suyai o nesekenkei, etipika ninche atua olchumati le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
Masaai: Nenotaki ninye neoru ina tiyani naibung'ita, neoshioshie endukuya enye.

English: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
Masaai: Nelotu olapolosani aim ina oitoi, ore pee edol nepaash, nelo.

English: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
Masaai: Nelotu olapolosani ajur ninye te nkolong e naapishana; naa teneibulayie to lchoni lo sesen lenye, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo oloiduruk naa keeta, enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie enkata, nekurraki enkitok olkitok lenye inkonyek enyena ang'uar Yosef, nejoki, “Irraga tenebo nanu.”

English: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
Masaai: Ina kitok apa natung'uayie olpayian lenye le lelero, nerikino ninye osotua le Nkai enye.

English: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
Masaai: Kang'ida naleng adol kulie kera inono esujita esipata anaa ina ake naitanapa iyiook Papa.

English: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
Masaai: Nejokino ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Keetae oloyaka endaa?”

English: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te neipirare Hahirot neim empolos e naiposha nepuo olpurkel, nepuo elototo oo nkolong'i uni tiongata e Etam, neun ilng'oborri te Mara.

English: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
Masaai: Ore apa eton mayiolo naayau oltau lai, tiatua engarri oo mbartan tembata olkitok lai.”

English: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing Yesu empeut, nesuj ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
Masaai: Entodol pee melaaki oltung'ani olikae entorrono te ntorroni, kake entetem anaake entaasata isidain maate o ltung'ana pooki.

English: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
Masaai: Ena aitanap intae, inchere entonyorrata.

English: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: Neyieng Musa ninye, neisuaaki osarge enchumata eilo perere lo lasar aitaman.

English: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,
Masaai: Harshulal, o Beer-sheba o nkang'itie enyena,

English: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
Masaai: Amaa amu kemurati oltung'ani te nkolong e Sabato pee megili nkitanapat e Musa, oo pee kigorokinono intae nanu amu aitaa oltung'ani biyoto katukul te nkolong e Sabato?

English: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le likae oji Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onomm o ong'uan.

English: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, ore atua Olaitoriani, mme toki eng'oruoi metii olee neme toki olee metii enguruoi;

English: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
Masaai: “Etulusoyie enkisampuare; eishunye enkata enkirowuaj, neitu eitajeuni iyiook.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani ilo likintobira, ilo likintobirua te nkoshoke e ng'utunyi naa ninye likilo aret. Miureishoyu iyie, Yakobo lo sinka lai, Yeshurun laa iyie ategelua.

English: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
Masaai: Neked Simon Petero empeut neikurtutu orreshet enkop natoyio ebore sinkir sapuki oora iip o onom o okuni; kake ore hoo naa kumok aaba neijia eitu epolosa orreshet.

English: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
Masaai: Neitasheyie ninye endung'oroto aitaman ilo ng'obor le Nkai o lperere lo lasar nepik ninye olkarasha te kishomi e ina dung'oroto. Neaku eidipa Musa esiai.

English: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanyisho te nkalo o loo saen - te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong naa keaku enanka o lng'obor le Yuda too lturrurri lenye, aa ore olarikoni lo lturrur le Yuda naa Nahashon olayioni le Aminadab;

English: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
Masaai: Ore peyie eitanap ilo tung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui ajoki, “Iwa enkima te mpolos e nena kejek eng'arri naapuo to loing'ang'e, te rishata oo lkerubi”, nelo ninye atua neitashe te mbata enkeju e ng'arri.

English: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Miyiololo eniomonunu, aa ndimidimi aatook enkikompe naok nanu?” Nejoki, “Ee kindim.”

English: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche olkilikuai meipotuni ninye. Ore Yeroboam o Siraeli pooki nepuonu aajoki Reroboam,

English: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
Masaai: Anaa osiwuo ogol le nkilepunoto enkolong kaidapash nanu ninche te dukuya olmang'atinta. Kaisho nanu ninche oriong ai, mme omom ai, te nkolong enye o sina.”

English: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
Masaai: Ore abori enkererema enye netii iltuleta oomanita, ore lelo tuleta naa ilkererin oare, neenikini ilo moti metaa entoki nabo.

English: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki taata, mayieu naaitoki likae tung'ani aitanyamal, amu ore nkiporo to sesen lai ilmishiren le Yesu ninche.

English: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
Masaai: Eetuo ninche shumata nanu te nkolong ai e nyamali; kake etaa Olaitoriani enkigarakinoto ai.

English: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
Masaai: Kake aitanap lelo ooyamishote, naa Olaitoriani oitanap mme nanu, pee meorore ake enkitok olpayian lenye,

English: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.
Masaai: ore to lari le tomon oobo le nkitoria e Sedekia, to lapa liong'uan, te nkolong e naaudo o lapa, negili isunta e nkang.

English: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
Masaai: Kake te nemeeta oltung'ani iltung'ana lenye ooidimi aatalaaki teina kitarruoroto, ore ina laakinoto neaku eno Laitoriani te nkaraki olapolosani neponikini ilo ker lo lningo lo sotua laa ninye eitobirakinyeki ninye olning'o lo sotua.

English: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
Masaai: Amaa naaji te naa kerubata nabo pooki, kaji eitoki atii osesen?

English: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
Masaai: Naa ore te pooki kata tenaibalunye nanu tialo olosho aashu enkitoria nchere kashet naun ninye,

English: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
Masaai: Ana kanu kitaduaa iyie ira omoni nikirik iyie ang? Anaa minchopo nikinchop iyie?

English: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
Masaai: nejoki ninche Yepta, “Wou taa olarikoni lang, pee kitum iyiook aataarare Ilamoni.”

English: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: He will take your sons, and appoint them for himself, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and some shall run before his chariots.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kuna naaku nkoitoi e ilo aiguanani oyooki aitore intae; keya ninye ilayiok linyi, negelaki ingarrin enyena neaku ilakedok loo mbartan enyena, neipirri ninche te dukuya ingarrin enyena;

English: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
Masaai: Ore Ilyahudi te nkaraki naa enkolong e Nkitobirakinoto, ejo pee meing'uari seseni te shumata o salaba te nkolong e sabato amu enkolong kitok sabato, neomon Pilato metigili ninche nkejek neiwuang'ieki aaya.

English: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
Masaai: ore kulo benia le naisho naa aing'ejuko apa pee kimput iyiook ninche, naa ng'ura, etadanyate; ore kulo kilani o namuka ang netumutate tena lototo naado.”

English: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
Masaai: Ore nena tokitin pooki naasinyari naapuo too naipuko indimidimi aainosa.

English: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
Masaai: Ore ina kewarie, inchoo enaimin narok ong'u eibung ninye! Mincho ninye eshipa tiatua nena olong'i o lari. Mincho ninye elotu ajing esiana oo lapaitin.

English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
Masaai: ore to losho le Benchamen, naa Palti olayioni le Rafu,

English: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
Masaai: Naa te neikilikuani intae aajoki, ‘Oo pee ilakuku?’ Entejo nji, ‘Olaitoriani oata enadung'ie.’ ”

English: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
Masaai: ntalaa ninche te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye; ore te ngoro ino, iyie Enkai, tusulaki ninche enkop!

English: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
Masaai: Amu ayawua nanu intae ailepunye te nkop e Misiri, nalaku intae te nkaji e sinkaisho; nairriu nanu Musa meshomo te dukuya intae, o Aron, o Miriam.

English: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
Masaai: Eeta apa iltung'ana le Israel olng'ur te nkaraki Benchamen olalashe lenye, nejo ninche, “Eiwuang'ieki olosho obo aaitung'uaa Israel ena olong.

English: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
Masaai: Ore ilkuoo le kerra, nedaa anaa ilootii endaata enye, ore ilkuoo le kineji nedaa to lmuaate.

English: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
Masaai: negilunore imelin pooki e Tarshishi negilunore pooki toki e nkarriyiano.

English: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye Hana emion sapuk to ltau neomon Olaitoriani, neishir te mion.

English: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore inaaing'uaa olosho le Dan naa El-teke te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Gibeton te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
Masaai: Kat are aen kewan aitupukoo te wiki, naishooyo ematua e tomon e pooki toki natum.’

English: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
Masaai: Te nadamu nanu inkoitoi inono, naibelekeny nkejek aainei aipirie enchakenisho ino;

English: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo ooiteng'eni aapuo nkang'itie enye.

English: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
Masaai: Nemeetae oloisho kewan ina kitoo, kake Enkai naipot, anaa apa pee eipot Aron.

English: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
Masaai: Niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata eirragaa impopoki enye tiatua inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu emanita ilpereren lenye, te shumata pooki doinyo oodo, o too nchumat pooki oo ldoinyo, o tiabori olchani pooki onyori, o tiabori pooki shani dapashi mbenek, o te pooki wueji ake neitainye esong'uana narropil aaitaiki inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
Masaai: Neibelekenya ninye anang silig, ore ake pee edol ninche, nedek ninche te nkarna o Laitoriani. Neipang'u tiatua entim ilng'arurum oare le ntim nedung nena ayiok artam o are aaitaa ndung'udung'ot.

English: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Saul Daudi elo aarare ilo Filisti, nejoki ninye Abna, olkitok le njore, “Abna, kole ng'ae ele barnoti?” Nejo Abna, “Anaa enaishu oltau lino, olaiguanani, maaidim nanu atolimu.”

English: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo nematii ine to sesen, kake atii te nkiyang'et ang'ida te nadol orrekie linyi sidai o enkitashoto e nkirukoto inyi ti atua Kristo.

English: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki oomanya olomanaa le naiposha, neing'asiate te nkaraki iyie; ore ilaiguanak lenye neiruto oleng, ore inkomomi enye netanyamala.

English: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elo olaiguanani Ahas Dameski atumore Tiglat-pilesa olaiguanani le Asiria, nelo ninye olperere lo lasar otii Dameski. Neirriwaki olaiguanani olapolosani oji Uria empukunoto eilo perere lo lasar, o enkitobirunoto enye, o mbaa enyena pooki.

English: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
Masaai: Naa kairragie lelo seseni ootuata loo ltung'ana le Israel te dukuya inkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin nemeishu; naidapash iloik linyi aitaman ilpereren linyi loo lasarri.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kagilunore nanu ele marei aipiru entorroni ometaa mindimidimi aaibelekenya imurto inyi. Nimintokiki aapuo te nkitokoos amu keaku enkata e ntorroni.

English: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
Masaai: Neng'utut ilalashera lenyena pooki neishiraki ninye ninche; ore pee eidip ina neiteru ilalashera aairorie ninye.

English: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.
Masaai: Ore naa, kainyoo iata? Nchooki nanu imukateni imiet, arashu entoki naba anaa enatii ene.”

English: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
Masaai: Ore ninye Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo makewan, o Enkai Papa lang ootonyorra iyiook, neisho iyiook enkilejilej oo ntarasi o siligi sidai oing'uaa empiris,

English: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Yahasiel olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Yerel, olayioni le Matania, Olawi loo layiok le Asaf, te mpolos eina umata.

English: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
Masaai: naa kerupi enkarna ino ntarasi, eji, ‘Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye Enkai oo Siraeli,’ ore enkaji o sinka lino Daudi neitubulari te dukuya iyie.

English: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
Masaai: “Naa ele olasar lintayu te nchumata o lperere lo lasar, ilkuoo oare le kerra lo lari obo, anaake te nkolong.

English: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
Masaai: ore kulo nariku nanu ilo doinyio lai sinyati naisho nanu ninche meting'idata ti atua ina aji ai e nkomono; ore lelo asarri lenye oopejori o nkishorunot enye, naa kepuoi aang'amaa te nchumata ilo perere lai lo lasar; amu kepuoi aajo enkaji ai enkaji enkomono too loreren pooki.

English: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo aajo ltung'ana le Nkai ooyooki aaiguanare enkop? Amaa te naa intae ooyooki aaiguanare enkop, keaku mindimidimi aaiguanare nkunyinyi baa?

English: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira elong'o naamanita nanu, iyie enkitoo ai, naa iyie likishumu endukuya.

English: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
Masaai: neorikino ninche ilkilani laainei maate, ore to lkila lai neosh ninche enkukuo.

English: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ina pee etii dukuya olorika le nkitoo le Enkai neisiaai ninye dama o kewarie ti atua enkaji enye, ore ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo naa keitushur ninche te ine netii ninye.

English: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
Masaai: Neraposhu inkonyek enyena neing'orisho, naa ng'ura, eitashe iltung'ana okuni te dukuya ninye. Ore pee edol ninche, nepuku akuetu tiatua olng'obor anang'are ninche, neirrugo ninye abaiki enkop ejo:

English: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
Masaai: Inchoo ninche metooko pee erikino osina lenye, nemeitoki aadamu osina lenye.

English: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
Masaai: tayiolo naa ajo neijia etiu eng'eno nagut tiatua oltau lino; tinitum ninye naa itum eseriani too nkolong'i naapuonu, nemedung'ori osiligi lino katukul.

English: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.
Masaai: Tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Atasayia nanu olaiguanani te nkanyit pee maaigil ake areu enkaji e Yonatan mashomo aye teine.’ ”

English: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
Masaai: Nelo ilo tung'ani enetii Pilato aomonu osesen le Yesu.

English: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
Masaai: Neitushulu kulo pooki enjore aitaa nabo to erata le Siddim (aa taa enaiposha e munyan).

English: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
Masaai: Ninguekiki ilayiok linyi te siadi intae, pee ejung aaitaa imasaa enye intarasi; ndimidimi intae aaitaa ninche irrindiki, kake ore te shumata ilalashera linyi lelo tung'ana le Israel mintorere, oltung'ani ake olikae tenkisikong'ata.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: ‘Tinilo tiatua inkoitoi aainei nimbung enkitanapata ai, neaku iyaku oloitore enkaji ai nintore sii indung'orot aainei, naa kaaisho iyie esipata nijing'ie tenebo kulo ooitashe tene.

English: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
Masaai: Ore apa oltau lino naa kewuasa te nkaraki enkishiaa ino; inyala iyie eng'eno ino nagut te sikar ino. Aatanang'aka iyie enkop; aataboloyie iyie te dukuya ilaiguanak meitaraposho nkonyek enye te iyie.

English: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
Masaai: Ore peyie ekenyu, enyeito ninche enasirie aainos pooki olmumai, neisho Isaak ninche meshomo, nepuo aaing'uaa ninye to sotua.

English: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
Masaai: Tenelo nelotu enkiguana naing'uaa ilalashera linyi ootii kulie anas, eipirta enkibukoroto o sarge, o enkitanapata, anaa nkikoot, o nkiguanat, ninteng'en iyie ninche, pee meas ake entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani, melotu ake engoro napi shumata intae o lalashera linyi. Ena intae entaas nimbayuyu intae entorroni.

English: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
Masaai: Ore ilo gilata le wueji sinyati oleng naa ntemat tomon oisiet e nkaina enkadoro.

English: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king's hand.
Masaai: Neibonisho iloibonok pooki aaiko neijia, nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead timirisho; amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik olaiguanani.”

English: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eitamanyuni ildoinyio, ore eton meetae indoinyo naaitobiruaki nanu.

English: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
Masaai: Te nejo napaji enkeju, “Ore amu mara nanu enkaina, mara eno sesen,” nemeibelekenya aaku mme eno sesen te nkaraki ina.

English: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
Masaai: Amu keinos ninche olasai anaa nkilani, neinos ninche olkurto anaa ilpapit loo nkerra; kake ore enkordunoto ai naa enoo ntarasi, ore enjeunoto ai naa enoo ishoritin pooki.”

English: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene imiet Natania, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye naa nkalifuni artam o obo o iip imiet.

English: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
Masaai: Nemeigili aajo oltung'ani omoda kedupa, nemeji lelo aisimak eji keleng.

English: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye olpisiai anaa osaei le murt nepik ninche enchumata e nena ng'apeta; neitobir ilgululu iip nabo neripaki ilo pisiaai.

English: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
Masaai: Netii enkitanapata e Nkai enye atua oltau lenye; nemeideketari too roruat enyena.

English: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
Masaai: Nepuo Musa o Aron atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo ore ake pee eipang'u ninche aapuonu boo nemayian ninche iltung'ana, neliooyu enkitoo o Laitoriani too ltung'ana pooki.

English: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
Masaai: Ore hoo naa enkop kitii kinchu, mme enjore e nkop kitii.

English: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
Masaai: Kedaa ilo oata osina neraposho, ore lelo ooing'oru ninye neisis Olaitoriani! Metaa keishu iltauja linyi ntarasi!

English: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
Masaai: Nelo Enok tenebo Enkai, nelai ninye amu ewa Enkai ninye.

English: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ninchooyo iyie ile Lawi aisho Aron o layiok lenyena; eishooki ninche ninye tukul ti atua iltung'ana le Israel.

English: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
Masaai: Etii iltung'ana ootii atua iyie ooiro imbaa enkarruoisho pee eibukori osarge, oltung'ana tiatua iyie oodaa too nchumat oo ildonyio; iltung'ana ooas enkarruoisho tiatua intae.

English: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
Masaai: Kalo nanu apik enkaina enye enchumata e naiposha, napik enkaina enye e tatene shumata ilkejek.

English: And shall say unto them, Hear, O Israel, ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies: let not your hearts faint, fear not, and do not tremble, neither be ye terrified because of them;
Masaai: nejoki ninche, ‘Toning'o iyie Israel, tinyikai iyie ena olong ng'utaki olarrabal taarare ilmang'ati linono: mincho oltau lino elepori; miureishoyu niming'aeng'ae, aashu mputukuny te nkaraki ninche;

English: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
Masaai: amu nkolong'i e nkitamioto kuna, naabaya mbaa pooki naatisiraki.

English: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
Masaai: Kake eyieunoto apa Olaitoriani pee epik ninye olbae; etipika Olaitoriani ninye osina; neitaa ninye kewan olasar loo ng'ok, nelo adol eishoi enye, neitoodori nkolong'i enyena; kelo eyieunoto o Laitoriani adupoyu te nkaina enye;

English: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
Masaai: Amu keibalunye ninye esipata ino anaa ewang'an, o enchunet ino aitotiu anaa dama.

English: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
Masaai: nerish naa ina umata ilo oitayio loikop o ilo oitalaku osarge te risioroto e kuna kikoot.

English: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
Masaai: nepik ina orropil enkima te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee etum enkatampoi eina puruo aimulumula ilo orika lolng'ur otii enchumata e wueji enchakenisho pee meye ake;

English: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
Masaai: ore lelo aranyak pooki le Lawi, o Asaf, o Heman, o Yedutum, o layiok lenye o lalashera lenye, neishop ilkilani sidain, neeta inkinantani dapashi, o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o lwululi loo usin, neitashe te nkalo o loo saen lo lperere lo lasar, tenebo ilapolosak iip nabo o tikitam ookut ntarumpetani.

English: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk enkitok naibor onyek naa engumoto nagut; ore ilo otagorokine Olaitoriani naa kesulakino atua ninye.

English: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be Hazazon-tamar, which is Engedi.
Masaai: Nepuonu kulikae tung'ana aajoki Yehoshafat, “Etii olorora kitok oing'ua Edom likipuonu aarare, ooing'uaa lido kekun le naiposha; naa ng'ura, etii ninche Hasasotama” (aa taa Enkedi).

English: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
Masaai: Neitashe Simon Petero aij enkima. Nejoki ninche ninye, “Oo iyie, aa ira obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena?” Nemiki, nejo, “Mara.”

English: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
Masaai: Nchopoko iyie olari esupatisho ino, ore rrekiei le ngarri ino neitong eilata.

English: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Amaa tenearaa olee enkitok enye nelo ninye aing'uaa ninye neaku enkitok e likae lee, keitoki ilo apa lee ashukokino ninye? Aimeitarruoo ina enkop oleng? Itaa iyie emulayoi too sanchan kumok naa eikintoki arrinyokino nanu? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Lod, Hadid o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o obo.

English: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
Masaai: iyaku olaitasheiki enkaji ai ore iltung'ana laainei pooki ekeaku ilooning ina nintanap; meteleku tolorika le nkitoo ake aaku nanu kitok te iyie.”

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet ele apa liopishana o too nkolong'i naapishana naa osirua loo lng'oborri lo Laitoriani.

English: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
Masaai: Neitorioo enkaina enye neiseyie nejo, “Ayieu; tisikayu.” Nesikari nabo kata enkeeya enye.

English: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
Masaai: naa te neeta enkitok olpayian leitu eiruk, netonyorrayie metotona te nebo, nemeorore sii ninye olpayian lenye.

English: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
Masaai: “Mipurrisho, nimiasisho te sunkureisho, nemilej oltung'ani olikae.

English: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
Masaai: Neijia etiu olng'ejep enkiti rubata to sesen, kake ejo sapuki oleng. Tadamu eneba esapuko e ntim, naidim oloti tiili atapejo?

English: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu enkarna e Nkai to sinkolio; narrep nanu ninye te nkishoroto e nashe.

English: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
Masaai: Enkop ake oo lapolosak eitu einyang'u; amu keeta apa ilapolosak emborei enye nauno naing'uaaa Farao, neishunyie ina borei enye naishoo Farao ninche; metaa eitu ninche emir enkop enye.

English: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
Masaai: Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki Israel; nejo ninye, “Ore enkaraki natigila kulo tung'ana olning'o lai apa laitanapa nanu loo menye, neitu ening oltoilo lai,

English: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
Masaai: “Nimitem Olaitoriani Enkai ino, anaa enitetema ninye te Masa.

English: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: metaa meitoki ninche aayieu neya ilkeek le nkima aaitung'uaa olokeri arashu edung'u too ntimi, amu keitobiru enkima enye too masaa enye olarrabal; ekeinyal ninche lelo ooinyal ninche, nemut lelo oomut ninche ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
Masaai: Enkaraki ina sii pee eshomo ina siamo anang'are amu etoning'o aajo etaasa ele monekie.

English: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
Masaai: Mme ate kilikioo iyiook; Kristo Yesu kilikioo aajo Olaitoriani, nikira iyiook isinkan linyi, te nkaraki Yesu.

English: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam ooudo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yeho-adin e Yerusalem.

English: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
Masaai: Ainyoo peyie incho oltau lino mikitanapa aitalamaa, naa ainyoo peyie incho inkonyek inono eirriap?

English: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo osomit lino o aisinanisho ino, kake ira karsis. Ayiolo sii imorot e lelo oojo ate Ilyahudi neme ninche, kake enkaji e ntumo e sheitani ninche.

English: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
Masaai: Neishiraki ninche Efraim papaai lenye nkolong'i kumok nepuonu ilalashera lenye aaitagol ninche.

English: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
Masaai: “Matudumunye, matarasaki kewarie, nikindaikie inkajijik enyena e nkitoo!”

English: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura! Neitashe olmalaika lo Laitoriani atashare ninye, neitawang ewang'an ina aji: neosh ilo Petero ematua, neinyeyie, nejoki, “Inyo tasioki?” Neitiaari inaduoo munyororoni naatii nkaik te ine.

English: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
Masaai: o Yehud, o Bene-berak, o Bat-rimon,

English: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
Masaai: Nekuet osinka anang'are ninye nejoki, “Aatoomono inchooki enkiti are naok te moti ino.”

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaisho ina kop e Misiri Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon; naa kenap ninye arsisisho enye neitaa ninye enaaruno neidaikie ninye; naa keaku elaata enjore enye.

English: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
Masaai: (Kulo ninche ilarin le nkishui e Ishmael ilarin iip o tomoni uni o naapishana, neitianya aye, neiturrurrokino ninye olorere lenye.)

English: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “Inchoo metijing'a nkariak ntokitin naaishu, inchoo sii imotonyi meshomo to loing'ang'e le keper aaingat enkop.”

English: For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.
Masaai: Amu eloolo Olaitoriani Enkai ino te mpolos oo lng'oborri linyi, pee eitajeu intae neirragie ilmang'ati linyi te dukuya intae, metaa nchoo ilng'oborri linyi esinyayu pee medol ake ninye entoki suuji tiatua intae, neibelekenya aing'uaa intae.

English: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
Masaai: Etoosho ninye ilkikaunot pooki le nkop enye, ilo ng'anayioi le dukuya le ngolon enye.

English: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
Masaai: Etegelua Enkai lelo lemejo enkop eeta tipat nemenari sii, o lelo lemeetae apa pee etum aitaa pesho nena naatae,

English: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
Masaai: Neitashe isirkon ti ong'ata too nkisiajat naaika, neipang'ipang aaok enkijape anaa mbariak neiliilaa nkonyek enye, amu meetae nkujit.

English: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
Masaai: Enchom maate, eyau olkujita linyi te wueji neba anaa enitumiemie; kake ore esiaai meitong'ori hoo ninye peno.’ ”

English: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
Masaai: kake keaku enkitoo o enkanyit o eseriani te pooki ng'ae oas isupati, neituruk to Lyahudi naa neijia etiu too Lyunani.

English: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
Masaai: Neriku ninye ninche atua ina kop sinyati, enetii ilo doinyo oisulie ninye te nkaina enye e tatene.

English: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
Masaai: Neiteru lasirak o lapolosak kituaak aajo matipik inkaik te ina saa, kake etureita olorere; amu etoduaa aajo ninche eipirie ina kitanyaanyukoto.

English: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kake mindim iyie atoduaa enkomom ai; amu meetae oltung'ani odol enkomom ai neishu.”

English: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
Masaai: Eitobira sii apa Yehoshafat osotua o laiguanani loo Siraeli.

English: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
Masaai: Naa aining'ining'i intae ilarrabali o mbaa oo njoreitin eimakini, naa entodol ake emirut amu meeta inchere pee mebau kuna baa; kake eton eng'or enkiting'oto.

English: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
Masaai: Te ina retoto ino naisiligunoyu tokorduaki nanu maimis ti atua esarng'ab; nchooki nanu manoto enkordunoto too lmang'ati laainei, o too nkariak naagut.

English: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entasho entirring'ata, pee atum atasayia intae te dukuya Olaitoriani ti alo nkiaasin pooki e njeunoto o Laitoriani naataasa ninye te nkaraki intae o te nkaraki iloo papaai linyi.

English: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
Masaai: Pee ipuopuo te nkishon naishiaakino te Nkai, ilo oipotoki intae atua enkitoria enye makewan e nkitoo.

English: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
Masaai: Ore lelo biasharani otii atua iltung'ana neisulisho te nkaraki iyie; ieuo iyie enkiting'oto torrono oleng' nimikintokini ae kata aata intarasi.’ ”

English: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
Masaai: Ore enjeunoto e ilo supat naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa; ninye esarunoto enye te nkata e engolikinoto.

English: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
Masaai: Neitoki Boas ajoki, “Ore akenya enkolong ninyang'u enkurma te nkaina e Naomi, ninyang'u sii ninye Rusi, ina tito oo Lmoabu, ina oliai olapa lemeishu pee errinyokini enkarna e ilo lemeishu enjung'ore enye.”

English: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
