Masaai: Esika endapashari te nelakua, entobik tiatua enguton, intae iloomanya Hasor! Olaitoriani ojo. Amu ore Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon, neitobira enkitobirata tialo intae neipirua ina nayieu tialo intae.

English: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
Masaai: Netiu emootian enye anaa enkurare nabolo iltung'ana magil ninche pooki.

English: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
Masaai: Mputa ntadooi te nkop ino anaa olkeju le Nail, na tito e Tarshishi; meekure eetae entoki nikimbooyo.

English: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
Masaai: “Mintayuyu intae ilomon le lejare. Mimbung'arere oltung'ani torrono aaitayu enchakenisho e lejare.

English: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
Masaai: nenuki nong'ot pooki, ore pooki doinyo o lkiushin neitodorropi; ore ineekordilo nererei, ore nkoitoi naasur neisiashayieki;

English: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
Masaai: Nitumokiki taa aaitayiolo nkera inyi nchere, ‘Etalang'a apa Israel ele keju le Yordan aaim enkop natoyio.’

English: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
Masaai: “Ng'ura, aitayu nanu ile Lawi aitung'uaa atua iltung'ana le Israel te rishata e pooki kikau too ltung'ana le Israel. Keaku ore ile Lawi naa ilaainei,

English: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.
Masaai: Neibalunyeki tiatua Yuda pooki o Yerusalem, pee eyakini Olaitoriani ina kodi apa natejo Musa osinka le Nkai pee eitayu Isiraeli tiong'ota.

English: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
Masaai: Neton ake eiko neijia kulo tung'ana too nkidetidetat enye neidurukie osesen, neany enkitoria, nemor iloata enkitoo le shumata.

English: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
Masaai: Inchoo metaa ore entito najoki, aatoomono intadou emoti ino matooko enkare, naajoki tooko, naa kaokoki sii intamesin inono inchoo metaa ninye itegelaka osinka lino Isaak. Teina ayiolou ajo intodolua enyorrata nauno to olkitok lai.”

English: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee kidol iyie nkariak, Olaitoriani, ore ake pee kidol iyie nkariak, neureishoyu ninche, ee, neikirikira enguton.

English: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
Masaai: Melo ninye aing'or lelo kejek, nena shorroi naaruko inaishi o kule.

English: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
Masaai: “Ntobira olperere too nkeek o lerai intemat imiet enkadoro naa intemat imiet endapasho; nerisioro olperere too nkaloli pooki. Ore enkilepata enye naa intemat uni.

English: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
Masaai: “Ore akenya ti nikiyau Olaitoriani enkop oo Lkanaani, anaa enainosa olmumai te iyie o too loo papaai linyi, naa eikincho iyie.

English: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
Masaai: Aiba nanu namen entorroni, kake anyor inkitanapat inono.

English: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak loo Lawi naa: Hashabia, o Sherabia, o Yeshua olayioni le Kadmiel tenebo ilalashera lenye ooipirakinore ninche, pee eisis Enkai neishooyo enashe, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi ilo tung'ani le Nkai pee easi aairukokino.

English: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
Masaai: Kake teneibor ilo pepedoi otii olchoni lo sesen lenye, nelioo ajo eitu eturoyu alang olchoni, neitu eibelekenya olpapita leine eitu eturoyu alang olchoni, neitu eibelekenya olpapita leine aiborru, neikenoo olapolosani ilo tamuoyiai nkolong'i naapishana,

English: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
Masaai: Aiti niyiololo intae oora torrok aaishoo inkera inyi inkishorot sidain, kebaa eitulusoo naleng Papa linyi otii shumata aisho intokitin sidain lelo oomon ninye?

English: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
Masaai: Ore apa eton mikiaata eretoto, ore te nkata naishiakino neye Kristo te nkaraki ltorrok.

English: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
Masaai: Nikiaasishore, ake etiu irorei le ng'eno te lelo ootubulutua, kake mme eng'eno ele porror neme ene lelo ooitoreisho te le porror amu eidipa ninche aataa keurori.

English: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninche ilalashera lenye neitisiny ate, nejing ninche atua anaa enaitanapishe olaiguanani, too rorei lo Laitoriani, pee eitisinyi enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
Masaai: Ore eitanyamal emion oleng', etiaka enkaitoyioni ninye, “Miureishoyu amu itum ae ayioni.”

English: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
Masaai: Etadara sii Olaitoriani to loing'ang'e, ore Ilo otii Shumata Aisul neitayu oltoilo lenye, neitayu enchan oo soito o nkuk naaishu.

English: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
Masaai: nemeirony hoo likae tung'ani, kake elaaki ilo oota esile elaata enye, nemeas inenkikonya, neisho emukate enye lelo oota esumash neitoip olemeeta enkila te nkila,

English: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
Masaai: Ore hoo naa neijia ti nikiro, ore te intae, ilanyor laainei, kesipa nchere kiaatayie intae osiligi loo mbaa naaikash e njeunoto.

English: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
Masaai: Neng'amaa ajoki, “Enkaraki naishooki intae entayiolo inkisudorot e nkitoria e shumata, kake eitu eishori ninche.

English: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
Masaai: Netum enkaina oo ltung'ana le Israel engolon oleng ti alo Yabin ilo aiguanani le Kanaan, o metaba anaa neidaikie Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan.

English: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
Masaai: Neitoki Yese aisho Shamas metogiroi. Nejo ninye, “Eitu sii egelu Olaitoriani ele.”

English: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
Masaai: “Ena enkitanapata naitanapishe Olaitoriani. Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel pee kiyaki enkashe nanyokie nemeeta eleyiata nemeeta entioto neitu ae kata eenikini enchata emurt.

English: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.
Masaai: neman ninche aang'adu olaiguanani, oltung'ani ake eibung'ita imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina. Ore pooki ng'ae onyikaki lelo turrurri neari metua. Etaa tenebo o laiguanani teneipang auluo o tenejing'u.”

English: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Masaai: Neranyaki Miriam ninche ejo: “Entaranyaki Olaitoriani amu etimirishe te nkitoo; ore embarta o ilo okedito netanang'aka ninye atua enaiposha.”

English: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
Masaai: Ina pee edumunye Yoab, nepolos olkila lenye, nebarn elukunya enye, nebatatakino enkop aserem.

English: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Nesia, lelo ayiok le Hatifa.

English: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
Masaai: Ore te nkowuarisho enye neitorogony intae too rorei loo monko, amu meiyiata enkiguana enye e opa, nemeirura erruorroto enye.

English: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
Masaai: Negiroo isinkan lenyena pooki ninye; o Lkereti pooki, o Lpeleti, o lelo iip ile le Giti apa ootusujaitie ninye ebaiki Gas, negiroo aaim dukuya olaiguanani.

English: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
Masaai: Ore anaa eneba ilarin te siadi ilo sirua neijia eba enkinyiang'a teilo lelatia ino, naa terisioroto oo larin loo ndaiki kimiraki ninye.

English: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
Masaai: Entirring'ata intae kulo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha, lo ainyiang'ak le Sidon, etalang'a apa lelo lirriwaitie intae enkare nepuo ninche aaim nkariak kumok;

English: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
Masaai: Ore ilo kikau lo laisinani nedaa, ore ilo oata osina neirrag te seriani; kake kamut nanu entonai eishoi ino to lameyu, ore ilo pisiai lino naar nanu to lalem.

English: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
Masaai: Esiaayia Olaitoriani te nchipai! Wootu dukuya ninye to sinkolio!

English: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
Masaai: Amu te naa ina natanyaita ninche nayaka enkop metoning'ore Enkai, keeta ae nayau enyorrarroto enye neme empiunoto too lootuata?

English: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
Masaai: Tuputunye na auo oo sinkolioitin o endule! Kainyototo nanu enasirie!

English: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keure iltung'ana ninye; meshilaa hoo lelo oojo aing'eni te lejare enye maate.”

English: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
Masaai: Eeta oltau lai enkure te nkaraki Enkai, Enkai naishu. Kanu kenya alotu aing'or enkomom e Nkai?

English: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, “Ninye.” Nejo kulikae, “Mme ninye, kake kenyaanyukie ninye.” Nejo ninye openy. “Nanu ilo.”

English: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
Masaai: Nayiolou ina naawaliki ninye nanu, naning'u ina naajoki ninye nanu.

English: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: Naa te ina oitoi ake inchooi anaake, too nkolong'i naapishana, ina daa o lasar opejori te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; keitarasari ninye te nebo ilo asar le anaake o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani neitoodor enkishui, kake ore ilarin loo larruok neitodorropi.

English: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
Masaai: Naa kamayian nanu ninye, ore sii naa kaaisho iyie enkayioni te ninye. Naa kamayian nanu ninye neaku ninye ng'otonye oo loshon, kepukunye ninye ilaiguanak loo loreren.”

English: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
Masaai: anaa sii enatiu nanu oloitiship iltung'ana pooki te pooki oitoi, nemaing'oru dupoto ai makewan, kake ene pooki, pee eitajeuni.

English: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
Masaai: Ore ejo olaiguanani agiroo, neishiraki ninye olaiguanani ejo, “Eshomo osinka lino empolos olarrabal, naa ng'ura, eibelekenye osikari neyau oltung'ani enatii, naajoki nanu, ‘Ng'ura ele tung'ani; naa tenelo neluaya, neinosieki enkishui ino enkishui enye, aashu ilak entalanta e nkosholai.’

English: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
Masaai: Ore enemeneng'a o Abadon neibala te dukuya Olaitoriani, kebaa eibala oleng iltauja loo ltung'ana! Abadon: Etii ewueji oo rorei lemeibala.

English: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
Masaai: Kake amaa te naa kenkarruoisho ang naibalie esipata e Nkai, te nkiguana, eikijo aa naa? Eikijo mme asipani Enkai te neyau engoro enye (Kairorita taa doi anaa naajo ltung'ana.)

English: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Hobab olayioni le Ruel ilo Midiani, aputani le Musa, “Eikidumunye iyiook aapuo ine wueji natejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kaisho nanu intae’ wootu te nebo iyiook, amu eikintaas iyiook intae esidai; amu eisiligie Olaitoriani Isiraeli embae sidai.”

English: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nenang'are ninye enkitok, neishope anaa emulayoi, neeta enareuta.

English: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore iloshon pooki nikimpot aajo olomayiana, amu iaku enkop nashipakinoi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Barsilai, “Wou talang'u te nebo nanu, naa kaagolie nanu iyie te nebo nanu te Yerusalem.”

English: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Olaitoriani olchakeni te intae, naa ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput olchakeni ena olong, nchere eitu intae itumutumu ae toki te nkaina ai.” Nejo ninche, “Ninye olchakeni.”

English: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
Masaai: nijokiki olopeny enkaji, ‘Kitiaaka Olaiteng'enani, koree ake olgilata loo lomon, lainosie Pasaka o looiteng'eni laainei?'

English: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki nena pooki naasita ilkipaareta, neaku kenapuni ltamueyia mbat oo nkoitoi oo nkaulele, neirragieki too rruatin o too lkarash paa ore eim Petero ine, neporoo oloip lenye kulikae lenye.

English: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong ai oo ng'olikinot, aaipoto nanu iyie, amu eikiwaliki iyie nanu.

English: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku te ine nelo olkirine le Turo o Sidon. Nejing enkaji nabo, nemeyieu neyiolouni aajo etii ine; kake etalaikinoteki aaisudoi.

English: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
Masaai: Tadamu, Olaitoriani, ti alo iltung'ana le Edom, ina batatata apa e Yerusalem, etejo apa ninche, “Endaikie ninye, endaikie ninye! Entigil o metabaiki olkitamanyunoto!”

English: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
Masaai: Neibung ilaturok isinkan lenyena, neidong obo, near likai metua, near likai too soito.

English: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
Masaai: “Naa kepuo ninche aaing'oru mpopoki oo ltung'ana apa laatogolong'akita, amu meye aekata olkurui lenye, nemeyagaa enkima enye, naa keaku ninche entoki naitureisho too ltung'ana pooki.

English: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
Masaai: o ltoilo le ntarumpeta o ltoilo laa ore nkirorot enyena neitureita lelo apa ootoning'o metasaisho aajo pee meitokini aaigilie kulie kirorot.

English: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro e ndung'oroto naa intemat imiet. Netii ilkarash ooluaa sidain oopuyiapui o nkitotoneta o suyai.

English: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
Masaai: Neyam Lamek inkituaak are. Ore enkarna e nabo naa keji Ada, neji enkarna enkae Sila.

English: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo oputu enaiposha o metaa keikurrukur ilopir lenyena - Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.

English: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Masaai: ore too neeiting'ie enkop naaipot nanu iyie, elepori oltau lai. Torikoyioki iyie nanu mashomo ina dapidapoi naado alang nanu;

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki Turo: amaa olmanie le naiposha aimeikirikira tenening embuaata e mbatatata ino, ina kata naigor ilo otipikaki olbae, ina kata etii lelo ootipikaki ilbaa atua erishata inyi?

English: And the LORD said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Eiroro ninche aaitobiraki nena pooki naatejo ninche.

English: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
Masaai: Nesai lelo oiriruani aajoki, “Te naa iaraa iyiook aipung'ie, inchoo iyiook maape aajing enda boo oo lbitiro.”

English: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
Masaai: Near Daudi ninche aiteru teipa o metabaiki enteipa e nkae olong. neitu eisik hoo obo lenye, meteleku ilbarnot iip ong'uan apa ookedito ntamesin neisik.

English: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o ile le nkitoria e Asa, nelo Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli agilunore Yuda, neshet Rama, ejo pee meipang hoo oltung'ani obo anaa ejing'u alo enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
Masaai: Neaku etudumutua ninche Yeremia nesulaki ninye atua olchorro le Malkia olayioni lo laiguanani, apa otii atua olgoriet le rripore, eitadoyio Yeremia abori too lgoso. Nemetii apa enkare atua ilo shorro, kake esarng'ab ake, neimis Yeremia tiatua ina sarng'ab.

English: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
Masaai: ejo, “Kaliki lalashera laainei enkarna ino, naaisis iyie te mpolos e umata.”

English: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
Masaai: ‘Entiaki Yosef, tapalaki, aatasayia enkitarruorroto oo lalashera linono o engoki enye, amu kintaasa ninche iyie entorroni.’ Ore naa taata, kisai iyie, tapalaki inkitadiaat oo sinkan le Nkai e papaai lino.” Neishir Yosef pee eirorie ninche ninye.

English: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
Masaai: Ene nking'asia enchakenisho ino; ore enkaraki ina neibung oltau lai ninche.

English: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Masaai: Ore ororei lino naa oltaa loo nkejek aainei naa ewang'an te nkoitoi ai.

English: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
Masaai: Nedumunye ltung'ana asayiak le Enkai aapuo aanukaa Stefano, eishiraki to ltoilo sapuk.

English: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
Masaai: Aaipoto nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, tasioku enatii nanu! toning'o oltoilo lai, te naaipot nanu iyie!

English: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:
Masaai: inchoo osesen lenye esika nejing kitisho inchoo ninye errinyokino inapa olong'i e ngolon e kitisho;’

English: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
Masaai: Neimie ninye nena bokishi atua lelo giso too murten e ilo perere lo lasar, pee enapieki ninche; neitobir too mbaoi aitugum.

English: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
Masaai: Naa keriki intae dukuya ilbalosini o laiguanak te nkaraki nanu, pee iakuku shakeni te ninche o too Loreren.

English: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: Neijia sii enchoo ewang'an inyi metawang'a te dukuya iltung'ana pee edol iasat inyi supati, pee eyanyituni Papa linyi otii shumata.

English: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ore ake irishat pooki nikitum, emaitaasa pooki ng'ae isupati, neisul lelo le nkaji e nkirukoto.

English: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
Masaai: Eoshieki elishie embarta, ore olgisoi nepiki enkume o sikiria, ore eng'udi naa ene nkoriong oo lmoda.

English: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?
Masaai: Nenyamalu oltau lo laiguanani le Siria te nkaraki ena bae; neipotu isinkan lenyena nejoki ninche, “Aimikintodolidolo nanu nchere kalo tiatua iyiook otii enkalo o laiguanani loo Siraeli?”

English: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejoki Yuda Tamar ina kitok o layioni lenye. “Totona ira enkoliai te nkaji e papaai lino, o metaba anaa nebulu olayioni lai Shela.” Amu etureishe ajo keidim sii ninye atua anaa ilalashera lenyena. Metaa eshomo Tamar enkaji e menye.

English: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
Masaai: nchoo ninye ilo mang'tinta lai aasuj naainepu nanu, naa nchoo ninye eitunyoki enkishui ai enkop, neipurrupur oltau lai.

English: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
Masaai: Amu keishir ena kop, ore shumata neroku; amu airoro nanu, atootikio nanu eitu nanu aainosu nemashuko siadi.”

English: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
Masaai: Netii apa oltung'ani oji Yosef le nkang oo Lyahudi naji Arimatea. Naa obo ninye lo lkiama, naa oltung'ani supat asipani,

English: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
Masaai: Nejoki Israel Yosef, “Etaa taa nchooki matua amu aatoduaa enkomom nayiolo ajo eton ake inchu.”

English: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
Masaai: Neilepu iltung'ana aapuku ti atua Yordan te nkolong e tomon o lapa le dukuya, neitayu ilng'oborri te Gilgal to lpolosie le nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong le Yeriko.

English: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
Masaai: amu aatiripakine enaimin, neitemoyie enaimin nairrusha enkomom ai.

English: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
Masaai: Nedumu Musa enkitok enye o layiok lenyena nepik osikiria, nelo ashuko enkop e Misiri; naa ore te nkaina enye neya Musa eng'udi e Nkai.

English: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku ketiu enkoitoi enye te ninche anaa enkoitoi naideket te naimin, atua ninye emirakini ninche nebatata amu kayau nanu entorroni shumata ninche tiatua ilo ari le nkitamioto enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, nelotu engoro o Laitoriani napi shumata e Yuda o Yerusalem, neitaa ninche entoki naitureisho, o enenking'asia, o entoki naimakini, anaa enidolidolo too nkonyek inyi.

English: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
Masaai: Embung'a ele kerreti anaa enkitanapata te ntae o too nkera inyi ntarasi.

English: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the LORD thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the LORD thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.
Masaai: Teninos olmumai to Laitoriani Enkai ino, miyiata te laata, amu keikilikuanu tukul Olaitoriani Enkai ino te iyie, naa keaku eng'oki teyie.

English: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.
Masaai: Ei sapuk apa ina ng'oki e lelo barnot oleng te dukuya Olaitoriani amu eitu eyanyit lelo tung'ana olasar lo Laitoriani.

English: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
Masaai: Ekaing'oru ina naimina, naa karrinyu ina natapong'ori, naa karub ina ng'ojine, naa kaitagol ina natashala, ore ina napir oina nagol naa kaing'or; naa kaitoti ninche te sipata.

English: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
Masaai: eitodolu ninye mbaa naagut oo nkisudorot; neyiolo ninye ina natii atua enaimin, naa ninye ebikie ewang'an.

English: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
Masaai: O ntapuka, oltaai, o nena tokitin naarieki iltaai e sahabu nasila;

English: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
Masaai: Iyiololo empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo. Iyiololo eneba enkarsisisho enye! Kake etaa aisinani te nkaraki intae, peyie iakuku intae karsisi te nkaraki aisinanisho enye.

English: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
Masaai: Mme sidai olwuasa linyi. Aimiyiololo aajo eisuijie enkiti suguroi entapa naipurji pooki?

English: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo olaiguanani loo Siraeli; o Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda Ramot-gilead.

English: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
Masaai: Neirrugu ninye shumata, nedou alotu kop; netii emisimisi kitok abori nkejek enye.

English: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
Masaai: Ore Sebulon naa kemany embata enaiposha, naa keaku ewueji neitasheyie imelin, Ore olpolosie lenye netii Sidon.

English: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
Masaai: Nekepu Olaitoriani ninye tiatua iloshon pooki le Israel te ntorroni, te risioroto oo ldeketa pooki lele ning'o lo sotua ooigero tiatua ena buku oo nkitanapat.

English: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
Masaai: Ara nanu kishomi; ore olaaimu nanu keitajeuni, nejing atua nepuku netum endaata.

English: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
Masaai: Neing'asia pooki nesis Enkai, neureishoyu, nejo, “Kitoduaa ake taata mbaa e nking'asia!”

English: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: neisho ninye meshomo ekedito engarri enye e are oo mbartan, neishir ninche te dukuya ninye ejo, “Entigil kung!” Neijia eikuna apik ninye meitasheiki ina kop pooki e Misiri.

English: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa keitayu olkitok te nkaraki enkewan enye tenebo iltung'ana pooki leina kop oloti oing'oni te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki.

English: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
Masaai: Ore oliare ninye te lelo pokira okuni magil naa, Eliesa olayioni le Dodo, le Ahoti.

English: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
Masaai: Ore to lari lioudo le nkitoria e Hoshea, neibung olaiguanani le Asiria Samaria, neya Isiraeli ootii Asiria nepik ninche enkanasa e Hala o embata olkeju le Habo, o olkeju le Gosan, o atua nkanas oo Lmedi.

English: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
Masaai: Ore apa enjung'ore enye naa te nkukuo, anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa te lelo oshon ooudo o lpisiai loo loshon.

English: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Masaai: Ee, keng'ida enkishui ang ti atua ninye, enkaraki nikisiliga iyiook enkarna enye sinyati.

English: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Debir, obo; olaiguanani le Geder, obo;

English: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD'S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
Masaai: Naayau ninye nanu olgilata liatua le nkaji o Laitoriani: naa ng'ura ore te kutukaji e nkaji o Laitoriani, enerish eneimi olgoriet o lperere, netii iltung'ana oobaya tikitam o imiet, eisho nkoriong'i enye ina aji Olaitoriani, neing'orita nkomomi enye enkalo o loosaen, eomon enkolong te nkalo oloosaen.

English: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
Masaai: “Intae ake atayiolo nanu, too lmareita pooki le nkop; neaku kaitame nanu intae te ntorroni inyi pooki.

English: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
Masaai: Neisho ninche meshomo. Nepuku lelo oiriruani ooiduruk nejing lelo bitiro; ore ina luaata, nabaya nkalifuni are, neipirri aadoyio to loshong'ishong'i nengorokino enaiposha, neimis te naiposha.

English: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
Masaai: Eitong'u too inkonito e nkutuk ino enaisho namelok, esiankiki ai; etii enaisho olkenkei o kule abori olng'ejep lino; Ore olng'usil loo nkilani inono netiu anaa olng'usil le Lebanon.

English: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
Masaai: “Naa keaku eno lkitok enkop pooki natii nkaloli pokira ina kop sinyati o ine wueji e nkanasa, emanita ine wueji sinyati o ine wueji enkanasa, te nkalo oloontoluo o te nkalo o loosaen, eipirarete nkadoro nabo sashati olorere, nenyikaa eiteru te nkalo o loontoluo o meshomo oloo saen lo lpolosie leina kop. Keaku ina enkop enye te Israel.

English: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

English: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etejoki, ‘Mitem iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.’ ”

English: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
Masaai: Neitobiru ninye ilong'oi iip uni naaidong'uoki te sahabu, nepik ake elong'o nabo nkiloi are e sahabu. Nepik olaiguanani nena long'oi atua enkaji natii atua entim e Lebanon.

English: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
Masaai: “Tudumunye naa taata shomo enkaji ino. Naa tenebaiki nkejek inono enkanasa, neye ina kerai.

English: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

English: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.

English: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
Masaai: Etiu anaa enkoileelio e Hermon, nadoiki ildoinyo le Sion! Amu te ine eitanapishe Olaitoriani imayianat, enkishui ntarasi.

English: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
Masaai: Neaku etiaka olaiguanani Yoab o lkituaak le njore, apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Enchom atua iloshon pooki le Israel, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, ninkenikene iltung'ana, pee atum atayiolo esiana oo ltung'ana.”

English: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
Masaai: Kake ti niyamisho, neitu ias eng'oki. Naa teneyami entito neitu eas eng'oki, kake ore lelo ooyamisho ketum osina te nkop, naa ilo ajo pee arishie intae.

Masaai: Ore ilo payian, olopeny ina aji, neipang'aki ninche nejoki ninche, “A-a, ilalashera laainei, emiaas intae ena torroni; itoduaa aajo eewuo ele tung'ani atua enkaji ai, emiaas intae ena bae suuji.

Masaai: Ng'ura, kayau nanu atua ninye embiotisho e nkishiunoto, naa kaishiunye nanu ninche naboloki ninche enkiputakinoto e dupoto o eseriani.

Masaai: o enkisuro, ilooiba Enkai, ilooilash, iloonya kutukie, ilooipiru ntorrok, iloogolong'aki ntoiwuo,

English: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
Masaai: Nedumunye apa olkiyioi kitok loo ltung'ana o nkituaak enye, te nkaraki Ilyahudi alashera lenye.

English: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida o lkeresi o lpelesi aaitaked Solomon enyumpu o laiguanani Daudi neyau ninye Gibon.

English: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
Masaai: Ore apa Rehum olkitok le njore o Shimshai ilo aigeroni neiger empalai te nkaraki Yerusalem aigeroki Artaserses ilo aiguanani nejo nji

English: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
Masaai: Keibala nkiaasin o sesen, naa ninche kuna, emarmalisho e loloito, loirerioni, ng'uarrat torrok,

Masaai: Nerretena aanyu elotunoto e Yosef enaipirie enkolong, amu etoning'o aajo kenya endaa tenebo teine.

English: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
Masaai: Amu meiturraa Olaitoriani ninye ntarasi.

English: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
Masaai: Ore lelo aitobirak loo nkilani naapuyiapui nepalari, o lelo ooitobir nkilani naaibor.

English: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

English: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
Masaai: nimintobiribiri sii intae olning'o o kulo oomanya ena kop; niaariara ilpereren lenye lo lasar’ kake eitu intae imbung'ubung'u enkitanapata ai. Kainyoo ena nitaasa intae?

English: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
Masaai: Airriua nanu metaarare ilo osho lemeure Enkai, naitanapa nanu ninye te nkaraki ilo orere laaitagoro, pee eibung aaraya ntokitin enye, neitunyoki enkop anaa esarng'ab e nkoitoi.

English: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Itai olaiguanani ajoki, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, naa ore enaishu olkitok lai olaiguanani, ore eneba enaa enetii olkitok lai olaiguanani, aa te keeya arashu te nkishui, ine sii ninye etii osinka lino.”

English: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye nebatata too nkejek enyena, neirrugo abaiki enkop; neitoki adumu enkayioni enye neipang alo boo.

English: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
Masaai: Amu imbung'a iyie nkikoot e Omri, o siaaitin pooki e nkaji e Ahab; nimbung'a iyie nkikoot enye, pee aatum nanu aitaa iyie olmuaate naitaa emanyisho ino entoki naimakini; neaku inap iyie esukeny oo ltung'ana.”

English: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye aitaa enjung'ore enye Beer-sheba, o Sheba, o Molada,

English: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

English: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ira ng'ae?” Newal ninye ajo, “Ara nanu Rusi, enkaisiaayiani ino; isalaasha olkila lino ntoipo enkaisiaayiani ino amu iyie olo lgilata lang o taana.”

English: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again.
