Masaai: Naa ore apa teneyaki Ilawi ilo sanduku iltung'ana kituaak lo laiguanani, naa tenedol ninche aajo etii mpisai kumok, nelotu olaigeroni lo laiguanani o lkitok loo lapolosak aapiku teilo sanduku, nerriny osanduku ewueji duoo netii. Neas ninche ina anaake, nesotu mpisai kumok oleng.

English: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Oi ena ishoi nemeeta enkirukoto, kaboitare intae naitaas intae o anu? Iyau enkerai ino ene.”

English: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
Masaai: Eanyu sii enkong'u e ilo ololoito metomisimiso, ejo, ‘meeta enkong'u naadol nanu’; neimulumul enkomom enye.

English: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
Masaai: Entoning ele rorei lajo nanu te nkishirata te nkaraki intae na aji e Israel:

English: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
Masaai: Neing'oru Yesu, ejokino maate eitashe to hekalo, “Aijojo aa? Eji melotu tukul ele sirua?”

English: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
Masaai: Kegolie Olaitoriani olobor; ore pee aaibookini enkop, naaitajeu ninye.

English: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
Masaai: Nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno elotu enatii nanu, Olaitoriani, nchoo enjeunoto ino elotu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino;

English: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ajoki, ninche, “Ainyoo doi ena shankar niaatata o ninche?”

English: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
Masaai: Neibelekenya Petero nedol olapa oiteng'eni onyor Yesu esujita. Aa ninye olapa oirishakine olgoo lenye te ndaa e teipa nejoki, “Olaitoriani, ai ng'ae ilo likirojaa?”

English: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
Masaai: Nchoo Enkai metudumunye, nchoo meidapashata ilmang'ati lenyena; nchoo lelo ooiba ninye meisika te dukuya ninye.

English: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
Masaai: Ore enatiu, eetae rubat kumok, kake obo osesen.

English: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Olaitoriani olo aitoreisho ntarasi, Enkai ino, iyie Sion, too ishoritin pooki. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
Masaai: Metaa atorikoyie ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri nayau ninche atua olpurkel.

English: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo le lelo aitoriak le na towuo otoning'uo ina, amu te naa ketoning'utuo, anaata eitu epuo aashe Olaitoriani le enkitoo;

English: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa aikirikoki enkishui; naa ore ilo oota neyeng'iyeng'a etaraposhe, melotu entorroni enetii ninye.

English: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena ening'ito olorere pooki,

English: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, kepuonu kuna baa pooki shumata kulo tung'ana le na kata.

English: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
Masaai: o lpisiai le Gilead, o Ashtarot, o Edrei, nena anas e nkitoria e Oog ti atua Bashan, etoorikiaki apa kuna iltung'ana le Makir olayioni le Manase aaisho olpisiai loo le Makir te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
Masaai: Te naaisiaai oltung'ani nanu, inchoo aairukurukore, ore enatii nanu neaku ine etii sii olaisiaayiani lai. Ore pooki ng'ae laaisiaai, neyanyitu Papa ninye.

English: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
Masaai: Neeta esilet enye te nkaina enye, naa keor asip olkurroto lenye oidong'ishoreki, nesotoki enkano enye empeche ore isuut nepej te nkima nemearayu.”

English: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
Masaai: Naa kainyoo eitoki Daudi ajo tialo iyie inchoo meyanyituni osinka lino? Amu iyiolo iyie osinka lino.

English: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
Masaai: neeta ake sii enchakenisho oo mbaa enyena sidain anaa enaitubulua inkera neitoomonishe, neitukuo inkejek oo sinyat, netasarua lelo oonyamal, netasheikine aas impukunot pooki oo siaaitin sidain too nkoitoi pooki.

English: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
Masaai: Nelo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena Keila, nearare Ilfilisti, neyau nchoo enye, near iltung'ana kumok metuata tiatua ninche. Neaku etokordua Daudi lelo oomanya Keila.

English: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Neyau taa ilo apolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput embata o sarge leilo oing'oni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
Masaai: Neosh enkukuo aadut nena arn pokira are. Nedoiki enkukuo Matias neikenakini encholiek e lelo kipaareta tomon o obo.

English: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
Masaai: Naa kepuo iltung'ana aaibookino enkop maate, neitorogony ake oltung'ani olikae oltung'ani ake ole latia enye; neitokoos olbarnoti te dukuya olpayian, neitokoos oltung'ani li abori te dukuya ilo kitok.

English: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
Masaai: Itoponaiyie ilamirak linono aitulusoo too lakir le shumata. Eisalaash olmaati inaipuko nepuo.

English: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
Masaai: Mintobiraki kewan enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta, arashu ae nanyaanyukie ae toki te shumata te keper arashu enatii abori enkop, arashu enatii atua tiabori enkop.

English: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
Masaai: “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, aaipoto nanu iyie te supatisho, aaibung'a nanu iyie enkaina naagolie; aaishorua nanu iyie taa olning'o too loreren, ore te iyie naa kayaki nanu ewang'an iloshon,

English: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
Masaai: amu mme kuna naalioo king'orita kake nena nemelioo. Ore kuna naalioo naa ne nkiti kata; ore nena nemelioo naa noo ntarasi.

English: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
Masaai: Ore aing'orisho, ng'ura, nadol osiwuo le nchan olotu aing'uaa enkalo e moikuape, o enkatampoi sapuk, o enkimerlel namanita ninye, olng'ejepa le nkima ooidikidiko, ore te mpolos enkima, netiu anaa entoki enkimerlel o suyai.

English: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong naaipoto nanu, nikitawalikia, ore engolon ai oltau nikitoponikia.

English: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Intayu.” Neitorioo ninye enkaina enye neitayu.

English: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
Masaai: Ore enkitokoos oo ltung'ana neitadouni, ore ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana neitadouni abori; neaku Olaitoriani ake eitaae kitok te ina olong.

English: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Lo Kitok, inchoo iyiook anaa ake ina mukate.”

English: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni nejoki Yosef ninche, “Entaas ena peyie inchushu, amu kaure Enkai:

English: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
Masaai: Naa te neitoki aang'oroo nedou esiana, te nkaraki enkibookinoto e nkop, o enyamali o osina,

English: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, mbelekenyayu, shomo ong'ata mpira enkalo Enaiposha Nanyokie.’

English: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yotan etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye tenebo loo menye, tiatua enkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Ahas olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
Masaai: Kake eitu eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika, eton ake eitayu iltung'ana ilasarri nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
Masaai: Ore taata Olaitoriani le seriani meishoo ninye intae makewan eseriani inkatitin pooki ti tua nkoitoi pooki, metaa Olaitoriani te nebo intae pooki.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani; eitu ninye epaash te nkishui enye pooki ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku etoriko ninye aitadoyio, ng'ura, eidapashate ninche te nkop pooki, edaa neokisho neranyisho, te nkaraki nena tokitin kumok naataarutua te nkop oo Lfilisti o te nkop e Yuda.

English: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
Masaai: ng'ura kaaitaas naa nanu taata te risioto o rorei lino. Ng'ura aaisho nanu iyie endamunoto e ng'eno nimusunye mbaa, metaa meetae olikinyaanyukie otulusoyie nemeetae oloyooki atiu anaa iyie tesiadi iyie.

English: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kayau nanu ntae atua enkop apa nainosa olmumai ajo kaisho Abraham, o Isaak, o Yakobo; kaisho nanu ntae metaa eninyi enkorrok. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
Masaai: Ilak iyie enkaina ino, nintaraposh pooki toki naishu.

English: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
Masaai: Ore ade pee eitigir olasirani kitok le ina anasa olorora, nejo, “Lo lewa le Efeso, keetae pasa oltung'ani lemeyiolo ajo ena anasa e Efeso oshi enkarriponi e nkaji naomonieki Artemis kitok o ilo soit sinyati apa odou eing'uaa te shumata?

English: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
Masaai: o Shimea olayioni lenye, o Higia olayioni lenye o Asaia olayioni lenye.

English: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entito ai, miureishoyu, kaaitaas nanu nena pooki niomonu, amu eyiolo pooki lena ang nchere ira enkitok e tipat.

English: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
Masaai: naang'aki nanu nkutukie enye, netiu anaa olng'atuny oikurrukur.

English: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
Masaai: nepolos olapolosani nabo te nkaraki olasar loo ngok, nepolos enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, enkaraki nataasa ninye engoki aiseyie ilo meneng'ani. Neitisiny ninye endukuya enye ina olong ake,

English: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
Masaai: Eiro ninche irorei le pesho; ore too lmuma le lejare keitayu osotua; nebulu nkiguanat enye anaa sayieti naabulu too nkong'at e nkurma.

English: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
Masaai: Kake etiaakitia menye o ng'otonye ninye, “Aimeetae enkitok ti atua ntoyie o lgilata linyi, aashu ti atua iltung'ana lang pooki, eji pee ilo ayamu enkitok too Lfilisti lememurata?” Kake etiaaka Samson menye, “Torikokoki nanu ninye; amu aaitiship ninye nanu oleng.”

English: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
Masaai: ore enkalo inyi e kopikop naa keaku ebaiki ongata e Sin amanaa tolkirine le Edom, naa ore olpolosie linyi te nkalo e kopikop naa ebaiki enkiting'oto Enaiposha e Munyan te nkalo o loosaen;

English: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
Masaai: Musa o Aron apa ilapolosak lenyena, etii sii apa Samuel lelo ooipot enkarna enye. Eishirakita ninche Olaitoriani, newaliki ninye ninche.

English: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
Masaai: “Itoduaa ajo eitoborro Ahab kewan te dukuya nanu? Ore enkaraki naitoborro ninye kewan te dukuya nanu, mayau nanu entorroni too nkolong'i enyena. Too nkolong'i oo layiok lenyena nanu ayau entorroni shumata enkaji enye.”

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Etang'asa apa iltung'ana laainei aadoyio aapuo Misiri aamany ine, neisomit lelo le Asiria ninche pesho.

English: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
Masaai: ore enkaraki meshilaa ninche isiaitin o Laitoriani, anaa esiaai oo nkaik enyena, kegil ninye ninche nemeigil ae kata ashetu ninche.

English: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Masaai: Kapik nanu anaake Olaitoriani dukuya ai; amu etii ninye enkaina ai e tatene, maaigusugusieki nanu.

English: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
Masaai: “Eyuko inaipuko e sidai to lwuasa; kake amaa, keeta ninche olng'ur?

English: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Osina lai ele, ore enkaina e tatene e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul neibelekenye.”

English: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
Masaai: Meure ninye enkata enkirobi tenebau amu ore enkaji enye pooki, neeta nkilani naairowua.

English: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
Masaai: Neisis Esra Olaitoriani, ina Ai kitok, newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Esai, Esai,” eilepie nkaik enye; neirrug ninche ilukuny enye neserem Olaitoriani eitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop.

English: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
Masaai: Ore too Lharisit, naa Kenaia o layiok lenyena, negeluni tenkaraki isiaaitin e boo too Siraeli, metaa ilkituaak o larishak.

English: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
Masaai: Nelotu Eliya anyikaki iltung'ana pooki nejoki, “Ibukaashasha akenya o anu too ndamunot are? Tenaa Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, entusuj ninye; kake tenaa Baal nisujaa ninye.” Neitu ewaliki iltung'ana ororei hoo obo.

English: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
Masaai: Nepik olapolosani embata eina ilata natii enkaina enye enchumata enkitipet enkiok e tatene eilo oitisinyi, olmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene, o le nkeju enye e tatene, teine wueji duoo netipikieki osarge lo lasar le nkitarruorroto;

English: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
Masaai: Nejo Adoni-besek, “Ore apa ilaiguanak ntomoni naapishana ootudung'oyioki ilmogirrani lenye loo nkaik o loo nkejek naa ti abori emesa ai esotu ndaiki naadoyio; anaa enataasa nanu, neaku aaitalakua nanu Enkai.” Neyau ninche ninye Yerusalem, neye ninye te ine.

English: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
Masaai: ore ajo pee atumoki Loreren leme nena kitanapat naaitore, atotiwuo anaa olemetii atua Nkitanapat, hoo natii nanu atua nkitanapat e Kristo metaa matii sii duoo auluo nkitanapat e Nkai;

English: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
Masaai: Neaku entagoloto oshuaa o likae o likae naa enteshet olikae olikae anaa ina niaasitata.

English: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo kintaasa intae anaa enaitaas menye inkera enyena, kinkoo pooki ng'ae te intae nikintagol oshuaa, nikintanapa intae.

English: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
Masaai: Neitoki ninye adumunye nelo Samaria. Ore te nkoitoi etii ninye Beteked ewueji oo lairritak loo ntare,

English: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore lelo tung'ana lenyena pooki naa keitukurruni. Ore lelo aguetak arriyiak naa iltung'ana ake; nchoo ninche pooki esoto, nchoo ninche eitashe, kepuo ninche pooki aairut, kepuoi aaitukurru ninche te nebo.

English: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo enetii ninye neikilikuan aajoki, ejo pee etem, “Keishiaakino te neiturraa oltung'ani enkitok enye?”

English: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.
Masaai: Kake eitu ejo aar Mordekai aa ninye ake. Amu eitayioloki ninye iltung'ana pooki le Mordekai, neing'oru Haman pee ear Ilyahudi pooki, iltung'ana le Mordekai, te nkitoria pooki e Serser.

English: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
Masaai: Amu kaing'ae too looishu pooki oata osesen, otoning'o oltoilo le Nkai naishu eiro eimu empolos e nkima, anaa enikitoning'o iyiook, neton ake kinchu.

English: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Ilfarisayo, iloonyor naa masaa neikordod Yesu.

English: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
Masaai: Ore naa taata iyie Olaitoriani nchoo ilo rorei liroro oipirta osinka lino, neipirta enkaji enye meitubulari ntarasi, niaas anaa eniroro;

English: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
Masaai: Neitoki aitayu ntokitin e sahabu nasila naa ninche epiki enchumata emesa o isaanini enyena, o ngirran o enkorropil, o lbakulini o siang'aun naapikunyeki olasar obukuni.

English: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
Masaai: Neitayu ninye endung'oroto, te nkalo e kopikop, ore nena kisiong'at e ndung'oroto naa katani napuyiapui napiyaya;

English: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
Masaai: eitu ninye eisho oltung'ani meitorogonya ninche, eisikong'a ninye ilaiguanak te nkaraki ninche,

English: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
Masaai: Kalak nanu ilmuma laainei to Laitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena pooki,

English: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
Masaai: Neaku etiaaka Daudi Yoab o larikok le njore, “Shomo nkena Isiraeli, ebaiki Beersheba o metabaiki Dan, nikiyaki nanu oratioti, pee atum atayiolo esiana enye.”

English: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
Masaai: Etesheta sii apa nkajijik naashumishoreki tenkaraki entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata, o laleta tenkaraki mpukunot pooki oo nkishu, o muatat oo nkerra.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
Masaai: Kake ore te nkolong e are, taisere e tulusoyie olapa ng'ejuk, neisiu ake ewueji e Daudi. Nejoki Saul Yonatan, olayioni lenye, “Kainyoo pee eitu elotu olayioni le Yese anya endaa, ng'ole arashu taata?”

English: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Miyau mpisai elaakinoto e mulayoi, anaa elaakinoto oldia atua enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ino, alakie olmumai ake ninye pooki amu ore kuna pokira naa olminong to Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
Masaai: Neirriwaki lelo tung'ana le Gibeon Yoshua olkilikuai too lng'oborri te Gilgal, ejo, “Miyeng'iyeng'ie iyie enkaina te nkaraki isinkan linono; tasieku wou enikitii, pee intajeu iyiook, niretu iyiook, amu ore kulo aiguanak pooki loo Lamori oomanya enkop oo ldoinyo neiturrurrote te nkaraki iyiook.”

English: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Yerameel olayioni lo laiguanani o Seraia olayioni le Asriel o Shelemia olayioni le Abdeel pee epuo aaibung Baruk ilo aigeroni o Yeremia oloiboni, kake eisudoyie Olaitoriani ninche.

English: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
Masaai: Ore nena kera apa naatoiwuoki te nkata o sina, nepuo sii ninche aajo ining'itoto, ‘Kepirik ene wueji te nanu; ing'urakaki ewueji namany.’

English: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Ee kaakordu Olaitoriani te ntorroni ake pooki naitajeu aaitaany ina kitoo enye e shumata metaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.

English: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
Masaai: Meitasimi aatemaki isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, ore enkinyiang'a e ng'eno nagut nelang isoito oogol enkinyiang'a.

English: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
Masaai: Kemutisho enkima te dukuya ninche. Ore te siadi ninche neinosisho olang'at le nkima. Eikununo ina kop anaa enkurma e Eden te dukuya ninche, kake ore te siadi ninche naa ong'ata nememanya, nemeetae entoki naidim ailanya ninche.

English: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
Masaai: Nji ejo olaiguanani: ‘Emincho Hesekia meteleja intae, amu meidim ninye aitajeu intae te nkaina ai.

English: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
Masaai: ore te Bilga, naa Shamua; ore te Shemaia naa Yehonatan,

English: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
Masaai: Neidaikie ninche ina ng'ape e Baal, neidaikie ina aji e Baal, neitaa enkaji narotokini ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
Masaai: Nipik ilmalaika oare ooji ilkerubi le sahabu; te nkidong'ore intobir ninche, too nkaloli pokira are e ilo orika lo lng'ur.

English: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
Masaai: Ore pee errinyo, ng'ura, neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yosef te nkidetidet nejoki, “Inyo, tudumu enkerai o ng'otonye, isikaki Misiri, niton te ine o metaba anaa naaliki, amu eing'oru Herode ina kerai pee ear metua.”

English: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Etaasate kuna pooki pee ebaya inaatejo Olaitoriani to lkilikuai lo loiboni le Nkai otejo,

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Masaai: Metaa te nebo intae empiris o Laitoriani Yesu.

English: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yuda ninye, “Eitanapa apa iyiook ilo tung'ani ejoki iyiook, ‘Midolidolo enkomom ai, arashu tenaa ketii olalashe linyi tenebo intae.’

English: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
Masaai: pee etum aaishoo olkiyioi le ilo aisinani elotu enetii, netoning'o ninye enkishirata e ilo oota enyamali.

English: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
Masaai: “Nikintoki iyiook aaibelekenya nikipuo aaim enkoitoi e Bashan; neipang'u Oog ilo aiguanani le Bashan alotu aarare iyiook, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, nearare iyiook te Edrei.

English: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
Masaai: Eitu apa ainining'u oltoilo loo laiteng'enak laainei arashu airrugoki enkiok ai ilautarok laainei,

English: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.
Masaai: Nening Isiraeli pooki eji nchere etimira Saul oltim loo Lfilisti, o sii etaa Israeli ilmang'ati too Lfilisti. Neipoti iltung'ana meetu aaibung'are Saul te Gilgal.

English: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
Masaai: Etooshoki Efraim, etoito ntona enye, meitoki aaiu ilng'anayio. Ore hoo duoo ninye neisho ninche, kaar nanu metuata nena kera enye kiroteti.

English: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
Masaai: naa neijia enkuna eyau ilasarri linyi oopejori o nkishorot inyi, e matua e tomon, o lasarri ooitarasari, o lasarri to lmumai, o nkishorot o lpela, o lkikaunot linyi loo nkishu o loo ntare;

English: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
Masaai: Ore ilo onyor iropiyiani nemeraposho ae kata too ropiyiani; neijia sii etiu ilo onyor enkarsisisho e dupoto; ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.

English: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
Masaai: Nejokini, “Oloirirua iata iyie.” Kake etareikio ninye ajo neijia etiu. Nejo ninche, “Olmalaika lenye pae!”

English: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ilepunye iyie oltau lai aitupuku te nemeneng'a, nikirrinyoki nanu enkishui ti atua lelo ooshomo aadoiki Engumoto.

English: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
Masaai: metaa, oi intae ildoinyo le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai: Inji ejoki Olaitoriani Enkai lelo doinyo o ndoinyo, o lashepak o nenen neeidurrieki o nkanas naaidurraki aaing'uaa, nena naataa entoki nainos pooki toki netaa enameni iloreren pooki oomanita;

English: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
Masaai: Kulo oodukino apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, Telhasha, Keurub, Adon, o Imer, kake meidim apa ninche aaibalie ilmareita loo loo menye aashu ineeikino ninche, tenaa ke ltung'ana le Israel ninche.

English: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
Masaai: Kake iata ena nabo, imba isiaaitin oo Lnikolatin naiba sii nanu.

English: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
Masaai: naa keidim ninye atokordu enkishui enye te keeya, nemeisho ninche eye te nkata o lameyu.

English: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
Masaai: Near enchan oo soito pooki toki natii ong'ata te nkop pooki e Misiri, aa tung'ani o eng'ues; near enchan oo soito pooki aitubului e ong'ata, negil pooki shani li ong'ata.

English: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Etegelua apa ninye ilapolosak tenkaraki enkisiaayiare neitagol ninche te nkisiaayiare e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
Masaai: o Ben-deker te nkop e Makas, o Shaalbim o Betshemesh o Elenbet-hanan

English: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
Masaai: nchoo ake oltung'ani pooki eishooyo anaa enaidim, te risioroto emayianata o Laitoriani Enkai ino nikinchoo ninye iyie.

English: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening lelo apa oomanya Gibeon ina apa naitaasa Yoshua Yeriko o Ai,

English: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
Masaai: Kepuoi aaing'uaa nkanas enyena o akenya; neaku ninche ndaat oo nkerrai, neirragie ninche ine nemeetae entoki naiture.

English: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
Masaai: “Toning'oki nanu, iyie Yakobo, o Israel, apa laipoto nanu iyie! Nanu ilo, nanu ole dukuya, naa nanu ole siadi.

English: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
Masaai: Nejoki Yudas ninye kake mme Iskariot, “Kaji inko lo Kitok, ti niboloki iyiook kewan, nimiboloki enkop?”

English: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
Masaai: Naa lelo ooinyiang'ua Olaitoriani ake oopuo aarrinyunye, nepuonu Sion eranyisho; nejing eng'ida oo ntarasi shumata ninche; nepuo ninche aatum enchipai o eng'ida, ore osina o emion neilanyisho aapuo.

English: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
Masaai: Neiter aaitang'or ninye, ejo, “Kineputua ele tung'ani eiwushie olorere lang nemitiki iyiook kincho Kaisari kodi, nejo kewan Kristo naa olaiguanani.”

English: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kainyoo iyie pee ncho iyiook matapaash nkoitoi inono nintagol iltauja lang metaa mikiure iyie? Torrinyunye te nkaraki isinkan linono, lelo oshon le njung'ore ino.

English: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
Masaai: Pee kitum iyiook aainyang'u olaisinani te nkosholai ore olomena nikinyang'u too namuka are nikimir isuut e nkano?”

English: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
Masaai: Amu ore oltung'ani aisinani melai aekata te nkop; neaku aaitanapa iyie talaa enkaina ino to lalashe lino, teilo oata enkolat o teilo aisinani otii enkop inyi.

English: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
Masaai: Nenyor apa entito e Saul, Mikal, Daudi; neliki ninche Saul, neitiship ina toki ninye.

English: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oibelekeny esipata tialo oltung'ani omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore eyia te kuna pooki, ore ina anashe enye nemeisiligayu, Yuda, neitu eshukunye enatii nanu to ltau lenye pooki, kake te nkitaakuno, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye ilperereni loo lasarri tenkaraki olorora le shumata too lgorieti pokira oare le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
Masaai: kake lelo ooure ninye eshipakino Olaitoriani, lelo ooisilig enyorrata enye nauno.

English: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
Masaai: Kake etune ninye aitashe te mpolos e ine, nengoroo ine, nesesekuan Ilfilisti; neyau Olaitoriani enkisulata kitok.

English: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
Masaai: Nedung'oo iltung'ana le Benchamen, nemir aasujaa ninche neitunyoo ninche ebaiki Noha o meitabaiki enkipirakinoto Gibea te nkalo o loosaen.

English: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
Masaai: Ore ng'uesi naawuasa, eitu eitunyoo ine; neitu eim olng'atuny shumata enye.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, keilepu nkariak naaing'uaa moikuape, naa keaku olkeju onang'ari; naa keiput enkop pooki o pooki nabore, enkanasa o lelo oomanya atua. Neyietu ilewa aaishir, ore pooki ng'ae omanya ina kop neyietu aishir

English: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nchooki enkishoroto; ore amu kiterewa nanu mashomo enkop e Negeb, nchooki sii nkonyek e nkare.” Neisho Kaleb ninye nkonyek e nkare e shumata o ni abori.

English: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
Masaai: “Ore te nkaraki kuna baa naishir nanu; neruko ilkiyio too nkonyek aainei, amu elakua olaaitagol nanu, ilo laaputu manyaaki apiju; eliyio nkera aainei, amu etimirishe olmang'atinta.”

English: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
Masaai: Ore enkop enye neitushulu Helkat, o Hali, o Beton, o Aksaf,

English: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
Masaai: Tena bae ake eidim kulo tung'ana aatonyorrai aatotoni tiatua iyiook, nikiaku olorere obo: pee emurati pooki lee tiatua iyiook anaa pee emurata ninche.

English: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
Masaai: Neinok ninye enkima tiatua nkajijik oo nkaitin e Misiri; naa kepejoo ninye ninche nenap ninche aya eyararoto; naa keituku ninye enkop e Misiri, anaa enaituku olairritani loo ntare olkila lenye meshomo lashe; naa kelo ninye aing'uaa ine te seriani.

English: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
Masaai: Ilalashera eminauru te asata oo supati.

English: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
Masaai: Nintaa iyiook ilmang'ati too le latia ang; ore ilmang'ati lang nekueni maate.

English: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
Masaai: Amu itung'uayie iyie iltung'ana linono, ina aji e Yakobo, enkaraki nabore ninche lasakutok ooing'uaa oloosaen, o lelo aitumusumusok anaa iltung'ana loo Lfilisti, neoshore ninche nkaik iltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
Masaai: Oi siaake elotu enkordunoto e Israel eing'uaa Sion! Te neitopok Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, naa keng'ida Yakobo, neshipayu Israel.

English: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
Masaai: Neaku etudung'uo pooki ng'ae te lelo tung'ana olng'osila lenye nesuj Abimelek neirishakini ilo sempewuet, nepik ilo sempewuet enkima te shumata ninche, neaku etuata apa sii ninche iltung'ana pooki to ltalet le Shekem, iltung'ana oobaya enkalifu ilewa o nkituaak.

English: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
Masaai: “Enkurare nang'a ilgoso lenye, neasishore ilng'ejepa lenye aalejishore.” “Esayiet o lasuriaa nanuka too nkutukie enye.”

English: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Masaai: Amu ore olekoisiayio loo ng'ok naa keeya; kake ore enkishorunoto e Nkai e pesho naa enkishui oo ntarasi ti atua Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninche, “Emincho ake nchomito e Yerusalem eboli ometaba anaa neilepu enkolong; naa ore eton eitashe aarripisho nchoo ninche eiken nepik isekenke ooikenieki nchomito. Entegelu ilarripok tiatua lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neitashe ake pooki ng'ae te rishata enye, neipirare ake oltung'ani enkaji enye.”

English: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
Masaai: Aashu ae te neomon osinkirri, keisho olasurai?

English: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
Masaai: Ng'ura olkutati lo Laitoriani! Eipang'ua engoro enye napi, olkutati ogol kedanyakino ninye endukuya eilo torrono.

English: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira Enkai o lng'ur niata osotua, nimisioki agoro, nibik te nyorrata nauno, nira oloisiligayu.

English: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
Masaai: Kake etagore apa Naaman oleng, nelo ejoito, “Ng'ura, kajo duoo nanu kelotu enatii, neitashe, neipot enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai enye, neyuk enkaina enye te shumata ene wueji naaya, neishiu enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
Masaai: Naa kanang'aa nanu intae too nkonyek aainei, anaa enatanang'ayie nanu ilalashera linyi, o eishoi pooki e Efraim.

English: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani ingero enkarna ena olong, etamuata olaiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem.

English: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.
Masaai: “Metaa eton aatakinore iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, ore nkera oo nkera inono naatakinore.

English: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
Masaai: Tisipu tujurru ilo tung'ani supat, ning'or ilo oitoriori nkoitoi enyena, amu ore enkiting'oto e ilo tung'ani naa eseriani.

English: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
Masaai: Ile ishoi apa oo ltung'ana sapuki kulo tung'ana ootii Gat, nebatata ninche aaye te nkaina e Daudi o too nkaik oo sinkan, lenyena.

English: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
Masaai: Atoriwuo nanu Yuda aitaa enkawuo ai. Naitotiu Efraim anaa mbaa enyena. Naa kaasishore ilewa le Sion anaa olalem, pee earare ilayiok loo Lyunani.

English: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Enkai Yona, “Itaasa iyie esidai ti nigorokino enkaitubului?” Nejo ninye, “Ataasa nanu esidai agoro, atagore ene keeya.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Koree empalai naarieki enkiyama e ng'utunyi amu ataarayie apa nanu ninye? Anaa kalo te lelo laatakinore esile apa atimiraka intae? Ng'ura, te nkaraki ntorrok inono apa pee kitimiraki iyie, naa te nkaraki engilata ino oo nkitanapat apa pee etaarayioki ng'utunyi.

English: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
Masaai: Ijo ming'idada aa ing'iriri Imoda! Ijo mirara pasa intae ng'eni maate!

English: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
Masaai: Neaku ninye mitil tiatua nena kuapi mitili, ore inkanas enyena nejing empolos e nena anas naaitomijoonoki.

English: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
Masaai: Yeshua, o Molada, o Betber Betpeler, o

English: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
Masaai: Neirriu apa Yeroboam iltung'ana olnukata aitaman ninche te siadi. Netii ilturrurri lenyena dukuya iltung'ana le Yuda. Netii lelo tung'ana oonuka siadi ninche.

English: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki apa lo larrabal ootii te nebo ninye neilep aapuo nenyikaa aataaniki ina anasa; nepik ilng'oborri enkalo e moikuape e Ai.

English: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
Masaai: neitaa Enkai ninye olapolosani kitok to lkerreti le Melkisedek.

English: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
Masaai: Neitoki aitarasaa ilo asar le ntapa, neiput nkaik enyena, nepejoo te nchumata olperere lo lasar, aitatashaki ilo asar opejori le nkakenya.

English: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
Masaai: Amu teneponari enkidetidet, neaku irorei kumok lemeeta tipat: kake turia iyie Enkai?

English: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
Masaai: Ore enamanarie enkakenya nedumunye olaiguanani neisarrisar alo eululu oo lng'atunyo.

English: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo kitok ninye, “Mikimbelekenya iyiook aajing atua enkanasa oo ltung'ana leeiking'a leme iltung'ana le Israel ninche; kake eikigiroo iyiook aapuo Gibea.”

English: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
Masaai: Amu ore tiatua ilolot enye pooki netii enkatampoi o Laitoriani shumata ilo ng'obor dama, netii enkima atua ninye kewarie, te dukuya ina aji pooki e Israel.

English: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
Masaai: “Nitoduaa apa iyie osina loo loo papa lang te Misiri nining enkomono enye te Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
Masaai: Aanotito nanu ilarripok, ina kata emanimanaa te nkanasa. “Itoduaa intae ilo onyor oltau lai?”

English: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
Masaai: Nedol olng'aboli te mbata e nkoitoi neiwuang'aki, neitu etumie toki, imbenek ake; nejoki ilo shani, “Tala Ing'anayio ntarasi.” Netoyu nabo kata olng'aboli.

English: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
Masaai: “Itoning'o aajo etejoki, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino, nimbayu olmang'atinta lino.’

English: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
Masaai: Aikiyookiki aaing'oru, kake mikitumutumu, ore enatii nimindimidimi aaetu.”

English: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
Masaai: Enkaraki nena paa oltung'ani obo, etiu apa ninye anaa olotua enotoki eishoi naba te nkumoi anaa ilakir le shumata nemeikenayu etiu anaa osinyai le mbata e naiposha.

English: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
Masaai: Amu meidimayu neitokini aitasheyie te nkirridunoto lelo ooidipaki aaitawang'a, neishamishama enkishorunoto e shumata, netang'arieki Enkiyang'et Sinyati,

English: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
Masaai: ore euriata o Laitoriani nemeiduruk, nebikoo ntarasi, ore nkiguanat o Laitoriani nesipa naa supati pooki.

English: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
Masaai: Ena ejo Olaitoriani tialo Kedar o enkitoria te Hasar apa natesesekuana Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon: “Entudumunye, enchom entaarare Kedar! Endaikie iltung'ana le nkilepunoto enkirowuaj!

English: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitobiruni te eilata teina girra nayierishoreki, niyau iyie eipurjaki aaitobiraki, too rubat naatapejoki anaa olasar le ntapa, ninchooyo anaa esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye naa: ile Shela, olmarei loo le Shela; ile Peres, olmarei loo le Peres, ile Sera, olmarei loo le Sera.

English: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
Masaai: Amu iltung'ana linono ninche naa enjung'ore ino ninche, laa iyie oitupukuo ninche te ngolon ino kitok o te nkaina ino naitoriori.’

English: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
Masaai: Neibulaa ilo rorei too lalashera nchere ore ele oiteng'eni nemeye, hoo neitu ejo Yesu, meye ninye, “Kake, Amaa tenaa eyiunoto ai pee eton ninye o metushukunye, kainyoo nikitii iyie?”

English: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
Masaai: Near ninche Ilfilisti ina olong ebaiki Mikmash o metabaiki Aijalon. Neaku etanaurate iltung'ana,

English: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
Masaai: Nelo Daudi anang'are ninche nejoki ninche, “Tenaa iyetuo intae enatii nanu to sotua, pee kiretutu nanu, naa keibung'are oltau lai intae; kake tenaa ietuo pee kikaldaa too lmang'ati laainei, hoo tenemaata entorroni nataasa nchoo naa edol Enkai oo loo papa neitalaku te intae.”

English: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
Masaai: Kitadamutua iyiook te ina nyorrata ino kitok, Olaitoriani, te mpolos e nkaji ino.

English: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
Masaai: Ee, neiguanakino ninche to ltau obo; neitobir ninche olning'o pee kitum aataarare iyie -

Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ajoki Hesekia, “Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani:

English: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
Masaai: ore naa taata tishipayu iyie pee imayian enkaji osinka lino, pee etum ashomo dukuya ntarasi te dukuya iyie; amu ore iyie, ee Olaitoriani Enkai, niroro, naa te mayianata ino emayiani enkaji o sinka lino ntarasi.”

English: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
Masaai: Nejoki isinkan lo laiguanani le Siria ninye, “Ore nkaitin enye naa nkaitin oo ldoinyo, neaku kegol ninche aalang iyiook. Metaa maape iyiook aarare ninche te nkop naisiaja, nemeeta nchere pee eitu kimir ninche.

English: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
Masaai: Ee, ninye epuo aairrugokino lelo pooki oowuasa lena kop; te dukuya ninye epuo aairrugo lelo pooki oopuo enkop, o ilo lemeidim aitopiu oltau lenye.

English: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
Masaai: Nipik nkikodot are e sahabu.

English: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani nkatitin pooki; etii enkisisa enye enkutuk ai anaake.

English: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni, “Olaitoriani, toponiki iyiook enkirukoto!”

English: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and twelve.
Masaai: Ore nkishu naa nkalifuni tomoni uni oile, ore te kuna naa ntomoni naapishana oare elaakinoto o Laitoriani.

English: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
Masaai: Nejo ninye; ilo oing'urrie ninye. Nejoki Yesu Ninye shomo sii iyie taasa ina.

English: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
Masaai: Elepa intae enchom osirua. Mailep nanu alo ele sirua amu eton eitu ebaya enkata ai.”

English: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
Masaai: Naa tenaa eng'ues nemesinya anaa enemeishoori anaa olasar to Laitoriani neyau naa ilo tung'ani ina ng'ues dukuya olapolosani,

English: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
Masaai: Ore taata, enkaraki nitaasa intae kuna baa pooki, Olaitoriani ojo, ore pee airorie intae aitirrishaki neitu ining'ining'i, ore pee aipot intae neitu irukishosho, ore pee aaipot intae neitu irukishosho,

English: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the LORD, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?
Masaai: Intanaura intae Olaitoriani too rorei linyi. Nijojo ake sii: “Kaji doi kinkuna ti nikintanaur ninye?” Intanaura ninye te nijojo: “Aisupat pooki tung'ani oas ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa keshipakino ninye ninche.” Anaa inkilikuanunu ijojo, “Koree doi Enkai oo sipat?”

English: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
Masaai: amu eikang'ate ltauja le kulo tung'ana, naa ming'anta nkiyiaa mening, neikeno nkonyek enye; pee medol ake too nkonyek enye, nening too nkiyiaa enye, nejing'aa ltauja lenye, neibelekenya maishiunye nanu ninche.’

English: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
Masaai: tolikioi ele rorei isiosiono te nkata sidai o te ntorrono. Inguanaki intijing'ai, nisikong, ninkok niaaku otemesi te ngiriata o te nkiteng'enare.

English: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
Masaai: Ore ile Gershom te risioroto oo lmareita lenye neorikini nkanas tomon ookuni, o losho le Isaakar, o Asheri, o Naftali, o Manase te Bashan.

English: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
Masaai: Ore olng'ejep le ilo asipani naa enkosholai sidai gelunoti, ore endamunoto olaasani loo ng'ok nemeeta tipat.

English: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
Masaai: Tiaaki lelo ootureishote, “Entagoluoto, emiureishoyu! Eng'ura Enkai inyi elotu te lap, eeta olerrinyore le Nkai, Kelotu ninye aitajeu intae.”

English: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
Masaai: aatamuata ninye nanu naaimulumul te mion o sina.

Masaai: neyooki sii aok e naisho e ngoro, e Enkai, natubukokoki enkikompe e ngoro eirrusha. Naa keitamei te nkima o te nkibiriti te dukuya lelo malaika sinyat o te dukuya ilo Kuoo le Ker?

English: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
Masaai: neman ilo polosie enkalo oloontoluo le Baala o metabaiki oldoinyo le Seir, negiroo o meshomo oljurum lo ldoinyo le Yearim te nkalo e kopikop Kesalon nedoyio o meshomo Betshemesh, nelo agiroo Timna.

English: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
Masaai: kelo Sharon aaku endaata oo nkerra, ore Oerata le Akor neaku ewueji neirragie nchoo, e lelo tung'ana laainei laaing'oru nanu.

English: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
Masaai: Te nias ena, anaa enikirikoo Enkai, naa ina kata ibikoo, nepuo sii kulo tung'ana pooki ewueji enye te seriani.”

English: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
Masaai: Kalo likae osho te nkop onyaanyukie iltung'ana linono Israel, laa ninche eshomo Enkai akordu pee eaku iltung'ana lenyena, pee intobiraki kewan enkarna too mbaa sapuki naaitureisho, aaraa aipang'ie iloshon te dukuya iltung'ana linono, apa litokordua ninche aitayu te Misiri.

English: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
Masaai: Neitokini aabol enkaji e Enkai te shumata nedoli osanduku lo sotua lenye ti atua enkaji e Enkai. Netii enkimerlel oo nkiwuang'at o ltoiloishi oobuak, o ndarat e nkikurrukur o lokirikiri le nkop, o enchan oo soito sapuki oleng.

English: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
Masaai: Ining iyie esayiata ai, ‘Minken iyie enkiok ino, te nkishirata ai te nkaraki eretoto!’

English: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

English: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Musa aisho enjung'ore olosho le Gad, te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Mishma naa: Hamuel olayioni lenye, o Sakur olayioni lenye o Shimei olayioni lenye.

English: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
Masaai: neiputa Enkai ninye te nkiyang'et e Nkai, te nkidimata, o te nkalamasisho, o te ng'eno, o te nkarriyiano.

English: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
Masaai: amu keure Herode Yohana, eyiolo ajo oltung'ani supat naa sinyati, nerrip eserian. Ore pee elo neinining nemilo; eji neng'ida sii te nening.

English: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
Masaai: Neiturruro olorere kitok, neibooyo nkonyek oo nkariak pooki o erata apa naaruko teina kop, ejo, “Kainyoo pee epuonu ilaiguanak le Asiria aatum enkare sapuk?”

English: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the LORD, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.
Masaai: Nejoki Naomi ina tito o layioni lenye, “Metamayiana Olaitoriani ilo leitu eing'uaa esupatisho enye ilo oishu aashu iloo tuata!” Neitoki sii Naomi ajoki ninye, “Olo lmarei lang ilo tung'ani, obo le ntaloishi ang.”

English: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
Masaai: Intae ate empalai e rrepet ang, naigero to ltauja lang, nayioloi neisoma ltung'ana pooki.

English: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;
Masaai: Ore o te na kata, kiaata esumash nikiaata enkure, nimikinchopo toki, nelimanitae iyiook, nimikiaata enemanya iyiook,

English: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kuna etiaaka Musa Aron o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana pooki le Israel.

English: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
Masaai: Ore olemaanyor nanu, nemeibung irorei laainei, ore ele rorei lining'ining'i neme olalai kake ole Papa laairriwua.

English: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
Masaai: Metaa eshomo Yosef anukaa papaai lenye, neiriamarie ninye isinkan pooki le Farao, o lpayiani lo lmarei lenye pooki tenebo ilpayiani pooki le nkop e Misiri.

English: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
Masaai: o pooki toki natii enkop natoyio naata enkiyang'et e enkishui, neye pooki.

English: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
Masaai: Naisho nanu meinosa ninche nkiri oo layiok lenye o noo ntoyie enye, nenya pooki ng'ae nkiri e ilo lelatia enye emanitae ninche o to sina, opik ninche ilmang'ati lenye, o lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye neisomit ninche.’

English: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
Masaai: Aishoo ninche ororei lino; neibayu ninche enkop, amu mme le nkop anaa enemara nanu ole nkop.

English: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
Masaai: Netem sii esuntai enye naa meta ntomoni ile te ntemata o ltung'ani aa taa enoo lmalaika.

English: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te Rameses o metabaiki Sukot, ilewa oobaya nkalifuni ile too nkejek, metii nkituaak o nkera.

English: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
Masaai: Amu eponiki ninye enkiseroto ing'ok enyena, eosh inkaik enyena tiatua iyiook, neponaa irorei lenyena akeshare Enkai.”

English: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, airriwaa olmalaika dukuya iyie, pee kirrip iyie te nkoitoi, nikiyau iyie ewueji naidipa aitobira.

English: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
Masaai: Amu ore pee eisho Enkai Abraham enkisiligata naa ore amu meetae likae kitok olang oinosie olmumai, neinosie kewan olmumai,

English: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
Masaai: Ore ilooinosa nera ilewa nkalifuni ong'uan, metii inkituaak o nkera.

English: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye indaiki te nkop e Misiri to lorere, neishiraki olorere Farao meishoo endaa; nejoki Farao iltung'ana pooki le Misiri, “Enchom enetii Yosef; ore pooki najoki intae, entaas.”

English: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

English: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.
Masaai: “Amu ore anaa ina keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk nalo nanu aitobiru, nelo atii dukuya nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, neijia elo atiu iishoritin ino, o enkarna ino, kepuo aabikoo.

English: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

English: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

English: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

English: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

English: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

English: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

English: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
Masaai: Milo iyie aitore ninye te nkisikong'ata kake turia Enkai ino.

English: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
Masaai: Etapalari iloo loreren, nepuonu eikirikira aaipang'u too nkisudorot enye.

English: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

English: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
Masaai: Pee itum atorripo te yiolounoto naiguana, ore enkutuk ino nerrip e ng'eno.

English: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
Masaai: Ore etii auluo etinyikaka kishomi e ina anasa, ng'ura, enapitai olmeneng'ani aaya, naa ilo otua ake eeta ng'otonye, naa enkoliai; nerubare ltung'ana kumok le ina anasa.

English: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
Masaai: Atua ninche epukunye isinkolioitin le nkishoroto e nashe o ltoiloishi le lelo ooshipa. Kaponaa nanu ninche nemeitoki ninche aaku kuti; kaisho nanu ninche meyanyituni nemeitoki aaku ooti.

English: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye lelo kiliku enetii Yakobo nejoki, “Kitabaikitia olalashe lino Esau, naa elotu ninye peyie kinang'are iyie nerikito ilewa iip ong'uan.”

English: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee eeta olmodai enkinyang'a te nkaina enye nainosie eng'eno nagut, nemeeta ninye endamunoto?

English: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
Masaai: Enchom ineerishare inkoitoi ore pooki lidolidolo, empotoki osirua le nkiyama.’

English: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.

English: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
Masaai: Ateeke natamio too ngolikinot. Kumok nkatitin alau njo, naata esumash o enkure, nkatitin kumok maata endaa, naanya enkijape nkatitin kumok maadupa nkilani.

English: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

English: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

English: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
Masaai: Eikilikuana apa olkitok lai isinkan lenyena ajoki, ‘Iyatata papaai linyi anaa likae alashe?’

English: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
Masaai: Kapik nanu ndamunot aainei nena kiaasin e nking'asia o Laitoriani; ee, kadamu nanu nena apa e nking'asia nitaasa.

English: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
Masaai: Ee, ira iyie oltaa lai, Olaitoriani, naa keitawang Enkai ai enaimin ai.

Masaai: Einosa pooki ina daa apa naisho Enkai,
