Masaai: Nebik olairrag le nkare tioriong enkop nkolong'i artam, neponari enkare o metudumu aing'atie enkop ailepie e safina.

English: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
Masaai: Kake eiputa ninche engoro napi neiguana maate eing'oru enaitaas Yesu.

English: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
Masaai: Ore naa taata nchoo euriata o Laitoriani eaku tenebo intae; entujurru eniasiasa; amu meetae enkibelekenyata e sipata to Laitoriani Enkai, anaa enyorrakinoto, anaa eng'amunoto oo ntokitin e ropare.”

English: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return unto the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts unto the LORD, and serve him only: and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel enkaji pooki e Israel, “Tenaa eishukunyenye aapuonu enetii Olaitoriani to ltau linyi pooki, ewuangie naa nena aitin oo loreren o ina Ashtarot entung'uai ate, nintoriokiki oltau linyi Olaitoriani, nisiaayiayia ninye ake, naa keitajeu ninye intae aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.”

English: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii naajoki:

English: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
Masaai: Naa ilo ajoki Farao, ‘Etejo Olaitoriani inchere, ore Israel naa olkikau lai,

English: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejoki Farao Yosef, “Ng'ura ajo aaitasheyie iyie ing'ura enkop pooki e Misiri.”

English: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae loo Lawi, lelo mareita loo Lmerari neishori ninche to losho le Sebulon, Yokne-am te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Karta te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
Masaai: “Ore ake tenebo nena intobira, olng'obor le Nkai too lkarash le katani napuyiapui tomon, pusi, o lmorijo o lpilei, neripakini ilkerubi te nkarriayiano oleng.

English: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
Masaai: neng'as aarikoki Annas, amu olaputani le Kaiafas, laa ninye Olapolosani Kitok te ilo ari.

English: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji neroro nkejek inyi naa keaku eninyi; ore enkop inyi naa keiteru ebaiki ong'ata o Lebanon o ebaiki olkeju le Frati o metabaiki enaiposha enkalo oloo ntoluo.

English: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
Masaai: Amu kadumu nanu enkarna ai aitabaiki keper, nainos olmumai, anaa enaishu nanu ntarasi.

English: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
Masaai: Inyanya intae nena naapir, ninchopokiki ate inkilani oo lpapit loo ntare, niyieng'iyieng'e nena naaisul te mpiron; kake mintotiti intae nena tare.

English: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
Masaai: Ore ninye kairorie nanu kiwalikino too nkutukie, te nkibalakinoto, neme te nkiroroto misil; naa keing'or ninye eneikununo Olaitoriani. Kainyoo naa pee miurere intae aatukur ilo sinka lai Musa?”

English: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
Masaai: Neimaki pooki ninye aarrep eing'asia too rorei le mpiris ooimu enkutuk enye. Nejo, “Ae mme olayioni le Yosef doi ele?”

English: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
Masaai: Meishoru olkarsis inkumok nemeishoru olaisinani inkuti, to lpisiai le shekeli, te ninchoru olasar lo Laitoriani aitaiyu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan ino.

English: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
Masaai: Ayieu naitoki aitadamu intae, hoo naidipa apa aitayiolo intae nchere ore ilo oitajewuo iltung'ana aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, nenyaaka amut lelo leitu eiruk.

English: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
Masaai: Netum oltung'ani otii ine oji Aeneas oirraga te rruat larin isiet naa keilenye.

English: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoshua iltung'ana, neipirri ninche aapuo olng'obor; naa ng'ura, keturoro apa ti atua olng'obor lenye etii enkosholai abori.

English: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
Masaai: Neas lelo yarunot apa ootorrinyunye ina. Negelu Esra olapolosani iltung'ana, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ore ake pooki ng'ae te ninche neigeri enkarna enye. Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le tomon netoni ninche pee ejurru ina bae.

English: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
Masaai: “Toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani, nining olkiyioi lai migirare ilkiyio laainei! Amu ara nanu olomoni lino olo, nara olalotoni anaa loo papa pooki.

English: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
Masaai: Neitu aekata edumunye te Israel oloiboni le Nkai laaijo Musa, laa keyiolore Olaitoriani too nkomomi,

English: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neng'amu ninye ina sahabu too nkaik enye, neitobir te ntoki naguetishoreki, neitayu olashe le sahabu natosholaki; nejo ninche, “Kuna ninche nkaitin inyi, intae Isiraeli, naayautua aailepunye aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri!”

English: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.
Masaai: Keilep ilaitajeunok aapuo Oldoinyo le Sion aaitore Oldoinyo le Esau; neaku enkitoria eno Laitoriani.

English: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
Masaai: Ore isempewueti linono pooki, neikununo anaa ilng'abolo, ooto ilng'anayio le dukuya teneipiripiri, nerrarrunye, aadoiki enkutuk eilo oinos.

English: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
Masaai: Aashu te neomonu olmosori, keisho enkulupa?

English: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
Masaai: “Etoosho ninche entarumpeta nerretena pooki; nemeeta obo lenye olo olarrabal, amu etii engoro ai napi shumata olorora lenye pooki.

English: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooikenaki too le Lawi, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron o Larikok le Israel, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Pekahia, o nena pooki naataasa, ng'ura, eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ore too le Lawi naa nkalifuni ong'uan o iip ile,

English: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
Masaai: Anaa enajo endung'et e rashe e apa moitie, ‘Atua ilo torrono epukunye entorroni.’ Kake mikiarare iyie enkaina ai.

English: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
Masaai: Neas anaa enaitanapa Yosef ninye. Ore ake pee ekenyu, neishori iltung'ana epuo aareu isirkon lenye.

English: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aapuo enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kintisinya iyiook enkaji o Laitoriani pooki, ilo perere lo lasar opejori o masaa enyena pooki, o ina mesa e mukate e nkitoduaaroto o masaa enyena pooki.

English: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon ajoki Enkai, “Mincho iyie engoro ino eyupuyup ti alo nanu, kake nchooki nanu mairoro ena kata nabo ake, aatoomono, nchooki nanu manyaaki atem ena kata nabo endapana; aatoomono, nchoo endapana ake metoyio, ore enkae kop pooki nchoo ejing enkoileelio.”

English: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
Masaai: Ore eyia, eisupati apa lelo tung'ana te iyiook, neitu iyiook kitum entorroni, neitu iyiook kilau toki apa kitii ong'ota, te nkata naba anaa enikishomo te nebo ninche;

English: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
Masaai: Neaku Olaitoriani olaiguanani le Yoshurun, ina kata apa pee etumo ilkituaak loo ltung'ana iloshon pooki le Israel tenebo.

English: Neither give place to the devil.
Masaai: Emincho sii sheitani erishata.

English: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Mintalaku ake elap aashu iata enkiba tiatua oltau tialo ilayiok loo ltung'ana linyi, kake tonyorra olelatia ino anaa kewan ino. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: kake ore ore sorri e nkoshoke o loilelek lenyena neituku ninye te nkare. Nepejoo olapolosani pooki te nchumata olperere lo lasar, anaa olasar opejori, olasar le mpejoroto te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
Masaai: Te nairriu nanu Atemas aashu Tikikos meeu enitii, tonyuaa oleng, wou ene natii te Nikapolis, amu atudung'o pee aton te ine te nkata e nkirobi.

English: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani awaliki ina kitok nejo, “Mikisudorie nanu pooki toki naba anaa enaaikilikuan iyie.” Nejo ina kitok, “Nchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani eiro.”

English: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ninche ilo kurroto oidong'ishoreki le Nakon neitorioki Usa enkaina enye ilo sanduku le Nkai, neibung amu etarrorrote lelo mong'i.

English: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
Masaai: Ena mukate nadou aing'uaa shumata, ore olonya ninye nemeye.

English: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o isiet le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Sakaria olayioni le Yeroboam aitoreisho too Siraeli te nkop e Samaria, ilapaitin ile.

English: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
Masaai: Intupuku impang'ie ilo oimaki intorrok, naa aikipuku enchankar aing'uaa, ore olarrabal o emorore naa keish.

English: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
Masaai: Keidim oltung'ani aitobiraki kewan nkaitin? Ore kuna mme nkaitin!”

English: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
Masaai: Ore apa ile Gershon naa olmarei le Libni o lmarei le Shimei; kulo apa ilmareita loo le Gershon.

English: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
Masaai: Eidaikieki Moab; ening'itoi olkiyioi tenelakua anaa Soar.

English: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
Masaai: aitarasaa enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaji e Saul, neitasheyie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi te shumata Israel o te shumata Yuda, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba.”

English: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Masaai: Meishieki eishoi enye; meimisieki enkarna enye te ishoi e are!

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar loo ngok,

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
Masaai: nji naa ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Melau ae kata Yonadabu olayioni le Rekab oltung'ani oitashe te dukuya nanu.”

English: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
Masaai: Nejoki Ahab, ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, “Eilo iyie tenebo nanu Ramot-gilead?” Newal ninye ajo, “Atiu nanu anaa enitiu iyie, netiu iltung'ana laainei anaa iltung'ana linono. Kiaku iyiook tenebo iyie to larrabal.”

English: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel. Etapejoyie ninye olayioni leye aitaa olasar, te risioroto e ilo minong loo loshon apa ootaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya Isiraeli.

English: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
Masaai: Ore ake pee alo atua ewueji sinyati e Nkai, namusu taa enkiting'oto enye.

English: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche nkikoot o nkiguanat nilo iyie aing'or te ina kop nikichoo iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi pee iya, too nkolong'i pooki ninchu tioriong enkop.

English: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
Masaai: Ina pee aaishiraki ninye nanu ajoki, “Ng'ura ore nena naapuo ina kop e moikuape neitoborro Enkiyang'et ai te nkop e moikuape.”

English: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
Masaai: Etoosho ninye endapidapoi nerukunye enkare, neruko ilkejek aadooyo. Keidim sii ninye aishoru imukateni, anaa eisho iltung'ana lenyena nkiri?”

English: When thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.
Masaai: “Tenilo atua enkurma oo lng'anayio eilo tung'ani le latia ino, nindim ainosa ataraposhoyu ilng'anayio, ilooba anaa liyieu, kake mipik ake hoo obo olbene lino.

English: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
Masaai: Ketii olng'ejep lai emonkoi ake ninye pooki? Amaa enkishamisham aimemusu enyamali?

English: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
Masaai: Neaku ore peyie eidurru iltung'ana aaing'uaa oloosaen netum enkop naisiasha te nkop e Shinar, neitaa ine emanyisho enye.

English: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
Masaai: Etaa Abraham oloo larin iip peyie eikini ninye enkayioni enye Isaak.

English: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
Masaai: Atoomonuo naaishori ena kerai, naaishoo nanu Olaitoriani eomonunoto ai apa natoomono ninye.

English: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki ninye, “Eji intayu enkishui ino te nkaraki nanu? Esipa, esipa, aajoki, meru olkuku eitu kimiki iyie katitin uni.

English: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Aitaa nanu embata oo layiok linyi iloibonok le Nkai ore embata oo lbarnot linyi Ilnasari, aimesipa ena, lo tung'ana le Israel?” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
Masaai: netii te nebo ninye ilaiguanak tomon, obo ake loo loshon loo lmareita le Israel.

English: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
Masaai: Ore apa pee elikini Sanbalat o Tobia le Geshem ilo Marabui o kulikae mang'ati lang nchere atesheta nanu ina esuntai nemeekure etii olong'eng'e, hoo naa ore ebaiki ina kata eton eitu apik nkikeneta e kishomi,

English: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa ninche o nenen wuejitin pooki neemanita ildoinyo laainei e mayianata; naa kairriu aitadou enchan terishata enye; naa ninye enkoirujuruji e emayianata.

English: Abram; the same is Abraham.
Masaai: o Abram aa taa Abraham.

English: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
Masaai: o emukate nipik kuna pooki nkaik e Aron, o nkaik oo layiok lenyena, niyukuyuk iyie ninche metaa olasar oyukuyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
Masaai: neya ninye te nebo olaiguanani lenye o nkang'itie enyena pooki; near ninche te nepi o lalem, neidaikie tukul pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye, eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani obo eishu; ore anaa apa enataasa te Hebron o te Libna o laiguanani lenye neijia sii eikuna Debir o laiguanani lenye.

English: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
Masaai: Nikiroroki ninche nikincho iyie imukateni are ning'amu iyie te nkaina enye.

English: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
Masaai: Ena doi iyieuu naitadedeyie nchere Yesu oirorie intae ti atua nanu. Nemeshal taa ninye too nkiaasin naaitaas intae; keasisho engolon enye ti atua intae.

English: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
Masaai: amu neijia etiu kedoiki lelo pooki, oomanya enkop pooki.

English: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
Masaai: Naa keaku ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani, nekorduni. Amu ore to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem netii lelo oopuo aaimisho, anaa enatejo Olaitoriani; ore te lelo ooleku, ninche etii lelo ooipot Olaitoriani.

English: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
Masaai: Nejo Yakobo, “Na Ai Enkai e papa lai Abraham naa Enkai e papa lai Isaak, Lo Aitoriani, ilo apa laatiaaka nanu, ‘Torrinyoyu shomo enkop ino enetii olorere lino le sotua, naa kaitaas iyie esidai,’

English: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.
Masaai: Neitoki Esta aipot Hatak, obo le lelo sunaishi oogelema lo laiguanani, laa ninye etegeluaki pee eisiaai ninye, neirriwaa ninye meshomo enetii Mordekai pee eyiolou ajo kaa ena naa ae tenkaraki nyoo pee etotiuo neijia.

English: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
Masaai: Naa ele olmeitai laa ninye emutie Olaitoriani iloreren pooki lelo oodumaki olarrabal Yerusalem. Ekeng'uoyu iseseni lenye eton eitashoo, naa keng'uoyu inkonyek enye etii atua ilukuny enye, naa keng'uoyu ilng'ejepa lenye tiatua inkutukie enye.

English: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Benchamen: Bela, o Besher, o Yediael, lelo pokira okuni.

English: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
Masaai: “Teneaku aisinani olalashe lino, nemir embata oo masaa enyena, ore ilo alashe onyikare nelotu akordu ina natimira olalashe lenye.

English: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Olaitoriani, ng'ura doi, noolo lalema aare.” Nejoki ninche, “Eidipe.”

English: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ilo kitok loo sikarini, “Shomo ang; metotiwuo te iyie anaa ina niruko.” Neishiunyeki olaisiaayiani lenye te ina kata ake.

English: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
Masaai: Neipang Gaal alo ajing dukuya iltung'ana le Shekem nearare Abimelek.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Masaai: Ore apa olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Isaakar naa Natanel olayioni le Suar.

English: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
Masaai: nisiaaishosho te yieunoto sidai anaa eninkoko to Laitoriani neme anaa too ltung'ana,

English: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etadowuo oltung'ani eing'uaa Yerusalem alo Yeriko, neinepu ilaisimak neoru nkilani, near neing'uaa etaa keye.

English: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
Masaai: niparan ninye anaake tadekenya, nitem ninye pooki kata?

English: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
Masaai: Te netum oltau lai emion, te neitagori oltau lai,

English: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
Masaai: Ore einosita endaa, nedumu emukate nemayian, nebelibel, neisho ninche, nejo, “Enkoito; osesen lai ele.”

English: O that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
Masaai: “Oi duoo tenaa kepiki entemet nainenengishoreki isinaitin laainei! te nebo enyamali ai pooki aaineneng.

English: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
Masaai: Keitu doi isomama ele kigeroto ojo, ‘Ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak otaa ole lukunya o lmairroto;

English: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
Masaai: Etemene Dameski, eibelekenye ninye aisik, neterewa ninye olkirutoto; neibung ninye emion o sinaitin, laaijo ilenkitok nasaisai.

English: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
Masaai: Ing'ura, mincho enkuretisho ai kinture iyie mesapuku enkitirrishakinoto ai te iyie.

English: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
Masaai: Kainyoo apa pee atupukuo te nguset alotu adol enyamali o sina, naton nkolong'i aainei te nkurruna?

English: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
Masaai: Nemeidim enkong'u atiaki enkaina, “Maatayie nanu iyie tipat,” nemeidim sii ninye elukunya atiaki nkejek, “Maatayie nanu intae tipat.”

English: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Yoshua o Israel pooki nchere eibung'a lelo apa ootii olnukata enkanasa, neilepa empuruo e ina anasa alo shumata, neibelekenyunye aar metuata lelo tung'ana le Ai.

English: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ilmang'ati linono, Olaitoriani, ng'ura, keidak ilmang'ati linono, ore lelo arruok naa keisardakieki.

English: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
Masaai: naa keinyiototo ltung'ana ti atua intae, oojo mbaa e nkiushoto, pee eyiataa looiteng'eni laa ninche esujaa.

English: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
Masaai: Mincho oltau lino eng'uar ilaing'okok kake shomo inkolong'i pooki tiatua euriata o Laitoriani.

English: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
Masaai: Neirorie olorere anaa enatuutakitia ninye ilbarnot, ejoki, “Eiroshiyie apa papaai enchata inyi oo murto, naa kaponaa nanu ina shata inyi oo murto; eitamio apa intae papaai too lishien kake kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.”

English: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
Masaai: Metalakuana ena bae te iyie pee mias ena bae, aar metuata isupati o ltorrok, eji metaa kenyaanyuk osupat o ltorrono! Metalakuana ina bae te iyie! Amaa ilo oiguanare enkop pooki aimeas esipata?”

English: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
Masaai: Etotiwuo Olaitoriani anaa olmang'atinta, eidaikie ninye Israel, eidaikie ninye wuejitin enyena pooki enkitoo neitomijoon isempewueti lenyena netopona ninye tiatua ina tito e Yuda osina o enkishirata.

English: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
Masaai: Neikirikira enkop te dukuya ninche, neikirikira shumata. Neitomisimisi enkolong o lapa, neibooyo ilakir ewang'an enye.

English: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
Masaai: Nikiyiolo aajo edoiki enkiguana e Nkai lelo ooas nena baa.

English: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo oiteng'eni onyor Yesu Petero, “Olaitoriani doi!” Ore pee ening Simon Petero meishopo, neidaki atua enaiposha;

English: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Nitaa intae ilooduaaya iyiook o Laitoriani amu, itang'amutua ilo rorei te nkaripo sapuk, te ng'ida nadumaki intae Enkiyang'et Sinyati;

English: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
Masaai: Eng'ura eneba enyorrata natonyorra iyiook Papa, pee eipoti iyiook aajo nkera e Nkai; naa kesipa eikira. Ore pee meyiolo iyiook enkop enkaraki neitu eiyiolou ninye.

English: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
Masaai: Ore hoo naipotishe naishiru eretoto neikeno ninye enkomon ai.

English: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
Masaai: Neaku aabore nanu engoro napi o Laitoriani; anaure aibookino. “Tubukoki ninye shumata nkera te nkoitoi nalala enkanasa, o shumata sii iumat oo lbarnot; neyae olmoruo o enkitok, lelo moruak olelo kituaak lenye.

English: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
Masaai: Amu ore akenya enkolong nilo, alang enongoto e Kebron, tayiolo ntisipa nchere meeta nchere miye. Ore osarge lino nelotu shumata endukuya ino makewan.”

English: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
Masaai: Airragie apa nanu orreshet te nkaraki iyie, nikimbung'aki iyie Babilon, neitu apa iyie iyiolou; kinotoki apa iyie nikimbung'i, enkaraki nitekeshere iyie Olaitoriani.

English: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
Masaai: Neaku ore ebaiki ina olong etaa keji ninye Yerubaal, aa taa, “Nchoo Baal eng'or agilunore ninye” amu etusulayie ninye auroo olperere lenye lo lasar.

English: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Masaai: Ti nikimbalunye ng'ok ang keisiligayu ninye naa asipani, metaa kepalaki ninye iyiook ng'ok ang neisujaa ntorrok ang pooki.

English: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
Masaai: Nemir Olaitoriani ninche metijing'a atua enkaina e Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan, apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Hasor; ore apa olarikoni le njore enye naa Sisera, nemanya apa ninye Harosheta-goiim.

English: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
Masaai: Kake enotoki sii kulikae Yahudi oopuaya, ooaraa loiriruani, nedumunye aaku enkarna o Laitoriani Yesu ejokinye lelo oiriruani, “Aainosie olmumai te nkarna e ilo oji Yesu olikioo Paulo.”

English: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
Masaai: Neiruk ninye Olaitoriani, neikenakini ninye aajo oloitashe too sipat.

English: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
Masaai: ore naa taata, olkitok lai, anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa enaishu oltau lino, idolita ajo kimbooyie iyie Olaitoriani aitung'uaa enkibukoroto o sarge, o enkitalakunoto e lap te nkaina ino makewan, ore naa taata nchoo ilmang'ati linono o lelo ooing'oru aaitaas entorroni olkitok lai etiu anaa Nabal.

English: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
Masaai: Ore endukuya ino neitashe aitobiraki anaa oldoinyo le Karmel, ore nena enat inono oo lpapit naaisiong'a netiu anaa nkilani pilei, netil olaiguanani tiatua ina sidano.

English: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
Masaai: Ore Isiraeli o Lfilisti nenyikakino pee eara, enjore earare njore.

English: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ajoki ninye ene uni, “Simon olayioni le Yohana, ai kinyor iyie nanu?” Neisinanuo Petero amu etiaaka ene uni, “Ai kinyor iyie nanu?” Nejoki ninye, “Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie pooki toki; iyiolo ajo kaanyor.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Intotio nkerra aainei.

English: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
Masaai: “Atoning'o nanu imorot e Moab o esukeny oo le Amon, ina natusukenya ninche iltung'ana laainei nerup ate ti alo enkop enye.

English: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ilo obor neng'amu ninye eng'ida ng'ejuk naing'uaa Olaitoriani, ore olaisinani aisul iltung'ana nelo ashipakino ilo sinyati le Israel.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
Masaai: oina naitaasa ninye Datan o Abiram lelo ayiok le Aliab, olayioni le Ruben, ina natabolo enkop enkutuk neijoo ninche tenebo ilmareita lenye, o lng'oborri lenye, o pooki toki naishu apa nasujita ninche, te mpolos e Israel pooki;

English: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
Masaai: Pee ening Iltung'ana pooki le Israel, neureishoyu, nemeigil aekata aas entorroni naikununo nji tiatua intae.

English: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
Masaai: Ore nchomito enyena neyietu aaishir; neirrag ninye te nkop meishopo.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo te nebo intae pooki.

English: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
Masaai: Kebaa enkiroishi oo rorei oosipa! Kake amaa doi ainyoo eutu eutaroto ino?

English: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Enkop nalakua eing'uaa isinkan linono te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ino; amu kitoning'o iyiook ilomon lenyena, o nena pooki naataasa ninye te Misiri,

English: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki likae, ‘Kebaa esile niata iyie?’ Nejo, ‘Mboreitin iip e nkano.’ Nejoki ninye ilo, ‘Tudumu empalai ino e sile ngero ntomoni isiet.’

English: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
Masaai: Ore ilomon sidain nemeishaakino olmodai, nemeiro ilomon le lejare olayioni lo laiguanani.

English: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki ilo Filisti, “Ilotu iyie enatii to lalem o te mpere, o te nkae pere naado; kake alotu nanu enitii iyie te nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani, ina Ai oo njoreitin e Israel, naa ninye iyie itamoro.

English: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
Masaai: Ina peyie etem endapasho eine nebolieki kishomi, intemat tomon; o endapasho e ina kishomi, intemat tomon oo kuni.

English: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake kaitagol oltau le Farao, naa ore hoo tenaponaa nkitoduaat aainei o mbaa e nking'asia te nkop e Misiri,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Entadamu eninkunariri intae.

English: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
Masaai: Neitu eitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadamu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninye apa otokordua ninche aitayu te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenye pooki te pooki shoto:

English: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nadol epuonu ilakedok, nadol ilakedok loo mbartan epuonu maare!” Newal ninye ajo, “Etabatate, etabatate Babilon, ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin, netarrarrakinote enkop.”

English: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
Masaai: Nepuku lido otua, neena nkaik o nkejek too nkarash naanukarieki ltung'ana; neena enkomom enye te nkarasha. Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entalak ninchosho ninye meshomo.”

English: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
Masaai: Kake etanya Sihon eisho Israel meima atua enkop enye. Neiturrur ninye iltung'ana lenyena pooki te nebo, neipang alo aarare Israel to lpurkel, nebau Yahas, nearare Israel.

English: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
Masaai: nior nena naataaruaki katitin are, aoriki lelo morran apa ooshomo enjore o e umata pooki.

English: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu matobiko ti atua olng'obor lino ntarasi! Ee, pee atum ataseriana tiabori inaipuko inono!

English: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
Masaai: Nikiyiolo aajo etashoki enkorrok ang musana te nebo ninye peyie eitarruorri osesen loo ng'ok pee mikintoki aaku rrindiki loo ng'ok.

English: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Pahat-moab, naa Elieho-enai olayioni le Serahia, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa iip are o onom.

English: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya eloito arrinyokino ina anasa netir esumash.

English: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:
Masaai: Ore ilo oitobira Inkokua o Inkapiak uni neibelekeny enaimin nagut aitaa enkakenya neitomisimis endama aitaa enkewarie ilo oipotu nkariak e naiposha neitashaiki ninche shumata oriong e nkop, Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye,

English: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
Masaai: Neitoki Eli awaliki, “Shomo te seriani, mikinchoo Enkai oo Siraeli nena nitasayua te dukuya ninye.”

English: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa ooetuo enetii Daudi te Siklag, ina kata metumoki ashomo oleng tenkaraki Saul olayioni le Kish; netii apa ninche tenebo lelo tung'ana magil ootareto ninye to larrabal.

English: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
Masaai: Neirriu ninye enaimin neitomisimis enkop, negolong'u ninche aany irorei lenyena.

English: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
Masaai: Kenkaraki euriata niure iyie ninye peyie kisikong'a ninye, niking'uanare ninye iyie?

English: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Metaa eira doi Enkerai e Nkai?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Intae ootejo kara.”

English: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
Masaai: Kake te niaatata kulie ning'oruru, epuonunui aaiguanare nena te noshi ake kiguana.

English: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
Masaai: etopona intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa ng'ura, ibaba intae ena olong anaa ilakir le shumata te nkumoi.

English: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
Masaai: Ore ina kata lootii Yudea esikaki ldoinyo, ore lelo ootii atua ina anasa nepuku aapuo, nemejing'u lelo ootioyo ti ong'ata;

English: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak, o laitasheikinok sunaishi oogelema o lbalusuni o laikook lo laiguanani neiturrurro te nebo nedol aajo eitu etum enkima ai golon too seseni le lelo tung'ana; ore ilpapit loo lukuny enye eitu ninye eisui, ore nkilani enye neitu eikoni ae, nemetii olng'usil le nkima ninche.

English: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
Masaai: Neitoki Abraham ajo, “Oi mincho Olaitoriani egoro naa kairo. Oo tenaa tomoni oni etumi te ine?” Newal ninye, “Maas nanu ina tenatum tomoni uni te ine.”

English: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
Masaai: Kulo aiguanak apa ooitoreisho te enkop e Edom, eton eitu eitore hoo likae aiguanani Isiraeli: Bela ole Boer, laa ninye eipotieki enkanasa naji Dinhaba.

English: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
Masaai: Te naa keitarru olalashe lino entoki ninosita iyie, nemeekure ilotie iyie enyorrata. Mincho ake ina toki ninya eaku ninye nabatat obo otanang'a Kristo.

English: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.
Masaai: Negiroo ninche nepuo aaibung enkoitoi enye; nedoyio enkolong etii ninche embata e Gibea, nara ninye ene Benchamen,

English: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
Masaai: Neas Noa nena pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
Masaai: Ore naa enkaraki naa iyie kingarakino, nemeishiaakino iyiook nikiduaaki olaiguanani esulare, enkaraki ena pee kirriwakita olaiguanani olkilikuai aaitayiolo,

English: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
Masaai: Nelang'u Ilamori Yordan aapuonu sii aarare Yuda earare Benchamen nearare enkaji e Efraim; neaku etudupa osina Israel oleng.

English: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
Masaai: Etujutuoki pooki toki naishu natii enkoriong enkop, aa tung'ani, o ng'uesi, o pooki toki naiserpepiari, o motonyi oloing'ang'e, etujutuo ninye pooki te nkop. Noa ake etung'uayioki tenebo ilooboitare tiatua e safina.

English: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
Masaai: “Te ina kata taa errorro ilkumok nekaldaa olikae olikae, neibayuno ninche maate.

English: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, Ilo Sinyati le Israel, Olaitajeunoni lino. Aishorua nanu Misiri pee kinyang'unyeki iyie, naishooyo Etiopia o Seba pee aawalunye iyie.

English: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
Masaai: eitirrishakita iyiook naleng eyieu neishori metang'ara eretoto nareti ltung'ana le Nkai.

English: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina atejo nanu: “Mbelekenyayu miking'or nanu, nchooki nanu maishira olkiyioi le mion; mintanaur kewan kintigir nanu, te nkaraki enkidaata e ina tito o lorere lang.”

English: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
Masaai: Kake ilapolosak kumok o Lawi o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ilpayiani kituaak apa ootoduaa enkaji e dukuya neyietu aaishir ina kata pee edol olkitamanyunoto lena aji eshetuni, hoo netabuakutua ilkumok te nchipai;

English: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
Masaai: Eitaasa ninche te nkeleekisho Olaitoriani; amu etoiutuo ninche nkera oo naataluno. Ore taata ele apa ng'ejuk kemut ninche te nebo o nkurman enye.

English: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
Masaai: Etisiraki ti atua nkitanapat inyi nchere, kesipa shakenisho oo ltung'ana aare.

English: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
Masaai: Tenajoki enkurare, ‘Ira iyie papa lai’ najoki ilo kurto, ‘Ira yeiyio lai’; arashu ‘Enkanashe ai,’

English: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
Masaai: Naa keirriwaa ninye ilmalaika lenyena te ndarata kitok e ntarumpeta meiturrurru ilgelunot lenyena too lubot pokira ong'uan naaing'uaa osiwuo, neitung'uaa ineeiting'ie keper, too lubot pooki.

English: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
Masaai: Esipa eisupat Enkai te ilo oitoriori nkoitoi enyena, te lelo sidain iltauja.

English: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
Masaai: Neitoki sii olaiguanani ajo, ‘Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, laa ninye oishoo obo le ishoi ai metotonie olorika lai le nkitoo ena olong, adolita too nkonyek aainei.’ ”

English: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
Masaai: Kake enchopo Olaitoriani Yesu Kristo, naa emintoki ake aaisho osesen erishata, metaa nena ake naayieu intabayaya.

English: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nejoki Olaitoriani Solomon, “Ore amu ena itadamua, neitu imbung olning'o lai lo sotua o nkiguanat aainei naaitanapa nanu iyie esipa, kadung'oo nanu enkitoria ino aiwuang'ie te iyie naisho osinka lino.

English: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
Masaai: Ore lelo oodaa te sikar, neidak too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa; ore lelo apa ootamoo eishop nkilani pilei neirrag too lchalai loo nkuruon.

English: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
Masaai: “Emayiana ilooata esumash o enkure eing'oru enayieu Enkai; amu ninche eitaraposhi.

English: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
Masaai: Ninye nyaanyukie e ina Ai nemelioo, olkikau le pooki toki naitayioki;

English: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
Masaai: Newaliki taa Olaitoriani nejoki, “Lo sunkuro! Keetae obo linyi lemelaku olkiteng anaa osikiria lenye to lale te nkolong e sabato, nerik aitook enkare?

English: And as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?
Masaai: Ore eilepaki oldoinyo aapuo ina ang, nenang'are ninche iselenken aisiaayiak eipang'u aapuonu aaoku enkare, nejoki ninche, “Ketii oladuani ene?”

English: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
Masaai: Ore nkajijik e Yerusalem o nkajijik oo laiguanak le Yuda nena ajijik pooki naatapejorieki enkorropil inchumat enye tenkaraki olorora pooki le shumata neibukorieki ilasarri ooki tenkaraki nkulie aitin naa keisarkionieki anaa ewueji e Tofet.’ ”

English: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
Masaai: Neitashe ilo moti te nchumata lelo mong'i, neing'or okuni enkalo e moikuape, neing'or okuni enkalo o loontoluo, neing'or okuni enkalo e kopikop, neing'or okuni enkalo o loosaen, naa ninche apa eiteleikiaki ilo moti, ore nkaloli enye oo lkidong'o naa enkalo e atua etii.

English: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
Masaai: ore olmang'atinta obayie oishieki naa keeya.

English: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
Masaai: tenaa aira sinyati nintashe too sipat, nesipa katukul inchere ekedumunye ninye te nkaraki iyie; nikilaaki ninye iyie te wueji neishaakino tinimany.

English: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
Masaai: nejoki olmalaika, “Sakaria, miureishoyu, etoning'oki enkomono ino: naa aikiiki enkitok ino Elisabet enkayioni, naa eimpot enkarna enye ajo Yohana.

English: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
Masaai: Ayaua nanu ninche enkaji o Laitoriani atua olgilata loo layiok le Hanan olayioni le Igdalia, ilo tung'ani le Nkai, apa otii embata olgilata loo lkituaak, shumata olgilata le Maaseia olayioni le Shalum, olarriponi le kutukaji.

English: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
Masaai: Ee kenapi ina toki kewan aaya Asiria, pee eaku enkishooroto te ilo aiguanani kitok. Keitukurruni Efraim, nekurru sii Israel te nkaraki enkitanyaanyukoto enye.

English: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
Masaai: Ore pee epiki iyiook mbaa e sulare nikiropiropisho. Kitotiwuo anaa suut e nkop; ore o te ne kitaa olchala loo suut e pooki toki!

English: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Ehudi aitarasai ina kodi, neisho lelo tung'ana meshomo apa ooyautua ina kodi.

English: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
Masaai: Ng'ura eitaa Enkai enkaji ino mijooni. Naajoki meekure kintoki ae kata adol o tejo, ‘Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani!’ ”

English: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
Masaai: Ore pee ejoki neijia, neitodol nkaik enyena o nkejek.

English: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye mbartan meshomo ine, o ngarrin oo mbartan o enjore kitok nepuonu ninche kewarie, neman enkanasa aang'adu.

English: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
Masaai: Nanu eishiraki ninche aajo, Enkai ai, kiyiolo iyiook Israel iyie.

English: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
Masaai: neituku ninye osesen lenye te nkare teine wueji sinyati, neitoki aishop lelo kilani lenyena, neipang'u alotu neishooyo ilo asar lenye opejori o ilo asar opejori te nkaraki iltung'ana, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan enye o te nkaraki iltung'ana.

English: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
Masaai: Nejoki Absalom Ahitofel, “Nchoru enkikoo ino; kaa iyiook kias?”

English: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
Masaai: Ninye Olaitoriani Enkai ang; etii nkiguanat enyena enkop pooki.

English: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Kaa iyieu naitaas nanu? Tolikioki nanu entoki niaata tiatua aji?” Nejoki ninye, “Meeta esinka ino toki tiaji meteleku esiang'au e ilata.”

English: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
Masaai: Nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki ninye, “Kaji etiu pee irorie ninche too nkitanyanyukot?”

English: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
Masaai: Nepuonu ilarripok enetii lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo, nejokini ninche, “Ainyoo pee eitu iyauu ninye?”

English: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.
Masaai: Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata ninye, nedoyio ninye alo Ashkelon near metuata iltung'ana tomoni uni le ina ang, neya ntokitin enye neisho nkilani lelo apa ootolimutuo oloyiote. Ore te ngoro napi neshuko alo enkaji e papaai lenye.

English: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
Masaai: Naliki lelo yarunot imbaa pooki naaitodua Olaitoriani nanu.

English: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
Masaai: Tuputunye naa nintagol ina natelekua netaa keye, amu eitu ainepu isiaaitin inono aa bayarot too nkonyek e Enkai ai.

English: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
Masaai: pee miaakuku yietuti, kake ilooduaaya lelo laa te nkirukoto enye o te ng'iriata etujung'o nkisiligat.

English: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
Masaai: Tabuaaki iyie nena ng'uesi naatii atua enarau, o ina luaata oo loing'ok natii te nebo ilasho le tung'ana. Nkirikirie tiabori nkejek inono lelo oong'uar kodi; ndapasha lelo oreren ooshipakino olarrabal.

English: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
Masaai: Ore pee enya endaa netum engolon. Nebik Saulo te nebo o lelo ooiteng'eni otii Dameski nkolong'i naaje.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, taraposhu nkonyek inono shumata ing'ura enkalo e moikuape.” Metaa ataraposhuo nkonyek aainei aitorioki moikuape, naa ng'ura, ore te moikuape e kishomi olperere lo lasar, teine nejing'ieki, netii apa enkitanyaanyukoto olom.

English: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
Masaai: ore ina ae kop pooki e Gilead o Bashan pooki, ina kitoria e Oog, aa taa, ina kop pooki e Argob aishoo nanu olpisiai oitorit Manase. Ore ina Bashan pooki naa keji enkop e Refaim.

English: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
Masaai: eisika apa Ilbeeroti aapuo Gitam netoni ninche te ine o metabaiki ena olong.)

English: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
Masaai: Etii lelo oodamu aajo aisidain ninche oleng, ee, eji kejo ninche aisidain oleng'!

English: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
Masaai: nedung Abram atua enkop o meshomo ewueji e Shekem o metabaiki eor e More. Ore ina rishata naa Lkanaan oomanya ina kop.

English: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;
Masaai: Kake etejo Esta, “Ore enkolat ai o eomonunoto ai naa;

English: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
Masaai: metaa kanangaa nanu intae aitung'uaa ena kop apik atua enkop nimiyiololo nemeyiolo apa loo papaai linyi, ore teine nitum taa aisiaayia kulie aitin dama o kewarie, amu maaisho nanu iyie omom!

English: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening' iltung'ana ina kitanapata, nekepaa ninche aaitung'uaa Israel lelo pooki loo loreren.

English: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
Masaai: Neitoki shetani arik ninye oldoinyo oado oleng, neitodol ninye nkitoriat pooki e nkop o enkitoo enye.

English: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki Tapua nelo olpolosie enkalo o loo ntoluo o metabaiki enong'oto e Kana, nelo aiting te naiposha. Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho loo le Efraim too lmareita lenye,

English: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Onam: Shamai o Yuda ore ilayiok le Shamai naa Nadab o Abishur.

English: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD'S anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana lenyena, “Maatomitiki nanu Olaitoriani pee maitaas nanu ena olkitok lai, ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput aitorioo enkaina ai agilunore ninye adolita ajo olotuputo Olaitoriani ninye.”

English: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
Masaai: Naeku etiakitia ninche ilo tung'ani modooni, “Aijo iyie aa ninye, amu kitabolo naa nkonyek?” Nejo, “Oloiboni ninye.”

English: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
Masaai: Naa ore ake te neiwuang'ieki ina atampoi te nchumata e ilo ng'obor, ore te siadi ina nedumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaidur; naa ore ake ewueji nedoiki ina atampoi neun iltung'ana loo Siraeli ilng'oborri teine.

English: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
Masaai: kake meeta intona makewan, kake eton penyo, ore pee epuonu isinaitin anaa enkinyala, enkaraki e ilo rorei nerrorro.

English: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee meish emion ai. Nemeishiunoyu olbae lai ketanya eishiunyeki? Itiu iyie te nanu anaa ereyiet nalejisho, anaa nkariak naaishiunye?

English: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
Masaai: ore ewang'an o ltaa nemeitoki ae kata awang'u ti atua iyie; ore oltoilo lo loyamisho o enayami nemeitokini ae kata aaning ti atua iyie amu ore lbiasharani linono naa ninche apa ltung'ana kituaak te nkop, netelejaki nkuapi pooki te ina sakutore ino.

English: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
Masaai: Nedumu Olaitoriani olmang'atinta metigilunore Solomon, oji Hadad le Edom. Ole nkaji enkitoo apa ninye te Edom.

English: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:
Masaai: Neitoki Boas ajoki Rusi, “Ore taata, toning'o, entito ai, milo asotisho ti ai kurma, nimilo aing'uaa ena, kake tataaniki ntoyie aainei.

English: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ashet olperere lo lasar to ldoinyo le Ebal, ashetaki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel,

English: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
Masaai: Keiro enkutuk ai ine ng'eno nagut; ore nkibirribirrat o ltau lai naa keaku eyiolounoto.

English: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?
Masaai: nejo ilkituaak le njore loo Lfilisti, “Kainyoo easita kulo Hebrania tene?” Nejoki Akish lelo kituaak le njore loo Lfilisti, “Aime Daudi ele, osinka le Saul, olaiguanani le Israel, otaa ninye te nebo nanu too nkolong'i o too larin, naa ore anaa neing'uaa ninye alotu enatii nanu eitu atum entorroni ti atua ninye o metabaiki ena olong.”

English: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
Masaai: Netamorua apa Yoshua neaku oloo larin kumok; nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Itamorua iyie nitaa oloo larin kumok, neton ake etii enkop sapuk oleng naji pee eyae.

English: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
Masaai: Etii enkoitoi nalioo to ltung'ani aa sidai, kake ore enkiting'oto enye naa enkoitoi e keeya.

English: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
Masaai: ore ewueji enkima olperere lo lasar, naa intemat ong'uan enkaina; ore epuku te wueji enkima olperere lo lasar eilep shumata naa imowuarak ong'uan entemata nabo enkaina eilep.

English: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
Masaai: Nerikuni oladuoo barnoti eishu neme kiti enkilejilejata nanoto ninche.

English: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Oi! Oi! Enkuet entung'uai ina kop e kopikop, Olaitoriani ojo; amu aidapasha intae aitalamaa anaa enatii inkaloli ong'uan enkijape e keper, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
Masaai: Anaa kainok nanu enkima tiatua olpaashe, naa keidaikie lelo sempewueti le Benhadad.”

English: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
Masaai: Nejoki Shemei olaiguanani, “Ore ina nitejo iyie naa eisidai; ore anaa enatejo olkitok lai olaiguanani, ina elo osinka lino aas.” Neaku etobiko Shimei te Yerusalem nkolong'i kumok.

English: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
Masaai: Ore esipata ino nesipa ntarasi, ore inkitanapat inono nesipa.

English: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
Masaai: Ore peyie eirriu Yuda olkuoo eyau olchore lenye le Adullam, peyie etum enaduoo kitok aishoru intokitin naata e Yuda nelotu alau ninye te naduoo wueji.

English: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
Masaai: o Shemia, o Yoiarib, o Yedaia,

English: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
Masaai: Atagore apa oleng pee aning olkiyioi lenye o kulo rorei.

English: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
Masaai: Nchoo eumata oo ltung'ana kinturrurrokino iyie, aaman; ore te shumata tipika olorika lino.

English: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
Masaai: Neosh te modoki lelo tung'ana otii boo e kutuk aji e ina ilooti o lbotoro metaa eitanaura ate eirrapurrapu enetii kutuk aji.

English: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
Masaai: kake ore ti atua entumo nayieu nairo irorei imiet loo ndamunot aainei, pee atum atuutai sii ninche lelo kulikae; alang te nairo irorei iip tomon te likae ng'ejep.

English: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
Masaai: Neshomo enkima aing'uaa entonata enye, nemut ilng'osil lenyena olng'anayio, metaa metii enetelekua te ninye teina tonata nagol, nemeetae eng'udi o laiguanani. Ore ena naa enkishirata, netaa enkishirata.

English: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
Masaai: Newaliki ilootoiutuo aajoki. “Kiyiolo aajo olayioni lang, netoiwuoki apa aa modooni;

English: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
