Masaai: Amu meetae entoki naisudoyioki neme keji ake pee eibalunyeki; nemeetae entoki natunukaki neme keji ake pee eibalayu.

English: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani oitiship ninye neisho Enkai ninye eng'eno nagut o eyioulounoto o eng'ida; kake ore olaing'okoni, neisho ninye ina siaai esotore neiturrur peyie eisho ilo oitiship Enkai. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho naa enkijape ake emirareki.

English: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa awalu, nejo, “Ng'ura, maairuk ninche nanu aashu ening enajoki, amu kejo ninche, ‘Eitu kimpang'aki iyie Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
Masaai: “Ajoki naa intae, ore pooki rorei lemeeta tipat oiro iltung'ana, eikenu kenya ake te nkolong e nkiguana.

English: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keinos oldeket enkop, ore lelo oomanya kemeyu te nkaraki enkitarruorroto enye; ore naa kepejori lelo oomanya enkop, naa ilkuti ake elekuni.

English: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
Masaai: Neitashe ilapolosak too wuejitin enye. Neitashe sii Ilawi aaiko neijia, eeta nena kinantani oo sinkolioitin, apa naaitobira olaiguanani Daudi pee eishorieki Olaitoriani enashe - amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi. Naa teneisis apa Daudi Olaitoriani te nkisiaayiare enye, ore te nda shoto neosh ilapolosak ntarumpetani; neitashe Israel pooki.

English: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
Masaai: Amu to lom lai o te ngoro ai napejisho aibalie, ore kenya te ina olong naa ketumi olokirikiri sapuk tiatua enkop e Israel;

English: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
Masaai: Talama engoro ninturraa eserserisho! mintanyamal kewan, amu entorroni ake eyau ina.

English: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
Masaai: iltung'ana laa ore nkaik enye nebore osarge, ore nkaik enye oo ntateniaa nebore ntokitin e ropare.

English: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
Masaai: nikitum taa ashomo atung'uai, ninye o nkera enyena naatii tenebo ninye, neshuko alo enetii olmarei lenye, neshuko alo enetii imasaa o loo menye.

English: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
Masaai: Neishoru Farao inkitanapat aisho iltung'ana te karaki Abram; neisho ninye meshomo, tenebo enkitok enye, o pooki toki naata.

English: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Sidai; Kaitobir nanu olning'o o iyie; kake nabo toki nanu aayieunye iyie; nchere midol iyie enkomom ai, arashu ake te niyau Mikal, entito e Saul, te nikilotu adol enkomom ai.”

English: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
Masaai: kashipa taata, neme te nkaraki naitamio intae, kake te nkaraki nayawua enkilishoto inyi enkirridunoto, iwaita ina mion inyi anaa enayieu apa Enkai, neaku meetae hoo enatalang'a intae neitu itumutumu enkaraki yiook.

English: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
Masaai: Naa keibayuni intae iltung'ana pooki te nkaraki enkarna ai. Kake ore olong'iri metabaiki enkiting'oto naa keitajeuni.

English: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
Masaai: Ore pee ejo ninye neijia, neosh obo loo larripok oitashe te mbata eseder te nkaina, nejoki, “Ai neijia ijo ti niwaliki Olapolosani Kitok?”

English: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
Masaai: Amu mikiaata iyiook enkanasa nikibikie te ne, kake ae anasa king'oru nalotu.

English: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
Masaai: Naa kaitisiny nanu ninche te ntorroni pooki oo ng'ok enye o engolong'akinoto naatogolong'akitia nanu.

English: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:
Masaai: Nejo lelo tung'ana pooki ootii kishomi, o lpayiani, “Kira iyiook ilchakenini. Meitotiuo Olaitoriani ina kitok nalotu atua enkaji ino anaa Raheli o Lea, naa ninche pokira naatesheta enkaji e Israel. Tubulu iyie te Efrata nining'oyu te Betlehem;

English: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
Masaai: Newal Elihu olayioni le Barakel le Busi ajo, “Ara nanu oti too larin, nitamorua iyie metaa kaata duoo nanu enkuretisho aibalunye enduaata ai te iyie

English: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
Masaai: Ore tenebau ina olong, naa keitajeu Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena. Amu ore ninche naa intare oo ltung'ana lenyena. Naa kewang'u ninche te nkop enye anaa enawang isoito ooripakino enkopiyia.

English: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
Masaai: o Kiriataim, o Betagam, o Betmeon,

English: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
Masaai: Kake etii apa iltung'ana tomon atua ninche ootiaakitia Ishmael, “Miar iyie iyiook matuatua, amu kiata ilchumat le nkano, o eilata, o enaisho oo lotorok eisudoro ti ong'ata.” Neaku etoning'o ninye neitu ear ninche metuata tenebo lelo apa le ncholuek enye.

English: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo kitok loo sikarini oorripito Yesu o lelo ootii te nebo ninye, pee edol eikirikire enkop o kulie baa naatotiwuo, neureishoyu oleng ejo, “Esipa Enkerai e Nkai ele tung'ani.”

English: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Masaai: Nejoki Yohana lelo ororani ooetuo enetii ninye meibatisa, “Na ishoi oo lasuriaa! Ae ng'ae naikoo intae eng'atai engoro nalotu?

English: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.
Masaai: Naa intanapa iyie lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua, nchere, ‘Ore pee ipuonunu aabaiki emurt e nkare e Yordan nintasheshe intae aaitirring'a te Yordan.’ ”

English: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
Masaai: Naa ore pee eibukori osarge le Stefano olchakeni lino, aitashe sii nanu atonyorrayie, naa nanu oitasheikio nkilani e lelo ootara.’

English: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
Masaai: Ashomo apa nanu abore, naatorrinyuo nanu Olaitoriani arok. Kainyoo pee kimpotipoto nanu aajo Naomi, aaisilisilo nanu Olaitoriani neyaua Olmagilani entaboi shumata nanu?”

English: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
Masaai: Itoning'okito ate emoroto namor Enkai. Ijojo aa?” Nedung'oki pooki enkiguana aajo keishiakino keeya.

English: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
Masaai: Ore ine wueji neisuma ilo tung'ani too lkigerot naa ewueji nejo, “Etorikoki anaa olkuoo le ker opuoi aayieng; anaa enoshi ker nemebol enkutuk edung'i ilpapit, eitu sii ninye ebol enkutuk enye.

English: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
Masaai: Ore osoit naa keiroishi, ore sii osinyai neiroshi, kake ore engoro olmodai neiroshi alang pokira.

English: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ainyoo pee king'oruru? Aimiyiololo aajo eishiaakino tenatii enkaji e Papa?”

English: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
Masaai: Ekelaki te lulung'ata eng'or enkata enye, ore olng'osila lenye nemenyoriju.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nipuopuo aalang olkeju le Yordan aapuo enkop e Kanaan,

English: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
Masaai: Ore enkaji eabori naa ntemat imiet e nkaina endapasho, ore enkaji e polos naa ntemat ile e nkaina endapasho, ore enkaji e uni te shumata naa ntemat e nkaina naapishana endapasho. Ore te manaroto eina aji neitodorropu isunta pee meibung ake nena rishinani isunta e ina aji.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yosia, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi; naa Yeshua o Binui o Kadmiel, o Sherebia, o Yuda, o Matania, laa ore tenebo ilalashera lenyena, naa ninye oitasheiki isinkolioitin le nkishooroto e nashe.

English: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
Masaai: naa Shefa olasirani; naa Sadok o Abiata apa ilapolosak;

English: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
Masaai: “Neirriwaa Darias ena walata; ejo, Ore taata Tetanai, olbalusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, o Shetar-bosenai, o lelo le ncholuek ino, lelo balusuni ootii olkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, entalamari;

English: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kaayau iyie apik enkiting'oto torrono, nimintoki aekata atii; hoo naa aiking'oruni iyie, kake mikintokini ae kata aatum aaigil, ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai.”

English: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
Masaai: “Shomo inosai tening'oto e Yerusalem ena natejo Olaitoriani, adamu nanu eseremata e kitisho ino, enyorrata ino anaa esiankiki narikori, ina kata kisujita nanu tiong'ota, tiatua ina kop neitu eunishoreki.

English: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
Masaai: Kake eitu eng'amaa Kain tenebo enkishooroto enye. Negoro Kain nesot enkomom oleng.

English: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
Masaai: Eishir ninche teidie, mewaliki ninye ninche, te nkaraki ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana torrok.

English: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
Masaai: Neeta apa Bela ilayiok: Adar, o Gera o Abihab,

English: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
Masaai: Amu itaara iltauja loo supati te monkoi, hoo neitu nanu aar ninye oltau, nintagolo ilo torrono, nemeibelekenya ninye aing'uaa enkoitoi enye e ntorroni pee eitajeu enkishui enye;

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;

English: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
Masaai: Neitanapisho meitasheyieki engarri; nedoyio pokira aare aapuo enkare, Filipo o ilo sunash, neibatisae ninye.

English: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
Masaai: Ore engoro o lmodai neibala asioki, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en nemeshilaa emoroto.

English: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki laaiba nanu neing'oming'om te nebo aaimaki nanu; nemusu ninche ntorrok ti alo nanu.

English: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
Masaai: te ina oitoi ng'ejuk naishu nataboloko ninye iyiook te ilo karasha, aa taa to sesen lenye,

English: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
Masaai: Nejo, “Aainyo, kaa torroni etaasa ninye?” Neitoki aaitulusoo aabuak aajo, “Inchoo metashei.”

English: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
Masaai: Ore amu eitu idamu nena olong'i e kitisho ino, kake kintagoro nanu oleng te kuna tokitin pooki; neaku ng'ura, kaitalaku sii nanu inkiaasin inono te shumata endukuya ino, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Keitu doi ias eloloito aitushulaki olminong lino pooki?

English: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
Masaai: o Hilen tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Debir tenebo ndaat enyena, oo nchoo,

English: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ekaitaa intae endapidapoi nasipa nemetii toki; iakuku intae ewueji neisalaashieki irresheta; nemeitokini aekata aashet intae; amu nanu Olaitoriani oiroro, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani intae iloo menisho, intae lelo ooitore kulo tung'ana le Yerusalem!

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Dan nkalifuni ntomoni ile o are o iip naapishana.

English: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
Masaai: o nena kitobirat pooki naata to ltau, tenkaraki ilgorieti le nkaji o Laitoriani, o lgilat pooki oomanita, o wuejitin pooki neeshumishoreki e nkaji e Nkai, o eneshumieki nkishorot naaitisinyaki;

English: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo te nebo enkishui inyi, ilalashera laainei. Esai.

English: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
Masaai: o Siklag, o Madmana, o Sansana,

English: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
Masaai: Enkiyang'et kewan naishakenu te nebo enkiyang'et ang nchere kira nkera e Nkai,

English: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
Masaai: Neisarrisar Yosef amu etayiewua oltau lenye olalashe lenye te nkirimo sapuk, nelo aing'oru ewueji nelo aishirie. Nejing atua olgilata, nelo aishir teine.

English: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
Masaai: “Naa nanu sii oibooyie enchan meshaiki intae eton eng'or ilapaitin okuni le nkisampuare nairriwaki; nanu enchan shumata e nkanasa nabo napal enkae anasa atashaikia ewueji nebo ore ewueji neitu eshaiki netoyu;

English: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
Masaai: Enkaraki kuna pee kintanyamal ate nikinyok, amu Enkai naishu kitipika osiligi lang naa ninye Olaitajeunoni le pooki tung'ani neisulaki lelo ooiruk.

English: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
Masaai: Kake to loirrag le nkare nadooyo eishie ninye tukul ilmang'ati lenyena, nemir ilmang'ati lenyena amiraki enaimin.

English: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
Masaai: Tenairo naa kairo napaji too lng'ejepa loo ltung'ana anaa too loo lmalaika, kake nemaata enyorrata natotiwuo ana esekenkei naru anaa empilbil nadar.

English: And she shall put the raiment of her captivity from off her, and shall remain in thine house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month: and after that thou shalt go in unto her, and be her husband, and she shall be thy wife.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilkilani lenyena ooishopito pee eyaruni neton tiatua enkaji ino neishiraki menye o ng'otonye olapa olulung'a; ore te siadi naa indim ashomo atayiolo ninye, niaku olpayian lenye neaku ninye enkitok ino.

English: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.
Masaai: pee itumutumu aatayiolo enkoitoi niimiimi, amu eitu ae kata iimiimi ena oitoi. Kake enchoo ejing erishata intae o ilo sanduku, erishata naba anaa intemat e nkaina inkalifuni are; emipuonunu intae aanyikaki ninye.”

English: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Aimejing'aa sii ninche intae? Aimidolidolo aajo ore pooki toki natii oriong oltung'ani, te nejing nemeidim aitarruoi;

English: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
Masaai: Nekurtu ninye nkonyek e Sedekia neen ninye too lpisia, neya olaiguanani le Babilon ninye Babilon, nepik ninye korokoroni ometabaiki enkolong enkeeya enye.

English: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
Masaai: Kake ore ilalashera laainei apa ooshomo te nebo nanu neitalepoo oltau loo ltung'ana, ore eyia naiting'ie nanu asuj Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
Masaai: Nelotu enkaji e Nkai, erikito Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninye: ore pee eyaki intoiwuo enkerai Yesu meitaasa anaa entipat oo nkitanapat e Musa,

English: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
Masaai: Nejoki lkulikae loo Lfarisayo, “Kaji etiu pee iasiasa enemeishoruno too nkitanapat ang te nkolong e sabato?”

English: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, nebau enaurate Yordan; neyeng'iyeng'a ninye te ine.

English: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
Masaai: Ijojo, “Keishoruno ntokitin pooki,” ee, kake mme pooki toki naretisho. Nijojo, “Keishoruno ntokitin pooki,” kake mme pooki toki nashetisho.

English: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
Masaai: Eng'uarrisho iltorrok endama pooki, kake ore isupati keishooyo nememit.

English: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye ilapaitin okuni, nelikini Yuda aajoki, “Ore Tamar enkitok o layioni lino, etaa emulayoi, ore ake sii eiroishi te nkerai e mulayaisho.” Nejo Yuda, “Entoriku entupuku boo peyie kipuo aapejoo ninye.”

English: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
Masaai: Ore Amasa neirrag akurro tiaatua o sarge lenye te mpolos enkoitoi. Ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo, nedol ninye, neitashe; ore pee edol ilo tung'ani ajo eitasheito iltung'ana pooki, nenap ninye Amasa aitung'uaa enkoitoi apik ong'ata, nenang'aki enkila shumata ninye.

English: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni, neraposhu Abraham inkonyek nedol ewueji nelakua.

English: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.
Masaai: neiwuang'ie Isiraeli nkaitin naaji baal o Astorot, neisiaai ninche Olaitoriani ake.

English: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
Masaai: Natorikoko ilooiteng'eni linono, neitu eidim aaishiunye.”

English: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
Masaai: Naikilikuanu naa ajo, keidipa ninye Enkai atanya ltung'ana lenyena? Mme neijia pae! ara nanu makewan Osiraeli, ole ishoi e Abraham, ole ntalipa o losho le Benchamen.

English: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
Masaai: Nejoki Agripa Paulo, “Ijo sa eikintaa olkiristianoi te nkiti kata.”

English: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
Masaai: nejo, “Metalakuana te nanu, Olaitoriani, tenaa kaas nanu ena. Kaok nanu osarge loo ltung'ana ooshomo te mbatisho e nkishui enye?” Neaku meok ninye. Kuna baa etaasa lelo tung'ana okuni magil.

English: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
Masaai: Ore eseremare sidai nemeeta entiyoto te nkomom e Enkai, Papa, naa ena: embaikinoto oo ltung'ana okishin o nkolia, ti atua isinaitin lenye nerrip kewan pee metum entibili te nkop.

English: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
Masaai: Neitadoiki olapolosani olkimojino lenye atua ilo sarge neisuaaki katitin naapishana dukuya Olaitoriani tioriong olkarasha le wueji sinyati.

English: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
Masaai: Neya Esau inkituaak enyena o layiok lenyena, o ntoyie enyena o ltung'ana pooki lo lmarei lenye, o nkishu enyena, o ng'uesi pooki enyena, o ntokitin enyena pooki e tipat naanoto te nkop e Kanaan; nelo enkop nalakua alam olalashe lenye Yakobo.

English: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai enkop ajo etarruoyie oleng. Amu ore iseseni pooki neitarruoitie inkoitoi enye te nkop.

English: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
Masaai: Kake teneibulayie ilo pepedoi osesen eidipaki aaisuja ninye,

English: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
Masaai: Ore sii eetuo ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani aaisho enashe olkitok lang Daudi ejo, ‘Eishoo Enkai ino enkarna e Solomon metoning'oyu alang enkarna ino, neitaa olorika lenye le nkitoo kitok alang olino.’ Neirrugo olaiguanani te ndapash.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Aime neijia etiu.” Ore oltung'ani oar Kain metua, neitamei ninye kat naapishana. Nepik Olaitoriani olmishire Kain peyie ore oloinepu ninye nemear metua.

English: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.
Masaai: neponari Saul aureyu Daudi oleng. Neaku etaa apa Saul olmang'atinta le Daudi anaake.

English: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
Masaai: Enchom taata ine wueji ai apa netii shilo, naa ine aishoo enkarna ai metobikie te dukuya; pee idolidolo enaitaasa ninye te ntorroni oo ltung'ana laainei Israel.

English: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli aas ina; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa o Aron neiko neijia.

English: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
Masaai: Ore te kulo arin tikitam natotona te nkaji ino; naataasaka esiaai ilarin tomon oong'uan te nkaraki intoyie inono pokira are, naataasaka esiaai ilarin ile too ntare inono, nimbelekenya olekoisiaayio lai katitin tomon.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani nerubare ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli. Eitu ninye eing'uaa nena ng'ok.

English: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
Masaai: Meiputa endaa enkop; nchoo meipiripiro ninye te nchumata oldoinyo; metotiutu ilng'anayio lenyena anaa Lebanon; naa nchoo ebul iltung'ana too nkanas aabayu anaa nkujit e ong'ata.

English: Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:
Masaai: Ore enkitok o laiguanani, te nkaraki irorei lo laiguanani o lelo kituaak lenyena, nelotu olgilata oitoomonishoreki, nejo ina kitok olaiguanani, “La aiguanani, tobiko ntarasi! Mincho ndamunotinono kintanyamal aashu emua ino eibelekenya.

English: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
Masaai: Ororei ele oing'uaa Olaitoriani oipirta Moab too nkolong'i naatulusoitie.

English: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
Masaai: Neitoki Amos awaliki Amasia ejo, “Mara nanu oloiboni le Nkai nemara olayioni lo loiboni, kake kara olairritani o laitobirani loo lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo,

English: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
Masaai: Earare ilang'orok loo mbaa ninye te ng'olon, neng'or ninye, neitagor ninye oleng;

English: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Meitisinya intae tukul Enkai e siriani makewan, ore Enkiyang'et inyi o ltau o sesen, metaa biyoto meeta entibili o metaa enkata e lotunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Kake ajoki intae too sipat nchere etii kulo ooitashe te ne ilemeishamisham enkeeya katukul, eitu eng'as aadol enkitoria e Nkai.”

English: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,
Masaai: Ore te siadi nelotu Daniel dukuya nanu - ilo apa oji enkarna Belteshasa aaipotie enkai ai, naa atua ninye etii enkiyang'et oo nkaitin sinyat naliki nanu ninye ina kidetidet, ajoki,

English: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
Masaai: Ilo supat olo ajung enkop, nemany ina kop ntarasi.

English: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomenaa inkitanapat neisis lelo torrok, kake ore lelo ooibung inkitanapat nearare ninche.

English: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
Masaai: ‘Nchooki nanu maimai atua enkop ino; enkoitoi ake aim nanu, nemaiwuang nanu alo enkaina e tatene aashu ene kedienye.

English: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
Masaai: Mikitawaliki Olaitoriani iyie te nkolong e nyamali! Mikitorripo enkarna e Nkai e Yakobo!

English: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
Masaai: O ira le Itiri, o Gareb le Itiri,

English: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
Masaai: Nebik inkolong'i kumok te Yopa te nkaji e Simon, olaitobirani loo lonito.

English: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye ewueji neidong'ishoreki neas anaa enaitanapa enkaputani ninye.

English: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
Masaai: Luka ake openy laaboitare. Ing'oru Marko pee ishoru, amu kaaretu oleng te siaai.

English: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
Masaai: Neitoki ina kitok ajo, “Kaing'ae aayaki ailepakinye?” Nejo ninye, “Iyau ilepakinyeki nanu Samuel.”

English: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
Masaai: Ore te ina olong' nepuonu Isadukayo, lelo oojo meetae empiunoto, neikilikuan aajoki,

English: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enataa Yona embae enking'asia too ltung'ana le Ninawi, neijia sii etiu Enkerai e Tung'ani too ltung'ana le na kata.

English: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
Masaai: Eroroki oltung'ani le mudong lang oji Herodion. Eroroki lootii atua Olaitoriani le nkaji e Nakirso.

English: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee etonie Yehoram olorika le nkitoo le papaai lenye, nebul, near ilalashera lenyena pooki metuata to lalem, tenebo sii kulikae tung'ana kituaak le Israel.

English: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
Masaai: kake te ngolong'akinoto etusujaitie iltauja lenye maate neshomo aasujaa nena Baali, anaa enaiteng'ena loo menye ninche.

English: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
Masaai: Nayiolou nanu aitisip, nadol ajo eitu eirriu Enkai ninche, kake eibalunye ninye enaibon pee aagilunore nanu, enkaraki naigero Tobia o Sanbalat ninye.

English: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
Masaai: Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa iyie otem olasipani kaing'ae odol oltau o ndamunot, nchooki nanu matoduaa elap ino te shumata ninche, amu iyie nanu atipika mbaa aainei.

English: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu ninche metoini nemaretu? Olaitoriani ojo, Amaa, nanu ilo oretu kaiken eng'uset? Enkai ino najo.

English: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat, o ing'apeta enyena tenebo ilgorieti lenyena naa erisiori o lkulikae; netii atua ilusien naamanita tiatua tenebo olgoriet lenye ore enkadori enye naa intemat enkaina onom, ore endapasho enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet.

English: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilasirak lo Lfarisayo eng'arie ninye endaa looata ng'ok o lasotok le kodi, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Kaji etiu pee eng'arie ninye ilasotok le kodi o looata ng'ok endaa?”

English: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
Masaai: Eima enkoitoi inyi iloomanya Shafir, te masipaisho o te nkurruna; mepuonu lelo oomanya Saanan emipuonu aaipang'u; Ore enkishirata e Betesel naa kaiwuang'ie te iyie enkitashoto enye.

English: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
Masaai: ine neshomo Yesu aituruk te nkaraki iyiook, eidipa ninye ataa olapolosani kitok intarasi to lkerreti le Melkisedek.

English: Now the LORD hath brought it, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
Masaai: eyaua Olaitoriani, netaasa ninye anaa enatejo. Enkaraki nitaasa iyie eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani, neitu ining oltoilo lenye, pee eewuo ena toki shumata iyie,

English: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa oimiet Yehoiakim pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Sebida entito e Pedaia.

English: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
Masaai: Nikindaikie iyiook ninche katukul anaa apa enikinkuna Sihon, ilo aiguanani le Heshbon, aaidaikie pooki anasa, ilewa, o nkituaak o nkera.

English: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naipirutua Siria, te nebo Efraim entorroni te nebo olayioni le Remalia, ejo,

English: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.
Masaai: Ore tioriong ilo goriet tenkalo najing'ieki e kishomi moikuape, netii imisai are, ore te nkae alo eilo goriet eina kishomi netii imisai are.

English: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oota olwuasa le nkitokoos naa olminong' to Laitoriani; tayiolo miata olng'ash, esipa tayiolo, melo ninye eitu eitamei.

English: And then the LORD'S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
Masaai: ore engoro o Laitoriani neyupuyup tialo intae, neiken ninye shumata, ometaa meetae enchan, nemeiu enkop ilng'anayio, nindaayaya nabo kata aaishunye teina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani.

English: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
Masaai: Etooro ninye enaiposha neisho ninche meima atua, neisho enkare meturupayu anaa olkiu.

English: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
Masaai: Neitoki Samuel adumu osoit neirragie te rishata e Mispa o Yeshana, nejo enkarna enye Ebenesa; amu etejo ninye, “Ore otene etareto iyiook Olaitoriani.”

English: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie aaku entoki naimakini, endung'et e rashe, o entoki naimakini tiatua iloreren pooki teine nereu intae Olaitoriani.

English: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
Masaai: Nesotu ninche anaake tadekenya, oltung'ani ake anaa enaidim ainosa, kake ore ake pee eirowuaju enkolong neshola.

English: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
Masaai: Amu amaa te na keewuo olkilikuai apa otolimutuo ilmalaika neaku ore engilata enye aashu eanyata netum enkitamioto,

English: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
Masaai: Kake eewuo enkitok enye Yesebel enetii ninye nejoki, “Kainyoo pee eeta oltau lino osina eji neaku minos endaa?”

English: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
Masaai: Eiroro apa Enkai; atoning'o nanu ena katitin are, nchere Enkai eing'uaa engolon,

English: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
Masaai: Nejo to oltoilo sapuk, “Entureita Enkai ninchosho ninye enkisisa. Amu eewuo e nkiguana enye. Enteserem ilo oitobira shumata o enkop, o enaiposha o nchorroi oo nkariak.”

English: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
Masaai: Kake etejo Farao, “Kaing'ae Olaitoriani, laidim nanu atoning'o oltoilo lenye naisho Isiraeli epuo.”

English: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
Masaai: nchooki nanu matoning'o enajo Olaitoriani Enkai, amu keiro ninye eseriani too ltung'ana lenyena, too sinyat lenyena o te lelo ooibelekenyakino ninye too ltauja lenye.

English: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name's sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.
Masaai: Amu meiturraa Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, te nkaraki enkarna enye kitok, amu eitisipa Olaitoriani pee eitaa intae iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, te neitu eini oltung'ani te nkare o te Nkiyang'et, nemeidim atijing'a Enkitoria e Nkai.

English: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
Masaai: Neaku ore naa anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa tukul, ore amu isarkionie ewueji ai sinyati too ntokitin pooki torrok o siaaitin inyi pooki torrok, neaku kadung'oo intae, meleku enkong'u ai nemaata nanu olng'ur.

English: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Iwa nena baa.” Neya olaiguanani nena baa. Nejoki ninye ilo aiguanani le Israel, “Tooshie nena baa enkop;” neoshie ninye enkop katitin uni, neitirring'a.

English: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
Masaai: Te nkirukoto etobiko aa omoni te ina kop naisiligieki, anaa te neeiking'a naa ilng'oborri emany o Isaak o Yakobo, oora sii ninche ilajung'ok le ina kisiligata te nebo ninye.

English: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie pee kimpoti, totona te wueji nebayie tukul, paa te nelotu ilo oitoomonisho nikijoki, ‘Olchore, ilepa sii iyie;’ nikiyanyitu esiamo pooki niboitare te mesa.

English: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
Masaai: Kake te naa olkilikuai le Nkai elikioo pooki ng'ae nelotu oltung'ani ake duoo aashu ejing'u oleitu eiruk, ore embae pooki naning neputu metadamisho naleng.

English: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
Masaai: Nejur ilo apolosani ine netii olpepedoi olchoni to sesen lenye, naa teneibelekenyate ilpapit leine wueji netii olpepedoi lenye, aaiborru, nelioyu ina muoyian etugumo to sesen lenye, naa enkeeya oo lbolot ina, ore pee eidip olapolosani atujurro ninye, neibalunye ninye ajo oloiduruk.

English: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yoram etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Ahasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Tijing'u, olomayiana lo Laitoriani, ainyoo peyie intashe tiauluo: naidipa aitobira enkaji o ewueji oo ntamesin.”

English: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
Masaai: o Siklag, o Bet-markabot, o Hasar-susa,

English: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
Masaai: Ore Enkai e Abraham, oe Nkai e Nahor oe Nkai oo papaai lenye inchoo metirisha iyiook.” Ina peyie einos Yakobo olmumai te uriata e papaai lenye, Isaak.

English: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
Masaai: Etarresho apa Yehu olayioni le Yehoshafat olayioni le Nimshi pee ear Yoram metua. Ore apa Yoram o Siraeli pooki, nerripisho ninche te Ramot-Gilead te nkaraki Hasael olaiguanani le Siria;

English: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
Masaai: Te naa napaji ilasujak loo nkitanapat oaku ilajung'ok, pesho naa enkirukoto naa pesho ina kisiligata.

English: But ye have not so learned Christ;
Masaai: Neme nena eiteng'enieki intae ti atua Kristo!

English: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
Masaai: Neigany enkaji e Enkai empuruo eing'uaa enkitoo e Enkai neing'uaa engolon enye. Nemeetae hoo obo oidima atijing'a atua ina aji e Enkai o metaba anaa nelusoo lelo meita oopishana le lelo malaika oopishana.

English: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
Masaai: neisis Enkai, neshipakino iltung'ana pooki ninche. Neponaa Olaitoriani ilo turrur lenye anaa ake te lelo ooitajeuni.

English: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
Masaai: Ira iyie entito e yieyio lino, ina naiba olpayian lenye o nkera enyena; nira enkanashe oo nkanashera inono, nena naaiba ilpayiani lenye oo nkera enye, ore apa yieyio lino naa e Hiti ore papaailino naa Olamori.

English: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
Masaai: Etii oltoilo le ndarata ino atua oleimua; ore nkiwuang'at inono neitawang enkop; neikirikira enkop, neigirigiro.

English: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
Masaai: Ore pee abaiki ninche enkaji e ilo oitore enkaji e ntumo, nedol olorere o ltung'ana ooishirita oobuaku aaishir oleng.

English: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keng'ida oltau lai, neshipa enkishui ai; neton sii osesen lai te seriani.

English: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
Masaai: Tejo tiatua iloshon, “Olaitoriani oitoreisho! Ee, eitasheyieki enkop, nemeigusugusieki ae kata; kelo ninye aiguanare iloshon te sipata.”

English: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong neipotu Olaitoriani loo lororani olkiyioi o enkishirata, nebarni iltung'ana te nkaraki osina neishop ilkuniyiani;

English: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
Masaai: nereu ilng'osil lenyena aitabaiki enaiposha, neitabaiki ntona enyena olkeju.

English: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
Masaai: Ore to ltoilo le nkishirata lo lkiyioi loo larewak linono le meli ore nkuapi naamanita neikirikira,

English: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
Masaai: Ing'ura, ore inapa pisai nikinotito too nkutukie oo lbenia lang, kitushukutuo aashukoki iyie king'ua enkop e Kanaan; kaji naa kinko siake tinikipurroo enkosholai arashu sahabu te nkaji olkitok lino?

English: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
Masaai: Etoorote apa iltung'ana loo Siraeli katitin are: etusujaitie olpisiaai loo ltung'ana Tibni olayioni le Ginat aaitaa olaiguanani. Etusujaitie olikae pisiaai Omori.

English: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
Masaai: Pee etumi aatopon inkolong'i inono o nkolong'i oo nkera inono teina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho ninche, anaa enatii keper shumata enkop.

English: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
Masaai: Kake etejo ti alo Oinoti lenye, “Ore olorika lino, iyie Enkai naa oloo ntarasi o ntarasi orinka le supatisho ilo rinka le nkitoria ino.

English: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
Masaai: Yaareshia o Eliya o Sikri, naa ilayiok le Yeroham.

English: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaitobir enchili e sahabu nasila e ilo marisian sinyati nesiraki ninye enkarna anaa enkarna nataguetakaki to lmishire, “Sinyati to Laitoriani.”

English: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
Masaai: Eikipuonu nena tuaan aaked iyie, o ltung'ana linono o sinkan linono.” ’ ”

English: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
Masaai: Naarik ninye nanu enkalo e kopikop, naa ng'ura, etii apa enkishomi enkalo e kopikop; netem ninye ing'apeta enyena tenebo ilgilat lenyena; neeta apa pooki erisiori nabo anaa ilkulikae.

English: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
Masaai: Nekuet nabo kata obo le lelo nepik osuguroi enaisho naisuijo oo sabibu neremoki eng'udi naado neisho metooko.

English: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile taasisho, nias isiaaitin inono pooki;

English: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.
Masaai: Naiko doi neijia te Yerusalem; neme taa kaikenoyie ake lelo sinyat kumok te korokoroni, ekaaishoo lapolosak kituaak enkidimata, ore ninye pee eari metuata katii esiana e lelo ooyiewuaki ina.

English: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
Masaai: Neibelekenya apa Yoshua te ina kata, neya Hasor, nesesekuan olaiguanani lenye to lalem; amu ore Hasor li apa naa ninye endukuya e nena kitoriat pooki.

English: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
Masaai: Neirorie Daudi Olaitoriani irorei lele sinkolio ina olong natalakua ninye Olaitoriani aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena pooki, neitung'uaa enkaina e Saul.

English: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
Masaai: Idie etii enaiposha, naa kitok nelala, neuma ntokitin ti atua nemeikenayu ntokitin naaishu sapuki o nkutiti.

English: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong naitasheiyie nanu enkaji e Daudi apa naturori naitobir nanu ineetarruoitie, nashumu nanu ineeturori, naitoki nanu ashet metotiuo anaa apa.

English: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
Masaai: Amu ainyoo dupoto o ltung'ani tenetum enkop pooki neiturra enkishui enye.

English: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli tomon, nabore enkorropil;

English: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
Masaai: Ore peyie eyooki Yosef ninche enasirie, nedol ninche, nenyorriki ajo kenyamal oleng pokira.

English: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Masaai: Metaa ira iyie kitok, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai; amu metii likae oikununo anaa iyie, nemetii ae Ai neme iyie ake, te risioroto e nena pooki nikitoning'o too nkiyiaa ang.

English: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.
Masaai: Nintoomon Yese meeu olasar, naa kaaitadol eniaas; nibukoki iyie eilata aput ilo laaipotoki enkarna enye.”

English: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: “Neaku iorioro ena kop tiatua intae te risioroto oo loshon le Israel.

English: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tomon oo nguan o lapa le dukuya, neibung lelo apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto pasaka.

English: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
Masaai: Iyie nanu Olaitoriani aishiraka, naa Olaitoriani ayaka enkomono ai;

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu enaisho naisuisho oo sabibu too lala, anaa empuruo too nkonyek, nejia sii etiu oltashalai te lelo ooirriwaa ninye.

English: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Ore nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan e kulo, ninche ooitasheiki esiaai e nkaji Olaitoriani, ore nkalifuni ile neaku ilkituaak o larishak.

English: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
Masaai: Naing'oru oltung'ani tiatua ninche olo ashet ina suntai neitashe teina lusie e suntai te dukuya nanu tenkaraki ina kop, peyie matum aidaikie ninye; kake eitu atum hoo obo.

English: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli: ‘Tiaki ilo tung'ani likirriwua enatii,

English: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
Masaai: Neya olaiguanani ilayiok oare le Rispa entito e Aia apa naa ninye etoikio Saul, Armon o Mefiboshet; o layiok imiet le Merab entito e Saul laa ninche etoikio Adriel olayioni le Barsilai ilo Meholati;

English: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.
Masaai: Nenap isinkan lenyena ninye etua te ngarri oo mbartan te Megido neyau ninye Yerusalem, nenukaa ninye te nkurare enye makewan. Neyau iltung'ana leina kop Yehoahas, olayioni le Yosia, nebukoki ninye eilata aaput, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eing'or ilo Filisti, nedol Daudi; nemenaa ninye, amu olbarnoti apa ninye onyokie neikishiaan te nking'urata.

English: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
Masaai: Mijo ake, “Ainyoo apa pee eikash inkolong'i naatulusoitie te kuna?” Amu ime te ng'eno inkilikuanu ena.

English: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ilo orere Yesu, neing'asia oleng, nekuetiki aairoroki.

English: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
Masaai: Amu kang'aashana aaitirrishita oleng nkaloli pokira are. Ore eyieunoto ai naa pee aiwuang'a to sesen naaku te nebo Kristo, amu ina esidai oleng.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore amu itoosho inkaik inyi nioshieshie inkejek inyi enkop nishipapa te nkaraki intorrok pooki naatii atua intae te nkaraki enkop e Israel,

English: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.
Masaai: Ore naa, mincho osarge lai ebukokino enkop te nelakuaniki ine netii Olaitoriani; amu eipang'ua olaiguanani le Israel alotu aing'oru enkishui ai, anaa oltung'ani orresh enkurle too ldoinyo.”

English: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
Masaai: Naa te neleku iltung'ana tomon te nkaji nabo neye ninche.

English: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
Masaai: Neiro Paulo o Barnaba aashirraki, nejo, “Keishiaakino naa intae eiteraki aaliki ororei le Nkai. Kake ore amu itanang'aitie, nitoduaa oopeny nchere meishiaakino intae enkishui nemeish, ng'ura, kipuo iyiook enetii Loreren.

English: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
Masaai: iyiololo aajo to Laitoriani itumutumu enjung'ore anaa olekoisiaayio linyi; Olaitoriani Kristo isiaaitata.

English: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
Masaai: “Teneyau ninye olkuoo le ker metaa enkishoroto enye o lasar le ng'oki, nchoo ninye eyau esupen nemeeta entioto,

English: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibooyo irorei lenyena eeta eng'eno, ore ilo oota oltau obor naa oltung'ani oota ening'unoto.

English: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
Masaai: Ore ake ina kewarie nedumunye ninye arik inkituaak enyena pokira are, o nkaisiaayiak enyena pokira are tenebo inkera enyena tomon oobo nelang te lang'ata e Yabok.

English: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee, which are not of the cities of these nations.
Masaai: Neijia shomo nkuna te nena anas pooki naalakua oleng te iyie, te nena neme nkanas e kulo oshon tene.

English: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
Masaai: Kakua kulo oopuo tiaai anaa enkatampoi, netiu anaa nturkuluni eim ilusien enye?

English: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
Masaai: Eikitok Olaitoriani te Sion; etii ninye shumata iloreren pooki.

English: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: ore intoyie enyena naatii enkop natoyio naa keyieng'i to lalem. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: kake ore lelo laa ninche naaji ile ina kitoria nenang'akini atua enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.”

English: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
Masaai: Kake keng'or Enkai ninche te mbae enye, nepiki ninche ilbaa nabo kata.

English: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
Masaai: Nchoo meting'idata loshon nerany te ng'ida, amu nguanare iyie te nkaraki entorroni nirikoo iloshon ootii oriong enkop.

English: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.
Masaai: Etediaaki intae to ldeket, amu kipurritoto intae nanu, intae olosho pooki.

English: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
Masaai: Netii ilusien enchoto e ilo gilata too nkaloli pokira, neikodoki nena sunta too lkeek loltukai.

English: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.
Masaai: Kerrumoo ninche arriny siadi Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te dukuya intae nereu ninche aiwuang'ie too nkonyek inyi; naa iyaya intae enkop enye anaa apa enaisiligie intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Naaman ajo, “Teniming'amaa, aatoomono naa, nchoo naa meishori osinka lino inyumpui are naanap ilolan, amu ore ebaiki ena olong', meigil osinka lino aitayu olasar opejori, anaa olasar liae ai meteleku ake Olaitoriani.

English: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
Masaai: “Mintokiki ae kata aaisho iltung'ana olkujita oitayunye ilmatofali anaa oshi eninkoko; enchoo ninche epuo aasotu olkujita maate.

English: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
Masaai: misujaa iyie ninye nimimbung ninye, nimincho meing'urrie ninye, nimipal iyie ninye nimimitu iyie ninye

English: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
Masaai: Etii ilchoreta oitaakuno ilchoreta, kake etii olchore likimbung'are anyikaki alang olalashe.

English: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
Masaai: Kake ore taata nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo likintayio iyie Yakobo, ilo likintobirua Israel: “Miureishoyu amu aatokordua nanu iyie, Aaipotuo nanu iyie te nkarna ai, ira iyie olalai.

English: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
Masaai: Kake etaasate kuna pooki pee ebaya ilkigerot loo loibonok le Nkai. Neilanyisho ina kata ilooiteng'eni pooki aaing'uaa.

English: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
Masaai: Ore sii apa enkaji e Yosef neilep aapuo aarare Betel; netii Olaitoriani te nebo ninche.

English: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
Masaai: Neiperra aaku are olkarasha oor enkaji e Nkai, eiteru te shumata o meiting'o ti abori.

English: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoiakim o nena tokitin o ilo minong otaasa ninye, o mbaa torrok naaipirta ninye, ng'ura eigeroki tiatua embuku oo laiguanak le Israel o le Yuda. Neitoreisho Yehoiakin olayioni lenye terishata enye.

English: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.
Masaai: Neitubulu Hadasa, aa taa Esta, entito o lenkapu lenye amu meeta apa menye aashu ng'otonye. Entito apa ninye sidai naa supat, ore ake pee eye menye o ng'otonye, neya Mordekai netiu anaa enkerai enye keon.

English: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

English: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

English: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

English: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

English: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

English: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.

English: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

English: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

English: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

English: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
Masaai: Amu ore ena kisiligata eninyi apa o nkera inyi, o lelo pooki oolakua lelo pooki ooipotoki Enkai kewan.”

English: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
