English: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
Masaai: Kake maata likae kipaaret laatoduaa meteleku Yakobo, olalashe Olaitoriani.

English: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
Masaai: Ti nimining'ining'i, tinimipikipiki atua iltauja ninchosho enkitoo enkarna ai, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, kaae nairriu oldeket shumata intae nadek sii imayianat inyi. Nesipa ajo aidipa nanu atediaa ninche, enkaraki mipikitata ntae ltauja linyi.

English: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
Masaai: Neitu adol enkaji e Enkai te ina anasa amu ore enkaji enye naa Olaitoriani Enkai Magilani, o Lkuoo le Ker.

English: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
Masaai: Aaishoo iyie enkiok ai, nemetii hoo nabo neitu ewalu Yoab, arashu olotawalua irorei lenyena te ntae.

English: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Neasisho ninche, neiwuang'ie ilperereni loo lasarri apa ootii Yerusalem, o lperereni loo lasarri oopejorieki enkorropil, neya ninche nepuo aanang'aki oerata le Kidron.

English: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
Masaai: Kake aing'ae oidim ateshetaki ninye keper, aa ore keper nalakua oleng nemeishaa? Kara nanu ng'ae oshetaki ninye enkaji, aa ore meteleku ake ewueji nepejieki enkorropil te dukuya ninye?

English: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
Masaai: entayiolo naa taata, ena olong nipikipiki iltauja linyi nchere, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai te shumata o tiabori enkop; meetae likae.

English: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
Masaai: naa keaku te iyie olkisialisialati oing'or nedamuni nkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani, pee easi ninche, mme pee isujaa oltau lino makewan o nkonyek inono makewan.

English: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
Masaai: naa Miklot apa menye le Shimeam, ore sii kulo nemanyisho aataaniki ilalashera lenye te Yerusalem, tenebo iltung'ana lenye.

English: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
Masaai: Nikintoki aaked emeli, nerrinyo ninche aapuo ang.

English: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enaishu olayioni le Yese ti oriong kop, mibul iyie nemebul enkitoria ino. Metaa irriwai olkilikuai niyau ninye enatii, amu esipa eye ake.”

English: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana ninche, “Entalamari ilooiduruk Entalamari, Entalamari! Emiseyie!” Neaku etaa ninche ilaisikak oloolimana; nejo iltung'ana too nkuapi, “Meigil ae kata aatoni tenebo iyiook.”

English: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
Masaai: Ee, ira iyie endapidapoi o sempewuet lai; ore te nkaraki enkarna ino torikoyioki nanu nikiutaa nanu,

English: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aya ninche too nkaik enye, nepejoo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar tenebo nena kishorunot naapejori; anaa olasar le nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, esong'ouna narropil, olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani.

English: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
Masaai: Ing'ura, metaa aitorioyie enkaina ai pee aagilunore iyie, naitong'oroo ina rubata nikinchooki iyie, naaitarasaki iyie ilo olubo loo lmang'ati linono, nena toyie oo Lfilisti, nena naatukurrutuate nkaraki olkuaak lino torrono.

English: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa eng'udi enye ti oriong e nkop e Misiri, neyau Olaitoriani olkutati le nkilepunoto e nkolong ina kop endama pooki o ina kewarie pooki; ore ake peyie ekenyu eyaua duoo olkutati lenkilepunoto e nkolong olmaati.

English: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
Masaai: Ekaajoki nanu iltung'ana lening'unoto, ore lelo tung'ana ng'eni laainining'ito nanu nejo,

English: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
Masaai: Naasuj ninche nanu; naatamana taata ninche; naaing'or nanu pee aatum aatanang'ie enkop.

English: In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
Masaai: Atua Olaitoriani nanu asaru; kaji iyie inko pee kijoki nanu, “Isika anaa emotonyi shomo ildoinyo;

English: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.
Masaai: Kake etanya apa ilo tung'ani eirrag ina kewarie etudumunye ninye alo, nelo abaya enkipirakinoto e Yebus (aa taa Yerusalem). Neeta apa te nebo ninye isirkon oare ooitobiraki pee ekedi, netii apa ina apiani te nebo ninye.

English: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
Masaai: Nchoo sii eng'asi aatem ninche, ore ake peyie eitisipi nchere meeta ileyiat, nchoo easisho anaa ilaisiaayiak.

English: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
Masaai: Iserememe intae enimiyiololo, nikiserem iyiook enikiyiolo, amu Ilyahudi eing'uaa enjeunoto.

English: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
Masaai: amu esujita ake ilo orere ebuakita aajo, “Ewaita ninye!”

English: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
Masaai: Eikitok Olaitoriani naa keisisi ninye oleng ti atua enkanasa e Nkai ang! Te ilo doinyo lenye sinyati

English: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
Masaai: Ore to lkila lenye o te nkupes enye neeta enkarna naigerokino ajo, Olaiguanani loo laiguanak naa Olaitoriani loo laitoriak.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore taisere neyooki iltung'ana aadumunye enasirie, neshet olperere lo lasar teine, neitayu ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani.

English: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo maiman naitaa nanu olpisiai oleku; ore lelo apa ooiturrayioki, naitaa olorere ogol; nelo Olaitoriani aitore ninche to ldoinyo le Sion; ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi.

English: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
Masaai: Ore te nkakenya, ore ake pee eng'oru enkolong iltiil, nidumunyenye aayooki nikuetikiki ina anasa; ore ake pee kimpang'aki ninye o lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo ninye aapuonu aarare, entaasa ninche anaa enaishiaakino.”

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong naaituku iyie too ntorrok inono pooki, naa kaisho inkanas inono metamanyi, ore iwuejitin nememanya nesheti.

English: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
Masaai: Neibelekenya Yesu, nedol esujita nejoki, “Ainyoo ing'oruru?” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Rabbi, aa keji enkitawalata olaiteng'enani, kaji nikimanya?”

English: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
Masaai: Etiu apa Babilon anaa enkikompe e sahabu te nkaina o laitoriani, eitemer enkop pooki; etemerate iloreren te naisho enye oo sabibu, neaku eshomo nkuapi etarruoitie ilukuny.

English: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
Masaai: Neitayuni enkitanapata tiatua Yuda pooki o Yerusalem tenkaraki lelo yararot pooki ootorrinyunye, pee epuo ninche aaiturrurro te Yerusalem.

English: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Musa, “ARA NANU ILO ORA.” Neitoki ajo, “Tiaaki ena iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘ARA NANU laairriwua nanu enitii.’ ”

English: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Merari: Mahali, o Mishi, kulo ninche ilmareita loo Lawi terisioroto oo loo menye.

English: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
Masaai: Eyawua Enkai ninye aitupuku te Misiri; netiu ninye anaa oloata mouarak o losokuan, kelo ninye aijoo lelo oshon mang'ati lenyena, negil iloik lenye aitaa mbelibelat, neng'or ninche too mbaa enyena.

English: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai, nerikuni ninye aaitijing'u. Naa kenyokie apa ninye newang nkonyek enyena, neikishiaan. Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tudumunye, tubukoki ninye eilata; amu ninye ele.”

English: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
Masaai: Ore peyie ebik ninye teine enkata naado eturumishe te lusie Abimelek olaiguanani loo Lfilisti, nedol Isaak eirrapirap Rebeka enkitok enye.

English: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
Masaai: Neiteleikiaki taata entolu intana oo lkeek naa ore pooki shani lemeiu lng'anayio sidain, nedung'i aanang'aki enkima.

English: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena olong'i, nashumu nanu Nebukadnesa nkonyek aainei aing'or shumata, naarrinyokino nanu ndamunot aainei, naisis nanu ilo otii shumata aisul, naisis nayanyitu ilo oishu ntarasi; amu ore enkitoria enye naa enkitoria oo ntarasi, ore enkitoo enye nebikoo too ishoritin o ishoritin

English: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
Masaai: Ore pee eisho, neitashe Paulo te nena kedeta e kishomi, neyuk olorere te nkaina; ore pee egira aajo tim, neirorie te nkutuk oo Lhebrania, nejoki:

English: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
Masaai: ore amu etanyaita ninche nkiguanat aainei neitu epuoyie ninche nkitanapat aainei, neisarkionie isabatoni aainei; amu etusuja iltauja lenye nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
Masaai: Neitashe Abija tenchumata oldoinyio le Semaraim otii ina kop oo ldoinyio e Efraim, nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu, iyie Yeroboam o Israel pooki!

English: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
Masaai: Ore Etiopia, o Put, o Lud o Arabia pooki, o Libya o iltung'ana pooki le nkop ooibung'are, naa kebatata te nebo to lalem.

English: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
Masaai: Mirut iyie te neaku oltung'ani karsis, te neponari enkitoo enkaji enye.

English: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
Masaai: Neirriwaa apa Musa ninche meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan, nejoki ninche, “Elepa enchom Negeb te idie, nilepilepe aapuo ina kop oo ldoinyo,

English: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ekaapik iyie inkeenta, metaa mimbelekenyakino ae alo, ometaba anaa niishu nkolong'i inono nimanie ina anasa.

English: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
Masaai: Yonatan ake olayioni le Asahel o Yohaseia olayioni le Tikfa otanya ena, ore Meshulam o Shebetai, ilo le Lawi, neibung'are ninche.

English: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae tung'ana, ilapolosak, o Lawi, o larripok le kishomi, o laranyak, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, o lelo pooki ooitekeputua ate aaitalam iloreren le nena kuapi, aaibelekenyakino nkitanapat e Nkai, tenebo inkituaak enye, o layiok lenye, o ntoyie enye, lelo pooki oata engeno o eyiolounoto,

English: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu tiauluo aitijing'u atua olodung'oro liatua, naa ing'ura, etii apa ilgilat aare sapuki otii atua olodung'oro liatua, ore obo naa ole nkishomi e moikuape naipirare kopikop, ore enkae neipirare enkalo e kishomi naing'orita moikuape.

English: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
Masaai: Ninye apa yioloti oleng te lelo tomoni uni, neaku olarikoni lenye, kake eitu etiu anaa lelo pokira okuni.

English: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
Masaai: Newaliki Isaak Esau ejo, “Ing'ura ajo aitaa ninye olkitok lino, naa ore ilalashera lenyena, aishoo ninye meitaa isinkan, naa too lpaek tenebo enaisho oo sabibu aitotio ninye. Kaa naa taata aaitaas enkerai ai?”

English: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
Masaai: neya olapolosani ilo kuo le ker lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, o ilo tulet le ilata, neyuk olapolosani ninche metaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
Masaai: Ninye oitaserian ilpolosien linono; ninye oiputaki intae enkano sidai.

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
Masaai: Keton nanu aata ae golon nairorie ai toki? Ilo rorei opik Enkai enkutuk ai, ninye nanu airo.”

English: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
Masaai: Neitobir sii ninye endaa sidai namelok, neyau ayaki papaai lenye. Nejoki menye “Inchoo papa lai edumunye aton ainos inkiri e ng'ues pee kitum atamayiana.”

English: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Inotito intae olosek lianyienyie nkitanapat e Nkai, pee itumutumu aaitabai nkoon inyi.

English: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Masaai: Neshetaki Gideon te ine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar, nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani eseriani.” Ore ebaiki ena olong neton eitashe ilo perere te Ofra nara enoo Ilabiesi.

English: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Usiel naa: Mika aa ninye olkitok o Ishia aa ninye oliare.

English: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
Masaai: Neitashe ninche te wueji enye neisum embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai enye te nkolong e ong'uan: ore tiae rishata e ong'uan nelimu ninche aaibalie ing'ok enye, neserem Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kalotu asioku naata olekoisiaayio lai te nebo nanu, pee alaaki pooki ng'ae anaa anataasa ninye.

English: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neitorioo neishiu atiu anaa enkae.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Ore te siadi, eidipa olaiguanani atapejo olpiyayati tenebo lelo rorei ooigero Baruk te limunoto e Yeremia ejo:

English: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
Masaai: Neun Olaitoriani Enkai enkurma, te Eden te nkalo oloosaen. Nepik ilo tung'ani oitobira atua.

English: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
Masaai: Neaku ore esiana pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, too nkajijik oo loo menye, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki ng'ae ooidim ashomo enjore te Israel

English: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
Masaai: Neaku neijia ake etotiwuo te ninye, amu eitunyoitie iltung'ana ninye te kishomi neye.

English: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore anaa enitishipakine ina jung'o enkaji e Israel, amu aimitil apa ninye, neaku kaarare sii nanu iyie; iaku sii iyie mitil, oldoinyo le Seir, o Edom pooki, pooki elulung'a. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
Masaai: Kake etara iltung'ana leina kop metuata lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootarresho olaiguanani Amon; ore iltung'ana leina kop neitaa Yosia olayioni lenye olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
Masaai: Torrinyoki iyiook kewan ino Olaitoriani, pee kitum aatorrinyunye! Ntang'ejuko nkolong'i ang metotiwuo anaa apa!

English: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
Masaai: Tadamu nchere ira orrindik te Misiri ning'or pee imbung kuna kitanapat.

English: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
Masaai: neji enkitok e Saul Ahinoam, entito e Ahimaas. Neji olkitok lenye le Njore Abna olayioni le Ner, olenkapu le Saul;

English: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.
Masaai: Neton apa eitu eyiolou Samuel Olaitoriani, neton eitu eibalunyeki ororei lo Laitoriani te ninye.

English: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
Masaai: Nepejoo olapolosani eilata te nchumata olperere lo lasar, kake ore oloikulu neaku ole Aron o layiok lenyena.

English: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
Masaai: Naa kelo Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie tiatua intae emuoyian pooki nemeetae hoo nabo te nena muoyiaritin torrok e Misiri niyiololo, nalotu shumata intae kake keiteleiki ninye shumata lelo pooki ooiba intae.

English: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani ninye erubata ai” neijia ejo oltau lai, “Ore enkaraki ina kaisilig nanu ninye.”

English: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
Masaai: Kake te nemejoki olmoruo lenye ae te nkolong ake ninye, neitubulaa naa ilo mumai le nkitok enye, o nena pooki naatejo ninye aenie kewan, nena naatii shumata ninye; eitubula ninye ninche enkaraki neitu ejoki ae ina olong apa naning nena baa.

English: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
Masaai: ore te Hilkia naa Hashabia; ore te Yedaia, naa Natanel.

English: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
Masaai: Ilo iyie adaa nimiraposho naa kelo olameyu atii iwuejitin inono e atua. Inteng'el iyie kake mintagol, ore ina ninteng'el nemeaku. Ore ina nisudoo aiteng'el naisho nanu metara olalem.

English: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa enenye enkitoo o enkitoria, intarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.

English: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
Masaai: Entoosh entarumpeta te Sion; entoosh entadara teilo doinyo lai sinyati! Nchoo eikirikira lelo pooki oomanya ena kop, amu kelotu enkolong o Laitoriani etataana.

English: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina paa enkirukoto eitasheyie peyie aa empiris eigarakino ina kisiligata, neitadedeyieki te ishoi enye pooki, neme te lelo asujak loo nkitanapat aa ninche ake, kake o te lelo oong'arie Abraham enkirukoto, amu ninye menye iyiook pooki.

English: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
Masaai: keosh Olaitoriani to lpepedoi nena lukuny oo ntoyie e Sion, naa keibalunye Olaitoriani emasipaisho enye.

English: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Midian naa Epa, o Eper, o Hanok o Abida, o Eldaa. Ore apa kulo naa nkera e ketura.

English: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani, nasiaitin enyena pooki, too wuejitin enyena pooki e nkitoria enye, isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai!

English: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
Masaai: ninteng'ening'ene meibung'a inaitanapa intae pooki; naa ng'ura, atii te nebo intae nkolong'i pooki o metabau enkiting'oto e nkop.”

English: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
Masaai: Tudumu elong'o ino o emasaai ino o larrabal, taretuoki nanu!

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Manoa, “Ore nena pooki natiaaka ena kitok nchoo ninye eing'or.

English: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
Masaai: Keiturrurro ninche te nebo aagilunore ilo supat, nedung'oki ilo asipani enkiguana e keeya.

English: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
Masaai: Metadamu ninye ilasarri linono pooki, neing'or te nyorrarota ilasarri linono oopejori!

English: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Naa tenetii obo Lawi lemeasishore esipata enye enkordunoto, ore apa ina aji natimiraki tiatua enkanasa enye nerrinyuni to lari le Yubilii; amu ore nena ajijik naatii atua nkanas oo Lawi naa imasaa enye tiatua ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
Masaai: Eipang'aka sii enkima ina sholuek; nepejoo olang'at le nkima ilarruok.

English: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
Masaai: “Eiyio nena baa! Entudumu ilong'oi! Etuputuo Olaitoriani oltau loo laiguanak le Amedi, amu ore eyieunoto enye tialo Babilon naa pee eidakie ninye, amu ina elap o laitoriani, elap te nkaraki enkaji enye.

English: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham tadekenya enasirie, neya endaa o lbene lolchoni le nkare; neisho Hagar meiteleiki oloililai lenye tenebo ina kerai neisho ninche meshomo. Nedumunye alo nelimana ti ong'ota e Beer-sheba.

English: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
Masaai: Etejo Olaitoriani, “Karrinyu nanu ninche aitung'uaa Bashan, Karrinyu nanu ninche aitung'uaa ineegut e naiposha,

English: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ejo iloshon, “Koree Enkai enye?” Nchoo ina lap, apa enkibukoroto o sarge loo sinkan linono metayiolouni too loshon pooki te dukuya nkonyek ang!

English: If there be a controversy between men, and they come unto judgment, that the judges may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.
Masaai: “Teneishankarra iltung'ana, nepuonu kotini, nedung ilarishak enkiguana te ninche, nepali ilo asipani neiguanareki ilo arruoni,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Abijam, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda. Neeta apa Abijan olarrabal o Yeroboam.

English: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi ailep to rorei le Gad, anaa enaitanapishe olaiguanani.

English: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
Masaai: neaku ore engeno nagut e Solomon kelusoo te engeno oo ltung'ana pooki to loosaen, o engeno pooki e Misiri.

English: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
Masaai: “Ore nkolong'i pooki e ilo mumai lenye le nkiteng'elata meiseyie olmurunya endukuya enye; o metaba anaa neishunye ina kata apa naiteng'elaka ninye kewan Olaitoriani. Keaku ninye sinyati; keisho ninye iyenat oo lpapit lenyena metoodorito.

English: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
Masaai: Amaa, ilo oitame iloshon, ae meitameisho ninye? Ilo oiteng'en iltung'ana te ng'eno,

English: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
Masaai: Te naarikino nanu iyie, Yerusalem, nchoo enkaina ai e tatene etoyu!

English: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
Masaai: Naa kayau enkiti daa peyie intokiki aagolu nindimidimi aashom itagolo amu iimutua enetii osinka linyi.” Nejo ninche, “Taasa anaa enitejo.”

English: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
Masaai: “Ekaaitodol nanu iyie ininingoki nanu; ore ina natoduaa naa kaibalunye.

English: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninche, “Embung'a lelo oibonok le Baal; emincho ninye elo obo.” Neibung'i ninche, neyau Eliya ninche aitadou ayau olchorro le Kishon, near ninche metuata teine.

English: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro e Saul tialo Yonatan, nejoki ninye Yonatan “Iyie olayioni le nkitok modai nemening'isho, aimayiolo nanu ajo itegelua iyie olayioni le Yese te nkurruna ino makewan, o te nkurruna e masipaisho e ng'utunyi?

English: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
Masaai: Ore iyiook nikiyiolo aajo sidain inkitanapat te neasishore oltung'ani te sipata,

English: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
Masaai: Ore ejoito ninche nena, neitashe Yesu makewan ti atua ninche, nejoki, “Entaseriana!”

English: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
Masaai: Ore larin te nkishui ang naa ntomoni naapishana, naa ntomoni isiet te nikigol; ore to lelo arin naa enkisiaayiare ake o sina; nalusoo aasiooyo, nikipuo sii iyiook aish.

English: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.
Masaai: Ore eokore naa anaa enaitanapishoteki, mearakini hoo ng'ae, amu eitanapishe olaiguanani too lkituaak lenyena pooki ootii enkaji enye e nkitoo nchere nchoo metaasa pooki tung'ani enayieu.

English: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
Masaai: Ore ile Afim, lelo oomanya nkang'itie kutiti ometabaiki Gasa, ore lelo le Kaftorim apa ooing'ua Kafta neidaikie ninche nemany enkop enye te rishata enye.)

English: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: Ore kuna pooki naa inchere peyie meeta ilkeek le mbata enkare oobulu aaika oleng teshumata arashu epik ilukuny enye inkatampo, nemeetae likae shani ook enkare ebaiki shumata ninche te nkadori; amu eishooki ninche pooki metuata, teina kop oo lmeneng'a natii tung'ani oye, tenebo lelo oopuo olodo le nkop.

English: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
Masaai: Naa keishoru ninye nkujit te nkop inyi te nkaraki nkishu inyi, nidaa intae aaraposho.

English: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
Masaai: Neimu te siadi, neiseyie olcholoi lo lkila lenye, negem nabo kata osarge.

English: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa nkang'itie e Yuda o wuejitin neemanita Yerusalem, eing'uaa enkop e Benchamen, eing'uaa Shefela, eing'uaa ina kop oo ldoinyo, o looing'ua negeb, eyau ilasarri oopejori o nkishorot, nkishorot e nkurma o lbani, neyau nkishorot e nashe enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
Masaai: neaku meitokini ninye aadamu enapa naatae sapuk te nkaraki ilo ameyu osuju, amu ekeaku torrono oleng'.

English: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nepik ninye embata o sarge enchumata oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar otiii atua olng'obor le ntumo dukuya Olaitoriani; ore olikae sarge neibukoo te ntonata eilo perere lo lasar opejori otii kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
Masaai: Nedumu ilapolosak nena pisai enkosholai nejo, “Mebara ti nikipik olbene le Nkai amu osarge einosieki.”

English: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto etamayiana Isaak Yakobo o Esau too naapuonu.

English: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani apa oirriwayioki meshomo aipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, ore irorei loo loibonok pooki naa eisidain tialo olaiguanani; nchoo irorei linono metotiwuo anaa irorei liobo lenye, niro mbaa sidain.”

English: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neibelekenya iltung'ana aaisis ninche; nemetumie ninche entioto.

English: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Neya ninye sahabu pooki o enkosholai, o masaa pooki naatii atua enkaji e Nkai, netii Obed edom tenebo ninche. Neya sii ilchumat ootii enkaji o laiguanani, o ltung'ana ooibung'aki aaya, nerrinyo alo Samaria.

English: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
Masaai: Ore taata ishomo aidur enkaraki niyieu oleng to ltau enkaji e papaai lino, kake ainyoo peyie itupurroyie inkaitin aainei?”

English: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
Masaai: Neaku eisula Daudi ilo Filisti te nkopito o to soit, neosh ilo Filisti, near ninye metua; nemetii apa olalem enkaina e Daudi.

English: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi iltung'ana lenyena pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye te Yerusalem, “Entudumunye, emaisika iyiook, arashu eaku mikiata iyiook enikisikaki aailany Absalom; enchom entasiooi meinepu akeninye iyiook asioki, neyau entorroni aitadoiki shumata iyiook, neshurt ena anasa te nepi o lalem.”

English: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
Masaai: Ore teina olong ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa keitoomon pooki te intae olelatia enye meetu aatoni te ntonata o sabibu lenye o te ntonata olng'aboli lenye.”

English: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
Masaai: Aainyo enkerai ai pee incho enyorrata enkitok naibor onyek kidumu? Nimbung olgoo le ntang'oroi?

English: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani oilepu alotu te nebo iyie, naa nchoo metaa meetae oltung'ani odoli too doinyo pooki; nchoo eaku medaa nkishu o nkerrai te dukuya ilo doinyo.”

English: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
Masaai: Ntotiwuo ninche anaa suut naakutita osiwuo, ereuta olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninche!

English: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
Masaai: “Entorripisho naa, amu miyiolo enkolong nalotu Olaitoriani linyi.

English: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

English: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Kain, “Ainyoo peyie itagore naa ainyoo peyie isot enkomom?

English: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
Masaai: Lo tung'ana, eikintukurrurru akenya o anu? Inyorrurru intae irorei le pesho o anu, nirubarere elejare?

English: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
Masaai: Te nesipa eyieu oltung'ani neishooyo, nemejoki Enkai ninye meishooi entoki nemeeta, kake eng'amu ina naata eishorua.

English: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
Masaai: Nchoo eaku ninche olminong te intae, ore nkiri enye niminosinoso, ore mpopoki enye niminyikakiki. Nchoo eaku olminong te intae.

English: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
Masaai: Neetae ilayiok oopishana le likae, apolosani kitok, oji Skewa ooikuna ninche neijia.

English: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Masaai: Naa keaku irubat isiet, tenebo nkitotoneta enye e nkosholai, nkitotoneta tomon o ile, o nkitotoneta are tiabori erubata nabo, o nkitotoneta are tiabori enkae rubata.

English: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
Masaai: Kake ore Mikael ilo malaika kitok, eishankarra o loirirua eorro osesen le Musa eitu ninye eitasim aipotoki emoroto e nkiguana, Kake etiaaka, “Metaa Enkai nikisikong.”

English: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
Masaai: ore paa ene nkikoo nikinkokishore; ore paa ene leng'on te nkaminino; ore paa eretore, neaku te nkisosion; ore paa eno lng'ur, niking'urrie te nchipai.

English: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

English: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;

English: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
Masaai: Amu etaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya intae nkuapi kituaak naagol, ore tialo intae meetae oltung'ani oidima aitasheikinore intae o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo ninche etoduaa te nkaji ino?” Newal Hesekia ajo, “Etodua ninche nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ai; meetae entoki natii atua enkaji ai neitu nanu aitodol ninche.”

English: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
Masaai: Ore egira ninye aliki olaiguanani eneikuna Elisha pee eitopiu oltung'ani otua, ng'ura, ore ina kitok apa naitopiwuoki enkerai enye, nesai olaiguanani te nkaraki enkaji enye o enkurma enye. Nejo Gehasi, “Olkitok lai, lo aiguanani, nena ina kitok naa nena ina kerai enye apa naitopiwuoki.”

English: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
Masaai: Enkai naisho ilo lemeeta ang ewueji nemany, nerikoo lelo ooena metudupoto; kake ore lelo maisero netoni te nkop natoyio.

English: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore ake etiu neijia ina ong'u enkare aashu eng'umoto natii enkare naa eisidai; kake ore ake teneshoroo mpopoki enye neaku keiduruk.

English: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu oliatua lo lodung'oro tenkalo oloosaen, netem ninye ina kishomi; nerisiore nena kulie.

English: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
Masaai: Ng'ura kitoning'o iyiook te Efrata, nikitum iyiook too nkong'at e Yaar.

English: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
Masaai: Nelaikino ataasa inenking'asia te ine; ilkuti tung'ana ake oomuei eiteleikia nkaik neishiunye.

English: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, neisho Yosef le Arimatea, laa oloiteng'eni le Yesu, kake too nkurrat te nkaraki naure Ilyahudi, neomon Pilato meishoo meewa osesen le Yesu; neisho Pilato. Nelotu neya osesen lenye.

English: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
Masaai: Tadamu nchere ira apa osinka te nkop e Misiri, nikintupuku Olaitoriani Enkai ino teine te nkaina enye magilani naitoriori; metaa kintanapa iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino pee imbung enkolong e Sabato.

English: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Nchoo eing'or ntae Olaitoriani neiguanare, amu intaa ntae iyiook ilarruok te dukuya Farao o laisiaayiak lenyena, nitipika olalem enkaina enye pee ear iyiook matuata.”

English: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
Masaai: Nelo enetii ninye, naa ng'ura, eitashe ninye te mbata o lasar lenye opejori, o lkituaak le Moab te nebo ninye. Nejoki Balak ninye, “Kainyoo etejo Olaitoriani?”

English: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie keeya e Yehoida, nepuonu ilkituaak le Yuda aailejilej olaiguanani nening olaiguanani ninche.

English: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
Masaai: Metaa eirure Yosef, aa oloo larin iip o tomon te moruao; neitobir ninche osesen lenye pee mengueyu, nepiki osesen lenye osanduku te Misiri.

English: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
Masaai: Ara nanu olino, ntajeuoki; amu aing'orua nanu nkiteng'enat inono.

English: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
Masaai: Neitoki Ahasia Olayioni le Ahab ajoki Yehoshafat, “Nchoo isinkan laainei epuo tenebo isinkan linono too melin.” Kake eitu enyorraa Yehoshafat.

English: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
Masaai: “Emayiana ilooitukuo ltauja; amu ninche oodol Enkai.

English: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
Masaai: “Ara Olyahudi, naa te Tarso e Kilikia aaini, kake te na anasa aaitubuluni too nkejek e Gamaliel, naaiteng'eni te risioroto oo nkitanapat oo loo papa naarrish, naata olokiyo te Nkai anaa ena nitiuwu pooki te le kekun.

English: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.
Masaai: Ore oltau lo ltung'ani ng'en neboiniki ninye meitoriokinoyu esipata, kake ore oltau lo lmodai neboiniki entorroni.

English: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ahab lelo rorei, nepolos nkilani enyena, neishopoki kewan ilkuniyiani, neen ninye apukoo neirrag too lkuniyiani, nelo ninye to sina.

English: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
Masaai: Neshukunye aapuo En-mishapat (aa ninye Kadesh) near enkop pooki oo Lmaleki, near sii Ilamori lelo oomanya Hasason tamar.

English: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
Masaai: Toning'o irorei laainei, iyie Olaitoriani; toduaa ndamunot aainei o ltau.

English: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
Masaai: Ore apa Barsilai le Giliad netadowuo alotu aing'uaa Rogelim; nelo ninye te nebo olaiguanani Yordan, pee eitarioo ninye aitalang Yordan.

English: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
Masaai: Amu ore enkiguana ninguanarere, naa ninye eiguanareki intae; ore enintorisiokiki ilkulikae, naa ninye eitorisiokini intae.

English: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki Uria, “Totona ake sii taata tene, ore taaisere naaisho iyie shomo.” Neaku etotona Uria te Yerusalem ina olong o pee ekenyu.

English: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ibaya, ning'oru Yehu olayioni le Yehoshafat olayioni le Nimshi; nijing'aki ninye, nirik ninye aitung'uaa ilchoreta lenyena, nirik ninye enkilepata to lgilata liatua.

English: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
Masaai: Ore pee etumo, nejoki Pilato ninche, “Kalo iyieuu nalaaki intae? Ai Barabas anaa Yesu oji Kristo?”

English: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Itoduaa iyie ena, Nakerai e tung'ani? Kentoki nalelek te nkaji e Yuda pee eas intabo olminong naasita tene, eji metaa keiput enkop pooki enkikonya naainuaaki nanu oleng matagoroyu? Ng'ura, epik olng'osila lenye inkumeishin enye.

English: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
Masaai: (Ore omer naa erubata e tomon e efa.)

English: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
Masaai: Emintagol iltauja linyi, anaa apa te Meriba, anaa apa te nkolong e Masa ti ong'ata,

English: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
Masaai: Nepuonu te ina kata ilooiteng'eni lenyena, neing'asia enkaraki nairorie enkitok: kake metii olotejo, “Ainyoo ing'oru?” aashu, “Oo pee irorie iyie ninye?”

English: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani neaku ninye olkitok loo larikok loo Lawi neitasheiki lelo aitasheikinok le wueji sinyati.

English: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena te nkoitoi, ina kata eloito Shimei te murte o ldoinyo eipirakinore ninye, nedekisho eloito, nenang ninye too soito neisuaaki enterit.

English: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
Masaai: Kalo nanu aipirri te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono ti nikintalalaki nanu eyiolounoto ai!

English: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
Masaai: Kitok Olaitoriani, naa kitok enkisisa enye, ore enkitoo enye nemelimunoyu.

English: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
Masaai: amu keiput apa enkitoo o Laitoriani enkaji e Nkai.

English: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka enkitok enye ninye, “Tenaa keyieu apa Olaitoriani near iyiook matuata, anaata eitu ninye eng'amu ilo asar opejori o lasar le ntapa too nkaik ang, aashu eitodol iyiook kuna baa pooki, aashu eliki iyiook mbaa naaijo kuna.”

English: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
Masaai: Eitayuni esekenkei te nkop, nesholuni osuyai te nterit enye.

English: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
Masaai: Negiroo ninche ine nepuo ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, nepuonu enkaji e Mika.

English: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
Masaai: Eming'asia lalashera, nchere eiba intae enkop.

English: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
Masaai: Tubukoki engoro ino lelo oshon limikiyiolo iyie, o shumata nena kitoriat nemeipot enkarna ino!

English: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
Masaai: Netupurdate imasaa inyi, neinosa olasai inkilani inyi.

English: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
Masaai: Kake eirriwua Olaitoriani olkutati sapuk shumata enaiposha, nejing enkilugo kitok enaiposha, o metaa kejo emeli pee egila.

English: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni oare apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem. Eiwuang'a ninye meetae oltung'ani otishilayie. Etunukaitie ninche ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, kake mme too nkuraren oo laiguanak.

English: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejoki Isaak olayioni lenye, “wou tinyikakaki tung'ututaki olayioni lai.”

English: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
Masaai: Ore ilo olo te sipata naa keitajeuni, kake ore ilo opong'ori too monko too nkoitoi enyena naa kesulakino eng'umoto.

English: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Miureisho, amu ore lelo ootii tenebo iyiook naa eikumok aalang lelo ootii tenebo ninche.”

English: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
Masaai: Eiroro ninche o Yoab olayioni le Seruyia tenebo Abiata olapolosani; nesujaa ninche Adonija neretu ninye.

English: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore to losho le Isakar neyai Kadesh tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Damerat tenebo nena ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
Masaai: ‘Mesioki Olaitoriani agoro, neton ninye te nyorrata nauno, nepalaki iltung'ana te ntorroni o te ngolon e nkong'u, kake meeta ninye nchere pee eiwuang'ie eng'oki eitu eitabaiki entorroni oo loo menye shumata nkera enye, shumata e ishoi e uni o shumata eishoi e ong'uan.’

English: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
Masaai: Nejoki Abna Yoab, “Nchoo ilbarnot edumunye aarany te dukuya iyiook.” Nejo Yoab, “Nchoo edumunye ninche.”

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore enkanashe ino Sodom o ntoyie enyena eitu eas ninche anaa ina nitaasa iyie o intoyie inono.

English: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
Masaai: Metaa etejo ninye, “Ara nanu osinka le Abraham! Netamayiana Olaitoriani olkitok lai oleng, neitaa ninye karsis:

English: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
Masaai: naa te ninye etumutaki ina kop apa naatae aaitemoo to loirrag le nkare neidaaya.

English: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
Masaai: Karanyisho nanu te nkaraki enkirukoto o esipata; iyie Olaitoriani nanu aranyaki.

English: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
Masaai: Neing'or Enkai kop etii shumata, aing'or nkera e tung'ana pee edol tenaa ketii obo ng'en oing'oru Enkai.

English: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki,

English: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
Masaai: Amu amaa eidipa ailanya ilduruki le nkop te yiolounoto o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo, neitoki ake aaisho metarrueshi te ninche, neidimuni, ore imbaa enye e nkiting'oto neaku torrok te ninche oleng aalang ine dukuya.

English: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
Masaai: Neishankarrare lelo tung'ana Musa, nejoki, “Enaikash apa tenaa eikituata ina kata apa pee eye ilalashera lang te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
Masaai: Neisho embelati o sinkirri oyiera,

English: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
Masaai: Neinyototo ninche aayooki taisere, neitayu ilasarri oopejori, neyau ilasarri le seriani; netoni iltung'ana aadaa neokisho, neinyototo aaiguran.

English: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
Masaai: Neilepu ildoinyo, nedoyio ierat aagutu nepuo iwuejitin nitegelaka ninche.

English: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Musa, “Irorie iyie iyiook, amu eikining; kake nchoo metaa mme Enkai nairorie iyiook, mikiye ake.”

English: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
Masaai: Imbung'a sii iyie ninye; tadamu sii olarrabal, mintoki aigil aas!

English: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
Masaai: Amu ainosa nanu olmumai te kewan ai, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere keaku Basara, entoki naitureisho, enkurruna, olmuaate oldeket, ore nkanas enyena pooki neaku ilmuaateni anaake.”

English: And every raven after his kind,
Masaai: o lkurruk o mpukunot e pooki toki naata naipuko o mpukunot enyena pooki,

English: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
Masaai: Aimikiaata iyiook pooki papa obo? Aime Enkai nabo naitobira iyiook? Ainyoo naa peyie mikisiliga iyiook maate, nikisarkionie olning'o loo loo papa lang?

English: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
Masaai: ore ilalashera lenyena te risioroto oo iiishoritin enye naa iip naaudo o onom o ile. Ore kulo pooki naa lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lasarri oopejori, ooyautua ina umata naa iloing'ok ntomoni naapishana, o lmeregeshi iip nabo, o lkuo le kerra iip are. Ore kulo pooki naa iloo lasarri oopejokini Olaitoriani.

English: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
Masaai: Nejoki Obadia ninye, “Kaa ng'oki ataasa nanu, eji metaa nchooyo osinka lino apik enkaina e Ahab, maataara nanu matua?

English: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
Masaai: Naa kaaisis nanu iyie anaa naishu; kailepie nanu nkaik aainei naipot enkarna ino.

English: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
Masaai: o Betsur, o Soko, o Adulam,

English: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
Masaai: Mining'ore aitayunye osotua ninche arashu te nebo nkaitin enye.

English: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
Masaai: Ore pee eorore, nelo aomon te nena doinyo.

English: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
Masaai: Neaku ore apa ilashetak le Solomon o lashetak le Hiraim, oltung'ana le Gebal neas esiaai e nguetare neitobir mbaoi o soito pee eshet enkaji.

English: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
Masaai: “Tayiolo naa nchere, mikinchorita iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino ena kop sidai te nkaraki esupatisho; amu ira iyie olorere ogolong'u.

English: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
Masaai: kake kaarita osesen lai naitore, pee meaku ore aidipa atoliki ilkulikae naadung'ori nanu.

English: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keiwuang'ie Olaitoriani nena masaa naang'idare,

English: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
Masaai: Naa keyau ninche atua ina anasa enkitoo o enkanyit oo loreren.

English: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore te umata naa keaku enkitanapata nabo ake, te intae o to lomoni otii te nebo intae, enkitanapata nabikoo ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, ore anaa enitiuu naa neijia etiu ilo omoni te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche edekisho, kake tamayianisho iyie! Nchoo lelo ainyalak laainei meitukurruni; metishipayu osinka lino.

English: Oh that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
Masaai: Oi naaji tenaa aikisudoo nanu te nemeneng'a, nikisudoo nanu ometogiroi engoro ino, metaa aikigelaki nanu erishata niyiolo, nikidamu nanu!

English: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
Masaai: Miking'uaa nanu iyie Olaitoriani! iyie Na Ai, mikilam nanu!

English: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
Masaai: “Naa teneiteng'elaki oltung'ani Olaitoriani ometua e nkurma enye naa enenye te njung'ore ore entemata ino e nkinyiang'a naa te risioroto e unoto enye. Ore omeri nabo (mpilbil ile kutiti) e shairi neaku shekeli onom oo ropiyiani, enkosholai.

English: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
Masaai: Kaji nanu aiko te nadek ilo leitu edek Enkai? Kaji nanu aiko te nailepilepaki ilo leitu eilepilepaki Enkai?

English: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.
Masaai: Neitoki Mordekai ajoki ninche metushuku ewalata enetii Esta, “Mijo taa ore ti atua enkaji o laiguanani niserian alang ilkulikae Yahudi pooki.

English: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
Masaai: Ore etaa ninye ake, neikilikuan lelo ooboitare te nebo ilooiteng'eni lenyena enajo nena kitanyaanyukot.

English: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Masaai: Ntishipa oltau lo sinka lino, amu iyie nanu, Olaitoriani, ailepakinye oltau lai.

English: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
Masaai: Ore olonyor olalashe lenye neton ti atua ewang'an, ore tiatua ewang'an nemeetae entoki narrorrisho.

English: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Tonyorra naa ilo ora omoni; amu irara sii apa intae omon te nkop e Misiri.

English: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani, teina kata apa egilunore Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o enjore enye pooki o nkitoriat pooki e nkop naatii abori enkitoria enye o ltung'ana pooki le Yerusalem o nkanas enyena pooki ejo:

English: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
Masaai: Kake etabuaa ninche to ltoilo sapuk, neiken inkiyiaa enye, neitiamaki pooki te nebo;

English: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
Masaai: Naipang'unye nanu loo papaai linyi aitung'uaa Misiri, nipuonunu enaiposha; nesuju apa Ilmisiri loo papaai linyi too ngarrin o too mbartan o meetu Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
Masaai: Ore naa taata, ore tenalotu enetii osinka lino papaai lang, nemetii enkayioni tenebo iyiook, neaku ore enkishui enye neibung'are ena ayioni,

English: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Amu eidapashayie olkirutoto te nkop oo loishu; metaa keirragieki ninye tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem, Farao tenebo olorora lenye pooki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
Masaai: Nejo Yonatan, “Eitanyamala papaai enkop; ng'ura ajo etawang'ita nkonyek aainei enkaraki naishamishama enkiti ena aisho.

English: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
Masaai: Ore imasaa naanotoki aasioki naa kengoroo, kake ore ilo osotu aakutiti naa keponaa.

English: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
Masaai: Neton Daudi ti atua ilnukat ti ong'ota, te ina kop oo ldoinyo lo lpurkel le Sif. Neing'oru Saul ninye nkolong'i pooki, kake eitu epik ninye Enkai atua enkaina enye.

English: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Masaai: tenelo neshuku ilo torrono ina nainosie apa olmumai, neshuku ina apa nawa te nkikonya, nelo too nkoitoi enkishon, nemeitoki aas enkarruoisho; naa kesipa keton katukul eishu, nemeye ninye.

English: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
Masaai: Tudumunye ndong'o ninche na tito e Sion, amu kaitaa nanu emowuo ino esekenkei, naitaa iloisotok linono osuyai; iar iyie iloreren kumok aitaa mpurdat, ore imasaa enye nintisinyaki Olaitoriani. Ore enkarsisisho enye nintisinyaki Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

English: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
Masaai: nchere ti nimimbalunyenye intae ina kidetidet te nanu, naa ena nabo ake endung'okinoto inyi e nkiguana. Itoning'okinote intae pee iroro elejare o lemeitoriori te dukuya nanu o meibelekenyata nkatitin. Metaa entolikioki nanu enkidetidet pee ayiolou nchere eikindimidimi aatoliki enkibalakinoto enye.”

English: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Agira aing'oru ilalashera laainei, tolikioki sii ake aatasayia, kaji doi etii aairritayie intare.”

English: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
Masaai: “Naa ore taata kaaitodol nanu esipata. Ng'ura keitoki aailepu laiguanak okuni te Parsia; ore oliong'uan eikarsis alang ninche pooki; ore ake pee egolu te nkaraki karsisisho enye neisisaki ninye ninche pooki metaarare enkitoo oo Lyunani.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa loo menye.

English: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
Masaai: keyooki ake alo enetii ilporori loo loo menye, lelo lemeigil ai kata aadol ewang'an.

English: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
Masaai: Ore too nteipan nerrinyunye ninche, nebuak anaa ildiein neman enkanasa.

English: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
Masaai: tenebo mbaa pooki e nkitoria enye, o mbaa pooki e nkitoria enye, o emagilanisho enye, o mbaa pooki naaetuo shumata ninye o shumata Israel, o shumata nkitoriat pooki oo nkuapi.

English: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu, “Iwa embao dapash ngero too sirat sapuki, ‘Ene Maher-shalal-hash-bas.’ ”

English: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Gad, “Atii nanu atua osina sapuk; matabatatakinoto iyiook enkaina o Laitoriani, amu kitok olng'ur lenye, kake mikincho abatatakino enkaina e tungani.”

English: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
Masaai: o Magdiel, o Imran. Kulo ninche ilarikok le Edom (aa ninye eji Esau, menye le Edom), te risioroto oo manyishoritin enye teina kop nataa enenye.

English: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Benchamen, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore entorroni enkaji e Israel o Yuda netuluso aaku sapuk oleng; eiputa enkop pooki osarge, neiputa enkanasa imbaa nemesipa; amu ejo ninche, ‘Eibayie Olaitoriani enkop, nemedol Olaitoriani.’

English: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
Masaai: Te nemaas isiaaitin e Papa, emikiruk;

English: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore enkaing'urani e kutuk aji negelita enkano, kake eimugo ninye neirura; neaku etasaakinote Rekab o Baana olalashe lenye atua aji.

English: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
Masaai: Naa ore taata nikijoki, “Oo naa pee eitokini ake aajo eitarruoitie ltung'ana?” Ae ng'ae oidim aibooi eyieunoto enye?

English: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
Masaai: Metaa eibung'a ilapolosak o Lawi enkipimore e nkosholai o sahabu o masaa, neyau ninche Yerusalem atua ina aji e Nkai ang.

English: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Sapuk enkisampuare, kake kuti laisiaayiak entoomon naa olopeny enkisampuare meirriu laisiaayiak meetu enkisampuare enye.

English: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
Masaai: o entilagos, o empukunoto e motoroki o lanke, o enagor kewan.

English: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
Masaai: Nejoki ake sii ninye Shekem menye ina tito tenebo ilalashera lenyena, “Nchooki manoto omom te dukuya inkonyek inyi, naa ore pooki nikijokiki intae naa kaishoru.

English: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
Masaai: Kainanu ninche eitagor? Olaitoriani ojo. Aime ate, to lmilo lenye.

English: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche te Sukot neitayu ilng'oborri te Esam, te bayie o lpurkel.

English: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
Masaai: Oo naa taata pee itemiteme intae Enkai, aaiteleiki enchata murto oo lalashera, eneitu eidim iloo papa neitu kindim iyiook aatanap?

English: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
Masaai: Neitadoiki ninye ninche ina pijan e ngoro enye, o engoro, o empushuna, o sina, te nebo entukus oo lmalaika ooidaikie ninche.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Dan naa Buki olayioni le Yogli.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, te neibung oltung'ani ororei lai nemedol ai kata keeya.”

English: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
Masaai: Ore ake pee eyam ninye, neikilikuan Aksa ninye metoomono menye enkop; nedou ninye to sikiria lenye, nejoki Kaleb ninye, “Kainyoo iyieu?”

English: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
Masaai: Ashomo nanu apong'ori anaa enker naimina; ing'oru osinka lino, amu maarikino nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo neijia, nebuaku enkitok nabo ti atua olorora nejoki, “Emayiana sii ake enkoshoke nikitoiwuo o lki likintanaaki.”

English: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kelotu enkata, ore anaa enaing'ura nanu ninche, pee adotu nanang'aa, nainyal nayau entorroni, neijia sii aiko aing'oru ninche pee ashet naun, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
Masaai: “Ore kuna kitanapat naitanapa nanu intae ena olong enchom entisipu entaas, pee itumutumu aatopok niponariri, nipuopuo aaya ina kop nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai pee eisho loo papaai linyi.

English: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
Masaai: neibelekeny esipata too nkiguanat, menyorraa Olaitoriani nena.

English: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i are neitopiu ninye iyiook; ore te nkolong e uni nedumu ninye iyiook maitasheito, pee kitum aataa aikinchu te dukuya ninye.

English: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
Masaai: Nejo Yeroboam to ltau lenye, “Kerrinyunye taata enkitoria alotu enkaji e Daudi,

English: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
Masaai: Entoning pooki tung'ani oitoreisho. Amu meetae enkitoria neme Enkai eing'uaa, ore lelo ooatae naa Enkai naitasheyie.

English: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
Masaai: pee atum atoduaa dupoto e lelo gelunot linono, pee atum ating'idayu te nchipai o losho lino, pee atum ating'idare enjung'ore ino.

English: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
Masaai: Amu eisha enkishui ai to sina, neishunye enkishui ai te nkishirata, eishunye engolon ai te nkaraki osina lai, netororonyate iloik laainei.

English: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
Masaai: Nejoki olapolosani kitok oji Ananias lelo ooitashe aatashare Paulo metooshi enkutuk.

English: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.
