Masaai: Nilo iyie enetii ilo apolosani oasisho teina kata, nijoki ninye, ‘Aibalie nanu ena olong to Laitoriani nchere, atabaua atua ina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papa pee eisho iyiook.’

English: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
Masaai: Esipa nchere nkitanapat naaitaa ltung'ana ooshal lapolosak kituaak, kake ore ilo rorei lo lmumai, otusujua nkitanapat, netegelua ilo Inoti bayaroti obik intarasi.

English: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo Esta? Kainyoo eomonunoto ino? Eikinchori iyie, o metabaiki olpisiai le nkitoria ai.”

English: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
Masaai: ‘Kintaa iyie Olaitoriani olapolosani te rishata e Yehoida ilo apolosani, pee intore enkaji o Laitoriani te pooki ng'ae oata oloirirua oibonisho, apik ninye olpisiai emurt.

English: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Toi olaiguanani le Hamat nchere etimira Daudi enjore pooki e Hadadesa,

English: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
Masaai: Ntagolo nena aik naatalepori, ntasheyie ilo oikirikira te nkuretisho.

English: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
Masaai: Ore ilarripok le kishomi naa nkalifuni ong'uan, naa nkalifuni oong'uan oisis Olaitoriani te nena kinantani naitobira nanu pee eisisieki.”

English: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
Masaai: Ninye otegelaka iyiook enjung'ore ang, ina kishiaa e Yakobo otonyorra ninye.

English: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
Masaai: naa ninche naaidaikie pooki toki nanyori te nkop, neinos ilng'anayio le nkop enye.

English: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
Masaai: Neipang'u; ore ilootaasa isupati nejing empiunoto e nkishui; ore ilootaasa intorrok nejing empiunoto e nkiguana.

English: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkolong e sabato, neim Yesu atua nkurman e nkano. Negilu ilooiteng'eni lenyena lukuny e nkano nepupu too nkaik aanya lanterera.

English: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
Masaai: te nkolong e isiet aatumurataki, nara ololorere loo Siraeli, lo losho le Benchamen, Olhebraniai, ore ti alo nkitanapat nara Olfarisayoi,

English: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Betsheba enetii olaiguanani Solomon, pee eirorie ninye te rishata e Adonija. Nedumunye olaiguanani anang'are ninye, neirrugokino ninye, neitoki aton to lorika lenye le nkitoo, neitoki aipotu olorika meyakini ngotonye olaiguanani, neton ninye te nkaina enye e tatene.

English: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Ore ilo Aitoriani laaitajeuo nanu too loisotok lo lng'atuny o te nkaina o lng'arurumi naa kaaitajeu te nkaina ele Filisti.” Nejoki Saul Daudi, “Shomo, neaku Olaitoriani te nebo iyie.”

English: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
Masaai: Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o Kalebu olayioni le Yefune apa ootii te nebo lelo ooshomo aaikitalan enkop, nepolos ilkilani lenye,

English: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
Masaai: “Ena enkitanapata, o enkikoo o nkiguanat naaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee aiteng'en intae, pee itumutumu aataas teina kop nipuopuo aaya;

English: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yeriko, naa iip uni o artam o imiet.

English: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
Masaai: “Kake tenelotu olapolosani ajurrisho, neitu eibulu ina keeya ina aji ina kata eidipaki aatumur te nturoto, neibalunye olapolosani ina aji ajo meiduruk, amu eishiunyeki ina keeya.

English: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
Masaai: Nekut enkiyang'et enkomom ai, ore ilpapit lo sesen lai neitashe.

English: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, kaing'ae olo aton to lng'obor lino? Kaing'ae olo amany ilo doinyo lino sinyati.

English: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yora naa, iip nabo o tomon oare.

English: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
Masaai: Neiruko Isamaria kumok le ina anasa te nkaraki ororei oishakenoko ina kitok inchere: “Aatolikio nataasa apa pooki.”

English: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
Masaai: Nkilikuana ilbarnot linono, amu eikiliki ninche. Metaa nchoo ilbarnot laainei etum omom too nkonyek inono; amu kipuonu iyiook te nkolong o sirua. Kitoomono iyie, nchoo pooki toki niaata isinkan linono o olayioni lino Daudi.’ ”

English: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, etinyikua peyie aya ina ng'udi e Yosef (ina natii ina aina e Efraim) o iloshon le Israel ooboitare ninye; naitutumoki ninye ina ng'udi e Yuda, naitaa ninche eng'udi nabo peyie etum aataa ninche nabo te nkaina ai.

English: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
Masaai: Ng'ura, Enkai ninye olaretoni lai; Olaitoriani ninye olaibung'ani le nkishui ai.

English: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
Masaai: Ore naa te nkaraki naitamioki Kristo to sesen, enterreten sii intae ate te ina damunoto, amu ore pooki onoto emion to sesen etapala eyasata oo ng'ok,

English: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
Masaai: Ore te nkai kewarie natusujua ina, neitashe Olaitoriani ti alo ninye nejo, “Intagoluoyu, amu ore anaa ina nikinchakenoko nanu te Yerusalem, neijia kiyooki aiko aishakenoki te Roma.”

English: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
Masaai: nedoyio ilo polosie alo olkeju le Yordan, ore enkiting'oto enye nelo aaku Enaiposha e Munyan. Ena ninye nalo aaku enkop inyi emanita ilpolosien pooki.”

English: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
Masaai: Nenyorru Yakobo Raheli, o metejo “Ekaaisiaai iyie ilarin oopishana tenkaraki Raheli ina tito ino kiti.”

English: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
Masaai: Nchoo loreren pooki eiturrurro te nebo, naa iloreren euma te nebo. Kalo tiatua ninche oidim aibalunye ena, neitodol iyiook mbaa e apa? Nchoo ninche eyau enchakenisho enye pee eitisip kuna, naa nchoo ninche ening nejo, Ee ekesipa.

English: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
Masaai: Neitoki sii Yeremia ajoki olaiguanani Sedekia, “Kaa torroni ataasa te iyie aashu too sinkan linono aashu te kulo tung'ana pee kitipika nanu korokoroni?

English: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.
Masaai: Nelotu ina kitok enetii Saul, ore ake pee edol ajo eiputukunyo, nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, kitoning'o iyie esinka ino; aitayio nanu enkishui ai te nkaina ai natoning'o ina nikitiaaka iyie nanu.

English: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
Masaai: neya ingarrin oo mbartan naageluno iip ile o kulie garrin oo mbartan e Misiri ekedito ilkituaak ninche pooki.

English: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
Masaai: Pesho nanu ataara nkera inono, eitu ninche eitoriori, olalem lino kewan oinosa iloibonok linono anaa olng'atuny otupusha.

English: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
Masaai: Netiaakaki apa Yoab, “Ng'ura, eishirita olaiguanani neisina te nkaraki Absalom.”

English: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
Masaai: Ore oltau lo laiguanani naa ereyiet e nkare tiatua enkaina o Laitoriani. Neibelekenyaki ninye pooki wueji neyieu.

English: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.
Masaai: najoki ninche, “Ore iyiook anaa enikindim nikinyiang'utua aarrinyu ilyahudi alashera lang apa ootimirakaki iloreren; kake eji imir iyie ilalashera linono eji pee etumi aatimiraki iyiook!” Etigirate ninche neitu etum ororei owalu.

English: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche enkitamioto oo ntarasi; nejing iltung'ana le Nkai enkishui nemeish.”

English: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kaarrep nanu iyie, Enkai ai, Olaiguanani, naisis enkarna ino ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
Masaai: pee kitum ninche aatureita iyie, nepuo too nkoitoi inono, nkolong'i pooki naaishu teina kop apa ninchoo iloo menye.

English: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
Masaai: Amu ina anasa eanyita naata enkitamanyunoto enaa ore oloshetu o loitobir naa Enkai.

English: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
Masaai: Tujurroki nanu, iyie Enkai, niyiolou oltau lai! Ineneng'aki nanu niyiolou ndamunot aainei!

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa;

English: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aya embata eilata natii oltulet nebukoki endap enye e nkaina e kedienye

English: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
Masaai: ene lelo ootii Betel, o lootii Ramot e Negeb, te Yatir,

English: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
Masaai: Neliki Musa olaputani lenye nena pooki naaitaasa Olaitoriani Farao o Ilmisiri te nkaraki Isiraeli, o sinaitin oogol pooki ooetuo shumata ninche te nkoitoi.

English: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Meremot olayioni le Uria, olayioni le Hakos oitobira enkae rishata, ebaiki kutukaji e nkaji e Eliab o metabaiki enkiting'oto, e nkaji e Eliaship.

English: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
Masaai: “Ng'ura ajo ore tena nimira asipani. Ekaawaliki nanu iyie, aikitok Enkai alang oltung'ani.

English: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
Masaai: Eishopo ninye esipata anaa enkila o lgoo, neishop emaupe e njeunoto ten dukuya enye; neishop ninye ilkilani le lap, neimulumul kewan te mpushuna napi.

English: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
Masaai: Etua apa Eliesa meeta ilayiok, ntoyie ake eeta; ore iltung'ana lenye, lelo ayiok le Kish, neyam ninche.

English: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
Masaai: Torripo enkishui ino ti alo enyorrata oo mpesai aa nchoo kibaiki entoki niaata; amu etejo ninye, “Maapal maadamu nemaaing'uaa.”

English: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa enkiteng'enare tiatua eng'eno nagut, ore emborron nelo te dukuya enkanyit.

English: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
Masaai: Nejo sii kulikae rorei kumok aayietaa ninye neinyal.

English: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tenaa kegol oleng Isiria te nanu, naa eikiretu iyie nanu; kake tenaa kegol oleng Ilamoni te iyie naa kaalotu nanu aretu iyie.

English: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
Masaai: Keitu apa iyiolou ena temusano, anaa apa peyie epiki tung'ani oriong e nkop.

English: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;
Masaai: Neijia eikununo, ore apa pee ening Ilyahudi pooki ootii Moab o atua Ilamoni o atua Edom o atua kulie kuapi nchere etelekua olaiguanani le Babilon olpisiai tiatua Yuda netegelua Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, olayioni le Shafan aitaa olbalusui te shumata ninche.

English: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
Masaai: Kake etiakitia iltung'ana le Israel lelo Hafi, “Ebaiki naa atua iyiook intae itii; kaji naa kinko iyiook ti nikintobir olning'o o intae?”

English: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
Masaai: Neisho Enkai ina kata Abraham olkerreti le muratare. Abraham Isaak, nemurat te nkolong e isiet; Neiu Isaak Yakobo, neiu Yakobo lelo loo papa pokira tomon o aare.

English: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
Masaai: ‘Aing'ae doi italang'a iyie te nkishiaa? Shomo abori, nikirragieki iyie tenebo ilememurata.’

English: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu kake eitu aning'u ayiolou. Najo nanu, “Olaitoriani lai, kainyoo akenya epuo kuna baa aaku.”

English: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
Masaai: Ore akenya te nena olong'i neitajeuni Yuda nebik Yerusalem te seriani. Naa ena arna kenya eipotieki: ‘Olaitoriani esupatisho ang.’

English: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
Masaai: Amu iyiololo, enkisilisiloto o morot nikinoto te Filipi, neme toki amu eishoo iyiook Enkai empijan nikilikinye intae Ilomon Supati, hoo netii kesha sapuk.

English: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro e Balak ti alo Balaam, neosh ninye nkaik, neitoki Balak ajoki Balaam, “Aaipotuo nanu iyie pee ilotu adek ilmang'ati laainei, naa ng'ura, itamayiana iyie ninche kuna katitin pokira uni.

English: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna baa nelotu Yesu o looiteng'eni lenyena enkop e Yudea, nebik te ine te nebo ninche olorere.

English: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
Masaai: Ore apa enkapiani enye natii Shekem neiu sii ninye olayioni, neji enkarna enye Abimelek.

English: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Etabawua enkata pee eilepie iyiook Olaitoriani enkilepioto ang, wou, maibalunye iyiook tiatua Sion esiaai o Laitoriani Enkai ang.

English: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
Masaai: Amu ejo ninche, “Keiroishi mpala e Paulo negol, kake te ning'or ninye mijo hoo toki naa ore te neiro neme hoo nyoo ninye.”

English: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Aing'ae olo alej Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, pee etum ninye ashomo atabatatayu te Ramot-gilead?’ Nejo obo embae nabo, nejo olikae enkae.

English: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
Masaai: Nerikoki ninche Yesu olapolosani kitok, netumo lapolosak pooki kituaak o lpayiani o lasirak.

English: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
Masaai: Ee, aikununo nanu anaa oltung'ani ming'ani lemetii enkutuk enye ilomon torrok.

English: Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo aajo iyiook ooyooki aaiguanare lmalaika, tapala duoo iyie noshi ake baa pooki e nkishon?

English: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Ore eton eiguanare kuna baa, ng'ura neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani te nkidetidet, nejoki, “Yosef, olayioni le Daudi, miureyu irik esiankiki ino Mariamu, amu ore enutai naata ninye, naa ene Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
Masaai: Te naa keidimayu, paa intae etioorie, entotoni te seriani o pooki ng'ae.

English: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
Masaai: Nkirikirayu na kop, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya e Nkai e Yakobo,

English: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
Masaai: Ore apa ilarikok loo ltung'ana netoni te Yerusalem; ore ilkulikae tung'ana, neosh enkukuo, pee eyau oltung'ani obo te tomon meeu amany Yerusalem ina anasa sinyati, nebik lelo ooudo te kulie ang'itie.

English: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
Masaai: Ore pee ening iltung'ana pooki o loosotu kodi neitadedeyie Enkai amu eibatisaki te nkibatisare e Yohana.

English: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani oripaki erashe nemenota enkila musana; amu te neripaki, neng'erunye ina ng'ejuk te idia musana, nejarari eng'erata.

English: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
Masaai: pee etum Olaitoriani aitabai ina apa nairoro tialo nanu ejo, ‘Teneing'or ilayiok linono nkoitoi enye, aapuo te dukuya nanu too sipat, too ltauja lenye pooki o te nkishui enye, melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo too Siraeli’.

English: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
Masaai: ore Asaria olayioni le Hoshaiai o Yohanan olayioni le Karea o ltung'ana pooki oowuasa nejoki Yeremia, “Elejare iyie ijoito. Eitu iyie kirriu Olaitoriani Enkai ang tejo, ‘Emipuo intae Misiri aatoni teine.’

English: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
Masaai: Nejoki Tomas oji Olmaoi lkulikae ooiteng'eni, “Emaape sii yiook pee kiye te nebo ninye.”

English: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
Masaai: Nintoki aibung ina wiki oo wikii to Laitoriani Enkai, too nkishorot o lpela naaing'uaa enkaina ino, ninchooyo iyie anaa enikitamayiana Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
Masaai: Naa kaitame nanu ninye o eishoi enye o sinkan lenyena tenkaraki entorroni enye; kayau nanu shumata ninche, o shumata lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o shumata ilewa le Yuda, ina torroni pooki natudung'oko nanu ninche, kake mening ninche.’ ”

English: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
Masaai: Neitaaki taata intae sidain te nkaraki o rorei latiaaka intae.

English: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilkarash loo lpapit loo nkineji te nkaraki olng'obor meitushura enkaji e Nkai; neitayu ninye ilkarash tomon o obo.

English: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaigil aas entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani; neitagol Olaitoriani Eglon olaiguanani le Moab metaarare Israel, enkaraki nataasa ninche entorroni too nkonyek o Loitoriani.

English: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootadoikitio atua lkiku naa lelo ooning;

English: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
Masaai: Atuturuo ilchorroi naok nkariak enkop eeiking'a, naaituny nanu too nkejek aainei nchorroi pooki neelepo e Misiri.”

English: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
Masaai: Ore Esra ilo apolosani neyau nena kitanapat dukuya ina umata, oo lewa o ng'oruo, o lelo pooki ooidim aatoning neyiolou, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana.

English: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
Masaai: Neaku nkera enye apa etudumua ninye te rishata enye, ninche etumurata Yoshua; amu memurata apa, enkaraki neitu apa emurati ninche te nkoitoi.

English: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
Masaai: tadamu inapa baa e apa musan; amu ara Olaitoriani nemeetae likae; ara nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae laanyaanyukie,

English: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
Masaai: Ainyoo eeta oltung'ani too siaitin o enauri natum easisho tiabori enkolong?

English: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
Masaai: Eisupat ilo tung'ani oasisho te leng'on neishooyo te sile, ilo oas mbaa enyena too sipat.

English: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
Masaai: Te nepuo atua olng'obor le ntumo, arashu te nepuonu embata o lperere lo lasar aaisiaisho, aapejoki Olaitoriani olasar te nkima, neitukuo ninche te nkare, meye ake.

English: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
Masaai: Ina pee ayieu oleng naliki sii ninche intae Ilomon Supati ti atua Roma.

English: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Herode Yesu, neshipa oleng, amu keyieu apa nedol te nkata naado, amu ketoning'o imbaa enyena, nejo sii pee edol neas embae e nking'asia.

English: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
Masaai: Anaa Yanes o Yampres ootanyaita enatejo Musa, neijia sii etiu kulo tung'ana ootanyaita esipata, iltung'ana ootarruoitie ndamunot ninche.

English: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
Masaai: Neipot Enkai ewang'an ajo endama, neipot enaimin ajo enkewarie. Neaku eetae enteipa o entadekenya enkolong e dukuya.

English: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eyiolou Daniel nchere etipikaki olmishire ina naimieki nelo ninye enkaji enye ebolo ildirishani le nkaji e shumata eing'orita Yerusalem; negil ninye kung katitin uni te nkolong neomon neishooyo enashe te dukuya Enkai enye, anaa apake enataasa.

English: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
Masaai: Ore hoo naata nkumok naaigeroki, mayieu naasishore enkardasi o lbukoi, kake kaisilig ajo kalotu adol intae nairorie intae inotote nkomoni, pee elulung'ayu eng'ida ang.

English: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kohat naa: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron, o Usiel, lelo pokira oong'uan.

English: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
Masaai: Neitayiolo Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninye nchere meye eitu edol Kristo lo Laitoriani.

English: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
Masaai: Enkitanapata nabo ake eetae to inoti o to ltung'ani omoni oton ti atua intae.”

English: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
Masaai: Kake eshomo ake duoo ninche eneika te ina kop oo ldoinyo, hoo neitu eipang osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, o Musa aaing'uaa ilng'oborri.

English: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho e lelo le meeta entioto neitaa enkoitoi enye enaitoriori, kake ore oltorrono nerrek intorrok enyena.

English: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee epuo ninche aanukaa ninye, neitu edol toki meteleku ake endukuya o nkejek, o ndapi oo nkaik.

English: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
Masaai: “Tenipuopuo kenya aajing ina kop niunuunu mpukunot pooki oo lkeek te nkaraki endaa, niyiolouu lelo ng'anayio lenye aajo etomitikioki intae ilarin okuni, minosinoso ninche.

English: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
Masaai: ore endukuya enye o lpapit lenyena naa keibor anaa lpapit loo ntare, neibor anaa enturoto, netiu nkonyek enyena anaa olng'ejep le nkima,

English: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Kaing'ae likintaa iyie olkitok o larishani te iyiook? Ijo pee kiar nanu matua anaa enitaara Olmisiri metua?” Neirut Musa, nejo, “Esipa etayioloki ena bae.”

English: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
Masaai: Etipika ninche orreshet nkejek aainei; neirrugi oltau lai aaing'orie enkop. Etuturutuo ninche engumoto te nkoitoi ai, kake etusulakinote ninche maate.

English: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, ore te ina olong naya aitung'uaa ninche isempewueti lenye, enchipai enye, o enkitoo enye, o enchipai oo nkonyek enye o iyieunot oo ltauja lenye, tenebo sii ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye,

English: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Aron, lelo apolosak, lelo apa ootii enkop namanya pooki ng'ae, o nkanas enye netii iltung'ana ootii atua kulie anas ootegelakaki too nkarn, pee eoriki irubat pooki lee tiatua ilapolosak, o pooki tung'ani tiatua Ilawi apa ooigeroki enkarna enye.

English: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
Masaai: Ore te nkutuk ai kaisho Olaitoriani enashe sapuk; kaisis nanu ninye ti atua eumata.

English: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Neinos Manase Efraim, neinos Efraim Manase, ore ninche pokira nedumakino Yuda. Ore te kuna pooki neitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye, Neitorioki enkaina enye.

English: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
Masaai: Amu kabukoki nanu enkare ina kop e nkure, napik nkonyek oo nkariak ina kop natoyio; kabukoki nanu Enkiyang'et ai shumata eishoi inyi, nabukoki imayianat aainei eishoi inyi.

English: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau, neinepu etooroki neikodi,

English: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, toning'o; Olaitoriani tapalaki iyiook; Olaitoriani toning'o iyiook niasisho; mimutie, te nkaraki kewan ino, na Ai ai, ore te nkaraki ena anasa ino o ltung'ana linono naa enkarna ino eipotieki.”

English: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
Masaai: Mincho oltung'ani hoo obo kimenu te nkaraki kitisho ino, kake intoduaa ilairukok enkitanyaanyukoto ti atua enkiroroto o to lkuaak, ti atua enyorrata, ti atua enkirukoto, o ti atua esinyatisho.

English: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
Masaai: Kaanyu nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye oisudoo enkomom enye aitung'uaa enkaji e Yakobo, naa kaisilig ninye.

English: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
Masaai: “Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, irorie enkaji e Israel nijoki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ake sii, nena ae toki naatamorie iloo papaai linyi, amu eitarruoitie ninche te dukuya nanu.

English: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaa intae iututu pee kiwaliki ele orere laatiaakitia nanu, ‘Nteneneng'a ina shata oo murto apa natipika papaai lino shumata iyiook?’ ”

English: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Sibeon: Ayia, o Ana, Ana apa ilo onoto inchorroi nairowua tiong'ota, eirrita isirkon le Sibeon papaai lenye.

English: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
Masaai: Ore atua enkoitoi oo sipat ninye etii enkishui, kake ore enkoitoi enkiminata nelo keeya.

English: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
Masaai: “Naa ti nieniene ate aapukoo, emitiu anaa isunkuro oosot inkomomi, amu keidisie ninche inkomomi enye, pee edol iltung'ana aajo etupukoitie. Esipa ajoki intae, eidipa aanoto shunet enye.

English: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
Masaai: Enino sii ena, ilo asar loo nkishorunot enye, ore lelo asarri pooki ooyuki loo ltung'ana le Israel; aaishoo nanu iyie ninche, o layiok linono o ntoyie inono te nebo iyie, metaa erubata ino e anaake. Ore pooki ng'ae le meeta entioto otii atua enkaji ino neidim ainosa.

English: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
Masaai: “Kake aitiaji etumi engeno nagut? Naa koree ewueji ening'unoto?

English: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
Masaai: O lng'anayio le dukuya le ntapa ino, o le naisho ino oo sabibu o le ilata ino, o lpapit le nkiterata oobarnuni te nker ino, nchoo ninye.

English: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
Masaai: Negiroo artam ilooinosa ina kiguana o kiguan enkarruesho.

English: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
Masaai: Keokisho ninye too nchorroi naatii embata e nkoitoi; ore enkaraki ina keraposhu ninye endukuya enye.

English: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.
Masaai: Nerik Samuel Saul o ilo sinka lenye neyau ninche atua aji* neisho ninche ewueji te dukuya lelo pooki ooitoomonoki, nebaya apa lelo tung'ana tomoni uni.

English: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
Masaai: Kuna apa njung'oreitin naaishooyie Musa too nkisiajat e Moab, te lido kekun le Yordan te nkalo o loo saen le Yeriko.

English: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
Masaai: Nejoki Rabshake ninche, “Entiaaki Hesekia, ‘Nji ejo olaiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria: ‘Kainyoo iyie ingarakino?

English: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena neitaa ninye Enkai kitok oleng, neisho ninye enkarna nalang inkarn pooki,

English: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
Masaai: Ee, te nkaraki enkorrok ino pee eari iyiook endama pooki, neikoni iyiook anaa nkerra naayieng'i.

English: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
Masaai: Ting'idayu ti atua Olaitoriani, iyie ilo ora asipani, nincho enashe enkarna enye sinyati.

English: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
Masaai: A'a, ore te kuna pooki kisulie kimirisho aaisulie te nkaraki ilo otonyorra iyiook.

English: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, aaibung'a nanu enkaina naaikirikirie nanu nkaik aainei o nkung.

English: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
Masaai: “Aing'ae ele oitomisimis enkikoo too rorei lemetii eng'eno?

English: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
Masaai: Neany nerik apik korokoroni metaba anaa nelak esile pooki.

English: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, eidipa atoorori Lot ainguaa ninye, “Taraposhu inkonyek inono ing'ura aiteru teine nitii, moikuape, o kopikop o loo saen o oloo ntoluo.

English: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo aisiaayiani le Musa, obo le lelo tung'ana oogeluno, nejo, “Olkitok lai Musa, tomitiki ninche.”

English: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
Masaai: Irorei le Yeremia, olayioni le Hilkia, loo lapolosak apa ootii Anatot tiatua enkop e Benchamen,

English: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
Masaai: Nekuetiki nkejek enye enkarrueisho, neisarisaraki aaibukoo osarge lemeeta entioto; ore ndamunot enye naa ndamunot e nkarruoisho, eliyio o enkidaata naatii nkoitoi enye.

English: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo ojoki enchata, inyo; nejoki osoit lemeiro, tudumunye! Ng'ura etumuraki ninye te sahabu o te nkosholai, kake metii enkiyang'et tukul atua ninye.

English: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki apa ooikenaki too le Lawi, laa ninche apa eikena Musa o Aron te nkitanapata o Laitoriani, anaa too lmareita, ore ilewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni tikitam o are.

English: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip ninye airoro, nenang'aa ilo tagiligili lo sikiria te nkaina enye; neji apa enkarna e ine wueji Ramat-lehi.

English: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.
Masaai: Neitoki Saul ajo, “Endapashaki ate atua olorere, nijokiki ninche, ‘Nchoo pooki tung'ani meyau olkiteng lenye arashu enker enye, neyieng ninche tene, nenya; nimiasiasa eng'oki to Laitoriani aanya nkiri te nebo osarge.’ ” Neaku eyaua pooki tung'ani olkiteng lenye te nebo ninye ina kewarie apa, neyieng ninche te ine.

English: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
Masaai: Newaliki aajoki, “Ejo Yohana Olaibatisani, nejo kulikae, Eliya; nejo kulikae ira obo loo loibonok li apa otopiwuo.”

English: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
Masaai: Nedumunye isinkan lenyena aarreshisho, near Yoash metua te nkaji e Milo teina oitoi nadoyio alo Sila.

English: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
Masaai: Nepuo too nkisudorot aarop iltung'ana ooetuo aajo, “Kitoning'o ninye eiro amor Musa, nemor Enkai.”

English: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
Masaai: Newaliki Pilato, “Kara nanu Olyahudi? Olorere lino o lapolosak kituaak likiyakita nanu. Kaa itaasa iyie?”

English: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
Masaai: Metamayiani eng'eno ino, naa mikitamayiani iyie, aa iyie nikimbooyie nanu ena olong te nkibukoroto o sarge o te nkitalakunoto elap te nkaina ai makewan!

English: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
Masaai: Nadol, naa ng'ura, embarta naibor, neeta ilo okedito enkawuo, o enkopiyia e nkitoo naishooki ninye, neipang alo.

English: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
Masaai: Itapalaitie intae inkitanapat e Nkai, nikurrakiki aaibung inkoon oo ltung'ana.’ ”

English: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
Masaai: Enkerai ai, tenaa aing'en oltau lino, naa keshipa sii ninye oltau lai;

English: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye nedumunye Yair, ilo le Gilead, laa ninye apa otaa olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam oare.

English: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
Masaai: Eishooyie ninye pesho, eishoo ninye ilo aisinani; kebikoo esipata enye ntarasi; keishur emowuo enye te nkisisa.

English: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu enetii ilkulikae ooiteng'eni, nedol emanita olorere kitok, neishankarrarre ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ninche.

English: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
Masaai: Ejo Abadon o keeya, ‘Kitoning'o iyook olmarenke too nkiyiaa ang.’

English: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
Masaai: Keish shumata o enkop kake meish irorei laainei katukul.

English: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
Masaai: Te Silvano, olalashe laaijo nanu eisiligayu, atisiraka intae ena kiti palai, pee aruj intae naishakenoki intae inchere empiris e Enkai ena nasipa. Entasho emiwuatiwuata ti atua Ninye.

English: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Sofa: Sua, o Harnefen o Shual, o Beri, o Imra,

English: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
Masaai: nemajo kara hoo ng'ae likilotu anang'are: kake ororei doi ake tejo neishiu osinka lai.

English: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Ena apa esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel, nkalifuni iip ile o obo o iip naapishana o tomoni uni.

English: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
Masaai: Nejoki menye, “Shomo.” Neisho ninye meshomo ilapaitin oare; nelo ninye ina tito, ninye o encholuek enye, nelo aishiraki titoisho enye too nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
Masaai: Neiteru Yona alo atua ina anasa, nelo elototo e nkolong nabo. Neishir ninye ajo, “Nkolong'i artam ake naangor pee eidaikieki Ninawi!”

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kalo nanu anapa pee alo olarrabal, kake nchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli anapa nelo olarrabal.

English: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
Masaai: amu eton intae eitu ipuonunu ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata oina jung'ore naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
Masaai: Niaas iyie nkitoduaat o mbaa e nking'asia agilunore Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki o ltung'ana pooki le nkop enye. Amu iyiolo iyie ajo etaasa apa ninche mbaa e nkinyala too loo papa, nintobiraki iyie kewan enkarna, anaa enatiu taata.

English: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Ore Nob ina ang oo lapolosak, near ninye to lalem; ilewa o nkituaak, nkera o naanakita, ilmong'i, isirkon o nkerra, near to lalem.

English: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
Masaai: Amaa ena mayianata ei loo murata ake ootum, anaa ketum sii ninche ilememurata? Kijo iyiook, eikenakaki Abraham esupatisho te nkirukoto.

English: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejoki, “Kaisikua nanu aing'uaa ilng'oborri le Israel.”

English: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
Masaai: nikitum naa Olaitoriani Enkai ino aing'urrie iyie, niking'il aiturrur iyie aitung'uaa lelo oreren pooki apa likindapashaka Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
Masaai: neirriwaa olaiguanani olkilikuai aipotu Shimei, nejoki ninye “Keitu apa nanu aainosie iyie olmumai to Laitoriani, naairorie oleng aikok ajoki, ‘Tayiolo ntisipa nchere ore akenya enkolong nilo ake ninye dikae wueji, niye iyie?’ Nikijoki iyie nanu, ‘Ore enitejo naa eisidai; kairuk nanu.’

English: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
Masaai: Ore pee kidumunye te ine, nikiyooki aapuonu te ntaaisere o maipirare Kios, ore te nkolong nasuju nikintashe peno te Samo, ore te nkae olong nikipuonu Mileto.

English: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
Masaai: Naa ore ina naitopiwuo aitung'uaa ilootuata, nemeitoki naa ai kata arrinyokino erruorroto, eiroro nejo, ‘Ekaaisho iyie ilo sinyati imayianat naadede e Daudi.’

English: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
Masaai: Neaku etejo Saul, “Eyautu ilo asar opejori ene natii, o ilo asar le seriani.” Neitayu ninye olasar opejori.

English: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam oobo apa Sedekia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem.

English: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
Masaai: Nening Adonija o lomon pooki ootii tenebo ninye ina shipai o osirua. Ore pee ening Yoab oltoilo le ntarumpeta nejo, “Kainyoo ele odoo te nkanasa?”

English: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
Masaai: Eisudoitie lelo oowuasa oreshet te nkaraki nanu, neitoluaa ninche too nkeenta orreshet, ore te mbata e nkoitoi aatipikakita ninche orreshet.

English: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
Masaai: Naa oloo larin tomoni uni apa Daudi pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilarin artam.

English: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae loo Lkohat oora iloo lmareita loo Lkohat loo Lawi, ore apa nkanas naatoorikiaki ninche naa olosho le Efraim eing'uaa.

English: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
Masaai: Kaing'ae Olaiguanani le nkitoo? Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye Olaiguanani le nkitoo!

English: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
Masaai: Koree enkapune oo lng'atunyo ina apune oo lkuoo loo lng'atunyo ine neyau olng'atuny engues natara, ine netii nkiyioitin enyena nemeeta entoki naitanyamal?

English: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
Masaai: Ore te ina olong neirorie Olaitoriani Musa te nkop e Misiri,

English: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
Masaai: Enemeneng'a, ina kitok olupi, enkop naata anaake enkure eyieu enkare, o enkima nemejo aekata “Ataraposhe.”

English: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Nanu Yohana olalashe linyi ong'arie intae ti atua Yesu, osina o enkitoo o eng'iriata o enkisulata, atii apa lemankale le naiposha oji Patmos te nkaraki ororei le Enkai o enchakenisho e Yesu.

English: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
Masaai: Neanyita apa lelo tung'ana pee etum ororei supat, netum ninche nabo kata to laiguanani, nejo ninche, “Ee olalashe lino Benhadad.” Neitoki ninye ajo, “Enchom entoriku ninye.” Nelotu Benhadad enetii ninye, neisho ninye metijing'a engarri oo mbartan.

English: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
Masaai: Metaa atejo, “Maaku nanu olchekut linyi. Ore ilo oye inchoo eye; ore ina namuta inchoo emuta; ore lelo ootelekutua nchoo eidaikie iseseni loo lkulikae maate.”

English: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol enkitok ilo shani ajo sidai te ndaa, naa olchani sii oitiship inkonyek, naa olchani sii onguarrayu oiteng'en oltung'ani neitayu olng'anayioi lenyena neinos; neisho sii olpayian lenye embata, neinos ninye.

English: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham neirrugo te dukuya lelo Hiti oopeny enkop.

English: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
Masaai: Wootu, ematimir ninye aamiraki kulo tungana le Ishmael, nimikincho inkaik ang ebaiki ninye, amu olalashe lang ninye, olo sarge lang.” Nenyorraa ilalashera ina natejo.

English: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna, enyaaka abik nkolong'i kumok etulusoitie nena, neitanapare lalashera, neked emeli alo Siria, neiriamariyie Prisila o Akuila. Netabarnoki te Kenkrea: amu einosa olmumai.

English: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
Masaai: Nejokini, “Ira ng'ae, pee kitum ewalata nikiyaki lelo ooirriutua iyiook? Aijo iyie aa te nkaraki enkorrok ino?”

English: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon neishoo enjore enye metaasisho oleng earare Turo, ore pooki dukuya netabarnoki ore pooki oililai netujutoki aasip; ore ake eyia eitu hoo etum ninye arashu enjore enye ae toki naing'uaa Turopeyie elak ina siaai nataasa earare ninye.

English: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Neaku neijia etiu Esekiel te iyie aaku olmonekie; terisioroto e nena pooki naataasa ias sii iyie. Ore peyie elotu ena naa iyiolouu taa aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai!’

English: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
Masaai: naa kedung ninye iltauja le lelo kituaak, ilo laa ninye eure ilaiguanak pooki le nkop.

English: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
Masaai: Etaana Olaitoriani te pooki ooipot ninye, te pooki ooipot ninye te sipata.

English: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
Masaai: o Dedan, Tema, o Busi, o pooki oo dung ilpijat loo lpapit lenye;

English: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
Masaai: ina kata eranyisho ilakir le ntadekenya tenebo, nebuaku inkera pooki e Nkai te nchipai?

English: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
Masaai: Neaku kejo ninche kuna olong'i Purim, aaitusuj ilo rorei oji Pur. Metaa ore te nkaraki nena pooki naaigeroki tena palai, o nena naatadua tena bae, o te nena naaetuo atua ninche.

English: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: aomon impala lelo ooitore nkajijik e ntumo te Dameski, paa te netum iloosujita ina Oitoi te ine, neidim atipika nkaik, aa lewa o aa nkituaak, neriku Yerusalem eena.

English: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Musa airoro kulo rorei pooki te Israel pooki,

English: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
Masaai: Amu eibelekenyate ninche aany esuj ninye nemeikenaa hoo enkoitoi enye nabo,

English: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
Masaai: Kinteleikitia sii ate olola pee kintalak ate te pooki ari erubata e uni e shekeli te nkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai.

English: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
Masaai: Ore pee miaakuku iloo wuasa te ng'eno inyi, ayieu niyiolouu ena naisudoro, ilalashera laainei, nchere einepua engoloto ae shoto e Israel, o metaba anaa neiputayu esiana oo Loreren oopuonu,

English: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
Masaai: ilo ojoki ewueji negut, ‘Toyio, kaitoi nanu ilkejek linono’;

English: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,
Masaai: Ore eton eitu elo Isaya aipang to lgoriet le polos, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii nejoki,

English: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go again to his own place, that it slay us not, and our people: for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city; the hand of God was very heavy there.

Masaai: Ore kulo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal, neishopo iruparen, nepuonu Hebron eeta eyieunoto pee eitaa Daudi olaiguanani le Israel pooki. Neijia sii apa etiu ilkulikae tung'ana le Israel, etumuta nabo pee eitaa Daudi olaiguanani.

English: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
Masaai: Ore to lapa liare, te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan naa keibung; keinos ninche tenebo imukateni neitu eisuishieki, o mbenek naadua.

English: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
Masaai: paa ore too lporori oopuonu netum aitoduaai eneba enkarsisisho e mpiris enye nemetemayu te nanai e nkoshoke enye ti alo iyiook ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women unto the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:
Masaai: Negelu olaiguanani ilaitasheikinok too loshon pooki le nkitoria enye, pee eiturrurru ntoyie pooki sidain meshomo enkaji oo nkituaak te Susa te ina ang kitok netoni ti abori enkirrita e Hegai ilo sunash ogelema lo laiguanani laa ninye olaing'urani loo nkituaak; nchoo meishori ninche iila enye.

English: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
Masaai: Teneitanyamal oltung'ani osarge le ilo tung'ani apa otara, inchoo ninye elimana o metua naa inchoo melo ake oltung'ani hoo obo aretu ninye.

English: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
Masaai: Nintisiny iyie ninche pee etum aataa sinyat tukul. Ore pooki naiseyie ninye neaku sinyati.

English: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Enchom entoliki Yohana kuna nitoduaa o nitoning'o; etodolishote ilmodook, nepuo lmaiman, neishiunyeki aasik iloota enkeeya oo lbolot, nening'ishoyu lming'anta, neitopiuni ilootuata, nelikini laisinak ororei supat,

English: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
Masaai: Ore te nejoki intae oltung'ani, ‘Oo pee inkoko inji?’ Entejo, ‘Olkitok oatayie enkolat naa keshuku ene nabo kata.’ ”

English: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
Masaai: “Nintoki ayau oloing'oni dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo. Neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya e ilo oing'oni,

English: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
Masaai: Kake tenetii ina kurroto e ndukuya aashu ina kurroto enkalo enkomom oloti pepedoi onyokie neibor, naa enkeeya oo lbolot natijing'a enkurroto enye e ndukuya aashu ina kurroto enye enkalo enkomom.

English: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
Masaai: Entagolie ate maate o ina luaata pooki naitaa intae Enkiyang'et Sinyati ilaing'urak lenye, aaitoti esirit e Nkai nainyiang'aka ninye kewan to sarge lenye.

English: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: eitu intae inosinoso imukateni neitu intae iokioko enaisho aashu enaitemerisho; pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
Masaai: o Abishua, o Naaman, o Ahoa, o

English: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
Masaai: “Ore lelo tung'ana le Rode netaasa biashara tenebo intae; iloomanaa loo naaiposha iwuejitin inyi nimirishorere, eyakita intae te laata ilala loo lkanchaoni o nkeek oltiasika.

English: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Kibsa-im te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Bet-horon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
Masaai: Emisilig kulo rorei le lejare: ‘Enkaji Olaitoriani ena, enkaji Olaitoriani, enkaji o Laitoriani.’

English: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
Masaai: Te neetae oltung'ani ojo keeta ninye olkilikuai le Nkai aashu ejo keeta nkishorot e nkiyang'et, entiaaki ore kuna naigeroki intae, Olaitoriani oitanapishe.

English: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
Masaai: Tinimiata entoki nilakie, ainyoo doi pee inyorraa meewai endapash ino?

English: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
Masaai: Ore ilojong'a ootuata neidim aitong'ua eilata narropil. Naa ore enkiti modai neidimu eng'eno nagut o enkanyit.

English: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Akish, “Kake kaa nanu ataasa? Kainyoo iyie inoto to sinka lino ebaiki enkolong apa natijing'a enkisiaayiare ino o taata, nchere malo nanu aarare ilmang'ati lo kitok lai olaiguanani?”

English: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
Masaai: neaku, ing'ura, ekayau nanu ilomon atua iyie lelo ooitureisho oleng loo loreren, naa keshutu ninche ilalema lenye aarare esidano eng'eno ino nagut neisarkionie esikar ino.

English: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: “Eti sii Elam ine, nemanita ninye olorora lenye pooki enkurare enye; netaraki pooki, aabatat to lalem, lelo lememurata ooshomo atua olodo le nkop, lelo oidapashaa olkirutoto teina kop oo loishu, neya enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oopuo abori eng'umoto.

English: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kedolu batisho neisudoo kewan; kake ore olmodai naa kelo dukuya netum enkitamioto.

English: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
Masaai: Amu keponikini ilo oata aaisho kulie; ore ilo lemeeta, neoruni ina naata.”

English: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, madung'oo nanu enkitoria pooki; kake kaisho nanu olosho obo olayioni lino, tenkaraki Daudi osinka lai, o tenkaraki Yerusalem naa ninye ategelua.”

English: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
Masaai: Embalunye engolon e Nkai, ilo otii enkidimata enye shumata Israel, netii engolon enye atua nkatampo.

English: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
Masaai: Entulusoi enchom Tarshishi, enteyietu enchira, intae lelo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha.

English: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests garments.
Masaai: te risioroto e nkidimata enye eishorutua ninche aapik olchumati le siaai nkiloi iip imiet e sahabu, o nkiloi nkalifuni are o ntomoni isiet e nkosholai, o lkilani iip nabo loo lapolosak.

English: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
Masaai: Neya Samuel emowuo e ilata nebukoki ninye eilata aput te mpolos oo lalashera lenyena; nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata Daudi ebaiki ina olong neito dukuya. Nedumunye Samuel nelo Rama.

English: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.
Masaai: Neipotisho Olaitoriani ajo, “Samuel! Samuel!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu!”

English: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
Masaai: Ore lasotok le kodi o laasak loo ng'ok neaku kepuonu aanyikaki aainining.

English: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
Masaai: Ituroyie iyie isunta enyena pooki; intomijoono iyie lelo sempewueti lenyena.

English: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
Masaai: Etoning'o ninye ilo toilo leina tarumpeta, neitu esuj ina naitayioloki ninye; ekeaku etii osarge lenye shumata enkorrok enye. Kake tenetusuja ina naitayioloki, anaata eitajeuo enkishui enye.

English: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
Masaai: Meetae oloton ti atua ninye oas ng'ok, nemeetae oloas ng'ok etoduaa ninye aashu otayiolo ninye.

English: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
Masaai: Ore Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore neya ninche, neyau ninche enetii olaiguanani le Babilon te Ribla.

English: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Ninye kilikioo, kinkok pooki tung'ani nikinteng'en pooki tung'ani te ng'eno pooki, peyie kitum aaitarasai pooki tung'ani etabayie ti atua Kristo.

English: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
Masaai: Niariara metua ilo aishoroni le nkishui. Kake eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata, nikira iyiook lchakenini le ina bae.

English: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
Masaai: Enoo motonyi te risioroto oo mpukunot enye enoo ng'uesi te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, enoo naaiserpepiari te risioroto e mpukunoto enye. Ejing maare anaa impukunot enye enitii, peyie iramat meye.

English: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
Masaai: Kake ore nena kera inyi apa nitejo kearari kaitijing nanu ina kop, naa kepuo ninche aayiolou ina kop apa nitemenaitie.

English: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.
Masaai: Kake ore eutaroto ai naa nchere pee kinturrurrokino iyie Israel pooki, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, eba anaa osinyai le naiposha te nkumoi naa nchere, mirikoo iyie makewan olarrabal.

English: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Sebulon Eliab olayioni le Helon;

English: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
Masaai: Neishiu nabo kata ilo tung'ani, nedumu erruat enye nelo. Naa enkolong e sabato apa ina olong.

English: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
Masaai: Orreshet to ltung'ani te nesioki ajo, “Aisinyati Olasar”, neitoki ake asipu eidipa ainosa olmumai lenye.

English: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
Masaai: Neirorie olosho le Yosef Yoshua, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee kinchoo nanu erubata nabo o eoroti nabo metaa enjung'ore, hoo nara olosho loo ltung'ana kumok, naatamayiana nanu Olaitoriani aiko nji?”

English: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
Masaai: Ore apa te ina kata nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Ntobira nkalema oo soito oogol pee intoki amurat iltung'ana le Israel enkata e are.”

English: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
Masaai: Kake ore pee eirrash kewan nejo, ‘Kaja pasa laisiaayiak le papa ooata endaa nanya neleku, kake eji nanu ele oya olameyu te ne!

English: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
Masaai: Eishooyo oltung'ani obo pesho, ore ake sii neitoki aponaa e enkarsisisho; ore olikae neibok ina naishiakino neishooyo, nenyamalu oleng te yieunoto sapuk.

English: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Masaai: Nchoo siaake iyiook eretoto te nkaraki ilmang'ati lang, amu ene pesho eretoto e tung'ani!

English: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
Masaai: Nejo Ilyahudi, “Kear kewan? Amu etejo, ‘Ore enalo nanu nimindimidimi aaetu’?”

English: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
Masaai: Neshaiki enchan e shumata enkop inkolong'i artam o nkewaritin artam.

English: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
Masaai: Ara apa nanu o loo larin artam ina kata apa pee aairriwaa nanu Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te Kadesh-Barnea mashomo aikitalan enkop; naitoki nanu arrinyoki ninye olomoni anaa apa enatiu ti atua oltau lai.

English: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
Masaai: Ore pee kijing empeut te Troas, nikipolos aaitoriokino Samotrake, nikiyiooki te ntaaisere aapuo Neapolis;

English: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltimito Edom; ore atua Edom pooki nepik iltimito, lelo le Edom pooki isinkan le Daudi. Neishoo Olaitoriani Daudi metimirisho te pooki wueji neba anaa eneshomo.

English: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol ninye olmishire li oong'uan, naning oltoilo le ina ng'ues e ong'uan naishu ejo, “Wou!”

English: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
Masaai: Ore ewang'an oo loo sipat neshipa, kake ore oltaa loo ltorrok naa keari.

English: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
Masaai: kake esipa ore anaa enaishu nanu, o anaa sii enabore enkop pooki enkitoo enkisisa o Laitoriani,

English: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
Masaai: Iyiolou iyie ina kata ajo keserian olng'obor lino, naa ijur intare inono netii pooki elulung'a.

English: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
Masaai: Too larin artam nanu aaitagoro ina ishoi najo nanu, “Iltung'ana ootapaashaitie iltauja, nemeshilaa ninche nkoitoi aainei.”

English: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
Masaai: Ore enchata enye empolos neaku eng'udi olaiguanani; etubulua ninye alus pooki, ti atua nenen neesur oo lng'osil; nedoli enkadori enye, ti atua enkumoi oo lng'osil lenyena.

English: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Melau ae kata Daudi oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo le nkaji e Israel,

English: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neitoki Menaham olayioni le Gadi alotu eing'uaa Tirsa nelotu Samaria, neosh ninye Shalum olayioni le Yebesh te Samaria near ninye metua, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.

English: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
Masaai: Ore te neinining olarikoni le nkop imbaa e lejare, naa keaku ilooitoreisho lenyena pooki torrok.

English: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
Masaai: Naa tenedoiki ake ninye nabo enye atua entoki naitobiruaki too nkulukuok ore ina toki pooki natii atua neaku eiduruk, ore ina moti oo nkulukuok entadany ninye.

English: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
Masaai: Amu ore apa enatotiuo pee enang'aa Enkai Sodom o Gomora o nkang'itie naatashare, Olaitoriani ojo, neijia etiu meitokini aata oltung'ani omanya ine nemeitokini aata oltung'ani obik teine.

English: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
Masaai: (Najoki nanu ninche, koree ine wueji neika nipuopuo? Neaku keji enkarna e ine Bama o metabaiki ena olong.)

English: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Ayiolo ajo kelotu Mesia laa ninye eji Kristo, Naa te nelotu neboloki iyiook imbaa pooki.”

English: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
Masaai: Eitigir enaiposha te ngolon enye; te ng'eno enye etoosho Rahab.

English: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
Masaai: Neipotu ninche neitanap nereiki aajoki pee meigil ake aairorie aashu eiteng'en likae tung'ani te nkarna e Yesu.

English: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo enashe Olaitoriani loo laitoriak, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
Masaai: neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani iltung'ana aitalamaa oleng, neaku ilmuaateni kumok te mpolos e nkop.

English: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro o lkarasha obo naa intemat tikitam o isiet, ore endapasho naa intemat ong'uan; nerisio ilkarash pooki te nkadoro.

English: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
Masaai: Kaji naa eikuna pee eikenakaki ninye? Eidipaki aatumurat anaa etiu. Mme eidipaki aatumurat, anaa eitu. Mme eidipaki aatumurat, kake eton eitu emurati.

English: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
Masaai: Esipa aasuju esidano o lng'ur inkolong'i pooki e nkishui ai, naa kabik nanu ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani ntarasi.

English: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
Masaai: Ore ina kurriny o lasar le ngoki nepejoo ninye te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
