English: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
Masaai: Neishopito apa ninye Yohana enkila oo lpapit le ntames, o enkeene te mpolos enye; ore endaa enye na lmaat o naishi e ong'ata.

English: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
Masaai: Neaku eton apa eeta likae obo, laa oinoti lenye kirotet; neirriwaki aitabayie ninye, ejo, ‘Keyanyit oinoti lai.’

English: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani lenye o lkituaak lenye nepuo eyararoto,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
Masaai: Ore tenkiti kata neye ninche; ore te mpolos enkewarie neari metuata ore lelo magil neyae ninche neme too nkaik e tung'ani.

English: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aitayu ina palai namishira e nkinyiang'unoto, natii olning'o o ndung'eta o ina boitati enye;

English: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
Masaai: Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kalo nanu aiturrur ilmaiman, naiturrur lelo apa ootarayioki o lelo apa laaisilisilo.

English: But the hand of the LORD was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and he destroyed them, and smote them with emerods, even Ashdod and the coasts thereof.
Masaai: Keiroishi apa enkaina o Laitoriani te Shumata iltung'ana le Ashdod, neitame ninche, neisomit ninche too ltuduta, Ashdod o ina kop namanita.

English: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
Masaai: Neaku ore ake pee eidip ninche aashom enkop pooki, nepuonu ninche Yerusalem te nkiting'oto oo lapaitin ooudo o nkolong'i tikitam.

English: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
Masaai: Kake ajoki nanu intae, ore pooki ogorokino olalashe, naa keishiakino enkiguana; ore olosurdaany olalashe, neishiaakino, nerikokini ilkituaak; ore olodekisho ajo ‘Lo modai!’ keishiaakino olbalbal le nkima.

English: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
Masaai: Tushukoki olalem enchashur enye. Teine wueji nikintobirieki iyie, teina kop apa ning'uaa ekaaiguanare nanu iyie.

English: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
Masaai: Naa te neishiakino nalo sii nanu, nikiriamari.

English: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
Masaai: Nchoo meishopokini ilapolosak linono esupatisho, naa nchoo isinyat linono metabuaku te ng'ida.

English: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
Masaai: Nepuonu aji neisho ninche enkirragata. Ore pee ekenyu neinyototo airiamariyie ninche, nerik kulikae alashera ooing'uaa Yopa aitaa encholiek.

English: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore ake sii keishooyo sii Olaitoriani Israel te nebo iyie apik atua enkaina oo Lfilisti; ore taisere iyie o layiok linono niakuku te nebo nanu; naa kelo aishoru Olaitoriani enjore e israel apik atua enkaina oo Lfilisti.”

English: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
Masaai: ore lelo apolosak le Lawi nemelau ae kata oltung'ani te dukuya nanu oitayu ilasarri oopejori, nepejoo entapa o lasar, neitayu ilasarri ntarasi.”

English: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
Masaai: Neiteru too mbukui e Musa o too loibonok pooki, neibalakinye ninche ilkigerot ooipirta enkorrok enye.

English: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
Masaai: Entoiu ilng'anayio ooishiaakinore enkirridunoto.

English: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Oi kulo shekuti ooidaikie neidapash ntare enkirrita ai?” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo apolosani Daudi ajo, “Maata nanu imukateni e oshi ake tene, kake etii imukateni naasinya, te neitalama ake duoo ninche ilbarnot ate nkituaak.”

English: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
Masaai: O Obadiah olayioni le Shemaia, olayioni le Galal, olayioni le Yedutum, o Berekia olayioni le Asa, olayioni le Elkana laa ninche apa oomanya nkang'itie kutiti oo Lnetofati.

English: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
Masaai: Ore shumata naa isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, ooguetuno anaa enairirikino, tenebo iltarakua.

English: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
Masaai: Aimeipotisho eng'eno, aimedumu eyiolounoto oltoilo lenye?

English: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
Masaai: Ore emanaroto e nkanasa naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon o isiet. Ore enkarna e nkanasa eiteru teina kata nelo dukuya naa keji, Etii Olaitoriani ine!”

English: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Bet-asmapet naa artam oare.

English: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
Masaai: Nepuku olarrabal te shumata. Earare Mikael olmalaika le ilo asurai. Nearare sii ninye ilo asurai o lmalaika lenyana.

English: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
Masaai: Kake eishooki ake oltung'ani pooki te iyiook, empiris te risioroto e enkishorunoto e Kristo.

English: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto enoto Sara enkidimata nemenayu te ishoi etaa moruo, netulusoitie ilarin lenyena, etoduaa ninye ajo keisiligayu ilo oishoo enkisiligata.

English: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo, “Itang'amaitie apa Enkiyang'et Sinyati pee irukuruku?” Nejoki ninche ninye, “A'a, keitu ninye ai kata kining aajo keetae Enkiyang'et Sinyati.”

English: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata o sarge leilo asar le ng'oki to lkimojino lenye nepik nchumat oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar opejorieki ilasarri, neibukoo olikae sarge lenye te ntonata olperere lo lasar.

English: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua aipotu iltung'ana tomon oare ti atua iltung'ana le Israel, laa ninche etegelua, oltung'ani ake to losho;

English: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
Masaai: pee etum enkaina ai ataa te nebo ninye, neitagol sii enkaina ai ninye.

English: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Metaa eikoo Abimelek iltung'ana pooki ejoki, “Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ele tung'ani anaa enkitok enye naa keari metua.”

English: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee airorie nanu ninche too nkitanyaanyukot amu edolisho too nkonyek nemedol, nening'isho too nkiyiaa nemening, nemejing'aa.

English: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput neya embata osarge leilo oing'oni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
Masaai: Neinepu olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye tembata enchorro enkare ti ong'ata. Etii ina shorro enkoitoi nalo Shur.

English: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
Masaai: Etadoyie olanyor lai alo enkurma enye, ine neitobirieki isonkoyoni, alo airrita iluaat oo ntare enyena too nkurman, nesotu ntapuka.

English: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
Masaai: Meyam ninche enkoliai, arashu enkitok natung'uayie o lpayian lenye, kake eselenkei ake o lorere le nkaji e Israel, arashu enkoliai naa enkoliai o lapolosani.

English: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
Masaai: ore eyiolounoto inyi niponikiki enkibooroto ate, ore enkibooroto e ate enkitashoto, ore enkitashoto esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Nkai.

English: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena naning entoki naijo oltoilo kitok lo lorora kitok te shumata ebuaku aajo, “Haleluya, ene Enkai ang enjeunoto o enkisisa o ngolon.

English: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
Masaai: ore ake enejing, entiaaki olopeny enkaji. ‘Etejo Olaiteng'enani, Koree enkaji ai oo lomon, nainosie Pasaka te nebo ilooiteng'eni laainei?’

English: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana laa ninche eibonoki nenang'ari boo tiatua nkoitoi e Yerusalem, pee ear ninche olameyu o lalem, metii hoo obo onukaa ninche o nkituaak enye, o layiok lenye o ntoyie enye. Amu kabukoki nanu entorroni enye shumata ninche.

English: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
Masaai: Nipik enkikompe ai ina kikompe enkosholai enkutuk olbene lo loti tenebo impisai enyena naainosie ilpaek.”

English: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
Masaai: Neitobir olaiguanani Nebukadnesa enkitanyaanyukoto e sahabu, naa ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat e nkaina ntomoni ile naa ntemat e nkaina ile neitasheiyie ninye enkong'ata e Dura, to lkerenket e Babilon.

English: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
Masaai: Neipot Samson Olaitoriani ajo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tadamuaki nanu, nikintagol nanu aatasayia ena kata nabo, Na Ai, pee atum aitalaku too Lfilisti nabo oo nkonyek aainei.”

English: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Taranyisho iyie na olupi, ina neitu eisho; tabuaku taranyisho to ltoilo sapuk, iyie ina neitu ae kata esaisayu! Amu ore nkera e ina apa naiturrayioki naa eikumok aalang ine ina nayama, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
Masaai: kalo nanu ajoki ina kop e moikuape, nchoru, najoki kopikop, mimbooyo iyie; ilayiok laainei ooing'uaa enelakua o nena toyie aainei naaing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop,

English: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
Masaai: Kake ore Rahabu ina mulayoi, o enkaji e papaai lenye o pooki oora ilkulenye, eitajeuo Yoshua metopua; neton ninye ti atua Israel o metabaiki ena olong, enkaraki apa natunuka ilaikitalak ooirriua Yoshua meikitalana Yeriko.

English: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
Masaai: Anaa ei Barnabas doi ake o nanu etiakaki maisiayu entoki nikinya?

English: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
Masaai: Ng'ura, te nkaraki eseriani ai apa pee anoto emion sapuk kake mbooyie iyie enkishui ai arishie ina gumoto e nkidaata, amu itanang'aka iyie ng'ok aainei oriong ino.

English: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Nebatatakino ilkumok ootuata atua intae, niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
Masaai: Kaae neaku etua olaiguanani, neyauni ninye Samaria; nepuoi aanukaa ninye te Samaria.

English: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
Masaai: Ebaa enyorrata nanyor nanu nkitanapat inono! Ninye nanu aibirribir endama pooki.

English: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
Masaai: Enchom taata, naa entaasisho; amu meetae olkujita oishori intae, ore ake eyia, niyauu enoshi ake siana oo lmatofali.”

English: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Nelo Daudi teilo rorei le Gad oiroro te nkarna o Laitoriani.

English: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
Masaai: Ore te intae, neitodoluaki apa, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, metii likae oponieki ninye,

English: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
Masaai: Toduaa kewan mejing ake endamunoto e pesho oltau lino, nilo ajo, ‘Ore olari liopishana, olari le mpalakino netinyikua,’ neing'ode enkong'u ino ilo alashe lino aisinani, nimincho iyie ninye toki, neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani te nkaraki iyie, naa keaku eng'oki te iyie.

English: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
Masaai: Aime nkiyang'eta aisiaayiak ake ninche pooki naairriwayioki meisiaaisho, te nkaraki lelo ootum enjeunoto?

English: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
Masaai: Amu keitaraposh ninye ilo oata enkure, ore ilo oisumash neiputaki ntokitin sidain.

English: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ore anaa enashomo osinka lai Isaya meishopo nemeeta namuka too larin okuni anaa olmonekie le ngolon ogilunore Misiri, o Etiopia,

English: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
Masaai: Etaa apa moruak oleng ina kata Abraham o Sara, etaa kituaak oleng, metaa meekure duoo ninye eidim Sara atoiu enkerai.

English: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
Masaai: “Ayiolo nanu ajo indim ataasa pooki toki, nayiolo ajo meeta eyieunoto ino nemeitabari.

English: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: o Oog, olaiguanani le Bashan, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
Masaai: Inaure iyie te nena kiguanat inyi kumok, nchoo naa ninche eitashe pee kintajeu, lelo oor shumata, ootoni aing'or ilakir, laa ore te nedoli olapa neibonu ina nayooki alotu.

English: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
Masaai: Netonita apa Saul te netaaniki Gibea ti abori olchani otii Migron; ore iltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye nebaya iip ile,

English: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
Masaai: Kake tenikijoki iyie nanu, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang kingarakino iyiook” aime ilo eiwuang'ie Hesekia iwuejitin enyena neeika, ejoki Yuda, o Yerusalem, “Te dukuya ele perere lo lasar intae enteseremisho te Yerusalem?”

English: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura ore esujita Barak Sisera nelo Yael anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye, “Wou maaitoduaa ilo tung'ani ligira aing'oru.” Nelo ninye atua olng'obor lenye, neirrag Sisera te ine etua, etii encheitoi o lng'obor olpura le nkomom enye.

English: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

English: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
Masaai: Ore lelo malaika oopishana ooibung'ita ntarumpetani naapishana neitobir ejo pee eosh.

English: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaa nanu ataasa te naaitanyaanyukieki intae? Aimesidan ilekunot oo sabibu le Efraim alang enkisampuare e Abisi?

English: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
Masaai: Kake amaa te netigiluaki kulikae ng'osil, ore iyie olng'osila lo loirien le ntim, nikirubakini ine netigilunyeki pee king'arieki ina arsisisho e ilo oirien,

English: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
Masaai: Neipot Musa Besalel o Oholiab o pooki tung'ani oota enkidimata otipika Olaitoriani enkarriyiano o pooki ng'ae odumu oltau lenye meeu aas esiaai;

English: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
Masaai: Neijia eikuna ororei lo Laitoriani te magilanisho neponari te ngolon.

English: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
Masaai: Kake ore apa pee eaku olaiguanani Usia oltung'ani ogol, newuasayu ninye, ina pee eidak ninye. Amu eitarruoyie apa ninye to Laitoriani Enkai enye, nejing atua enkaji o Laitoriani alo apej enkorropil to lperere lo lasar le nkorropil.

English: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
Masaai: amu etonyorra enkisisa oo ltung'ana aaitalang enkisisa e Nkai.

English: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
Masaai: Naa ninche eikokieki osinka lino; ore te nkibung'ata enye netii olerrinyore kitok.

English: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
Masaai: “Esipa ore ilmuateni linyi o wuejitin apa neetomijono, o ina kop inyi apa nainyalaki - naa kepuo aapiriku te lelo oomany; ore apa lelo oo toijoitie intae naa kelamari oleng.

English: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
Masaai: Naa ninye laaitaa nanu kitok; amu inaainei eng'amu neitodol intae.

English: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
Masaai: Neitoki alo lido kekun le Yordan ewueji neibatisishore apa Yohana te nkiterunoto; neton te ine.

English: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo pooki liking'oru iyie meting'idata neshipa ti atua iyie! Nchoo lelo pooki oonyor enjeunoto ino metejo ntarasi, “Eikitok Enkai!”

English: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
Masaai: Aimeeta kulo ooas ntorrok indamunot, kulo ooinos iltung'ana laainei anaa endaa, nemeipotu ninche Enkai?

English: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
Masaai: “Lo alashera, kira e ntalipa e Abraham, o intae kulo ooure enkai, iyiook eirriwakaki irorei le na jeunoto.

English: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.

English: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
Masaai: Ore pooki ooiturukutuo te dukuya nanu naa lapurrok o laisimak, kake eitu ening inkerra ninche.

English: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
Masaai: Amu enkishui ninche teilo otum ninche naa olmairo lo sesen lenye pooki.

English: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.
Masaai: neibelekenyakino iltung'ana le Israel olarrabal. Neiterua apa Benchamen aar metuata iltung'ana loo Siraeli oobaya tomoni uni nejo ninche, “Esipa etooshoki ninche aanang'ie enkop te dukuya iyiook, anaa apa to larrabal le dukuya.”

English: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
Masaai: nejoki Saul osinka lenye, “Enkiroroto sidai, wou maape.” Nepuo ninche ina ang apa natii ilo tung'ani le Nkai.

English: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
Masaai: ina kata enukaa ile Misiri ilkikaunot lenye pooki ootara Olaitoriani ti atua ninche; ore nkaitin enye nedung'oki Olaitoriani enkiguana.

English: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
Masaai: Enukaa oltashalai inkaik enyena tiatua esaani; neinaur ninye te neshuku arrinyoki enkutuk enye.

English: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
Masaai: Nainyiang'ua irrindiki ilewa, o ng'oruo, naata apa irrindiki ootoiuoki te nkaji ai; naata sii apa iluaat kumok oo nkishu o ntare, alang pooki ng'ae apa otii dukuya nanu te Yerusalem.

English: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku kerrinyunye isargeta lenye aapuonu shumata endukuya e Yoab o shumata oo lukuny eishoi enye, intarasi; kake ore tialo Daudi, o eishoi enye o enkaji enye o lorika lenye le nkitoo, naa keaku eseriani naing'uaa Olaitoriani ntarasi moitie.”

English: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
Masaai: “Kalo te ntae laa te neeta intare iip pee eimin nabo, lemeing'uaa kunda ntomoni naaudo ti ong'ata, alo aing'oru ina nabo naimina, o menoto ade?

English: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
Masaai: naa kaisho nanu intae entobik tene wueji, tiatua ena kop apa naishoo nanu loo papaai linyi ntarasi.

English: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
Masaai: Ore naa taata, ng'ura, Yerusalem aloito aaena oltau mayiolo mbaa naapuo aatum te ine:

English: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Yuda aapuonu enetii Yoshua te Gilgal; ore Kaleb olayioni le Yefune ilo loo Lkeni nejoki ninye, “Iyiolo iyie apa enatiaka Olaitoriani Musa oltung'ani le Nkai te Kadesh-Barnea ti alo nanu o iyie.

English: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
Masaai: Neijia eiko Enkiyang'et pee elotu aretu iyiook te nchalan ang; amu aimikiyiolo iyiook aajo ainyoo kiomonu nimikiyiolo enikijo ti nikiomonu, kake Enkiyang'et makewan naomonoki iyiook te mion nagut nemeinosunoyu.

English: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata e Nkaji e Nkai: ina kop pooki namanita te shumata e ilo doinyo keaku enasinya oleng. Ing'ura ajo ena ninye enkitanapata e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.
Masaai: Ore Absalom o ltung'ana pooki le Israel nejo, “Ore enkikoo e Hushai Olakiti naa eisidai alang enkikoo e Ahitofel.” Amu etegelua Olaitoriani pee emir enkikoo sidai e Ahitofel, pee etum Olaitoriani ayau entorroni shumata Absalom.

English: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
Masaai: Te ng'eno eiputi ilgilat pooki, too ntokitin pooki sidain naagol enkinyang'a

English: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
Masaai: Kenyor ninche olasar; neitayu ninche olasar loo nkiri neinos; kake meshipakino Olaitoriani ninche. Ore taata kedamu ninye entorroni enye neitame ing'ok enye; kerrinyo ninche aapuo Misiri.

English: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
Masaai: Nejoki lamirak loo nturkuluni, “Ewaita kuna tokitin te ne emintaa enkaji e Papa ene biashara.”

English: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
Masaai: Amaa, tenaa isir intorrok ang, Olaitoriani, kanaata aa ng'ae oidim aitasho?

English: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
Masaai: Metaa ore Ilyahudi loo nkang'itie kutiti, ootoni too nkang'itie nemeeta isunta, neitaa enkolong e tomon o ong'uan olapa le Adar enkolong e nchipai, osirua o enkiyeng'iyeng, enkolong naa ninye eishorore nkishorot.

English: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
Masaai: kake te naa adoru enkitok ilpapit, neaku esikar te ninye. Eishooki ninye lelo papit adoru pee eitoipore.

English: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
Masaai: Amu ore enyorrata oo mpesai ninye entonai oo ntorrok pooki, enkaraki kuna pee etapaashari lkulikae aaing'uaa enkirukoto nerem ltauja lenye too nkitamiot kumok.

English: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
Masaai: neitodolu Olaitoriani nkitoduaat o mbaa enking'asia, mbaa sapuki naaitureisho tialo Misiri o tialo Farao o enkaji enye pooki, nikidol too nkonyek ang;

English: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
Masaai: Nchoo iyiook matabuaku te ng'ida te nkaraki enkisulata ino, ore te nkarna e Nkai ang nikiun iyiook inankan ang! Meitabai Olaitoriani iomonunot inyi pooki.

English: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
Masaai: Menya ninye ae toki naing'uaa isabibu nemeok enaisho aashu ae toki nemesinya; ore nena pooki naitanapa ninye nchoo ninye eas.”

English: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana ng'eni neshum eng'eno, kake ore enkilepilep olmodai neitinyiku enkidaaroto.

English: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
Masaai: Neinining ninche ninye amu keing'asiayie ninche te nkata naado, eing'asiayie nena kidong'i enyena.

English: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo barnoti ninye, “Aidipa aibung'a nena pooki: ainyoo ae naatong'orikia?”

English: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
Masaai: “Minguanare pee mikinguanareki; minor pee mikinorri, entapalaki pee epalakini intae.

English: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki nena, lalashera laainei lanyor, entasheito, entaa ilemeigusugusieki, entaboreyia anaa ake te siaai o Laitoriani, iyiololo aajo ore ti atua Olaitoriani mme ene pesho esiaai inyi.

English: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
Masaai: Eirrugoki tung'ani aaing'orie enkop, neitadowuoki iltung'ana aayau kop, ore nkonyek e ilo oitokoos neitoborraki.

English: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
Masaai: “Eitamodoo nkonyek enye, neitagol iltauja lenye, pee medol ake too nkonyek enye, neyiolou too ltauja lenye, neibelekenya, pee aishiunye.”

English: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
Masaai: Ore te nborron enye, neoruni ninye esipata: naa ae ng'ae naa olimu eishoi enye? Amu eisha enkishui enye te nkop.”

English: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le nkop pooki nedol nchere eipotoki intae te nkarna o Laitoriani; naa keureyu ninche intae.

English: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kejing enkopiyia e nkitoo atua enkaji Olaitoriani metaa endamunoto te Heldai o Tobiya o Yedaia o Yosia olayioni le Sefania.

English: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
Masaai: Nerresh ninche ninye te Yerusalem, neisikaki enkop e Lakish. Kake eirriwakita ninche iltung'ana le Lakish, nepuo ninche aar ninye metua teine.

English: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
Masaai: Tinilo iyie aim atua nkariak, naaku nanu te nebo iyie; naa ti nilang ilkejek nimikiya ninche; naa ti nilo iyie aim atua enkima nimikipej iyie, nimikinos iyie olng'ejep le nkima

English: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
Masaai: Keiteng'en ninche iltung'ana laainei enepaashare ina nasinya o ina nemesinya, neitodol ninche eneiko teneirishu ina naiduruk o enemeiduruk.

English: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
Masaai: Ore eboita Simon Petero, o Tomas oji Olmaoi, o Natanael le Kana e Galilaya, o layiok le Sebedayo o kulikae ooiteng'eni aare lenyena.

English: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
Masaai: Enchololoto naa entasaisho pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat; keyieu oltau, kake eshal osesen.”

English: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
Masaai: Endogo ilchempei linyi metaa lalema, nintaa ilalema linyi oodung'ishoreki iremeta; nchoo ilo oshal ejo, “Ara nanu olmurrani.”

English: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?
Masaai: ore lelo pooki oomanya enkop neikenaki aajo pesho; neas ninye te risioroto e yieunoto enye to lorora le shumata o ti atua lelo oomanya enkop; nemeetae oloidimaa enkaina enye, aashu ejoki ninye, “Kaa iasita iyie?”

English: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
Masaai: Etesheta ninye nkanas naata isunta te Yuda, amu enoto enkop enkiyeng'iyeng. Eitu ninye etum olarrabal te nena olong'i amu eishoo Olaitoriani ninye eseriani.

English: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
Masaai: Neyau ninche nena kishorot, o ematua e tomon, o nena tokitin naaitisinyaki. Ore olaitasheikinoni kitok naa Konania olayioni le Lawi, tenebo Shimei olalashe lenye, aa ninye oliare.

English: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
Masaai: “Eirowuaja engoro ai tenkaraki lelo shekuti, naa kaitame nanu lelo arikok; amu kegolie Olaitoriani loo lororani eluata enye ina aji e Yuda. Eketiu ninche anaa imbartan aainei naagol o larrabal.

English: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.
Masaai: “Ore taisere enyikita ena saa naairriwaki nanu iyie oltung'ani oing'uaa enkop e Benchamen, naa ibukoki iyie ninye eilata aput pee eaku olkitok oitore iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli. Neitajeu ninye iltung'ana laainei aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; amu atoduaa nanu osina loo ltung'ana laainei, amu eewuo olkiyioi lenye enatii nanu.”

English: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
Masaai: Ore enkurma naa enkop, ore ina antererai sidai naa nkera e ina Kitoria, ore endiati na nkera e ilo torrono.

English: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
Masaai: o esidai, olmuntut, olmagiro, o entilalu terisioroto oo mpukunot enyena,

English: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
Masaai: Ore pee aas enda nemayieu naas nemeekure aa nanu oas kake eng'oki natii atua nanu.

English: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
Masaai: Ore naa, emiaaku ilmoda, entoning'u eyieunoto o Laitoriani.

English: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiruk ninye; nemeiguanareki, ore ilo lemeiruk neidipaki aaiguanare, amu eitu eiruk enkarna e Nkerai inoti nabo e Nkai.

English: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika li okuni olbakuli lenye atua lkejek o nchorroi e nkare, neaku ninche osarge.

English: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
Masaai: Ore Abna olayioni le Ner o sinkan le Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, neipang aapuo te Mahanaim nepuo Gibeon.

English: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
Masaai: ore apa pee eitanap iyiook Musa enkitanapata, metaa enjung'ore to lturrur le Yakobo.

English: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
Masaai: Enchoo eyanyiti enkiyama ti atua iltung'ana pooki naa emincho ina rruat e nkiyama eisarkionieki; amu Enkai naiguanare lelo ooibor onyek o loololoito.

English: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
Masaai: neishooyo ninche apik atua nkaik oo Lgibioni; neilili ninche teilo doinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, ore ninche pokira oopishana neidak te nebo. Neari ninche metuata too nkolong'i e dukuya e nkisampuare, te nkiterunoto e nkisampuare e shairi.

English: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
Masaai: Ng'ura etii Enkai tenebo iyiook, ninye orikito iyiook, tenebo ilapolosak eeta ntarumpetani enye o larrabal pee eosh tenikinteru olarrabal o intae. Nakera, e Israel emiarare intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo minyi, amu mimirishosho.

English: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
Masaai: Ore pee etejo ninye neijia, Enkiyang'et eimaka natum lelo pooki ooiruk ninye, amu eton eitu ebau ina Kiyang'et ina kata, amu eton eitu eilepieki Yesu metaa kitok.

English: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
Masaai: Neijia naa etiu, te neitu ilimu ororei oibala to lng'ejep lino, kaji eiko pee ening'unoyu ina nilimu? Keaku enkijape ake irorie,

English: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
Masaai: Ing'ura, ekaikirikirie enkaina ai te shumata ninche, naa keidaikie ninche lelo ooisiaai ninche. Nitum taa atayiolo nchere Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye lairriwua nanu.

English: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
Masaai: Amu ng'en emodai e Nkai alang eng'eno o ltung'ani, negol enchalan e Nkai alang engolon o ltung'ani.

English: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
Masaai: o Halohesh, o Pilha, o Shobek,

English: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
Masaai: Neomon Isaak Olaitoriani tenkaraki enkitok enye, amu koolupi apa ninye, newal Enkai enkomono enye, neiroshiu Rebeka enkitok enye.

English: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
Masaai: neipang enapita openy osalaba aya eneji Ewueji e Mborbor, neji te nkutuk oo Lyahudi Golgota.

English: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amu Yesu ina siki nejo, “Eidipe!” Neirrug elukunya nedung tau.

English: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
Masaai: Naa te nelotu Moab aibalunye kewan, naa te neitanaur kewan too wuejitin neeika, te nelotu ninye atua ine wueji enye sinyati pee eomon, meret ninye ina.

English: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
Masaai: ore obo naatung'uayie nanu, ina pee ajo, esipa etumutaki apa aaitaa ndung'udung'ot, neitu aekata aitoki adol ninye.

English: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: “Kuna baa naaishiakino too le Lawi: ore ebaiki ilarin tikitam o imiet neilep kepuo ninche aas enkisiaayiare ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu makewan nchere keing'unyung'uny ilooiteng'eni lenyena te nkaraki ina, nejoki ninche, “Amaa keikob intae ena?

English: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aayietu aaishir, neng'utut Orpa enkaputani enye kake etamuatakine Rusi ninye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa ore akenya te ina olong kepuoi aaosh entarumpeta kitok, ore lelo apa ooimina te nkop e Asiria, o lelo oopuonu ootarayioki Misiri nepuonu aaserem Olaitoriani te nchumata ele doinyo sinyati te Yerusalem.

English: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
Masaai: Neitobir Ahab ashera. Etaasa Ahab mbaa kumok aitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli aitulus too laiguanak pooki loo Siraeli apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

English: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
Masaai: Iltung'ana lo lkerenket kulo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto e lelo apa ootarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon nenap aya, etorrinyunye ninche Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye.

English: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le nkae Nebo naa onomm o are.

English: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
Masaai: Nejoki Israel Yosef, “Aimegira ilalashera linono aairrita intare te Shekem? Wou maairriwai enetii ninche.” Nejoki Yosef ninye, “Nele nanu.” Ina peyie ejoki ninye,

English: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom ildoinyo, meinepu ake intae lelo oosujita intae; nisudoriri te ine nkolong'i uni, o metaba anaa neshukunye lelo oosujita intae, nitumutumu taa aashom aaima enkoitoi inyi.”

English: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:
Masaai: ena ninye enkibalakinoto enye, laaiguanani: Enkitanapata e ilo otii shumata aisul, ninye shumata olkitok lai olaiguanani,

English: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
Masaai: Kuna imbaa nayieu niasiasa: eroro esipata o likae o to likae, entayu too nkishomin inyi inkiguanat naasipa nintayuyu sii osotua.

English: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
Masaai: Ore hoo neas olaing'okoni entorroni katitin iip nabo neitoodor enkishui enye, kake ayiolo ake ajo kesidanu oleng te lelo ooure Enkai, amu keureisho te dukuya ninye;

English: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
Masaai: Neikilikuan Yesu ninche ajoki, “Koleng'ae ele oip o ele kigeroto?”

English: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
Masaai: Amu kaiwuang'ie nanu nkarn e Baal te nkutuk enye, nemeigili ae kata aaipot ninche katukul.

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasarri ooki te lelo oing'ok, o loo lmeregeshi, o loo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata.

English: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
Masaai: O Baalat o nkanas naasheta too soito apa naara ine Solomon, o nkanas pooki oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, o nkanas oo lakedok lenyena loo mbartan, o pooki toki nayieu Solomon neshetu te Yerusalem, o te Lebanon, o teina kop pooki enkitoria enye.

English: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
Masaai: Te nedumunye iltung'ana pee kisujaa iyie pee eing'oru enkishui ino, ore enkishui o lkitok lai naa keenari to rridata loo looishu te nking'urata o Laitoriani Enkai ino; ore enkishui oo lmang'ati linono nenang'aa ninye anaa osoit onang'ari te nkopito.

English: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
Masaai: Nedoyio aapuo ilo pisiai loo lkituaak; neruko aadoyio iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, te nkaraki ninye, aapuo aarare lelo magil.

English: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu oltung'ani torrono te ntorroni enye, nebul netiu ninye anaa oltarakuai le Lebanon.

English: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD'S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu airorie ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki, ajoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Emining irorei le lelo oibonok ooibonoki intae, ejo, ‘Ng'ura, keshukuni nena masaa enkaji o Laitoriani aaitasieku aaitung'uaa Babilon,’ amu elejare ina naibonoki ninche intae.

English: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
Masaai: Ore epuo neimaa Yesu enkang namanya enkitok naji Marisa neitoomon te nkaji enye.

English: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
Masaai: Entooshiosh ilgooitie linyi te nkaraki nena kurman sidain, te nkaraki nena kurman oo sabibu naatoishete oleng.

English: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
Masaai: Ore too le Simeon, iltung'ana magil arriyiak to larrabal, naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip nabo.

English: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Neinosi ninye teina olong ake, nimileku ae toki mekenyiki: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai le lelo keek lenyena ooleku naa keaku kuti, o metaa ninye keidim enkerai aikena.

English: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
Masaai: Eyawua Enkai ninche aitung'uaa Misiri, netiu apa ninche anaa loata imouarak olosokuan.

English: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
Masaai: olayioni le Yonan, olayioni le Resa, olayioni le Serubabel, olayioni le Shealtiel, olayioni le Neri,

English: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
Masaai: ore ilo tung'ani osinya neisuaki ilo tung'ani lemesinya te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, ore te nkolong e naapishana neitisiny ninye, neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare, ore pee eaku teipa nesinyayu ninye.

English: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
Masaai: Esipata, Olaitoriani, nchere eitomijoono ilaiguanak le Asiria iloreren o nkuapi enye,

English: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooata olkilikuai oing'uaa Enkai, enchoo aare aashu okuni eiro, neineneng lelo kulikae irorei lenye;

English: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
Masaai: Neilepu ninye alotu, nejoki menye o ng'otonye, “Atoduaa nanu entito nabo oo Lfilisti te Timna; entorikokoki nanu metaa enkitok ai.”

English: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo Samuel, “Kaji nanu aiko te nalo? Te nening Saul ina naar nanu matua.” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Iwa enkashe te nebo iyie nijo, ‘Aewuo pee apolosaki Olaitoriani olasar.’

English: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
Masaai: Ore tiabori lelo gialat netii kutuk aji te nkalo oloosaen, ejing iltung'ana ninche eing'uaa oriong endung'oroto, ine neiterunye esuntai e oriong.

English: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrurr iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, iltung'ana iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “Aikipuo iyiook olarrabal aagilunore Ramot-Gilead, anaa aimikipuo?” Nejoki ninche, enchom, amu keishoru Enkai apik nkaik o laiguanani.

English: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya e pooki oitoi nalala e nkanasa nishetu ewueji nimborrie onyek esidano ino, nincho kewan pooki ng'ae ogiroo, niponaa esiaai ino enkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ng'ura, kaaitayiolo nanu iyie ina nayooki aaku te nkata e siadi e ngoro, amu ina kata apa nageluno e nkiting'oto eipirta.

English: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
Masaai: Iwaita embata oo nkilani inyi, nintobirakiki ate iwuejitin neeika, niasiasa inenkiborra oo nkonyek te nchumata enye; eitu aikata etumi inaanyaanyukie, nemeitokini aikata aatum.

English: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
Masaai: Ore apa Abishai, olalashe le Yoab laa olarikoni le tomoni uni. Near ninye te mpere iltung'ana iip uni metuata, nening'oyu enkarna enye tenebo lelo okuni.

English: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)
Masaai: Ore entito enye naa keji Sheera, naa ninye apa natesheta Betoron e abori o ene shumata o Usensheera.

English: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Ore pooki oitadou kewan anaa ena kerai, ninye olkitok aisul te nkitoria e shumata.

English: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki ng'ae lemebatata aserem nepuoi nabo kata aanang'aki atua olkokuet le nkima oyupuyup.”

English: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
Masaai: Ore ina kitok apa naishu enkayioni enye nejoki olaiguanani, enkaraki naata ninye enkirimo to ltau te nkaraki enkayioni enye. “Oi olkitok lai, nchoo ninye meewa ina kerai naishu, nimimper ninye.” Kake etejo ina ae kitok, “Nchoo eaku mme enaai neme enino, tasasha ninye matoor.”

English: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
Masaai: o Naftali pooki ina kop e Efraim, o Manase, o enkop pooki e Yuda ometabaiki enaiposha o loo ntoluo,

English: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
Masaai: Itadowuo apa iyie alotu enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai, nirorie ninche itii keper nincho ninche nkikoot sidain o nkitanapat naasipa, o nkiguanat supati.

English: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
Masaai: Meishoo Olaitoriani olng'ur enkaji e Onesiforo amu aaitagolo ninye oshoke katitin kumok, eitu edol isura too lpisia le enata ai,

English: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
Masaai: Kake ore eton eirorita ninye nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Eikintaa iyiook iyie olaikooni lang? Tigirayu! Eijo iyie pee kiari tua?” Neaku etigire ilo oiboni le Nkai, kake etejo, “Ayiolo nanu ajo eitobira Olaitoriani pee kindaikie iyie, enkaraki nitaasa ena neitu ining enkikoo ai.”

English: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie kuna baa etetema Enkai Abraham ejoki ninye, “Abraham” nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
Masaai: “Kake eng'ura ate pee meaku ltauja linyi biitia o emerai o nkolati e na kop, neirrashu intae ina olong neluam intae anaa orreshet;

English: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
Masaai: Nejo taa Lyahudi, “Eng'ura eneba enyorrata nanyor ninye!”

English: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
Masaai: “Na ore pooki ng'ae oning kulo rorei laainei nemeas, neitanyaanyukieki oltung'ani omoda oteshetaka enkaji enye shumata osinyai;

English: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
Masaai: Ewaki enchipai o eng'ida aaitung'uaa ina kop naisho oleng e Moab; aishoo nanu enaisho oo sabibu meishunye too nkironyeta; meetae hoo ng'ae oirony ninche too mbuakunot eng'ida; ore ina buakunoto neme embuakunoto e ng'ida.

English: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Masaai: Kake ore too ltauja linyi eyanyita Kristo anaa Olaitoriani, enterretenata anaake pee iwalikiki oltung'ani pooki oikilikuan intae olbae lo siligi otii atua intae. Kake te mborron o te nkanyit.

English: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ara, nera esiana enye iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o imiet.

English: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo enetii aatem aajoki, “Kebara te neorore oltung'ani enkitok enye te pooki bae?”

English: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
Masaai: ‘Tiaki ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ng'ura ajo kaisarkionie ewueji ai sinyati, o lwuasa le ng'olon ino o enchipai oo nkonyek inono, o eyieunoto oltau lino; ore ilayiok linono tenebo ntoyie inono nena nitung'uayie te siadi naa kebatata to lalem.

English: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
Masaai: Ore te siadi enkikirikirata enkop nelotu enkima, kake metii Olaitoriani atua enkima. Ore te siadi enkima nelotu oloti toilo obor.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Simeon naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai.

English: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
Masaai: Naa ijokiki intae, ‘Ore ake elotu osinka lino Yakobo te siadi.’ ” Amu etadamua ajo, “Kaidim aitoborro ninye too nkishorot naashomo te dukuya nanu, ore esuju ina naidim atoduaa enkomom enye; ebaiki naaidim atang'amai nanu.”

English: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
Masaai: Nejoki Moab lelo payiani le Midian, “Kemeju taata ele orora pooki toki namanita iyiook, anaa enameju olkiteng nkujit e ong'ata.” Neaku ore apa Balak olayioni le Sipor, laa ninye apa olaiguanani le Moab te ina kata,

English: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
Masaai: Kake ore eewuo Kristo anaa olapolosani kitok loo mbaa supati naapuonu, neaku ore to lng'obor kitok obaya, leme inkaik naaitobira, inchere, ime olena kitayunoto,

English: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.
Masaai: Kake etii apa oloiboni lo Laitoriani ine, oji enkarna enye Oded. Neipang ninye alo atumore ina jore naing'uaa Samaria, nejoki ninche, “Ng'ura, ore amu etagorokine apa Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi Yuda, eishorua ninche apik nkaik inyi, kake itasesekuana intae ninche te ngoro naing'uaa shumata.

English: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
Masaai: Ore pee eishari enkolong nayeng'iyeng'areki, neinyang'u Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'oto Yakobo, o Salome iila naarropil pee epuo aael ninye.

English: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
Masaai: Neig'urrie olkitok ilo sinka nelaku nepalaki ina sile pooki.

English: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore pee edol osajini oitashe aipirare ninye, ajo etaa etundung'e tau, nejo, “Edede Oinoti le Nkai ele tung'ani.”

English: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
Masaai: teneme Olaitoriani otonyorrayie?

English: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
Masaai: Ore ilo arikoni le njore o Laitoriani nejoki Yoshua, “Ntayu inamuka inono too nkejek inono; amu ore ine wueji nintasheyie naa eisinyati.” Neas Yoshua ina.

English: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
Masaai: nenyaakaki sii ajo, “Enting'idata Loreren, te nebo ltung'ana lenyena;”

English: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
Masaai: Nayiolo nanu makewan ajo kining oshi ake; kake te nkaraki ele orere laamanita pee atejo nji, pee etum aairuko nchere iyie likirriwua.”

English: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: nekordu iyiook aitung'uaa ilmang'ati lang, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo inkoitoi naalala enkanasa, neiturrurru pooki oonoto ninche, iltorrok o supati, neiput ilomon ina aji e nkiyama.

English: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
Masaai: pee itum aturia Olaitoriani Enkai ino, iyie o layioni lino o layiok loo layiok linono, nimbung'ubung'u kuna kikoot pooki, o nkitanapat enyena, naitanap nanu intae, too nkolong'i pooki enkishui inyi; pee etumi aatoponai nkolong'i inyi.

English: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
Masaai: Amaa naaji te netii iltung'ana onom supati atua ina anasa, indim aidakie ewueji pooki nimipalie lelo supati onom otii atua?

English: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
Masaai: Naa keutaki intae olgilata le shumata oidipaki aaitobira; entobira te ine.”

English: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
Masaai: Amu aisupat Olaitoriani, nenyor ninye nkiaasin supati; ilo oata oltau sidai odol enkomon enye.

English: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
Masaai: Neaku etaa enemesinya te nkaraki nena kiasin enye, neiborrie ninche onyek too nkiasin enye.

English: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Eeta apa Daudi papaai lai to ltau lenye pee eshet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
Masaai: Emincho eitapong'ori intae too nkiteng'enat naapaashaa; amu keishiaakino naa empiris naitagol oltau, neme indaiki, neitu eret lelo ooitudupita.

English: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
Masaai: nkolong'i artam, metetema shetani. Neitu enya toki te nena olong'i, ore pee eitabaya netir esumash.

English: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
Masaai: Neitagol olaguetani loo nkeek olkunoni oshoke, ore oloyutuutisho neitagol oshoke ilo oidong'isho; ore te nkiruburubare nejo ninche, “Eisidai,” neitirrish ninye too lmushomaani pee meing'unung'un.

English: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
Masaai: Etotiwuo iloibonok linyi anaa mbariak tiatua ilmuaateni, iyie Israel.

English: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
Masaai: Amu eiputa lopat imesai pooki, meetae ewueji nemetii olduruk.

English: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Ore amu itanya ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani, ng'ura, teneaku ishomo nikilo olng'atuny aar tua.” Ore pee elo aing'uaa nenang'are olng'atuny ninye near metua.

English: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
Masaai: nitigiligila iyiook ti atua ewueji oo mbariak, nimulumul iyiook te naimin namisimis.

English: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.
Masaai: Neitayu Yese olkurrarruu onap imukateni, olbene lo lchoni le naisho, o lkuoo le kine, neirriwaa ninche te Daudi, olayioni lenye, airriwaki Saul.

English: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
Masaai: Kake keaku ilkumok le dukuya ile siadi, neaku ile siadi ile dukuya.

English: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
Masaai: Netii ine wueji netasheyieki ninye enkurma, netii atua ina kurma enkurare ng'ejuk neton eitu ae kata eirragieki likae.

English: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
Masaai: Miwaliki olmodai te risioroto e modai enye, arashu iyaku sii iyie olonyaanyukie.

English: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.
Masaai: Kake ore ilkulikae tung'ana le pesho, nejo, “Kaji eiko ele tung'ani te neitajeu iyiook?” Nemenaa ninche ninye, neitu ninche eyaki ninye nkishorot. Kake etigire ninye.

English: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Masaai: Neaku nena naaning'i eimu enkirukoto, ore ina naning'i naa elikioroto e Kristo.

English: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejoki Yuda Onan, “Shomo tijing'aki ina kitok oliai o lalashe lino tayiolo ninye, pee etum olalashe lino nkera te iyie.”

English: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
Masaai: Tinikipalaa iyiook ninye etiu nji, neiruk pooki ninye, neyooki Ilroma aapuonu aaidaikie ene wueji ang sinyati neidaikie olorere lang.”

English: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Finehas olayioni le Eliesa, ilo ayioni le Aron olapolosani, nedumunye ninye alo aing'uaa ilo turrur, nedumu empere te nkaina enye

English: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye aing'orie keper nejing enaimin sapuk atua enkop e Misiri nkolong'i uni;

English: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
Masaai: Nejoki, ‘Enkerai ai, itii oshi ake iyie ene natii naa enino entoki pooki naata.

English: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Hilkia ilo apolosani kitok, o lapolosak oosujaki te nkitoo, o laing'urak le kishomi, pee eipang'unyeki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani nena masaa pooki apa naaitobirakaki Baal, o Ashera, o lorora pooki le keper. Nepejoo ninye ninche tiauluo Yerusalem too nkong'at e Kedron, nenap nkuruon enye aaya Betel.

English: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
Masaai: Nejoki sii likae, “Olaitoriani, aasuj kake, nchooki ang'as alo aitanapare iltung'ana to lmarei lang.”

English: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
Masaai: Nepej Aron enkorropil naisonkoyo oleng te nchumata enye, anaake tadekenya te neitobir iltaai nepej.

English: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
Masaai: Naa tenemeidim ninye anoto olkuoo le ker, neya ninye nturkuluoni are aashu nturkuluoni are kutiti, nabo te nkaraki olasar opejori o enkae te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki. Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, nesinyayu ninye.”

English: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani laa ninye laaikok, ore sii te nkewarie naaiteng'en oltau lai.

English: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
Masaai: Ekaarik nanu iyie o maaitijing'a enkaji e yieyio, olgilata le ina apa naatoiwuo nanu, Naaisho nanu iyie enaisho oo sabibu natii enkorropil tooko, ina are oo lng'anayio le kukumanka.

English: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
Masaai: Ore too nkaloli pooki, nemanimanaa anaa olng'atuny lelo torrok anaa enatudumuye entorroni aponari ti atua nkera e tung'ana.
