Masaai: Kake eibelekenyate iltung'ana iip ile neisik aapuo ong'ata enkalo e ndapidapoi e Rimon, nebik ninche te ina dapidapoi e Rimon ilapaitin oong'uan.

English: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
Masaai: “Itijing'a oshi aikata atua nkonyek enaiposha arashu ilo tiatua enegut enaiposha too nkejek?

English: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
Masaai: Neinyototo Farao kewarie, ninye, o laisiaayiak lenyena pooki o Ilmisiri pooki; netii apa olkiyioi sapuk Misiri amu metii apa enkaji neitu eye oltung'ani obo.

English: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
Masaai: Ishomo iyie te nkaraki enjeunoto oo ltung'ana linono, te nkaraki enjeunoto eilo litubukoko eilata aput. Itupurda iyie endukuya eilo arruoni, irragie ninye meishopo ebaiki enkupes o metabaiki emurt.

English: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
Masaai: pee etum aitaiki kewan ina sirit te sikar nemeeta entibili aashu emuguta aashu eeta ae ake toki nayia neijia, pee etum esirit ataa sinyati nemeeta eleyiata.

English: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
Masaai: Neeta ina suntai e ina anasa ilkitamanyunot tomon o aare, nesirakino ninche inkarn tomon o aare o lkipaareta lo Lkuoo le Ker.

English: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
Masaai: Neitobir olaiguanani Solomon ilong'oi iip are dapashi naaidong'uoki te sahabu; ore ake nabo naa shekeli iip ile e sahabu enkiroishi.

English: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
Masaai: toning'o iyie te keper, teina manyisho ino, niaas te risioroto e nena naaomonu ilo tung'ani loo loreren te iyie; pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aataiyiolo enkarna ino nikiureyu iyie, anaa enatiu iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, netum sii aatayiolo nchere ore ena aji natesheta nanu naa enkarna ino eipotieki.

English: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
Masaai: Eitobir indamunot o ltung'ani enkoitoi enye, kake Olaitoriani ninye outaa iroruat enyena.

English: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
Masaai: Amu ore olapolosani ake pooki netegeluaki meishooi nkishorot neitayu lasarri, naa keishaakino apa neeta sii ninye ele apolosani entoki naishooyo.

English: If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
Masaai: Ore pee etune enchetata naitayio oltung'ani, netum ilo olekoisiayio lenye;

English: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan, o lapa li oudo to lari li are le nkitoria e Darias, eeuo ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, ejo,

English: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
Masaai: Neaku etaasishote apa lelo ootipikaki esiaai, ore enkitobirata e nkaji nelo dukuya too nkaik enye, neitobir ninche enkaji e Nkai netiu anaa apake, neitagol ninye.

English: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.
Masaai: Ore naa taata ewaita iltung'ana tomon oare too loshon le Israel, to losho ake oltung'ani.

English: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
Masaai: Neitagol Olaitoriani oltau le Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nesujaa ninye iltung'ana loo Siraeli ooisula aapuku te ng'olong'u.

English: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
Masaai: Netaasa sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa enatiaaka Musa, amu etoomonutuo ilgiso loo Lmisiri le nkosholai o le sahabu, o nkilani;

English: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
Masaai: Neyieng' ninche ilo oing'oni, neitoki ninche aayau ina kerai enetii Eli.

English: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
Masaai: Intaasa ninche enapa nintaasa Midian, o Sisera o Yabin to lkeju le Kishon,

English: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
Masaai: Eitipij ninche ilng'ejepa lenye anaa ilasuriaa, ore nkutukie enye netii esayiet oo nturbubuani.

English: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
Masaai: Neitoki apuku likae malaika te ina aji e Enkai natii shumata, neeta sii ninye olalem opi oololo.

English: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
Masaai: Kulo lelo, Aron o Musa, laa ninche etiaka Olaitoriani, “Entayu iltung'ana loo Siraeli metupuku aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri too lororani lenye.”

English: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo nena, nelikini Yosef aajoki, “Ing'ura kemuoi papaai lino;” metaa etoriko ninye ilayiok lenyena aare, Manase o Efraim.

English: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
Masaai: Anaa kaji inko ti nijoki olalashe lino, ‘Inchooki maitayu esuama te nkong'u ino;’ naa, ing'ura etii olchata atua enkong'u ino makewan?

English: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani, o Siraeli pooki ootii tenebo, aaitayu olasar te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
Masaai: o Heshuba, o Obel, o Berekia, o Hasadia, o Yushabhesed, ninche pokira imiet.

English: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
Masaai: Oi napaji tenaa iaku olalashe lai, ilo otanaa ilki le yieyio! Tenaainepu nanu iyie te boo, naa kaang'utut, nemeetae hoo obo laamenaa nanu.

English: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie isiaayia ilmang'ati linono tiatua enkop nimiyiolo, amu ore te engoro ai neinuaaki enkima nayupuyup ntarasi.”

English: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
Masaai: Eiterutua apa ninche aaitisiny te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya, ore te nkolong e isiet o lapa nepuonu ninche olgoriet le kutukaji enkaji o Laitoriani; ore too nkolong'i isiet neitisiny ninche enkaji o Laitoriani ore te nkolong e tomon o ile o lapa le dukuya neidip ninche.

English: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
Masaai: Ore ilo oota olorok too masaa naatumi te nkoitoi torrono neyaki enyamali enkaji enye, kake ore ilo oiba eropare nebikoo.

English: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
Masaai: eliki enajo neitadedeyie ti atua ninche nchere meeta apake kata nemeinosieki Kristo osina, neitoki ake apiu too lootuata. Nejoki, “Naa ele Yesu laliki intae, ninye doi Kristo.”

English: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
Masaai: Eng'iri enyorrata, neeta olng'ur, nemeeta olom, nemewuasa enyorrata, nememenisho,

English: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook esiaai enye naitayioki ti atua Kristo Yesu te nkaraki isiaaitin sidain naaitobira apa Enkai te dukuya pee kipuo ti atua ninche.

English: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon aiken iltung'ana pooki dokunot apa ootii enkop e Israel, aiturubare ina kikenare apa naikenishe Daudi papaai lenye. Netumi iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o onom o okuni o iip ile.

English: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
Masaai: Kaitadou nanu ninche anaa ilkuoon le kerra oopuoi aayieng, anaa ilmeregeshi o loroi.

English: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en, neyiolo enaikunakino enkanasa o logol, negil isunta naaisilig ninche.

English: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
Masaai: Ore nkonyek olwuasa tenebo oltau o wuasa, oltaa loo ltorrok naa ing'ok.

English: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
Masaai: Neaku etoorori apa Edom te nkitoria e Yuda ometabaiki ena olong. Neitoki ake sii Libna aorori teina kata.

English: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
Masaai: Mincho ilo oitorogonyaki meitukurruni, nchoo ilo aisinani omena meisisa enkarna ino.

English: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
Masaai: naipirare ilomon supati kituaak le Enkai namayiana, laaishooki nanu aaisilig.

English: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee emanaa enkakenya te nkolong e are, negelu Enkai olkurto oinosa ina aitubului, neaku etoyio.

English: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
Masaai: “Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, ‘Tupuku shomo tung'uai enkop ino o ltung'ana linono le sotua, o enkaji e papaai lino, shomo enkop naautaki.

English: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
Masaai: neya ninye aanang'aki eng'umoto, ore ina gumoto nemetii toki, metii enkare atua.

English: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ninche ninye aajoki, “Aainyoo naa pee imbatisisho iyie, ti nimira ilo Kristo, aashu Eliya aashu ilo oiboni?”

English: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
Masaai: ina peyie ejo Lea, “Aaishoo Olaitoriani enkishoroto sapuk; ekaayanyitu taata olpayian lai, amu atoikio ninye ilayiok ile;” neipot enkarna enye Sebulon.

English: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
Masaai: Talakuaki nanu too ltung'ana laaibooki enkop, pee atum aibung'a nkitanapat inono.

English: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
Masaai: (Nikira pooki iltung'ana oobaya iip are o ntomoni naapishana o ile ti atua ina meli.)

English: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye, neitobir aram Nehemia olayioni le Asbak, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo o lkerenket le Betsar o meitabaiki enkipirakinoto oo nkuraren e Daudi, o meitabaiki olchorro oitobiruaki, o meitabaiki enkaji oo ltung'ana magil.

English: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
Masaai: Nikiyieu neitoduaaya pooki ng'ae linyi enyuaata naikununo neijia pee itumutumu emborei oo sipat osiligi o meiting'o,

English: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
Masaai: Ore ina matua naleku te nchoto nabo, o ematua naleku te nkae shoto, te nkadoro oo nkilani o lng'obor.

English: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
Masaai: neitomisimisi enkolong, nedoru olapa atiu anaa osarge, eton etiooyo ina olong o Laitoriani, enkolong kitok e nkisisa.

English: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
Masaai: Kake ing'amumu intae engolon, tene elotu Enkiyang'et Sinyati shumata intae, niaakuku intae lchakenini laainei ti atua Yerusalem, o ti atua Yudea pooki o Samaria, o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.”

English: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
Masaai: Toning'o iyie eomonokinoto o sinka lino o enoo ltung'ana linono le Israel, te neomon eing'or ene wueji, ee toning'o iyie itii emanyisho ino te keper, naa te nining nipalaki.

English: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
Masaai: Nchoo ebikoo ina nyorrata ino nauno te lelo likiyiolo iyie, nebikoo enjeunoto ino te lelo loo ltauja sidain!

English: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Yehoahas etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye te Samaria neitoreisho Yoash olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.
Masaai: nitoduaa intae nena pooki naaitaasa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi kuna kuapi pooki te nkaraki intae, amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninye otijing'a olarrabal te nkaraki intae.

English: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
Masaai: enkitoria pooki e Oog te Bashan, laa ninye apa oitoreisho ti atua Ashtarot etii atua Edrei (ninye apake etelekuaki to lpisiai le Refaim); kulo apa etimira Musa nearaa aipang'ie.

English: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
Masaai: Nchoo eaku enkitanapata nabo iata te ilo oas pooki toki eitu eotiki, o te ilo ora oinoti le Israel o te ilo omoni otamanyishe ti atua intae.

English: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
Masaai: Ina pee indimidimi aatayiolo esipata o enkiguana e sipata o emborron, o pooki oitoi sidai.

English: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo inkariak natii abori e keper eiturrurrokino pooki nebo, naa inchoo enkop natoyio eibalayu.” Neaku neija.

English: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
Masaai: Amu irrumoo te murte o too ronyi, nimponyaa nena pooki naashal too mowuarak inyi, o metaba anaa nindapashakiki ninche pooki wueji,

English: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat, thou shalt destroy and cut them down; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee, until it be subdued.
Masaai: Lelo keek ake liyiololo aajo ilkeek leme le ndaa indimidimi aaidaikie nidung'udung'u aauroo pee itumutumu aateshetunyie isempewueti teina anasa naitayunye intae olarrabal, ometaba anaa nebatata.

English: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
Masaai: neing'or shumata, neitadoiyie oltau, nejoki ninye, “Efafata,” nchere, “Taboloyu.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Shomo tijing'aki Farao nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo peyie aatum aaisiaayia.

English: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia kegol iltung'ana oomanya ina kop, naa kesheta nkanas enye nelala oleng; ore te nebo ina kitoduaa eishoi e Anak te ine.

English: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
Masaai: Nedung'oki enkarna enkikau enye ajo Yemima; ore eniare neipot ajo enkarna enye Kesia, ore eneuni nedung'oki enkarna ajo Karen Happuk.

English: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
Masaai: Neipang'aki Olaitoriani ninye ina kewarie nejoki, “Ara nanu Enkai e Abraham papaai lino, miureishoyu amu atii tenebo iyie, naa kaamayian iyie naitubul eishoi ino tenkaraki osinka lai Abraham.”

English: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
Masaai: Newaliki Nabal isinkan le Daudi nejo, “Kaing'ae Daudi? Kaing'ae olayioni le Yese? Etii oshi taata kuna olong'i isinkan kumok oopuo aaing'uaa ilkituaak lenye.

English: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
Masaai: Ore Efraim enkashe apa naitamooki, nanyor aidong'o entapa. Naitajeuo apa nanu ina murt enye sidai, kake kalo nanu apik Efraim enchata emurt meeta nchere pee meturisho Yuda, meeta nchere meitupuyiapui Yakobo enkulukuoni makewan.

English: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?
Masaai: Neaku, tiaaki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Inyanya intae inkiri tenebo osarge, nidumakiki inkonyek inyi inkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin inyi nemeishu, nimbukoo osarge; intokiki ake aaku iloopeny ena kop?

English: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
Masaai: Tenebo sii ilpolosien loo le Manase, o Betshean tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o Taanak o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o Dor o nkang'itie enyena kutiti. Kunen apa neemanya ilayiok le Yosef ole Israel.

English: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD,
Masaai: Entisinya eenata inyi e mpukoroto, empotu eumata nasinya enturrurro ilpayiani, o lelo pooki oomanya ina kop meetu enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai inyi; nipuonunu aaishiraki Olaitoriani.

English: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
Masaai: Netagorote enkaraki naiteng'enita ilkipaareta olorere aaliki te Yesu empiunoto o lootuata.

English: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
Masaai: Ore te rishata o suyai naa kayau nanu sahabu, ore te rishata e sekenkei naa kayau nanu enkosholai; ore te rishata e nchata nayau osuyai, ore te rishata oo soito naa esekenkei. Kaitaa nanu lelo aitasheikinok linono eseriani, naitaa lelo likintore te ngolon esupatisho.

English: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
Masaai: Ore itii ine naaisho pooki toki niyieu, amu eton eetae kulikae arin imiet leton epuonu lo lameyu; pee mikiya iyie osina o lmarei lino pooki o pooki toki niata.’

English: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
Masaai: Itaa intae iloogolong'aki Olaitoriani ebaiki ina olong natayiolo intae.

English: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
Masaai: o layiok le Hagab, o layiok le Shamlai, o layiok le Hanan,

English: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
Masaai: Ore nena mowuarak tomon nitoduaa, ore ninche o ina ng'ues keibayu ina mulayoi, nekiny ninye aitalioo meishopo, nenya nkiri o sesen lenye nepejoo ninye te nkima.

English: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
Masaai: neitanap olapolosani ninche meteyiang'a nabo e nena motonyi tiatua emoti oo nkulukuok te nkare naruko.

English: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
Masaai: O Ekron, te nebo nkanas enyena o nkang'itie kutiti,

English: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
Masaai: Eikira doi iyiook erropili e Kristo kewan naing'uaa Enkai alo enetii lelo oopuo erruorroto,

English: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
Masaai: Ore taaisere, neitayu dinari are aisho olopeny ina aji nejoki, ‘Ing'ura taa ele tung'ani, ore pooki toki nanya nalusoo te nena, nalotu alak te nashukunye.’

English: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
Masaai: Neibulu enkisisa enye pooki wueji te nena murua naamanita.

English: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
Masaai: Kake ajoki nanu intae, entonyor ilmang'ati linyi, niomonokiki lelo ooisilisil intae;

English: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
Masaai: Neibelekenya empukunoto enye newang'u enkomom enye anaa enkolong, neiborru inkilani enyena aatiu anaa ewang'an.

English: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
Masaai: Emiureyu olaiguanani le Babilon, laa ninye iurere intae; emiureyu intae ninye, Olaitoriani ojo, amu atii nanu tenebo intae, pee aitajeu intae nakordu intae aitung'uaa enkaina enye.

English: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
Masaai: Nejo, olaiguanani le Siria, “Shomo taata, amu kairriwaki nanu empalai olaiguanani loo Siraeli.” Neaku eshomo ninye, neshoroo talanta tomon, o shekeli nkalifuni ile e sahabu, o ntukusi tomon oo nkilani.

English: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
Masaai: Nadol sii te nkaina e tatene e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo olpiyayati le embuku naigero atua o oriong, netipikaki ilmishiren oopishana.

English: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
Masaai: Neitoki Isaak aipot Yakobo, nemayian ninye, neitanap ejoki, “Mayieu niyam hoo nabo oo nkituaak oo Lkanaan.

English: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
Masaai: “Neng'amu ninche sahabu o nkarash pusi o morijo o mpilei o enkatani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
Masaai: naa kalo nanu aisho ti atua enkaji ai o ti atua isunta e nkaji ai, entoki nadamunyeki sidai nalang ilayiok o ntoyie; kaisho nanu ninche enkarna oo ntarasi nemeiwuang'ieki ae kata.

English: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Aron: Nadab olkikau, o Abihu, o Eleasar o Itamar;

English: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
Masaai: Neiteng'el ninche ilasarri oopejori pee etumi aatooriki iltung'ana terisioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, pee eishori Olaitoriani, anaa enaigeroki te mbuku e Musa. Neiko ninche neijia lelo oing'ok.

English: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana leina anasa, ilpayiani, o lkituaak apa oomanya ina anasa, neas anaa enatolikio Yesebel ninche. Anaa enaigeroki te nena pala naaigeroko ninye ninche.

English: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
Masaai: kake kitobiko iyiook too lng'oborri nikitoning'o nikias nena pooki naaitaanapa iyiook Yonadabu papa lang.

English: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
Masaai: Kepaashare nena kitanapat enkisiligata e Nkai? Mme neijia pae. Te naa apa kepokie ltung'ana nkitanapat naaishoruaki, naa anaata eikenaka Enkai iyiook isipat enkaraki nena kitanapat.

English: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metayiolo nchere iyie ake openy eji enkarna Olaitoriani, iyie Otii Shumata Aisul te nkop pooki.

English: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
Masaai: Tushukunye iyie Israel, torrinyokinoyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino amu itarrorre iyie te nkaraki enkarruoisho ino.

English: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilo, “Inyo shomo; kintajewuo enkirukoto ino.”

English: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
Masaai: o nkikenata are e kutukaji oltepesi, ore imatuan are e nkikenet nabo naa keshukunoyu eikeni o eboli naa neijia eitiu enkae matua e nkikenet.

English: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
Masaai: (Kake ti nimipalakinono, nemepalaki sii ninye Papa linyi otii shumata intae nkitarruorot inyi.)”

English: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani pooki lemening enajo ilo oiboni le Nkai, neari aaidaikie to lorere.’

English: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king's house,
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie ilarin tikitam, eidipa Solomon atesheta nena ajijik pokira are, enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
Masaai: kitok too nkiguanat naa magilani te yasata; obolo nkonyek enyena too nkoitoi pooki oo ltung'ana, nilaaki pooki tung'ani te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena o terisioroto oo lng'anayio loo nkiaasin enyena;

English: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i uni eidipa ninche aaitobira olning'o te nebo ninche, nening ninche nchere ilelatia enye ninche, naa atua ninche oshi ake etii.

English: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
Masaai: Enteserem Olaitoriani te sinyatisho e nkishiaa enye, inkirikirayu te dukuya ninye, na kop pooki!

English: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo barnot le sirit enye, “Nji shomo tiaki ele orere likijoki ninche, ‘Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto, kake inteneneng'aki iyie iyiook’; nji iyie shomo tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore enkilinta ai naa eisapuk alang empolos e papaai.

English: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
Masaai: Etotiutuo anaa ilbaa torrok to sesen lai, imorot oo lmang'ati laainei, aajoki ninche anaake, “Koree e Nkai ino?”

English: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
Masaai: Nalo nanu Farite, naturu, naitayu ina karasha teine wueji apa naisudorie ninye. Naa ng'ura etarruoyie apa ina arasha e mpolos; meekure apa eeta tipat.

English: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
Masaai: Neyakini. Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ai ng'ae ele osirakino naa ae ng'ae eigero?” Nejokini, “Kaisari.”

English: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
Masaai: Tenaa duoo ninye shumata keper oleng apa kindapashakaki naa teine kirrinyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, naa teine king'amu ninye iyie;

English: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
Masaai: laa ninye ake le meye, obik te wang'an nemeing'urayu. Nemeetae ae kata oltung'ani otoduaa ninye nemeeta oloidim atoduaa. Metaa enenye enkanyit o enkitoria intarasi. Esai.

English: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
Masaai: Eeta olchani otudung'oki osiligi, tenedung'i, naa keitoki abulu, nemetoyu intapuka enyena.

English: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kagil nanu esekenkei e Dameski naiwuang'ie lelo oomanya aitung'uaa oerata le Afen, naiwuang'ie ilo oibung'ita eng'udi e nkitoo aitung'uaa Besedan; naa kepuo iltung'ana le Siria eyararoto te Kir, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie iltung'ana ilpolosien; neibung iluaat oo ntare aapurroo nepuo aaramat.

English: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
Masaai: Apurdaki enkop too nkejek, lelo pooki ooena te nkop.

English: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
Masaai: Neisho ninche, eirriwayie Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nedoyio aapuo Seleukia; nejing empeut te ine aapuo Kupro.

English: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
Masaai: “Nchoo metijing'a olning'o erishata ai o iyie, anaa enatiu te papaai o te papaai lino. Ng'ura kaairriwaki nanu iyie enkosholai o sahabu; shomo tigila olning'o lino o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli; pee aalo aing'uaa nanu.”

English: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
Masaai: Neipot olkitok ilo sinka nejoki, ‘Lo sinka arruoni, kaatapalaka idia sile pooki enkaraki nikitasayia:

English: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD'S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
Masaai: o metaba anaa neisho Olaitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng ilalashera linyi o intae sii, neya sii ninche ina kop naisho ninche Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; nitumutumu taa aatushukokinoto enkop inyi, niyaya ninye, ina kop apa naishoo intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong.”

English: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
Masaai: Woi nanu, amu atotiwuo anaa enkata naiturrurri ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj anaa enkata naisampuni isabibu, eitu eleku toki naidimi aainosa meetae nkimarrimarrat oo lng'abolo le nkiterata ooshipakino oltau lai.

English: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.
Masaai: Etaasa osinka lino Yoab ena pee etum aibelekenya kuna baa. Kake ore olkitok lai neeta eng'eno anaa olmalaika le Nkai ayiolou mbaa pooki naatii enkop.”

English: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,
Masaai: Neitashe Yehoshafat tiatua eumata e Yuda o Yerusalem, tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, te dukuya ilo goriet ng'ejuk,

English: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
Masaai: Tadamu nchere ira apa iyie orrindik tiatua enkop e Misiri; metaa kaaitanap nanu iyie taasa ena.

English: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
Masaai: Meyieu enkikoo ai hoo nabo, netemenaitie enkisikong'ata o eutaroto ai pooki.

English: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Simion, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloontoluo, naa Isaakar, erubata nabo.

English: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia laa ninye olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo, o Shebna, laa ninye olaigeroni, o Yoa olayioni le Asafu, ilo aikenani, aapuonu enetii Hesekia etopolosa ilkilani lenye. Neinosaki ninye irorei le ilo kitok le njore.

English: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
Masaai: Neitobir ninche enkurare enye te nebo lelo arruok etunukayioki ninye te nebo olkarsis, hoo duoo ninye nemeeta entorroni nataasa, neitu ae kata ejo elejare te nkutuk enye.

English: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
Masaai: “Naa tenejur olapolosani, neitu eitoki ina keeya adaari teilo kila oripuno anaa o too ntokitin naapiyaya, anaa oloripuno anaa pooki toki oo ndapan,

English: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
Masaai: Neji enkarna o lalashe lenye Yubal, laa ninye menye le lelo oosh ilwululi loo usin o ndulen.

English: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Naaitoki ake ajoki nanu, “Imbonoki kulo oik, nijoki ninche, intae kulo oik ootoito, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amaa ninye endung'oti neipang nabo kata; naa kewarie.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa eing'ura too nkomomi anaa oltung'ani te neirorie olchore lenye. Ore pee eitoki Musa ashuko alo atua ina ang oo lng'oborri, ore osinka lenye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo barnoti neitu elo aing'uaa ilo ng'obor.

English: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
Masaai: “Tudumunye shomo tanang'are Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, etii ninye Samaria. Ng'ura etii ninye atua enkurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot, neshomo ninye aya ine aitaa enenye.

English: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.
Masaai: kake teneaku enteipa, neituku kewan te nkare, ore pee edoyio enkolong neidim ninye atijing'u atua ilng'oborri.

English: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
Masaai: nedumakino engoro o Laitoriani ninche, near ninye metuata lelo lenye oogol aaisul, neirragarie lelo gelunot le Israel.

English: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
Masaai: Anaa te neidetidetu oltung'ani oata esumash einosita endaa, neinyototo te sumash enye eitu eraposho, aashu anaa te neidetidetu oltung'ani oata enkure eokito enkare neinyototo ninye te nkure enye eitu eok enkare, neaku neijia epuo aatiu ilororani loo loshon, lelo oarare oldoinyo le Sion.

English: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eirriu Isiria le Dameski enjore nalotu aretu olaiguanani Hadadesa olaiguanani le Soba, neibung Daudi ina jore near metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oare le Siria,

English: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
Masaai: Ore ejo Yosia eibelekenya, nedol nkuraren teine to ldoinyo, neirriwaa olkilikuai meyauni iloik aaitupuku too nkuraren, nepejoo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar, neisarkionie ninye, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani apa otolimuo oltung'ani le Nkai, laa ninye apa otolimuo aibonu kuna baa.

English: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
Masaai: Ore pee kiosh oltung'ani eseder nyaaki inchoo sii enkae; ore pee eya oltung'ani engoti ino; inchoo sii enchati meewa.

English: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
Masaai: Metaa imbung naa ena kitanapata te nkata enye nageluno te pooki ari.

English: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
Masaai: Kake kelo ake pooki tung'ani oton tiabori osabibu lenye o tiabori olng'aboli lenye, nemeetae oloiture ninche; amu enkutuk o Laitoriani loo lororani nairoro.

English: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
Masaai: naa kaitaa ninche olorere obo te nkop, o too nchumat lelo doinyo le Israel, naa olaiguanani obo oitasheiki ninche pooki; nemeitoki aaku ninche iloshon aare, nemeitoki aaoro aaku inkitoriat are.

English: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
Masaai: Kake aatawalikia ilo toilo ajoki te nkata e are eing'uaa keper, ‘Ore entoki naitisinya Enkai, nimintaa iyie enturuj.’

English: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
Masaai: amu etisiraki aajo, “Ore anaa pee aishu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, ‘Aayooki pooki ng'ae agilaki kung, neyooki pooki ng'ejep aisis Enkai.’ ”

English: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
Masaai: Naa kapik nanu ina matua nabo te uni atua enkima, naa kasil nanu ninche anaa olosil enkosholai naitoki atem ninche anaa enatemi sahabu. Naa keipot ninche enkarna ai, nawaliki nanu ninche. Naa kajo nanu, ‘Iltung'ana laainei ninche, Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’ ”

English: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neishie ninye nkolong'i enye anaa enkiyang'et, neishie ilarin lenye te nkuretisho.

English: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;
Masaai: “Teneiwuang'ie Olaitoriani Enkai ino lelo oreren likilo iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino aisho enkop enye, niwuang'ie iyie ninche, nimany nkanas enye o nkajijik enye,

English: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
Masaai: Airoro apa te nkata nabo, nemaitoki awal; kat are, nemaitoki alo dukuya.”

English: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
Masaai: Ore Mefiboshet olayioni le Saul nedou alotu anang'are olaiguanani; neitu ninye eituku nkejek enyena, arashu eitobir olmunyei lenye, arashu eituku nkilani enyena, ebaiki enkolong apa nashomo olaiguanani o metabaiki enkolong naewuo ninye ashukunye te seriani.

English: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
Masaai: Ore nkiyiaa inyi te siadi intae, nening oltoilo ojo, “Nena enkoitoi, eima intae ine,” ti nimbelekenyanya intae aapuo enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kidienye.

English: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee aaibooyioki nkatitin kumok eitu alotu abaiki intae.

English: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
Masaai: Eshton apa menye le Betrafa, o Pasea, o Tihina menye le Irnabash. Kulo ninche iltung'ana le Reka.

English: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
Masaai: ore nena rubat sidain naaing'urayu nemeetayie tipat enkirrita. Kake eiruburuba Enkai osesen, neisho enkanyit sapuk nena rubat nemeeta,

English: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
Masaai: “Keisho Olaitoriani lelo mang'ati linono likidumakino, iyie metimirari ninche te dukuya iyie; eikipuonu ninche aadumakino eimu enkoitoi nabo neisik te dukuya iyie eim, nkoitoi naapishana.

English: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
Masaai: Neaku etanyaita ninche ninye, kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “Melau oloiboni le Nkai enkanyit mme te nkop enye aashu te nkaji enye.”

English: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
Masaai: Ore pooki nong'oto negum neilepunyeki, ore pooki doinyo o ewueji nerupa neitadouni; ore ewueji nemeitoriori neitoriori, ore ewueji nemeisiaja neisiajayieki.

English: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol Raheli ajo eitu eiki Yakobo inkera, netum olom te nkanashe enye oleng, nejoki ninye Yakobo, “Nchooki nanu nkera ashu aye!”

English: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
Masaai: ore ninye maata enataasa, nekuet ninche aapuo aanapa. Tudumunye, wou taretoki nanu, ning'orisho!

English: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye ina kata kiboitare intae nikinchoo intae ena kitanapata: Te nemeasisho oltung'ani emincho enya endaa.

English: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
Masaai: Nairragie enkiguana ai te dukuya ninye, naiput enkutuk ai inchankarri.

English: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
Masaai: ore eyia neitu ninche aainining nanu, arashu eishoru enkiok enye, kake eitagolo lukuny enye. Etaasa ninche ntorrok aalang loo papaai lenye.

English: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.
Masaai: Nejoki Hushai Absalom, “Ore tena kata enkikoo naishorua Ahitofel neme sidai.”

English: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina meetae hoo obo oipot enkarna ino, meetae oliking'oru aibung'are, amu isudoyie iyie enkomom ino te iyiook, nitanapua iyie iyiook apik enkaina oo nkitarruorot ang.

English: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore taata netudumakine olmarei pooki esinka ino, nejo ninche, ‘Nchoru ilo tung'ani otara olalashe lenye, pee kitum iyiook aataar ninye metua te nkaraki olalashe lenye apa otasesekuana’; neaku keinyal sii ninye olajung'oni. Neiko neijia aar enkukuo ai natung'uayioki, nemeing'ueiki olmoruo lai enkarna arashu olpisiai ti oriong enkop.”

English: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
Masaai: O Halhul, o Bet-sur, o Gedori,

English: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
Masaai: Neilep empuruo e nkorropil o lasar te nebo enkomono e lelo sinyat te nkaina o lmalaika otii dukuya Enkai.

English: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
Masaai: Ore te nkutata oo nkumeishin inono neiturrurro nkariak, neitashe inkariak aarupa, netoyu enegut ti atua enaiposha.

English: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
Masaai: “Idolitata too nkonyek inyi, nedolita nkonyek o lalashe lai Benchamen inchere enkutuk ai nairorie intae.

English: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
Masaai: “Kake tenejur olapolosani, nedol ajo eimisiloyie ilo tipoti eidipaki aaitukuo, netum naa ninye aigeru ilo tipoti aitayu teilo kila, aashu te ndapana, aashu teina naripuno aashu teina oo ntokitin naapiyaya.

English: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
Masaai: naa kapik nanu olorika lai le nkitoo Elam, naidaikie olaiguanani lenye o lkituaak, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
Masaai: Amu eeta ake enkaji pooki oloteshetua kake Enkai olashetani loo ntokitin pooki.

English: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
Masaai: Timoteo enkerai ai nanyor aigeroki: Metaa te nebo iyie empiris, o lng'ur o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
Masaai: Nejoki Abna ninye, “Shomo enkaina ino e tatene arashu ene kedienye, imbung'a obo loo lbarnot, pee iya nena naataarua ninye.” Kake meyieu Asahel neibelekenya te sujata enye.

English: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
Masaai: Ore te shumata e nena lukuny e nena ng'uesi naaishu netii entoki nanyaanyukie oloing'ang'e le keper, newang oleng anaa soito oibor oleng, neisalaashakino shumata ilukuny enye.

English: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
Masaai: amu Olaitoriani Enkai ang apa oyaua iyiook o loo papa aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitupuku te nkaji e sinkaisho, naa ninye apa otaasa nena kitoduaat sapuki too nkonyek ang, negolie iyiook te ina oitoi pooki apa nikiima o ti atua iltung'ana pooki apa likiimaitie atua ninche;

English: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
Masaai: Ng'ura ntapuka, eneiko te nebulu, nemeekenya nemepiyaisho; kake ajoki ntae, ore ninye Solomon te sikar enye pooki nemeikodo anaa enatiu nabo e kuna.

English: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
Masaai: Ore to lari le ile, to lapa le ile, te nkolong e miet o lapa, ore atonita te nkaji ai, tenebo ilpayiani le Yuda etoni te dukuya nanu, ore enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai naaiteleikino nanu.

English: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.
Masaai: Kake eyautua iltung'ana nena tokitin naataarutua, nkerra o lmong'i, nena tokitin sidain apa naatejoki keidaikieki pee epolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ino te Gilgal.”

English: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
Masaai: Kake etejo osinka lenye, “Kaji nanu aiko te naisho kuna iltung'ana iip nabo?” Neigil Elisha ajo, “Nchoo ninche iltung'ana, pee etum aainosa, amu neijia ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Keinos ninche neleku.’ ”

English: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha, neshukunye enaiposha enoshi ake kirragata enye emanaa enkakenya; nejo Ilmisiri maisika aailany enkare kake eibooko ninche Olaitoriani empolos enaiposha.

English: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
Masaai: Ore pee enyikaki Yeriko, netii oltung'ani modooni oton te mbata e nkoitoi aomonisho;

English: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
Masaai: te lelo ooitobir nkitobirat torrok too ltauja lenye, nedumu ninche olarrabal anaake.

English: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim atejo, “Aitukuo nanu oltau lai; ara nanu sinyati maata eng'oki?”

English: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
Masaai: Amu neijia ti apa eikuna inkituaak sinyat, naaisilig Enkai te nekus ate, aaning ilmoruak lenye.

English: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
Masaai: “Amaa tenikishirraki oltung'ani airorie, igoro Naa kaing'ae oidim atigirayu eitu eiro.

English: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu laduoo ooiterutua saa tomon o obo netum ake pooki tung'ani dinari.

English: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
Masaai: Neunisho Isaak teina kop ilo ari, netum enkisampuare iip nabore. Nemayian Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
Masaai: Naa keshumuni endukuya ai aailepie neitulusori te lelo mang'ati laainei laamanita, naa kalo nanu aishooyo ti atua olng'obor lenye, ilasarri te mbuakunoto o te ng'ida; naa karanyisho nanu narrep Olaitoriani.

English: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
Masaai: Kake enchom, entoliki ilooiteng'eni lenyena o Petero nchere, keituruk alo Galilaya; te ine ipuopuo aadol, anaa enatiaaka intae.”

English: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
Masaai: Nejo Solomon, “Teneitodolu ninye neitisip nchere oltung'ani le tipat, meiseyieki ninye olpapita hoo obo le ndukuya enye.”

English: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
Masaai: Tudung'o shomo olomanaa le Kupro toduaa, arashu irriwaa olkilikuai Kedar metujurru asipu; toduaa tenaa kenotoki ae kata entoki naikununo nji.

English: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
Masaai: Meetae obo lenye onauru, meetae obo lenye orrorro, meetae oloimug neirura, meetae olololong'u enkimeita, nemedung'o enkeene e namuke enye;

English: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
Masaai: O enkiroishi e sahabu te pooki mesa, e mukate e nkitoduaaroto, o enkosholai tenkaraki imisai naaitobiri te nkosholai.

English: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkata naidurrieki ilo ng'obor, naa te nepuoi aaun, naa ile Lawi ooun. Naa tenenyiku likae tung'ani, neari ninye metua.

English: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
Masaai: Ninye oitodolu enatiu enkisisa e Enkai naa ninye otaa olmishire le naikununo Enkai, naa ninye oibung'ita shumata o enkop to rorei le ngolon enye. Ore apa pee eidip aitobira enkipooto oo ng'ok, neton te tatene e Nkitoo te shumata.

English: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.
Masaai: Kake ore pooki ng'ae loo Siraeli nedoyio alo enetii Ilfilisti pee eii enchempe enye, o osururu, o entolu enye, o empanka enye nariuo nadung'ieki enkano;

English: Wherefore Adonizedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neirriwaki Adoni-sedek olaiguanani le Yerusalem Hoham olkilikuai ilo aiguanani le Hebron, o Piram olaiguanani le Yarmut, o Yafia olaiguanani le lakish, neirriwaki sii Debir olaiguanani le Eglon, ejoki,

English: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
Masaai: Neitoki adumunye Yeshua olayioni le Yohasadak, tenebo ilapolosak le ncholuek enye, o Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel tenebo iltung'ana lenye le sotua, neshetu ninche olperere lo lasar le Nkai e Israel, pee etum aaitayu olasar opejori te nchumata enye, anaa enaigeroki too nkitanapat e Musa ilo tung'ani le Nkai.

English: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
Masaai: Ekaisho iloreren meikirikirata to ltoilo lembatata enye, ina kata nanang'aki ninye abori enemeneng'a tenebo lelo oopuo tenebo engumoto; ore lelo keek pooki le Eden, lelo ooisul gelunot sidain le Lebanon, lelo pooki ook enkare, neitagoli to lodo le nkop.

English: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
Masaai: o layiok le Resin, o layiok le Nekoda, o layiok le Gasam,

English: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon ajo, “Etipika Olaitoriani enkolong keper, kake etejo ninye keton ninye te naimin namisimis.

English: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
Masaai: Te naa aikitayioloito nanu, anaata iyiololo sii Papa. Ore ebaiki taata iyiololo ninye; nitoduaa ninye.”

English: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.
Masaai: Nemayian Eli Elkana o enkitok enye, nejoki ninye, “Mikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani inkera tena kitok te ina sile apa naisilenoki ninye Olaitoriani,” neitoki ninche aashuko aapuo enkang enye.

English: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
Masaai: Ti niking'uanare ate too sipat nemeitokini aaiguanare iyiook;

English: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
Masaai: Neiteru, adek kewan nenya olmumai nejo, “Maiyiolo ilo tung'ani.” Neru nabo kata olkuku.

English: So the people rested on the seventh day.
Masaai: Neyeng'iyeng'a iltung'ana te nkolong e naapishana.

English: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
Masaai: Amu kaar nanu to lkutati ogol neponaa ilbaa laainei meeta emporeet.

English: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
Masaai: Neisik ninche ina teipa aailanyisho, neing'uaa ilng'oborri lenye, o mbartan enye, o sirkon lenye, neing'uaa ilng'oborri etiu anaa duoo ake. Neilanyisho aaitajeu enkishui enye.

English: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
Masaai: “Ntalaku iyie te ninche Olaitoriani, te risioroto e siaai oo nkaik enye.

English: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
Masaai: ore anaa nebaya ina apa natejo ninye eitisipa ororei lo Laitoriani ninye.

English: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
Masaai: Ore eidipate nena netum Yesu ninye to nkaji e Nkai, nejoki ninye, “Ing'urai, inchiwuo; mintoki ae kata aas ing'ok mikijing entorrono nalang ena.”

English: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
Masaai: Ore olkereri li are naa oltotoi sintet, oltotoi pus oata iltiil o ltotoi sidai oji almasi;

English: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
Masaai: Naa teneyieu ilo oishoo Olaitoriani ina aji nekordu enkaji enye, nelo ninye aponaa erubata e imiet e tomon entemata e nkinyiang'a too mpisai neaku taa enkaji enenye.

English: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
Masaai: Netii enchan oo soito o enkima naimerlelita ti atua enchan oo soito, enchan oo soito sapuk oleng, neitu ae kata ejing enkop e Misiri ebaiki apa pee eaku olosho.

English: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Nchoo esinka ino menoto omom too nkonyek inono.” Nelo ina kitok te nkoitoi enye nenya endaa, neitu ninye eitoki aisinanuo.

English: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
Masaai: Ore te nkata e are neibalakinye Yosef kewan ilalashera lenyena, neyiolou Farao, olorere le Yosef.

English: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
Masaai: Nearaa ninche te dukuya intae iloshon kituaak naa magil aalanag intae maate pee etum aisho intae ina kop enye metaa enjung'ore inyi anaa enatiu taata;

English: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
Masaai: Kake eitiaa ninye ilo karasha neisik meishopo.

English: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
Masaai: eitu iyiook kining isinkan linono lelo oibonok le Nkai, apa ooirorie ninche te nkarna ino ilaiguanak lang, o ilkituaak lang o loo papa, o ltung'ana pooki lena kop.

English: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramothgilead.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ilo barnoti oiboni Ramot-Gilead.

English: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
Masaai: Ore apa pee kiya iyiook ina kop teina kata, naisho nanu ile Ruben o le Gad ina kop eiteru te Aroer, natii olkirine lo oerata le Afnon, o lpisiai oitorit ina kop oo ldoinyo e Gilead tenebo nkanas enyena;

English: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
Masaai: Ore te ina saa ake nepuonu embata oo Ilfarisayo, nejoki, “Inyo shomo te ne amu keyieu Herode nikiaar tua.”

English: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
Masaai: “Kake ejo ninche, ‘Pesho ina! Kisuj iyiook nkitobirat ang maate, neas pooki ng'ae te risioroto engolon oltau lenye torrono.’

English: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
Masaai: Milo iyie aiko neijia to Laitoriani Enkai ino,

English: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
Masaai: Naa keitayu anaa olasar le ntapa e efa te pooki oing'oni, e efa te pooki meregesh, o hini e ilata te pooki efa.

English: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
Masaai: Anaa kutuk aji nabolo too enat enyena, neijia sii etiu oltashalai te ndapash enye.

English: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo le Nkai nening irorei le Nkai. Ore te nkaraki ena nimining'ining'i intae amu mirara le Nkai.”

English: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
Masaai: ‘Ayiolo nanu olwuanet lino o eninkunari te nimpang o ti nijing'u, o ina nikigorokino nanu.

English: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
Masaai: Ore enkiterunoto oo rorei le nkutuk enye naa emodai, naa ore enkiting'oto e nkiroroto enye naa olkuenyi torrono.

English: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
Masaai: Neitaa ninche peyie etum aaing'oru Enkai, pee ebaiki ake neirrapirrapu, nebaiki netum. Hoo nemelakuaniki ninye hoo obo lang,

English: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
Masaai: Neaku easisho ake keeya ti atua iyiook, kake enkishui naasisho ti atua intae.

English: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
Masaai: Einosie ninche Olaitoriani olmumai to ltoilo sapuk, o te mbuakunoto o too ntarumpetani, o te oshoto oo mowuarak.

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neng'amaa te ninche ina sahabu pooki apa naitaaki imasaa.

English: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
Masaai: nejoki, “Ainyoo pee irurara? Enyeito entoomon pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat.”

English: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
Masaai: Etii Enkai atua ina anasa, nemeigusugusieki ninye; keretu Enkai ninye tadekenya.

English: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
Masaai: Ore kira laisiaayiak te nebo ninye nikisai intae eming'amaa empiris e Nkai pesho;

English: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
Masaai: Neiteru Ahasia olayioni le Ahab aitoreisho te Isirael te Samaria to lari le tomon oopishana le nkitoria e Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oare te Israel.

English: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neyau ninye lelo tung'ana apa ootii atua enkanasa, nepik ninche enkisiaayiare too musumenoni, o sururuni o ntoluo, neisho ninche meteekenyata te mpejoto oo lmatofali naa nji eikuna ninye too nkanas pooki oo Lamoni. Kaae neitoki Daudi o ltung'ana pooki aashuko Yerusalem.

English: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
Masaai: Ina pee atoduaa ajo keishiaakino ake nairriu lalashera meituruku aapuonu enitii te dukuya neitobir ina kishoroto nitejo nchoruru. Naa te neetuo eirrag eidipe neitoduaaya ina nchere intae ate ootonyorra aaishoru, nemetii olmonir.

English: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa nalotu enetii Farao airo te nkarna ino, neitaasa ninye ntorrok kulo tung'ana, neitu iyie intajeu iltung'ana linono tukul.

English: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
Masaai: Ilo otayiewua to ltau keeya, nemelotu ninye, neturu ninye ninye oleng alang entoki nagol enkinyang'a naiteng'ela.

English: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani oishooyo olasar te nkaraki eng'oki nenya ninye; nenya ninye tiatua ine wueji sinyati, tiatua olgoriet lo lng'obor le ntumo.

English: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
