English: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
Masaai: Iyie otarrarra Rahabu anaa empopong, iyie oidapasha ilmang'ati linono te nkaina ino.

English: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
Masaai: Kake eipiripirokito ninche enterit oo nkejek enye, nepuonu Ikonio.

English: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
Masaai: Todua kewan mimbelekenyakino intorrok amu ena ninye itegelua eitu igelu olosilisili.

English: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
Masaai: Aaiteng'ena nanu iyie nkoitoi e ng'eno; aatoriko iyie too nkoitoi naaitoriori.

English: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi e nkiti rishata neitoki Daudi arasaki Ilfilisti nemir ninche. Ewa ninye aoru ninche enkanasa e Gaat o nkang'itie naataaniki kutiti neoru Ilfilisti.

English: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
Masaai: Nejo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ootadoutuo eing'uaa Yerusalem, “Beelsebul eeta, naa oloitore loiriruani eararie loiriruani.”

English: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
Masaai: Neitobir sii olaiguanani olorika le nkitoo kitok loo lala loo lkanchaoni, nemur te sahabu nasila.

English: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana ootoduaa ina kitoduaata nataasa Yesu nejo, “Esipa ele oloiboni olotu enkop.”

English: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo kitok le njore ninche, “Entiaaki Hesekia, ‘Nji ejo ilo aiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria: Kainyoo iyie ing'idare?

English: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
Masaai: Keitu iyie inkilikuan lelo oopuo too nkoitoi naalala, naa keitu iyie ing'amaa enchakenisho enye,

English: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.
Masaai: Toduaa, papaai lai, toduaa ajo etii olcholoi lo lkila lino enkaina ai; amu ore te sipata nchere atudung'oyie olcholoi lo lkila lino, neitu aar iyie tua, indim atayiolo nidol nchere metii entorroni e nkibelekenyata arashu enkitoria atua nkaik aainei. Eitu aas eng'oki ti alo iyie, hoo nirresh enkishui ai pee intayu.

English: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
Masaai: Kake ti nikisiligu entoki nemelioo, naa eikiaanyu te ng'iriata.

English: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.
Masaai: Amu etegelua Olaitoriani Enkai ino ninye tiatua loshon linyi pooki, pee eitashe neisiaisho te nkarna o Laitoriani, ninye o layiok lenyena ntarasi.

English: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani enkata e are, neiseyie ninye, nejoki, “Tudumunye inosa endaa, amu kegolu elototo te iyie.”

English: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku meshomo atua Manase pooki, neipotuni sii ninche metusujai ninche. Neitoki airriwaa ilkiliku meshomo Asheri, o Sebulon, o Naftali neilep ninche aapuo aanang'are ninche.

English: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
Masaai: Nebarn ninye olmunyei lenye, olpapit loo nkonyek o lpapit lenyena pooki. Neitoki aituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku osesen lenye te nkare, neaku ninye olemeiduruk.

English: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
Masaai: Amu Adam apa eiteraki aaitobir neitokini Hawa.

English: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
Masaai: Neyieu oltau lo laiguanani nelo enetii Absalom; amu eitigiraki ti alo Amnon, etodua ajo etua ninye.

English: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
Masaai: Neisikong olikae ajoki, “Ai miure iyie Enkai, nidol ajo ina kiguana kitudung'okoki sii iyie?

English: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
Masaai: ore olosujaki naa Amasia olayioni le Sikri, ilo oishorua kewan te nkisiaayiare o Laitoriani, tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip are magil yiolot.

English: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
Masaai: Tenaa eitaasa apa te nkirukoto sidai o te nkanyit o Yerubaal o enkaji enye ena olong, enting'idakinoto naa Abimelek, naa nchoo sii ninye eng'idakino intae,

English: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
Masaai: Metaa eitayio Enkai oltung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan. Te nkitanyaanyukoto Enkai eitayio ninye ninche, olee o eng'oruoi.

English: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
Masaai: nenukaa Olaitoriani ninye to erata te nkop e Moab eipirakinore Bet-peor; kake meetae oltung'ani oyiolo enkurare enye otaata.

English: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
Masaai: Ilkanaani te nkalo o loo saen o to loontoluo, o Lamori, o Lhiti, o Lperisi, o Lyebusi, ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo, o Lhifi ti abori Hermon ti atua enkop e Mispa.

English: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
Masaai: ore too le Yuda naa Elihu, obo loo lalashera le Daudi; ore too le Isaakar, naa Umri olayioni le Mikael;

English: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
Masaai: neisuaaki ilo oitisinyi teina keeya oo lbolot katitin naapishana; netum taa aibalunye ninye nchere meiduruk, neing'ueiki ina motonyi naishu aisho meshomo te nkisiajata.

English: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
Masaai: Kake ore amu kira ile ndama emaiteng'enuoto nikinchop elong'o oo lgooitie inchere enkirutoto o enyorrata, ore enkopiyia e sekenkei osiligi le njeunoto.

English: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari naa: Mahali o Mushi. Ore ilayiok le Mahali naa: Eliesa o Kish.

English: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare oldoinyo le Seir, nimbonoki aarare ninye

English: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
Masaai: Entoliki nkera inyi, naa nchoo nkera inyi metoliki nkera enye, neliki nkera enye eishoi enye.

English: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi pooki teina anasa sinyati naa iip are o ntomoni isiet o ong'uan.

English: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
Masaai: Neaku kepulusokino ninye eng'olikinoto aluam; ore te nkiti kata naa kegila enemeishiunoyu.

English: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Taanak, obo; olaiguanani le Megido, obo;

English: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
Masaai: Amu eyupuyupieki enkima te ngoro ai, naa keyupuyup ometabaiki enguton e nemeneng'a, nemut enkop o nena naabulu neinok too lbakunot loo ldoinyo.

English: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak o lbalusuni neing'oru enaitang'orie Daniel ti alo enkitoria; kake eitu ninche etum enaitang'orie aashu eleyiata, amu keisiligayu apa ninye, nemeetae enkitadiaata aashu eleyiata nanotoki te ninye.

English: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
Masaai: amu aitasho nanu te nkuretisho sapuk aure olturrur, naaiture nanu enkiba oo lmareita, metaa atigire neitu aipang aim inchomito.

English: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
Masaai: Neitoki Daniel ajoki ilo aitasheikinoni laa ninye apa etegelua ilo kitok loo laitasheikinok sunash ogelema meing'ura Daniel, o Hanania, o Mishael o Asaria;

English: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
Masaai: Pee maraposho ake naayooki aany iyie, najo, “Aing'ae doi ilo aitoriani?” Anaa aaku aisinani, naaku olopurrisho, naisarkionie ina arna e Nkai ai.

English: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
Masaai: Ore enkitoria ino naa enoo ntarasi, nebikoo enkitoo e nkitoria ino too ishoritin pooki. Asipani Olaitoriani too rorei lenyena pooki, naa aipirisioni too nkiasin enyena pooki.

English: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul ninye, “Ira iyie ole ng'ae, lo barnoti?” Newal Daudi ajo, “Ara nanu olo sinka lino Yese le Betlehem.

English: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani aminin naa kemayiani, amu keng'arie endaa enye ilaisinak.

English: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
Masaai: Ore Enkai nayiolo ltauja, neaku shakeni te ninche aisho Enkiyang'et Sinyati, anaa enapake naishoo iyiook;

English: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu enkare nairobi to ltau oota enkure, neija etiu ilomon supati ooing'uaa enkop nalakua.

English: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
Masaai: Aashu mukateni naapishana naainosa inkalifuni ong'uan oo ltung'ana, kaja nkikapuni ninturrurrutuo?

English: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
Masaai: Neitodol ninye ninche enkoitoi nalo atua ina anasa; near ninche ina anasa te nepi o lalem, kake eishoo ninche ilo tung'ani te nebo olmarei lenye meshomo.

English: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
Masaai: “Amaa taata Israel, kainyoo eyieu Olaitoriani Enkai ino te iyie, neme teniureyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nilo too nkoitoi enyena pooki, ninyorru ninye, nisiaai Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki.

English: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
Masaai: Ore intokitin naarieki iltaai o neeiteleikini naa ile sahabu nasila.

English: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
Masaai: “Lo tung'ana oosho murto, lememurata ltauja nememurata nkiyiaa, igolong'akiki oshi ake Enkiyang'et Sinyati; ore enapake nataasa iloo minyi, neijia nkona sii intae.

English: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
Masaai: Neinos ninche neraposho oleng, amu eishoo ninye ninche ina natang'uarra.

English: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
Masaai: Amaa oshi kinchooyo enashe te ina kikompe e mayianata, mme osarge le Kristo oshi ilo liking'ar? Naa amaa oshi kibel emukate, mee osesen le Kristo ilo liking'ar?

English: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Musa Enkai, “Kara nanu ng'ae olo enetii Farao, nayau ilayiok loo Siraeli aaitung'uaa Misiri?”

English: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
Masaai: Kake tinintayiolo ilo torrono pee eibelekenyunye te nkoitoi enye, neitu eibelekenyunye ninye te nkoitoi enye; naa keye ninye too ng'ok enyena, kake intajeuo iyie enkishui ino.

English: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
Masaai: Ore sii too layiok loo lapolosak, lelo ayiok le Barsilai, laa ninye apa oyama nabo oo ntoyie e Barsilai le Gilead, laa ninye apa eipotieki enkarna enye.

English: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
Masaai: Taboloki nkonyek aainei pee atum atoduaa mbaa e nking'asia naaing'uaa enkitanapata ino.

English: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
Masaai: Kumok sii iltung'ana le nkeeya oo lbolot oatae te Siraeli te nkata o loiboni le Nkai Elisha, nemeetae hoo likae obo oitukuoki, leme Naaman ake le Siria.”

English: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
Masaai: Neisiaai iltung'ana Olaitoriani nkolong'i pooki e Yoshua, o nkolong'i pooki e lelo payiani apa ootii te siadi Yoshua, apa ootoduaa ina siaai pooki kitok nataasa Olaitoriani te nkaraki Israel.

English: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
Masaai: Neaku kiyiolo iyiook aajo ore pooki najo nkitanapat naa lelo ejoki ootii abori nena kitanapat, pee eitigiri ake pooki kutuk, neaku Enkai eikenaki enkop pooki imbaa enye.

English: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
Masaai: Kelo ilo supat ang'idayu te nedol enkitalakunoto e lap, nelo ninye aituku nkejek enyena to sarge le lelo arruok.

English: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Eitu eibelekenyakino iltung'ana ilo otoosho ninche, neitu eing'oru Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee ing'or entubuloi natii enkong'u o lalashe lino, nimidol olchata otii enkong'u ino makewan?

English: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki Enkai, “Amaa te nalotu enetii iltung'ana loo Siraeli najoki ninche ‘Aairriwua nanu Enkai oo loo papaai linyi maeu enitii ntae’; naaikilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Keji ng'ae enkarna enye?’ kaa ajoki ninche?”

English: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
Masaai: etoyio engolon ai anaa oleleo le moti, neterepa olng'jep lai ntakul aainei; nikirragie iyie nanu te nterit e keeya.

English: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
Masaai: Ore enkishon ino newang'u alang enaiwulie enkolong; ore enaimin enye netiu anaa entadekenya.

English: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
Masaai: Amu keiba ninche eng'eno, neitu egelu euriata o Laitoriani.

English: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
Masaai: nedol aajo keinos kulikae ooiteng'eni lenyena endaa eiduruk inkaik, eji meisuja.

English: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
Masaai: Neshetaki Daudi te ine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar, neishoru olasar opejori o lasar le seriani. Neaku etoning'o Olaitoriani eomonokinoto enkop, neiwuang'ieki olmeitai aaitung'uaa Israel.

English: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
Masaai: o Kenas, o Tenan, o Mibsar,

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Teshetakaki nanu tene ilperereni oopishana lo lasar, nikincho nanu tene iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana.”

English: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
Masaai: “Ore oltaa lo sesen naa enkong'u, metaa te neikishiaan enkong'u ino, neiput osesen lino pooki ewang'an.

English: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
Masaai: Metaa meigil aekata ninche aayiang'aki ilasarri lenye loo loiriruani, laa ninye etololoitore. Keaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi te nkaraki ninche tiatua iishoreitin enye pooki.

English: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye Daudi nelang alo, ninye o lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootii te nebo ninye, aapuo enetii Akish olayioni le Moak, olaiguanani le Gas.

English: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
Masaai: Kake itudumakine iyie iltung'ana laainei anaa olmang'atinta; nioru olkila ilo oata eseriani, lelo oopuo eisiligayu lelo lemeeta ndamunot o larrabal.

English: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
Masaai: Nipik lelo soito pooki inkaloli ooronyi le ina kila dorrop, pee eaku isoito oodamunyeki ilayiok le Israel; nenap Aron inkarn enye te dukuya o Laitoriani too ronyi lenyena pee edamuni.

English: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore lelo tung'ana apa ootelekutua to lalem nenoto empiris ti ong'ota; ina kata apa eing'oru Israel enkiyeng'yeng.

English: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
Masaai: Amu enkolong nabo ti atua enkaji ino naikash alang nkolong'i enkalifu nabo te dikae. Enaikash nanu te naaku olarriponi te kutuk aji e nkaji e Nkai ai, alang te nabik too lng'oborri le nkarruoisho.

English: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
Masaai: nepik olapolosani ina ng'ues entemata e nkinyiang'a tenaa eisidai aashu tenaa torrono; anaa enitem iyie olapolosani ninye, neaku neijia etiu enkinyiang'a.

English: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
Masaai: Edamu Yerusalem nkolong'i enyena olosilisili o emion, mbaa pooki naatulusoitie, apa naa nkunenyena ebaiki moitie. Ina kata apa pee ejing iltung'ana lenyena, enkaina olmang'atinta, nemeetae hoo obo oretu ninye. Neikordod olmang'atinta ninye, nesurdaany teina batatata enye.

English: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
Masaai: Te nadamisho nanu, “Neideketari enkeju ai,” enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ninye naaibung'ita.

English: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
Masaai: Neaku eetuo ilpayiani pooki le Israel enetii olaiguanani te Hebron; neitobir Daudi olning'o o ninche te Hebron te dukuya Olaitoriani. Nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput metaa olaiguanani le Israel, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani oimunye Samuel.

English: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
Masaai: ore edol ninche te ntae induaat elejare ina kata eibonoki ninche intae elejare, peyie eeniki imurto e lelo tung'ana lemesinya torrok, lelo ootabaikia ninche enkolong enye enkata enkitamioto enye nabayie.

English: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
Masaai: Netir apa ninye enkure oleng, neipot ninye Olaitoriani nejo, “Nchorua iyie enkordunoto kitok te nkaina o sinka lino; naa kaye nanu taata te nkure, nabatatakino atua nkaik oo lememurata?”

English: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
Masaai: Ore eidipa ashomo, nepuonu ilaisiaayiak; ore pee edol aajo keikeno nkutukie e lelo gilat le shumata, nejo ninche, “Ebaiki naa kewan ebakita ti atua ilo gilata oirobi.”

English: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
Masaai: Eetae apa oltung'ani omanya enkop e Us, oji enkarna enye Yoab. Naa ore apa ilo tung'ani nemeeta entioto naa oltung'ani oitashe too sipat, neure ninye Enkai oleng, neorunye aing'uaa intorrok.

English: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
Masaai: te nebo nena ang'itie naaiteng'elakaki ile Efraim ti atua enjung'ore oo le Manase, nena ang'itie pooki o nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
Masaai: A'a, Kajoito ore lelo asarri oopolos lelo lemeyiolo Enkai loiriruani epolosaki mme Enkai.

English: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
Masaai: Kake mme ina eyieu ninye, neme ina edamu ninye; kake ore ndamunot enyena naa pee einyalisho, nedung'oo iloshon leme kuti;

English: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
Masaai: Niriku sii ilayiok lenyena ninchopoki ninche ilkilani,

English: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
Masaai: o Sanoa, o En-ganim, o Tapua, o Enam,

English: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
Masaai: “Ainyoo pee eishori ewang'an ilo otii engolikinoto, neishori enkishui ilo oata emion to ltau.

English: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
Masaai: neitoki Yoshua aipotu ile Ruben o le Gad, o lpisiai lo losho le Manase,

English: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Benchamen, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloontoluo, naa Simion, erubata nabo.

English: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
Masaai: Neitoki Huram, ajo, “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, ilo oitobira shumata o enkop, laa ninye oishoo olaiguanani Daudi olayioni ng'en, neiputaki enkarriyiano o eyiolounoto, laa ninye oshetaki Olaitoriani enkaji, neshetaki kewan enkaji e nkitoo.

English: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
Masaai: Toning'o, iyie na tito, tadamu, nirrugu enkiok ino; nchoo kirikino olorere linyi o enkaji e papaai lino,

English: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
Masaai: Ninye etegelua Paulo pee eiriamariyie; neibung nemurat te nkaraki lelo Yahudi le ilo kirine; amu keyiolo pooki aajo Olyunani apa menye.

English: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
Masaai: Nebatata ile Benchamen nkalifuni tomon o isiet, ore pooki naa iltung'ana yiolot.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kainyoo pee kinchiraki nanu? Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo dukuya.

English: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
Masaai: Amu mme rorei le pesho kulo te intae, kake enkishui inyi, ore enkaraki ina, ipuopuo aabikoo teina kop nilang'akiki te lido kekun le Yordan nipuopuo aaya.”

English: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilarin oare oolulung'a neeta apa Absalom ilabarnok loo nkerra te Baal-haso, naa ninye nataaniki Efraim, neitoomon Absalom ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani.

English: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
Masaai: Kake ti nintayu iyie enkishoroto ino o lng'ur nimincho enkaina ino e kedienye metayiolo enaas ene tatene;

English: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
Masaai: Neipotoki sii Yesu o looiteng'eni lenyena te ina kiyama.

English: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
Masaai: Ore enasirie te nkolong e dukuya e wiki, ore eton emisimis nelotu Mariamu Magdalena enkurare nedol ajo eiwuang'ieki osoit te nkurare.

English: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
Masaai: Kadoiki nanu ninche anaa olng'arurumi otooruoki nkera enyena, kapolos nanu olgoo lenye, ore teine naidaikie nanu ninche anaa olng'atuny, anaa enaiko enkukuu.

English: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
Masaai: “Etii atua olng'obor.” Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Meeta duoo inchere peyie maarrinyokino iyie te nkata olorujuruj, ore Sara enkitok ino, keaku anaata enkayioni ina kata.” Ore eiro einining'isho ake Sara te nkutuk olng'obor ti oriong e Abraham.

English: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
Masaai: Ning'iriri metabaiki enkiting'oto pee iakuku ilooiputakinote nelulung'a neitu eng'oriki toki.

English: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
Masaai: Ore te pooki siaai netii dupoto kake ore too nkirorot e pesho neyau osina.

English: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Amori oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo nepuonu aarare intae, nemir intae anaa enamirisho ilotorok, near intae aairragie te Seir, o metabaiki Horma.

English: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
Masaai: Neaku te eina aas, netiu anaa nkitanapat ake atonyorrayie ajo supati.

English: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
Masaai: Intoomono olikae olikae metii enking'unyung'uny.

English: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
Masaai: Naa nji eikununo enkisiaayiare, apa nataasa olaiguanani Solomon eshet enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji enye makewan, o Milo, o esuntai e Yerusalem, o Hasor, o Megido, o Geser.

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
Masaai: Neijia eiko olapolosani aitobiraki ninye olasar olning'o lo sotua teina ng'oki nataasa ninye tiae nabo e kuna baa naa kepalakini ninye. Ore enaleku neaku eno lapolosani anaa enkishoroto e ntapa.”

English: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
Masaai: “Naa keitobir ninche osanduku too nkeek o lerai; intemat are o lpisiai enkadoro, entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai enkilepata.

English: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
Masaai: Ore teilo ari lionom naa keaku osirua te intae, ore teina nimiunishosho aashu isampumpu ina nabulu openy, aashu isotutu ilng'anayio loo sabibu leitu eitobiri.

English: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni osipa nemelejisho, kake ore olchakeni lemesipa neitayu entooma e lejare.

English: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
Masaai: Meiwuang'ie ninye inkonyek te lelo supati, kake ore too laiguanak te nkitoo enye, eitasheyie ninche intarasi, nejukari ninche.

English: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
Masaai: Aatadoikio nanu ena mayianata, nchere aibung'a nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
Masaai: Itoning'o intae empukunoto ai apa eton aa lkerreti loo lyahudi aishuyie. Iyiololo enaikona ainosie osina esirit e Enkai maibooroyu aa kajo aidaikie,

English: And he said unto him, We are passing from Bethlehemjudah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Bethlehemjudah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilo payian kitok, “Kipuoito iyiook aagiroo Betlehem ti atua Yuda, aapuo nekua rishat naabayie e ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, naa ninye aing'uaa nanu. Ashomo apa Betlehem ti atua Yuda, naloito taata enkang ai, nemetii hoo ng'ae laatoriko nanu atua enkaji enye.

English: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore apa enkata naitoreisho Daudi te Israel naa ilarin artam eitoreishe ninye ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni te Yerusalem.

English: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Marrinyo nanu te nebo iyie; amu itanya iyie ororei lo Laitoriani, nikitanya iyie Olaitoriani pee miaku olaiguanani te Israel.”

English: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye te Obot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Iye-abarim, te ilo purkel oipirare Moab, te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong.

English: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
Masaai: (nchoo naa olapolosani einosie ina kitok olmumai lo ldeket, nejoki ina kitok), ‘Kintaa iyie o Laitoriani oldeket o lmumai ti atua iltung'ana linono, ti nikincho Olaitoriani meibibiari enkupes ino neiteijia osesen lino;

English: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
Masaai: Neyooki taaisere aashukunye emanyata, neing'ueikini iloo mbartan metoriko aapuo.

English: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
Masaai: Te nemeimulumul enkitok endukuya nemeeta naa enatiu te nedung'i ilpapit; naa te naa esulare te nedung'i enkitok ilpapit aashu ebarni elukunya, neishaakino naa neimulumul endukuya.

English: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
Masaai: Amu etiaaka Yohana, “Mikinchoro too nkitanapat ti niaata ninye.”

English: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
Masaai: Nejo enkitok nabo e nena, “Oi olkitok lai, ore ena kitok o nanu naa enkaji nabo kimanya; naisho nanu eton kishula teina aji.

English: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
Masaai: nikiyanyit naleng nena rubat o sesen naaijo mme ne tipat; ore nena nemeing'urayu naa ninche kirrita oleng;

English: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
Masaai: ore te nchumata oldoinyio le Israel naa kaun ninye peyie etum atoiu ilng'osil neiu ilng'anayio, neaku oltarakuai kitok; ore tiabori enye nemany impukunot pooki oo ng'uesi; ore to loip loo lng'osil lenyena ore impukunot pooki oo motonyi neponari aaisho.

English: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
Masaai: Neyau Olaitoriani arrinyu nkiasin enyena e nkibukoroto o sarge shumata endukuya enye makewan, amu ore apa meyiolo papa Daudi, etarasaka ninye nesesekuan to lalem iltung'ana oare supati naa iletipat aalang ninye, Abna olayioni le Neer, ilo kitok le njore oo Siraeli o Amasa olayioni le Yeter, olkitok le njore e Yuda.

English: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
Masaai: Keyieu oltau lai, ee, naa keiterriakino enkaji o Laitoriani; neranyaki te ng'ida oltau lai o sesen lai Enkai naishu.

English: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.
Masaai: Nchoo Solomon enkerai ai meibung'a to ltau lenye nkitanapat inono, pooki o enchakenisho ino, o nkikoot inono, neitabaya pooki, neshet ninye ine wueji apa naitobira.”

English: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
Masaai: Naa kaitalaku nanu katitin are entorroni enye o eng'oki enye enkaraki naituruja enkop ai too mpopoki oo nkitaanyaanyukot, neiputa ninche enjung'ore ai nena o lminong lenye.”

English: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
Masaai: Ore nena dapan oo lbalelon nepik inkaik enyena o ine wueji nesipa te murt enye;

English: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
Masaai: Kaae nelo Eliya teine, nelo atum Elisha olayioni le Shefat eturishore ilmong'i tomon oare. Netii apa ninye tenebo ilo kiteng le tomon oare. Negiroo Eliya ninye nenang'aki olkila lenye.

English: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
Masaai: Neboitare ilo malaika, olorora kitok le shumata oisis Enkai ejo,

English: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and hast a desire unto her, that thou wouldest have her to thy wife;
Masaai: nidol tiatua ninche lelo yarunot enkitok sidai, ning'uar iyie ninye, niya iyie aitaa enkitok ino,

English: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
Masaai: Etuata ninche, nemeitoki aapiu, etaa ninche loipi, nemeigil ninche aaitashe; ore te ina, nitumutana iyie ninche aishie, niwuang'ie ninche pee meigili ai kata aadamu.

English: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa lelo tenebo ilayiok lenye. Ore too layiok le Kohat naa: Haman olaranyani ole Yoel, olayioni le Samuel,

English: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkanashe ino, ning'arie menye aashu ina tito e ng'utunyi aa einoti eang aashu enayawuaki.

English: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
Masaai: Enoto sii ninye entiitiit ewueji, netum enkomerei enkaji, ewueji neirragakinyie nkera enyena, too lpereren linono loo lasarri, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, Olaitoriani lai naa Enkai ai.

English: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer unto Ashdod.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eibung' Ilfilisti ilo sanduku le Nkai, nenap ebaiki Ebenesa o metabaiki Ashdod.

English: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
Masaai: Etii nkonyek aainei dukuya Olaitoriani anaake, amu keitayu ninye nkejek aainei to rreshet.

English: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
Masaai: nelotu taa oltung'ani osinya aitayu mbenek e nchani naji hisopo, neitadoiki atua ina are, neisuaki shumata ilo ng'obor, o shumata imasaa pooki ilorikan o shumata lelo tung'ana ootii ine, o shumata ilo oiseyie oloito, aashu olotasesekuanaki, aashu olotua, aashu enkurare;

English: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
Masaai: neitaarriyian ninche ejoki, “Inji intae enchom entiaaki olkitok lai Esau inji ejo olaisiaayiani lino Yakobo, ‘Ataboitare Laban o taata,

English: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
Masaai: amu keitoriori ororei lo laitoriani; ore siaitin enyena pooki neasi te nkitoriori.

English: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
Masaai: Naa tenelo ninye ajing atua enkanasa, neyau Isiraeli pooki nkeenta ina ang, nikinkurtutaa iyiook ina ang atua oerata o metaba anaa neaku metumi ninye osoit obo te ine.”

English: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
Masaai: O mbaoi o oltarakuai nemeikenayu; amu eyautua iltung'ana le Sidon, o le Tiro mbaoi kumok o ltarakuai aayaki Daudi.

English: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
Masaai: Ore embata e lelo oora ng'eni nebatata, pee esil neitisiny ninche neiborrie ninche, o metabau enkata e nkiting'oto, amu eton ina aa ene nkata apa nategeluaki.

English: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
Masaai: Ore Epafras, ora obo linyi, osinka le Yesu Kristo, neiroroki intae, nedamu intae anaa ake te nkomono enye, peyie intasheshe itubulutua neitisipaki eyieunoto e Enkai ti atua intae.

English: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
