English: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
Masaai: Neiken ninye tenebo ilo apa oyawua ninye ebaiki ilo ari apa otimirakinye kewan ninye ometabau olari le Yubilii, ore enkinyang'a e lakunoto enye neaku te risioroto oo larin. Ore apa enkata natii ninye tenebo ilo ora olopeny neikenari anaa enkata olaisiaayiani lolmushaara.

English: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
Masaai: Nedol ina aisiaayiani, neitoki ake ajoki lelo ooitashe te ine, “Ore ele tung'ani, obo lenye.”

English: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
Masaai: Enkitok naibor onyek nang'amu ilomon terishata olpayian lenye!

English: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Entusulaki ninye enkop.” Nesulaki ninche ninye enkop; ore embata o sarge lenye neisuakino esuntai, o mbartan, neitunyoo mbartan ninye.

English: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
Masaai: Neliki ilooiteng'eni le Yohana. Yohana nena baa pooki.

English: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
Masaai: Ndipakine apa iyie ti atua entorroni ino, nijo, “maadolita nanu oltung'ani;’ ” ore eng'eno ino o enkarriyiano ino nikintapong'oyie, nijo iyie to ltau lino, “Atii nanu, nemetii likae.”

English: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
Masaai: amu eishorutua pooki te nkumoi oo naata, kake eishorua ninye to sina lenye pooki toki naata.”

English: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip ilo maati ainosa inkujit e ina kop, najo nanu, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tapalaki ninche, aatasayia iyie! Kaji naa eiko pee eitashe Yakobo? Eikiti ninye oleng!”

English: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
Masaai: Ilotu amany enkop e Goshen nikilotu anyikaki iyie tenebo inkera inono o nkera oo nkera inono, o ntare inono, o nkishu inono, o pooki toki niata.

English: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel o Yuda nedumunye te mbuakunoto nesuj Ilfilisti o metabai Gas o nchomito e Ekron neaku ore lelo Filisti loo lbaa nebatata ebaiki She-ara-im o metabaiki Gas o Ekron.

English: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
Masaai: Ore pooki kikau aa olayioni le tung'ani aashu olayioni le ng'ues, ilo oishori Olaitoriani naa keaku olinyi, ore ake eyia olkikau le tung'ani tokordu ainyiang'u, ore olkikau pooki le ng'ues lemesinya inyang'u tokordu.

English: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Binui: naa Shimei,

English: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
Masaai: Ore ninye apa atii Sesalonike, kirriwakita nanu eretoto e dukuya o ene nkaigil.

English: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani le Misiri ajoki inkaitoyiok oo Lhebrania, aa keji nabo Shifra neji enkae Pua,

English: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
Masaai: Ainyoo etum oltung'ani te siaai enye pooki natanaurikia, ina natanaurikia tiabori enkolong?

English: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu matoning'o tadekenya ina nyorrata ino nauno, amu iyie nanu atipika osiligi lai. Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi naaim, amu iyie nanu ailepakinye oltau lai.

English: O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.
Masaai: Enino Olaitoriani esipita, kake kiaata iyiook enkurruna anaa enikitiu ena olong too ltung'ana le Yuda, te lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o Israel pooki, lelo ootaana o lelo oolakua pooki, ti atua nenakuapi pooki apa niterewa iyie ninche. Te nkaraki ina taboi nataasa ninche ti alo iyie.

English: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa eiun inkurman oo sabibu too nchumat oo ldoinyo le Samaria neunisho ilaunok neitumurru ilng'anayio.

English: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bebai naa Yehohanan, o Hanania, o Sabai, o Atalia.

English: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
Masaai: isudoyioki nanu ntung'uayioki ilnukat le ilo torrono, ntung'uayioki mpuot oo laasak loo ntorrok,

English: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
Masaai: Oi nanu, olomanya atua Meshek, obikito too lng'oborri le Kedar!

English: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
Masaai: Eteshetaka apa Daudi kewan nkajijik te nkanasa e Daudi; neitobir ewueji nepiki osanduku le Nkai, neunoki olng'obor shumata ninye.

English: So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninche pokira are ometabai Betlehem. Ore ake pee ebau Betlehem neing'asia enkang pooki te nkaraki ninche; nejo nkituaak, “Ai Naomi ena?”

English: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
Masaai: Ataa Olyahudi ti alo Lyahudi peyie atum Ilyahudi; ore nena kitanapat naaitore ninche, atotiwuo anaa oloitore nena kitanapat peyie atum atoriku ninche, hoo neme nena kitanapat naaitore nanu makewan;

English: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
Masaai: “Naa ena nalo aaku olmonekie te intae: ore tele ari, ninosinoso intae nena naabulu oopeny, ore to lari liare ninosinoso nena ake ore to lari liokuni, niunuunu nisampumpu, niunuunu isabibu, ninosinoso ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
Masaai: Ayiolo ajo ore ilo tung'ani (te naa taa to sesen, aashu metii osesen nemayiolo, Enkai nayiolo) eilepieki aaya Paradiso,

English: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aayau lelo alashera linyi pooki ooing'uaa loshon pee eaku olasar lo Laitoriani, nepuonu too mbartan, o too ngarrin oo mbartan, o too ngarrin naaimulumula, o nyumpui, o ntamesin ilo doinyo lai sinyati, Yerusalem, Olaitoriani ojo, aaikununye anaa ake duoo Israeli te neyau olasar lenye le ntapa too ngirran nemeiduruk atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
Masaai: Kish apa menye le Saul, ore Ner menye le Abna naa olayioni apa le Abiel.

English: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
Masaai: Amu ore nkitanapat enyena pooki netii dukuya nanu, ore too nkitanapat enyena neitu nanu aibelekenya.

English: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
Masaai: Ina peyie ejo ilo tung'ani, ilo kitok leina kop ajoki iyiook, ‘Tena ayiolou ajo irara iltung'ana asipak; entunguai olalashe linyi obo entung'ueikiaki, niyaya ilpaek aayaki olorere tenkaraki olameyu lo lmareita linyi, nipuopuo aarrinyo.

English: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Meeu empiris o eseriani atua intae eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo

English: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD'S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
Masaai: Aimetolikioki apa olkitok lai enataasa ina kata apa ear Yesebel iloibonok lo Laitoriani, naisudoo nanu iloibonok iip lo Laitoriani, moonom tiatua enkapune, naitoti nanu ninche too mukateni o te nkare?

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, oina kidimata enye naitodolua, oina nashomo olarrabal, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
Masaai: Neaku etesheta ninye ina aji neidip; nepik enkitoipet e shumata too mbaoi o ltarakuai.

English: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
Masaai: Eiputukunyo ilaiguanak le Edom; eibung'a ilarikok le Moabu olokirikiri; Etalepori to lkirutoto lelo pooki oomanya Kanaan.

English: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
Masaai: Naa kekordu ninye Israel too ntorrok enye pooki.

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore ena dung'et e rashe mintokiki aikata aasishore te Israel.

English: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Masaai: Nikiya iyiook nena anas enyena pooki teina kata meetae hoo enkanasa neitu iyiook kiya te ninche - nkanas ntomoni ile, enkop pooki e Argob, ina kitoria e Oog tiatua Bashan.

English: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee ing'uraa esuama natii enkong'u o lalashe lino, nimidol olchata otii enkong'u ino makewan?

English: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
Masaai: Neaku ore apa pee eyieu Enkai neitoduaya tukul nchere meibelekenya enkiguana enye, nepik olmumai,

English: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
Masaai: Amu ore apa too nkolong'i pooki naa kepuonu apa iltung'ana enetii Daudi, ometaba anaa neaku olorora kitok le njore, nebayu anaa enjore e Nkai.

English: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
Masaai: Aishoo ninche olpurkel metaa emanyisho enye, ore enkop emunyan neaku emanyisho enye.

English: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Musa o lpayiani le Israel aapuo ilng'oborri.

English: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
Masaai: “Ore tiatua ele ari lo sirua nerrinyo ake oltung'ani te intae alo enetii imasaa enyena.

English: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye engolon oo ltung'ana lenyena, iyie enjeunoto nasaru ilo lenye otubukoki eilata aaput.

English: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: “Etii sii Edom ine, o ilaiguanak lenyena tenebo ilkituaak lenye pooki, laa ore te ngolon enye pooki neirragieki tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem; neirrag ninche tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo oopuo abori enemeneng'a.

English: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
Masaai: ore too nkolong'i uni naa aikidumu Farao endukuya ino nikinyaaki esiaai ino, neaku aipikaki Farao enkaina enye enkikompe enye anaa apake te dukuya aa olaitasheikinoni le naisho oo sabibu.

English: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD'S anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
Masaai: Metomito Olaitoriani nchere kadumu nanu enkaina ai aar ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput; kake iwa taata ina pere natii embata endukuya enye, o ina moti e nkare, pee kipuo iyiook.”

English: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
Masaai: Neaku eeta apa Solomon osirua teina kata, o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye, eumata kitok nabaiki enejing'ieki Hamat o metabaiki oerata le Misiri, te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang, nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
Masaai: “Ore pooki toki naikurtutari ti oriong enkop naa keiduruk; meinosi ninye.

English: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.
Masaai: Ore enyamalita osinka lino tene o teidie, neluaya ninye.” Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninye, “Neija elo atiu endung'okinoto ino enkiguana; amu iyie makewan otudung'o ina.”

English: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
Masaai: “Amu aamanita nanu ilopir le keeya, naapik nanu indoorot e ntorroni enkuretisho.

English: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
Masaai: Eing'or Olaitoriani kop etii keper, neing'or nkera e tung'ana, pee edol tenaa ketii iloasisho te ng'eno, lelo ooing'oru Enkai.

English: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eitayuni enkop netegelua ninye iyiook ti atua Kristo mataa sinyat nimikiaata entibili te ninye.

English: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
Masaai: Eewa apa olaiguanani le Asiria Isiraeli eararoto te Asiria, nelo apik ninche atua Hala, nepik embata olkeju le Gosam, o atua nkanas oo Lmedi,

English: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
Masaai: Nejo olosho le Yosef, “Meidip iyiook ena kop oo ldoinyo; ore ake sii kulo Kanaani pooki oomanya enkop naisiaja naa keeta ngarrin oo mbartan oo sekenke, lekua ootii Betshean o nkang'itie enyena o lekua ootii oerata le Yesreel.”

English: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
Masaai: Amaa ele tung'ani oji Konia kemoti natemenayioki natadanye, entoki nemeshilaa hoo ng'ae? Kainyoo paa ore ninye o nkera enyena netanang'ayioki aaiturraa tiatua enkop nemeyiolo ninche?

English: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
Masaai: Neitoki apuku te ine nelo embata e naiposha, nesotokino olorora pooki ninye neiteng'en ninye ninche.

English: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu aishu, pee aatum aisisa, naa nchoo nkiguanat inono aaret nanu.

English: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
Masaai: Naitoki adol ilorikan le nkitoo, ore lelo ootonita ninche naa ninche eishoro endung'okinoto e nkiguana. Naitoki sii adol iltauja le lelo ootudung'oyioki lukuny enye te nkaraki enchakenisho e Yesu o te nkaraki ororei le Enkai, naa lelo leitu eserem ina ng'ues aashu ina kitanyaanyukoto enye, neitu, eng'amu olmishire lenye too lpurai loo nkomomi enye aashu too nkaik enye. Nepiu ninche neitoreisho te nebo Kristo ilarin iip tomon.

English: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Masaai: Ewang'an naitawang ilo asipani, netum enchipai ilo oata oltau sidai.

English: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
Masaai: Ore pee eitu Yesu, neitoomon olorere te nchipai amu keanyita ake pooki.

English: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
Masaai: Nearare ninche iltung'ana le Midian anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, near metua olee ake ninye pooki.

English: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
Masaai: Eitu ninche epik ndamunot enye engolon enye, neitu edamu ina olong apa naitajeuo ninye ninche too lmang'ati lenye;

English: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
Masaai: Amu keitabaya ninye ina naategelaka nanu; ore intokitin kumok naaijo nena netii endamunoto. Netii atua endamunoto enye mbaa neeijo nena.

English: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
Masaai: Aitorioko nanu nkaik aainei endama pooki aipotu olorere kiserut, lelo oopuo te nkoitoi nemesidai, esujaa mbaa enye maate;

English: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto eilo rorei oirriwayie olaiguanani Sairos, neas Tatenai ilo balusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju o Shetar-bosenai, o lelo le ncholuek enye, nena pooki naaitanapishe olaiguanani Darias.

English: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
Masaai: Tenening ninche ninye neisiaai ninye, neishu ninche inkolong'i enye te dupoto, ore ilarin lenye nebore enchipai.

English: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
Masaai: Amu keaku ina embae torrono oleng, neaku entorroni naiguanare neitame ilarishak.

English: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
Masaai: Intanapisho ena pee metum ake ninche ileyiat.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ng'ura keibukori engoro ai o engoro ai napi tene wueji, te shumata oltung'ani o eng'ues, shumata ilkeek liong'ota olng'anayio le nkop: keyupuyup ninye nemearayu.”

English: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
Masaai: Ore ina aiguanani enye, etooruoki ilkilani, etanapaki aaya, neishirita nkaisiayak enyena neishir anaa nturkuluoni, neoshiosh ilgooitie lenye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong naa kaisho Gog ewueji nanukarieki te Israel, ina nong'oto oo lapuayak te nkalo o loo saen le naiposha; keibooyo ninye ilapuayak, amu keaku teine eturori Gog o lorora lenye pooki naa keipoti ninye aajo o yarata le Hamon-gog.

English: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Pashur: netumi Elioenai, o Maaseia, o Ishmael, o Natanael o Yosabad, o Elasa.

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki;

English: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
Masaai: Shalum apa olayioni lenye, o Mibsai olayioni lenye, o Mibsam olayioni lenye o Mishma olayioni lenye.

English: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
Masaai: Kake eteleja apa ninye ninye. Neaku eshomo tenebo ninye neinos endaa te nkaji enye neok enkare.

English: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliakim o Shebna o Yoa aajoki ilo kitok le njore, “Kitoomono iyie, irorie isinkan linono ti ae kutuk nikiyiolo, mirorie iyiook te nkutuk e Yuda metoning'o iltung'ana ootii esuntai.”

English: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
Masaai: naa keishoru ninye enchan te nkop inyi too nkatitin enyena, ina shan oltumurel naituruku oina shan oo nkokua, pee itumutumu aaiturrurro tiatua enkurma inyi o sabibu linyi o eilata inyi.

English: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
Masaai: Te nisudoo iyie enkomom ino, neidang ninche, ti niya enkiyang'et enye, neye ninche nerrinyokino enterit enye.

English: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
Masaai: Neirorie Petero Yesu nejoki, “Lo Kitok, ai sidai kitii ene, naa te naa iyieu naitobir ilng'oborri okuni, olino obo, o le Musa obo, o le Eliya obo.”

English: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
Masaai: “ ‘Niminteeniki ilo le latia ino elejare.

English: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
Masaai: netanyamala oleng eruk ilabaak kumok, netumuta ntokitin pooki apa naata, nepal enaikashu, neponari arrishu.

English: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
Masaai: Eitu aing'uaa nkitanapat e nkutuk enye; atushuma tiatua oltau lai irorei le nkutuk enye.

English: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
Masaai: Kake ore too layiok le Kohat neitu eishori ninche toki, enkaraki naitanapaki apa ninche meing'ura nena tokitin naasinya naanapi too loilila.

English: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
Masaai: Mikinturraa nanu aitung'uaa ine nitii, nimiwuang'ie ina kiyang'et ino sinyati ti atua nanu.

English: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
Masaai: Keishankarra ninye te nkiroroto nemeeta tipat, arashu too rorei lemeidim aitaasa ae sidai?

English: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore te ilo ng'obor o tumoreki, ti oriong ilo liatua otii dukuya enchakenisho, neitobir Aron o layiok lenyena ebaiki teipa o metabaiki tadekenya te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku enkitanapata ntarasi naibung'i ti atua iishoritin enye iltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
Masaai: kake ore peyie eidip ainosa ninche, meetae hoo obo otayiolo ajo einosa ninche, meetae hoo obo otayiolo ajo einosa ninche inkulie amu eton ake emueyiaa naa sasin anaa enatiu te nkiterunoto. Ina peyie aputunye.

English: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
Masaai: Eilo kenya iyie ajo te ina olong: “Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, amu ore hoo nikitagorokine iyie nanu, neibelekenye engoro ino, nikintagolo iyie nanu.

English: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui, “Shomo atua nena kejek e ngarri naapuo to loing'ang'e naatii abori lelo kerubi; imputa nkaik inono inkuk naaishu te rishata lelo kerubi, nindapashaki ninche ina anasa.” Naduaaya ninye elo,

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Manase nkalifuni tomoni uni o are o iip are.

English: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
Masaai: Aing'ae doi ilo Magilani, netaa aikisiaiai ninye? Naa kainyoo kitum tinikiomon ninye?

English: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkong'u ino, tukurtu nturrai amu enaikash ti nijing enkishui iata enkong'u nabo alang ti nikinang'akini enkima e Gehena iata nkonyek pokira are.

English: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
Masaai: Amu inos iyie ilng'anayio le nkisiayiare oo nkaik inono; ishipayu iyie neaku sidain mbaa ti alo iyie.

English: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
Masaai: Kake ashe te Nkai, narik iyiook maisula anaa ake te Kristo, neasishore iyiook maibulunye e yiolounoto e Kristo pooki wueji anaa esonkoyo narropil.

English: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
Masaai: Nearaa oloirirua lemeiro. Neaku ore pee epuku ilo oirirua lemeiro, neiro ilo tung'ani apa oonyo kutuk, neing'asia olorere.

English: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
Masaai: Neilep ninye alo Baalperasim, nemir Daudi ninche teine; nejo Daudi, “Etusulaka Enkai ilmang'ati laainei enkaina ai, anaa oloirrag le nkare.” Ore enkaraki ina naa keji enkarna eine wueji Baalperasim.

English: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
Masaai: laa ninye oetuo aainining ninye nejo sii pee eishiunye nkeyaitin enye; ore lelo ooitanyamalita loiriruani ooiduruk, neishiunye.

English: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
Masaai: Neitoki aliki enkitanyaanyukoto lelo ooitoomoni, etoduaa eneiko tenegelaki ate iwuejitin lorikan ooilepie, nejoki ninche,

English: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
Masaai: Aitobirua sii osotua lai o ninche, pee aisho ninche enkop e Kanaan, enkop apa natobikie aa lomon.

English: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
Masaai: Atai apa menye le Natan,

English: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
Masaai: Ore pee eraposho ninche nejoki ninye ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Enturrurru ilmong'oishi ootelekutua pee meimin toki.”

English: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
Masaai: Netii ninye enkop, naa te ninye eitaa Enkai enkop, neitu eyiolou enkop ninye.

English: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
Masaai: Neigil ake errindik e Lea naji Silpa aiki Yakobo ae ayioni e are.

English: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
Masaai: “Kainyoo intae pee eitu inosinoso olasar le ng'oki tiatua ewueji sinyati naa entoki nasinya ninye oleng nikinchooki apa iyie pee itum atanapa entorroni ele turrur pee intobir olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani?

English: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.
Masaai: Nemir Yonatan oltim loo Lfilisti apa otii Geba; nening Ilfilisti ina. Neosh Saul emowuo te nkop pooki; ejo, “Nchoo Lhebrania metoning'o.”

English: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
Masaai: nelotu Hananai obo loo lalashera laainei tenebo kulikae tung'ana eing'uaa Yuda. Naikilikuan nanu ninche mbaa naaipirta lelo Yahudi ootelekutua, lelo apa ooimishote te yararoto, naikilikuan sii mbaa naapirta Yerusalem.

English: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir iltung'ana le Tekoa enkae rishata te nkipirakinoto eilo talet oilep shumata, o metabaiki esuntai e Ofel.

English: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
Masaai: kake ore te iyiook nabo ake Enkai, Papa, laa ninye eing'uaa ntokitin pooki, naa ninye kinchuyie iyiook naa obo Olaitoriani, Yesu Kristo laa ninye eimu ntokitin pooki naa ninye kinchuyie.

English: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
Masaai: Eitiship apa Olaitoriani, te nkaraki esupatisho enye makewan, pee eibalunye enkitanapata enye neitaa kitok.

English: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
Masaai: “Ore pooki ng'ae oosh menye arashu ng'otonye neari metua.

English: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
Masaai: Ore olkilikuai oisiligayu, neitagol ilo oirriwaa ninye, etiu anaa enkare nairobi, te nkirouaj enkata e nkisampuare.

English: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
Masaai: Amu etuutua Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa aing'ae oiwuang'ie ina? Eitorioyioki enkaina enye, naa aing'ae oshuk?

English: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Keinyiang'uni nkurman too mpesai neigerokini mpala nkarn nemishiri neikeni, tiatua enkop e Benchamen, tiatua iwuejitin naamanita Yerusalem, o tiatua nkanas e Yuda, tiatua nkanas e nkop oo ldoinyo, tiatua nkanas e Shefela, o tiatua nkanas e Negeb; amu kashuku nanu ilooena lenye, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
Masaai: Neitoki lelo le Ruben, o le Gad, o lpisiai le Manase aajo te walikinoto e nena lukuny oo lmareita le Israel,

English: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
Masaai: “Naa teneeta olee anaa enkitok enkeeya te ndukuya anaa to lboony.

English: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
Masaai: Oi ele oibe oji nanu! Ainyoo kenya naakordu nanu tele sesen le keeya!

English: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Asa alimu enkitanapata, tiatua Yuda pooki, pee meing'uari ninye oltung'ani obo, pee epuo aaya lelo soito apa le Rama o mbaoi enyena, apa naa ninche eshetishore Baasha, nelo olaiguanani Asa ashetie Geba e Benchamen o Mispa.

English: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
Masaai: Neaku einyo Yakobo tadekenya enasirie, neya oladuo soit oirishunye elukunya enye neitasheyie aitaa eng'ape nebukoki eilata shumata ninye.

English: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
Masaai: naa Elam olayioni le imiet, naa Yehohanaan olayioni le ile, naa Eliehoenia oliopishana.

English: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
Masaai: Kake ore eidipa ninche aayagie neitoki ninche aas entorroni too nkonyek inono, nintoki iyie aiturraa ninche apik nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, pee atum aaitoria ninche. Kake ore ake eyia teneibelekenya ninche nikinchiraki iyie, nining iyie ninche itii shumata, naa katitin kumok itokordua iyie ninche te risioroto olng'ur lino.

English: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
Masaai: Neidondorra ninche aailepaki endapasho e nkop, neman ina ang oo ilng'oborri loo sinyat, o ina anasa kirotet. Etadowuo enkima eing'uaa shumata neidaikie ninche.

English: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
Masaai: neitobir ninye too imbokishi oo nkeek o lerai, nemur ninche to suyai.

English: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
Masaai: Nanu kewan oibelekenyakino aipirakinore ilo tung'ani naiwuang'ie nanu ninye tiatua iltung'ana lenyena, enkaraki naishooyie nabo oo nkera enyena aisho Molek, nepik enkaji ai entioto neisarkionie enkarna ai sinyati.

English: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
Masaai: Nejoki Elkana ilo payian lenye, “Taasa ina naa ninye sidai te iyie; totona ometaba anaa neoruni ninye lke; meibung'a ake duoo ninye Olaitoriani ororei lenye.” Neton ina kitok neing'or aitubulu olayioni lenye, ometaba anaa neere ninye.

English: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
Masaai: Ore etoni aainos endaa, nejo Yesu, “Esipa, ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi, oloinosita endaa te nebo nanu.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa enasaru olchekut loo ntare nkejek are aashu endung'oti e nkiok te nkutuk olng'atuny, naatelekua olng'atuny neijia etiu iltung'ana le Israel oomanya Samaria ilkuti ake ooleku, eeta embelati o lorika o enchoto e rruat.”

English: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
Masaai: neipang ninye alo anang'are Asa. Nejoki ninye, “Toning'oki nanu Asa, o Yuda pooki o Benchamen: Etii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie, eton sii iyie itii tenebo ninye. Tening'oru iyie ninye nitum, kake tening'ua iyie ninye niking'uaa sii ninye iyie.

English: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo lemeyanyit menye aashu ng'otonye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Yoshua o ltung'ana le Israel aatasesekuan ninche te sesekuanata kitok, o metaba anaa nejutuni ninche, ore ake ilo pisiai, arashu ore ake ilo pisiai lenye otelekua pee ejing atua nena ang'itie naagol naasheta sunta,

English: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
Masaai: Ting'idayu naa, iyie shumata o intae lelo pooki ootii atua. Kake wooi, intae nakop o enaiposha, amu etadowuo shetani enitii te ngoro sapuk. Amu eyiolo ajo dorrop enkata enye.”

English: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ninchooyo to lasar ooki empirbil naitorit e naisho oo sabibu pee eaku olasar le nkima, olng'usil orropil to Laitoriani.

English: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Naning esiana, e lelo ootimishiraki; naa nkalifuni iip artam o oong'uan ilootimishiraki eing'uaa iloshon pooki loo layiok le Israel,

English: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
Masaai: Ilo oiteng'eni ele oishakenu kuna baa neigero ninche, nikiyiolo iyiook aajo kesipa shakenisho enye.

English: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
Masaai: Ore te ina olong, niomonono te nkarna ai, nemajoki intae kaomonoki intae te Papa;

English: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
Masaai: Etuputuo ena anasa engoro ai o engoro ai napi ebaiki enkolong apa nateshetaki ometabaiki ena olong, neaku kaiwuang'ie nanu ninye too nkonyek aainei.

English: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
Masaai: Inchoo sii metaa ketii iwang'aritin oloing'ang'e le keper peyie eisho ewang'an enkop.” Neaku neija.

English: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ketaa ena aji, naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, enkapune oo lapurrok too nkonyek inyi? Ng'ura, atoduaa nanu enkorrok ai ina, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
Masaai: neitadoiki olapolosani olkimojino lenye atua ilo sarge neisuaaki embata osarge katitin naapishana dukuya Olaitoriani te dukuya ilo karasha le wueji sinyati.

English: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, ore pee king'oruru intae nanu, mme te nkaraki nitoduaa ilmonek kake te nkaraki ninosa mukateni niraposhosho.

English: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
Masaai: Nesot ninche te shumata ninye enkurare kitok too soito leton etii o metabaiki ena olong neibelekenya taa Olaitoriani te ina goro enye nayupuyup. Neaku ore ebaiki ena olong ore enkarna e ine wueji naa keji oerata le Akori.

English: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
Masaai: naa ore olosulakino ilo soit, negiligil. Ore olosulakino ilo soit ninye neidong aitaa emposio.”

English: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kindetideta duo, nemeeta hoo oltung'ani oidim aibelekenyaki iyiook atoliki aibalakinye.” Nejoki Yosef ninche, “Amaa doi enkibelekenyata aime ene Nkai? Entolikioki atasayia intae.”

English: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
Masaai: Neyuk Simon Petero te nkaina nejoki, “Nkilikuana tiaaki ai ng'ae eimaki.”

English: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
Masaai: Eng'ura sii intae enkirukoto o lkerreti loo Lyahudi: keitu eaku lelo oonya nena tokitin naapolosi ile nchula e ina Ai natopolosakita lelo asarri?

English: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
Masaai: nepik olkerubi bayie nabo, nepik olikae kerubi enkae bayie; te ntoki nabo o ilo orika lo lng'ur eitobira ninye lelo kerubi too matuan enyena pokira are.

English: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
Masaai: ore to likae pisiai lo losho le Manase te Gilead naa, Ido olayioni le Sakaria, ore too le Benchamen, naa Yaasiel olayioni le Abna;

English: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
Masaai: neitoki sii aarrid nkonyek neikilikuan aajoki, “Imbonu! Ai ng'ae likitoosho?”

English: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Eeta imbariak ingumot, neeta intaritik o loing'ang'e sinkin kake meeta Enkerai e Tung'ani eneiteleiki endukuya enye.”

English: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
Masaai: Neitoki ilpayiani leina umata aajo, “Kaa iyiook kiaas tenkaraki nkituaak e lelo ootelekutua, neidaikieki apa ing'oruo aaishie te Benchamen?”

English: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
Masaai: Newangu ewang'an ti atua enaimin neitu eidimu enaimin ninye.

English: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo metaa ketii o loing'ang'e erishata oo nkariak, naa inchoo metirisha inkariak o nkariak.”

English: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia olapolosani le Betel airriwaki olkilikuai Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel, ejoki, “Eitobirita Amos entorroni tialo iyie te mpolos e nkaji e Israel; meidimaa ena kop ilomon lenyena pooki.

English: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: near to lalem ilaiguanak ning'ot, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
Masaai: Ore kulo rorei laaitanap nanu iyie ena olong nchoo ejing oltau lino;

English: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajoki ninye, “Toliki iyiook, kaing'ae eimua ena torroni naewuo shumata iyiook? Kainyoo esiaai ino? Naa kaji ing'uaa? Kaa enkop inyi? Naa eira iyie oli alo orere?”

English: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
Masaai: naa ti nikira nkera, nikira ilajung'ok, kira lajung'ok le Nkai te nebo Kristo, te naa keisilisili iyiook te nebo ninye pee eyookini sii aaisho iyiook enkitoo te nebo ninye.

English: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;
Masaai: “Tenetii entito natisiraki nenang'are olee ninye tiatua enkanasa neyiolou ninye,

English: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
Masaai: Neinyototo lelo tung'ana te ine neing'or enkalo e Sodom neiriamariyie Abraham ninche aitarioo.

English: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Keyau Olaitoriani shumata iyie, o shumata iltung'ana linyi, o shumata e nkaji e papaai lino nkolong'i neitu ae kata etumi ina olong apa nalo Efraim te Yuda - ilo aiguanani le Asiria.”

English: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
Masaai: Ore too lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo le Bashan, nintobiru ilkurteta le meli; neitobiru ewueji ino neitasheyieki too nkeek olchani oing'uaa olomanaa le naiposha e Kupro, nepik ine ilala loo lkanchaoni.

English: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
Masaai: Neaku etekepari apa Edom aing'uaa enkitoria e Yuda o metabaiki ena olong. Ore apa teina kata nekepari sii ninye Libna aing'uaa enkitoria enye, enkaraki natanya ninye Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ekeitoreisho Olaitoriani ntarasi o ntarasi.”

English: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilayiok lenyena, “Erotokoki osikiria,” Neirotoki ninche ninye osikiria, neked ninye.

English: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
Masaai: Emanya sii apa ile Hori Seir, kake etaraitie ilayiok le Esau ninche, neidaikie ninche te dukuya ninche, nemanyisho ninche te rishata enye; anaa apa enaikuna Israel teina kop enye, apa naishoo ninche Olaitoriani.

English: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
Masaai: Ore anaa enapa naaitanapa aloito Makedonia, tobiko te Efeso peyie intanap amitiki lelo kulikae elikioo pooki kiteng'enare napaashaa.

English: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
Masaai: nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Iwa kuna masaa, shomo tipika ninche atua enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, naa nchoo enkaji e Nkai eitokini aashet te wueji enye.”

English: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
Masaai: Meitodua intae Olaitoriani enyorrata nauno o enkisiligata! Naa kaitaas nanu intae esidai enkaraki nitaasa ena bae.

English: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
Masaai: Neya Daudi kulo rorei to ltau, neureyu oleng Akish ilo aiguanani le Gas.

English: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
Masaai: Eitu iyie kinyang'aki nanu enkorropil too mpisai, neitu kintaraposh eilata oo lasarri linono. Kake kiteeka iyie too ng'ok inono, kintanaura iyie nanu te nkarruoisho ino.

English: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
Masaai: Pee tenilo nidaa araposho, nishet nkajijik sidain nimany,

English: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
Masaai: Enuk ninye inkaik e pooki tung'ani pee etum iltung'ana pooki aatayiolo esiaai enye.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani. Mikaia olayioni le Imla, kake kaiba nanu ninye amu maaibonoki aekata ninye embae sidai, ntorrok ake aaibonoki.” Nejo Yehoshafat, “Mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.”

English: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
Masaai: Neipirri aituruk neked o lng'aboli pee edol, amu ine wueji, eim Yesu.

English: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
Masaai: ore te Ido naa Sekaria; ore te Gineton naa Meshulam;

English: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
Masaai: Tenirrarru ilng'anayio linono, ming'il arrarru aishu; nchoo eaku ileilo tung'ani omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai.

English: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Samuel asuj Saul; neserem Saul Olaitoriani.

English: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:
Masaai: Te neton nanu aishu, ntoduaaki nanu enyorrata nemeibelekenya o Laitoriani, pee maye nanu;

English: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
Masaai: Epuonu ilayiok lenyena aayanyit, nemeyiolo ninye; eyawuaki ninche abori, neitu emusu aayiolou.

English: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
Masaai: Nikitoduaa iyiook nikintayu shakenisho nchere eirriwua Papa Enkerai enye metaa Olaitajeunoni le nkop.

English: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkiyang'et Sinyati Filipo, “Shomo tinyikaki, turubare ina garri.”

English: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
Masaai: “Kake ore ebaiki leleroisho ang neidaikie ina toki e nkurruna nena pooki naaisiaayutua loo papa, nkerrai enye o nchoo enye, ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye.

English: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
Masaai: Ore pooki nganayio le dukuya le pooki pukunoto o pooki kishoroto e pooki pukunoto too nkishorot inono pooki, naa keaku inoo lapolosak; nincho sii ninche lelo apolosak olng'anayioi lino le dukuya le mukate, peyie etum emayianata atotona te nkaji ino.

English: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
Masaai: Ore ake pee egolu Israel, nepik ninche Ilkanaani enkisiaayiare nagol, kake eitu earaa ninche aaipang'ie tukul.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, iltung'ana kulo laa ninche ooipiru enkarruoisho laa ninche ooishoru nkikoot torrok tena anasa;

English: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eye Ahab, neiser olaiguanani le Moab apaashare olaiguanani le Israel.

English: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
Masaai: Entobira ilmuma linyi to Laitoriani Enkai inyi, nintabayaya ninche; nchoo lelo pooki oomanita ninche meyau nkishorot aayaki ilo ourei,

English: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooigarakino enkitabaroto oo Nkitanapat netii abori oldeket, amu ejo lkigerot, “Etediaaki pooki ng'ae lemeas nena pooki naaigero too nkitanapat.”

English: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
Masaai: ore etiu neijia, nchoo ake pooki ng'ae linyi enyorru enkitok enye anaa kewan, naa nchoo enkitok edol ajo keyanyit olpayian lenye.

English: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
Masaai: Neitobiru too rorei enchan, neitobiru enkoitoi enkiwuang'ata e ndarata;

English: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani amutan Hana, nenutayu ninye neiu ilayiok okuni o ntoyie are. Nebulu ina ayioni Samuel te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ena are nerukokino enkalo enkop oloosaen, nelo arukokino atua Araba; ore peyie ejing atua nkariak nemeruko e naiposha, nesilayu ina are.

English: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
Masaai: neiu eng'iriata olkuaak nadupa, neiu entonata nadupa osiligi,

English: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
Masaai: Amaa engolon ai keng'olon oo soito, arashu amaa osesen lai kolo suyai?

English: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.
Masaai: Naa te nedung ninye ilpapit le ndukuya enye (amu kedung apa te nkiting'oto e pooki ari; te neiroshiu oleng te ninye, nedung) neipim ninye ilpapit le ndukuya enye, naa shekeli iip are te ntemata o laiguanani.

English: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
Masaai: Neitashe enkolong o lapa too wuejitin enye, te wang'an e nkimerlel oo mbaa inono epuo etangoroyioki, o te nkimerlel e ina remet ino naimerlel.

English: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
Masaai: Miureishoyu, iyie Yakobo osinka lai, Olaitoriani ojo, amu atii nanu tenebo iyie. Kaiting'ie nanu katukul iloshon pooki lelo apa laaterewa nanu iyie. Kake ore iyie maaiting'ie tukul kaaitame nanu iyie te nkiririkinoto nasipa, nemeeta nanu nchere pee aatung'uayie mintamio.”

English: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
Masaai: peyie itum aitabaiki ninye olpolosie lenye, peyie itum atumusu atayiolo nena oitoi naapuo enkang enye?

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki,

English: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
Masaai: Kake ore ina kata te nerik intae, eming'aeng'ae aajo, ‘Kaa kijo’, amu keishori intae te ina kata enijojo.

English: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Bela; ile Ashebel, olmarei loo le Ashbel; ile Ahiram, olmareita loo le Ahiram;

English: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Masaai: Oorripi te ngolon e Enkai te nkaraki enkirukoto inyi, pee itumutumu enjeunoto nairragita ake pee eibalunyieki te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
Masaai: Ore te na kata, ake etiu neijia, alo Yerusalem ayaki lelo sinyat eretoto.

English: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
Masaai: Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam ookuni. Neye ninye, nenukari te Shamir.

English: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.
Masaai: ore shumata ninche naa ilkituaak okuni, laa Daniel apa obo, aa ninye eyaki kulo balusuni ilomon, pee metum ake olaiguanani eng'orikinoto.

English: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie ile Lawi meetu abori Aron o layiok lenyena, pee eishooyo ninche anaa olasar oyuki to Laitoriani.

English: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye imbokishi oo nkeek o lerai pee enapieki ina mesa, nemuraa ninche te sahabu.

English: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan le nkitoria e Hesekia, laa ninye olari liopishana le nkitoria e Hosea olayioni le Ela, ilo aiguanani le Israel nelotu Shalamanesa olaiguanani le Asiria agilunore Samaria neman ninye ang'adu.

English: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
Masaai: nemir Asahel Abna, ore eloito nemeibelekenya aing'or enkaina e tatene arashu enkaina e kedienye esujaa Abna.

English: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
Masaai: Nening apa Pashur olapolosani, olayioni le Imer, laa ninye apa olkitok tiatua enkaji Olaitoriani, Yeremia eibonisho te kuna baa.

English: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Olaitoriani ajo eibelekenye aing'or, neipot Enkai ninye ti atua empolos o sanag, nejo, “Musa, Musa!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
Masaai: Metaa iata sii iyie kulikae ooibung nkiteng'enat oo Lnikolatin.

English: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
Masaai: Keirorie ninye iltung'ana te rishata ino, neaku ninye enkutuk te iyie, nitiu te ninye anaa Enkai.

English: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninye oltoilo le nkomono ai.

English: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
Masaai: naa ninye laaitabaikia nanu enyorrata enye nauno te dukuya olaiguanani, o lautarok lenyena. O te dukuya iltung'ana pooki magil lo laiguanani. Naagolu nanu oshoke amu etii enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai ai shumata nanu, naiturrur nanu iltung'ana ooisul Isiraeli pee aapuo aairiamariyie.

English: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
Masaai: Mbalunye enkitoo e nkisisa enye too nkuapi pooki, o nena siaaitin enyena e nking'asia too loreren pooki!

English: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
Masaai: Nemeitoki pooki ng'ae aiteng'en ole latia enye aashu eiteng'en pooki ng'ae olalashe lenye, ajoki, ‘Tayiolo Olaitoriani,’ amu kaayiolou pooki nanu, eiteru to loti te pooki o metabaiki olkitok te pooki.

English: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
Masaai: Neaku ninye oitore ilchumat le sahabu ole nkosholai, ore nena tokitin pooki e tipat e Misiri; o ne Libia o ne Etiopia neirukurukore iroruat enyena.

English: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani le Moab ajo etii olarrabal agilunore ninye, neshoroo iltung'ana oata ilalema, iip naapishana pee epuo aagiroo olaiguanani le Edom, kake eitu ninche eidim aashom.

English: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
Masaai: Eng'ura, aiteng'ena nanu intae nkikoot, anaa enaaitanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ai, nchere pee ipuopuo aas teina kop nipuopuo aaya.

English: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa to lari liare oetunye ninche enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, to lapa liare, neitobir Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel o Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak enkiterunoto, tenebo ilkulikae alashera lenye, lelo apolosak o Lawi o pooki ooetuo Yerusalem eing'ua eyararoto. Negelu ninche Ilawi ooitabaitie ilarin tikitam neilep, pee eitasheiki esiaai enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o lmodai naa enkidaaroto enye, ore enkutuk enye naa orreshet te ninye.

English: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
Masaai: Kulo laing'unyung'unyak, iloata olorok, iloosuj ing'uarrat oo seseni lenye, iloorup ate te njartano enye, nepakas iltung'ana ejo pee edupore.

English: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
Masaai: Neibung Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel Amasia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, olayioni le Yehoash, olayioni le Ahasia te Betshe-mesh, nelotu Yerusalem neuroo esuntai e Yerusalem erishata oo ntemat e nkaina iip ong'uan, ebaiki kishomi e Efraim ometabaiki kishomi o lpijata.

English: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
Masaai: Naa kaaisho iyie tenebo eishoi ino nikisuju enkop nitaayie omon, enkop pooki e Kanaan metaa enino oo ntarasi naa kaaku Enkai enye.”

English: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
Masaai: Neikenori ninye, amu eitu apa eibalunyeki enaitaasi ninye.

English: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
Masaai: Nejing Shetani Yudas oji Iskariot, olaa obo le lelo tomon o aare;

English: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina, pee eshukunye te Betania, netir esumash.

English: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye te mpolos e nkewarie neya enkayioni ai te mbata ai ina kata eirura esinka ino, neirragie ninye to lgoo lenye. Neirragie ina kerai enye natua to lgoo lai.

English: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
Masaai: Nipikaki iltung'ana olpolosie aitamanaa, ijo, ‘Entodol ake mipuopuo shumata o ldoinyo arashu iseyieyie olpolosie lenye; ore pooki ng'ae ororo oldoinyo neari metua.

English: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Ara Enkai magilani; entoisho entoponari, epuku te iyie olorere o lorora loo loreren, nepuku ilaiguanak te iyie.

English: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.
Masaai: Nejoki Yonatan ilo barnoti apa onapita imasaa enyena o larrabal, “Wou, maape iyiook enetii oltim le kulo lememurata; eidimayu pee eret Olaitoriani iyiook; amu meetae ae toki naidim aibooi Olaitoriani amitiki eitajeusho too lkumok arashu too lkuti.”

English: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajo, “Ene nelo aaku enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai, naa ene nelo aaku olperere lo lasar opejori te Israel.”

English: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Mariamu enetii Yesu nedol nebatata too nkejek enyena nejoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa itii apa ene anaata eitu eye olalashe lai.”

English: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki iyiook osinka lino papaai lang, ‘Iyiololo apa aajo aatoikio enkitok ai ilayiok oare;

English: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
Masaai: teneosh intae olkirutoto anaa olkutati, nelotu engolikinoto inyi anaa osiwuo torrono te nelotu osina o emion shumata intae.

English: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
Masaai: Te nemeetae empiunoto oo lootuata, netaa naa eitu eitopiuni Kristo kewan;

English: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
Masaai: O enkata ake pooki naishori Olaitoriani olasar opejori te nkolong e sabato, o to lapa ng'ejuk, o too nkolong'i o Sirua, terisioroto e siana nayieuni te ninche, anaake te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
Masaai: Emincho ilkumok te intae ilalashera laainei eaku ilaiteng'enak, amu iyiololo aajo ore iyiook pooki ooiteng'enisho naa keiguanareki enagol te nikintadiak.

English: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
Masaai: Aikira pooki ilayiok lo lpayian obo, nikira iltung'ana ooisiligayu, ore isinkan linono neme ilaikitalak.”

English: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Arfad o Helek netii apa isunta inyi aamanita, ore iltung'ana le Gamad netii sii ninche iltaleta linono; neik ninche ilong'oi enye too isunta inono aaitaman; neitisidan aitaa bayarot enkishiaa inyi.

English: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
Masaai: Ore ina tapukai natoyio enkishiaa enye, natii endukuya e ilo erata oleng, naa ketiu anaa ilng'abolo le dukuya ooton eng'or te nkata e nkirowuaj: te nedol oltung'ani ilo ng'anayioi neinos nabo kata anaa ake pee eibung te nkaina.

English: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ilo Kanaani, olaiguanani le Arad, apa omanya Negeb te nkop e Kanaan, nening ina lotunoto oo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: Grace be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris te nebo intae pooki. Esai.

English: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
Masaai: olaisiaayiani le ine wueji sinyati o le ilo ng'obor osipa leme oltung'ani oitasheyie kake Olaitoriani.

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh's army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Nji iyie tiaaki ilo aiguanani le Yuda likirriwua iyie enatii nanu pee kinkilikuanishore nanu, ‘Ng'ura, ore enjore e Farao duoo nikiyewuo aretu iyie netaa keshuko alo Misiri, enkop enye makewan.

English: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
