Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori;

English: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
Masaai: Neya Gideon iltung'ana tomon te lelo aisiaayiak lenyena, neas anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani ninye, kake ore amu keure apa aataas dama te nkaraki olmarei lenye, o lelo tung'ana le ina ang, etaasa apa ninye ina kewarie.

English: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
Masaai: Eshet eng'eno e nkitok ng'en enkaji enye, kake ore emodai near enkaji enye too nkaik enyena.

English: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak loo loshon le Edom naa; olaiguanani Timna, o Alka, Yetet,

English: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
Masaai: Ore lapuayak le Tema neing'oru ore lelo apuayak le Sheba neisiligu.

English: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
Masaai: Enkuet eng'oru eseriani, intae iltung'ana le Benchamen, entung'uai empolos e Yerusalem! Entoosh entarumpeta te Tekoa, nidumumu olmonekie te Bet-hakerem; amu edakunye entorroni aipang'u te nkalo e moikuape, o enkidaata kitok.

English: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani okepari, indipa aikoo ninye ene dukuya o eniare, talama.

English: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
Masaai: Ore Yair olayioni le Manase nelo aya nkang'itie enye neisho ninche enkarna ajo Hafot-yair.

English: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki Yesu ine neraposhu nkonyek nejoki, “Sakayo, tasieku tadou; amu enkaji ino ade taata ajing.”

English: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
Masaai: Neitanap ilooiteng'eni lenyena pee meliki oltung'ani nchere ninye Kristo.

English: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
Masaai: Ee, aning'ito nanu enking'oming'om oo lkumok - etii enkuretisho pooki shoto - aaiguanare ninche nanu pee eitayu enkishui ai.

English: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
Masaai: nchere eing'ura ninye kop te ine wueji e shumata nesinya, te keper eing'ura Olaitoriani enkop,

English: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
Masaai: Naa te Nkitobirakinoto e Pasaka, anaa saa ile. Nejoki ninye Lyahudi, “Eng'ura olaiguanani linyi!”

English: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
Masaai: Nemaaitukurruni naa nanu, amu aipirakinye nkoitoi aainei nkitanapat inono.

English: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
Masaai: Ore lapolosak lenye nebatata too lalema, ore nena olia enye nemeishir.

English: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo olo enkiguana te sipata, meetae ololo aiguana te sipata, osayia le pesho eng'idare ninche, neiro elejare, neipiru ninche esuujisho neyau entorroni.

English: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
Masaai: Enkai nairriu enchan metashaiki enkop, eidim airriu meitamio iltung'ana, anaa eitodol ninche omon enye.

English: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
Masaai: Neitadooyo entemet netum ntemeta tomon o miet.

English: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata iyie, naa imbonisho iyie te nebo ninche nikimbelekenyi iyie aaitaa likae tung'ani.

English: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
Masaai: Ore apa te dukuya ninye nemetii olaiguanani oikununo anaa ninye, oibelekenyakine Olaitoriani, to ltau lenye pooki, o te nkishui enye pooki, o te nkidimata enye pooki, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Musa pooki, neitu eitokini aatum likae laaijo ninye te siadi ninye.

English: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
Masaai: naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et ailepie, naayau atua olgoriet liatua; naa ng'ura, eiputa enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Enkiti kata eton etii ena wang'an atua intae. Enchom eton iatata ina wang'an, pee meidimu intae enaimin, ore ilo olo te naimin nemeyiolo enelo.

English: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
Masaai: eyanyiti iyiook o meyanyiti; einorri iyiook o meinorri. Keitaai iyiook ilalejak, kake kira asipak;

English: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
Masaai: Ekaapik ilala oololo iltagiligil linono, naisho lelo sinkir loonchorroi inyi mikimbung'a iyie akurraki, naa kaaitayu iyie aitupuku tempolos oo inchorroi inono, nena nikimbung iyie.

English: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani le Samaria naa kelo aidaaya, anaa olaburra ti oriong enkare.

English: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore esiana o rorei lino naa esipata, ore pooki ng'ae loo sipat oo inkiguanat inono nebikoo ntarasi.

English: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
Masaai: te nimikisiligayu, neton ninye eisiligayu — amu meidim ninye atomiki kewan.

English: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore kulikae mareita loo layiok le Kohat neeta nkanas natii enkop enye apa anaa inolosho le Efraim.

English: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
Masaai: Aar ninche metuata, “Newal ninche ajo miaar iyie ninche metuata lelo litaarua to lalem lino o too mbaa inono? Nchoo ninche endaa o enkare, pee etum ainosa neok, nepuo enetii olkitok lenye.”

English: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother's house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
Masaai: Kake enyaaka Naomi ajoki nena toyie are oo layiok lenyena, “Enchom entorrinyoto, shomo ake oltung'ani enkaji e ngotonye. Naa meitaasa intae Olaitoriani isupati, anaa apa enintaasa intae ilootuata o nanu.

English: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Nele Natan oloiboni le Nkai.” Ore pee ejing'u ninye alotu aitashe te dukuya olaiguanani, neirrugo ninye te dukuya olaiguanani, neitabaiki enkomom enye enkop.

English: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
Masaai: Nemayian Enkai ninche, nejoki “Entoisho entoponari emputa enkop nintorere. Entoria sii isinkir le naiposha o motony o loing'ang'e, o pooki toki ake ninye naishu naiseuseu te nkop.”

English: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
Masaai: Enang'ari oltorrono te nena baa enyena torrok, kake etum isupati osempewuet tiatua esupatisho enye.

English: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
Masaai: Ore Daudi o lelo kituaak le nkisiayiare neiteng'el kulikae te nkaraki enkisiaayiare embata oo layiok le Asaf le Heman o le Yedutum, laa ninche apa ooibonisho too lwululi loo usin, o too nkai oosinkolioitin, o too nkinantani dapashi. Ore lelo ootaasa esiaai enkisiaayiare enye naa:

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore amu eitalakutua Ilfilisti elap neya ina to lwuasa lo ltau pee eidaikie teilo omang'ati lemeish;

English: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Moikuape eipang'unye entorroni alotu shumata lelo pooki oomanya enkop.”

English: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Eshek olalashe lenye: Ulam olkikau lenye, o Yeush laa ninye oliare, o Elifelet laa ninye oliokuni.

English: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche to sina lenye;

English: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur ilpayiani pooki leina kop, nejoki, “Entisipu taata nidolidolo aajo enyamali eing'oru ele tung'ani. Amu aairriwaka ninye nanu olkilikuai te nkaraki nkituaak aainei o nkera aainei, o tenkaraki enkosholai ai osahabu, nemaata nanu entoki natomito.”

English: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i tomon nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia.

English: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
Masaai: Ore nanu, atejo apa te nkitumurrunoto ai, “Maaiwuang'ieki ae kata nanu.”

English: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
Masaai: Neishori ina ng'ues enkutuk nairorie imbaa naarupie kewan o rorei le morore, neishori meitoreisho too larin artam o aare.

English: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ipuopuo intae aaim esuntai nataaraki neitashe pooki ng'ae te dukuya ninye nepuoi aanang'aki intae Harmon,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
Masaai: Amu ejo Ninye: “Te ngolon e nkaina ai ataasa nanu ena, o te ng'eno ai, amu kara nanu ng'en; naiwuang'ie nanu lpolosien loo loreren, natarayie nanu ilchumat lenye; ore anaa oloing'oni atusulua nanu lelo ootoni too lorikan le nkitoo.

English: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
Masaai: Enkaina e lelo shakenini naiter aar ninye metua, ore adake near enkaina oo ltung'ana pooki. Metaa ewuang'ie entorroni tiatua intae.

English: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
Masaai: inchere mepong'ori oltung'ani meinyial olalashe lenye te na bae; amu Olaitoriani oitalaku ti atua kuna baa pooki, anaa enikinturukokito aaikok intae te dukuya.

English: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
Masaai: Nelotu sii elde oitaakaki talanta nabo nejo, ‘Lo Kitok, ayiolo ajo ira iyie oltung'ani ogol odung ineitu iun, ninturrur ineitu isuaaya.

English: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
Masaai: eilepieki enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, te nkaina enye e tatene eas Olaitoriani inenking'asia!”

English: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajoki, “Kaji kinkuna? Kaji eikuna pee kitabolo nkonyek inono?”

English: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
Masaai: nakordu intae te nkaina oo Lmisiri o te nkaina e lelo pooki ooibooki intae enkop, naaraa ninche te dukuya intae, naisho intae enkop enye;

English: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
Masaai: te nkaraki ing'ok enye. Te neidimu iyiook nkitarruorot ang, nipalaki iyie iyiook.

English: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
Masaai: Keiro ninye mbaa naapaashare Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, naa kelo ninye aitanaur lelo sinyat le Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, nedamu pee eibelekeny nkatitin o nkitanapat; naa keishoori ninche aapik atuaenkaina enye te nkiti kata, nkatitin are o lpisiai le nkata.

English: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
Masaai: Meena apa nkaik inono, nemeena apa nkejek inono; Ore anaa enabatata oltung'ani te dukuya lelo torrok itabatate iyie.” Neitoki iltung'ana pooki aaishiraki ninye.

English: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.
Masaai: Olaiguanani Agripa, isiligita doi iyie loibonok le Nkai? Ayiolo ajo isiligita.”

English: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu enatejo lelo oibonok ooibonisho te lejare te nkarna ai, ejo, ‘Aidetideta nanu, aidetideta nanu!’

English: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.
Masaai: Tadou naa wou, olaiguanani, te risioroto e yieunoto o ltau lino pooki pee idou alotu; ore erishata ang naa pee kinchoru ninye aapik atua enkaina o laiguanani.”

English: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
Masaai: Metii hoo obo likinyor iyie meetae olchani to lbae lino meetae enkishuinoto te iyie.

English: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; and tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
Masaai: Eitukurruaki Moab, amu etigilaki; teyietu ninchir! Tolikioi te mbata olkeju le Aron, nchere eirragita Moab aa olmuaate.

English: And it shall be, when ye are come nigh unto the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people,
Masaai: Naa tenilo iyie aigutaki olarrabal, nelotu olapolosani dukuya airorie iltung'ana,

English: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
Masaai: Kake etayiolo Yesu ndamunot enye nejoki ilo tung'ani tasat o aina, “Inyo wou dukuya tene.” Neinyototo ilo tung'ani neitashe te ine.

English: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
Masaai: Naa tenijojo intae, “Kainyoo kinya teilo ari liopishana, tenimikiun aashu kinturrur enkurma ang?”

English: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
Masaai: Anaa enajo Lkigerot, “Eidapashaka pesho, eishoo laisinak, nebik esupatisho enye ntarasi.”

English: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
Masaai: Etijing'a apa Yehoida olayioni le Benaia tenebo Abiata erishata e Ahitofel. Naa Yoab apa olarikoni le njore olaiguanani.

English: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
Masaai: Neaku aishooyie nanu te ina golon oo ltauja lenye, metusuja nkiguanat enye.

English: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
Masaai: Oigeroki Timoteo, enkerai ai te sipata ti atua enkirukoto. Metaa enino empiris, o lng'ur, o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
Masaai: Na ishoi e Abraham, ilo sinka lenye, lo ayiok le Yakobo, oogeluno.

English: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
Masaai: Ore naaji tenaa kayiolo ewueji natumie ninye, pee elotu doi ninye olorika lenye!

English: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
Masaai: Nedumunye olaiguanani kewarie, nejoki isinkan lenyena, “Kaliki nanu intae ina naitobira iltung'ana le Siria tialo iyiook. Eyiolo ninche aajo eikisumash; neaku eipang'a ninche too lng'oborri aapuo aaisudori te nkop naisiaja, ejo, ‘Teneipangu ninche te nkanasa, nikiya iyiook ninche, eishu meshomo eyararoto nikijing atua enkanasa.’ ”

English: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
Masaai: Ore eripata enye ti abori tiripaki ilonyek le usi pus, o empile o enanyokie aitaman, o ntualan e sahabu erishata enye,

English: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
Masaai: Eitobira ninye olperere lo lasar lo suyai, naa ntemat e nkaina naaudo enkadoro, naa neijia etiu endapasho, naa ntemat ong'uan olpisiai enkadoro nailep.

English: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
Masaai: Ntunyo iyie enaiposha too mbartan inono, ine wueji oo nkariak kumok.

English: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
Masaai: Itangoro iyie too mbaa inono endukuya oo lmurran lenyena, ilo oewuo anaa olkutati aidapash iyiook, neng'ida ninye anaa oloidaikie olaisinani te nkisudoroto.

English: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
Masaai: Teneboitare olee enkitok eata emuoyian enye, nebolu nkilani enyena, netusula ninye erukunoto enye, neitalioo ninye erukunoto osarge lenye; ore ninche pokira are naa keiwuang'ieki tiatua iltung'ana lenye.

English: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
Masaai: Aing'ae oyiolo tenaa ore enkiyang'et oltung'ani neilep alo shumata ore enkiyang'et eng'ues nelo abori atua enkop?

English: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Etamorua apa Eli oleng ina kata, nening ninye nena pooki naaitaasita ilayiok lenyena Israel pooki, neboitare ninche nena kituaak naasisho te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
Masaai: Naa ninche emayian Olaitoriani loo lororani ejo, “Emayiana Misiri, olorere lai o Asiria ina siaai oo nkaik aainei, o Israel enjung'ore ai.”

English: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD'S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Tabolo elusie te nkalo oloosaen,” nebol olaiguanani elusie. Neitoki Elisha ajoki ninye, “Tang'oroi embae,” nengoroo olaiguanani embae. Nejoki Elisha, “Embae o Laitoriani e nkisulata embae e nkisulata namirieki Siria! Amu ilo aarare Siria te Afek ometaba anaa niishie ninche.”

English: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
Masaai: Inosinoso nena kiri e lelo magil niokioko osarge loo lkituaak le nkop, o loo lmeregeshi, o loo lkuoo le kerra, o loo lkineji o loo loing'ok, lelo pooki oopir le Bashan.

English: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
Masaai: ore sii te ine naa enkaina ino naarikoo, naa enkaina ino e tatene naaibung nanu.

English: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
Masaai: “Meetae oltung'ani oinok oltaa neitoki aitoip to ltoo anaa epik orunku le rruat, kake epik enerupa neitasheyie pee edol iloojing' ewang'an.

English: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
Masaai: Amu ti ninyorrinyorro iloonyor intae, kaa shunet itumutumu intae? Ai meiko neijia oshi ilasotok le kodi?

English: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
Masaai: Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e imiet.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani: “Lo tung'ana laainei, kulo oomanya Sion, emiureyu ile Asiria te neoshisho te ng'udi aashu te nedumu orinka lenye aar intae anaa apa enaikuna ile Misiri.

English: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
Masaai: Ore entito botor etoiwuo enkayioni neipot enkarna enye ajo Moab, naa ninye menye lo Lmoabu ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Musa aibalakinye iltung'ana le Israel isiruai oogeluno to Laitoriani.

English: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
Masaai: Nebik ninye tenebo ninche ilarin ile, eisudori tiatua enkaji e Nkai, ina kata eitore Atalia ina kop.

English: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
Masaai: Minosinoso intae enkolong nabo, aashu nkolong'i are, aashu nkolong'i imiet, aashu nkolong'i tomon, aashu nkolong'i tikitam,

English: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumu ilo sinka ninye, neyau enetii ng'otonye, neton ina kerai too nkejek e ng'otonye o meiulo enkolong', neye.

English: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
Masaai: “Ooi Yesu le Nasaret, ainyoo iatakinore iyiook? Iyewuo aidaikie iyiook? Kaayiolo ajo ira ng'ae: ira ilo obo Sinyati le Nkai.”

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo enashe Olaitoriani, amu aisupat ninye; amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi!

English: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
Masaai: Neaku ore eomonito te dikae wueji, ore pee eidip, nejoki obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena, “Olaitoriani, inteng'ena iyiook enkomono anaa enaiteng'ena Yohana ilooiteng'eni lenyena.”

English: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Airorie enkop aibalakinye mbaa. Aiteng'enisho oshi ake too nkajijik e ntumo o te nkaji e Nkai natumore Lyahudi pooki, nemeeta embae nairoro too nkisudorot.

English: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
Masaai: Ore pee edol olkitok loo sikarini enatotiwuo, neisis Enkai, nejo, “Edede meeta hoo ele tung'ani entiyoto!”

English: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
Masaai: Ore te nkishiaa ino shomo isula te nkaraki esipata nimitu ilo asipani; nchoo enkaina ino e tatene mikinteng'ena nkiaasin naaitureisho!

English: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
Masaai: Ore enkitoria e Nkai mme embae oo rorei kake ene ngolon.

English: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.
Masaai: Kake te nedolu olarriponi olalem elotu nemeosh ninye ina tarumpeta, metaa eitu eitayioloi iltung'ana, nelotu olalem, neya ake ninye obo lenye; ore ilo tung'ani newaki too ng'ok enyena, kake ore osarge lenye naa kaikilikuanu too nkaik e ilo arriponi.

English: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
Masaai: neya ninye embata o sarge leilo oing'oni, neisuaaya to lkimojino lenye te dukuya eilo orika lo lng'ur, otii dukuya e ilo orika lo lng'ur neisuaaki ninye ilo sarge to lkimojino lenye katitin naapishana.

English: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
Masaai: Andrea, o Filipo, o Bartolomayo, o Matayo, o Tomas, o Yakobo le Alfayo o Tadayo, o Simon olkanaani,

English: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
Masaai: kake maiwuang'ie nanu enyorrata ai nauno aitung'uaa ninye, anaa apa enaiwuang'ie te Saul, ilo apa laiwuang'ie nanu te dukuya iyie.

English: Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.
Masaai: ilapurrok, iloota olorok, ilamerak, iloomorisho, ilaisimak, meetae hoo obo le lelo ojung enkitoria e Nkai.

English: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
Masaai: Eishiaakino olaitasheikinoni le sirit, nemeeta eleyiata olee le nkitok nabo loo nkiririkinot, naa ng'en, pirisut, naa aminin, neyiolo aiteng'enisho,

English: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
Masaai: Ntorioyoki nanu, Olaitoriani kake te sipata; neme te ngoro ino, pee mikintaa ake nanu olemetii.

English: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ele orere! Eilepa anaa elipong o lng'atuny, edumunye anaa olng'atuny odumunye; nemeirrag ninye o metaba anaa neinos ina ng'ues narreshito, neok osarge le ina natasesekuanaki.”

English: And it was so, that, after they had carried it about, the hand of the LORD was against the city with a very great destruction: and he smote the men of the city, both small and great, and they had emerods in their secret parts.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eyau aaitamanu, near enkaina e Nkai ina anasa ayau enkuretisho sapuk, neitame ninye lelo tung'ana le ina ang, ilooti o lbotoro, o metaa eibulaitie iltuduta te ninche.

English: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
Masaai: Natipika ine osanduku laa ninye etii ilo sotua lo Laitoriani oitobira ninye tenebo iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”

English: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
Masaai: Eitaa ninche enaimin endama; ‘Ore ewang'an, anaa enajo ninche, netaaniki enaimin.’

English: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
Masaai: Ore eloito te mbata e naiposha e Galilaya nedol ilalashera oare, Simon oji Petero o lalashe lenye Anterea, enang'aki o rreshet atua enaiposha, amu ilarreshok apa loo sinkir.

English: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
Masaai: Keitu iyie taata kimpot nanu ajo ‘Papa lai, ira iyie olchore le leleroisho ai

English: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard, and hath not yet eaten of it? let him also go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man eat of it.
Masaai: Naa kalo tung'ani tene otuuno isabibu neton eitu eitumurru ilng'anayio lenyena? nchoo ninye errinyo alo enkaji enye, melo ake aye to larrabal nelotu likae tung'ani aitumurru ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
Masaai: o Ido, o Ginetoi, o Abija,

English: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
Masaai: inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Isaakar naa nkalifuni tomon o aare ilootimishiraki eing'uaa olosho le Sebulon, nkalifuni tomon aare ilo losho le Yosef, nkalifuni tomon oare ilootimishiraki to losho le Benchamen.

English: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
Masaai: ore enkiyang'et ake pooki nemeibalunye Yesu neme ene Nkai. Enkiyang'et o Loiba Kristo ina, naa ninye apa itoning'o aajo kelotu, neidipa taata atijing'a enkop.

English: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kitanapata naishoo Yonadabu olayioni le Rekab ilayiok lenyena, pee meok enaisho oo sabibu, neibung'aki, nemeok aaitasim ometabaiki ena olong, amu eibung'a ninche enkitanapata e papaai lenye. Airorie nanu intae aitirrishaki kake eitu intae kining'ining'i nanu.

English: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
Masaai: Amu mba iyie eutaroto, ninang'aa irorei laainei aidie kewan.

English: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
Masaai: metaa anyaaka arrinyunye enkaji e papa lai te seriani, naa keaku Olaitoriani Enkai ai.

English: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le dukuya le nkitoria e Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, pee etumi aaitabai ororei lo Laitoriani te nkutuk e Yeremia, neputu Olaitoriani oltau le Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, pee eibalunye enkitanapata te nkitoria enye pooki, neiger sii aajo,

English: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
Masaai: Ore ilootelekutua neari to lalem le ilo okedito ina barta. Te ilo alem opuku ti tua enkutuk enye; ore imotonyi pooki nenya inkiri enye omeisiligata.

English: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aajoki Gideon, “Ntoria iyiook, iyie o layioni o layioni lo layioni lino, amu itokordua iyiook aitayu te nkaina e Midian.”

English: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
Masaai: Keisikong' Enkai lelo torrok, ore lelo supati neshipakino omom enye.

English: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: Ore pooki laamiki te dukuya ltung'ana naa kamiki sii nanu ninye te dukuya Papa lai otii shumata.

English: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
Masaai: eitasheyie ineeidong'ishoreki enye te wueji ai neidong'ishoreki, o ntaloishin e kutuk aji enye tembata oo ntaloishin e kutuk aji aainei, metaa esuntai ake natii erishata e nanu o ninche. Eisarkionie ninche enkarna ai sinyati teilo minong otaasa ninche, metaa atumuta nanu ninche te ng'oro ai.

English: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
Masaai: naaya apa nanu Olaitoriani aitung'uaa esujata oo ntare, naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Shomo, mbonoki iltung'ana laainei Israel.’

English: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
Masaai: nejur olapolosani ninye, naa tenetubulayie ilo pepedoi to lchoni lo sesen lenye, netum olapolosani aibalunye nchere keiduruk enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo oyau olasar le nashe ninye laayanyit nanu; ore ilo oitorioo nkoitoi enyena, naa kaitodol nanu enjeunoto e Nkai!”

English: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
Masaai: Neitoki enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Olaitoriani alotu shumata Saul, etonita ti atua enkaji enye eeta empere enye te nkaina enye; neoshito Daudi enkawuo oo sinkolioitin.

English: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
Masaai: Eitomijoonoki nkong'at, neishir enkop; enkaraki naidaikieki entapa, etoito isabibu neishunye eilata.

English: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
Masaai: Neijia sii eikuna Daudi aimaki emayianata o ltung'ani oikenaki Enkai esupatisho neme te nkaraki isiaaitin ejo:

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, te nkitoo enye laa ninye makewan laairriwaka lelo oreren ooidaikie intae, amu ore ilo likiseyie iyie, naa enerok enkong'u ai eiseyie:

English: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel iltung'ana, “Olaitoriani olchakeni apa otegelua Musa o Aron neyau iloo papaai linyi ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
Masaai: Naidapashaki inkiri inyi inchumat oo ldoinyo, naiput inong'ot too mpopoki inono.

English: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
Masaai: kake endaa ake eipirta o enaoki o enkitukuore oo mpukunot kumok, naa imbaa naaitore osesen naatuunoki o metabau enkata enkibelekenyata.

English: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
Masaai: Kake meikeni nena pisai tialo ninche amu keasisho ninche te nkoitoi naisiligayu.

English: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
Masaai: Neing'oru ninye Ahasia, neibung'i ninye eisudori tiatua Samaria, neyauni ninye enetii Yehu neari ninye metua. Nenukaa ninye amu etejo, “Nkakuyiaa lenye Yehosahafat, apa oing'oru Olaitoriani to ltau lenye pooki.” Ore te nkaji e Ahasia nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aitoreisho.

English: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yehoram tenebo ilarikok lenyena le njore, o ngarrin enyena oo mbartan pooki, nepuo kewarie aaidaikie iltung'ana le Edom apa oomanita ninye o lkituaak lenyena loo ngarrin oo mbartan.

English: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Is it not on thee, and on all thy father's house?
Masaai: Ore te lelo sirkon linono ooimina nkolong'i uni naatulusoitie, mintoki adamu ninche, amu eidipaki aanoto. Naa kaing'ae ilo oyieuni ti atua Israel pooki? Aime iyie o enkaji e papaai lino pooki?”

English: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.
Masaai: “Nteru nkena iwikii naapishana; ntera nkenu nena wikii naapishana ebaiki ina kata nisampu ina kurma ina nauno.

English: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
Masaai: Enkaraki eina peyie etejoki enkarna enye Babel, amu teine apa etomilo Olaitoriani enkutuk enkop pooki, naa teine eidapashaka Olaitoriani ninche oriong enkop pooki.

English: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
Masaai: Ee, aamanita nanu ildiein; aatang'adua nanu olturrur loo laasak loo ntorrok, etaremo ninche ndapi oo nkaik aainei o nkejek -

English: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
Masaai: ng'ura, kairragie nanu endapana enker te wueji neidong'ieki enkano; ore ake pee ejing enkoleelio endapana ake, netoyio enkae wueji pooki, nayiolou taa ajo ikordu iyie Israel te nkaina ai, anaa enitejo iyie.”

English: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkoshoke e ng'otonye neibung ninye olalashe lenye entutunyo, o e etaa oltung'ani kitok nekeshare Enkai.

English: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
Masaai: Naa teneishunye ilpapit lo ltung'ani te nkalo enkomom enye o nkushu, naa endukuya ake natukurre te nkalo enkomom, kake meeta ninye olduruk.

English: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
Masaai: Ilo kep lenye oishakenoki ninche; keibalunye ninche ing'ok enye anaa Sodom, meisudoo ninche. Woi ninche Amu eyautua entorroni shumata ate.

English: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata pee elotu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena Siklag te nkolong e uni, netaara Ilmaleki Negeb o Siklag. Eisulie ninche Siklag nepejoo te nkima.

English: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
Masaai: Miking'ili aekata aajo Enaiturrayioki, nemeigili ae kata aajo enkop ino Olmuate; kake keaku eikiji iyie Enatii eng'ida ai atua ninye, naa keji enkop inyi Nayamaki; enkaraki nashipakino Olaitoriani intae, ore enkop inyi neaku keyama.

English: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
Masaai: Ore eidipa ninye atudumunye negila enkitoria enye neoro aipir isiwuon okuni le shumata, kake mme taa te nkaraki dupoto enye, neme te nkaraki ina kitoria naitore ninye; amu kedotuni ina kitoria enye neishori ilkulikae leme ninye.

English: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong neisuma ninche embuku e Musa aaitoning olorere; netumi eigero teina buku nchere meetae Olamori aashu Olmoabui ojing ae kata eumata e Nkai;

English: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Masaai: pee etum Enkai e seriani atasioki atupurda shetani ti alo nkejek inyi. Metaa te nebo intae empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
Masaai: Neya Musa iloik lo sesen le Yosef te nebo ninye, amu eitayio apa Yosef enkutuk neinos olmumai too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ejo, “Kemutan intae Enkai; naa eiyaya intae iloik laainei te nebo intae aaitung'uaa Misiri.”

English: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Masaai: neitera Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani aputu ninye ti atua Mahane-dan te rishata e Sora o Eshtaol.

English: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
Masaai: Ore pee eputunye Yosef too injo neas anaa enaitanapa olmalaika lo Laitoriani nerik esiankiki enye ang;

English: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
Masaai: Nerrinyokino Aron Musa te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ina kata pee eish olmeitai.

English: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
Masaai: Ore enkae pooki neinos Aron o layiok lenyena; nenyae ninye eitu eisuishieki tiatua ewueji sinyati; tiatua olgoriet leilo ng'obor le ntumo neinos ninche.

English: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani te Sion, ilo obikito le Yerusalem! Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
Masaai: Aipoto nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye eishiaakino neisisi, naaitajeuo nanu too lmang'ati laainei.

English: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
Masaai: Ore kulo ooigeroki nkarn ninche apa loo nkolong'i e Hesekia, olaiguanani le Yuda, neidaikie ilng'oborri lenye o Lmeunin apa oomanya ine, neishieki ninche teine o taata, nemany ninche ina kop enye enkaraki natii ine ndaat oo nkerrai enye.

English: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto olng'en eitaa ilomon lenyena le nkiguana, neponaa enkarriyiano te nkutuk enye.

English: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
Masaai: Eiteng'ela ninye eng'eno sidai te lelo ooitashe too sipat; ninye elong'o e lelo oopuo te mborron.

Masaai: Neitashe ninche te nelakua te nkuretisho o enkitamioto enye ejo, “Wooi ina anasa kitok, naa magilani Babilon. Te saa nabo eewuo endung'okinoto ino enkiguana.”

English: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
Masaai: Mme eng'oruoi etupukunye olee, kake olee etupukunye eng'oruoi;

English: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
Masaai: Kake nchoo lelo pooki likisaru iyie meting'idata, nchoo ninche metaranyisho anaake te ng'ida; naa tomitu iyie ninche, paa ore lelo pooki oonyor enkarna ino niking'idakino iyie.

English: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipang'u ilapolosak aaing'uaa ine wueji sinyati, neiput enkatampoi enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki toki naino te Nkai nemir enkop; ina ena emirata namir enkop naa enkirukoto ang.

English: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
Masaai: Metaa Olaitoriani orish erishata ai o iyie, maaitalaa nanu Olaitoriani te iyie; kake mikiarare iyie enkaina ai.

English: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
Masaai: ilo laa ninye ake eishooki ina kop, nemeetae olomoni oimayie ninche.)

English: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
Masaai: pee itum atayiolo esipata e kuna baa nikinosakaki.

English: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
Masaai: metaboloki Enkai iyiook enkoitoi ele rorei, matolikioi enkisudoroto naipirta Kristo naa te nkaraki ninye pee atii nanu korokoroni,

English: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
Masaai: Ore kenya ake peyie ipuonunu enkop naisho ntae Olaitoriani, anaa enatejo, nimbung'ubung'u ena kisiaayiare.

English: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
Masaai: Tapaasha ninye, milo aim ninye; imbelekenyunye tung'uai milo agiroo.

English: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
Masaai: “Ore pee eipung ilo sinka nedol likae sinka oboita te siaai oata esile enye dinari iip nabo; neibung olgos agor nejoki, ‘Talaakaki esile ai pooki.’

English: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neye Hadad, neitoreisho Samla le Masreka te rishata enye.

English: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi lelo Gibioni, “Kaa nanu aitaas intae? Naa kaji nanu aikunu enkipooto, pee itumutumu intae aatamayian enjung'ore o Laitoriani?”

English: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, be defiled.
Masaai: “Miun tiatua enkurma ino oo sabibu mpukunot are oo lanterera meiwuang'ieki ake ilng'anayio lenyena, lelo ng'anayio lituuno o lelo ootubulakitia.

English: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
Masaai: Nchoo nena kutukie e lejare metunukata, amu ninche naairo te ntorroni tialo ilo asipani, to lwuasa o te ng'ogong'i.

English: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
Masaai: Te nailep nanu alo shumata, itii iyie ine! Te naitobir nanu endapash ai te nemeneng'a itii iyie ine!

English: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
Masaai: Neiken ninye neyiolou esiana oo lakir, neisho ninche pooki nkarn enye.

English: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Netii etii Olapolosani Kitok oji Ananias, netii Kaiafas, o Yohana o Aleksanta o kulikae ake lo lmarei lo Lapolosani Kitok.

English: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
Masaai: Ejo, “Ng'ura, Yerusalem kilep aapuo; naa keitarasakini Enkerai e Tung'ani ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, nedung'oki ninche ninye enkiguana e keeya, neitarasaki Iloreren;

English: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
Masaai: Ainyoo peyie eishori ewang'an oltung'ani laa ore enkoitoi enye neisudoro, ilo oitamana Enkai olpaashe ninye.

English: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
Masaai: Aimetii ninche lido kekun le Yordan, enkalo o loo ntoluo enkoitoi dapash endoyioroto enkolong, tiatua enkop oo Lkanaani apa laa ninche emanya Araba, eipirakinore Gilgal embata oo lkeek le More?

English: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
Masaai: Kake eisika Absalom. Ore apa olbarnoti orripisho nedumu nkonyek enyena, neing'orisho, naa ng'ura, epuonu iltung'ana aaimu enkoitoi e Horonaim emurte o ldoinyo.

English: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
Masaai: nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa shumata ojo, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai lanyor; atishipe te iyie.”

English: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
Masaai: Nayau nanu intae atua enkop sidai, pee ishipakinono ilng'anayio lenyena o ntokitin enyena sidain. Kake ore pee ipuonunu atua ninturujuju enkop ai, nintaa enjung'ore ai olminong.

English: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
Masaai: Ore naa tayooki tudumunye tadekenya te nebo isinkan lelo lo lkitok lino apa ooetuo te nebo iyie, nipuopuo anaa ake pee ewang'aki intae.”

English: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
Masaai: Netum Ilyahudi ewang'an, o enchipai, o eng'ida o enkanyit.

English: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i ile ninosinoso imukateni neitu eisuishieki ore te nkolong e naapishana naa keaku eneumata o Laitoriani Enkai inyi; miasiasa esiai teina olong.

English: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
Masaai: Lo sunkuroi, tang'asa intayu ilo shata te nkong'u ino makewan pee itumoki atoduaa oleng, aitayu ina suama te nkong'u o lalashe lino.

English: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
Masaai: Karrar nanu ilmang'ati lenyena te dukuya ninye, naosh anang'ie enkop lelo ooiba ninye.

English: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, tialo nena masaa naatung'uayioki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani o tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda, o tiatua Yerusalem:

English: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Abrona nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Esion-geber.

English: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ooibelekenya aapuo aaim nkoitoi enye naalojiloja, nelo Olaitoriani arikoo ninche te nebo lelo torrok! Meeu eseriani Israel!

English: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
Masaai: Kake Oldoinyo le Sion epuo aatii lelo ooilanyisho, naa keaku sinyati ine; ore enkaji e Yakobo neya wuejitin enye.

English: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
Masaai: Enchoo ng'oruo egira ti atua ntumoritin, amu meishoro meiroro. Ele kerreti esujita sirito pooki oo ltung'ana le Nkai. Enchoo ninche eigara olorere, amu neijia sii ninye ejo Olaitoriani.

English: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
Masaai: Ore ake eing'orisho Arauna airrugo, nedol olaiguanani o sinkan lenyena epuonu aayiaya ninye; nelo Arauna, neserem olaiguanani neitabaiki enkomom enye enkop.

English: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
Masaai: aashu eselenkei nemeyiolo olee enye neitu eyami naa ninye enyikare amu meeta olmoruo; ore teina neidim ninye aisarkionie kewan.

English: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
Masaai: Nelioyu ina kata olmonekie le Nkerai e Tung'ani te keper neaku olkiyioi lo lauui too loreren pooki le nkop, nedoli Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu too nkatampo e keper te ngolon o te nkitoo sapuk.

English: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
Masaai: Naibelekeny endamunoto ai ayiolou naing'oru aturu naing'oru eng'eno nagut o esiana oo ntokitin, nayiolou nena torrok e modai o ina modai aa ninye olkuenyi.

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiai ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo

English: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul Yonatan, “Tolikioki nanu ina nitaasa.” Neliki Yonatan ninye, “Ainyorrinyorra nanu enkiti aisho te ndukuya e ng'udi apa natii enkaina ai; nele nanu, naa kaye.”

English: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
Masaai: neme enkaraki nkiaasin, metum ake likae tung'ani enawuasare.

English: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
Masaai: “Eishirita Yuda netameito nchomito enyena; neishir iltung'ana lenyena etoni te nkop neilep olkiyioi le Yerusalem alo shumata.

English: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
Masaai: Kaing'or nanu enanka o anu naning oltoilo le ntarumpeta?

English: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.
Masaai: Neipotu lelo tung'ana lo ltim, Yonatan o ilo anapani loo masaa enyena olarrabal nejo, “Elepu wootu enikitii, naa eikintodol intae entoki.” Nejoki Yonatan ilo anapani lenye, “Ilepu wou tusujuaki amu eishoo ninche Olaitoriani metijing'a atua enkaina e Israel.”

English: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
Masaai: ore ake enkomono pooki o esayiata naomon oltung'ani obo anaa iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, eyiolo ake oltung'ani eoshoto enye o sina lenye, neitorioo nkaik aaing'orie ena aji;

English: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
Masaai: Kake ore pee iyiolouu aajo keeta Enkerai e Tung'ani enkitoria te nkop napalakinye ng'ok,” nejoki ilo tung'ani maima, “Aajoki inyo tudumu erruat ino shomo ang.”

English: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
Masaai: Kake ti nimiasiasa ina, ng'ura, nitaasa naa eng'oki to Laitoriani; naa entayiolo nchere meeta nchere, esipa meinepu intae ina ng'oki inyi.

English: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
Masaai: Naa ing'ura, ore enkanashe ino Elisabet nenuta te moruo enye, naa keiu enkayioni, naa ole ile ele apa, te nutai enye, enatejoki oshi koolupi.

English: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
Masaai: Eiba ninche ilo oisikong'isho te kishomi neinyal ilo oiro esipata.

English: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
Masaai: Ore ake sii etii apa emisa ai iltung'ana iip nabo o onom, Ilyahudi o lkituaak metii lelo apa ooetuo enikitii eing'uaa lelo oreren oomanita iyiook.

English: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae tung'ana neishooyo sahabu nkiloi iip nabo o ntomoni ile o isiet, o nkiloi iip nabo o artam e nkosholai, o lkilani ntomoni ile oopishana loo lapolosak.

English: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.
Masaai: Naa te nejoki ilo tung'ani ninye, “Nchoo ninche eng'as apej eilata, pee intoki aya inaaba anaa iniyieu,” nejo ninye, “A-a, iyau tena kata; naa te neme neijia, naya nanu te ngolon.”

English: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
Masaai: Kake etii ilkumok ooiturukutuo ooyooki aaku ile siadi, neaku ilooisiadutua ile dukuya.”

English: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
Masaai: “Aibalakinye enkarna ino lelo tung'ana likinchoo iyie aitung'uaa enkop. Ilinono apa ninche, nikinchoo iyie ninche, neibung'a ororei lino.

English: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ketupurroyioki too nkaik enyena, nelaaki naa ninye olopeny.

English: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
Masaai: Tenaa kena kintaas nanu taaraki matua nabo kata, te nanoto omom too nkonyek inono, pee madol nanu entorroni ai.”

English: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni oopishana le yararoto e Yehoiakin olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le tomon oare, te nkolong e tikitam oopishana o lapa, nelaaya Efil Merodak, ilo aiguanani le Babilon, teilo ari oitera aitoreisho, Yehoiakin olaiguanani le Yuda metupuku te jela.

English: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
Masaai: neitoki olapolosani ayau enkare nasinya te moti oo nkulupuok, neya enkiti terit to ltiren le ina aji e Nkai nepik atua ina are.

English: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
Masaai: Nearaa ninye ilo tung'ani. Ore te nkalo oloo saen e Eden, etipika ninye olmalaika, o lalem oyupuyup oman pooki alo peyie errip enkoitoi olchani le nkishui.

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine to lasar le ng'oki; epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
Masaai: O nena sii pooki naaitisinya Samuel oladuaani, o Saul olayioni le Kish, o Abna olayioni le Neer, o Yoab olayioni le Seruya - ore nena kishorot pooki naaitisinyaki naa abori enking'urata e Shelemot etii o lalashera lenyena.

English: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
Masaai: Eton eng'eno nagut te ina damunoto oltung'ani oota ening'unoto, kake meyioloi tiatua iltauja loo lmoda.

English: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuo nkaisiaayiak e Esta o lelo sunaishi oogelema aainosaki, neisina oleng ina kitok o laiguanani: Neirriwaa nkilani aishop Mordekai, pee etum aitayu ilkuniyiani, kake menyorraa ang'amaa nena kilani.

English: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
Masaai: Ore ilki linono pokira netiu anaa nkoliin, ilmao le nkolii oodaa too ntapuka.

English: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
Masaai: Amu ketaarayie ninye ilo oirirua torrono otii ilo tung'ani metupuku. (Amu eibung'a nkolong'i kumok, neteenaki aarrip, nerridi too sekenke naairoishi o too munyororoni; ore pee eitirrie pooki nearaa oloirirua ninye ong'ata.)

English: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: ore ninye naaji te kulo tung'ana okuni, Noa, o Daniel o Yakobo te netii atua, naa keitajeu ake enkishui enye maate te supatisho enye maate, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
Masaai: Naaing'or nanu nkonyek inono eton eitu aaku toki; neigero te mbuku ino inkarn e pooki, nena olong'i pooki naategeluaki eton eitu ebau.

English: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
Masaai: naa to sesen lenye eiwuang'ie ninye nena kitanapat o nkoon naaitanapishoteki pee etum ninye aitaiki kewan oltung'ani obo ng'ejuk te lelo ootoorote are, neyau eseriani,

English: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
Masaai: Iyie otooro enaiposha te nkidimata ino; itadanya iyie endukuya o lasurai ti atua nkariak.

English: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
Masaai: Elo Enkerai e Tung'ani anaa enatisiraki, kake, ee kake ayia elde la ninye oitarasaa Enkerai e Tung'ani. Enaikash apa te neitu eini.”

English: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
Masaai: O Maen, o Karmel, o Sifi, o Yuta,

English: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
Masaai: o Betlebaot, o Sharuhen - nkanas tomon o okuni te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti;

English: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
Masaai: Aing'ura nanu, kake meetae hoo obo laaretu, naing'asia amu meetae hoo obo laatijing'a enkoriong, neaku te nkaina ai ake anoto enkishuroto, naaitasheyie nanu empushuna ai.

English: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
Masaai: “Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Yuda, eiteru te nkalo o loosaen, o metabaiki oloontoluo, naa keaku erubata naitaini aaiteng'el, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet e ndapasho, ore tenkadori nerisiore eneba nabo e nena rubat olosho, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo, etii ewueji sinyati empolos enye.

English: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.
Masaai: Miturishore iyie olkiteng o sikiria te nkata nabo.

English: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
Masaai: Meiwuang'ieki aekata isupati kake ore iltorrok nemebik te enkop.

English: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
Masaai: Amu kitanang'aka nanu atua enguton, atua enguton oo naaiposha, naaman nanu nkariak pooki wueji; ore lopir pooki o nang'arot oo nkariak neim shumata nanu.

English: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Eitanapa apa Olaitoriani olkitok lai pee eishooyo enkop anaa enjung'ore te oshoto e nkukuo aisho iltung'ana le Israel, neitanapaki apa olkitok lai o Laitoriani pee eisho enjung'ore e Selofehad olalashe lang ntoyie enyena.

English: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
Masaai: o Yuda, o Benchamen, o Shemaia, o Yeremia,

English: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
