English: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
Masaai: Aitenkitanapata ino edumunye olkurragos alo ashet enkaji enye te shumata?

English: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
Masaai: Entadou naa ate ti abori enkaina nagol e Enkai, pee etum ninye ailepie intae te nkata nageluno.

English: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
Masaai: Ore apa te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan ele apa, neiturrurro iltung'ana le Israel te eenata empukoroto neishop ilkuniyiani, nepik enterit ilukuny enye.

English: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
Masaai: nincho ninye metaiyiolo inchere ore pooki oshuku olaasani loo ng'ok aitung'uaa enkoitoi enye e marmalisho, eitajewuo oltau lenye te nkeeya neitoipoo olorora loo ng'ok.

English: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
Masaai: Te neduaki likae lang olalashe eas entorrono neme ene keeya, neomonoki, naa kening'oki Enkai neisho enkishui lelo leme ine keeya ng'ok enye. Keetae ng'ok e keeya; eitu ajo metomonokini oltung'ani te ina.

English: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:
Masaai: Neinyiototo taa Olaiguanani aitashe, o ilo balosi o Bernike o lelo ootoni te nebo ninche,

English: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
Masaai: neijia sii etiu Kristo, ore eidipaki aaitarasai ena nabo newa ng'ok oo lkumok, keliooyu eni are, neme ng'ok elotu aararr kake kelotu aitajeu lelo ooanyita ninye te yieunoto sapuk.

English: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
Masaai: “Kake ore oloitapong'oo nabo kiti te kuna naairuk nanu metaasa inyok, eishiaakino neenikini osoit oituutishoreki emurt nenang'akini olmegut le naiposha.

English: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
Masaai: Ake sii, ore teneibelekenyunye oltung'ani aing'uaa nena torrok naataasa neas ina naishiaakino nesipa, naa keitajeu enkishui enye.

English: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
Masaai: “Ara osabibu odede, naa Papa olaramatani.

English: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
Masaai: Naa ti nintobir oloing'oni pee eaku olasar opejori, aashu olasar, pee intabaya olmumai, aashu olasar le seriani to Laitoriani,

English: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
Masaai: naa ina pee aaipotoki nalotu neitu aing'ash. Naikilikuan naa intae ajoki, aainyoo pee kietuo aaipot?”

English: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
Masaai: Netorokita taata nkomomi enye aalang nkuk, meekure eyiolounoyu too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa; neibibiari iseseni lenye aarep iloik te saso netoito anaa nkeek.

English: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
Masaai: Edekisho lelo tung'ana too ldeketa lemening'u ninche, ore too naayiolo te mpukunoto o sesen anaa pee eyiolo ng'uesi, neyaki ate embatisho nemuti ninche.

English: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
Masaai: Mincho ninche ejokino maate, “Aha, kinoto iyiook eyieunoto oo ltauja lang!” Mincho ninche ejo, “Kitoijoitie iyiook ninye.”

English: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
Masaai: ‘Amaa te nenap oltung'ani enkiring'o nasinya to lcholoi lo lkila lenye, neiseyie te ilo sholoi lenye emukate, aashu enkurma, aashu enaisho oo sabibu, aashu eilata, aashu ae pukunoto e ndaa, keaku ina sinyati?’ ” Newal ilapolosak aajo, “A-a.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Na kitok, ainyoo pee nchirita? Ai ng'ae ing'oru?” Ore amu kejo kolaturoni le nkurma nejoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa iyie owa ninye, tolikioki enishomo apik ninye, pee alotu aya.”

English: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
Masaai: (kulo ninche ilayiok le Raheli ootoikioki Yakobo - iltung'ana tomon oong'uan pooki.)

English: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yakobo ninye, “Eyiolo olkitok lai ajo ore kuna ng'aturran naa kenana, naa nanu ogolie intare o nkishu tenebo ilasho lenye, naa te nerewi oleng enkolong nabo, naa keye imasaa pooki.

English: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
Masaai: Eitobirutua ninche olashe te Horeb, neserem ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno.

English: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
Masaai: Mbung'a iyie tialo osinka lino Daudi, papaai lai ina apa nimbalakinye ninye; ee iroro iyie te nkutuk ino, nintabayie te nkaina ino nena ena olong.

English: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
Masaai: Enchiunye iloomuei, entopiu ilootuata enchiunye iloota enkeeya oo lbolot, entaarai iloiriruani. Eishooki intae pesho, enchooi sii intae pesho.

English: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ilo kilikuai, “Nji iyie shomo tiaaki Yoab, ‘Mincho iyie ena bae kintanyamal, amu ear olalem obo taata near taata olikae; ntirrisha erasakinoto ino, enkanasa nimbung ninye.’ Nintagol ninye oshoke.”

English: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
Masaai: Neitu aasishore rorei oomelok le ng'eno airorita, o te likioroto ai, kake aataasishore enkitoduaaroto e Nkiyang'et o engolon,

English: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
Masaai: Ore ewalata e mborron nerriny engoro napi, kake ore ororei le nkisikong' neinyeyie engoro.

English: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
Masaai: Eijo iyie keaku rorei ake duoo enkoitoi nagol napuoyieki olarrabal? Kaing'ae taata iyie ingarakino, eji peyie kimpirakinore nanu?

English: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: Ore apa enkitanapata oo layiok le Gershon te ilo ng'obor le ntumo, naa pee eing'or ilo ng'obor le Nkai, olng'obor kewan o enkimulumulata enye o enkikenet e kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo o neeikishoreki to lgoriet,

English: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
Masaai: Amu kaibalunye nanu enkarna o Laitoriani. Enchoo enkitoo Enkai ang!

English: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
Masaai: “Arashu aing'ae oiken ina aiposha too nkikeneta, ina kata nadanya aing'uaa eng'uset;

English: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
Masaai: Kake tenaairorie iyie, naabol iyie enkutuk, naa aijoki iyie ninche, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;’ ore ilo oning, inchoo ening; ore ilo oany ening, inchoo eany amu enkaji kiserut ninche.

English: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
Masaai: o Yeremia naa ninye olayioni le tomon, o Makabania aa ninye olayioni le tomon oobo.

English: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
Masaai: Nebaya lelo tung'ana nkalifuni ong'uan.

English: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejokini Saul nchere eshomo Daudi Gas, neitu ninye eitoki aing'oru ninye.

English: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
Masaai: Ore ena naa te nkaraki ing'ok oo loibonok le Nkai o ntorrok oo lapolosak lenyena lelo ooibukoo te mpolos enye osarge le lelo lemeeta entioto.

English: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
Masaai: nelak ilo kuoo katitin ong'uan, enkaraki ena bae, o enkaraki nemeeta olng'ur.”

English: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina aaiputa nanu olkirutoto; aaibung'a nanu emion naikununo anaa enenkitok nasaisai; atashala nanu o metaa meekure aning'isho, airuto nanu o metaa meekure adolisho.

English: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
Masaai: Adamu sii ina kirukoto ino nasipa, enkirukoto apa naitera amany kokoo ino Lois, o ng'utunyi Oinike, nayiolo taata aitisip nchere etamanya atua iyie.

English: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
Masaai: naa kaainosie iyie olmumai to Laitoriani, te Nkai e keper o enkop, inchere miyamaki olayioni lai enkitok too ntoyie oo Lkanaan laa ninche amanya atua.

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar le anaake, o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasarri lenye ooki.

English: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
Masaai: Pee etum atabai enairoroki to loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo, “Ewa ninye openy imuoyiaritin ang, netanapa inkeyaitin ang.”

English: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye ilpereren loo lasarri tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, laa ninche apa etejo Olaitoriani, “Atua Yerusalem nanu alo apik enkarna ai.”

English: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip aiduruko, neikenaki kewan nkolong'i naapishana neaku ninye olemeeta olduruk.

English: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
Masaai: Ore naa nji tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, aawa apa nanu iyie aitung'uaa enkirritare, aitung'uaa esujata oo nkerra, pee itum ataa olkitok te shumata iltung'ana laainei Israel;

English: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
Masaai: Metaa netupurro iltung'ana loo Siraeli ate too masaa enye, ebaiki oldoinyo le Horeb neito idia alo dukuya.

English: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
Masaai: o atua oerata le Bet-haram, o Bet-nimra, o Sukot, o Safon, o ina ae kitoria pooki e Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon, aitaa Yordan olpolosie, o metabaiki enkalo e abori enaiposha e Kineret te nkalo o loo saen te lido kekun le Yordan.

English: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
Masaai: Ore pee eiterre oltau lai ti atua nanu, nadamu nanu Olaitoriani; nelotu enkomono ai enitii atua enkaji ino sinyati.

English: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
Masaai: Olaitoriani engolon ai naa osinkolio lai, netaa sii enjeunoto ai; Enkai ai ena naa kaisis ninye, Enkai e papa lai, naa karrep ninye.

English: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
Masaai: “Kebaa eretoto nitareto ilo lemeeta engolon. Intajewuo ina aina nemeeta engolon!

English: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
Masaai: eitoroka kewan neitanyaayukie kewan osinka, neini anaa iltung'ana.

English: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
Masaai: Nejoki oloramat ilng'anayio, ‘Eji larin okuni taata alotu ake aing'orunye ele ng'aboli lng'anayio, nematumie, tudung'o tuuroi; oo pee etumuta enkop?’

English: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
Masaai: o Hafaraim, o Shion, o Anaharat,

English: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
Masaai: Neishur enkarna e Daudi. Ore pee eshukunye ninye, nesesekuan Iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon o isiet ti atua Oerata le Munyan.

English: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
Masaai: Ekeitorioki ninye intae entoki oo sekenke agilunore isunta inyi ore too ntoluo enyena naa keuroo iltaleta linyi.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee atum ailepakinye Daudi olng'osila le supatisho, naa keitoreisho anaa olaiguanani neasisho te ng'eno, nedung enkiguana te sipata o te supatisho te nkop.

English: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
Masaai: Naa keishie Olaitoriani katukul olkina le naiposha e Misiri; naa keyuk ninye enkaina enye te shumata olkeju, te ilo kutati lenye opejisho, naa keosh ninye aitaa inong'ot naapishana pee eim iltung'ana anaa enkop natoyio.

English: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
Masaai: Neitokini aaisho erubata olosho le Manase, amu ninye apa olkikau le Yosef. O Makir olkikau le Manase, menye le Gilead, neorikini ninche Gilead o Bashan, amu oltung'ani apa lo larrabal.

English: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
Masaai: Enchololoto niomonono pee mijing'ijing'i intemat; esipa eyieu oltau, kake eshal osesen.”

English: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
Masaai: Neiko ninche neijia, neyau lelo aiguanak pokira imiet aaitayu te nkapune aayaki ninye, olaiguanani le Yerusalem, o laiguanani le Hebron, o laiguanani le Yarmit, o laiguanani le Lakish, o laiguanani le Eglon.

English: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
Masaai: Neraposhu Yakobo inkonyek enyena aing'orisho, ng'ura, elotu Esau nerikito iltung'ana iip ong'uan. Metaa etooro inkera aoriki Lea o Raheli o nkaisiaayiak enyena.

English: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
Masaai: Ore eimariri keper eduaaya ninye eloito, ore nabo kata nemaniki ltung'ana aare ooishopito nkilani naaibor eitashe.

English: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o isiet le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Ahab olayioni le Omori aitore Isiraeli te Samaria. Neitoreisho ilarin tikitam oong'uan.

English: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
Masaai: Metii ene amu etopiwuo anaa enatejo ninye. Wootu eng'urai ewueji neirragieki.

English: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
Masaai: ore tadekenya nidolidolo enkitoo o Laitoriani amu etoning'o ninye inking'unyung'unyat inyi ing'unyung'unyakiki Olaitoriani. amu eikira iyiook nyoo pee ing'unyung'unyakiki iyiook?”

English: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
Masaai: naa ninye apa oitore oldoinyo le Hermon o Saleka o Bashan pooki o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lkishi o Lmaakati, o lpisiai le Gilead o metabaiki olpolosie le Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon.

English: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, mbung'a to sinka lino Daudi, papaai lai, ina apa nisiligie ninye, ijo, “Mikiany ae kata oltung'ani kisiaai iyie te dukuya nanu, pee etonie olorika le nkitoo le Israel, oi duoo tenaa kejurru ilayiok linono nkoitoi enye nepuo too nkitanapat aainei anaa enishomie iyie te dukuya nanu.”

English: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
Masaai: Nelo Musa aing'uaa Farao, neomon Olaitoriani.

English: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
Masaai: Ore enkarruoisho e Efraim netirridaki, ore eng'oki enye netushumaki te mpere.

English: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
Masaai: Atoduaa ake sii tiabori enkolong ajo ore ina kesha neme ene lelo ake ooten, neme ene lelo ake oogol to larrabal, neme enoo lang'eni ake e ndaa, neme enoo lkarsisi ake eng'eno, neme ene leloake arriyiak too siaitin omon; kake eipang'aki ake erishata e munyani ninche pooki.

English: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
Masaai: Neidak ninche, kake ibikoo iyie; keidaaya ninche pooki anaa ilkilani. Mbelekeny iyie ninche anaa nkilani neishari ninche.

English: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
Masaai: Inchoo enchorro ino emayiani, nishipakino enkitok e lelero ino, ololii oikishiaan anaa enkolii nadeenyari.

English: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
Masaai: Ore naa taata na Ai ang, Enkai kitok magilani naitureisho, naibung o sotua o enyorrata nauno, mincho kuna golikinot naaetuo shumata iyiook elioyu aa kutiti te iyie o shumata ilaiguanak lang, o lkituaak lang, o lapolosak lang, o loibonok lang, o loo papa, o shumata iltung'ana linono pooki ebaiki enkata oo laiguanak le Siria, o metabaiki ena olong eaku entoki kiti te iyie.

English: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa ninye edamu aitodolu esupatisho, kake etusujayie ninye olaisinani o ilo omena, o ilo otalepori oltau aar metuata.

English: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
Masaai: Ishipa iyie na kop, tenaa ore olaiguanani lino naa olayioni loltung'ani olakuno, ore ilkituaak linono nenya osirua te nkata naishaakino, te nkaraki eng'olon, neme tenkaraki emerai!

English: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
Masaai: Amu kaing'ae to loing'ang'e eidimi aaitanyaanyukie Olaitoriani? Kaing'ae ti atua lelo le keper onyaanyukie Olaitoriani.

English: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
Masaai: Ilo ng'obor enyaakita loo papa aanapu te nebo Yoshua pee epuonu aajung enkop etaarayie Enkai kulikae oreren aing'atarie ninche, Nebik ilo ng'obor o metabaiki enkata e Daudi.

English: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Samuel: Yoel olkikau lenye, ore olosuju naa Abija.

English: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, idolita enaasita ninche, olminong kitok oasita enkaji e Israel tene, aaraa nanu aitalam ewueji ai sinyati? Kake eton ake intoki adol likae minong sapuk.”

English: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak le nkop ootololoitare o ninye neiborrie onyek te nebo ninye naa keyietu neishir neishiraki ninye te nedol empuruo enye e mpejoroto.

English: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
Masaai: “Neitarasaa Aron ilo oing'oni metaa olasar le ngoki te nkaraki kewan enye o enkaji enye; nelo ninye ayieng ilo oing'oni metaa olasar lenye makewan.

English: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ti nikipuonu akenya aarasaki ena kop, teeniki enkarasha nanyokie ele dirisha liimie iyiook; nisot ti atua enkaji ino papaai lino o yieyioo lino, o lalashera linono o lelo pooki le nkaji e papaai lino.

English: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
Masaai: Nejoki Yakobo Yosef, “Aaipang'aka Enkai magilani nanu te Lus te nkop e Kanaan naamayian nanu,

English: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
Masaai: Beka nabo te lukunya, aa taa (olpisiai le shekeli te risioroto e wueji sinyati) te pooki ng'ae apa oikenaki, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, too ltung'ana iip ile, o nkalifuni uni, o iip imiet oonom.

English: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
Masaai: Nelo ninye enetii enchorro e nkare neisuaaki emunyan atua, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani aitamelono nanu ena are, ore ebaiki ena kata meitokini ae kata aatum keeya anaa olkibiroto tialo ena are.”

English: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
Masaai: Ijo taata iyie, ‘Ng'ura, aidaikie nanu Edom,’ nikitudumua iyie oltau lino to lwuasa. Kake ore taata totona iyie tiang; kainyoo iyie pee impiru enyamali pee itum atua, iyie tenebo Yuda?”

English: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, ajoki intae, etii doi ilooitashe tene lemeinyorrinyor keeya katukul o metaba anaa nedol enkitoria e Nkai eewuo te ng'olon.”

English: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
Masaai: Kake etiaka ninye, “A-a, olalashe lai, amu ore ena kitarruoroto nikiararie nanu naa eikitok alang ina ae nikintaasa nanu.” Kake meinining ninye ninye.

English: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
Masaai: Nepuo ina kata Ilfarisayo aaiguana eneiko pee erresh ninye too nkirorot enyena.

English: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
Masaai: Emimputukunyunyu nimiruturutu teilo marenke oning'o te nkop tenelotu olomoni to lari obo. Neitoki ake olomoni alotu to likae ari netii olarrabal enkop nearare oloitoreisho likae oitoreisho.

English: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
Masaai: Neshuko Daudi alo amayian enkaji enye. Kake eipang'ua Mikal entito e Saul alotu anang'are Daudi, nejo, “Kebaa duoo taata enkanyit nayanyita olaiguanani le Israel kewan, aiturraa duoo taata nkilani te dukuya nkonyek oo nkaisiaayiak oo sinkan lenyena, anaa obo loo ltung'ana oomoda oiturraa nkilani medol enkurruna!”

English: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
Masaai: Neya ninye ina motonyi naishu tenebo nkeek oo ntarakua oina arasha nanyokie o hisopo, neitadoiki ninche oina motonyi naishu atua ilo sarge leina motonyi nateyieng'aki te shumata ina are naruko

English: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
Masaai: Iyanyitata nintasiekuku ina olong e Enkai, amu enkaraki ina pee epeji keper nesholi, ore intokitin naaitobirieki inkulie neshola te nkima.

English: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Entabuaku entaranyaki Enkai engolon ang; entabuaaki te ng'ida Enkai e Yakobo!

English: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I am he.
Masaai: Kalo ilo otaasa ena bae, aipotu iishoritin ebaiki enkiterunoto? Nanu, Olaitoriani, ilo le dukuya, nara ole siadi; Nanu ilo.

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Kainyoo pee inkilikuanu enkarna ai, itoduaa ajo enenking'asia?”

English: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
Masaai: “Nalotu duoo nanu e nchorro najo, ‘Oi Olaitoriani Enkai olkitok lai Abraham, tenaa aitumunyana tena kata enkoitoi naim aitorioo,

English: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
Masaai: ilo oun ororei lo sinka lenye, neitabaya enkiguana oo lkipaareta lenyena; ilo ojo ti alo Yerusalem, ‘Kepuoi aamany ninye,’ nejo ti alo nkanas e Yuda, ‘Kepuoi aashet ninche, naitasheyie nanu ineeturori apa’;

English: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?
Masaai: Neshumu ninye nkonyek enyena nedol ilo tung'ani elotu to losinko leina anasa nejo ilo payian kitok, “Kaji iyie iloito? Naa kaji ing'uaa?”

English: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
Masaai: Naa ore apa ake to sirua le Pasaka, naa kelaaki olbalusui esiamo oltung'ani obo oena anaa oloyieu ninche.

English: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
Masaai: Neitashe Olfarisayoi neomon te nkorrok enye makewan ejo nji, ‘Na Ai, aaisho enashe amu matiu nanu anaa ikulikae tung'ana, matiu anaa laikonyak ilaimonkok, iloololoito, nematiu sii anaa ele osotu kodi.

English: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
Masaai: Ore Shalum olayioni le Galhose, ilo aitoriani lo lkerenket le Mispa neram aitobir, enkishomi e nkong'u enkare. Etesheta ninye neimulumul nepik nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena, o sekenke enyena. Neshet ninye esuntai o lchorro le Shela, le nkurma o laiguanani, omeitabaiki nkedeta naadoyio aapuo enkanasa e Daudi.

English: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
Masaai: o lkiteng o lmeregesh metaa olasar le seriani, pee ipolososo intae te dukuya Olaitoriani o enkishoroto e ntapa naipurja te ilata, amu ore taata keipang'aki intae Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
Masaai: Mintokiki aayau ilasarri le pesho; olminong enkorropil te nanu. Ore olapa ng'ejuk o sabato o enkipototo e umata - maidim nanu aing'ura ena torroni o eumata.

English: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
Masaai: Neidur Israel alo, neun olng'obor lenye te dukuya oltalet le Eder.

English: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
Masaai: Taranyisho te ng'ida, iyie shumata, nishipayu na kop; entaranyisho intae lo doinyo! Amu eitagolo Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, naa kelo aing'urrie lelo apa ooisilisiloki.

English: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
Masaai: Ainyoo engolon ai metaa katon aanyu? Naa kainyoo enkiting'oto ai metaa katon ang'iri?

English: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
Masaai: emesa o ntokitin enyena, o ina kitashet o ltaa e sahabu nasila te nebo ntokitin enyena pooki, olperere le nkorropil,

English: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
Masaai: Ekairriwaa nanu meshomo dukuya, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kejing enkaji o lapurroni, nejing sii enkaji e ilo onya olmumai te lejare te enkarna ai; naa kebik te nkaji enye anya ninye, enya imbaoi tenebo isoito.”

English: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia aiturrurr iltung'ana le Yuda, neitoton ninche anaa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, tiabori ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni o loo maa iip te Yuda pooki o te Benchamen. Nepik ninye lelo loo larin tikitam neilep. Ore esiana enye neaku iltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni gelunot, ooidim olarrabal, ooidim aatanap iremeta o long'oi.

English: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, lalashera laainei, eikiaata esile, kake mme eno sesen, metaa osesen oitore iyiook kinchu —

English: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
Masaai: Neitoip oloip lenye ildoinyo, neitoip ilng'osil lenyena iltarakua sapuki;

English: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
Masaai: Anya ake kutuk hoo naamakua, metaa kalimu taata nduaat o mbolunot naaing'uaa Olaitoriani.

English: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
Masaai: Enaikash te neenikini ninye osoit oiutuutishoreki emurt nenang'akini atua enaiposha, alang te neitapong'oo nabo e kuna kutiti.

English: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: Meetae kulikae omon supati. Iltung'ana ooetuo aaliman intae eyieu neitapong'oo Lomon Supati le Kristo.

English: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
Masaai: Narishie nanu nkejek aainei pooki oitoi torrono, pee atum aibung'a ororei lino.

English: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Masaai: Heles o Lpalti, Ira olayioni le Ikesh le Tekoa,

English: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
Masaai: Eyamisho niiuu ilayiok o ntoyie; eyamaki ilayiok linyi, ninchosho ntoyie inyi meyami, pee etum aatoiu ilayiok o ntoyie; entoponari teine, nimiakuku kuti.

English: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
Masaai: Inchoo enkutuk ino eiro te rishata e lelo lemeyiolo aairoro, niro esipata e lelo pooki ootung'uayioki oopeny.

English: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kepuonu kulo eing'uaa enelakua, naa ng'ura, eing'uaa kulo moikuape, neing'uaa oloo ntoluo, neing'uaa kulo enkop e Sirini.”

English: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, neiteru Olaitoriani adung'oo kulie wuejitin e nkop oo Siraeli. Etimira apa Hasael ninche eisulie tialo ilpolosien le Israel pooki.

English: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
Masaai: “Ore ilo pooki omoda, inchoo eibelekenyunye alotu ene.” Oilo le meeta ndamunot, ejo ninye,

English: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
Masaai: kake ore entoki naleku too nkiri eilo asar te nkolong e uni nepejori te nkima.

English: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
Masaai: “Naa kepuku ntabo e nkolong o lapa o lakir, ore te nkop neinepu osina loreren o enking'aing'ai neikurrukur enaiposha o lopir le nkare,

English: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, I say, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;
Masaai: Etii atua enkitoria ino oltung'ani otii atua ninye enkiyang'et oo nkaitin sinyat. Ore apa too nkolong'i e papaai lino, nenotoki ti atua ninye ewang'an, o eyiolounoto o eng'eno natiu anaa eng'eno oo nkaitin, ore apa olaiguanani Nebukadnesa, papaai lino, neitaa ninye olkitok loo lkuyantik, oloo ntalengo, Ilkaldayo o laing'urak loo lakir,

English: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.
Masaai: Naa dol teneim kulo atua ina kop nedol ake obo oloito lo ltung'ani, naa kepik ninye olmonekie enye, o metaba anaa neturoo lelo aturorok ninye teina nong'oto e Hamon-gog.

English: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.
Masaai: Ore nena molinkaishi e kutuk aji e ilo gilata nerisioro pooki aloli. Ore te dukuya ine wueji sinyati netii entoki nanyaanyukie olperere loo nkeek,

English: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
Masaai: Naa tenemeneijia, toning'oki nanu; tigirayu, amu kaaiteng'en iyie eng'eno nagut.”

English: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
Masaai: enkishooroto sii e Nkai to ltung'ani nchere ore pooki ng'ae neinos, neok, neisikarra te ekenyata enye pooki.

English: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
Masaai: Nejoki Petero, “Olaitoriani, aiyiook ake iliki ena kitanyaanyukoto ena ei pooki ng'ae?”

English: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
Masaai: pee inguenare te sipata ilo okishi o ilo oibookoki enkop, paa ore ilo tung'ani le nkop nemeigil ae kata aitureisho.

English: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Aainyo pee iureishoyuyu intae ilooti enkirukoto?” Neinyototo neisikong olkutati o enaiposha; nelotu enkitirring'ata kitok.

English: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
Masaai: kake tinimirriwaa ninye nimikipuo ine, amu etiaka apa iyiook, ilo tung'ani, ‘Midolidolo enkomom ai tukul, arashu tinirikitoto ake olalashe linyi.’ ”

English: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
Masaai: Neitasheyie ninye nena ng'apeta ntaloishin pokira are e wueji nejing'ieki enkaji e Nkai; nepik ninye eng'ape enkalo e kopikop nejo enkarna eine Yakini; neitoki, apik eng'ape enkalo e moikuape nejo enkarna enye Boas.

English: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
Masaai: Neaku iyiolou iyie euriata o Laitoriani, nitum eng'eno e Nkai.

English: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
Masaai: Kake ore apa pee eponari iltung'ana le Israel aagolu, nepik ninche Ilkanaani enkisiaayiare nagol, neitu earaa ninche tukul aaipang'ie.

English: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
Masaai: Kirriutua naa Yudas o Sila naa ninche maate ooliki intae kuna baa te nkutuk.

English: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atua Herode, ng'ura neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yosef te nkidetidet te Misiri.

English: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aisudoo ina retoto ino naitajeusho ti atua oltau lai, atolimuo nanu esupatisho ino o enjeunoto ino; eitu nanu anuk ina nyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino, aaibalakinyie nanu te umata sapuk.

English: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
Masaai: Tenaa eloibonok ninche, naa tenaa ketii ororei lo Laitoriani tenebo ninche, nchoo naa ninche esaisho to Laitoriani loo lororani, paa ore nena masaa naatung'uayioki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda, o tiatua Yerusalem nemepuo Babilon.

English: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaikilikuanu to Laitoriani, “Keewuo ele tung'ani ene?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, eisudori ninye ti atua lolan.”

English: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani loo Lfarisayo oji enkarna Nikodemo, aitoriani loo Lyahudi.

English: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani loo lororani naa kelo aiting'ie anaa enatudung'oki ti atua enkop pooki.

English: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie ajoki ninche, ‘Olosho ele leitu ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitu eng'amu enkitamito e rerioroto; eidaayie esipata; eiwuang'ieki too nkutukie enye.

English: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisikong oltung'ani, ore te siadi naa keitoki atum omom, alang ilo opakas ninye too rorei lo lng'ejep lenye oopuyiapuy.

English: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Olaitoriani, Enkai e shumata, Enkai kitok naitureisho naibung osotua o enyorrata nauno, te lelo oonyor ninye, neibung nkitanapat enyena.

English: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche Yoshua aajo, “Ore enkaraki natolikioki apa isinkan linono aaitisipaki nchere eitanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino osinka lenye Musa pee eisho intae ena kop pooki, pee indaikiekie lelo pooki oomanya ena kop aaiwuang'ie te dukuya intae; neaku kitureishote iyiook oleng te nkaraki enkishui ang te dukuya intae; nikiaas ena bae.

English: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
Masaai: Ore tiatua iloibonok le Samaria atoduaa nanu entoki e modai eibonishote ninche te Baal nerik iltung'ana laainei Israeli aaitapong'oo.

English: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidipayu ina neturoo Abraham Sara enkitok enye te nkapune olokeri le Makpela natii oloo saen le Mamre (aa ninye Hebron) te nkop oo Lkanaan.

English: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imanya atua enkaji kiserut, lelo oota nkonyek naadolishore, nemedolisho, lelo oota nkiyiaa naaning'ishore, nemening'isho

English: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani osinya nesotu nkuruon e ina ashe nelo apik auluo ilngoborri e ewueji nemetii olduruk; neshumi ninche te nkaraki eumata oo ltung'ana le Israel te nkaraki enkare naitisinyishoreki, te nkitukuoroto oo ng'ok.

English: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

English: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

Masaai: Neaku kishomo apa iyiook, nikigiroo ilalashera lang lelo ayiok le Esau, oomanya Seir, nikigiroo enkoitoi e Araba ebaiki Elat o Esiong'eber. “Nikimbelekenya aaing'or enkalo olpurkel le Moab.

English: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
Masaai: Metaa eitobiraka ninye ninche osirua, nedaa neokisho.

English: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, nejoki, “Eshomo olaiguanani obo kitok enkop nalakua meishori enkitoria neshukunye.

English: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
Masaai: Ore peyie epuonu ilbiasharani le Midian aaim ine: neyietu Yosef aaitayu te ng'umoto, nemiraki ninye lelo tungana le Ishmael te shekeli tikitam e nkosholai; neya ninche Yosef Misiri.

English: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
Masaai: Olbiasharai oata entemet e lejare te nkaina enye.

English: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
Masaai: Kake ore pee epuonu aairuk ilomon supati le nkitoria e Enkai ooinosu Filipo, neimaka enkarna e Yesu Kristo, neibatisae ninche ndung'ot pokira, ilewa o nkituaak.

English: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
Masaai: Amu elotu atua empesho nerrinyo alo atua enaimin, neitoipori enkaina enye te naimin;

English: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
Masaai: Nesioki aitadou emoti enye to loililai lenye nejo; ‘Tooko, naa kaisho sii ninche ntamesin inono.’ Neaku atooko nanu neisho sii nena tamesin enkare.

English: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki nkolong'i e Yohana Olaibatisani o taata eisimitai te ngolon enkitoria e keper, neisimaa iloogol.

English: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
Masaai: Nelo ina kop pooki oo mbat o lkeju le Yordan elikioo enkibatisa naitoduaaya enkirridunoto nayau e mpalakinoto oo ng'ok,

English: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
Masaai: Neeta ake te pooki garri nkeek onguan naairishaa tiabori, naa nabo ninche o engarri.

English: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
Masaai: Kake eing'urrie Olaitoriani ninche, neibelekenyakino ninche, te nkaraki osotua lenye o Abraham, o Isaak, o Yakobo, neaku meidaikie ninye ninche; nemearaa ninche aitung'uaa kewan ometabaiki taata.

English: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
Masaai: netii ake eneigululu nabo abori ilng'osil oare o oiriamari te lelo ngosil ile le ina kitashet.

English: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo iltung'ana pooki Gilgal, ore te ine neitaa ninche Saul olaiguanani te dukuya Olaitoriani te Gilgal. Ore te ine nepolos ninche ilasarri le seriani te dukuya Olaitoriani; ore te ine neshipa Saul o ltung'ana pooki le Israel oleng.

English: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani Sedekia Yehukal olayioni le Shelemia o Sefania olapolosani, olayioni le Maaseia meshomo enetii Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai, ejo, “Toomonoki iyiook to Laitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:
Masaai: Kintaasa iyie Olaitoriani anaa apa enairoro te nanu; amu etopolosayie Olaitoriani enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaina ino, neisho ilo le latia ino Daudi.

English: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, o anu kenya kulo torrok, o anu kenya eisulie kulo torrok.

English: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
Masaai: tinitarresho kewan to rorei lintayio te nkutuk ino, tinikimbung'a ororei le nkutuk ino,

English: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?
Masaai: Neitoki Samuel ajo, “Kainyoo naa pee kinkilikuan nanu, aa Olaitoriani likimbelekenye aing'uaa neaku ninye olmang'atinta lino?

English: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani oiputa emootian enye mbaa! Medol ninye enkurruna te neirorie ilmang'ati lenyena te kishomi.

English: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
Masaai: “Ore enkikurrukur oo mbartan enye nening'o te wueji neji Dan. Ore to ltoilo loo mbartan enye e njore neikirikira enkop pooki. Kepuonu ninche aaidaikie enkop o pooki toki nabore, enkanasa o lelo oomanya atua.

English: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: “Ore ile Lawi aishoo nanu ninche pooki ematua e tomon ti atua Siraeli metaa enjung'ore enye, pee eaku ole rrinyore te ina kisiaayiare enye naisiaisho, ore ina kisiaayiare enye netii atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
Masaai: Kake keitanyamal ninye ilomon ooing'uaa oloo saen o moikuape, naa kelo ninye te ngoro kitok napi pee einyal neidaikie ilkumok.

English: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
Masaai: Neeta nkonyek naabore eloloito, nemeraposho ae kata ing'ok nelejaa iltauja lemeuno, neeta iltauja ooitamooki ing'uarrat nemeishiaakino, Inkera o Ldeket!

English: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aning osinyati eiro; ore likae sinyati nejoki ilo oiroro, “Ae te nkata nabaa eetae ina duaata naipirta ilo osar opejori anaake, o ina gilata oo nkitanapat naitaa olmuaate, o ina naishooyioki emanyisho enye, o lorora meitunyi too nkejek?”

English: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana Samuel, “Kaing'ae ilo apa otejo, ‘Eji keitore iyiook Saul?’ Entoriku lelo tung'ana pee kiar iyiook metuata.”

English: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
Masaai: Neitayu Yesero, olaputani le Musa, enkishoroto olasar opejori o nkishorot naapolosakini Enkai, nelotu Aron te nebo ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli aanya endaa te nebo olaputani le Musa te dukuya Enkai.

English: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
Masaai: Atejo nanu kaked ilo tukai, naitayu ilng'anayio lenyena nchoo ilki linono metotiwuo anaa nkimarrat o sabibu, ore olng'usil le nkiyang'et ino netiu anaa olng'usil loo lng'anayio oonyaanyukie ilama.

English: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
Masaai: Nelo penyo aigut neirrabalakino enkop neomon nejo, “Papa lai, te naa keidimayu intapaashaki ena kikompe, kake mme anaa enayieu nanu kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”

English: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
Masaai: Toning'o enajo Olaitoriani: “Tudumunye, tasaisho te dukuya ildoinyo, nincho ndoinyo metoning'o oltoilo lino.

English: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
Masaai: Apakashad apa menye le Shela; naa Shela menye le Eber.

English: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong nimikintukurruni iyie te nkaraki nena kiasin nikitogolong'aka nanu; amu kaiwuang'ie nanu te ina kata te mpolos inyi lelo linyi oowuasa oorup ate, nimintoki iyie awuasa te ilo doinyo lai sinyati.

English: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Emiureishoyu, entasheito tukul, metii olng'ash pee idolidolo enjeunoto o Laitoriani, naitobiraki ninye ntae taata; amu ore kulo Misiri idolitata taata, mintokiki ae kata aadol.

English: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
Masaai: Ore sii ilmareita loo laigerok apa oomanya Yabes, naa Iltirati o Ichimeat o Lsukati. Ore kulo naa Ilkeni apa ooetuo aaing'uaa Hamat, menye lolmarei le Rekab.

English: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
Masaai: amu olpayian elukunya e nkitok anaa paa Kristo elukunya e sirit, ilo sesen lenye, naa ninye Olaitajeunoni lenye.

English: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
Masaai: te nelo neboitare olee ninye, neisudori ina bae too nkonyek o lmoruo lenye, neaku mejurrunoyu hoo neinosie kewan olduruk, nemeetae olchakeni oishakenoki ninye, amu eitu eibung'akini ina bae;

English: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
Masaai: te nkaraki nadol ninche olkuaak linyi sidai, le nkuretisho.

English: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
Masaai: te nebo nena ang'itie pooki kutiti naamanita kuna anas o metabaiki Baalat-beer, o Rama e Negeb. Ena apa enjung'ore o losho le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena.

English: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Amu enkitobirata apa o Laitoriani pee eitagol iltauja lenye pee etum aaetu aataarare Israel to larrabal, pee etumi aaidaikie ninche katukul, nemeng'amu ninche olng'ur kake pee eishuni anaa apaenaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
Masaai: kake ore lelo oikuluaa o emuro e tatene eyuko Aron anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; anaa enaitanapishe Musa.

English: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani le Betlehem ti atua Yuda, lo lmarei le Yuda, laa olawi apa ninye; neidurraki apa ninye ine.

English: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
Masaai: Kake ore Yehosheba, ina tito o laiguanani Yoram, enkanashe e Ahasia, neya Yoash olayioni le Ahasia, nepurroo ninye nelo aisudoo aitung'uaa lelo ayiok lo laiguanani apa ooji pee eari metuata, nepik ninye o enkaibung'ani enye atua olgilata oirragi. Neisudoo ninye te nkaraki Atalia, neaku eitu eari ninye metua.

English: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
Masaai: Ore pee isumama ena niyiolouwu aajo katabaraka ayiolou embae e kristo naisudoro,

English: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.
Masaai: Ing'ura iyie ewueji nepuo ninche aaisampishore, nilo iyie asujaa ninche. Keitu nanu aitanap ilbarnot pee mikintanyamal ninche iyie? Naa te niata enkure shomo enetii motioo tooko ina natookutuo ilbarnot.”

English: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye aim ae oitoi, neitu eibelekenya aim enkoitoi duoo naimua elotu Betel.

English: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
Masaai: Neitarasaa kuna too nkaik oo laisiaayiak lenyena, meeta ake ineitu erewi te luaata enye maate, ejoki sinkan lenyena, “Enchom enturuko ninchosho metaa ketii erishata eluaata ake o eluaata.”

English: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
Masaai: Entaa ate ilmoda, ninyanya kutukie, entaa ate ilemedolisho nimodokuku! Entaa lamerak, neme te naisho; eyukuyukori neme enaisho napi itooko!

English: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Amu kaleku nanu ti atua iyie iltung'ana supati oobor. Naa keing'oru ninche enkisudoroto te nkarna o Laitoriani,

English: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
Masaai: Aeme irorei apa kulo ooiroro Olaitoriani too loibonok le Nkai te dukuya ina kata apa eton egol Yerusalem o nkanas naamanita, nebore iltung'ana atua ninche, atua o neemanita olkerenket le kopikop te nkalo oo ntonat oo ldoinyo lo loontoluo?

English: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ore ake enkata nadoli aajo aikumok mpisai naatii atua ilo sanduku, nelotu olasirani lo laiguanani o lapolosani kitok, aaiken neenaa ninche too lbenia oo notoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
Masaai: Amaa naa te nimindimidimi aataas enkiti bae anaa ina, oo pee intanyamaluoluo too nkulie pooki?

English: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
Masaai: Ena iyiook maitaasa ninche, nikincho ninche epok, mejing ake engoro shumata iyiook, te nkaraki ilo mumai apa likinosakitia ninche.”

English: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
Masaai: Ore teina kata neitashe iltung'ana pooki le Yuda te dukuya Olaitoriani, tenebo nkera enye kutiti o nkituaak enye, o nkera enye.

English: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
Masaai: Neaku Daudi kitok oleng oleng, amu ore Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, etii apa te nebo ninye.

English: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.
Masaai: Naa ore te pooki bae e ng'eno o eyiolounoto naipirta enaikilikuana olaiguanani ninche, nedol ajo kelang ninche katitin tomon ilkuyantik pooki o lasakutok ootii atua enkitoria enye pooki.

English: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
Masaai: Kinchoo iyie nanu ewueji nelala too roruat aainei ti abori nanu, neitu eideketari nkejek aainei;

English: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
Masaai: Amu ore ilkumok laa ketii ilaidipa atoliki intae, naa kaliki sii taata intae, ebaiki too lkiyio, naa ilmang'ati lo salaba le Kristo

English: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria ejoki,

English: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
Masaai: Eikiyiolo iyiook aajo kitupukutuo te keeya aajing empuaan, amu kinyor ilalashera. Ore olemenyorrisho etii atua keeya.

English: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
Masaai: Intae lelo oong'uar enkolong o Laitoriani! Kainyoo pee iyieuu intae enkolong o Laitoriani? Enaimin ninye neme ewang'an;

English: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
Masaai: Aikipik sii nanu enkitapong'oto? Aikidung'oki iyie nanu enkiguana peyie itum aitaa kewan olasipani?

English: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
Masaai: Nipik aitaman enkamanaa e ntemata e ndapasho endap

English: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
Masaai: Nelotu Enkai enetii Balaam nejoki, “Kakua tung'ana kulo ootii te nebo iyie?”

English: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
Masaai: Netaa kuna pooki enkikoo te iyiook, pee miking'uar enkarrueisho anaa enataasa ninche.

English: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
Masaai: Naa nji nkuna, iwuang'ie ilaiguanak too wuejitin enye, nipik ilarikok le njore irrishat enye;

English: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Ketura, ina apiani e Abraham, netoiuo Simra, o Yokshan o Medan o Midian o Ishbak o Shua. Ore ilayiok le Yokshan naa Sheba o Dedan.

English: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
Masaai: neitasheyieki enkarna ino neibalieki ntarasi, ejo, ‘Olaitoriani loo lororani Enkai e Israel, ninye Enkai oo Siraeli.’ Ore enkaji osinka lino Daudi naa keitasheyieki te dukuya iyie.

English: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
Masaai: kake ore apa pee eilepu Israel te Misiri nepuo aaim olpurkel o metabaiki Enaiposha Nanyokie nepuonu Kadesh.

English: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
Masaai: Neitarasaki ilayiok le Aron ninye osarge, neitadoiki ninye olkimojino lenye atua osarge nepik osarge nena mowuarak o lperere lo lasar, nebukoki ilo sarge entonata o lperere lo lasar;

English: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu nkineji are, nepik ninche dukuya Olaitoriani te kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
Masaai: Kaae near metua Yoab o Abishai olalashe lenye Abna, enkaraki etara apa ninye metua olalashe lenye Asahel ti atua olarrabal te Gibeon.

English: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
Masaai: Kake meyiolo ninye ajo etii keeya ine, inchere ore lomon lenyena netii ineegut e nemeneng'a.

English: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nelotu Shafan ilo aigeroni enetii olaiguanani, neliki olaiguanani ajoki, “Eitayutuo isinkan linono nena pisai naanotoki tiatua enkaji, newaita ninche aapik nkaik e lelo aisiaayiak ooitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
Masaai: Aaitoduaa ninye: ng'ura, eitashe Olaitoriani te mbata e suntai nateshetaki te ntemet e nkitorioroto, eibung'ita entemet te nkaina enye.

English: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
Masaai: Keimakini ena na aji e Yakobo? Aimeeta Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani eng'iriata? Ke nkiaasin enyena kuna? Aimeeta enaitaas irorei laainei ilo olo too sipat?

English: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
Masaai: Eidong'u olkunoni ninye neitobiru te nchumata oo nkuk, neitobiru too sekenke oo idong'ishoreki, neriu ninye te ina aina enye nagol; netir ninye esumash neishunye engolon enye, naa te nelau enkare naok neiterre.

English: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
