English: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
Masaai: pee te neing'or, neing'or nemedol, naa te nening, nening nemejing'aa, pee meibelekenyakino ake Enkai, nepalakini.”

English: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
Masaai: Naa ena kitieunoto kiata iyiook ti atua ninye, nchere ti nikiomonu ake ninye entoki pooki te risioroto e yieunoto enye naa kening ninye iyiook.

English: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
Masaai: Oo doi pee idung'oki olalashe lino enkiguana? Oo, pee imen olalashe lino? Amu kintashe ake pooki te dukuya olorika le Nkai le nkiguana;

English: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
Masaai: Nilo iyie ajo te ina olong: “Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalunye nkiaasin enyena too loreren, embalunye nchere eikitok enkarna enye.

English: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
Masaai: neitupuku, nejoki, “Lo kituaak, kaji aiko pee ajeu?”

English: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
Masaai: Ainyoo nanu aidim anoto te ngolon oo nkaik enye, iltung'ana ooisha engolon enye?

English: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
Masaai: Neibung akurraki ilo rorei osipa anaa enaiteng'enishoteki, pee eidim ninye aishooi eutaroto ti atua ina kiteng'enare supat, neibooyo lelo ooishankarra.

English: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
Masaai: Ore lelo erat linono sidain neiput ngarrin oo mbartan, ore lakedok loo mbartan netumoki nkitashot too nchomito.

English: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
Masaai: Ore oloing'oni lenye kikau neeta engolon, ore mowuarak enyena naa imowuarak o larro, naa ninche errumorie iloreren, nerumoo pooki omeitabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop; ore lelo naa lelo oora nkalifuni iip tomon le Efraim, ore kulo naa lelo oara nkalifuni le Manase.”

English: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.
Masaai: Kake etoning'o olkitok le ina meli loo sikarini, o lopeny emeli nening sii olopeny ina meli aitalang ina natejo Paulo.

English: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
Masaai: Kake ore nkajijik e nena ang'itie kutiti nemeeta isunta naamanita ninche neitanyaanyukieki inkurman enkop; keidimi aatokordu, naa kepuoi aarriny to lari le Yubilii.

English: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani te ngolon, naa enkaina enye nalotu aitoreisho; ng'ura netii enkishooroto enye te nebo ninye, netii nchuneti enyena dukuya ninye.

English: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
Masaai: Nitum taa atudupoyu, tenijurru, nimbung nena kikoot o nkiguanat naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa tenkaraki Israeli. Ntagoluoyu, nintagol oshoke. Miureishoyu; mipalari.

English: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ahis olayioni le Abdiel, olayioni le Guni ninye apa olkitok te nkaji e menye;

English: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
Masaai: Neaku te negut te nkop ilo iyie airo, abori enterit eimu irorei linono; enkop eimu oltoilo lino anaa oltoilo, neing'oming'om oltoilo lino eimu enterit.

English: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
Masaai: Metaa etinyikua ninye neng'utut ninye neing'uaya olng'usil too nkilani enyena, nemayian ninye ejo, “Ing'ura olng'usil lo layioni lai otiu anaa olng'usil liong'ata otamayiana Olaitoriani.

English: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
Masaai: A'a, amu ategelua ninye peyie atum aitanapa nkera enyena olmarei lenye osuju ninye meibung'a orrekie lo Laitoriani eas isupati o sipat, peyie etum Olaitoriani ayaki Abraham imbaa naaisiligie ninye.”

English: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
Masaai: Esipa, Olaitoriani ojo: “Ekeidimi ninye aawaita lelo ooena le ilo ogol, neidimi aatokordu ina naibung'ita ologol, amu kagilunore nanu lelo oogilunore intae; naa kaitajeu nanu nkera inyi.

English: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Esau ajo, “Emaibung'a enkoitoi aapuo, naa kaituruk te dukuya iyie.”

English: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
Masaai: Enaikash enkiti etii esupatisho alang imasaa kumok nemetii esipata.

English: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
Masaai: Neyau ninche ninye too mbartan. Nenukari tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi.

English: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
Masaai: Nintasheyie ninye metii toki te shumata nkuk, peyie etum airowuaja, ore osuyai lenye nepeji peyie aa ore oloirerio lenye nesholi tiatua ninye, nemuti kuti lenye.

English: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
Masaai: Neaku enyaaka sii Yakobo alo ayiolou Raheli nenyorru Raheli oleng aitalang enanyor Lea neisiaai Laban kulikae arin oopishana.

English: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiputakine naa keany enaisho, kake ore te ilo oota esumash, edol ninye ina pooki nadua anaa kemelok.

English: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
Masaai: Embai entorroni, ninyorrurru esupatisho, nintubulaa esupatisho te kishomi; amu eidimayu to Laitoriani, Enkai oo lororani pee eipirisie Enkai olpisiaai le Yosef.

English: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
Masaai: o Benchamen, o Maluk, o Shemaia.

English: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
Masaai: Meiruk ninye ajo keitoki arrinyo aing'uaa enaimin. Naa olalem elo ninye aitingoki.

English: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
Masaai: Entorripisho, naa, amu miyiololo intae ina olong aashu esaa.

English: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
Masaai: Tudumunye, Olaitoriani! Intoriokinoyu ninche taarare, tanang'ai ninche! Tokordu enkishui ai ti alo ilo torrono to lalem lino,

English: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino enkitok, nejoki Simon, “Dol ena kitok? Aewuo enkaji ino neitu kincho enkare oo nkejek; kake aaitashala ena kitok inkejek aainei too lkiyio nejut too lpapit lenyena.

English: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, ‘Talaku namuka too nkejek inono, amu ore ene nintasheyie, ewueji nesinya.

English: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
Masaai: Ore apa olayioni le Yonatan naa Meribaal; naa Meribaal apa menye le Mika.

English: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
Masaai: tipika sii iyie erubata ino atua iyiook neaku olbene obo kiata.”

English: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
Masaai: Tipika olarriponi enkutuk ai, Olaitoriani, torripo enkutuk ai, Olaitoriani!

English: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
Masaai: “Naa einken iyie iwikii naapishana oo larin, katitin naapishana ilarin oopishana, peyie aa ore nena katitin naapishana o nena wikii naapishana oo larin neaku ilarin artam ooudo.

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Manoa, “Tinikimbok iyie nanu, nemanya nanu endaa ino; kake ti nintobir olasar opejori, ntobiraki naa Olaitoriani.” (Amu eitu apa eyiolou Manoa nchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye.)

English: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eitu eitarruoo ele tung'ani, anaa ilootoiutuo, kake esiaai e Nkai eji pee eibalunyeki ti atua ninye.

English: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aasita nanu embae ng'ejuk, egira taata ninye ailepu, aimimusu iyie? Kaitobir nanu enkoitoi ti ong'ata, napik ilkejek olpurkel.

English: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
Masaai: Nepik atua entutua nabo, niyau ninche teina tutua, niyau ilo oing'oni o lelo meregeshi pokira oare.

English: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
Masaai: Etamorua apa olaiguanani Daudi neaku oloo larin kumok. Ore hoo ninye teneimulumuli too ilkilani nemeirouaju osesen.

English: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
Masaai: ore te nkolong e naapishana nejur olapolosani ina keeya; naa teneitu eibulaa ilo pepedoi nemetii ilpapit sikitok, nemelio ilo pepedoi etugumo alang olchoni lo sesen,

English: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
Masaai: Ore Yoab olayioni le Seruiya, o sinkan le Daudi, neipang aapuo nenang'are ninche te nchorro e Gibeon; netoni ninche, obo te nchoto nabo e nchorro o likae te nkae shoto e nchorro.

English: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
Masaai: Neyiolou menye ina kata ajo, enang'ole saa natiaakinye Yesu, “Ekeishiu olayioni lino.” Neiruk ninye makewan o enkaji enye pooki.

English: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonoki taarare lelo airritak le Israel, imbonoki tiaaki ninche, o metabaiki lelo airritak inchere: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Oi ilairritak le Israel lelo ooitotito ate! Amaa ilairritak aimeitoti intare?

English: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
Masaai: Aing'ae laishoo nanu, metaa kalaaki nanu ninye? Ore pooki toki natii abori e keper naa enaai.

English: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
Masaai: “Eten inkolong'i aainei aalang oltung'ani oipirri; eisik aailanyisho, medol ninche esidano.

English: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
Masaai: Keilepaki ewang'an ti atua enaimin ilo supat; aipirisioni Olaitoriani, neeta olng'ur naa asipani.

English: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
Masaai: Kemuti ninche anaa orrarrati loo lkiku, anaa olkujita otoyio.

English: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
Masaai: Pee itum atoning'u endung'et e rashe, o enkipirta enye, o lelo rorei loo lang'eni o loyietiaa lenye.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
Masaai: Ore taaisere neiturrurro larikok o lpayiani loo Lyahudi, o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat te nebo te Yerusalem.

English: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
Masaai: Etoning'o iloreren, neikirikira ninche; eibung'a emion lelo ootoni te Filistia.

English: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie neun ilng'oborri tiongata e Sin.

English: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.
Masaai: Amaa, kaaishooyo nanu iltung'ana le Keila aapik atua enkaina enye? Kedou Saul alotu, anaa enatoning'o osinka lino? Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, aatasayia iyie, toliki osinka lino.” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kedou ninye alotu.”

English: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki olololoitore empukunoto ake ninye eng'ues.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong, inchoo ilo otii shumata enkaji, oata ntokitin ti atua, milotu ake ajo aya; ore sii ilo otii enkurma mirrinyo ake.

English: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
Masaai: Nejoki Yonadab olaiguanani, “Ng'ura, eetuo ilayiok lo laiguanani; anaa enatejo osinka lino, metaa etaa ina.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Tenaa indim iyie atigila olning'o lai o enkolong olning'o lai o enkewarie, metaa meekure elotu endama o enkewarie nkatitin naategelakaki,

English: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
Masaai: “Ore anaa enaishu nanu, Olaiguanani ojo, laa ore enkarna enye naa Olaitoriani loo lororani, ore anaa Tabor tiatua ildoinyo, o anaa Karmel te mbata enaiposha, neijia etiu ilo olotu.

English: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
Masaai: Kake ti nitapong'ori iyie hoo nitii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lino, naa ti ninosie kewan olduruk neaku kitaboitare likae lee leme olmoruo lino,’

English: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
Masaai: Kerikino entito imasaa enyena, arashu esiankiki narikori ilkilani lenyena? Kake maadamu nanu iltung'ana laainei too nkolong'i nemeikenayu.

English: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
Masaai: Negelu tomon o aare, ooisiritore ninye, pee etum airriwai metolikioi ororei le Nkai;

English: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
Masaai: Ele rorei apa eitanapa Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai Seraia olayioni le Neria, olayioni le Mahaseia ina kata apa pee elo tenebo Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda Babilon, to lari liong'uan le nkitoria enye. Olaitasheikinoni apa Seraia.

English: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
Masaai: Kulo ninche ile ishoi e Esau menye loo le Edom teina kop ooldoinyo e Seir.

English: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, Olaitoriani, amu atii nanu atua osina. Etii oltau lai atua enyamali, eibelekenye oltau lai tiatua nanu enkaraki nara apa nanu oltung'ani kiserut oleng, ore te nkoitoi nalala enkanasa neitayu olalem nkera okishin, ore tiatua aji netiu anaa keeya.

English: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
Masaai: “Ore sii taata ena olong naa keme enking'unyung'uny ai, ekeiroshi enkaina enye hoo naigorito nanu.

English: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
Masaai: naa Yoiada menye le Yonatan, naa Yonatan menye le Yadua.

English: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
Masaai: Amaa kenya te nelotu olopeny ina kurma oo lng'anayio, kaa eitaas lelo aturok?”

English: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Nirara intae intare, intare o lokeri lai, nara nanu Enkai inyi, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
Masaai: Neibibiari osesen lenye ometaa meekure elioo; ore iloik apa lemelioo nepuku aibalayu.

English: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae te ninche neeta nkomomi ong'uan: Ore enkomom e dukuya naa enkomom olkerubi, ore enkomom e are naa enkomom oltung'ani ore enkomom e uni naa enkomom olng'atuny, ore enkomom e ong'uan naa enkomom olkurragos.

English: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitu ninye eishooyo iyiook matotiu anaa eng'ues natarreshoki te rishata oo lala lenye.

English: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.
Masaai: Eng'orutu Olaitoriani pee ipokipoko, pee melotu ake ninye anaa enkima ajing enkaji e Yosef, nenya ninye nemetii oloar ninye te Betel,

English: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening'isho nelejaki Manase ninche metaasa ntorrok aaitulus te lelo oreren apa ooidaikie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore to lpisiai loo Siraeli loo ltung'ana, le nena tokitin ntayu nabo ti atua onom ake ninye, too ltung'ana, o too lmong'i, o sirkon, o too nkerrai, o too nchoo pooki, ninchosho ninche ile Lawi laa ninche ooing'or olng'obor lo Laitoriani.”

English: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
Masaai: Nejoki Raheli Papaai, lenye, “Mincho olkitok lai egoro amu maidim aitasho te dukuya iyie, amu kaata empukunoto oo nkituaak.” Metaa etuturuo aing'oru oleng neitu etum inkaitin enkaji enye tukul.

English: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
Masaai: Neirrag ninche te mbata e pooki perere lo lasar too nkilani naalakieki isilen; naa ore tiatua enkaji e Nkai enye neok ninche enaisho e lelo ooitalaaki esile.

English: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
Masaai: neiu Serubabel Abiud; neiu Abiud Eliakim; neiu Eliakim Asor;

English: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
Masaai: Nelotu ng'otonye Yesu o lalashera lenyena neitu eidim aatabaiki ninye te nkiding'a o lorere.

English: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo ninche etoduaa te nkaji ino?” Newalu Hesekia ajo, “Etoduaa ninche nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ai. Meetae entoki tiatua nena ajijik aainei naashumishoreki neitu nanu aitodol ninche.”

English: And the men of Kirjathjearim came, and fetched up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana le Kiriat-Yearim, neilepie ninche aaya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani neyau ninye enkaji e Abindab te nchumata oldoinyo; neitisiny ninche olayioni lenye Eliesa, pee etum enkitasheikinoto e ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani.

English: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai ino makewan likilo arikoo; kelo ninye aidaikie kulo oshon ootii dukuya iyie pee itum aiwuang'ie ninche, nelo Yoshua arikoo intae te dukuya, anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.

English: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
Masaai: Oi iyie oton too nkariak kumok, karsis too lchumat etabawua enkiting'oto ino, etudung'oki olpiyayoil le nkishui ino.

English: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
Masaai: Tataanikiaki nanu, tokorduaki nanu, talakuaki nanu, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei!

English: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
Masaai: Ore ake enaidipie Isaak atamayiana Yakobo, ore ake enaipangie Yakobo aing'uaa ine netii Isaak Papaai lenye, nejingu olalashe lenye Esau eing'uaa engorore.

English: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
Masaai: “Nchoo nkiaasin enye pooki torrok epuonu dukuya iyie nintaas ninche anaa enikintaasa nanu te nkaraki nkitarruorot aainei pooki amu kumok nkishirat aainei e mion neiterria oltau lai.”

English: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
Masaai: Ore oloilepie kewan, neitadouni; ore oloitadou kewan neilepieki.

English: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Naa kaitotiu nanu enkaji ino anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, o enkaji e Baasha olayioni le Ahija, tenkaraki ena goro nikintagoro nanu. O enkaraki sii nitorikoko Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
Masaai: Tenaituku kewan te ntoki naibor anaa enturoto, naituku inkaik aainei to sabuni ogol.

English: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: Eishoo ninche mpopoki oo seseni loo sinkan linono, ilmotoni lo loing'ang'e meitaa endaa, ore lelo sinyat linono neinos ing'uesi e nkop nkiri oo seseni lenye.

English: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
Masaai: Netoikioki apa Absalom ilayiok okuni o entito nabo naji Tamar; naa enkitok sidai apa ninye.

English: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
Masaai: lelo oojo: “Nchoo ninche eisarrisar, nchoo ninche eitasiooyo esiaai enye pee kitum iyiook aatodol; nchoo eyiolounoto e ilo Sinyati le Israel etaanu, naa nchoo ninye elotu, pee kitum iyiook aatayiolo!”

English: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie ninye, ‘Airriwua nanu Olaitoriani enitii, Enkai o Lhebrania ejo, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, pee aatum aaisiaayia ti ong'ata; naa ng'ura, eton ake eitu iruk.”

English: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: ti atua enkima nayupuyup neyau enkitamioto e nkitalaata shumata kuldo lemeyiolo Enkai, o shumata kuldo lemening Ilomon Supati lo Laitoriani lang Yesu.

English: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
Masaai: Ore apa olasurai naa aing'en oleng alang ing'uesi pooki naaitobira Olaitoriani Enkai. Neikilikuan ninye enkitok ajoki, “Eji ketejo doi Enkai, ‘Eminya pooki ng'anayio lo lchani otii ena kurma?’ ”

English: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
Masaai: Tudumu imasaa inono, emootian ino tenebo enkawuo ino, nilo ong'ota pee kilo ang'oroki eng'ues.

English: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
Masaai: Nelotu Yakobo te Seriani o metabaiki enkanasa naji Shekem, natii ina kop e Kanaan einguaa Padan-aram, neun ilngoborri te mbata enkanasa.

English: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
Masaai: Inyang'u esipata nimimir ake, inyang'u eng'eno nagut, e nkiteng'enare; o ening'unoto.

English: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.
Masaai: Totona te nebo nanu, miureisho; amu ore ilo oing'oru enkishui ai neing'oru enkishui ino; ore te nebo nanu niton te wueji neserian.”

English: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
Masaai: peyie aa too mbaa are nemeibelekenya, naa te nena meidimayu pee eaku Enkai olalejani, kinoto iyiook ilooisikakita aasaru eretoto nagol nikimbung'ie ilo siligi otipikaki dukuya iyiook.

English: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
Masaai: Ore apa ti atua Israel pooki nemetii oltung'ani orrepi te nkishaa enye anaa Absalom; ore ebaiki endap e nkeju enye o metabaiki endukuya enye nemeetae eleyiata te ninye.

English: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
Masaai: te shumata eishoo ninye intae entoning oltoilo lenye, pee etum aiteng'ena intae, ore te nkop neisho intae entodol ina kima enye kitok, nining'ining'i intae irorei lenyena epuku te mpolos eina kima.

English: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
Masaai: Edol ninye esekenkei etiu anaa olkujita, ore osuyai netiu anaa oltiapurusi.

English: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa ilapolosak, lelo tung'ana le nkisiajata, ooitobira aaram.

English: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
Masaai: Mme oltung'ani Enkai, eji metaa kelejisho, aashu enkerai e tung'ani eji metaa keirridu. Amaa, keiro ninye nemeitabaya? aashu kelimu ninye nemeas?

English: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even into this day.
Masaai: “Iwa olpiyayati ninger tiatua ninye lelo rorei pooki laairorie iyie tialo Israel o Yuda o loreren pooki, ebaiki apa enkolong naairorie nanu iyie ebaiki nkolong'i e Yosia ometabaiki taata.

English: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
Masaai: Ee kenyor ninye iltung'ana lenyena ore apa lelo pooki ooiteng'elakaki ninye netii atua enkaina enye; nesujaa ninche orrekie lenye, neng'amu eutaroto te iyie,

English: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
Masaai: Mijo ake, “Ekaitalaku intorrok,” taanyu Olaitoriani naa aikiretu ninye.

English: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee intokoos too yarat linono naselenkei nemeisiligayu, apa naisiliga olchumati lenye, ejo, ‘Kaing'ae laalo aarare nanu?’

English: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
Masaai: Ore ilo torrono nejurru ilo supat, neing'oru eneiko pee ear ninye metua.

English: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
Masaai: Kake etiaka ninye, “Oi, Olaitoriani lai, aatoomono, irriwai likae tung'ani.”

English: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
Masaai: Ildoinyo o ndoinyo pooki, ilkeek loo lng'anayio o ltarakua!

English: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
Masaai: Keibung ninye olning'o lenye ntarasi, te ilo rorei apa oitanapishe, too ishoritin naabaya enkalifu nabo,

English: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
Masaai: amu ti nimbalunye iyie te nkutuk ino nchere ninye Olaitoriani Yesu niruk sii to ltau nchere eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata, nikintajeuni.

English: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Masaai: Entudumu lukuny inyi na shomito! nidumunyenye intae, na shomito musan! pee etum Olaiguanani le nkitoo atijing'u.

English: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nenya Aron o layiok lenyena nkiri e ilo meregesh o mukateni naatii atua ltutuan te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo.

English: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyie nanu aishiraka pee kiretu, nikinchiunye iyie nanu.

English: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
Masaai: Kake eewuo erishata to lkekun otoinieki Herode neitoomonisho ninye neipot ilkituaak lenyena o ltung'ana arikok le Galilaya.

English: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana te Kibrot-hatafa nepuo Haserot nebik ninche te Haserot.

English: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?
Masaai: Neitoki Boas ajoki ilo aisiaayiani lenye oitasheiki lelo ooisampu, “Keneng'ae ena sila?”

English: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
Masaai: Nening Yohana eena te korokoroni nkiasin e Kristo, neirriwaki ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki,

English: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore Saul o iltung'ana le Israel neiturrurrote, nepik ilng'oborri oerata le Ela, neluaa too lkererin lo larrabal pee earare Ilfilisti.

English: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
Masaai: o enkikenet o lgoriet, ilo omanita olng'obor le Nkai o lperere lo lasar, o nkeenta enyena, o enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna.

English: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
Masaai: “Teyietu nchira, nimigira, tabuaku ilepunye oltoilo lino anaa entarumpeta; mbalakinye iltung'ana laainei nkitarruorot enye, mbalakinye enkaji e Yakobo ing'ok enye.

English: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
Masaai: Tushumu nkonyek inono ntamanai ing'orisho; eiturrurrote pooki, nepuonu ninche enitii. Ore anaa enaishu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo iyie aishop ninche pooki anaa emasaai, nienikino ninche anaa enaenikino esiankiki narikori imasaa enyena.

English: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
Masaai: Ore te neitiship inkoitoi o ltung'ani Olaitoriani, neitainye ilmang'ati lenyena ooboitare osotua.

English: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Te naa katejo ntorrok, tolimu shakeni e ina torroni; kake amaa te naa sipat, aainyoo pee kiosh?”

English: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
Masaai: naa intae ootang'amutua nkitanapat, anaa enaishorutua lmalaika kake eitu ntabayaya.”

English: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo le meitabaya irorei lena kitanapata aas ninche.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o naaudo le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda neiteru Menahen olayioni le Gadi aitoreisho te Israel, neitoreisho ilarin tomon te Samaria.

English: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
Masaai: Neya Eliya isoito tomon oare te risioroto e siana oo layiok le Yakobo, laa ninche apa eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii, “Ejo keaku eikiji enkarna ino Isiraeli.”

English: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
Masaai: Amu etii imbaa e ilo magilani atua nanu; neok oltau lai e sayiet enye; ore nena naaitureisho e Nkai neitoluaaki te dukuya nanu maataare.

English: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
Masaai: Metaa eng'ura naa pee imbung'ubung'u irorei lele ning'o lo sotua, pee itumutumu aatubul te nena pooki niasiasa.

English: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i enkitoria enye, nekepari Edom aing'uaa enkitoria e Yuda, negelaki ninche ate olaiguanani.

English: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
Masaai: Ng'ura, karrinyu nanu oloip iroruat tomon, te ine netabaikia te wueji nekedi e Ahas.” Neaku etorrinye apa enkolong siadi iroruat tomon te wueji duoo netabaikia.

English: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
Masaai: Ore elotu ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani atua ina anasa e Daudi, neing'orisho Mikal entito e Saul te lusie, nedol Olaiguanani Daudi eipid neiguran te dukuya Olaitoriani; nemenu ninye to ltau lenye.

English: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
Masaai: Neitobir nkitobirat torrok too ltung'ana linono, neiguanakino te nebo pee ear lelo litomituo iyie.

English: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
Masaai: Ore lkumok loo Lyahudi, ooetuo tenebo Mariamu, pee edol kuna baa naataasa Yesu, neiruk ninye,

English: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong pee eidip Musa atuuno olng'obor le Nkai, nebukoki eilata neitisiny ninye te nebo imasaa enyena nebukoki eilata neitisiny olperere lo lasar, te nebo imasaa pooki,

English: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: peyie itum atadamu nimputukuny, nimintoki aekata abol enkutuk ino te nkaraki enkurruna ino, tenaapalaki iyie nena pooki nitaasa, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
Masaai: Toning'o niyiolou naa nisipu nchere ore ebaiki elototo e ilo rorei pee eitobiri neitokini aashet Yerusalem o metabau elotunoto e ilo otubukokoki eilata aaput, ilo kitok, naa keaku iwikii naapishana. Ore too wikii ntomoni ile oare naa keaku keigili aashet too lkurrat oo tumoreki o wuejitin neegol, kake te nkata e nyamali.

English: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
Masaai: Ore ilchumat lenyena pooki nepuo aajing enaimin nagut, enkima neitu einoki nalo amut ninye, ore ina natelekua to lng'obor lenye nemuti.

English: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
Masaai: Kaitalaku nanu osarge lenye, naiwuang'ie nanu entorroni enye, amu ebik Olaitoriani te Sion.”

English: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
Masaai: “Naa ti niomonono nimitiuwu anaa isunkuro, amu enyor ninche aatoomon eitashoo too nkajijik e ntumo o too lojat oo nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, pee etum aatodol iltung'ana. Esipa ajoki intae, eidipa ninche aanoto shunet enye.

English: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
Masaai: pee ailejileji iltauja lenye neitushuli te nebo ti atua enyorrata, pee etum endupai pooki e ning'unoto nasipuno eng'eno e nkisudoroto e Enkai, o Kristo,

English: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Shemer olalashe lenye: Roga, o Yehuba, o Aram.

English: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
Masaai: “Teneiwuang'a ena kitobirata apa naitoriokoki alo te dukuya nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, netum taa iishoritin e Israel aaishunye, meitoki aaku olosho te dukuya nanu ntarasi.”

English: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
Masaai: Aimebaiki intae entadaata too neeleng sidain eji metaa intunyoo ake too nkejek inyi olokeri pooki; niokioko enkare nasila, peyie intunyoo inkulie too nkejek inyi?

English: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Ahimelek ilo apolosani, “Aairriwayie nanu olaiguanani te mbae naje, naajoki nanu, ‘Mincho ake hoo ng'ae eyiolou ae toki ena bae naa ninye aairriwarie, naa ninye aaitanapa iyie.’ Aata nanu ndung'eta oo lbarnot te wueji neje.

English: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
Masaai: Tapalaki lelo tung'ana linono ootaasa eng'oki tialo iyie, tapalaki nkitarruorrot enye pooki naataasa tialo iyie. Nchoo ninche olng'ur too nkonyek e lelo ooibung'a aaraya ninche pee etum aaing'urrie ninche.

English: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorrioki enkomom ino enkalo oo Lamoni, imbonisho tigilunore ninche.

English: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, isiligigi intae irorei le lejare lemeeta eretoto.

English: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
Masaai: Netii apa enkoitoi ino atua enaiposha, neim enkoitoi ino atua inkariak kumok; nemelioo sii iroruat inono.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
Masaai: “Amu neijia ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Kebaa elang tenairriwaki Yerusalem nena kitamiot aainei ong'uan enkiguana, olalem, olameyu, ing'uesi torrok o lmeitai, pee adung'oo tung'ani o eng'ues tiatua!

English: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
Masaai: “Kalo nanu te dukuya iyie naitorioo ildoinyio, kagiligil nanu nena shomito o suyai nagiligil nena shomito e sekenkei,

English: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
Masaai: Ninchopoki enkarasha narridieki endukuya enye. Nipik ilo marisian osinya enchumata e ina arasha.

English: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neyau Musa lelo ayiok le Aron, neishopoki ninche ilkilani nerreten ninche too nkimeitani nkoishuaa nepik ninche imaupen, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
Masaai: Ore Yesu, eyiolo inaaitaasi ninye pooki, nepuku nejoki, “Ai ng'ae ing'oruru?”

English: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
Masaai: Ore hoo nikimbor onyek, iyie Israel, mincho Yuda etiu neijia. Mijing atua Gilgal, nimilep alo Bet-afen, niminya olmumai ajo, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Anaa enatiu kulo ng'abolo sidain neijia adol aa sidain lelo yararot ooing'uaa Yuda, apa lairriwayie nanu meshomo aaing'uaa ene wueji aapuo enkop oo Lkaldayo.

English: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo polosie alo aim enkae shoto, aibelekenya te nkalo o loo ntoluo aing'or moikuape te ilo doinyo otii enkalo e moikuape, eipirakinore Bet-horon, nelo aiting te Kiriat-baal (Kiriat-Yearim taa ena), enkanasa nara eno losho le Yuda. Ena naitayu enkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, mpotu enkidimata ino; ntodolu engolon ino, iyie Enkai, amu iyie apa oitaasa iyiook ene nking'asia.

English: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
Masaai: Ore tialo Yesebel neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, ‘Keinos ildiain Yesebel too lpolosien le Yesreel.’

English: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

Masaai: Neitoki ninye aya ilkituaak le njore, o nkasisin, o lbalusuni loo ltung'ana o ltung'ana pooki le nkop; neriku ninche olaiguanani aaitadou te nkaji o Laitoriani, erukunye aagilaki te nkishomi e shumata o meetu enkaji o laiguanani. Neitoton ninche olaiguanani to lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
Masaai: Nejo, Abimelek, “Ore enkop ai pooki, etii dukuya ino tamanya pooki neba anaa eninyor.”

English: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
Masaai: Eitu eitoki olaiguanani le Misiri aipang'u te nkop enye, amu eewa olaiguanani le Babilon nena pooki apa naara ino laiguanani le Misiri ebaiki oerata le Misiri o metabaiki olkeju le Frati.

English: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
Masaai: Ore iyie, Loomanaa le naiposha, naa iaku endaata oo ntare, ilokerin loo lchekuti o muatat oo luaat oo ntare.

English: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
Masaai: Neipang'u enkai barta nanyokie oleng, ore ilo okedito neishooki engolon meiwuang'ie eseriani aitung'uaa e nkop pee eyiang'a iltung'ana maate, neishooki ninye olalem sapuk.

English: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
Masaai: Neyaki ilkurruki ninye imukateni o nkiri tadekenya, neyaki sii teipa, neokisho teilo shorro.

English: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol Lea ajo etudunge meekure eisho, neisho sii ninye enkaisiaayiani enye Silpa Yakobo meitaa enkitok.

English: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
Masaai: Meisisi ina arna enye nabore olng'ur ntarasi; meiputa enkitoo enye enkop pooki! Esai, Esai!

English: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
Masaai: Eiruk likae ajo keidim ainosa pooki toki, ore olomena naa mbenek ake enya ninye.

English: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
Masaai: Kake ororei oigeroki ti atua nkitanapat enye eitabari, ‘Aaibaitie nanu pesho'.

English: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
Masaai: Naa ti nilo iyie te nebo iyiook, ore pooki toki sidai naba anaa enaitaas iyiook Olaitoriani, nikintaas iyiook iyie ina ake.”

English: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
Masaai: Ning'unyung'unyunyu tiatua ilng'oborri linyi, nijojo ‘Enkaraki naiba iyiook Olaitoriani pee eitupukuo iyiook te nkop e Misiri, pee elotu apik iyiook atua nkaik oo Lamoni, pee eidaikie iyiook.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Ng'ura, aiterua nanu aisho intae Sihon o enkop enye; enteru ewaita, pee itumutumu aatamany ena kop.’

English: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
Masaai: Kitayioloito taata aajo iyiolo iyie pooki toki, nimikinare nikinkilikuanishore oltung'ani; te na kiruko inchere iewuo iyie aing'uaa Enkai.”

English: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana oota enkure o sarge naa keiba ilo lemeeta entioto neingoru lelo torrok enkishui enye.

English: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
Masaai: neitu iyie kinchooyo nanu apik nkaik olmang'atinta; itipika iyie nkejek aainei ewueji nelala.

English: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon ataarai aitung'uaa Yerusalem Yekonia olayioni le Yehoiakin, olaiguanani le Yuda, tenebo ilkituaak le Yuda, o lelo arriyiak o lkunono, neyau ninche Babilon, naaitodol nanu Olaitoriani ena duaata: ng'ura nkikapuni are naabore ilng'abolo eirragieki te dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
Masaai: Newal Yuda ajo, “Inchoo ninye eya nena tokitin aitaa inenyena, peyie mekueniyieki ake iyiook; idol ajo airriwaka ele kuo, neitu ilo ainepu ninye.”

English: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Yosef, o Manase o Efraim neng'amu enjung'ore enye.

English: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Harim: naa Eliesa o Ishija, o Malkija, o Shemaia, o Shimeon,

English: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: neirriwaa olaiguanani Sedekia olkilikuai meyauni ninye, neng'amu ninye. Neikilikuanishore olaiguanani ninye too nkurrat tiatua enkaji enye, nejo, “Ketii ororei oing'uaa Olaitoriani?” Nejo Yeremia “Etii” Neitoki ajo, “Eikiyauni iyie aapik atua nkaik olaiguanani le Babilon.”

English: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
Masaai: Etanapa sii apa Nebukadnesa aya kulie tokitin e nkaji o Laitoriani Babilon, nepik ninche atua enkaji e nkitoo o laiguanani te Babilon.

English: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
Masaai: Ore nena kejek oo ng'arrin, neipoti aning'ito aajo nkejek osiwuo oloing'ang'e.

English: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
Masaai: oldeket, tenimibung'ubung'u intae nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, nimbelekenyanya aaing'uaa ina oitoi naitanapa nanu intae ena olong, nipuopuo aasujaa kulie aitin apa neitu intae iyiolouu.

English: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
Masaai: Neitayunye Solomon lelo keek nkedeta naajing'ieki enkaji e Nkai o enkaji o laiguanani, o wululi loo usin, o nkinantani oo usin, tenkaraki lelo aranyak. Eitu aikata edoli embae naaijo ena te nkop e Yuda.

English: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
Masaai: Amu etiaaka Yohana Herode, “Mikinchoro too nkitanapat iyama enkitok o lalashe lino.”

English: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
Masaai: Netumore Enkai Balaam; nejoki Balaam ninye, “Aitobira ilperereni lo lasar oopishana, naishorua nanu te nchumata e pooki perere, oloing'oni o lmeregesh.”

English: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
Masaai: Amu eilo iyie aisuaa te tatene o te kedienye, naa kelo eishoi ino aya iloreren nepuo aamany nena anas apa naatung'uayioki.

English: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
Masaai: Etoduaakita intae iloibonok linyi elejare o nduaat naapong'ori; eitu ninche eitodolu entorroni inyi pee errinyu intae te araroto, kake etodua te nkaraki intae olkilikuai le lejare opong'ori.

English: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
Masaai: Nening Enkai oltoilo leina ayioni, neipot olmalaika le Nkai Hagar eing'uaa keper nejoki ninye, “Ainyoo nikigira aitanyamal iyie Hagar? Miureishoyu, amu etoning'o Enkai oltoilo le nkishirata leina ayioni te ine netii.

English: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ina kitok, “Naito, kinchiunye enkirukoto ino. Shomo te seriani.”

English: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
Masaai: Inining'o, olmarenke! Ng'ura elotu! embuakunoto sapuk naipang'u te nkop e moikuape, pee eitaa nkanas e Yuda ilmuateni, emanyisho oo mbariak.

English: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
Masaai: Kake eitu ening Amasia ina. Neaku etudumunye Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel alo, ore ninye o Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda neipirakino to larrabal te Bet-shenesh, e Yuda.

English: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Olaitoriani aitajeu Isiraeli ina olong too nkaik oo Lmisiri; nedol Isiraeli Ilmisiri etuata te mbata e naiposha.

English: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
Masaai: nedoiki ene naapishana Hakos, nedoiki ene isiet Abija,

English: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
Masaai: “Inchoo ina olong apa naatoinyieki eidak, te nebo ina kewarie apa natejoki, ‘Kenutae enkayioni!’

English: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
Masaai: Ore pee elang ninche lido kekun, nepuonu enkop e Genesaret, neen empeut te mbata e naiposha.

English: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
Masaai: Amu kaaku nanu te ninye esuntai enkima namanita ninye, Olaitoriani ojo, naaku sii enkisisa tiatua ninye!”

English: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ilo oiboni le Nkai alotu enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kaa etejo kulo tung'ana? Naa kanu eetuo ninche enitii?” Nejo Hesekia, “Enkop nalakua eing'uaa ninche, Babilon eing'uaa ninche.”

English: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisilig enkarsisisho enye naa ketoyu, kake ore ilo supat naa keipilipil anaa embeneyioi nanyori.

English: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Misiri Musa o Aron te ilo purkel,

English: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
Masaai: Amu eitu eipotoki iyiook Enkai olduruk kake atua esinyatisho.

English: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
Masaai: Eitobirua Olaitoriani pooki toki te nkipirta enye, neija sii etiu ilarruok teina olong e nyamali.

English: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Metaa, enchoo ltung'ana ooata enkitoria te intae edou mairiamari, naa te neetae enatapong'e te ilo tung'ani, nepuo aaitang'or.”

English: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
Masaai: neirrash ninche ina, neisikaki Listra o Derbe nena anas e Likonia o lelo kirinen oomanita:

English: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri arasaki Yerusalem; neya ninye ilchumat le nkaji o laitoriani o lchumat le nkaji o laiguanani. Eewa ninye pooki toki. Eewa sii nena long'oi e sahabu apa naaitobira Solomon.

English: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, and Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
Masaai: Kulo lelo tung'ana le Daudi magil; Yashabean le Hakomon, ilo arikoni le lelo okuni, etara ninye te mpere iltung'ana iip uni near pooki metuata te nkata nabo.

English: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
Masaai: Eming'unyung'uny anaa enaikuna kulikae lenye, lelo apa ooidaikie Olmalaika Omutisho.

English: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
Masaai: neitu aikata eitokini aata olarrabal o metabau olari le tomoni uni o imiet le nkitoria e Asa.

English: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajo, “Eikirrinyu iyiook kuna nimikinkilikuanu toki te ninche. Eikiaas iyiook anaa enijo.” Naipotu nanu ilapolosak nainosie ninche olmumai pee eas anaa enaisiligishore.

English: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
Masaai: ore olkikau lenye naa Abdon, nesuju Sur, o Kish o Baal, o Neer, o Nadab,

English: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
Masaai: Neaku etapala lelo tung'ana le njore lelo yarunot aaisho meshomo, tenebo nena masaa, te dukuya lelo kituaak o eumata pooki.

English: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
Masaai: Ias iyie mbaa e nking'asia too lootuata? Eikinyototo iloipi aaisis iyie?

English: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina mintoki aata hoo obo onang'aa enkopito te oshoto e nkukuo, tiatua eumata o Laitoriani.

English: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu ilayiok ilkituaak lenye, naa nkera naapuo aaitore ninche.

English: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
Masaai: Naa keibelekenyaki ninye iltauja loo menye inkera enye, neibelekenyaki sii iltauja loo nkera iloo menye, malotu ake aosh enkop to ldeket.”

English: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
Masaai: Nening Enkai Lea, nenutayu neiki Yakobo olayioni le imiet.

English: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
Masaai: Te ine atumore iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neitisiny enkitoo ai ine.

English: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
Masaai: “Kake eitu ening iltung'ana laainei oltoilo lai; nemaayieu nanu Israel.

English: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
Masaai: Etotiwuo te ninche anaa endung'et e rashe nasipa inchere, “Eshukokino oldia irrugumat enyena,” neji sii “Naa keisuji embitir neitoki ashukokino olokidong'oi aiperipera.”

English: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
Masaai: Kemitu intae Olaitoriani, metaa entirring'ata.”

English: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
Masaai: ee tininchiru aomonu ening'unoto oo rorei oogut, nidumu oltoilo lino aaku oloning'u.

English: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu iltung'ana iloodoorieki anaa sahabu nasila netiu iltung'ana anaa sahabu e Ofir.

English: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
Masaai: Amu enkiteng'enata te shumata nkiteng'enat, enkitanapata te shumata enkitanapata, olkereri te shumata olkereri, olkereri te shumata olkereri, etii enkiti ene netii enkiti idie.”

English: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
Masaai: Enduaata e Isaya olayioni le Amos, apa natoduaa, naipirta Yuda o Yerusalem, too nkolong'i e Usia, o Yotam, o Ahas, o Hesekia, aiguanak le Yuda.

English: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilmang'ati lang nchere kitayioloito nena kitobirat enye, neibooyie Olaitoriani, nikirrinyokino pooki esuntai, nelo ake oltung'ani esiaai enye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, ebaiki olkeju le Frati o metabaiki oerata le Misiri, naa keiturrur Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena moobo, anaa oltung'ani osilu isuut te nkano.

English: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
Masaai: Kake tenejur olapolosani ine ore ilpapit leine neitu eiborru neitu egutu alang osesen, kake etunukunye, neikenoo olapolosani ninye aiwuang'ie nkolong'i naapishana.

English: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
Masaai: nejokini Rebeka, “Keaku olbotor oisiaai oloti.”

English: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
Masaai: Ore ilo omenaa ororei le nkikoo neyaki kewan enkidaata, kake ore ilo oyanyit enkitanapata naa ketum olerrinyore.

English: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
Masaai: Apa aa kuti ninche oleng, neme toki, naa ilomon te ina kop,

English: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
Masaai: Nelotu enkitok e Samaria aoku enkare. Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Inchooki enaok,”

English: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
Masaai: “A-a, olkitok lai, toning'o enajo, ekaisho olokeri tenebo enkapune natii atua, te dukuya ilayiok pooki lo lorere lai, aaishoo iyie tunukarie entang'atang'a ino.”

English: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
Masaai: Kake maadamu nanu iltung'ana laainei, epejoki ninche enkorropil nkaitin e lejare; netarrorrote ninche tiatua nkoitoi enye, too ilbaribarani musan, neshomo aaim nkoitoi naangel mme enkoitoi kitok,

English: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
Masaai: Neitoki ina umata pooki aairriwaki olkilikuai ile Benchamen apa ooti endapidapoi e Rimon, neibalakinye ninche eseriani.

English: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
Masaai: Nikirikoo iyie Olaitoriani anaake, nikintaraposh Olaitoriani iyieunot inono too mbaa sidain, neitagol iloik linono, nitiu iyie anaa enkurma natubukokoki enkare, nitiu anaa enchorro e nkare, nemeishunye ae kata.

English: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
Masaai: Ore te nelotu olautaroni, Enkiyang'et e sipata, olotu aing'uaa papa intae oing'uaa Papa ninye laaishakenoki nanu;

English: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Neiger Musa irorei pooki lo Laitoriani. Nedumunye ayooki tadekenya neshet olperere lo lasar te ntonata o ldoinyo, o ng'apeta tomon o are aitorisioki iloshon tomon o are loo Siraeli.

English: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nemeitayuni te iyie osoit oitaae o lo lmairroto, nemeitayuni osoit lo lkitamyunoto, kake iaku iyie mijooni anaake Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
Masaai: Ore Yokim oltung'ana le Koseba, o Yoash o Saraf apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Moab nerrinyo alo Lahem. (ore apa kuna baa naa iniopa oleng.)

English: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
Masaai: nedumunye Daudi nelo, te nebo iltung'ana lenyena, near metuata Ilfilisti iip are; neyau Daudi isuaaten enye, naaishooki apa te siana nalulung'a olaiguanani, pee etum ninye ataa olaputani lo laiguanani. Neisho Saul ninye ina tito enye Mikal meitaa enkitok.

English: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
Masaai: amu keaku esidano tinishum ninche tiatua iyie, te netii pooki atua enkutuk ino.

English: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

English: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

Masaai: Nemeitokini ae kata aata hoo toki nadiaa, kake ilo orika le nkitoo le Enkai o lo Lkuoo le Ker, ninche kenya ootii atua ine, naa keserem ninye isinkan lenyena;

English: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
Masaai: Neton ake iwuasasa. Oo pee eitu nchirishiri, o metaba anaa nearari aaitung'uaa intae ilo otaasa ina bae?

Masaai: Te neitu apa aas ti atua ninche isiaaitin neitu eas likae, anaata meeta eng'oki; ore taata netoduaa naaibayu nanu o Papa lai.

Masaai: Ore ake sii natodua empesho tiabori enkolong;

English: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
Masaai: Na Ai ai, iyie nanu aisilig, mincho nanu aaitukurruni; mincho ilmang'ati laainei eng'ida te nkaraki nanu.

English: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

English: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Itawala aitobiraki, taasa ina pee iton inchu.”

English: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
Masaai: Etaarayioki ninche aaitung'uaa iltung'ana, nebuaku iltung'ana emirta ninche anaa iloosujaa olapurroni.

English: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
Masaai: Kake ore ti alo olosho le Lawi eitu eisho Musa enjung'ore; Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel ninye enjung'ore enye, anaa apa enatiaka ninye ninche.

English: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
Masaai: Neaku kejokini ldoinyo, ‘Entuurokinoto iyiook,’ nejokini ndoinyo, ‘Entoipoi iyiook.’

English: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
Masaai: Inchoo inkonyek inono eing'or aaitoriokino dukuya; neaku enking'urata ino enaitoriori te dukuya iyie.

English: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
Masaai: Eikununo ninye anaa olchani otuunoki te mbata e nkare e nchorro, oiu ilng'anayio lenyena te rishata enye, nemetoyu mbenek enyena. Ore te nena pooki naas ninye, nedupoyu.

English: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
Masaai: Ng'ura, mira iyie toki, naa pesho esiaai ino; naa olminong nikitegelua iyie.

English: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Osarge lai ele lo sotua, oibukori te nkaraki ilkumok.

English: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
Masaai: Enino keper naa enino enkop; o enkop o pooki toki natii atua, iyie oitobirua ninche.

English: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
Masaai: naa amaa te neitajewuo Lutu supat, oitanyamala naleng orrekie lo duruk loo ltung'ani torrono,

Masaai: Ore Sedekia olayioni le Yosia, laa ninye eitaa Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho te rishata e Konia olayioni le Yehoiakim.

English: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae Timoteo, laaisiritore te siai; naa neijia etiu Lukio o Yason o Sosipater oora le mudong lang.

English: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
Masaai: neinosieki iyiook osina kake eitu sii eiturrarri iyiook.

English: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

English: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
Masaai: Nepuo enetii ninye iltung'ana le nkop pooki e Yudea, o le Yerusalem, neibatisae ninche to lkeju le Yordan eirridu ng'ok enye.

English: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata nereu ninye Enkiyang'et e Nkai ong'ata.

English: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
Masaai: Etoning'o apa Yakobo ilayiok le Laban ejo, “Ewa Yakobo pooki apa naara ine papa lang; ore sii te nena pooki apa naara ine papa lang, nenoto ninye ena arsisisho.”

English: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
Masaai: Neyaki ilkituaak loo Lfilisti ninye mpi oo nkai naapishana ng'ejuko neenie ninye.

English: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
Masaai: Amu ore Demas, etonyorra ena kop e taata naashomo aing'uaa nelo Sesalonike, eshomo Kreskes Galatia neshomo Tito Dalmatia.

English: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
Masaai: Neitayu Sipora olmurunya nedung'u isuaaten oo layiok lenyena amurat paa keelie nkejek e Musa, nejo,

English: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.
Masaai: Nenya olaiguanani Sedekia olmumai te nkisudoroto te Yeremia, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye oitayio iltauja lang, maar nanu iyie tua aashu aapik atua nkaik e kulo tung'ana ooing'oru enkishui ino.”

English: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
Masaai: Eitayio ninye olee o eng'oruoi nemayian ninche neipot ninche ajo, tung'ani peyie eitobiru.

English: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
Masaai: ilo ladol etii enkalo ai, naa kadol too nkonyek aainei; neme too ne likae. Eiterre oltau lai tiatua nanu!

English: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
Masaai: amu kelotu esipata enetii lelo supati, ore lelo pooki sidain iltauja, nesuj.

English: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
Masaai: Adumunye nanu aishir enamanarie enkakenya, naishir te nkaraki eretoto; naisilig nanu irorei linono.

English: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata nkera kutiti aaye ti atua ninye, nemeitokini aata iltung'ana kituaak lemebikoo, amu keaku keye enkerai etaa enoo larin iip, ore olaing'okoni loo larin iip netum oldeket.

English: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
Masaai: Metaa etorrinye Esau ina olong alo Seir.

English: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
Masaai: eyiolo oltau lino ajo ore too nkatitin kumok nitedia sii iyie ilkulikae.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

English: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina neshet esuntai e oriong e nkanasa e Daudi te nkalo oloo ntoluo le Gishon, to erata, tembata e wueji nejing'ieki enkishomi e dukuya, nelo aitamanaa te Ofel. Neilepie aitoodor oleng. Etipika sii ilarikok le njore nkanas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda.

Masaai: Neikilikuan olang'eni obo lenye atem ninye, ajoki,

English: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
Masaai: “Tenedumunye oloiboni tiatua intae, aashu olaidetidetani loo nkidetidetat, neisho intae enkitoduaata aashu embae e nking'asia,

English: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
Masaai: Amu mme Olyahudi odede pooki ng'ae ake odoli etiu ti oriong, neme pooki ake emurata naa olodung'o ake osesen.

English: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

Masaai: Ore tenebo nena neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
