English: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
Masaai: Neisirng'ang'a lelo ooisiritore ninye negira aaitashe, naa oltoilo ake etoning'o neitu edol oltung'ani.

English: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore imasaa pooki apa naawa olaiguanani Ahas te nkitoria enye apa meisiligayu, nikintobira iyiook, nikintisinya; naa ng'ura etii ninche dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani.”

English: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
Masaai: Kake te nemeidim aaitoria ate, enchoo eyama ninche; enaikash ti niyama alang ti nikipejito ake eyieunoto.

English: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
Masaai: Inosa intae olkar te nkop, nitonini ti atua inaaitiship osesen, nintotiti iltauja linyi te nkolong e yieng'are.

English: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
Masaai: Neya ninche imotioo, o nchempei o ntokitin o ltaa o ngirran, o masaa naapejieki enkorropil o masaa pooki osuyai apa naasishoreki te nkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai.

English: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
Masaai: Keikirikira lelo oomanya Samaria te nkuretisho, te nkaraki ilo ashe le Babel. Keishiraki iltung'ana lenyena ninye, ore lelo apolosak lenyena ooserem nkitanyaanyukot neyietu aaishiraki ninye, teina kitoo enye nashomo aing'uaa ninye.

English: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye nchere neton ti atua ninye, neton ninye ti atua iyiook, enkaraki naishoo iyiook Enkiyang'et enye.

English: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
Masaai: Itimira iltung'ana linono neitu inosie toki, eitu iyie ing'oru enkinyang'a nagol te nkaraki ninche.

English: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
Masaai: Amu kelusoo nkolong'i aainei anaa empuruo, neyupuyup iloik laainei anaa olkokuet.

English: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neilep olaiguanani alo enkaji o Laitoriani, tenebo iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o lapolosak o Lawi, o ltung'ana pooki kituaak o looti. Neisum ninye ening'ito pooki irorei pooki leina buku o sotua apa nanotoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
Masaai: “Keaku Edom entoki naitureisho; ore pooki ng'ae oim embata enye neiputukuny, te nkaraki ina nataraki ninye.

English: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
Masaai: Naaitoki ariku nanu ina kishomi e auluo e ine wueji sinyati, naipirare enkalo oloosaen, naa keikeno apa.

English: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
Masaai: “Entudung'oi ilpapit linyi ninturraa; to sina elepie olkiyioi too nkisiajat naaika; amu etanya Olaitoriani netung'uayie ina ishoi e ngoro enye napi.’

English: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto etuurori isunta e Yeriko etamanaki too nkolong'i naapishana.

English: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
Masaai: entayiolo te sipata nchere meitoki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi areu kuna kuapi te dukuya intae; kake keaku ninche orreshet te intae, enchipishipi too sunta inyi o lkiku too nkonyek inyi, o metaba anaa nindaayaya aaishunye tena kop sidai naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD'S thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
Masaai: Ng'ura eno Laitoriani keper nalakua aisul, o enkop o pooki toki natii atua;

English: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Ore enkaraki naanyikaki naanyor nanu kulo tung'ana too nkutukie naayanyit ninche nanu too nkutukie, aalamita iltauja lenye, ore euriata enye te nanu naa enkitanapata oo ltung'ana nayiolo ake too lukuny;

English: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
Masaai: Ore teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa esupatisho enye, neas ing'ok, naa keye te nkaraki ina; keye te nkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa.

English: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.
Masaai: ore Olawi, enkaraki nemeeta ninye erubata aashu enjung'ore tenebo iyie, oilo omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai natii atua nkang'itie inyi, nepuonu aainos neraposho; pee kitum Olaitoriani Enkai ino atamayiana teina siaai pooki oo nkaik inono nias.

English: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
Masaai: (Amu miserem iyie ae Ai, amu ara Olaitoriani laa ore enkarna enye naa Olom, naa Enkai oo lom).

English: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai loo ltung'ana le Manase nebik teina kop, neaku ninche kumok oleng te Bashan o metabaiki Baarhermon, o Senir, o ldoinyio le Hermon.

English: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Olaitoriani ajo eitoborro ate, neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Shemaia ejo, “Eitoborro ninche ate nemaidaikie nanu ninche, kake kaisho nanu ninche enkiti oitoi napokie, nemebukokini engoro ai shumata Yerusalem te Nkaina e Shishak.

English: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.
Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani Yerubaal o Barak o Yepsa, o Samuel, nekordu ninche intae aaitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati linyi te pooki shoto; nibikibiki intae te seriani.

English: And now I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.
Masaai: Naibalakinye nanu ena olong intae, kake eitu irukuruku oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi te pooki toki naairriua nanu matoliki intae.

English: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie ninche te keper teina manyisho ino, enkomono enye o esayiata enye. Nchoo ninche meisula.

English: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
Masaai: nadol tiatua ilmoda, namusu olbarnoti obo tiatua ilbarnot, oloti barnoti lemedamisho.

English: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
Masaai: Nejoki Yosef ilalashera lenyena o enkaji e menye pooki; “Ekalo ainosaki Farao, naa kajoki ninye, ‘Ore ilalashera laainei o enkaji e papa pooki, otii apa enkop e Kanaan, eetuo enatii.

English: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
Masaai: Itapalaka iyie entorroni oo ltung'ana linono, nipalaki iyie ing'ok enye pooki.

English: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
Masaai: nedoiki ene naaudo Yeshua, nedoiki ene tomon Shekenia,

English: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Neaku eidimuaki apa iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina kata, neisulu iltung'ana le Yuda, enkaraki naigarakinote ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
Masaai: Aimidol iyie inaasita ninche too nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem?

English: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
Masaai: Kake ore intae keiput mpopoki inyi ena ong'ata.

English: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
Masaai: Enkai, Olaitoriani ninye engolon ai; neitotiu nkejek aainei anaa ine ntarakuet te neneng'i, naaidimie ninye maimai nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
Masaai: Etotona Gilead te lido kekun Yordan; oo Dan, kainyoo pee etotona ninye too melin? Etotona Asheri aitirring'a to lomanaa le naiposha, neton abik te nedounyeki.

English: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
Masaai: o Shabetai o Yasabad, loo lkituaak loo lawi laa ninche apa ooitasheiki esiaai e oriong e nkaji e Nkai;

English: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche, neinepu olkurrarru eena te kishomi ti auluo enkoitoi nalala e nkanasa, nelaku ninche.

English: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.
Masaai: te nkaraki ninyor iyie lelo likimba iyie nimba lelo likinyor iyie. Amu imbalunye iyie taata nchere, ore larikok le njore o sinkan naa pesho te iyie; amu ore taata adol nanu ajo, tenaa naaji keishu Absalom nikituata iyiook pooki taata, anaata ishipa iyie.

English: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
Masaai: Ng'ura, esipata e atua oltau iyieu iyie; ore enkaraki ina inteng'enaki nanu eng'eno nagut ti atua enkisudoroto o ltau lai.

English: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki ewueji neji Golgata, aa keji ewueji e mborbor,

English: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
Masaai: Nedoyio Yakobo alo Misiri, te ine eitianye ninye o lelo loo papa.

English: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
Masaai: Keidim olee atanapa enkima to lgoo lenye, nemepejoo inkilani enyena?

English: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye ilgiso oong'uan le sahabu neeniki lelo giso lelo pijat pokira oong'uan too nkejek enyena.

English: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
Masaai: Nejo Musa “Tena taa iyiolouu nchere Olaitoriani laairriua mataasa kuna siaitin pooki neme te nkaraki kewan ai.

English: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.
Masaai: Neitoki Haman ajoki olaiguanani Serser, “Etii iltung'ana moobo ooisardakari aaorikino atua iltung'ana loo loshon pooki le nkitoria ino; ore nkitanapat enye nepaashare inoo lkulikae tung'ana pooki, nemeibung nkitanapat o laiguanani, metaa metumie olaiguanani dupoto te nepalaa ninche.

English: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
Masaai: Esa laa ninye olkitok, o Obadia aa ninye oliare, o Eliab aa ninye oliokuni,

English: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
Masaai: Ore te wueji neisiaja near ninche olalem ore tiatua aji neaku neidaikie ilbarnot o selenken, enkerai nanakita tenebo olmoruo oibor elukunya.

English: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu ilkuti te kulo, nipik ninche enkima, nipejoo ninche te nkima; ore te ine nelotu enkima adoiki atua ina aji pooki e Israel.

English: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, ore pooki wueji nelikiorieki ele rorei supat te nkop pooki, naa keimakini ena naaitaasa ena kitok metaa enadamunyeki ninye.”

English: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena enchoo lelo pooki oomeyu te risioroto o enyorrata e Enkai, eas isupati neitarasaki iltauja lenye ilo oitayio enkop oisiligayu.

English: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
Masaai: Ore nena kikeneta neikodi aapik olkerubi, o ltuka o ntapuka, nemur ninche te sahabu, anaa ina natipikaka nena tokitin naaguetuno.

English: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
Masaai: “Kajur nanu Olaitoriani ndamunot natem oltau, pee aisho pooki tung'ani te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena te risioroto oo lng'anayio loo nkiaasin enyena.”

English: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
Masaai: Kake te nelo ilo tung'ani oitayio loikop, te nkata ake ninye pooki agiroo ilpolosien le ina anasa enye nasaruni, apa naa ninye eisikaka,

English: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.
Masaai: Nejoki Agripa Festo, “Keidimi napaji aatalaku ele tung'ani te neme ketoomonuo meyakini Kaisari enkiguana enye.”

English: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
Masaai: Metaa eilepa Abram alo aing'uaa Misiri, ninye o enkitok enye, o pooki toki naata, tenebo Lot aapuo enkop e Negeb.

English: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo akedok loo ngarrin oo mbartan Yehoshafat, nejo, “Esipa olaiguanani le Israel.” Kaae neibelekenya aarare ninye, neyietu Yehoshafat aishir.

English: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
Masaai: Ele rorei eiroro Olaitoriani neipirta Babilon eipirta enkop oo Lkaldayo eimunye Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai ejo:

English: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
Masaai: Ore sii kulikae alashera lenye le Kohat neitasheiki emukate e nkitoduaaroto, pee eitobir te pooki sabato.

English: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
Masaai: Nchoo metishipayu keper, naa nchoo nkop meting'idayu; nchoo enaiposha meikurrukurro o nena pooki naabore atua;

English: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
Masaai: Ayiolo taata nanu ajo keretu Olaitoriani ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput, kewaliki ninye te ine wueji sinyati te shumata, eeta nkisulat sapuki naaisula te nkaina enye.

English: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
Masaai: neyau ninye aitinyiku ilmareita le Yuda, neyae olmarei loo Lsera; neyau ninye aitinyiku to lmarei loo Lsera oltung'ani o ltung'ani; neyae Sabdi;

English: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
Masaai: naa ninye enkitisipata nauno e njung'ore ang, o metaba anaa niking'amu ina, te nkisisa oe nkitoo enye.

English: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
Masaai: nitii sii intae ilooipotoki te nebo ninche entaa le Yesu Kristo.

English: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
Masaai: “Too larin tikitam oo kuni, ebaiki olari le tomon ookuni le Yosia olayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda, ometabaiki ena olong, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu, nairorie nanu intae akurraki, kake eitu intae ining'ining'i.

English: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.
Masaai: Naa oloo larin ntomoni naaudo o isiet apa Eli, netiripate nkonyek enyena metaa meidim atodolisho.

English: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
Masaai: Ore enchipai o ltau, neitaa osesen bioto, kake ore eng'uarrata neitong'u apurd iloik.

English: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
Masaai: Koree nkaitin e Hamat o Arpad? Koree nkaitin e Sefarfaim, Hena o Ifaa? Ketokordutua ninche Samaria aaitupuku tiae aina hoo nabo?

English: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
Masaai: o endaa natii emesa enye, oltonei loo lkituaak lenyena, o enkisiaayiare oo sinkan lenyena, nkilani enye, o lanapak lenyena loo nkikompeni o lasarri lenyena oopejori ooishooyo ninye tiatua enkaji Olaitoriani, eitu eitoki aidim atejo ae.

English: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;
Masaai: Neirorie ninye te supatisho, neisho ninye olorika olus too lorikan loo laiguanak apa ootii tenebo ninye te Babilon.

English: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoshua olayioni le Nuni te nkisudoroto iltung'ana oare te Shitumu metaa ilaikitalak, ejo, “Enchom, eng'ura enkop, neisul Yeriko.” Nepuo ninche, nepuonu enkaji e mulayoi apa naji enkarna enye Rahabu, neirrag ninche ine.

English: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
Masaai: Amu te rikoto e ng'eno indim aipiru enjore, naa tiatua enkumoi oo lautarok etumi enkishuroto.

English: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana ootelekutua, leitu eari metuata te kulo meita, neitu eirridu nkiaasin oo nkaik enye, neitu epal eseremata o eomonoto oo loiriruani, o nkitanyaanyukot neme Enkai e sahabu o enkosholai, o suyai, o soito o enoo nkeek nemedolisho, aashu ening'isho aashu aashom.

English: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
Masaai: Ninche lelo ooitunyoki endukuya o laisinani enterit e nkop, neibelekeny enkoitoi eilo oibookoki enkop nelo olayioni o menye ayiaya enkitok nabo, neidurukie ninche enkarna ai sinyati.

English: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana ninye, “Mikiyieu iyiook nikiaata eleyiata ti alo ele mumai linosie iyiook.

English: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Sharaim, o Aditaim, o Gedera, o Gederotaim: nkanas tomon o ong'uan te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
Masaai: Kake ore pooki rrindik oinyiang'uaki too mpisai neidim ainosa te neidipi aatumurat ninye.

English: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
Masaai: Aisiligita nanu enjeunoto ino, Olaitoriani, naas nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
Masaai: Shama le Harod, Elika le Harod,

English: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
Masaai: Tenetii atua intae oltung'ani lemesinya te nkaraki enataase te ninye kewarie, nchoo naa eipang ninye alo auluo, mejing'u ninye atua ilng'oborri;

English: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hanania, naa Peletia o Yeshaia, o layioni lenye Refaina, o layioni lenye Arnan, o layioni lenye Obadia, o layioni lenye Shekania.

English: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
Masaai: Ore Edom nikitoning'ore te siaai e biashara, te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa inono; eitawalunye ninche imasaa inyi isoito oonyori o nkilani morijo, intokitin naaikodo, kitani naapuyiapui, o sikira le naiposha o soit oji agate.

English: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
Masaai: naa te nemeetae olowalu, ninchosho ilo oiro to lng'ejep egira etiiki olturrur neirorie kewan neirorie Enkai.

English: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

Masaai: “Naa kaleku ilkuti linyi eishu. Neaku iatata too loshon ilekunot ooilanya ilo alem, naa teneidapashi intae too nkuapi,

English: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
Masaai: neaku ore lelo linyi ooilanyishote naadamu nanu te lelo oshon oowaita ninche aitaa iyarunot, ina kata atigila iltauja lenye lemaairuk naaing'uaa nanu, naitamodok inkonyek enye nena naaibelekenyakinote to lng'uarra nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin; naa keibayu te nduaata enye maate nena torrok naataasa, o lminong lenye pooki.

English: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
Masaai: Aipirisioni Olaitoriani, naa asipani; eeta Enkai ang olng'ur.

English: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani ninye meima iwuejitin neeika enkop, neinos ninche ilng'anayio le nkop neisho ninye meibibiu olkenkei te ndapidapoi, o eilata te ndapidapoi.

English: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
Masaai: Na kera kutiti emikinyorrisho to rorei ake aashu to lng'ejep kake te asata o te sipata.

English: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata naba anaa olari obo, nipuopuo intae aatum enyamali, intae kuna naaishiliga; amu meitoki aatii ilng'anayio, meitoki atii enkisampuare oo lng'anayio.

English: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
Masaai: Ore nena sunta adoru e nkang enye nesulu ninye, neitadou, nenang'aki enkop, neitabaiki enterit.

English: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
Masaai: Naa tenedoiki ake ninye erubata oo mpopoki enye ilanterera oopuoi aaun, ore lelo anterera naa aisidain ake;

English: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
Masaai: Amu emutita Olaitoriani Babilon neimisie ilo toilo lenye kitok. Ore ilopir lenye neikurrukur anaa ilopir loo nkariak kumok, ore embuakunoto oo ltoiloishi lenye neitabuakuni;

English: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa, Olaitoriani, isudoo iyie kewan, ae ntarasi? Kenkata nabaa eyupuyup engoro ino anaa enkima?

English: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD, and I will not keep anger for ever.
Masaai: Shomo, ntudupai kulo rorei te nkalo e moikuape, ijo, ‘Tushukunye Israel nemeisiligayu, Olaitoriani ojo. Maaing'or nanu iyie te ngoro, amu kara ololng'ur, Olaitoriani ojo; magoro nanu ntarasi.

English: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Masaai: meetae obo olo atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai nchere kaisho intae entamany, meteleku ake Kalebu olayioni le Yefune o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
Masaai: Ore ilo otur enkop enye naa ketum endaa sapuk kake ore ilo osuj imbaa e pesho nemeeta endamunoto.

English: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
Masaai: iltung'ana laa ore inkoitoi enye naa keriwuo naa inaapaashaa neimin ninche tiatua inkoitoi enye.

English: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni oare apa ninye pee eiteru aaku olaiguanani, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem.

English: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
Masaai: Nenya olmumai nchere, ore entoki pooki naomon ninye, neisho.

English: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
Masaai: Reaia ole Shobal apa menye le Yahat, naa Yahat menye le Ahumei o Lahad. Kulo apa ilmareita loo le Sorat.

English: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
Masaai: Eirishakino ninye enkaji enye nemeitashe ina aji; eibung ninye ina aji enye, kake meitashe.

English: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
Masaai: Neing'oru eneiko pee edol Yesu ajo ai ng'ae, nelaikino, te nkaraki olorere, amu dorrop ninye.

English: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
Masaai: Nintayiolo iyie ninche sabato ino sinyati nintanap ninche nkitanapat o nkikoot o enkitanapata aimunye Musa osinka lino.

English: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
Masaai: Kiyiolo iyiook aajo ore pooki ng'ae oino te Nkai nemeas ng'ok, kake Ilo oino te Nkai orrip ninye nemeiseyie ilo torrono ninye.

English: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
Masaai: ore lchekuti tenebo nkerrai enye nepuonu aarare ninye neun ninche ilng'oborri lenye aaitaman ninye, neirritisho ninche, oltung'ani ake te wueji enye.

English: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
Masaai: Naa kaishoru nanu eseriani tiatua ena kop; naa irurara intae nemeetae oltung'ani oiture intae; naiwuang'ie nanu ing'uesi torrok tena kop, nemeitoki olalem atii enkop inyi.

English: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Masaai: eikimulumul ninye too naipuko enyena, ore ti abori inaipuko enyena nitum esarunoto; ore esupatisho enye naa elong'o o emitunoto.

English: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
Masaai: Naa kaishie nanu isiruai lenyena pooki, o mashoi, o lapaitin lenyena ng'ejuk o sabatoni enyena, o siruai lenyena pooki gelunot.

English: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
Masaai: Ore Enkai te ina nyorrata enye nauno naa kelotu enatii; kaaisho nanu Enkai ai matoduaa enkishuroto too lmang'ati laainei.

English: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
Masaai: Ekedoru inkonyek enyena te naisho oo sabibu, Neibor ilala lenyena te okoto e kule,

English: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
Masaai: Oo naa ti nidolidolo Enkerai e Tung'ani eilepieki enetii apa te dukuya?

English: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
Masaai: Naa kaanang'aki iyie ong'ota, iyie tenebo lelo sinkir pooki loo nchorroni inono; isulakinono enkoriong e ong'ota naisiasha, nemeiturrurri intae aapuo aanukaa. Meinosa intae ing'uesi e ina kop o montonyi o loing'ang'e aaishooyie iyie taa endaa enye.

English: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
Masaai: Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, neilep ninche aapuo enchumata oldoinyo le Hor eing'orita ina umata pooki.

English: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
Masaai: Ore ilo oirriwaa olkilikuai te nkaina olmodai, nedung'oo nkejek enyena makewan, neok enapiak.

English: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Mincho kirikino, nimimbelekenya aing'uaa irorei le nkutuk ai. Noto eng'eno nagut, noto sii ening'unoto.

English: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
Masaai: meeta kulo tung'ana ening'unoto kake ashipakino nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
Masaai: Neitobiraki Olaitoriani Enkai Adam o enkitok enye nkilani oo ndapan, neishopoki ninche.

English: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.
Masaai: Naa ore anaa enaitanapishoteki pee eing'uari enkobei o ntona e ilo shani, naa kelo enkitoria ino adedeyu obaiki ina kata niyiolounye nchere keper naitoreisho.

English: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
Masaai: Naa teneipang'u ina keeya oo lbolot to lchoni lo sesen lenye, metaa eibulua enkeeya oo lbolot olchoni pooki lo sesen leilo tung'ani omuoi ebaiki endukuya o metabaiki nkejek, anaa enadol olapolosani

English: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
Masaai: nerretena te nkolong e uni; amu ore te nkolong e uni nelotu Olaitoriani adou enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai metoduaa iltung'ana.

English: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
Masaai: Naa tenejur olapolosani ina muoyian e mion, nelioyu ajo megut alang olchoni lo sesen, nemetii ilpapit oorook ine, netum taa olapolosani aikenoi ilo tung'ani oota olpepedoi nkolong'i naapishana,

English: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
Masaai: Koree lelo oibonok linono apa likimbonokito iyie, ejo, ‘Mikilotu olaiguanani le Babilon agilunore iyie nearare ena kop?’

English: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae atua ilkiku negor ilkiku nkaitubulu.

English: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.
Masaai: Kilome mikigolong'aki iyiook Olaitoriani aaibelekenya ena olong aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani te nchetata o lperere lo lasar te nkaraki nkishorot naapejori, o nkishorot e nkurma aashu olasar. Mikishet iyiook likae perere lo lasar meteleku ake ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang oitashe te dukuya olng'obor lenye!”

English: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
Masaai: Nejoki ina kitok ninye, “Esipa iyiolo ina nataasa Saul, ina naitaasa ninye iloibonok oodolisho, o lasakutok aipang'ie tena kop. Kainyoo naa pee kirragakinye nanu orreshet te nkaraki enkishui ai pee iyau keeya ai?”

English: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
Masaai: Nepuonunui neyakini oltung'ani tarrush oilenye onapita ltung'ana oong'uan.

English: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana apa imiet ooshomo aaikitalan enkop e Laish lelo alashera lenye, “Iyiololo intae aajo ore atua kuna ajijik netii enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o Terafim e nkitanyaanyukoto naaguetuno o naasholuno? Ore naa taata entayiolo eniaasiasa.”

English: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ile ishoi e Esau (aa ninye Edom),

English: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
Masaai: (Airo anaa naajo ltung'ana enkaraki e nchalan inyi e tung'ani.) Amu ore anaa ina apa ninchooitie ate aaku irrindiki loo loirerioni o enkarruoisho, etaa taata inchooitie ate aaku rrindiki le supatisho pee itumutumu aatubulu te sinyatisho.

English: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
Masaai: Neiro ninye meeta enkuretisho, metoni inkejek enyena tiang;

English: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel metii Benchamen neiturrur iltung'ana nkalifuni iip ong'uan oata ilalema; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana lo larrabal.

English: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
Masaai: Neiturrur Musa o Aron ina umata te nebo te dukuya ina dapidapoi nejoki ninche, “Entoning taata, intae iloogolongu; Aikiyaki iyiook intae enkare naing'uaa ena dapidapoi?”

English: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.
Masaai: Naa olayioni lo Lframiti apa Daudi le Betlehem e Yuda, oji Yese, oata apa ilayiok isiet. Ore apa too nkolong'i e Saul netamorua ilo tung'ani oleng neaku oloo larin kumok.

English: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
Masaai: Netonita apa Daudi te rishata oo nchomito are; neilep olarriponi alo shumata enkishomi te mbata e suntai, ore ake pee eshumu nkonyek enyena neing'orisho, nedol oltung'ani oipirri openy.

English: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa iloshon tomon oare le Israel; naa ina apa eitanapa menye pooki emayian ninye ninche, emayianaki pooki ng'ae emayianata naishiaakino ninye.

English: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur, ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Manase:

English: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Yoshua, “Esipa eishorua Olaitoriani enkop pooki apik inkaik ang; netalepori sii lelo pooki oomanya ina kop te nkaraki iyiook.”

English: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
Masaai: naa te naomon nadamu intae pooki te nchipai sapuk,

English: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
Masaai: ore enkaraki ina, kelo ena ng'oki atiu te ntae anaa olbaata le suntai naado netaa kejo pee eurori, naa ore euroroto enye naa nabo kata;

English: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Etabawua esaa pee eitaae kitok Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
Masaai: Neisik Daudi neimisho nelotu apa ninye enetii Samuel te Rama, neliki nena pooki naaitaasa Saul ninye. Ore ninye o Samuel nepuo aabik te Naios.

English: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
Masaai: Ore olpisiai lenye nepejoo ninye te nkima, ore to likae pisiai neinosie ninche nkiri. Nepej nkiri neraposho; neij sii enkima neitoki ajo, “Ee, airowuaja nanu, atoduaa nanu enkima!”

English: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
Masaai: Ore naa taata enkerai ai, metaa Olaitoriani tenebo iyie, pee itum atudupoyu te nchetata enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ino, anaa apa enairoro ninye tialo iyie.

English: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
Masaai: Nerany osinkolio ng'ejuk aajo, “Kinchiaakino iyie pee idumu olpiyayati le embuku, nibel ilmishiren lenyena. Amu kiteyieng'aki apa naa to sarge lino inyiang'aka Enkai iltung'ana aitung'uaa loshon pooki, o lng'ejepa, o ltung'ana o loreren.

English: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
Masaai: “Te naiseyie ake olcholoi lo lkila lenye naishiu.”

English: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Sebulon, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
Masaai: Ore eton ejoito Petero kulo rorei, nedoiki Enkiyang'et Sinyati lelo pooki ootoning'o ilo rorei.

English: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
Masaai: Metedeki engoro enye, amu kepi ninye; o engoro enye napi, amu ketolo! Ekaor ninche tiatua Yakobo, naidapash ninche tiatua Israel.

English: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
Masaai: Etipikaki ilkeek lo Laitoriani enkare aaitaraposh, lelo tarakua le Lebanon apa ootuuno ninye.

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii ejo:

English: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.
Masaai: Neiturrurro lfilisti pee eitayu olarrabal o Israel, ngarrin oo mbartan nkalifuni ntomoni uni, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni ile, o sikerin ooba anaa osinyai le mbata enaiposha te nkumoi; nepuonu aailepu nepik ilng'oborri lenye Mikmash, natii enkalo oloo saen e Beshafen.

English: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo isiaaitin inono, enyorrata ino, o enkirukoto o enkisiaayiare, o eng'iriata, o nchere etalang'a isiaaitin inono e det ine dukuya.

English: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
Masaai: neirriwayie ninye oltung'ani dukuya ninche, Yosef, ilo apa otimiraki aaitaa orrindik.

English: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Masaai: Naa kamayian nanu ndaiki enyena oleng; naitaraposh lelo aisinak lenyena too ndaiki.

English: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
Masaai: o Kedesh, o Edrei, o En-hasor,

English: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
Masaai: Neitoki aiu olalashe lenye Abel. Ore apa Abel naa olairritani loo ntare, ore Kain naa olaturoni le nkop.

English: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
Masaai: “Naa kaji etiu pee mirishushu oopeny enasipa?

English: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
Masaai: Tenaipang nanu alo auluo enkishomi e nkanasa, ina kata naitobir nanu olorika lai to lkurroto otumoreki.

English: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
Masaai: Nemetii ho obo oidima atawaliki ninye ororei hoo obo, nemetii oltung'ani ebaiki ina olong onyaaka aitieu aikilikuana likai rorei.

English: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
Masaai: Aishooyie taata nanu kuna kuapi pooki apik nkaik e Nebukadnesa, olaiguanani le Babilon, osinka lai, naishoo sii ninye ing'uesi e ong'ata meisiayia ninye.

English: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
Masaai: Aikisikong ninye iyie katukul tenaa intodolu olkep too nkisudorot.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Olaitoriani ajoki, “Marisa, Marisa, intanyamaluo nimposha too mbaa kumok;

English: The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ele rorei eirorie Olaitoriani Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai oipirta elotunoto e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon pee eosh enkop e Misiri:

English: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
Masaai: Naa ng'en ake sii ninye neyau enkidaata, merrinyokino ninye irorei lenyena, kake kedumakino ninye ina aji oo larruok, nedumakino lelo aretok le lelo oas entorroni.

English: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
Masaai: Ore tiatua iloibonok: Aatigile oltau lai tiatua nanu, keikirikira iloik laainei pooki; atiu nanu anaa oltung'ani otemere, anaa oltung'ani oidimua enaisho, te nkaraki Olaitoriani o te nkaraki irorei lenyena sinyat.

English: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
Masaai: Lalashera laainei emiaku nkera too ndamunot inyi. Ore too ntorrok entotiu ana nkera kutiti, kake ore too ndamunot inyi entimitunye.

English: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: O enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli nabore enkorropil;

English: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero, “Te naa kaye te nebo iyie maamiki nanu iyie.” Nejo sii neijia ilooiteng'eni pooki.

English: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
Masaai: Ore esiaai inyi pooki entaas too ltauja, anaa Olaitoriani iasakiki neme iltung'ana,

English: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai, mimbelekeny enkomom ino aitung'uaa ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput! Tadamu enyorrata ino nauno tenkaraki Daudi osinka lino.”

English: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.
Masaai: Kake keton enkiguana aiguana, ore enkitoo enye naa keyae aaitung'uaa ninye, pee eishieki neinyali aaiting'ie.

English: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
Masaai: Kake kekepari ake nelo ong'ata, aomon Enkai openy.

English: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu intae olng'ur, pee etum ninye aing'urrie intae neisho intae itonini te nkop inyi maate.

English: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nelo Hesron ayam entito e Makir, menye le Gilead. Neyamisho ninye aa oloo larin ntomoni ile, neiki ina tito ninye Segub.

English: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
Masaai: Kenyorru ninye intae, nemayian intae, nepon intae, kemayian sii lelo ng'anayio lo sesen lino o lelo ng'anayio le nkop ino, enkurma ino, o enaisho oo sabibu ino, o eilata ino, nepon nkishu inono o ntare inono teina kop apa nainosie olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho intae.

English: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, itoduaa iyie, migira! Olaitoriani, mikilam iyie nanu!

English: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
Masaai: “Amu mpang'ipang'a intae aapuo te ng'ida, nerikori intae te seriani; ore lelo doinyio o ndoinyio naatii dukuya intae, nebuaku aaranyisho, ore lelo keek pooki li ong'ata neosh nkaik.

English: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e imiet naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai, olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Simeon:

English: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
Masaai: Entonyok eng'ura ina kitanapata naishoo intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, pee inyorrurru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nipuopuo too nkoitoi enyena, nimbung'arere ninye nisiaayiayia ninye to ltau linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki.”

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
Masaai: Metaa ore olokeri le Efron otii Makpela natii oloosaen le Mamre olokeri oota enkapune tiatua o lkeek ootii olokeri, enkop pooki,

English: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
Masaai: neinosisho ninche too nkala pee etum aatakuenia too siruai, neony ninche ilala lenye te nkaraki nanu.

English: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ina oitoi naimu ninye eigil aim errinyo, nemelotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
Masaai: Ele rorei apa lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Hosea olayioni le Beeri, too nkolong'i, e Usia, o Yotam, o Ahas, o Hesekia ilaiguanak le Yuda, o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel.

English: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
Masaai: kilikioo esipata, naa te ngolon e Nkai; too masaa e supatisho te tatene o te kedianye,

English: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
Masaai: Ira ng'ae olodung'oki enkiguana osinka le likae? To lkitok lenye makewan eitashe aashu ebatata. Naa keitasheyieki, amu Olkitok lenye eitasheyie ninye.

English: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
Masaai: Nelus enking'asia enye neaku keji, “Etaasa mbaa pooki aitobiraki ore ninye ilming'anta o lemeiro, neidimie aisho meiroro.”

English: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: kake etusulayie Farao o lorora lenye ti atua Enaiposha Nanyokie, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
Masaai: Neisik Musa te nkaraki ilo rorei, nelo aaku olomoni te nkop e Midian, nelo aiu layiok aare te ine.

English: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
Masaai: Kake eitashe Petero ti auluo te mbata e kutuk aji. Nelotu taa ilo likae oiteng'eni oyiolo Olapolosani Kitok, neirorie enkarriponi e kutuk aji, neitijing'u Petero atua.

English: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
Masaai: Kake keyau ilo lee enkishoroto o lasar le nkitarruorroto ayaki Olaitoriani, kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo, neyau ninye olmeregesh metaa olasar le nkitarruoroto.

English: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
Masaai: Naa tenining iyie nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie, nilo too nkoitoi aainei, niaas isupati too nkonyek aainei, aibung nkikoot aainei, anaa apa enataasa Daudi osinka lai, naaku nanu tenebo iyie, nashetu nanu enkaji ino aitubul, anaa apa enateshetaka Daudi, naaisho nanu iyie Israel.

English: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
Masaai: Kerrinyoki ninye ninche ntorrok enye, nejut ninche aiwuang'ie te nkaraki enkarrueisho enye; kejutoo Olaitoriani Enkai ang ninche aiwuang'ie.

English: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
Masaai: Ntajeu iyiook, Olaitoriani Enkai, ninturrurru iyiook aaitayu too loreren, pee kitum aaishoo enashe enkarna ino sinyati niking'idare enkisisa ino.

English: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
Masaai: Kake ntanapa Yoshua, nintagol ninye oshoke nintipij ninye, amu kelang ninye aimu te dukuya kulo tung'ana, naa kelo ninye aitujung ninche ina nilo iyie adol.’

English: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
Masaai: Ore teneas enkop ng'ok, neeta ilaitoriak kumok, kake ore iltung'ana oota ening'unoto o eng'eno, naa keitasheyie ninche ninye te nkata naado.

English: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
Masaai: Nchoo shumata o enkop meisisa ninye, o enaiposha o pooki toki naatii atua.

English: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
Masaai: Niya ina kurriny pooki naimulumul imonyit o lkina le monyua, o lairakuj pokira aare eeta enkurriny enye, nipej ninche ten chumata olperere.

English: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.
Masaai: Naariku ninye nanu aimunye enkalo e kishomi e moikuape omatabaiki enkalo e dukuya e nkaji e Nkai, naing'or naa ng'ura, eiputa enkitoo Olaitoriani e nkaji o Olaitoriani; nabatata te nkomom ai.

English: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
Masaai: Kashukoki nanu Israel ewueji enye nedaare, naa kedaa ninye te nchumata e Karmel o tiatua Bashan, neiputakini ninye eyieunoto enye te nchumata oldoinyo le Efraim o tiatua Gilead.

English: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
Masaai: ore etii ninye ine wueji e nkitoo neing'orisho, neing'or lelo pooki oomanya enkop,

English: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
Masaai: Irara intae inkera e lelo oibonok le Nkai, o ne ilo sotua oishoo Enkai iloo minyi, anaa pee ejoki Abraham, ‘Te ishoi ino emayiani iloreren pooki le nkop.’

English: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
Masaai: Naa ketonie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye, enkiyang'et e ng'eno o enkarriyiano, enkiyang'et e utaroto o enkidimata, enkiyang'et e ng'eno o euriata o Laitoriani.

English: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
Masaai: “Kinchiaakino iyie, Olaitoriani lang o Enkai ang, pee ing'amu enkisisa o enkanyit o engolon, amu iyie oitobirua intokitin pooki, naa te yieuna ino eetae ninche eitobiruaki ninche.”

English: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye enkaji nalala oo ng'apeta; ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat onom e nkaina, ore endapasho enye naa ntemat tomoni uni e nkaina. Netii apa olodungoro dukuya enye oitobiruno too ng'apeta, netii enkitushuret dukuya ninye.

English: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
Masaai: Neishooyo olapolosani te dukuya Olaitoriani neitobir olning'o lo osotua te nkaraki ninye, nesinyayu ninye teina rukunoto osarge lenye. Ena ninye enkitanapata tialo ina naiu enkerai aa enkayioni aashu entito.

English: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.
Masaai: niyau auluo ino ilo lee aashu ina kitok nataasa ena bae torrono, ninang toosoito ilo lee aashu enkitok ometua.

English: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
Masaai: Nejoki Olapolosani Kitok, “Ei neijia etiu nena baa?”

English: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hashum naa, iip are o tikitam o okuni.

English: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
Masaai: Ore ake pee errinyunye olaiguanani te Dameski nelo aing'or ilo perere lo lasar. Neitoki olaiguanani anyikaki ilo perere lo lasar. nelo aked shumata enye,

English: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaraki nemeyiolo esupatisho naa Enkai eing'uaa, nejo ninche maing'oru enenye naitasheyie, neaku eito eisho meitoria esupatisho naing'uaa Enkai.

English: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
Masaai: Ore Yeshua o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana lenye le sotua oonyikare o Kadmiel, o layiok lenyena, lelo ayiok le Yuda, neitasheiki pooki ilaisiaayiak tiatua enkaji e Nkai, tenebo ilayiok le Hanadad o Lawi, o layiok lenye, o ltung'ana lenye le sotua oonyikare.

English: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
Masaai: Amu kiterretena nanu te ngolon te nkaraki olarrabal; nincho iyie ilmang'ati laainei meimiso ti abori nanu.

English: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
Masaai: esikiria e ong'ata natamoo olpurkel, ore pee eyieu oloing'oni neisugaa osiwuo! Kaing'ae oidim aibooi eng'uarrata enye? Meetae ilooyieu ninye ooinaur ate, ore too lapaitin lenyena neinepu ninye.

English: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
Masaai: Naa iya te nkaina ino ena ng'udi, naa ninye iasie nkitoduaat.

English: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
Masaai: Neas ile Benchamen ina, neya nkituaak enye terisioroto esiana enye te nena toyie apa naaranyisho naaibung'a ninche aaya. Neitoki ninche aapuo aarrinyokino enjung'ore enye, neshet inkang'itie nemany.

English: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee eidip empukoroto neomon, neiteleiki ninche lelo nkaik, neirriwaa meshomo.

English: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
Masaai: Neiro ninche mbaa torrok ti alo Enkai o Musa. Neing'unyung'uny ninche ejo, “Kainyoo pee iyaua iyiook aitupuku te nkop e Misiri maetu aaye tene tiong'ota? Amu metii endaa nemetii enkare, neitirika iyiook ena daa nemeeta tipat.”

English: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
Masaai: Neitoki atem intemat enkaina enkalifu, naarik nanu aimie atua enkare; naa enkung'u ebaiki eng'uton, neitoki atem intemat enkalifu, naarik nanu aimie atua enkare; nebaiki empolos ai ina are.

English: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
Masaai: Meishopo enemeneng'a te dukuya Enkai, nemeeta Abadon entoki naitoipieki.

English: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
Masaai: olayioni le Tahat, olayioni le Asir, olayioni le Ebiasaf, olayioni le Kora,

English: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Enaikash apa tenaa eikituata te nkaina o Laitoriani te nkop e Misiri, ina kata apa kitoni te mbata oo motio oo nkiri nikinya imukateni aaraposho; amu impang'unye intae iyiook aayau ele purkel, aar ena umata pooki te sumash.”

English: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
Masaai: Amu etejo apa Daudi, “Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, eishoo eseriani iltung'ana lenyena, nebik ninye te Yerusalem ntarasi.

English: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
Masaai: Nelo Yesu te ine ashep enaiposha e Galilaya; neilepaki oldoinyo neton te ine.

English: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Masaai: Tenelo najoki ilo torrono, Oi iyie ele tung'ani torrono, meeta inchere pee miye neitu iyie irorie ilo torrono aitayiolo meibelekenyunye aing'uaa enkoitoi enye, ore ilo tung'ani torrono naa keye tiatua ing'ok enyena, kake ore osarge lenye naikilikuanu too nkaik inono.

English: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Dishan: Usi o Aran.

English: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho, nejoki ninche, “Keitu eigeri aajo, ‘Keaku enkaji ai ene sayiare too loreren pooki’? Kake intaa intae enkapune oo laisimak.

English: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
Masaai: Nintaiki sii ngesherreta naashetuno to suyai; ore nena ngesherreta nipik ilgiso oong'uan lo suyai ilpijat lenyena pokira oong'uan.

English: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
Masaai: Ore teine wueji nesinya aisul nepik ilkerubi oare loo nkeek, nemur ninche te sahabu.

English: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
Masaai: Ore tenajo, ‘Ekaaitagol endapash ai, ekeitololong olorika lai enkilepilep ai’;

English: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
Masaai: Etanyaita ninche ening, neitu eshilaa nena baa e nking'asia apa nitaasa tiatua ninche. Kake eitagolo ninche ilukuny enye negelu olarikoni pee errinyo aapuo esinkaisho enye te Misiri. Kake ira iyie Enkai nasioki apalaki, osupat, neeta olng'ur, nemesioki agoro nebik te nyorrata nauno neitu iyie inturaa ninche.

English: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Ore iyiook isinkan linono, kira ilalashera tomon aare, ilayiok lo lpayian obo te nkop e Kanaan; naa ng'ura, ore oloti te iyiook eboitare ena olong papaai lang, ore obo nemeekure eetae.”

English: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Hanan, lelo ayiok le Gidel, lelo ayiok le Gahar,

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
Masaai: neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa kepalakini ninye te pooki bae naba anaa enataasa oltung'ani neaku oloitarruoyie.”

English: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
Masaai: Eitu aairriwaa Kristo maibatisa, kake pee alikioo lelo Omon Supati naitelelek enkutuk pee ening'unoyu meoruni ake osalaba le Kristo ina najo.

English: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
Masaai: o Ben-hesed, te nkop e Arubot (enenye apa enkop e Soko o enkop pooki e Hefer)

English: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
Masaai: Amu atua oltung'ani eing'uaa indamunot torrok, enkiborra oo nkonyek, empurrorre, earata metua, eloloito,

English: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee etii Kristo atua intae, te neye ninye iseseni linyi te nkaraki ng'ok,

English: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
Masaai: Metaa ewaita ilmang'ati imasaa e Sodom o Gomorra, o ndaiki enye pooki nepuo.

English: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
Masaai: Ore te shumata oloing'ang'e te nchumata oo lukuny enye netii enkitanyaanyukoto olorika le nkitoo, nenyaanyukie osoit pus oji Safi; ore entopij enye netonie enkitanyaanyukoto olorika le nkitoo netii enkitanyaanyukoto naa ijo oltung'ani.

English: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
Masaai: o loom imiet too rubat enkae alo o lng'obor, o loom imiet too rubat o lng'bor te nkalo e oriong te nkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
Masaai: o Adama, o Rama, o Hasor,

English: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
Masaai: Tiaaki Olaiguanani o ng'otonye enkitok olaiguanani “Ewaita olorika liabori, amu etadowuo enkopiyia ino e nkitoo sidai aing'uaa endukuya ino.”

English: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
Masaai: Naisho nanu intae oltau ng'ejuk, naisho intae enkiyang'et ng'ejuk napik atua intae; naitayu aitung'uaa iseseni linyi ilo tau lo soit, naisho intae oltau le nkirring'o,

English: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
Masaai: Nepaash ninche nkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitobiraki ate nkitanyaanyukot naasholuno oo lasho oare, neitobir Asherim, neserem olorora pooki le shumata, neisiaai Baal.

English: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
Masaai: Entobira esesekuanata oo layiok lenyena te nkaraki entorroni oo loo menye, pee mebul ake neibung enkop, neiput oriong enkop nkanas.”
