Masaai: Ore te naa kena kop etii, nemeaku hoo olapolosani, amu keetae naa lelo kulikae apolosak ooishooyo nkishorot anaa enajo nkitanapat.

English: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Siria ootii enkalo o loo saen o lelo le Filisti ootii enkalo o loo ntoluo, kepuo aamut te nkutuk nang'a. Amu ore te kuna pooki eitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neitorioyioki enkaina enye.

English: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
Masaai: Ore oloitoreisho le meeta ening'unoto naa olaironyani ogogong; kake ore ilo oiba imasaa naapurruno naa keitoodor inkolong'i enyena.

English: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
Masaai: Entadou ate te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee eilepie ninye intae.

English: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki entutunyo e nkeju o metabaiki endukuya, metii embiotisho, kake ilbaa, o ltuduta, o ngoldonyot naaruko nkimek; neitu eironyuni, aashu eeni, neitu eelieki eilata.

English: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etudung'okoki enkiguana lelo torrok, negeluni aaitalam olturrur le lelo supati

English: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eruko Enkai.

English: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
Masaai: Ore ilchoreta laainei o encholuek ai, naaitashe aalam to lmeitai lai, ore iltung'ana lang le mudung neitashe te nelakua.

English: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
Masaai: ebaiki oldoinyo le Halak, ilo oshumunye aing'or Seir, o metabaiki Baalgad to erata le Lebanon ti abori oldoinyo le Hermon. Neya ninye ilaiguanak lenye pooki, nesesekuan ninche, near ninye ninche metuata.

English: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye olkutati lo loo saen metukutu te keper, ore te ngolong enye nerikoo osiwuo le kopikop;

English: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening Yakobo nchere keetae entapa te Misiri, neirriwaa lelo loo papa te nkata e nkiterata.

English: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina olong nenang'aa iltung'ana aaiturraa nena kitanyaanyukot enye e nkosholai o nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin e sahabu, apa naaitobirakita ate pee eserem, nenang'aki ilkirrumun o sarampalani,

English: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
Masaai: Naadumu ina Kiyang'et nanu ailepie naaya, nalo te mion enkirowuaj oltau lai, eiroishi ina aina te shumata nanu;

English: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee, or if thou know him not, then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house, and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it, and thou shalt restore it to him again.
Masaai: Naa tenimitaaniki aashu tenimiyiolo iyie ninye, tereu enkang ino, ning'or ninche ometaba anaa nelotu olalashe lino aing'oru; nitumoki taa aishoo ninye.

English: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
Masaai: Ore apa peyie ariku ninche ina kop apa nainosie olmumai ajo kaisho ninche, neaku ore pooki doinyo oodo odol arashu olchani ake ninye pooki oota mbenek, neishooyo ninche teine ilasarri lenye, neitarasaa ninche teine iolasar le ngoro; neirriwaa teine olasar le ngoro ooki.

English: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Kainyoo pee kilepilepaka iyie nanu? Kitogolong'akitia intae pooki, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo ng'eni newang'u anaa ewang'an e shumata; ore lelo ooboiniki ilkumok enkoitoi oosipat newang'u anaa ilakir ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
Masaai: Neiu ninche ilmosor le nturbubua neitobiru ninche orreshet te nkaji e surusuri; ore ilo oinos lelo mosor neye, ore ilo mosori odanyi nedanyuni olasurai.

English: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
Masaai: Oi ina olong! Amu etataana ina olong o Laitoriani, nelotu anaa enkidaaroto naing'uaa ilo magilani.

English: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
Masaai: Ore te retoto enye, eishooki apa ninye eretoto e anaake naishoo olaiguanani, ore ake te nkolong neng'amaa erubata, te nkishui enye pooki.

English: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata Yuda, naa kenya isempewueti le Yerusalem.”

English: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
Masaai: Neaku ematua e uni e naiposha osarge, neye ematua e uni oo ng'uesi naaishu naatii atua enaiposha, nemuti ematua e uni oo melin.

English: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
Masaai: Ore ake pee einyototo osinka loltung'ani le Nkai tadekenya, neipang alo boo, ng'ura etamana duoo enjore oo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan enkanasa. Nejo ilo sinka, “Oi lokitok lai! Kaa iyiook kiaas?”

English: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
Masaai: Neliki Ahab Yesebel nena pooki naataasa Eliya. Oina sii natara metuata iloibonok pooki to lalem.

English: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani torrono netum olekoisiaayio lelejare, kake ore ilo oun esupatisho netum olerrinyore osipa.

English: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
Masaai: “Nebukadresa ilo aiguanani le Babilon laatumuta nanu, aatupurda ninye nanu, aaitaa ninye empirbil narok aatoijoie ninye anaa enkukuu. Eiputa ninye enkoshoke enye intokitin ainei e sikar, aaiturrayie ninye anotu.

English: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
Masaai: nesulunye ilakir te keper, neikirikirieki engolon o loing'ang'e.

English: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
Masaai: Ore enasirie, te niosowuani, neinyototo ayok alo ewueji neliyio neomon te ine.

English: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
Masaai: Ore eiganya Petero Enkiyang'et Sinyati, newaliki ajoki, “Lo kituaak lo lorere, o lpayiani,

English: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
Masaai: Ore ilaranyak Heman o Asaf o Etan naa pee eosh aaitabuaku nkinantani dapashi o suyai,

English: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aipot Abraham enkata e are eing'uaa shumata.

English: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Elfas naa Teman, o Omar o Sefi o Satam o Kenas o Timna o Amaleki.

English: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
Masaai: neitasheyie Yakobo eng'ape te nchumata enkurare e Raheli; naa eng'ape ina enkurare e Raheli, netii ina ng'ape o taata.

English: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neikurrukur Olaitoriani te Sion neitayu oltoilo lenye te Yerusalem, ore keper o enkop neikirikira. Kake Olaitoriani esarunoto too ltung'ana lenyena, osempewuet too ltung'ana lenyena le Israel.

English: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
Masaai: Irara taata intae osesen le Kristo, nirara moobo rubat enyena.

English: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim anoto enkitok nadupa naishiaakino enkanyit? Amu eeta ninye tipat oleng alang isoito oogol enkinyang'a.

English: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
Masaai: Kake etejo Naomi, “Entorrinyoto enchom ntoyie aainei, kainyoo pee kiriamariyieyie nanu? Keton nanu aata ilayiok te nkoshoke ai eji pee eyooki aayam intae?

English: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Ore oltung'ani oiter arasaki Ilyebusi naa keaku olkitok neaku olarikoni le njore.” Ore olayioni le Seroya, neituruk alo, neaku etaa ninye olkitok.

English: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
Masaai: Neshumu Balaam nkonyek enyena, nedol Israel etii ilng'oborri, anaa loshon. Nelotu Enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata ninye,

English: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
Masaai: Naa ore pee majo ailepie kewan ajo kara kitok te nkaraki enkumoi oo mbaa naatabolokoki, aaishooki olkikuei to sesen lai, olkipaaret le sheitani, oirriwuaki maatarasaki, pee maailepieki aaitulusoo oleng.

English: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku etalakuaki nena naaye aaoru keeya, netaa nena naaye inemeye, neitabari ina kata ina nasira too Lkigerot nesipayu nchere. “Etoijoyioki keeya ti atua olkishuroto.”

English: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
Masaai: Amu eewuo Yohana enitii, te nkoitoi e supatisho, neitu irukuruku; kake eiruko iloosotu kodi o loololoito; kake ore pee indolidolo intae ina, neitu irridudu te siadi, aairuk ninye.

English: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
Masaai: Ore laiguanak le lelo tung'ana pooki, too loshon pooki le Israel neyau ate atua ilo turrur loo ltung'ana le Nkai, naa nkalifuni iip ong'uan apa iltung'ana oopuo too nkejek ooata lalema.

English: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Pilato lelo rorei neipang'unye Yesu boo, neton to lorika le nkiguana te wueji neji olpura loo soito, neji te nkutuk oo Lhebrania Gabata.

English: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
Masaai: Olkitok ake oton tiatua ninye peyie etum ainosa emukate te dukuya Olaitoriani; naa kejing ninye atua te nkoitoi olgilata le kishomi, neitoki ake aipang teina oitoi.”

English: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
Masaai: Neaku tiaaki iyie oloiboni, ‘Kainyoo kitawalikia Olaitoriani ajoki?’ aashu ‘Kainyoo eiroro Olaitoriani?

English: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
Masaai: Olaitoriani, Na Ai e Abraham o Isaak o Israel, loo papa, tipika ntarasi kuna yieunot o ndamunot atua iltauja loo ltung'ana linono, niutaa iltauja lenye meetu enitii.

English: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
Masaai: Ore pee aigerito nanu ena matii kajo paa te nabau nemaasishore enkidimata naata aitame intae. Olaitoriani laaishoo ena kidimata mateshetishore mme enaitarruorrie.

English: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
Masaai: Tiaaki lelo asipak nchere aisidain mbaa ti alo ninche, amu keinos ninche ilng'anayio loo nkiaasin enye.

English: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
Masaai: neiteru ilarin oopishana lo lameyu aabau, anaa enatejo apa Yosef. Neaku olameyu sapuk too nkuapi pooki; kake ore te nkop pooki e Misiri, netii endaa ina rishata.

English: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkeju ino, tudung'oi; amu enaikash te iyie ti nijing enkishui ira ng'ojine, alang ti nikinang'akini Gehanum, iata nkejek pokira are;

English: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
Masaai: Neewuo ele te nkaraki shakenisho, pee eishakenoki ina wang'an, pee etum pooki aairuko te ninye.

English: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tiniaku iyie supat tialo kulo tung'ana, nintiship ninche, niro irorei supati tialo ninche, naa keaku ninche isinkan linono ntarasi.”

English: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
Masaai: Ing'ura, etoduaa enkong'u ai kuna pooki, etoning'o enkiok ai nening'u ninye.

English: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
Masaai: Ketiu pasa ena anaa kenkisisa oo ltung'ana aing'oru ana kene Nkai? Katiu pasa anaa eiltung'ana ayieu naitiship? Te naa ltung'ana napaji ayieu naitiship, nemaitoki aaku olaisiaayiani le Kristo.

English: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
Masaai: Tushumunye, tushumunye, ntasho, iyie Yerusalem, iyie anaa ina natookishe te nkaina o Laitoriani te ina kikompe e ngoro enye, iyie enatookishe to lbakuli amera, niyukuyukori

English: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Amu ime engoro enye eiyieu Enkai nikinting'oki kake pee kitum enjeunoto naimu Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo,

English: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
Masaai: Kake eyiolo ninye enkoitoi nalo aim; ore peyie aaidip atetema nanu, nalotu apuku atotiuo anaa sahabu.

English: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Manase etua tenebo apa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkurma natii embata e nkaji enye. Tiatua e nkurma e Usa; neitoreisho Amon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
Masaai: Ore te nerrip oltung'ani ogol otanape enkaji enye, neserian imasaa enyena pooki.

English: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
Masaai: “Kerikino enkitok enkerai enye nanakita, eji meitoki aing'urrie ina kerai e nkoshoke enye?” Ee keidim atorikinoyu, kake maarikino nanu iyie.

English: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Pee aa ore enkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu, neisisi ti atua intae, neisisi intae tiatua ninye, te risioroto e mpiris e Enkai ang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
Masaai: Ore oloitasheiki nchoo too ndaat te Sharon naa Shitrai le Sharon, ore oloitasheiki nchoo naadaa too erat naa Shefat olayioni le Adlai.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong, meetae hoo enkirobi arashu enkurriny e ndeem.

English: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kerayae akenya ntamesin enye ore luaat enye oo nchoo neaku iyararot. Naidapashaki nanu pooki siuo lelo oodung ilpijat loo lpapit lenye nayau nanu osina lenye aimunye pooki shoto enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie enkata nairrugo neiu nkera enye?

English: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
Masaai: Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani; ng'ura, eipotu Olaitoriani Enkai enkiguana e nkima, nenya ina kima ineegut oleng, neinosita sii enkop.

English: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.
Masaai: Naa tenepuonu loo menye anaa ilalashera lenye aailepilepaki iyiook, nikijoki iyiook ninche, ‘Enchoo iyiook mawaita ninche te mpiris, amu eitu iyiook kiya ninche aaitaa nkituaak ang to larrabal, neitu sii intae inchosho iyiook, anaa naa eaku eninyi entorroni.’ ”

English: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
Masaai: Ekaimie intae abori eng'udi, naisho intae entijing atua te nkikena.

English: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
Masaai: Ore pee idol iyie ina ning'idayu, neiput oltau lino enchipai, amu ore ina kumoi e naiposha naa eikimbelekenyakini iyie, kelotu ina arsisisho oo loshon enitii.

English: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
Masaai: Kake eitasho ninye olasotoni le kodi, te nelakua nemeshumu ninye nkonyek enyena aing'orie shumata kake olgoo eoshiosh, ejo, ‘Na Ai, ing'urrieki nanu olaing'okoni!’

English: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
Masaai: Ore eton iriamariri te nkoitoi o ilo likintang'or to larishani, tetema toning'ore ninye eton ipuopuo, pee mikiyeataki enetii olaiguanani, nikintarasaki olaiguanani osikari, nikipik osikari korokoroni.

English: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
Masaai: Entabuaku entarany te ng'ida, intae iloomanya Sion, amu eikitok ilo otii atua intae, Ilo Osinya le Israel.”

English: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari liare le nkitoria e Peka olayioni le Remalia, olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru Yotam olayioni le Usia ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
Masaai: Ore pee ebik nkuti olong'i te ine, nedumunye alo neimaa olkirine le Galatia, o Prigia aruk nenen, eitagol ilooiteng'eni pooki.

English: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
Masaai: Esipa nchere atoduaa osina loo ltung'ana laainei te Misiri, naning olkiyioi lenye, naewuo pee asaru: wou naa taata amu, kaairriwaa Misiri.’

English: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
Masaai: Nanu eishoo Papa pooki toki, nemeetae oloyiolo Oinoti leme Papa ake, nemeetae oloyiolo Papa leme Oinoti lenye ake, o lelo pooki ngae ake ogelu enkerai aboloki ninye.”

English: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
Masaai: Intagolikio ilalashera linono te sile nitoning'okinote nioru ninye nkilani meshomo meishopo.

English: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
Masaai: ore anaa enaaishoo Papa enkitoria, aisho sii nanu intae aiko neijia

English: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
Masaai: kake entarasai olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani, esong'uona narropil: oloing'oni obo oti, olmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo; nchoo eaku meeta ntiot;

English: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
Masaai: “Nebore nkutukie enye ildeketa o enduaran.”

English: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
Masaai: Ore pee eputunye Petero ayiolou enaasita, nejo, “Atayiolo taa taata ajo Olaitoriani oirriwua olmalaika lenye maatasaru ang'adie enkaina e Herode, o nena pooki naayiewuaki olorere lo Lyahudi.”

English: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

English: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

Masaai: Ore ilkumok le lelo ooirurate ti atua enterit e nkop neinyototo, ore kulikae nedumakino enkishui nemeiting, ore ilkulikae naa enkurruna o esulare oo ntarasi.

English: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

Masaai: Kolkitok lang olaiguanani oyaua ena bae neitu iyie iliki isinkan linono nchere kalo otonie olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai te siadi ninye.

English: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina kata too lng'oborri pee etum iltung'ana olom te nkaraki Musa o Aron, ilo sinyati lo Laitoriani,

English: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

English: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.

English: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
Masaai: Ore embata eina ilata naleku te nkaina enye nepik olapolosani enchumata enkitipet e nkiok e tatene eilo oitukui, o enchumata olmogirra lenye le nkaina e tatene, o le nkeju enye e tatene, shumata ilo sarge lo lasar le nkitarruorroto;

English: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
Masaai: entalam empukunoto pooki e ntorroni.

English: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani osinkirri sapuk metoijoi Yona; netii apa Yona enkoshoke o sinkirri nkolong'i uni o nkewarieitin uni.

English: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani irorei leina kitok, nepolos nkilani enyena ore ina kata negira ninye alo te nchumata e suntai nedol iltung'ana naa ng'ura, eishopito ninye ilkuniyiani tiatua nkilani enyena.

English: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
Masaai: Kake ore ti alo nanu eyieu errorro nkejek aainei, eyieu eideketari nkejek aainei.

English: I and my Father are one.
Masaai: Kira nabo nanu o Papa.”

English: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
Masaai: Nedumu enkikompe, neisho Enkai enashe, neitarasaki ninche nejoki, “Entook pooki;

English: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
Masaai: Ore pee eiteleiki Paulo nkaik enyena, nedoiki Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninche: neiro kulie kutukie neibonisho.

English: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani endapidapoi ai, naa osempewuet lai,

English: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye abik nkolong'i tomoni uni oo kuni teilo sarge lenye le nkitisinyata; nemeishori ninye meiseyie entoki sinyati aashu elotu atua enkaji Enkai o metaba anaa neishunye nkolong'i enyena enkitisinyata.

English: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
Masaai: “Te neosh oltung'ani enkong'u o rrindik lenye, olee arashu enkitok, neitarruoo, neisho ninye ilo rrindik meshomo te nkaraki enkong'u.

English: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
Masaai: Neituruk Gehasi alo neiteleiki ina ng'udi enkomom eina kerai kake eitu etumi enkikashata anaa enkitoduaata e nkishui. Neaku etorrinye alo anang'are ninye, nejoki ninche, “Eitu einyototo ina kerai.”

English: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
Masaai: “Kake intooko intae Ilnasari enaisho, nintanapinapa iloibonok le Nkai aajoki ‘Emimbonisho’.

English: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
Masaai: Eirorita apa Hana to ltau lenye, nchonito enyena e nkutuk ake naaiseuseu nemening'o oltoilo lenye; ore enkaraki ina nejo Eli tenaa kenkitok natemere.

English: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
Masaai: Mme doi nena baa nemeeta nchere pee eitu irukuruku kisikong'aki intae; eidipa pae atuunoyu enkirukoto inyi. Eikisiaaisho doi te nebo intae too mbaa e nchipai inyi maate.

English: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo Lawi aaiteleiki nkaik enye ilukuny e lelo oing'ok; nipolos iyie obo pee eaku olasar le ngoki ore olikae neaku olasar opejori oishori Olaitoriani, pee eitobir osotua lo lning lo Laitoriani too le Lawi.

English: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
Masaai: Kepuonu ninche aabuaku aaranyisho te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion, naa keaku keng'ida ninche teina supatisho o Laitoriani te nkurma, te naisho oo sabibu te ilata, o to lkuo le luaata oo ntare o lashe loo nkishu; ketiu enkishui enye anaa enkurma natipikaki enkare, nemeitoki ae kata aatum osina.

English: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Nemir Yoshua aitadoyio Ilmaleki o ltung'ana lenyena neshurt te nepi o lalem.

English: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
Masaai: Ina pee eikenakaki enkirukoto enye nchere esupatisho.

English: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
Masaai: Kake ore ina kewarie ake, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Natan, ejo,

English: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata iyie, Israel, toning'o nkitanapat o kuna kikoot naiteng'en nanu intae, niasiasa ninche, pee itumutumu aatopok nipuopuo aaya ina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi.

English: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
Masaai: Eitobirua apa Olaitoriani Enkai ang olning'o lo sotua o iyiook te Horeb.

English: So there was a division among the people because of him.
Masaai: Ore te ina nejing empong'o atua esiamo te nkaraki ninye.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, ‘Kaitiaa oitoi?’ Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu aaku ololejisho too nkutukie oo loibonok pooki.’ Nejo ninye, ‘Ilo iyie alej ninye naa ilo aidimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.’

English: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
Masaai: o Eliel le Mahafi, o Yeribai o Yoshafia, ilayiok le Elnaan, o Itam, o Itma le Moab,

English: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eitu eyauni osarge lenye atua ewueji sinyati esipa eishaakino ninosa iyie tiatua e wueji sinyati, anaa enaitanapishe nanu.”

English: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn e lelo tung'ana oopuonu aaku te nebo intae. Neing'uaa olosho le Ruben Elisur olayioni le Shedeur;

English: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
Masaai: Neya ninye ilmong'i oare ootii enchata emurt nabo, nedung'udung ninche aitaa ndung'ot, neirriwaa nena dung'ot enkop pooki e Israel, too nkaik e lelo kiliku ejo, “Ore pooki ng'ae lemeipang'u asuj Saul o Samuel, neikoni neijia ilmong'i lenyena!” Nejing iltung'ana euriata e Nkai, neipang'u ninche anaa oltung'ani obo.

English: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
Masaai: Kake ore te siadi nena olong'i uni o lpisiai, nejing enkiyang'et e nkishui naing'uaa Enkai, atua ninche neitashe ninche too nkejek enye, neiput enkuretisho sapuk lelo ootoduaa ninche.

English: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
Masaai: Neaku kelo Petero idie o idie abaiki ninche pooki o meeu enetii isinyat oomanya Luda.

English: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ilo kila adoru inkaik meyakini menye, nejo, “Nele olkila likinotito, ng'ura sii iyie tujurru tenaa kolkila lo layioni lino anaa aimeninye.”

English: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
Masaai: Kinchoo nanu enkishui o enyorrata nauno; ore erripoto ino netorripo oltau lai.

English: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
Masaai: netum naa olapolosani aitanapisho meitukui ina toki natijing'a enkeeya neikenoo ninye nkulie olong'i naapishana;

English: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
Masaai: “Terretena empolos ino anaa olee; kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, nikimbalakinye nanu.

English: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia nena anas oo Lawi nena ajijik naatii atua nkanas enye keidim ile lawi aatokordu pooki kata.

English: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie o ltung'ana linono pee iyeye to lalem, o to lameyu o to lmeitai, anaa enairoro Olaitoriani tialo pooki orere lemeisiaai olaiguanani le Babilon?

English: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
Masaai: ina kata eisudori too nkapuniaa enye, arashu eirrag aanyisho too rrumati lenye?

English: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani aipang'u teine wueji enye, nedou alotu aituny iwuejitin neeika e nkop.

English: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
Masaai: Neiguana te nebo neinyiang'unye enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo pee enukarieki iltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
Masaai: Ore amu meeta olorok lenye enkiyagata, meleku ninye ae toki hoo nabo nashipakino.

English: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aton to lturrur loo looshipa, ang'ida; atotona nanu openy, amu etii apa enkaina ino shumata nanu, amu kimputa nanu engoro.

English: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
Masaai: Nearare Yoab Raba loo Lamoni, neya ina ang e nkitoo.

English: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
Masaai: Kake ore dupoto apa naata, naikena aitaa pesho te nkaraki Kristo.

English: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu eisidai te nataaniki Enkai; aitaa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai esarunoto ai, pee atum atolimu isiaaitin inono pooki.

English: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee edol Saul neyiolou ajo etii Olaitoriani te nebo Daudi, o nchere kenyor Isiraeli pooki ninye,

English: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
Masaai: Mbalie na Ai nchere maata entorroni nikimitu nanu. tokorduaki nanu too lalejak o te lelo lemeitoriori!

English: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, kainyoo pee eewuo ena atiu nji tiatua Israel, eji metaa keetae taata olosho obo lemeetae te Israel?”

English: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
Masaai: Nejoki Yakobo ninche, “Ilalashera laainei, kaji doi ing'uaa?” Nejo ninche, “King'uaa Haran.”

English: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kalo tung'ani linyi oata enker nabo, naa te nedoiki ina ker engumoto te nkolong e kiyeng'iyeng'ata, nemeibung aitayu?

English: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
Masaai: “Olaitoriani lai, tenanoto omom too nkonyek inono, migiroo ake osinka lino.

English: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
Masaai: naa iyie oyooki apiyai ninche anaa enkila neibelekenya ninche. Kake itiu iyie anaa apake, nemeishunye ilarin linono ntarasi.”

English: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
Masaai: Tinintodolu olkep neme sidai; kake eas oltung'ani ntorrok te neishori enkiti daa.

English: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
Masaai: Neaku airorie ilpayiani ootii atua intae, ara sii nanu olpayian anaa ninche nara shakeni loo nkisilisilot e Kristo Nang'arie enkitoo napuoi aabolu.

English: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kake mbelekenye iyie apaash enkoitoi; nchoo ilkumok errorro too nkiteng'enat inono, indurukie iyie olning'o lo sotua le Lawi

English: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
Masaai: Ore enjung'ore ang neibelekenyakaki iltung'ana leeiking'a, ore nkang'itie ang neaku inoo ltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
Masaai: etii ilaranyak dukuya, netii ilaoshok loo ntampurini siadi, ore erishata enye netii ntoyie naakut ndulen:

English: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
Masaai: Naa ketoni tiatua ninye te seriani naa keshet ninche inkajijik neun inkurman oo sabibu. Naa ketoni tiatua te seriani, ina kata nayau adung'oki enkiguana shumata lelo le latia enye lelo ootarare ninye te ng'oro sapuk. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye.”

English: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
Masaai: Ng'ura eneba ilmang'ati laainei, o eneba enkiba naaiba ninche nanu te ntoloi.

English: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina, etejo, eng'eno e Nkai, ‘Kairriwaki ninche loibonok o lkipaareta, near kulikae metuata, nearaa kulikae’,

English: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
Masaai: pee kijeu too lmang'ati lang, o too nkaik e lelo pooki ooiba iyiook;

English: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
Masaai: Neked empeut nelang alo enkanasa enye.

English: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
Masaai: Meetae entorroni enye nabo naataasa naitokini aadamu te nkaraki ninye; ore tesupatisho nataasa nemeeta nchere, meton eishu.

English: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
Masaai: Ore lapa apolosak ooiturukutuo naa kumok esiana enye, amu etomitikio enkeeya ebikoo te mpolosare;

English: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Yehu olayioni le Hanani, ilo aduaani anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye olaiguanani Yehoshafat, “Iretu iyie olarruoni ninyor lelo ooiba Olaitoriani? Ore enkaraki ena, eewuo engoro naing'ua Olaitoriani enkaraki iyie.

English: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
Masaai: Neitoki olarrabal apuku; neipang Daudi alo nearare Ilfilisti, neitayu esesekuanare sapuk ti atua ninche, neaku eipirritio te dukuya ninye.

English: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
Masaai: Meitubulu Enkai Yafet naa inchoo metotona to lng'obor le Shem, neaku Kanaan osinka lenye.”

English: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
Masaai: peyie erreteni lelo sinyat, te nkaraki ina siaai e ramatare, ene nchetata o sesen le Kristo,

English: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
Masaai: Metaa kepuku olpolosie le naiposha e Hasarenon, ina natii moikuape olpolosie le Dameski, tenebo olpolosie le Hamat o meshomo moikuape. Keaku ena enkalo e moikuape.

English: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
Masaai: ore olojo keton ti atua ninye neishiakino te neikunari anaa eneikunari apa ninye.

English: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
Masaai: Ore taaisere, etii lelo enkoitoi, etinyikakita ina anasa, nelo Petero aomon te shumata enkaji, etaa enaipirie enkolong.

English: And another company turned the way to Bethhoron: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
Masaai: ore olikae turrur neibelekenya aing'or enkalo e Bet-horon, ore olikae turrur neibelekenya aing'or ilo polosie oing'orita oerata le Sebuim te nkalo o lpurkel.

English: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
Masaai: Kake ore Kristo netaa oloisiligayu te nkaji e Enkai anaa Oinoti. Nikira iyiook enkaji enye ti nikimbung aakurraki empijan ang o lwuasa ti atua ilo siligi lang.

English: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore iyie niaku ningoti ti atua iloshon kumok te nkaraki enkishiaa ino, amu aisidai apa oleng eibulayie iloshon te nkaraki ina kishiaa naisul naaishopoko nanu iyie, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
Masaai: Erany olng'ejep lai irorei linono, amu ore inkitanapat inono pooki nesipa.

English: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Yosef aa taa to losho olayioni le Manase, naa Gad olayioni le Susi;

English: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
Masaai: Amu keishori oltung'ani enchunet te naa, ore nkaraki nadamu Enkai neng'iri te neidong'i metii esipata.

English: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth, and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain:
Masaai: nepuonu naa ilpayiani linyi o larishak linyi, netem erishata e nena anas naamanita ilo otasesekuanaki

English: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
Masaai: amu ore irorei likinchoo iyie naishoo nanu ninche, netang'amutua ninche, netisiputua aayiolou inchere, iyie aing'uaa, neiruko inchere iyie likirriwua.

English: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
Masaai: Naa Ore inkoitoi naalala eina anasa, neiput inkayiok o ntoyie eiguran teine.

English: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.
Masaai: Ore nkituaak inono pooki o layiok linono naa keyookini aaipang'ie aarikoki ilkaldayo, ore iyie enkorrok ino nimijeu te nkaina enye, kake eikimbung olaiguanani le Babilon; ore ena anasa nepejori te nkima.”

English: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
Masaai: Kaji naa etii olwuasa lang? Eiwuang'ieki. Ti aa kitanapata? Ai te nkitanapata oo nkiasin? Mme neijia, kake te nkitanapata e nkirukoto.

English: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.
Masaai: Nejoki Delila ninye, “Kaji iyie inko ti nijo, ‘Kaanyor nanu iyie,’ te nemetii oltau lino te nebo nanu? Kitusunkenya iyie kuna katitin pokira uni, neitu iyie kiliki enetii engolon ino kitok.”

English: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
Masaai: Ara nanu shakeni te ninche nchere keeta olokiyo kitok te Nkai, kake mewang eyiolounoto.

English: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
Masaai: Nikiomon iyiook Enkai ang, nikipik ilarripok ooibooyo ninche, dama o kewarie.

English: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkaji e Israel atoduaa nanu embae busus oleng; ine etii eloloito e Efraim, neidurukie Israeli.

English: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
Masaai: Kake ore intae enyaaki wootu intae pooki, nematum nanu oltung'ani ng'en te ntae pooki.

English: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o ltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye neyietu aaishir o metaba anaa neaku meeta engolon naishirie.

English: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
Masaai: Enchom enteng'ena ate eneikununo ele rorei, ojo, ‘Olng'ur ayieu mme olasar;’ amu eitu alotu aipot isupati kake ilaing'okok.”

English: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.
Masaai: Ore naa taata meiwuang'a ae kata olalem te nkaji ino amu kitemena nanu, niya enkitok e Uria ilo Hiti metaa enkitok ino.’

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
Masaai: ore naa enkaraki ina, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ng'ura, kayau nanu shumata Yerusalem o Yuda, entorroni naikununo neijia naa ore ake nkiyiaa pooki naaning neng'eyu.

English: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
Masaai: Nirupurupu intae ate oleng kiararere nanu too nkutukie inyi, niponaa irorei aitaa kumok kiararere nanu; natoning'o nanu ina.

English: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Aron; nepik ninye iltaai lenyena meitawang'a dukuya ina kitashet oo ltaai, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
Masaai: naa keaku te ninye o te ishoi enye, te siadi ninye, ilo ning'o lo sotua le mpolosare e anaake, enkaraki naata ninye olom te nkaraki Enkai enye, neitobira olning'o lo sotua too ltung'ana le Israel!’ ”

English: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: nintobiraki ina kila o lgoo ilgiso oare le sahabu nipik lelo giso oare ilpijat pokira oare le mbene o lgoo.

English: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
Masaai: Amu anaata apa airraga nagira; anaata airure; naa anaata ayeng'iyeng'e.

English: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
Masaai: Neomon Yabes Enkai e Israel ejo, “Tamayianaki Na Ai, nikiponiki enkop, nchoo enkaina ino eaku tenebo nanu, naamitu nanu te mbatisho pooki pee maatum nanu!” Neisho Enkai ninye ina natoomonuo.

English: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
Masaai: Nesar pooki aaibung Sostene, ilo apa oitore enkaji e ntumo oo Lyahudi, neidong te nkalo o lorika le nkiguana. Neitu hoo eshilaa ninye Galio nena baa pooki.

English: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, nchoo enkisisa enye eimu ilubot e nkop! Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha, o nena naabore atua, o loo manaa le naiposha o lelo oomanya ninche.

English: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
Masaai: arashu eim ilang'at e Yordan aapuo e nkop e Gad o Gilead. Neton apa etii Saul Gilgal, nesujaa iltung'ana pooki ninye eikirikira.

English: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
Masaai: Kake keye pooki ng'ae te ng'oki enye makewan; ore pooki lee onya isabibu ooisuijo nesirayu ilala lenyena too mbat.

English: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,

English: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu ing'uraki, niking'urrie nanu, anaa oshi ake enintaas lelo oonyor enkarna ino.

English: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake etoponayie ake ninye enkiborra oo nkonyek, edamu inkolong'i enyena e kitisho, ina kata eiborrie onyek te nkop e Misiri

English: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
Masaai: Ng'ura eirragie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ena kop te dukuya intae; elepa enchom, ewaita anaa apa enatiaka intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi; miureishoyuyu niming'aing'aiyiayia.’

English: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
Masaai: Neibung ilo kitok enkaina nerik enkilepata neikilikuan too nkurrat ajoki, “Kaa kiyieu nikijoki?”

English: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
Masaai: Ekekut olkutati ninye meeta olng'ur ina kata etem ninye ailany engolon enye.

English: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Yehoshafat airura neye anaa loo menye, nenukari te nkurare oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
Masaai: Neikenoo ninche ninye ometaba anaa neibalakinyeki ninche yieuna o laitoriani.

English: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
Masaai: Neyieu ninye neitaa kewan asipani, nejoki Yesu, “Ai ng'ae doi ole latia ai?”

English: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
Masaai: Neitobiraki ninye ninche osirua sapuk; ore ake pee eidip aainosa endaa neokisho, neisho ninche meshomo, nepuo ninche enetii olkitok lenye. Neitu aekata eitoki iltung'ana le Siria aapuonu aarasaki enkop e Israel.

English: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki apa ootabatatate ina olong, ilewa o nkituaak naa nkalifuni tomon o are, iltung'ana pooki le Ai.

English: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, ore anaa eyieunoto naata naleng pee aigeroki intae mbaa naaipirta enjeunoto ang niking'ar, nadol ajo meeta nchere maigeroki intae, asai intae erishisho aamitu enkirukoto e Nkai naishooki apa nabo kata te lulung'ata lelo sinyat.

English: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
Masaai: Amu ore elong'o ang naa eno laitoriani, ore olaiguanani lang naa oleilo sinyati le Israel.

English: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
Masaai: naa eikitum pooki toki nikiomonu, amu eikimbung nkitanapat enyena nikias ina naitiship ninye.

English: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
Masaai: Ti atua ninye, te risioroto e ina nayieu ninye ilo oitabaya intokitin pooki te risioroto e nkiguana enye,

English: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
Masaai: kake ore ilo tung'ani aisinani nemeeta toki meteleku ake enkiti supen e ker, apa nainyiang'ua ninye. Neoroo ninye, nebulu ninye te nebo ninye o te nebo nkera enyena; naa keng'arie apa ninye endaa enye, neokisho te nkikompe enye, neirrag to lgoo lenye, netiu apa ninye anaa entito te ninye.

English: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
Masaai: Ore eing'orisho, etoduaa enchorro ti ong'ata, ore ake sii, etodua iluaat uni oo nkishu o nkerrai eirrag te mbata eina shorro amu teina shorro eokokinyieki enkare naok. Netii osoit sapuk enkutuk enchorro.

English: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa keaku olmishire te nkaina ino arashu te rishata oo nkonyek inono, amu te nkaina nagol eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri.”

English: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
Masaai: Ketokordutua nena aitin oo loshon ninche, lelo oshon apa ooidaikie loo papa, Gosan, o Haran, o Resef o lelo tung'ana le Eden apa ootii Telasar?

English: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
Masaai: Etii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata nanu, amu aatubukoko nanu Olaitoriani eilata aput pee ayaki lomon supati lelo aisinak aairriwayie ninye nanu pee alo aruburub lelo ootigilate iltauja, pee aibalunye elakunoto te lelo ooena, o emboloroto te lelo ooikenoro te korokoroni.

English: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, eetuo kulie kishu naapishana sasin, naaikinyoot aailepu to lkeju le Nail aasuju ninche, neitashe te mbata oo nkulie te nkiyopata olkeju le Nail.

English: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
Masaai: Nadol nanu te ina duaata; naa ore apa pee adol, natii Susa ina anasa kitok, natii olkerenket le Elam; nadol apa nanu te nduaata, atii embata olkeju le Ulai.

English: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nepik ilo apolosani embata eilo sarge imowuarak ol perere lo lasar naatii enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani, apa otii atua olng'obor le ntumo. Ore ilo likae sarge lo loing'oni neibukoo te ntonata olperere opejorieki olasar otii kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eishoo Musa intae entoorore inkituaak inyi enkaraki engolon oo ltauja linyi, kake mme neijia apa etiu te nkiterunoto.

English: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
Masaai: Ore te nkipirta e inoto ino, teina olong eitu edung'i osotua lino, neton eitu kisuji iyie te nkare neton eitu kiutuutieki emunyan, arashu kirridi too nkarash.

English: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
Masaai: Ore tinipal enkerai ai inining'u nkiteng'enat aainei, nipong'ori alo apaash irorei le ng'eno.

English: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
Masaai: Kaae nedumu Naomi ina kerai neirragie to lgoo lenye, neaku ninye enkaing'urani enye.

English: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake eitu eitoomon ilopeny enkaraki naipirta Yerusalem.

English: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
Masaai: amu eishoo Enkai ninye metorikinoyu eng'eno nagut, neitu eoriki ninye erubata ening'unoto.

English: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
Masaai: Nelotu Absalom enetii olaiguanani, nejo, “Ng'ura, eeta osinka lino ilabarnok loo nkerra; aatasayia nchoo olaiguanani o sinkan lenyena epuo te nebo osinka lino.”

English: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
Masaai: Amu te naa keidipa apa Yoshua aishoo ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaata eitu eitoki Enkai aimaki ae olong.

English: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
Masaai: ore nena nong'ot neing'usilu, ore ilkejek ooibung'are ilo keju le Nail le Misiri nemitari aatoyu, ore oseyiai o lkujita netoyu.

English: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
Masaai: Kaing'ae naidim aikena nkera e Yakobo naaba anaa enterit, aashu ematua e ong'uan e Israel? Ntasho matua nanu keeya o ltung'ani supat, naa nchoo enkiting'oto ai etiu anaa enenye!”

English: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
Masaai: Ore kindipa elototo ang king'uaa Tiro, nikibau Tolemai; nikiroroki ilalashera nikibik nabo olong te nebo ninche.

English: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
Masaai: Ore te nejing iltorrok enkitoria, naa keponari ntorrok, kake keanyu lelo supati aadolu embatatata enye.

English: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
Masaai: Enchom entejo, ore isinkan linono naa ilaramatak loo nkishu eiteru te keraisho o metabaiki ena kata, iyiook tenebo iloo papa lang; pee itumutumu aatamany enkop e Goshen; Amu ore pooki aramatani loo ntare naa olminong too Lmisiri.”

English: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
Masaai: nchere eshomo kulikae tung'ana le pesho tiatua intae neitapong'oitie lelo oomanya ina anasa, ejo, ‘Maape iyiook aaisiaai kulie aitin,’ neitu apa iyiolouu,

English: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
Masaai: Ina peyie ejoki Farao Yosef, “Ore amu kintoduaa Enkai kuna pooki, meetae likae arriyia naa ng'en laijo iyie;

English: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
Masaai: “Ore peyie epuonu iltung'ana leina kop dukuya o Laitoriani te lelo siruai oogeluno, ore ilo ojing'u te kishomi e moikuape aseremisho neipang alo te kishomi e kopikop; ore ilo ojing'u te kishomi e kopikop neipang auluo te kishomi e moikuape; meetae oltung'ani oshuko aipang eimaa kishomi natijing'ie, kake keipang ake pooki ng'ae aitoriori alo dukuya.

English: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
Masaai: Aitarasaka intae naiturukie ina natang'amua sii nanu: nchere etua Kristo te nkaraki ng'ok ang anaa enajo Lkigerot,

English: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Eliya, “Kaa kiaatakinore iyie nanu, lo tung'ani le Nkai? Iewuo iyie enatii pee edamuni eng'oki ai, niyau keeya e nkayioni ai!”

English: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
Masaai: Ore ilo okepari makewan naa iyieunot enyena eing'oru, pee etum atoorunye te pooki kiguana nasipa.

English: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
Masaai: Keaku ninche ilaisiaayiak te wueji ai sinyati, neitasheiki too nkishomin e nkaji e Nkai, neisiaaisho te nkaji e Nkai; naa keyieng ninche olasar opejori te nkaraki iltung'ana, naa keramat ninche olorere, eisiaai ninche.

English: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
Masaai: neaku, ing'ura ekaiturrurru isintan linono pooki, lelo litishipakine lelo pooki linyor o lelo limbayie; ekaiturrurru ninche mikitaarare iyie too nkaloli pooki, naboloo emasipaisho ino eboloki ninche, pee etum aatodol emasipaisho ino pooki.

English: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
Masaai: Nieniki ina arasha narridieki endukuya te nkeene pus; tipika enkalo e dukuya e ina arasha narridieki endukuya.

English: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
Masaai: Te mayianata oo supati eisisi nerrepi enkanasa, kake kemuti too nkutukie oo ltorrok.

English: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kaarare nanu lelo ooibonu enkidetidetat e lejare, Olaitoriani ojo, laa ninche oojoki ninche nerikoo iltung'ana laainei aaitapong'oo te lejare enye o te nkitokoos enye, eitu nanu airriwaa ninche aashu aitanap ninche; metaa meret ninche ele orere katukul, olaitoriani ojo.

English: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Masaai: Nepik ele sirata shumata elukunya enye aajo “YESU ELE OLAIGUANANI LOO LYAHUDI.”

English: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
Masaai: Ore pee ikurraki inkonyek inono ninye, neimin; amu ketum ninye asioki inaipuko, neilep anaa olkurragos olo te keper.

English: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
Masaai: “Ena ninye enkitanapata te neye oltung'ani ti atua olng'obor: ore pooki ng'ae ojing'u atua olng'obor, o pooki ng'ae otii atua olng'obor neaku olemesinya nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
Masaai: Neitoki olalashe lenye asuju, ore enkaina enye eibung'ita entutunyo e Esau, neipot ninye aajo Yakobo ore apa Isaak naa oloo larin ntomoni ile peyie eiki Rebeka ninye lelo mao.

English: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, negelu Olaitoriani kulikae ntomoni naapishana neirriwaa maare, meturuko nena ang'itie o pooki wueji neyieu openy nelo.

English: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Aishoo ninye ina kop e misiri metaa olerrinyore teina naisiayua, amu nanu eisiaayia ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
Masaai: ore ake pee eaku keikeni kishomi, etomisimiso, neipang lelo tung'ana aapuo, ore eneshomo lelo tung'ana mayiolo nanu; entasioki entusujai ninche amu inepupu.”

English: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
Masaai: teneirridu ninche too ndamunot enye pooki o too ltauja lenye pooki tiatua ina kop oo lmang'ati lenye, apa oowaita ninche aaraya, nikiomon ninche eing'orita enkop enye, apa ninchoo iyie loo menye, ina anasa nitegelua iyie, o ina aji natesheta nanu tenkaraki enkarna ino;

English: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
Masaai: Neaku enyaaka apa Solomon ashet Geser) o Bet-horon e abori

English: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ing'ura ekaaisho iyie ilboro le modiei e nkiteng te rishata oonkik o ltung'ani, neaku ninye ipejunye emukate ino.”

English: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
Masaai: Pee eitaki Olaitoriani ilasarri oopejori anaake tadekenya o teipa, te risioroto e nena pooki naaigeroki te nkitanapata o Laitoriani naitanapa ninye Israel.

English: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Abraham, “Ainyoo doi peyie etakuenia Sara nejo, ‘Kesipa hoo doi ajo kaiu enkerai, nataa taata moruo?’

English: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
Masaai: Kake atiaaka intae nchere, kitoduaa kake eton mirukuruku.

English: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Masaai: Mbung'aki nanu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino, pee aton aishu, nimikincho nanu manoto enkurruna to siligi lai!

English: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Yuda oilep alo; ng'ura aishooyie nanu enkop apik atua enkaina enye.”

English: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
