Masaai: O layiok le Usiel: Mishael, Elsafan o Sisri.

English: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
Masaai: Meeta nchere melak ninye ina toki natupurroyie. Te nemeeta ninye toki, nemiri ninye anaa orrindik, pee elak ina natupurroyie.

English: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
Masaai: naa entetem aajo mateng'ena te nena naaitiship Olaitoriani.

English: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ipuopuo intae aaipuotu lelo oreren limiyiololo intae, ore lelo oreren lemeyiolo intae nekuetiki intae, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, o Ilo Osinya le Israel, amu eitaa ninye intae olosho kitok.

English: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
Masaai: Mikiaata iyiook olkob likipikaki hoo likae tung'ani, pee metumi ake olopik esiaai ang entiyoto.

English: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.
Masaai: naa ore enkaraki ina kitoo naishoo Enkai ninye eikirikirate iltung'ana pooki, o loreren, o lng'ejepa neureishoyu te dukuya ninye; ore oloyieu near metua near metua; ore oloyieu neitopok neitopok; ore ilo oyieu neilepie, neilepie, ore oloyieu neitadou neitadou.

English: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
Masaai: amu eewuo olchore lai eing'uaa nkang'itie nemaata entoki naisho.’

English: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino amu kitishipakine ninye iyie nikipik iyie olorika lenye le nkitoo pee iyaku olaiguanani te rishata o Laitoriani Enkai ino! Ore amu kenyor Olaitoriani Enkai ino Israel naa keitasheyie ninche ntarasi, kintaa ninye iyie olaiguanani lenye, pee itum aiguanayu te sipata o te supatisho.”

English: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
Masaai: neitalaku te lelo ooiba ninye, eidaikie ninche; meshololo te lelo ooiba ninye, keitalaku te ninye teine ake.

English: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Meetae hoo ng'ae oiteng'elaki, oidimi aaidaikie tukul tiatua iltung'ana oidimi aatokordu keari ake metua.

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
Masaai: niyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani; amu eitu imbung alotie nkitanapat aainei, arashu isujaa nkiguanat aainei, kake itaasa anaa enatiu nkitanapat oo loshon lelo likimanita iyie.”

English: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin okuni neya ninye. Ore to lari le ile le nkitoria e Hesekia laa ninye olioudo le nkitoria e Hoshea, olaiguanani le Israel, neyai Samaria.

English: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina entanyaanyukie ate Enkai anaa nkera kutiti naanyorri.

English: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
Masaai: Neisho ninche Kiriat-arba (aa Arba taa menye le Anak) aa Hebron taa ina, ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Yuda, te nebo nene wuejitin neeirritishoreki neemanita.

English: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
Masaai: Amu etipika Esra oltau lenye pee eiteng'enuo enkitanapata o Laitoriani, neas ninye, neitengenisho nkiguanat enyena, o nkikoo enyena tiatua Israel.

English: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
Masaai: o layiok le Shefatia, o layiok le Hatil, o layiok le Pokeret-hasebaim, tenebo ilayiok le Ami.

English: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
Masaai: Te ng'iriata eidimi aailejileja olaiguanani le nkop, naa ore olng'ejep omelok naa kegil oloito.

English: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
Masaai: Ahimaas menye le Asaria, Asaria menye le Yohanan,

English: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo keek olng'aboli, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.’

English: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
Masaai: Ore pee kipuonu Yerusalem, neng'amu iyook ilalashera te nchipai.

English: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Uria enetii ninye, neikilikuanu Daudi enaasita Yoab o eneikununo iltung'ana, o eneikunari olarrabal.

English: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
Masaai: Na kera esaa nabayie ena, naa ore amu itoning'o aajo kelotu Oloiba Kristo, eidipa doi taata aaetu ilooiba Kristo kumok, te ina kiyiolo aajo esaa nabayie ena.

English: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam Yohanan olayioni le Karea, “Miaas iyie ena bae, amu irorita iyie te lejare tialo Ishamel.”

English: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
Masaai: Kake eewuo oltung'ani le Nkai enetii ninye nejoki, “Lo aiguanani, mincho enjore e Israel elo tenebo iyie, amu metii Olaitoriani tenebo Isiraeli, tenebo kulo pooki le Efraim.

English: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
Masaai: Ore apa te Listra netii oltung'ani otonita otuata nkejek, olaa olmaima pee eini, leitu ai kata elo too nkejek.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore nena baa nitejo naa kaas; amu inoto kirotetisho too nkonyek aainei, naa kaayiolo nanu iyie enkarna.”

English: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
Masaai: Ore entemet enye neado alang enkop, nelala alang enaiposha.

English: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya ninche, neomonoki lelo ooiruko pee eng'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati;

English: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
Masaai: naa kayau nanu intae ongota too loshon, najing te ine enkiguana tenebo intae king'ura too nkomomi.

English: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
Masaai: Nejoki Eli Samuel, “Shomo, irraga; naa ti nikimpot ninye tejo, ‘Iroro, Olaitoriani, amu ening'ito osinka lino.’ ” Nelo Samuel airrag te wueji enye.

English: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
Masaai: o nena pooki naaitaasa ninye ilaiguanak loo Lamori apa otii lido kekun Yordan, Sihon ilo aiguanani le Heshbon, o Oog olaiguanani le Bashan ilo apa omanya Ashtarot.

English: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
Masaai: Kake lido Autaroni, ora Enkiyang'et Sinyati oirriu Papa te nkarna ai, oitayiolo intae imbaa pooki neitadamu intae nena pooki natolikio intae.

English: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
Masaai: Ore eekenyata pooki o ltung'ani naa tenkaraki enkoshoke ake, nemeraposho ake te sumash enye. Kainyoo elang'ie ilo ng'en olmodai?

English: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
Masaai: Neitayu Olaitoriani oltoilo lenye, te dukuya enjore enye, amu aikitok oleng olorora lenye ore ilo olimu ororei lenye neeta engolon. Amu ore ina olong o Laitoriani naa kitok neitureisho oleng, aing'ae oidim ating'iria?

English: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
Masaai: Neiko neijia nkolong'i kumok. Kake ore Paulo, etanyamala oleng neibelekenya nejoki ilo oirirua, “Aaitanapa iyie te nkarna e Yesu Kristo tupuku tung'uai ninye.” Nepuku aing'uaa te ina saa ake.

English: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
Masaai: Nintayuyu intae te nkolong e dukuya ilng'anayio le lelo keek sidain, o ilng'osil loo ltuka, o ilng'osil lo lchani olit, ning'idayuyu te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi nkolong'i naapishana.

English: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
Masaai: Netiu neijia, amu etaasa apa iltung'ana le Israel eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninye oitayio ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, neitupuku te nkaina e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri. Eteserema ninche kulie aitin,

English: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
Masaai: o kulo alashera ootii te nebo nanu. Isirito e Galatia aigeroki:

English: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.
Masaai: Ore to sina ning'or iyie te nkong'u o lom ina karsisisho pooki nayookini aaisho Israel; nemeitoki ae kata atii oltung'ani kitok atua enkaji ino ntarasi.

English: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aashuko Yerusalem aaing'uaa oldoinyo oji Olooloirienito otaaniki Yerusalem oba anaa elototo e nkolong e sabato.

English: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
Masaai: Ore hoo duoo ninye neirorie Yosef anaake neitu ening Yosef ninye, peyie eirrag tenebo ninye, arashu eisiritore ninye.

English: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
Masaai: Neing'asia ninche oleng, nejoki ninche ninye, “Ae ng'ae naa kenya oidim atajeu?”

English: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Irara intae ile abori; nara nanu ole shumata; nirara intae ile na kop; nemara nanu ole na kop.

English: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
Masaai: Neiturrurro ninche te nebo, neisudori, neing'oru iroruat aainei. Anaa enataanyutua ninche enkishui ai,

English: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
Masaai: Neyau ake pooki tung'ani enkishooroto enye, ntokitin e nkosholai o ne sahabu, o lkarash, o manemane, o enkorropil, o mbartan, o nyumpui, neyau nkumok te pooki ari.

English: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ira apa iyie supat te nkop ino; itorrinyuo iyie olpisiai le Yakobo.

English: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee akurraki nkonyek aing'or, nadol ajo, ng'uesi e nkop oo nkejek maa ong'uan, o ng'uesi e ong'ata, o ntokitin naaikurtutari o motonyi e shumata.

English: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
Masaai: Neibung Daudi nkilani enyena, nepolos, neiko sii neijia lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye;

English: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
Masaai: naa ore pee eyiolouni eneba enkarsisisho e nkitoo enye te lelo laa olng'ur eitobirakaki, naa ninye sii oitera aitobiraki ninche te dukuya te nkitoo enye,

English: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani Daudi atua neton te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, “Kara nanu ng'ae, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kainyoo enkaji ai, metaa eikiyaua nanu eneba nji?

English: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
Masaai: Iyie na Ai ai, aaishiraka nanu dama kake eitu iyie kiwaliki; naaishiraki kewarie, kake eitu nanu atum enkiyeng'iyeng.

English: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
Masaai: Enchoo Moab inaipuko, amu kelotu ninye tiaai, keaku nkanas enyena ilmuateni meetae olomanya atua ninche.

English: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
Masaai: Meetae enaimulumularo nemeibalunyeki, aashu enaisudoro nemeyiolouni.

English: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.
Masaai: Ira iyie sidai anaa Tirsah, olanyor lai ira sidai anaa Yerusalem, keitureisho anaa enjore naata inankan.

English: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu Olaitoriani! Toduaa enyamali naata te nkaraki lelo laaiba, Iyie ilo laadumu nanu aitung'uaa nchomito e keeya,

English: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
Masaai: Ore ilo oishu, ilo oishu, ninye likincho enashe, anaa enaasita nanu ena olong; neitayiolo menye nkera enyena esupatisho ino.

English: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
Masaai: Ore sii nchoo inapa masaa e sahabu o ne nkosholai e nkaji e Nkai naawa Nebukadnesa te nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neya Babilon, errinyuni aayau atua ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neyauni ake pooki nabo ewueji enye, nipik ninche atua enkaji e Nkai.”

English: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
Masaai: o lgululu iip ong'uan ooikodieki ina siaai e ripare oo usin, te nkarasha ake nabo, pee eimulumul nena girran pokira are naatii nchumat e nena ng'apeta.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Anaa enatonyorra apa aitaas intae intorrok aitame ina kata pee aaitagor iloo papaai linyi te ng'oro sapuk, neitu arriny endamunoto ai, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani,

English: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
Masaai: neyau ninye aitinyiku enkaji enye oltung'ani ake oltung'ani, neyae Akan, olayioni le Karmi, olayioni le Sabdi, olayioni le Sera lo losho le Yuda.

English: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te nerikoki emodai oltung'ani enkoitoi enkidaaroto, negorokino oltau lenye Olaitoriani.

English: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
Masaai: Ore hoo netaasa ilmonek kumok etii ninche eitu eiruk ninche ninye,

English: But thou shalt in any wise let the dam go, and take the young to thee; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days.
Masaai: nchoo ng'otonye elo kake indim aawa nkera; pee iserianu, nitum sii atobikoi.

English: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
Masaai: Amu maitoki nanu aing'urrie lelo oomanya ena kop, Olaitoriani ojo, ng'ura, kaisho nanu iltung'ana metabatatakinoyu, oltung'ani ake, inkaik olchekut lenye, oltung'ani ake nkaik o laiguanani lenye, naa kepuo ninche aarrarrakino enkop, nemakordu nanu hoo obo too nkaik enye.”

English: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa kagelu ninche meitasheiki ina aji e Nkai, peyie atum aas esiaai pooki naasi tiatua ninye.

English: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
Masaai: Anaa keidim oltung'ani ashomo aitunyoi inkuk naaishu, aimenya indapi enyena enkima?

English: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani alotu te nkolong e naapishana, aing'uraa, ore pee eidapashakine enkeeya isunta eina aji,

English: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Daudi ilkiliku Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, ejoki, “Nchooki nanu enkitok ai Mikal, naa ninye apa atisira te nkinyang'a oo suaten iip oo Lfilisti.”

English: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD'S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
Masaai: neaku ore pooki ng'ae oipang'u aimu nkutukie e nkaji ai, pee aalotu anang'are nanu, te narrinyo alotu aisula ile Amon, neaku olo Laitoriani, naishoru nanu ninye metaa olasar opejori.”

English: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Finehas naa Gershom. Ore too layiok le Itamar, naa Daniel, ore too layiok le Daudi naa Hatush,

English: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Eton aa kumok kulo tung'ana oleng; toriko ninche metadoi aapuo enkare pee atem nanu ninche te ine; ore olaajoki nanu, ‘Kelo ele tung'ani te nebo iyie,’ nelo te nebo iyie, ore oloba anaa olaajoki, ‘Melo ele tung'ani te nebo iyie’, melo ninye.”

English: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
Masaai: Neitayu sii ninye eilata nasinya naputishoreki enkorropil naisonkoyo naaitushula olaitobirani loo sonkoyoni.

English: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo arripok loo nchomito netii imatuan ong'uan, oloosaen, o loontoluo, o kopikop o moikuape;

English: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
Masaai: Intayu ilala onom le sahabu oololo paa ninche intutumie entukus oo lkarash o enkae pee eaku enkaji e Nkai entoki nabo.

English: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, neji ine Beer-sheba, amu te ine einosa pokira oare olmumai.

English: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Elija le Tishibi, ejo,

English: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, nchoo eunoyu ilo rorei lino, apa lirorie osinka lino Daudi.

English: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
Masaai: Amu ntasheyie iyie esipata ai; itotona iyie to lorika le nkitoo ninguana te sipata.

English: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
Masaai: Mintayuyu ake enkorropil nemesinya te nchumata te ine, arashu olasar opejori, arashu olasar le nkurma naidong'o nimibukokiki olasar opikuni.

English: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
Masaai: Neaku etanya apa Edom eisho Isirael enkoitoi naaim te nkop enye, nerrinyo Isiraeli aaing'uaa ninye.

English: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
Masaai: Ore pee eaku teipa nedoiyio ilooiteng'eni lenyena aapuo enaiposha,

English: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
Masaai: Maarikino ae kata nanu nkitanapat inono; amu te ninche nanu kinchoo iyie enkishui.

English: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
Masaai: Tenelotu oltung'ani orupati loo mboreitin tikitam, tomon ake etum; te nelotu oltung'ani olchumati le naisho oo sabibu, ajo aaoku mboreitin onom, tikitam ake naatii.

English: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul ilo anapani lenye loo masaa o larrabal, “Tushutu olalem lino, taremieki nanu matua, pee maapuonu ake kulo tung'ana lememurata aasul.” Kake etanya ilo anapani loo masaa enyena o larrabal; amu etureishe ninye oleng. Ore enkaraki ina neshutu Saul olalem lenye makewan nebatatakino.

English: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
Masaai: Te nkidetidet o nduaat e kewarie, ina kata najing injo nairoishi iltung'ana ina kata eimugito too ndapashi enye,

English: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
Masaai: Ore ilpereren linyi naa keaku mijoonto ore ilpereren le nkorropil inyi naa kegili; ore lelo linyi ootaraki metuata nanang'aa ninche te dukuya inkitanyaanyukot inyi oo nkaitin.

English: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Oholibama entito e Ana olayioni le Sibeon, enkitok e Esau: Etoikio ninche Esau Yeush, o Yalam o Kora.

English: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
Masaai: Ore pee eidapasha entumo, nesuj Ilyahudi kumok o kulikae ooure Enkai Paulo o Barnaba: neirorie ninche lelo neitirrishaki metobiko te mpiris e Nkai.

English: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
Masaai: Naa eikintoki ninye airriwaki iyie imuoyiaritin pooki e Misiri, nena apa niure; naa eikisuj ninche.

English: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
Masaai: Nelotu Filipo neliki Andrea; nepuonu Andrea o Filipo neliki Yesu.

English: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: ore too wuejitin pooki oo sabibu naa keaku e nkishirata, amu kaim nanu atua empolos inyi.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo oirienito aare, o lelo kilang'ilang'eta aare ooitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop.

English: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aaitirrishaki iyie pee irriu entorroni, neitu nanu ang'uar enkolong e mutai, iyiolo iyie; ore ina napuku tiatua enkutuk ai netii dukuya enkomom ino.

English: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
Masaai: Neitayu Musa lelo kilani le Aron, neishopoki Eliesa olayioni lenye; neye Aron te ine te nchumata o ldoinyo. Neitoki Musa o Eliesa aadou te ilo doinyo.

English: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, etawale ninye atum ae mua, neitalioo kewan te kulikae aare lenye epuo nkurman.

English: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
Masaai: Nebulita lelo Omon Supati aaiu ilng'anayio te nkop pooki; naa enaikuna ti atua intae ebaiki ina olong apa nining'ining'i empiris e Enkai niyiolouwu te sipata,

English: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
Masaai: Neme seuseu ake, kake ore sii ninche iyiook, ooidipa aanoto enkishorunoto e Nkiyang'et naiturukuo te kulie naapuonu, nikinchirita sii iyiook ti atua ate kiaanyu meitaa Enkai iyiook inkera enyena, neitabaya elakunoto ang.

English: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
Masaai: Naa enkarna enye eyooki Loreren aaisilig.”

English: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
Masaai: ore pee eirut neirrugo aaing'orie nkomomi enye enkop, nejoki lelo lewa, “Ainyoo pee ing'oruru oloishu to lootuata?

English: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
Masaai: Kake entubulu te mpiris o te yiolounoto o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo. Metaa enenye enkitoo te pokira, taata o metabaiki ina olong oo ntarasi.

English: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: ninchooyoyo olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; oloing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto;

English: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
Masaai: o Asaria olayioni le Hilkia, olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Sadok, ilo aitasheikinoni kitok le nkaji e Nkai.

English: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
Masaai: Mebaya eng'eno ang, nemebaya enaibon ang;

English: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.
Masaai: Neitayu olaiguanani olgisoi ashurtu te nkaina enye neisho Haman le Agag ole Hamedata, olmang'atinta loo Lyahudi.

English: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
Masaai: pee aa ninye eitukuyie Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye o nkejek enye.

English: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nelo Musa atua ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho; naa ng'ura, ore eng'udi e Aron te nkaji e Lawi etijing'a nkaitubulu nejing ilng'osil neitapuku, neiu ilng'anayio ooto.

English: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
Masaai: Neitutum ninye ilkarash imiet maate, o lkarash ile maate.

English: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
Masaai: Topolosa olkuoo obo le ker tadekenya, ore olikae kuo le ker nipolos teipa.

English: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo ninche, “Eming'asia; Yesu le Nasaret ing'oruru, otashoki. Etopiwuo, metii ene; eng'ora enapa wueji neirragieki ninye.

English: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
Masaai: “Najoki nanu ntae, ore pooki laaibalie te dukuya ltung'ana, neibalie sii ninye Enkerai e Tung'ani ninye te dukuya ilmalaika le Nkai.

English: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
Masaai: “Te nejoki intae ina kata oltung'ani, ‘Nele Kristo otii ene!’, anaa ‘Nelido otii idie!’; emiruk.

English: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
Masaai: neetae enkoliai te ina anasa nalotu anaa ake enetii ajoki, ‘Tomituoki sii ake te le mang'atinta.’

English: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
Masaai: Aishoo ninye enkata meirridu, kake etanya eirridu te loloito enye.

English: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore amu imbung'a ororei lai te nyuaata o eng'iriata, ekaarrip te ina saa oo ntemat nalotu enkop pooki, atem lelo ootii enkop.

English: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
Masaai: Keurori ninche aabatata; kake kidumunye iyiook nikintashe aaitoriori.

English: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
Masaai: “Tenepuo iltung'ana linono olarrabal aagilunore ilmang'ati lenye, ore te pooki oitoi niimie iyie ninche; nikiomon ninche iyie eing'or ena anasa nitegelua, iyie o ena aji natesheta nanu te nkarna ino,

English: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
Masaai: “Mintayu ake osarge lo lasar lai te nebo entoki naisuijo, nimincho sii olasar lo sirua le Ngiroroto eirrag o mekenyu.

English: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aaing'uaa Kadesh, ore lelo tung'ana le Israel ina umata pooki, nepuonu oldoinyo le Hor.

English: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
Masaai: Eing'oru kulo tung'ana torrok lena kata olmonekie kake meishori likae leme olapa le Yona.” Nelo aing'uaa ninche.

English: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
Masaai: Ore ti alo nanu te ilo ari le dukuya le Darias loo Lmede, aitasho aitisip ninye napik engolon.

English: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
Masaai: Ore enkiterunoto e nchankar netiu anaa oltung'ani opolol olong'elu le nkare; metaa shomo tung'uai eton eitu ebau olarrabal.

English: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
Masaai: Tokordu ilo oshal o ilo aisinani; tokordu ninche ntung'uai enkaina e ilo torrono.”

English: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
Masaai: Tonyuaa ake duoo iyie nintagoluo oleng, ning'or pee ias te risioroto e nena kitanapat pooki apa nikintanapa Musa osinka lai; mimbelekenya apaash alo enkaina e tatene aashu ene kedienye, pee itum aisula te pooki wueji neba anaa enilo.

English: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
Masaai: Kaatayie nanu enchipai keeya e ilo torrono, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, neme nchere pee eibelekenya ninye te nkoitoi enye neton eishu?

English: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eikena apa Musa ilkikaunot pooki ti atua iltung'ana le Israel, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
Masaai: Iwa enkila oltung'ani te neitayio ajo kelak esile olomoni, nimbung ninye to rorei le nkutuk enye nchere keitasheiki olomoni te sile.

English: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
Masaai: Nipalaki iyiook ing'ok ang, anaa te nikipalaki sii iyiook ilooinyal iyiook. Nimirik iyiook atua ntemat.”

English: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
Masaai: Amu eilepu enkolong eirowua, nepej intapuka nemugut, nedoiyio, nerruoyo empukunoto e sidano enye. Neijia ake etiu oltung'ani karsis, kerruoyo eitoritote mbaa enyena pooki.

English: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura to lalem apa etabatatate loo papa o ilayiok lang, o ntoyie ang, ore nkituaak ang naatii netii atua eyararoto tenkaraki ena.

English: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: neiteleiki ninye nkaik enyena shumata ninye, neitanap ninye aisho enkitoo anaa enatuutua Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak oopishana nenap imouarak naapishana oo lmeregeshi te dukuya ilo sanduku; ore te nkolong e naapishana, nimanimana enkanasa katitin naapishana, ekutita ilapolosak imouarak:

English: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
Masaai: Nidolitata, nining'itoto aajo mme te Efeso ake, kake etaa ore ninye Asia pooki, eibelekenye eilejileja ilo oji Paulo ltung'ana kumok aitapong'oo, ajoki eji mme hoo nkaitin kuna naa too nkaik eitobiri.

English: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
Masaai: Ore to lapa le imiet, te nkolong e tomon o lapa aa olari apa le tomon ooudo le nkitoria o laiguanani Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon ore Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore apa oisiaai olaiguanani le Babilon, nejing Yerusalem.

English: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
Masaai: Netiu enkomom enye anaa enkiwuang'ata, neibor inkilani enyena anaa empaso.

English: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
Masaai: Ore Yosef naa olng'osila oiu ilng'anayio, olng'osila loo lng'anayio te nkong'u enkare; eibulaa ilng'osil lenyena esuntai.

English: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatiu apa too nkolong'i e Noah, neijia etiu too nkolong'i e Nkerai e Tung'ani.

English: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
Masaai: Nebul too nkoitoi enyena nkatitin pooki; ore nkiguanat inono netii shumata, mebaiki ninye; ore ilmang'ati lenyena pooki neikordod ninche.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel,

English: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
Masaai: Nekurraki pooki inkonyek aing'or, neitoki ajoki ilo tung'ani, “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neiko neijia, neishiu enkaina enye.

English: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
Masaai: Ore eilata e ng'ues natua openy, o eilata eina natara ilowuarak, neidimi aataasishore tiae oitoi, kake meeta nchere pee inosa intae.

English: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.
Masaai: Kake kaakordu kenya nanu iyie teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, nimikinchoori iyie aapik atua enkaina e lelo tung'ana liure.

English: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
Masaai: Kake ore intae ooibung'a aakurraki nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, ninchushu pooki ena olong.

English: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
Masaai: Kuaak, ening'o oltoilo loo ltung'ana kumok, eikurrukur ninche anaa enkikurrukur e naiposha! kuak, enkikurrukur oo loreren kumok eikurrukur ninche anaa e nkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok!

English: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
Masaai: Enkoitoi olkurragos to loing'ang'e, enkoitoi olasurai te ndapidapoi, enkoitoi emeli te mpolos oo naaiposha, o enkoitoi e tung'ani eboitare eselenkei.

English: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;
Masaai: nitumokiki taa aaikilikuanu nikililitu aaitirrishaki; naa ng'ura tenaa kesipa neibale nchere etaasaki ena toki nadiaa tiatua intae.

English: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
Masaai: Amu, “Ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani naa neitajeuni.”

English: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
Masaai: Eilepa ninye alo Rimon, eewuo ninye Aiat; etudung'o ninye enkop e Migron, ore te Mikmash neshum ninye olola lenye;

English: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
Masaai: Enoto naa entirishu eng'ues nasinyari o enemesinyari, o te motonyi nasinyari o enemesinyari, emindurukie naa ate te ng'ues aashu emotonyi aashu tiae toki naikurtutari te nkop, apa natorishie nanu intae nchere mesinyari.

English: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Simion Shelumiel olayioni le Shurishadi;

English: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
Masaai: Ina peyie ewalu Laban ajoki Yakobo, “Ore kuna toyie naa inaainei, ore kuna kera naa inaainei, ore kuna tare naa inaainei, naa ore pooki nidolita naa inaainei. Kake kaa naa aitaas kuna toyie aainei ena olong arashu inkera enye naatoiutuo ninche? Wou taata maitayu olning'o terishata ai o iyie;

English: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
Masaai: Ore teneasi esipata, naa enchipai too supati, naa enking'asia too laasak loo ntorrok.

English: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu airorie ninche, too nkitanyaanyukot ejo:

English: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
Masaai: “Atolikio intae kuna baa, eton aboitare intae.

English: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
Masaai: Ore ina aji nalo nanu ashet naa keaku kitok, amu ore Enkai ang naa aikitok alang nkaitin pooki.

English: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
Masaai: Nejo Yoram, “Entobira engarri ai oo mbartan.” Neipang'u Yoram olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda, meetae ake olemetii engarri enye oo mbartan, nepuo aanang'are Yehu, nepuo aanang'aa te wueji e Nabot le Yesreel.

English: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
Masaai: Enchoo nkirorot inyi nkatitin pooki eaku ine mborron naata emunyan, pee itumutumu aatayiolo enijojo te niwalikiki pooki ng'ae.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Isaakar te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena - nena anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ngero ele tung'ani ajo meeta nkera, ele tung'ani lemedupoyu too nkolong'i enyena; amu meetae hoo obo tiatua eishoi enye odupoyu atonie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi, neitoki aitoreisho te Yuda.”

English: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ilo oiteng'eni, “Ng'ura ng'utunyi.” Ore ebaiki ina kata nerik ilo oiteng'eni ninye enkang enye.

English: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
Masaai: Ore Nehemia laa ninye apa olbalusui, o Esra ilo apolosani naa olaigeroni, o Lawi laa ninche ooiteng'en iltung'ana, nejoki iltung'ana pooki, “Ore ena olong naa aisinyati to Laitoriani Enkai inyi; emisinanuo niminchirishiri.” Amu eishira apa iltung'ana pooki ina kata pee ening irorei loo nkitanapat.

English: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
Masaai: ore to losho le Isaakar naa Igal olayioni le Yosef;

English: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
Masaai: te neiturrurro iloreren te nebo, o nkitoriat, pee eserem Olaitoriani.

English: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le ng'oro napi naa kedumu olarrabal, naa ore oltung'ani oota engoro naa keyau ntorrok kumok.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ekanang'aki orreshet lai shumata iyie; tenebo olorora sapuk loo ltung'ana; naa kaaikurtutaa iyie tiatua orreshet lai.

English: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
Masaai: Ore oltoilo le nkinanta netigire, ore ilo toilo le nchipai netigire, ore oltoilo lolwulul loo usin neitigiraki.

English: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariki nanu atua olgoriet liatua le nkalo e moikuape, naariku nanu atua ilgilat ooipirare enkalo olodungoro le nkaji e Nkai netii sii enkae alo eina aji natii moikuape.

English: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
Masaai: Neye sii Eliesa olayioni le Aron nenukaa ninche ninye te Gibeya, te nkang e Finehas olayioni lenye, apa naishooki ninye ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim.

English: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nataasa entaboi tiatua Israel, etololoitote too nkituaak oo lelatia enye, neiroro ninche, te nkarna ai irorei le lejare leitu nanu aitanap ninche. Nanu ilo oyiolo naa nanu olchakeni, Olaitoriani ojo.’ ”

English: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Kalotu aishiunye.”

English: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: kake ore sorri e nkayaitie o loilelek neituku ninye te nkare. Ore ilo apolosani neitayu olasar pooki, nepejoo ninye to lperere lo lasar, olasar ninye opejori, olasar le mpejoroto te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
Masaai: Amu eaku ninye kitok te dukuya Olaitoriani, nemeok enaisho oo sabibu arashu enaisho napi, naa keigany Enkiyang'et Sinyati ebaiki etii enkoshoke e ng'otonye.

English: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninye, “Ore oloidipa aitukuoyu meitoki ayieu enkitukuo meteleku nkejek enyena, tuan pooki wueji enye, nirara intae tuani, kake mme intae pooki;”

English: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
Masaai: Neyakini olkilikuai aajoki, “Etii ng'utunyi o lalashera linono boo, eitashe, kiyieu nikitumore.”

English: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
Masaai: Amu ore inkoitoi oltung'ani netii dukuya Olaitoriani, naa keing'orita ninye irrekiei lenyena pooki.

English: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
Masaai: Nemeinok sii ltung'ana oltaa nepising to ltoo, kake eiteleiki olperere; neitawang'aki pooki ootii aji.

English: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
Masaai: Aimetiu ororei lai anaa enkima, Olaitoriani ojo, netiu anaa enyuntu nabelibel endapidapoi?

English: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
Masaai: Netem enkadori e ilo gilata, intemat e nkaina tikitam, o endapasho enye, intemat e nkaina tikitam, tinigiroo olgilata le mpolos. Naajoki ninye nanu, ore ene naa ewueji sinyati aisul.

English: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e keper laaitayio nanu te nkaji e papaai lai o te nkop apa naatoinyieki, laairorie naainosie olmumai aajoki, ‘Iishoritin inono aisho ena kop.’ Ekeirriwaa olmalaika lenye te dukuya iyie, naa ilo iyie arikoki olayioni lai entito te ine.

English: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
Masaai: Nedou Olaitoriani alotu kop te ng'ape neitashe te kutukaji o lng'obor, neipot Aron o Miriam, nepuonu pokira are dukuya.

English: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Ore lelo pereren loo lasarri ootii enchumata enkaji e shumata e nkaji e Ahas, apa naaitobira ilaiguanak le Yuda, o lpereren apa ooitobira Manase too lgorieti pokira oare le nkaji o Laitoriani, nesulu ninche aitadou nebel aitaa mbelibelat, nenang'aki ina punyua enye atua oerata le Kedron.

English: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
Masaai: Ore naa ilo leitu eisiaayu toki kake neiruk ilo oikenaki isipat oleme supat, neikenaki Enkai enkirukoto enye nchere esupatisho.

English: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, eing'orita ninche, neilepieki aaya keper neitemoo enkatampoi arishie nkonyek enye.

English: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Kamir nanu ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono apik nkaik oo layiok le Yuda, naa kepuo ninche aamiraki lelo oshon le Sabea, oolakua, amu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Musa aigero irorei lena kitanapata tiatua embuku, omeitabaiki enkiting'oto,

English: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
Masaai: Enchoru iltung'ana okuni ake to losho, pee airriwaa nanu ninche meshomo aailep nedou te ina kop, nasirakino ninche anaa injung'oreitin enye, neitoki ninche aapuonu enatii nanu.

English: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
Masaai: Nejo Barnaba Seu; nejo Paulo Herme, amu ninye oljartan to rorei.

English: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
Masaai: Aing'orua oleng te ndamunoto ai enaiko te naitiship osesen lai te naisho oo sabibu neton ake aarikito endamunoto ai arikoo te ng'eno nagut, o enaiko te natum aibung emodai o metaba anaa nadol ina apa naji aisidai too nkera oo ltung'ana neas tiabori keper te nena kuti olong'i e nkishui enye.

English: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
Masaai: Nebol ilo gos le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie, neilepu empuruo te ilo gos naikununo anaa empuruo o lkokuet sapuk, nemisimisu enkolong, o enkijape te ina puruo napuku te ina gumoto.

English: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
Masaai: Meisikong'isho ninye anaake, nemeibung engoro enye ntarasi.

English: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
Masaai: Tayiolo naa ena olong nchere ore ilo oloito te dukuya intae anaa enkima nanyaisho naa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; keidaikie ninche neishie ninche te dukuya intae; metaa ipuopuo intae aamiraa ninche, nimutumutu ninche nabo kata, anaa enaisiligie Olaitorianiintae.

English: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
Masaai: nchoo metishipayu enkop, o pooki toki natii atua! Neranyisho taa ilkeek pooki le ntim te ng'ida

English: For our God is a consuming fire.
Masaai: amu ore Enkai ang naa enkima namutisho.

English: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kenutayu entito neiu enkayioni; nejo ninche enkarna enye Immanuel;” naa eji, “Enkai te nebo iyiook.”

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i,” Olaitoriani ojo, “ore ilo oturisho neinepu ilo oisampisho ore ilo oirony ilng'anayio neinepu ilo ounisho; ore ildoinyo neitong'u enaisho namelok, neruko too ildoinyo pooki.

English: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Asahel ilo alashe le Yoab ninye apa oliong'uan, to lapa liong'uan, naa olayioni lenye Sebadia osujaki ninye; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, ‘Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e keper, naaisho nanu nkitoriat pooki enkop, naaitanap ninye nanu pee ashetaki ninye enkaji te Yerusalem. Aa taa te Yuda. Ore pooki ng'ae tiatua intae, te kulo tung'ana pooki nchoo eaku Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye, nchoo ninye eilep alo.’ ”

English: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
Masaai: Metaa eitobirua Yosef nkiguanat naaipirta enkop e Misiri, neitashe nena kiguanat o taata, inchere etum Farao ematua e imiet; enkop ake oo lapolosak neitu eaku ene Farao.

English: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, kaa dung'et e rashe ena niata naipirta ena kop e Israel, ijo, ‘Etoodoro inkolong'i, ore pooki duaata nelotu aaku enemeetae.’ Tiaaki naa ninche,

English: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Yesu Galilaya ebore engolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, neibulaa enkisisa, nkuapi naamanita.

English: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
Masaai: Neitoki Elisha aomon nejo, “Olaitoriani, aatoomono iyie tabolo nkonyek enyena pee etum atoduaa.” Nebol Olaitoriani nkonyek eilo barnoti, nedol ninye, naa ng'ura, ebore ilo doinyo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan e nkima naamanita Elisha.

English: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
Masaai: kalo sii airo enchakenisho ino te dukuya ilaiguanak, nemaaitukurruni nanu;

English: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Elam, naa Yeshaia olayioni le Atalia, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa ntomoni naapishana.

English: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
Masaai: Kake minyorraa ina nayieu ninche; amu artam nadooyo iltung'ana lenye ootii olnukata aaresh ninye, eteena ate to lmumai aajo menya endaa nemeok toki mme keidipa aatar ninye metua; neidipa taata aatanapata, iyie eanyita tonyorrai ina.”

English: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
Masaai: kejing ilalema lenye atua iltuaja lenye maate, ore nkai enye naa kegila.

English: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
Masaai: pee kitum sii iyiook aatotiu anaa nkuapi pooki, netum sii olaiguanani lang aitoria iyiook, nerikoo ninye iyiook, nearisho ninye too larrabali lang.”

English: And they found among the inhabitants of  Jabeshgilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: Netum ninche tiatua lelo oomanya Yabesh-gilead iselenken iip ong'uan nemeyiolo olee, neriku ninche ilng'oborri te Shilo, naa enkop e Kanaan etii.

English: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika li oopishana aosh entarumpeta enye, netii iltoiloishi sapuki shumata oojo, “Etaa enkitoo e nkop enkitoo o Laitoriani lang o ene Kristo lenye, naa keitoreisho ninye intarasi o ntarasi.”

English: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: “Tenelo neas ing'ok oltung'ani aas nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi, hoo duoo ninye nemeyiolo, ore ake eyia netaa ninye oloitarruoyie naa kenap ninye enkitarruorroto enye.

English: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.
Masaai: Kebaa esapuko oo lmonek lenyena le nking'asia, kebaa enkidimata oo mbaa enyena e nking'asia! Ore enkitoria enye naa enkitoria oo ntarasi, ore enkitoo enye nebaiki iishoritin o ishoritin.

English: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
Masaai: nemeyau ninye kutukaji eilo ng'bor le ntumo, pee eishooyo anaa enkishooroto to Laitoriani te dukuya ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, neikenakini ilo tung'ani aajo eata entioto o sarge; eibukoyie ninye osarge; neyae ilo tung'ani aaiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kaa intae iututu pee kiwaliki kulo tung'ana laatiaakita ninche nanu, “Nteneneng'a enchata ang oo murto apa natipika papaai lino shumata iyiook?’ ”

English: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
Masaai: Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani, “Ore anaa enaikurrukur olng'atuny anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny te ina ng'ues natara, naa te neipotuni olturrur loo lairritak meetu aarare ninye, nemeiture ninye nena buakunot enye aashu eirutie enkilepilep enye, neijia eikununye Olaitoriani te nedou alotu aitayu olarrabal te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion, o te shumata endoinyo enye.

English: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
Masaai: Ajoki nanu intae, ore pooki ng'ae oorore enkitok enye neme enkaraki eloloito neyam ae, netololoite, ore oloyam enda natoororeki naa keloloito.”

English: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
Masaai: Ore hoo nejo ninche, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,” kake ore eyia, enya ninche olmumai te lejare.

English: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
Masaai: Ore ina kata te netii ilewa oare enkurma, neyae obo neing'uari olikae.

English: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye tiongata e Sin neun ilng'oborri te Dofka.

English: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD'S release.
Masaai: Naa nji eikununo ina palakino; ore pooki tung'ani oisilenishe nepalaa ina naisilenoko ole latia enye; meitalaku ninye to le latia enye, o to lalashe lenye, enkaraki naibalunyeki empalakinoto o Laitoriani.

English: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Yehoshafat etua anaa loo menye, nenukari tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye, te rishata enye.

English: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
Masaai: Neipot Paulo obo le lelo sajinini nejo, “Toriko ele barnoti enetii olkitok loo sikarini, amu keeta enajoki.”

English: For he clave to the LORD, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Eiruko apa ninye Olaitoriani, eitu epaash esujata enye, kake eibung'a nena kitanapat apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on,) but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.
Masaai: Ore epuoito ninche auluo ina ang, nejoki Samuel Saul, “Tiaaki ele sinka meituruko alo dukuya iyiook, ore eidipa aituruko, ntasho iyie tene te nkiti rishata, pee atum aibalunye te iyie ororei le Nkai.”

English: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
Masaai: Eeuo ena pooki shumata olaiguanani Nebukadnesa.

English: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
Masaai: Neaku ashomo enetii olmalaika najoki ninye maaishoo nanu ilo piyayati le mbuku. Naajoki ninye nanu, “Tudumu naa inosa. Kelo aduaru te nkoshoke kake kemelok anaa enaisho oo lotorok te nkutuk ino!”

English: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
Masaai: Netii apa oltung'ani obo le Sora, lo losho le Dan, oji enkarna enye Manoa; naa koolupi apa enkitok enye nemeeta nkera.

English: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
Masaai: Te ilo ng'ejep kimayian Olaitoriani o Papa, naa ninye kidekie iltung'ana, lelo ooitobiraki te nkitanyaanyukoto e Enkai.

English: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
Masaai: Amu aitisipa nanu nchere mme keeya, neme enkishui, neme ilmalaika, neme engolon e naimin, ne ntokitin naatii, ne ntokitin naapuonu neme nkitoriat neme enguton, neme ae toki to seuseu pooki, naidim atirishie iyiook enyorrata e Nkai natii Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
Masaai: Neitoki aanyiku nena toyie e Selofehad olayioni le Hefer, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Makir, olayioni le Manase, olayioni le Yosef. Ore apa nkarn e nena toyie enyena naa: Mahala, o Noa, o Hogla, o Milka, o Tirsa.

English: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
Masaai: olayioni le Etni, olayioni le Serak, olayioni le Adaia,

English: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae aadol neng'idayu iltauja linyi; nebulu iloik linyi anaa nkujit; naa kepuoi aayiolou nchere etii enkaina o Laitoriani te nebo isinkan lenyena, ore engoro enye negilunore ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
Masaai: Neboloyu nkonyek enye. Neitanap Yesu nereiki ajoki ninche, “Entodol emincho hoo oltung'ani obo eyiolou.”

English: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Sakaria neirut,

English: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, amu te nkirukoto eikenakaki iyiook isipat, kiaata iyiook eserian te Nkai ti atua Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
Masaai: Neitashe ninche te dukuya Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, o te dukuya lelo arikok o ina umata, te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ejo,

English: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
Masaai: Esipa nchere, ore to lkerreti loo nkitanapat o sarge apake eipoki pooki toki to sarge, naa ore eitu eibukori osarge nemeetae empalakinoto oo ng'ok.

English: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
Masaai: Aaikenakaki nanu lelo oodoiki engumoto; ara nanu oltung'ani lemeeta engolon,

English: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.
Masaai: Neas Asa mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
Masaai: Newaliki Lyahudi aajoki ninye, “Keitu kisip ti nikijo aira Osamariai naa iata oloirirua?”

English: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
Masaai: netum atokordu lelo pooki ooena te nkishui enye pooki enkaraki naure enkeeya.

English: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
Masaai: Ore Yaiel menye le Gibeon nebik te Gibeon, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Maaka.

English: And the way of peace have they not known:
Masaai: nemeiyiolo ninche inkoitoi e seriani.”

English: And the messenger answered and said, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.
Masaai: Ore ilo oyaua lomon newalu ajo, “Eisika Isiraeli te dukuya Ilfilisti, netaaraki sii iltung'ana kumok metuata; etuata sii ilayiok linono pokira oare, Hofni o Finehas, neibung'aki aaya osanduku le Nkai.”

English: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
