English: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
Masaai: nejo, “Ai ti aji irragie?” Nejoki ninche, “Lo Kitok, wou toduaa.”

English: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
Masaai: Etooshoko ninye ninche enkukuo, enkaina enye natoorikia ninche rubat enye too lkererin; kepuo ninche aaya ina kop ntarasi, ore too ishoritin naa kepuo ninche aamany ina kop.

English: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aairriwaki Yesebel olkilikuai ejo, “Etanang'aki Nabot too soito, etua ninye.”

English: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
Masaai: Neitoki sii aaitobir Ilkilani li oriong te nkarasha napiyaya te nkaraki Aron o layiok lenyena,

English: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
Masaai: nejo, “Kaayooki ainining te nebau lelo likintang'or.” Neitanapisho metorripi te nkaji e Herode e nkitoo.

English: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye enkitok, “Kaaponiki nanu emion te ishoi ino, te mion sapuk iiu inkera. Ore iyieunot inono pooki keaku ino lpayian lino, neaku sii ninye likintore iyie.”

English: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
Masaai: Neitasheyie Yakobo eng'ape teine apa neirorie Enkai o ninye eng'ape osoit; nebukoki olasar opikuni enchumata enye, nebukoki eilata shumata enye.

English: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
Masaai: Miar ninche metuata, merikino ake iltung'ana laainei; ndapasha ninche te ngolon ino, nintadou ninche, Olaitoriani, iyie elong'o ang!

English: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.
Masaai: Ore te pooki osho, o te pooki ang, eneba anaa enetabaikia enkitanapata o lkilikuai lo laiguanani, netii enchipai o eng'ida atua Ilyahudi; o sirua o enkisampash. Ore ilkumok te lelo tung'ana le ina kop neibalunye ate aaitaa ate Ilyahudi amu eiputa enkuretisho oo Lyahudi atua ninche.

English: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
Masaai: Etoning'o Olaitoriani enkomono ai, etang'amayie Olaitoriani enkomono ai.

English: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
Masaai: ore enkikapu natii shumata inkulie netii indaiki oo mpukunot pooki naapejuno e Farao, neinosita imotonyi nena daiki naatii enkikapu natii endukuya ai.”

English: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
Masaai: Nebulu ina kerai negolu, neiput eng'eno nagut, netii enkirotetisho e Nkai shumata ninye.

English: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Amu ore olayioni le Remalia netasesekuana iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o tikitam te Yuda te nkolong nabo. Ore lelo pooki naa iltung'ana yiolot, enkaraki natanyaita ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
Masaai: Naa inosinoso intae endaa musana apa nitushuma, nintokiki aaiwuang'ie ina musana pee itumutumu enipikipiki eng'ejuk.

English: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, keji ake keloloito te nelo meewa likae lee eishu olpayian lenye. Kake te neye olpayian netalakuaki te ina kitanapata, naa te neyam likae lee nemeji keloloito ninye.

English: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu enchorro natii esarng'ab, arashu enkong'u enkare naing'ola, neijia etiu oltung'ani supat oisho kewan oltung'ani torrono.

English: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elusoo inkolong'i o sirua, neinyototo Yoab alo aitisiny ninche te dukuya Enkai. Naa keyooki tadekenya alo aitayu olasar opejori terishata oo layiok lenyena pooki; amu ejo apa Yoab, “Ebaiki netaasa ilayiok laainei ing'ok, nedek Enkai too ltauja lenye.” Neas Yoab ina anaake.

English: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
Masaai: Migorokino iyie iyiook oleng, Olaitoriani, nimidamu nkitarruorot ang ntarasi. Ng'ura, tadamu nchere kira iyiook pooki iltung'ana linono.

English: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
Masaai: Nintoki sii abukoki eilata olperere lo lasar opejori o ntokitin enyena pooki, nintisiny ilo perere naa kesinyayu ilo perere oleng.

English: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
Masaai: amu ore ilkuaaki loo ltung'ana naa eitorrok. Keurori olchani te ntim, neitayuni enchata entolu too nkaik oltung'ani arriyia.

English: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le meeta tipat naa oltung'ani arruoni, neloolo einosaa ilomon le lejare.

English: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel, ina umata pooki, nepuonu ina ong'ata e Sin, to lapa le dukuya, netoni lelo tung'ana te Kadesh; neye Miriam te ine, nenukari ninye te ine.

English: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
Masaai: Neaku meekure eidim Yosef aibooi kewan te dukuya lelo pooki ooitashe te dukuya ninye; neishir ejo, “Enchoo pooki ng'ae otii ene aaipung aing'uaa.” Metaa meetae hoo oltung'ani obo otii ine ina kata eibalakinye Yosef kewan ilalashera lenyena.

English: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
Masaai: Elang inkolong'i aainei erisioroto oo naipuko olkurragos, nepuonu aaiting meeta osiligi.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani. Eitu ninye epaash ing'ok pooki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli.

English: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
Masaai: Te ngolon ino eng'ida olaiguanani iyie, Olaitoriani; naa te retoto ino eisulie ninye oleng.

English: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
Masaai: Enchoo olojo neijia eyiolou nchere ore ina nitoduaa too mpala aainei alakuaniki intae, nikiyooki aas atabawua ine nitii.

English: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
Masaai: Ekaiba apa eekenyata ai pooki nateekenye tiabori enkolong, adol ajo kaing'ueki ninche ilo tung'ani olotu te siadi nanu,

English: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
Masaai: Nening Enkai ilo somit lenye, nedamu Enkai olning'o lenye lo sotua o Abraham o Isaak, o tenebo Yakobo.

English: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo e kopikop, naa kepuku te Tamar o metabaiki nena ariak e Meribatkadesh, o meshomo lelo motioo le Misiri, o metabaiki enaiposha kitok. Keaku ina enkalo e kopikop.

English: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
Masaai: Ewa enkielata inoshi ake olong'i artam naasieki ina siaai e nkitobirata o sesen. Neishiraki Ilmisiri ninye too nkolong'i ntomoni naapishana.

English: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
Masaai: Nikira iyiook lchakenini te kuna baa, naa shakeni Enkiyang'et Sinyati, naisho Enkai lelo ooning metoning'o ninche, nerem oltau nejo mataar.

English: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
Masaai: Ore laiguanak le na kop, o ltung'ana kituaak, o larikok loo njorin, o lkarsisi o loogol, o pooki ng'ae, orrindik aashu ololakuno. Neisudori too nkapuniaa o too isoito loo ldoinyo,

English: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
Masaai: Neitoki Esta, ina kitok o laiguanani, entito e Abihail o Mordekai ilo Yahudi, aaiger enkitanapata nalulung'a te nkitoria, aaitadedeyie ena palai e are naipirta Purim.

English: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
Masaai: ebaiki ina olong apa naishorua Olaitoriani nkitanapat neito dukuya ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki,

English: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keidim ilchorueta lo loyamishe aaishira eton eboitare oloyamishe? Kake kepuonu nkolong'i naayae olayamishe aaitung'uaa ninche, ina kata kenya epukoo.

English: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
Masaai: Kake eton Olaitoriani to lorika le nkitoo ntarasi, neitasheyie olorika lenye le nkitoo pee etum atudung'o enkiguana;

English: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos e nkewarie near metuata Olaitoriani ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, ebaiki ilo kikau le Farao oton to lorika lenye le nkitoo o metabaiki olkikau le ilo o ena te nkaji naenishoreki, o ilkikaunot pooki loo nkishu.

English: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
Masaai: Neitu apa eyiolou lelo tung'ana kituaak aajo kaji nanu ashomo anaa kaa aasita; neton apa nanu eitu aliki Ilyahudi, o lapolosak, o ltung'ana le nkaji e nkitoo, o lkulikae kituaak, o lelo kulikae laa ninche oas esiaai.

English: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Delaia, ilayiok le Tobia, ilayiok le Nekoda, naa iip ile o artam oare.

English: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi alang alo lido kekun, neitashe te nelakua te nchumata o ldoinyo, etii erishata sapuk erishata enye.

English: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.
Masaai: Kiaata iyiook endaa o lkujita loo sirkon lang, o mukateni o enaisho te nkaraki nanu o ena sinka ino, o ele barnoti otii te nebo isinkan linono; eitu eng'oriki iyiook toki.”

English: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
Masaai: Etur ninye atua nong'ot, neng'idare engolon enye, neipang ninye alo ong'ata anang'are te ngolon olarrabal.

English: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
Masaai: Eirriwua Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sion eng'udi ino e nkitoria, nintoreisho te mpolos oo lmang'ati linono!

English: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
Masaai: Ore too layiok loo sinkan le Solomon; naa ilayiok le Sotai, o layiok le Hosoferet, o layiok le Peruda,

English: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
Masaai: Nebol Olaitoriani enkutuk e ina sikiria, nejoki ninye Balaam, “Kainyoo nanu aaitaasa iyie, pee kitoosho iyie nanu katitin uni?”

English: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
Masaai: ore pee errinyo aaing'uaa enkurare neinosaki lelo pokira tomon o obo nena baa neliki sii lkulikae.

English: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
Masaai: Etesheta ninye kishomi e shumata e nkaji o Laitoriani neshet oleng esuntai e Ofel.

English: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
Masaai: “Ore enaleku te pooki alo eina rubata sinyati o ina nara ene nkanasa naa keaku ino lkitok. Eiteru too ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet eina rubata nasinya o meshomo olpolosie lo loosaen, neito oloontoluo eiteru too ntemat enkaina inkalifunitikitam o imiet o meshomo olpolosie lo loontoluo, ine neshepita isashat oo loshon, naa keaku eneilo kitok. Ore inewueji sinyati tenebo ina aji sinyati Enkai natii empolos enye,

English: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
Masaai: ore apa esiana enye pooki naa nkalifuni iip ile o okuni o iip imiet o onom.

English: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
Masaai: “Te near olkiteng orrindik metua, olee arashu enkitok, neisho olopeny olkitok le ilo rrindiki shekeli tomoni uni e nkosholai. Neari ilo kiteng too soito metua.

English: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
Masaai: Eirrokirrok ilbaa laainei netong'ueita aasioki, te nkaraki emodai ai,

English: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
Masaai: Naayau nanu too nduaat Enkai atua enkop e Israel naaitoton ninye nanu te nchumata oldoinyo oodo oleng, netii shumata enye olchetei laaijo enkanasa naipirare nanu.

English: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
Masaai: o Obed-edom o lalashera lenyena ntomoni ile oisiet; ina kata aa ilarripok le kishomi Obed-edom, olayioni le Yehutum o Hosa naa larripok le kishomi.

English: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
Masaai: Kaing'ae eipang'u olaiguanani le Israel asujaa? Kaing'ae isujita iyie? Koldia otua isujita iyie! Kolpidilai isujita!

English: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
Masaai: “Ore iyie, iwa enkano o shairi, mpoosho o lpompo, o loikempe, o enkurma napuyiapui nipik nena pooki eng'irra nabo, nintobiru emukate te ninche. Ore te siadi e nena olong'i nirrag te murte ino; inkolong'i iip uni o ntomoni naaudo ina mukate.

English: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
Masaai: “Ore oltung'ani ake pooki oituraa enkitok enye neyam ai keloloito. Ore oloyam enkitok natung'uayie olmoruo lenye naa keloloito.”

English: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
Masaai: Ore to lameyu naa aikilaku iyie te keeya, ore to larrabal sapuk nikilaku aitung'uaa engolon eilo alem.

English: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
Masaai: Ore ilo pooki lemening irorei laainei ooiroro ninye te nkarna ai, naitalaku nanu makewan te ninye.

English: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
Masaai: Etiu enkitok e nchankar anaa enkare naitipitipu te nkolong nasha.

English: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
Masaai: Neitagol ninche enkitoria e Yuda, ore too larin okuni neitaserian ninche Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, amu eshomo ninche too larin okuni aaibung orrekie le Daudi o Solomon.

English: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
Masaai: Nepik Musa nena ng'udisin dukuya Olaitoriani ti atua ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho.

English: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
Masaai: Neeta ake pooki obo te ninche nkomomi ong'uan, neeta ake pooki inaipuko maa ong'uan, ore tiabori inaipuko enye nenyaanyukie nkaik oo ltung'ana.

English: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
Masaai: Kake aikiaata iyiook ele shumata atua masaa oo nkulupuok pee eliooyu nchere ore ina golon magilani naa Enkai eing'uaa, mme atua iyiook ate.

English: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
Masaai: Ti atua ninye intae ilootoning'o ilo rorei lesipata, lelo omon supati le njeunoto inyi, niruko ninye, nemishiri intae te ina Kiyang'et Sinyati e nkisiligata enye,

English: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
Masaai: Aayooki aajoki ilkumok te ina olong, ‘Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani, keitu kimbonisho te nkarna ino, nikiaraa iloiriruani te nkarna ino, nikiaas ine nking'asia te nkarna ino?’

English: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
Masaai: “Ore sii ake eitu aishu enkiroroto oltau lai, ng'ura, nelotu Rebeka enapita emoti e nkare to loililai, nedoiki enchorro aoku enkare. Najoki ninye, ‘Aatoomono inchooki matooko.’

English: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee elotu Hiram te Turo adol nena anas naaishoo Solomon ninye, neitu eitiship ninye.

English: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
Masaai: Merrinyo ina goro napi o Laitoriani, ometaba anaa nedung'oki enkiguana neitabaya iyieunot oltau lenye. Ore too nkolong'i e siadi naa ilo ayiolou ena.

English: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
Masaai: Nebaiki lelo omon olaiguanani le Ninawi, nedumunye ninye to lorika lenye le nkitoo, neitayu olkila lenye, neimulumul kewan too lkuniyiani, neton too nkuruon.

English: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: ele ninye olasar opejori le pooki olong e sabato, te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar ooki.

English: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
Masaai: Neshukoki olaitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu, nepik enkikompe inkaik e Farao,

English: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
Masaai: Neya Olaitoriani Enkai ilo tung'ani apik ninye enkurma e Eden peyie etur neramat sii.

English: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
Masaai: nikidol iyiook eishiaakino, kitoning'okinote nabo, nikigelu lewa likirriwaki intae meiriamunore ilaisotuak lang Barnaba o Paulo,

English: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
Masaai: Eisho eng'eno engolon ilo tung'ani ng'en alang ilaiguanak tomon ootii atua enkanasa.

English: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo oitook ile latia enye, enkikompe e ngoro enye, neitemer ninche, pee etum atishila enkurruna enye!

English: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
Masaai: Kalikioo nanu ina natejo Olaitoriani: Aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Ira iyie enkerai ai, ore ena olong, aatoiuo nanu iyie.

English: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye menye, “Nchoo maaitaasi ena bae; nchooki ake duoo iyie ilapaitin oare, pee alo nanu aisampash too ldoinyo aishiraki titoisho ai, nanu o esirit ai.”

English: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Ena bae etejo Olaitoriani, ‘kaitoduaaya nanu kewan nchere kara sinyati tiatua lekua laataaniki nanu, ore te dukuya iltung'ana pooki naaisisi nanu.’ ” Negira Aron.

English: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
Masaai: Kake ore to lari le tikitam ookuni le nkitoria o laiguanani Yehoash, neitu eram ilapolosak ina aji.

English: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

English: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.

English: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Charchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

English: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
