English: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
Masaai: tenaing'ura nanu enkolong ewang oleng, arashu olapa elo te sidano enye,

English: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
Masaai: Iyie losiligi le Israel, Olaitajeunoni lenye te nkata e nyamali kainyoo iyie pee itiu anaa olomoni te nkop, anaa olalotoni oun olng'obor lenye te nkaraki enkewarie.

English: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye te ntampuri o te nkinoyata o sinkolio; meisisi ninye too usin o te nkinanta nakuti!

English: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
Masaai: Neaku iwa nkera enye meshomo aatum olameyu; nchooi ninche meshomo engolon empijan olalem, nchoo nkituaak enye eaku olupeno o nkolia. Metanang'are ilewa lenye keeya to lmeitai, metaari eleleroenye to lalem to larrabal.

English: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
Masaai: tenkaraki Ilkaldayo; amu keure apa ninche, enkaraki netasesekuana apa Ishmael olayioni le Netania Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, laa ninye eitaa olaiguanani le Babilon olbalusui oitore ina kop.

English: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, ‘Enteen ninye inkaik o nkejek, ninang'akiki enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.’

English: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
Masaai: Te near olkiteng olayioni le likae tung'ani arashu entito, neiguanareki olopeny te risioroto ena kitanapata nabo.

English: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
Masaai: Etii enkinosata o lmumai, o elejare, o esesekuanare, o empurrorre, o eloloito; elang'u ninche ilpolosien pooki neitusuj iloikop iloikop.

English: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
Masaai: Olyahudi odede olora ti atua kewan, ore emurata nara naa embae o ltau naa ene nkiyang'et mme enasira ake. Ore enkisisa e ilo neme enoo ltung'ana kake ene Nkai.

English: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: “Ajoki intae teina kata, engoru omom e Nkai peyie eidim aing'urrie iyiook. Amaa teina kishooroto naing'uaa inkaik inyi, aijojo keidim aing'urrie hoo obo linyi? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: For there is no respect of persons with God.
Masaai: Amu meeta Enkai olkep.

English: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naatanyaita ninche nanu, netapejokitio enkorropil kulie aitin, pee aatum ninche aaitagoro nanu te siaai oo nkaik enye, kebukokini naa engoro ai napi shumata ene wueji nemeibooroyu ina goro ai.

English: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
Masaai: “Ara nanu Alfa o Omega,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, Otii taata, netii apa, naa ninye olotu, Olaidimani.

English: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
Masaai: o Ramot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Anem tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
Masaai: ore te Salai naa Kalai; ore te Amok naa Eber,

English: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
Masaai: Aaibung'a nanu emion oleng te nkaraki lelo arruok, lelo ootanyaita nkitanapat inono.

English: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Kashukokino Sion, naa kalotu amany atua Yerusalem, naa keitokini aaipot Yerusalem aajo enkanasa naisiligayu, oldoinyo lo Laitoriani loo lororani, ilo doinyo sinyati.

English: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe to ltau lai pooki; kalikioo nena kiaasin inono e nking'asia.

English: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.
Masaai: Nepik iruparen o larrabal enkaji e nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Ashtarot; nesheiki osesen lenye esuntai e Bet-shan.

English: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
Masaai: Metotiwuo anaa ninche lelo ooitobiru ninche! ee metotiwuo neijia pooki ng'ae oisilig ninche!

English: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
Masaai: Nesesekuan ilairritak loo ntare o nkerrai enye, nesesekuan ilaturok loo nkurman o mbartan enye, nepurd ilaitoriak o lelo oota enkitoo.

English: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
Masaai: (Eitu nanu aisho enkutuk ai eas eng'oki, pee aomonu enkishui enye to ldeket);

English: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
Masaai: Ore eipang'u Yoab aing'uaa ine aing'uaa ine netii Daudi, neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku metusujai Abna, nerik ninye aashuku teilo kesumet le Sira; kake eitu eyiolou Daudi ina.

English: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
Masaai: nelo Yeremia te Yerusalem alo enkop e Benchamen pee eng'amu erubata enye teine tiatua iltung'ana.

English: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
Masaai: Ore naa nemeetae Olgiriki o Lyahudi, olomurata o lememurata, olmeeki, Osikite, orrindik, ololakuno, kake Kristo pooki toki, netii ninye atua pooki.

English: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ore shumata eilo soit laitasheyie te dukuya Yoshua, enchumata osoit obo oota imatuan naapishana, naguetaki osirata, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kaitayu ina kitarruorroto ena kop te nkolong nabo.

English: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
Masaai: Amu ore eneiting'oki iltung'ana naa ninye sii eiting'oki ng'uesi; ore anaa enaye nabo neye ake sii ninye enkae. Eeta pooki enkiyang'et nabo nenyanyuk, nemeeta oltung'ani enelang'ie nena ng'uesi; amu ore pooki naa empesho.

English: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.
Masaai: Neas Omori ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neas ntorrok aitulus te lelo pooki ooituruko te dukuya ninye.

English: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
Masaai: Neisho ninye lelo pooki apa ootii Yerusalem o Benchamen meitasho aaibung ina. Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem neas te risioroto o sotua le Nkai ina Ai oo loo menye.

English: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
Masaai: Netum Isaak olokirikiri sapuk le ng'oro nejo ninye; “Aing'ae doi naaji otang'oro eng'ues naayaki nanu, nainosa pooki eton eitu ibau, naidipa atamayiana ninye? Nesipa Ee, naa kemayiana ninye.”

English: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
Masaai: “Ore apa Mika le Moreshet neibonishe too nkolong'i e Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki iltung'ana pooki le Yuda: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, keturi sion anaa enkurma neaku Yerusalem osototi loo suut ore enkaji e Nkai neaku entim oo lkeek.’

English: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
Masaai: Nelotu Hamor menye le Shekem enetii Yakobo airorie ninye.

English: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
Masaai: Keitu apa eas olaiguanani Solomon eng'oki tenkaraki kuna kituaak? Ore tiatua iloshon kumok meetae olaiguanani otiu anaa ninye, naa kirotet te Nkai enye, neitaa Enkai ninye olaiguanani te shumata Israel pooki; ore ake eyia, etorikokitio nkituaak oo loreren ninye metaasa ing'ok.

English: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
Masaai: Near metuata ilewa o ngoruo nesesekuan iltung'ana moruak o looti; near metuata nkayiok o ntoyie.

English: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
Masaai: metaa meishaa enkop pokira aare te nemanya, amu aikumok imasaa e pookira.

English: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
Masaai: Kaing'ae oiro embae nebaya aaku,

English: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
Masaai: Newaliki Simon ajoki, “Entoomonokoki intae to Laitoriani pee maatum ake nena baa pooki nitejo.”

English: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Asuba, neyam Kaleb Efarat naa ninye natoiuo Huri.

English: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiriamariyie iltung'ana ng'eni, naa keaku ng'en, kake ore ole ncholiek oo lmoda naa ketum enkitamioto.

English: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
Masaai: Neyieng ilapolosak ninche neitobir olasar loo ng'ok to sarge le lelo kineji te nchumata olperere lo lasar, pee eitobir olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki Israel pooki. Amu eitanapishe olaiguanani nchere, ore olasar opejori, o lasar le ng'oki naa keitobiri tenkaraki Israel pooki.

English: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
Masaai: Kake ore duoo tenaa keiro Enkai, nikiboloki ninye enkutuk enye,

English: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: but who are they that shall go?
Masaai: Neshukuni Musa o Aron meetu enetii Farao; nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom esiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; kake kakua oopuo?”

English: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
Masaai: Kedooyo enkare too ltooi lenyena, ore olantererai lenye neaku nkariak kumok etii, ore olaiguanani lenye naa ninye olusoo alang Agag, ore enkitoo enye naa kebul.

English: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
Masaai: nemayiana ilo tung'ani lemetum olkob te nanu.”

English: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom enkop pooki entoliki ltung'ana pooki ele rorei supat.

English: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok loo loibonok le Nkai ootii Yeriko nepuonu aataaniki Elisha, nejoki ninye, “Iyiolo iyie ajo keya taata Olaitoriani olkitok lino nikintung'uaa iyie?” Newal ninye ajo, “Ee kayiolo, entirring'ata ake intae.

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Yuda, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye, amu etanyaita ninche nena kitanapat o Laitoriani neitu eibung nkiguanat enyena kake eitapong'oiyie ninche elejare enye, naa ninye etusuja iloo menye.

English: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
Masaai: ootiaakita, “Etopiwuo taa ninye Olaitoriani neipang'aka Simon!”

English: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;
Masaai: Netii apa Olyahudi otii Susa ina ang kitok oji enkarna enye Mordekai, olayioni le Yair, olayioni le Shimei olayioni le Kish Olbenchamini,

English: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
Masaai: Ilo iyie aroro olng'atuny o enturbubua, intuny iyie olng'atuny o lasurai too nkejek inono.

English: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
Masaai: Amu eitashe ninye te nkaina e tatene e ilo omena, pee eitajeu ninye te lelo oiguanare pee ear metua.

English: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
Masaai: Ore isoito lenyena neeta ewueji oo soito sidain, neeta enterit e sahabu.

English: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
Masaai: neme iloreren kumok loo lng'ejepa oopaashaa o enkutuk nagol, ilaa mining'u irorei lenye. Esipa tenaairriwaki iyie kulo, naa aikindim aatoning'u iyie.

English: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
Masaai: Naibirribir to ltau lai kewarie: nalimana adamisho to ltau lai.

English: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, Olaitoriani, iyie aishiraka; ore tadekenya nelotu enkomono ai dukuya iyie.

English: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
Masaai: Metaa ataa apa kitok oleng nagiroo pooki apa laatii te dukuya nanu te Yerusalem; naata ake sii eng'eno nagut tiatua nanu.

English: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.
Masaai: Negelu Saul iltung'ana nkalifuni uni le Israel; ore nkalifuni are netii te nebo Saul te Mikmash o ina kop oo ldoinyo e Betel, ore enkalifu nabo netii te nebo Yonatan te Gibea e Benchamen; ore ilkulikae tung'ana nerriny ang, pooki tung'ani ake nelo olng'obor lenye.

English: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
Masaai: o Shekemia, o Rehum, o Meremot,

English: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and rie in their place?
Masaai: Amaa te neidip ninye aitobira enterit, emeisuaaki ninye enkop ilanterera lenyena loo mpukunot pooki, neun enkano too lkererin nepik shairi ewueji enye, neitobiraki enerishare?

English: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
Masaai: Neeta apa olayioni oji enkarna enye Saul, ilo barnoti oikishiaan. Metii apa oltung'ani ti atua iltung'ana pooki le Israel olang ninye te nkishaa; ebaiki ironyi lenyena neilep neado apa ninye alang pooki tung'ani.

English: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ena esiana oo ntokitin e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho, anaa enaikenaki te ina kitanapata e Musa, te nkisiayiare oo Lawi ti abori erubaroto e Isamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.

English: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Masaai: o nkitotoneta enye artam e nkosholai are ti abori erubata nabo o nkitotoneta are ti abori enkae rubata.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Atipika nanu shumata emurt e kuna kuapi pooki esekenkei e sinkaisho te Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, naa keisiaai ninche ninye, amu aishoo nanu ninye ebaiki ing'uesi e ong'ata.”

English: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
Masaai: Nchoo meitukurruni neitadouni lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai! Nchoo meibelekenyata ninche nekurru lelo ooiguanu entorroni te nkaraki nanu!

English: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore kulo turrurri pooki loo larripok loo nchomito, negeluno ake aaipirare ltung'ana lenye kituaak, negelakino enkisiaayiare, anaa apa enataasa ilalashera lenye, eisiaaisho tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa, eidipa lelo ayiok pokira oare le Aron aatuata, ina kata apa pee enyiku ninche aapuonu dukuya Olaitoriani neye;

English: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.
Masaai: Ore Asaria ilo apolosani kitok, o lelo apolosak pooki neing'or ninye, naa ng'ura, etijing'a enkeeya oo lbolot enkomom enye! Neipang'ie ninye boo nabo kata, ore ninye makewan neisarrisar alo boo, amu etoosho Olaitoriani ninye.

English: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
Masaai: kake keipoti intae aajo ilapolosak lo Laitoriani, keimaki intae iltung'ana aajo ilaisiaayiak le Nkai ang; ipuopuo intae aainos olkar loo loshon, ore enkarsisisho enye nipuopuo intae aaisikarrare.

English: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
Masaai: Naa te nebau ilo sirua loo ltung'ana le Israel odamunyeki ilarin onom, neitokini aaponaa enjung'ore enye aaponiki ilo osho ora olenye; ore enjung'ore enye neyai aaitung'uaa enjung'ore olosho loo loopapa.”

English: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
Masaai: Metaa tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Ti nindipidipi aaishooi ilo asar, ina naisul, ore ina naleku neikenakini ile Lawi anaa entoki naing'uaa olkurroto oidong'ishoreki anaa entoki naingua enkironyet oo sabibu;

English: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
Masaai: Ing'orn oo nkishu o kule oo ntare, tenebo iila oo lkuo le kerra o lmeregeshi, iluat oo nchoo e Bashan o nkineji, o enkano sidai aisul ore to sarge loo sabibu niokioko enaisho.

English: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
Masaai: Naa kayau nanu shumata iyie esulare oo ntarasi o enkurruna e anaake, ina nemerikinishoi ae kata.’ ”

English: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkaraki enyorrata nayieu naasai nanu Paulo, Olkilikuai lo Laitoriani naena taata te nkaraki Kristo Yesu

English: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.
Masaai: nchere keishiaakino nedamuni kuna olong'i neibung'i ti atua iishoritin pooki ishoi, te pooki marei, o losho o enkang, naa ore kuna olong'i e Purim nemeishori aekata eimin ti atua Ilyahudi, nemepali sii enkitadamunoto ti atua ishoritin pooki.

English: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli enkaji enye te Samaria eiruto neeta osina.

English: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
Masaai: neranyisho te dukuya iltung'ana ejo: ‘Ataasa eng'oki, natokordilo ina apa nasipa, neitu apa aaitalaki nanu.

English: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.
Masaai: Kake etejo Saul, “Meari ninye oltung'ani obo metua ena olong, amu ore taata neyaua Olaitoriani enkordunoto ti atua Israel.”

English: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
Masaai: Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye ening ninche anaa enairorie Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Keisiligayu nesipa kulo rorei. Naa Olaitoriani Enkai o nkiyang'eta oo loibonok le Enkai nairriwua olmalaika lenye meitoduaa isinkan lenyena nena nemeeta nchere pee eitu epuonu aasieku.

English: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana le Yuda, na Benchamen o Efraim, o Manase nebik te Yerusalem.

English: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come near; for them the LORD thy God hath chosen to minister unto him, and to bless in the name of the LORD; and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be tried:
Masaai: Ore lapolosak lelo ayiok le Lawi nepuonu dukuya, amu etegelua Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninche pee eisiaai ninye nemayianisho te nkarna o Laitoriani, naa ore to rorei lenye ore pooki shankar o pooki oshoto neitobiri.

English: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
Masaai: olayioni le Yoshua, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Yorim, olayioni le Matar, olayioni le Lawi,

English: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
Masaai: Eirriwayie Musa osinka lenye o Aron laa ninye etegelua.

English: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
Masaai: Ore ilemeitoomon intae, entung'uai ina ang nimpiripiroo enterit natii nkejek inyi metaa shakeni te ninche.”

English: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
Masaai: Shomo naa taata, naa kaaku nanu te nebo enkutuk ino naaitayiolo enijo.”

English: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
Masaai: ore nkariak naadou eing'uaa shumata neitashe aaku orupati olo enelakua abaiki Adam, ina anasa apa natii embata e Saretani, ore nena ariak naanang'ari aadoyio aapuo enaiposha e Araba, ina Enaiposha e Munyan, nedung'o katukul; nelang iltung'ana aaim enkishaakinoto e Yeriko.

English: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
Masaai: Inchira niyietu nakerai e tung'ani, amu kegilunore ninye iltung'ana laainei; kegilunore ninye iltung'ana pooki kituaak le Israel; etipikaki ninche pooki olalem tenebo iltung'ana laainei. Toosho naa enkupes ino.

English: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
Masaai: ore osiligi lang te intae nemeigusugus, amu eikiyiolo aajo, ore pee ing'arierie iyiook osina, ning'arierie sii iyiook ina kilejilej.

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa iyiolouu inchere ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naitaas intae ina te nkaraki enkarna ai, neme te nkaraki inkoitoi inyi torrok neme te nkaraki isiaaitin inyi torrok, iyie naaji e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
Masaai: Nejoki olaputani le Musa ninye, “Ore ena niasita ne me sidai.

English: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
Masaai: Miaata eniporoki enchankar e modai nemeeta enajo, iyiolo iyie ajo ilarrabali ake eiu.

English: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
Masaai: Metuutai Olaitoriani iltauja aitorioki enyorrata e Enkai o enkitashoto nemeiwuatiwuata e Kristo.

English: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amu enkikompe, neisho Enkai enashe nejo, “Entudumu ena entang'ar;

English: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
Masaai: “Meetae likae onyaanyukie Enkai, iyie, Yeshurun, ilo olo te keper pee kilotu aret, neimu nkatampo te nkitoo enye.

English: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Oi o Laitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, inchooki ena olong dupoto aatoomono iyie, nintodolu enyorrata ino nauno to olkitok lai Abraham.

English: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.
Masaai: Ntobira nkoitoi nior aitaa irubat uni ina kop nikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino metaa enino, pee etum pooki tung'ani oitayu loikop akuetiki.

English: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
Masaai: “Ore ilo oisiligayu too nkuti neisiligayu sii too nkumok ore olemeisiligayu too nkuti nemeisiligayu too nkumok.

English: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
Masaai: Kake ore ina olong, eitayio Laban iloroi pooki o otipo neirrimo tenebo inkineji pooki netipo neirrimo pooki ake ninye naata eneibor, o pooki sitima lo ker orok, neisho ilayiok lenyena metaramata.

English: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
Masaai: Nebatata ilo sinka oboita te siaai too nkejek enyena nesai ejo, ‘Ting'iriakaki metaba anaa naalaaki pooki.’

English: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
Masaai: Ore ilo oing'oru isupati te nyuaata neing'oru omom, kake ejing'aki intorrok ilo olo aing'oru.

English: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
Masaai: nejo, “Ng'ura, adolita etabole shumata, neitashe Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkaina e tatene e Enkai.

English: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
Masaai: Ore nekua ng'eni, neya eilata too ltuleta lenye te nebo iltaai.

English: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina neikilikuanishore te nkata naado; kake eitu ewaliki.

English: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni le meeta tipat te likae nekueniyie enkiguana nasipa, ore enkutuk oltorrono naa keijoo intorrok.

English: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
Masaai: amu te nena eitobiraki ate olkitamanyunoto sidai too nkolong'i naapuonu, peyie eyooki aang'amu ina kishui naa ninye nara katukul.

English: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
Masaai: “Kake amaa, kesipa kebik Olaitoriani tenebo iltung'ana te nkop? Ng'ura, ore keper o keper nalakua nemikiishaa iyie; kebaa naa mikiishaa iyie ena aji natesheta nanu!

English: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
Masaai: naitanapa apa nanu intae teina kata nena tokitin pooki naaishiakino niasiasa.

English: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
Masaai: enaikash te nemenya oltung'ani nkiri aashu eok enaisho oo sabibu aashu ae ake bae nabatat likae alashe.

English: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;
Masaai: neikilikuanishore ilarishak aabaraki naa tenaa olelejare ilo shakeni, neitang'oro olalashe lenye te lejare,

English: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
Masaai: nejo, “Esipa kaamayian nanu iyie naaponaa.”

English: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
Masaai: Eing'or ake too nkonyek inono, nidol elaakinoto oo larruok.

English: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
Masaai: Enteng'enuoto too mbaa nining'ining'i amu ore oloata, naa keishori, ore olemeeta neoruni ina najo ninye keeta.”

English: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
Masaai: Kake intorioi sii iyie enkaina ino tenakata iseyie nena pooki naata, naa aikidek ninye aitoriokino enkomom ino.”

English: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
Masaai: Ore tinincho osinka lino pooki toki nayieu te keraisho, niyiooki amaniki etaa olajung'oni lino.

English: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
Masaai: pee etum iltung'ana te Sion aaibalunyie enkarna o Laitoriani, neibalunyie enkisisa enye te Yerusalem,

English: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
Masaai: Neitashe Yesu nejo metorikuni enetii; ore pee enyikaki, nejoki,

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar loo ngok;

English: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
Masaai: Neitemoo enkare ildoinyo pooki metaa eng'uton ntemat e nkaina tomon o imiet.

English: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
Masaai: “Kake ore lelo le Lawi laashomo aalam nanu, ootapong'ori te nanu aasuj nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin ina kata peyie epong'ori Israel, naa kenap enkitamioto enye maate.

English: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.
Masaai: Nejo ninye Yonatan, “Ng'ura, eikilang iyiook aapuo enetii ilewa, nikintodol ate ninche.

English: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
Masaai: Naa kenya intare aainei nena nintunyoitie too nkejek inyi, neok ina are ning'ola too nkejek inyi?

English: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilaiguanak pooki apa ootii lido kekun Yordan ina kop oo ldoinyo o ina kop nagum ilo omanaa pooki le naiposha kitok te nkalo e Lebanon, o Lhiti, o Lamori, o Lkanaani, o Lperisi,

English: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
Masaai: Eisapuk enkitoo enye te nkaraki eretoto ino; nchopoko iyie ninye enkikodo o enkitoo.

English: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
Masaai: neitu ninche eduaa maate neitu edumunye hoo ng'ae te wueji enye too nkolong'i uni; kake eeta iltung'ana loo Siraeli pooki ewang'an te ine nemanya ninche.

English: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
Masaai: Kiteleja iyie ilo wuasa lo ltau lino, iyie ilo omanya enchumata endapidapoi, laa keika oleng emanyisho enye, ilo ojo to ltau lino, “Kaing'ae laaitadou nanu ayau enkop!”

English: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
Masaai: te nkaraki ilo toilo lo lmang'atinta, te nkaraki ilo kibookinoto enkop eilo torrono amu keyau ninche enyamali shumata nanu; ore te ngoro neitobir ninche mang'atisho ti alo nanu.

English: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
Masaai: Kake ore eyia, etetemishote ninche, negolong'aki ilo otii Shumata Aisul, neitu eshilaa shakenisho enye,

English: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
Masaai: Nepik ninche olalem lelo pooki apa ootii atua ninye, aaidaikie ninche tukul; eitu ninye eing'uari obo leton eiresa, nepejoo ninye Hasor te nkima.

English: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
Masaai: Neosh Olaitoriani ina kerai apa natoikio enkitok e Uria Daudi, nemueyu ninye.

English: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
Masaai: meekure aa orrindik, kake etuluso alang orrindik, etaa olalashe onyorri, eisulaki te nanu kake eisul naa oleng te iyie, te pokira are to sesen o to Laitoriani.

English: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
Masaai: Torikoyioki nanu Olaitoriani te supatisho ino, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei; ntorioi enkoitoi ino te dukuya nanu.

English: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
Masaai: ore ilpayiani leilo turrur neiteleiki nkaik enye endukuya eilo oing'oni te dukuya Olaitoriani, neyieng'i ilo oing'oni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
Masaai: “Ekaitanyamal sii iltauja loo ltung'ana kumok, ina kata naaya iyie eyarunoto tiatua iloreren, naapik iyie inkuapi neitu iyiolou.

English: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: Neitoki aitarasaa olmeregesh liare, ilo meregesh le nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik; neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena nkaik enye endukuya eilo meregesh.

English: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
Masaai: Naa te ilo obo eitobira iloreren pooki te nkop, metamanya oriong e nkop. Naa ketang'asa te dukuya aitaiki rishat o lpolosien oorish ineemany.

English: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
Masaai: Ore te nkiyang'et e Nkai naa keidak, ore te ndarata e ng'oro enye neijori ninche.

English: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
Masaai: Netii olong'unyung'unyi atua esiamo te nkaraki ninye, ejo kulikae, “Oltung'ani supat,” nejo kulikae, “A'a keitapong'oo ninye olorere.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Entadamu, nimpotutu nena kituaak naaishir meetu; erriu nena kituaak arriyiak meetu.

English: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu elotu olari lo lameyu, eeta Yosef ina rishata ilayiok aare, ootoikio Asenata entito e Potifera olapolosani le Oni.

English: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Enchom entaa loreren pooki ilooiteng'eni laainei, nimbatisasa te nkarna e Papa o ene Nkerai o ene Nkiyang'et Sinyati:

English: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: Tenaa keshipakino iyiook Olaitoriani, naa keyau iyiook atua ena kop neisho iyiook, ena kop naruko kule o naishi.

English: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie apa ninche Yoshua; nepuo ninche ewueji o lnukata, neirrag te rishata e Betel o Ai, enkalo e ndoyoroto e Ai; kake etotona apa Yoshua ina kewarie te nebo iltung'ana.

English: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
Masaai: Nimintalioo emasipaisho entito o layioni lino aashu ene ntito e ntito ino amu ore emasipaisho enye naa emasipaisho ino makewan.

English: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Adam ilarin iip nabo o tomoni uni, neaku ninye menye lo layioni laa ninye kewan enyaanyukie, neipot ninye ajo Seti.

English: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
Masaai: Nepuo isinkan enetii olopeny enkaji nejoki, ‘Lo kitok, keitu iyie iun enkano te nkurma ino? Kaji eing'uaa endiati?’

English: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
Masaai: Ore ninye te nalo aim empolos e nyamali, igolie ake enkishui ai; intorioo iyie enkaina ino aibooyo engoro napi oo lmang'ati laainei, naa enkaina e tatene naakordu nanu.

English: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find it.
Masaai: Kelimana ninche ebaiki enaiposha o metabaiki enaiposha, moikuape o metabaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong; kekuet ninche aapuo neitu, aaing'oru ororei lo Laitoriani, kake metum ninche.

English: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
Masaai: Ore Moab naa engirra ai naitukuore; shumata Edom nanu aiteleiki ina amuke ai; naa te shumata Filistia nanu abuaku te nkisulata.”

English: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae aatiu anaa iloata osirua osinya kewarie iranyishosho. Nitumutumu eng'ida o ltau nitiuu anaa te neoshi enkinanta pee epuoi oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, ina dapidapoi e Israel.

English: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.
Masaai: Ore ilala oololo, naa ore enkadori enye naa endap e nkaina, neenikino atua ninye tiatua. Ore tenchumata e nena misai naa ine eiteleikini nena kiri naaitaini olasar.

English: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
Masaai: “Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto. Ore naa taata nteneneng'a ina kisiayiare nagol natii shumata iyiook, naa eikisiaai iyiook iyie.”

English: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
Masaai: Naa, ing'ura, itiu iyie te ninche anaa ilo oranyaki isinkolioitin le nyorrata, to ltoilo sidai oleng neosh te nkarriyiano e nkinanda, amu ening ninche ina nijo, kake meas ninche ina.

English: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: kake ore te nkaraki ninche kadamu osotua o loo nkakuyiaa lenye apa layaua nanu ninche aitupuku te nkop e Misiri too nkonyek oo loshon, pee atum nanu ataa Enkai enye; Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
Masaai: Te Yakobo easisho engolon e nkitoo, ore lelo aishirak too nkanas neidaikieki!”

English: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
Masaai: Neaku eitu ening olaiguanani iltung'ana amu embae ena nayaua Enkai, pee etum Olaitoriani aitabai ororei lenye, apa oiroro aimunye Ahija le Shilon metoliki Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

English: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
Masaai: Ore te njing'et e shumata nedung'udung ninche nkeenta too ntoluo.

English: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
Masaai: Naa te nejo enkiok, “Ore amu mara nanu enkong'u, mara nanu eno sesen,” nemeibelekenya aaku mme eno sesen te nkaraki ina.

English: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
Masaai: Oi intae oomanya atua nena kurman, einining'ito ilencholuek ai oltoilo lino; nchooki matoning'o ninye.

English: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
Masaai: Meikilikuanu oltung'ani tenaa eisidai aashu torrono, aashu ewalu ninye; tenelo newalu ninye, neaku ore pokira ina natawalunyeki o ina natawaluaki neaku sinyati, nemekorduni ninye.”

English: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore pooki oonoto ninche neinosa ninche, netejo ilmang'ati lenye, ‘Eitu iyiook kintarruoo; amu etaasa ninche eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani, laa ninye emanyisho enye nadede, Olaitoriani osiligi loo loo papaai lenye.’

English: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.
Masaai: Ore emarti nabo neitashe te moikuape te dukuya Mikmash ore enkae te kopikop te dukuya Geba.

English: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
Masaai: “Ing'ura, ina olong! Ing'ura elotu ninye! Eewuo emutata inyi, eitapuka imbaa enkikonya, etubulutua ilukuny olwuasa.

English: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
Masaai: ijojo, “Kanu eishunye olapa ng'ejuk pee kitum aatimir enkurma. Keishunye sabato, pee kitum aatimir enkano, pee kitum aaterepeny entemet naji eta nikiponaa shekeli, nikilej iltung'ana too ntemat e lejare,

English: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
Masaai: Intae lelo ooiruko Enkerai e Nkai aigeroki ena, pee iyiolouu intae aajo iatata enkishui oo ntarasi.

English: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ina, (amu Misiri apa etii ninye, ine apa neisikaka ailany olaiguanani Solomon) neitoki Yeroboam arrinyunye te Misiri.

English: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:
Masaai: eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o te nkiputukuny kitok o too nkitoduaat o mbaa enking'asia

English: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.
Masaai: Ore amu etupukoitie kata naado, neipang'u Paulo ti atua ninche nejo, “Lo lewa, keishiaakino apa te naa eikitoning'o naa anaata eitu idumunyenye te Krete nipuonunu metobori intae aaiko nji neimina imasaa naaba nji.

English: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
Masaai: Miaku supat aitulus, nimintaa sii kewan ololus te ng'eno, ainyoo peyie imut kewan ainyal?

English: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
Masaai: Eidaa eishoi enye te Heshbon, o metabaiki Dibon, kindaikie iyiook o metaba anaa nebaiki enkima Medeba.”

English: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
Masaai: Metaa, entagoluoto, lo lewa, amu kaata enkirukoto te Nkai nchere ketiu anaa ina ake naatiaakaki.

English: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
Masaai: Tamana iyie ina anasa, ore iltung'ana pooki lo larrabal nepuo aaman enkanasa te nkata nabo. Ninkoko neijia too nkolong'i ile.

English: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
Masaai: “Ore ake eyia eitu intae ipuopuo, kake itogolong'akita enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai inyi;

English: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
Masaai: Nerik Saul ninye ina olong, nemeisho ninye metushukoyu alo enkang enye.

English: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
Masaai: Amu kimbung'a iyiook nchere te nkirukoto eitaae oltung'ani supat metii easata oo nkitanapat.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ti oriong e nkop e Misiri te nkaraki olmaati, peyie elotu oriong e nkop e Misiri, nenya pooki aitubului te nkop, pooki toki natung'uayie enchan oo soito.”

English: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
Masaai: Nebolo Sakaria enkutuk ina kata ake, nelaa olng'ejep lenye, neiro, aisis Enkai.

English: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
Masaai: Indim iyie atuutai ilakir too nkatitin enye, arashu indim iyie atorikoi olgarurumi tenebo ilkuoo lenyena?

English: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
Masaai: Kake tenemening ninche, naa keidak to lalem neye meeta eng'eno.

English: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
Masaai: ilaiguanak pooki le moikuape oolakua o lootaana, obo te siadi o likae, o nena kitoriat pooki enkop naatii oriong enkop. Naa ore te siadi ninche neok olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.
Masaai: Nadumaki nanu kewan olapolosani supat, oas ninye te risioroto e ina natii atua oltau lai o atua endamunoto ai; nashetaki nanu ninye enkaji nasipa, nejingu ninye neipang boo te dukuya ilo gelunoti lai intarasi.

English: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD'S glory.
Masaai: Neilep enkitoo o Laitoriani aing'uaa olkerubi o metabaiki enejing'ieki enkaji; neiput ina aji enkatampoi, ore olodung'oro neiput ewang'an enkitoo o Laitoriani.

English: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
Masaai: Ninye ake endapidapoi ai naa enjeunoto ai, ninye osempewuet lai, maaigusugusieki nanu.

English: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.
Masaai: Neitoki Saul ajo, “Matadoi aapuo aasujaa Ilfilisti nikimbung, nikiya ntokitin enye nikiar kewarie ninche o mekenyu; miking'uaa iyiook oltung'ani obo te ninche.” Nejo ninche, “Taasa enaba anaa enidol aa sidai te iyie.” Kake etejo olapolosani, “Maigutu iyiook aanyikaki Olaitoriani tene.”

English: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki enkop natabee, enkaraki neitu eshaiki enchan enkop netukurrutua ilaramatak, neimulumul ilukuny enye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin naataasa Omori, oina kidimata naitodolua, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: Jesus wept.
Masaai: Neishir Yesu.

English: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Yarmut te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, En-ganim te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo enkop metoiu inkaitubulu, inkaitubulu naaiu ilanterera, o lkeek loo lng'anayio ooiu ilanterera too mpukunot enye te enkop.” Neaku neija.

English: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tenaa kegol Siria oleng te nanu nikipuonunu aaretu nanu; naa te negol Ilamori oleng te intae, naa karetu intae.

English: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “A-a; kake aewuo nanu anaa olarikoni le njore o Laitoriani.” Nebatata Yoshua te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, neserem, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo ejoki Olaitoriani lai osinka lenye?”

English: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
Masaai: Ilarin tomon ookuni apa etesheta Solomon enkaji enye, neidip ninye enchetata enkaji pooki.

English: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
Masaai: Naa keor ninche ebaiki oloililai loo filisti te nkalo o loo ntoluo, neibung'a ninche te nebo aaidaikie iltung'ana lo loosaen. Nepik ninche nkaik enye enkop e Edom o Moab, ore ile Amon neiruk ninche.

English: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
Masaai: te ina olong kenya anaa enalimu nanu te kulo omon laainei supati, te ina olong kenya eiguanare Enkai inkisudorot oo ltung'ana te Yesu Kristo.

English: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
Masaai: Eiturrurroki apa kulo te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye. Ore te Yuda netii ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni; etii olarikoni le njore e iip oji Adna, tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni magil yiolot.

English: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
Masaai: Newaliki oloirirua ajoki ninche, “Kayiolo Yesu, nayiolo Paulo; kake airara doi intae iloo ng'ae?”

English: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
Masaai: Irorei kulo le Aga olayioni le Yake le Masa, etiaaka ilo tung'ani Itiel, Itiel tenebo Ukai.

English: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Ng'ura, miliki oltung'ani; kake shomo intoduaa kewan olapolosani, nintayu enkishoroto naitanapishe Musa, metaa shakenisho te ninche.”

English: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
Masaai: anaa enatejo apake too nkirorot oo sinyat, enoo loibonok le Nkai liapa moitie

English: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
Masaai: Ketoni nkera oo sinkan linono te seriani, ore eishoi enye naa keitasheyieki te dukuya iyie.

English: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Saul; ninye o layiok lenyena pokira okuni neidak enkaji enye pooki tenebo.

English: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
Masaai: Aiturrayie nanu enkaji ai, aitaa nanu enjung'ore ai aishooyie nanu ina nanyor to ltau lai, apik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenyena.

English: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:
Masaai: la aiguanani, eishoo Enkai kitok oleng Nebukadnesa, papaai lino enkitoria o enkisisa o esikar;

English: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
Masaai: Nenyaakitia apa Ilfilisti aata olarrabal o Israel, nedoyio Daudi alo te nebo isinkan lenyena nearare ninche Ilfilisti; neilepunye Daudi.

English: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
Masaai: Nikiwal apa aajoki olkitok lang, ‘Kiata papa, naa olpayian kitok oleng, nikiata sii olalashe lang, oti olotioiwuoki te moruao enye, netua apa olalashe lenye, neaku ninye ake etung'uayioki too nkera e ng'otonye; naa kenyor menye ninye oleng.’

English: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
Masaai: Ore etaa kedoyio enkolong, netir injo naairoshi Abram; naa ing'ura, etijinga oloputukunyi kitok le naimin kitok shumata ninye.

English: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
Masaai: Ntajeu iyiook, kitasayia iyie, Olaitoriani! Olaitoriani, kitasayia iyie, nchoo iyiook dupoto!

English: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
Masaai: Neaku etagore Yakobo oleng oleng metaa keitarriki Laban; nejoki Yakobo Laban, “Ainyoo doi enkitarruorroto ai? Ainyoo eng'oki ai pee kitusujua te ngoro sapuk?

English: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye meiguanaki iltung'ana linono te supatisho, neiguanaki lelo aisinak te sipata!

English: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore kuna naa iwuejitin neeyierie lelo oasisho te nkaji e Nkai ilasarri ooishorutua iltung'ana.”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tiaalo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda, metum ninye hoo obo otonie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi, ore empopok enye naa kenang'ari nepej oldalati dama neinosie endeem kewarie.

English: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
Masaai: “Aitorrono, aitorrono,” ejo ilo oinyang'isho, kake te nelo aing'uaa, neaku oloisis kewan.

English: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu olorere ekuetu aasotokino, neing'ode ilo oirirua oiduruk, nejoki, “Lo oirirua ming'ani lemeiro, nanu laaitore, tupuku tung'uai, nimingil ajing ae kata.”

English: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oishoo Olaitoriani Malaki metoliki Israeli.

English: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Shomo, tiaaki ele orere: ‘Ining'ining'i, kake miyiolouu; Idolidolo kake mimususu.’

English: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
Masaai: Adamu nanu nkolong'i e apa, naibirribir nanu nena apa nitaasa; naing'asia te siaai oo nkaik inono.

English: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye iltaleta tiong'ota, neturu ilchorroi kumok, amu eeta apa ninye nkishu kumok oleng too ldoinyio o te nkop naisiasha. Neeta apa ninye ilaramatak o laitobirak loo lng'anayio too ldoinyio o te wueji sidai enterit, amu kenyor apa ninye enturore e nkurma.

English: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
Masaai: Ina etodolua Daudi naas kenya ake Enkai, paa keiroro aimaki empiunoto e Kristo pee ejo: ‘Eitu eing'uari ninye te nemeneng'a. Neitu epurda osesen lenye ang'uoyu.’

English: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena katitin nemeetae eseriani teilo oipang o teilo ojing'u amu etijing'aka enyamali sapuk lelo oomanya nkuapi.

English: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
Masaai: Neshum Yosef entapa te nkumoi naba anaa osinyai le naiposha, o metaa meekure eyiolo eneba ndaiki te nkumoi amu aimeekure etemayu.

English: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, eitu edamu ilo kitok le naisho oo sabibu Yosef, etorikine ninye.

English: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
Masaai: Kake ore pooki toki natii inaaiposha aashu atua ilkejek nemeeta lopir, aashu ilpala, te nena naapuo tiatua nkariak o nena naaishu naatii atua nkariak naa olminong te intae.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina naa keitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye aigil eni are, pee errinyu ilo pisiai apa otelekua loo ltung'ana lenyena, aitung'uaa Asiria, o Misiri, o Patros, o Etiopia, o Elam, o Shina, o Hamat, neitung'uaa sii olomanaa le naiposha.

English: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
Masaai: Kedung'oki ninye nkuapi enkiguana, neiput nkuapi mpopoki; near ninye ilaiguanak te ina kop nalala.

English: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
Masaai: Naa kedumu enkishirata aaishiraki intae, nejoki intae ‘Kaji inkuna peyie iisha too naaiposha, iyie na anasa yioloti, ina apa magilani teina aiposha, iyie o lelo likimanya, lelo ooikonyu olkirutoto lino, tiatua enkop natoyio!

English: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shem naa, Elam, o Ashur, o Arpakashad, o Lud, o Aram.

English: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
Masaai: Metaa ilo iyie te nkoitoi oo ltung'ana supati, nimbung nena oitoi oo lasipak.

English: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
Masaai: Ore pee ening enkitok e Uria nchere etua Uria olmoruo lenye, neishir ninye olkiyioi lo Sina enkaraki olmoruo lenye.

English: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Enoto ena damunoto ti atua intae maate niaatata sii ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
Masaai: Kaing'ae oidim aing'oru nkitarruorot ang? Kitadamutua iyiook nikintobir olnukata te ng'eno.” Amu ore endamunoto e atua o ltau le tung'ani naa kegut!

English: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
Masaai: Ore etoodoro enkiguana narrish, neinyototo Petero, nejoki ninche, “Ilalashera laainei, iyiololo aajo ore apa te nkata naado etegelua Enkai obo linyi, peyie aa te nkutuk ai ening ltung'ana loo Loreren ororei supat, neiruk.

English: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
Masaai: anaa enaikununo olokishoni loo lapolosak, nedoiki enkukuo metaa ninye ojing enkaji o Laitoriani, ainok olasar le nkorropil.

English: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
Masaai: Kake mme nabo tukul Nkitanapat o enkirukoto, amu ejo Nkitanapat, “Ti niaas nena naajo Nkitanapat nipok.”

English: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
Masaai: Paulo, Apolos, o Kefa, enkop, enkishui o keeya, entaata o entaaisere, nkuninyi pooki.

English: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
Masaai: Nejing iltung'ana nkapuniaa oo ndapidapo, o ngumot e nkop, aailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani, neilany ina kitoo e nkisisa enye, te nedumunye aiture enkop.

English: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
Masaai: Ore ninye lelo oinos endaa enye sidai ninche oar ninye. Ore enjore enye neishieki, nebatata ilkumok etaraki too lalema.

English: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitalaku osarge ninye makewan oar ilo aitayio iloikop metua; te nenang'are ninye near ninye metua.

English: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
Masaai: Ore ilo lemeeta Enkai to ltau, nenyor engoro; meishiru ninche eretoto teneen ninye ninche.

English: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Samuel, “Ming'or enaikununo ninye arashu enkadoro enye o lkitashei lenye, amu atanya nanu ninye; amu meing'or Olaitoriani anaa enaing'or tung'ani; eing'or tung'ani enaikununo oriong, kake oltau eing'or Olaitoriani.”

English: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye osinka lenye, “Ilepa taata shomo, ning'or enkalo e naiposha.” Neilep ninye alo neing'or, nejo, “Metii toki.”

English: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
Masaai: naisarrisar nanu eitu aimutie aibung nkitanapat inono.

English: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
Masaai: Eipirri oltung'ani anang'are olikae nenang'are olkilikuai olikae pee eliki olaiguanani le Babilon nchere eibung'aki enkanasa enye te pooki shoto.

English: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
Masaai: Amu etumuta Paulo ajo kegiroo Efeso te meli, pee meya enkata te Asia; eyieu nesiooyo, ejo te neidimayu neyieu netii Yerusalem te nkolong e Pentekoste.

English: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa Yoshua tadekenya enasirie, neyau Israel aitinyiku olosho o losho, neyae olosho le Yuda;

English: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
Masaai: Amu ayieu niyiolouwu eneba enyamali nanyamaliki intae, lelo ootii Laodikea, o lelo pooki leitu ae kata aadol enkomom,

English: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
Masaai: Itipika iyie eng'ida kitok oltau lai nalang eng'ida naata ninche teneponari entapa enye o enaisho oo sabibu.

English: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ilaisiaayiak le nkanasa, too loreren pooki le Israel, naa ketur ninye.

English: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
Masaai: Nadol nanu ilo meregesh eipusho te nkalo o loo ntoluo, o moikuape o kopikop; nemeetae eng'ues naidim aitasho te dukuya ninye; nemeetae hoo obo oidim atokordu enatii abori engolon enye; etaasa anaa enayieu makewan nerup kewan aitaa sidai.

English: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
Masaai: Amu ejo Sadukayo meetae empiunoto, nemeetae ilmalaika, nemeetae enkiyang'et; kake enyorraa ninche Lfarisayo nena pooki.

English: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo tung'ana eirrag aanyisho naa osarge lenye erreshoo, enkishui enye ninye erreshoo.

English: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
Masaai: Ekaitobiru olning'o le seriani tenebo ninche; naa keaku ninche olning'o lo sotua intarasi tenebo ninche; naa kamayian ninche naitaa ninche kumok, naitasheyie tiatua ninche enkaji ai sinyati intarasi o ntarasi.

English: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Naa ore lelo oo lakua naa kepuonu aaretu aashet ina aji Olaitoriani, naa iyiolouu aajo ilo Aitoriani loo lororani ninye laairriwua nanu enetii. Naa kelotu ina bae abaya tininyorraa katukul aairuk ilo toilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
Masaai: Neas ilayiok le Israel ina; neisho Yosef ninche ingarrin te risioroto eina naitanapishe Farao, neisho sii ninche endaa nainosaa epuo te nkoitoi o epuonu.

English: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
Masaai: Kake meyiolo apa ina ayioni toki; Yonatan ake o Daudi ooyiolo ina bae.

English: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
Masaai: Ore endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye lo lmarei le Merari naa Suriel olayioni le Abihail; neun ninche ilng'oborri lenye te nkalo e moikuape o lng'obor le Nkai.

English: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
Masaai: pee kilotu aliki irorei lijeunye, iyie o enkaji ino pooki.’

English: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
Masaai: Amu ore esayiakinoto ang nemepuku eing'uaa enkitapong'oroto anaa ilduruki neme to losek eitobiruaki.

English: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
Masaai: Nchoo kirrepi iyie, Iyie Enkai, te keper! Nchoo enkitoo ino meeu shumata enkop pooki!

English: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
Masaai: Neitarasaki ninye enkishoroto enye Olaitoriani, olkuo obo le ker sitima lemeeta entioto te nkaraki olasar opejori, o esupen nabo e ker o lari obo nemeeta entioto naaku olasar loo ngok, o lmeregesh obo lemeeta entioto oaku olasar le seriani,

English: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche meshomo Lebanon, nepuo ake iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon te nkata nabo to lapa, netii ake iltung'ana Lebanon to lapa obo, netii ang ilapaitin oare. Adoniram apa olkitok le lelo tung'ana oasisho.

English: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lai, olakordunoni lai ogol, intoipo iyie endukuya ai te nkolong o larrabal.

English: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
Masaai: Nedumunye Rebeka tenebo inkaisiaayiak enyena, neked ntamesin neirukurukore ilo tung'ani, neaku etoriko ilo aisiayani Rabeka, nelo enkop enye.

English: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

English: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
Masaai: Ore ti abori erikoroto enye netii enjore oo ltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni o oopishana o iip imiet, ooidim aatigilunore engolon kitok, pee eretu olaiguanani tialo ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

English: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
Masaai: Aaitamana nanu esuntai pee maisik; naapik nanu olpisiai oiroishi.

English: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.
Masaai: nteng'ela iyie nkanas uni te nkaraki ntae teina kop nikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino metaa enino.

English: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.
Masaai: Nenyiku Ilfilisti aaluaa pee earare Isiraeli; ore ake pee eibulaa olarrabal, nemir Ilfilisti Isiraeli nesesekuan iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni ongu'an te ine wueji o larrabal.

English: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
Masaai: Emayiana naa sinyati ilo ong'arieki empiunoto e dukuya. Ore te lelo, nemeeta keeya e are engolon. Kake keaku ninche ilapolosak le Enkai o le Kristo naa keitoreisho ninche te nebo ninye ilarin iip tomon.

English: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

Masaai: Metaa eetae enteipa neetae entadekenya enkolong e uni.

English: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
Masaai: o Eltolad, o Chesil, o Horma,

Masaai: Neeta sii apa Usia enjore oo sikarini, ooidim olarrabal, too lturrurri, terisioroto enkikena e Yeiel ilo aigeroni o Maaseia ilo kitok, tiabori erikoto e Hanania, obo apa loo larikok le njore lo laiguanani.

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.
Masaai: neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eina kine, neyieng ninye te wueji neyieng'ieki lelo asarri oopejori te dukuya Olaitoriani; olasar le ng'oki ninye.

English: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neeniki ninche ninye te nkeene pus, aakurraki shumata ina arasha naeniki endukuya; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

Masaai: Ore enaipukoi olkerubi obo nelo atumore enaipukoi e likae kerubi te mpolos e nkaji.

English: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
Masaai: Eru ninche anaa ng'uesi tiatua ntimi, neiturrurro tenebo too loipi.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa ore teina olong, naa kaing'oru amut lelo oshon pooki oopuonu aarare Yerusalem.

English: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
Masaai: Ore apa obo loo layiok le Yehoiada olayioni le Eliashib, ilo apolosani kitok, naa olaputani le Sanbalat le Horoni; ore enkaraki ina aterewa nanu ninye aitalam kewan.

English: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gibeon naa ntomoni naaudo o imiet.

English: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
Masaai: A'a, “Ore pee eeta olmang'atinta lino esumash, intotio; ore pee eeta enkure nchoo entoki naok; amu ore inko neijia, inkuk naayupuyup inteleikia elukunya enye.”

English: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
Masaai: Ore apa ina masaai naitobirita ninye te nkulukuoni nerruoyo te nkaina o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok, neitoki aitobir aitayunye enkae masaai, anaa enadol o laitobirani too ntokitin oo nkulupuok enaa enadol aa sidai te neas.
