Masaai: Nelo ina kata obo te lelo tomon o aare oji Yudas Iskariot enetii ilapolosak kituaak,

English: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yakobo aitanapa ilayiok lenyena, nerriny inkejek enyena endapash, neirurayie ina. Nepiki ninye eneiturrurrorre olorere lenye pooki.

English: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
Masaai: Eitu ninye eing'or olbuket le Yakobo; neitu ninye edol entorroni te Israel. Etii Olaitoriani Enkai enye te nebo ninche, ore embuakunoto o laiguanani netii te nebo ninche.

English: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche imasaa enyena, neya endukuya enye o masaa enyena o larrabal, neiriwaa ilkiliku aaibulunye enkop pooki oo Lfilisti, pee eyae ilomon supati aayaki nkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin, oltung'ana.

English: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
Masaai: Amu kenyor Olaitoriani esupatisho; meiturraa ninye lelo sinyat lenyena. Kegolieki ilo supat ntarasi, kake ore nkera e ilo torrono naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
Masaai: “Taara metua enkasakutoni.

Masaai: Meetae olkujita ooishooki isinkan linono, ore ake eyia, nejoki ninche iyiook, ‘Entobira ilmatofali!’ Naa ng'ura earitae isinkan linono, kake ore enkitarruoroto netii atua iltung'ana linono ake.”

English: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
Masaai: Itanya iyie lelo oopaash nkitanapat inono; ee, ore enkeleekisho enye naa pesho.

English: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
Masaai: Enaikash oltung'ani aisinani olo te ng'eno enye, alang oltung'ani karsis laa torrok inkoitoi enyena.

English: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Israel ilkiliku olaiguanani le Edom, ejo, ‘Nchoo siaake iyiook maima enkop ino.’ kake etanya olaiguanani le Edom ening. Neitoki sii airriwaki ilkiliku olaiguanani le Moab, kake eitu enyorraa. Neaku etobiko apa Israel te Kadesh.

English: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keitu ae kata isomama too lkigerot, ‘Ore ilo soit otanyaita lashetak otaa osoit kitok lo lmairroto. Ore ilo rorei naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa, naa ole nking'asia too nkonyek ang.’

English: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
Masaai: Negoro apa Musa oleng', nejoki Olaitoriani, “Mishilaa iyie olasar lenye. Eitu ninye nanu aya osikiria lenye neitu ainyal obo lenye.”

English: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
Masaai: Kaae nelo ilo kilikuai, nelotu neliki Daudi nena pooki naairriwua Yoab ninye metoliki.

English: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
Masaai: te nkishui enye neng'idare enkurruna enye naa ntokitin e nkop eenikino ndamunot enye.

English: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
Masaai: Too ngarrin oo mbartan magil, nkalifuni tomon katitin are, nkalifuni o nkalifuni, apa eeunye Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sinai, nelotu atua ine wueji sinyati.

English: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ena olong neas ninche ilo rrekie apake. Meure ninche Olaitoriani, nemerubare ninche nkikoot anaa nkiguanat, anaa nkitanapat apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani nkera e Yakobo laa ninye apa etejoki Israel.

English: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
Masaai: Ore hoo naata esipata aaikenayioki aajo olaimonkoni; meishiunoyou olbae lai, hoo nemaata entorroni.’

English: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
Masaai: Emilej ate; mederrieki Enkai. Amu inaaun oltung'ani elo ake sii aisampu.

English: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aitanapisho neitisinyi ina aji, naitoki nanu arrinyu nena masaa e nkaji e Nkai, tenebo olasar le ntapa o enkorropil.

English: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.

English: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

English: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
Masaai: Tadamu olturrur lino apa litegelaka kewan moitie, ilo apa litokordua pee eaku enjung'ore ino! Tadamu oldoinyo le Sion apa litobikie.

English: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatii esipata e Kristo atua nanu, meetae entoki hoo naamitiki awuasare ina ti atua Akaia.

English: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
Masaai: Ore etiooyo enkirukoto, eton apa kiena iyiook ti abori nkitanapat o metaba anaa neboluni ina kirukoto nalotu.

English: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

English: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:

English: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,

English: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

English: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?

English: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
Masaai: Te nelotu ilo omoni Misiri, nejing ninche osina tenkaraki ilo omoni oipirta Turo.

English: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.

English: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

English: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

Masaai: Kake ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o Kalebu olayioni le Yefune neitu eye, te nebo lelo tung'ana apa ooshomo aaikitalan enkop.

English: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
Masaai: Teneishooyo ninye te nashe, neishooyo ninye imukateni neitu eisuishieki naaipurjaki te ilata, o nkaukau neitu eisuishieki o emukate e ntapa naelieki eilata napuyiapui naaipurjaki te eilata aaitobiraki.

English: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
Masaai: Itudumutua olng'obor le Molok, o lakira le nkai e Rafan, nkitanyaanyukot nintobirakita ate iteserema; kaidurrie naa intae aitogiroo Babilon.’

English: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Babilon neitobir Sukot-be-not. Ore iltung'ana le Kut, neitobir Nergal, ore iltung'ana le Hamat, neitobir Ashima.

English: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
Masaai: Ore pee eshukunye ilkipaareta, neinosaki Yesu mbaa pooki naataasa. Nerik nepuo enkilepata, o metoriko enkanasa naji Betsaida.

English: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore ina sahabu apa nataasishoreki te siaai, te nchetare pooki e wueji sinyati teina sahabu naishorutua iltung'ana, naa talanta tikitam ooudo o shekeli iip naapishana o tomoni uni te risioroto eshekeli e wueji sinyati.

English: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yosef olkilikuai aipotu menye, Yakobo, o lmarei lenye pooki, iltung'ana oobaya ntomoni naapishana o miet.

English: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
Masaai: Neaku kang'iri pooki te nkaraki lelo gelunot, pee etum sii ninche aanoto ina jeunoto ti atua Kristo Yesu, te nebo enkitoo oo ntarasi.

English: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
Masaai: Ore lelo aing'okok ootii Sion neiruto; eibung'a olokirikiri lelo lemeyiolo Enkai: “Kalo ti atua iyiook oidim atotona te nkima nanyaisho? Kalo ti atua iyiook oidim atobiko te nkima oo ntarasi?”

English: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
Masaai: Ore masaa nikiarare neme ake masaa o larrabal; kake keeta nkunaang enkidimata e Enkai enaa keparripar isempewueti.

English: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
Masaai: Ore keeya natua ninye naa ng'ok etanang'a, nabo kata ake. Kake ore enkishui naishu ninye naa te Nkai eishu.

English: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Eli ninye, “Imera ade o anu? Intalamai ina aisho ino.”

English: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
Masaai: Neitoki Yakobo aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Tolikioki aatasayia enkarna ino.” Kake etiaaka, “Ainyoo doi peyie inkilikuanu enkarna ai?” Nemayian ninye teine.

English: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
Masaai: neitobir olopeny ina gumoto neisho impisai olopeny o lkiteng o sikiria neaku ina natua enenye.

English: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
Masaai: Kristo oinyiang'ua iyiook asaru to ldeket loo Nkitanapat etanapa ninye makewan ilo deket te nkaraki iyiook, amu ejo Lkigerot, “Kediaa pooki ng'ae oilili to lchani.”

English: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
Masaai: Naa kaiger nanu te nena soito dapashi irorei ootii nena soito e dukuya nitebela, nipik iyie ninche atua osanduku.

English: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
Masaai: Neyietu pooki ng'ae te ina siamo neiseyie ninye amu, kepuku engolon ti atua ninye neishiunye pooki.

English: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
Masaai: amu etipika ninye enkishui enye nkaik enyena nesesekuan ninye ilo Filisti, neyaki Olaitoriani Israel pooki emirata kitok. Itoduaa apa iyie, ning'idayu; kainyoo naa pee ias eng'oki to sarge lemeeta entioto aar Daudi metua meeta emporeet?”

English: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei asai intae, anaa ilomon o laisikak pee ipaasharere ing'uarrat o sesen naashet enjore naarare iltauja linyi.

English: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
Masaai: entonyorrata intae maate to sotua loo lalashera; entukujata te nkanyit.

English: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
Masaai: Meeta nchere meitigiri ninche, meitoki aaibelekeny nkajijik naalulung'a eiteng'enisho nena nemeitoriori ejo pee etumisho te ntorroni nemeeta esipata naiteng'enishore.

English: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
Masaai: Kijojo intae nanu, ‘Lo Aiteng'enani’, o ‘Lo Kitok’ nitisipa amu kara.

English: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
Masaai: neme ilo orere ake kake keji sii pee eiturrurru nkera e Nkai pooki naaisardaka aitaa nabo.

English: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
Masaai: tenaisudoyie aitemoo enkarruoisho ai too ltung'ana anuk intorrok aainei to lgoo lai,

English: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
Masaai: Ore olalashe le Mika naa Ishia; ore ilayiok le Ishia naa Sakaria.

English: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nimimpiru entorroni to ltau lino tenkaraki olikae. Niminyorru enkinosata olmumai le lejare, amu ore kuna tokitin pooki naa kaiba, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
Masaai: Ore te wueji nejing'ieki ine wueji sinyati nepik nkikeneta o loirien; ore imolinkaishi neriwi aaitobiraki, nemur ninye.

English: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
Masaai: Nena naamisimis too soito le nchan, oine neisudoriyie isoito le nchan ate.

English: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
Masaai: Amu etayiolo apake Enkai ilenyena negelu metotiutu anaa ilo Inoti lenye, pee eaku ilo Inoti olkikau loo lalashera kumok.

English: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
Masaai: Ore erikitoi, neibung'i oltung'ani obo oji Simon le Kirene, oewuo eing'uaa nkurman, neitanapa osalaba, metanapa esujita Yesu.

English: Then spake Haggai the LORD'S messenger in the LORD'S message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Hagai, ilo kilikuai lo Laitoriani, airorie iltung'ana to lkilikuai lo Laitoriani, ejo, “Atii nanu te nebo intae, ejo Olaitoriani.”

English: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
Masaai: nemeisilenoo eponaa arashu eya pooki ponaroto, neibooyo enkaina enye aitung'uaa ntorrok, nedung enkiguana nasipa terishata oltung'ani o likae

English: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
Masaai: Itejo apa iyie to ltau lino, ‘Kailep alo keper; te idia alo ilakir le Nkai kapik olorika lai le nkitoo shumata oleng; katon nanu to ldoinyo le umata te nelakua te nkalo e moikuape;

English: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn oo layiok le Gershom: Libni o Shimei.

English: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
Masaai: Amu aning'ito nanu ing'omakinot kumok. Etii enkuretisho pooki shoto! “Intang'oro ninye! Maitang'oro iyiook ninye!” Tejo ore ilchoreta laainei latamoore, neanyita embatatata ai. “Ekeidimi aatelej ninye, nikisulie iyiook ninye, nikintalaku iyiook elap te ninye.”

English: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
Masaai: (Ore apa lelo tung'ana le njore newaita nena naatarutua ewa ake oltung'ani nkunenyena.)

English: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
Masaai: Neituku ninche inkaik enye o nkejek enye, meye ake. Neaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi te ninche, o te ninye o too ishoritin enyena ti atua ishoritin enye pooki.”

English: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Samuel atoning'o irorei pooki loo ltung'ana, nelimu ninche pooki too nkiyiaa o Laitoriani.

English: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
Masaai: neetae enkata nanang'ari isoito, neetae enkata naiturrurri isoito tenebo; neetae enkata naibung'i aaitamuat nkaik, neetae enkata nemeibung'i aaitamuat nkaik

English: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
Masaai: naa iyie oirorie Papa lang Daudi ilo sinka lino, te Nkiyang'et Sinyati, pee ejo, ‘Aainyo pee epush Iloreren leme Lyahudi, neipiru ltung'ana enkiguana nemeaku?

English: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
Masaai: o layiok le Barkos, o layiok le Sisera, o layiok le Tema,

English: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
Masaai: Ntodolu enyorrata ino nauno te mpukunoto e nking'asia, iyie Laaitajeunoni le lelo likisaru, too lmang'ati lenye te nkaina ino e tatene.

English: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
Masaai: Newal embata oo lasirak aajo, “Olaiteng'enani, iroro aitobiraki.”

English: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
Masaai: Neitoki obo lenye ajoki, “Tonyorrai shomo tenebo isinkan linono.” Newalu ninye ajo, “Kalo nanu.”

English: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Maliki sii nanu intae eneing'uaa engolon naasie kuna baa.”

English: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
Masaai: neitoki aitayu ilgiso aare le sahabu apik ti abori enkamanaa, too nkaloli enyena naaipirakino, pee eibung nena bokishi naanapieki.

English: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
Masaai: Nekurraki ninche pooki nkonyek te ngoro, eisinanuo te nkaraki narook oishuaa, nejoki ilo tung'ani “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neitorioo, neishiu, enkaina.

English: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
Masaai: etesheta Betlehem, o Etam, o Tekoa,

English: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Atigila nanu ina shata e murt o laiguanani le Babilon.

English: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore pooki ng'ae tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, too lporori linyi pooki, tenenyikaki nena tokitin sinyat, naaitisinyakitia iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, eata kereek, ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa ine natii: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: ng'ura kaisho nanu meishunye tene wueji, te dukuya nkonyek inyi o too nkolong'i inyi, oltoilo le ng'ida, oltoilo le nchipai, oltoilo lo loyamisho oltoilo le nayami.

English: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
Masaai: Eirruge oltau lai abaiki enkop; ntopiuoki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino!

English: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
Masaai: “Keaku ena olpolosie leina kop: ore te nkalo e moikuape, eiteru te Naiposha kitok te nkalo enkoitoi e Hetlon, o metabaiki ine nejing'ieki e Hamat, o te nkalo e Sedad, o Berota,

English: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Yoab, “Ng'ura taata, aishorua ena; shomo tushuku ilo barnoti Absalom.”

English: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Solomon atejo ena omono pooki o esayiare to Laitoriani, neinyototo ninye aing'uaa dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, te wueji duoo netigilie kung neilepie nkaik enyena aing'orie keper.

English: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
Masaai: eshum ninche endaa enye te nkata enkirowuaj neiturrurru endaa enye te nkata enkisampuare.

English: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eisika Enkai inyi napi Apis kainyoo pee eitu eitashe oloing'oni linyi? Enkaraki natanang'aka Olaitoriani ninye enkop:

English: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
Masaai: Ore pee erany osinkolio neipung aapuo oldoinyo loo Loirienito.

English: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
Masaai: Neisik Seba o Salmuna; nemir ninye ninche neibung lelo aiguanak pokira oare le Midian, Seba o Salmuna, nepik ninye ina jore pooki olkirutoto.

English: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
Masaai: Eng'ura ate, merikino ake intae olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, apa oitobira ninye tenebo intae, nimintobiruru enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta e ae ake ninye pukunoto natomitikio intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
Masaai: Aimira iyie oloo ntarasi, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai lo Sinyati lai? Mikiye iyiook, Olaitoriani itegelua iyie ninche aitaa iladung'ok le nkiguana; ore iyie na dapidapoi, nintasheyie ninche pee eitameisho.

English: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
Masaai: o te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, te Yeriko, te nkalo oloo saen to lkeju le Yordan, ore to losho le Ruben neyai: Beser tiong'ota, tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Yahasa tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o

English: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
Masaai: meisisi Olaitoriani, endapidapoi ai, laa ninye oitaarriyian nkaik aainei to larrabal, neitayiolo ilkimojik laainei olarrabal;

English: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
Masaai: Wootu taata matoning'oto o lkitok lai olaiguanani le Asiria: Kaaisho nanu iyie mbartan iip are; tenindim iyie te nkalo ino atipika ilakedok shumata ninche.

English: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
Masaai: Kipik iyiook enkishui ang batisho pee kitum endaa, te nkaraki ilo alem tiong'ota.

English: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
Masaai: Ng'ura, nelotu enkitok e Kanaan naing'uaa ina kop neishiraki ajoki, “Lo Kitok, ng'urrieki, ara Daudi, eitanyamalita enkerai ai oloirirua.”

English: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
Masaai: Ng'urai amu kitaarayie nanu ena olong aitung'uaa enkop, nikintalam sii enkomom ino peyie madol, naaku ololo te nkop metaa ore oltung'ani laatum naar nanu matua.”

English: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
Masaai: Atushumaka sii kewan enkosholai o sahabu o lchumati pooki loo laiguanak, loo lkirinen; anoto sii ilaranyak, ilewa o ng'oruo o nkapiak kumok oleng, inkituaak kumok naayieu olee neeta.

English: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
Masaai: Naitoki aing'orisho naa ng'ura, enkatampoi naibor. Netonita te ina atampoi obo onyaanyukie enkerai e tung'ani, neishopito te lukunya enye enkopiya e nkitoo e sahabu, neibung'ita olalem opi oololo te nkaina enye.

English: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.
Masaai: Nelo Elkana ang te Rama. Neisiaai ina ayioni Olaitoriani te ine netii Eli ilo apolosani.

English: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
Masaai: Nejoki Yepta ninche, “Ore nanu o ltung'ana laainei nikitii olarrabal kitok te nebo Ilamoni; ore ake pee aipotu nanu intae, neitu kikordudu nanu te nkaina enye.

English: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nemuoyu olayioni oji Abija, olayioni le Yeroboam.

English: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
Masaai: kake ore entonata te nkaina ai e tatene aashu te ne kedienye, mme nanu oishoru, kake ene lelo laa ninche eitobirakaki.”

English: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues apa natii nemetii taata, naa ene isiet kake ene nena naapishana sii, naa kelotu enkidaaroto.

English: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
Masaai: Nikirrapirrapu iyiook esuntai kipuo anaa iltung'ana modook, nikirrapirrapisho anaa iltung'ana lemeeta nkonyek; nikirroro dama nikitiu anaa iloopuoito te nkinuku, ore ti atua lelo tung'ana oogol kitotiutuo anaa iltung'ana ootuata.

English: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
Masaai: Ore too loisotok loo mbartan enyena naa keituny inkoitoi dapashi e nkanasa inyi naa kear iltung'ana linyi to lalem; ore ing'apeta inyi kituaak naa kesulakini enkop.

English: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
Masaai: ore etii Yehanum, eitamei, nedumu nkonyek, nedol Abraham elakua netii Lasaro olgoo lenye.

English: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the LORD have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the LORD; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the LORD, saying, Go, serve other gods.
Masaai: Ore naa taata nchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani ening irorei lo sinka lenye. Tenaa Olaitoriani likituputuo iyie taaraki nanu, metang'amu ninye olasar; kake tenaa iltung'ana, metaa kediaa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu aataaraitie ninche aaipang'ie ena olong pee matum nanu eng'arata e njung'ore o Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Shomo isiaayia kulie aitin.’

English: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
Masaai: Neijia etiu inkoitoi e lelo pooki ootum dupoto te nkikonya; eitayu enkishui aaitung'uaa iloopeny.

English: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
Masaai: Amu etataama ina olong o Laitoriani te shumata iloreren pooki. Ore anaa enitaasa, ina eyookini aitaas intae, keshukokino nkiaasin inyi shumata ilukuny inyi maate.

English: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake etorikoyie Enkai iltung'ana aitamanaa te nkoitoi o lpurkel aing'orie Enaiposha Nanyokie. Neilepu iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri eterretenate to larrabal.

English: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: nejoki, “Enchooki sii ninye nanu ena kidimata paa ore ake oltung'ani laiteleiki nkaik neng'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati.”

English: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
Masaai: Neiteng'en ninye ninche nejo:

English: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
Masaai: Amu Mordekai ilo Yahudi naa ninye apa osujita te nkitoo olaiguanani Serser, naa aikitok too Lyahudi nening'o to lorora loo lalashera lenyena, amu eing'orua olmabarishoi loo ltung'ana lenyena neiro eseriani too ltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Etua Musa osinka lai; ore naa taata tudumunye, shomo talang'a Yordan, iyie o kulo tung'ana pooki, enchom atua ina kop naishorita nanu ninche, iltung'ana le Israel.

English: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
Masaai: Eno Laitoriani Enkai ang olng'ur o empalakino amu kitogolong'akitia iyiook ninye,

English: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
Masaai: Nejoki Uria Daudi, “Ore osanduku le Nkai, e Israel o Yuda nebikito too lng'oborri; ore olkitok lai Yoab o sinkan lo lkitok lai netii ilng'oborri ti ong'ata naisiaja; kalo naa nanu enkaji ai, adaa naokisho, nairrag te nebo enkitok ai? Anaa eninchu, o anaa enaishu oltau lino, maas nanu ena bae.”

English: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
Masaai: Newaliki Filipo ajoki, “Mebaiki ninche inaainosieki dinarii iip are, te neishori pooki ng'ae enkiti.”

English: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai; inchoo metijing'a ewang'an, nejing ewang'an.

English: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
Masaai: Amu etegelaka Olaitoriani kewan Yakobo, etegelua Israel aitaa olenye.

English: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
Masaai: naa tenaa ore enkishorunoto ino naa olasar le ntapa nateyiaraki te nkarae, nchoo eaku ole ntapa sidai neitu eisuishieki, naipurjaki te eilata;

English: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
Masaai: Nepuku lelo oiriruani te ilo tung'ani, nejing ilbitiro; nekuet ina luaata oo lbitiro to loshong'ishongi neimis te naiposha neya enkare.

English: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
Masaai: Ore teina kop sinyati nirishu aoru erubata intemat nkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadoro o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te ndapasho, naa ninche ejing ina aji sinyati, ewueji sinyati oleng.

English: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
Masaai: Nchoo enkiok ino einining, nincho nkonyek inono eing'orisho, pee ining enkomono o sinka lino, naomon taata nanu te dukuya iyie, dama o kewarie, te nkaraki iltung'ana linono le Israel, isinkan linono, airridu ing'ok oo ltung'ana le Israel, nikitaasa iyiook tialo iyie. Ee ore nanu o enkaji e papaai lai nikitaasa eng'oki.

English: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura, ilo kenya adol teina olong nilo ajing'ie olgilata liaji isudori.”

English: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
Masaai: Aisisita intae amu kidamumu te pooki toki o enkaraki nitukurrakita aaibung ilkerreti anaa enapake naitarasaka intae.

English: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the LORD, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.
Masaai: Ng'ura, anaa enaata enkishui ino tipat ena olong too nkonyek aainei, neaku metaa enkishui ai ene tipat too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa maatokordu ninye aitayu ti atua isinaitin pooki.”

English: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie kuna tokitin neiduruku ninye, neituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
Masaai: Neas isiaaitin enye pooki pee edol iltung'ana, amu eitalala lkerreti lenye neitulus enkikodo oo nkilani enye.

English: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
Masaai: Amu etaboloki nkutukie torrok e lejere te nkaraki nanu, pee eiro ti alo nanu mbaa e lejare.

English: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
Masaai: pee eitalaku elap too loshon neitame lelo lemeure Enkai,

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore pooki ng'ae otaasa eng'oki te nanu, ninye ajut enkarna enye ti atua embuku ai.

English: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Olaitoriani aing'or Petero. Nedamu Petero ororei lo Laitoriani otiaka, “Ore ade taata eitu eru olkuku aikimiki iyie katitin uni.”

English: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
Masaai: Aaibalakinyie nanu iyie eng'oki ai te iyie neitu nanu aisudoo entorroni ai; atejo nanu, “Kairridu nkitarruorot aainei to Laitoriani;” nikitapalaka iyie esuujisho e ng'oki ai.

English: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, lalashera laainei, maidim apa airorie intae anaa ltung'ana ootamanya enkiyang'et e Nkai kake anaa ltung'anak ake, anaa nkera kutiti ti atua Kristo.

English: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ebaiki ntarasi o ntarasi! Naa nchoo ejo iltung'ana pooki, “Esai!” Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
Masaai: Neisis ilo oro kewan oleng, kake ore ina kata egol ninye, negila ina mouo enye kitok, ore te rishata enye, nepuonu imowuarak ong'uan e nking'asia naaing'uaa ilkutat pokira ong'uan le shumata.

English: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
Masaai: “Too nkolong'i ile taasisho, kake ore te nkolong e naapishana niyeng'iyeng'a; ore te nkata e nkiremore o te nkisampuare niyeng'iyeng'a.

English: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
Masaai: Iyie oitore engolon e naiposha, naa te nedumunye ilopir lenyena, nintirring'ie ninche.

English: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
Masaai: Neirut oleng te nkaraki lelo rorei, nejo to ltau, “Kaji eikununo ena kirorokino?”

English: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
Masaai: Ore pee ening kulikae ooitashe te ine nejo, “Ining, Eliya eipoto.”

English: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
Masaai: kake ore ile Lawi neitaman ilng'oborri lenye ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho, pee metumi ake embae naitagorisho ti alo eumata oo ltung'ana le Israel; naa ile Lawi ooitasheiki ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho.”

English: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu ilgiso aare le sahabu nimbungie lelo lemowuarak aare le nkila to lgoo te nkalo e atua te mbata e ina kila dorrop.

English: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
Masaai: Neaku etasotishe ninye ti atua enkurma o metaa teipa; neitoki aidong nena naatasotuo ninye, neaku efa nabo e ntapa naji shairi.

English: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
Masaai: Nilo ajo to ltau lino: ‘Kaing'ae laatoikio nanu kuna? Aatung'uayioki apa aa nanu ake nara olupi, nashomo eyararoto naayae enelakua, kake aing'ae naitubulua kuna? Ng'ura, aatung'uayioki apa aa nanu ake; Kaji naa eimutua kuna?’ ”

English: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
Masaai: Kake etua apa Nadab o Abihu ina kata apa pee eitarasaki enkima nemesinya Olaitoriani.

English: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Enkaraki naatung'uaitie ninche nanu, netapejo ninche enkorropil te nkaraki nkulie aitin, pee aatum ninche aaitagoro teina siaai pooki oo nkaik enye. Ore enkaraki ina keyupuyup engoro ai tenkaraki ene wueji, nemeyagaa.

English: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
Masaai: Metaa etungueikia apa pooki naata metaa Yosef oitasheiki; neaku ore eeta ninye, eitu eitoki anyamaliki ae toki meteleku endaa ake nanya ninye. Ore apa Yosef naa oltung'ani sidai te nking'urata.

English: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Kaisho nanu enkishiaa ai pooki meshomo te dukuya iyie, naibalunye te dukuya iyie enkarna ai, ‘Olaitoriani’; naipirisie nanu ilo laipirisie naing'urrie ilo laing'urrie.”

English: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
Masaai: hoo nikituata apa te nkaraki nkitarruorrot ang, enyaaka ninye aitopiu iyiook pee kinchu te nebo Kristo, (enkaraki empiris pee eitajewuoki intae)

English: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
Masaai: Amu aikiyiolo aajo te neidaikieki ele ng'obor te nkop likimanya nikiaata emanyisho naing'uaa Enkai, e nkaji neme too nkai eitobiraki, nabikoo te shumata ntarasi.

English: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
Masaai: Ore sii pooki tung'ani too ltung'ana le Israel aashu lelo omon ootii atua ninche olo arresh aibung eng'ues aashu emotonyi pee etumi aainosa neibukoo osarge lenye neitemoo too nkulukuok.

English: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
Masaai: Ketorikine Olaitoriani olng'ur? Keibooyie ninye olng'ur lenye te ngoro enye?”

English: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
Masaai: Ijo iyie ira olaiguanani enkaraki nishet inkajijik oo ltarakua? Keitu apa edaa papaai lino neokisho neas esipata o esupatisho? Neaku etaa sidai te ninye.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, te lelo pooki le yararoto apa natarayie nanu meshomo eyararoto aaing'uaa Yerusalem nepuo Babilon:

English: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
Masaai: tenainosa ilng'anayio lenyena eitu alak, nayau keeya oo loopeny;

English: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ooyau eoro, ile na kop ninche lemeeta Enkiyang'et Enkai.

English: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
Masaai: Adolita nanu ninye, kake mme tena kata; adolita ninye, kake mme taana; eipang'ua olakira ti atua Yakobo, naa keilepu eng'udi enkitoo te Israel; kedany ninye olpura le nkomom le Moab. negiligil ilayiok pooki le Sheti.

English: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
Masaai: Naa te neishiaakino intae ina aji, nejing osotua linyi shumata ninye, naa te nemeishiaakino, neshukokino intae osotua linyi.

English: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore anaa enkerai nailejilej ng'otonye, kaailejilej nanu iyie aiko neijia; eikipuoi aaitigir iyie te Yerusalem.

English: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
Masaai: “Kagelaki nanu shumata ninche mpukunot ong'uan oo looidaikie, Olaitoriani ojo: olalem oar, ildien oopolos, olmotonyi lo loing'ang'e o ng'uesi enkop pee emut ninche aaidaikie.

English: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
Masaai: Neitoki ake sii aitobiru ilgululu oopurupurana oonyaanyukie kukumanka ilkererin oare pee eitoip nena lukuny oo ng'apeta.

English: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Masaai: Aidim ataasa mbaa pooki ti atua ilo laa ninye laaidimie.

English: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
Masaai: Neilep Musa alo oldoinyo, neitoip enkatampoi oldoinyo,

English: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etagorokine Olaitoriani Isiraeli oleng, neiwuang'ie ninche te dukuya ninche; eitu eing'uari toki meteleku olosho le Yuda ake.

English: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
Masaai: Neya Yoab o ltung'ana lenyena osesen le Asahel, nenukaa te nkurare e papaai lenye, apa natii Betlehem. Nelo Yoab o ltung'ana lenyena enkewarie pooki, neilepaki ninche enkolong te Hebron.

English: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
Masaai: Eteshetaka Turo kewan esuntai nagol, netasoto ninye enkosholai naba anaa enterit, tenebo sahabu naba anaa enterit oo nkoitoi.

English: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
Masaai: Nelo apa Yerubaal olayioni le Yoash aton te nkaji enye.

English: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
Masaai: Eiturrurru ninche endaa enye tiong'ota, nesot isabibu too nkurman oo larruok.

English: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
Masaai: Ore Tomas oji Olmaoi, laa obo le lelo tomon o aare, nemetii te nebo ninche pee elotu Yesu.

English: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?
Masaai: Kake etiaakitia lelo lkituaak loo Lamoni Hanan olkitok lenye, “Ijo iyie ore enkaraki nikirriwaka iyie Daudi iltung'ana likintagol naa keyanyitita papaai lino? Keitu ninye eirriu Daudi isinkan lenyena enitii iyie pee eing'or enkanasa, neikeern ninye, nenang'aa ninye?”

English: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
Masaai: Anaa oldia orrinyokino irrugumat enyena, neijia etiu olmodai oigil emodai enye.

English: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yoab ninye, “Iro iyie anaa nabo oo nkituaak naamoda. Aiking'amu esidai te nkaina Enkai, nimiking'amu intorrok?” Ore te kuna pooki eitu eas Yoab eng'oki te nkutuk enye.

English: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
Masaai: Nejo Mariamu, “Kara nanu esinka o Laitoriani; metotiwuo te nanu anaa enitejo.” Nelo olmalaika aing'uaa ninye.

English: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.
Masaai: Tudumunye, ntisinya iltung'ana, nijoki, ‘Entisinya ate te nkaraki taisere, amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, “Ntokitin apa naaiteng'elaki kuna naatii atua intae, Israel; mindim iyie aitasho te dukuya ilmang'ati, linono, o metaba anaa nintayu nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki aiwuang'ie ti atua iyie.”

English: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
Masaai: naa kaiterep olng'ejep lino enoret ino, metaa iaku olemeidim airoro aikoo ninche; amu enkaji kiserut ninche.

English: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata naaigany Enkiyang'et, naa ng'ura, euno olorika le nkitoo te keper, netii obo otonita te ilo orika.

English: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
Masaai: Nepuo aaitagol erripoto e nkurare, nepik olmishire osoit te nebo ilarripok.

English: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.
Masaai: Ore nena kulie ng'uesi neoruni enkitoria enye, kake ore enkishui enye neitoodoroki te rishata o te nkata.

English: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
Masaai: Netii ilgorieti oomanita, intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet enkadori naa intemat imiet endapasho.

English: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spake, Come, and let us go to the seer: for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
Masaai: (Ore apa te Israel, te nelo oltung'ani aikilikuanisho ti alo inaaipirta Enkai, nejo ninye, “Wootu maapeiti enetii oladuani,” amu ore ilo taata oji oloiboni naa keji apa oladuani.

English: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
Masaai: Amu eitu ninye emenu aashu eiteeng lelo oaata osina; neitu ninye eisudoo enkomom enye te ninye, kake etoning'o ninye ina kata pee eishiraki ninye te nkaraki eretoto.

English: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
Masaai: neiu Hesekia Manase; neiu Manase Amon; neiu Amon Yosia;

English: When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;
Masaai: “Tenilotu akenya ina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino, niya aitaa enino, nimany ninye, nintoki ajo, ‘Kapik olaiguanani shumata nanu, anaa kulo oshon pooki laamanita;’

English: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Airriwaka nanu atua intae olmeitai anaa apa enaikununo te Misiri; naar nanu ilbarnot linyi to lalem; naya nanu imbartan inji aiwuang'ie naya nanu olng'usil loo lng'oborri linyi apik nkumeishin inyi; ore eyia eitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
Masaai: Kake ore taata ti atua Kristo ore intae iloolakuaniki apa oleng neitinyikuaki intae ti atua ilo sarge le Kristo.

English: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
Masaai: Naa keaku enkitanapata oo nkatitin pooki te ninche. Ore ilo oisuaaya ina are naitisinyishoreki neituku ilkilani lenyena neaku mesinya o metaa teipa.

English: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
Masaai: Nanu oirriwua ninye enitii te nkaraki ena pee iyiolouu enaikununo, netum ninye ailejileja iltauja linyi.

English: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

Masaai: Tuputunye nchira kewarie, te nkiterunoto e pooki kata e rripore! mbukoi oltau lino anaa enkare te dukuya Olaitoriani! Ilepie nkaik inono te dukuya ninye, te nkaraki enkishui oo nkera inono, naaiterre to lameyu te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi nalala e nkanasa.

English: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, tiaaki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri o lororani lenyena inchere: “Aing'ae doi inyaanyukie iyie te sapuko ino?

English: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Tena iyie iyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani: ng'ura, ekaosh nanu enkare natii atua olkeju le Nail tena ng'udi naata te nkaina ai, naa keibelekenya aaku osarge.

English: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
Masaai: Aisupat Olaitoriani osempewuet ninye te nkolong e nyamali; eyiolo ninye lelo oosaru ninye.

English: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
Masaai: Neme lido kekun le naiposha etii, metaa ijo iyie, kalo olo alang enaiposha te nkaraki iyiook, pee elo ayaki iyiook, pee kitum aatoning nikiaas?’

English: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
Masaai: Amu eewuo Yohana Olaibatisani eitupukoo kewan, nemeok enaisho oo sabibu; nijojo intae, ‘Keeta oloirirua.’

English: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
Masaai: Neitoki ake aigil aiu enkayioni, neisho ng'otonye enkarna enye ajo Shela. Naa Kesib apa etii peyie eiu Shela.

English: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
Masaai: kake enchooi olasar le nkima, olasar opejori te nkaraki Olaitoriani: iloing'ok oare ooti, olmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo; toduaa nchere meeta entioto;

English: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
Masaai: Near ninye metuata lelo kikaunot pooki le Misiri, lelo ng'anayio lenye le dukuya ti atua olng'obor le Haam.

English: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
Masaai: Miking'ode nanu, pee atum atayiolo enchipai, eton eitu alo nemaitoki atii.”

English: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
Masaai: “Kake ore pee idolidolo Yerusalem etamana mpuot, entayiolo aajo etinyikua emutata enye.

English: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
Masaai: Ina peyie aaitieu airoro imbaa enyena maata enkuretisho amu ime neijia atiu tiatua enkewan ai.

English: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia aitirrishaka nanu airriwaki intae isinkan laainei pooki lelo oibonok le Nkai, ajo, ‘Ee, miaas ena taboi naiba nanu!’

English: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.
Masaai: Ore te siadi neitanyamal Daudi oltau lenye, enkaraki natudung'oyie ninye olcholoi lo lkila le Saul.

English: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
Masaai: Metaa ore ilo malaika laairorie aatiaaka, Inchira tabuaku tejo, ena ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Aata olom sapuk tenkaraki Yerusalem o Sion.

English: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
Masaai: nejo aing'orisho, eitashe olaiguanani te mbata e ng'ape, anaa enatiu olkerreti lenye, ore ilarikok le njore o laoshok loo ntarumpetani ootashare olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki leina kop, neshipa neosh ntarumpetani. Nepolos Atalia nkilani enyena neishir ajo, “Entorroni! Entorroni!”

English: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye, ‘Shomo, amu nanu laairriwaa enelakua shomo enetii Loreren.’ ”

English: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo laa ninye oitasheiki osanduku oshumishoreki, “Iyau masaa o ntokitin enkisiaayiare te nkaraki eseremare e Baal.” Neyau ninye nena masaa,

English: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
Masaai: Kaing'ae olo aked ilo doinyo lo Laitoriani? Naa kaing'ae olo aitashe te wueji enye sinyati?

English: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
Masaai: Aime iyie apa oitoyio enaiposha, nena ariak e ine wueji kitok negut; aime iyie apa oitaa enguton e naiposha enkoitoi, pee etum lelo ootokorduaki aaima?

English: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong naa keitashe nkejek enyena toldoinyo loo loirienito, ilo otii dukuya Yerusalem te nkalo o loosaen. Ore ilo doinyo loo loirienito naa keiperra kat are eiteru to loo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo aaku eululu sapuk. Metaa ore ematua nabo oldoinyo nelo enkalo e moikuape ore enkae seshati oldoinyo nelo enkalo e kopikop.

English: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
Masaai: Kake etamorua Yehoida, neye; naa oloo larin iip o tomoni uni apa ninye ina kata pee eye.

English: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
Masaai: neitokini taa aayau kulikae soito nepiki erishata e lekua soito, neyau ninye ae turoto nemurie enkaji.

English: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
Masaai: “Kelo Aron eneiturrurrore iltung'ana lenyena apa ootuata; amu mejing ninye atua ina kop naishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel, amu etogolong'aka apa enkitanapata ai too nkariak e Meriba.

English: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
Masaai: Kebaa enkitoo oo siaitin inono, Olaitoriani! Kegut oleng ndamunot inono!

English: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
Masaai: Neyau Daudi ailepunye lelo tung'ana lenyena apa ootii te nebo ninye, oltung'ani ake o enkaji enye; nebik ninche too nkang'itie e Hebron.

English: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
Masaai: Bet-nimra o Bet-haran, nkanas naasheta sunta, o muatat oo nkerrai.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura kanang'aa nanu boo lelo oomanya ena kop tena kata, nayau nanu osina shumata ninche, pee etum ninche aatayiolo.”

English: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
Masaai: Neiguan ng'otonye, nejo, “Inchooki tena mbesen elukunya e Yohana Olaibatisani.”

English: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oitobira shumata (ninye Enkai!), ilo oitobirua enkop neitayu (ninye oitotona; eitu ninye eitobir olmuate, eitayio ninye pee emanyi!): “Ara nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae.

English: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
Masaai: Iton aibung ina oitoi musana, naa ninye apa eima ilarruok?

English: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
Masaai: Neiput Sakaria, menye lenye Enkiyang'et Sinyati neibonisho ajo,

English: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
Masaai: Eibung Olaitoriani airishu lelo pooki oobatata, nedumu ailepunye lelo pooki oolepokino enkop.

English: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.
Masaai: enkaraki nairridua oltau lino nintoborro kewan te dukuya Enkai, ina kata pee ining irorei lenyena ooipirta ene wueji o lelo oomanya, nintoborro iyie kewan tialo nanu, nitopolosa iyie nkilani inono ninchir te dukuya nanu, aatoning'o sii nanu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
Masaai: Kake tenaa naaji keitasheito ninche te nkiguana ai, anaata etolimutuo irorei laainei too ltung'ana laainei, naa anaata aibelekenya ninche metung'uai nkoitoi enye torrok, o entorroni oo nkiaasin enye.

English: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
Masaai: Neishori embuku o loiboni le Nkai Isaya. Nebol ina buku netum ewueji netisiraki aajo,

English: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ng'ura, esintani ino eshomo olorere lenye nelo enetii nkaitin enyena; torrinyoyu tusuja esintani ino.”

English: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
Masaai: neisulieki ina kop te dukuya Olaitoriani; ore naa te siadi ina nindimidimi aatorrinyoto, nimintokiki aatakinore to Laitoriani o te Israel; ore ena kop naa keaku eninyi te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
Masaai: Metedeki olalejani pooki ooata olkuoo supat te luaata enye, neinos olmumai ejo ekaishoru eji neitoki apolosaki Olaitoriani ina naata eleyiata. Amu ara nanu olaiguanani kitok, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani naa keurei enkarna ai too loreren pooki.

English: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
Masaai: Ore obo le lelo oare ootoning'o Yohana eiro, nesuj ninye, naa Andrea, olashe le Simon Petero.

English: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
Masaai: Nenya ninche nena tokitin naaitobirieki to lning'o lo sotua, pee epikieki ninche esiaai sinyati, neitisinyi, kake menya oltung'ani le boo, amu eisinyat ninche.

English: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
Masaai: Kake keitajeuni enkitok te ishoi oo nkera te nebik ti atua enkirukoto, o enyorrata o esinyatisho, te nebo eng'eno o esupatisho te nebo eng'eno biyoto.

English: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu olkilikuai ajoki ninye, “Eyautua ninche ilukuny oo layiok lo laiguanani,” nejo ninye, “Erragie ninche too lturrurri oare tembata e kishomi o mekenyu.”

English: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
Masaai: too nkutukie oo nkera kutiti o naanakita, intobira iyie olkitamanyunoto le negol, te nkaraki ilmang'ati linono, pee imbooyo ilo mang'atinta o ilo oitalaku elap.

English: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
Masaai: Nesai, ajoki, “Etaa keye entito ai kiti. Wou inteleiki nkaik, pee eishiu, nepok.”

English: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
Masaai: Ore imasaa o lkarsis naa enkanasa enye nagol, netiu anaa esuntai naado namitu ninye.

English: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Masaai: Aing'orua nanu Olaitoriani naawaliki ninye, naakordu ninye nanu te nkuretisho ai pooki.

English: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
Masaai: Na tito e Babilon, iyie naainyalani! Emayiana ilo oing'oru te iyie ina apa nintaasa iyiook!

English: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
Masaai: Mikirubare iyiook mbaa torrok e nkiborra oo nkonyek, anaa enaikuna ilkulikae lenye, ore te nkolong nabo neye nkalifuni tikitam o okuni.

English: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
Masaai: Entayioloito naa intae inchere, ore ena jeunoto e Nkai, eirriwakaki Loreren; ekeinining'u ninche.”

English: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
Masaai: Ning'ueikiki intae enkarna inyi lelo gelunot laainei meitaa oldeket, naa kear intae Olaitoriani Enkai entuata; kake ore lelo sinkan lenyena naa keipot ninye ti ae arna.

English: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
Masaai: Metaa keeta ilo aisinani osiligi, ore imbaa nemetii isipat nenuk enkutuk enye.

English: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
Masaai: Enyor Olaitoriani lelo ooiba enkarruoisho, negolie ninye enkishui oo sinyat lenyena; nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina e ilo arruoni.

English: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
Masaai: Ore nena nitayioloto, nitang'amutua, nitoning'o, nitoduaa te nanu, entaas; neaku Enkai e seriani te nebo intae.

English: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
Masaai: Wootu enchamishama pee idolidolo aajo eisupat Olaitoriani! Emayiana ilo tung'ani osaru ninye!

English: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
Masaai: laa ninye etolikio Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem:

English: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
Masaai: Neureishoyu ninche pooki; neisis Enkai nejo, “Einyo oloiboni kitok le Nkai ti atua iyiook,” nejo sii, “Eewuo Enkai abaiki ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
Masaai: Ore ina kitokoos oo ltung'ana naa keitadouni, ore ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana naa keitoborri; neaku Olaitoriani ake eitaae kitok te ina olong.

English: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
Masaai: Keaku Dan olasurai te nkoitoi, enturbubua te nkoitoi, ina naony intutuny oo mbartan, ometusulu ilo okedito embarta.

English: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
Masaai: Metaa kear ninche olng'atuny oing'uaa entim metuata, keidaikie ninche osuyiani oing'uaa olpurkel. Erreshito olkinyalasho nkanas enye, ore pooki ng'ae ooipang tiatua ninche nepolosi aaitaa ndung'udung'ot; amu eikumok nkitarruorrot enye, ore nchukot enye errinyo siadi naa aikumok.

English: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
Masaai: Nimiya enkanashe enkitok ino ayam eton eishu enkanashe enye.

English: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
Masaai: Neishori ina kitok e Samson ilo apa oboitare ninye, aa ninye apa shepu-lkerra lenye.

English: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
Masaai: Entasieku wootu, intae iloreren pooki ootaana, enturrurro ate teine. Ntadou ilmurran linono, iyie Olaitoriani.

English: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki Farao Yosef, “Eewuo papaai lino o lalashera enitii.

English: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
Masaai: Oi! Isikaki Sion, iyie ilo oboitare ina tito e Babilon.

English: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
Masaai: ejo, “Etabaua enkata, netinyikua enkitoria e Enkai; erridutu, naa eruko ele rorei supat.”

English: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
Masaai: Neyau ninche ilo ng'obor enetii Musa, ilo ng'obor o ntokitin enyena pooki, o lala lenyena oo lolo, o rubat oo isunta enyena, o loom lenyena, o ng'apeta enyena, o nkitotoneta enyena;

English: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
Masaai: nchere entang'amu to Laitoriani anaa enaishiaakino lelo sinyat, niretutu te mbae ake pooki nayieu te intae, amu ninye nataa enkaretoni oo lkumok ebaiki latii nanu.

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ninche apa eishooki nkanas e sarunoto. Shekem tenebo nena daat enyena oo nchoo, te nkop oo ldoinyio e Efraim. O Geser tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
Masaai: Emincho hoo elej intae oltung'ani too rorei le pesho, amu enkaraki oshi kuna baa pee edoiki engoro e Enkai nena kera nemening'isho.

English: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
Masaai: eikaolote ninche neishooitie ate aaisho iloirerioni, netum enkului e pooki bae naiduruk.

English: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Oyiote: Etupukuo enainosi tiatua ina nainosisho. Etupukuo entoki namelok aimu ina nagol.” Neitu ninche eidim aatayiolo ilo oyiote too nkolong'i uni.

English: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
Masaai: Anaa enaikununo olgisoi le sahabu te nkume embitir, nejia etiu enkitok sidai nemeeta eng'eno naret.

English: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
Masaai: Ng'ura ajo kaar ninye matua, aaiting'o osiligi kake kamitu inkoitoi aainei te dukuya enkomom enye.

English: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ng'olikinoto ai, naing'oru nanu Olaitoriani; ore te ina kewarie neitoriori enkaina ai menauru, neany oltau lai eitigiri.

English: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
Masaai: “Ore tena kaaisis nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, ti atua iloreren, naa karanyaki irrepat e nkarna ino.

English: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
Masaai: kayau nanu entorroni shumata enkaji e Yeroboam, naiwuang'ie te Yeroboam pooki lee, aa oloena o lolakuno tiatua Israel pooki, namut nanu enkaji e Yeroboam tukul, anaa enapejoo oltung'ani olchala neishie.

English: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi arasaki olaiguanani Hadadesa le nkop e Siria naji Soba, natii embata enkop e Hamat, amu keyieu apa Hadadesa neing'oru pee eitore ina kop aimu te nkalo e shumata e Frati.

English: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
Masaai: Nejoki Petero, “Ananias, aainyo pee nchoo Sheitani mikintoria oltau lino teleja Enkiyang'et Sinyati adung'oo ematua oo mpesai nitimirie te nkurma ino?

English: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai Gehasi, “Terretena empolos ino, ninap eng'udi ai te nkaina ino, nilo. Teninang'are oltung'ani nimiroroki ninye, naa tenikiroroki ninye niming'amaa, nilo aiteleiki ena ng'udi enkomom eina kerai.”

English: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
