Masaai: Kake eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata:

English: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
Masaai: pee kitum oltau lai aisisa iyie nemegira. Olaitoriani Enkai ai, kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ntarasi.

English: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
Masaai: “Eigeroki eng'oki e Yuda te nkalamu e sekenkei, ore te ntopij e almasi, etisiraki te mbao oltau lenye, o too mowuarak oo lperereni lenye loo lasarri.

English: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
Masaai: Ore pee einyototo aapuo aainyiang'u, nebau olayamisho, nejing nena naaterretenate tenebo oloyamisho atua osirua le nkiyama; neikeni kutuk aji.

English: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
Masaai: Neitoriori ninye te shumata ina ayioni katitin uni, neishiraki Olaitoriani, ejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, nchoo enkishui ena kerai errinyokino.”

English: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
Masaai: Amu kiaata iyiook ilo rorei le naibon oitadedeyieki oleng nitaasa intae esidai te ning'amaa ninye anaa oltaa ooilang ewueji nemisimis o metaba naa nekenyu, neilepu olakira too ltauja linyi.

English: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo tung'ana kituaak neisho ninche Solomon endaa o pooki oopuonu emisa o laiguanani Solomon, oltung'ani ake neishooyo endaa to lapa lenye; eitu ninche eisho metongoro hoo toki.

English: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
Masaai: Nikira iyiook shakeni le nena baa pooki naataasa te nkop oo Lyahudi, o te Yerusalem. Ninye doi etara ninche, aashe to lchani.

English: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
Masaai: Eya ninye lelo ng'eni to losek lenye maate, ore inkitobirat e lelo lo losek neiting'ie asioki.

English: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
Masaai: Eiwuang'ieki enkopiyia e nkitoo te ndukuya ang; oi iyiook, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki!

English: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
Masaai: Eishorua olaiguanani Solomon olasar ilmong'i nkalifuni tikitam oare, o nkerra nkalifuni iip o tikitam. Ore olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki neitisiny ina aji e Nkai.

English: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, neipotu olaiguanani Yehoash Yehoida olapolosani o kulikae apolosak nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee mintobiriri enkaji aaram? Ore naa taata mintokiki aaya mpesai te lelo liyiolorere, kake enchooi nena pisai pee eitobirieki enkaji.”

English: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
Masaai: Ewaita entung'uayioki nanu enkilepilep oo sinkolioitin linyi; mainining nanu oltoilo loo nkinantani inyi.

English: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
Masaai: Ore pee edol intoiwuo neing'asia. Nejoki ng'otonye, “Na kerai; aainyo pee inkuna iyiook inji? King'orutua iyie, nanu o papaai lino te nkirutoto o to sina.”

English: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.
Masaai: Midol anaa entoki nagol tenilaaya ninye meshomo; amu to lpisiai le laakinoto olaisiaayiani kisiayia ninye ilarin ile. Neaku eikimayian iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino teina pooki nias.

English: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
Masaai: Nchoo iyie ninye enkitoria te shumata isiaaitin oo nkaik inono; itipika iyie ntokitin pooki abori nkejek enyena,

English: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
Masaai: amu ore anaa pee eitayioki eng'oruoi to lee, neing'uaa sii ninye olee, kake Enkai eing'uaa ntokitin pooki.

English: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
Masaai: “Ore ina kata naim embata ine nitii naaing'or iyie, ing'ura, itaa apa olerisiori le nyorrata; naaisalaashaki iyie enkila ai, naitoipoo emasipaisho ino: ee naaliki ajoki ainosa olmumai te iyie nikintayu olning'o o iyie, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, niaku iyie olalai.

English: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilo ng'en negira te nkata naikununo nji; amu enkata e ntorroni.

English: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, meishari ena ishoi eitu eitabari kuna baa pooki.

English: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Entisinya naa ate niakuku sinyat, amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: kake ashe te nkai naishoo yiook matimirisho to Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
Masaai: ena entashati eina palai apa nairriwaitie ninche - “Enetii Artaserses olaiguanani: Ore isinkan linono, lelo tung'ana lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, kirriu enkirorokino. Ore taata,

English: And the damsel's father shall say unto the elders, I gave my daughter unto this man to wife, and he hateth her;
Masaai: nejoki ninye menye leina kitok lelo payiani, ‘Aishoo nanu entito ai ele tung'ani meyama, neibayie ninye;

English: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
Masaai: neishankarrarre ilchekuti le Gera ilchekuti le Isaak ejoki, “Enaang ena are.” Neaku eipoto ina shorro enkare ajo Esek, amu eishankarrarre ninche ninye.

English: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Ore ti alo ile Ruben, o le Gad, o olpisiai lo losho le Manase nejoki Yoshua,

English: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, lelo apa ootuata to lmeitai naa nkalifuni tikitam o ong'uan.

English: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olasar nepejoo enkorropil, too wuejitin e shumata o too ldoinyio, o tiabori pooki shani onyori.

English: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua o Siraeli pooki ootii te nebo ninye neya Akan olayioni le Sera, o enkosholai, o lkila o ilo belati le sahabu, o layiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena, o lmong'i lenyena o sirkon lenyena o nkerra, o lng'obor lenye o pooki toki apa naata ninye; neyauni ninche oerata le Akori.

English: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
Masaai: Kake etiutuo lelo rorei te ninche anaa le mpesho, neaku eitu eiruk ninche.

English: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
Masaai: Emayiana enkitoria nalotu e papa lang Daudi! Hosana te shumata naisul!”

English: Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die: because she hath wrought folly in Israel, to play the whore in her father's house: so shalt thou put evil away from among you.
Masaai: neipang'unyeki naa ina kitok aayau kutukaji enkaji e menye, ore lelo lewa leina anasa enye nenang ninye too soito o metua, enkaraki nayawua ninye esulare atua Israel aiborrie onyek tiatua enkaji e menye; neaku impooitie entorroni aaiwuang'ie tiatua Israel.

English: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
Masaai: Ai iyie olkitok alang papa lang Abraham, otua? Netuata sii loibonok le Nkai. Aing'ae doi iyie ijo aitaa kewan?”

English: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
Masaai: Ore olkarsis naa ninye oitore ilo aisinani, ore ilo oisilenu naa osinka le ilo oisilenoko.

English: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
Masaai: Enyor apa neitu ijing kishomi oo ltung'ana laainei, te ina olong o sina lenye; enyor apa neitu ing'idakino ashil enkidaata enye, te nena olong'i e nkidaata enye; enyor apa neitu imbung imasaa enyena te ina olong e nkidaata enye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkanashe e papaai lino amu eno lmarei le papaai lino ninye.

English: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
Masaai: Neiteru ninche aaisinanuo, nejoki maa obo ninye, “Kae nanu sa?”

English: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani ilo farisayioi, “Intukuku ntae Lfarisayo oriong enkikompe o esaani, kake ore atua ntae ebore enkowuarisho o enkarruoisho.

English: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
Masaai: Ore olemenap osalaba lenye naasuju nemaaishiakino nanu.

English: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?
Masaai: Ara nanu nabo e nekua nemeetayie olomang'ati neisiligayu too Siraeli amaa ing'oru iyie aidaikie enkanasa naa ninye ng'otonye ti atua Israel; kainyoo pee iijoo iyie ina jung'ore o Laitoriani?”

English: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
Masaai: Emincho rubat oo sesen linyi eaku entoki naasishore tenkarruoisho, kake enchoo ate Enkai anaa ltung'ana ooitopiwuoki aaitung'uaa enkeeya meetu empuaan, ninchosho Enkai rubat oo seseni linyi metaa ntokitin naaisiaaishore esupatisho.

English: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?
Masaai: naa keya ninye Sedekia Babilon, nebik ninye teine ometaba anaa namutan nanu ninye, Olaitoriani ojo. Ore hoo niaarare iyie Ilkaldayo mimirisho iyie.’ ”

English: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aata apa nanu olom te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani amu etanyaita iltung'ana loo Siraeli olning'o lino, neuroo ilpereren linono loo lasarri, near iloibonok linono metuata tolalem, netaa nanu ake openy otelekua, neing'oru ninche enkishui ai peyie eiwuang'ie.”

English: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
Masaai: Naa amaa doi enkitopiunoto oo lootuata, keitu isomama te mbuku e Musa, te noshi nesirakino enapa shani, pee ejoki Enkai ninye. ‘Ara nanu Enkai e Abraham, o Enkai e Isaak, o Enkai e Yakobo?’

English: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika le imiet aosh entarumpeta enye, nadol olakira otusulunye eing'uaa shumata elotu enkop. Neishori ninye olbolet lo lgos le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie.

English: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
Masaai: Naa tiaaki Amasa, ‘Aimira iyie oltoilo lai o sesen lai? Nchoo eiko neijia Enkai te nanu, neitulusoo sii, ti nimira iyie olkitok le njore ai ebaiki taata te rishata e Yoab.’ ”

English: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani Solomon metoning'oyu oleng te dukuya Israeli pooki, nepik shumata ninye enkitoo neitu aekata eishori likae aiguanani too Siraeli.

English: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
Masaai: Tudumunye, wou taretu iyiook! Tokordu iyiook te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino nauno!

English: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
Masaai: “Woi ninye ilo okeshare oloitayio ninye, keishankarrare emoti oo nkulupuok ilo oitobira! Keikilikuan enterit ilo oitobir ajoki, ‘Kainyoo iyie intobirita’? aashu ejoki, ‘Meeta ena toki ino ineeibung'i’?

English: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
Masaai: Naaitoki nanu olaiguanani ajoki, “Naa kainyoo iyie iomonu?” Naomon nanu Enkai e keper.

English: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
Masaai: Ore pee enyikaki ina anasa nedol neishiraki;

English: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted judgment.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu apa eibung lelo ayiok lenyena nkoitoi enyena, kake eibelekenyate aasujaa dupoto; neya ninche ntokitin eropare neboin esipata.

English: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
Masaai: Naa kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Gershon too lmareita lenye: Libni o Shimei.

English: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
Masaai: Ore tinikimbung ninche iyie te nkaina, nigiligili, nipolososo iloilila lenye pooki; naa tenepetaa ninche intae, nigiligili, ninchosho impolosi enye pooki meikirikirata;

English: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
Masaai: o Hafer le Mecherat, o Ahija le Pelon

English: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
Masaai: Neaku ore ina nayau enkitoria oo ng'ok keeya too ltung'ana, neyau ninye empiris olning'o o Enkai, olning'o oriku enkishui oo ntarasi ti atua Yesu Kristo Olaitoriani lang.

English: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
Masaai: inkalao: naa imme iltung'ana oogol, neitaiki ake ate endaa neshum te nkata enkirowuaj;

English: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
Masaai: “Teneikeno keper neaku meetae enchan, enkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki tialo iyie, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji, neibalunye enkarna ino, neibelekenya aaing'uaa ing'ok enye ina kata intamio iyie ninche,

English: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
Masaai: Kekorduni Sion te sipata, ore lelo ootii atua nekorduni te supatisho.

English: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
Masaai: Naa keipirakinore ninye te nkomom enye pee elotu atua enkitoria enye pooki, naa keyau ninye olning'o lo sotua neas ninche. Naa keisho ninye entito e nkitok meidaikie enkitoria, kake meitashe ninye nemetum dupoto.

English: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
Masaai: Ore te ina imeekure kindim aating'iria, nikinyorraa metung'uari iyiook oopeny te Atene.

English: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
Masaai: Anaa enataase taata, eitanapishe Olaitoriani metaasi pee eitobiri olning'o lo osotua te nkaraki intae.

English: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
Masaai: Teneiputayu inkolong'i inono pee irura aye anaa iloo papaai lino, naa kadumu nanu eishoi ino te siadi iyie, obo loo layiok linono inot, naitubulaa nanu enkitoria enye.

English: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
Masaai: Nchoo meibalunyeki esiaai ino too sinkan linono, neibalunyeki ina golon ino kitok too nkera enye.

English: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
Masaai: Nepuo ilpayiani le Moab o lpayiani le Midian eibung'ita mpisai naalakieki enaibon too nkaik enye; nepuonu ninche enetii Balaam, neisho ninye olkilikuai le Balak.

English: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
Masaai: Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno naa eikitok o metabaiki keper, nebaiki esupatisho ino nkatampo.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani ninye, “Metaa eseriani te nebo iyie, miureishoyu, miye iyie.”

English: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto eyaka Abel Enkai olasar ong'amaroyu alang ole Kain, laa ninye etonyorrarrie Enkai ninye ajo supat, etaa Enkai shakeni amu etang'amayie olasar lenye; etua ninye kake ore te nkirukoto enye neton eirorita.

English: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
Masaai: Hoshea, o Hanania, o Hashub,

English: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
Masaai: Emincho enkisosion inyi edukenya, entaa lkirowua te Nkiyang'et, esiayia Olaitoriani.

English: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Masaai: Ore enabayie, entagol ti atua Olaitoriani naa te ngolon e nkidimata enye.

English: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo ira iyie, asipani, nimishilaa hoo iyie likae tung'ani; amu mishilaa enkitoo oo ltung'ana, kake enkoitoi ake e Nkai iutaa too sipat. Keishiaakino te nikincho Kaisari kodi, anaa aimeishiaakino?

English: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
Masaai: Amu eimaka Daudi ninye nejo, ‘Atoduaa Olaitoriani etii dukuya nanu nkatitin pooki: aatii te tatene, metaa maaigusugusieki.

English: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto e nkishui ino ninchir, etumutaki inkiri o sesen lino,

English: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: pee etum iishoritin inyi aatayiolo nchere aishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel metotoni too lng'oborri ina kata apa ayau ninche aipang'unye te nkop e Misiri: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
Masaai: olayioni le Elan, olayioni le Sima, olayioni le Shimei

English: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
Masaai: Ketii obo oidim atigila esekenkei naing'uaa moikuape o suyai?

English: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
Masaai: Nebatata Abram te nkomom enye, neirorie Enkai ninye ajoki,

English: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
Masaai: Ore enkitejo, amu keinyaku ninye eng'amurai kake mesasha ninye iloisotok, mesinya te ntae.

English: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
Masaai: Nejo Esta, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, nchoo Ilyahudi ootii Susa menyaakini aanyorraki taisere metaasa anaa ena kitanapata ena olong. Naa nchoo layiok le Haman meilili to lchani ogorishorek.”

English: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
Masaai: Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani etii Sion, toduaa iyie dupoto e Yerusalem, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino!

English: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yerameel ilo kikau le Hesron: Ram ilo kikau lenye, o Buna, o Oren o Osem o Ahija.

English: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoash lelo pooki apa ooing'orunore ninye, “Ai Baal ing'oring'oro intae? Arashu orrekie lenye igolielie? Ore oloba anaa oloing'or ninye neyookini aar metua tadekenya. Tenaa ke nkai ninye nchoo eing'or kewan amu etusulayioki aauroo olperere lenye lo lasar.”

English: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

English: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
Masaai: Nemepik sii iltung'ana enaisho ng'ejuk oo sabibu ilbenia musan; naa te nepik nepolosa ilbenia, neibukori enaisho oo sabibu nepolosa sii Lbenia; kake ilbenia ng'ejuko epiki pee erripi pokira are.”

English: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
Masaai: Naajoki nanu olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee eeta enkomom ino osina, nadolita ajo mimuoi? Meeta ae toki osina lo ltau ele.” Nairut nanu oleng.

English: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu ninche ening kake eshomo ake pooki ng'ae te ngolon oltau lenye torrono. Neaku ayawua nanu shumata ninche irorei pooki lele ning'o lo sotua apa laitanapa nanu ninche metaasa, kake eitu ninche eas.”

English: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
Masaai: Neosh olmalaika li aare entarumpeta enye. Ore enkito toki naaijo oldoinyo nayupuyup te nkima nenang'akini atua enaiposha.

English: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman's part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.
Masaai: Totona ena kewarie, ore tadekenya, ti nikintaas ninye te rishat o ltung'ani lo lgilata, naa sidai; nchoo ninye eas ina. Kake te nemeyieu ninye neas ina rishata o ltung'ani lo lgilata te iyie, ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, nalo nanu aas erishata o ltung'ani lo lgilata te iyie. Irraga mekenyu.”

English: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
Masaai: Neaku kitejo apa, ‘Mateshetu iyiook olperere lo lasar, neme olopejorieki nkishorunot, neme ino lasar.

English: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod unto this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee aa ore ilapolosak le Dagon o pooki oojing ina aji e Dagon nemeroro embata e kutukaji e Dagon te Ashdod o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ene wueji, o shumata lelo oomanya o lelo deketa pooki ooigero teina buku naisumakaki olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
Masaai: Tayiolo naa to ltau lino nchere, ore anaa enaitame oltung'ani enkerai enye aikintame sii ninye iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Manase, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani ake ninye oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aipot enkarna o Laitoriani: “Olaitoriani, aatasayia nanu, ntajeu enkishui ai!”

English: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
Masaai: Amu ore to lari le isiet le nkitoria enye, eton aa oti, neiteru aing'oru Enkai e Daudi papaai lenye; ore to lari le tomon oare neiteru aituku Yuda o Yerusalem, aiwuang'ie iwuejitin neeika, o Asherim, nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuno o naatosholuaki.

English: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
Masaai: Nelo Saul enchoto nabo o ldoinyo, nelo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena te nkai shoto o ldoinyo, neisarisarita apa Daudi pee eilany Saul, ore etinyikutua Saul o ltung'ana lenyena aapunyaki Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena pee eibung ninche,

English: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.
Masaai: Neipotisho lelo arripok le kishomi, nelimuni ina bae tiatua enkaji o laiguanani.

English: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
Masaai: Ore iloreren neyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny Isiraeli, ina kata etii ewueji ai sinyati atua ninche intarasi pooki.

English: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
Masaai: Toning'o enkerai ai, ning'amaa irorei laainei, pee etum ilarin le nkishui ino aataa kumok.

English: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootelekutua le Kohat, neishori te oshoto e nkukuo, anaa ilmareita leilo osho olpisiai lo losho le Manase, nkanas tomon.

English: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olkilikuai, nepuonu ilpayiani pooki le Yuda o Yerusalem aaiturrurrokino.

English: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Totona isuma.” Neisumaki Baruk ninche.

English: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
Masaai: Amu ore nkaitin pooki oo loreren naa nkitanyaanyukot, kake Olaitoriani oitobira keper.

English: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
Masaai: neiteleiki ninche ina kurriny enchumata oo luikuluaa, nepejoo ninye ina kurriny te nchumata olperere lo lasar,

English: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.
Masaai: Neitoki Saul ajoki isinkan lenyena, “Eng'urakaki nanu enkitok nadolisho te naibon, pee atum nanu ashomo enetii ninye naikilikuanishore ninye.” Nejoki isinkan lenyena ninye, “Etii enkaisi nadolisho te naibon Endor.”

English: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
Masaai: Pee eitabari ororei lo Laitoriani oimua enkutuk e Yeremia, o metaba anaa neshipakino enkop sabato. Ore te nena olong'i pooki naitomijoonoki, neibung sabato neitabaya ilarin ntomoni naapishana.

English: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
Masaai: aitobira nanu enkitanapata ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa ilapolosak lenye anaa Ilawi tiatua enkitoria ai, onyorraa alo Yerusalem te yieunoto enye, neidim ashomo tenebo iyie.

English: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yoram, o nena pooki naataasa ninye neigeroki te mbuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And they shall amerce him in an hundred shekels of silver, and give them unto the father of the damsel, because he hath brought up an evil name upon a virgin of Israel: and she shall be his wife; he may not put her away all his days.
Masaai: neitalaki ninye shekeli iip e nkosholai, neisho ninye menye ina kitok, enkaraki nayawua entorroni shumata ina tito nemeyama e Israel; naa keaku ninye enkitok enye; meidim ninye aiwuang'ie ina kitok too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye.

English: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Te seriani; aewuo nanu apolosaki Olaitoriani; entisinya ate, nipuonunu te nebo nanu olasar.” Neitisiny ninye Yese o layiok lenyena, neitoomon ninche to lasar.

English: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
Masaai: Ore aa enagirorie ninche, natum ilo apa onyor oltau lai. Naibung ninye, nemaisho ninye elo, o metaba anaa nayau ninye enkaji e yeiyio, o maitijing'a ninye ilo gilata apa le ina naatoiwuo nanu.

English: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Isaakar te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Tola, olmarei loo le Tola; ile Puni, olmarei loo le Puni;

English: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Elam netumi: Matania, o Sekaria, o Yehiel, o Abdi, o Yeremot o Eliya.

English: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
Masaai: amu iaku shakeni lenye too ltung'ana pooki te nena nitoduaa o nitoning'o.

English: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau ang, neiturrurru ilchoreta lenyena o elatia enye ajoki ninche, ‘Matishipata, amu anoto enaduoo ker ai naimina.’

English: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye te Etam neibelekenya aarrinyo Pi-ha-hirot, aa ninye natii enkalo oloo saen le Baal-sefon; nepuo ninche aaun ilng'oborri te netaaniki Migdol.

English: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
Masaai: Neitashe enkanashe enye te nelakua, pee eyiolou enaitaasi ninye.

English: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
Masaai: Kake eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii, ejo, ‘Mbukoyie iyie osarge sapuk nitijing'a ilarrabali kumok sapuki; mishetu iyie enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai, amu imbukoyie iyie osarge sapuk te dukuya nanu o tioriong enkop.

English: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Ng'ura, etii ewueji te mbata nanu naa ninye intasheyie te shumata e ndapidapoi;

English: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building.
Masaai: Kira iyiook ilaisiaayiak te nebo Enkai; nirara intae enkurma enye, airara enkaji Enkai.

English: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
Masaai: Ore naa kiaanyita iyie Olaitoriani pee king'urrie; neaku keisisi ninye, pee etum aing'urrie intae. Amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai oo sipat; emayiana lelo pooki ooanyu ninye.

English: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
Masaai: “Neshipakino taa ina kop isabatoni enyena ina kata aa mijooni, ina kata iyie itii enkop oo lmang'ati linono; netum taa enkop ayeng'iyeng'ayu neshipakino isabatoni enyena.

English: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
Masaai: o lasarri lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata, o matuan uni e tomon e efa, to loing'oni obo, o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh obo,

English: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
Masaai: Etii nkaik enyena enguton e nkop, naa enenye sii enkadoro oo ldoinyo.

English: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloas esiaai teina olong, ore ilo tung'ani naidaikie aiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
Masaai: Eteyietuo ninye enkawuo enye anaa olmang'atinta, ore te nkaina enye e tatene nesesekuanisho anaa olmang'atinta, netasesekuana ninye ntokitin pooki niking'idare, tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntito e Sion; etubukuo ninye engoro enye napi anaa enkima.

English: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
Masaai: Eetae enkata naini, neetae enkata naye, neetae enkata eunore, neetae enkata nadotuni ina natuunoki;

English: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
Masaai: (Eimaki ninche intokitin naapurda easishoreki), aasuj inkoon oo ltung'ana o enkiteng'enare enye?

English: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
Masaai: Nipik imowuarak lelo pijat lenyena pokira oong'uan; neaku nena mowuarak entoki nabo o ninye. Nimur to suyai.

English: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
Masaai: pee aisho lelo ooishir ti atua Sion - olmarisian te rishata oo nkuruon, o ina ilata e ng'ida te rishata osina, o olkila le nkisisa te rishata e lepori o ltau; pee etumi aatejo ninche ilkeek le supatisho, ina unore o Laitoriani, pee etumi aaitaa ninye kitok.

English: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
Masaai: neirowuaju oltau lai ti atua nanu. Ore anaa enadamisho, neyupuyup enkima; nairo nanu to lng'ejep lai:

English: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye olairrag le nkare, enyaaka Noa abik ilarin iip uni o onom.

English: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
Masaai: Ore eitashe ilo tung'ani te mbata nanu, naning obo laairorie nanu tiatua enkaji e Nkai; naajoki ninye nanu,

English: And Job spake, and said,
Masaai: Nejo Yoab:

English: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa ejo Olaitoriani keiwuang'ie enkarna e Israel tiabori keper. Neaku eitajeuo ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash.

English: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
Masaai: Ore olkilikuai torrono nesulaki iltung'ana kumok enyamali, kake ore olkilikuai oisiligayu neyau enkishiunoto.

English: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yudas, nelo nabo kata enetii Yesu, nejoki, “Lo kitok!” Neng'utut.

English: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Amaa te nayieu nebik ninye o maeu, ainyoo nikitii iyie? Tusujuaki iyie nanu.”

English: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
Masaai: Nesujaa Abija Yeroboam, neoru ninye nkanas, Betel o nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Yeshana tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Efron tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
Masaai: Ore pooki, lkituaak o looti naa kepuo aaye tiatua ena kop; nemenukari ninche, nemeetae hoo obo oishiraki ninche aashu edung'udung kewan aashu ebarn kewan tenkaraki ninche.

English: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani odamu ilo ng'en, nemeetae olodamu olmodai, amu ore too nkolong'i naapuonu nerikinisho pooki. Eye ake ilo ng'en anaa ilo modai!

English: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
Masaai: Eijo doi kiaku irorei ake engolon to larrabal? Kaing'ae taata iyie ingarakino, peyie kitogolong'aka nanu?

English: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
Masaai: Naa inji eikununo enyorrata te nikisuj iyiook nkitanapat enyena, naa ena enkitanapata anaa enikitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto, nchere enchomie enyorrata.

English: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ewaita ninche eishu.” Neyae ninche eishu, nepuo ninche aar metuata te ngumoto e Beteked, iltung'ana artam oare neitu elekuni obo lenye.

English: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
Masaai: kiyiolo ena nchere, ore nkitanapat, eitu eitanapisho te nkaraki lelo supati, kake te nkaraki lelo aasak loo ntorrok o loogolong'u, te nkaraki lelo lemeure Enkai o laing'okok, te nkaraki lelo lemesinya o loomorisho, te nkaraki lelo ooar iloo menye o looar inoo ng'otonye metuata, te nkaraki lelo ooitayu iloikop,

English: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
Masaai: Ore ninye nkera kutiti naatemenaitie nanu, ore tenainyototo neimaki imbaa olmena te nanu.

English: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
Masaai: o metabaiki ine nemetii toki te shumata kutuk aji, o tenebo ilo gilata liatua, o tenkalo e oriong; Ore too sunta pooki naamanita tiatua olgilata liatua o ilo gilata sapuk liatua neguetuno te nkitanyaanyukoto o lkerubi,

English: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
Masaai: Amu etanang'akaki atua orreshet too nkejek enyena, nelo te nkoitoi nebatatakino.

English: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki ine wueji nejoki ninche, “Entoomon pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat.”

English: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
Masaai: kake nebuaku ninche aajo, “Tasho ninye tasho!”

English: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
Masaai: Ore loo le Benchamen naa: Salu olayioni le Meshulam ole Hodafia, olayioni le Hasenau,

English: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
Masaai: Olapa lioudo apa ina rishata, netonita apa olaiguanani tiatua enkaji enye enkirobi netii enkima nayupuyupito dukuya ninye.

English: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
Masaai: Entotoni ti atua nanu anaa te naton ti atua intae. Ore anaa enemeidim olng'osila otoiu lng'anayio makewan, te nemetii olchani, mindimidimi sii intae ti ni mitonini ti atua nanu.

English: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
Masaai: olayioni le Amsi, olayioni le Beni, olayioni le Shemer,

English: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
Masaai: naa ore ntokitin aainei pooki inkuninono, naa inaainei ininono, naaitaaki kitok ti atua ninche.

English: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
Masaai: Kake etadotuoki olchani lo sabibu te ngoro napi, aanang'aki enkop, ore olkutati loo loo saen neitoi ninye; ore ilng'anayio lenyena nedung'ori, ore entonata o lchani ogol neitoi, nemut ninye enkima aidaikie.

English: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
Masaai: Ele rorei eiroro Olaitoriani oipirta ninye: “Kitemenayie ninye iyie, kitusurdaanya ninye iyie na tito e Sion; eipirripir endukuya enye te siadi iyie; na tito e Yerusalem.

English: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
Masaai: Kake etiaka Musa lelo ayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben, “Kepuo ilalashera linyi enjore itonini intae tene?

English: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
Masaai: Kake eitajeuo ninye ninche te nkaraki enkarna enye, pee etum aibalunye engolon enye magilani.

English: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
Masaai: Entoosh nkaik, te ng'ida lo oreren pooki! Esisa Enkai too mbuakunot oo sinkolioitin.

English: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
Masaai: Ore naa taata inkaik e Nkai aitarasaki intae, o ele rorei le mpiris, oidim atesheta intae neisho intae enjung'ore te nebo lelo pooki ooitengelaki.

English: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
Masaai: Naa kaisuroki enkima Misiri; ore Pelusium neigor enkigoroto kitok; ore Tebes nepiki ilusien, ore isunta enyena neurori aasulaki enkop.

English: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
Masaai: Ore emodai naa enchipai teilo le meeta endamunoto, kake ore ilo oota ening'unoto nelo aitoriori.

English: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
Masaai: Amu kintashe ake pooki te dukuya olorika le Kristo le nkiguana, neng'amu pooki ng'ae inaairirikino nena naataasa to sesen aa supati aashu aa torrok.

English: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
Masaai: Neitigiran ildoinyo anaa ilmeregeshi, neitigiran ndoinyo anaa ilkuoo le kerra.

English: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
Masaai: Ore inkilani enyena naa engolon o enkanyit, nekueni too nkolong'i naapuonu e dukuya.

English: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
Masaai: Etakaldayie ninye osinka lino to lkitok lai olaiguanani. Kake ore olkitok lai olaiguanani netiu anaa olmalaika le Nkai; taasa naa ina nidol aa sidai te iyie.

English: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
Masaai: Kake ore pee eidipi aaitadou ntokitin pooki abori ilo Inoti lenye, ina kata kenya eitadouni ninye kewan abori Enkai, neitadowuo ntokitin pooki abori ninye, peyie eitore Enkai pooki toki.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Ntorioi eng'udi ino toosho enterit e nkop, peyie eaku enkojong'ani te nkop pooki e Misiri.’ ”

English: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
Masaai: Ore ilo ooipot intae, keisiligayu naa keitabaya ninye.

English: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
Masaai: naa kalo nanu apik nkaik e lelo aisilisilok linono, lelo apa likitiakita, ‘Irrugoyu pee kitum iyiook aashom’; nintotiu iyie enkoriong ino anaa enkop netiu anaa enkoitoi naaim ninche.”

English: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
Masaai: Kelotu ina kitoo e Lebanon enitii, o lelo keek pooki sidain, pee epuonu aapik enkishiaa ene wueji e nkaji ai; ore ene wueji neitasheyie nkejek aainei naitaa kitok.

English: And they remembered his words,
Masaai: Nedamu nena kituaak irorei lenyena,

English: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
Masaai: Ore to siwuo le nkilepunoto e nkolong nigil imelin e Tarshishi.

English: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
Masaai: Amu ti nikitudung'uoki to loirien le ntim, nikipuonunui aarubaki oloirien oramati, kebaa naa etumoki lelo ng'osil le ilo oirien oramati enkibung'ata einyakuaki oloirien openy.

English: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
Masaai: Ore oleimiet naa Shefatia otoiwuo Abital; ore ole ile naa Itream otoiwuo enkitok enye Egla.

English: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
Masaai: Atejo nanu: entoning intae ilukuny e Yakobo o larikok le nkaji e Israel! Aimeishiaakino intae niyiolouu esipata,

English: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
Masaai: Nchoo etoni ti auluo nkolong'i naapishana; pooki ng'ae ake ninye linyi otasesekuana oltung'ani, o pooki ng'ae oiseyie olmeneng'ani, entisinya ate o lelo yarunot linyi te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana.

English: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
Masaai: Etijing'a enkaji e Nkai neinos emukate enkitoduaaroto nemeishoruno too nkitanapat meinosa ninye o lelo ooboitare, ilapolosak ake ooinos.

English: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
Masaai: nememor likae tung'ani, nepaash olarrabal, neaku loobor, neitoduaaya esupatisho too ltung'ana pooki.

English: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Masaai: Ntae kulo ooure Olaitoriani, esiliga Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto enye naa elong'o enye.

English: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
Masaai: Emayiana enairuko inchere keitabari inaatiaakaki ninye eing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

English: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
Masaai: Eitagolo apa Solomon olayioni le Daudi kewan te nkitoria, netii Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye, neitaa ninye kitok oleng.

English: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
Masaai: Ayieu niyiolouwu lalashera laainei nchere, ore nena naaitaasaki nanu, netaretutuo enkitubularoto o rorei supat,

English: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Eser; o Bilham, o Saafan o Akan.

English: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Samuel, “Miyagie ake eitu inchiraki Olaitoriani Enkai ang te nkaraki iyiook, pee etum ninye aitajeu iyiook aitung'uai enkaina oo Lfilisti.”

English: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
Masaai: ore ake pee eitobir ate iltung'ana laainei, lelo laa enkarna ai eipotieki, neomon ninche neing'oru enkomom ai, neibelekenya aaing'uaa nkoitoi enye torrok, naa kaning nanu atii keper, napalaki eng'oki enye naishiunye enkop enye.

English: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
Masaai: Eitobira ninche te oshoto e nkukuo, aaitanyaanyuk pooki, amu eetae apa ilkituaak anaake te wueji sinyati, o lkituaak le Nkai tiatua ilayiok le Eliesa o layiok le Itamar.

English: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
Masaai: Ai ng'ae te intae oidim te neitanyamaluo atoponai enkadori enye entemata nabo?

English: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
Masaai: (Aa kejo ninye keyiolou olorere lenye aajo ninye eyooki Enkai aisiaaishore elaku ninche te sinkaisho; kake eitu eyiolou ninche ina).

English: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Masaai: Eirragieki ilorikan le nkiguana te ine, lelo orikan le nkitoo le nkaji e Daudi.

English: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Keila, o Aksib o Maresha: nkanas naaudo o nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
Masaai: kake etobiko apa ile Asheri ti atua Ilkanaani lelo oomanya ina kop; amu eitu earaa ninche aaipang'ie.

English: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu ninche olkirutoto too nkitoriat pooki e nkop neaku enkurruna, enaileti o enkitakuenisho, o oldeket tiatua iwuejitin pooki nareu nanu ninche.

English: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
Masaai: Ore nena masaa pooki naawa Enkai aitung'uaa papaai lang eishoo metaa inkunaang o nkera ang, ore tena kata, ore pooki nikijoki Enkai iyie, taasa.”

English: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
Masaai: Neitoki nena aisiaayiak aanyiku, ninche tenebo inkera enye, neirrugo aabaiki enkop;

English: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Masaai: o Ladan olayioni lenye o Amihud olayioni lenye, o Elishama, olayioni lenye

English: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
Masaai: Nedol iltung'ana pooki oomanya Luda o Sharon ninye neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani.

English: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
Masaai: Neas ina iltung'ana loo Siraeli, nesotu ilkulikae nkumok, nesotu kulikae nkuti.

English: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king's son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
Masaai: Neosh Olaitoriani ilo aiguanani, neaku ninye olayioni le nkeeya oo lbolot ometabaiki ina olong apa natua ninye. Neton apa ninye te nkaji enye etekepayioki. Naa Yotam apa olayioni lo laiguanani oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, neitore iltung'ana leina kop.

English: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
Masaai: Nchoo metayiolouni to laiguanani nchere kishomo iyiook olkerenket le Yuda, enkaji e Nkai kitok. Eshetitae ninye too soito sapuki, netipikaki isunta enyena mbaoi, eloito ena siaai dukuya aponari easita nkaik enye.

English: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
Masaai: Ntotiuo iyie iyiook anaa ntare naayieng'i, nindapashaka iyiook iloreren.

English: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
Masaai: Alotu te rishata e njore e Misiri o enjore oo Siraeli. Netii ina atampoi o enaimin; nelusoo enkewarie meetae enaewuo anyikaki enkae enkewarie pooki.

English: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
Masaai: Aisha nanu anaa oloip le nteipa; aaipiripiroyioki nanu anaa olmaati.

English: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:
Masaai: Nejo Shimei ina kata edekisho, “Shomo, shomo, iyie oltung'ani lo sarge, iyie oltung'ani le pesho!

English: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
Masaai: Amu kaa dupoto ina, te neitamei intae enkata niaasiasa intorrok? Kake te niaasiasa isupati, ning'iriri te neisilisili intae niaatata enchunet te Enkai.

English: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
Masaai: nejoki Shetani ninye, “Aaisho ntoria kuna pooki, o enkitoo enye, pee aisho pooki, o enkitoo enye, pee aisho pooki layieu naisho;

English: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
Masaai: Ore amu nabo emukate, ore iyiook hoo nikira kumok nikira osesen obo; amu eng'amu ake oltung'ani embelati e ina mukate nabo.

English: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
Masaai: anaa ilooti te ninye ooirriwuaki meitamio lelo ooas intorrok neisis lelo ooas isidain.

English: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
Masaai: “Tenelo neas oltung'ani ake ninye embae naainyal enkirukoto, neas eng'oki eitu eotiki, te pooki toki e nena sinyat o Laitoriani nchoo eyau ninye, neyau anaa enkishoroto enye o lasar lenkitarruorroto to Laitoriani, olmeregesh lemeeta entioto aitayu tiatua eluaata, nidung'oki iyie enkinyiang'a te shekeli e nkosholai terisioroto e shekeli e wueji sinyati; olasar le nkitarruorroto ninye.

English: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
Masaai: Neponari Yehoshefat agolu te nkitoria. Neshet ninye te Yuda isempewueti o nkanas naashumishoreki.

English: And he said, What is the thing that the LORD hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.
Masaai: Nejo Eli, “Kainyoo kitiaaka ninye? Misudoo iyie te nanu. Metaasa Enkai ena te iyie aitulus, ti nimiki pooki toki e nena pooki nikitiaaka ninye.”

English: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
Masaai: Neduaaki Saul Daudi olom ebaiki ina olong neito dukuya.

English: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
Masaai: Neaku etejo Esau, “Inchooki maatung'ueiki embata oo ltung'ana laainei laata tene.” Kake etejo, “Meeta tipat ning'uarie. Ayieu ake duoo natum omom te dukuya enkomom ino olkitok lai.”

English: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
Masaai: Nipik ina mesa oriong o liaatua, nipik enkitashet o ltaa enkalo e kopikop o lng'obor neipirakinore emesa; nipik emesa enkalo e moikuape.

English: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
Masaai: neitook ninye ina kitok ina are e nduaran nayau oldeket ore ina are nayau oldeket nelo atua ninye nepik ninye emion kitok.

English: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatoponari, neponari aas ing'ok ti alo nanu; kaibelekeny nanu enkisisa enye metaa enkurruna.

English: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
Masaai: Mincho kirikino oltoilo loo lmang'ati linono, ilo odoo loo nchankarri oilep anaake.

English: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
Masaai: Emincho entorroni emir intae, kake entimir entorroni too supati.

English: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Metusela naa ilarin iip naaudo o ntomoni ile o naaudo neye ninye.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa loo papaai lenye.

English: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
Masaai: Nepuo ewueji neji Getsemane; nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Entaanyisho te ne, o maidipa enkomono.”

English: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
Masaai: Neton sii apa ninye Efron tiatua Lhiti. Newaliki Efron ilo Hiti Abraham ening'ito ilhiti o pooki oim kishomi e nkanasa, ajo:

English: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
Masaai: neitu kinya endaa o ltung'ani hoo obo eitu kilak kake kinaurita nikisiaaisho, aasisho kewarie o dama, pee mikiaaku ake olola le likae obo linyi.

English: Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
Masaai: entegelu oloisul ogol te lelo ayiok lo lkitok linyi, ninchosho ninye olorika le papaai lenye, nimitutu enkaji olkitok linyi.”

English: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon ashetu ewueji e shumata e Kermosh ilo minong le Moab o ene Molek oilo minong le Amon, to ldoinyo te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e Yerusalem.

English: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
Masaai: Atobiko te nkata naado ti atua lelo ooiba eseriani.

English: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
Masaai: Naa keaku ninye osikiria le ntim tiatua iltung'ana, keaku ore enkaina enye ear pooki tung'ani, ore inkaik e pooki tung'ani keaku kearr ninye. Naa keibayu ninye ilalashera lenyena.

English: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Husham ore Hadad ole Bedad laa ninye apa otimira Midian te nkop e Moab neitoreisho te rishata enye; ore enkarna enkanasa enye naa Afit.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
Masaai: Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaiwuang'ie nanu mbartan inyi aitung'uaa intae, naidaikie ngarrin inyi oo mbartan;

English: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
Masaai: Eewuo olkirutoto o esulakinoto e ngumoto shumata iyiook, eliyio o enkidaata.

English: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena, etayiolo Yesu ajo eitabayioki mbaa pooki, pee etumi aaitabai olkigeroto katukul, nejo, “Aata enkure.”

English: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
Masaai: Naa keputu ninye engolon enye o empijan enye pee elo aitayunye olarrabal o laiguanani le kopikop eeta enjore kitok; ore ilo aiguanani le kopikop nelo olarrabal te nebo enjore kitok oleng magilani; kake melo ninye aitashe, amu keitobirakini ninye ilnukat.

English: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.
Masaai: Kake etejo lelo lewa, “Mimpang iyie alo. Amu ti nikisik iyiook nemeshilaa ninche iyiook. Te neye olpisiai lang nemeshilaa ninche iyiook. Kake inyaanyukie iyie iip tomon katitin tomon lang. Metaa enaikash tinirriwaki iyie iyiook eretoto te nkanasa.”

English: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
Masaai: Kalom nanu intae to lom le Enkai kewan. Aishoo intae Kristo anaa entito naishoori meyiolo likae lee, naishoo intae ninye metaa ninye ake openy olpayian linyi.

English: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki natanyaita ele orere nkariak e Shiloa naaruko akiti, netalepori ninche eure Resin olayioni le Remalia;

English: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
Masaai: Arashu tenairriu olmeitai atua ina kop, nabuku engoro ai napi abukoki shumata ninye tenebo osarge, pee adung'oo te ninye tung'ani o eng'ues;

English: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie Daudi ilkiliku, neya ninye; nelotu ninye enetii, neboitare ninye ninye. (Naa keitobira apa ninye kewan te nkiduruk enye.) Neitoki ashuko alo enkaji enye.

English: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
Masaai: Matum nanu ae ng'ida nalang ena, te naning eji kesujita nkera aainei esipata.

English: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye Maaka, ng'otonye, eiwuang'ie olaiguanani Asa pee meitoki aata enkitoo enye enkaraki nataasa embae olminong, aitobir enkitanyaanyukoto e Ashera. Nedung Asa ina kitanyaanyukoto auroo, neidong aitaa irrarrat, nelo apejoo to erata le Kidron.

English: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
Masaai: Ejo Ilkigerot oojo: “Ore te nkaraki iyie earitai iyiook dama o kewarie matuata; kitotiutuo anaa noshi tare naapuoi aayieng.”

English: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
Masaai: “Nkena nena tokitin naa taaruaki, aa iltung'ana o aa nchoo, iyie o Eliesa ilo apolosani o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye e ina umata;

English: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
Masaai: Ore te neye oltung'ani torrono, neish osiligi lenye, ore enkisiligata e lelo lemeyieu Enkai neaku ene pesho.

English: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
Masaai: Ore eiteng'enisho nejo, “Entodol ake ate too laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, oonyor aaishopo lkilani adoru neyieu neirorokini too neemirishoreki,

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
Masaai: Ore apa Benaia olayioni le Yohoida naa oltung'ani opi oleng le Kabseel, olaasani loo nkiasin sapuki; etara ntiamasini are e Moab. Eshomo sii apa adoyio near olng'atuny ti atua engumoto ina kata apa etadowuo empaso e nkirobi.

English: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
Masaai: Ee, mincho hoo obo likingarakino iyie meitukurruni; nchoo meitukurruni lelo aitang'orok le pesho.

English: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
Masaai: kake ore pee ebau enkata sidai, neirriu Enkai Oinoti lenye, otoiwuo enkitok, netoiwuoki ninye te abori Nkitanapat,

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
Masaai: Metii likae likinyaanyukie iyie Olaitoriani; ira iyie kitok, naa kitok enkarna ino te magilanisho.

English: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ai yie makewan ojo nji ana ail kulikae likitolikitio mbaa aainei?”

English: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
Masaai: naa entobiraki inkejek inyi inkoitoi naaitoriori, paa ore ilo ng'ojine nemeburukusha kake pee etumi aaishiunye.

English: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye aashu isinkan lenyena aashu iltung'ana leina kop ening lelo rorei lo Laitoriani ooiroro aimunye Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai.

English: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,
Masaai: Kake tenijojo intae, ‘Mikitoni iyiook tiatua ena kop,’ aagolong'aki oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi;

English: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
Masaai: aaterewa ninye naayau nanu enaimin metii hoo ewang'an;

English: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok loo lapolosak apa ooyama nkituaak oo loreren, netumi, Maaseia, o Eliesa, o Yarib, o Gedaia, loo layiok le Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak, o lalashera lenyena.

English: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
Masaai: Neutaki te nkaina enye lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Kulo yieyio o lalashera laainei.

English: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
Masaai: Nepik ninye enkila olgoo ore ina kila olgoo nepik Urim o Tumim.

English: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
Masaai: “Kake ore olongiri ometabaiki enkiting'oto nejeu.

English: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
Masaai: Ore naa amu etiooyo pee ejing kulikae ine, ore lelo ootang'amutua lelo omon supati neitu ninche ejing te nkaraki eitu eiruk,

English: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, ejo, “Amaa, kalo nanu aarare Ilfilisti? Inchoru iyie ninche apik atua enkaina ai?” Nejoki Olaitoriani Daudi, “Ilepa shomo; amu esipa kaishoru nanu Ilfilisti apik atua enkaina ino.”

English: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
Masaai: “Tushukoyu enkang inyi, imbalakinye enaba ina nikintaasa Enkai.” Nelo aing'uaa, einosaa te ina anasa pooki nena e nking'asia naaitaasa Yesu ninye.

English: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
Masaai: Etotiutuo nena anas inono sinyat anaa ong'ata, etotiuo Sion anaa ong'ata, etaa Yerusalem olmuate.

English: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
Masaai: Metaa meeta oltau lai entioto too nkitanapat inono, pee maaitukurruni nanu.

English: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Esipa ajoki intae nchere egol pee ejing olkarsis enkitoria e keper.

English: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.
Masaai: Nipolosaki iyie olasar le pasaka Olaitoriani Enkai ino, too ntare aashu too nkishu, teine wueji negelu Olaitoriani pee eitamany enkarna enye ine.

English: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Gederat, o Bet-dagon, o Naama, o Makeda: nkanas tomon o ile te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
Masaai: “Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura kaing'orie nanu enkomom ai intae te ntorroni, pee aiwuang'ie Yuda pooki.

English: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Masaai: Ore aa isupati kiaasita emikidukenya, amu kelotu enkata nikisotisho te neitu kintololong enyuaata ang.

English: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.
Masaai: Mipik enkaji ino mpukunot are e ntemeta enalala o enkiti.

English: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
Masaai: Enkaraki ena apa pee aatung'uayie te Krete, pee itum aitobira mbaa naang'or, nigelu ilpayiani too nkang'itie pooki anaa enaatuutaka,

English: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Enkiguana ina natishirrakita Petero o Yohana, nemusu aajo ltung'ana ake ninche lemeeta enkisuma nashomo, neme ng'eni sii, neing'asia; neyiolou aajo ninche lapa ooisiritore Yesu.

English: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.
Masaai: nejoki Samson enkayioni apa naa ninye narik aibung enkaina, “Ntasho sii iyie mairrapirrapa ng'apeta naairishaa ena aji, pee atum aigarakinoyu ninche.”

English: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
Masaai: Enkaraki intae pee ajoito kuna baa; neme kajo pee aibooyo intae, kake te nkaraki barare nauno o ndamunot naasho naanyor Olaitoriani.

English: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
Masaai: Olng'atuny: ogol te pooki ng'ues, nemerrinyo siadi tiae toki;

English: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
Masaai: Kepuo iloshon aadol ina kilepunoto e sipata, nedol ilaiguanak pooki enkitoo ino, naa eikipuoi aaisho iyie ina arna ng'ejuk, naa enkutuk o Laitoriani naishoru.

English: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
Masaai: Eing'orita nkonyek o Laitoriani lelo supati, neinining'ito nkiyiaa enyena enkishirata enye.

English: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
Masaai: amu etem enkiok irorei, anaa enkutuk te ndaa.

English: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
Masaai: ore te nebo ninye netii Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak lo losho le Dan, olaitobirunoni o laipirunoni naa olaikodoni too usin pusi, o morijo o mpilei o katani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitobiraka iyiook ena toki naa Enkai, laa ninye oishoo iyiook Enkiyang'et meitisipa.

English: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika liong'uan olbakuli lenye enkolong, neishori ninye metapejo ltung'ana te nkima.

English: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore Yuda o Israel netoni te Seriani; ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, eton ake oltung'ani tiabori osabibu lenye o tiabori olng'aboli lenye, too nkolong'i pooki e Solomon.

English: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai e lap, Iyie Enkai e lap, tawang'a!

English: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD'S lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
Masaai: Neitarasaki Aron ina kine natadoikio enkukuo te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neishooyo ninye metaa olasar le ngoki;

English: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
Masaai: Nekurru Moab tenkaraki kemosh, anaa apa enatukurrua enkaji e Israel tenkaraki Betel, osiligi lenye.

English: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
Masaai: Neshetu ilo apolosani oji Uria olperere lo lasar oikununo anaa ilo, te risioroto e nena pooki naairriwaka ninye olaiguanani Ahas te Dameski, neaku eitobira olapolosani Uria ina, eton eitu ebau olaiguanani Ahas te Dameski.

English: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shefatia naa iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
Masaai: Neitoki asuju olosho le Naftali, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Naftali naa Ahira olayioni le Enan,

English: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
Masaai: Meetae hoo eng'oki nabo oo naataasa apa ninye naitokini aadamu te nkaraki ninye; etaasa ninye ina naishaakino nesipa, nemeeta inchere pee meton ninye eishu.
