English: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
Masaai: Temerregelayu ning'or aishir, na tito e Sion, anaa enkitok nasaisai; amu ore taata naa ilo aing'uaa ena anasa, nilo abik teina kop naisiaja ilo iyie Babilon. Naa teine kipuoi aakordu, teine kilo Olaitoriani alaku iyie aitung'uaa nkaik oo lmang'ati linono.

English: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena entipik enyuaata pooki, entoponiki eyiolounoto;

English: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
Masaai: Kake kayieu niyiolouu aajo Kristo endukuya o lee ake pooki, naa olee elukunya e nkitok, naa Enkai endukuya e Kristo.

English: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
Masaai: Kake etiakitia lelo arikok pooki olturrur, “Kinosakitia iyiook ninche olmumai to Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ore taata mikindim iyiook aaiseyie ninche.

English: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
Masaai: Naa tenipolos olasar le nkishoroto e nashe apolosaki Olaitoriani nipolos naa pee etum ataa keng'amaroyu.

English: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
Masaai: Amu meeta nchere pee miaatata eng'iriata, pee itumutumu aataas enayieu Enkai, ning'amumu ina kisiligata natolimuoki,

English: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
Masaai: kake mingil ae kata aibonisho te Betel, amu enkaji o laiguanani naseremishore naa enkaji e nkitoo naseremieki Enkai.”

English: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli oltung'ani meshomo ine netiaaka ninye oltung'ani le Nkai. Neaku ninye oikok ninye, neitajeuo ninye kewan katitin naagiroo nabo anaa are.

English: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ekaisujaa lelo kiseruti tiatua intae, o lelo ooas intorrok aagilunore nanu; ekaitupuku ninche te ina kop nashomo kake mejing ninche enkop e Israel. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i, enyaaka olorora kitok asoto, nemeeta entoki nanya, neipotu ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki ninche,

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ing'orie shumata, peyie ejing enchan oo soito enkop pooki e Misiri.”

English: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
Masaai: Newaliki Pilato ajo, “Ore enatisira, atisira.”

English: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?
Masaai: “Ore irorei linyi naaitame nanu katukul Olaitoriani ojo. Nijojo ake: ‘Kaji kinkuna tinikiro mbaa torrok tialo iyie?

English: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu ina olong naibalunyeki Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: And a stone was brought and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
Masaai: Neyauni osoit aairragie te nkutuk e ina ululu nemishir olaiguanani to lmishire lenye o to lmishire loo lkituaak lenyena, nchere meetae embae naidimi aaibelekenya ti alo Daniel.

English: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
Masaai: Etamueyia embata te nkaraki ing'ok enye, o te nkaraki entorroni enye netum isinaitin;

English: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Masaai: Ore nkituaak pokira are e Daudi newaki sii ninche aaraya, Ahinoam e Yesreel o Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel.

English: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
Masaai: Amu keitadou Enkai lelo oowuasa, neitajeu lelo oobor.

English: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooturoki enkop aaisudoriyie Olaitoriani mbaa enye, lelo ootii mbaa enye enaimin, lelo oojo, “Kaing'ae nadol iyiook? Kaing'ae nayiolo iyiook?”

English: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
Masaai: Nchoo mikisisi iyie, Iyie Enkai aaitulusoo te shumata nkatampo! nchoo enkitoo ino eibulu enkop pooki!

English: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
Masaai: Ina kata eton etii Olmagilani tenebo nanu ina kata aamanita nkera aainei nanu.

English: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
Masaai: Kake aisiliga nanu ina nyorrata ino nauno; naa keng'ida oltau lai te nkaraki enjeunoto ino.

English: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Neibung apa ninye orrekie le Asa papaai lenye, neitu eibelekenya apaash. Etaasa ninye isidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
Masaai: Eitobira ninche emesa, eisalaasha ninche ilkarash oopiki oltiren, nedaa ninche neokisho. Entudumunye intae, lo kituaak, eelie long'oi eilata!

English: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni lemesipa melo eitu eitamei, ore ilo oiro inelejare naa keimin.

English: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
Masaai: Ore ilo otur enkurma enye naa ketum endaa sapuk, kake ore ilo osuj imbaa nemeeta tipat naa ketum aisinanisho sapuk.

English: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.
Masaai: Neosh Yoab emowuo nepuonu iltimito aashukunye te mirata oo Siraeli amu etomitikio Yoab ninche.

English: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
Masaai: Intaasa ilkulikae tung'ana anaa eniyieu nikintaas ninche iyie.

English: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
Masaai: nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Esekiel ilo apolosani, olayioni le Busi teina kop oo Ilkaldayo te mbata olkeju le Keba; netii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata enye teine.

English: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo larin iip ong'uan o ntomoni isiet eidipa iltung'ana loo Siraeli aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, to lari liong'uan eitore Solomon Israel, to lapa oji ole Sif, aa ninye olapa liare, neiteru ninye ashet enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
Masaai: o Elon, o Timna, o Ekron,

English: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
Masaai: Amu Enkai natipika atua oltau lenye meitabai inaayieu ninye, neaku ile ndamunoto nabo, neishooyo engolon enye, e nkitoria aaisho ina ng'ues, o metaba anaa neitabari ororei le Enkai.

English: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
Masaai: Kerishata naba aa miwuang'ie enkomom ino te nanu, anaa kipal nanu matoijoi nkamulak.

English: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
Masaai: Embae e sayiet olng'ejep lenye; keiro ninye te lejare; ore te nkutuk enye meetae ake olemeirorie olelatia enye te seriani, kake ore tiatua oltau lenye neitobiraki ninye orreshet.

English: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
Masaai: Etadara Olaitoriani te shumata, ore ilo otii shumata oleng neitayu oltoilo lenye.

English: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
Masaai: nebukoki ninye olmena lelo kituaak, neisho ninche metilimanata too nkoitoi misili;

English: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e are, ina kata eokito enaisho oo sabibu, neitoki olaiguanani ajoki Esta, “Kainyoo eomonunoto ino Esta? Eikinchori iyie. Ainyoo eyieunoto ino? Tenaa ninye kolpisiai le nkitoo ai, naa keitabari.”

English: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
Masaai: Nejing'aa te ina kata inchere, mme enkisuijo oo mukateni eimaka kake inenkiteng'enare oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.

English: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
Masaai: Nepuo ilkumok enetii ninye; nejo, “Eitu eas Yohana olmonekie kake ore pooki natejo Yohana eimaki ele tung'ani kesipa.”

English: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
Masaai: Ore Maaka ina kitok e Makir neiu olayioni, neisho enkarna ajo Peres, ore enkarna o lalashe lenye naa Sheresh: Ore ilayiok lenyena naa Olam o Rakem.

English: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
Masaai: Neitu ake kindip enkiimata oo nkoitoi enye arashu ias enatiu olminong lenye; ore te nkata kiti oleng nitarruoyie alang ninche too nkoitoi inono pooki.

English: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.
Masaai: Mening ninye hoo likae toilo, meng'amaa ninye ererioroto enkikoo. Meisilig ninye Olaitoriani, menyikaki ninye Enkai enye.

English: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
Masaai: Kake eyupuyupo engoro e Nkai te nkaraki nashomo ninye; nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkoitoi anaa olmangatinta lenye. Nekedito apa Balaam osikiria, netii isinkan lenyena oare te nebo ninye.

English: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
Masaai: Ore ina kata nening oltoilo sapuk oing'uaa shumata ejoki ninche. “Elepu wootu ene!” Ore eing'orita ilmang'ati lenye neilep ninche aapuo shumata te nkatampoi.

English: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
Masaai: Netii apa Daudi ina kata atua enkisudoroto; ore oltim loo Lfilisti netii Betlehem.

English: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
Masaai: Meeta kata nemeng'as ninye abik te shumata o metaba anaa neitang'ejuki pooki toki anaa enatolimuo apake Enkai te dukuya too nkutukie oo loibonok lenyena sinyat.

English: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Elifas le Teman awal ajo:

English: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
Masaai: Kake etejo, “Ore enemeidimayu too ltung'ana keidimayu te Nkai.”

English: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Masaai: Ore olosujaki ninche naa olosho le Manase, ore olarikoni loo ltungana le Manase naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur,

English: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
Masaai: Aaitamio nanu Olaitoriani oleng, kake eitu ninye aapalaa matua.

English: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.
Masaai: Neaku etaasa apa Solomon entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitu ninye, eunokino asujaa Olaitoriani anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
Masaai: emboron, enkibooroto e kewan. Nemeetae nkitanapat naagilunore mbaa naaijo kuna.

English: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
Masaai: Nemayian Enkai ninche ejo, “Entoisho niponariri aaiput inkariak oo naaiposha, naa nchoo sii imotonyi o loing'ang'e metubula te enkop.”

English: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
Masaai: “Ore Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani neitasheiki eilata oo ltaai, o enkorropil, ilo asar le ntapa li anaake, o ina ilata naputishoreki o enkitasheikinoto pooki eilo ng'obor le Nkai o nena pooki naatii atua, o ine wueji sinyati o masaa enyena.”

English: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
Masaai: Eitoip ninye olapa neisalaashaki ninye enkatampoi enye.

English: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
Masaai: “Toriko Aron o layiok lenyena tenebo ninye, neya lkilani o eilata naputishoreki o loing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, olmeregeshi oare, o enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuishieki;

English: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kalo linyi oota lchore laa te nelo ainyeyie eitorite enkewarie, ajoki, ‘Olchore, isilenokoki mukateni uni;

English: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
Masaai: “Eikimayian iyie tiatua enkanasa, nikimayiani iyie tiong'ata.

English: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
Masaai: “Emayiana ilo tung'ani oisilig Olaitoriani, otii osiligi lenye atua Olaitoriani.

English: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le tomon, to lapa le tomon naa Maharai le Netofa, loo le Serahit, ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Medol Olaitoriani; memusu Enkai e Yakobo.”

English: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
Masaai: Etodua apa Esau ajo etamayiana Isaak Yakobo neisho ninye meshomo Padan-aram meing'oru enkitok teine netamayiana sii neitanap ejoki, “Mayieu niyam enkitok hoo nabo oo Lkanaan,”

English: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo oloosaen, naa kepuku olpolosie te Hasarenom te rishata Hauran o Dameski; eimaa Yordan te rishata e Gilead o enkop e Israel; o meshomo enkalo oloosaen enaiposha o metabaiki Tamau. Keaku ina enkalo oloosaen.

English: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Obo doi le kulo tomon o aare, obo oitadoiki emukate engirra te nebo nanu.

English: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
Masaai: Inguanarere intae anaa to sesen; maiguanare nanu oltung'ani.

English: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
Masaai: Naa kedoiki olmeitai laaijo oloo mbartan, o nyumpui, o ntamesin, o sirkon o pooki ng'ues ake ninye natii atua lelo ng'oborri.

English: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
Masaai: engilata o loito te ng'ilata oloito, enkong'u te nkong'u, o lalae to lalae, anaa enaitaasa ninye olikae neija sii ninye eitaasi.

English: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
Masaai: Keisilig oltau lo lpayian lenye ninye, nemelau aekata ninye dupoto.

English: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
Masaai: Aisidai apa oleng te sapuko enye; o te nkadori oo lng'osil lenyena; amu eshomo intona enyena abori, ine netii inkariak kumok.

English: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
Masaai: Neijia apa eikuna iltung'ana le Israel; etaasa apa ninche te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel ninye, “Eikipuo iyiook aaim enkoitoi nalala; naa ti nikiok iyiook enkare ino, nanu o nkishu aainei, nalak nanu; nchooki ake duoo maimai too nkejek, metii ae toki.”

English: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Salmona, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Punon.

English: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
Masaai: Nejoki Yosef papaai lenye, “Ime neijia etiu papaai, amu ore ilo naa ninye olkikau; tipika enkaina ino e tatene shumata endukuya enye.”

English: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
Masaai: Etiakita ninche Enkai, ‘Shomo tung'uai iyiook’ naa ‘Kaa eidim ilo Magilani aitaasa iyiook?’

English: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
Masaai: Etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu ina teipa eng'or elotunoto e ilo oisikua; netabolo ninye enkutuk ai te ina kata naewuo ilo tung'ani enatii tadekenya; metaa etaboloki apa enkutuk ai, nemeekure ara olemeiro.

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
Masaai: Newaliki ninche ajoki, “Ijojo pasa ai lelo Galilaya oota ng'ok aalang ilkulikae Galilaya pooki, eji amu neijia eikunaki enkitamioto?

English: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.
Masaai: Nedol olarriponi likae tung'ani ekuetu; neipotisho olarriponi te nkishomi nejo, “Ng'ura ekuetu likae tung'ani openy!” Nejo olaiguanani, “Ilomon sidain sii ninye eyau.”

English: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
Masaai: Kake etejo Abram, “Oi Olaitoriani Enkai, kaji aiko tenayiolou ajo keaku enaai?”

English: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
Masaai: Ore ake etiu neijia, enchoo oltung'ani eunokino enkishon enye te risioroto oo nkishorunot naaisho Olaitoriani o te nkipototo natang'amayie te Nkai. Ena kitanapata aitanap sirito pooki.

English: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them,
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia aitanap ninche meitobira ilgilat tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, neitobir ninche.

English: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
Masaai: Amaa teneye oltung'ani keitoki apiu aigil? Ore inkolong'i aainei pooki esiaai ai naa kaanyu. Ometabau elakunoto ai.

English: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Eyakaki nanu olbakuli ng'ejuk, nipikipiki emunyan atua.” Neyaki ninche ninye.

English: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
Masaai: Neshau enchan oo soito sapukin oleng, laa nkiloi onom enkiroishi o soito obo, nedoiki ltung'ana eing'uaa shumata, o metaba anaa nedek iltung'ana Enkai te nkaraki ina shan oo soito, ilo meitai oitureisho naleng.

English: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.
Masaai: Kepolosaki ninche Olaitoriani anaake tadekenya o teipa ilasarri oopejori, o enkorropil o sonkoyoni naarropil, neirragie emukate e nkitoduaaroto te mesa e sahabu nasila, neing'or nena kitasheta oo ltaai e sahabu pee etum iltaai lenyena aayupuyupo anaake teipa. Amu eikimbung iyiook enkitanapata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, kake itanyaita intae ninye.

English: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
Masaai: amu enkaji kiserut ninche. Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, intobiraki kewan olola le yararoto, nilo eyararoto dama kiduaaya ninche; ilo anaa oloaruno aing'uaa ewueji ino alo dikae wueji kiduaaya ninche. Ebaiki neidim ninche aatoning'u hoo naa enkaji natogolong'ua ninche.

English: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon, lo lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon aare o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu naajoki:

English: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore ina sikar nayooki alotu ena aji naa keaku kitok alang enapa, e dukuya Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa ti atua ene wueji aaishooyo nanu dupoto, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.’ ”

English: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
Masaai: Olaitoriani loo lororani sii eing'uaa ena; ole nking'asia ninye too nkikoot, naa arriyia aisul te ng'eno.

English: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
Masaai: Lemetiu anaa olapa sotua laitayio o loo menye enapa olong pee aibung ninche te nkaina ariku aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; amu eitu ninche etoni ti atua osotua lai, naa ina pee eitu aitoki ashilaa ninche Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
Masaai: Ore taata te niar ele orere metuata anaa oltung'ani obo, ore apa lelo oshon ootoning'o enkaisisa ino nejo,

English: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
Masaai: Naa manyaaki iyiook aayau osanduku le Nkai ene nikitii amu kitapalaitie apa too nkolong'i e Saul.”

English: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
Masaai: Nenya ninche nkiri ina kewarie, naatapejoki; te nebo imukateni neitu eisuijieki nenya sii mbenek naadua.

English: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
Masaai: Amu ore engoro o ltung'ani nemeas isipat e Enkai.

English: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
Masaai: Etii apa ninche pooki abori eutaroto e papaai lenye to sinkolio le nkaji e Nkai, too nkinantani, o nkai oo sinkoliotin, o lwululi loo usin, tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai. Ore Asaf, o Yedutum, o Heman netii abori enkitanapata o laiguanani.

English: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.
Masaai: Nejing'aa kulikae nena naatejo ninye kake eitu eiruk kulikae.

English: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
Masaai: Ore etobiko lapaitin okuni te ine, neiguanare Lyahudi ejo pee ear metua, enoshi kata ejo pee elo aked emeli alo Siria, nerrinyo etumuta ajo keimaa ake pookata Makedonia.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel te nelo nepong'ori enkitok e likae moruo ake ninye, neas emarmalisho ti alo ninye,

English: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
Masaai: Miasiasa anaa enaasita ninche te nkop e Misiri, teine apa nemanya intae, nimiasiasa anaa enaasi te nkop e Kanaan teine nayaita nanu intae nimipuopuo intae too nkiguanat enye.

English: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore eseremisho ninye te nkaji e Nisrok, ina ai enye, nepuonu Adramalek o Shereser, lelo ayiok lenyena, aasesekuan ninye to lalem, neisik aapuo oldoinyo le Ararat. Neitoreisho olayioni Esar-hadon te rishata enye.

English: And when the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us: for his hand is sore upon us, and upon Dagon our god.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Ashdod eneikununo mbaa, nejo ninche, “Meton osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli te nebo iyiook; amu keiroishi enkaina enye te shumata iyiook o te shumata Dagon, enkai ang.”

English: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
Masaai: Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani: “Shomo ngero olarriponi, nchoo ninye elimu aibalunye ina nadol.

English: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
Masaai: “Enosa imukateni neitu eisuijieki nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e dukuya niwuang'ieng'ie enkisuijo aaitayu too nkajijik inyi, amu te nenya oltung'ani emukate naisuijo, ebaiki enkolong edukuya o metabaiki enkolong e naapishana nekepari ilo tung'ani aaitung'uaa Isiraeli.

English: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
Masaai: “Neitoriou ninye te shumata naaya ninye nanu, naaitayu ti atua nkariak kumok.

English: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
Masaai: Ore te lelo arin oopishana lo lari sapuk, enoto enkop eishoi sapuk,

English: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Mijing enkaji naishirieki, aashu ilo aishir, aashu aishiraki ninche, amu aiwuang'ie nanu eseriani ai te kulo tung'ana, Olaitoriani ojo, enyorrata ai nauno o lng'ur.

English: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
Masaai: Neitu eyiolou ninche inchere Papa eimaki.

English: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
Masaai: Ore Dedan netaasa esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie too nkilani naarewueki imbartan.

English: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
Masaai: Amu ti nimbelekenyanya aany isujusuju ninye, naa keigil ninye apalaa ninche ti ong'ata, nendaikiekie intae kulo tung'ana pooki.”

English: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
Masaai: Ore anaa enitoduaa iyie esekenkei eshula o esarng'ab neijia etiu eshula maate aayama, kake meibung'a maate aaku nabo, anaa ake enemeibung'a esekenkei o enterit.

English: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Hiram tenebo nena melin kumok isinkan lenyena, iltung'ana oopuo too nkariak, ootamoo enaiposha, tenebo isinkan le Solomon.

English: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ewaita iltung'ana leina kop Yoahas olayioni le Yosia neitaa ninye olaiguanani terishata e papaai lenye te Yerusalem.

English: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
Masaai: ejo kuna, “Kaa kintaas kulo tung'ana? Amu eibale ake ninye too ltung'ana pooki oomanya Yerusalem nchere ninche etaasishoreki te na bae naba nji e nking'asia, nimikiindim sii aatomiki.

English: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
Masaai: Kake ti nishuko iyie alo enkanasa, nijoki Absalom, ‘Kaaku nanu osinka lino, iyie olaiguanani, naa ore apa anaa enara nanu osinka le papaai lino te nkata natulusoyie, neijia sii taata etiu kaaku nanu osinka lino,’ niaku intashal iyie te nkaraki nanu enkiguana e Ahitofel.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa te nebo intae empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo. Esai.

English: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
Masaai: Nepik ninye nena kitasheta imiet enkalo e kopikop eina aji, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape enkaji, nepik ilo moti olpijata aaitorit kopikop o loo saen leina aji.

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Samuel ejo:

English: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilo ojo kenotoko enkitashoto neing'or kewan mebatata.

English: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
Masaai: Ore eosh Olaitoriani, ninche aigil, netoni iltung'ana lenyena aaranyisho too lwululi o too nkai oo sinkolioitin Enkai makewan naarare ile Asiria.

English: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
Masaai: Ore tiatua nkanas e Manase o Efraim, o Simion o metabaiki Naftali, te nkidaata enye too nkaloli pooki,

English: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
Masaai: Aitoduaa intae ilmonek lo lkipaaret o sipa, too lmonek o mbaa e nking'asia o nkiaasin e ngolon.

English: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
Masaai: Netum taa iltung'ana pooki aatureita; nelimu ninche ina nataasa Enkai, nedamu ina nataasa ninye.

English: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
Masaai: Keitoborri iltung'ana, neitadouni iltung'ana - mipalaki ninche!

English: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
Masaai: Neaku eitagoloki oltau le Farao neitu eisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo; anaa enairoro Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye Yesu aing'uaa ilo kirine le Turo, neimaa Sidon alo enkalo e naiposha e Galilaya, nepolos aimaa atua Dekapoli.

English: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
Masaai: Naa keng'amaa ajoki, ‘Esipa ajoki intae, ore anaa eneitu intaasiasa obo le kulo ooti, nanu eitu intaasiasa.’

English: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
Masaai: Ore taa iyiook iltung'ana linono, ina luaata e nkirrita ino, nikincho iyie enashe ntarasi; ore ebaiki iishoritin o ishoritin, nikilimu enkisisa ino.

English: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
Masaai: Neiteng'el Solomon iltung'ana nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana pee enap ilolan, neiteng'el iltung'ana nkalifuni ntomoni isiet pee eturu isoito teina kop oo ndonyio, neiteng'el iltung'ana nkalifuni uni o iip ile ooitasheiki ninche.

English: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
Masaai: Ore ina niyiolo nayiolo sii nanu, maaure iyie tukul.

English: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
Masaai: amu ore enetii masaa inono kiroteti, naa ine eyooki atii oltau lino.

English: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna baa neitoki Yesu aitoduaaya kewan te lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena te naiposha e Tiberias; neitoduaaya kewan tena oitoi.

English: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
Masaai: Ore ilo oton te shumata nekueni; neikordod nena kitobirat enye e pesho.

English: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
Masaai: Te iyie iyiook kisulie ilmang'ati lang; te nkarna ino iyiook kintunyoo lelo oogilunore iyiook.

English: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
