Masaai: Neijia sii etiu ilpayiani eishiaakino nenyor inkituaak enye anaa iseseni lenye maate. Ore olonyor enkitok enye kewan enyor.

English: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
Masaai: Eikununo anaa ierat oopuo eniado, anaa nkurman naatii embata e wuaso, enyaanyukie o sugoroi otuno Olaitoriani, eikununo anaa iltarakua ootii embata e nkare.

English: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
Masaai: Naa te nearari intae te na ang, esikaki enkae, amu esipa ajoki intae, miishushu nkang'itie e Siraeli pooki eitu elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
Masaai: Naa teneitoki ake ninye oltung'ani alotu anaa oloiboni naa kejoki ninye menye otoiwuo tenebo ng'otonye, ‘Mintoki taa aishu, amu iroro elejare te nkarna o Laitoriani;’ ore menye o ng'otonye naatoiutuo ninye nengor ninche ninye meipang'a ina kata eibonisho.

English: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
Masaai: Atigire nanu, mabol enkutuk ai; amu iyie otaasa ina.

English: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejing'u lelo kipaareta, ng'ura, etii ina kitanyaanyukoto endapash, o ina toki nairishunyeki endukuya oo lpapit loo nkineji te ndukuya enye.

English: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
Masaai: Neirriwaa enkaji e Yosef ilaikitalak meshomo aaikeern Betel. (Ore apa enkarna e ina anasa naa keji Lus).

English: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
Masaai: Nerik o meitabaiki Golgota eji ewueji e mborbor.

English: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
Masaai: Entoning'oki nanu, intae ilmanien le naiposha, nining'ining'i intae iloreren oo lakua. Aaipotuo apa nanu Olaitoriani atii enkoshoke, ore atii enkoshoke e yieyio neipot ninye enkarna ai.

English: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
Masaai: neisho Solomon Hiram mboreitin e mpirbil nkalifuni tikitam e nkano meitaa endaa enkaji enye, o mboreitin empirbil e ilata nkalifuni tikitam. Neisho Solomon Hiram kuna te pooki ari.

English: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
Masaai: Naning entoki naaijo oltoilo te mpolos e nana ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu ejo, “Emborei e mpilbil e nkano te mpesai nabo, o mboreitin uni o shairi te dinari. Kake mintarruoo eilata o enaisho oo sabibu.”

English: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
Masaai: nijo, ‘Nji eikoni Babilon aaimisie, pee meigil ae kata adumunye, tenkaraki ina torroni nayau nanu shumata ninye.’ ” Ene ebaiki irorei le Yeremia.

English: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
Masaai: lelo oorany isinkoliotin le pesho to ltoilo le nkinanta, neitobiraki ate ntokitin oo sinkolioitin anaa Daudi;

English: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
Masaai: Amaa te naa ore apa kira iyiook ilmang'ati neitoning'oki iyiook o Enkai te nkeeya o Inoti lenye, elusoo oleng, taata kitoning'ote, eitajeu iyiook enkishui enye.

English: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
Masaai: Ore pee epuo ninche neimaki Yesu Yohana to lorere ajoki, “Ainyoo ishomo intae aadol ti ong'ata? Kolperesi oyuk enkijape?

English: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
Masaai: Ening'o apa ninye oleng te lelo tomoni uni, kake menyaanyukie lelo pokira okuni. Nepik Daudi ninye meitasheiki lelo arripok lenyena.

English: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
Masaai: Entodol naa ate, meinepu intae enapa nairoro iloibonok le Nkai aajo:

English: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
Masaai: Etejieita nkonyek enye te mpiron, netulusoitie mbaa enye aalang iltauja lenye.

English: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
Masaai: Ebulu iltung'ana torrok anaa entiati natii ewueji netii enkolong, neibulaa ilukuny aaidapashakino enkurma enye.

English: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.
Masaai: Ore ina kewarie neirriwaa Saul ilkiliku enkaji e Daudi metaleeno ninye, pee etum ataara ninye metua tadekenya. Kake etiaaka ninye Mikal, enkitok e Daudi, “Ti nimintajeu enkishui ino ena kewarie, ore taisere niye.”

English: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
Masaai: Ore ilo olo eishirita, enapita olantererai olo aun, nelotu ang too mbuakunot e ng'ida, enapita enkisampuare enye.

English: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Masaai: O shem, o Arpakshad o Shela,

English: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitudup nena kilang'ilang'eta enkima neisho nena bariak meshomo aaim atua enkano oo Lfilisti nepejoo isotot o enkano nauno o nkurman oo loirienito.

English: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Masaai: Ore apa lelo tung'ana magil loo njorin naa Asahel, olalashe le Yoab, o Elhanan olayioni le Dodo le Betlehem,

English: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
Masaai: kake tenedamu ninche too ltauja teina kop apa nawaki ninche, neirridu, nikisai ninche iyie teina kop e yararoto enye, ejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, nikitaasa ntorrok’;

English: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
Masaai: ekapik ninye atua enkaina e ilo magilani loo loreren naa kearare ninye anaa enatiu ing'ok enyena, atanang'ayie ninye ong'ota.

English: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
Masaai: nejo Israel eidipe eton doi eishu olayioni lai Yosef; ekalo adol ninye eton eitu aye.

English: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
Masaai: Neimaa Siria o Kilikia neitagol nena sirito.

English: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
Masaai: Nejo Abraham, “Ekeisho Enkai kewan olkuo le ker lolasar o pejori enkayioni ai.” Kaae nepuo pokira are aairiamari.

English: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
Masaai: Aime pee ing'arie endaa ino ilo oisumash, neyau ilo aisinani le meeta ang atua enkaji ino; ore pee idol ilo lemeishopo ninchop, neme pee isudoo kewan te lelo tung'ana leeijo iyie?

English: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani aisinani naa keiba olelatia enye, kake ore olkarsis neeta ilchoreta kumok.

English: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
Masaai: neipang olapolosani alo auluo ilng'oborri nelo ilo apolosani ajur ninye. Ore ake pee eishiwuo ina keeya oo lbolot teilo oata enkeeya oo lbolot,

English: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
Masaai: Emintamanaa endung'oto oo lpapit loo lmowuarak loo lukuny inyi nimibarnibarna mbat oo lmunyo linyi.

English: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Asiria aitanapisho ajo, “Erriwai ine obo loo lapolosak apa litaaraitie ninchosho ninye meshomo abik teine; pee eiteng'enisho nkitanapat e Nkai eina kop.”

English: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
Masaai: Naa ore ake tenelo olaiguanani enkaji o Laitoriani, nenapu olarriponi nena long'oi ayau enkaji e rripore.

English: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
Masaai: Ara oltung'ani orok oleng, nara sii sidai, na toyie e Yerusalem, atiu anaa lelo ng'oborri le Kedar, anaa lkarash le Solomon.

English: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi awalu ajo, “Nena empere o laiguanani! Nchoo obo loo lbarnot elang'u alotu aya.

English: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
Masaai: Nejoki olaitasheikinoni ninche, “Entotoni miatata enkuretisho; ore Enkai inyi o Enkai oo loo papaai linyi ninye natipika ilo shumati atua ilbenia linyi apikaki intae; atang'amayie impisai inyi.” Neriku ninye Simon enetii ninche.

English: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
Masaai: Ore eneituutishoreki o eneironyieki ilng'anayio meitoti ninche.

English: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
Masaai: Enino, iyie Olaitoriani enkitoo, o engolon, o enkitoria, o enkisulata, o enkishiaa; amu ore pooki natii shumata o enkop naa nkuninono; enino enkitoria, iyie Olaitoriani, naa iyie eilepieki aaitulusoo te pooki.

English: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
Masaai: Neijia eikununo, ore iltung'ana pooki le Israel apa ooisudoitie ate te ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim nening nchere eisikita Ilfilisti; nesuju sii ninche te ngolon epuo enjore.

English: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
Masaai: Metaa Enkai nainyeyie Osinka lenye, naa intae eiteru airriwaki, pee emayian intae pooki aibelekeny entung'uai nkoitoi inyi e nkarrueisho.”

English: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
Masaai: Amu, ng'ura, keirrag ninche pee aarresh nanu aar matua, neiturrurro lelo pushunot te nebo pee aar nanu. Neme te nkaraki enkitarruorroto ai anaa eng'oki ai, Olaitoriani,

English: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Solomon enkomono enye nedou enkima naing'uaa shumata neinos ilo asar opejori o nkishorot neiput enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.

English: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
Masaai: Tenikijo iyiook matijing atua enkanasa; netii olameyu atua enkanasa, naa eikipuo aaye teine. Naa tenekitoni tene nikiye ake sii. Maape naa taata ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria. Tenetapala ninche iyiook, nikinchu, naa tenetaara iyiook matuata, nikiye naa.”

English: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
Masaai: laa ninye likitorikoyie aimie ilo purkel kitok, ilo otii lasuriaa torrok o nkolupani oina kop natoyio nemetii enkare, laa ninye likiyaka iyie enkare aimunye e ndapidapoi nagol.

English: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
Masaai: Enduaata e Obadia. Inji ejo Olaitoriani ti alo Edom: Kitoning'o iyiook ilomon supati ooing'uaa Olaitoriani, neirriwuaki olkilikuai atua iloreren. “Tudumunye! matudumakinoto iyiook ninye to larrabal!”

English: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia te neimaki intae ltung'ana aaisis; neijia taa apake eikuna iloo papaai linyi aaisis iloibonok le lejare.

English: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
Masaai: “Imbung'a osirua loo lng'oborri nkolong'i naapishana, ina kata itasoto enkurma ino te wueji neidong'ishoreki o te wueji ino neironyishoreki;

English: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
Masaai: “Wou pooki ng'ae oata enkure, wootu entook nkariak; wou, iyie ilo lemeeta mpisai inyang'u endaa inosa! Wou, inyang'u enaisho o kule, wou, miata ropiyiani nemetii enkinyang'a.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ina enata nintupukoo ate to lapa liong'uan o enata enkitupukoroto nintupukoo ate to lapa le imiet, o ina enata enkitupukoroto o lapa liopishana, o enata nintupukoo ate to lapa le tomon, keaku ninche te nkaji e Yuda irishat e ng'ida o enchipai o sirua lo lkerempe. Metaa entonyor esipata o eseriani.

English: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
Masaai: Ituuno apa intae entorroni, nisampupu enkarruoisho, inosa intae ilng'anayio le lejare. Amu isiliga apa intae ngarrin inyi o larrabal o ina siamo oo lmurran linyi.

English: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, ore te ina olong e nkiguana, Sodom eikashieki alang enaitaasi ina ang!

English: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
Masaai: Ore apa Filipo naa Betsaida eing'uaa, enkanasa oo Andrea o Petero.

English: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
Masaai: Eitu eany Enkai ltung'ana lenyena laa ninche apake etayiolo, Aimiyiololo enajo Ilkigerot te Eliya o ina natasayia Enkai agilunore Isiraeli ejo?

English: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni, te ina olong kewan, neipang aapuo ilororani pooki lo Laitoriani aaing'uaa Misiri.

English: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina kata naa kayau nanu intae ang, te ina kata naiturrur nanu intae te nebo; ee, kaisho nanu metayiolouni intae nerrepi ti atua iloreren pooki le nkop, te ina kata nalo nanu arrinyoki karsisisho inyi dukuya nkonyek inyi,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
Masaai: Iyieu iyie nikintodoli lo tung'ani omoda inchere ore enkirukoto nemeeta siaitin naa koolupi?

English: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yuda naa, Peres, o Hesron, o Karmi, o Huri, o Shobal.

English: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
Masaai: “Meetae enkishoroto e ntapa nayakini Olaitoriani naitobiruni te ntoki naisuisho, amu mipejokiki Olaitoriani te nkima entoki naisuisho aashu pooki aisho anaa olasar le nkima.

English: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana lenyena, “Ng'ura, eikumok oleng iltung'ana loo Siraeli, negol oleng te iyiook.

English: And they laid the ark of the LORD upon the cart, and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods.
Masaai: Nepik ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai eng'arri, o ilo sanduku te nebo indero e sahabu o inkitanyaanyukot oo ltuduta lenye.

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki,

English: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
Masaai: Ore etulusoite nkolong'i kumok naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Tudumunye, shomo Farite, ntayu teine enkarasha empolos apa naaitanapa iyie isudoi teine.”

English: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
Masaai: Nepurrokino iltung'ana ina olong anaa enapurrokino iltung'ana atua ootukurrutua ekueta to larrabal.

English: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
Masaai: Enkai openy natudutayie te yieunoto o te ng'eno enye makewan apake nchere, keitarasari Yesu, nitara intae ninye, aaisho ltung'ana arruok metasho.

English: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
Masaai: ore lelo marei ootelekutua, neishir ake olmarei makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate.

English: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
Masaai: nimbonoki agilunore entim e nkop e Negeb ijoki: entim e Negeb toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ing'ura ekaainuaaki iyie enkima, naa kemut pooki shani onyori otii atuaiyie o pooki shani otoyio; ore olang'a le nkima nemearaiyu, ore inkomomi pooki eiteru te kopikop o metabaiki moikuape naa keilang ninye.

English: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninye, “Elisha, totona tene, aatoomono amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Yeriko.” Kake etejo ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa eninchu iyie makewan, maaing'uaaa nanu iyie.” Nepuonu ninche Yeriko.

English: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
Masaai: Atorikoyie nanu ninche too nkeenta o lng'ur, too enat e nyorrata, natiu nanu te ninche anaa ilo oitololong enchata too iltagiligil lenye too murto enye, nairrugokino nanu ninche naitoti ninche.

English: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
Masaai: Amaa teniaraa Shetani, Shetani, neoro ninye makewan kaji naa eiko enkitoria enye teneitashe.

English: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
Masaai: Inchoo iyie ilmang'ati laainei maaibelekenyaki nkoriong'i enye, lelo laaiba nanu, naidaikie nanu ninche.

English: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aya ilo asar le ntapa otii enkaina e ina kitok, neyuk ilo asar le ntapa te dukuya Olaitoriani neitoki ayau enchumata o lperere lo lasar.

English: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
Masaai: Aishopoko kewan esupatisho, naaitoip ninye nanu. Ore esipata ai netiu anaa olkila o enkarasha e lukunya.

English: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eitobirua ing'apeta enyena te nkosholai, ore oriong enye naa ene sahabu, ore olorika lenye naa morijoi; neripuno atua te nkarriyiano, intoyie e Yerusalem naatiriputua te nkarriyiano.

English: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, itubulua ajing erishata oo loo minyi, entipat oo ltung'ana aing'okok, pee iponaa oleng ina goro o Laitoriani napi ti alo Siraeli!

English: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.
Masaai: ore pee epuo, nejokino maate, “Meeta ele tung'ani enaasita nairirikino keeya anaa eenata.”

English: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Baasha ina neitu eitoki ashet Rama, neitasheyie esiaai enye.

English: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
Masaai: Etetemaki naleng to sina, kake ore ti atua nena pooki nedooyo eng'ida enye, naa ore hoo naa aisinak naleng, neitulusoitie elengon te nkishooroto enye.

English: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
Masaai: Neaku eitaasa isinkan le Absalom Amnon anaa enaitanapishe Absalom. Nedumunye ilayiok lo laiguanani pooki, neked ake oltung'ani enyumpu enye neisik.

English: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
Masaai: Eisalaash moikuape aisalaashaki olngam neik enkop aililioki olngam.

English: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
Masaai: ninya endaa niok enkare tene wueji, nikitiaaka apa ninye iyie “Minos endaa nimiok enkare.” Mepuoi aanukaa osesen lino te nkurare oo loo papaai lino.’ ”

English: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
Masaai: olayioni le Abishua, olayioni le Finehas, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani kitok - neilepu sii ilo Esra eing'uaa Babilon.

English: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye kulikae Lawi, Mahat olayioni le Amasia, o Yoel olayioni le Asaria loo layiok le Kohat; ore too layiok le Merari naa Kish olayioni le Abdi, o Asaria olayioni le Yahalel; Ore too le Gershon, naa Yoa olayioni le Sima, o Eden olayioni le Yoa.

English: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
Masaai: “Emincho ake erikino intae kuna taata naliki intae! Keishoori Enkerai e Tung'ani aaitarasaki inkaik oo ltung'ana.”

English: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
Masaai: Kake eikiaas iyiook pooki toki naba anaa enikinosakita olmumai, aapejoki enkorropil enkaiguanani e shumata nikibukoki ninye ilasarri ooki, anaa apa enikitaasa iyiook o loo papa, o laiguanak lang o lkituaak lang, tiatua inkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem; amu ore apa ina kata nikiata endaa sapuk nikidupoyu, neitu kidol entorroni.

English: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeroboam ashet Shekem teina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, nelo abik teine, neitoki alo teine nelo ashet Penuel.

English: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.
Masaai: Eikipuo elototo oo nkolong'i uni ti ong'ata peyie kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai anaa enaitanap iyiook.”

English: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
Masaai: Keish shumata o enkop, kake meish ororei lai hoo obo.

English: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
Masaai: Neiki ilkituaak aaisiong too nkaik enye; nemeyanyiti ilpayiani kituaak.

English: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
Masaai: Neipot Abraham ine wueji ajo, “Eneishorunye Olaitoriani.” Naa ina arna eeta ine o taata, ore to ldoinyo lo Laitoriani keishoruni.

English: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
Masaai: pee incho ninye enkiyeng'iyeng'ata te nkata e nyamali, o metaba anaa neturokini ilo torrono engumoto.

English: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
Masaai: Etelejishote iltauja lenye; meeta taata nchere meitalaki entorroni enye. Kegil Olaitoriani lelo perereni lenye loo lasarri, neparripar nena ng'apeta enye.

English: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena metalama nena tokitin naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel naaishoo ninche nanu, pee meisarkionie enkarna ai sinyati: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.
Masaai: Neitanapa apa olaiguanani le Siria ilkituaak loo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, ajoki, “Emiarare ake oloti anaa olkitok, kake olaiguanani loo Siraeli ake entaarare.”

English: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
Masaai: Ore teina rishata o lari neipotu Benhadad aiturrur enjore e Siria, neilep aapuo Afek, pee earare Isiraeli.

English: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ore taisere tena rishata, nemiri entemet empirbil entapa napuyiapui te shekeli nabo, ore mpirbili are e shairi te shekeli nabo, te kishomi e Samaria.

English: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee ejo oltung'ani anyiku alotu aserem ninye, neitorioo enkaina enye neibung ninye, neng'utut ninye.

English: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
Masaai: Neinyototo ake te ina saa nerrinyo Yerusalem; neinepu lelo tomon o obo o lelo ooboitare,

English: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aigeroki ninche enkae palai e are, ajoki, “Tenaa enkalo ai itii, naa tenaa eikining'ining'i nanu, entudung'oi ilukuny oo layiok lo lkitok linyi, nipuopuo aapuonu enatii taisere te Yesreel tena rishata.” Ore apa lelo ayiok lo laiguanani pokira ntomoni naapishana, netii tenebo iltung'ana kituaak le nkanasa, laa ninche apa ooitubulu ninche.

English: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward:
Masaai: amu ajo sii ake itoning'o enkitanapa e mpiris e Enkai naaishoki metaa eninyi intae

English: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Masaai: Entaretokinoto lolan olikae o likae, amu te ina ntabayaya enkitanapata e Kristo.

English: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
Masaai: kake etejo Enkai, ‘Eminya ilo ng'anayioi leilo shani otii empolos enkurma, nimishoroo hoo ninye arashu iyeye.’ ”

English: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
Masaai: Etusulaka enkop te ngoro napi emagilanisho pooki e Israel; eiwuang'ie te ninche enkaina enye e tatene, te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye. Eyupuyupo ninye anaa olang'at le nkima tiatua Yakobo, ainos pooki wueji.

English: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
Masaai: “Naa kabukoki nanu enkaji e Daudi o lelo oomanya Yerusalem enkiyang'et o lng'ur o esayiare, metaa, tenelo neing'or aakurraki ilo otaremo ninche, naa keishiraki ninye, anaa oltung'ani oishiraki ina kerai nabo naa ninye ake eeta. Neishir te mion sapuk oleng te ninye anaa ilo oishiraki olkikau lenye otua.

English: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
Masaai: ore ake eyia, iyeye intae anaa iltung'ana, nibatatata anaa pooki tung'ani kitok.”

English: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
Masaai: Eikiyiolo losekin le sheitani nimikiyieu neidimu iyiook.

English: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
Masaai: “Ore ake pee eidip aitobira olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ine wueji sinyati o ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, neitarasaa ninye ina kine naishu;

English: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: ninche napa, etii ninye Galilaya, naatusujutua neisiaai. Netii sii kulie kituaak kumok naairiamunore ninye epuonu Yerusalem.

English: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
Masaai: Nejo ninye metaari Yakobo olalashe Yohana to lalem.

English: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eikisis iyie iloreren oogol; ore nkanas e lelo oshon lemeeta olng'ur naa eikiureyu iyie.

English: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
Masaai: Kake etimiraki ninche neaku meeta ewueji netii ninche te shumata.

English: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
Masaai: Ore olkikau lo sikiria niwalu to lkuoo le ker, arashu ti nimiwalu nigil emurt enye. Ore ilkikaunot pooki loo layiok linono niwalu akordu nemetii hoo obo olotu dukuya nanu meeta toki.

English: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.
Masaai: Nemir Israel Yuda neisik pooki tung'ani alo enkang enye.

English: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
Masaai: Etii entaboi torrono natoduaa nanu tiabori enkolong; ore karsisisho nashum oltung'ani naa kewan ake eshumaki batisho.

English: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
Masaai: Ina kutuk ake eimu emayian o ldeket. Ilalashera laainei, aime neijia duoo eishiaakino netiu.

English: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
Masaai: Kelo ninye aton anaa olasilani osil enkosholai, naa kesil aitisidan ilayiok le Lawi neitisidan ninche anaa sahabu o enkosholai o metaba anaa neitarasaki Olaitoriani ilasarri ooishiaakino.

English: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
Masaai: kake epuo aaisho iwalat ilo oterretene pee eiguanare ilooishu o lootuata.

English: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Etii sii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata Yuda, pee eisho ninche oltau obo oasie nena naaitanapishe olaiguanani o lkituaak lenyena, tialo ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
Masaai: Etanaurate nkonyek aainei te nkishirata eeta oltau lai emion o sina, eiputa oltau lai emion te nkaraki enkidaata e ntito oo ltung'ana laainei enkaraki naiterre nkera o looyoni, tiatua nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa.

English: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land?
Masaai: Kaji iyiook kinko te nikirany osinkolio le Nkai te nkop eiking'a?

English: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
Masaai: Kenan o Mahalael, Yared;

English: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
Masaai: Etaanyua apa Elihu peyie eirorie Yoab amu aibotoro apa ninche te ninye.

English: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
Masaai: “Tudumunye tadoi shomo enkaji o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok ore tene naaisho nanu iyie toning'o irorei laainei.”

English: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
Masaai: Niminapinapa olola aaitayu too nkajijik inyi te nkolong e sabato aashu iasiasa ae siaai, kake entaa enkolong e sabato sinyati, anaa apa enaitanapa loo papaai linyi.

English: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
Masaai: Neitoomon Lawi ninye to sirua kitok netii esiamo kitok oo loosotu kodi o kulikae ake oodaa te nebo ninche.

English: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo apa Yoshua enetii ninche aipang'aki te luamata, eewuo apa enkewarie pooki eing'uaa Gilgal.

English: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
Masaai: amu etejo ninche, “Neme taa te nkata o sirua, mepuku ake olong'oling'oli lo lorere.”

English: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
Masaai: Amu ore apa kitii te nebo intae, kitolikitio intae eado kop inchere keyookini aaisilisil iyiook; anaa enayewuo ake atiu, anaa eniyiolo intae.

English: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
Masaai: Ore too lala oololo nepiki ninye osanduku, oibung'ieki nenapieki ing'uesi neyakini ninye olaiguanani le Babilon; nenapi ninye atua ewueji neikenorieki, peyie meitokini aekata aaning oltoilo lenye, te shumata lelo doinyo le Israel.

English: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
Masaai: Te neiteng'enisho oltung'ani ae kiteng'enare napaashaa neibung irorei supati lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o enkiteng'enare naishiaakino orrekie le Nkai

English: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Sion le tipat anaa sahabu sidan nesila, kainyoo pee etotiutuo anaa motioo oo nkulupuok, esiaai oo nkaik o laitobirani!

English: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
Masaai: Ile ndamunoto nabo kulo neishoo ina ng'ues engolon o enkidimata enye.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ena tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli: ‘Itoduaakita ntae ate nchere airorie nanu intae atii keper.

English: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
Masaai: Kuna apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, naa kuna nkarn oo ishoritin e lelo apa ooshomo tenebo nanu eing'uaa Babilon, te nkitoria o laiguanani Artaseses.

English: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nena, ilalashera, ore naa amu eikiaata iyiook enkitieunoto nikijing'ie ine wueji sinyati to sarge le Yesu,

English: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua iltung'ana le Israel, “Wootu ene, entoning irorei lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
Masaai: ninchopokito nkejek inyi inamuka oo Lomon Supati le seriani;

English: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
Masaai: Eitajeu ninye ilo tung'ani lemeeta entioto; aikintajeuni iyie te nkaraki nkaik inono nemeiduruk.

English: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
Masaai: Minyorru injo, arashu ijing atua osina; tabolo inkonyek inono naa itum endaa sapuk.

English: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
Masaai: napaashare sii nanu intae, naosh nanu makewan intae aitulus katitin naapishana te nkaraki ing'ok inyi.

English: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo, ‘Intore sii iyie nkanas imiet.’

English: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
Masaai: Ore pee eriku, neitasheyie te dukuya enkiguana. Neikilikuan Olapolosani Kitok.

English: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
Masaai: Edumu Olaitoriani oloitunyokoki enkop, nenang'ie olarruoni enkop.

English: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
Masaai: Amu mme doi entoki naiseyieki ietuo enetii, enkima nayupuyup, o enaimin o entoki naitureisho, o lkutati,

English: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
Masaai: Nebik ti ong'ata nkolong'i artam, etemita shetani; neboitare ng'uesi e ong'ata; neisiaai ilmalaika ninye.

English: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
Masaai: Metaa kenya ninche ilng'anayio le nkoitoi enye, neitarruoo inkoitoi enye maate.

English: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
Masaai: “Emincho ildiein entoki nasinya, niminang'akiki ilului inyi ilbitiro pee meituny too nkejek enye, neibelekenyakino intae aakij.

English: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
Masaai: Teneiguanare olaiguanani ilo aisinani te sipata, naa keitasheyieki enkitoria enye ntarasi.

English: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
Masaai: “Ore te nena olong'i pooki naaiteng'elaki ninye kewan Olaitoriani nemenyikaki olmeneng'ani.

English: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
Masaai: Newaliki Lfarisayo ninche nejoki, “Keitapong'oyioki sii intae?

English: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani pooki oltung'ana pooki, nejoki ninye, “Mining iyie ninye niminyorraa.”

English: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
Masaai: Nelotu enjore naing'uaa ninye neisarkionie ina aji e Nkai o sempewuet neya ilo asar opejori le anaake. Neitasheiyie ninche olminong aaitaa ine olmuaate.

English: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Lfilisti etuputoki Daudi aaitaa olaiguanani te Israel pooki, nepuo Lfilisti pooki aaing'oru Daudi; nening Daudi ina nelo agilunore ninche.

English: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.
Masaai: “Tiaki Aron o layiok lenyena, ena enkitanapata o lasar le ng'oki. Ore te wueji neteyieng'ieki olasar opejori, neyieng'i ilo asar le ng'oki te dukuya Olaitoriani; naa kesinya ninye oleng.

English: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
Masaai: Ore inkishu naapishana sidain naapir, naa ilarin oopishana, ore ilkiyaa oopishana sidain naa ilarin oopishana; ore enkidetidet naa nabo.

English: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
Masaai: Ore naa pee aidip ena, naitabaiki ninche kuna naatasotuoki, nalotu aimaa intae alo Spein;

English: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae aainyiang'u endaa te ninche too mpisai, pee itumutumu aainosa, naa einyang'ung'u sii enkare te ninche too mpisai, pee itumutumu aatook.

English: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
Masaai: Ore inkajijik enye neserian metii enkuretisho, nemeetae eng'udi Enkai natii shumata ninche.

English: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Masaai: Amu etejo sii to Lkerempe le Nkai, ‘Nimincho iyie Ilo Sinyati lino edol erruorroto.’

English: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
Masaai: o Gilead o nkuapi oo Lgeshuri o Lmaakati, o ldoinyo le Hermon pooki, o Bashan pooki o metabaiki Saleka;

English: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
Masaai: o Mijamin, o Maadia, o Bilga,

English: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
Masaai: Te neany nkera enyena enkitanapata ai, nemepuo te risioroto oo nkikoot aainei,

English: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
Masaai: Neaku kitobiko apa iyiook tiatua ilo erata otalakinore Betpeor.

English: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
Masaai: te nebo o sitima obo le kine, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki intae.

English: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Geshom: Libni o Shimei, too lmareita lenye.

English: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
Masaai: “Aijojo aa intae? Amaa te neeta oltung'ani nkerra iip nabo, aimeing'uaa kunda ntomoni naaudo o naaudo too ldoinyo nelo aing'oru ina naimina?

English: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo neijia nedumu emukate, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe etii pooki, negil neiter anya.

English: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake etejo olturrur pooki pee enang ninche too soito. Nelioyu enkitoo o Laitoriani to lng'obor le ntumo too ltung'ana pooki le Israel.

English: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena pee eishoo intae Musa emuratare, neme Musa doi eing'uaa kake lekua loo papa, nimuratata intae oltung'ani te nkolong e sabato.

English: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.
Masaai: Te naa kara olkiminchali, aashu te naa kaata enataasa nairirikino keeya, maing'oru ajo ailanyaa keeya; kake te nemeetae esipata te nena naaitang'orieki, nemeetae likae laaidim aitarasaki ninche. Atejo Kaisari eyakini enkiguana ai.”

English: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, ntajeu iyiook, aatasayia, ntung'uai iyiook enkaina enye, pee etum nkitoriat pooki e nkop aatayiolo nchere, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie ake Enkai.”

English: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
Masaai: Nejoki naamoda kunda ng'eni, ‘Enchoo iyiook enkiti ilata inyi; amu keye iltaai lang.’

English: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pahatmoab, aa taa ilayiok le Yeshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon oare.

English: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo ooisardakieki to lapa sina otupukuo te nkaraki Stefano nepuo o metabaiki Foenike o Kupro o Antiokia, naa Lyahudi ake einosakita ilo rorei.

English: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
Masaai: Nahashon apa menye le Salma, Salma le Boas,

English: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Emintulus aaoru ltung'ana enalang ina naitanapaki intae.”

English: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna enkitok e Abishur naa Abihail neiki Abishu Ababan o Molid.

English: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
Masaai: Kaji naa inko iyie tinikintagol nanu te mpesho narok? Meetae toki natelekua too walat inono neme elejare ake.”

English: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Etii tenebo isinkan linono iltung'ana onom oogol; aatoomono nchoo ninche epuo aaing'oru olkitok lino, ebaiki neewa ninye Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani nelo anang'aki ninye likae doinyo, aashu epik atua oerata.” Nejo ninye, “Mirriwaa intae ninche.”

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
Masaai: Meisisi Enkai naa Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, laa te nkaraki olng'ur lenye sapuk eishoo iyiook metoini aaigil ti atua osiligi oishu te mpiunoto e Yesu Kristo aing'uaa lootuata,

English: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
Masaai: Nedumu ailepie lelo oobor ore lelo ooishir nedumuni aailepakinye eneserian.

English: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
Masaai: Enkenai iyiook entejo kira laisiaayiak le Kristo ooisiligaki aaitanap nkisudorot e Nkai.

English: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
Masaai: Neriku Ariok Daniel aitasieku aitijing'u meitasho te dukuya olaiguanani nelo ajoki ninye nji: “Anoto nanu ti atua lelo yarunoto ooing'uaa Yuda oltung'ani oidim aitayiolo olaiguanani ina kibalakinoto.”

English: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
Masaai: Neinyototo Balam tadekenya, nejoki lelo kituaak le Balak, “Enchom enkop inyi, amu etanya Olaitoriani alo te nebo intae.”

English: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
Masaai: Kake etigirate iltung'ana neitu ewaliki ninye olomoni hoo obo; amu ore apa enkitanapata o laiguanani naa, “Kejo emiwaliki ninye.”

English: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
Masaai: Neibalunye Ilawi too ltung'ana pooki le Israel to ltoilo sapuk aajo.

English: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
Masaai: Tolimu elaakinoto ino naa kaishoru.”

English: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
Masaai: “Enining'o sii ai kitanyaanyukoto: Etii apa oltung'ani oata enkang, neun enkurma oo lng'anayio neitaman enkikarrata netur ewueji neironyie lng'anayio, neshetaki oltalet, neing'ueiki ilaturok, nelo ninye paran.

English: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
Masaai: Neitayu Yoshua eseriani te nebo ninche, neitayu olning'o te nebo ninche, pee eisho ninche epok; ore lelo kituaak apa lo lturrur neinosaki ninche olmumai.

English: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; enchomie nkitanapat aainei ning'oring'oro oleng aajurru nkiguanat aainei,

English: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Miureshoyu iyie; kainyoo iyie idolita?” Nejoki ina kitok Saul, “Adolita nanu enkai eilepu apuku te nkop.”

English: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
Masaai: Kake ilo enkop ai olgelata lai, nirikoki olayioni lai Isaak enkitok.”

English: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
Masaai: Ore naa taata ntanapisho pee aadung'okini ltarakua le Lebanon; ore ilaisiaayiak laainei, neibung'are ilaisiaayiak linono naa kalaaki nanu isinkan linono olekoisiaayio anaa enijo; amu iyiolo iyie ajo meetae likae oyiolo atuuroi iltarakua anaa iltung'ana le Sidon.

English: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
Masaai: Eshomo Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli agilunore Yuda, neshet Rama, pee etum aibooi pooki ng'ae olotu enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Heman naa: Bukia, o Matania, o Usiel o Shebuel, o Yerimot, o Hania, o Hanani, o Eliata, o Gidalti, o Romantieser, o Yoshbekasha, o Meloti, o Hotir, o Mahasiot.

English: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
Masaai: Ebaiki olkeju le Yordan te nkalo o loo saen, o enkop pooki e Gilead, o ene Gad, o ene Ruben o ene Manase, ebaiki Aroa, te mbata o erata oji Arnon, aa taa Gilead o Bashan.

English: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
Masaai: Netum taa olng'ejep lai atolimu esupatisho ino o enkisisa ino endama pooki.

English: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
Masaai: Metaa neiturraa ieneta lenyena nelaku nkeenta naaenita lkurteta ooboinieki emeli; neitoki taa alaaki olkarasha kitok osiwuo neitoriokino ilo sinyai oisiasha.

English: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ng'ura, ekashau imukateni naaing'uaa shumata te nkaraki intae; naa keipang'u iltung'ana aaiturrurru endaa naidip ina olong, pee atem ninche tenaa keibung nkitanapat aainei anaa emeibung'.

English: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Marrinyo nanu alo tenebo iyie, anaa alo ajing atua aji tenebo iyie; nemainos nanu endaa anaa aok enkare tenebo iyie tene wueji;

English: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
Masaai: Kake etii ilootagorote nejokino, “Ainyoo pee eitarruoyioki ena ilata narropil aaiko inji?

English: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Ainyoo naa pee eitanapishe Musa meishori empalai e oro, neing'uaro?”

English: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ninye eirrag, neiyiolou ajo etobiko enkata naado te ine, nejoki ninye, “Iyieu nikinchiunyeki?”

English: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
Masaai: neisho ninche ninye embelati e mukate oo lng'abolo o nkimarrat are oo sabibu. Ore ake pee enya ninye, nepiu oltau lenye; amu eitu apa ninye enya endaa arashu eok enkare too nkolong'i uni o nkewaritin uni.

English: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
Masaai: neaku etureishote lelo oomanya ineelakua te nkop, te nkaraki nkitoduaat inono; nchoo iyie ineelusorie enkakenya o enteipa metabuaku te ng'ida.

English: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
Masaai: Nedumunye Daudi nelotu ine wueji apa netipika Saul olg'obor, nedol Daudi ine wueji neirragie Saul, te nebo Abna olayioni le Ner, olkitok le njore enye; neirragita apa Saul ti atua olng'obor nemanita enjore pooki ninye.

English: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
Masaai: Katitin uni to lari eliooyu ilewa linono pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai, Enkai oo Siraeli.

English: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore te siadi Abimelek nedumunye pee ekordu Israel Tola olayioni le Pua, olayioni le Dodo, oltung'ani le Isaakar, neton apa ninye te Shamir ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim.

English: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
Masaai: Eikiosh iyie Olaitoriani to loirirua o te modoki o te miloi oo ndamunot;

English: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
Masaai: Amu ore engolon e nena bartam naa atua nkutukie enye etii, olkidong'o lenye. Netiu lkidong'o lenye anaa lasuriaa, keeta lukuny, naa ninche epikishore ilbaa.

English: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.
Masaai: Ore pee eikilikuan Akish ajo, “Kakua duoo taata itaara?” Nejo Daudi, “Ilnegeb le Yuda,” arashu, “Ilnegeb le Ijerame,” arashu, “Kitaarare Ilnegeb le Keni.”

English: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
Masaai: Ore too le Hebron, naa Hashabia o lalashera lenyena, iltung'ana enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana oata enkidimata, ooing'or aagolie Isirael, te nkalo o loo ntoluo olkeju le Yordan, te siaai pooki Olaitoriani, o te nkisiayiare olaiguanani.

English: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kibrot-hatafa nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Heserot.

English: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
Masaai: Ning'or nchere, intobira te nkitanyaanyukoto enye, apa nikintoduaaki to ldoinyo.

English: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
Masaai: pee metumi oltung'ani hoo owousa te dukuya Enkai.

English: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
Masaai: Kiaata enkiti anashe, nemeeta ninye ilki. Kaa kintaas enkanashe ang, teina olong nasai ninye?

English: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
Masaai: Te nalo nanu too naipuko e nkakenya, nalo amany enaiposha

English: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
Masaai: Neosh ilmang'ati lenyena arriny siadi; nepik ninche enkurruna oo ntarasi.

English: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Eisero apa Sedekia apaashare olaiguanani Nebukadnesa, laa ninye apa oishoo ninye meinosa olmumai tialo Enkai; negolong'u ninye neitagol oltau lenye, neany eibelekenyakino Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
Masaai: Aaimulumulaitie nanu nkarriak, aatamana nanu enguton nkaloli pooki; neteene olairampai aman endukuya ai,

English: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
Masaai: Neidaikie Simri anaa enkaji e Baasha pooki, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro tialo Baasha aimunye Yehu oloiboni le Nkai,

English: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
Masaai: Nenang'akini keeya o enemeneng'a atua ilo balbal le nkima; Ena ninye keeya e are, ilo balbal le nkima.

English: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
Masaai: Amu ore nena pooki naatii enkop, ng'uarrat o sesen, ng'uarrat oo nkonyek o lwuasa le nkishui, ine nkop nena mme ne Papa.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ilpayiani kituaak o ntasati moruak, ekeitoki aatoni too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem, pooki ng'ae eeta entirma te nkaina enye tenkaraki enkitoo.

English: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
Masaai: Eiroro ninche elejare neibonu elejare; nejo ninche, ‘Ejo Olaitoriani’ eitu eirriwaa Olaitoriani ninche, neisilig ninche meitabai irorei lenye.

English: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.
Masaai: enkaraki neitu apa ninche kintanang'are iyie enkare o endaa te nkoitoi, ina kata apa pee ipuku aing'uaa Misiri, o enkaraki nayautua Baalam olayioni le Beor aaitung'uaa Petor e Mesopotamia meeu adek intae.

English: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
Masaai: Neiput enkoshoke enye aitaraposh, keirriu Enkai engoro enye napi shumata ninye neitashaiki shumata ninye anaa endaa.

English: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia adumu likae piyayati neisho Baruk ilo aigeroni, ayioni le Neria, laa ninye oigero te limunoto e Yeremia lelo rorei pooki lo lpiyayati otapejo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda te nkima; neponiki kulikae rorei laaijo lelo.

English: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo ooing'oru isipat, lelo ooing'oru isipat nkatitin pooki!

English: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Kitudung'okitio iyiook ate, pee kiyau ilng'anayio le dukuya te nkop ang, o lng'anayio le dukuya le pooki shani, te pooki ake ari, enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
Masaai: Neinyototo Samuel ayooki pee enang'are Saul tadekenya; netiaakaki apa Samuel, “Eewuo Saul Karmel, naa ng'ura eshetaki kewan esoit nadamunyeki neitoki ashuko, nelo agiroo, nedoyio alo Gilgal.”

English: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
Masaai: nedol sii enkoliai aisinani eitadoiki ielai are naanyokie.

English: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
Masaai: Kake eshomo ina tito e Farao teina anasa e Daudi nelo enkaji enye makewan apa nateshetaka Solomon ninye, neitoki ashetu Milo.

English: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
Masaai: Metaa eipoto olaiguanani le Misiri nena aitoyiok, nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee itaasa ena, ninchosho nkayiok eishu?”

English: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
Masaai: Ore enyorrata enye o enkiba enye o olom lenye neidipa pooki aisha, nemeekure eetaae ntarasi erubata e pooki naasi tiabori enkolong.

English: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
Masaai: Te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, te ine kiyaki iyie ilaiguanak nkishorot.

English: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
Masaai: Metaa meekure eeta tipat nanapie Ilawi olng'obor le Nkai o kulie tokitin ake pooki e nkisiaayiare.”

English: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
Masaai: Ore tenkae alo naipirare kishomi tenkalo e moikuape, anaa enatiu tenkalo o loo ntoluo netii enkishomi natii atua olgoriet; netem eiteru te kishomi o metabaiki kishomi, intemat e nkaina iip nabo.

English: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
Masaai: Nairrabalakino nanu enkop te dukuya Olaitoriani anaa apake, nkolong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam; neitu ainos endaa aashu aok enkare, te nkaraki ina ng'oki pooki nitaasa, aas ina bae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, aaitagor ninye.

English: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
Masaai: Amu enaikash tinikijokini, “wou ilepu ene” alang tinikintadoyiori te netii olaiguanani.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho o lalashe papaai lino, aa taa minyikaki enkitok enye; amu nkapu ino ninye.

English: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
Masaai: Ore apa olaitasheikinoni loo lchumat lo laiguanani naa Asmafet olayioni le Adiel. Naa ore olaitasheikinoni loo lchumat leina kop, tiatua nkanas, o tiatua nkang'itie kutiti, o too ltaleta, naaYonatan olayioni le Usia;

English: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this is the day whereof I have spoken.
Masaai: Ing'ura, elotu ninye, naa keyauni aaitabau, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Ina olong ina naimaka.

English: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
Masaai: Nepik emion enkishui e Isaak o Rebeka.

English: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: ilo otasesekuana ilaiguanak kituaak, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ng'ues ti atua entim naa enaai, o nena kishu naatii ndoinyo inkalifuni.

English: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
Masaai: Neya ilo oiboni osesen leilo tung'ani le Nkai neiteleiki osikiria, nerrinyu ayau enkanasa pee eishiraki nenukaa.

English: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yoab inchere eirragieki olarrabal aarare ninye te dukuya o te siadi, negelu ninye embata oo ltung'ana gelunot le Israel, neitobiraki ninche metaarare Isiria;

English: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
