English: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
Masaai: Ejo Lkigerot, ti alo Abraham, ilo tung'ani oiruko, “Ti atua iyie emayiani Loreren pooki;” naa te lelo rorei etolikioki apa ninye eton etiooyo kulo Omon Supati. Enkata eitodoluaki nayooki Enkai aikenaki Loreren isipat te nkaraki enkirukoto enye.

English: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha nepuo kenya aajo te ina olong, ‘Ng'ura, ena nataase te kuldo laa ninche apa kisiliga, naa ninche kisikakitia aaing'oru, eretoto pee ekordu iyiook aitung'uaa ilo aiguanani le Asiria! Naa amaa, iyiook, kaji kinko pee kiimisho?’ ”

English: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
Masaai: Etii nkonyek o Laitoriani shumata eng'eno, kake kenang'aa ninye lelo rorei le lelo le meeta enkirukoto.

English: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
Masaai: kake tenetujurruoki ilo pepedoi too nkonyek enyena, netubulakitia ilpapit oorook neishiuo ilo pepedoi, meeta ninye entioto, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo meiduruk ninye.

English: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
Masaai: Iyagie naa, enkerai e tung'ani; iyagie oltau omu eeta osina to ltau le mion te dukuya nkonyek enye.

English: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.
Masaai: Nelo Enkiyang'et e Nkai aing'uaa Saul, nelotu enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Olaitoriani aitanyamal aisomit ninye.

English: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
Masaai: “Entoning ele rorei, ntae nkishu e Bashan, naatii oldoinyo le Samaria, nena naaibooki olaisinani enkop neitorogony olomena nena naajoki ilpayiani lenye, ‘Eyau pee kitum atook!’

English: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa keaku keetae enkoitoi kitok naing'uaa Asiria, te nkaraki ilo pisiai otelekuaki loo ltung'ana lenyena, ina kata apa pee epuonu ninche eing'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
Masaai: Neaku eilejileja Daudi iltung'ana lenyena te kulo rorei, neitu eisho ninche metarasaki Saul. Nedumunye Saul neing'uaa enkapune, nelo te nkoitoi enye.

English: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
Masaai: Ore tialo iloshon le Israel, ore too le Ruben, naa Eliesa olayioni le Sikri ninye olkitok; ore too le Simeon, naa Shefatia olayioni le Maaka;

English: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
Masaai: kake too sipat ninye eiguanare laisinak, neikok ninye te mborron lelo oobor ootii enkop; naa kear ninye enkop te ng'udi e nkutuk enye, near ilo arruoni metua te nkiyang'et e nkutuk enye.

English: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata ake, ejo maing'orisho neitu eitoki aadol likae otii te nebo ninche. Yesu ake openy.

English: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eaku ketii dukuya Olaitoriani anaake; nchoo eiwuang'ieki endamunoto enye te nkop!

English: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
Masaai: Ninye eitu ening iloo papa, neaku etaaraitie aarishie ate, nerrinyo ltauja lenye aaito Misiri,

English: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
Masaai: Embesen ai naitukuoreki Moab; shumata Edom nanu aiteleiki nkejek aainei; te Filistia nanu abuaku te nkisulata.”

English: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
Masaai: Kake nchoo enkaina ino elotu shumata ilo le nkaina ino e tatene, ina kerai e tung'ani nintagolo iyie te nkaraki kewan ino!

English: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu, nebuak, nebatata te dukuya ninye, nejo to ltoilo sapuk, “Kainyoo aatayie nanu iyie Yesu, Oinoti le Nkai Natii Shumata Aisul te pooki? Aatasayia mikisilisil.”

English: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
Masaai: Naa ias iyie anaa ina nataasa; minuk iyie enkutuk ino, arashu inos endaa e lelo ooishir.

English: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
Masaai: “Etua enkitoo ino, iyie Israel, etasesekuanaki te shumata iwuejitin inono neeika! Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil!

English: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana pooki Samuel, “Toomonoki isinkan linono to Laitoriani Enkai ino, pee mikiye iyiook; amu kinkilikuanakita ate ing'ok o ena suujisho amu kitopona iyiook ing'ok ang tena torroni, kinkilikuanakita ate olaiguanani.”

English: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
Masaai: Tonyuaa tasioku eton eng'or enkata e nkirobi. Kirriwaki Eibulo enkirorokino naa neijia etiu Punten o Lino o Klaudia o lalashera pooki.

English: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
Masaai: Netinyikua Pasaka oo Lyahudi, neilep ilkumok aapuo Yerusalem eing'uaa ina kop eton eitu ebau Pasaka, pee epuo aaipok ate.

English: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
Masaai: Neing'urung'ura ilooiteng'eni maate amu meyiolo aajo kalo eimaki.

English: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
Masaai: Ti atua ninye kiaata iyiook enkordunoto te nkaraki osarge lenye, aa empalakinoto oo ntorrok ang, te risioroto e mpiris enye,

English: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shekania naa Shemaia. Ore ilayiok le Shemaia naa Hatush, o Lgal, o Baria, o Neris o Shafat, kulo pokira ile.

English: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
Masaai: Iroroki Priska o Akuila o enkaji e Onesiforos.

English: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
Masaai: Neirragie Yoshua isoito tomon o are aitobiraki te mpolos e Yordan, te ine wueji apa neitasheyie nkejek e lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua; netii ninche ine ebaiki ena olong.

English: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
Masaai: Neiguenare ninche iltung'ana nkatitin pooki; ore ilomon oogol neyaki ninche Musa, kake ore embae pooki kiti nedung oopeny.

English: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye Barnaba o Saulo eing'uaa Yerusalem, eidipa esiaai enye, neriku Yohana oji Marko.

English: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
Masaai: kake nepuo neitirrishaki enyamali oo masaa o esikar e na kishon nemeitabaya aaiu ilng'anayio.

English: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
Masaai: neitashe sii ilng'atunyo tomon oare teine, netii ake obo enkalo nabo e nkedet. Eitu aekata etumi embae nanyaanyukie ena te nkitoria ake ninye pooki.

English: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
Masaai: Ninye olo ashet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai. Keaku ninye enkerai ai naaku nanu menye lenye, naa kaitasheyie nanu olorika lenye le nkitoo tiatua Israel ntarasi.’

English: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
Masaai: Ore pooki naibung enkaina ino aas, taasa ninye te ngolon ino pooki; amu metii esiaai anaa endamunoto, anaa eng'eno anaa eng'eno nagut atua enemeneng'a naa ninye ilo.

English: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
Masaai: Ilepa iyie alo shumata oleng, nirik lelo yarunot araya, ning'amaa nkishorot too ltung'ana, ning'amaa sii ine lelo torrok, pee etum Olaitoriani Enkai atobiko te ine.

English: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Ng'ura, aaishoo iyie pooki aitubului naiu ilanterera natii oriong enkop, o pooki shani oota ilanterera too ilng'anayio lenyena intaa endaa.

English: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilo aitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo, o laitasheikinoni le nkanasa, tenebo ilpayiani, o laing'urak, neirriwaki Yehu olkilikuai ejo, “Kira iyiook isinkan linono, naa eikiaas pooki nintanap iyiook. Mikintaa iyiook likae tung'ani, olaiguanani; taasa enaba anaa enidol aa sidai too nkonyek inono.”

English: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
Masaai: Nemayian ninye ejo; “Metamayiana Enkai natii shumata aisul Abram, ilo oitobira shumata o enkop.

English: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie pooki toki natonie ninye neituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neton eiduruk ometaa teipa;

English: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
Masaai: Amu ore nkaitin pooki oo loreren naa nkitanyaanyukot; kake Olaitoriani oitobira keper.

English: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
Masaai: Ore lelo apaitin linyi ng'ejuko o lelo siruai linyi oogeluno, keiba oltau lai; netaa ninche olola te nanu, atanaure anapita ninche.

English: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
Masaai: “Maape iyiook aaitayunye Yuda olarrabal, nikinture ninye, nikisulie iyiook aaya, nikipik iyiook olayioni le Tabel metaa olaiguanani ti atua ninye,”

English: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
Masaai: nejo olaiguanani, “Aimekitok ena Babilon natesheta nanu te ngolon ai kitok metaa enkaji e nkitoo nairragie o te nkitoo e nkitoria ai.”

English: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
Masaai: “Ng'ura airragie nanu ena olong te dukuya iyie puaan o mbaa sidain, keeya o entorroni.

English: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
Masaai: Neitoki aaku ilkeek le enkima, neya oltung'ani embata nelo aij, neinok ninye ina kima nepej emukate, neitoki sii aitobiru enkai te ilo shata neserem ninye. Neitobiru ninye enkitanyaanyukoto enkai neserem ninye, neitobiru ninye enkitanyaanyukoto e nkainagueta nebatata te dukuya ninye.

English: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye te risioroto e nkikena oo lewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip imiet.

English: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
Masaai: Amu kelo Olaitoriani ashet Sion, neliooyu ninye te nkitoo enye;

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Masaai: Enyaaka ake sii ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii nanu ejo,

English: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
Masaai: Esipa ore enkitorogonyata neitomod oltung'ani ng'en, naa keinyal eropare oltung'ani e ndamunoto.

English: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
Masaai: nerikino ajo eidim enkeju atadanya ninche, ore ng'uesi entim neitunyoo ninche.

English: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana, lelo arikok le Gilead, nejokino maate, “Kalo tung'ani oiteru aarare ile Amon? Ninye oaku olkitok te lelo pooki oomanya Gilead.”

English: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Mahalel ilarin ntomoni ile o imiet, neaku menye le Yared.

English: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
Masaai: Neya lelo tung'ana le Gilead ilang'at e Yordan pee earare ile Efraim. Naa ore ake pee ejo oltung'ani le lelo apa ootimiraki le Efraim, “Ntasho nanu matalang'a alo,” nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Gilead, “Eira iyie ole Efraim?” Ore ake pee ejo ninye, “A-a,”

English: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
Masaai: Kake etawalikia ninye nejoki, “Ee itisipa lo kitok; kake ore sii ninche ndiein naalutoo emisa nesotu rrarrat ooitadoyio nkera.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo:

English: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
Masaai: ore naa ilo iyie aisiaai lelo mang'ati linono likirriwaki Olaitoriani mikietu aar, te sumash o te nkure, te masipaisho o te yieunoto oo ntokitin pooki; naa kepik ninye enapet e sekenkei emurt ino ometaba anaa nikindaikie ninye.

English: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
Masaai: Elimu endarata elotunoto enye, Ilo oata olom o engoro eiba entorroni.

English: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
Masaai: Neraposhu Lot inkonyek enyena, nedol ajo ore oyerata le Yordan keeta inkariak te pooki wueji, anaa enkurma o Laitoriani, anaa enkop e Misiri te nkalo e Soar, ina kata eton eitu eidaikie Olaitoriani Sodom o Gomorra.

English: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Tahat nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Tera.

English: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
Masaai: nincho ninche ena kop, apa ninosie iyie olmumai tenebo loo menye pee incho ninche, enkop naruko inaishi o kule;

English: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
Masaai: Ore ake te nkolong nintayu, nipolos oloing'oni pee eaku olasar loo ng'ok lo lning'o lo sotua. Nintayu sii olasar loo ng'ok te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, ti nintayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye, nibukoki ninye eilata, aitisiny.

English: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oiwuang'ie olpolosie leilo le latia enye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
Masaai: nena kilani naaripuno aaitobiruno te nkaraki enkisiaayiare te wueji sinyati, lelo kilani oosinya le Aron ilo apolosani, o lelo kilani loo layiok lenyena, te nkisiayiare enye anaa ilapolosak.

English: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
Masaai: Aatamana aamuat nanu iloreren pooki; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!

English: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
Masaai: o enkiroishi e sahabu tenkaraki imasaa e sahabu te pooki kisiaayiare, o enkiroishi oo masaa e nkosholai te pooki kisiayiare.

English: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
Masaai: Neliki Yesu ninche enkitanyaanyukoto; eitodol inchere eishiaakino ake neomon anaa ake nemenauru.

English: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Enkai, “Aime nanu doi oitanapishe meikeni olorere? Nanu otaasa eng'oki naas ena bae torrono. Kake amaa kuna kerra, kaa ninche etaasa? Nchoo naa enkaina ino Olaitoriani aatoomono, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, maatara nanu o enkaji e papaai lai; kake mincho olmeitai elotu shumata iltung'ana linono.”

English: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
Masaai: Kake etejo Sion, “Aaiturrayie nanu Olaitoriani, meekure aadamu Olaitoriani lai.”

English: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
Masaai: Neaku eishorua sii Olaitoriani Enkai ang apik atua enkaina ang Oog, ilo aiguanani le Bashan, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, nikiosh iyiook ninye o metaba anaa neaku meeta ninye olaishirani otelekakaki ninye.

English: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani likiindim ashomo airisha; kelo Olaitoriani opik enkuretisho te nkaraki intae o loputukunyi te nkaraki intae shumata ina kop pooki niimiimi, anaa enaisiligie ninye intae.

English: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Farao olkilikuai meipoti Yosef, neyauni ninye aaitasieku aaitung'uaa korokoroni ore peyie eidip atabarnoyu neibelekeny sii inkilani enyena nelotu atua aitashe te dukuya Farao.

English: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
Masaai: Emanimanaa ninche meishopo, meeta nkilani neisumash enap irridat le nkano.

English: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
Masaai: Kaigil nanu ayau oloisulie shumata intae, iloomanya Maresha; ore enkitoo oo Siraeli nelotu Adulam.

English: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
Masaai: Eitaa ninye iloreren kituaak, neitoki aidakie ninche, eitasapuk iloreren, nerikoo aiwuang'ie.

English: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
Masaai: Neitanapisho meibatisai te nkarna e Yesu Kristo Nesai ninche ninye metobiko nkuti olong'i.

English: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
Masaai: nabo te nkaraki olasar le ngoki o enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori tenebo olasar le ntapa, neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te dukuya Olaitoriani tenkaraki ilo oitukui.

English: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
Masaai: Metaa eitayio Olaitoriani Enkai ninye te nkurma e Eden peyie epuo aatur enkop apa naitobirunyeki ninche.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo, “Metaa mikingil likae anyayie lng'anayio ntarasi.” Nening ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
Masaai: Emisukenya maate ilalashera laainei, amu ore ilo osukeny olalashe lenye anaa eiguanare olalashe lenye, inkitanapat esukeny, aa ninche eiguanare. Amu te ninguanare inkitanapat, nimira naa olaibung'ani loo nkitanapat, kake itaa oloiguanare.

English: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
Masaai: Eminchosho eaku enkuso inyi enioriong osesen, o enchetata oo lpapit, o enkikodo oo ntokitin e sahabu anaa ene nkishopoto o nkilani,

English: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
Masaai: Tadamu ajo kintobirua apa nanu te nterit, naa aikintoki aigil arrinyoki nanu enterit?

English: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
Masaai: Kake te nkaraki ena ore ti atua nanu ara oloituruk naibalunye Yesu Kristo o eng'iriata enye nalulung'a, pee aaku enkitanyaanyukoto te lelo ooyooki aairuk ninye, netum enkishui nemeiting.

English: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena eitu eibelekenya nkoitoi e Yeroboam torrok, kake enyaaka aitayu ilapolosak too wuejitin e shumata tiatua olorere pooki; te pooki ooyieu, neitisiny metaa ilapolosak too wuejitin e shumata.

English: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
Masaai: neiborrie ninye onyek te lelo sanchan lenyena ooba irubat oo seseni lenye anaa inoo sirkon neeta esingate oo lamuyeishi loo mbartan. oonyaanyukie isirkon, neikununo eneing'uaa anaa enetiu eneing'uaa mbartan.

English: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
Masaai: Neaku nelakuni lelo malaika pokira oong'uan apa ooibooki aaitaanyu ina saa, o ina olong, o ilo apa, oilo ari, pee ear ematua e uni o ltung'ana.

English: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
Masaai: Ina kitanapata kewan naji apa aayaki enkishui nataa keeya te nanu.

English: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.
Masaai: lelo ooibelekenyate ootapala esujata o Laitoriani, lelo lemeing'oru Olaitoriani anaa eikilikuanishore ninye.”

English: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
Masaai: Kaiafas olapa otiaaka Lyahudi nchere keishiaakino naa oltung'ani obo onang olorere.

English: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
Masaai: Ing'ura, etijing'a enkikirikirata kitok enkop, amu etadowuo olmalaika lo Laitoriani oing'uaa shumata, nelotu neibeleleng'oo osoit netonie enchumata.

English: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Koree enkirukoto inyi?” Neureishoyu, neing'asia, nejokino maate, “Kaing'ae taa ele laa keitore osiwuo o enkare, nening?”

English: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
Masaai: Ore peyie aing'or nena ng'uesi naaishu, nadol enkeju e ng'arri te nkoriong enkop te mbata e nena ng'uesi naaishu, meeta ake eng'ues nemeitoriokino enkeju nabo te pokira ong'uan.

English: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
Masaai: nejia naa elo atiu olaiguanani le Asiria erikoo lelo le Misiri ootarayioki o le Etiopia epuo eyararoto. Ore ndung'ot pokira ilooti o lkituaak nepuo meishopo nemeeta namuka. Nemeeta toki too ltuli neaku enkurruna e Misiri.

English: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
Masaai: Olosho kitok naa kumok naa adoru anaa iltung'ana le Anaki; neishooki sii ninche enkarna anaa ile Anak naji Refaim, kake keipot iltung'ana le Moab ninche aajo Emim.

English: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
Masaai: neishooyo ninye ninche apik nkaik oo loreren, pee etum ilapa ooiba ninche aaitoria ninche.

English: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee itapalari lo tau lai, naa kainyoo iyie pee itanyamala ti atua nanu? Isiliga Enkai, amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.

English: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
Masaai: kake keaku eninyi ena kop oo ldoinyo, ore hoo naa entim, isiajayieyie intae niyaya ninye aaitabaiki ilpolosien lenyena oolakua; amu iyookiki intae aaraa aaipang'ie lelo Kanaani, hoo neeta ninche ngarrin oo mbartan oo sekenke, hoo naa kegol.”

English: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
Masaai: Eneneng mbartan enye aalang ilowuarak kerin, nepi aalang isuyian le nteipa; ore lakedok lenye loo mbartan nenyok oleng to lwuasa. Ee enelakua eing'uaa lakedok lenye loo mbartan, nepuo tiai anaa olkurragos oipirri alo ainos eng'ues.

English: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
Masaai: “Ore enkanashe enye Oholiba netoduaa ena naa torrono apa ninye oleng alang ninye te nkiborra oo nkonyek, naa torrrono apa ninye alang enkanashe enye.

English: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
Masaai: naa keitoip oriong e nkop, metaa metii hoo ng'ae oidim atoduaa enkop; nenya ina nikitelekakaki te nchan oo soito, naa kenya pooki shani lino onyori obulu ti ong'ata,

English: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
Masaai: Neaku eiturrurrote apa iltung'ana le Israel aaipirakinore ina anasa etaa oltung'ani obo.

English: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
Masaai: Amaa nanu, ke iltung'ana aing'unyung'unyaki? Ainyoo peyie maidim ating'iria?

English: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
Masaai: Ore olng'aboli neitayio ilng'abolo, ore osabibu neitapuka eitayu olng'usil orropil. Inyo, enyorrata ai, enaikishiaan ai wou tupuku.

English: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
Masaai: Naa eikintaa iyie Olaitoriani endukuya, mme olkidong'oe, naa eilepu ake alotu shumata, nimidoyio; tenimbung nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong, ing'ura pee ias ninche,

English: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
Masaai: “Tinining'ining'i intae oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, niasiasa ina sidai too nkonyek enyena, nining'ining'i nkitanapat enyena nimbung'ubung'u pooki, nemapik hoo nabo oo nkeyaitin ntae apa natipika Ilmisiri; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oishiunye intae.”

English: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo, to lapa li okuni, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
Masaai: neiteng'eni sii isiankikin metonyorra Lmoruak lenye o nkera enye,

English: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
Masaai: Neaku lalashera laainei, enosai olkilikuai le Nkai te nkisosion, naa emimit enkiroroto oo lng'ejepa,

English: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu oltung'ani oeniki osoit enkopito, neija etiu ilo oisho olmodai enkanyit.

English: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaitopiu Papa ilootuata neisho ninche enkishui neijia sii ninye etiu Enkerai enye eisho enkishui, oloyieu neisho.

English: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
Masaai: nchere kepuo ake ntoyie e Israel to lari aaishiraki entito e Yepta ilo le Gilead nkolong'i ong'uan to lari.

English: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
Masaai: Eterewa sii inkishu enye o masaa enye, naanoto te nkop e Kanaan, nepuonu enkop e Misiri, Yakobo o eishoi enye pooki,

English: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
Masaai: Etareto apa ninche Daudi tialo olturrur loo lapurrok, amu iltung'ana apa oopi ninche naa magil, naa ilarikok le njore.

English: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
Masaai: Ore te nedumunye iltorrok, neisudoo iltung'ana ate, kake te neidaaya neponari iltung'ana supati.

English: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ore anaa olng'atuny olotu te ntim e Yordan ajing'aki eluaata oo ntare, kaluam nanu ninche mekueta aaing'uaa Babilon; nagelu nanu meitoria ninye oloba anaa olagelu. Amu kaing'ae laanyaanyukie nanu? Kaing'ae laakesh nanu? Kalo shekut loo ntare oidim aitasho te dukuya nanu?

English: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
Masaai: nalo adaa te nebo ninye, nedaa sii ninye te nebo nanu. Ore ilo omirisho naa kaisho ninye metotona te nebo nanu to lorika lai le nkitoo anaa apa enatimirishe nanu, naton te nebo Papa lai to lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
Masaai: kake te neme neijia, nchoo enkima epuku te Abimelek, nemut lelo oomanya Shekem o Bet-milo nemut Abimelek.”

English: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Lod, o Hadid, o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o imiet.

English: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Naa keaku ena enkitanapata oo ntarasi te intae; nchere keidimi aitobiraki iltung'ana le Israel olning'o lo sotua kata nabo to lari te nkaraki ing'ok enye pooki.” Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
Masaai: o Baalat, o Tamar tiong'ota, tiatua enkop e Yuda,

English: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
Masaai: metii isinkan lenye lewa o sinkan enye ng'oruo, nera apa ninche nkalifuni naapishana o iip uni o ntomoni ile o opishana; neeta apa ninche ilaranyak iip are o artam o imiet, ilewa o ng'oruo.

English: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
Masaai: Amaa ake sii, aijo ke nkaraki nemetii Olaitoriani pee aewuo nanu agilunore ena kop naidaikie ninye? Aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, shomo tigilunore ene wueji, nindaikie.’ ”

English: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
Masaai: Eetae sii apa lelo oojo, “Kiteena te sile nkurman ang, o nkurman ang oo sabibu o nkajijik ang, pee kitum entapa te nkaraki olameyu.”

English: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
Masaai: Entoomon Olaitoriani, amu eidipa iyiook ena kikurrukur o ena shan oo soito; ekaisho ntae enchom, nimintokiki aabik.”

English: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ainyoo idolita?” iyie. Najo nanu, “Adolita naa ng'ura, enkitashet oltaa naitobiruno pooki te sahabu, neeta olbakuli otii shumata ninye, o ltaai oopishana te nchumata ninye, o ltampii oopishana otii lelo taai otii shumata e ina kitashet.

English: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, ‘Te nemening Musa o loibonok le Nkai, nemening sii ninye oloing'uaa lootuata.’ ”

English: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Shimei naa Shelomot, o Hasiel, o Haran, lelo pokira okuni. Kulo apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too le Ladan.

English: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Usia etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye tenebo loo menye te wueji oo nkuraren oo laiguanak, amu etejo ninche, “Ole nkeeya oo lbolot ninye.” Neitoreisho Yotam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
Masaai: Ore entoki naba anaa enalo te nkoshoke enye aashu pooki nalo too nkejek ong'uan aashu pooki toki naata nkejek kumok, nena tokitin pooki naaikurtutari ti oriong enkop, eminya ake, amu olminong ninche.

English: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together.
Masaai: Minchop iyie enkila nashula ilpapit oopuyiapui o kitani.

English: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku eishoo Akish ninye ina olong Siklag; metaa etaa Siklag enoo laiguanak le Yuda o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.
Masaai: Ore ake sii ilo perere lo lasar apa otii Betel, ine wueji neika apa natesheta Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, laa ninye otorikoko Isiraeli metaasa eng'oki, ore ilo perere lo lasar tenebo ewueji neika nesulu auroo nebel aitaa mbelibelat isoito lenyena, nerrar aitaa enterit; neitoki sii apejoo Ashera.

English: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Delila Samson, “Tolikioki sii ake enetii ena golon ino kitok, naa kaji naaji kinkoni ti nikieni, pee kitum oltung'ani atigilu.”

English: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
Masaai: Naa te naa ilalashera linyi ake irorokiki, kaa yasata naa italang'ie ilkulikae? Ai meiko oshi neijia ilkulikae oreren?

English: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee intashe alamari, iyie Olaitoriani? Kainyoo iyie pee isudoo kewan too nkatitin oo ng'olikinot.

English: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
Masaai: “Nanu Yesu laairriwaka iyie olmalaika lai meeu enitii, ayau ena shakenisho enkaraki sirito, nanu entonai e ishoi e Daudi, olakira owang le Nkakenya.”

English: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
Masaai: Ore apa nena yarunot naatelekutua naawaita lelo tung'ana le njore naa nkerra nkalifuni iip ile o ntomoni naapishana o imiet,

English: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
Masaai: naaimisie enkare endukuya ai; najo, ‘Aimina nanu.’

English: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
Masaai: Ore pee egira ilo toilo, nedoli Yesu aa ninye ake. Negira ninche, eitu eliki ltung'ana te nena olong'i inaatoduaa.

English: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini olaiguanani Solomon, nchere, “Eisika Yoab alo atua olng'obor lo Laitoriani, naa ng'ura, etii ninye embata olperere lo lasar.” Neirriwaa Solomon Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, ejo, “Shomo toosho ninye tanang'ie enkop.”

English: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
Masaai: Kinchoo iyie nanu elong'o e njeunoto ino, naaitaa nanu eretoto ino kitok.

English: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: “Natum taa atinyikaki intae te nkiguana, aaku olchakeni osieku agilunore ilkuyandik, nagilunore iloololoito, nagilunore lelo oonya ilmuma le lejare, nagilunore lelo ooitorogonyisho too laakinot enye, tenebo inkolia o nkera okishin, nagilunore lelo ooinyal ilomon nemaaure ninche nanu; ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
Masaai: Eitaa Olaitoriani nkiguanat oo loshon pesho; neitukurru ninye nkitobirat oo loreren.

English: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
Masaai: o Seraia olayioni le Hilkia, olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Sadok, olayioni le Merairiot, olayioni le Ahitab, olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e Nkai,

English: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
Masaai: Aisinanuo te nkaraki iye olalashe lai Yonatan; eikishipakino apa iyie nanu oleng; ore apa enyorrata ino te nanu naa enking'asia, kegiroo enyorrata oo nkituaak.

English: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
Masaai: “Metaa tiaaki enkaji e Israel, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Erridutu nimbelekenyunyenye aaing'uaa nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu; nimbelekenyunyu inkomomi inyi to lminong linyi pooki.

English: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eisero ninche nikigolong'aki iyie, nenang'aa nkitanapat inono aainyaaya oriong, near iloibonok linono metuata. laa ninche apa ooikoo ejo pee errinyu ninche enitii, neas ninche mbaa sapuki e morore.

English: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
Masaai: o Yohanan aa ninye olayioni le isiet, o Elasabad aa ninye olioudo,

English: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata eigil ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aipang'aki Manoa o enkitok enye. Neyiolou apa Manoa nchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye.

English: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
Masaai: Neton ake eitu eibelekenya Olaitoriani teina goro enye napi, naa te ninye apa eyupuyupo egoro o Laitoriani tialo Yuda te nkaraki nena pooki naaitagorie Manase ninye.

English: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
Masaai: Egogong engoro napi, ore engoro nemutisho, kake aing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya olom.

English: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
Masaai: Neaku eibulayie ina kitanapata nchere ore lelo tung'ana ang'eni naa keari metuata, neing'oru ninche Daniel o lelo le ncholiek enye, pee ear ninche metuata.

English: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
Masaai: Neeta apa mefiboshet olayioni oti oji enkarna Mika. Ore pooki ootobiko te nkaji e Siba neaku isinkan le Mefiboshet.

English: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
Masaai: Amu iatata ilaisinak anaa ake kake mikiatata nanu anaa ake.

English: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Ruben; ore esiana enye naa nkalifuni artam o okuni o iip naapishana o tomoni uni.

English: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
Masaai: Amu ewaita ninche embata oo ntoyie enye aayamaki ate o layiok lenye, metaa etushulare ilo osho osinya iltung'ana loo loreren. Ore te nkaraki ena nemeisiligayu ninche, eituruk lelo kituaak o laiguanak eitarruoitie.”

English: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “A-a; eikien ake iyiook iyie nikinchooyo iyie aapik atua nkaik enye; mikiaar iyiook iyie tua.” Neen ninche ninye too lgoso ng'ejuko oare, neyau aailepunye te ndapidapoi.

English: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?
Masaai: Neirriwaa iloshon le Israel iltung'ana meshomo atua olosho pooki le Benchamen, ejo, “Kaa torroni ena nataase ti atua intae?

English: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
Masaai: nijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaarare iyie oldoinyo le Seir, naa kaaitorioki enkaina ai aarare iyie, naa kaaidapash iyie naaidaikie naitaa ene pesho.

English: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.
Masaai: Nejoki apa iltung'ana le nkanasa Elisha, “Ng'ura, eisidai ena anasa, anaa enadolita olkitok lai; kake eitorrono enkare, nemeisho enkop.”

English: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
Masaai: “Ainyoo eutu ena ningil ena dung'et e rashe te nkop e Israel, ‘Einosa iloopapa isabibu ooisuijo, ore ilala loo nkera nenoto enkisuijo?’

English: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
Masaai: Mbelekenya nkonyek aainei pee meing'or mbaa e pesho, nikincho nanu enkishui too nkoitoi inono.

English: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
Masaai: Te nedol intae oltung'ani oshal, intae taa lelo ng'eni, itonini aadaa te mesa e nkaji nasayieki enkitanyaanyukoto, ijo meitagol ina oltau, te ina shalan enye, nelo ninye anya endaa natopolosakaki nena kitanyaanyukot?

English: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten before Israel.
Masaai: Ore eitayu Samuel olasar opejori, nenyiku Ilfilisti pee ear Israel: kake etadara Olaitoriani to ltoilo sapuk adaraki Ilfilisti nenang'aki ninche atua olmilo; neilanyisho aaisik te dukuya Israel.

English: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
Masaai: ore teina kikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuishieki natii dukuya Olaitoriani neitayu ninye emukate nabo neitu eisuishieki, ore emukate nabo tenebo eilata, o enkaukau nabo neitatashaki ninche ina ilata oina muro e tatene;

English: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
Masaai: Neipotisho aaikilikuanu te naa ketii Simon oji Petero ina aji.

English: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel airriwaki olkilikuai olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki, “Etiaaka apa olkikuei lo doinyo le Lebanon oltarakuai, ‘nchoru entito ino meyama olayioni lai.’ Nelotu eng'ues entim e Lebanon aim ine neituny ilo kikuei.

English: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
Masaai: Neitayu Eliya olkila lenye nenunuk, neoshie enkare, neoro enkare neito ena shoto o enda shoto. Neim ninche pokira oare ine etaa enkop natoyio.

English: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa peyie eitu iyie imbung olmumai to Laitoriani oina kitanapata naaitanapa nanu iyie?”

English: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
Masaai: Yesu eimakita lkigerot pee ejo, ‘Ilo soit litemenaitie intae ilashetak otaa osoit kitok lo lmairroto.’

English: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
Masaai: iltung'ana laaitagor ninche oas mbususi anaake te dukuya nkonyek aainei, epolosisho ti atua nkurman neinok enkorropil te shumata isoito;

English: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:
Masaai: Ekaitasheyie osotua lai tenebo iyie, naa iyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani,

English: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani oton to lorika le nkiguana, negel asilu ntorrok pooki te nedol too nkonyek.

English: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
Masaai: “Ore kenya te nena olong'i o teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, ore iltung'ana le Israel o ltung'ana le Yuda, nepuonu tenebo, neishir ninche epuonu neing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa olaputani lenye, “Enkaraki napuonu iltung'ana enatii aaikilikuan mbaa e Nkai;

English: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
Masaai: Amu kaidim nanu atiaaki intae nchere eishorutua naairirikino nena naata neitoki aaitogiroo ine. Ore te yieunoto enye maate,

English: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
Masaai: Tenebo enkitani sidai naikodo naing'uaa Misiri, naa ninye apa olkarasha oreu emeli, naa ninye naitashe anaa enanka ino; enkarasha pus o emorijoi naing'uaa olomanaa le naiposha e Elisha, naa ninye apa enchuret ino.

English: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu ajo ore te siadi keeya ai meeta nchere miasiasa entorroni, nimbelekenyanya aapaash ina oitoi apa naitanapa nanu intae; naa ore too nkolong'i naapuonu nejing intae entorroni, enkaraki naa eiyookiki intae aas entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani, aaitagor ninye tialo esiai oo nkaik inyi.”

English: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
Masaai: Neitaarriyian ake sii ilo liare o ilo liokuni o lelo pooki ooreuta nena masaa ejoki, “Entiaaki Esau ina bae tininang'arere, ninye.

English: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
Masaai: Ore pee eipung lelo, ng'ura, neyakini ninye oltung'ani lemeiro otijing'a oloirirua.

English: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
Masaai: “Ti ninang'arere enkiteng arashu osikiria lo lmanga'tinta lino eimina tushukoki ninye.

English: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
Masaai: Amu eeta apa ninye enkitoria te nkop pooki o loo ntoluo to lkeju le Frati ebaiki Tipsa ometabaiki Gasa, te shumata ilaiguanak pooki le Frati; neeta ninye eseriani too nchot pooki naamanita ninye.

English: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
Masaai: Oi naaji aa kaata to lpurkel ewueji neirragari pee atum nanu atung'uai iltung'ana laainei nalo enelakua aing'uaa ninche! amu ile loloito ninche pooki, olturrur loo ltung'ana le nkaldoroto

English: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
Masaai: neiu Hesron Raam, Neiu Raam Aminadab,

English: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
Masaai: Neiutuutisho nkituaak are to soit neyai nabo neing'uari enkae.

English: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
Masaai: “Oo pee eitu emiri ena ilata narropil aainosie dinarii iip uni neishori laisinak.”

English: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Yoram ailanyisho, ejoki Ahasia “Olosek Ahasia!”

English: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
Masaai: pee eigeri te nebo enkitok enye, Mariamu, natasayia aa entuaa.

English: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn e kulikae ayiok le Lawi: ore too layiok le Amram naa, Shubael; ore too layiok le Shubael, naa Yehedia.

English: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
Masaai: Nejoki Samson ninche, “Kaisho nanu intae oloyiote, naa ti nikindimidimi aatoliki nanu eneikununo, ti atua kuna olong'i naapishana o sirua, niyiolouu aajo kainyoo, naisho nanu intae nkilani tomoni uni e kitani o kulie kilani tomoni uni sidain;

English: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
Masaai: olukunku, o loro, olaiguanani ele te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee eishooki metotiwuo anaa lalashera lenyena too mpukunot pooki, pee etum ataa olapolosani oata olng'ur neisiligayu te siaai e Enkai, netum aitayu enkitukuoroto oo ng'ok oo ltung'ana.

English: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
Masaai: Etii enkoitoi nalioo to ltung'ani aa sidai, kake ore enkiting'oto enye naa keeya.

English: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
Masaai: Mintayuyu nkaitin e nkosholai pee eaku te nebo nanu, nimintaikiki sii ate nkaitin e sahabu.

English: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Samaria, near metua lelo pooki apa ootelekutua lo lmarei le Ahab ootii Samaria, ometaba anaa neishu pooki, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa otiaka Eliya.

English: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
Masaai: Kake itanyaita intae Ilo Sinyati naa Supat. Niomonunu olarani meishori intae.

English: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
Masaai: Te neitaaki Enkai kitok ti atua ninye, keitaa sii ninye Enkai ninye kitok ti atua kewan, naa taata inji eitaa ninye kitok.

English: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Daudi aikilikuanishore Olaitoriani. Newaliki Olaitoriani ninye ajo, “Tudumunye, tadoi shomo Keila; amu kaishoru nanu Ilfilisti apik atua nkaik inono.”

English: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
Masaai: nejo ninye, ‘Taraposhu inkonyek inono ing'orisho, ore inkineji pooki naaitigiran tiaatua intare naa keeta nkererin, neeta iltipot nerasha; amu atoduaa nena pooki nikintaasa Laban iyie.

English: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
Masaai: Ore nkonyek e lelo oodol nemeitokini aaiken, ore nkiyiaa e lelo ooning nening.

English: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku etekepari Isiraeli te nkaji e Daudi ometabaiki ena olong.

English: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
Masaai: Ore olasar ong'amaroyu te Nkai naa oltau obor; ore oltau obor neitadou kewan, mimenaa iyie Olaitoriani.

English: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
Masaai: kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, itii shumata ntarasi.

English: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
Masaai: Netaaniki Saul Samuel te kishomi, nejo, “Tolikioki nanu enetii enkaji o laduani.”

English: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Abraham naa Isaak o Ishmael.

English: And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda o sikarini pooki ninche, neisik ninche, nepuo auluo enkanasa te nkewarie aaim enkoitoi o enkurma o laiguanani aaim ina kishomi natii erishata oo sunta pokira are; nepuo ninche aaipir enkalo e Araba.

English: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
Masaai: Amu aaishooki nanu ninche tukul iltung'ana le Israel; te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki le Israel, ore ilkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel aawa nanu makewan ninche.

English: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
Masaai: Ijo pasa, lo tung'ani, te ninguanare lelo ooas nena niaasita sii iyie openy, eijo pasa ilany iyie enkiguana e Nkai?

English: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
Masaai: nesai iloiriruani Yesu aajoki, “Irriwai iyiook maape aajing kuldo bitiro, nchoo iyiook matijing.”

English: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
Masaai: Ataarare olarrabal sidai, aidipa ina kuetata, atagolie enkirukoto.

English: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;
Masaai: Ore ina natoduaa olaiguanani olarriponi, ilo sinyati, edou eing'uaa shumata ejo, ‘Entudung entuuroi olchani ninyalinyala ninye, kake entung'uai enkobei o ntona enyena te nkop, eena te sekenkei o to suyai, too nkujit naanana e ong'ata; naa nchoo erubata enye eaku te nebo ng'uesi e ong'ata, o metaba anaa negiroo ninye nkatitin naapishana;’

English: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye, “A-a, olalashe lai, mikiaraki nanu; amu measi ena te Israel; mias ena torroni emodai.

English: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
Masaai: Nejoki Nebukadnesa ninche, “Kesipa doi, Shadrak o Meshak o Abednego, nchere misiaayiayia intae nkaitin aainei aashu iserememe ina kitanyaanyukoto e sahabu naitasheyie nanu?

English: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
Masaai: Neiturrurri ninche te nebo anaa ilooena te ngumoto; neikenori ninche te korokoroni, ore te siadi nkolong'i kumok neitamei ninche.

English: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
Masaai: Neitu eitoki Ishboshet aidimu atawaliki Abna likae omoni, amu eturia ninye.

English: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
Masaai: Ore sahabu inyi o nkoshola inyi etodoro einosa enkop, ore ina doron e nkinosata e nkop neaku olmonekie te intae naa kenya inkiri oo seseni linyi anaa enkima. Irragie olchumati loo masaa too nkolong'i e nkiting'oto.

English: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
Masaai: nedumunye lelo lewa pooki magil, neya osesen le Saul o loo layiok lenyena neyau ninche Yabesh. Nenukaa ninche iloik lenye tentonata olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli te Yabesh, neen ate aapukoo nkolong'i naapishana.

English: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche. “Ti nilepiepie intae Enkerai e Tung'ani niyiolouu nchere ‘Ara nanu’, nemeeta nanu enaas te nkitoria ai makewan, kake airo kuna baa pooki anaa enaatolikio Papa.

English: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkaraki naponari entorroni neiropiju enyorrata oo lkumok.

English: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ore inaapuku ti atua oltung'ani, ninche naaitarruoo oltung'ani.

English: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yosef ajo eiteleikia menye enkaina e tatene shumata endukuya e Efraim neitu eitiship ninye, nedumu enkaina e menye aitayu aitung'uaa endukuya e Efraim apik ene Manase.

English: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitanana oshoke too laisinak naa Olaitoriani eisilenoko, naa kelaaki olaitoriani ninye enkias enye.

English: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
Masaai: o Babakar, o Heresh, o Galal, o Matamia olayioni le Mika, olayioni le Mikiri, olayioni le Asaf.

English: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Masaai: nepik emukate aitobiraki te nchumata enye te dukuya Olaitoriani; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel's father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife; because he hath humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.
Masaai: ore ilo lee otayiolo ninye neisho menye ina tito shekeli onom e nkosholai, neyam ninye, enkaraki nainyala ninye; meidim ninye ataarai ninye too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye.

English: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
Masaai: amu, ‘Ninye kinchuyie, naa ninye kipuoyie, naa ninye pee kira.’ Anaa enatejo likae aranyani linyi otejo, ‘Kira sii iyiook eishoi enye.’

English: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
Masaai: Ore ng'ututat inono netiu anaa enaisho sidai oo sabibu. Ina nalo adoyio aitobirari, naisotuni te nkutuk neim rishat oo lala.

English: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
Masaai: Amu ore enaipirta enkitanapata ang naa enyorrata naing'uaa oltau owang o ltau sidai lemeeta ileeni, enkirukoto nemetii esunkureisho.

English: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
Masaai: nemerrep enkarrueisho, kake eshipakino esipata;

English: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
Masaai: nebarn ninche ilukuny enye te nkaraki iyie, neen ate too lkuniyiani neishiraki intae oleng te mion sapuk oltau, te nkishirata sapuk e mion.

English: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.
Masaai: Te neishiaakino to laiguanani nchoo meigeri enkitanapata pee emuti ninche, naa kalak nanu ntalantani nkalifuni tomon oo mpisai apik nkaik e lelo ooitasheiki esiaai o laiguanani pee eyau aapik atua masaa o laiguanani.”

English: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
Masaai: Ore imasaa pooki e kuna anas o nkishu neya iltung'ana le Israel aaitaa intokitin naataraitie, kake ore pooki tung'ani nesesekuan ninche te nepi o lalem, o metaba anaa neidaikie ninche tukul, neitu ninye eleku obo eiresa.

English: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
Masaai: neirriwaki ninche ninye olomoni, oigerore kuna baa: “Enetii Darias olaiguanani, eseriani te pooki.

English: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
Masaai: “Entoning lo tung'ana laainei, amu kairo nanu, iyie Israel, kaaishakenoki nanu iyie. Ara nanu enkai, Enkai ino.

English: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
Masaai: Neijia enkuna sii intae iltung'ana leleru entoning enkitoo inyi, Enchopoki ate intae pooki emborron anaa enkila, nintadounyenye ate pee isiaayiayia maate, amu eany Enkai iloowuasa, “Kake eisho empiris ilooitadou ate.”

English: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
Masaai: neaku te netii oltung'ani atua Kristo, netaa enkitayunoto ng'ejuk etulusoyie enapa musana, ng'ura nelotu ng'ejuk.

Masaai: Intajeu lelo ooyae meshomo keeya; imbooi lelo oorrorrokino keeya.

Masaai: Neiger apa Yeremia tiatua embuku ina torroni pooki nalotu shumata Babilon, kulo rorei pooki apa eigeroki ooipirta Babilon.

Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, kemutu te ntae nimintokiki aata nduaat nemisimisu te ntae nimintokiki aata nkitumusumusot. Kedoyio enkolong too loibonok, neman emisimisi ninche;

Masaai: Eibalunye Olaitoriani kewan, etudung'o ninye enkiguana; etijing'a lelo torrok orreshet ti atua esiaai oo nkaik enye maate.

English: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
Masaai: Naa kaisho nanu kulo tungana omom too nkonyek oo Lmisiri, naa ore tenipuopuo, nimipuopuo too nkaik naarook.

Masaai: Nejing enkaji e Nkai neiteru aaraa lelo oomirisho

Masaai: Neipukie Ilmisiri iltung'ana, peyie earaa ninche metupuku aaing'uaa enkop te nkisarrisar amu etejo, “Kituata pooki.”

English: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche nkurruon to lkokuet, neitashe te dukuya Farao, nenang'aa Musa aipirie shumata, neaku iltuduta ooiwotiota aaku mpaldakani torrok te tung'ani o te ng'ues.

English: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
Masaai: Ore edou ninche to ldoinyo neitanap Yesu ajoki, “Emiliki oltung'ani nena nitoduaa metaba anaa nepiu Enkerai e Tung'ani aing'uaa ilootuata.”

English: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana, “Enterretenata te nkolong e uni, nimipuopuo aanyikaki nkituaak.

English: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
Masaai: Atikinyayie nanu nkitarruorot inono anaa enkatampoi, aishie ing'ok inono anaa enkinuku; torrinyunye wou enatii nanu, amu aatokordua nanu iyie.

English: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
Masaai: “Saul o Yonatan oonyorri naa shaati! Ore te nkishui o te keeya merisha ninche; neneneng ninche aalang ilkurragoso, negol ninche aalang ilng'atunyo.

English: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
Masaai: “Minosinoso pooki toki ake ninye naye openy. Indimidimi intae aaishoo oltung'ani omoni ootii atua nkang'itie inyi, pee einos ninche, aashu indimidimi aatimiraki oltung'ani loo loreren; amu intae iltung'ana oosinya to Laitoriani Enkai inyi. “Miyierie olkuoo kule e ng'otonye.

English: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
Masaai: Neun Abraham enchani nanyaanyukie oloilei te Beer-sheba, neipot ninye te ine enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai oo ntarasi.

English: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Masaai: Nepuonu ninche dukuya Eliesa olapolosani o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o larikok, nejo, “Eitanapa apa Olaitoriani Musa pee eisho iyiook enjung'ore te nebo ilalashera lang.” Neaku ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani eishoo ninye ninche enjung'ore te nebo ilalashera le papaai lenye.

English: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, “Ele Kristo.” Nejo kulikae, “Ai Galilaya epukunye Kristo?

English: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
Masaai: Neiko sii ninche neijia ilapolosak kituaak aaikordod ejokino maate, “Kulikae ake eitajewuo; nemeidim aitajeu kewan.

English: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
Masaai: neipid, neitashe too nkejek enyena, neiteru alo amanimanaa. Neitoki airiamariyie ninche ajing atua enkaji e Nkai, eloito neipid neisisita Enkai.

English: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
Masaai: Ninteng'ening'ene ninche nkera inyi, niimakiki ninche itonini too nkajijik inyi o ipuopuo te nkoitoi, o irurara o itonini.

English: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naa ele osiligi lang, eikiro kintieu.

English: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
Masaai: Naa ore amu etareto apa Olaitoriani lelo Lawi oonapita osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, etopolosa ninche iloing'ok oopishana, o ilmeregeshi oopishana.

English: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
Masaai: Iyie eng'uar oltau lai kewarie, ore enkishui ai ti atua nanu naa iyie elilitu. Ore enkata natii nkiguanat inono enkop, neiteng'enuo lelo oomanya enkop te sipata.

English: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
Masaai: Etonyorraitie ninche maate pee eiwuang'ie nena kituaak enye oo loreren, ore apa olasar lenye le nkitarruorroto naa olmeregesh le luaata oo ntare te nkaraki enkitarrurroto enye.

English: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
Masaai: Neton ilo sanduku le Nkai te nkaji e Obed-edom ilapaitin okuni, nemayian Olaitoriani enkaji e Obed-edom o pooki toki naata.

English: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
Masaai: Emintololoiki easata oo supati, o eng'arata oo ntokitin niaatata, amu ore ilasarri laaijo lelo naa keitiship Enkai.

English: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
Masaai: “Kerrip ninye nkejek e lelo ooisiligayu lenyena. Kake keiturrarri lelo arruok tiatua enaimin; amu mme te magilanisho eisulu oltung'ani.

English: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
Masaai: Inchoo enkiteng'ena oltung'ani ng'en, naa keponaa eng'eno oleng, inteng'ena oltung'ani supat naa keponaa eng'eno enye.

English: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
Masaai: “Entoning'oki nanu intae ilooyiolo esipata, kulo tung'ana ootii enkitanapata ai iltauja lenye; emiureyu imorot oo ltung'ana, niming'aeng'ae te neinyal intae nesukeny.

English: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
Masaai: Kinapita anaa ake too seseni lang keeya e Yesu, pee eitoduaari enkishui e Yesu ti atua seseni lang.

English: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
Masaai: Netum Olyahudi obo oji Akuila, laa oinoti le Ponto, naa enalotunye det eing'uaa Italia te nebo enkitok enye Prisila, enkaraki naitanapishe olaiguanani kitok Klaudius meshomo Lyahudi pooki aaing'uaa Roma. Nelo Paulo enetii ninche;

English: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Netum taa shumata o enkop, o pooki natii atua ninche, aatarany te ng'ida tenkaraki Babilon amu kelotu oloidaikie aarare ninche oing'uaa moikuape, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
Masaai: o eneikuna pee aaboloki nkisudorot e yieunoto enye, anaa enaidipa aigeroki intae too ndorropu.

English: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
Masaai: Eewuo olkirutoto o lokirrikir shumata nanu, naaibulua nanu enkiputukuny.

English: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
Masaai: aing'ae oiguanare engolon e ngoro ino, o empushuna ino te risioroto e uriata ino?

English: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
Masaai: Neaku eitajeuo ninye ninche te nkaina o lmang'atinta lenye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa engolon o lmang'atinta.

English: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
Masaai: o layioni le Yahat, olayioni le Gershom, olayioni le Lawi.

English: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

English: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
Masaai: Neirorie taa Yesu nejoki, “Entagoluoto, Nanu doi! Emiureisho.”

English: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. English: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.
Masaai: Ore enkadori eina aji natii enkalo e moikuape naa intemat iip nabo, ore endapasho enye naa intemat onom.

English: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

English: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

English: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
Masaai: Neiter aairoroki aajoki, “Olele Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi!”

English: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
Masaai: Neewuo ninye aliki intae eseriani iloolakua apa neliki eseriani lelo apa ootaana,

Masaai: Amu eyiolo Enkai lelo tung'ana lemeeta tipat; amaa tenedol ninye entorroni, aimeshilaa ninye?

English: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
