English: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
Masaai: Tadamu ilo rorei apa lintanapa osinka lino Musa, ijo, ‘Tenirara intae ilemeisiligayu, nalo nanu aidapash intae tiatua iloreren.

English: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu tung'uai tung'ani laa ore nkumeishin enyena netii enkiyang'et, Amaa kole tipat ninye?

English: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Wootu entodol.” Nepuonu nedol enemanya; nebik o ninye ina olong. Netaa eaku saa tomon ina kata.

English: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
Masaai: Kear ninye to lalem intoyie inyi naatii enkop natoyio; naa kemuat aaman ninche esuntai nagol nikiarare, nashetaki intae oltim aagilunore intae, neitasheyie ilchureta o long'oi aarare intae.

English: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
Masaai: Amu eishooki intae nchere ore te nkaraki ninye,

Masaai: Amaa, kemerregel Enkai esipata? Amaa kemerregel Olmagilani enasipa.

English: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Naa kulo apa ilayiok le Lawi anaa too nkarn enye: Gershon o Kohat o Merari.

English: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

English: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

Masaai: Emayiana ilo osho laa Enkai Olaitoriani lenye, ilo orere otegelua ninye aitaa enjung'ore enye!

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yoshua, “Ore ena olong kaang'as nanu ailepie iyie too nkonyek e Israel pooki, pee etum ninche aatayiolo nchere, ore apa anaa enatii nanu te nebo Musa, kaaku sii te nebo iyie.

English: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
Masaai: neibung ninche olokirrikir te ine, o emion neeijo ene nkitok nasaisai.

English: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
Masaai: Keipok ilkumok ate, neiborrie ate, nesilayu; kake ore lelo arruok neasisho te nkarruisho; nemeetae obo le lelo arruok olo aning'u; kake ore lelo ng'eni naa kepuo aaning'u.

English: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
Masaai: Eng'asunye olwuasa nesuju enkidaaroto, naa neijia etiu oltau oisis kewan eng'asunye nesuju embatatata.

English: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Kainyoo iyie idolita, Yeremia?” najo nanu ilng'abolo, “Ilng'abolo, sidain sidain oleng, o lng'abalo torrok torrok oleng, torrok, oleng lemeinosayu.”

English: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
Masaai: Kebaa esidano e nkaji ino, Olaitoriani loo lororani!

English: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
Masaai: Ele olo aaku olmonekie te intae, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere kaitame nanu intae tene wueji, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere esipa keitashe ororei lai tialo intae te ntorroni:

English: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Meishiaakino neton olee aa ninye ake, ekaitaiki enkaretoni naishaakino ninye.”

English: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
Masaai: Ore ilo oloolo ainosaa olmarenke, neibalie imbaa naaisudoro, metaa mintaa encholiek ilo oiro te modai.

English: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
Masaai: Atadamua nanu nkolong'i e apa, nadamu ilarin liapa moitie.

English: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
Masaai: Neishop ninye ilo kila osinya le kitani, neishop ninye nkilani e atua e kitani to sesen lenye, nerretena te nkimeita e kitani, neishop enkopiyia e kitani, kuna ninche nkilani naasinya. Neituku ninye osesen lenye te nkare paa keishop taa.

English: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
Masaai: Naaboloki ninche nkutukie enye aagilunore; nejo ninche, “Aha, Aha! Etoduaa nkonyek ang!”

English: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
Masaai: nalaaki Olaitoriani olmumai lai te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
Masaai: Ng'ura, epiki ninye enkima metaa eilata enye; ore peyie emut enkima ineeiting'ie enyena pokira, ore empolos enye netumute, keitoki aata tipat tiae toki?

English: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
Masaai: Ore peyie einyototo Noa te merai e naisho, neyiolou enaitaasa olayioni lenye oti ninye,

English: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
Masaai: Nerrinyo Yesu te ine te nebo looiteng'eni lenyena aapuo enaiposha, nesuj olorora kitok oing'uaa Galilaya; o looing'uaa Yudea

English: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
Masaai: Aashu tenelo neiseyie ninye mbaa nemesinya oo ltung'ana e pooki pukunoto laa te ninye eaku olemesinya, ore ina bae neisudoro te ninye, ore ake pee elotu ayiolou ina bae neaku ninye oloitarruoyie.

English: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn enye, Benhuri teina kop oo ldoinyio e Efraim,

English: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
Masaai: Kake etejo Esau, “Ekaata inaabaiki, olalashe lai; intaa pooki niata ininono.”

English: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki naapuo too ndapi, tiatua nena ng'uesi oo nkejek moo ng'uan naa olduruk te ntae; ore oloba anaa oloiseyie empopok enye neiduruku ometaa teipa.

English: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
Masaai: Iwaita sii kulikae soito le tipat laainei le sahabu o le nkosholai ai, lelo laaishoo iyie, nintobirakinye kewan inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu oo ltung'ana, niasie ninche ine nkiborra oonkonyek;

English: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
Masaai: Amu “Etiu iseseni anaa nkujit, netiu enkitoo enye pooki anaa ene ntapukai oo nkujit. Etoyu inkujit, nedoiyio entapukai;

English: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.
Masaai: Aaitanyaanyukie nanu iyie enyorrata ai, embarta oo ngarrin e Farao.

English: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
Masaai: Etadoikio enkukuo e dukuya Yehoirib, nedoiki eniare Yedaia,

English: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
Masaai: Nelo ina kata enetii Yesu nejoki, “Supa Olaiteng'enani;” neng'utut.

English: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
Masaai: O meiruko sii ninye Simon; ore pee eibatisae, neaku Filipo eisiritore. Ore pee edol nkitoduaat o mbaa sapuki e ngolon naas Filipo neitoki ninye aing'asia.

English: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.
Masaai: Metaa kanya nanu olmumai te nkaji e Eli nchere ore ina torroni e nkaji e Eli meitayu ae kata olasar arashu enkishoroto ntarasi.”

English: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
Masaai: Nenyikaki Aron ilo perere lo lasar, neyieng ilo ashe lo lasar le ng'oki, te nkaraki enkorrok enye.

English: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
Masaai: Newal Olaitoriani nejoki iltung'ana lenyena, “Kairriwaki nanu intae entapa o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata. Naa ipuopuo intae aaraposho; nemaigil aekata nanu aitaa intae enkurruna too loreren.

English: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Gershom naa Ladan, o Shimei.

English: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku aabaiki enkop natoyio nedol te ine enkima oo nkuk naiteleikino sinkir, o emukate.

English: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Masaai: Amu eitu iyie kipalaa mashomo atua enemeneng'a, neitu ncho ilo oure Enkai edoiki engumoto.

English: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
Masaai: ile Arod, olmarei loo le Arod; ile Areli, olmarei loo le Areli.

English: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
Masaai: Ore ina kata nejoki Yesu ina siamo, “Aikipuonunu aaibung iatata ilalema o siaren anaa ilooibung olaisimani? Natii oshi ake enkaji e Nkai aiteng'enisho neitu kimbung'ubung'u?”

English: For he that is not against us is on our part.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo lemegilunore iyiook naa ole nkalo ang.

English: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
Masaai: Ore lelo Siraeli pooki oomanita ninche, neisik to lkiyioi lenye, amu etejo ninche, “Eji pee meijoo iyiook enkop.”

English: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ayieng ilo kuo le ker lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, neya olapolosani embata osarge leilo asar le nkitarruorroto, nepik enchumata enkitipet e nkiok e tatene eilo oitukui, o enchumata olmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene, o lmogirra le nkeju enye e tatene.

English: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
Masaai: Olchorro le nkurma, enchorro e nkare naishu, o nchorroi naarukunye e Lebanon.

English: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie te keper, teina manyisho ino, nipalaki, ore ake pooki tau liyiolo iyie nilaaki te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena (Amu iyie ake openy oyiolo iltauja loo nkera e tung'ana);

English: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
Masaai: Kaputoki nanu ninche oloiboni leeijo iyie tiatua ilalashera lenye; napik nanu irorei laainei atua enkutuk enye, neirorie ninye ninche nena pooki naitanap ninye.

English: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
Masaai: “Aing'ae oishoo iloitikoishi meidapashari aapuaya? Aing'ae otalaa ieneta enkurrarru naten.

English: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
Masaai: Kake newaliki ng'eni nejoki, ‘Aa mebaiki iyiook o intae; neikash ti nipuopuo enetii loomir aainyang'aki ate.’

English: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
Masaai: meeu enkitoria ino, metaasi eniyieu te nkop anaa enatiu te shumata.

English: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
Masaai: Pee eipiru mbaa e nkarriyiano, neasisho te sahabu, o te nkosholai o to suyai,

English: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Meitokini aata Olyahudi anaa Olyunani, orrindik arashu ololakuno, olee arashu eng'oruoi; irara pooki nabo ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
Masaai: “Eng'or enkiti kata, pee mikintokiki aadol ore ake sii te nkiti kata, nikintokiki aa dol.”

English: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
Masaai: Ore tenenapi ninye aaya enkurare, neing'ori aarrip enkurare enye.

English: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
Masaai: Ore lelo mang'ati lo Laitoriani naa kegiligili aaitaa mbelibelat, kegilunore ninche naa kedaraki ninche te keper. Kedung'oki Olaitoriani enkiguana ineeiting'ie enkop, neisho ninye engolon ilo aiguanani lenye, neilepie ninye engolon eilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput.”

English: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
Masaai: Koree naa taata ina aripo inyi? Ara shakeni nchere te naa apa ndimidimi, anaata itukurtutuo nkonyek inyi pee kinchosho nanu.

English: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
Masaai: Nedumu olmalaika emoti neiput enkima naitayio to lperere lo lasar, neisuaaki enkop neaku kumok indarat sapuki o nkikurrukurrot naabuaku, o enkimerlel o nkiwuang'at, o enkikirikirata e nkop.

English: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
Masaai: Nelotu Yakobo Lus (aa ninye Betel), aa ninye natii enkop e Kanaan, ore ninye tenebo olorere pooki oboitare,

English: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
Masaai: Ore pee eimaa nene wuejitin, neikok ninche oleng nelotu enkop oo Lyunani.

English: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
Masaai: Atejo nanu eitoritote nkolong'i aainei etaa kalo; aipirakinore nanu kishomi enemeneng'a, too larin pooki le nkishui ai.

English: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
Masaai: Ore peyie ening Abram inchere ewaki oltung'ani lenye le mudong eararoto, nerik iltung'ana ooyiolo olarrabal laa iinot le nkaji enye, iltung'ana oora esiana iip uni o tomon oisiet, nelo asujaa ninche ometabaiki Dan.

English: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
Masaai: Iyie nanu aigarakine ebaiki apa pee aaini, iyie apa likintayio nanu te nkoshoke e yieyio. Iyie nanu aaisis anaake.

English: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
Masaai: “Entoning naa intae enkitanyaanyukoto o launoni.

English: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
Masaai: Metaa ore ilayiok le Noa ootupukutuo te safina naa Shem, o Ham, o Yafet. Naa Ham apa menye le Kanaan.

English: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
Masaai: kake eibung'ita ninye empolosare enye nemeiting, amu ebik ninye intarasi.

English: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ena meeta nchere meng'as aitayu olasar loo ng'ok enyena makewan neitayu sii noo ilkulikae tung'ana.

English: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Eng'urai ena nining'itoto; amu ore emborei ninchooyo iyie naa ninye kinchori sii iyie, nikiponikini.

English: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ng'ura, kaitayu nanu osotua. Ore te dukuya iltung'ana linono pooki naas nanu ine nking'asia, neitu ae kata easi ti atua enkop pooki arashu ti ae kop; ore lelo tung'ana litii iyie atua ninche nedol esiaai o Laitoriani; amu entoki naitureisho aitaas intae.

English: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
Masaai: Metaa entagoloto olikae olikae te kulo rorei.

English: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
Masaai: eishorua Olaitajeunoni Magilani to lgilata lo sinka lenye Daudi,

English: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
Masaai: ekaamayian iyie oleng', naa kaponaa eishoi ino metotiwuo anaa ilakir le keper netiu sii anaa osinyai le nkiyopata enaiposha. Ore eishoi ino neaku e nenye kishomi oo lmang'ati lenye.

English: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
Masaai: Einyeito lelo laaiba aaitirrish intae oleng, kake mme too supati; kejo pee erishie intae nanu pee eaku ninche enyokitai.

English: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche olarrabal o Lhagri, olyetur, Olmafish, Olnadab;

English: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
Masaai: Ore eomonito Yesu openy, netii ilooiteng'eni lenyena, neikilikuan ajoki, “Kejo olorere kara ng'ae?”

English: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
Masaai: Ore ilo asar le ntapa opudakini naa rubat are e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, pee eitayunyeki olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, esong'ouna narropil o lasar le ntoki naoki tenebo ninye naa enaisho oo sabibu erubata e ong'uan etomon ninye.

English: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
Masaai: Ore lelo ayiok le Aron, lelo apolosak, nekut ntarumpetani. Ore eoshoto oo ntarumpetani naa keaku te intae enkitanapata e anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
Masaai: Nerany Daudi ele sinkolio le nkishirata, aishiraki Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye.

English: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
Masaai: Enchoo pooki ng'ae erripo to lelatia enye nemepik osiligi atua likae alashe; amu ore pooki alashe naa olairrikinoni amu ore pooki lelatia enye neloolo ainosaa olmarenke.

English: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
Masaai: Neserem iltung'ana ilo asurai, amu eishoo ninye enkidimata enye ina ng'ues neserem, ninche ina ng'ues ejo “Ae ng'ae otiu anaa ina ng'ues, naa ae ng'ae oidima airisha?”

English: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
Masaai: Kepi mbaa inono, netii atua iltauja loo lmang'ati lo laiguanani, nebatata iloreren ti abori iyie.

English: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
Masaai: Naigeroki intae iloo papa, amu iyiololo ilo otii apake te nkiterunoto. Naigeroki intae, lo murran, amu igoligolo, neton ororei le Nkai intae, nitimira ilo torrono.

English: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
Masaai: Yuda, osinka le Yesu Kristo naa olalashe le Yakobo, oigeroki lelo ooipotoki, oonyorri ti atua Enkai Papa lang ooiteng'elaki te nkaraki Yesu Kristo.

English: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkiguanat o nkikoot o nkitanapat naaitobira Olaitoriani te rishata enye o ltung'ana le Israel te nchumata oldoinyo le Sinai aimunye Musa.

English: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
Masaai: Abuaku nanu anaa emotonyi aishirita anaa enturkulu, enaurate nkonyek aainei aimariri shumata. Iyie Olaitoriani, aaisoruoki nanu, taa iyie esarunoto ai!

English: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
Masaai: Te ina kata eini Musa naa sidai apa ninye oleng te dukuya Enkai; neitubuluni ninye lapaitin okuni te nkaji e menye:

English: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol ninye ilo mishire li aare, naning ina ng'ues e are naishu ejo, “Wou!”

English: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
Masaai: Ore etaa kekenyu, nejoki Paulo ninche pooki meinosa endaa, nejoki, “Ene tomon o oong'uan ade taata ena olong isirng'ang'ate miatata endaa, eitu inyanya toki.

English: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
Masaai: Inchoo enkutuk ino eiguana anaa olarishani osipa, torripo isipat e lelo aisinak o lelo oomena.

English: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
Masaai: naa te netaa eitu eitopiuni Kristo, naa pesho enkirukoto inyi neton itii atua ing'ok inyi.

English: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
Masaai: Tenerriny ninye enkiyang'et enye makewan, neiturrurroki kewan enkiyang'et enye,

English: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
Masaai: “Nanu Klaudius Lisia laairoroki, Oloyanyiti Olbalusui Feliks.

English: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
Masaai: Araposhu nanu nkonyek aainei aing'or ildoinyo. Kaji eing'uaa eretoto ai?

English: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
Masaai: Ee, olalashe kayieu nanu dupoto te iyie ti atua Olaitoriani. Entagolo oltau lai ti atua Kristo.

English: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
Masaai: Amu etejo apa Daudi, “Ore Solomon olayioni lai, naa koti, nemeyiolo toki, naa ore ena aji nashetakini Olaitoriani naa aisidai oleng, nening'o neeta enkitoo te nkop pooki; kaitobir nanu mbaa olchetei leina aji.” Neaku eishorua Daudi ntokitin kumok e nchetare eton eitu eye.

English: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau olapa liopishana, netii iltung'ana loo Siraeli nkang'itie, neiturrurro iltung'ana aaku tenebo te Yerusalem.

English: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.
Masaai: Netiaakaki apa Saul, “Ng'ura, etii Daudi Naios te Rama.”

English: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
Masaai: Ti nikintobiraki ninche iyie entorroni, te neiguenu entaboi nemerasaa ninche.

English: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie, Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, iyie Enkai e Israel. Tudumunye ntamio iloshon pooki; mileku ninye obo le lelo ooipiru entorroni.

English: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
Masaai: Nejo Gehasi, “Aairriwua nanu olkitok lai pee ajoki, ‘Eetuo tena kata enatii nanu ilbarnot ooing'uaa enkop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, ilbarnot oare loo layiok loo loibonok le Nkai, aatoomono nchoo ninche entalanta e nkosholai, o ntukusi are oo nkilani.’ ”

English: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
Masaai: Ore einining'ito ltung'ana nena, neitoki Yesu aliki ninche enkitanyaanyukoto, amu etinyikaka ninye Yerusalem naa kejo ninche etaa keibalunyeki enkitoria e Nkai te ina kata.

English: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.
Masaai: Neyau ninye enetii olapolosani, neitayu ilo apolosani emborei enkaina eina tapa metaa erubata nadamuni nepejoo ina to lperere lo lasar, apejoki Olaitoriani teine neishoorieki ilasarri oopejori; olasar le ng'oki ninye.

English: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou oltoilo le Petero, neng'as apal kishomi mebolo, nekuet aji te ng'ida alikioo nchere eitashe Petero te kishomi.

English: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
Masaai: Tonyuaa oleng, tasioku ene natii.

English: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
Masaai: Ore te lotunoto e ilo torrono te ngolon e shetani, neasi te nkidimata pooki ilmonek le lejare o ne nking'asia,

English: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
Masaai: Ore nanu, aishooyo kewan naleng te ng'ida, naishorua kewan katukulie maataasishoreki enkaraki iltauja linyi. Omaa te naituluso enyorrata nanyor intae, keng'oru enyorrata naanyorri nanu?

English: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
Masaai: Kaa tiatua nkaitin oo nkuapi, natokordua nkuapi enye aitupuku te nkaina ai, eji metaa kekordu Olaitoriani Yerusalem aitupuku te nkaina ai?’ ”

English: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,
Masaai: Namitu naa kewan ajoki lelo laayieu naajur.

English: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
Masaai: Kang'as abik te Efeso o metabau Pentekoste;

English: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
Masaai: sidai te nkadoro enye, naa ninye eng'ida e nkop pooki. Etii oldoinyo le Sion enelakua te moikuape, ina anasa o laiguanani kitok.

English: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
Masaai: o enaisho te nkaraki olasar ooki, ore erubata e ong'uan nintobir te nebo olasar opejori, aashu te nkaraki olasar, to lkuo ake le ker.

English: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
Masaai: “Kaji intae inkoko tenijojo, ‘Kira iyiook ng'eni, ore enkitanapata O Laitoriani netii tenebo iyiook?’ Kake, ng'ura, ina alamu elejare oo lasirak ajo eitaa ninye emonkoi.

English: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
Masaai: Eirragita enkop inyi aa mijooni, netapejoyioki nkanas inyi te nkima; te dukuya intae idolitata einosa iltung'ana leeiking'a enkop inyi; netomijoono ninye, anaa ina nainyala iltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
Masaai: “Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, nanu, nanu kewan oing'oru intare aainei, nalilitu ninche.

English: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
Masaai: Ore too nkiyopat o lkeju too lkekuno pokira lo lkeju, naa kebulu impukunot kumok oo lkeek aaku endaa. Metoyu mbenek enye arashu elau ilng'anayio lenye, kake keiu ilng'anayio sidain te pooki apa, amu ore ina are enye nerukunye aing'uaa ine wueji sinyati. Ore ilng'anayio lenye naa keaku ile ndaa ore imbenek enye neaku olmairo oishiunye olorere.

English: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD'S people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
Masaai: Kake etiaka Musa ninye, “Iata iyie olom te nkaraki nanu? Oo napaji tenaa ore iltung'ana pooki lo Laitoriani, naa loibonok, naaji te nepik Olaitoriani enkiyang'et enye shumata ninche.”

English: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi te ina olong, “Ore pooki ng'ae olo aar Ilyebusi, nchoo eilep to lbaata le nkare pee erasaki lelo modook o lmaiman, apa ooiba oltau le Daudi.” Neaku etejoki, “Ore olmodooni o lmaima melotu atua aji.”

English: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
Masaai: Ore kulikae le lelo ayiok loo lapolosak neitushul isonkoyoni,

English: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu enetii Yesu, nedol aajo eidipa atua, neitu egil inkejek enyena.

English: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
Masaai: Ore olwuasa le Israel neishakenu enkomom enye; kelo Efraim arrorro te ntorroni enye; kerrorro sii Yuda te nebo ninche.

English: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
Masaai: te neme taa apa Olaitoriani otii enkalo ang, ina kata pee edumakino iyiook iltung'ana aagilunore,

English: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
Masaai: nchere, ore pee eitajeu iyiook, too nkaik oo lmang'ati lang, nikisiaai ninye,

English: He must increase, but I must decrease.
Masaai: Meeta nchere pee mebul ninye nang'oroo nanu.”

English: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
Masaai: Amu ore Daudi, eidipa too rishat enyena aitabai inaaitanapishe Enkai, neirura, neirragieki te nebo iloo menye, netum erruorroto.

English: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
Masaai: Kalotu nanu atua enkaji ino aata ilasarri oopejori; kaalaaki nanu iyie ilmuma laainei,

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
Masaai: o lairakuj pokira oare tenebo ina kurriny enye, oilo kina le monyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj.

English: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
Masaai: Neipotu enetii ninye, nejoki too nkitanyaanyukot, “Kaji eiko pee eidim shetani ataarai shetani?

English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
Masaai: Nchoo eshipayu keper, neng'idayu enkop, naa nchoo ninche ejo tiatua iloshon, “Olaitoriani oitoreisho!”

English: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o ltung'ana le Israel pooki neilep aapuo Baala, aa taa Kiriat-Yearim natii Yuda, pee epuo aayau teine osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye eipotieki Olaitoriani oton te nchumata oo Lkerubi.

English: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
Masaai: Ore apa pee elo Musa atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo airorie Olaitoriani, nening ninye oltoilo eirorie ninye eing'uaa shumata ilo orika lo lng'ur apa otii shumata osanduku le nchakenisho, eimu erishata e lelo kerubi pokira oare; neirorie ninye.

English: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
Masaai: Kake ore ninye, neibung, neipot ajoki, “Nakerai, inyo!”

English: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
Masaai: “Miureisho, na tito e Sion! ing'ura, elotu olaiguanani lino, ekedito olkurrarru le sikiria.”

English: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
Masaai: Kake etejo kulikae lenye, “Beelsebul, olkitok loo loiriruani, oishoo engolon naararie loiriruani.”

English: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
Masaai: nintutum ninche te nebo aitaa eng'udi nabo, peyie etum aataa nabo te nkaina ino.

English: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
Masaai: Nejoki, ‘Intobira, osinka supat! Ore enkaraki nitaa oloisiligayu too nkuti oleng, iyooki aitore nkanas tomon!’

English: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
Masaai: Kake eitu etum hoo pito hoo neetuo lchakenini kumok le lejare.

English: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Ore kulo naa laisinak ake, meeta ninche endamunoto; amu meyiolo ninche enkoitoi o Laitoriani, enkitanapata e Nkai enye.

English: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai naa iip are o tikitam o okuni.

English: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yonatan, olayioni le Saul, nelo enetii Daudi te Horesh, neitagol enkaina enye te Nkai.

English: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
Masaai: nejo, ‘Paulo miureishoyu, amu meeta nchere pee mintashe ake te dukuya Kaisari, naa ng'ura, kinchoo Enkai pooki likiriamariyie te meli.’

English: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nememir arashu ewalaa ina rubata enkop ake pooki, amu aisinyati ninye to Laitoriani.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Gad naa Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel.

English: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
Masaai: Toning'o ninye nias enajo, migolong'aki ninye, amu mikipalaki ninye enkitarruoroto ino; amu etii enkarna ai atua ninye.

English: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Naa teneiseyie oltung'ani ake ninye entoki naiduruk nemesinya, tenaa olduruk te tung'ani aashu eng'ues nemesinya aashu ae toki naiduruk o lminong paa keitoki ainos nkiri olasar lo Laitoriani le seriani, neiwuang'ieki ilo tung'ani tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.”

English: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii apa Yosia aiwuang'ie ilaitumusumusok o lasakutok, o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin o ilo minong pooki otii ina kop e Yuda o Yerusalem, pee etumoki aitudupai irorei leina kitanapata ooigero tiatua ina buku apa nanoto Hilkia olapolosani tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eitu apa enyorraa ilaiguanak le nkop anaa hoo obo le lelo oomanya enkop, nchere keidim olmang'atinta atijing'u nchomito e Yerusalem.

English: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
Masaai: Amu ore too nchumat oo ldoinyo nadol nanu ninye, te nchumata oo ndoinyo aing'or nanu ninye; ng'ura, olorere ninche ootoni o openy, nemeitushulaki ninche ate kulikae oreren!

English: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
Masaai: Naa kaisudoo nanu enkomom ai katukul ina olong te nkaraki ina torroni nataasa ninche, amu eibelekenyakinote ninche kulie aitin.

English: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
Masaai: Te ina olong ake etijing'a Noa, o Shem, o Ham, o Yafet ilayiok le Noa, o enkitok e Noa, o nkituaak uni oo layiok lenyena atua esafina.

English: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
Masaai: Nairrug elukunya aserem Olaitoriani, naisis Olaitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, ilo laatorikoyie te nkoitoi nasipa matoriko entito o lalashe lo lkitok lai arikoki olayioni lenye.

English: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu meishiunoyu olbae lenye neewuo Yuda, etabawua kishomi oo ltung'ana laainei, eewuo Yerusalem.

English: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
Masaai: kake ore pooki ng'ae oure ninye aa ololorere ora, neas isupati te Enkai, nenyorraa ninye.

English: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
Masaai: enkop e nkano o entapa, enkop oo sabibu o lng'abolo, o lng'anayio, enkop oo loirienito o enaisho,

English: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
Masaai: “Ti nintoishosho nkituaak oo Lhebrania nidolidolo ina kata eisho, tenaa enkayioni niariara ninye metua; kake tenaa entito enchoo eton eishu.”

English: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo onapita imasaa enyena olarrabal ninye, “Taasa anaa eniyieu niaas; ng'ura, atii nanu te nebo iyie, anaa enatiu ndamunot inono neijia etiu inaainei.”

English: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
Masaai: neretisho te nkisiaayiare e mukate e nkitoduaaroto, o entapa tenkaraki olasar le ntapa, naa ninye eitobirieki imukateni neitu eisuishieki, o lasar loo mukateni naatapejoki, o lasar oitushula te ilata, o ntemat pooki e nkumoi o esapuko.

English: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
Masaai: Naa kaponaa nanu ilarin tomon o imiet te nkishui ino. Kaakordu nanu iyie o ena anasa aitayu te nkaina o laiguanani le Asiria, naa kamitu nanu ena anasa te nkaraki kewan ai, o tenkaraki o sinka lai Daudi.’ ”

English: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bilhah enkaisiaayiani e Raheli naa: Dan o Naftali.

English: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
Masaai: o eneikuna lapolosak lang kituaak o laitoriak pee eitarasaa metudung'okini enkiguana metari metua, neshei ninye.

English: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
Masaai: Amu iyie Olaitoriani nanu aanyita; iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai likiwaliki.

English: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
Masaai: kake tishipayu ning'idayu ntarasi te nkaraki ina naitobiru; amu ng'ura, kaitobiru nanu Yerusalem natii eng'ida, ore lelo tung'ana lenyena neiput enchipai.

English: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoab ninye, “Miya iyie ilomon taata; indim iyie aawa lomon ae olong, kake ore taata miya iyie lomon, amu etua olayioni lo laiguanani.”

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki, “Itoduaa iyie aitobiraki, amu arripito nanu ororei lai pee aitabaya ninye.”

English: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye arrinyunye alotu enetii oltung'ani le Nkai nejoki, ninye o encholuek enye pooki, nelotu aitashe te dukuya ninye, nejo ninye, “Ng'ura ayiolo nanu ajo meetae Enkai te nkop pooki meteleku te Israeli. Tang'amai naa taata enkishoroto naing'uaa osinka lino.”

English: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
Masaai: Kake te nintodolulu olkep, nitaasa eng'oki, neiguanare intae inkitanapat inchere irara ilagilak loo nkitanapat.

English: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Meetae hoo oltung'ani obo meteleku Ilawi ake ooidim aatanap osanduku le Nkai, amu etegelua Olaitoriani ninche metanapa osanduku lo Laitoriani, neisiai ninye ntarasi.”

English: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
Masaai: Anaa ainyoo einosie oltung'ani enkishui enye?

English: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
Masaai: Eishoruno pooki toki te nanu kake meretisho ntokitin pooki, “Aaishoro nanu pooki toki” — kake mayieu naaitore engolon e ae toki.

English: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
Masaai: Nejoki olalashe lenye Absalom ninye, “Ketii duoo Amnon olalashe lino te nebo iyie? Tigirayu naa taata, enkanashe ai; olalashe lino ninye; mipik ena oltau.” Nebik Tamar, anaa enkitok naliyio, ti atua enkaji o lalashe lenye Absalom.

English: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ootipika olmishire lenye naa Nehemia ilo balusui, olayioni le Hekalia, o Sedekia,

English: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
Masaai: Etaa pooki toki te ninye, nemeetae hoo toki te nena naataa, naitaaki metii ninye.

English: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
Masaai: Ijojo pasa keisho ilo sinka enashe enkaraki nataasa enaitanapaki?

English: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
Masaai: Nalo nanu arikoo lelo modook te ina oitoi apa neitu eyiolou ninche, aimie atua ina oitoi nemeyiolo ninche karikoo nanu ninche. Kaibelekeny nanu ina aimin natii dukuya ninche aitaa ewang'an, naisiajayie iwuejitin neesur. Kuna baa nanu aas, nemalo nanu aing'uaa ninche.

English: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
Masaai: Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Emincho Hesekia meteleja intae, amu meidim ninye atokordu intae.

English: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
Masaai: Neyau Melkisedek olaiguanani le Salem e mukate o enaisho oo sabibu: ore apa ninye naa Olapolosani le Nkai natii shumata aisul.

English: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace:
Masaai: Ore nanu Nebukadnesa kaisikarra apa ti atua enkaji ai natudupe ti atua enkaji ai natudupe ti atua enkaji ai e nkitoo.

English: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
Masaai: neirragie te nkurare enye ng'ejuk nataguetua to soit, neibeleleng'oki osoit sapuk enkutuk e ngumoto, nelo.

English: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kaa nanu eton ajo eibelekenyate Israel aaisho oriong ilmang'ati lenye!

English: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
Masaai: “Amu inkilikuanu, aatoomono too lporori ooshomo, nijurru ayiolou nena naanoto iloo papa;

English: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
Masaai: ore peyie ening ajo ailepie oltoilo lai aishir oleng', neing'uaa enkila enye te nkaina ai neilanyisho aipirri aipung boo.”

English: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
Masaai: Amu nabo Enkai, naa ninye oitusupat iloomurata te nkitanapata e nkirukoto enye o lelo lememurata te nkirukoto enye.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, ore to lapa liopishana te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nimbung'ubung'u enkolong naeng'ieng'ae aaitirring'a, endamunoto nalimuni aaibalunye te oshoto oo ntarumpetani, eumata sinyati.

English: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
Masaai: Amu itetema iyie iyiook, Enkai, itetema iyie iyiook anaa enkosholai, anaa enkosholai natemi.

English: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
Masaai: Kaa nalelek, ai te najoki ele oilenye, ‘Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono,’ ana ai te najoki, ‘Inyo, tudumu erruat ino shomo’?

English: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,
Masaai: o Parmasta o Arisai o Aridai o Faisata,

English: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
Masaai: Neitanapisho olapolosani ajo meitayuni ntokitin naatii ina aji eton eitu elo olapolosani ajurru ina keeya, pee meibalunyeki nena pooki naatii atua ina aji aajo keiduruk; ore te siadi neitoki olapolosani alo atua adol ina aji.

English: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo oltung'ani okedito embarta anang'are ninye, nejoki, “Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Keseriani ake.’ ” Nejoki Yehu, “Kaa iyie intaasa eseriani? mbelekenyayu tusujuaki.” Nelikioo olarriponi ina ejo, “Etabaikia olkilikuai ninche, kake merrinyunye ninye.”

English: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
Masaai: Entoning, lo tung'ana laainei, te naikok nanu intae! Oo Israel, oi siaake tenaa eikining nanu!

English: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
Masaai: Netii apa olameyu too nkolong'i e Daudi too larin okuni, to lari ake o to lari, neing'oru Daudi enkomom o Laitoriani. Nejo Olaitoriani, “Etii entorroni o sarge shumata Saul o shumata enkaji enye, enkaraki natara Ilgibioni metuata.”

English: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
Masaai: Kake ore ejo ninche etii ake atua encholiek enye, nepuo endama nalulung'a, neing'oru te lelo lo lgilata lenye, o too le latia enye.

English: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
Masaai: negilu ilukuny oo ltarakua nena lukuny enye naaipilipil aya ninche enkop namirishoreki, nepik enkanasa oo lbiasharani.

English: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
Masaai: Amu meeta nchere pee eitu eitabari ele sirata te nanu ojo, ‘Amu eikenakini ninye ilwushuush;’ amu epuonu o metimitunye inaatisiraki ti alo nanu.”

English: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
Masaai: Netaanu nkolong'i pee eilep alo shumata, nemut nabo ajo kelo Yerusalem.

English: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
Masaai: Naitujung karsisisho lelo laanyor nanu, neiput ilchumat lenye masaa.

English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa. Neaku eikena apa ninye ninche ti ong'ata e Sinai.

English: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
Masaai: netum naa olapolosani aikena entemata enye e nkinyiang'a ometabaiki olari le Yubilii, nelo taa ilo tung'ani aishooyo esiana e nkinyiang'a te ina olong anaa entoki sinyati to laitoriani.

English: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
Masaai: Neikilikuan aajoki, “Ira Eliya?” Nejoki, “Mara.” Nejoki, “Ira ilo oiboni?” Newaliki ajoki, “A'a,”

English: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari naa Yaasia, o Beno, o Shoham, o Sakur, o Ibri.

English: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
Masaai: “Aibayie enkishui ai tukul; ekaisho enkiroroto e pesho enking'unyung'uny ai; ekairo tiatua emion oltau lai.

English: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
Masaai: Ore emaupe e nkitoo oo lng'eni naa eng'eno enye nagut, kake ore emodai naa enkishili oo lmoda.

English: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
Masaai: naa ninye eilep iloshon aapuo, lelo oshon lo Laitoriani, anaa apa enaitanapaki Israel, pee eisho enkarna o Laitoriani enashe.

English: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
Masaai: ore teine wueji nelo agelu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee epik enkarna enye metobiko teine, ine eyau nena pooki naitanap intae; ilasarri linyi oopejori o nkishorot inyi, o ematua inyi e tomon o nena kishorot nintarasaa, o nena kishorot ninosie olmumai pee inchosho Olaitoriani.

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Nyaaki shomo tonyorra ina kitok nanyor osintani lenye, naa enaibor onyek, tonyorra anaa enanyor Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, hoo neibelekenyakino ninche kulie aitin nenyorru imukateni o sabibu naatoito.”

English: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
Masaai: Eibookito sii intae enkop iltung'ana le Sidon, o Lmaleki, o Lmaoni; nikinchirakiki intae nanu, nakordu nanu intae aitayu ti atua nkaik enye.

English: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
Masaai: Neaku neipot Samuel Olaitoriani, neirriu Olaitoriani endarata o enchan ina olong apa; neureyu iltung'ana pooki Olaitoriani o Samuel oleng.

English: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
Masaai: Aaikidamu lelo sanchan pooki linono; mikishilaa ninche iyie amu aaikuna nanu anaa olmang'atinta enkitamioto o lmang'atinta lemeeta, olng'ur, amu eikitok enkitarruoroto ino enkaraki natoponari ing'ok inono.

English: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ilarin tikitam laa ninche eteshetie Solomon enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji enye makewan

English: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
Masaai: Amu osinka le Nkai ninye likiyaki isupati. Kake ore ake pee ias intorrok, tureisho, amu menapita ninye olalem pesho; osinka le Nkai ninye oitabaiki engoro enye ilo oas intorrok.

English: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
Masaai: Nedumu ninye ilo kila apa oitadoikio ninye, nerrinyo ninye nelo aitashe tembata olkeju le Yordan.

English: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
Masaai: Meiture ninye embae meilanyisho; amu ore isoito oonang'ieki ninye netiu anaa ng'uetat.

English: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
Masaai: Kake etabuaakaki te nkaraki natigila ninye makewan inkitanapat; airo osikiria lemeeta enkutuk to ltoilo lo ltung'ani; aibooyo oloirirua le ilo oiboni.

English: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
Masaai: Amu ore nanu Olaitoriani naa esipata ayieu, kaiba empurrore o enkitarruoroto; kalo nanu aisho ninche elaakinoto nasipa, nalo aitobir osotua loo ntarasi o ninche.

English: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani ng'en nesilu iltorrok nereu enkeju e ngarri aitunyoo ninche.

English: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ining iyie oltoilo lai tadekenya; ore tadekenya naaitobiraki nanu iyie olasar, naton aanyisho.

English: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
Masaai: Neinyototo ina kata nena toyie aaitobir iltaai lenye.

English: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
Masaai: Ore pee epuo ilooiteng'eni lido kekun, nerikino eitu eya mukateni.

English: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Daudi, neiturrur ninye Israeli pooki te nebo, nelang Yordan, nepuonu Helam. Neitobira Isiria maate aarare Daudi, neitayu olarrabal te nebo ninye.

English: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie olari nelotu enjore e Siria agilunore Yoash. Nepuonu ninche Yuda o Yerusalem, neidaikie ninche ilkituaak pooki loo ltung'ana, neishie tiatua olorere, neirriwaki ninche nena masaa pooki naawaita o laiguanani le Dameski.

English: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo nkolong'i naatobiko Daudi te nkop oo Lfilisti naa olari o lapaitin oong'uan.

English: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
Masaai: Ore to lari le naapishana, to lapa le imiet te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nepuonu embata oo lpayiani le Israel aaikilikuanu mbaa to Laitoriani, netoni te dukuya nanu.

English: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
Masaai: “Kadumunye alo aman enkanasa, atua inkoitoi naalala e nkanasa o lkurrot oo tumoreki, ekaing'oru nanu ilo onyor oltau lai.” Aing'orua ninye, kake eitu nanu atum ninye.

English: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato lapolosak kituaak o lorora, “Eitu atum entiyoto te le tung'ani.”

English: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
Masaai: nepik mbokishi lelo giso te pooki shoto e ilo sanduku pee enapieki ilo sanduku.

English: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
Masaai: Igal olayioni le Natan le Soba, Bani Olgadi,

English: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
Masaai: Nebik Daudi ti atua ilo sempewuet nejo ninye enkanasa e Daudi. Neshet Daudi ina anasa aitamanaa ebaiki Milo neito atua.

English: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Minchooyo ae nabo oo nkera inono meitarasari to lasar le nkima aaisho enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai e Molek aisarkionie enkarna e Nkai ino; Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
Masaai: Nagelu nanu metaa ilashumak ooitasheiki nena ajijik naashumishoreki, Shelemia ilo apolosani, o Sadok olaigeroni, o Pedaia loo Lawi, ore olaretoni lenye naa Hanan olayioni le Sakur, olayioni le Matamia, amu ninche apa eisiligaki. Ore apa esiaai enye naa pee eoriki ilalashera lenye ntokitin.

English: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia ajoki iltung'ana pooki, ilewa o nkituaak, o lelo tung'ana pooki ooishoo ninye ena walata:

English: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
Masaai: amu too nkitanapat inono nanu atum enchipai, amu ninche nanu anyor.

English: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
Masaai: Neaku eidurra apa Isaak teine, nelo apik olng'obor lenye o erata le Gera nebik teine.

English: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: nebik Kenan etoiwuoki Mahalel ilarin iip isiet o artam, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Eser, Bilhan, o Saafan o Yaakan. Ore ilayiok le Dishon naa Usi o Aran.

English: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
Masaai: Ore nkanas enye pooki too wuejitin neemanya o lng'oborri lenye pooki, nepejoo te nkima,

English: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
Masaai: Neyau Musa iltung'ana aitung'uaa ilng'oborri meetu aatumore Enkai; neitashe ninche te ntonata o ldoinyo.

English: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.
Masaai: Kake ore taata mebikoo enkitoria ino; eing'orua Olaitoriani oltung'ani onyor oltau lenye; netegelua ninye Olaitoriani pee eaku olkitok too ltung'ana lenyena, enkaraki neitu iyie imbung ina nikintanapa Olaitoriani.”

English: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie adumunye o meshomo embata oerata lo layioni le Hinom te murte moikuape oo Lyebusi (aa taa Yerusalem) nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki enchumata e ilo doinyo o talakinore oerata le Hinom, te nkalo o loo ntoluo te nkalo e moikuape te ine neiting'ie o erata le Refaim;

English: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
Masaai: netumi taa aaitotona olorika le nkitoo te nyorrata nauno, ore te shumata e ilo orika neton ninye te sipata ti atua ilo ng'obor le Daudi, ilo obo oiguana te sipata amu keneneng ninye pee eas esipata.”

English: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
Masaai: Ainyoo iyie pee itejo, enkanashe ai ninye,” metaa aawa ninye ayam aitaa enkitok ai? Ore naa iyie, nena enkitok ino toriko enchom.

English: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
Masaai: ore Matitia obo loo Lawi, ilo kikau le Shalum le Kora, naa ninye oitasheiki enkitobirata oo mukateni dapashi.

English: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
Masaai: aashu oloo rasheta aashu olaenani, aashu olasakutoni, aashu oloirorie ilmeneng'a.

English: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
Masaai: Keetae too laitoriak anaa too Lfarisayo oloiruko ninye?

English: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo oiken olaisinani! Kekordu Olaitoriani ninye te nkolong e nyamali;

English: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
Masaai: Keoshoki olkutati ninye nkaik, neiture ninye aitupuku te wueji enye.

English: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
Masaai: Ore enkisampuare enye nenya lelo oota esumash, naa keya doi ninye aitayu tiatua ilkiku; ore iloota enkure neipang'ipang eing'oru enkarsisisho enye.

English: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Kake kang'ida nanu ntarasi, karanyaki enkisisa e Nkai e Yakobo.

English: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
Masaai: ore ilgilat loo mbaat naa entiyani nabo enkadoro ore erishata e lelo gilat loo mbaat naa intemat emiet e nkaina; ore ine neitasheyie ina kishomi te mbata o lgoriet tenejing'ieki kishomi naa entiyani nabo.

English: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
Masaai: Ore apa Debora enkoiboni e Nkai, ina kitok e Lapidot, naa ninye apa narishita Israel te ina kata.

English: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
Masaai: “Tenaisho ing'uesi entim meima atua ina kop, neinyal ninye metaa mitil, metaa meetae oltung'ani oidim aima atua te nkaraki nena ng'uesi;

English: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
Masaai: ilo apa otejo tialo menye o ng'otonye ‘Mashilaa nanu ninche’; eiturrayie ninye ilalashera lenyena, nepalaa nkera enyena, amu eibung'a ninche ororei lino neibung olning'o lino.

English: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
Masaai: Neaku ina ng'eno inyi natara ilo tung'ani oshal, ilo alashe otua Kristo te nkaraki ninye.

English: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
Masaai: Etiu ninche anaa enkidetidet te neinyototo oltung'ani, te nidumunye iyie, Olaitoriani, niwuang'ie ina golon enye.

English: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.
Masaai: Amu eidimi aishoo ninye ioshot artam kake meitulusi; amu tenelo likae tung'ani aponiki ninye ioshot naalang kuna, netemenayioki naa ilo alashe lino too nkonyek inono.

English: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
Masaai: Amu eewuo olosho agilunore enkop ai, negol nemeikenayu te nkumoi; netiu ilala lenyena anaa ilala lo lng'atuny, neeta iltagiligil le lipong o lng'atuny.

English: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
Masaai: Naalaaki ninche ntorrok too supati naitaasa ninche, etalepori oltau lai.

English: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
Masaai: Olchakeni le lejare olimu te nkutuk elejare, oltung'ani oun empeu engogong'i tiatua ilalashera.

English: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
Masaai: “Tiaki Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani, pee eitayu nena girran naapejieki enkorropil te nkima; neitalamaa enkima neidapashaa. Amu kesinya ninche.

English: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
Masaai: Neliki Mikaia ninche lelo rorei pooki ootoning'o ninye, ina kata pee eisum Baruk olpiyayati ening'ito iltung'ana.

English: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
Masaai: Irragie elakunoto ai te kewan ino; kalo likae om aishoru elakunoto te nkaraki nanu.

English: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
Masaai: Naa kaapon oleng, naa kaitayu iloshon tiatua iyie, naa kepuku ilaiguanak tiatua iyie.

English: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Masaai: ore ile Ruben o le Gad naishoo nanu ina kop ebaiki Gilead o metabaiki oerata le Arnon, tenebo empolos o erata metaa olpolosie o metabaiki olkeju le Yabok, ilo polosie loo Lamori;

English: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
Masaai: Neibung ninche olning'o lo sotua pee eing'oru Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, too ltauja lenye pooki o te nkishui enye pooki;

English: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye atum likae tung'ani, nejoki, “Tooshoki nanu, aatoomono.” Neosh ilo tung'ani ninye nepik olbae.

English: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
Masaai: Ore olotang'amayie shakenisho enye netipika olmishire lenye ena nchere asipani Enkai.

English: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
Masaai: Neitoki Finehas olayioni le Eliesa ilo apolosani, o lkituaak aashuko too le Ruben, o le Gad te nkop e Gilead aapuo enkop e Kanaan, enetii iltung'ana le Israel neyaki ilomon.

English: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
Masaai: Amu etubulua ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani anaa enkaitubului kiti, o anaa entonai te nkop natoyio; meeta ninye enkishiaa anaa eneing'ori, eji metaa eiking'or iyiook ninye, nemeeta esidano eji metaa eiking'uar.

English: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, ore pee edol esiamo ajo metii Yesu ine anaa ilooiteng'eni lenyena, nejing ninche oopeny atua e mpeut nepuonu Kapernaum, eing'oru Yesu.

English: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
Masaai: Neitobir ninche pee esulaa ninye aaitadou to lorika lenye. Neshipakino ninche entorroni. Nemayian too nkutukie enye, ore ti atua iltauja lenye nedekisho.

English: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ilarin imiet oltung'ani neilep o metabaiki ilarin tikitam, ore entemata ino to lee naa shekeli tikitam, ore te ng'oruoi naa shekeli tomon.

English: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
Masaai: Ore ti alo olosho le Yuda o losho le Simeon neishooyo ninche kuna anas naaipoto too nkarn,

English: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
Masaai: ore lelo timito ootii ilng'oborri nening eji, “Etarresho Simri olaiguanani near metua.” Ore enkaraki ina neitaa Isiraeli pooki Omori ilo kitok le njore, metaa olaiguanani le Israel ina olong oo lng'oborri.

English: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
Masaai: “Tenindipidipi aatalang olkeju le Yordan nchoo kulo eitashe to ldoinyo le Gerisim, pee emayian olorere. Simion, o Lawi, o Yuda, o Isaakar, o Yosef, o Benchamen.

English: But ye are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
Masaai: Kake ore intae iloany Olaitoriani, lelo lemedamu oldoinyo lai sinyati, lelo ooirragie emesa oo mbaa oo nkitumusumusot, nimputuputu nkikompeni e naisho naitushula.

English: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Iye iyie aya enkeeya e ilo lememurata te nkaina oo ltung'ani leeiking'a, ilo omoni, amu airoro nanu ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.’ ”

English: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
Masaai: Nemur ninye nena rubat te sahabu, neitayu ilgiso lenye le sahabu too laibung'ak le lelo loom, nemur lelo loom te sahabu.

English: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
Masaai: Na kituaak, entoning ilpayiani linyi, anaa enaitoriori ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
Masaai: Amaa ina nidaa, niokishosho aimidaa tenkaraki nkorroki inyi, niokishosho tenkaraki nkorroki inyi?

English: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
Masaai: “Kitoning'o iyiook ejo, ‘Kagil nanu ena aji e Nkai naitobiraki too nkaik, ore nkolong'i uni nashetu ae, neitu eitobiri too nkaik.’ ”

English: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
Masaai: Amu etoduaa nkonyek aainei enjeunoto ino

English: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
Masaai: Nelotu ninye enetii iltung'ana le Sukot, nejoki, “Eng'ura Seba o Salmuna, laa ninche apa kinkorojie nanu ijojo, ‘Keidipa Seba o Salmuna, aatijing atua enkaina ino pee kitum aaishoo endaa lelo tung'ana linono ooiterre?’ ”

English: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitodolua ninye te nking'asia ina nyorrata enye nauno ti alo nanu, ina kata apa pee aaibung'i anaa enkanasa natang'aduaki aaman.

English: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye erubata ai; atonyorrayie nanu nchere kaibung nkitanapat inono.

English: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
Masaai: Keiwuang ilo lom le Efraim, ore lelo ooiture Yuda neiwuang'ieki; meigil Efraim aatayie olom Yuda, nemeigil Yuda aiture Efraim.

English: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
Masaai: Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare olodung'oro li oriong netii iltuka ing'apeta enyena, ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.

English: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
Masaai: Neor olkidong'oe lenye ematua e uni oo lakir le shumata, nenang'aki ninche enkop. Neitashe ilo asurai te dukuya ina tuaa nasaisai, pee enya enkerai enye te neini.

English: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
Masaai: Nejoki Ilkaldayo olaiguanani, “Lo aiguanani, tobiko ntarasi! Toliki isinkan linono enkidetidet, pee kintodol iyie enkibalakinoto enye.”

English: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
Masaai: Negem nabo kata erukoto enye, nening to sesen lenye nchere eishiunyeki emueyian enye.

English: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
Masaai: Ina pee eitanap ninye ninche ejoki ninche, “Ore amu ekalo enetii iltung'ana lainei te keeya; etunukayioki tenebo iloo papa te nkapune natii enkurma e Efron le Hiti.

English: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
Masaai: erropili naa enkishui te lelo ooitajeuni, naa enkeeya te lelo ooye. Aing'ae doi ilo obaya te kuna pooki?

English: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
Masaai: Ore apa Isaak naa oloo larin artam peyie eyam enkitok enye Rebeka, ina tito e Betuel le Aramean te Padan-aram, ina anashe e Laban le Aramean.

English: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
Masaai: naa keoro ndamunot enyena. Ore enkitok nemeyama, anaa enemeyiolo olee naa mbaa o Laitoriani enyamaliki; pee etum ataa sinyati to sesen o to ltau. Kake ore enkitok nayama naa mbaa e nkop enyamaliki; naa olpayian lenye eyieu neitiship.

English: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Israel, “Te neikilikuan akenya nkera inyi iloo papaai lenye te nkata nalotu aajoki, ‘Kainyoo tipat e kulo soito?’
