English: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.
Masaai: Naa ore ena nadoiki ilayiok linono pokira oare, Hofni o Finehas neaku olmonekie te iyie! Keye ninche pokira te nkolong nabo.

English: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
Masaai: Amu keshipakino Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena; neikod ninye olobor te nkisulata.

English: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
Masaai: Neisarkionie ninye Tofet, ina natii oerata loo layiok le Hinom, pee meitoki atii hoo obo opejoo olayioni lenye anaa entito enye aitaa olasar oishori Molek.

English: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
Masaai: Nijoki iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Ewaita ositima le kine, oaku olasar le ng'oki, o lashe o sitima le ker, naa ilo lari obo pooki nemetii oloata entioto, pee eaku olasar opejori

English: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Bakbuk, lelo ayiok le Hakufa, lelo ayiok le Hashur,

English: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.
Masaai: Atoduaa sii ajo ore enkaji e Nkai neeta eneika namanita; ore ilkitamanyunot loo lgilat le nchoto naa entiyani nalulung'a oo ntemat ile naalulung'a enkadori.

English: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
Masaai: Neya iltung'ana enkurma enye eton eitu eisuijiek, o ngirran naaipurjishoreki neimulumulari too nkilani enye nenap too loilila.

English: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
Masaai: o Dishon, o Eser, o Dishan: kulo ninche ilarikok le Hori te risioroto oo ilgilat lenye te nkop e Seir.

English: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak le Soan netaa lmoda, ore lelo kituaak le Memfis neteleja ate; ore lelo apa laa ninche eitasheyie iloshon lenye, neitapong'oitie Misiri.

English: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ninye, nepolos nkilani enyena, nejo, “Ee entito ai! Kintadouo iyie nanu oleng, nitaa iyie enkipirunoto e nyamali sapuk te nanu; amu ataboloko nanu Olaitoriani enkutuk ai nemaidim ainyaai olmumai lai.”

English: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
Masaai: Itoponayie iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, nkiaasin inono e nking'asia o ndamunot inono ti alo iyiook; meetae olikinyaanyukie iyie! Tenaa napaji kaibalunye alimu ninche, naa eikumok oleng meikenayu.

English: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
Masaai: Ore too le Isaakar, lelo tung'ana ang'eni ooyiolo nkatitin, ooyiolo enayieu Israel neas, naa iltung'ana kituaak iip are, tenebo lelo alashera lenye pooki ootii abori enkitoria enye.

English: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
Masaai: Amu ejo lkigerot, “Kaitarruoo nanu eyiolounoto oo lang'eni, naiwuang'ie eng'eno e lelo ng'eni.”

English: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
Masaai: Neyuk olapolosani ninche tenebo ina mukate oo lng'anayio le dukuya anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya o Laitoriani, tenebo lelo kuoo oare le kerra; neaku ninche sinyat to Laitoriani tenkaraki olapolosani.

English: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
Masaai: O metaba anaa nemanaa, nelusoo enkewarie imbelekenyunye olanyor lai, totiwuo anaa enkoilii arashu itiu anaa oloing'oni le nkolii te nchumata oldoinyo osur.

English: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
Masaai: Ina ake etoning'o loreren, neng'ida oleng, neisho ilo rorei le Nkai enkisisa: ore lelo oogelakino enjeunoto neiruk.

English: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
Masaai: Ore olchore nenyorrisho te pooki kata, ore olalashe netoiwuoki tenkaraki ing'olikinot.

English: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Idol kuna kituaak ajijik sapuki? Meing'uari tene osoit obo oiteleikino olikae lemesulakini enkop.”

English: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD'S ministers, mourn.
Masaai: Ore olasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki neiwuang'ieki, te nkaji o Laitoriani. Eishira ilapolosak, lelo aisiaayiak lo Laitoriani.

English: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
Masaai: Ore oloinosie keper olmumai neinosie olorika le nkitoo le Nkai neinosie ilo otonita.

English: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Babilon aitaa Matania olenkapu le Yehoiakin, olaiguanani te rishata enye, neibelekeny enkarna enye ajo Sedekia.

English: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
Masaai: Ntukuoki nanu tukul meishunye entorroni ai, nikintisiny too ng'ok aainei!

English: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: Nadol nanu, naa ng'ura embarta pus, ore enkarna e ilo okedito naa keji Keeya, neirukurukore ninye Enemeneng'a. Neishooki ninye engolon meitoria ematua e ong'uan e nkop, peyie ear metuata to lalem o to lameyu o too lmeitai o too ng'uesi e ntim naatii enkop.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaiting'ie karsisisho e Misiri, teina aina e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.
Masaai: Neya Daudi enjore ematua nabo e uni ti abori erikore e Yoab, ematua nabo e uni ti abori erikore e Abishai olayioni le Seruiya, olalashe le Yoab, o ematua nabo e uni ti abori erikore e Itai Olgiladi. Nejoki olaiguanani lelo tung'ana, “Kalo sii nanu makewan aipang te nebo intae.”

English: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man's hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king's palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata neliooyu ilkimojik le nkaina e tung'ani neiger enturoto naelare esuntai e nkaji o laiguanani enkipirakinoto oiket lo ltaa; nedol olaiguanani ina aina eigerisho.

English: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong, naa keitaman Olaitoriani elong'o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, metaa ore ninye oloshal aisul tiatua ninche teina olong netiu anaa Daudi. Ore enkaji e Daudi netiu anaa Enkai, netiu anaa olmalaika lo Laitoriani olo te dukuya ninche.

English: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
Masaai: Nkishu kiwaita aaraya tenebo iyarunot e nena anas nikimbung'a.

English: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Benaia atua ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani nejoki ninye, “Eitanapishe olaiguanani ejo, ‘Tupuku’ ” kake etejo ninye, “A'a tene nanu aye.” Neitoki Benaia ayaki olaiguanani olomoni ajoki, “Nji ejo Yoab naa ena einosa olmumai ajo.”

English: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya esaa, neton adaa, netoni lkipaareta lenyena te nebo ninye.

English: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
Masaai: Ore teneishunye nkujit nebulu kulie, nesotuni nkaitubulu oo ldoinyo,

English: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
Masaai: Kejing olkitok eimu olgoriet leina kishomi eing'uaa auluo, neitashe ninye te mbata entaloishi e kishomi. Neitayu ilapolosak ilasarri lenye oopejori, ilasarri lenyena le seriani, neseremisho tempolos e kishomi, neipung alo auluo, kake meikeni kishomi o metaa teipa.

English: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani le Asiria neirriwaa olkitok obo le nkitoria enye te Lakish meshomo enetii olaiguanani Hesekia te Yerusalem eeta enjore kitok. Nelo ninye aitashe te mbata olchorro le shumata, te ina oitoi natii olaitobirani loo nkilani.

English: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
Masaai: Entuunokinoto enyorrata empirare, kake entonyok eng'oru nkishorot e nkiyang'et, neisul ina kishorunoto e likioroto o lkilikuai le Nkai.

English: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
Masaai: Eitu eas ninye eng'oki, neitu etumieki te nkutuk enye ororei lo losek laa ore pee emori,

English: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
Masaai: naa Adoram oitasheiki esiaai oo nkaik; naa Yehoshafat olayioni le Ahilud apa olaigeroni;

English: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
Masaai: Esipa etanapa ninye emion ang nenap isinaitin lang; ore ake eyia nikidol ninye etooshoki, etoosho ninye Enkai, neisilisil.

English: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
Masaai: Amu nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, likimbung enkaina e tatene; nanu ilo likijoki iyie, “Miureisho, kaaretu nanu.”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo tung'ana le Anatot, lelo ooing'oru enkishui ino nejo, “Mimbonisho te nkarna Olaitoriani, arashu iye te nkaina ang”

English: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
Masaai: Kake ore pee edol ilopeny aajo eshomo osiligi le ina dupoto enye, neibung Paulo o Sila, neikurtutaa aaya enetii laitoriak te nemirishoreki,

English: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
Masaai: Ore te neaku irorei kumok, nemelai inkitadiat, kake ore ilo onuk enkutuk enye naa aing'en.

English: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
Masaai: Ore ilo oirriwua Enkai ninye oiro orerei le Nkai, amu meishoru Enkai Enkiyang'et te ntemakinoto.

English: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
Masaai: “Ore olonyor menye anaa ng'otonye aitalang nanu, anaa olonyor olayioni lenye anaa entito enye pee aaitalang nanu, nemaishiaakino nanu.

English: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
Masaai: Naa ore taata, ng'ura, aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani aishu, anaa enatejo ninye, ore kulo arin artam o imiet ebaiki ina kata apa nairorie Olaitoriani Musa ele rorei, ina kata eloito Israel to lpurkel, ore taata ara nanu ena olong o loo larin ntomoni isiet o imiet.

English: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.
Masaai: Neitoki Nebusaradan, olkitok le rripore aya te yararoto meshomo Babilon lelo kulikae tung'ana ootelekutua tiatua ina anasa, lelo apa ooshomo enetii ninye, o lelo tung'ana otung'uayioki.

English: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?
Masaai: Nejing'u Haman atua aji, nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kaa eitaasi oltung'ani oshipakino olaiguanani pee eyanyit.” Nejo Haman to ltau lenye, Kaing'ae pasa oitishipa olaiguanani pee eyanyit aitalang nanu?

English: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
Masaai: “Emayiana Yael aisul too nkituaak, ina kitok e Heber loo Lkeni, emayiana aisul ti atua nena kituaak naamanya lng'oborri.

English: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eigero apa Musa ilo sinkolio ina olong ake, neiteng'en ninye iltung'ana le Israel.

English: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
Masaai: Ore pee eiting kuna baa, nemut Paulo openy te Nkiyang'et Sinyati ajo, ore pee eidip aimai Makedonia o Akaia, neitoki alo Yerusalem, nejo, “Ore pee aidip ashomo ine, meeta nchere eitu alo Roma.”

English: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:
Masaai: “Teneipang iltung'ana linono aapuo olarrabal aagilunore ilmang'ati lenye, te nkoitoi ake ninye naba anaa enirriwayie ninche meima, neomon ninche Olaitoriani eing'or ina anasa nitegelua iyie oenkaji natesheta nanu te nkaraki enkarna ino,

English: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
Masaai: Neishori ninye ilo orora te nebo ilo asar opejori anaake te ngilata oo nkitanapat; ore esipata nenang'akini enkop, neas ina mouo anaa enayieu nedupoyu.

English: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
Masaai: Ore te nebo nena, intobirakaki olgilata loo lomon, amu aisilig ajo ore te nkaraki enkomono inyi naa kaaishori nanu maeu enitii intae.

English: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
Masaai: naa teneaku ilo Magilani ninye sahabu ino, naa ninye enkosholai ino naata tipat;

English: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham te dukuya ina tang'atang'a enye, nejoki lelo Hiti,

English: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
Masaai: Kake ore pee mikintoki aaibok iyie, naaomon to lng'ur lino toning'o iyook too ndorropu.

English: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
Masaai: neitu eitaini olee te nkaraki eng'oruoi, kake enkaraki olee pee eitayioki engorui.

English: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,
Masaai: “Ina pee atudumunye alo Dameski aaitanapa lapolosak kituaak naata sii mpala enye.

English: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa iyie pee itigila enkikarrata enye, neaku ore pooki oogiroo aaim enkoitoi, neng'osilu ilng'anayio lenyena?

English: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani opaashari inkoitoi enyena, naa keiputakini ninye ilng'anayio loo nkoitoi enyena, ore oltung'ani supat naa keiputakini ninye ilng'anayio loo nkiasin enyena.

English: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
Masaai: Wou tadou tung'uai enkitoo ino, niton te nkop e nkure iyie olomanya Dibon! Amu eewuo oloidaikie Moab pee kigilunore, neidaikie ninye isempewueti linono.

English: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
Masaai: Kake emincho obo te intae meitamei te nkaraki etara metua anaa olapurroni, anaa olarruoni, anaa olaisurusuroni.

English: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
Masaai: peyie atum aibalunye enaaishiaakino nairo.

English: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii iyiolo enaaitaasa nanu Yoab olayioni le Seruyia, ina naitaasa ilkituaak oare le njore oo Siraeli, Abna olayioni le Neer o Amasa olayioni le Yeser, oo tasesekuana ninye. Eitalakua ninye te nkata e seriani, elap o sarge apa oibukoyioki to larrabal, nepik osarge lemeeta entioto enkimeita natii empolos ai, nepik inamuka naatii nkejek aainei.

English: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
Masaai: Ore Yakim o Sikri, o Sabdi,

English: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
Masaai: amu kenyor ninye Papa openy intae, amu kitonyorra intae nanu niruko nchere kaewuo aing'uaa Enkai.

English: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
Masaai: Eilepu enkolong neitoki adoyio, nesiooyo alo ine neilepunye.

English: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
Masaai: “Ntobira intorioi irubat oo sunta o lng'obor too nkeek o lerai.

English: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
Masaai: Maiken nanu nkonyek enkewarie pooki, pee atum aibirribirra enkisiligata ino.

English: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
Masaai: nitoduaa intae nena tokitin enye naaitagorisho, nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin nkeek o noo soito, o nenkosholai o ne sahabu, apa naatii atua ninche.

English: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
Masaai: Ninye otii enkiterunoto oo ntokitin pooki, naa atua ninye eitasheyie aatumokino ntokitin pooki.

English: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
Masaai: Tenaa keibelekenye eroruata apaash enkoitoi neshomo oltau lai arubare nkonyek aainei, naa teneibung'a oltipoto ake ninye pooki inkaik aainei;

English: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Daniel, laa keji apa enkarna enye Belteshasa, “Eikindim iyie aitayiolo nanu ina kidetidet natoduaa o enkibalakinoto enye?”

English: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
Masaai: Metaa atudumunye nalo enkisiajata; naa ng'ura, neitashe enkitoo o Laitoriani teine, neikununo anaa enkitoo apa natoduaa te nkiyopata olkeju le Keba; nabatata te nkomom ai.

English: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
Masaai: nemeetae oltung'ani oidima ateena ninye too lpisia.

English: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
Masaai: Te nejo likae keeta ae nayiolo nemeeta ilo enayiolo anaa enaaishiaakino neyiolo;

English: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
Masaai: Keeta ninye olng'ur anaake neishooyo te sile, ore nkera enyena neaku emayianata.

English: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
Masaai: Niya te kulo enkiti siana oo lpapit aeniki olcholoi lo lkila lino.

English: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
Masaai: Naa tinimining'ining'i iyiook ninchosho metumurati intae, neaku aikiya entito ang', nikipuo aaidur.”

English: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
Masaai: “Ing'ura ajo ore pooki ng'ae oasishore endung'et e rashe naa keasishore ena dung'et e rashe te nkaraki iyie, anaa enatiu ng'otonye, ‘Anaa enatiu entito.’

English: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
Masaai: “Keitu etum oltung'ani esiaai nagol tioriong enkop, naa amaa inkolong'i enyena, aimetiu anaa inkolong'i oltung'ani oigero?

English: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltung'ana pooki metaa ilarripok lo laiguanani, eeta ake pooki tung'ani masaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina, ebaiki enkalo e kopikop enkaji o metabaiki enkalo e moikuape e nkaji, neman olperere lo lasar o enkaji.

English: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
Masaai: Ore ilo oun inemesipa naa keisampu eng'olikinoto, ore eng'udi e ngoro enye napi naa keish.

English: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii Forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
Masaai: Ore ilalashera ootii ine, pee ening'oo iyiook, nepuonu o metabau Sokoni e Apio o Mukaonini Uni aanang'are iyiook. Ninche ake etoduaa Paulo neisho Enkai enashe negolu oshoke.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore nanu enkorrok ai naa kaitayu elukunya oltarakuai oodo, naitayu ninye aipang'ie; nagilu te ntopij, elukunya enye elukunya embeneyioi, naa idol nanu naa kaun ninye te nchumata entopij eine neeika aisul oldoinyio;

English: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki apa ootii tenebo Ishmael Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin tenebo ninye, neng'idayu ninche.

English: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ena olong kelo ninye aitashe te Nobu, nelo aikirikirie enkaina enye te ilo doinyo le nkidaata le Sion, te ilo doinyo le Yerusalem.

English: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
Masaai: Nkuraren enye ninche nkang'itie enye ntarasi, ninche imanyishoritin enye ti atua iishoritin pooki, hoo neipot ninche nkuapi aajo nkunenye.

English: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki Yoab o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Entopolos inkilani inyi, nirrotianana ilkuniyiani, ninchirishiri te dukuya Abna.” Nesujaa olaiguanani Daudi ilo sanduku otii osesen.

English: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Benchamen naa: Bela, o Becher, o Ashbel, o Gera, o Naaman, o Ehi o Rosh, o Mupin, o Huppin o Ard

English: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
Masaai: Aimeishoro doi iyiook endaa mainosa nikiok iokisho?

English: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
Masaai: Ore pee einosaa ilo rorei te Perga, nedoyio aapuo Italia;

English: Concerning the words of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
Masaai: Ore ti alo isiaaitin e tung'ana, ore to rorei lino, natapaasha nanu nkoitoi oo larruok.

English: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu Olaitoriani amu atii atua osina; etimitari nkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina, o ltau lai o sesen lai sii.

English: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
Masaai: Aatoning'oyie nanu iyie te ning'oto e nkiok, kake ore tena kata naadolita too nkonyek aainei.

English: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
Masaai: Naa te netii oltung'ani le seriani ine netum ninye eseriani inyi, naa te nemetii, neshukokino intae eseriani inyi.

English: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel o le Yuda ootii nkanas e Yuda neyau sii ninche erubata e tomon oo nkishu o nkerra, o ntokitin apa naaitisinyaki neiteng'elakini Olaitoriani Enkai enye, neirragieki ninche aasot too lturrurri.

English: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee eidip Olaitoriani Yesu airorie ninche, neilepieki aaya shumata, neton te nkaina e tatene e Nkai.

English: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
Masaai: Enyaaka olameyu ajing enkop leme olapa ameyu le nkata e Abraham. Nelo Isaak Gera enetii Abimelek olaiguanani loo Lfilisti.

English: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Kaae neitisiny ate ilapolosak o Lawi, pee etum aayau osanduku lo Laitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ina kishomi teine nejing'ieki o metabaiki ine enkiting'oto olgoriet liatua leina kishomi naa intemat onom.

English: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
Masaai: Nintoki taa airriwaa oltung'ani meshomo enkop pooki aosh entarumpeta aitadar te nkolong e tomon o lari liopishana; ore teina olong o lning'o lo sotua niosh entarumpeta aitadar tiatua enkop ino pooki.

English: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
Masaai: enkaraki apa nataasa Daudi mbaa supati too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitu ninye eibelekenya te pooki toki naitanapa ninye Olaitoriani, too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye, meteleku ake te mbae naipirta Uria ilo le Hiti.

English: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ootuata to lmeitai naa nkalifuni tomon oong'uan o iip naapishana, metii lekua ootuata te siaai e Kora.

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
Masaai: Naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naidapashaki ninche iloshon naidapashaa ninche too nkuapi.

English: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
Masaai: Ore naa taata iwa iloing'ok oopishana olmeregeshi oopishana, nilo enetii osinka lai Yoab, nilo aitayu teine te nkaraki kewan ino olasar opejori; pee kiomonoki osinka lai Yoab, amu kang'amaa enkomono enye nemaaitaas nanu iyie terisioroto emodai ino; amu eitu iro te nanu ina nasipa anaa enairoro osinka lai Yoab.”

English: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Usi: Israhia. Ore ilayiok le Israma naa: Mikael, o Obadia, o Yoel, o Ishia, lelo pokira imiet, naa iltung'ana kituaak pooki.

English: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
Masaai: Te nenyorraa oltung'ani aas eyieunoto e Nkai, keyiolou ineina kiteng'enare, te naa ke Nkai eing'uaa aashu te naa ai te nkitoria kewan ai airo.

English: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
Masaai: Ng'ura mewang doi ninye olapa nemewang'an aasila ilakir te dukuya ninye.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tena kata naa kashukoki Yakobo imayianat enyena, natum olng'ur te nkaji pooki e Israel; naaku oloota olom te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati.

English: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompense of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
Masaai: Ore too lng'anayio loo rorei lenyena, neitaraposhi oltung'ani too supati, ore esiaai oo nkaik oltung'ani nerrinyokino ninye.

English: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiteru aaranyisho neisis Olaitoriani, nerasaki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Amon, o Moab o lo ldoinyio le Seir, laa ninche apa ooetuo aagilunore Yuda, neaku eishieki ninche.

English: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina ilanyor amu kuna iyanyitata entonyok naa pee einepu ninye intae miaatata entibili anaa entiyoto, niserianana.

English: And thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that is among you.
Masaai: ning'idayu iyie te nena pooki supati nikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino o lmarei lino, iyie o Lawi o ilo tung'ani omoni otii atua intae.

English: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
Masaai: Ele apa olasar le nkitisinyata te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, te ina olong apa natubukokoki eilata aaitisiny, oing'uaa ilarikok le Israel: isaanini tomon o are e nkosholai, o ngirran tomon o are e nkosholai, o nkijikoni tomon o are e sahabu,

English: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
Masaai: nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa oloing'ang'e le keper, oimua shumata lukuny enye; ore pee eitashe aaitirring'a neshuk inaipuko enye.

English: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooitoki aaun ilng'oborri aatashare ninye naa olosho le Isaakar, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Isaakar naa Natanel olayioni le Suar,

English: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ootuunokoki enkulupuoni sidai, naa lelo ooning ilo rorei neiruk nepik iltauja neiu ilng'anayio maa tomoniuni, maa ntomoni ile, maa iip.”

English: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
Masaai: Iyieu nitumore oltung'ani kitok? Iyaki ninye enkishooroto naa kelelek itum ninye.

English: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
Masaai: Neisik Yepta aing'uaa ilalashera lenyena, nelo abik te nkop e Tob; neiturrurrokino iltung'ana le pesho Yepta, nepuo aarisho te nebo ninye.

English: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
Masaai: Naibelekenya nanu nadou to ldoinyo, napik nena soito atua ilo sanduku laitobira; naa ine taata etii, anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.

English: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
Masaai: amu ninye oitamanyua too naaiposha, neitasheyie too lkejek.

English: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore anaa enaing'or nkonyek oo sinkan olkitok lenye, anaa enaing'or nkonyek enkaisiaayiani enkaina e eina naitore ninye, neijia etiu nkonyek ang eing'or Olaitoriani Enkai ang, o metaba anaa neing'urrie ninye iyiook.

English: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
Masaai: kake ore ina kurma tenelakuni to lari le Yubilii, neaku sinyati to Laitoriani, ore anaa enkurma naishoruno, keaku olapolosani ninye olopeny.

English: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
Masaai: Ahitub menye le Sadok naa Sadok menye le Shalum,

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kayaki nanu shumata Yuda o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem nena natudung'oko nanu ninche; enkaraki nairorie nanu ninche neitu ninche ening, aipoto nanu ninche neitu ninche eirukisho.”

English: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
Masaai: Nejoki likae, “Tusujuaki nanu.” Kake etiaka, “Lo Kitok, nchooki ang'as alo anukaa papa.”

English: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
Masaai: Ore oloitasheiki ntamesin naa Obil le Ishmael; ore oloitasheiki isirkon lipong'a naa Yehedia le Meronot. Ore oloitasheiki Illuat oo nkerrai naa Yasis le Hagrit.

English: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
Masaai: Neiturrurru Musa olorere pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli nejoki ninche, “Kuna ninche ntokitin naaitanapa intae Olaitoriani entaas.

English: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Ore oltung'ani otonyorra enturore neitoki anang silig, nemeishiaakino enkitoria e Nkai.”

English: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
Masaai: pee etum eishoi nasuju aaitayiolo ninche nena kera neton meino, nedumunye ninche aaliki nkera enye,

English: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
Masaai: Etoiwuo Abraham Isaak, neiu Isaak Yakobo, neiu Yakobo Yuda o lalashera lenyena;

English: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
Masaai: amu ore ena kerai ai ketua apa, nenyaaka apiu.’ Neimina apa, nenyaakaki aatum.

English: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
Masaai: Ore peyie ening olkitok lenye lelo rorei o oiroro enkitok enye, “Neijia aaikuna osinka lino.” Neiyupuyup engoro enye.

English: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Too lkeek ootaaniki ine kitiika iyiook nkinantani ang.

English: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
Masaai: Naaitoki ake ajoki nanu, “Intoki ake adol kulie tabo olminong naasita ninche.”

English: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
Masaai: Aime ele Daudi, oshi ilo oranyakino maate too sinkolioitin ejo: ‘Etaara Saul inkalifuni enyena, near Daudi nkalifuni tomon enyena!’ ”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, o Telhasha, o Kerub, o Adan, o Imer, hoo neitu apa ninche eidim aaibalie nkajijik oo loo menye anaa enetii ntipati enye, tenaa keitipat ninche Isirael:

English: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
Masaai: naa aing'ae oyiolo te naa keaku oltung'ani ng'en arashu olmodai. Naa keaku ake oloitore nena pooki natanyamalaka aasishore eng'eno ai nagut tiabori enkolong. Ore sii ninye ena naa enepesho.

English: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
Masaai: Eyauaki enkosholai naidong'i aaitung'uaa Tarshish, neyauni sahabu aaitung'uaa Ufas. Esiaai oltung'ani arriyia ninche o enoo nkaik olaitobirani le sahabu; ore nkilani enye naa pilei o sinteti; esiaai oo ltung'ana arriyiak pooki.

English: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
Masaai: “Kaji naa doi eing'uaa engeno nagut? Naa koree ewueji ening'unoto?

English: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
Masaai: Ilo malaika laaitajeuo nanu te pooki torroni, tamayiana kuna ayiok; Naa te ninche inchoo enkarna ai meipoti, tenebo enkarna oo loo papa Abraham o Isaak; Naa inchoo ninche ebulu aaku ilororani tiatua ena kop pooki.”

English: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Miureisho; amu kaaitodol nanu esupatisho te nkaraki papaai lino Yonatan, naa kaashukoki iyie enkop pooki e Saul papaai lino; nidaa iyie te mesa ai anaake.”

English: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
Masaai: Eroroki ilarikok linyi pooki o lelo sinyat pooki. Eiroroki intae ilooing'uaa Italia.

English: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
Masaai: Eitokitokie ninye eng'uton anaa emoti; neitotiu enaiposha anaa emoti e ilata.

English: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
Masaai: Nikibau iyiook Yerusalem nikibik teine nkolong'i uni.

English: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
Masaai: Ore te neiro oltung'ani aisinani, naa keomonisho to sayia, kake ore olkarsis newal te ng'olon.

English: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
Masaai: naa te netaa eitu eitopiuni Kristo, naa pesho ele kilikuai likinosu, naa pesho sii ninye enkirukoto inyi.

English: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Kora, “Entoning' taata, intae ilayiok le Lawi!

English: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
Masaai: lelo oojo maishoo iltung'ana laainei erikino enkarna ai te nena kidetidetat enye naa ninche ejokino maate, anaa apa enatorikine loo menye enkarna ai tenkaraki Baal?

English: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
Masaai: enchopo enkewan ng'ejuk, naitayioki enyaanyukie Enkai ti atua esupatisho nasipa o te sinyatisho.

English: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
Masaai: Nebatata ninche too nkomomi enye, nejo, “Na Ai, na Ai ooltauja le pooki naishu, keas oltung'ani obo eng'oki nigorokino eumata pooki?”

English: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
Masaai: Neaku ajoki taata intae, maaraa ninche aipang'ie te dukuya intae; kake keaku ninche ilmang'ati te intae, naa keaku nkaitin enye orreshet te intae.”

English: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
Masaai: Kintodol iyie nanu enkoitoi e nkishui; ore enitii iyie, netii eng'ida nabore, ore enkaina ino e tatene netii ntokitin sidain ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
Masaai: Amu ore ninye netiu anaa ilo limikiyeu to ltau kijoki ninye, “Inosa doi niok!” Kake metii oltau lenye te nebo iyie.

English: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
Masaai: “Te lusie ninye eturumishe, neishir ng'otonye e Sisera erumisho te lusie, ‘Kainyoo pee eimutie engarri enye oo mbartan eitu elotu? Kainyoo pee eimutie oltoilo loo nkejek oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan?’

English: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
Masaai: Kake etaa Olaitoriani osempewuet lai, etaa Enkai ai endapidapoi e sarunoto ai.

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Te naanyor oltung'ani nanu, keibung ororei lai, naa kenyorru Papa ninye, naa aikipuonu enetii ninye nikimany nebo o ninye.

English: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ainyoo atemaki kulo tung'ana le kuna olong'i? Kainyoo enyaanyukie?

English: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, mintoki iyie agira; migira nemintirring'a, Iyie Enkai!

English: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yoab:

English: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
Masaai: Neitayu Yakobo ing'usidin naashal too lkeek oonyaanyukie olporokuai, o seki o siteti nekinyu nkopit e oriong te nena keek metaa kelio ing'udisin eibor.

English: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
Masaai: Ore ina kata earisho, naatung'uayioki aa nanu ake, nabatata te nkomom ai aishir, “Aha Olaitoriani Enkai! Indaikie iyie ilekunot pooki le Israel tembukunoto engoro ino napi te Yerusalem?”

English: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto, etaa keye, etamayiana Yakobo ilayiok le Yosef, eigarakino ninye elukunya e ntirma enye eirrugo aseremisho.

English: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
Masaai: Te naailepieki nanu te nkop nayietu iltung'ana pooki enatii.”

English: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
Masaai: Mikintokini aajo enkarna Abram, kake keaku aikiji enkarna ino Abraham amu aaitaa iyie menye loo lororani too loshon.

English: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Nemuel, olmarei loo le Nemuel; ile Yamin, olmarei loo le Yamin, ile Yakin, olmarei loo le Yakin;

English: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
Masaai: Kake tenetoni lelo tipot te wueji nebo nemeponari naa enkiporoi ake oltudutai, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo meiduruk.

English: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.
Masaai: Neaku emipuny intae aadung'oki likae enkiguana eng'or enkata, o meeu Olaitoriani. Ninye olotu aitupuku nkisudorot e naimin meetu enewang, nebolu iyieunot oo ltauja loo ltung'ana. Te ina kata kenya etum pooki tung'ani enkisisa naing'uaa Enkai.

English: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.
Masaai: iyanyunyu naa o metubulu? Eipalipala intae meyami intae. A-a, ntoyie aainei, amu keme oleng te nanu te nkaraki intae, nchere aatigilunore nanu enkaina o Laitoriani.”

English: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
Masaai: Eshipa oltung'ani laaning nanu, oing'or anaake nchomito aainei, laanyu too mbat oo nkutukie oo nkajijik aainei.

English: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
Masaai: Mikincho nanu maawa oloirrag le nkare, anaa aaijoo nanu ina guton, anaa aagamaa engumoto.

English: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Lawi: Gershom, o Kohat, o Merari.

English: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak o Lawi apa ootii atua Israel pooki, neing'uaa ninye too wuejitin pooki apa neetii ninche.

English: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Masaai: o Maknadebai, o Sheshai, o Sherai

English: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
Masaai: Nimipuopuo aasujaa olkerreti leilo orere laaraa nanu te dukuya intae, amu etaasa apa ninche kuna baa pooki naibayie nanu ninche.

English: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.
Masaai: “Naa ore iyie Esra te risioroto eina ng'eno nagut e Nkai ino niata te nkaina ino, tegelu ilooiguanare o larishak oorish iltung'ana to lkerenket pooki otii lido kekun olkeju, ore lelo pooki naa ilooyiolo nkitanapat Enkai ino: ore lelo lemeyiolo nkitanapat ninteng'en.

English: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
Masaai: Netua apa Samuel neidipa Israel pooki aaishiraki ninye nenukaa ninye te Rama, te nkanasa enye kewan. Netaarayie apa Saul lelo aisi le yiolounoto o lasakutok meshomo te ina kop.

English: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Satu, naa Shekania olayioni le Yehasiel, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa iip uni.

English: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
Masaai: Nejoki menye le ina kitok, “Kajo apa eimba ninye oleng naisho ninye ilo apa liboitare. Aimesidai ina anashe enye kiti alang ninye? Aatoomono iwa ninye te rishata e nkae.”

English: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
Masaai: Ing'oru isuma te mbuku o Laitoriani; meetae hoo nabo e kuna nemelo aaku; nemeetae ake enemelotu eboitare enkae. Amu enkutuk o Laitoriani naitanapishe, naa Enkiyang'et enye naiturrurro pooki.

English: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
Masaai: Neijia etiu enkirukoto openy, te nemeeta siaitin, ketua.

English: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
Masaai: Kepuonu iltung'ana ine eeta nkai o mbaa amu keaku enkop pooki entim oo lkiku;

English: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
Masaai: Nelaikino aaibung'a ninye etii olorere te nena naatejo; kake eing'asiate ninche te nena naawalu negira.

English: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
Masaai: “Te neyieu oltung'ani newuasa nchoo eaku Olaitoriani ewuasare.”

English: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana le Israel aaishir te dukuya Olaitoriani o metaa teipa; neikilikuanishore Olaitoriani, “Eikingil iyiook aaluakino olarrabal aarare ilalashera lang lelo le Benchamen?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Elepa enchom entaarare ninche.”

English: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
Masaai: Ilooudoo ilkulenye, neipopong'a to lwuasa, iloonyor esikar alang enanyor Enkai.

English: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
Masaai: Eeta apa ntare kumok o luaat oo nkishu, olmarei sapuk ometaa etoduakita Ilfilisti olom.

English: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Embung'a intae isabatoni aainei niyanyititi emanyisho ai sinyati. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
Masaai: pee eitodolu nchere eisupat Olaitoriani; ninye endapidapoi ai, nemetii entorroni atua ninye.

English: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neliki Musa iltung'ana le Israel pooki toki anaa ake enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
Masaai: Inchere ore enkisulata eilo torrono naa dorrop, ore enchipai e ilo lemeeta Enkai naa enkiti kata?

English: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
Masaai: Te nkutuk ai nanu aibalunye nkiguanat pooki naaing'uaa enkutuk ino.

English: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho anaa ake te nkaji e Nkai. Neing'oru ilapolosak kituaak, o lasirak o ltung'ana kituaak le ilo orere pee eidaikie ninye;

English: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
Masaai: Nedumunye teine aapuo teine wueji netii ninye te nebo ntoyie are oo layiok lenyena, neibung enkoitoi aapuo enkop e Yuda.

English: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
Masaai: Eikirriwaki iyie Olaitoriani olosho likilotu aarare eing'uaa enelakua, eing'uaa eneiting'ie enkop, olosho oneneng anaa olmotonyi olo ti ai, ilo osho limiyiolo iyie enkutuk enye.

English: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
Masaai: Naa ena ninye enkitanapata enkiduruk enye teilo supetai oruko: teneruko ilo supetai lenye aashu tenetudung'e, naa enkiduruk ake te ninye.

English: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
Masaai: Ore naa taata mbalunye too nkiyiaa oo ltung'ana, tejo, ore pooki ng'ae otureishe neikirikira, nchoo ninye eshuko alo ang.’ ” Netem Gideon ninche, neshuko iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oare, neleku iltung'ana tomon.

English: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
Masaai: netii olperere lo lasar le nkorropil le sahabu o ilo sanduku losotua omura pooki alole te sahabu, netii atua ilo moti e sahabu natii mana, o enapa ng'udi e Aron natubulakita mbenek, o lapa soito lo sotua;

English: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
Masaai: o layiok le Keros, o layiok le Siaha, o layiok le Padon,

English: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Sebulon, naa Gadiel olayioni le Sodi;

English: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilarikok modook oojo, ‘Te nenyayie oltung'ani enkaji e Nkai olmumai neme toki; kake te nenyayie olmumai sahabu e nkaji e Nkai neen ilo mumai.’

English: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
Masaai: Nelak lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aaitorioo, neitoip ilo orika lo lng'ur too naipuko enye eing'ura inkomomi enye maate, neing'or inkomomi e lelo kerubi ilo orika lo lng'ur.

English: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king's matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
Masaai: Newaliki Ilkaldayo olaiguanani aajoki, “Meetae hoo oltung'ani te nkop oidim aitabai ena yieunoto o laiguanani; amu meetae aekata olaiguanani kitok aashu ogol oikilikuanua embae naaijo ena too loibonok pooki o too lasakutok, o too Lkaldayo.

English: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
Masaai: Neitoki sii aiger iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo magil ooing'uaa Isiraeli te shekeli iip nabo e nkosholai.

English: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
Masaai: Nelo ninye asujaa ilo tung'ani le Nkai neinepu etonita te ntonata olchani, oji olmaloni; nejoki ninye, “Eiyie doi oltung'ani le Nkai oing'uaa Yuda?” Nejoki ninye, “Ee nanu.”

English: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ieki sii Maaka ng'otonye meitoki aaku enkaiguanani enkaraki naata apa enkitanyaanyukoto olminong apa naitobirakaki Ashera, nesulaki Asa ina kitanyaanyukoto enkop nepejoo to erata le Kedron.

English: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile easi esiaai kake ore enkolong e naapishana naa sabato e nkiyeng'iyeng naitisinyi, sinyati to Laitoriani; ore oltung'ani oas pooki siaai te nkolong e sabato neari metua.

English: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
Masaai: Ore olng'anayioi leilo supat naa olchani le nkishui, ore enemetii euriata oo nkitanapat neiwuang'ie enkishui oo lkumok.

English: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani e nkosholai naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni enkiroishi enye, o engirra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, ebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata aaitaa olasar le ntapa;

English: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
Masaai: Ore osinka obo lo Lapolosani Kitok alashe le ilo otundung'oyie Petero enkiok, nejo, “Keitu duoo aadol to lokeri te nebo ninye?”

English: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
Masaai: Aainyo doi pee ijojo meirukoyu te intae nchere keitopiu Enkai ilootuata?

English: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
Masaai: “Iyie ena nainosa osina, ena natara olkutati neitu eitagoli, ng'ura, kairragie nanu isoito linono aitobiraki, naitobir ilkitamanyunot linono too ltoto oogol enkinyang'a ooji safira.

English: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
Masaai: Neiroshiu Bilhah neiki Yakobo olayioni.

English: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
Masaai: kake eibelekenyi ake aaitaduar endaa enye te nkoshoke, edua naleng anaa enduaran e pooki sayiet.

English: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
Masaai: Asa taa doi iyiololo ntae iltung'ana torrok, aaisho nkera inyi ntokitin sidain, kebaa na aitulus Papa linyi otii keper aisho Enkiyang'et Sinyati lelo oomon ninye?”

English: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ntokitin uni nanu aaisho; tegelu nabo te ninche, pee aatum aitaasa iyie.’ ”

English: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie enkata, neyooki olaitasheikinoni le naisho oo sabibu lo laiguanani le Misiri tenebo olapejoni loo mukateni o laiguanani, aaitagor olkitok lenye ilo aiguanani le Misiri.

English: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
Masaai: Kake ore pee itumutumu aatayiolo aajo, eeta Enkerai e Tung'ani engolon te nkop napalakinye iltung'ana ng'ok,” nejoki ilo maima, “Inyo, tudumu erruat ino, shomo ang.”

English: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
Masaai: nejoki olaiguanani Natan ilo oiboni, “Ng'ura taata, abikito nanu te nkaji oo ltarakua, kake ore osanduku le Nkai netonita ti atua olng'obor.”

English: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: neitobir olapa o lakir meitoria enkewarie, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena negoro olaiguanani nerasu oleng te ngoro neitanapisho nchere ore lelo tung'ana pooki ang'eni le Babilon neidaikieki.

English: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Mikal, “Te dukuya Olaitoriani laa ninye apa laategelua te shumata papaai lino, o te shumata enkaji enye pooki naagelu nanu aitaa kitok te shumata Israel, iltung'ana lo Laitoriani - naa kashipa nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
Masaai: Naa kelo Olaitoriani aidapashaki intae iloreren, niakuku kuti tiatua lelo oshon ooreu intae Olaitoriani.

English: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Masaai: Ketumo enyorrata nauno o esupatisho, neng'ututa esupatisho o eseriani te nebo.

English: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
Masaai: Meitasheyie oltung'ani intorrok, kake ore intona eilo supat nemeigutieki aekata.

English: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
Masaai: Eitamanaki intae esuntai, etamanaki iyiook aamuat to ngudi etoosho ninche eseder o Laitoriani le Israel.

English: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
Masaai: Ore ilo otonita te ine neikununo anaa osoit oji Yaspa, o ltoto oonyori ooji karnelian nemanita olokirrai ilo orika oikununo anaa ltoto ooji emerald.

English: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
Masaai: Naa kelotu aaku teneibung ninche aakurraki nkoitoi oo ltung'ana laainei, pee enya olmumai te nkarna ai, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,’ anaa sii apa enaiteng'ena ninche iltung'ana laainei meinosa olmumai te Baal, naa keshetuni ninche tiatua iltung'ana laainei.

English: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
Masaai: “Atoduaa tena kewarie naa ing'ura, oltung'ani okedito embarta nanyokie! Negira duoo aitashe tiatua ilkeek oo nyori ooji mihadasi tiatua oyerata ore tesiadi ninye netii kulie bartan pilei, o naanyokie o naaibor.

English: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka obo loo lbarnot Abigail, enkitok e Nabal, “Ng'ura, Eirriwua Daudi ilkiliku ooing'uaa ong'ata meetu aairoroki olkitok lang, kake etamoro ninche.

English: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, lalashera laainei, ore te nkaraki nawuasare intae Ilkiristiano laaijo nanu, kaye nanu anaa ake.

English: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
Masaai: Tenebo nena sabatoni o Laitoriani o tenebo nkishorot inyi o tenebo lelo muma linyi pooki o tenebo nena kishorot inyi pooki o lpela ninchosho intae Olaitoriani.

English: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
Masaai: Nejo esiamo, “Yesu ele, oloiboni le Nkai le Nasaret e Galilaya.”

English: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Nchoo nkaji e Aron ejo, “Ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
Masaai: Pee etum aitonyorra iltauja lang kewan enye pee kipuo too nkoitoi enyena pooki, nikimbung nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena, o nkiguanat enyena, apa naaitanapa ninye loo papa.

English: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
Masaai: Neshetu Musa olperere lo lasar nejo enkarna enye, Olaitoriani ninye enanka ai

English: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
Masaai: Ore pee eitopiuni too lootuata nedamu ilooiteng'eni lenyena inchere etiaaka neijia, neiruk ilkigerot, o rorei oiroro Yesu.

English: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
Masaai: Ore ilooinining'ito pooki, neing'asia te ng'eno enye o too naawalu.

English: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
Masaai: Kake einyo Petero neipirri alo enkurare; neirrugo aing'or atua, nedol lkarash le kitani eirrag oopeny; nerrinyo alo ang eing'asia te nena naatotiwuo.)

English: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
Masaai: “Naa tenepuonu kuna tokitin pooki shumata iyie, emayianata o ldeket, kuna nairragie nanu te dukuya iyie nidamu iyie ninche tiatua lelo oshon likiterewa Olaitoriani Enkai ino,

English: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Entoning irorei laainei: Tenaa ketii oloiboni atua intae, ore nanu Olaitoriani makewan naitayiolo kewan ai ninye te nduata nairorie ninye te nkidetidet.

English: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
Masaai: Ninye doi eimakita lkigerot aajo, ‘Nele olkilikuai lai laiturukie te iyie, olaa ninye likintobiraki enkoitoi ino.’

English: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
Masaai: ore lelo oshon pokira oare o ilo pisiai lo losho netang'amutua enjung'ore enye te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, etalita Yeriko, te nkalo o loosaen, te neilepunye enkolong.”

English: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
Masaai: Naa entiaaki Arkipus, “Toduaa ake pee intabaya ina siaai nitang'amua ti atua Olaitoriani.”

English: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
Masaai: Idol oltung'ani arriyia te siaai enye? Keitashe te dukuya ilaiguanak; meitashe te dukuya iltung'ana misili.

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo:

English: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni isiet o iip ile, lelo ooisiaisho te wueji sinyati.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
Masaai: “Neaku, ng'ura kepounu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitoki iltung'ana aajo, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani oitayio iltung'ana le Israel ailepunye te nkop e Misiri,’

English: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
Masaai: Ore to olminong lino pooki o te nkiborra ino oo nkonyek eitu idamu nena olong'i inono e kitisho, ina kata minchopo nira emasipai, itii atua osarge lino.

English: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.
Masaai: Ore Saul o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye neipirri aapuo olarrabal; naa ng'ura, ore ake olalem lo ltung'ani near olikae, netii apa olmilo kitok oleng.

English: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nyaaki inchira tejo, nji Olaitoriani loo lororani; Ekeitoki inkanas aainei aatum dupoto nalus, naa keitoki Olaitoriani aitagol Sion oshoke neigil agelu Yerusalem.

English: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
Masaai: Ing'ura, mepik Enkai osiligi isinyat lenyena, nemesinya keper too nkonyek enyena;

English: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neaku eipang'a apa Musa alo ajoki iltung'ana ilomon lo Laitoriani; neiturrur ninye iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana loo lpayiani loo ltung'ana, neitaman ninche olng'obor.

English: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
Masaai: Kake einuaakita ilapolosak kituaak olorere metejo pee elaakini ninche Barabas.

English: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
Masaai: “Ore anaa naadumu ailepie iyie aitung'uaa nkulukuok, naaitaa iyie olarikoni loo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli, nimbung'a iyie orrekie le Yeroboam, nitorikoko iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok, kintagoro nanu tenkaraki ing'ok enye.

English: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
Masaai: Neipot Yesu ajoki, “Iyiololo aajo, ore laitoriak loo Loreren eitaa ate kituaak, neitoreisho te ngolon.

English: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
Masaai: Iyie Yerusalem, ntukuoi entorroni to ltau lino, pee kitumi aaitajeu keton akenya endamunoto ino torrono tiatua iyie o anu?

English: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
Masaai: Amu meetae oloas ai bae too nkisudorot laa keyieu ninye openy nelioyu aibalayu. Te naa iasita iyie nena baa aibalunye, imbalakinye kewan enkop.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntobira olasurai opi nipik shumata eng'ape; ore ake pooki ng'ae oonyi, te neing'or ninye, nepok.”

English: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
Masaai: amu ore ilkikaunot pooki naa ilaainei; ore apa ina olong natara nanu metuata ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, aitisinyaka nanu kewan ilkikaunot pooki tiatua Israel aa olayioni le tung'ani o le eng'ues; keaku ninche ilaainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.
Masaai: Nejo Yoab, “Maitoki nanu aiturraa enkata aiko nji te nebo iyie.” Neyau ninye iremeta uni te nkaina enye neibitaki ninche oltau le Absalom, eton eishu to lchani.

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Turo, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie enkitamioto enye; Amu etokordutua eyakita ninche olosho olulung'a le Edom, neitu edamu osotua loo lalashera.

English: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
Masaai: keaku keshet ninche nkajijik nemany ninche; neun ilkeek loo lng'anayio neinos ilng'anayio lenye.

English: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
Masaai: nemej ninche enterit anaa olasurai, anaa nkeenta e nkop; nepuonu ninche eikirikira eing'uaa isempewueti lenye; neibelekenyakino ninche to lkirutoto Olaitoriani Enkai ang, neureishoyu ninche te nkaraki iyie.

English: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
Masaai: Neigil ake iltung'ana le Israel aas entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, ina kata eidipa Ehudi atua.

English: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
Masaai: Meisho iyiook endaa errepet te Nkai; nimikilau toki te neitu kinya endaa, nemeeta ae nikitum ti nikinya.

English: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
Masaai: amu ore ina naa elejare naibonoki ninche intae te nkarna ai, eitu nanu airriu ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
Masaai: Tijing'a atua endapidapoi, nilo aisudori ti atua enterit ailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani, nilany ina kitoo e nkisisa enye.

English: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
Masaai: Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie lo tau lai, nimincho kirikino nkitaasat enyena pooki,

English: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
Masaai: Amu enyaaka ninye ashet iwuejitin neeika apa neetigila papaai lenye Hesekia auroo. Neshetaki Baal ilperereni loo lasarri, neitobir Ashera, neserem olorora pooki le shumata, neisiaai ninche.

English: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
Masaai: Enaikash te negeluni enkarna sidai, alang enkarsisisho sapuk, naa ore omom nelang enkosholai o sahabu.

English: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
Masaai: Nejoki olaitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu e Farao, “Atadamua taata inkitarruorrot aainei.

English: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: Teneinosi pooki toki oo nkiri eilo asar lenye le seriani te nkolong e uni, ore ilo oishorua ilo asar nemeng'amuni, nemeikenakini ninye ilo asar; neaku ilo asar olminong ore ilo oinos nenap ninye enkitarruorroto enye.

English: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
Masaai: Neitoki engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyup te nkaraki Israel, nepik Daudi endamunoto te nkaraki ninche, ejo, “Shomo nkena Israel o Yuda.”

English: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
Masaai: Neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani ejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyaka iyie entorroni shumata ena oliai apa naa ninye aewuo airragaa, aar enkayioni enye metua?”

English: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eyooki aainyototo iltung'ana le Ashdod, ng'ura, etusulari Dagon te nkomom aosh enkop te dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani. Neya ninche Dagon neinyaaki ewueji enye.

English: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
Masaai: nera ing'apeta enye tikitam naa tikitam nena kitotoneta o suyai, kake ore ilala oo lolo le nena ng'apeta o nena keek enye naa ine enkosholai.

English: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
Masaai: Nadumu eng'udi ai naji “Empiris,” nagil ninye pee atum atujuto ilo sotua apa oitayio Olaitoriani too loshon pooki.

English: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
Masaai: kake etegelua Enkai nena naamoda te nkop pee eitukurru nena naagol, etegelua lelo oojo enkop emodai pee eitukurru lelo oogol.

English: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
