Masaai: Esotu nkera ilkeek, neinok loo menye enkima, neipurj nkituaak enkurma, pee eitobiraki imukateni enkaiguanani e shumata; nebukoki ninche ilasarri ooki kulie aitin, pee aaitagor nanu.

English: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
Masaai: Amaa, ijo kaewuo nanu ena kop metii Olaitoriani aidaikie nainyal? Aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, Shomo taarare ena kop, ninyal ninye.’ ”

English: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
Masaai: Kenya ltung'ana kumok kutukie too mbaa enye e nkishon; ainyoo naa pee manya sii nanu kutuk?

English: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yakobo olkilikuai aipotu Raheli tenebo Lea meetu ina ong'ata natii ntare enyena,

English: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
Masaai: Naainepu Enkiyang'et te nkolong o Laitoriani, naning oltoilo kitok te siadi nanu laaijo ole ntarumpeta,

English: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
Masaai: irorei le ilo oning irorei le Nkai, ilo odol enduata o Laidimani, otabatate, kake meimulumul nkonyek enyena:

English: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bani naa iip ile o artam o are.

English: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
Masaai: Neing'asia Ilyahudi nejo, “Kaji eiko pee eyiolo ele tung'ani sirat, neitu ae kata eiteng'eni?”

English: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
Masaai: Neaku etiaka Musa iltung'ana le Israel pee eibung pasaka.

English: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
Masaai: Taranyaki Olaitoriani na kop pooki, mbalunye enjeunoto enye nkolong'i pooki.

English: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
Masaai: “Aimetii embae te idia alo iyie?” Neipot Yonatan enkayioni, “Tasiooi, isarisara, miton.” Neaku etasotuo enkayioni e Yonatan mbaa, nelotu enetii olkitok lenye.

English: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
Masaai: Amu te naa kaitamio intae (hoo te naainosua) te mpalai ai, nemairridu, amu adol ajo eitamio intae ina palai, hoo te naa te nkiti rishata ake;

English: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
Masaai: “Ore ina natii indamunot inyi nemeaku ae kata ina damunoto, ‘Matotiu anaa iloreren anaa iloshon loo nkuapi, nikiserem inkeek o soito.’

English: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, nejo ninye, “Milep alo; shomo tamanai iimu te siadi, nilotu enetii ninche te nkishiaakinoto oo lkeek adoru.

English: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Masaai: Etorrinyote pooki aapuo siadi etarruoitie pooki; meetae hoo obo oas esidai, a-a, metii hoo obo.

English: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
Masaai: “Tenairo nemeish emion ai, naa amaa tenangiri, kebaa emion naaing'uaa nanu?

English: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
Masaai: Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani ti alo Israel, neishooyo ninye ninche apik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye nemiraki ninche engolon e lelo mangati oomanita ninche, o metaa meekure eidim aairisha ilmang'ati lenye.

English: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Tera nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Mitka.

English: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
Masaai: Enkolong nashetieki isunta inono! Ore teina olong naa kepuoi aaitalala ilpolosien aaponaa.

English: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
Masaai: o lalashera lenye, o Shebania, o Hodia, o Kelita, o Pelaia, o Hanan,

English: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
Masaai: Emayamata maate, enchoo iyiook intoyie inyi; niyaya sii intae intoyie ang.

English: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
Masaai: Ore erripata e abori e ilo kila oodo neripakini ilonyek oopurupurana too usin pusi, o morijo ompilei o katani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
Masaai: Ore imotonyi pooki o loing'ang'e, neitobira isinkin enye too lng'osil lenyena sapuki; ore abori ilng'osil lenyena netii ing'uesi pooki e ong'ata, neisho teina aaiu nkera enye; ore abori oloip lenye, netii iloreren kituaak.

English: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
Masaai: Eipurrokito ilng'atunyo ninye, eipurrokito aabuaku. Neitaa ninche enkop enye mitil; neidaaitie nkanas enyena, metii iloomanya.

English: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: ‘Ore te sipata, anaa enatoduaa ngole osarge le Nabot, o sarge loo layiok lenyena Olaitoriani ojo kaitalaku nanu te iyie tene wueji.’ Ore naa taata iwa iyie ninye nilo anang'aa ninye teine wueji te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani.”

English: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
Masaai: Itaasa sii iyie esiaai enkiborra oo nkonyek too Lmisiri, tenebo lelo litashare oobore eng'uarrata, niponaa enkiborra oo nkonyek nikintagor nanu.

English: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
Masaai: Amu eyiolo lelo ooishu inchere keyooki aaye, kake meyiolo ilootuata ae toki, nemeeta ae laakinoto; kake ore endamunoto enye neimin.

English: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
Masaai: Ore pee eitupuku oloirirua, neiro ilo lemeiro apa, neing'asia esiamo nejo, “Eitu ae kata edoli ena ti atua enkop e Israel.”

English: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.
Masaai: Neilepie olaiguanani aisho enkitoo Shadrak o Meshek o Abednego to lkerenket le Babilon.

English: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
Masaai: Intalakuanana intae enkolong e ntorroni, niyauu aaitataanu entonata o larrabal?

English: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, epuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa enkalo e moikuape; erretena olosho magilani o laiguanak kumok too wuejitin neelakua enkop.

English: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
Masaai: Amu eeniki ilolan sapuki ooiroishi aaiteleiki iloilila loo ltung'ana; nemeyieu ninche neigusie to lkimojino lenye.

English: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
Masaai: Amu kelak apa lelo kerubi inaipuko enye te shumata ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua, neaku keitoip lelo kerubi ilo sanduku lo sotua, o mbokishi enyena.

English: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
Masaai: Naa nji enkuna te nirorokiki ninye: ‘Metaa enino eseriani, metaa eseriani ene nkaji ino, metaa eseriani ene lelo pooki liata iyie.

English: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Betlehem Efrata, iyie ora kiti too lgilat le Yuda, iyie epukunye ilo olotu te nkaraki nanu, ilo olo aaku Olaitoriani loo Siraeli; ilo laa ore enkiterunoto enye naa e niopa, ebaiki nkolong'i e moitie.

English: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
Masaai: Enteng'enuoto melej ake intae Hesekia ejo, “Kelo Olaitoriani akordu iyiook.” Keetae ae kata enkai oo loshon natokordua enkop aitung'uaa enkaina o laiguanani le Asiria?

English: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
Masaai: neishooyo enkop enye aitaa enjung'ore, enjung'ore too ltung'ana lenye loo siraeli.

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, o lker obo lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;

English: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
Masaai: Ore te kulo naa Daniel, o Hanania, o Mishael, o Asaria lo losho le Yuda.

English: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
Masaai: Neaku etushukunye olaiguanani alotu Yordan; nelotu Yuda Gilgal anang'are olaiguanani neriku olaiguanani aaitalang'u Yordan.

English: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
Masaai: Nimijojo oltung'ani papa te nkop, amu obo Papa linyi otii keper.

English: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
Masaai: Amu ipuopuo intae aalang Yordan, nipuopuo aaya ina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani; naa tenindipidipi aawaita nimanyimanya,

English: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
Masaai: Emiaatayie esile oltung'ani hoo obo, ae neme ene nyorrata maate; amu ore ilo onyor ole latia enye neitabayie nkitanapat.

English: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat neyiolo sipat eilo aisinani; ore oltung'ani torrono nemening'u ine ng'eno.

English: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
Masaai: Ore to lari li okuni le nkitoria o laiguanani Belshasa nadol nanu enduaata eare.

English: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
Masaai: Nepuku Isaak alo ong'ata adamisho teipa, neraposhu inkonyek enyena, ngura nedol intamesin naapuonu.

English: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:
Masaai: Neitoki lelo tung'ana pokira oare aadou too ldoinyo, nelang olkeju, nepuo enetii Yoshua olayioni le Nuni; neliki ninye nena pooki naatupukokitio ninche.

English: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
Masaai: Ore ena bae naikilikuanu olaiguanani naa kegol, nemeetae likae oidim aitoduaa ninye olaiguanani meteleku ake nkaitin, naa ore emanyisho enye neme te nebo iloata seseni loo nkiri.”

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, ore ilo oishoru olasar le seriani loo nkishorot enyena aisho Olaitoriani neyaki ninye ina kishoroto enye Olaitoriani; teilo asar loo nkishorunot enyena e seriani.

English: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
Masaai: Torripoki nanu, Olaitoriani, too nkaik e ilo torrono; tagolieki nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal, te lelo ooitobira pee eitapong'oo nkejek aainei.

English: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
Masaai: Kindipa apa aatejo naa kaitoki ake nanu ajo, te naa keetae oltung'ani olikioo kulikae “omon supati” leme lapa litang'amutua, nchoo ilo metaa kediaa.

English: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
Masaai: Ning'il iyie aning irorei lo Laitoriani nimbung nena kitanapat enyena pooki naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong.

English: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu iltung'ana le Siria aagilunore ninye, neomon Elisha Olaitoriani, nejo, “Toosho kulo tung'ana aatoomono, ntamodoo.” Neaku etoosho aitamodok ninche te risioroto e nkomono e Elisha.

English: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
Masaai: Nejur olapolosani ninye, naa tenetii enetukurrunye neibor olchoni lo sesen lenye, neibelekenyate ilpapit leine aaiborru, niewotiote ine wueji

English: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
Masaai: Eroroki Mariamu nataasishe oleng ti atua intae.

English: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.
Masaai: Kake ore te nanu, mme te nkaraki eng'eno ai naata alang pooki ooishu pee eibalunyeki ena kisudoroto te nanu, kake pee etumi aaitayiolo olaiguanani enkibalakinoto enye, pee itum atayiolo indamunot o ltau lino.

English: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
Masaai: Neibelekeny ninye oltau loo ltung'ana le Yuda netiu anaa oltung'ani obo; neaku eirriwaitie ninche ororei enetii olaiguanani ejo, “Tushukunye, o sinkan linono pooki.”

English: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
Masaai: Nepuo apake ntoiwuo enyena Yerusalem to lari ake pooki pee emanu osirua le Pasaka.

English: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
Masaai: O Senan, o Hadasha, o Migdal-gad,

English: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
Masaai: Tenatanya nanu aning enyamali olaisiaayiani lai arashu enkaisiaayiani ai, ore peyie eyau olong'unyung'unyi te nkaraki nanu,

English: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
Masaai: “Shomo, tiaaki Hanania, nji ejo Olaitoriani: itigila iyie nkeek, kake akaitobir nanu te rishata enye isekenke.

English: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
Masaai: Ore nkera e lelo aranyak, neiturrurro too manyishoritin enye naamanita Yerusalem, o too nkang'itie e Netofati;

English: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua, te nebo Israel pooki, aashukunye aapuonu Debir neibung ninye,

English: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
Masaai: Neaku aibelekenye apa nanu nadou to ldoinyo, naa keyupuyup apa ilo doinyo te nkima; ore nena soito are naagueta olning'o lo sotua netii nkaik ainei.

English: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
Masaai: Tawalikiaki nanu tinindim; intobiru irorei linono te dukuya nanu; inyo mbalie enkitashoto ino.

English: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
Masaai: ore ake eyia, milo iyie ashet ina aji, kake olayioni lino likiikini iyie, ninye olo ashet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai.’

English: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
Masaai: Toning'o naa enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye, Olaitoriani Enkai ai. Toning'o enkishirata o enkomono nayau osinka lino dukuya iyie;

English: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
Masaai: Amu ninye eing'uaa naa ninye eimu naa enetii ninye epuo intokitin pooki. Metaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi. Esai.

English: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
Masaai: neme taa olo ltau lino makewan, ajo, kake olo ltau le ilo tung'ani. Ijojo intae, “Oo paa ore elakunoto” ai naa to ltoilo lo ltau le likae eiguanareki?

English: But neither so did their witness agree together.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, eitu eipira ina shakenisho enye.

English: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
Masaai: Nainyototo abolu olanyor lai, nebore inkaik aainei emanoo, neitong ilkimojik laainei teina manoo naruko, aibung inkikeneta e kutuk aji.

English: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
Masaai: Kake ore Nadab o Abihu netuata te dukuya Olaitoriani ina kata apa pee eishoru olasar le nkima nemesinya te dukuya Olaitoriani ti ong'ata e Sinai; nemeeta apa ninche nkera. Neaku Eliesa o Itamar apa ooisiaishote anaa lapolosak te nkata e nkishui e Aron papaai lenye.

English: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
Masaai: Nemipik nkurrot ilukuny enye nemebarn mbat oo lmunyo lenye aashu edung'udung iseseni lenye.

English: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Eliya ajoki ninche, “Tenaa kara nanu oltung'ani le Nkai, nchoo edou enkima naing'uaa shumata nikinos iyie o kulo tung'ana linono pokira onom.” Nedou enkima e Nkai naing'uaa shumata neinos ninye o lelo tung'ana lenyena pokira onom.

English: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
Masaai: pee etum ninche aatipik osiligi lenye Enkai, nemerikino isiaaitin e Nkai, kake pee eibung nkitanapat enyena;

English: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore ina kimeita narripuno te nkarriyiano neenieki ninye, pee eibung ninye, naa te nena tokitin eripuno o te ina arriyiano, te sahabu o usin pusi o morijo o mpilei, o katani napuyiapui napiyaya nashetuno anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth unto heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.
Masaai: iyie, ilo laaiguanani, itubula nigolu. Etubulua enkitoo ino o metabaiki shumata ore enkitoria ino netabaikia lubot e nkop.

English: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki ninche, “Aidipa duoo atoliki intae, neitu ining'ining'i. Kaji etiu pee iyieuu nintokiki ake aaning? Iyieuu sii intae niakuku ilooiteng'eni lenyena?”

English: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena wikii ntomoni ile o are neiwuang'ieki ilo otubukokoki eilata aaput, ilo kitok nemeitoki aata toki, ore lelo tung'ana le ilo kitok olotu neidaikie ina anasa o ewueji sinyati. Kelotu enkiting'oto enye anaa to loirrag le nkarenetii olarrabal o metabaiki enkiting'oto; neibalunyekiemijoonisho.

English: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
Masaai: Neton olaiguanani Usia eeta enkeeya oo lbolot o metua. Naa ore anaa oltung'ani oata enkeeya oolbolot neton te nkaji enye makewan. Amu eiwuang'ieki ninye tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani. Naa Yotam olayioni lenye ninye apa oing'or ntokitin e nkaji o laiguanani, neitore iltung'ana leina kop.

English: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
Masaai: Kake ore te risioroto e nkisiligata enye, kiaanyita iyiook keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk naa atua ninye emanya esupatisho.

English: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
Masaai: Mme intae pooki aimaki. Ayiolo ilo lategelua; kake nchoo eitabari lkigerot oojo, ‘Ore ilo oinosa emukate ai aatudumaka entutunyo enye aagilunore nanu.’

English: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
Masaai: Ore te ngolon e nkitoo ino, nimir lelo liking'orunore; irriwaa engoro ino neyupuyupoki ninche anaa olkujita.

English: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatadalare, neoru ilo kila mugie neishopoki nkilani enyena. Nerik auluo pee epuo aashe.

English: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
Masaai: Aaibukoyioki nanu anaa enkare, netirishate iloik laainei pooki too rubat; netotiwuo oltau lai anaa enkapoi, etoshole oltau lai ti atua olgoo lai;

English: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
Masaai: Niaatata nkolong'i nieniene, o lapaitin, o nkatitin o larin.

English: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
Masaai: Naa ilaiguanak oopishana sii. Netabatatate imiet lenye, netii obo, neton eitu elotu olikae, naa ore te nelotu meeta nchere pee me nkiti kata ake eton.

English: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
Masaai: Ore nkiri eilo asar lenye le seriani le nkishoroto e nashe nenyae teina olong olasar lenye; meisho ninye ae eleku o mekenyu.

English: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
Masaai: Neipid ninche te nchumata eina anasa, nekuet too nchumat oo sunta; neked nkajijik, neim ilusien anaa lapurrok.

English: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
Masaai: nedoyio ninye alo enkaji o laiguanani, atua olgilata lo laigeroni netonita apa lkituaak pooki teine. Elishama ilo aigeroni, o Delaia olayioni le Shemaia, o Enatan olayioni le Akber, o Gemaria olayioni le Shafan, o Sedekia olayioni le Hanania, olkituaak pooki.

English: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
Masaai: Ekairo nanu peyie atum ayagie, ekabol enkutuk ai awalu.

English: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye teine nelo Betel; ore eloito ninye te nkoitoi, nepuonu nkuti ayiok aakueniyie ninye, ejo, “Ilepa shomo iyie olokurro lukunya! Ilepa shomo olokurro elukunya!”

English: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
Masaai: Nejing Yesu enkaji e Nkai nearaa lelo pooki oomirisho o looinyiang'isho aitupuku te nkaji e Nkai neibeloo mesai oo looitawal mpesai o lorikan loo loomir inturkuluni.

English: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
Masaai: Ore Sheba, o Dedan o lbiasharani le Tarshish tenebo inkang'itie enye pooki naa kejoki intae, ‘Iyetuo intae aaibung iyarunot? Inturrurro ilororani linono peyie enap aaya iyarunot, peyie enap aaya enkosholai tenebo sahabu, neya nkishu tenebo imasaa, nenap iyarunot kumok?’

English: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
Masaai: Netaa Yohana oltaa oinuaaki newang, nitonyorraitie intae aang'idakino te nkiti kata ewang'an enye.

English: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
Masaai: Te ninguan ilalashera te kuna kiteng'enat niaaku olaisiaayiani supat le Kristo Yesu, oitubuluaki too rorei le nkirukoto e nkiteng'enare sidai naa ninye iyie itusuja.

English: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore anaa osoit oidong'ishoreki te neiper enkop, neijia etiu iloik lenye eidapasha te nkutuk e nemeneng'a.

English: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
Masaai: Amu etuuno ninche enkijape, naa kepuo ninche aaisampu olkutati.

English: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
Masaai: o nkishu nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o are,

English: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
Masaai: Inkineji iip are, o oloroi tikitam, o supeni e kerra iip are tenebo ilmeregeshi tikitam,

English: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
Masaai: Milej olikae olikae, idolitata aajo ituburushutua enkewan musana o rrekiei lenyena.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Torripo oltoilo lino pee minchir, o nkonyek inono too lkiyioi; amu kelaki esiaai ino, Olaitoriani ojo, naa keshukunye ninche aaing'uaa ina kop olmang'atinta.

English: We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
Masaai: Iyiook ootaa Lmoda te nkaraki Kristo, nitaa intae ng'eni ti atua Kristo! Kishal iyiook; nigoligolo intae! Neyanyiti ninche intae, nemenuni iyiook.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee eshetakini Olaitoriani enkanasa aaigil ebaiki oltalet le Hananel o metabaiki kishomi olpijata.

English: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
Masaai: Ore ilo olo te nkoitoi naitoriori nelo te seriani, kake ore ilo oibelekeny inkoitoi enyena naa ketumi.

English: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
Masaai: Ore irorei pooki le nkutuk ai naa esupatisho; metii entoki nabo namonira anaa enariwuo te ninche.

English: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.
Masaai: Neaku etuunokito ninche Absalom olng'obor te nchumata enkaji; nelo Absalom atua enetii nkapiak e papaai lenye edolita Israel pooki.

English: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka Olaitoriani Israel olmeitai ebaiki tadekenya o metabaiki enkata apa natudung'uoki; neye te ine iltung'ana ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana.

English: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
Masaai: Ore eng'eno oltung'ani ng'en naa pee emusu enkoitoi enye, kake ore emodai oo lmoda naa elejare.

English: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
Masaai: Aatolikioki nanu te nduaata entoki torrono; keisimisho olaisimani, neinyalisho o lainyalani. Ilepa shomo, iyie Elam, irraga kitang'aduaki, iyie Media; ore lelo sinaitin pooki ooyaua ninye kaishie nanu.

English: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore teina kata lelo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto, lelo yararot ootorrinyunye, neishoru ilasarri oopejori aaisho Enkai e Israel, iloing'ok tomon oare tenkaraki Isiraeli pooki o lmeregeshi ntomoni naaudo o ile, o lkuoo le kerra ntomoni naapishana, neitayuni anaa olasar le ng'oki ilkineji tomon oare: ore kuna pooki naa ilasarri oopejokini Olaitoriani.

English: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
Masaai: Nenang'u enkitok nabo nenang'aki osoit le shumata oituutishoreki endukuya e Abimelek, nedany elukunya enye.

English: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
Masaai: Ore naa taata toning'o ena, iyie ena aisikarrani, ena naton eidipakine, ina najo to ltau lino, “Atii nanu, nemetii ae neiijo nanu; maton nanu anaa enkoliai nemeye nkera aainei.”

English: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
Masaai: Neirriwaki ninche ninye iloointeng'eni lenye te nebo le Herode aajoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo ira olasipani nintayiolo ltung'ana; enkoitoi e Nkai te sipata amu miing'or empukunoto o ltung'ani. Toliki naa iyiook.

English: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
Masaai: Kake nanu enchom te Nkiyang'et nimintabaya iyieunot o sesen;

English: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i enyena o sesen etoomonuo Yesu esaisho, nebuaku oleng too lkiyio, esai ilo apa oidim aitajeu te nkeeya, netoning'oki ninye te nkaraki naure ninye Enkai.

English: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
Masaai: Isipat ajoito tiatua Kristo, malejisho nanu; naaishakenoki nanu oltau lai te Nkiyang'et Sinyati,

English: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore ndamunot aainei neme ndamunot inyi, ore nkoitoi aainei neme nkoitoi inyi, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki enkitok enye, “Keton ake imbung akurraki enkirukoto? Ainyoo pee midek Enkai pee itum atua.”

English: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
Masaai: Neiguanate lapolosak kituaak eyieu near sii Lasaro metua.

English: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
Masaai: Emimera te naisho oo sabibu amu emutata e nkishon ina; kake enchoo Enkiyang'et eiput intae,

English: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
Masaai: Neitayu olperere lo lasar le nkorropil too nkeek o lerai; ore enkadoro enye naa entemata nabo naa entemata nabo endapasho, naa kerisioro apa, naa intemat are enkilepata; ore apa imouarak enyena naa entoki nabo o ninye.

English: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
Masaai: Amu ore ake pee aning too nkiyiaa aainei enkiroroto ino, neipid enkerai te nchipai te nkoshoke ai.

English: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
Masaai: Eishoo enaimin metamana ninye, neman ninye nkatampo naairrusha o nkariak naaiturrurro.

English: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
Masaai: Neitoki Senakerib ilo aiguanani le Asiria arrinyo nelo aton te nkang enye te Ninawi.

English: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
Masaai: Ore ilo onyorraa te nkutuk ajo kelaaki olomoni esile, naa kelotu anyamalu te siadi, kake ore ilo oany enyorraa neserian.

English: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
Masaai: Naa kalotu nanu enetii ninye etanaure netashala, nanang'aki ninye atua enkiputukuny; ore iltung'ana ootii te nebo ninye neisik. Naar nanu olaiguanani ake,

English: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Naa keiputaki Enkai pooki olat inyi te risioroto e nkarsisisho enye te nkitoo ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
Masaai: Niyaki ninye papaai lino meinosa peyie kitum atamayiana eton eitu eye.”

English: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
Masaai: amaa te neitu eing'urrie enapa kop musana, kake etalakua Noa eserian ilo alikioroni loo supati te nebo kulikae oopishana, pee eyau oloirrag le nkare shumata enkop oo ltung'ana torrok;

English: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yesu enkaji e ilo oitore enkaji e ntumo nedol ilookut indulen o lorere eilepilep oleng,

English: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
Masaai: olayioni le Kainan, olayioni le Alfasad, olayioni le Shem, olayioni le Noa, olayioni le Lamek,

English: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
Masaai: Ore te lelo supati nintodolu esupatisho ino, ore to ltung'ani lemeeta entioto nintodol esinyatisho ino.

English: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
Masaai: Keitiship ena Olaitoriani alang olkiteng anaa oloing'oni loo mowuarak neeta loisotok.

English: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
Masaai: ntayioki nanu ti atua orreshet oisudoyioki te nkaraki nanu, amu ira iyie esarunoto ai.

English: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
Masaai: Nepuonu Sadukayo enetii, lelo taa oojo eji meetae empiunoto; neikilikuan aajoki,

English: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
Masaai: Neitoki ake alo anaa saa ile, o saa naaudo, neiko ake neijia.

English: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
Masaai: Eitushulaka Efraim kewan iloreren; ore Efraim naa emukate neitu eibelekenyi.

English: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
Masaai: naa te naa kesipa nchere ira iyie olarikoni loo lmodook, nira ewang'an e lelo ootii enaimin,

English: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani ‘Midolidolo intae olkutati anaa enchan, kake ore ele erata pooki naa keiputi enkare, pee itumutumu aatook, intae, o nkishu inyi, o ng'uesi inyi.’

English: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Nanu oyaua olameyu atua nkanas inyi pooki o enkiishunoto oo mukateni too nkajijik inyi pooki, ore ake eyia neitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
Masaai: o Lhifi ole Arki o Lsini, o

English: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
Masaai: Neas iltung'ana le Israel entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, nerikino ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Asherot.

English: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
Masaai: Mikinchoo Enkai enkolielio e keper, tenebo empiron e nkop, tenebo enkisampuare sapuk o enaisho oo sabibu.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu “Enkerai e tung'ani, keidim kulo oik aatopiu?” Nawalaii ajoki, “Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyiolo iyie.”

English: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
Masaai: Neitashe olapolosani ake pooki anaake te siaai enye, eigil aitayu iloshi ake asarri, lemeidim ae kata aawaita ng'ok.

English: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
Masaai: “Itoning'o sii iltung'ana li apa enatiaakaki, ‘Minya olmumai le lejare, kake intabai ilmuma linono to Laitoriani.’

English: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe amu kitawalikia nitaa iyie enjeunoto ai.

English: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
Masaai: Neiput enkuretisho sapuk ina sirit e lelo ooiruko pooki, o lelo pooki ootoning'o kuna baa.

English: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
Masaai: lemetum nkatitin kumok taata te na kata, ore te idia kata nalotu netum enkishui oo ntarasi.”

English: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
Masaai: Ina apa pee enoto Manase irubat tomon, metii enkop e Gilead o Bashan, apa naatii lido likae kekun le Yordan;

English: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
Masaai: Kimputa iyie engoro oleng nimir iyiook nisesekuan metii olng'ur;

English: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
Masaai: Enkerai ai, tinitonyorrayie te nkutuk ino aitasheiki ole latia ino te sile enye, ninosa olmumai te nkaraki olomoni;

English: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:
Masaai: Nebulu ilo shani negolu ore enchumata enye nebaiki keper, naa kelioo te neiting'ie enkop pooki.

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro e Nkai te nkaraki Usa, near Enkai ninye te ine te nkaraki naitorioyie enkaina enye aibung ilo sanduku; neye ninye te ine te mbata ilo sanduku le Nkai.

English: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki etoning'o ake Olaitoriani ina neiput engoro; neyupuyupieki engoro metigilunore Yakobo, neitashe engoro enye te shumata Israel;

English: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong naa kaitotiu nanu ilgilat le Yuda anaa olmoti le nkima te mpolos entim, arashu enkima nayupuyup natii atua irridat le nkano; naa kemut ninche eiteru te tatene o metabaiki kedienye olorere pooki omanita ninche. Ore Yerusalem neton ake emanyae.

English: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
Masaai: “Endapidapoi ninye, nelulung'a esiai enye amu kesipa nkoitoi pooki enyena. Enkai naisiligayu nemeeta entioto, Kesipa neitoriori ninye.

English: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
Masaai: Mikurru te nintayu shakenisho o Laitoriani lang aashu te nanu oloena lenye, kake tonyorrai erishata ino o sina litum te nkaraki ororei supat te ngolon e Enkai,

English: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
Masaai: Ore lelo supati nedol neshipayu; ore lelo torrok neidang.

English: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
Masaai: Neibung'i ina ng'ues, te nebo ilo oiboni lenye le lejare, otaasa ilmonek te dukuya ninye naa ninche etelejie lelo ootang'amaitie olmishire le ina ng'ues o lelo ooteserema ina kitanyaanyukoto enye ore lelo pokira o are, nenang'akini eishu atua ilo balbal le nkima, oyupuyup te nkibiriti.

English: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong eibung'ita Olaitoriani ilo alem lenye kitok ogol, nelo ninye aitame Lefiatan, ilo asurai oisikita, ilo asurai ojo lefiatan omerregela, near ninye metua ina kukuu natii atua enaiposha.

English: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore apa Saul, o ninche, o ltung'ana pooki le Israel, netii atua oerata le Ela, eara o lelo Filisti.

English: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
Masaai: “Ekeishu Olaitoriani! Meisisi endapidapoi ai! Naa meitubulari enkitoo e Nkai ai, endapidapoi e njeunoto ai.

English: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.
Masaai: Nelo ninye aing'uaa Elisha, nelo enetii olkitok lenye, nejoki ilo kitok lenye ninye, “Kaa iyie kitiaaka Elisha?” Newaliki ninye ajo, “Aatiaaka ninye inchiu iyie.”

English: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Neisho ninye enkitok olupi ang, neitaa ninye entomononi nashipa naata nkera. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
Masaai: ore ninche te nkalo enye neas enkeleekisho neitobir ninche ndaiki, neyau ilkuniyiani ootopolosate nepik nkoriong'i oo sirkon lenye, o lbenia le naisho, oopolosa nepololo nerami,

English: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
Masaai: Kenya ninche enkisampuare ino o endaa ino, neinos ninche ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi; nenya ninche nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi nenya ninche isabibu linyi o lng'abolo linyi; ore nkang'itie inyi naasheta isunta naa ninche isiligigi naa keidaikie ninche.”

English: For though ye have ten thousand instructers in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
Masaai: Te nera iip katitin iip laramatak linyi ti atua Kristo, mme kumok iloo papaai linyi! Amu ore ti atua Kristo Yesu nanu otaa papaai linyi atolikio intae lelo Omon Supati.

English: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
Masaai: Ore pee eikilikuanishore Saul Olaitoriani, neitu ewaliki Olaitoriani ninye, aa te nkidetidet arashu te Urim, arashu too loibonok.

English: And he put them all together into ward three days.
Masaai: Nepik pooki tenebo Korokoroni too nkolong'i uni.

English: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening ilkipaareta ina, Barnaba o Paulo, nepolos ilkilani lenye, neipangu te siamo, ebuakita neishir,

English: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
Masaai: Pee eyau enchan enkop ine nemetii tung'ani, ilo purkel lememanya tung'ani.

English: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni neishop Esta nkilani enyena e nkitoo neitashe ti atua olgoriet le nkaji o laiguanani, oipirakinore ina aji o laiguanani. Neton olaiguanani to lorika lenye le nkitoo ti atua enkaji e nkitoo aipirakinore kutukaji e nkaji e nkitoo,

English: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.
Masaai: Kake ore pee einyaku Paulo ajo metorripi paa Kaisari olo aiguanare, naitanapisho metorripi o manoto enaikunaa airriwaki Kaisari.”

English: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
Masaai: Neigutu iltung'ana le Israel aapuonu aarare lelo le Benchamen te nkolong e are.

English: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon alo Esiong'eber o Elot te mbata e naiposha, te nkop e Edom.

English: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani Daudi, “Empotokoki Sadok olapolosani, o Natan oloiboni le Nkai o Benaia olayioni le Yehoiada.” Neaku eetuo ninche dukuya olaiguanani.

English: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
Masaai: Amu ore olapolosani ake pooki ogeluni ti atua olorere negeluni metaasisho te nkaraki olorere tiaalo Enkai, neitayu nkishorot o lasarri te nkaraki ng'ok.

English: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani oas ena, o enkerai e tung'ani naibung akurraki, ilo oibung sabato, nemeisarkionie, neibooyo enkaina enye pee meas entorroni ake pooki.”

English: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
Masaai: “Neaku kemany ilouarak le ntim o lng'ojinia Babilon, nebik isidan tiatua ninye; meitoki aatii iltung'ana atua ninye ntarasi, nememanyi too lporori pooki.

English: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

English: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
