English: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
Masaai: Ore apa ilo Daniel nening'oyu oleng alang lelo kituaak pooki o lbalusuni, amu etii apa enkiyang'et sidai atua ninye. Neitobir olaiguanani pee epik ninye shumata enkitoria pooki.

English: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
Masaai: Naa kaitame nanu ina ai e Babilon naji Bel, naitayu tiatua enkutuk enye ina toki natoijoyie meitoki nkuapi aarukokino ninye etusulari esuntai e Babilon.

English: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
Masaai: Papa, intaa kitok enkarna ino.” Nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa shumata, “Aitaa kitok, naa kaigil aitaa kitok.”

English: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
Masaai: Nepik ninche Olaitoriani olkirutoto te dukuya Israel, laa ninche ootasesekuana ninche te sesekuanata kitok te Gibeon, nemiraa ninche aaimie enkoitoi nashong'ishong e Bet-horon near ninche metuata o metabaiki Aseka o Makeda.

English: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
Masaai: Ntobiraki nkuapi olarrabal pee earare ninye lelo aiguanak le Mede, tenebo ilbalusuni lenye, o laretok lenye, o pooki kop natii abori enkitoria enye.

English: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
Masaai: Nening Olaitoriani oltoilo le Israel, neishooyo lelo le Kanaan; neidaikie Siraeli ninche o nkanas enye. Neaku keji ene wueji Horma.

English: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Masaai: Meitaiki ilaiguanak le Tarshishi o lelo loo lepolosi ninye nkishorot, nchoo meyau ilaiguanak le Sheba o Seba nkishorot!

English: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
Masaai: “Aibatisa nanu intae te nkare pee eitodolu nchere irridutua ng'ok; kake ore olaasujita, naa kegol ninye, aalang nanu, maaishiaakino hoo nanu te nanapaki inamuka enyena, naa ninye oibatisa intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o te nkima.

English: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
Masaai: naa ng'ura eitashe Olaitoriani te nchumata ninye, nejo ninye, “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e Abraham papaai lino, nara sii Enkai e Isaak, naa ore ena kop naa ninye irragie, ekaaisho nanu iyie tenebo o eishoi ino.

English: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
Masaai: ore too le Efraim, naa Hoshea olayioni le Asasia; ore to lpisiai lo losho le Manase, naa Yoel olayioni le Pedaia;

English: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
Masaai: Ore ndaat oo nchoo ti ong'ata neitong, ore ildoinyo nemanita eng'ida,

English: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
Masaai: Amaa ilo oturisho pee eunisho keturisho anaake? ketur ninye enkop enye neitupuyiapui enterit anaake?

English: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
Masaai: “Kalo naa sinka ilo oisiligayu naa ng'en otung'eikia olkitok lenye enkaji enye, meitotio ltung'ana te nkata naishiaakino?

English: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
Masaai: Neaku ore sii ninye Yesu naa ti auluo kishomi einosieki osina pee etum aitisinya iltung'ana lenyena to sarge lenye makewan.

English: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
Masaai: Aatamana aamuat ninche nanu, naaimu too nchot pooki; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!

English: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Harim naa enkalifu nabo o tomon oopishana.

English: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.
Masaai: Nebik Daudi te nebo Akish te Gas, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena, pooki tung'ani te nebo enkaji enye o Daudi te nebo nkituaak enyena pokira are, Ahinoam e Yesreel, o Abigail e Karmel, enkoliai e Nabal.

English: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
Masaai: nemany sii Yesu atua iltauja linyi eimu enkirukoto; paa ore intae, inoto ntona nitonini te nyorrata,

English: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
Masaai: nikinang'ie enkop, iyie taa, o nkera niata ti atua, nemeetae osoit obo ti atua iyie oing'uari eiteleikino olikae; amu eitu iyiolou olkekun likibaikinye Enkai.”

English: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
Masaai: Naa ore nena tokitin nisudoyie tiatua oltau lino; ayiolo ajo ena apa eyieuna ino.

English: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
Masaai: Metomijoono enkang enye, metaa metumi ae kata olojing ilng'oborri lenye.

English: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
Masaai: Kake iyie nanu aisiliga, Olaitoriani, atejo nanu, “Ira iyie Enkai ai.”

English: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
Masaai: nijo, ‘Entoning ororei lo laitoriani intae ilaiguanak le Yuda, o Yuda pooki, o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem, oojing'u te kuna shomito.

English: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and one.
Masaai: Ore isirkon naa nkalifuni tomoni uni o iip imiet, ore te kuna naa ntomoni ile o obo elaakinoto o Laitoriani.

English: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
Masaai: Nadol lelo tung'ana torrok enukari; lelo apa oojing nepuku aaing'uaa ewueji sinyati, neisisi tiatua enkanasa teine netaasie imbaa naaijo nena. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.

English: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip ninche aatoning olaiguanani nepuo; ng'ura, ore ilo akira apa otoduaa ninche to loo saen nerikoo ninche o metaba anaa neitashe te shumata ewueji netii enkerai.

English: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
Masaai: Ore amu kenyikita Luda Yopa, ore pee ening ilooiteng'eni nchere etii Petero ine, neirriwuaki lewa aare nesai aajoki, “Wou sii ake ene nikitii nimimutie.”

English: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura kayau olairrag loo nkariak shumata enkop, peyie eishu iseseni pooki oota enkiyang'et enkishui, napuku tiabori keper. Ore pooki toki natii enkop naa keye.

English: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
Masaai: Kake etejo ninye Yehoshafat, “Aimeetae likae oiboni le Nkai likinkilikuanishore?”

English: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
Masaai: Meetae embaata too lbaa linono, aitorrono oleng olbae lino. Ore lelo pooki ooning mbaa inono, neosh nkaik tenkaraki iyie. Amu kaing'ae eitu ebaiki ina torroni ino nemeish aekata?

English: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
Masaai: Neaku enkata naitupukoo ate ilooiteng'eni le Yohana o loo Lfarisayo; nepuonu ltung'ana enetii ninye nejoki, “Kaji etiu pee eitupukoo ate ilooiteng'eni le Yohana o loo Lfarisayo, nemeitupukoo ate ilinono?”

English: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eetuo ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani te Hebron; neitobir olaiguanani Daudi olning'o te nebo ninche te Hebron te dukuya o Laitoriani, nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata Israel.

English: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ore te risioroto oo nkiaasin inono naasipa, nchoo engoro ino o empijan ino eibelekenya apaash ena anasa ino Yerusalem, ena doinyo ino sinyati; amu te nkaraki ing'ok ang o entorroni oo loo papa pee eimakini Yerusalem o ltung'ana linono ti atua kulo tung'ana pooki oomanita iyiook.

English: Last of all the woman died also.
Masaai: Ore te siadi neye sii ninye enkitok.

English: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore teina naishorua nanu ewueji nepiki osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye etii atua olning'o lo Laitoriani, apa oitobira tenebo loo papa, apa pee eyau ninche aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.”

English: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
Masaai: O pooki toki naishu e pooki sesen, iyau maare e pooki pukunoto atua e safina. Niramat ninche peyie meye; naa ore pooki naa oloing'oni ake o elipong.

English: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
Masaai: Aajoki naa te nkaraki ina, etapalakaki ng'ok enyena, aa kumok, amu etonyorrishe oleng, amu ore doi olopalakini nkuti naa kiti enyorrata enye.”

English: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
Masaai: neitoki taa alo ajur ina keeya te nkolong e naapishana. Teneibulayie enkeeya ilo kila, oripuno anaa oloo ntokitin naapuyiapui, anaa oloo ndapan, o endapana naasishoreki keiduruk ninye.

English: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
Masaai: Nelotu ilo enatii, neitashe ti alo nanu naajoki, ‘Olalashe lai Saulo, todolisho.’ Ore te ina saa ake nadolishoyu nadol ninye.

English: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
Masaai: Neitaas Enkai esidai nena aitoyiok; neponari iltung'ana aagolu neaku kumok oleng.

English: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
Masaai: Eikirikira ing'apeta e keper, neirut aaiputukuny te nkisikong'ata enye.

English: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
Masaai: Ore peyie ebau ewueji natuutaka Enkai ninye, neshetu Abraham olperere lo lasar te ine neirragie ilkeek aitobiraki, neen Isaak enkayioni enye, neirragie ninye te wueji o lasar te nchumata oo lkeek.

English: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
Masaai: Ti nidol osikiria li obo likimba etepetikia olola enkop, nimilo aing'uaa, taretoki ninye metudumu olola.

English: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi, lelo ayiok le Yeshua o Kadmiel, loo layiok le Hadafia, naa ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan.

English: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
Masaai: Neiu sii ninye enkiti enkayioni, neipot enkarna enye ajo Ben-ammi, naa ninye menye loo Lamoni o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
Masaai: Ore Yudas, ilo otakaldayie ninye, neyiolo sii ninye ine wueji amu kesesh apa elo Yesu ine o looiteng'eni lenyena.

English: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
Masaai: Ore ina kila o lgoo e nkiguana tipika Urimu o Sumimu, pee eaku ketii ninche oltau le Aron, te nebo ninye enkata nilo dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku kenapita ninye Aron enkiguana oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli to ltau lenye te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake.

English: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
Masaai: neikash oleng te pokira ilo leton eitu eini neitu edol nena baa torrok naasi tiabori enkolong.

English: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
Masaai: “Intaiki kewan esafina olchani le Gofer, nipik ilgilat atua esafina, nimur atua o oriong te nkoronko.

English: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
Masaai: Naa ina eitukuyieki iyiook te nkishorunoto o sesen le Yesu Kristo nabo kata ake te rishata e pooki.

English: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
Masaai: Mme intae likitegelutua nanu kake kategelua intae naitanap intae enchom entoiu ilng'anayio, nebik ilng'anayio linyi, paa ore pooki niomonono Papa te nkarna ai, neisho, intae.

English: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kakua omon kulo liimakiki ipuopuo pokira aare?” Neitashe, neisinanuo.

English: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
Masaai: Amu etijing'a olameyu enkop te kulo arin pokira aare; neton aa kepuonu kulikae arin imiet laa metumi enturore anaa enkisampuare.

English: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
Masaai: Aime enkiti rishata nang'or pee eitaa Lebanon enkurma naleng, ore ina kurma naleng neibelekenyi aaitaa entim?

English: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Meishiraki ninche ninye ejo, oi olkitok, anaa ejo oi oloyanyiti! kenukari ninye anaa osikiria, eing'irtitori nenang'ari aaitogiroo nchomito e Yerusalem.”

English: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
Masaai: neikirikira anaa emoti naitokitok pee eibalieki enkarna ino too lmang'ati linono, netum iloreren aikirikirata te dukuya iyie!

English: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
Masaai: Entutur intae esuntai edolita ninche niimiimi ina lusie.

English: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
Masaai: Meishopokini ilaitang'orok laainei esulare; meimulumula ninche enkurruna enye anaa olkila.

English: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, engolon ai naa osempewuet, naa esarunoto ai te nkolong e nyamali enitii iyie epuonu iloreren. Eing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop nepuonu aajo: “Eitu ejung loo papaai toki neme elejare, o ntokitin e pesho nemeeta dupoto.

English: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
Masaai: kake entaasa ninche ena pee etum ninche aatopok nemeye te nepuonu aanyikaki nena tokitin naasinya aaisul: nchoo elo Aron o layiok lenyena atua olng'obor negelaki ake oltung'ani esiai enye o lola lenye,

English: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
Masaai: Nedung'oki nkituaak e latia e nkarna, ejo, “Etoikioki Naomi olayioni.” Neisho ninche ninye enkarna aajo Obed; ninye apa menye le Yese, menye le Daudi.

English: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
Masaai: Maitobira iyiook enkiti aji naitushura netii isunta, nikipikaki ninye endapash, o emesa, o lorika, o ltaa, paa ore enkata ake pooki nalotu ninye enikitii, neidim ashomo ine.”

English: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
Masaai: Ore te pooki toki neetae enkata enye, neetae enkata e pooki toki tiabori keper:

English: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
Masaai: “Mien olkiteng enkutuk eidong'ito entapa.

English: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
Masaai: Nkilikuanu taata pee idol, keidim olee anoto enutai enkerai? Kainyoo naa pee adol pooki lee etii nkaik enyena enkoshoke anaa enkitok nasaisai? kainyoo pee eipusa pooki ng'ae?

English: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
Masaai: Nedou Yesu airiamunore ninche nebau Nazaret, nening ninye ninche. Neshum ng'otonye nena baa pooki to ltau lenye.

English: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
Masaai: Meitaa intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi katitin enkalifu te nkumoi alang enibaba. Nemayian intae, anaa enaisiligie intae!

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tenaiturrur ina aji e Israel tiatua lelo oreren ooidapashakaki ninche, naibalie esinyatisho ai tiatua ninche te dukuya lelo oreren pooki, neaku kepuo aatoni te nkop enye maate ina naishoo apa osinka lai Yakobo.

English: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
Masaai: Kake ore ina nyorrata nauno o Laitoriani naa enoo ntarasi o ntarasi te lelo ooure ninye, neton esupatisho enye too nkera oo nkera enye,

English: Now when every maid's turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu enkata pee elo ake pooki tito enetii Serser, te siadi ilapaitin tomon ti abori nkitanapat oo nkituaak, aa taa ena apa enkata enye naisikarrare, ilapaitin ile te ilata o manemane, o lapaitin ile loo sonkoyoni naarropil oo nkituaak.

English: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Masaai: Ore olasar leilo torrono naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore enkomono eilo oitashe too sipat naa enchipai enye.

English: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
Masaai: entipik enkima atua ninche nipikipiki enkorropil shumata ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani taisere, ore ilo tung'ani oyooki Olaitoriani agelu neaku ilo sinyati. Ishomo aaitulus ilayiok le Lawi!”

English: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
Masaai: Irara le papaai linyi, ilo oirirua, ore eyieunoto inyi naa easata oo ng'uarrat naaing'uaa papaai linyi. Olarani apa ake ninye te nkiterunoto, meitashe ninye te sipata, amu metii esipata, atua ninye. Te nejo ninye elejare, nejo te risioroto olkuaak lenye makewan; amu olalejani naa menye le lejare.

English: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Irriwaka iyie mpala te nkarna ino iltung'ana pooki le Yerusalem, o Sefania olayioni le Maaseia ilo apolosani, o lapolosak pooki, ijo,

English: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
Masaai: Anaa enasholi enkosholai to lkokuet, naa kesholi intae te rishata enye; naa iyiolouu ajo nanu Olaitoriani otubukoko engoro ai shumata inyi.”

English: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani Enkai ino Ilo ogol le ltung'ana lenyena: “Ng'ura, aiwuang'ie nanu te nkaina ino ina kikompe e merai nikiyukuyukie; ina girra e ngoro ai mingil ae kata iyie aok;

English: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Gesam, lelo ayiok le Usa, lelo ayiok le Pasea,

English: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
Masaai: “Ore olomoni pooki opong'oreki, tenaa te nkaraki olkiteng anaa, enkaraki osikiria, anaa enkaraki enker, anaa enkaraki nkilani, arashu pooki toki naimina najoyie oltung'ani, ‘Ninye ena’, neyauni enchankar oo nkaloli pokira dukuya Enkai; ore ilo odung'oki Enkai enkiguana nelaaki katitin are ilo le latia enye.

English: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfilisti nepik ilng'oborri Yuda, neibung enkang e Lehi.

English: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
Masaai: Inkilikuanu te nanu imasaa pooki naaba anaa niyieu too nkishorot, naa kaishoru te risioroto eina nikijokiki nanu, kake intabai ake ena naata to ltau, inchooki ake ninye nanu ena tito metaa enkitok ai.”

English: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
Masaai: Inining'o tisipu irorei laainei, nincho ina eaku enkitagoloto ino.

English: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
Masaai: Ore ninye te naarresh nkeenta e ilo torrono, maarikino nanu enkitanapata ino.

English: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo netii Olaitoriani shumata, keing'or ninye, keing'or ninye ilo obor; ore ilo owuasa neyiolo ninye elakua.

English: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
Masaai: neitu eyiolou o meeu oloirrag le nkare aya pooki; neijia sii etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.

English: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
Masaai: Naa keitarasaa olalashe olalashe lenye metari metua, neitarasaa menye enkerai enye, nedumakino nkera iloomenye, neitarasaa metari metuata.

English: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
Masaai: neibayu iltauja lenye empukunoto pooki e ndaa, nenyikaki ninche kishomi e keeya.

English: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against  Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Nahash, ilo Amoni, ailep alo neman Yabesh-gilead; nejoki iltung'ana pooki le Yabesh Nahash, “Ntaiki iyiook olning'o pee kisiaai iyie.”

English: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
Masaai: Eetae apa enkata naishu ake maata nkitanapat, kake ore pee elotu ina kitanapata, neinyototo ng'ok naye nanu.

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nainuaaki enkima Misiri, ore ilaretok lenye pooki negili.

English: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
Masaai: Etudumunye enemeneng'a to lodo le nkop pee kinang'are te nilotu, etudumua ninye iloipi pee kiroroki iyie, ee, lelo pooki oora ilarikok le nkop; etudumunye too lorikan lenye le nkitoo le lelo apa oora ilaiguanak loo loshon.

English: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro; naa kelotu aasayu ina, ekaas nanu; marrinyo nanu siadi, maaleku nanu, mairridu nanu; ore terisioroto oo inkoitoi inono o siaaitin inono ekaaiguanare nanu iyie ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
Masaai: Ena bae nabo ake eitanapa iyiook nchere atadamu laisinak naa ina bae apake airowuare aas.

English: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
Masaai: Teneyieu oltung'ani nekordu ae nabo e matua enye e tomon oo nkishorot enyena nelo naa ninye aponaa ematua e imiet e tomon.

English: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
Masaai: Amu ore apa lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku neitasheito te mpolos e Yordan, o metaba anaa neidipayu pooki toki apa naitanapa Olaitoriani Yoshua metiaaki iltung'ana, te risioroto e nena apa pooki naaitanapa Musa Yoshua. Nelang iltung'ana ilo keju te nkisarrisar;

English: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
Masaai: Ore elakunoto e nkishui o ltung'ani naa karsisisho enye, kake meeta olaisinani enakordunye kewan.

English: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
Masaai: Ore ti alo ilmalaika nejo ninye, “Oloitaa ilmalaika lenyena isiwuon, neitaa isinkan lenyena ilng'ejepa le nkima.”

English: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
Masaai: Nelotu shumata nanu enkuretisho sapuk olokirikiri ina naikirikirie iloik laainei pooki.

English: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
Masaai: Kintoduaa ninye iyie lo tung'ani embae sidai o ina nayieu Olaitoriani te iyie, pee ias esipata ninyorru isupati nilo te mborron tenebo Enkai ino?

English: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani: “Ore enkaraki nairoro ninche ele rorei, ng'ura, kaitaa nanu irorei laainei tiatua enkutuk ino enkima, ore kulo tung'ana neaku ilkeek, nenya enkima ninche.

English: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
Masaai: Neitoki ilapolosak aayau ilo sanduku lo lning'o ewueji enye, tiatua ilo gilata liatua le nkaji, tiatua ine nesinya aisul. Tiabori inaipuko oo lkerubi.

English: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
Masaai: “Tiaki ena umata, ‘Ewuang'a tena manyisho e Kora o Datan o Abiram.’ ”

English: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
Masaai: Te neibung ilayiok linono olning'o lai o enchakenisho ai nalo nanu aiteng'en ninche, ore sii ilayiok lenye ntarasi nepuo aatonie olorika lino le nkitoo.”

English: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo lemeikenaki Olaitoriani entorroni, laa ore atua enkishui enye metii elejare.

English: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
Masaai: Aatang'adutua nanu iloing'ok kumok, aatamana nanu iloing'ok oogol le Bashan;

English: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
Masaai: Tena eidimi aatodol nchere kaku nkera e Nkai, naa kakua nkera e Sheitani: ore pooki ng'ae lemeas enaishaakino neme ole Nkai, naa neijia etiu ilo lemenyor olalashe lenye.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ena Yerusalem; aitasheyie ninye te mpolos oo loreren, netii nkuapi naamanita ninye.

English: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
Masaai: Eibelekenyaki olwulul lai loo usin, metaa enkishirata o sina ore oltoilo le ndule ai neibelekenyaki metotiwuo anaa oltoilo le lelo ooishir.

English: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
Masaai: Koos apa menye le Anub, o Sebeba, o lmareita le Aharhel olayioni le Harum.

English: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kairriwaki nanu intae Eliya oloiboni le Nkai eton eitu elotu ina olong torrono o Laitoriani.

English: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata nelo Yesu te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata aim atua nkurman e nkano, netir esumash ilooiteng'eni lenyena, neitayu enkano aainos.

English: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
Masaai: Naawaliki nanu Olaitoriani ejo, “Ngero ena duaata; ngero mbalie too soito dapashi, pee etum akueta ilo oisum.

English: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
Masaai: Emanita ninye inaaitureisho te pooki alole, nemir ninye too nkejek enyena.

English: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
Masaai: amu esipa kaaisho nanu iyie enkanyit kitok, ore entoki pooki naba anaa enikijoki iyie naa kaas; wou tediaa ele orere te nkaraki nanu.’ ”

English: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
Masaai: “Ore ilo oata osupetai teneitukui te nkaraki ilo supetai lenye, netum taa aikenaki kewan nkolong'i naapishana enkitukuoto, neituku ilkilani lenyena, nelo aituku osesen lenye te nkare naruko neaku taa olemeiduruk.

English: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye ntokitin pooki o lperere lo lasar, imotioo, o inkisureta, o ngirran, o nkurteta o nena kiyuketa e nkima; ore nena tokitin enyena pooki neitobiru ninye to suyai.

English: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
Masaai: Ana mme iyiook sa pee etejo neijia? Enkaraki iyiook pee etisiraki ina, amu ore ilo oturisho neishaakino neturisho to siligi, ore olorrarru lng'anayio nerrarru eisiligu ajo ketum eoroti enye.

English: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
Masaai: Ore endapash pooki nairrag ninye too nkolong'i pooki o sarge, netiu te ninye anaa endapash enkiduruk; ore pooki toki natonie ninye neiduruku, anaa ake tenkiduruk e nena olong'i enyena osarge.

English: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
Masaai: nejoki Musa, “Ekeyau iltung'ana ntokitin kumok oleng naalusoo te asata e ina siaai apa naitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani mataas.”

English: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
Masaai: Entotiu sii intae neijia lo payiani, entotoni o nkituaak inyi te ng'eno, nincho enkitok inaairirikino anaa entoki nashal, amu irara ilajung'ok te nebo le mpiris e mpuaan pee meiboori enkomono inyi.

English: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
Masaai: Kaji eikuna ina anasa naisiligayu, pee etaa enaibor onyek, ore apa ina nabore esipata! Naa enkiguana nasipa naton ti atua ninye, kake ore taata netaa ilarak.

English: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena pee aategeluaki nanu mataa olalikioroni o lkipaaret (naasipa ajoito, malejisho nanu), ataa olaiteng'enani loo loreren te nkirukoto o te sipata.

English: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
Masaai: Ayieu naa nimbung akurraki kuna baa, peyie aa ore looiruko Enkai nejurru aaitayiolo ate nkiasin sidain; kuna ninche sidain naata dupoto too ltung'ana.

English: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
Masaai: nemeiturraa sii ninye olpayian enkitok enye. Naa te neorore enkitok olpayian, neton meyama aashu eshuko aning'ore olpayian lenye.

English: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
Masaai: Ore enkipirunoto e modai naa eng'oki, naa ore ilo asukenyani naa olminong too ltung'ana.

English: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
Masaai: O nturkuluoni are sii aashu nturkuluoni kutiti are, anaa enaidim ninye anoto; ore nabo naa olasar le ngoki ore enkae naa olasar opejori.

English: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Ilamori aajo eitagoro Daudi, neirriwaa Hanan ntalantani enkalifu nabo e nkosholai pee eisilenu ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan te Mesopotamia, tenetii Aramaaka, o te Soba.

English: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
Masaai: Naa kejung Olaitoriani Yuda anaa erubata enye tiatua ina kop enye sinyati, neitoki ake agelu Yerusalem!

English: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
Masaai: Amu mme enkiyang'et e rrindikisho eishooki intae entushukokinoto enkuretisho, kake eishooki intae enkiyang'et oo nkera inot. Ore te nikijo “Abba! Papa!”

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aitame nanu lelo pooki oomurata kake memurata sii

English: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
Masaai: Enkai olaiguanani loo sipat, naa Enkai naata engoro nkolong'i pooki.

English: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nelotu enetii oloata enkeeya oo lbolot, negil kung aserem, nejoki, “Lo kitok, ti niyieu kindim atisika.”

English: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
Masaai: Neas ilayiok le Lawi te risioroto ororei le Musa; nebatata ina olong iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni.

English: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
Masaai: Nchoo olaiguanani esipata ino, na Ai, nincho esupatisho ino ilo le nkaji e nkitoo!

English: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?
Masaai: Ore naa taata emincho Hesekia meitapong'oi intae anaa elej intae, tena pukunoto enye, nimining'ining'i intae ninye.
