English: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
Masaai: neijia sii kitiu iyiook, ore hoo nikira kumok, kira osesen obo ti atua Kristo, nikira rubat olikae o likae.

English: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
Masaai: Neaku eyaua apa Daudi o enkaji e Israel pooki osanduku le Nkai aailepunye te mbuakunoto o to ltoilo le mowuo.

English: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
Masaai: neitoki aaing'or enkop, kake ng'ura, osina ake o enaimin, ina misimisi o sina. Naa kenang'akini ninche atua enaimin narok ong'u.

English: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
Masaai: “Neaku, ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, pee adung'oki nanu enkiguana nena kitanyaanyukot enyena naa ore tiatua enkop enye pooki neishir te mion lelo oata ilbaa.

English: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
Masaai: Ore naa taata tayiolo ena nidamu eniaas; amu eitobirakitia olkitok lang entorroni o enkaji enye pooki, naa kegogong ninye oleng meetae oltung'ani oidim airorie ninye.”

English: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
Masaai: Eitobira sii apa Solomon imelin kumok te Esiong'eber naa ninye nataaniki Eliton, to lomanaa le naiposha Nanyokie, te nkop e Edom.

English: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
Masaai: Amu kepik ninye olbae, neitoki aen, neoshisho ninye kake aikinchiunye enkaina enye.

English: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'oru Herode, nelau, nejur lelo sikarini ootorripo neitanapisho meewai aar metuata. Neing'uaa ninye Yudea nedoyio alo Kaisaria, nebik te ine.

English: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Daudi, “Iyie asipani alang nanu, amu kitalaaka nanu esidai aa entorroni nanu aatalaaka.

English: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
Masaai: Te nepuonu ilarruok shumata nanu, aainos nkiri osesen lai, lelo mang'ati laainei o larak, nerrorro ninche nebatata.

English: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
Masaai: ninken nkajijik e Yerusalem, nigil nkajijik pee ishet esuntai aitagol.

English: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
Masaai: Iyie otipika enkop ilkitamanyunot lenyena, pee meigusugus ae kata.

English: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
Masaai: Ore pooki oitulus nemebik te nkiteng'enare e Kristo nemeeta ilo Enkai; ore ilo obik te ina kiteng'enare neeta pokira aare Papa o Enkerai.

English: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
Masaai: Ore te nkipooto eina aji neya ninye nturkuluoni are kutiti, tenebo nkeek oltarakuai o enkarasha nanyokie o hisopo,

English: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
Masaai: o Daniel, o Gineton, o Baruk,

English: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
Masaai: nchoo ilpayiani leina anasa eirriwaa olkilikuai meyauni ninye teine, neitarasakini ninye ilo oata e lap osarge, pee etum ninye atua.

English: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
Masaai: Ore inaatuunoki to lkarkar loo soito, na elde oning ororei neng'amaa nabo kata te ng'ida;

English: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
Masaai: Ore olerrinyore le mborron o euriata o Laitoriani, naa enkarsisisho o enkanyit o enkishui.

English: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.
Masaai: Neaku ore ake pee ejoki ilo tung'ani lo lgilata lenye Boas, “Inyang'u iyie,” nedotu ninye enamuke.

English: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Iwaita intae nkaitin aainei naitayio nanu, o lapolosani, nipuopuo, kainyoo naa aatung'ueikiaki? Kainyoo naa pee kijokiki intae nanu, ‘Eji kainyoo nikinosita?’ ”

English: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
Masaai: intagolo enkinyang'a enye oleng, naa aikintaa ninye iyie kitok; aikianyitu ninye iyie tininbung'are ninye.

English: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
Masaai: Oi duoo tenaa aiking'utut too ng'ututat enkutuk ino! amu ore enyorrata ino nelang enaisho oo sabibu.

English: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
Masaai: Ore apa ina olong natuunoki olng'obor le Nkai, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho; ore teipa netii ina atampoi shumata ilo ng'obor nelioo eikununo anaa enkima o mekenyu.

English: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
Masaai: Naa tenemelo olmarei loo Lmisiri aapuo aaitarasaa ate, nedoiki ninche olmetai laa Olaitoriani ninye oosh lelo oshon lemeilep aapuo aaibung osirua loo lng'oborri.

English: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oar metua olelatia enye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: When thou buildest a new house, then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof, that thou bring not blood upon thine house, if any man fall from thence.
Masaai: “Tenishet enkaji ng'ejuk tipika ntamanai iloom pee miyau ake entorroni osarge shumata enkaji ino, tenesulunye ake ninye oltung'ani.

English: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubim, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
Masaai: Neeta ngarrin oo mbartan enkalifu nabo o iip are, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni ntomoni ile. Nemeikenayu esiana e lelo tung'ana oo etuo tenebo ninye ooing'uaa Misiri ile Libia o le Sukiim o le Etiopia.

English: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
Masaai: Eikash enkiti toki naata oltung'ani supat alang nkumok o ltung'ani torrono.

English: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
Masaai: Ayiolo ajo ore pooki naas Enkai neitashe ntarasi; meetae ae toki naponikini ninye; nemeetae toki naiwuang'ieki te ninye; eitaa Enkai metotiwuo neija, peyie etum iltung'ana aatureita ninye.

English: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
Masaai: Naa itum iyie enchipai o eng'ida to ltau lino, neng'ida ltung'ana kumok te inoto enye.

English: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
Masaai: Ore egira ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani alotu enkanasa e Daudi, nerum Mikal entito e Saul Daudi te lusie, nedol olaiguanani Daudi eranyisho eipid aranyisho neng'ida; nemenaa ninye to ltau lenye.

English: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
Masaai: Anaa enaing'oru olchekut intare enyena ina kata naidapashate kulie tare enyena too neelakua, neaku kaing'oru sii nanu ntare aainei; naa kaitajeu ninche too wuejitin pooki neeidapashakaki teina olong natii inkatampo netii sii enaimin narok ong'u.

English: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
Masaai: Ore irorei le nking'oming'om netiu anaa embelati e mukate namelok, nejing'aa atua osesen lenye.

English: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
Masaai: Nepuo te nebo Absalom iltung'ana iip are ooing'uaa Yerusalem aa ilomon apa ooitoomonoki, nepuo ninche meeta ae too ltauja neitu eyiolou toki.

English: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
Masaai: Etiaaka Olaitoriani olkitok lai: “Totona te nkaina ai e tatene, o metaba anaa napik ilmang'ati linono, abori nkejek inono.”

English: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neye ninye aa oltung'ani moruo oleng, oiputakinote nkolong'i eeta enkarsisisho o enkanyit kitok; neitoreisho Solomon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.
Masaai: Niyier aitokitokie ninos teine wueji negelu Olaitoriani Enkai ino; ore tadekenya nimbelekenyanya aapuo ilng'oborri linyi.

English: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
Masaai: Meinos olamutanani arashu olaisiaayiani oigeroki.

English: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Solomon, “Enkerai ai, aata apa to ltau lai pee ashetu enkaji te nkarna Olaitoriani Enkai, ai.

English: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
Masaai: Kake eishooki ina kitok inaipuko are naaijo ino lkurragos sapuk loo lmurran, pee elotie ti ai ailany ilo asurai, nelo ong'ata, ine ewueji neitotiyieki aaitagol, te nkata, o too nkatitin, o lpisiai le nkata.

English: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
Masaai: Enosa olmumai intae natoyie e Yerusalem, enosa olmumai too ntarakueti o naaten, inchere mipututu enyorrata ang, ometaba anaa nenyorru openy.

English: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo tung'ana ootusujaitie Omori, nemir lelo ootusuja Tibni olayioni le Ginat. Neaku etua Tibni neaku Omori ninye olaiguanani.

English: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
Masaai: Ore apa enkop nemeeta shoto, nemetii toki naa enaimin natii oriong o enguton, ore Enkiyang'et e Nkai nelo tioriong inkariak.

English: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
Masaai: nipik ilo moti oitukuoreki erishata e ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, nipik enkare.

English: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Ore teina aji e Israel nemeitokini aata ilkiku oorem arashu eitame lelo oomanita ootaarare ninche. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
Masaai: Tang'amai enkiteng'enare te nkutuk enye, nishum ororei lenye tiatua oltau lino.

English: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.
Masaai: Neisho ilo aiguanani Daniel enkitoo e shumata o nkishorot kumok sapuki neisho ninye meitoria olosho e nkop e Babilon pooki, neitaa sii ninye olkitok loo lang'eni pooki le Babilon.

English: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
Masaai: Negoro Daudi enkaraki natarasaka Olaitoriani Usa; ore ine wueji neaku keji Peres Usa; o taata.

English: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
Masaai: Ore Baasha olayioni le Ahija lo losho le Isaakar, nerresh ninye. Near Baasha ninye metua te Gibeton nara enoo lfilisti, amu eirraga apa Nadab o Siraeli pooki aang'adu Gibeton.

English: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki ilo sinka lenye, “Wou matataaniki iyiook nabo e kuna wuejitin pee kirrag ena kewarie Gibea aashu Rama.”

English: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
Masaai: Amu ena eibung'a kulikae nepong'ori neitu etil enkirukoto. Metaa empiris te nebo intae.

English: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
Masaai: “Entaas esiaai inyi too nkolong'i ile, kake ore te nkolong e naapishana niyeng'iyeng'a pee etum olkiteng lino o sikiria lino enkiyeng'iyengata, negolu olayioni le rrindik ino o ilo dokunoti.

English: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Eitayioki enkolong e sabato te nkaraki oltung'ani, eitu eitaini oltung'ani te nkaraki enkolong e sabato;

English: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
Masaai: Neaku eikenoyioki apa Miriam ti auluo ilng'oborri nkolong'i naapishana, neitu edumunye iltung'ana aapuo o metaba anaa neitokini aaitijing'u Miriam.

English: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
Masaai: Ayiolo eneikununo eng'orikinoto aashu te enkiputakinoto, ore te pooki toki oo too rishat pooki atayiolo olosek lashurakinye eraposhoi e esumash, ti ari o ti ameyu.

English: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nebik tiong'ata e paran, neyamaki ng'otonye enkitok naitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adin, naa iip ong'uan o onom o ong'uan.

English: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajo, “Tena intae iyiolouu nchere etii Enkai naishu atua intae, naa nchere meitadiak ninye eitu earaa te dukuya intae Ilkanaani, o Ilhiti, o Ilhifi, o Ilperesi, o Ilgilgashi, o Lamori o Ilyebusi.

English: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
Masaai: Mimbooyo enkitamioto ererioroto te nkerai; amu tinindong ninye te ng'udi nemeye.

English: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
Masaai: Nelo Hilkia o lelo pooki ooirriwayie olaiguanani enetii enkoiboni naji Hilda. Naa enkitok apa e Shalum olayioni le Takat, olayioni le Hasra, ilo aing'urani lo sanduku. (naa Yerusalem apa namanya ninye) neirorie ninche ninye aaikilikuanishore.

English: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Setu naa iip isiet o artam o imiet.

English: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
Masaai: Te naaipot ninye nanu nawaliki nanu ninye; kaaku nanu te nebo ninye te nkata e nyamali, kamitu nanu ninye nayanyitu ninye.

English: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu Kana e Galilaya ine neitaayie enkare enaisho oo sabibu. Netii apa oltung'ani kitok omuei olayioni lenye te Kapernaum.

English: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
Masaai: Ore amu oltung'ani loo sipat Yosef, olpayian lenye, nemeyieu nesul, neyieu neleliari aing'uaa.

English: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
Masaai: “Entuutarie ate enkitanyaanyukoto o lng'aboli ore te neiteru aitayu imbenek niyiolouu aajo etinyikua olodalu.

English: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
Masaai: Neaku nena kinyat naanya lbitiro eng'uar pee enya; nemeetae oloisho toki.

English: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
Masaai: Etonita taata Solomon to lorika le nkitoo.

English: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yehu, “Ore enkaraki nitaasa esidai too nkonyek aainei, nintaasa enkaji e Ahab te risioroto e nena pooki naatii oltau lai, ore ilayiok linono le ishoi e ong'uan, kepuo aatonie olorika le nkitoo too Siraeli.”

English: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
Masaai: Etii nkatitin aainei nkaik inono, tokorduaki nanu too nkaik oo lmang'ati laainei o lelo laaisilisil nanu!

English: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
Masaai: Neinyala ilbitiro le ntim ninye, ore nena pooki naapuo ti ong'ata neinos ninye.

English: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Kaji aiko te naning'u eitu atum oltung'ani laautaa?” Neikilikuan Filipo meilepaki ina garri enye aton atashare.

English: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Isiraeli ilng'oborri lenye. Kake eitoria apa Rehoboam iltung'ana loo Siraeli oomanya atua nkanas e Yuda.

English: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
Masaai: Tenaa ira iyie ng'en, naa aira ng'en te nkorrok ino; naa tinisukenyisho, naa iyie ake openy onap.

English: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
Masaai: neng'iri Ilamori aabik ti atua Har-heres, o ti atua Aiyalon, o ti atua Sha-albim, kake eturokine enkaina e nkaji e Yosef ninche te ngolon, neaku ile nkisiaayiare nagol.

English: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
Masaai: Kake te na kenchankar oo rorei o nkarn o nkitanapat inyi, eng'urai oopeny; mayieu nanu naaku olarishani loo mbaa neeijo nena.”

English: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
Masaai: Nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani, nelo aar metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet o imiet te lelo ng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Asiria. Ore ake pee einyototo iltung'ana tadekenya ng'ura, etaa duoo kulo pooki mpopoki.

English: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
Masaai: Ore ti atua iwuejitin pooki nashomo nanu te nebo iltung'ana pooki le Israel, eitu nanu airo ororei te likae hoo obo loo larishak loo Israeli laa ninche aitanapa meirrita iltung'ana laainei Israeli, ajoki “Kainyoo pee eitu kishetakiki nanu enkaji oo ltarakua?” ’

English: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
Masaai: Neibalunye enkutuk ai nena kiaasin inono supati, nena kiaasin inono e njeunoto endama pooki, amu etogiroitie esiana enye eng'eno ai.

English: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha; nereu Olaitoriani enaiposha siadi to siwuo ogol le nkilepunoto e nkolong e nkewarie pooki, neitaa enaiposha enkop natoyio, neoro nkariak.

English: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Te naa naaji irara modook anaata miatata eng'oki. Ore enatiu, ijojo, ‘Kidolisho;’ nebik enkitarruoroto inyi.

English: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon, “Lo Kitok, kitaasishote enkewarie nalulung'a neitu kitum toki, kake ore amu itejo, kaitadoyio resheta.”

English: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
Masaai: Naatum ilarripok nanu, ina kata emanaa te nkanasa; naar nanu, naapik nanu olbae, naaoru nanu enkila ai, lelo arripok le nena sunta.

English: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip airoro nejoki Simon, “Terewa enegut nintadoikiki rresheta inyi enaiposha aaibung isinkir.”

English: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
Masaai: Amu kedumakino olorere olikae orere, nedumakino enkitoria enkae kitoria; netumi olokirikiri le nkop too wuejitin kumok, netumi lameitin; naa ena enkiterata oo sinaitin.

English: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
Masaai: Etiaakita intae, “Ore te nkata e nkiting'oto naa kepuonu ilasukenyak, oosuj ing'uarrat enye nemetii euriata e Nkai.”

English: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ninye ninche ilomon le seriani ejo, “Aisupat papaai linyi, ilo apa payian kitok liimakiita? Keton eishu?”

English: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
Masaai: Meetae eushei ti alo Yakobo, metii esakut ti alo Israel; kepuoi taata aajo ti alo Yakobo o Israel, ‘Kaa etaasa Enkai!’

English: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
Masaai: Nepon Absalom ajo, “Oi naaji aa kara oladung'oni le nkiguana tena kop! Neaku ore pooki tung'ani oata enkiguana arashu enaikilikuanu neidim aeu enatii, naisho nanu ninye esipata.”

English: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
Masaai: Near olaiguanani le Babilon ninche metuata te Ribla tiatua enkop e Hamat. Neaku eibung'aki Yuda aaraya neitung'uari enkop enye.

English: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
Masaai: Kake ijojo intae, ore oltung'ani ojoki menye anaa ng'otonye inchere, ‘Ore toki naata naaretie iyie etaa enaisho Enkai to lasar,’ neaku meyanyit menye aashu ng'otonye.

English: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani lemelo enkiguana oo ltung'ana torrok, nemeitashe te nkoitoi oo laing'okok, nemeton to lturrur le lelo loo lderrat torrok;

English: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
Masaai: ore lelo pooki oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo ebaiki Lebanon o metabaiki Misrefot-maim, o metabaiki doi ninye Isidoni pooki. Kamiraa nanu makewan aipang'ie te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel; kake tooriki ake duoo iyie ina kop iltung'ana le Israel metaa enjung'ore enye, anaa apa enaaitanapa nanu iyie.

English: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
Masaai: Neiturrurrukino loreren pooki dukuya ninye negel ninche anaa olchekut ogelu nkerra arishie nkineji.

English: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
Masaai: Neitayu ilgiso oong'uan oonapieki le sahabu neibung'ie ninche lelo pijat lenyena pokira oong'uan, etii ake ilgiso aare enkalo nabo netii ilgiso aare enkae alo.

English: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
Masaai: Eikilikuanua ninye enkare neisho ninye kule, eyaka ninye kule naaoto te ngirra e nkitoo.

English: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
Masaai: ijoki lelo ooena, ‘Wootu ene,’ nijoki lelo ootii enaimin, ‘Entalioto.’ Nepuo ninche aadaa too mbat oo nkoitoi, ore nkisiajat pooki naaika neaku endaata enye.

English: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
Masaai: Amu kelotu enkata nemeyieu iltung'ana neng'iri ina kiteng'enare supat kake esuj ninche iyieunot enye neing'uraki ate ilturrurri loo laiteng'enak ooitabaya nena naayieu ninche, te ng'ion oo nkiyiaa enye,

English: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
Masaai: nabo olong too loshon pooki lo laiguanani Serser te nkolong e tomon o okuni to lapa le tomon o are, laa olapa le Adar.

English: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
Masaai: Eewuo osina kitok shumata Gasa, eidaa Ashkelon. Lopisiai o telekua le Anakim, eidung'udung'u akenya kewan to sina o anu?

English: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
Masaai: Ing'uraki nanu, nimimputukuny, nipik enkaina ino enkutuk ino.

English: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
Masaai: Naa keibung'are iloreren kumok Olaitoriani teina olong, naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei; naa katon nanu tiatua intae, niyiolouu aajo Olaitoriani loo lororani laairriwua nanu atua intae.

English: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
Masaai: Neipot Abna Yoab, nejoki, “Amaa, keaku kedaa olalem ntarasi? Aimiyiolo ajo keduaru enkiting'oto? Kebaa kenya enkata pee imbok iltung'ana linono metapala emirata oo lalashera lenye?”

English: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
Masaai: Neas enkitok e Yeroboam ina, nedumunye ninye nelo Shilo, nelo enkaji e Ahija. Nemeekure apa edolisho Ahija amu eiliilaitie nkonyek enyena te nkaraki emoruao.

English: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
Masaai: metaa ore ena are nayau enduaran, nchoo elo atua enkoshoke ino, neiteijia osesen lino neibibiaa enkupes ino.’ Nejo ina kitok, ‘Esai, Esai.’

English: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
Masaai: Anaa lelo oshon ooishoo Olaitoriani mediaa te dukuya nkonyek inono, enkaraki nimiyieu iyie nining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Paulo, Silvano, o Timoteo, enetii esirit oo Lsesalonike, Ti atua Enkai Papa o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo, Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani.

English: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
Masaai: Kake ore egira obo lenye auroo olchani nedoiki entolu enye atua enkare, neishir ninye ajo, “Oi olkitok lai! Katoomonuo apa ena tolu.”

English: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
Masaai: o nkishu nkalifuni tomoni uni o ile,

English: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
Masaai: Entasaisho pee mebau nena te nkata e nkirobi.

English: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ham naa Kush, o Misri, o Put, o Kanaan.

English: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
Masaai: Ti atua enguton aaishiraka nanu, Olaitoriani!

English: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Masaai: Entayiolo nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai! Ninye oitobira iyiook, nikira iyiook ilenyena; kira iyiook iltung'ana lenyena, o nkerra e nkirrita enye.

English: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
Masaai: Eitu einepu intae ae temata nemetiu anaa noshi ake naatum ilkulikae tung'ana. Keisiligayu Enkai, nemeisho ninye metetemi intae enalang ina nimindimidimi aairisha, kake ore ake entemata nalotu neisho ake intae enkoitoi nipaashieshie pee itumutumu aairisha.

English: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
Masaai: “Ijojo aa? Eeta apa oltung'ani ilayiok aare; nelo enetii obo nejoki, ‘Enkerai ai, shomo taata ntayu esiaai te nkurma oo sabibu.’

English: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
Masaai: Nepuonu sii ninche iloosotu kodi meibatisai, neikilikuan aajoki, “Lo aiteng'enani, kaa kiaas iyiook?”

English: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
Masaai: Ore olosujaki naa Yehosabad tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet ootanapate pee epuo olarrabal.

English: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Saul Enkai, “Amaa, kalo nanu adoyio asujaa Ilfilisti? Amaa nchoru ninche apik atua enkaina e Israel?” Kake eitu ninye ewaliki ninye ina olong.

English: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong ake neitayu Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri too lororani lenye.

English: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilooiteng'eni ina bae, neing'asia nejo, “Kaji eikuna pee etoyio olng'aboli nabo kata?”

English: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
Masaai: Ng'ura, elotu ninye ailepu anaa nkatampo, neikununo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan anaa olkutati, neneneng mbartan enyena aalang ilkurragoso - oi iyiook, amu kindaaitie!

English: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
Masaai: Kake eipotuo Musa ninche; neshukokino ninye Aron o larikok pooki lo lorere, neiro Musa te nebo ninche.

English: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena ninye enalimu ena kitanyaanyukoto.

English: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
Masaai: naa tenaa eikiti oleng enkaji to lkuo le ker, ore ake oltung'ani o lelatia enye otashare enkaji enye neitayu te risioroto esiana oo ltung'ana; anaa enaidim ake oltung'ani ainosa nintayuyu olkuo le ker obo.

English: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
Masaai: Nemebukokini iseseni ake le pooki ng'ae, nimintayu ae nanyaanyukie te nkitobirunoto; kesinya ninye, naa keton esinya te iyie.

English: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
Masaai: Neaku eirraga Amnon, neitaakuno kemuei; ore ake pee elotu olaiguanani adol ninye, nejoki Amnon olaiguanani, “Nchoo siaake enkanashe ai Tamar elotu aitobir inkuti mukateni te dukuya nanu, pee aatum ninye aishoo endaa.”

English: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
Masaai: Neipotuni iltung'ana le Israel te Naftali o te Asheri o te Manase pooki metusujai aamir iltung'ana le Midian.

English: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
Masaai: “Naa keitayu ninye olkuoo le ker lo lari obo lemeeta entioto metaa olasar opejori to Laitoriani anaake; tadekenya eitayu ninye.

English: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
Masaai: Ore eng'eno oltau naa kening'u inkitanapat, kake ore olmodai loo rorei kumok naa keidaaya.

English: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e naapishana naa iloing'ok oopishana, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,

English: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
Masaai: Metomitu ninye ewalata e lelo aisinak le tung'ana, nchoo enkordunoto lelo oomena, nirrar ilo oitorogonyisho!

English: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
Masaai: Te naing'or nanu keper ino, ina siaai oo lkimojik linono, olapa o lakir litipika iyie;

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok inchoo ening enajoki, Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho naa kaisho ninye eoroti e mana naisudoro, naisho osoit oibor, osirakino enkarna enye ng'ejuk, nemeyiolo likae tung'ani meteleku ilo ake ong'amu.’

English: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.
Masaai: Entujurroto naa maate, pee inyorrurru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
Masaai: Te nenya enkima enkop, neibung ilkiku o metaa ore enkanasa nateenaki arashu enkano naitashe arashu enkurma nabulu einosa enkima, ore ilo oinua enkima nelak pooki.

English: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki nataasa Manase, olaiguanani le Yuda, ele minong, netaasa mbaa torrok aitulus nena oo Lamori, apa laa ninche ootii te dukuya ninye, nerikoki Yuda metaasa eng'oki te nena kitanyaanyukot enyena;

English: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
Masaai: nchoo eiteng'el kewan te naisho oo sabibu o te naisho napi, meok ninye ae toki naironyuaki too sabibu aashu enaisho napi; nemeinos isabibu ooshal aashu ilootoito.

English: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
Masaai: Nikirriwaa te nebo ninche likae ake alashe lang likitetema enkirowuaj enye nkatitin kumok too nkoitoi kumok, naa ninye taata oirowua oleng te nkaraki enkisiligata kitok naata ti atua intae.

English: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki natonyorra apa ninye iloo papaai linyi negelu eishoi enye te siadi ninche, neitayu intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, te ngolon enye kitok, etii ninye tenebo intae.

English: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
Masaai: ore pee eitayioloi ninye ina ng'oki nataasa, neyau ninye anaa olasar lenye enkine, ositima lemeeta entioto,

English: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
Masaai: Kake eewuo Enkai kewarie enetii Abimelek te nkidetidet, nejoki, “Ing'ura ira iyie oltung'ani otua tenkaraki ina kitok niwa, amu ore ninye naa enkitok e likae tung'ani.”

English: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltimito nena anas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda, nepik iltimito enkop e Yuda, o nkanas e Efraim apa naatarayie Asa papaai lenye.

English: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyau Yakobo osoit, neitasheyie aitaa eng'ape.

English: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
Masaai: Een inkariak too nkatampo naairrusha, nemepolosa inkatampo tiabori ninche.

English: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
Masaai: Ore enkiputakinoto e raposhoi enye, naa osina, kelotu engolon pooki o sina shumata ninye.

English: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
Masaai: o lelo ooshong'ishong le lelo erat oopuo aabaya entonata e Ari, nepuo o meikobo olpolosie le Moab.”

English: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
Masaai: Kaji etiu pee eitu etumi obo oshukunye aisho Enkai enashe meteleku ele leeiking'a?”

English: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyau Shem o Yafet olkila eiteleikino iloilila lenye, nepuo te siadi, neitoip emasipaisho e Papaai lenye; ore inkomomi enye neingorie dikae, neitu ninche edol emasipaisho e papaai lenye.

English: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ninche ina neiput engoro, nebuak aajo, “Kitok ake Artemis oo Leefeso.”

English: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
Masaai: Ajo etijing'a enkaji e Nkai, neitayu emukate e nkitoduaaroto, nenya, neng'arie sii lelo ooisiritore. Neibala nchere meishoruno too nkitanapat meinosa likae tung'ani ina mukate leme lapolosak?”

English: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
Masaai: neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eilo asar opejori, naa keng'amari te nkaraki ninye pee eitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye.

English: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
Masaai: tinirragie sahabu te nterit, aashu inang'aa sahabu naisul too lturot ootoito

English: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.
Masaai: Amu eitadouo apa Olaitoriani Yuda tenkaraki Ahas olaiguanani le Israel, amu etaasa apa ninye inenkarruoisho tiatua Yuda, netaa olemeisiligayu to Laitoriani.

English: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
Masaai: Nguanareki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai ai, te risioroto e supatisho ino; nimincho ninche eng'ida te nkaraki nanu!

English: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, meetae olorere aashu enkitoria neitu eirriwaa olkitok lai ilkiliku king'oru iyie, naa tenejo ninche, ‘Metii ninye ene,’ neinosie olmumai ina kitoria aashu ilo orere, nchere eitu ninche kitum iyie.

English: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
Masaai: Nedumu enkikompe, ore pee eishooyo enashe neisho ninche, neok pooki.

English: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
Masaai: Ore apa nkiaasin o laiguanani Daudi, ebaiki enkiterunoto ometabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki te mbuku oo nkatinin e Samuel oladuaani, o too nkatinin e Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai, o too nkatinin e Gad oladuaani,

English: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
Masaai: Netolikioki apa Yoshua, “Ore lelo aiguanak pokira imiet nenotoki eisudori ti atua enkapune te Makeda.”

English: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
Masaai: Atanya nanu ilo ashe lino, iyie Samaria. Eyupuyup engoro ai tiaalo ninche. Ketoni kenya o anu, pee esinyayu ninche ti alo Israel?

English: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
Masaai: Kake aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Miureyu ninye; amu aishorua nanu ninye, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, o enkop enye apik atua enkaina ino, naa ilo iyie aitaas ninye anaa enintaasa Sihon ilo aiguanani le Amori, apa omanya Heshbon.’

English: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
Masaai: Eikimuat ninche aaman too nkang'itie inono pooki, ometaba anaa neurori nena sunta inono adoru naagol apa nisiliga tiatua enkop ino pooki, nikimuat ninche aaman too nkang'itie inono pooki, tiatua enkop ino pooki apa nikinchoo Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
Masaai: Ilo iyie anaku kule oo loshon, nilo iyie anak ilki loo laiguanak, naa ilo ayiolou nchere, nanu, Olaitoriani, Olaitajeunoni lino, naa nanu Olalakunoni, Ilo Magilani le Yakobo.

English: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Saul enjore oo Lfilisti, neureishoyu neikirikira oltau lenye oleng.

English: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Nejo, “Esipa ajoki intae, te neitu imbelekenyanya aatiu anaa inkera kutiti, nimijing'ijing'i katukul enkitoria e shumata.

English: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
Masaai: Kake eyiolo Onan ajo ore inkera naaiu nemeaku inenyena, neaku ore ake peyie elo ayiolou enkitok olalashe lenye, nebukoki enkare e le waisho enkop pee meisho ake inkera olalashe lenye.

English: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
Masaai: Neitu ejing'aa ele rorei otiaaka.

English: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
Masaai: Elkana olayioni lenye, o Sofai olayioni lenye, o Nahat olayioni lenye,

English: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
Masaai: Ore pee eitoki aipang likae kekun, ng'ura Ilhebrania aare oopupung'a; nejoki ninye ilo tung'ani oitarruoyie, “Kainyoo pee iar oltung'ani lo lorere lino?”

English: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
Masaai: Ore eishoi e Yehoiakin ilo apa oshomo eyararoto naa: Shealtiel olayioni lenye,

English: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neye isinkir ootii atua olkeju le Nail; neng'ueyu olkeju le Nail o metaa meidim Ilmisiri aatook enkare naing'uaa olkeju le Nail; neaku osarge te nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseiyie endapash enye neituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
Masaai: nebik apa ninye te Gilead, tiatua Bashan o too nkang'itie enyena, o teina kop pooki nairritishoreki e Sharon o meiting'ie.

English: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
Masaai: Ore taisere tadoi shomo tigilunore ninche; ng'ura keilepu ninche aaimu enkoitoi e Siis; ilo iyie ainepu ninche te nkiting'oto o erata, te nkalo o loo saen tiong'ota e Yeruel.

English: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD unto the people that asked of him a king.
Masaai: Neliki Samuel irorei pooki lo Laitoriani lelo tung'ana ooikilikuanu olaiguanani te ninye.

English: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatukurtoi empeut mail uni aashu ong'uan nedol Yesu elo te shumata e naiposha elotu anyikaki empeut; neureishoyu ninche.

English: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
Masaai: Kitoning'o iyiook ele toilo pee elotu eing'uaa shumata amu kiboitare apa iyiook ninye te ilo doinyo sinyati.

English: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
Masaai: Rekem, o Irpeel, o Tarala,

English: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia airriwaa ilkiliku meshomo enetii Yoash olayioni le Yehoahas, olayioni le Yehu, olaiguanani le Israel, ajoki, “Wou maing'urata iyiook too nkomomi.”

English: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
Masaai: Neitoki aitayu enkurriny o eilata olkidong'oe, oina kurriny pooki e nkoshoke, olkina le monyua, o lairakuj pokira oare o enkurriny enye, o emuro e tatene;

English: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Helem olalashe lenye: Sofa, o Imna, o Shelesh, o Amal.

English: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
Masaai: nara ilo oishu atua apa, naa ng'ura aishu taata o ntarasi, naa nanu oata imboleta e keeya o ewueji e nkima.

English: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
Masaai: Kake ore ninche o loo papa netaasa mbaa olwuasa neitagol ilukuny enye, neitu eiruk nkitanapat.

English: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
Masaai: Nepik ninye emesa atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nkalo e moikuape e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ti oriong ilo karasha lo liatua,

English: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.
Masaai: Ore sii Ilo ora Enkitoo e Israel nemelejisho arashu eirridu; amu mme oltung'ani ninye, metaa keirridu.”

English: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
Masaai: Irridu naa enkarrueisho ino niomon Olaitoriani pee idol te naa eikipalakini ina yieunoto o ltau lino.

English: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
Masaai: Yakobo le Sebedayo, o Yohana olalashe Yakobo, neisho lelo enkarna ajo Boanerge, aa keji Ilenkikurrukur:

English: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
Masaai: Nenang'aa olkila lenye, neipid nelo enetii Yesu.

English: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atumuta loreren oopishana te nkop e Kanaan, neisho ninche enkop enye metujung'o, te rishata oo larin iip ong'uan o onom.

English: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
Masaai: Eirrag ninye tiabori entim oo lkiku, tiatua ine netii iseyia to lbalbal.

English: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
Masaai: Tudumunye, iyie Enkai, nguanare enkop; amu ilkulinono iloreren pooki!

English: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
