Masaai: Amu ore enetumore oare anaa akuni te nkarna ai, natii nanu ine atua ninche.”

English: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
Masaai: Amu Ilo Likintobira iyie ninye olpayian lino, Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye; naa Ilo Sinyati le Israel Olakordunoni lino, naa keji ninye Enkai e nkop pooki.

English: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
Masaai: pee eaku pooki nabo, anaa iyie Papa itii atua nanu natii nanu atua iyie, pee etii sii ninche atua iyiook, pee etum enkop airuko nchere iyie likirriwua.

English: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
Masaai: Nchira anaa esila naishopokoki ilkuniyiani, eishiraki keeya eilo ojo pee eyam ninye.

English: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
Masaai: “Mintoki naa alimu irorei le naibon.” Ejo ninche elimu ilomon, “Meishiaakino nelimu oltung'ani ilomon le kuna baa; meinepu iyiook esulare.”

English: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
Masaai: Intayu olkerubi obo te nkalo nabo nintayu olikae te nkae shoto; te ntoki nabo intobira lelo kerubi o ilo orika lo lng'ur too nkaloli enyena pokira are.

English: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
Masaai: kake ore ebaiki ena olong eitu eisho intae Olaitoriani eng'eno niyiolounyenye, aashu nkonyek nidolielie aashu nkiyiaa nining'ieng'ie.

English: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii aitobir nkejek tomon naatonie ilo moti. Ore ake enkitotonet nabo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina enkadoro, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina endapasho, naa ntemat uni e nkaina enkadoro nailep.

English: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
Masaai: Entoning ena, intae ilooibooki iloomena enkop, niyauu lelo aisinak le nkop aaishie,

English: For he found her in the field, and the betrothed damsel cried, and there was none to save her.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nainepua ninye ti ong'ota, naa ore hoo neishira ina kitok nasayia metomituni metii oltung'ani omitu ninye.

English: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
Masaai: Naaitanap nanu Olaitoriani ina kata pee aiteng'en intae nena kikoot o nkiguanat, pee itumutumu aataas ninche teina kop nipuopuo aaya.

English: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
Masaai: Metumi ninye te sahabu, nemeineneng'i enkosholai metaa elaata enye.

English: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
Masaai: Enchiraki ninye, intae pooki oomanita ninye, o pooki ooyiolo enkarna enye; entejo, ‘Eng'ura etigile eng'udi nagol, ina ng'udi enkitoo.’

English: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie pooki toki natii abori ninye neiduruku o metaa teipa, ore ilo onap entoki neijo ina nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
Masaai: Naa teneleji oloiboni lai neiro ororei, ore nanu, Olaitoriani oteleja ilo oiboni, naa kaitorioo enkaina ai agilunore ninye naidaikie ninye tiatua iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.

English: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore enkata apa naitoreishe Yeroboam, naa ilarin tikitam oare, neirura aye anaa loo menye neitoreisho Nadab te rishata enye.

English: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
Masaai: Neipang'aki Lot ninche teboo, nerrinyoki enkikenet enkaji.

English: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:
Masaai: Amu olorere kiseruti ninche nkera naalejisho, nkera nemening ninche enkiteng'enare o Laitoriani;

English: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing atua, nejoki ninche, “Ainyoo pee nchirishiri aabuakita? Eitu eye enkerai keirura.”

English: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninye, “Ara entito e Betuel olayioni le Milka otoikio Nahor.”

English: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.
Masaai: Nejo apa ile Ruben o le Gad enkarna e ilo perere lo lasar “Shakeni;” amu etejo ninche, “shakeni ninye te iyiook nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.”

English: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
Masaai: Neya ninche Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore ayaki olaiguanani le Babilon te Ribla.

English: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
Masaai: Etii enkutuk olaiguanani iwalat naatipikaki engolon: nemeitadiak enkutuk enye te nkiguana.

English: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
Masaai: Ore nena naayautua ilainyang'ak o lamirak, eyautua sii ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o lbalusuni leina kop sahabu o enkosholai aayaki Solomon.

English: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
Masaai: Tenajo, ‘Madamu nanu enking'unyung'uny ai, ekaiwuang'ie esototo enkomom ai, naaku oloota enchipai’;

English: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong, etigile enkolong, ore pee edumunye Daudi te ndapash enye, neloolo ninye te nchumata oltapeet le nkaji o laiguanani, nedol ninye te nchumata olperere enkitok eitukuo; naa eisidai ina kitok oleng.

English: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
Masaai: ore nena doinyo apa naaturi too nchempei nimintokiki intae aapuonu ine iurere entim oo lkiku; kake keaku nene wuejitin ineeidapashakino nkishu o nkerra.

English: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
Masaai: “Tenetang'uarra oltau lai enkitok ole latia ai, nairraga aanyisho te kutukaji ole latia ai,

English: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
Masaai: Etii imayianat endukuya e ilo supat kake ore enkutuk eilo torrono nemuk enapiak.

English: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le dukuya to lari li aare, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, neitasheyieki olng'obor le Nkai.

English: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
Masaai: Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Ara nanu Gabriel, oitashe te dukuya Enkai; naairriwuaki maairorie naaitabaiki ele kilikuai supat.

English: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
Masaai: Etiu nkonyek inono anaa oltaa lo sesen lino, naa te naa biyot nkonyek inono, newang osesen lino pooki; kake ore pee kira torrok nkonyek nerip enaimin osesen lino pooki.

English: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
Masaai: Ajo neijia aa intae aiteleliaki, mme kaitoriaki intae.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ina suntai dapash e Babilon naa keitorisiokini enkop aaitadou, ore nena shomito enyena adoru naa kepeji te nkima. Eisiaaisho iltung'ana te mpesho ore nkuapi pooki naa te nkima ake eitanaur ate.”

English: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
Masaai: Ore enaipirie enkolong, lo aiguanani, nadol te nkoitoi ewang'an naing'uaa keper, nawang alang enkolong, newang'u aamanita o lelo apa laairiamariyie.

English: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: “Kaing'ae doi ilo litamoro nisurdaany? Kaing'ae ilo lidumaki oltoilo lino, nishumaki nkonyek inono to lwuasa? Ilo osinya le Israel!

English: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
Masaai: enkolong e oshoto e ntarumpeta o lkiyioi lo larrabal, egilunore nena anas naasheta isunta negilunore iltaleta lo larrabal.

English: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
Masaai: Ing'ura keper pee idol, naa ng'ura nena atampo, naatii shumata oleng shumata iyie.

English: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
Masaai: King'uaa iyiook Partia, Media, Elam; niking'uaa Mesopotamia, Yudea, o Kapodokia; niking'uaa Ponto o Asia,

English: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
Masaai: Kake etorikine ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye; nemiraki ninye ninche atua enkaina e Sisera, olkitok le njore e Yabin, olaiguanani le Hasor, o atua enkaina oo lfilisti, o atua enkaina o laiguanani le Moab; nearare ninche lelo.

English: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
Masaai: Neng'amaa olaiguanani Hesekia ina palai te lelo ooirriwuaki, neisum ninye, Neilep Hesekia alo enkaji o Laitoriani, nelo aisalaash ina palai te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
Masaai: Ore Yuda o ina kop e Israel netimirishote tenebo iyie; einyang'utua imasaa inyi emirare te nkano, too loirienito o lng'abolo le dukuya, o inaishi o ila, o lchani oji Seri.

English: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
Masaai: Ntorrok edamu ninye te ndapash enye; nepik ninye kewan enkoitoi neme sidai; nemeiturraa entorroni.

English: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
Masaai: Ore pee edol ajo keitiship ina Lyahudi, neitulus aibung sii Petero. Naa to sirua loo Nkolong'i oo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki.

English: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD'S anointed.
Masaai: Dol, ore ena olong etoduaa nkonyek inono aajo kitipika taata iyie Olaitoriani atua enkaina ai ti atua enkapune; naajoki nanu ilkulikae maataara iyie tua, kake aatapala nanu. Najo, ‘Maitorioo enkaina ai aar olkitok lai; amu olotubukokoki eilata aaput lo Laitoriani ninye!’

English: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
Masaai: Nedumunye apa lelo tung'ana aaiteru elototo enye; neitanap Yoshua lelo apa ooshomo aasir eoroto e nkop, ajoki, “Enchom elepa nidouu nisirisiri eoroto e nkop, nintokiki aashukunye aapuonu enatii; amu kaosh nanu enkukuo te nkaraki intae tene te dukuya Olaitoriani te Shilo.”

English: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
Masaai: ajo kaaboloki ilo Inoti lenye peyie atum atolikioi Lomon Supati ti atua Loreren, eitu aikilikuanishore likae tung'ani loo nkiri o sarge.

English: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
Masaai: Neitoki ake aaing'oru eneibung'ie ninye; kake etuluarie ninye ninche.

English: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
Masaai: ina kata nayau ninche ashuku too loreren naiturrurru ninche aitung'uaa ilmang'ati le nkop enye, naa tiatua ninche aibalie esinyatisho ai edolita iloreren kumok.

English: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
Masaai: Oo taa endaa napolosakini nkitanyaanyukot naaitaai nkaitin. aikiyiolo doi anaa enoshi nijojo, “aikiata pooki eng'eno.” Kake ore ina “ng'eno” inyi naa olwuasa epik iltung'ana; kake keshetu ninye enyorrata ltung'ana.

English: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Neing'urrie apa iltung'ana Benchamen enkaraki natipika Olaitoriani elusie iloshon le Israel.

English: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Masaai: ore anaa enalakuaniki oloo saen oloontoluo, neijia eiko ninye aitalamaa nkitarruorrot ang te iyiook.

English: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
Masaai: Nemir Israel Yuda neisik pooki tung'ani alo enkang enye.

English: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
Masaai: Enkiti wueji pee eitu aaishie nanu te nkop; kake eitu nanu aiturraa nkitanapat inono.

English: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
Masaai: Emanya apa Gibeon menye le Gibeon, oji Yeiel, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Maaka,

English: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
Masaai: Iyie eing'or kuna pooki, pee incho ninche endaa enye too rishat enye.

English: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
Masaai: Ore pee etum obo, nelo amir intokitin pooki naata, neinyang'u ina.

English: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
Masaai: Kiyiolo doi aajo ore Nkitanapat naa ne nkiyang'et, nematiu nanu neijia. Kake ara nanu oltung'ani otimiraki mataa orrindik loo ng'ok.

English: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo inkolong'i ile, nerik Yesu Petero o Yakobo o lalashe lenye Yohana ailepie ninche oopeny shumata oldoinyo oado.

English: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
Masaai: Amaa, enkibatisa e Yohana, kaji eing'uaa? Keshumata eing'uaa ana iltung'ana?” Nejokino maate, “Te nikijo, ‘Shumata eing'uaa;’ naa kejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?’

English: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana le Israel ina, neiturrurro olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel te Shilo, pee earare ninche.

English: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
Masaai: Neya osesen le Yesu neirin too nkarash e kitani napuyiapui te nebo ina ilata narropil, anaa enatiu olkerreti loo Lyahudi le nukaroto.

English: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni, to lapa liong'uan, te nkolong e miet, o lapa, ina kata atii tenebo yarunot te mbata olkeju le Keba, nebolo keper nadol induaat e Nkai.

English: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
Masaai: amu etarishe papa te nkaraki intae, nepik enkishui enye batisho, nekordu intae aitung'uaa enkaina e Midian;

English: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
Masaai: Nedol shumata etabole nedou entoki neeijo olkarasha oililio too lcholo pokira oong'uan eililiunye adoiki enkop;

English: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
Masaai: Eisidai apa te naaitamioki nanu, pee atum atayiolo nkitanapat inono.

English: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
Masaai: Metaa etua Raheli, nenukari te nkoitoi epuoi Efrat, (aa ninye Betlehem),

English: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
Masaai: neya ninye ilchumat te nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat te nkaji o laiguanani, neya ninye pooki toki. Neya sii nena long'oi pooki e sahabu apa naaitobira Solomon;

English: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
Masaai: Kitijing'a kuna tabo pokira are - kaing'ae likintigir iyie? - eliyio, o enkidaata, o lameyu o lalem; kaing'ae likintagol iyie?

English: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eitirrishaki ninye o metaba anaa nedol enkurruna, nejo ninye, “Erriwai.” Neirriwaa ninche iltung'ana onom; ore too nkolong'i uni, neing'oru ninye kake eitu etum ninye.

English: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie ilarin ooikash, neye ilo aiguanani le Misiri. Neton ake eisomita iltung'ana loo Siraeli te sinkaisho enye, neyietu aaishiru eretoto; ore ilo kiyioi lenye le sinkaisho neilep enetii Enkai.

English: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
Masaai: Neing'uaa shetani ninye te ina kata; naa ng'ura, nepuonu ilmalaika aaisiaai ninye.

English: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
Masaai: Tadamu ororei lino to sinka lino, laa ninye nanu kinchoo maisiliga.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olmeregesh metaa olasar le seriani to Laitoriani, tenebo enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, neyau sii olapolosani olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki.

English: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
Masaai: “Aatanyamala oltau lai taata, naa kajo aa? Kajo ‘Papa intajeuoki te na saa?’ Kake te nkaraki ena bae e mion pee atabaikia ena saa.

English: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
Masaai: Ore ilo ora ng'en, nchoo eyiolou kuna baa; ore ilo ojurrisho, nchoo eyiolou ninche; amu keitoriori nkoitoi o Laitoriani, ore ilasipak neim ninche, kake kerrorro ilaitarruorok te ninche.

English: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
Masaai: Naa kaishooyo iyie apik inkaik oo sintan linono naa kasulaa ilgilat linono negil aauroo iwuejitin inono neeika, naa aikioru ninche iyie inkilani inono neya imasaa inono sidain, niking'uaa iyieira emasipai minchopo.

English: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
Masaai: Kake ore ilalashera anaa neorieki iyiook intae te nkiti kata, too seseni neme too ltauja, kitoinyua o te yieuna sapuk o te nyorrata kitok pee kiduaa inkomomi.

English: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
Masaai: matayooki apuo nena kurman oo sabibu, nikipuo aaing'uraa tenaa keitapuka isabibu, tenaa ketabolote intapuka oo sabibu neitapukita sii ninche kukumanka. Ore te ine naa kaaisho nanu enyorrata ai.

English: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
Masaai: amu ore ake pee eaku osesen irubarere inchushu niyeye, kake ti niaariara intae te nkiyang'et inkiaasin o sesen metuata ninchushu.

English: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Meigil ninche aabukoki Olaitoriani ilasarri ooki le naisho oo sabibu; nemeitiship ninye too lasarri lenye. Ore imukateni enye naa ketiu anaa imukateni o lkiyioi; ore naa pooki oinos ninche neisarkioneki amu ore imukateni enye naa keaku inesumash enye ake; meyauni atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oing'oni, o lchoni lenye, o nkiri enyena, o modiok enyena nepejoo ninye te nkima tiauluo ilng'oborri, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
Masaai: ometaa meisho ninye nabo nena kiri oo nkera enyena naainosita ninye, amu meetae entoki natelekakaki ninye, teina namani aamuat o teilo sina oisomit intae ilmang'ati linyi tiatua nkang'itie inono pooki.

English: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Enkai, te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno; ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino kitok, tujutoi nkitarruorot aainei.

English: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
Masaai: ore inaaing'uaa olpisiai lo losho le Manase, naa Taanak te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki o Gat-rimon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas are.

English: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
Masaai: Ina pee eshal nemueyiaa lkumok ti atua intae, netuata esiana.

English: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
Masaai: Metaa eshomo tenebo ninye ingarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan; metaa olorora kitok apa oleng.

English: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
Masaai: iteshetaka kewan enkaji sidai, nintobiraki kewan ewueji neika too wuejitin pooki enkanasa, neesotoreki.

English: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i naapishana intayu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, nintisiny, neaku ilo perere lo lasar sinyati oleng; ore pooki toki naiseyie olperere lo lasar nesinyayu.

English: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
Masaai: Ore ilo oar eng'ues metua nelak ore ilo oar oltung'ani metua neari sii ninye metua.

English: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
Masaai: Naitobir nanu iltaleta linono too soito oji agate, naitobir nchomito inyi too ltoto ooji almasi, naitobir isunta inono pooki too soito oogol e nkiyang'a.

English: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
Masaai: Metaa eishooyioki olalem metisiki, peyie etumi aaibung'a neiyioki nesiki, peyie etumi aatipik ina aina oloyieng'isho.

English: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
Masaai: “Kake ore ilo tung'ani lemesinya nemeituku kewan, nedung'ori ilo tung'ani aitung'uaa atua eumata, enkaraki naidurukie ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani; enkaraki neitu ebukokini enkare e enkitisinyata shumata ninye, mesinya ninye.

English: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche atua olgoriet enetii. Eidipa aairragie ilo piyayati to lgilata le Elishama ilo aigeroni; neinosaki olaiguanani mbaa pooki.

English: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
Masaai: Ekaairiamariyie iyie Misiri, naa kaaitoki ashuku ene, neaku inkaik e Yosef ilo airurare.”

English: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
Masaai: Neluaya Yakobo eitu eliki Laban le Aram, ajoki ekeisikita alo.

English: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
Masaai: Eshomo ina tito e Dibon iwuejitin neeika aishir; aishiraki Nebo neishiraki Medeba, eishirita Moab. Etabarnoki lukuny enye o lmunyo lenye,

English: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
Masaai: Kake keetae ole mankale likikuetiki aaiponyakino.”

English: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
Masaai: Aatamana nanu nkeenta e nemeneng'a, naaipirakinore nanu irresheta le keeya.

English: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
Masaai: Naa ena enkigerore oo nkarn e nkiterata naigeroki te nkata e Kirinius olbalusui le Siria.

English: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
Masaai: Itorrinyo iyie engoro ino pooki; nimbelekenya iyie aing'uaa ina goro ino napi.

English: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
Masaai: Nimipuopuo intae aaipang te kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo too nkolong'i naapishana, o metaba anaa neishunye nkolong'i enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, amu nkolong'i naapishana ine nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik te iyie.

English: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
Masaai: Entujur ate te naa itii atua enkirukoto; entetem ate. Eimiyiololo aajo etii Yesu Kristo atua intae? Aashu te nesipa eturua intae.

English: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
Masaai: kake etasiokito apa Nadab o Abihu aaye te dukuya papaai lenye, nemeeta ninche nkera, neaku etaa Eliesa o Itamar ilapolosak.

English: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?
Masaai: Etisiraki too Nkitanapat e Musa neji, “Nimien olkiteng enkutuk errarru entapa.” Ijojo ei lelo, mongi doi eimaka Enkai?

English: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
Masaai: Tadamu Yesu Kristo, otopiwuo aing'uaa ilootuata, le ntalipa e Daudi, anaa enainosuaki te ilo rorei lai supat.

English: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
Masaai: Ore ina nataasa, eitu katukul eitiship Olaitoriani, near sii ninye metua.

English: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
Masaai: Nikintobiraki endaa namelok, anaa enoshi nanyor, nikiyaki mainosa peyie aatum atamayiana eton eitu aye.

English: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eitoreisho apa Daudi olayioni le Yese te Israel pooki.

English: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
Masaai: Nelo olapolosani ajur ina keeya, neikenoo ina naata enkeeya nkolong'i naapishana;

English: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, wherewith they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto oo nkiaasin pooki naaitaasa ninche nanu, ebaiki ina olong apa nayaua ailepunye aitung'uaa Misiri o metabaiki ena olong, aaing'uaa nanu, neisiai kulie aitin, metaa easita sii ina te iyie.

English: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
Masaai: Kake te neitaa nena baa pesho neitaa parmetii eidipa ninye atoning'o, nenap naa ninye eng'oki e nkitok enye.”

English: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:
Masaai: Mikincho iyiook ntoyie ang meyama iltung'ana lena kop, nimikiyamaki iyook ilayiok lang ntoyie enye:

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
Masaai: o lairakuj lenyena pokira oare tenebo enkurriny enye oilo kina le moinyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj

English: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.
Masaai: Naa ore ake te neipang Daudi alo eneba anaa eneirriwayie Saul nedupoyu; neaku etipika ninye Saul shumata iltung'ana le njore. Naa eisidai apa ina too nkonyek oo ltung'ana pooki o too nkonyek sii oo sinkan le Saul.

English: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
Masaai: Naa tenereuni nkerrai pooki meirraga teine, neibeleleng'oo ilchekuti ilo soit te nkutuk enchorro peyie etum aishoo ntare enye enkare. Ore ake peyie eidip aaitooko pooki, neitoki aapising enchoro teilo soit aapik enkutuk enchorro.

English: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
Masaai: Woi ena anasa o sarge ebore elejare o enkisima nemeiting aekata eyararoto enye.

English: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitapong'oo ilo supat autaki atua enkoitoi torrono, naa kesulakino engumoto enye makewan, kake ore ilo le meeta entioto naa ketum enjung'ore sidai.

English: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
Masaai: Amaa te nenyaaka taata engolon enye oo nkonyek aaku enkarsisisho too loreren, naa amaa te netaa ina natalaikinote ninche naitaa Iloreren karsisi, kebaa kenya elusoo ina nayau emborei e ning'oto te nening'ishoyu ninye!

English: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
Masaai: Kake etipikaki ninye olbae te nkaraki nkitarruorot ang, eitamorroojoki ninye tenkaraki ntorrok ang. shumata ninye etii enkitamioto naa ninye naishiunye iyiook, naa too oshot enyena eishiunyeki iyiook.

English: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
Masaai: Neponari enkare oleng te nkop, ometaa ore ildoinyo pooki adoru ootii abori keper neimisieki.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehosafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim iyiook aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani, Mikaia olayioni le Imala; kake manyor nanu ninye, amu meibonu aikata isupati tialo nanu, ntorrok ake eibonu.” Nejo Yehoshafat, mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.”

English: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
Masaai: Intaaki nanu matotiwuo anaa olmishire tiatua oltau lino, anaa olmishire otii enkaina ino; amu ore enyorrata naa kegol anaa keeya, ore olom netolo anaa enkurare. Ore inkiwuang'at enyena naa nkiwuang'at e nkima, enkima napejisho oleng to lang'at.

English: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
Masaai: Amu too ldoinyio epuku endaa enye, teine neiguranie ng'uesi pooki entim.

English: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Neya ninye sahabu pooki o enkosholai, o masaa pooki apa naainepuaki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o tiatua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani, o ltung'ana apa ootarayioki, neyau ninche Samaria.

English: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
Masaai: Etii lelo oodek iloomenye, nememayian sii noo ng'otonye.

English: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
Masaai: Ore kitajeutuo, nikipuonu aayiolou aajo keji ilo lemankale Malta.

English: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Enkai Noa ajoki,

English: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
Masaai: Keitalaku ninye entorroni too lmang'ati laainei; ore te supatisho ino nting'ie ninche.

English: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
Masaai: Etii ilkiku o rresheta enkoitoi eilo otapong'ori; ore ilo orrip kewan naa kelam ninche.

English: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
Masaai: Nening ninche, lelo kituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki ooibung'akinote olning'o nchere pee elaaya pooki ng'ae orrindik lenye olee aashu eng'oruoi meitokini aaigil aairrindikishore; neiruk ninche nelaaya ninche.

English: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
Masaai: Metaa kagelu engoroto o keeya aitalang iloik laainei.

English: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
Masaai: Netii enkitok naturuke larin tomon o aare,

English: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
Masaai: Kitok Olaitoriani lang naa kitok engolon enye; ore eng'eno enye nemeimakinoyu.

English: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
Masaai: Ore ina umata pooki e Yuda, oina umata pooki naing'uaa enkop e Israel, o lelo oomanya Yuda, neshipayu.

English: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
Masaai: Kayieu naaji netiu lewa pooki anaa nanu; kake eeta ake oltung'ani enkishoroto enye naing'uaa Enkai, neisho likae te na oitoi, neisho likae te nda.

English: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
Masaai: Naitoki adol entoki sapuk enking'asia te shumata, kitok naa ene nking'asia, ilmalaika oopishana ooata ilmeita oopishana laa ninche oobayie, laa te ninche etimitunye engoro e Enkai.

English: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.
Masaai: Ore nkaik enyena netiu anaa sahabu nairina, naikodoki too soito oogol enkinyang'a. Ore osesen lenye anaa ilaa ooitobiraki loo lkanchaoni, netii ninye iila naarropil oleng.

English: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
Masaai: Ore tenelo nadamu naing'asia oleng, neibung olokirikiri osesen lai.

English: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
Masaai: Entamayian lelo ooisilisil intae; entamayian emidek ninche.

English: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa Olaitoriani? Igoro iyie ntarasi? Keyupuyup ina goro o lom lino anaa enkima?

English: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.
Masaai: Newal obo loo lbarnot ajo, “Ng'ura, atoduaa nanu olayioni le Yese le Betlehem, laa kaarriyia te ranyare, oltung'ani opi, naa oltung'ani lo larrabal, arriyia te nkiroroto naa oltung'ani le nkishaa sidai; netii Olaitoriani te nebo ninye.”

English: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
Masaai: Naa ore inaatuunoki ti atua lkiliku, naa ilo oning ororei, neirony isinaitin le na kop, o elejare oo masaa e na kop, negor ororei nemeisho.

English: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
Masaai: naa kalo nanu te lakunoto, amu aing'orua nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai, “Aing'ae likitiaaka minchopo? Inosa o lng'anayioi lo lchani laitanapa apa intae ajoki eminya?”

English: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Mitka nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Hashmona

English: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
Masaai: o Sibraim (ina natii olpolosie orish Dameski o Hamat) o metabaiki Haseratikon, ina natii olpolosie le Hauran.

English: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho ninche te Yuda, eeta embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani tenebo ninche. Nepuo ninche aamanaa too nkanas pooki e Yuda aiteng'enisho tiatua olorere.

English: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu aisinani namena, netalepori oltau lai ti atua nanu.

English: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkiti kata nelotu osiwuo oji ole rishata e nkilepunoto e kopikop, adoku teina kop;

English: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
Masaai: naa teneishoru ninche Olaitoriani apik nkaik inyi, nimirimiri intae ninche, nitumutumu taa aaidaikie ninche katukul; emipuo ake aaitobir olning'o o ninche, nimintodolulu olng'ur te ninche.

English: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.
Masaai: Neirriu apa ile Dan iltung'ana imiet oodupa ti atua iltung'ana lo losho lenye pooki, eing'uaa Sora neing'uaa Eshtaol, pee epuonu aaikitalan enkop nejur; nejokini ninche, “Enchom entujur enkop.” Nepuonu apa ninche ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, ine netii enkaji e Mika, neirrag ine.

English: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
Masaai: neitayu ninye ilidat oolgoso onom to lkarasha obo, neitoki aitayu ilidat oo lgoso onom te manaroto o lkarasha le ina tukus e are; ore nena lidat oo lgoso naa keipirakino maate.

English: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Todolisho; kinchiunye enkirukoto ino.”

English: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
Masaai: Ore nkoitoi naapuo Sion, naa olkiyioi, amu meetae oltung'ani olotu lelo siruai oogeluno, etoliyiote nchomito enyena pooki eig'orita ilapolosak lenyena te mion; neteyietayioki intoyie enyena aaya; ore ninye makewan neeta olosilisili te mion sapuk.

English: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
Masaai: Mirrag arreshisho anaa oltung'ani torrono aarare emanyisho oosupati; miarare enkang enye,

English: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
Masaai: Emintarruoo esiaai e Nkai te nkaraki endaa. Kesinya pooki toki, kake torrono te neaku kebatat oltung'ani ilkulikae te ntoki nanya;

English: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa lelo tung'ana neilep nedou ti atua ina kop nepik atua embuku eoroto enye anaa too nkang'itie ti atua iorot naapishana; neitoki ninche aapuonu enetii Yoshua too lng'oborri te Shilo,

English: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
Masaai: Naa kebayu eishoi ino anaa enterit enkop naa aiponari aibulaa aidapashakino enkop te nkalo o loontoluo, o tenkalo o loosaen, o te nkalo e moikuape o te nkalo e kopikop; naa te iyie tenebo eishoi ino emayian iloshon le nkop pooki ate.

English: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
Masaai: Nemelo ninye ayiaya osesen lo ltung'ani otua, aashu epik kewan entioto te papaai lenye aashu te ng'otonye;

English: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
Masaai: inchere enyor nidamumu intae irorei ooiroro iloibonok sinyat le dukuya o enkitanapata o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni, oimua ilkipaareta linyi;

English: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipang'unye ninche lelo aiguanak aayau enetii Yoshua, neipotu Yoshua iltung'ana pooki le Israel, nejoki lelo kituaak apa loo ltung'ana le njore ooshomo te nebo ninye, “Wootu entinyiku, entipik nkejek inyi enchumata oo murto e kulo aiguanak.” Nepuonu ninche aanyiku nepik nkejek enye nchumat oomurto e lelo aiguanak aaroro.

English: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Sadok, “Entanap osanduku le Nkai entorriny tiaatua enkanasa. Te natum nanu kirotetisho too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa kaashuku ninye naaisho ninye matodua ninye o emanyisho enye;

English: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

English: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

English: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

English: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
Masaai: Embung'a nena pooki natiaaka intae, nimimpotipoto ake nkarn e kulie aitin arashu minchosho metoning'i eimu nkutukie inyi.

English: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

English: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

English: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
Masaai: Aing'ae otipika eng'eno nagut atua nkatampo, arashu aing'ae naishoo eyioulounoto enkinuku?

English: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neye Bela, neitoreisho Yobab olayioni le sera le Bosra te rishata enye.

English: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
Masaai: Itoduaa oltung'ani ng'en too nkonyek enyena makewan, eeta olmodai osiligi sapuk alang ninye.

English: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
Masaai: o lasar le ntapa napuyiapui, naipurja te ilata, o matuan uni e tomon e efa to loing'oni ake obo, o matuan are e tomon e efa to lmeregesh,

English: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ilo tung'ani oata osupetai eitu eng'as aisuj nkaik enyena te nkare nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
Masaai: Enkai aipot metaa shakeni lai nchere intae atejo aduaaya pee eitu aigil alotu Korintio.

English: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
Masaai: Olbitir amu kesasha ninye iloisotok kake meinyaku eng'amurai, mesinya te ntae.

English: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
Masaai: Naa kaitajeu intae too loirerioni linyi pooki; naitanap entapa naitaa sapuk nemaitoki aiteleiki intae olameyu.

English: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

English: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
Masaai: Neim ilo gos embata nena shomito, eipirare ina adori e nena shomito; ele apa olgos le abori.

English: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?
Masaai: Netejo sii ninye Hesekia, “Kainyoo olmonekie nchere kalo nanu Enkaji o Laitoriani?”

English: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaiturrur nanu ninche aitung'uaa nkuapi pooki apa naterewa ninche te ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi te mpushuna kitok; kashuku nanu ninche meetu ene wueji, naisho nanu ninche metobiko te seriani.

English: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
Masaai: nijoki ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kairriu nanu nayau Nebukadresa ilo aiguanani le Babilon, osinka lai, naa kepik ninye olorika lenye le nkitoo shumata kulo soito laisudoiyie nanu, naa keisalaashaki ninye olng'obor lenye le nkitoo shumata ninche.

English: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel aapuo nebaya nkanas enye te nkolong e uni. Ore apa nkanas enye naa Gibeon, Chefira, Be-erot, o Kiriat-yearim.

English: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
Masaai: “Ore ti alo ilayiok le Merari nkena ninche anaa too lmareita lenye, o too nkajijik oo loo menye;

English: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
Masaai: Neitemer menye te naisho oo sabibu ina kewarie, nejing entito botor aisiap menye, neitu eyiolou Lot enkata naisiapa ninye o enkata natupukuo aing'uaa.

English: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
Masaai: Eikununo Efraim anaa enturkulu namoda nemeeta endamunoto naipotu Misiri, neloito Asiria.

English: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
Masaai: Ore ilo aitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu, neliki Yosef enkidetidet enye nejoki ninye, “Ore te nkidetidet ai etii duoo o sabibu dukuya nanu,

English: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
Masaai: Nejoki Farao Yosef, “Tiaki ilalashera linono, entaas ena ‘Eroto isirkon linyi nipuopuo aarrinyo enkop e Kanaan;

English: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
Masaai: Niyeniki ninche enkaina ino metaa olmonekie, netiu ninche anaa nkishiliaa te rishata oo nkonyek inyi.

English: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore nkolong'i pooki naaisis nanu iyie, naisis enkarna ino ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
Masaai: Mintanyamal kewan tenkaraki ilaasak loo ntorrok, niming'uar ilarruok.

English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
Masaai: Ore olo losho loo layiok le Benchamen naa Elida olayioni le Kislon.

English: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Neara naa Elioenai, Hiskia, o Asrikam, kulo pokira okuni.

English: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
Masaai: Ore taa pee eng'as aabau kuna baa eng'ura shumata entushumu lukuny inyi, amu etinyikua esarunoto inyi.”

English: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

English: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
Masaai: aashu adumu entoki naimina nelejishore ainos olmumai te lejare, tiae nabo oo mbaa naas iltung'ana netaasa eng'oki teina.

English: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
Masaai: Shomo tipika ninche atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, dukuya ina shakenisho, teine naalotu atumore.

English: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
Masaai: Amu eidim aaidurra ildoinyo, neidimi aaiwuang'ie ildoinyo, kake melo ae kata ina nyorrata ai nauno aing'uaa intae, ore ilo sotua lai le seriani nemeiwuang'ieki, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo oata olng'ur tialo iyie.

English: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
Masaai: Kake etejo Musa, “Kainyoo naa taata pee igolong'akiki intae enkitanapata o Laitoriani, amu melo dukuya intae?

English: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
Masaai: naa nelo osotua lai o ninche ina kata alotu aiwuang'ie ng'ok enye.”

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, minyanya intae eilata, olkiteng, aashu enker, aashu enkine.

English: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
Masaai: Ore too nchumat oo ng'apeta netii ntokitin naaitobiruaki anaa ntapuka sidain. Neaku eidipe apa esiaai oo ng'apeta.

English: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

English: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
Masaai: Metii oltung'ani oidim aeu enatii, te neme Papa laairriwua oyietu ninye; naa kaitopiu nanu ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Masaai: Neye apa Gideon olayioni le Yoash etaa moruo oleng, nenukari ninye te nkurare e Yoash papaai lenye, te Ofra oo Labiesi.

English: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
Masaai: Te ine wueji etigila ninye mbaa, o elong'o, o lalem, o masaa o larrabal.

English: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
Masaai: Naitoki ajoki ninye eniare, “Ainyoo eutu kulo ng'osil pokira lo loirien, lelo ootii embata lelo goso ooitobiruno te sahabu oobukunyeki ina ilata aaitayu?”

English: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam o ile lo laiguanani Asa le Yuda, neitore Ela olayioni le Baasha Isiraeli te Tirsa. neitoreisho ilarin oare.

English: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
Masaai: Naa kepuo iltung'ana pooki aayiolou, aa taa, Efraim o lelo oomanya Samaria, lelo oojo to lwuasa o te nkitokoos oo ltauja:

English: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

English: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

English: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

English: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

English: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

English: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
Masaai: Ing'ura eim embata ai, nemadol ninye; eloolo dukuya, nemaning'u ninye.

English: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

English: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
Masaai: Amu ole siana ang apa Yudas neishooki ematua enye te na siaai.”

English: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

English: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

English: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Ulam: Bedan. Kulo apa ilayiok le Gilead ole Makir, olayioni le Manase.

English: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

English: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.

English: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
