English: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.
Masaai: Neitu elimu Esta olmarei lenye arashu iltung'ana lenye, anaa enaitanapa Mordekai; amu kening apa Esta Mordekai ebaiki apa pee eitubulu ninye.

English: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
Masaai: Kaata nkumok naaigeroki paa ae mayieu naiger te nkalamu o to lbukoi;

English: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Yotam, nelo ninye aitashe te nchumata o ldoinyo le Gerisim, neyietu aishir nejoki ninche, “Entoning'oki nanu lo tung'ana le Shekem, pee etum Enkai atoning'o intae.

English: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.
Masaai: Ore nena kera eishoi e uni naaikini ninche neidim aatijing eumata Olaitoriani.

English: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Baasha ina, neitu eitoki ashet Rama, nelo ninye abik te Tirsa.

English: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.
Masaai: nejoki ilo kitok loo laitasheikinok sunash ogelema Daniel, “Kaureisho nanu, medol ake olkitok lai olaiguanani, laa ninye likitegelaka endaa ino o entoki niok, ajo ira menati alang lelo barnot lerisiori ino. Neaku ipik iyie enkishui ai batisho ti alo olaiguanani.”

English: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet, neyau ninye nturkuluoni are aashu ntaritik are ayaki olapolosani te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
Masaai: Nesulunye lakir to loing'ang'e nesulakino enkop anaa lng'abolo oorrarrunye ilng'anayio te nkata enkirobi eyukito olkutati.

English: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
Masaai: Nejoki ilaisiaayiak le Farao ninye, “Keaku kenya ele tung'ani orreshet te iyiook o anu? Enchoo kulo tung'ana epuo, peyie etum aaisiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai enye; keton ake midol ajo eitarruoyioki Misiri?”

English: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo tung'ani lo lgilata lenye ajo, “Maidim nanu ainyang'u te nkaraki kewan ai, pee mainyal ake enjung'ore ai. Iwa iyie erishata ai metaa enino makewan, amu maidim nanu atalaku.”

English: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
Masaai: Ore enkiok naning'isho te nebo enkong'u nadololisho, Olaitoriani ninye oitobirua pokira.

English: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
Masaai: Nelo Noba aya Kenat o nkang'itie enye neisho ninye enkarna ajo Noba, aipotie kewan.

English: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
Masaai: Ore ina kitanyaanyukoto e Ashera apa naitobira ninye nepik ninye atua ina aji natiaaka Olaitoriani Daudi, o Solomon olayioni lenye, “Atua ena aji o atua Yerusalem naa ninche nanu ategelua too loshon pooki loo Siraeli, nchere kapik nanu enkarna ai ntarasi.

English: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
Masaai: Imbung'a enino shomo. Amu atonyorrayie aisho ele oisiadua anaa enaaisho iyie.

English: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
Masaai: Nemeetae enkaina naiseyie ninye kake kenang'i too soito arashu eng'ori, aa eng'ues arashu oltung'ani, melo ninye eishu.’ Ore pee eru entarumpeta ayiataa, naa keilepu ninche aapuonu oldoinyo.”

English: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
Masaai: Ina peyie aadumu enkiyang'et nanu ailepie, ore edumunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te wueji enye, naning te siadi nanu oltoilo sapuk le nkirikirata enkop.

English: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
Masaai: Neipotu Ahab iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, neiturrur iloibonok tenebo to ldoinyo le Karmel.

English: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
Masaai: Olorika le nkitoo le nkisisa otipikaki apa shumata ebaiki enkiterunoto, ninye ewueji ang sinyati.

English: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
Masaai: Naa Simon oipoto ajo Petero o Anterea olalashe lenye; o Yakobo o Yohana, o Filipo o Bartolomayo;

English: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ina Ai nategelua Abraham niyau ninye aitupuku te Uri, oo Lkaldayo ninchoo ninye enkarna ajo Abraham;

English: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
Masaai: te ng'eno o te yiolounoto enye pooki te risioroto e mbarakinoto enye te atua Kristo

English: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninye, “Kainyoo eliooto enye?” Nejo ninye, “Olpayian moruo oilepu alotu; neirina ninye to lkila.” Neyiolou Saul inchere Samuel ninye, neirrugo ninye te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, neserem.

English: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
Masaai: anaa oloruja enkoriong, anaa olkorriot lemebulu, anaa oloata oltialei anaa oloata ilpepedo, anaa oloata ilbolot to sesen lenye anaa oloidong'oki aaitaa osunash,

English: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
Masaai: tenimimbookiki enkop ilo omoni, ilo lemeeta menye arashu enkoliai arashu imbukoo osarge leilo lemeeta entioto tene wueji, nimintokiki aasujaa kulie aitin te nkitamioto inyi,

English: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
Masaai: nimiwuasa naa ake ti alo lelo kulikae ng'osil. Naa ti niwuasa, tadamu tejo mme iyie doi onapita ina tonai, kake ina tonai nikinapita.

English: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
Masaai: Naa ore ilo oyai eeta nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki nepejori te nkima, ninye o ntokitin pooki naata ninye, enkaraki natigila ninye olning'o lo Laitoriani, o enkaraki nataasa ninye embae e sulare ti atua Israel.’ ”

English: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
Masaai: Ore ake oloitarruoo enkaji e Nkai, neitarruoo Enkai sii ninye; amu sinyati enkaji e Nkai, naa intae doi ina aji.

English: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
Masaai: Neliki ninye iyiook olmalaika otoduaa te nkaji enye, nejoki, ‘Irriwai ltung'ana Yopa, mpoto Simon oji Petero;

English: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche iloik le Saul o layioni lenye Yonatan te nkop e Benchamen te Sela, ti atua enkurare e Kish papaai lenye; neas ninche nena pooki naaitanapishe olaiguanani. Ore te siadi ina nening Enkai eomonokinoto te nkaraki enkop.

English: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: naa iakuku intae te nanu enkitoria oo lapolosak o losho osinya. Kulo ninche irorei lilo ajoki nkera e Israel.”

English: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
Masaai: Neitoki aibelekenya netem enkalo e kopikop, intemat iip imiet e nkaina teina tiyani natemishoreki.

English: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
Masaai: Irorei kulo le Lemuel olaiguanani le Masa, ooiteng'ena ng'otonye ninye:

English: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.
Masaai: Ore pee eimaki osanduku le Nkai, nebatata Eli ti oriong aurori to lorika lenye te mbata e kishomi; negila emurt enye neye, amu oltung'ani moruo apa ninye, neiroshi. Netirisha ninye Israeli ilarin artam.

English: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
Masaai: Amu eikitok apa Mordekai ti atua enkaji o laiguanani, ore ening'oi enye neidapashakino iloshon pooki; amu ore ilo tung'ani oji Mordekai netoponari oleng agolu.

English: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
Masaai: to sinkolio le nkinanta o usin, o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o to lkerempe lo lwulul loo usin.

English: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
Masaai: Ng'ura mme Olaitoriani loo lororani eing'uaa, nchere pee easisho iltung'ana te nkaraki enkima, neitanaur ilosho ate te mpesho?

English: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
Masaai: Kake indipa iyie atoduaa enkiteng'enare ai o rrekie lai o enaipirta te nkishui ai enkirukoto ai, eng'iriata ai, enyorrata ai, o enkitashoto ai,

English: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
Masaai: Metudung'oi Olaitoriani nkutukie pooki naaikorojisho lelo ng'ejepa le nkitokoos kitok,

English: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
Masaai: Neye Baalhanan olayioni le Akbor neitoreisho Hadar te rishata enye, ore enkarna e nkanasa enye neji Pau; neji apa enkarna enkitok enye Mehetabel, ina tito e Matred, entito e Mesahab.

English: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
Masaai: Mpiripiroi ina terit natii osesen lino, tuputunye; iyie ena naena, Yerusalem; ntololong'a nena keenta naatii emurt ino, iyie ena tito naena e Sion.

English: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
Masaai: neshilaa ninye enkomono e ilo aisinani, nememenaa ninye enkomono enye.

English: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
Masaai: aalimu lkerreti lemeishoruno matang'amai arashu kisuj, kira Iroma.”

English: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
Masaai: ore enkaraki ina kerewaki Olaitoriani aitaar ninche nkariak o Lkeju, kumok negol, ilo aiguanani le Asiria o enkitoo enye pooki; naa kenang'ari ninche aaimu imartin nepuo aaim mbat o lkeju.

English: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ajoki intae, ore te negira kulo nebuaku ninche kulo soito.”

English: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
Masaai: Netiu olorere anaa ilootapejoyioki aaitaa enkuruoni, netiu anaa ilkiku ootudung'oki nepejori te nkima.”

English: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata nemanita enjore o laiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem, ore Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai neikenoro apa to lgoriet le rripore otii enkaji enkitoo o laiguanani le Yuda.

English: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
Masaai: Nelo Musa dukuya airorie Israel pooki kulo rorei,

English: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
Masaai: Amu etulusoitie nkolong'i ang pooki tiabori engoro ino, naa keiting ilarin lang anaa enkiyang'ata.

English: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
Masaai: Neisho sii pooki ng'ae, looti o lkituaak, ilkarsisi o laisinak, irrindiki o leme rrindiki, metipiki olmishire enkaina e tatene aashu enkomom,

English: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
Masaai: aimeirrash Enkai ena? Amu eyiolo ninye nkisudorot o ltau.

English: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye, naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni, o eng'irra e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;

English: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Neas Aron o layiok lenyena nena tokitin pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
Masaai: Ore nena naatuunoki te nkulupuoni sidai, naa ilo oning ororei nejing'aa naa keiu ilng'anayio aiu obo iip, neiu likae intomoni ile, neiu likae tomoni uni.”

English: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
Masaai: Naa tenelotu oltung'ani omoni amanyisho tiatua intae, neibung pasaka to Laitoriani, te risioroto oo nkikoot e pasaka, nea naa ninye ina. Enkikoo nabo intae ipupuo aata, to lomoni o to inoti.”

English: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
Masaai: mikining iyie Farao; naitoki nanu aiteleiki enkaina ai shumata Misiri naitayu olorora lai, iltung'ana laainei lelo ayiok loo Siraeli, metupuku aaing'uaa Misiri too nkiasin sapuki e nkiguana.

English: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
Masaai: Tuputunye, tudumunye te nkaraki esipata ai, te nkaraki ewalata ai, Enkai ai naa Olaitoriani lai!

English: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
Masaai: Neipang'aki Olaitoriani Abram nejoki, “Ekaisho eishoi ino ena kop.” Metaa eteshetaka Abram Enkai teine olperere lo lasar ilo Aitoriani oipang'aka ninye.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kaamenu akenya kulo tung'ana o anu? Ketoni ninche eitu aairuk nanu o anu, aasita kuna kitoduaat pooki nataasa nanu ti atua ninche?

English: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.
Masaai: Kake tenimintayu iyie kewan aishooyo too ilkituaak ooya lo laiguanani le Babilon, neishoori ena anasa aapik atua enkaina oo Lkaldayo, naa kepejoo ninche ninye te nkima, nimisik iyie apuku te nkaina enye.”

English: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
Masaai: Kake iata iyie inkonyek o oltau, tenkaraki ake, dupoto o e lejare o te nkibukoroto o sarge lemeeta entioto, o easata enkitorogonyare o larrabal.”

English: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
Masaai: Emintagor Enkiyang'et Sinyati e Nkai, natipikieki intae olmishire le ina olong e lakunoto.

English: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
Masaai: Neya iltung'ana pooki le Yuda Asaria, laa oloo larin tomon o ile, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te rishata e papaai lenye Amasia.

English: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin neishieki tukul.

English: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
Masaai: Ore apa pee elotu Yehu Yesreel, nening Yesebel ina; nesir nkonyek enyena, neitobir akus endukuya enye, nerumisho te lusie.

English: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
Masaai: Nintobiraki ina kila o lgoo ilpisia ooipila anaa impi, le sahabu nasila;

English: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
Masaai: netolimuoki neitadedeyieki ninye te ngolon inchere Enkerai e Nkai to rrekie le Nkiyang'et Sinyati pee eitopiuni too lootuata, naa Yesu Kristo Olaitoriani lang,

English: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
Masaai: Amu eng'ura, kailepunye nanu Ilkaldayo ilo osho odua neisosion, nelo aibulu enkop pooki, nepuonu aaya imanyishoritin neme nkunenye.

English: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
Masaai: Nepuo lekua ooiteng'eni tomon o obo Galilaya o metabaiki oldoinyo otiaaka Yesu enchom.

English: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Olaitoriani oata enadung'ie.”

English: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
Masaai: Enkai naishoo mpukunot enye anaa enayiewuaki ninye enkantererai ake pooki.

English: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
Masaai: Eisho ilewa nkishorot ing'oruo pooki naibor onyek; kake inchoo iyie inkishorot inono lelo pooki linyor, irop ninche meetu ine nitii too nkaloli pooki te nkaraki isiaitin enkiborra oo nkonyek inono.

English: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
Masaai: “Emiyama ake o ninche, nemeyama ninche o ntae. Amu esipa kepuo ninche aaibelekeny iltauja linyi nisujaa nkaitin enye.” Neibung apa Solomon kuna te nyorrata.

English: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Masaai: “Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi pee eaku inkolong'i inono kumok te ina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neisho ninche ine wueji enkarna aajo Bokim; neitaiki Olaitoriani olasar te ine.

English: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
Masaai: Atoduaa sii ena kitanyaanyukoto e ng'eno nagut tiabori enkolong, nelioo aa sapuk te nanu.

English: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
Masaai: neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye apa laa ninye nayaua ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; nepuo ninche aasujaa kulie aitin, ti atua nena aitin oo loreren apa oomanita ninche, neirrugokino ninche; neitagor ninche Olaitoriani.

English: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
Masaai: Neaku ajo nanu, “Eshomo enkitoo ai neshomo enkisiligunoto ai naing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura, kaishooyo nanu Farao, aisho Hofra ilo aiguanani le Misiri apik atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena o atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye, anaa apa enaishooyie Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda apik atua enkaina e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon olaa olmang'atinta lenye apa neing'oru enkishui enye.”

English: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt put evil away from among you.
Masaai: “Teneibungi oltung'ani etupurroyie obo loo lalashera lenyena, lelo tung'ana le Israel, naa tenelo aiko ninye anaa orrindik aashu emir ninye, neari ilo apurroni metua; pee itum aiwuang'ie entorroni te mpolos inyi.

English: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
Masaai: Ore anaa enayieuni te nkisiayiare e pooki olong'i, neitayuni ilasarri terisioroto enkitanapata e Musa too sabatoni, o too lapaitin ng'ejuko okuni to lari o sirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, o sirua loo wikii, o sirua loo lng'oborri.

Masaai: Neirura Yoab, etaa olpayian kitok netobikoyie nkolong'i kumok oleng.

English: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
Masaai: Netii sii kulie baa kumok naataasa Yesu; naa te neigeri naaji maa naabo, kajo nanu meishaa enkop imbukui naaji naaigeri.

English: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul ilo anapani lenye loo ruparen, “Intayu olalem lino taremoki meipanga te nanu, maapuonu ake kulo lememurata aa ng'ung'ur nanu, naaitaa nanu enkiguran.” Kake meidim ilo anapani lenye loo ruparen; amu eturia oleng. Neaku eitayio Saul olalem lenye makewan, nebatatakino.

English: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol isinkan le Hadadesa nchere etimira Isiraeli ninche, neitayu osotua o Daudi, neaku ilaisiaayiak lenyena. Neaku meyieu Isiria neigil aaretu Ilamoni.

English: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

English: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
Masaai: Nebau ninye enkapune neirrag ine, naa ng'ura, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ninye, nejoki ninye, “Kaa iasita tene, Eliya?”

English: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
Masaai: Ore Papa laairriwua ninye makewan laaishakenoko. Eitu ae kata ining'ining'i intae oltoilo lenye, neitu idolidolo eneikununo;

English: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche ajoki, “Iruko taata?

English: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
Masaai: Neyau olaiguanani le Asiria iltung'ana ooing'uaa Babilon, Kuta, o Afa, o Hamat, o Shefafaim, nepik ninche nkanas e Samaria, terishata oo ltung'ana le Israel. Neya ninche Samaria nebik too nkanas enyena.

English: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.
Masaai: Neirrag Samuel o mekenyu, neitoki ninye abol nkutukie oo nkajijik e nkaji e Nkai. Neureyu Samuel eliki Eli ina duaata.

English: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
Masaai: Ore tenepuku imasaa inyi too naaiposha, nintaraposh iyie iltung'ana kumok; te nkumoi ino oo masaa e biashara ino, inkarsisiyie lelo aiguanak le nkop.

English: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
Masaai: Nejoki Debora Barak, “Tudumunye! Amu ena olong eishooyie Olaitoriani Sisera apik atua enkaina ino. Aime Olaitoriani olo te dukuya iyie?” Nedoiyio Barak to ldoinyo le Tabor tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oosujita ninye.

English: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;
Masaai: mintinyikaki ake enkaina ino nena tokitin nemenyikakini pee etum Olaitoriani aibelekenyayu teina goro enye napi, neisho intae olng'ur neitanana oshoke tialo intae, anaa apa enainosie ninye olmumai too loo papaai linyi.

English: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
Masaai: Ore ing'apeta enye naa ong'uan; ore nkitotoneta enye pokira ong'uan naa suyai, o lala o lolo lenye le nkosholai, o emurata oo lukuny enye o rubat enye e nkosholai.

English: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
Masaai: Nejoki Hilkia ilo apolosani kitok Shefat olaigeroni, “Anoto nanu embuku oo nkitanapat tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.” Neisho Hilkia ina buku Shafan, neisum ninye.

English: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
Masaai: Eisis oltau lo ltung'ani kewan eton ebau emutata, kake eng'asunye emborron eitu nesuju enkanyit.

English: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
Masaai: o Sibekai, le Hushati, o Ilai le Ahoti,

English: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
Masaai: Kake ore etiu neijia, eiruko ilkumok loo lkituaak, kake ore te nkaraki Ilfarisayo, eitu eibalunye pee merishieki enkaji e ntumo;

English: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilo laairorie nanu neeta ninye entemet e ng'udi e sahabu natemie ina anasa, o nchomito enyena o sunta.

English: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
Masaai: Ore Simion o Lawi naa ilalashera, ore imasaa enye olarrabal naa ilalema lenye.

English: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
Masaai: Neaku neisho Yakobo Esau emukate tenebo nena motori, nenya neok sii, neinyototo alo. Neaku etemenayie Esau esipata enye e kikausho.

English: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
Masaai: Ninye makewan otanapa ing'ok ang to sesen lenye te shumata olchani, pee kitum aatuata too ng'ok, neaku aikinchu too supati, too lbaa lenyena eishiunyieki intae.

English: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD'S tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Kake ore taata, te nemesinya enkop inyi, entogiru wootu atua enkop o Laitoriani ine netii olng'obor lo Laitoriani, nimbung'akiki ate enkop ti atua iyiook; emigolong'akiki ake duoo intae Olaitoriani, aashu intaa iyiook iloogolong'u te nchetakinoto nishetakiki ate olperere lo lasar leme ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang.

English: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
Masaai: Enkai e le orere le Siraeli nategelua iloo papa, neitaa olorere kitok eton emanya Misiri neilepie enkaina enye neriku aitung'uaa ine.

English: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
Masaai: Enkaina ai nairragie olkitamanyunoto le nkop, naa enkaina ai e tatene naisalaasha oloing'ang'e te naipot nanu ninche, neitashe pooki te nebo.

English: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
Masaai: “Ore te lelo siruai o nena rishat naageluno, ore olasar le ntapa tenebo oloti oing'oni naa keaku efa nabo, ore tenebo olkuoo le ker naa efa, ore tenebo ilkuoo le kerra anaa ake duoo enaidim oltung'ani aishoru, tenebo hini e ilata te efa.

English: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.
Masaai: Negira Saul alotu te nkurma te siadi ilmong'i; nejo Saul, “Kainyoo naishirie iltung'ana, pee eishirita?” Neliki ninche ilomon le lelo tung'ana le Yabesh.

English: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
Masaai: Nejoki papaai lenye Israel ninche, “Tenaa neijia etiu, entaas ena: ewaita embata oo lnganayio gelunot lena kop too lbenia linyi, niyakiki ilo tung'ani enkishooroto, enkiti ilata narropil, o enkiti aisho, o emanoo, o enkorropil, o lng'anayio lo lchani onyaanyukie oseki.

English: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.
Masaai: Neaku ewa Daudi empere o emoti e nkare aitung'uaa endukuya e Saul, nepuo ninche. Metii oltung'ani otoduaa ina, arashu otayiolo ina, arashu einyo hoo likae; amu keirura apa pooki, te nkaraki eetuo njo naairoishi naaing'uaa Olaitoriani shumata ninche.

English: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
Masaai: Kake aata nanu osina naata emion; nchoo enjeunoto ino, iyie Enkai maatudumu nanu ailepunye!

English: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaitayu nkuruon to lperere lo lasar, neisalaashaki ninche enkarasha sintet;

English: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
Masaai: Amu ore hoo naa Oinoti ninye, eitamoo kewan enkirukoto te ina mion nanoto,

English: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: “Amu irara intae olorere oitisinyakaki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; etegelua intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee iakuku olorere lenye makewan, negelu intae tiatua lelo oreren pooki ootii oriong enkop.

English: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
Masaai: Kake kepuonu imelin naaing'uaa Kitim, naa kepuonu aaisilisil Ashur o Eber; kake kelo ake sii ninye aidak.”

English: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore olainyalani le Moab o nkanas enyena neilepua alotu, ore ilbarnot lenyena gelunot nedoyio aapuo enkidaaroto Olaiguanani ojo laa ore enkarna enye naa Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
Masaai: ‘Toning'o amu kairo nanu; kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, nikimbalakinye iyie nanu?’

English: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaaisarkionieki nanu te dukuya iyie tiatua iloreren; niyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
Masaai: Ore lelo sinkan le Huram o sinkan le Solomon apa ooyautua sahabu naing'uaa Ofir neyau sii ilkeek ooji ilmusantali o soito oogol enkinyang'a.

English: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul olenkapu lenye, “Etiaaka ninye iyiook aibalakinye nchere enotoki lelo sirkon.” Kake ore ti alo ina bae e nkitoria natejo Samuel, eitu ninye eliki ai toki.

English: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: neisho Isiraeli meima atua ninye, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
Masaai: Naa tenilo iyie too nkoitoi aainei, aibung nkitanapat aainei o nkikoot aainei, anaa apa enataasa papaai lino Daudi, naitoodor nkolong'i inono.”

English: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
Masaai: Ore pee edou te mpeut nedol olorora kitok, neing'urrie ninche, amu etiu anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut; neiteru aiteng'en mbaa kumok.

English: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
Masaai: Amu kiishutua impisai ang'.” Newal Yosef ajo, “Enchoru inkishu inyi, naa kaisho intae endaa awalunye nkishu inyi tenetaa eishunye impisai inyi.”

English: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
Masaai: Ore sii enkae, ekesipa doi tenajo enkanashe ai amu ore ninye, naa entito e papaai lai neme entito e yieyio lai, netaa enkitok ai.

English: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
Masaai: Neirorie olaiguanani ninche, ore te ninche pooki meetae hoo obo onotoki onyaanyukie Daniel, o Hanania, o Mishael o Asaria; neaku eitasheito ninche te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
Masaai: anaata etoijoitie ninche iyiook kinchu, ina kata pee eyupuyup engoro enye ti alo iyiook;

English: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
Masaai: Ore enaisho musana o eng'ejuk, neoru iltung'ana ndamunot.

English: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest thyself.
Masaai: “Tiripaki kewan iltelelia too lcholo pokira oong'uan leilo kila lino linchop.

English: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.
Masaai: Naa ore te nindipidipi aawaita ina anasa, nipikipiki intae ina anasa enkima, niasiasa anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; entodol nchere aitanapa nanu intae.”

English: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki aikiwuasare iyiook intae maate ti atua nena sirito e Enkai te nkitashoto inyi nemeiwuatiwuata o enkirukoto ti atua inkisilisilot inyi pooki, o ti atua isinaitin ling'iriri taata.

English: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
Masaai: (amu kening'oo ninche enkarna ino kitok, o enkarna ino magilani, o enkaina ino naitoriori, tenelotu ninye neomon eing'or ena aji,

English: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kareu lelo le nkaji e ntumo e sheitani oojo ate Ilyahudi neme ninche, kake kelejisho ng'ura, kareu ninche meetu aairrugokino nkejek inono neyiolou nchere aatonyorra nanu iyie.

English: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
Masaai: Kinkurrukur pooki anaa lng'arurum le ntim nikinchir aayietu anaa nturkuluni; niking'oru esipata, kake meetae, niking'oru enjeunoto, kake kelakuaniki iyiook.

English: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu alo kewarie aim embata o erata, naing'or asipu ina suntai. Naitoki nanu aibelekenya najing kishomi natii enkalo o erata. Naitoki arrinyunye.

English: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

English: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
Masaai: Ore naa taata isika shomo ewueji ino; atejo apa nanu, ‘Kaanyanyit iyie,’ kake kimboo Olaitoriani amitiki enkanyit.”

English: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
Masaai: Ore lelo kigerot naa te nkarna o laiguanani Serser nemishira to lmishire lo lgisoi lenye, neyae nena pala iltung'ana ooirriwari ookedito mbartan naaten oleng apa naasishoreki te nkisiayiare o laiguanani, naaitubuluaki ti atua boo o laiguanani.

English: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Masaai: Eeta apa Ashuhur, menye le Tekoa nkituaak are, Heba, o Naara;

Masaai: Kake ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, neitaaki kitok te sipata, ore Enkai Sinyati neitodolu kewan te sinyatisho te sipata.

English: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

English: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
Masaai: nimbung nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, aim inkoitoi enyena, nimbung nkiguanat enyena, o nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena, o enchakenisho enye, anaa enaigero too nkitanapat e Musa, pee itum atudupayu te pooki niaas o te pooki wueji niim;

English: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
Masaai: Enkitoo enkisisa te Nkai te neisudoo ninye imbaa, kake enkitoo too laiguanak, te nejurru imbaa aaibalie.

English: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
Masaai: Kake ore apa eishoi e Israel naa kebul oleng neponari aaku kumok; neponari ninche neaku olosho ogol; neaku ore ina kop ninche oobore.

English: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
Masaai: amu aatiaka nanu ororei lo Laitoriani, ‘Minos endaa nimiok enkare teine, nimirrinyo aim enkoitoi duoo niimua.’ ”

English: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
Masaai: Newaliki Yosef ajoki, “Ime, nanu etii ewalata keisho Enkai Farao ewalata sidai naitiship.”

English: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
Masaai: Ntodorropa iyie nkolong'i enyena e kitisho, nimulumula ninye te nkurruna.

English: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
Masaai: Entadamu ilo rorei latiaaka intae, ‘Mme kitok osinka to lkitok lenye.’ Te naaisilisilo nanu keisilisil sii ninche intae; te neibung'a ororei lai, keibung sii ninche intae; te neibung'a ororei lai, keibung sii ninye olinyi.

English: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
Masaai: Eiputa ninye ninche te nkidimata metaasa empukunoto e siaai pooki naas laguetak loo soito, o ilasirak, o laripak loo usin pusi, o morijo o mpilei, o katani naapuyiapui napiyaya arashu ilashetak, te pooki pukunoto o laisiaayiani arashu olaipirunoni arriyia.

English: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
Masaai: Kake ore ake peyie etum enkiti are nepok; nepuku ilng'osil anaa enkiti aitubului.

English: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

English: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
Masaai: Amu ijoito, ‘Ore enkiteng'enare ai naa kesila, nara sinyati te dukuya nkonyek e Nkai.’

English: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
Masaai: Etusujayie ninye enkikoo enye, o meshomo ninye tenebo Yehoram olayioni le Ahab, ilo aiguanani le Israel, nepuo aaitayunye Hasael olaiguanani le Siria olarrabal te Ramot-gilead. Nepik iltung'ana le Siria Yoram olbae.

English: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
Masaai: Ore pee eirorie ninche ninye anaake neany ening ninche, neliki ninche Haman, ejo pee edol tenaa kepal Mordekai nena, amu etiaaka ninye ninche nchere Olyahudi ninye.

English: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa pee eng'as Olaitoriani airo eimunye enkiroroto enye Hosea, nejoki Olaitoriani Hosea, “Shomo, iyamaki kewan enkitok naibor onyek niiu nkera e nkibor oo nkonyek, amu eiborrie ena kop onyek oleng ainguaa Olaitoriani.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu Sarai nilo ayanyit ninye.”

English: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
Masaai: Kiting'idakinote iyie ilkeek laaijo iltarakua ore lelo tarakua le Lebanon, nejo, ‘Ore ebaiki ina kata apa nikirragieki aaitadou, meetae oladung'oni loo lkeek olotu adung.’

English: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
Masaai: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae ilaitoriak le Sodom! Enchoo enkiok enkiteng'enare e Nkai ang intae iltung'ana le Gomora!

English: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Amon apa naataasa, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Simeon, iishoritin enye, too lmareita, lenye too nkajijik oo loo menye, lelo apa lenye ooikenaki, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ilukuny pooki, pooki lee ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom enjore:

English: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari li are le Darias ilo aiguanani, to lapa le ile, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, alotu enetii Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, olbalusui le Yuda, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok.

English: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootipika iltauja lenye pee eing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel nepuonu aasuju ninche eing'uaa iloshon pooki loo Siraeli o meetu Yerusalem, aapolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye.

English: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
Masaai: Neimulumul olaiguanani enkomom enye, neishir olaiguanani to ltoilo sapuk, “Oi olayioni lai Absalom, Oi Absalom, olayioni lai, olayioni lai.”

English: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
Masaai: Nearare Abimelek ina anasa ina olong pooki, neya ninye ina anasa near metuata lelo tung'ana apa ootii atua, nemut ina anasa nebukoki enkop e munyan.

English: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
Masaai: eitaa ninye olkitok le nkaji enye, o Laitoriani loo masaa enyena pooki,

English: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
Masaai: Ore iroruat oltung'ani naa Olaitoriani oitore; kaji naa eiko oltung'ani te nening'u enkoitoi enye?

English: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
Masaai: Kesipa, lokituaak, idung'udung'u intae enkiguana te sipata? Inguanarere intae nkera e tung'ana too sipat?

English: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
Masaai: Naa ijoki ninye, ‘Ino sinka lino Yakobo naa enkishooroto nairriwaka olkitok lai Esau; ore ake sii, elotu ninye te siadi ang.’ ”

English: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
Masaai: Neiruk taa ina kata irorei lenyena; nerany enkisisa enye.

English: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
Masaai: Ntayu empere ino taarare lelo laasujita! Tiaaki oltau lai, “Ara nanu ilo likikordu!”

English: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
Masaai: amu aikiyiolo aajo ore ilo oitopiwuo Olaitoriani Yesu keitopiu sii ninche yiook te nebo Yesu neyau iyiook te nebo intae maetu enetii ninye.

English: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
Masaai: Neipung nelo ajoki ng'otonye, “Ainyoo aomonu?” Nejoki, “Elukunya e Yohana Olaibatisani.”

English: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
Masaai: Neeta sii lkuti sinkir ooti. Ore pee emayian, neitanapisho meitarasari sii ninche lelo aaisho olorere.

English: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche, ilewa o nkituaak; ore pooki oora ilo ltau le yieunoto neyau ilgameta, o lmiintoni, o lgiso, o mankek (isaen loo murto) o lkataarri, o ntokitin oo mpukunot pooki e sahabu eiteng'elaki ake pooki tung'ani Olaitoriani enkishoroto e sahabu Olaitoriani.

English: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
Masaai: ore enkiyang'et enye neikununo anaa enchorro naruko adooyo neilepu enkare o metaa keitabaiki oltung'ani olgos; pee esil ina are lelo oshon te silet e nkidaata entorroni, nepiki nkutukie oo loreren nkeenta naaitapong'orieki.

English: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
Masaai: Iyata iyie inkonyek o sesen? Idol iyie anaa enadol tung'ani.

English: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, olorere obo ninche, neiro pooki enkutuk nabo, naa ena enkiterunoto oo siaaitin naas. Naa ore pooki nayieu neas metii engoloto te ninche.

English: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
Masaai: Ore ake sii ainosie ninche olmumai tiong'ata inchere ekaisardakie ninche ti atua iloreren naidapashaa ninche too nkuapi,

English: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
Masaai: kake tegelu ile Lawi meitasheiki olng'obor le nchakenisho neitasheiki nena masaa enyena, neitasheiki nena tokitin pooki eine; nenap ninche ilo ng'obor o ntokitin enyena, neisiai ninye, neitaman ilo ng'obor emanyisho.

English: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu oleng ti atua Olaitoriani, keshipa oltau lai ti atua Enkai ai; amu aaishopo ninye nanu to lkila le njeunoto, aaimulumula ninye nanu to lkila le supatisho, anaa oloyamisho te nekus kewan too mporro anaa esiankiki narikori te neikod kewan too masaa enyena sidain.

English: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooirriwakaki Yohana naa Ilfarisayo eing'uaa.

English: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.
Masaai: Nepuonu aaimu enkalo e Gibea iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oogeluno ti atua Israel pooki. Negolu olarrabal oleng. Neitu apa eyiolou iltung'ana le Benchamen aajo etataanikia ninche enkidaata.

English: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
Masaai: Ore pee ening to sajini ajo etua, neisho Yosef ilo sesen.

English: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Ee nanu. Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino, ‘Ng'ura ajo etii Eliya ene!’ ”

English: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
Masaai: Ore too Lkigerot naa Abraham eishooki nkisiligat o ilo oiu ninye. Neitu eji, “O looiu ninye,” aajo ilkumok, kake obo etoiwuoki. Ore ilo obo naa Kristo.

English: And sixteen thousand persons;)
Masaai: o ltung'ana nkalifuni tomon o ile.

English: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani lo lorok neing'oru enkarsisisho nasieku, nemeyiolo ajo kelotu osina enetii ninye.

English: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
Masaai: Ai maata nanu iltung'ana oomoda, pee iyautua ele tung'ani metaasa emodaisho te dukuya nanu? Kelotu ele tung'ani atua enkaji ai?”

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel tialo iyie Barak:

English: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
Masaai: o enkaji olaiguanani, neidipa Hiram olaiguanani le Turo aishoo Solomon iltarakua o mbaoi o sahabu, anaa enayieu. Eishoo sii ninye olaiguanani Solomon Hiram nkanas tikitam tiatua enkop e Galilaya.

English: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong eiteng'enisho, netii ine ilfarisayo olasirak ooing'uaa nkang'itie pooki e Galilaya, o Yudea o Yerusalem. Netii engolon e Nkai atua Yesu pee etum aishiunye olorere.

English: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
Masaai: Keng'oriki nkiyioitin olng'atuny netum esumash, kake ore lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani nemelau ntokitin sidain.

English: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
Masaai: ejo “Miseyie lelo lainei ootubukokoki eilata aaput, miinyal ake iloibonok laainei!”

English: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooyiolo enkarna ino nepik osiligi lenye atua iyie, amu ore iyie Olaitoriani, neitu inturraa lelo likisilig iyie.

English: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
Masaai: Naa kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ti atua eumata kitok; ore ti atua olorora kitok naaisis iyie.

English: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
Masaai: Koree iyie, iyie lo doinyo sapuk? Ore te dukuya Serubabel naa iyaku enkisiashata; naa keyau ninye dukuya ilo soit le shumata ebuakitae aajo, ‘Empiris, Empiris te ninye!’ ”

English: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
Masaai: Naa eikirrinyu iyie Olaitoriani too melin ayau Misiri, elototo naisiligishoreki nchere ming'il aekata alo; ore teine ninyoraa aaishooyo ate meinyang'ai intae ilmang'ati linyi anaa rrindiki lewa o ng'oruo, kake meetae oltung'ani oinyang'u intae.”

English: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo enkipirrata e nkolong, nelimana ninche aaibonisho ometabau erishata naishoori olasar. Kake meetae oltoilo otoning'oki, metii ewalata, nemetii oltung'ani otishilayie.

English: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
Masaai: Kainyoo kenya kinchori iyie? Naa kainyoo kenya kintokini aaitaas, iyie lo lng'ejep le lejare?

English: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana lenye too lmareita lenye, ina kata pee eigeri iiishoritin enye naa: ore olkitok lenye naa Yerel, o Sakaria,

English: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Ruben, too lturrurri lenye naa nkalifuni iip o onom o obo o iip ong'uan o onom. Ninche oaku ili are.

English: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
Masaai: Ore edolita ninche intae nidumumu olola aaiteleiki iloilila linyi, ninapinapa aaipang'ie te naimin, nintoipipi nkomomi inyi, peyie midolidolo ina kop; amu aaitaa iyie olmonekie te nkaraki enkaji e Israel.”

English: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii Yohana nejoki, “Rabbi, ore olapa liboitare te lido kekun le Yordan, liimaka aishakenoki, ing'ura, eibatisisho, nepuonu pooki enetii ninye.”

English: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
Masaai: Amu te Yerusalem eipang'u ilo pisiai naa oldoinyo le Sion eimu ina tukus e lelo ooleku. Amu Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aitabaya ena.

English: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
Masaai: ore paa ene nkisiaayiare nikisiaaishore, ore paa ene nkiteng'enare, nikinteng'enishore;

English: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
Masaai: Naa tenemeyieu enkitok nikisuju iyie, nimikintoki olmumai lai aibung': kake mirrinyoki ake olayioni lai ine.”

English: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
Masaai: Aaitapaasha ninye enkoitoi ai naaitaa nanu mpurdat aaitoliyio ninye nanu;

English: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
Masaai: Neikununo osesen lenye anaa osoit oji beril, neikununo enkomom enye anaa enkiwuang'ata, neikununo nkonyek enyena anaa ilkilang'eta ooyupuyup, neikununo nkaik enyena o nkejek enyena anaa enkitiil o suyai osika, ore oltoilo loo rorei lenyena neikununo anaa oltoilo lo lorora.

English: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
Masaai: Netumore ninche Musa o Aron, eanyita apa ninche, epuku aaing'ua enetii Farao.

English: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti kata nelo enkanasa naji Nain; neiriamariyie ninye ilooiteng'eni lenyena o lorora kitok.

English: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata nanu aton ti atua enkaji ebaiki enkolong apa nailepunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa Misiri o metabaiki ena olong, kake to lng'obor oshi aloolo aitaa emanyisho ai.

English: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD. And they did so.
Masaai: Naa kaitagol nanu oltau le Farao, naa kesujaa ninche natum enkisisa te Farao o te njore enye pooki; naa keyiolou Ilmisiri aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.” Neiko ninche neijia.

English: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.
Masaai: Nejoki Abishai Daudi, “Eishorua Enkai olmang'atinta lino apik atua enkaina ino ena olong; ore naa nchooki nanu matupudaki ninye enkop te remoto nabo e mpere, nemaitoki nanu arem ninye kat are.”

English: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
Masaai: Naa ore anaa enaitanapishoteki metuata iltung'ana nabo kata ake, ore pee elusoo ina nelotu enkiguana,

English: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa te nkarna enye elikiori enkirridunoto o empalakinoto oo ng'ok too loreren pooki, neiteruni te Yerusalem.

English: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
Masaai: naa kayau ninche metotoni tiatua Yerusalem; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei naaku nanu Enkai enye, te dede o te sipata.”

English: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
Masaai: “Tiaki taata ina aji kiserut, Aimiyiolo enautu kuna baa? Toliki ninche tiaki, ng'ura, eewuo olaiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem, neya laiguanak lenyena tenebo ilkituaak lenyena neyaki ninche ninye te Babilon.

English: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
Masaai: o Obal, o Abimael, o Sheba,

English: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
Masaai: Ore iyie, ilo enetii iloo papaai lino to sotua, aikinukari itaa olpayian kitok oitobirakine enkirragata.

English: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
Masaai: Kaing'ae naa kintanyaanyukie Enkai, aashu ainyoo narisiore ninye?

English: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Masaai: Ore nkaik e nena kituaak naata olng'ur neitokitokie nkera enye maate; neitaa ninche endaa enye, teina kidaata e ntito oo ltung'ana laainei.

English: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
Masaai: Nemayian ninye Yosef ejo; “Ore ina Ai naisiaayia iloo Papa te dukuya enye, Abraham o Isaak, ina Ai naatorikoyie te nkishui ai pooki o metabaiki ena olong,

English: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
Masaai: Eikining naa iyiook intae nikias ena torroni sapuk aagolong'aki Enkai ang, aayam nkituaak oo loreren?”

English: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
Masaai: Metaa eitu eitoki kulo tung'ana pokira okuni aawaliki Yoab amu aisupat ninye too nkonyek enyena makewan.

English: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
Masaai: Naa kaaranyaki nanu iyie osinkolio ng'ejuk, Iyie Enkai; te nkauo oo sinkolioitin naata iusin tomon nanu aaranyaki iyie,

English: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
Masaai: Neitu ishilaa ina dapidapoi natoiuo intae nerikino intae ina Ai natoiuo intae.

English: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
Masaai: Amu etarrorre Yerusalem, netabatate Yuda; enkaraki naa ore nkirorot enye o nkiaasin enye negilunore Olaitoriani, nemor dukuya nkonyek enyena.

English: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
Masaai: Ore epuo lelo tung'ana aaing'uaa Yesu, nejoki Petero Yesu, “Lo Kitok, sidai kitii ene, maitobira lng'oborri okuni, obo lino, o obo le Musa o le Eliya.” Nemeyiolo enajoito.

English: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
Masaai: amu ore hoo neyiolo Enkai, eitu eyanyit aaitaa ninye Enkai aashu eisho ninye enashe, kake eirriirrana too ndamunot enye, neirriirrana nkorroki enye nemisimisu.

English: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
Masaai: Ore ekenyu, netumo olkiama loo lpayiani lo lorere, ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak neriki ninye enetii olkiama, nejoki,

English: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
Masaai: Metaa eirraga ine ina kewarie, neitayu te nena naata ninye enkishooroto naisho olalashe lenye Esau.

English: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
Masaai: Neing'oru ake lapolosak kituaak o lasirak eneiko pee ear metua; paa olorere eure.

English: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neiteru Yehoram olayioni le Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
Masaai: Neaku, nji ejo Olaitoriani: Eitu nanu kining'ining'i teina kibalunoto o elakunoto, pooki ng'ae to lalashe lenye o to lelatia enye; ng'ura, aibalunye nanu te ntae elakunoto to lalem o to lmeitai o to lameyu Olaitoriani ojo. Kaitaa nanu intae enkuretisho too nkitoriat pooki enkop.

English: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
Masaai: paa intokiki aapuonu aitashe te dukuya nanu tena aji, naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, nijojo, ‘Etokorduaki iyiook!’ nipuopuo dukuya iasiasa kuna pooki olminong?

English: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
Masaai: Ore enkitanapata naing'uaa enkutuk ino naa eisidai alang nkalifuni e sahabu o enkosholai.

English: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
Masaai: “Ainyoo pee meiteng'el Olmagilani nkolong'i e nkiguana, naa kainyoo paa ore lelo ooyiolo ninye nemedol aekata inkolong'i enyena?

English: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
Masaai: Neiturrur Daudi ilarikok pooki le Israel, o lapolosak pooki loo Lawi.

English: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

English: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

English: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
Masaai: Ketetema doi ninye ajo aisarkionie enkaji e Nkai paa iyiook ooibung'a. Eikijo apa iyiook pee kinguanare too nkitanapat ang,

English: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

English: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
Masaai: niraa sii intae ilchakenini, amu ore ebaiki enkiterunoto kiboitarere intae nanu.

English: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
Masaai: Ara nanu olchekut supat. Eitayu olchekut supat enkishui enye te nkaraki oo nkerra.

English: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, eitashe ina kata ltung'ana okuni ti auluo ina aji nikitii, eirriwuaki eing'uaa Kaisaria pee epuonu enatii.

English: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
Masaai: Kake mme osesen oitore intae, Enkiyang'et naitore intae, te nesipa nchere etamanya atua intae Enkiyang'et e Nkai. Ore pooki ng'ae ake lemeeta Enkiyang'et e Kristo neme olenye ilo.

English: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

English: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
Masaai: Atoduaa pooki toki naasitae tiabori enkolong; nanyorriki ajo ore pooki naa ine pesho, naa enkijape ake emirareki.

English: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

English: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
Masaai: Aanyaaka ake sii ajoki nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore irorei laainei pooki lelo laaliki iyie tang'amai toltau lino nining'u too nkiyiaa inono.

English: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

English: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

English: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

English: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
Masaai: Entinyikakaki nanu, entoning ena: ore ebaiki apa te nkiterunoto eitu nanu airo too nkisudorot, ore ebaiki ina kata apa naeuo ina aaku, atii apa nanu ine.” Ore taata naairriua nanu Olaitoriani Enkai te nebo Enkiyang'et enye.

English: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Masaai: Ore eishoi e Solomon naa: Rehoboam o Abija olayioni lenye, o Asa olayioni lenye, o Yehoshefat olayioni lenye,

English: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
Masaai: Etotiutuo nena toyie e Moab anaa ntaritik naaidapashari tiaai, anaa nkajijik oo motonyi naaidapasha too mpoorri o lkeju le Arnon.

English: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki ake Yoab airo nejo:

English: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
Masaai: tinibikibiki intae tiatua ena kop nashetu nanu intae nemauroo nanu intae; naun nanu intae, nemadotu nanu intae; amu airridua nanu ina torroni apa naitaasa nanu intae.

English: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka olmalaika, “Ainyoo pee ing'asia? Kaaliki taata enkisudoroto e na kitok, o ene ina ng'ues naata lukuny naapishana o mowuarak tomon nanapita ninye.

English: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye engolon ai naa elong'o ai; ninye eisilig oltau lai; naataretuo ninye nanu, ore enkaraki ina neting'ide oltau lai, naa kaisho nanu ninye enashe to sinkolio lai.

English: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
Masaai: Nemur ninye lelo kerubi te sahabu.

English: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
Masaai: Neiu ina kitok olayioni, neisho enkarna enye ajo Samson; nebulu ina ayioni, nemayian Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
Masaai: Neiu Aminadab Nashon, neiu Nashon Salmon,

English: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
Masaai: Amu ore pooki toki naitayio Enkai naa eisidai, nemeetae hoo ae toki nabo naanyi te naa te nashe eng'amuni;

English: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
Masaai: neishir ninche neitayu ilkiyio nepukoo o metaa teipa te nkaraki Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye o te nkaraki iltung'ana lo Laitoriani o te nkaraki enkaji e Israel, enkaraki etabatatate ninche to lalem.

English: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

English: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
Masaai: Edek iltung'ana ilo omit entapa kake eeta emayianata ilo omir.

English: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
Masaai: Oo iyie olojo miloloito, iloloito pasa iyie? Oo iyie oloiba nkitanyaanyukot naaitaai nkaitin, ipur pasa iyie inkajijik enye naasaishoreki?

English: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

English: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

English: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et e Nkai te ngolon shumata Saul pee eidip atoning'o kulo omon, neyupuyup oleng engoro enye.

English: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
Masaai: Ore eanyita Paulo ninche te Atene, nenyamalu naleng te kewan enye etoduaa eneba enkumoi oo nkitanyaanyukot naaitaai nkaitin te ina anasa.

English: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.

English: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

English: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues e dukuya naishu neikununo anaa olng'atuny, ore ina ng'ues e are naishu neikununo ana olkiteng, ore ina ng'ues e uni naishu neeta enkomom o ltung'ani, ore ina ng'ues e ong'uan naishu neikununo anaa olkurragos olo ti ai.

English: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

English: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
Masaai: Amaa euriata ino Olaitoriani aime ninye empijan ino naa enkitashoto sidai oo nkoitoi inono ninye osiligi lino?

English: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
Masaai: Naa keaku nkera inyi ilchekuti loo ntare to lpurkel ilarin artam netum ninche osina te nkaraki nimisiligayuyu o metaba anaa neirrag mpopoki olobayie linyi tiongata.

English: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
Masaai: Ti atua iyie nanu Olaitoriani aing'oru esarunoto; mikincho iyie nanu maaitukurruni ae kata; ore te supatisho ino tokorduaki nanu!

English: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

English: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
Masaai: Iyie nanu Olaitoriani adumaki oltau lai.

English: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
Masaai: Etinyikutua lelo laaisilisil nanu too ntorrok; elakuaniki ninche nkitanapat inono.
