English: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninche, “Itapala intae nkituaak pooki eishu?

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu nashipa te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno, amu itoduaa iyie osina lai, itoduaa iyie ilmang'ati laainei,

English: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
Masaai: Kake etotiro iltung'ana enkure oleng, neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Musa, nejo, “Kainyoo apa pee iyaua iyiook aaitung'uaa Misiri, nilotu aar iyiook matuata o nkera ang o nkishu ang te nkure?”

English: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

English: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

English: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
Masaai: nenang'are Yehu iltung'ana lo lmarei lenye lo laiguanani le Yuda oji Ahasia, nejoki ninche, “Irara akua?” Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Kira iyiook ilo lmarei le Ahasia, nikietuo iyiook aamutan iltung'ana le nkaji e nkitoo, o layiok le nkitok o laiguanani.”

English: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni osipa neitajeu enkishui oo lkumok, kake ore ilo oiro elejare naa olakaldaroni.

English: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
Masaai: Kitamana nanu te siadi o te dukuya, ninteleikia enkaina ino shumata nanu.

English: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
Masaai: Etabolo ninye endapidapoi nengorunye enkare; neruko aim olpurkel anaa olkeju.

English: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Mika: Pison o Melek, o Tarea o Ahas.

English: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
Masaai: Enyaaka ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Hagai enkata e are te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa, ejo,

English: O LORD God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, ira iyie asipani, amu etelekuaki iyiook olpisiaai oimishe, anaa enikitiu ena olong. Ng'ura kitii iyiook dukuya iyie te nkitarruorroto ang, amu meetae oloidim aitasho te dukuya iyie te nkaraki ena.”

English: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
Masaai: Kake neinyototo Petero eboitare ninye lelo kulikae tomon o obo, neiteru airorie olorere to ltoilo sapuk ajoki, “Lo lewa lang loo Lyahudi, o intae pooki oomanya Yerusalem, entoning enajo, matoliki intae enautu ena bae.

English: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
Masaai: Emigolong'aki ake duoo intae Olaitoriani; nimiureyuyu lelo tung'ana le ina kop, amu emukate ninche te iyiook; eiwuang'ie olchurie lenye aaitung'uaa ninche netii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook; emiureyu ninche.”

English: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelo osinka lai adupoyu, keitaae ninye kitok neilepieki, naa kelo ninye shumata oleng.

English: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Masaai: Ore te nelotu Timoteo, entodol ake pee meaku ketum ae toki naure etii te nebo intae, amu esiaai o Laitoriani easita anaa nanu,

English: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
Masaai: O ntokitin pooki naapuo too naipuko naa olminong te intae, meidimi aainosa ninche.

English: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai, naa iip o tikitam okuni.

English: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
Masaai: nitonini intae te shumata olorika sidai, niata emisa natipikaki dukuya iyie naa ninye itipika iyie enkorropil ai tenebo eilata ai.

English: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
Masaai: Aikilaku sii ninye iyie too sinaitin, nikipik ewueji nelala nemetii batisho, ore ina natipikaki emisa ino nebore olkar.

English: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejing iltung'ana entim, ng'ura, eitong'ita olkenkei le naisho, kake meetae oltung'ani otipika enkaina enkutuk; amu etureita iltung'ana ilo mumai.

English: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
Masaai: Erriwai obo linyi olo ayau olalashe linyi, ore intae nianyunyu te Korokoroni pee etumi aatujur irorei linyi, tenaa ketii esipata atua intae, arashu anaa te nkishui e Farao, esipa irara ilaikitalak.”

English: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
Masaai: Nejo Laban, “Aisidai! inchoo etiu anaa enitejo.”

English: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
Masaai: esupatisho e Nkai to rrekie le nkirukoto ti atua Yesu Kristo, te lelo pooki ooiruk. Amu meeta enepaashare;

English: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
Masaai: te mpukunoto e ae toki ake ninye naiserpepiari te nkop, te mpukunoto osinkirri ake ninye otii atua enkare tiabori enkop.

English: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
Masaai: Ore te nchoto e are o lng'obor, te nkalo e moikuape irubat tikitam oo sunta.

English: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
Masaai: Kaibelekeny nanu isiruai linyi aitaa osina, ore isinkolioitin linyi pooki neaku olkiyioi; karrotianaki nanu inkilani o lkuniyia pooki tung'ani napik enkurroto pooki lukunya, kaitotiu nanu anaa enkishirata naishirakini olayioni obo laa ninye ake eetae ore enkiting'oto enye netiu anaa enkolong nadua.

English: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
Masaai: Nepuonu ina kata ilooiteng'eni le Yohana enetii nejoki, “Aainyo pee kipukoo oleng iyiook o Lfarisayo, nemepukoo ilooiteng'eni linono?”

English: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
Masaai: Inchoo pooki likiomon; ore pee eya oltung'ani enino, mimpotu aoru.

English: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia Korasin, ee kake ayia Betsaida, amu te naa ketaasaki inenking'asia naataasaki ti atua intae, te Tiro o te Sidon anaata erridutua apa moitie, nepika ilkuniyiani o nkuruon.

English: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Masaai: Inteleiki esiaai ino Olaitoriani, naa keitasheyieki inkitobirat inono.

English: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
Masaai: Ore kulo naa inchorroi nemetii enkare, inkinukun naareu olkutati, amu ninche eitaanyaki emisimisi o lodo le nkop.

English: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
Masaai: Neidaikie ninche ilo pisiai apa le Ameleki oisika nebik ninye teine o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And when the inhabitants of  Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening lelo oomanya Yabesh-Gilead ina naitaasa Ilfilisti Saul,

English: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tooko olkitok lai”, nesiokisioki aitadou emoti te nkaina enye neisho ninye metooko.

English: And the LORD'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
Masaai: Neyupuyup apa engoro o Laitoriani te ina olong, neinos ninye olmumai ejo,

English: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?
Masaai: Etaa ina naibalie nchere eturua intae tukul ena te neton ake iatata nkiguanat e kotini olikae o likae. Aime enaikash ti ning'iri mikintaasi enemetii esipata? Oo doi pee mincho kisimarieki?

English: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
Masaai: Neipotu lkilangilang'eta, nengorokino atua, eikirikira te nkuretisho, nebatatakino Paulo o Sila,

English: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
Masaai: Nchoo enyorrata ino nauno etaanu pee aaitagol nanu, te risioroto e nkisiligata nisiligie osinka lino.

English: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche ti atua olng'obor neyau ninche enetii Yoshua o ltung'ana pooki le Israel; neirragie ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Maata enkosholai o sahabu, kake kaaisho enaata. Te nkarna e Yesu Kristo le Nasareti, aajoki shomo!”

English: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
Masaai: Ore roruat aainei neibung'a nkoitoi inono, eitu eideketari nkejek aainei.

English: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
Masaai: Ore kinturrayioki apa nikimbayuni, nemeetae obo oim atua iyie, kaaitaa nanu iyie kitok te nkishiaa ntarasi, eng'ida oo ishoritin pooki.

English: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
Masaai: Minko naa esinka ino aitaa enkitok e pesho, amu ore ena rishata pooki kagira alikioo eyieunoto ai o sina lai.”

English: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
Masaai: Kebaa naa elus tenijo midolita ninye, inchere etii enkiguana dukuya ninye, naa ninye iyie iyanyu!

English: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
Masaai: o Adina olayioni le Shisa le Ruben, olarikoni loo le Ruben, tomoni uni ootii tenebo ninye,

English: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
Masaai: Anaa ilgelunot, le Enkai, oosinya nenyorri enchopo enanai e nkoshoke, olng'ur, emoolisho emborron o eng'iriata,

English: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
Masaai: “Ore intae oo imishote to lalem, enchom, emintashe aaitirring'a! Entadamu Olaitoriani tenelakua enchoo Yerusalem elotu ndamunot inyi:

English: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
Masaai: Taata enkiguana e na kop; taata earari olaitoriani le na kop aaitupuku.

English: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
Masaai: Olosho ogogong le meshilaa likae tung'ani moruo nemeing'urrie oloti,

English: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
Masaai: nikisaisho pee ipuoyieyie enkishon naaku to Laitoriani, naitiship ninye katukul, nitumutumu aatoiu ilng'anayio too mpukunot pooki e supatisho, nitumutumu aatobikoi iponaa oleng oleng aayiolou Enkai.

English: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
Masaai: Amu ore mbaa naayiolounoyu ti alo Enkai keibala te ninche, amu Enkai naitoduaa ninche.

English: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
Masaai: neitobor ninye intae, neisho intae esumash, neitoti intae te Mana, apa nimiyiololo intae, nemeyiolo sii apa loo papaai linyi; pee etum ninye aitayiolo intae nchere, meishu oltung'ani te nkaraki endaa ake, kake keishu oltung'ani te nkaraki pooki toki naing'uaa enkutuk o Laitoriani.

English: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
Masaai: Ore to supat naa eisidain ntokitin pooki kake ore te ilo torrono o too lemeiruk meetae entoki sidai. Eidurukieki eng'eno enye o ltoiloishi loo ltauja lenye.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninche, nejoki Elisha, “Papaai lai, aar ninche metuata?”

English: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
Masaai: Neishir aajo to ltoilo sapuk, “Iyie Olaitoriani Kitok, Oyanyiti nesipa, kanu akenya inguana intalaku osarge lang te lelo ootii enkop?”

English: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
Masaai: Neeta apa Yonatan olayioni le Saul olayioni maima tarrushi nkejek enyena. Naa oloo larin imiet apa ninye ina kata pee epuonu ilomon ooipirta Saul o Yonatan eing'uaa Yesreel; nedumu ninye enkaibung'ani enye, neisik, naa ore eisik te nkisarrisar enye, nebatata, neakunye ine olmaima. Ore apa enkarna enye naa Mefiboshet.

English: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
Masaai: Teneeta olmang'atinta lino esumash, inchoo ninye endaa nanya, naa te neeta enkure, inchoo ninye enkare naok.

English: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.
Masaai: Ore apa Yonatan o Ahima-aa neanyisho ninche te En-rogel; nelo apa enkaisiaayiani aliki ninche, nepuo ninche aaliki olaiguanani Daudi; amu meeta nchere pee etoduaki ninche ejing enkanasa.

English: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
Masaai: Ore lelo supati naa kedol, neureishoyu, nekueniyie ninche ninye, ejo,

English: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
Masaai: amu imiet ilalashera laata, metoliki pee mepuonu sii ninche ene wueji o somit.’

English: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
Masaai: Kake ore ninye makewan eshomo elototo enkolong nabo tiong'ota. Nelo aton te ntonata olchani oata oloip. Neomonu pee eye, ejo, “Eiririkine Olaitoriani, iwuang'ie enkishui ai, amu maikash nanu too loo papa.”

English: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore enkishoroto enye o lasar le seriani oishori Olaitoriani naa enkiteng naing'ua eluaata olbung'ae aashu entauo neishoru enemeeta entioto.

English: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
Masaai: “Eiborrie ongu Ohola aa enaai ninye, netonyarra ninye isintan lenyena, le Asiria,

English: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
Masaai: Kake kibore iyie enkiguana e ilo torrono, kimbung'a akurraki enkiguana o esipata.

English: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
Masaai: Neing'unyung'uny Ilfarisayo o lasirak ejo, “Keitoomon ele tung'ani ilaasak loo ng'ok neng'arie endaa.”

English: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
Masaai: Nejing'aki nejoki, “Takuenya na kirotet! Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie!”

English: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani tikitam oong'uan o nena ng'uesi naaishu nebatata neserem Enkai etonita te ilo orika le nkitoo, ejoito, “Esai Haleluya!”

English: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee ing'or too nkonyek olorok lelo asarri laainei o nkishorot aainei apa naitanapishe, niyanyitu ilayiok linono aitalang nanu, intopiripiri ate too rubat nigelulu te pooki kishoroto oo ltung'ana laainei Israel?’

English: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
Masaai: Koree enkoitoi nalo ine wueji neidapashieki ewang'an arashu ewueji neidapashieki olkutati lo loo saen tioriong enkop?

English: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Neishir olaiguanani neiting'o osiligi lo ltung'ani kitok, ore nkaik oo ltung'ana oopeny enkop neikirikira tenkuretisho sapuk. Ekaitaas ninche te risioroto oo nkoitoi enye, o terisioroto oo nkiguanat enye ekaiguanare ninche, naa keyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
Masaai: Ore ilkeek linono pooki o lng'anayio le nkop ino naa keaku ilo lmaati.

English: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani naitanapa Yoshua, eishoo ninye Kaleb olayioni le Yefune erubata ti atua iltung'ana le Yuda, Kiriat-arba, aa taa Hebron (Arba apa menye le Anak).

English: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninche, entayu enturrai intokitin torrok naadaare nkonyek inyi, pooki ng'ae te intae, nimintokiki aaisarkionie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu e Misiri; Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
Masaai: Netipikaki lelo metorripo kishomi o laiguanani te nkalo o loosaen. Kulo apa ninche ilarripok le kishomi te nkang oo lng'oborri oo le Lawi.

English: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.
Masaai: Kake talaa enkaina ino tialo ninye, nisilenoki ninye enaidip enkolat enye, te mpukunoto enye ake ninye pooki.

English: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
Masaai: Ekepuo sii ninche abori enemeneng'a tenebo ninye, ine netii lelo ootaraki to lalem; ee, lelo ootoni tiabori oloip too loreren naa keish.

English: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
Masaai: kake olapa olulung'a, o metaba anaa neimu intae nkumeishin, nirikaka, enkaraki nitanyaita intae Olaitoriani otii te nebo intae, ninchirishiri te dukuya ninye, ijojo, “Kainyoo iyiook pee kitupukutuo te nkop e Misiri?” ’ ”

English: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Daudi ina umata pooki, “Ore Solomon enkerai ai laa ninye ake etegelua Enkai, naa oltung'ani oti lemeeta enkarriyiano, naa eikitok ena siaai, amu ore ena aji nemeaku ene tung'ani, kake eno Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
Masaai: Amu ore apa teina olong nayawua nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, eitu nanu airorie loo papaai linyi arashu aaraki ninche tialo nkishorunot naapejori o lasarri.

English: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
Masaai: Eitoreita iyiook irrindiki; nemeetae olokordu iyiook aitayu too nkaik enye.

English: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
Masaai: Ore oltau lo ltashalai naa keng'uarrisho, nemetum hoo pito, ore oltau leilo onyok naa keishori ninye te nkumoi.

English: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
Masaai: Amaa irorei le nkijape keeta enkiting'oto? Arashu ainyoo doi nikintagoro peyie iwalu?

English: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
Masaai: Maaraa nanu ninche meshomo te dukuya iyie to lari obo, pee meaku ake enkop ailitani neponari ilowuarak le ntim nikintanyamal.

English: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
Masaai: amu ejo ninye, “Ore te nkata namunyak aatoning'o nanu iyie; ore te nkolong e njeunoto naatareto nanu iyie.” Ng'ura, taata ina kata namunyak; ng'ura, taata ina olong e njeunoto.

English: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaiki ilomon Yoab, amu etijing'a apa Yoab Adonija enkoriong, hoo neitu ejing Absalom, neisikaki Yoab olng'obor lo Laitoriani nelo aibung imouarak o lperere lo lasar.

English: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.
Masaai: Nenyamalu iltung'ana le Israel ina olong; amu einosie Saul iltung'ana olmumai, ejo, “Ediaa ilo tung'ani onya endaa o metaba anaa neaku teipa aitalakua too lmang'ati laainei.” Neaku meetae obo too ltung'ana oishamishama endaa.

English: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
Masaai: Eiroro ninye nelotu olmaati, o nkiyioitin o lmaati nemeikenayu;

English: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oiboni aashu ilo aidetidetani loo nkidetidetat neari metua, amu eiteng'enishe ninye engolong'akinoto tialo Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo laa ninye likiyaua iyie aitupuku tiatua enkop e Misiri, nikikordu ninye iyie aitung'uaa enkaji esinkaisho, pee kitum aitung'uai ina oitoi nikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino pee iim. Neaku iwuang'ie iyie entorroni te mpolos inyi

English: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
Masaai: Eisikita Madmena, ore lelo oomanya Gebin neilanyishote aaing'oru enesaru.

English: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
Masaai: Neish endamunoto enye te nkop, nemeeta enkarna too nkoitoi naalala.

English: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.
Masaai: Negoro Usia. Neeta ninye te nkaina entoki napejieki enkorropil, ore ake pee egorokino lelo apolosak, nejing enkeeya oo lbolot enkomom enye, te dukuya lelo apolosak ootii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, ooitashe tembata olperere lo lasar le nkorropil.

English: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
Masaai: Amu meibelekenyayu nkishorunot aashu engelunoto e Nkai.

English: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Olaitoriani eing'uaa eretoto ai, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop.

English: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa kiyau ae toki atua enkop, nimikindim aawaita hoo toki aaitung'uai enkop.

English: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
Masaai: ore tiabori imelin enye, mepuonu lelo pooki aaing'uaa. Ore lelo sikarini le naiposha tenebo pooki ootii atua emeli o larewak loo melin, neitashe pooki te nkop natoyio

English: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
Masaai: iishu iltung'ana pooki kituaak teine, ilbarnot o ntoyie, nkera kutiti o nkituaak, kake mishoroo ake pooki ng'ae oota olmishire. Naa interu te wueji ai sinyati.”

English: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
Masaai: eton aa abori laramatak etii ilaitasheikinok o metabau enkata apa natejo menye.

English: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
Masaai: neaku imbonoki nijoki, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore enkaraki, ee, ore enkaraki naitaa ninche intae mitili nepurd intae too nkaloli pooki, metaa itaa intae entoki e kulie kuapi, nitaa intae enkiroroto o entorroni olmarenke loo ltung'ana;

English: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
Masaai: neisuaa ilng'osil lenyena; netiu esidano enye anaa oloirien, ore erropili enye netiu anaa iltarakua ootii Lebanon.

English: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
Masaai: Ore ngarrin are o lmong'i oong'uan neisho ilayiok le Gershon te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye.

English: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, neirorie ninye Musa o Eliya

English: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
Masaai: Nelo Hilkia ilo apolosani o Ahikam, o Akobor, o Shafan, o Asaya enetii Hulda ina oiboni. Ore apa ina oiboni naa enkitok e Shulam olayioni le Tikfa, olayioni le Harhas. Olaing'urani apa lo sanduku loo nkilani ilo payian le Huda, (naa Yerusalem apa namanya ninche), ina manyisho e are ina kata pee eirorie ninche.

English: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
Masaai: o Pelatia, o Hanan, o Hanaia, o

English: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Hesekia ina, nepolos ilkilani lenyena, neimulumul kewan too ilkuniyani, nelo ajing atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
Masaai: teng'eno ino o tening'unoto ino inotoko kewan imasaa, ninturrurruo sahabu o enkosholai apik atua arsisisho ino;

English: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Kepuonu inkolong'i naa ing'uarring'uarra te ni idolidolo enkolong nabo e Nkerai e Tung'ani, nimidolidolo.

English: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
Masaai: Eikiboloki iyie Olaitoriani olchumati lenye le shumata, pee eishoru enchan tenkop ino too rishat enyena, nemayian esiai oo nkaik inono; neaku isilenoki iyie nkuapi kumok kake misilenu iyie.

English: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, kepalaa ninye ninche ometabau ina kata, pee eiu ina nanuta ninye, netum taa ilalashera lenyena pooki aatorrinyokinoto iltung'ana le Israel.

English: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Masaai: Metadamuni entorroni oo loo menye te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa nchoo eaku meiwuang'ieki eng'oki e ngotonye aajutoo.

English: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
Masaai: Neisho ninche ilaguetak loo nkeek, o lashetak, pee einyiang'u isoito, o nkeek, o loom, tenkaraki ina shetare apa naishoo ilaiguanak le Yuda erruoyo.

English: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
Masaai: Keyanyitu ninye enkai oo sempewueti te rishata e kuna; ina ai neitu ae kata eyiolou loo menye eyanyit ninye te sahabu o te nkosholai, too soito oogol enkinyiang'a o too nkishorot naagol enkinyiang'a.

English: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo ilaing'okok metumuti te nkop, naa inchoo ilarruok eishieki! Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai! Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
Masaai: o Eliab olayioni lenye o Yeroham olayioni lenye, o Elkana olayioni lenye.

English: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
Masaai: Ore eton atii enkop, ara nanu ewang'an e nkop.”

English: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura! nepuku enkanasa pooki aapuo aanang'are Yesu; ore pee edol nesai metung'uai ilo kirine lenye.

English: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
Masaai: aikimputi iyie emerei o sina Enkikompe enkuretisho sapuk o emutata, ina kikompe enkanashe ino Samaria;

English: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
Masaai: Meetae entoki e oriong oltung'ani naa te nejing ade atua neidim aisarkionie ninye; kake mbaa naapuku ti atua oltung'ani naaitaa ninye torrono.

English: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
Masaai: Neirriwaki ake likae, near ilo metua; neiko sii neijia kulikae kumok, neosh kulikae near kulikae metuata.

English: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
Masaai: Etuturo ninye neiwuang'ie soito, neun isabibu ooshiluno; neshetu oltalet orripishoreki te mpolos e nkurma, neitobiru eneironyishoreki te ine; neton aanyu metoiu enkurma isabibu, kake isabibu le ntim etoiuo.

English: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
Masaai: Tudumunye, tawang'a, amu eeuo ewang'an ino, netudumunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te shumata iyie

English: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
Masaai: Nchoo naa osinka lino endamunoto e ningunoto pee etum aitoria ltung'ana linono, pee atum atumusu atirishu mbaa sidain o ntorrok, amu kaing'ae oidim aitoria ele orere lino kitok?”

English: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
Masaai: Neliki ninye lelo omon, ejoki, “Eton doi ake eishu Yosef, naa ninye oitore enkop pooki e Misiri!” Neiterre Yakobo, amu eitu eiruk ninye ninche.

English: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Kaji etiu pee kijo nanu supat? Meetae hoo obo supat, Enkai ake esupat.

English: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
Masaai: Neiko ninye neijia te nena kituaak enyena pooki oo loreren naapej enkorropil nepolosaki nkaitin enye.

English: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
Masaai: “Inos iyie endaa endaa sapuk nikiraposh, nilo aisis Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo laa ninye otaasa inenking'asia te nkaraki iyie. Maigil aekata aaitukurru iltung'ana laainei.

English: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
Masaai: Isujaa iyie embeneyio nayaita osiwuo, nimir errarrati natoyio?

English: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
Masaai: Nerik Tera Abram olayioni lenye, o Lot olayioni le Haran olayioni lo layioni lenye, o Sarai, enkitok olayioni lenye Abram, nepuku aing'uaa pooki Uri oo Lkaldayo aapuo enkop e Kanaan. Ore peyie ebau Haran, eetuo aitaa ine emanyisho.

English: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.
Masaai: Ore kuna pooki, olaiguanani, eishoo Arauna olaiguanani.” Nejoki Arauna olaiguanani, “Mikitang'amai iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”

English: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
Masaai: Menoto lelo pooki oosuj ena kitanapata eseriani o lng'ur, naa taa, lelo oora Siraeli le Nkai.

English: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
Masaai: neitabaya olng'ur oisiligie iloo papa lang, nedamu osotua lenye sinyati,

English: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tomon o obo naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran, ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Asheri:

English: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
Masaai: Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Elotu Enkiyang'et Sinyati shumata iyie, nikintoip engolon o Lotii Shumata Aisul, ore te nkaraki ina, ore enkerai naini, neji sinyati, Enkerai e Nkai.

English: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche nkitanapat nipik dukuya ninche.

English: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Masaai: ntokitin apa nikitoning'o nikiyiolou, nena apa naatolikitio iyiook loo papa.

English: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
Masaai: Metaa kuti nkolong'i enyena; metaa likae oya imasaa enyena!

English: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
Masaai: Amu aatung'uaitie nanu papa o yieyio, kake kaadumu nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooibung nkitanapat enyena netoni ninche tiatua ninye. Naa ena kiyiolounye nchere etonita ninye ti atua iyiook, te nkaraki ina Kiyang'et Sinyati naishoo ninye iyiook.

English: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
Masaai: Amaa, naa taata kainyoo nanu aata te ine, Olaitoriani ojo, idolita ajo eewaki iltung'ana laainei pesho? Kedar lelo aitoriak lenye, Olaitoriani ojo, ore endama pooki anaake nemenaa ninche enkarna ai.

English: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Masaai: kenyor Olaitoriani nchomito e Sion, aitalang imanyishoritin pooki e Yakobo.

English: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, minturaa iyiook. Mintadou olorika lino le nkitoo; tadamu nimigil olning'o lino lo sotua tenebo iyiook.

English: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
Masaai: ilo sanduku o nkeek enyena, ilo orika lo lng'ur o ilo liatua lenye,

English: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
Masaai: Ore ilo orojisho te nkong'u enye aitunyoo esipata neyau enyamali, kake ore ilo oibalie te mpijan esipata neyau eseriani.

English: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
Masaai: Mijoki olelatia lino, “Shomo pee intoki ashukunye, ekaaisho metabaiki” — ti niata ina kata ina toki.

English: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel iltung'ana pooki, “Idolitata olaa ninye etegelua Olaitoriani? Metii likae laaijo ninye ti atua iltung'ana pooki.” Nebuaku iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Metobikoi olaiguanani!”

English: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eosh nena tarumpetani iip uni neiuloki Olaitoriani olalem ake lo ltung'ani olikae tung'ani o enjore pooki; neisik ina jore o meshomo Betshita enkalo e Serera, o metabaiki olpolosie le Abel-mehola, te mbata e Tabat.

English: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
Masaai: Nikirriwayie iyie Olaitoriani esiaai, nejo, ‘Shomo, indaikie lelo aing'okok, Ilamaleki, niarare ninche o metaba anaa neishunye.’

English: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki natalaa Enkai enkeene ai naaitobor nanu, aaibelekenyakinote ninche nanu te ngoro enye pooki.

English: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aisho olaiguanani ntalantani iip o tikitam e sahabu, o sonkoyoni kumok oleng o soito oogol enkinyiang'a. Eitu aekata eitokini aatum enkorropil naba anaa ina naishoo enkaiguanani e Sheba olaiguanani Solomon.

English: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
Masaai: Nikincho sii iyiook oshiaake Enkai enashe te nkaraki ena, inchere pee ing'amumu ororei le Enkai litoning'o te iyiook, eitu intae ing'amumu anaa ororei loo ltung'ana, kake anaa enatiu te dede orerei le Enkai ti atua intae ilairukok.

English: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
Masaai: Naa oltoilo loo naipuko e nena ng'uesi naaishu eibung'a maate, naning sii nena kejek oo ngarrin naashepita te mbata enye, nening'oyu anaa olokirikiri sapuk le nkop.

English: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
Masaai: “Embalunye ninye, intae ilooked isirkon barrikon, intae ilootonie ilmukekani oogol enkinyiang'a, o intae iloopuo te nkoitoi.

English: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
Masaai: nkirikirayu te dukuya ninye na kop pooki; ee, eitashe enkop pooki aitirring'a, nemeigusugusieki aekata.

English: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: Ninye otadamua iyiook apa kishal, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
Masaai: Ore te nkalamasisho enye naa keponaa aitubul elejare te nkaina enye ore too ndamunot enyena makewan nerup kewan. Keidaikie ilkumok metii enkikoo naa kedumakino doi ninye o metabaiki Olkitok loo lkituaak, kake kepuoi aagil ninye metii enkaina e tung'ani.

English: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
Masaai: Neijia naa etiu, too lng'anayio lenye iyiolouu ninche.

English: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
Masaai: “Emayiana lelo ooitayu osotua; amu ninche eji inkera e Nkai.

English: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast now made known unto us the king's matter.
Masaai: Iyie, Enkai o loo papa, aaisho nanu enashe o enkisisa, amu kinchoo nanu eng'eno o engolon, nikintayiolo nanu nena nikinkilikuanutua te iyie, amu ntayiolo iyie iyiook ina bae naipirta olaiguanani.”

English: And the LORD'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani ti alo Siraeli, neisho ninche metilimanata ti ong'ata ilarin artam, o metaba anaa neishunye ilo porror apa pooki otaasa entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
Masaai: Naa karsis oleng Abram too nkishu o te nkosholai, o te sahabu.

English: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, were there.
Masaai: Naa keilep apa ele tung'ani to lari ake o to lari ailep te nkanasa enye alo aserem nepolosaki Olaitoriani loo lororani te Shilo, te ine apa nerayie ilayiok pokira oare le Eli, Hofni o Finehas ilapolosak lo Laitoriani.

English: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etudung'oyie Olaitoriani te Israel endukuya o lkidong'oi; nedung ilng'osil loo ltuka o seyia te nkolong nabo -

English: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore ilo toilo duoo latoning'o eing'uaa shumata, naaitoki airorie, nejo, “Shomo tudumu ilo piyayati le mbuku obolo, otii enkaina e ilo malaika oitashe te naiposha o te nkop natoyio.”

English: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Imer naa, enkalifu nabo o onom oare.

English: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
Masaai: Ore ntalantani iip e nkosholai naa inaaitobirieki apa nkitotoneta e wueji sinyati, o nkitotoneta e ilo karasha le ndung'oroto nera iip too ntalantani iip e ntalanta ake te nkitotonet.

English: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aibalunye eenata e mpukoroto to lkeju le Ahafa, pee kitum iyiook aitoborro ate te dukuya Enkai ang, pee king'oru te ninye enkoitoi naitoriori te nkaraki iyiook maate, o nkera ang o masaa ang pooki.

English: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
Masaai: Eibelekenyi ninye anaa enterit natii abori olmishire, neibelekenye emua enye anaa enkila.

English: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim the king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
Masaai: Naa ore tialo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda tejo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, itapejo iyie ele piyayati, ijo, “Kainyoo iyie pee ingero tiatua ninye nchere esipa kelotu olaiguanani le Babilon neinyal ena kop neishie tiatua ninye tung'ani o eng'ues?”

English: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
Masaai: Ara nanu Enkai e Betel, ine wueji apa nintisinyie eng'ape abukoki e ilata nikinosaki sii olmumai. Ore tena kata inyo shomo tung'uai ena kop nirrinyo alo enkop apa nikitoinyieki.’ ”

English: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

English: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

Masaai: Kake kaaliki nanu iyie ina natisiraki ti atua ina buku oosipat; meetae likae laaretu nanu aarare kulo meteleku Mikael ake ilo kitok linyi.

English: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
Masaai: Ore eton eirorita, nepuonu ilooing'uaa enkaji e ilo oitore enkaji e ntumo nejo, “Etua entito ino. Oo pee intoki aitanyamal Olaiteng'enani?”

English: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
Masaai: Enaikash te nesaruni Olaitoriani alang te neisiligi ilkituaak.

English: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
Masaai: Ore too lapolosak naa: Yedaia olayioni le Yairib, o Yakin,

English: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
Masaai: Kake etejo Musa, “Ore kulo tung'ana latii nanu atua oobaya nkalifuni iip ile oopuo too nkejek; eji nijo iyie, ‘Kaisho nanu nkiri, pee etum aainosa olapa olulung'a!’

English: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naabaya isiet eidipate nena baa nerik Petero o Yohana o Yakobo neked oldoinyo aaomon.

English: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
Masaai: Kulo pokira tomon o aare eirriwayie Yesu neitanap ajoki, “Emipuo nkoitoi oo Loreren, nimijing'ijing'i enkang hoo nabo oo ltung'ana le Samaria

English: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
Masaai: (kulo ninche ilayiok le Silpa oishoo Laban Lea entito enye; neaku kulo etoikio Yakobo - iltung'ana tomon o ile).

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
Masaai: metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, kaitame nanu Shemaya le Nehelam o eishoi enye; metum ninye hoo ng'ae oishu tiatua kulo tung'ana oaku olenye odol ina sidai naitaas nanu iltung'ana laainei, Olaitoriani ojo, amu eiroro ninye enapaashari tialo Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
Masaai: Naa te neng'amaa intae oltung'ani entiaaki, ‘Olkitok oatayie enkolat’; nerewakini te ina kata.”

English: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
Masaai: Ore olpolosie lenye le nkalo e moikuape nedumunye te nkiting'oto Enaiposha e Munyan ebaiki olkina le naiposha oing'or enkalo e moikuape:

English: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
Masaai: Netum ilalashera lenyena olom te nkaraki ninye, kake etushuma menye ina kiroroto to ltau.

English: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
Masaai: Amu ore erripoto e ng'eno nagut netiu anaa erripoto oo mpisai; naa ore dupoto e yiolounoto naa ina ng'eno nagut nagolie ina kishui eilo oata.

English: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kaiwuang'ie nanu olaiguanani te mpolos e Moab, naar metuata ilkituaak lenyena te nebo ninye Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
Masaai: Ore hoo naidapashaka nanu ninche atua iloreren, kake ore too nkuapi naalakua naa kaadamu ninche, nanu, neaku ore ninche tenebo inkera enye naa kepok nerrinyunye ang tenebo.

English: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
Masaai: Ashipakino nanu ororei lino, anaa oltung'ani otum imasaa kumok.

English: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
Masaai: aashu ae toki ake ninye nainosie ninye olmumai te lejare; nerrinyu ninye elulung'a neponiki erubata e imiet, neisho ilo ora olopeny, teina olong o lasar le nkitarruorroto enye.

English: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
Masaai: Aitaa nanu esiana oo nkolia enye kumok alang osinyai loo naaiposha; ayaka nanu noo ng'otonye ilmurran ooti olainyalani te nkipirata enkolong; aishoo nanu emion o lkirutoto metadoiki ninche aluam.

English: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
Masaai: ore to lari le artam, te nkolong e dukuya olapa le tomon oobo, neirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel te risioroto e nena pooki naaishoo ninye Olaitoriani aitanap ninche.

English: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
Masaai: Teeniki ninche oltau anaake; teeniki ninche emurt ino.

English: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena neisuma ninye irorei pooki le nkitanapata, emayianata o ldeket, te risioroto e nena pooki naaigeroki ti atua embuku oo nkitanapat.

English: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
Masaai: Maata likae laaijo ninye oing'or negolie mbaa inyi oleng;

English: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
Masaai: nijoki ina kop e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Ing'ura ekaarare iyie, naa kaaitorioki iyie olalem lashutu te nchashur enye, nadung'oo tiatua iyie lelo supati o ltorrok.

English: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
Masaai: eing'asiate sii ninche layiok le Sebedayo, aa Yakobo o Yohana, oora le ncholiek e Simon, Nejoki Yesu Simon, “Miureishoyu; ore ebaiki taata, iltung'ana intorioo aibung.”

English: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, eitoodor Enkai nkolong'i e ilo Magilani te ngolon enye. Edumunye ninche etapalari te nkishui.

English: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
Masaai: Neanyu ninche ejo ebaiki nejeyu aashu ebatata aosh enkop etua; kake ore pee eanyu te nkata naado neitu eduaaki ninye ae napiak, neibelekenya neaku kejo enkai ninye.

English: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
Masaai: Kelo ake atiu te pooki lenye anaa eneigarae te nkaraki olkutati, olchurie te nkaraki olkutati, netiu anaa nchorroi oo nkariak te nkop natoyio, netiu anaa oloip le ndapidapoi kitok te nkop e nauri.

English: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
Masaai: Neme Adam apa etelejaki, kake enkitok apa etelejaki, neaku etigila nkitanapat.

English: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
Masaai: Tipikaki nanu ndamunot, maishankarrata iyiook te nebo; iyau enkiguana ino, pee kitumi aaitisipa nchere iata esipata.

English: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
Masaai: Esipa etii tenebo nanu ilasukenyak, ore inkonyek aainei netii esurdaany enye.

English: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
Masaai: Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa eiyie, tiaakaki maeu enitii too nkejek ti oriong enkare.”

English: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
Masaai: Kake eiterua adek kewan nenya lmuma ejo. “Mayiolo nanu ele tung'ani liimakiki.”

English: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Hashum: naa Matenai, o Matata, o Sabad, o Elifelet, o Yeremai, o Manase o Shimei.

English: This is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
Masaai: ele ninye ilo rorei oiroro Olaitoriani eipirta ninye: ‘Eikimen ninye iyie, eikisukeny ninye iyie - ena tito e Sion; neipirripir endukuya enye te siadi iyie - na tito e Yerusalem.

English: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
Masaai: Metii embiotisho atua osesen lai, te nkaraki engoro ino; metii embiotisho iloik laainei te nkaraki eng'oki ai.

English: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
Masaai: Etudumunye ninche te Ramases to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa; te ina olong nasuju pasaka, neipung iltung'ana le Israel aapuo eishuro te dukuya ile Misiri pooki,

English: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
Masaai: kake entorroni inyi nayaua eoro, te rishata intae o Enkai inyi, naa ng'ok inyi naaisudoitie enkomom enye te intae, o metaa meekure ening intae.

English: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
Masaai: Ilepa shomo enchumata e Pisga; nishumu inkonyek inono aing'or enkalo oloo ntoluo, naa ng'ura etii ina kop nkonyek inono, amu milo iyie alang ele keju le Yordan.

English: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
Masaai: Ore sii eirragita ilkituaak aarreshito nanu, nkiguanat inono ninche eibirribir osinka lino.

English: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Nejoki ina tito enye ninye, “Papa, ti nitaboloko iyie Olaitoriani enkutuk ino, ntaasaki nanu enaba anaa enaimua enkutuk ino, amu kitalaaka Olaitoriani too lmang'ati linono te lelo le Amon.”

English: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
Masaai: Naa ore apa anaa enaitanapa Yoshua iltung'ana, ore lelo apolosak oopishana oonapita imouarak naapishana oo lmeregeshi te dukuya Olaitoriani nepuo dukuya, eoshito imouarak, esujita ninche ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani.

English: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye ninye nelotu ine netii oltung'ani le Nkai, to ldoinyo le Karmel. Ore ake pee edol oltung'ani le Nkai ina kitok elotu, nejoki ninye Gehasi osinka lenye, ng'ura elotu enkitok e Shunam te idie.

English: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
Masaai: Inemeeta olaiguanani lenye, o laitasheikinoni arashu oloitore,

English: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: niar ilo oing'oni metua te dukuya Olaitoriani te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo.

English: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ele naa ororei lo Laitoriani oirriwakaki Serubabel: Ime te nkidimata, neme te ngolon, kake te Nkiyang'et ai Sinyati, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Olkushiti, “Eisidain mbaa ti alo ilo barnoti Absalom?” Newal ilo Kushiti ajo, “Metaa ilmang'ati lo lkitok lai olaiguanani, o pooki likidumakino aarare iyie te ntorroni, etiu anaa ilo barnoti.”

English: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
Masaai: Ore olmumai pooki, o enata olmumai nainosie oltung'ani kewan osina, keidim olmoruo lenye atuuno, aashu eidim aitaa parmetii.

English: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
Masaai: Irriwai naa lkiliku Yopa, meipoto Simon oji Petero; naa olomoni ninye te nkaji e Simon laa olaitobirani loo lonito, omanya embata e naiposha.’

English: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
Masaai: Kake ore te ilo arruoni, ejo Enkai: “Kaa sipata iyie iata nilimunye nkitanapat aainei, anaa iya olning'o lai lo sotua te nkutuk ino?

English: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
Masaai: Ena taata empalai e are nasiraki intae, ilanyor laainei, ore te pokira are natuputuo indamunot inyi nemetii enkeleekisho te nkoitoi e nkitadamunoto,

English: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
Masaai: eitawang'aki ilootoni te naimin, o lootoni to loip le nkeeya, pee eutaki nkejek ang inkoitoi o sotua.”

English: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore ninye taata eisudoyie ninye kewan te ngumoto nabo, arashu ti ae wueji. Naa ore ake pee ebatata embata oo ltung'ana te rasakinoto e dukuya, ore pooki ng'ae oning nejo, ‘Etii enkidaaroto atua lelo tung'ana oosujita Absalom.’

English: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
Masaai: Kayieu naas isupati kake maas; neaku ntorrok nemayieu ninche aas.

English: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani metayiolouni ninye too le Misiri. Neyiolou lelo le Misiri Olaitoriani te ina olong, neserem ninye to lasar o too nkishorot o lasar opejori. Neinos ninche olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neitabaya.

English: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
Masaai: Nchoo iloreren eputu ate, nepuonu oerata le Yehoshafat; amu teine nanu alo aton adung'oki enkiguana, lelo oreren pooki ootaana.

English: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
Masaai: Entadamu enkipototo inyi, lalashera laainei. Mme kumok ilkulinyi oora apa ng'eni anaa naajo ltung'ana, neme kumok iloogol; neme kumok iloo lmarei kituaak;

English: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
Masaai: Neitokini aaoriki irubat lelo kulikae lo losho le Manase, too lmareita lenye, Abiesa, o Helek, o Asriel, o Shekem, o Hafer o Shenuda; kulo apa ilayiok ootoiuo Manase olayioni le Yosef, too lmareita lenye.

English: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
Masaai: Itipika nkejek aainei ilpisia, ningor inkoitoi aainei pooki, itipika ienat ndapi oo nkejek aainei.

English: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
Masaai: Ore nanu, kara aisinani namena, kake Olaitoriani laagolie. Ira iyie eretoto ai olakordunoni lai; mimutie iyie, na Ai ai!

English: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
Masaai: nepuo ninche eponari engolon enye ore ina Ai oo nkaitin nepuoi aadol te Sion.

English: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
Masaai: Nairriwaa nanu Musa o Aron, naar nanu enkop e Misiri te nena nataasa nanu ti atua ninche; ore te siadi naipang'unye nanu intae.

English: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
Masaai: Nepolosaki ninche iloiriruani, leme nkaitin, nena aitin neitu aekata eyiolou ninche nena aitin naaetuo det, neitu aekata ninye eidetidetu loo papaai linyi.

English: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninche nena naaitanapishe Musa dukuya olng'obor le ntumo, neigutu olturrur pooki anyiku neitashe te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
Masaai: Ore Aleksanta ele kunoni loo suyan aaitaasa ntorrok oleng, keitalak Olaitoriani te nkaraki nkiaasin enyena.

English: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
Masaai: Amu ore ele oimaki kuna baa naa ole likae osho lemeeta ninche ae kata oltung'ani lenye otopolosishe to lperere lo lasar.

English: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel Isiraeli pooki, “Eng'ura, atoning'o nanu oltoilo linyi te nena pooki nikitiaakita intae nanu, natuputoko nanu intae olaiguanani.

English: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
Masaai: neitawal enkitoo e Nkai nemeye ninye ntarasi newalunye inkitanyaanyukot neeijo oltung'ani oye ake, aashu imotonyi aashu ng'uesi, aashu ng'uesi naaikurtutari.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, nemeitokini aadamu Turo too larin ntomoni naapishana, naaba anaa nkolong'i o laiguanani obo. Ore te siadi lelo arin ntomoni naapishana netiu te Turo anaa enatiu te ilosinkolio le mulayoi:

English: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie ninye neing'uaa ewang'an te nkoitoi, neibelekeny enaiposha aiborrie anaa olaburra.

English: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki neitu iyie isiai Olaitoriani Enkai ino te ng'ida o te nchipai o ltau lino, te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa,

English: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
Masaai: Ore tenebo nena ang'itie enye pooki naamanita o kuna anas ometabaiki baal, kuna apa imanyiishoritin enye neigero iiishoritin enye.

English: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
Masaai: Amaa nena aitin oo loreren ketokordutua ninche, lelo oshon apa ooidaikie loo papa, Gosan, o Haran, o Resef o ltung'ana le Eden apa ootii Telasa?

English: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Abiatar olapolosani, olayioni le Ahimelek, “Iyakaki nanu enkila dorrop.” Neaku eyaka Abiatar ina kila dorrop Daudi.

English: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
Masaai: Amaa te natolikio intae mbaa e nkop nimirukuruku, kaji nkoko pee irukuruku te naliki intae mbaa e shumata?

English: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
Masaai: Neirorie Yesu nejoki, “Simon, aata embae naaliki.” Nejoki, “Ee Olaiteng'enani.”

English: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
Masaai: Metaa eshomo Esau amany enkop oo ldoinyo e Seir. Esau aa ninye Edom.

English: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Near ninche ebaiki Aroer o metabaiki elatia e Minit, nkanas tikitam, o metabaiki Abel-keramim, te sesekuanata kitok oleng. Neaku etimiraki apa ile Amon te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.

English: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
Masaai: Naa ore nena olong'i, anaa enatonita Mordekai te kishomi o laiguanani, negoro oare le lelo sunaishi oogelema lo laiguanani Bigsan o Teres neing'oru eneiko pee epik nkaik enye olaiguanani Serser.

English: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: amu eitabari nkitanapat te le rorei obo, nchere, “Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.”

English: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
Masaai: Oo naa ntae ilaa keikena ninye lpapit loo lukuny inyi. Emiureisho; iatata pae tipat aalang ntiitiini kumok.

English: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “Naa ti nimikiruk ninche, arashu te nemenyorraa enkitoduaata e dukuya, neidim ninche aairuko ina kitoduaata e are.

English: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
