English: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
Masaai: Keaku enino ina nasinya aisul naiteng'elaki neitu epejori te nkima; ore pooki kishoroto enye o lasar, o pooki asar lenye le ng'oki laaisho ninche nanu naa keaku kesinya oleng te iyie o too layiok linono.

English: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
Masaai: naiputa nanu ninye Enkiyang'et e Nkai, te nkidimata o te nkalamasisho, o te ng'eno o te nkarriyiano pooki.

English: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Yuda Nahashon olayioni le Aminadab;

English: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
Masaai: Ore pee eidipi aaibatisa Yesu, neilepu nabo kata aing'uaa enkare; ng'ura, nebolokino shumata nedol ninye Enkiyang'et Sinyati e Nkai edou anaa enturkulu, elotu shumata ninye;

English: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
Masaai: Etalaa olmang'atinta nkaik enyena, aisalaashaki ntokitin enyena pooki e tipat ee, etoduaa ninye iloreren eibung ewueji enye sinyati, lelo apa litomitioko iyie ejing atua eumata ino.

English: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
Masaai: Ore oltau le ilo ng'en, netii atua ina aji, olkiyioi; kake ore ilo tau loo lmoda netii ina aji enkuenia.

English: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
Masaai: Neas Yehoash mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani too nkolong'i enyena pooki, amu eiteng'ena apa olapolosani Yehoida ninye.

English: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
Masaai: Ore to lari le Yubilii nerrinyokino ina kurma ilo apa oinyang'unyeki, aa enenye apa ina kop natujung'o.

English: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
Masaai: Ejo sii pee eishooyo olasar anaa enajo nkitanapat o Laitoriani, aa, “Nturkuluni are, aashu nkera are e nturkulu.”

English: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
Masaai: Too larin kumok iting'iriakine iyie ninche, ninkok ninche te Nkiyang'et ino, iimunye iloibonok linono; ore ake eyia eitu ninche ening. Ore enkaraki ina inchooyie iyie ninche apik nkaik oo loreren.

English: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni, o eng'irra nabo e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;

English: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
Masaai: anaa apa enaitaasa nanu ilayiok le Esau oomanya Seir o Lmoabu oomanya Ari, o metaba anaa nalang alo lido kekun le Yordan ajing atua ina kop naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’

English: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani opakas ole latia enye, naa inkejek enyena eisalaashaka orreshet.

English: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
Masaai: Atua Enkai etii eng'eno nagut o emagilanisho; eeta eutaroto o ening'unoto.

English: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
Masaai: Emincho elej oltung'ani kewan. Te nejo likae linyi ng'en ninye anaa naajo taata ele porror, enchoo ilo eaku keshal, pee etum ataa ng'en;

English: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
Masaai: “Tenilotu akenya ina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino, milo ake aitamok kewan esujata e nena tabo o olminong le lelo oshon.

English: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
Masaai: Nchoo ilo leeiking'a oeuo aibung'are Olaitoriani ejo, “Esipa kaakepu nanu Olaitoriani too ltung'ana lenyena.” Naa nchoo ake mejo ilo sunash ogelema, “Ng'ura, ara nanu olchani otoyio.”

English: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
Masaai: Imerlelie nkiwang'at nindapashaa ninche, ning'oru mbaa inono aitanyamal ninche!

English: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ematua e siamo kulo rorei nejo, “Esipa ilo oiboni ele.”

English: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine pee eaku olasar le ng'oki pee eitayunyeki olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki iyie.

English: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie enkiroishi oo nkatampo, nena baa enking'asia e ilo oota eng'eno nalulung'a.

English: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
Masaai: Neaku aawa apa nanu lelo arikok loo loshon linyi, lelo tung'ana ng'eni arriyiak, naitaa ninche ilarikok linyi, ilaitasheikinok loo nkalifuni o ilaitasheikinok loo maa iip, o ilaitasheikinok loo maa-onom, o laitasheikinok loo maa tomon ilkituaak tiatua iloshon linyi pooki.

English: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura etii apa Yerusalem oltung'ani oji Simeon, naa oltung'ani supat nenyor Enkai, oanyita ninye meitajeu Enkai Siraeli, netii Enkiyang'et Sinyati atua ninye.

English: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
Masaai: Neliki Yakobo Raheli ajoki ole sotua, naa olayioni le Rebeka. Neipirri Raheli ang alo aliki menye.

English: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan ele apa, teipa, nimbung'ubung'u te nkata enye nategeluaki te risioroto oo nkikoot pooki, o nkiguanat pooki ipuopuo intae aaibung.”

English: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
Masaai: Keng'idakino oltau lai Olaitoriani, neshipakino enjeunoto enye.

English: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
Masaai: Amu eing'asie ninye o lelo ooboitare, te nkumoi oo sinkir ooibung'a;

English: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
Masaai: Einosa apa iltung'ana le Israel olmumai te Mispa, nejo, “Meetae hoo obo te iyiook oisho entito enye meyama iltung'ana le Benchamen.”

English: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Tiaaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Entinyiku wootu dukuya Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninye inking'unyung'unyat inyi.’ ”

English: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
Masaai: o Usia le Asheri, o Shama o Yerel ilayiok le Hotam le Arori,

English: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aipotu lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi, naa iip are ninche o tomoni uni oare, ore te siadi ninche neitoki aipotu iltung'ana loo Siraeli, nkalifuni naapishana.

English: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
Masaai: o Gebal, o Amon o Amaleki, o Filistia te nebo lelo oomanya Turo;

English: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
Masaai: Nelotu Serak le Etiopia agilunore ninche eeta enjore oo ltung'ana milion nabo, o ngarrin oo mbartan iip uni, nepuonu o metabau Maresha.

English: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
Masaai: Kaji naa etiu pee eitu ishum impesai aainei te mbenki, pee te na lotu, natum nena aainei o naaiu?’

English: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
Masaai: Nena duoo enkewan natayiolo nanu; ekayieu nanu naas isupati kake maaing'uaa ai kata entorroni.

English: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
Masaai: o shekeli iip imiet o sinantei oojuno, te risioroto e ntemata e wueji sinyati, o eilata oo loirienito mboreitin imiet e mpirbil.

English: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
Masaai: Minos iyie osarge, naa tubukoki enkop anaa enkare.

English: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
Masaai: Tinimiyiolo iyie ira sidai tiatua nkituaak, Tusuja irrekiei le nena kerrai, nilo airrita ilkuoo linono, te mbata oo lng'oborri loo lchekuti.

English: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai tigila ilala lenye too nkutukie enye; Olaitariani, tadotu iltagiligil loo lkuoo loo lng'atunyo!

English: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
Masaai: Meitoki aekata ninche aanya inkiri naatii osarge arashu kulie daiki naaiturujaki. Ore lelo lekunot naa keaku ile nchoto oo ltung'ana laainei, netiu anaa olgilata tiatua olosho le Yuda, neaku sii Ekron ile nchoto oo ltung'ana laainei anaa enataasa Ilyebusi.

English: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
Masaai: amu keitisiny ororei le Enkai o enkomono.

English: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
Masaai: Ainyoo! Ai te intae etang'asua olkilikuai le Nkai anaa ai intae ake etabaikia?

English: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
Masaai: Ore oliokuni naa Absalom apa laa Maaka ng'otonye. Entito e Talmai olaiguanani le Geshur. Ore oliong'uan anaa Adonija, neji ng'otonye Hagit.

English: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
Masaai: neishori nena kilani o ina barta eitarasakini obo loo laitasheikinok lo laiguanani oata enkitoo; nchoo ninye eishopoki ilo tung'ani oshipakino olaiguanani pee eyanyit, nerikoo ninye ekedito embarta te nkoitoi sapuk e ina ang, eitayiolo aibalunye te dukuya ninye nchere, neijia eikoni ilo tung'ani oshipakinoolaiguanani pee eyanyit.”

English: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
Masaai: Eyau ninye ninche pooki to ltarge, neyietu ninche pooki to rreshet neiturrur ninche to rreshet lenye sapuk; netum taa atishipayu neitokoos.

English: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Daudi aishooi ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani, nemayian ninye iltung'ana te nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani,

English: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka Ahas ilkiliku Tiglat-pilesa olaiguanani le Asiria, ejo, “Ara nanu osinka lino, nara olayioni lino. Wou tokorduaki nanu too nkaik o laiguanani le Siria o too nkaik o laiguanani le Israel, amu aatarasakitia ninche.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Mikimbung, amu eton eitu ailep alo enetii Papa, kake shomo enetii lalashera laainei tiaaki ninche, ‘Kailep alo enetii Papa lai laa Papa linyi, enetii Enkai ai naa Enkai inyi.’ ”

English: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
Masaai: Netejo apa Isaya, “Nchoo ninche eya emukate oo lng'abolo neelie ninche ilo tudutai pee etum ninye aishiu.”

English: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
Masaai: Ore enotote ilkipaareta te nebo neikilikuan Yesu aajoki, “Olaitoriani, ei te na rishata irrinyoki Siraeli enkitoria?”

English: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
Masaai: Kake inyo ntasho too nkejek inono; amu kaatayie enkolat pee aaipang'aka, aategelua iyie taasisho ninchakenoki nena baa nitoduaa o nena naaitoki aitaliorie te iyie.

English: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
Masaai: nadol teine isiaaitin pooki e Nkai, inchere meyiolou oltung'ani ina siaai naasi tiabori enkolong. O tenaa keturu oleng oltung'ani aekenya eing'oru, metum hoo ninye pito; hoo nenya kutuk oltung'ani ng'en ajo eyiolo. Metum hoo ninye pito.

English: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninye emanyisho enye te Shilo, ilo ng'obor apa otii ninye ti atua iltung'ana,

English: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
Masaai: Neitasheyieki Yesu te dukuya olbalusui neikilikuan olbalusui ninye ajoki, “Aa ira iyie olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie ojo.”

English: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
Masaai: Ore ilarewak linono loo melin nikintupukutuo iyie aapik inaaiposha naado. Ore olkutati lo loosaen nikitoosho amut te mpolos oo naaiposha.

English: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
Masaai: Aishoo intae enkitanyaanyukoto, paa ore ena naitaasa intae, nintaasasa sii intae,

English: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.
Masaai: Nening Eliab, ilo alashe lenye botor, eirorie iltung'ana; neyupuyup engoro e Eliab te nkaraki Daudi, nejo ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee itadouo ene? Naa kaing'ae itung'ueikia nekua kuti kerra naatii ong'ota? Ayiolo nanu enkitokoos ino, o entorroni o ltau lino; amu iewuo adou aing'or olarrabal.”

English: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
Masaai: kinchooki iyie eng'eno nagut o eyiolounoto. Kaaisho sii karsisisho, o masaa, o enkanyit, neitu ae kata etum obo le lelo aiguanak apa ootii dukuya iyie, nemeeta te siadi iyie olotum mbaa naatiu anaa kuna.”

English: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
Masaai: Kake karanyaki nanu emagilanisho ino karany nanu abuaku isinkolioitin le nyorrata ino tadekenya. Amu itaa iyie osempewuet te nanu, itaa esarunoto ai te nkolong o sina lai.

English: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
Masaai: Ejo ninche keyiolo Enkai, kake neany ninye too nkiasin enye; ilainyialak ninche, oogolong'u lemeeta tipat ti ae siaai sidai hoo nabo.

English: If one be found slain in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, and it be not known who hath slain him:
Masaai: “Tenelo netumi teina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi metaa eninyi, oltung'ani otaraki metua, eirrag tiong'ata, nemeyioloi aajo kaing'ae natara ninye,

English: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino ninche ine, nepuonu enkaji e ilo barnoti le Lawi te nkang e Mika, neikilikuan ninye ilomon lenyena.

English: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
Masaai: Kake eirriwaka oltung'ani le Nkai olkilikuai olaiguanani loo Siraeli ejo, “Toduaa ake migiroo ene wueji, amu etadoitie iltung'ana le Siria aapuo ine.”

English: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, atoning'o nanu mbaa inono, ore esiaai ino, iyie Olaitoriani kaure nanu. Ore te mpolos oo larin intang'ejuko iyie ninye ore te mpolos oo larin nchoo metayiolouni; ore te ngoro, tadamu olng'ur.

English: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Atoduaa Shetani esulunye anaa enkiwuang'ata eing'uaa shumata.

English: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
Masaai: Neing'ua Solomon nena masaa pooki eitu etemi aaineneng enkaraki naa eikumok apa oleng. Ore enkiroishi o suyai neitu apa eyiolouni.

English: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
Masaai: Neitang'or ilapolosak kituaak ninye too mbaa kumok.

English: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
Masaai: Ore pooki siaai nataasa ninye te nkisiayiare e nkaji e Nkai, o te risioroto e nkitanapata eing'orua Enkai enye, neas ninye ina to ltau lenye pooki. Nebul ninye.

English: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
Masaai: naa ninye eing'orua endamunoto ai aigil neton ake eitu atum. Oltung'ani obo anoto tiatua enkalifu kake eitu atum enkitok te pooki.

English: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
Masaai: neitoki Solomon ashetu nena anas apa naaishoo Huram ninye, nepik iltung'ana loo Siraeli ine.

English: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Metii Lo Kitok.” Nejoki Yesu, “Maaiguanare sii nanu. Shomo, ore ebaiki taata mintoki aas ing'ok.”

English: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD'S controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
Masaai: Entoning intae lo doinyo, enchankar o Laitoriani, o ntae ilkitamanyunot oo bikoo te nkop; amu eeta Olaitoriani enchankar o ltung'ana lenyena, naa kelo ninye aitang'or Israel.

English: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Aeneas, kinchiunye Yesu; inyo ntobira erruat ino.” Neinyototo nabo kata.

English: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man's hand.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Eitu iyie iinyal iyiook arashu ainosie osina, arashu aisimaa ae toki te nkaina o ltung'ani.”

English: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki ewueji naji Emborbor, neshe ninye te ine, o lelo maisero, atii obo te tatene netii olikae te kedianye.

English: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
Masaai: (Amu ore Lfarisayo, naa neijia etiu Ilyahudi pooki, menya endaa eitu eisuj inkaik enye, pee eitabaya nkoon oo lpayiani.

English: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
Masaai: Kake eitasheyie Petero ninye, nejoki, “Inyo ntasho. Kara sii nanu makewan oltung'ani ake.”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

Masaai: Eroroki Priska o Akuila, aisiaayiak te nebo nanu ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee kinturrayie nanu, kainyoo iyie pee kisudorie nanu enkomom ino?

English: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
Masaai: Neanyisho ninche o metaba anaa nepalari; kake ore ake eton eitu ebol ninye nkutukie e lelo gilat le shumata, neitayu ninche olbolet nebol; neirragita te ine olkitok lenye to ltiren etua.

English: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak lenyena naishopoki enjeunoto, ore isinyat lenyena naisho mbuakunot e ng'ida.

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
Masaai: ore hoo nemeyieu ninye nepal, nemuk ninye te nkutuk enye,

English: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
Masaai: Naa tenetii olmare obo te nkop lemelo Yerusalem aserem Olaiguanani, Olaitoriani loo lororani, nemetum ninche enchan.

English: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
Masaai: Neitayu Daudi enkopiyia e nkitoo te ndukuya o laiguanani lenye; nedol ajo entalanta e sahabu enkiroishi enye; naa osoit ogol enkinyiang'a, nepiki endukuya e Daudi. Neitoki ninye aya nena yarunot eina anasa ntokitin kumok.

English: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaaitaa nanu iyie te kulo tung'ana esuntai nasheta osuyai; nikiarare ninche iyie, kake mikimir ninche iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
Masaai: eiteru te nkibatisare e Yohana, o metabaiki ina olong nailepieki Yesu aaya keper, aaitung'uaa iyiook, meeta kata nemeaku obo le lelo shakenini le mpiunoto te nebo iyiook.”

English: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana loo Siraeli nejokino maate, “Kainyoo ena?” Amu meyiolo apa ninche aajo kainyoo ina. Nejoki Musa ninche, “Emukate naa ninye eishoo Olaitoriani intae enosa.

English: Neither shalt thou steal.
Masaai: “ ‘Nimipurrisho.

English: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
Masaai: Neishoru Olaitoriani Enkai ang ninye, nikimir iyiook ninye, o layiok lenyena, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
Masaai: Nchoo emisimisu enkoitoi enye neideketu, esujita olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninche!

English: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Neton ake intae mining'ung'u?”

English: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
Masaai: Kake ore taata kaputu nanu ninche teine wueji nitimiraka ninche, naitalaku nanu enkias ino te ndukuya ino makewan.

English: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
Masaai: Aime ninche doi ooiyietaki entai inkajijik e nkiguana? Aime ninche doi oomor ina arna sidai nayanyiti?

English: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
Masaai: Nedumunye olpolosie te ine aim enkalo e kopikop aipir Lusi, o metabaiki enkilepakinoto e Lusi (aa ninye Betel), neitoki ilo polosie adoyio alo Atarot-adar, te nchumata e ilo doinyo otii enkalo e kopikop tiabori Bet-horon.

English: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
Masaai: Kake einyieito kulikae te ncholiek oo Lfarisayo ooiruko, nejo, “Meeta nchere pee memurati ninche, neitanapi meibung'a nkitanapat e Musa.”

English: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo nena olong'i pokira are neing'uaa ine alo Galilaya.

English: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Metaa ore peyie eibulu olameyu ina kop pooki, nebol Yosef inkajijik naashumishoreki, nemiraki ninye Ilmisiri, amu etaa torrono olameyu oleng te nkop e Misiri.

English: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
Masaai: Kake teneitukui ninye te rukoto enye, neikenaki ninye kewan enye nkolong'i naapishana, ore tesiadi ina neaku ninye meiduruk.

English: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
Masaai: aaitarasaki ninche metanapa enkitarruoroto o enkitadiata, te nkinosata e nena tokitin enye sinyat, amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.”

English: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
Masaai: Neipang'u ti ong'ata Yohana Olaibatisani, nelimu enkibatisa naitoduaaya enkirridunoto nayau empalakinoto oo ng'ok.

English: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
Masaai: Neitoki Abram aidur teine neito alo enkalo e Negeb.

English: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
Masaai: ‘Eng'ura intae, ilasurdaanyak, ning'asiasia nindaayaya; amu keeta enaas too nkolong'i inyi, o enkiaas nemeeta nchere iruko, te neliki intae likae.’ ”

English: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
Masaai: Enkirukoto kipuoyie, neme enduaata.

English: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
Masaai: Kake ore taata, ewuang'ie nena pooki: aa ewuapa, engoro, enkiba, esukeny, o lderrat torrok ooing'uaa inkutukie inyi.

English: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
Masaai: Amu ore kuldo ooirura naa kewarie eirura ore kuldo oomera naa kewarie emera.

English: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ole Kaisari.” Nejoki ina kata, “Enchoo Kaisari ine Kaisari, ninchosho Enkai ine Nkai.”

English: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, ‘Esipa ajoki, intae, mayiolo intae.’

English: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
Masaai: o metabaiki kishomi e Efraim, o embata e kishomi musana, o embata e kishomi o sinkirri o ltalet le Hananel, o ltalet le iip o metabaiki kishomi oo nkerra. Nepuonu ninche aaitashe te kishomi oo larripok.

English: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
Masaai: Amu eikira sii apa iyiook ilmoda, nikigolong'u, neitapong'oyioki iyiook, nikiaaku rrindiki loo ng'uarrat o sikarri oo mpukunot pooki, nikinturraa nkolong'i ang te ntorroni o lom, neibayuni iyiook iltung'ana nikimbayuno iyiook maate;

English: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
Masaai: Ore taa pee ening olkitok loo sikarini le nkaji e Nkai o Lapolosak kulo rorei, nemilo oleng etalaita enapukoki ina.

English: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
Masaai: Kake tenikirrinyokinono intae nanu nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei, niasiaasa ninche, ore hoo neba enkidapashari inyi anaa nkatampo te lakuani, kaiturur nanu ninche tene, nayau ninche ine wueji nategelua, pee aisho enkarna ai metobiko teine.’

English: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Elisfas naa Teman, o Omar, o Sefo, o Gatam o Kenas

English: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
Masaai: ore ilkilani linono neitorropili te nkorropil o too sonkoyoni, o erropili o sinantei ore ti atua nena ajijik e nkitoo oo lala loo lkanchaoni, netii nkinantani oo usin nikintishipieki iyie;

English: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Near ilng'oborri le lelo apa oata nchoo, neya nkerrai te nkumoi, o ntemesin. Neitoki taa aarrinyo aapuo Yerusalem.

English: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,
Masaai: ore ake pee edol Simiri nchere eibung'aki enkanasa, nelo ninye olgilata liatua le nkaji o laiguanani, nepejoo inaa aji o laiguanani etii atua, neye ninye.

English: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
Masaai: ore olayioni le Etan naa Asaria.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Isaakar naa Paltiel olayioni le Asaan.

English: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia maya nanu enkitoo pooki aitung'uaa enkaina enye; kake kaitaa nanu ninye olarikoni too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye tenkaraki Daudi osinka lai, laa ninye ategelua, neibung'a ninye nkitanapat aainei o nkiguanat aainei;

English: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
Masaai: Imukateni neitu eisuijieki einosi too nkolong'i naapishana; medoli emukate naisuijieki te ntae, nemedoli emukate naisuijieki te nkop inyi.

English: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
Masaai: Nepuku iltung'ana aapuo aadol enatotiwuo; nepuonu enetii Yesu, neinepu ilo tung'ani otooruoki loiriruani aaraa, eton, neishopo, nenyakua oltau lenye biyoto, etonita too nkejek e Yesu; neureishoyu ninche.

English: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
Masaai: nesuj ninye isiamon kumok; neishiunye ninche te ine.

English: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
Masaai: Kake eetae apa oltung'ani obo te ine oji Simon oosh enkidong te ina anasa, neing'asiayie ilo orere le Samaria, eitaa kewan likae taani kitok,

English: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
Masaai: Eimulumul ninye inkaik enyena te nkiwang'ata, neitanap ninye metoosho ine neyieu.

English: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
Masaai: Metaa inyaanyukie apa iyie kulie kituaak te siaai ino enkiborra oo nkonyek, meeta olikitaaraka iyie taa enaibor onyek; nincho olekoisiaayio, eitu kinchori iyie olekoisiaayio; metaa ira iyie enapaashaa.

English: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
Masaai: aasai nanu iyie te nkaraki enkerai ai Onesimas, lataa nanu menye ti atua eenata ai.

English: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip olosho pooki atalang'a olkeju le Yordan, nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua,

English: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
Masaai: kake enkaraki sii ninche iyiook ilooiruk ilo oitopiwuo Yesu Kristo Olaitoriani lang too lootuata,

English: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
Masaai: Neitoki airriwaa enturkulu meing'urai tenaa keishunye inkariak ti oriong enkop.

English: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
Masaai: Kake etobiko ninche Paulo o Barnaba te Antiokia eiteng'enisho nelikioo ororei lo Laitoriani, te nebo sii kulikae kumok.

English: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
Masaai: Amaa ina nemeeta entoki naishamu, keinosayu metii emunyan.

English: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
Masaai: Ore iloik laainei netaremo olchoni lai o sesen lai, naa te mpesho nanu ailanya keeya aimisho.

English: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong' e naapishana, etishipe oltau lo laiguanani te nkaraki enaisho oo sabibu, neitanap ninye Mehuman, o Bista, o Harbona, o Bigta, o Abaguta o Setar o Karkas, lelo sunaishi oogelema oopishana ooisiaisho te dukuya olaiguanani Serser,

English: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eiwuang'ieki enkarna e papa lang to lmarei lenye, enkaraki nemeeta olayioni? Nchoo iyiook erubata ti atua ilalashera le papa.”

English: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Kake eitu eishoori te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani ntokitin naaitobirieki, ngirran e nkosholai, o ntokitin naarieki enkima, o lbakulini, o ntarumpetani, anaa kulie masaa e sahabu, arashu ine nkosholai, te nena pisai apa naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
Masaai: Ore ake sii apa kulie katitin etotona enkatampoi ebaiki teipa o mekenyu; naa ore ake pee edumuni aailepie enkatampoi tadekenya, nedumunye ninche aaidur aashu te netobiko enkolong nabo o enkewarie, ore ake pee eiwuang'ieki ina atampoi nedumunye ninche aaidur.

English: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
Masaai: Ore nena kikoot o nkiguenat, oina kitanapata apa naigeroki intae, entaas entobiraki. Miureyuyu intae kulie aitin.

English: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
Masaai: Te nedamu oltung'ani ajo olaseremani le Enkai, nemeitore olng'ejep lenye, kewan elej ore eseremare enye naa pesho.

English: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
Masaai: Amu kitok enkishui alang endaa, naa kitok osesen alang inkilani.

English: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
Masaai: Neisho enaisho natipikaki entoki naji manemane, kake etanya ninye eok.

English: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
Masaai: Ore taata Papa, intaaki iyie nanu kitok, te nebo iyie te nkitoo naata apa te nebo iyie eton eitaae enkop.

English: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
Masaai: Irrugu enkiok ino, iyie Olaitoriani, nikiwaliki nanu, amu kara nanu aisinani namena.

English: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: Nejo, “Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ishore, toning'o.”

English: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, eitu epashipashu oltau lai, neitu eshumunye nkonyek aainei aaing'or shumata; maitanyamal nanu kewan too mbaa kituaak o too mbaa e nking'asia te nanu.

English: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entobira nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, nining'ining'i oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, naa keirridu Olaitoriani te ina torrono natudung'ie enkiguana tialo intae.

English: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ng'ae odek menye aashu ng'otonye neari metua; etedia ninye menye aashu ng'otonye, neaku ore osarge lenye shumata ninye etii.

English: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
Masaai: Neiput enkop enye ntuaan e nkare, o metijing'a nkajijik oo laiguanak lenye.

English: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
Masaai: Ore kenya te netoyu lelo ng'osil lenyena, negili; nepuonu nkituaak aaitayunye enkima. Amu olorere ele lememuso; ore enkaraki ina, ore ilo oitobira ninche meduaaki ninche olng'ur, ore ilo oitobirua ninche meisho ninche omom.

English: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
Masaai: “Enteng'ena ate te nkitanyaanyukoto o lng'aboli; laa ore ake pee enanau ilng'osil neiturumisho mbenek, niyiolouu aajo etinyikua olari.

English: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejing atua olgilata liatua netem ing'apeta e kutuk aji, intemat are; o endapasho eina kutuk aji, intemat ile; o suntai natii embata e kutuk aji intemat naapishana.

English: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
Masaai: Esujaa ilkumok osesen lenye epuoi aanukaa, ore enterit e nkop neirrag aitirring'a aitemoo osesen lenye.

English: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Naa kepuonu ltung'ana ooing'uaa enkilepunoto o endoyioroto, o looing'uaa kopikop o moikuape aatoni te mesa ti atua enkitoria e Nkai.

English: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
Masaai: o te nkaraki o lalem loo lmang'ati. Kepuonu Ilkaldayo aagilunore intae neiput ninche mpopoki oo ltung'ana laar nanu te ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi, amu aisudoyie nanu enkomom ai pee maing'or ena anasa tenkaraki entorroni enye pooki.

English: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nchoo Moab eyietu aishir, nchoo pooki ng'ae eyietu aishiraki Moab. Enchira to sina kitok te nkaraki nena mukateni oo sabibu e Kir-Hareseti.

English: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Anaa enitejo! Maigil adol enkomom ino.”

English: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni, o eng'irra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;

English: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
Masaai: o enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, o mukateni e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, o mukateni naapejo naaelieki eilata, o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.

English: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
Masaai: Ore iyiook, Enkiyang'et naidimie iyiook maape dukuya te nkirukoto kiaanyu ilo siligi oikenakinye Enkai iyiook isipat.

English: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
Masaai: Ntobira iyie emisa te dukuya nanu, teine netii ilmang'ati laainei; nibukoki endukuya ai eilata, nipik enkikompe ai metaa kedooyo.

English: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD'S.
Masaai: Nepejoo olapolosani ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar anaa endaa naishoori te nkima metaa esong'ouna narropil. Ore enkurriny pooki naa eno Laitoriani.

English: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

English: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

English: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
Masaai: Amaa, Keikurrukur olng'atuny te ntim eitu ninye eibung toki, Keikurrukur olkuoo lo lng'atuny te nkapune enye meeta ninye toki?

English: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
Masaai: Ore lelo oora ile Kristo Yesu neidipa ninche aatasho enkewan o sesen o nena yieunot enyena.

English: And when they arose early on the morrow morning, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the LORD; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold; only the stump of Dagon was left to him.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee einyototo aayooki ti ae olong, ng'ura, etusulari Dagon te nkomom aosh enkop te dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani; ore endukuya e Dagon o nkaik enyena pokira are neirragita maate te mbata e kutukaji; osesen ake le Dagon etung'uayioki.

English: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
Masaai: Amu ilo Kuoo le Ker otii empolos o lorika le nkitoo oaku olchekut lenye, anaa kerikoo ninche too nchorroi oo nkariak naaishu. Naa kejut Enkai pooki kiyioi too nkonyek enye.

English: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
Masaai: ina Ai naitalaku elap nepik iloreren abori nanu;

English: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
Masaai: “Imbonisho naa, enkerai e tung'ani, toosho inkaik inono nincho olalem meeu adou katitin are, ee kat uni, ilo alem le lelo ooari metuata; olalem leyieng'are kitok, laa ninye oman ninche,

English: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.
Masaai: “Enchom enkilikuanishore Olaitoriani tenkaraki nanu, o tenkaraki lelo ootelekutua te Israel, o te Yuda, tialo kulo rorei lena buku nanotoki. Amu eikitok engoro napi o Laitoriani natubukokoki shumata iyiook, enkaraki apa neitu eibung loo papa irorei lo Laitoriani, neas te risioroto e kuna pooki naaigeroki tena buku.”

English: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
Masaai: ore ntoyie oo laiguanak netii te nebo nena kituaak inono naayanyiti; ore te nkaina ino e tatene neitashe enkaiguanani eishopito sahabu naing'uaa Ofir.

English: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
Masaai: Nejo Absalom, “Ti nimilo, aatoomono nchoo olalashe lai Amnon elo te nebo iyiook.” Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo pee elo ninye te nebo intae?”

English: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
Masaai: keidak iltung'ana supati nemeetae oltung'ani oshilaa; eiwuang'ieki lelo tung'ana le Nkai aaya, nemetii oltung'ani oyiolo, amu ewaki ilo tung'ani supat aaitung'uaa entorroni,

English: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
Masaai: Nejo Ilfilisti, “Kang'ae otaasa ena?” Nejo ninche, “Samson, ilo aputani lo Ltimini, enkaraki nawa ninye enkitok enye neisho ilo apa oboitare ninye.” Neilepu Ilfilisti aaponu nepejoo ninye o papaai lenye te nkima.

English: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Masaai: Ore apa Asahel olalashe le Yoab naa obo le lelo tomoni uni; Elhanan olayioni le Dodo le Betlehem,

English: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
Masaai: Neaku keing'oru ninye Lyahudi te ine to sirua, nejo, “Koree ninye?”

English: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
Masaai: Eimayiolo doi iasat aainei makewan, amu maas enayieu naas, kake ina naiba ninye aas.

English: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani le nkop oo ndoinyo e Efraim oji enkarna enye Mika.

English: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
Masaai: Ina oitoi oo nkiguanat inono, kiaanyunyie iyiook, iyie Olaitoriani; ina arna nikidamunye iyie, ninye eyieunoto oo ltauja lang.

English: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
Masaai: nelotu enetii ninye enkitok naata oltulet lo soit oji alabasta le ilata narropil nagol enkinyang'a nebukoki elukunya enye te ine einosita endaa.

English: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
Masaai: Kelotu ilo aiguanani le moikuape ayau eng'adunoto, neya ina ang nasheta isunta. Ore nena jorin e kopikop nemeitashe, aashu ilo orora lenye ogeluno, amu metumi engolon naitasheyie.

English: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.
Masaai: Eisiliga apa ninye Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli; neaku meetae oltung'ani oikununo anaa ninye too laiguanak pooki le Yuda te siadi ninye, anaa te lelo apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

English: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Neaku ore naa te ina kata inkera aainei, entoning'oki nanu nimipuopuo aaing'uaa irorei le nkutuk ai.

English: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
Masaai: Kake etii kulikae ootaa le nkalo enye neiruk: ilootii Dionisio, obo le lelo le Areopago, o enkitok naji Damaris, o kulikae ake.

English: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
Masaai: Iyie oloata nkonyek sidain nemeidim aaing'ura entorroni nemeidim aaing'ura enkarruoisho, kainyoo iyie pee ing'or iltung'ana lemeisiligayu, nintirring'a iyie eijoo ilarruok, lelo supati aalang ninche.

English: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Intajeuo enkishui ang; inchoo eitiship ena olkitok lang', aikiaaku iyiook irrindiki le Farao.”

English: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
Masaai: Nenyikaki neiseyie osanduku neitashe lewa oonapita. Nejoki Yesu, “Lo barnoti! Inyo!”

English: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
Masaai: neikirikira enkop, neshau shumata enkare, te ine netii Enkai; eikirikire oldoinyo le Sinai te dukuya Enkai, ina Ai e Israel.

English: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
Masaai: enyaaka naa apik ae olong, “Taata” ena olong etejo te Daudi etulusoyie enkata naado, te lelo rorei ooidipaki aairoro, “Ore taata ena olong ti nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye, emintagol iltauja linyi.”

English: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Aron enetii Farao neas anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; nenang'aki Aron ina ng'udi enye enkop te dukuya Farao o sinkan lenyena, neaku ina ng'udi olasurai.

English: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore ilturrurri loo lapolosak, o loo Lawi, teina kisiaayiare pooki enkaji e Nkai netii tenebo iyie, neeta ake pooki tung'ani eyieunoto, neeta pooki ng'ae enkarriyiano te pooki kisiaayiare; ore sii ilkituaak o ltung'ana pooki naa kening aakurraki tenintanap ninche.”

English: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kitujurro iyie nanu nikitayiolo nanu!

English: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
Masaai: Oo naa duoo tung'ani, laa oloti kurto, o enkerai e tung'ani laa enkurto!”

English: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oipirta Edom. Etii obo oipotisho te Seir, nejo, “Lo arriponi, kejaa enkewarie? Lo arriponi, kejaa enkewarie?”

English: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
Masaai: Ore naa te nkaraki iyie kepuoi aatur Sion anaa enkurma; keaku Yerusalem osototi le nkidaata; neaku ilo doinyo le nkaji entim.

English: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
Masaai: Taarai intung'uai kewan intorrok pooki nena nitaasa kigilunore nanu, nitumokiki ate oltau ng'ejuk o enkiyang'et ng'ejuk! Ainyoo peyie iye naaji e Israel?

English: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Aron aaiturrur te nebo ilpayiani loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
Masaai: Nejokino ninche maate, “Wootu emaitayu Ilmatofali le sarng'ab nikipej te nkima oleng.” Neshetishore ilmatofali te rishata oo soito o lami te rishata osinyai oshula o enturoto.

English: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
Masaai: Ore te nkata nalotu te nikinkilikuan olayioni lino, ajoki, ‘Kainyoo doi eutu ena?’ nijoki iyie ninye, ‘Te ngolon e nkaina eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri, aitung'uaa enkaji e sinkaisho.

English: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
Masaai: ore iltung'ana le nkop e Turo neyau nkishorot, lelo karsisi aalang iltung'ana pooki,

English: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, mikisikong nanu te ngoro ino, nimikintame nanu te ngoro ino napi.

English: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
Masaai: Toduaa kewan, pee mijo ake to ltau lino, ‘Engolon ai o enkidimata e nkaina ai anotie nanu kuna masaa!

English: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee indipidipi aatalang olkeju le Yordan, nintasheyieyie kulo soito laa ninche nanu aitanapa intae ena olong te nchumata oldoinyo le Ebal, nimurumuru ninche te nturoto.

English: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
Masaai: laa atua eidikidikokini enchetata pooki te nebo, nebulu enkaji nasinya ti atua Olaitoriani,

English: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
Masaai: Neipotu ninye nejoki, ‘Kaa bae ena natoning'o nikimpirta iyie? Inkenakaki intokitin pooki aainei ning'orita.’

English: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
Masaai: Irriwakita Yohana olkilikuai, neishakenoki esipata.

English: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
Masaai: “Ninchosho pooki tung'ani oata enkidimata ti atua intae meetu aitobir nena pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani: olng'obor le Nkai,

English: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
Masaai: Aatiaka ninye nanu, ‘Solomon olayioni lino olo ashet enkaji ai o lgorieti laainei, amu ategelua nanu ninye metaa enkerai ai, naa kaaku nanu menye lenye.

English: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
Masaai: Iyiook ooiteru aapuonu enitii kiyaki intae lelo Omon Supati le Kristo eton eitu hoo ebau likae, metaa ti nikiwuasare intae neitu taata kintogiroo nkiririkinot ang.

English: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
Masaai: Ore lelo muma laainei te iyie naa kaitabaya, kaishoru nanu olasar le nashe te iyie.

English: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
Masaai: Neiteru enkare te nkop ang'oroo. Ore te nkiting'oto enkolong, e iip o onom, etong'oroyie enkare aaku kiti,

English: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Asmafet naa artam oare.

English: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
Masaai: Eikiosh iyie Olaitoriani too ltuduta le Misiri oo too mpaldakani o too lpepedo o te ng'ion nemeishiunoyu.

English: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, eming'asia intae too ntemat naata emion e nkima naapuonu shumata intae, aatem intae anaa duoo kentoki omoni naipang'aka intae.

English: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Kaja mukateni niaatata?” Nejoki, “Naapishana o lkuti sinkir kutiti.”

English: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
Masaai: Kake tapaasha nchankarri, iishoritin oo lmakui, impaashat o enchankar oo mbaa oo nkitanapat, amu meeta eretoto naa pesho.

English: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
Masaai: Ninye eitaikitia iloibonok le Enkai pooki shakenisho, nchere ore pooki oiruk enkarna enye netum empalakinoto oo ng'ok.”

English: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
Masaai: Nejoki Gideon ninye, “Aatoomono, olkitok, amaa tenaa ketii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook, kainyoo naa pee etadoikitio kuna iyiook pooki? Naa koree nkiasin enyena pooki e nking'asia apa naainosakitia iyiook iloo papa, ejo, ‘Keitu ninye eilepunye iyiook Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri?’ Kake ore taata eiturrayie iyiook Olaitoriani neishooyie iyiook apik atua nkaik oo Lmidian.”

English: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
Masaai: pee etum aatijing ilbaat loo ndapidapo o nkapuniaa oo soito sapuki aailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani o ina kitoo e nkisisa enye, te nedumunye ninye aiture enkop.

English: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
Masaai: Kake eirriang'a ninche, neureishoyu, ejo koloip etoduaa.

English: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
Masaai: Naajoki ilo malaika, “Ingero, ena; emayiana lelo ooitoomonoki to sirua le nkiyama o Lkuoo le Ker.” Naajoki ninye nanu, “Irorei oosipa le Enkai kulo.”

English: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
Masaai: Nemeleku ninche toki o mekenyu, nemegil oloito lenye; te risioroto oo nkikoot pooki e pasaka eibung ninche.

English: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
Masaai: Neibelekenya iltung'ana te ine, nepuo aaitoriokino enkalo e Sodom. Kake eitirring'e Abraham aitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
Masaai: nitumutumu engolon niyiolounyenye te nebo isinyat pooki eneba elalai o enkadori o elakuani e shumata o enguton,

English: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
Masaai: tokorduaki too ltung'ana te nkaina ino, iyie Olaitoriani, tialo lelo tung'ana laa ore erubata enye te nkishui naa ena kop. Ntamio ninche teilo sina litushumaka ninche, menoto nkera enye osina olang ilo, metelekakini ilo sina nkera oo nkera enye.

English: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Irorei kulo lo laikooni, olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani te Yerusalem.

English: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ancles.
Masaai: Ore eloito enkalo o loo saen eeta enkopito te nkaina enye, netem ilo tung'ani intemat enkaina enkalifu nabo, naarik nanu aimie atua ina are; naa oloure kokoyo ebaiki eng'uton enye.

English: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki inkituaak Naomi, “Meisisi Olaitoriani, laa ninye leitu kipalaa iyie ena olong miata oltung'ani lo lgilata, naa metoning'oyu enkarna enye te Israel!

English: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etii enkitoo e Nkai e Israel ine anaa apa enduaata natoduaa te nkisiajata.

English: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: neibelekenyate aapaashaa aasioki aaing'uaa enkoitoi apa naa ninye aitanapa ninche; eitaikitia ate olashe oitobiruaki te sahabu nashola, neteserema ninche ninye neitaiki ninye olasar, nejo, ‘Kuna ninche nkaitin inyi intae Isiraeli, naa ninche naayautua intae aailepunye aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’ ”

English: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani oituku ninye nepik ilo tung'ani oitukui o kuna tokitin dukuya Olaitoriani, te kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
Masaai: ntalantani nkalifuni uni e sahabu, ina sahabu e Ofir, o ntalantani nkalifuni naapishana e nkosholai nasila, pee emurieki isunta eina aji,

English: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
Masaai: Neitoki Yonatan ajoki Daudi, “Shomo te seriani, amu ore anaa enikinosa olmumai iyiook pokira te nkarna o Laitoriani, kijo, Olaitoriani otii erishata nanu o iyie, o erishata e ishoi ai o eshoi ino, intarasi.” Nedumunye ninye nelo; nelo Yonatan ajing enkanasa.

English: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
Masaai: Naa kaanang'ie iyie enkop, ore te nkong'ata naisiaja naayieng iyie naisho ilmotonyi pooki lo loing'ang'e mikitadoiki iyie, naitaraposh ng'uesi enkop te iyie.

English: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
Masaai: Ore ologolie enkishui enye neiminie, ore oloiminie enkishui enye enkaraki nanu negolie.

English: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
Masaai: o Betpeor o ljurumi le Pisga, o Betjeshimot,

English: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai apa ootii Yeriko ninye, nejo ninche, “Etii Enkiyang'et e Eliya Shumata Elisha.” Nepuonu ninche aanang'are ninye, neirrugo aaitabaiki nkomomi enkop te dukuya ninye.

English: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
Masaai: Te nkaraki kewan ai, te nkaraki kewan ai ake, ataasa nanu ina, amu kaji eiko pee eisarkionieki enkarna ai? Ore enkitoo ai maisho nanu likae.

English: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
Masaai: Etigila Israel pooki enkitanapata ino neibelekenye, neany ening oltoilo lino. Ore ilo deket o lmumai naaigeroki ti atua nkitanapat e Musa ilo sinka le Nkai netubukokoki iyiook, enkaraki nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki ti alo ninye.

English: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enkewarie e tomon oong'uan, Kipuoito ake te naiposha e Adria, o metaa keitorito enkewarie, nemusu lelo tung'ana arewak le meli aajo kitinyikakita ae kop.

English: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
Masaai: Aagiligil nanu too nkaloli pooki, netaa aisha, neitayio ninye osiligi lenye anaa olchani.
