Masaai: Ore enkutuk e ilo supat neiro ine ng'eno, neiro olng'ejep lenye isipat.

English: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
Masaai: Newaliki Yohana ajoki ninche, “Te nkare aibatisisho nanu. Eitashe ti atua intae Obo limiyiololo,

English: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
Masaai: Meetae olaaoru enkishui ai, kake kaitayu openy te yieunoto ai. Aata enkidimata pee aitayu, naata enkidimata naitoki ang'amunye. Papa atangamayie ena kitanapata.”

English: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,
Masaai: neyau ndapashi, o ngirran, o motioo oo nkulukuok, o enkano, o shairi, o enkurma, naidong'o, o mpoosho, o ndaiki oo mpukunot pooki,

English: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
Masaai: laa ore too nkonyek enyena nemenaa looiba Enkai, neyanyit lelo ooure Enkai, ilo oinos olmumai nemeibelekenya;

English: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
Masaai: Eitobira Olaitoriani enkop te ng'eno nagut, ore te yiolounoto eitasheyie keper o ntokitin naatii.

English: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Masaai: Entudumu lukuny inyi na shomito! nidumunyenye intae na shomito musan! pee etum Olaiguanani le nkitoo atijing'u.

English: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
Masaai: o layiok le Usa, o layiok le Pasea, o layiok le Besai,

English: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
Masaai: ing'ura aitashe nanu te mbata enchorro e nkare, inchoo entito nalotu aoku enkare naa tenajoki, “Aatoomono inchooki te moti ino; enkiti are naok.”

English: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilkituaak loo lkerenketi ootamanya Yerusalem; kake ore too nkang'itie e Yuda, etii ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye neton tiatua imasaa enyena: ile Israel, o lapolosak, o Lawi, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, o le ishoi o laisiaayiak le Solomon.

English: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
Masaai: “Tudumunye shomo Ninawi, idia anasa kitok, nimbalakinye ninye ilo kilikuai laaliki nanu iyie.”

English: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
Masaai: Enaikash tiniton te nkop olpurkel natoyio, alang tiniboitare enkitok naata enchankar o lkwenyi.

English: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
Masaai: Kening'o ae kata Kristo o Belial? Ainyoo eng'ar oloiruko o leitu eiruk?

English: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, ore ake olojoki ele doinyo, ‘Tadotunye tanang'akinoyu enaiposha’, nemeing'ash to ltau lenye, kake eiruk ina najo nchere keaku, neaku te ninye anaa enatejo.

English: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
Masaai: Keidim Enkai aishoo intae inoo nkolati inyi neitulusoo, pee itumutumu aataret esiaai pooki supat enkaraki niaatata anaake inaaidip intae te pooki toki.

English: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
Masaai: Neas lelo tung'ana le Israel entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani neisiaai inkaitin e Baal;

English: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
Masaai: neijia nkuna, tusujai ninche to lkutati lino, nturia ninche to lemua lino!

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa nejoki,

English: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
Masaai: Keeta pooki nkishorot naaishiunye olorere? Keiro pooki to lng'ejepa oopaasha? Keyiolo pooki aatawalu?

English: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
Masaai: Metaa te nebo iyiook empiris o lng'ur, o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa neing'uaa Yesu Kristo Oinoti le Papa, te sipata o te nyorrata.

English: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eiturrurro apa Daudi te Yerusalem ilkituaak pooki le Israel, ilkituaak loo loshon, o larikok le lelo turrurri apa ooisiaai olaiguanani, o larikok le njore le nkalifu, o larikok le njore le maa iip, o laitashiekinok loo masaa pooki, o nkishu o laiguanani, o layiok lenyena, tenebo o lkituaak le nkaji o laiguanani, o lelo tung'ana magil, o lelo murran pooki yiolot.

English: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
Masaai: kake nabo bae ake naata tipat, ena bae natudutayie Mariamu naisul; nemeyae aaitung'uaa ninye.”

English: Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neipang'ua apa enjore e Farao tiatua Misiri, ore ake pee ening lelo Kaldayo apa oomanita Yerusalem ilomon lenye, nepuo aaing'uaa Yerusalem.

English: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
Masaai: Ahas apa menye le Yehoada; naa Yehoada menye le Alemet, o Asmefet, o Simri. Simri apa menye le Mosa.

English: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Neaku eilepa apa Yoshua te Gilgal, ninye o ltung'ana pooki lo larrabal te nebo ninye, o ltung'ana pooki magil oodupa.

English: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
Masaai: Amu keing'uari Gasa, naa keaku Ashkelon mijooni; nearari iltung'ana le Ashdod enaipirie enkolong, nedotuni Ekron.

English: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Amaa apa pee airriwaa intae miatata mbenia oo mpesai aashu olbene aashu namuka, italaita toki?” Nejo, “Eitu.”

English: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa iteleja apa iyie kulo tung'ana o Yerusalem, ijo, ‘Ekesidanu te intae,’ aa olalem otabaikia enkishui enye katukul.”

English: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
Masaai: Intemat tomon apa enkadoro e rubata nabo naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho e rubata.

English: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
Masaai: Mme hoo nyoo te nanu paa intae likipuonunu aajur aashu aaiguanare aashu likae ake tung'ani. Eimaiguanare doi ninye kewan.

English: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
Masaai: o layiok le Baslut, o layiok le Mehida, o layiok le Harsha,

English: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.
Masaai: Ore naa taata erriwai ilkiliku entasioki entiaki Daudi, ‘Mirura taata iyie kewarie too lang'eta oo lkejek to lpurkel, kake togiroi tukul; meijori ake olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki ootii te nebo ninye.’ ”

English: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
Masaai: “Entoning ena intae iltung'ana oomoda lemedamisho, lelo oata nkonyek kake medolisho lelo oata nkiyiaa, kake mening'isho.

English: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Ilapa rorei laainei kulo latiaaka intae, eton atii te nebo intae, nchere ore mbaa pooki naatisiraki aaipirta nanu too nkitanapat e Musa o too loibonok le Nkai o to Lkerempe le Nkai, meeta nchere meitabari.”

English: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Naftali naa ilkituaak le njore enkalifu nabo ootii tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni oopishana oata ilong'oi o remeta.

English: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: “Eng'ura pee miasiaasa isupati inyi te dukuya inkonyek oo ltung'ana ijojo pee edol ninche intae; amu ti ninkoko neijia nimitumutumu shunet te Papa linyi otii keper.

English: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
Masaai: Meetae apa olaiguanani te Edom; olaiguanani oti ninye apa etegeluaki

English: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
Masaai: “Te near olkiteng oltung'ani lee arashu enkitok metua, neari ilo kiteng too soito metua; nemenyae inkiri enyena; ore olopeny ilo kiteng nelakuni.

English: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
Masaai: Amu etabaikita iyiook lelo omon supati anaa enatabaikita sii ninche; kake ore ilo kilikuai otoning'o ninche neitu eret, amu eitu einepu enkirukoto ti atua lelo ootoning'o.

English: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
Masaai: Aishoo ninche ina kitoo nikinchoo iyie nanu, pee etum aataa nabo anaa enikira iyiook nabo;

English: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
Masaai: Nepik ilo apolosani ina kitok dukuya Olaitoriani, nelak ilpapit le ndukuya enye, nepik nkaik enyena ina tapa o lasar le ndamunoto, aa ninye o lasar le ntapa lo lom. Ore te nkaina enye neibung olapolosani ina are e nduaran naa ninye nayau oldeket.

English: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki nang'a nemepising'a neiduruku.

English: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
Masaai: “ ‘Niming'uar enkitok eilo le latia ino; niming'uar enkaji eilo le latia ino, aashu enkurma enye, aashu olaisiaayiani lenye aashu enkaisiaayiani enye, aashu olkiteng lenye, aashu osikiria lenye, aashu pooki toki ake ninye eilo le latia ino.’

English: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
Masaai: Kake ore ltung'ana loo Loreren ooiruko, kirriwakita apa empalai nayakita enkiguana ang nchere pee erishie ate ntokitin naapolosakini nkitanyaanyukot neme Enkai o sarge o ntokitin naagori o eloloito.”

English: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
Masaai: Nimiyauu nkajijik inyi ina toki nara olminong, miakuku ake oldeket anaa ninye, mbai tukul nilam amu entoki nadiaa.

English: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
Masaai: Mimoku enkaji o lelatia ino, pee miyek ake, nikiyooki aibayu.

English: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Gad, te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni artam o iip imiet.

English: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa Yotam pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Yerusha entito e Sadok.

English: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
Masaai: Neaku etesheta olperere lo lasar teine neipot enkarna Olaitoriani, neun olng'obor lenye teine, Netur ilaisiaayiak le Isaak enchorro enkare teine.

English: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil,

English: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
Masaai: Eimiya iyie ina nikincho Kemosh enkai ino? Ore ina pooki natarua Olaitoriani Enkai ang te dukuya iyiook nikiya iyiook.

English: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
Masaai: o nkitasheta oo ltaai, o lelo taai lenye le sahabu nasila, pee eyupuyup te dukuya ilo gilata liatua osinya, anaa apa enatuutuaki.

English: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
Masaai: Neishopito apa Daudi olkila le kitani sidai napiyaya, naa neijia sii eikununo lelo Lawi pooki oonapita osanduku, o laranyak, o Kenania ilo arikoni lo sinkolio o laranyak; neishop Daudi enkila olgoo e Kitani.

English: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
Masaai: Te naureishoyu nanu napik osiligi lai atua iyie.

English: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
Masaai: Ore apa Hasael olaiguanani le Siria neibooko Isiraeli enkop too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoahas.

English: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
Masaai: Enkaraki naa ioshot e nkikoo pee ing'iriri. Eitaasa intae Enkai enaitaas inkera enyena anaa kaa kerai eetae nemeosh menye arere?

English: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
Masaai: “Ti nikinyal olalashe lino, shomo toliki enikinyalie aa intae ake pokira aare; naa ti nikining inoto olalashe lino.

English: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Masaai: Ng'ejuko ninche anaake tadekenya, aikitok esupatisho enye.

English: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
Masaai: Ore kulo neinosu te nyorrata eyiolo aajo aatipikaki nanu ene te nkaraki nangorito ilo rorei supat;

English: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
Masaai: Ore eipira enkolong neikoroj Eliya ninche, ejo “Entabuaku oleng amu enkai ninye, ebaiki negira adamisho oleng, aashu enyamalita, aashu eshomo nkang'itie. Aashu ebaiki neirura naa keishiaakino neinyeyieki.”

English: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
Masaai: kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Ng'ura, inutayu iyie niiu enkayioni; metaa naa miok enaisho oo sabibu aashu ae aisho napi niminya entoki nemesinya, amu keaku ina ayioni Olnasarayoi te Nkai ebaiki einoto o metabaiki keeya enye.’ ”

English: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
Masaai: “Neijia nkuna nteng'ela ile Lawi ntung'uai atua iltung'ana le Israel, neaku ile Lawi ilaainei.

English: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
Masaai: Nejoki isinkan lenyena ninye, “Ng'ura, kitoning'o iyiook nchere, ore ilaiguanak le nkaji e Israel, naa ilaiguanak oata olng'ur. Nchoo iyiook maishopo ilkuniyiani too mpolosi ang, nikipik nkeenta ilukuny ang, nikipuo enetii olaiguanani loo Siraeli; amu ebaiki nikipal iyie nchu.”

English: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
Masaai: Nemikingil ae kata iyiook aaibelekenya aaing'uaa iyie; nchoo iyiook enkishui, pee kitum aaipoto enkarna ino!

English: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa lelo ootalang'a olkeju le Yordan to lapa le dukuya, ina kata edooyo enkare aim mpoorri, neisikie lelo pooki ootii ierat, te nkalo o loo saen o to loo ntoluo.

English: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
Masaai: nincho nena pisai e lelo ootuluso esiana enye, oolootalakuaki, nincho Aron o layiok lenyena.”

English: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche lelo ooetuo ooata olkilikuai, “Entiaaki iltung'ana le Yabesh-gilead inji, ‘Ore taisere, te neirouaju enkolong, nitumutumu intae enkordunoto.’ ” Ore pee epuonu lelo lo ilkilikuai neliki iltung'ana le Yabesh, neng'idayu ninche.

English: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
Masaai: Ng'ura kelo olaiguanani aitoreisho too sipat, nepuo ilkituaak aaitoreisho too nkiguanat naasipa.

English: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
Masaai: Keidim ataa sidai alang ina kishooroto ino e nashe, kake eitu eret ilo likae.

English: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore te lelo le ishoi e Aron ilo apolosani neishori Hebron, ina anasa nasaru olotasesekuanishe, te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
Masaai: Neya Yoab embelati e moti oo nkulukuok, nelo aton to lchala loo suut aoj kewan.

English: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Efraim, too lturrurri lenye naa nkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet o iip nabo. Ninche oaku ili okuni.

English: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Asiria naa keiput enkiputukuny o lkirutoto te nening ilo toilo lo Laitoriani, ina kata eoshisho ninye te ng'udi enye.

English: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
Masaai: Kake eitu etum eneroro, nerrinyokino ninye atua e safina, amu eton etii inkariak oriong enkop pooki. Neitorioo ninye enkaina enye aibung ninye neyau ninye atua e safina ine netii;

English: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
Masaai: Ore enkaji nashet ninye netiu anaa enkaji o lkedi, anaa olng'obor oitobiru olarriponi.

English: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
Masaai: Neitoki Yakobo ajoki Laban, “Inchooki nanu enkitok ai peyie alo ayiolou ninye, amu aitabayie enkata ai.”

English: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
Masaai: Ore obo lenye maate eji laa kejo ninche oloiboni, nejo, “Lalejak oshiaake Lkrete, ilowuarak torrok, ilaikoshuaak turua!”

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Oi enchoo Olaitoriani enashe amu eisupat ninye; amu obikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
Masaai: naa aikiarari iyie aaitung'uaa iltung'ana, ore emanyisho ino naa keaku te nebo ing'uesi e ntim; naa keaku inos iyie nkujit anaa olkiteng; naa eikigiroo iyie ilarin naapishana, o metaba anaa niyiolou nchere ilo otii shumata aisul oitore enkitoo etung'ana, neisho ninye ilo oyieu.”

English: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
Masaai: o Dilean, o Mispe, o Yokteel,

English: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
Masaai: neitigir ninye olkutati, neitirring'ieki ilopir le naiposha.

English: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.
Masaai: “Terretenayu niton irretena, iyie tenebo lelo ororani pooki ooiturrurro tenebo iyie, niaku olarriponi te nkaraki ninche.

English: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
Masaai: Ainining'ishe nanu, kake eitu ninche eiro aaitorioki; meetae oltung'ani oirridu te ntorroni enye, ejo ‘Kainyoo nanu ataasa?’ Eibelekenyakino ake pooki ng'ae nkoitoi enyena, anaa embarta nakuetiki olarrabal.

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
Masaai: Neitoki ninye araposhoki, nejo, “Irorei le Balaam olayioni le Beor, irorei lo ltung'ani otaboloki enkong'u enye,

English: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ina aji, neitobir ninye ing'apeta are naa ntemat e nkaina tomon o imiet o lpisiaai enkadoro, nepik inkopiyiani ilukuny naa ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro.

English: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
Masaai: Etoduaa nkonyek inyi ina nataasa Olaitoriani te Baal-peor; amu eidaikie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi aishie tiatua intae lelo tung'ana pooki ootusujaitie ina kitanyaanyukoto e nkai e Peor.

English: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
Masaai: Keisho Olaitoriani olmeitai mikindikidikore ometaba anaa nikimut aishu teina kop niloito aya.

English: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Daudi alo atua aji, neton te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, “Kara nanu ng'ae iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kainyoo enkaji ai, eji metaa kiyaua iyie naba nji?

English: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Iruko Olaitoriani Yesu, pee ijeu iyie o enkaji ino.”

English: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Yafan naa Elisha, o Tarshish, o Kitim, o Dodaim.

English: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
Masaai: O Benania, o Bedeia, o Cheluki,

English: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
Masaai: O sii, pee eyau olkikau lenye enkop nejo, “Inchoo eserem ninye ilmalaika pooki le Enkai.”

English: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
Masaai: Ore tiabori ilo moti netii intokitin naaijo ilmong'i ooitashe emanita; naa ilkererin oare apa ninche.

English: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
Masaai: amu iyie aturia, amu ira oltung'ani ogol pukunoto; odumu ineitu irragie, nidung neme iyie otuno!’

English: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ndamunot enye nejoki, “Aainyo pee mbirribirrirri ntorrok too ltauja linyi?

English: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
Masaai: Ore te ilo lemesinya nchoo eyae embata oo nkuruon e ilo asar otapejoyioki loo ng'ok, o enkare naruko napiki empirbil;

English: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
Masaai: Ilo tung'ani laa tenening kulo rorei lele ning'o lo lmumai, nemayian kewan to ltau, ejo, ‘Kaserianu nanu hoo tenaa kalo te ngolon oltau lai.’ Ore ena naa keidim ataa keyau enkidaata e ntoki nashal o enatoyio.

English: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
Masaai: Nening Yesu nchere etaaraitie ninche ninye aaipang'ie; ore pee elo netum nejoki ninye, “Iruko iyie Enkerai e Tung'ani?”

English: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
Masaai: Neaku eing'orutua ninche esiankiki sidai te nkishiaa tiatua enkop pooki e Israel, nepuo aatum Abishag e Shunam, neyaki ninye olaiguanani.

English: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
Masaai: Netagorokine sii apa Olaitoriani Aron ometaa kejo aidaikie ninye; naomonoki sii apa ninye Aron ina kata.

English: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong naa kajur nanu Yerusalem too ltaai, naa kaitame nanu lelo tung'ana ooishiligate te okoto e naisho enye, oojo too ltauja lenye, ‘Meas Olaitoriani esidai nemeas entorrono.’

English: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
Masaai: Eitorioyie ilo le ncholuek ai enkaina enye agilunore ilchoreta lenyena, etigila ninye olning'o lenye.

English: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nintutum ilkarash imiet te nebo, o nkilani ile te nebo, ore enkila e ile nipud te shumata te mbata e njing'et o lng'obor.

English: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata nedoluni Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu te ngolon te nkatampoi o te nkisisa kitok.

English: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
Masaai: Kake teneiteng'elaki ninye Olaitoriani enkurma enye te siadi Yubilii neikenaki taa olapolosani esiana oo mpisai te risioroto oo larin oong'or ometabau olari le Yubilii, neiwuang'ieki taa erubata teina kikenata ino.

English: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
Masaai: Iyie olomanya Lebanon oton tiatua iltarakua kebaa sii iyie enkigoroto tenelotu emion shumata iyie, emion naikununo anaa ene nkitok nasaisai!”

English: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
Masaai: nimikishetu inkajijik nikimany atua. Mikiata iyiook isabibu, aashu enkurma aashu olantererai,

English: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
Masaai: te nkaraki ninye pee eitayioki ntokitin pooki, naatii shumata o naatii enkop, inaalioo o nemelioo te naa lorikan loo looitoreisho, aashu nkitoriat, aashu looishoro engolon e nkitoria, te ninye eitayioki ntokitin naa ninye eitobirakaki.

English: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Itai ilo le Giti, “Kainyoo sii pee ilo iyie te nebo iyiook? Tushukoyu shomo, pee ilo aton te nebo olaiguanani; amu ira iyie olomoni, nira sii oloisikua aing'uaa enkang ino.

English: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
Masaai: “Ore nena tokitin naaisudoro naa ino Laitoriani Enkai ang; kake ore nena naaibalunyeki naa nkunaang o noo nkera ang ntarasi, pee kitum aataas irorei pooki lena kitanapata.

English: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
Masaai: Neponari Daudi aaku kitok oleng, amu etii apa Olaitoriani loo lororani tenebo ninye.

English: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
Masaai: Neing'uaa nabo kata irresheta lenye nesuj ninye.

English: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
Masaai: (Eisikaka apa Yakobo enkop e Aram, ore teine neisiaisho Israel te nkaraki enkitok, naa ore te nkaraki enkitok neirrita nkerra.)

English: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
Masaai: ore ematua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui nintayuyu pee eaku olasar le ntapa, naipurjaki te matua e ong'uan e hini e ilata naidong'oki.

English: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
Masaai: Amaa ai nkajijik miatata nidaarere? Anaa imenimene esirit e Nkai, nintukurrurru lelo aisinak? Kajoki aa intae? Kaisis intae? Maisis intae te ina.

English: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
Masaai: Ore Shekamia olayioni le Yehiel, loo layiok le Elam, neirorie Esra: ajoki, “Kinturraitie iyiook enkirukoto te Nkai nikiyama nkituaak oo loreren oo ltung'ana lena kop, kake ore ake o taata eetae osiligi too Siraeli hoo netii ena.

English: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche meitukurruni nipik olmilo te nebo, lelo ooing'oru pee eiwuang'ie enkishui ai; nchoo ninche meibelekenyi neitadouni lelo ooing'oru pee aainyal!

English: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
Masaai: Te nanu eitoreisho ilkituaak, ore ilaitoriak neitore enkop.

English: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
Masaai: Etanya ninye olng'obor le Yosef, eitu ninye egelu olosho le Efraim;

English: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
Masaai: Too sipat amu kalo enetii Papa nimikintokiki aadol:

English: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Nirorie lelo pooki oata enkidimata, lelo laishoo eng'eno, pee eitobir ilkilani le Aron, pee eitisinyi te mpolosare ai.

English: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Edede, Lo Kitok; kake einos sii ildiein inaadoyio te mesa oo lkituaak lenye.”

English: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninye naa enjore oo ltung'ana lo sesen kake ore tialo iyiook netii Olaitoriani Enkai ang, pee eretu iyiook nearisho too larrabali lang.” Negolu iltung'ana oishua te lelo rorei le Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
Masaai: Eidipa entaboi e dukuya atulusoi, ng'ura eton eng'or intabo are naapuonu te siadi.

English: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
Masaai: Meishiaakino neimulumul olee endukuya enye, amu ninye oitodolu eneyia empukunoto o enkitoo e Nkai; kake enkitoo o lee eitodolu ninye eng'oruoi.

English: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
Masaai: Ena jeunoto apa eing'orutua, neikeni iloibonok le Nkai ooibonutuo empiris nalotu aaku eninyi.

English: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
Masaai: Keiba enkomom o Laitoriani lelo oas ntorrok, neiwuang'ie ninche meitokini aadamu te nkop.

English: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
Masaai: Nejoki Lfarisayo ninye, “Iyie oishakenoki kewan. Mesipa shakenisho ino.”

English: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
Masaai: Amu etinyikua ina olong! etinyikua ina olong o Laitoriani; keaku enkolong oo nkatampo enkata enkidaaroto too loreren.

English: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa ene Nkai ang enkitoo ntarasi, tiatua Yesu Kristo. Esai

English: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie olaiguanani Solomon olkilikuai neyauni ninye aaitung'uaa olperere lo lasar. Nelotu ninye airrugokino Solomon aisho ninye enkanyit; nejoki Solomon ninye, “Shomo enkaji ino.”

English: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.
Masaai: Mikitalaaki Olaitoriani ina apa nitaasa, nikincho Olaitoriani olerrinyore te nkiputakinoto Enkai oo Siraeli, naa abori inaipuko enyena iewuo asaru!”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa te nena kisiajat e Moab te mbata e Yordan eipirare Yeriko,

English: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
Masaai: Amu kelak apa lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aaitushur ilo sanduku o nkeek enyena.

English: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
Masaai: “Teneiu ninye olayioni laa olaikonyani, olaibukoroni lo sarge, ilo lemeas nabo e kuna siaitin,

English: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
Masaai: Kake ore inkonyek oltorrono nemeitoki aadolisho. Ore enkoitoi pooki naaisikie naa keimin te ninche, ore osiligi lenye neyang enabayie.

English: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
Masaai: Nejoki kulikae loo Lfarisayo ootii atua olorere, “Olaiteng'enani, intigira ilooiteng'eni linono.”

English: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
Masaai: Ore lelo karsisi le na kop inkoo pe mepik osiligi atua enkarsisisho enye nemebikoo, kake peyie eisilig Enkai naiputaki iyiook nena pooki pee kishipakino.

English: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
Masaai: Neitu ninche eibelekenya apaash ina naitanapa olaiguanani ilapolosak o Lawi tialo pooki bae o too lchumat.

English: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
Masaai: naa kamoda apa nanu mayiolo toki, natiu apa nanu anaa eng'ues ti alo iyie.

English: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
Masaai: Oo Timoteo, torripo ina toki apa nikisiligieki. Talama nena kirorot neme no rrekie le Enkai, o mpaashat e nena naaitaae eng'eno te lejare.

English: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
Masaai: nejoki, “Aish ele obore olosek o enkarrueisho pooki, ai mipal ake mikordil nkoitoi supati o Laitoriani?

English: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
Masaai: nerretena impolosi enye too nkimeitani o nkarash natii ilukuny enye netiu pooki anaa ilkituaak, empisha oo Babilon, laa ore enkop enye naa Ilkaldayo.

English: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
Masaai: Ore menye ilo supat naa keshipa oleng; ore ilo otoiwuo olayioni ng'en naa keshipakino ninye.

English: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
Masaai: Amu iyiololo intae maate eninkoko te niduaayaya iyiook, amu ore apa kiboitare intae neitu kitoni pesho,

English: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
Masaai: Neureishoyu Yehoshafat, neing'oru Olaitoriani makewan, neitanapisho meteena iltung'ana ate aapukoo te Yuda pooki.

English: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki iltung'ana ooitobiru enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta aashu enamuruni, olminong to Laitoriani, entoki naaitobiruni too nkaik o ltung'ani arriyia, neirragieki aaisudoo.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: ore enker nabo te luaata oo nkerrai iip are, too lmarei pooki le Israel. Ena ninye enkishooroto te nkaraki olasar le ntapa, olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani, peyie itum aitobira olasar lo lning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
Masaai: Naa te neeta enkoliai nkera aashu inoo nkoko nchoo eng'as aitabaya nena siaaitin e nkirukoto too lmareita lenye neisho ntoiwuo enye olerrinyore amu keng'amaroyu ena te dukuya Enkai.

English: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ai; kaarrep nanu iyie, kaisis nanu enkarna ino; amu itaasa iyie mbaa e nking'asia, ntabayie te sipata nena kitobirat inono e apa moitie.

English: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
Masaai: Kake eitoborro Hesekia kewan teilo wuasa lo ltau lenye, ninye o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neaku eitu eitoki engoro napi o Laitoriani alotu shumata ninche too nkolong'i pooki e Hesekia.

English: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
Masaai: Kake ti nimipalakiki intae iltung'ana inkitarruorrot enye, nemepalaki sii intae Papa linyi inkitarruorrot inyi.

English: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
Masaai: Anaa nena pooki apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa esiaai pooki, naa ng'ura, etaasa ninche; anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani, neaku etaasa ninche ina. Nemayian Musa ninche.

English: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
Masaai: Shomo enetii Farao tadekenya, ina kata elo enkare; taanyu ninye te ngilata o lkeju niya iyie te nkaina ino ina ng'udi apa naibelekenya aaku olasurai.

English: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
Masaai: Tiniata embae niyieu nijo, tawalikiaki; iroro amu kayieu oleng naaisho iyie esipata.

English: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
Masaai: Kake atiu apa nanu anaa olkuoo le ker obor oriki aapuo aayieng. Eitu apa nanu ayiolou ajo nanu eitobiraki ninche entorroni ejo, “Mainyala iyiook olchani tenebo ilng'anayio lenyena, matudung iyiook aaiwuang'ie te nkop oo looishu, pee meitokini ae kata aadamu enkarna enye.”

English: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.
Masaai: Ng'ura, etii ene entito selenkei neitu eyiolou olee o enkapiani enye; ntasho maipang'unye nanu ninche. Embung'a ninche nintaasiasa ninche anaa enidolidolo eishiaakino te intae; kake ore ti alo ele tung'ani emintaas ena bae suuji.”

English: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
Masaai: Ekesipa nchere ore pee kipuonu Makedonia neitu eishori iyiook mayagie. Kinoto osina too nkaloli pooki: eetae iarat ti oriong, o enkuretisho ti atua.

English: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
Masaai: Olayioni lai, tinikilejaa ake ilaasak loo ng'ok, minyorraa mikitelejari.

English: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, ninye, “Inchoo iyiook meitoton obo lang te nkaina ino e tatene neton olikae te ne kedienye, te nkitoo ino.”

English: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
Masaai: Naa entisir intae ina kop too orot naapishana niyauu lelo sirat ene natii nanu; amu kaosh nanu enkukuo te nkaraki intae tene te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiyiolo ataasa esidai, nemeas, naa eng'oki te ninye.

English: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
Masaai: Amaa tiniaas isupati aimiking'amari? Naa teneitu ias isupati kigira ing'ok aarresh te nkutuk enkaji, naa iyie eyieu neibung kake eishiaakino nimir ninye.”

English: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
Masaai: Mikitiu iyiook anaa kulikae kumok oopuo aaitaa olkilikuai le Nkai anaa nkutiti baa nemeeta tipat; kiro iyiook anaa ltung'ana oojo mbaa naasipa, naa Enkai eing'uaa, naa te dukuya Enkai kiro, anaa ltung'ana ootii atua Kristo.

English: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
Masaai: Ainyoo naidim atirishie iyook enyorrata e Kristo? Keidim ingolikinot, anaa emion, anaa enkisilisiloto? anaa olameyu, anaa enikipuo mikinchopo, anaa batisho, anaa enkeeya o anaa olalem?

English: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
Masaai: Newaliki Simon Petero ajoki, “Ira Iyie Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai naishu.”

English: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
Masaai: Eikununo ninche anaa lamuyeishi pushunot ootaraposhote meetae ake olemeishir eyieu enkitok olelatia enye.

English: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
Masaai: Tudumunye, lo adung'oni le nkiguana le nkop, nchoo lelo oouasa inaairirikino ninche!

English: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
Masaai: Ore ilo otur engumoto nedoiki ninye; naa keony olasurai ilo otur elusie te suntai.

English: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Lamek naa iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o naapishana, neye ninye.

English: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Tudumunye maape.” Kake eitu ewalikini ninye. Nepik ilo tung'ani ninye enkoriong o sikiria lenye; nedumunye ilo lee nelo enkang enye.

English: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
Masaai: ejo pee etum atabai enatejoki te nkutuk o loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo,

English: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
Masaai: Ore ake tenebo nena tokitin pooki naishorua nanu tenkaraki ina aji sinyati, naata nanu olchumati lai makewan le sahabu o enkosholai, naa ore tenkaraki enyorrata ai tenkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai, aishoo nanu enkaji e Nkai ai:

English: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
Masaai: Metaa nchoo etiu neijia, Olaitoriani, teneitu nanu aaisiaai aitobiraki teneitu nanu aasai iyie terishata oo lmang'ati laainei etii ninche atua enyamali o sina.

English: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
Masaai: Amu meiwuang'ieki ae kata olasipani; kedamuni ninye ntarasi.

English: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
Masaai: Neitoki airora neitoki aidetidet eniare; naa ng'ura, ilkiyiaa oopishana loo lpaek oopir naa sidain ebulu to lpaeki obo.

English: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku etaa apa Hebron enjung'ore e Kaleb olayioni le Yefune loo Lkeni o metabaiki ena olong, enkaraki apa naiting'ie ninye asuj Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
Masaai: Neeta nkiyaa kake mening'isho; neeta nkumeishin kake meing'uaisho.

English: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Adin, naa Ebed olayioni le Yonatan, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa onom.

English: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
Masaai: Eitu king'utut; ore ninye, anaa duoo pee ajing'u eitu aapal maangutut inkejek aainei.

English: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
Masaai: Entasheito naa, iterretena mpolosi inyi te sipata, ninchopo elong'o o lgoo e supatisho,

English: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head saying,
Masaai: Ore pooki laaing'or nanu naakueniyie, naadasaki nkineji, neipirripir ilukuny;

English: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
Masaai: Ore amu eyiolo ninye isinaitin lenye, eibeleleng'oo ninche te nkewarie, nepurdi ninche.

English: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
Masaai: Neisikaki ninye nabo e nena anas nelo aitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi e ina anasa, nelimu mbaa enyena ainosaki ilpayiani le ina anasa; netum taa ninche aawaita ninye aaitijing'a atua enkanasa; neisho ninye ewueji, neton ninye te nebo ninche.

English: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
Masaai: “Ntobira ntarumpetani are e nkosholai te nkarriyiano ndong'u ninche, neaku ninche impotunye eumata, naa ninche egilieki ilng'oborri.

English: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
Masaai: Olaitoriani eing'uaa iroruat e tung'ana naa keitubul ilo oitiship enkoitoi enye;

English: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
Masaai: Nanu taa hoo nara oloti aisul too sinyat pooki, nanu eishooki ena piris, matoliki Iloreren lelo Omon Supati, le nkarsisisho nemejurroyu e Kristo,

English: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
Masaai: Nebau enkata neisho Elisabet, neiu enkayioni.

English: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Dan, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
Masaai: “Metaa, entoning intae lo airritak ororei lo Laitoriani ejo:

English: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
Masaai: “Niripu olkila te siaai tenkarriyiano te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui, nintayu ina arasha narridieki endukuya te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui, nintayu enkimeita aikodu to ltidu.

English: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
Masaai: amu etopolosaka ninye nkaitin e Dameski, naa ninche apa naatimira ninye, nejo ninye, “Ore enkaraki natareto nkaitin oo ltung'ana le Asiria ninche, kapolosaki nanu ninche pee aatum aataretu nanu.” Kake etaa ninche enkidaata te ninye o te Israel pooki.

English: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
Masaai: Neitu ninye eiteleiki enkaina enye lelo arikok loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli; nedol ninche Enkai, neokisho nedaa.

English: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
Masaai: Neitoki Noa aanyu kulie olong'i naapishana, neirriwaa enturkulu kake eitu eigil arrinyokino ninye.

English: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adonikan naa iip ile ontomoni ile oopishana.

English: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
Masaai: tenebo endapasho te nkalo oloontoluo te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, tenebo olodung'oro intemat enkaina iip nabo.

English: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
Masaai: o ina kitok naibae te netum olpayian, o enkaisiaayiani najung ewueji e ina kitok naitore ninye.

English: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
Masaai: Esipa enchakenisho ino ntarasi; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto pee aton aishu.

English: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
Masaai: Oi elotu enkordunoto e Israel eing'uaa Sion! Ina kata errinyu Enkai iltung'ana lenyena, neng'idayu Yakobo neshipayu Israel.

English: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
Masaai: Nepik atua ilkererin oong'uan loo soito. Olkereri loo ltoto barrikon, o oltoto sikitok, oltoto oonyori, olkereri le dukuya.

English: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oleng naa keitaae ninye karsis, ore ilo opiku enkare, naa kepikakini sii ninye enkare.

English: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
Masaai: Kalo otiu anaa nanu? Nchoo ninye elimu aibalunye, nchoo ninye meibalunye neitodolu te dukuya nanu. Kaing'ae apa otolimuo aibalunye mbaa naapuonu? nchoo ninche eliki iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu.

English: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
Masaai: Nebulu ailepu te nkop esupatisho, neirrugo esupatisho te shumata aing'or enkop.

English: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ore enkishorunoto ino naa olasar le ntapa nateyiaraki te moti eitobiruni te ntapa sidai o eilata.

English: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
Masaai: Nelotu Musa neipot lelo payiani loo ltung'ana, neibalie te dukuya ninche kulo rorei pooki ooitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
Masaai: Ore anaa eneba elakuani e keper, o eneba enguton e nkop neija etiu indamunot oo laiguanak mejurrunoyu.

English: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
Masaai: Ajoki ntae, neijia etiu, keshipa sii lmalaika le Nkai to laasani loo ng'ok obo oirridu.”

English: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
Masaai: Naomon nanu Olaitoriani najo, ‘Olaitoriani Enkai, Ooi mindaikie iltung'ana linono o enjung'ore ino, laa iyie otokordua te nkitoo ino, naa iyie oitupukuo te nkop e Misiri te nkaina magilani.

English: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.
Masaai: “Nyaaki ting'iria penyo peyie aatum aitoduaa, amu eton ake aata enajo terishata Enkai.

English: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao ajo, “Ng'ura, ajo aikumok taata kulo tung'ana tena kop niyeng'iyeng'ie iyie ninche too siaitin enye!”

English: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
Masaai: Neng'amaa olkitok lenye ajoki, ‘Lo sinka torrono oshal, itayiolo ajo adung ineitu aun, nasotu ineitu aisuaaya;

English: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.
Masaai: nejoki Absalom ninye, “Ng'ura, kesipa neishiaakino ena niyieu; kake metii oltung'ani otegelua olaiguanani likining iyie.”

English: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye nkitasheta oo ltaai anaa enatuutuaki nepik ninche atua ina aji e Nkai, nepik imiet enkalo e kopikop, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape.

English: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
Masaai: Naa amaa te neiriamunore enkishiaa naba neijia enkishorunoto oo nkitanapat naayau endung'okinoto e nkiguana, kebaa naa elusoo enkishiaa e nkishorunoto e ina Kiyang'et naitaa iyiook ilemeetakinore Enkai?

English: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
Masaai: “Teneishunye ilpapit aapuku te ndukuya oltung'ani, naa endukuya ake natukurre, kake meeta ninye olduruk.

English: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
Masaai: Emayiana ake lelo aisiaayiak laa te nebau olkitok lenye neinepu erripisho. Esipa ajoki ntae, kerretena ninye openy neisho ninche metotona te mesa, nelotu aitoti ninche.

English: And the LORD said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee: for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not reign over them.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Toning'o oltoilo loo ltung'ana te nena pooki nikijoki ninche iyie; amu eitu ninche kiany iyie, kake aatanyaita ninche nanu pee maitoki aaku olaiguanani te ninche.

English: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
Masaai: “Teneboitare olee enkitok nara errindik natisira, likae lee neton eitu elakuni aashu eishoori ae toki, nejurri ina bae, neari ninche metuata, enkaraki naa errindik ina kitok.

English: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
Masaai: Neikini Daudi ilayiok te Hebron: ore olkikau lenye naa Amnon, le Ahinoam e Yesreel;

English: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
Masaai: naa kaaosh enkawuo ino te nkalo e nkaina ino e kedienye naisho imbaa inono metadoiki enkop te nkaina ino e tatene.

English: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
Masaai: kake ayiolo intae ajo, miatata enyorrata e Nkai ti atua ate.

English: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani nesujaa iltung'ana pooki ninye; neitashe ninche te nkaji nabayie.

English: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
Masaai: Ore eton eliki ninche kuna baa, ng'ura, nelotu oltung'ani oitore enkaji e ntumo negilaki kung nejoki, “Etua te na kata entito ai, kake wou inteleiki enkaina ino pee epiu ninye.”

English: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
Masaai: Kaa naa alo aas teneinyototo Enkai? Amaa teneikilikuanisho, kaa nanu awaliki ninye?

English: And Saul's uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.
Masaai: Nejoki olenkapu lenye Saul o ilo sinka lenye, “Kaji apa ishomo?” Nejo ninye, “Kishomo aaing'oru isirkon; ore ake pee kidol aajo metumi, nikipuo enetii Samuel.”

English: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
Masaai: Anaa apa enatiu too nkolong'i e nkiputakinoto ai, ina kata etii shoruetisho e Nkai shumata olng'obor lai.

English: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
Masaai: Eng'oru Olaitoriani o engolon enye, eng'oru ninye anaake!

English: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
Masaai: neirriwaa Daudi ilaikitalak, pee eyiolou aasipu nchere eewuo Saul.

English: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
Masaai: Inchoo ninche eaku ininono aa iyie ake, neme pee eaku enino olomon likiboitare.

English: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
Masaai: “Ore aloito atinyikaka Dameski, etaa enaipirie enkolong newang'u nabo kata ewang'an naing'uaa shumata naaman.

English: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
Masaai: Newaliki Daudi ilo apolosani ajo, “Ore te sipata eitalamayioki apa nkituaak te iyiook anaa oshi ake te nalo te nkisiaayiare eisinyat imasaa oo lbarnot, hoo duoo ninye tenaa elototo e oshi ake; kebaa naa taata aa sinyat imasaa enye?”

English: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
Masaai: Atejo nanu, “Kagolie nkoitoi aainei, pee maas eng'oki to lng'ejep lai; kaen nanu enkutuk ai, enkata naba anaa enatii iltorrok ewueji natii nanu.”

English: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
Masaai: Amu ore aidipa nanu ayau ninche atua ina kop naruko naishi o kule, apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho loo menye, netadaate ninche neraposho nepiru, naa keibelekenyakino ninche kulie aitin neisiaai ninche, naamenaa ninche nanu negil olning'o lai.

English: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
Masaai: Eng'urai sii imelin, hoo naa sapuki oleng, nerrumoo olkutati ogol oleng, eutaa ninche enkiti toki aipirie enkalo ake ninye naba anaa enayieu olarewani.

English: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana le Manase neisik aapuo enetii Daudi ina kata pee epuonu Ilfilisti olarrabal aarare Saul. (Ore ake eyia eitu ninye eretu Lfilisti, amu eiguanate ilaitoriak lenye nearaa ninye, ejo, “Ilukuny ang edung'ori, teneing'uaa ninye iyiook nerrinyokino olkitok lenye Saul.”)

English: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
Masaai: Anaa enaikununo olang'oroni le nkawuo opik ilbaa pooki ng'ae, neijia etiu ilo oisho olmodai ogiroo esiaai arashu olamerani.

English: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
Masaai: Iyau lelo tung'ana modook hoo neeta nkonyek, lelo ming'an hoo neta nkiyiaa!

English: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia itishilayie iyie enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye, Olaitoriani Enkai ai. Toning'o enkishirata o enkomono naomon osinka lino te dukuya iyie ena olong;

English: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
Masaai: Naa keaku ena erubata oo lapolosak naing'uaa iltung'ana, neing'uaa nena kishorunot o lasar, aa olkiteng aashu enker, nchoo eisho ninche olapolosani orony o sederi pokira are o enkaya.

English: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, tobiko te nena nindipa atayiolo aitisip, amu iyiolo iyie ajo aing'ae likinteng'ena ina.

English: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
Masaai: “Ening'itoi oltoilo le nkishirata e Heshbon o Eleale te Yahas, eitayutuo iltoiloishi lenye eing'uaa Saor ometabaiki Horonaim o Eglat-shelishia. Amu etomijoono sii nkariak e Nimrim.

English: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
Masaai: Neyau mpeuti enkop natoyio, neing'uaa pooki toki nesuj ninye.

English: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
Masaai: Ore apa aa osesen kinchuyie, ore ng'uarrat ang oo ng'ok, etupututuo nkitanapat, neasisho ti atua rubat ang neiu ilg'anayio le keeya.

English: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
Masaai: Ore olkereri otemieki neipang alo auluo oleng, neitoriori abaya oldoinyo le Gareb, neitoki taa arrinyo alo Goa.

English: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatoduaa, ore lelo ooun entorroni; neun enyamali naa ninye ejung.

English: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Emincho Hesekia ejoki intae eji maigarakinoto Olaitoriani, eji ejo, “Kelo Olaitoriani akordu iyiook; ore ena anasa nemelo ninye ajing nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.”

English: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
Masaai: Ore te Tehafnehes keaku ina olong enaimin, ina kata nagil teine enkitoria e Misiri, ore ina golon enye olwuasa nebaiki enkiting'oto; keitoipi ninye te nkatampoi, ore ntoyie enyena nepuo eararoto.

English: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Kake tenimikining'ining'i intae nanu, aaitaa enkolong e sabato sinyati, niminapinapa olola niimumu nchomito e Yerusalem te nkolong e sabato, nainok nanu enkima too nchomito enyena, naa kemut nkajijik e nkitoo e Yerusalem nemeari ae kata.’ ”

English: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
Masaai: Olapa taa Benaia ele ora oltung'ani magilani tiatua lelo tomoni uni naa ninye olarikoni le tomoni uni; Amisabad olayioni lenye apa oitasheiki olturrur lenye.

English: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
Masaai: “Kake ore iyie, enkerai e tung'ani, ininingu enaajoki iyie; miaku iyie kiserut anaa ina aji kiserut tabolo enkutuk ino inosa ina naaisho iyie.”

English: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.

English: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

English: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

English: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

English: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
Masaai: Neaku ore te Ikonio, nejing enkaji e ntumo oo Lyahudi te nebo, neiro, o meiruko esiamo kitok oo Lyahudi o enoo Ilyunani.

English: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
Masaai: Neitoki aing'or ile Kain, neraposhoki, nejo, “Kegol neserian ina manyisho ino, ore enkaji netipikaki enchumata endapidapoi;

English: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

English: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
Masaai: Tudumunye shomo amu mme ewueji neyeng'iyeng'areki ene, te nkaraki olduruk omutisho, te nkidaaroto torrono.

English: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
Masaai: Naa teneilanyisho ake ninye obo loo lekunot, naa kepuo ildoinyo, anaa nturkuluoni oo nong'ot, eishir pooki, eishiraki pooki ng'ae intorrok enyena.

English: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

Masaai: Kake ore te pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana loo Siraeli aa oltung'ani aashu ing'uesi, mebuaaki ninye oldia ninche; peyie itumutumu aatayiolo nchere keor arishu Olaitoriani Ilmisiri o Siraeli.

English: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

English: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
Masaai: neitashe te siadi ninye too nkejek enyena, neiter aituku nkejek enyena too lkiyio, nejut too lpapit le ndukuya enye, neng'utut nkejek enyena, neelie ina ilata.

English: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
Masaai: o enkolepo, o lenkalem te risioroto oo mpukunot enye,

English: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
Masaai: Te neiguanareki ninye nchoo etumieki ninye enkitadiaata; nchoo enkomono enye eikenari aajo eng'oki!

English: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
Masaai: “Indim atayiolo intokitin naagut naaipirta Enkai? Indim atayiolo ineebaiki Olmagilani?

Masaai: Te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan neeng'iyeng'a neitaa ina olong osirua o enchipai.

English: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

English: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
Masaai: Naa tenaa keigeroki te nkalamu e sekenkei naata esipil! pee eguetakini endapidapoi ntarasi!
