Masaai: Ng'ura, ore akenya te ina kata naa Kagilunore nanu lelo likintorogony pooki. Naa kaitajeu nanu lelo maiman naiturrurru lelo ooidapashari, naibelekeny nanu enkurruna enye metaa errepet neyiolouni ti atua enkop pooki.

English: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
Masaai: Neijia eikuna Yehu eishie Baal tiatua Israel.

English: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
Masaai: Nikiyau sii atua enkaji e Nkai ang, aayaki lelo apolosak ooisiaaisho tiatua enkaji e Nkai ang, ilkikaunot lang o lkikaunot loo nkishu ang, anaa enaigero too nkitanapat, o lkikaunot loo nkishu ang o loo ntare ang.

English: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
Masaai: Ore enkisiligata ino netetemaki oleng, nenyor osinka lino ninye.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aadaa, kake ilo iyie aisumashu; ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aaokisho, kake ketir intae enkure; ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aang'idayu, kake kepuoi aaitukurru intae;

English: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
Masaai: Neinosie taa olapolosani ina kitok olmumai, ejo, ‘Te nemeetae olee litaboitare, naa te neitu iyie imbelekenya aibelekenyakino olduruk, eton itii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lino, talakunoyu iyie tena are nadua nayau oldeket.

English: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
Masaai: Kake etii ilookueniyie ilairukok ejo, “Ketemerate kulo tung'ana!”

English: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
Masaai: Ina kata eisuji iroruat aainei te kule, naabukoki ina dapidapoi inchorroi eilata!

English: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yuda Simion olalashe lenye, “Ilepu wou te nebo nanu tamanya atua ena kop naatoorikiaki nanu, pee kitum aataarare Ilkanaani; ore sii nanu naa kaiko neijia alo te nebo iyie atua ina kop nikitoorikiaki iyie.” Nelo Simion te nebo ninye.

English: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
Masaai: Nepuonu ina kata ltung'ana oonapita te rruat, oltung'ani maima, netem aajo mayaki Yesu ti atua aji.

English: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
Masaai: Neitoki Saul ajo, “Ataasa nanu entorrono; tushukunye, enkerai ai, Daudi, amu maaitoki nanu aitaas iyie entorrono, amu keeta enkishui ai tipat ena olong too nkonyek inono.”

English: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
Masaai: Ore Yesu, etayiolo ajo kepuonu ninche aaibung ninye te ngolon aaitaa olaiguanani neiwuang ninye openy arrinyokino oldoinyo.

English: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
Masaai: Ore Yoida olayioni le Pasea o Mehulam olayioni le Besodia, neitobir aaram enkishomi musana. Nepik iloom lenyena o nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena; o sekenke enyena.

English: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
Masaai: Najo kuna, pee melej intae likae too rorei le nkeleekisho.

English: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
Masaai: Woi ninye ina natogolong'ua neinosieki olminong ina anasa naitorogonyisho!

English: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
Masaai: Nijojo ake sii, ‘Ore ina oitoi o Laitoriani nemesipa’; iyie na aji e Israel, ekaiguanare pooki ng'ae linyi terisioroto oo nkoitoi enyena.”

English: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kejung enkanyit, kake ore ilmoda netum enkurruna.

English: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki nitapejo intae enkorropil o enkaraki nitaasa intae eng'oki to Laitoriani aashu ipuopuo te nkitanapata enye o too nkiguanat enyena o te nchakenisho enye, pee etadoikio intae ena torroni, anaa enatiu ena olong.”

English: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
Masaai: Ore olng'ejep le nkerai nanakita, neibung enoret te nkure; neomonu nkera endaa, kake meetae oloisho ninche.

English: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
Masaai: kake ore te nkiting'oto nedua anaa esayiet nepi anaa olalem opi imbat pokira.

English: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
Masaai: Naitoki adol entoki naikununo anaa enaiposha e kiook nashulare enkima. Ore lelo ootimira ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye o esiana e nkarna enye, neitashe te mbata e ina aiposha e kiook, neibung'ita nkinantani e Enkai too nkaik enye.

English: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
Masaai: Ina pee ewalaki Raheli o Lea aajoki ninye, “Ketii ae rubata arashu enjung'ore natung'ueikiaki iyiook te nkaji e papa lang?

English: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
Masaai: o Rabit, o Kishion, o Ebes,

English: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
Masaai: Neisikong Yesu oloirirua, nepuku ninye aing'uaa neishiu enkayioni te ina kata.

English: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
Masaai: Neiturrurro ile Benchamen ina olong too nkanas enye iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam o ile ooata lalema, te nebo lelo oomanya Gibea ooiturrurro iltung'ana iip naapishana gelunot.

English: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa Yoshua ina kop pooki, ina kop oo ldoinyo o Negeb pooki, o enkop e Goshen pooki o ina kop pooki nagum o Araba o ina kop oo ldoinyo e Israel o enkop nagum,

English: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
Masaai: Amu iyie, Enkai ai, naitalio to sinka lino nchere ishetaki ninye Enkaji, ore enkaraki ina etagolo osinka lino oshoke pee eomon te dukuya iyie.

English: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
Masaai: amu eyiolouni ake olchani too lng'anayio lenyena. Amu metumieki olaimurunyai ilng'abolo, nemetumieki isabibu intulele.

English: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
Masaai: Enteshet nkajijik nitonini tiatua ninche; entuun nkurman ninyanya enkisampuare enye.

English: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD'S house; and said to all the people,
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia alotu eing'uaa Tofet, ine apa neirriwayie Olaitoriani ninye meshomo aibonisho, neitashe ninye to lgoriet le nkaji e Nkai, nejoki ninye iltung'ana pooki:

English: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Farao, “Kietuo iyiook aamany ena kop, amu meeta indaat oo ntare isinkan linono, amu etaa olameyu sapuk te nkop e Kanaan; naa ore taata, kiomon iyie inchoo isinkan linono emany enkop e Goshen.”

English: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
Masaai: Keitoriori teilo oyiolo, naa keitoriori te lelo oonoto eng'eno.

English: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
Masaai: Ira iyie enkisudoroto ai o elong'o ai; ororei lino nanu aisiliga.

English: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Ngero tiatua embuku lelo rorei pooki laatiaaka iyie.

English: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
Masaai: Maapuonu ninche aanyikaki nanu aaisiai nanu anaa ilapolosak, arashu epuonu aanyikaki intokitin aainei sinyat o ntokitin naa sinyat oleng; kake kenap ninche enkurruna enye, te nkaraki ilo minong otaasa ninche.

English: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik seti anaa peyie eini Enosh ilarin iip isiet o naapishana, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
Masaai: Neaku etobiko Mefiboshet te Yerusalem; amu kedaa apa ninye anaake te mesa o laiguanani. Naa olmaima apa too nkejek enyena pokira are.

English: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
Masaai: Aitoki ake ajo emincho ake ejo likae kamoda, anaa ti nijojo nikinchosho sii ilo oti wuasa lai.

English: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu to ltoilo lai, Olaitoriani, ore to ltoilo lai naomon Olaitoriani.

English: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e imiet naa iloing'ok ooudo, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,

English: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ng'ura ajo etaa kaya enchipai oo nkonyek inono peyie aaitung'uaa iyie te oshoto, niminchir hoo arashu isinanuo nemedou ilkiyio linono.

English: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
Masaai: Neetae apa te sirit e Antiokia, te sirit natii ine, iloibonok le Nkai o laiteng'enak Barnaba Simeon oji Olorok, o Lukio le Kirene, o Manaen oyati lo lmarei lo laiguanani Herode o Saulo.

English: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
Masaai: Neirrag Asa etua anaa loo menye, neye ninye to lari liartam oobo le nkitoria enye.

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo orerei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam oo kuni o lapa liopishana neisho iltung'ana meshomo nkang'itie enye, eng'ida neeta enchipai too ltauja lenye tenkaraki ina supatisho naitoduaa Olaitoriani, Daudi, o Solomon o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli.

English: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
Masaai: Neisinanuo naleng olaiguanani; kake ore te nkaraki lmuma lenyena o lelo omon lenyena neaku, meyieu nedot ina natiaaka.

English: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
Masaai: Enyaaka alusoo enyorrata nanyor ninye intae to ltau lenye te nedamu ina nitoning'ishote o to lokirikiri.

English: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
Masaai: “Kintajeuo iyie nanu te lelo tung'ana ootekepari aakeshisho; kitipika nanu mataa endukuya oo loreren; ore apa iltung'ana leitu nanu ayiolou naaisiaai nanu.

English: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye te nkinanta naru oleng; meisisi ninye te ndarata e nkinanta!

English: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,
Masaai: oitoduaya enyorrata nauno too nkalifuni, kake intalaku entorroni oo loo menye too nkera enye te siadi ninche, Iyie Enkai olmagilani oji enkarna enye Olaitoriani loo lororani,

English: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
Masaai: ejo, “Iyie nanu aisho enkop e Kanaan, erubata ina naaku enjung'ore ino.”

English: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
Masaai: Naa inya ninye anaa emukate e shairi, naa ipeju ninye te nkima nainokieki nkik oo ltung'ana edolita pooki ng'ae.”

English: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
Masaai: nijo: Kaa lipong apa olng'atuny ng'utunyi ti atua ilng'atunyo! Eitubulua ing'atunyo kutiti ti atua ilng'atunyo.

English: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
Masaai: Amu ore tiae kata ore oltung'ani otaasishe te ng'eno nagut o te yiolounoto o te nkarriyiano neing'uaa pooki metishipakinoyu ilo leitu enyamaliki ninye. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho naa eng'oki sapuk.

English: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Elo enkorui e nkikurrukur ineeiting'ie enkop. Amu kegilunore Olaitoriani nkuapi; kejing ninye atua enkiguana tenebo pooki tung'ani ore ilo torrono nepik ninye enetii ilo alem, Olaitoriani ojo.’

English: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ilo otum enkitok nenoto entoki sidai, nenoto omom to Laitoriani.

English: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
Masaai: Naa te neany ening ninche toliki kanisa; naa te neitu ening sii kanisa, inchoo etiu te iyie anaa oloo loreren lemeiruk, anaa olosotu kodi.

English: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
Masaai: Naa ena apa eitanapaki ninche metaasa, anaa esiaai enye pooki ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo; nena rubat oo sunta o lng'obor le Nkai, te nebo nkeek enyena, ing'apeta o nkitotoneta.

English: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
Masaai: Amu eewuo Enkerai e Tung'ani pee eitajeu inaaimina.

English: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
Masaai: Eroroki lelo pooki sinyat ti atua Kristo Yesu. Eiroroki intae ilalashera ootii te nebo nanu.

English: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile taasisho, nias esiai ino pooki;

English: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
Masaai: Amaa tenepuonu ilaiturrurrok loo sabibu enitii aimeleku ninche kulikae ng'anayio? Amaa tenepuonu ilapurrok kewarie, aime ina ake nairirikino ninche einyal?

English: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani teina kishoroto entapa ina rubata endamunoto nepejoo ena rubata te nchumata olperere lo lasar, olasar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
Masaai: etalioote te nkitoo e keper neirorie Yesu eimaki eneyooki aiko eitabaya eyieunoto e Nkai aye te Yerusalem.

English: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, empolos enye etii engolon enye, netii engolon enye nkirnyany e nkoshoke enye.

English: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki empiris naaishoo Enkai, atotiwuo nanu anaa olashetani arriyia aitobir enkitamanyunoto; likae taata oshetisho te ine. Toduaa naa ake pooki tung'ani eninkunaa enchetata ino te ine.

English: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
Masaai: Nepej ninche imukateni neitu eisuijieki enapa kurma nayautua aaitung'uaa Misiri neitu eishori metotoni, neitu sii eitobiraki ate endaa.

English: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
Masaai: kake etushulare ninche nkuapi neitamok ate easata anaa enataasa ninche.

English: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
Masaai: Ina pee ewaliki Shetani Olaitoriani ajoki, “Olchoni to lchoni eitayu oltung'ani pooki naata te nkaraki enkishui enye.

English: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
Masaai: Neaku eitu eitoki ilo barnoti aitumutiki ina bae, amu etonyorra ninye ina tito e Yakobo. Naa ninye apa enyorri oleng aaitulus to lmarei pooki.

English: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Haga enkaisiaayiani e Sarai, kaji iyie ing'uaa naa kaji iloito?” Nejo Haga, “Kaisikita ailany ina naaitore ai naji Sarai.”

English: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
Masaai: Neas Yoash mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoida olapolosani.

English: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche ninye ti atua enjung'ore enye te Timnat-sera, apa naa ninye natii ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, moikuape o ldoinyo le Gaash.

English: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
Masaai: Mikinukari iyie aaitaboitaki ninche enkaraki nindaikie enkop ino, itara iyie iltung'ana linono metuata. “Ore eishoi e lelo aasak loo ntorrok, nchoo eaku meigili ai kata aaipot!

English: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
Masaai: Kaing'ae otonyorrayie ina nikitoning'o? Naa ae te ng'ae etabolokoki enkaina o Laitoriani?

English: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
Masaai: Mosa apa menye le Binea naa Refaia olayioni lenye, naa Eliesa olayioni lenye o Asiel olayioni lenye.

English: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
Masaai: Intamoo kewan kuna siaaitin tasheikinore ninche, pee edol pooki ng'ae eninkonari te nyuaata.

English: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
Masaai: Ore te neiputayu nkolong'i inono nirrag iyie te nebo loo papaai lino, nadamu nanu eishoi ino te siadi iyie, ilo olotu aing'uaa osesen lino, naitubulaa nanu enkitoo enye.

English: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki bae neeta erishata enye o enkoitoi enye, hoo naa ore enyamali oltung'ani naa keyek ninye.

English: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
Masaai: Neyiolou ndamunot enye nejoki, “Ore enkitoo pooki naoro ti atua nerruoyo; anaa enkang ake pooki, anaa enkaji naoro aara maate, meitashe.

English: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
Masaai: nijojo intae, ‘Ng'ura, eitoduaa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang enkisisa enye o enkitoo, nikitoning'o iyiook oltoilo lenye epuku te mpolos enkima; kitoduaa iyiook ena olong Enkai eirorie iltung'ana neton ake eishu lelo tung'ana.

English: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
Masaai: Mailepie iltauja lang o nkaik ang, aailepakinye Enkai natii keper:

English: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
Masaai: “Nji intae entiaaki Sedekia, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, Kashuku nanu nena masaa o larrabal naatii atua nkaik inyi naa te ninche iararere olaiguanani le Babilon niaararere Ilkaldayo oomanita intae tioriong isunta; naa kayau nanu ninche tenebo atua empolos ena anasa.

English: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo kitok le sikari ajoki, “Lo kitok, kaamakua nanu ti nijing'u enkaji ai, kake tejo ake ororei, naa keishiu olaisiaayiani lai.

English: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
Masaai: nebaiki nang'as aton te nebo aashu abik te nebo intae te nkata e enkijape, paa intae likipuonunu aaitobiraa te nene wuejitin pooki nalo.

English: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae turrurri loo Lawi te Yuda neshulare Benchamen.

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
Masaai: te nebo ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki intae;

English: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
Masaai: Isiliga Olaitoriani nias esidai; pee itum atobiko tena kop, nitum eseriani.

English: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
Masaai: amu ore shakenisho ang te Kristo neitadedeyieki ti atua intae

English: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina oitoi apa naimua ninye, ina ake eitoki aim arrinyo, nemelotu ninye ena anasa, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye, neshet aram Malkija obo loo lkunono omeitabaiki enkaji oo laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, o ewueji oo lamirak enkipirakinoto e kishomi e rripore, o meitabaiki enkaji e shumata natii olpijata.

English: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
Masaai: Erridutu naa, embelekenyakinoto Enkai, pee ejutori ng'ok inyi,

English: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
Masaai: Eitadowuo ilaitoriak too lorikan lenye le nkitoo, neilepie iloomeni.

English: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
Masaai: Neishooyo ninye iltung'ana lenyena metaari to lalem, nepik ninye engoro enye shumata ina jung'ore enye.

English: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
Masaai: Ilo iyie aing'oru lelo likikeshare, kake midol ninche; ore lelo likintayunye olarrabal naa kepuo aaku pesho.

English: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
Masaai: Kincho oshiaake Enkai enashe te nkaraki intae pooki kimpot intae anaake ti atua enkomono ang.

English: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Emiureishoyu amu ilomon supati le ng'ida kitok ayau naaku too ltung'ana pooki,

English: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
Masaai: “Naa tenimbung'ubung'u intae kuna kitanapat aainei naitanap nanu intae ena olong, aanyorru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nisiayiayia ninye too ltauja linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki,

English: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.
Masaai: Neiro ninche aaimaki Enkai e Yerusalem, anaa enaimaki nkaitin oo loreren le nkop, naa esiaai oo nkaik oo ltung'ana.

English: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
Masaai: Kake etusujaitie enjore oo Lkaldayo olaiguanani, neinepu ninche Sedekia te nkisiajata e Yeriko; ore enjore enye pooki neidapasha aaing'uaa ninye.

English: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
Masaai: Eiking'ida iyiook ti nikishal igoligolo intae. Ore enatii, intae kiomonoki pee imputakinono.

English: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
Masaai: Tenaa kumok ilarin niponaa iyie enkinyang'a, naa tenaa kuti ilarin nintaa kiti enkinyiang'a, amu esiana oo larin ninye kimirakinye iyie.

English: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
Masaai: Te mpesho aitanaura nanu kewan ore ina kutu enye nairrusha nemeim enkima.

English: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
Masaai: Neisalaash ilkumok lo lorora ilkilani lenye te nkoitoi nedung'u kulikae ilng'osil loo lkeek neisalaashaki enkoitoi.

English: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk e ilo supat neitoti ilkumok, kake ore ilmoda nemut emodai.

English: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
Masaai: neiko neijia oli aare,

English: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Inji eikununo einoto e Kristo; ore eidipa Yosef atisira Mariamu ng'otonye Yesu, eton eitu enyikakino, nedoli eeta enutai e Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: Then Job answered and said,
Masaai: Ina peyie ewal Yoab ejo:

English: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
Masaai: Nedung'udung aaitaa rubat tenebo endukuya enye o eilata, neirragie olapolosani ninche aitobiraki aiteleiki lelo keek ootii enkima te nchumata olperere lo lasar;

English: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
Masaai: Ore ebikito te ine, nebaya inkolong'i pee eisho.

English: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
Masaai: Keng'idayu olpurkel o enkop natoyio, neng'idayu ilo purkel neleng'u oleng; neiput ntapuka

English: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
Masaai: Nasai intae to Laitoriani pe eisomakini ena palai ilalashera pooki.

English: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
Masaai: “Tipikaki kewan enkoitoi ilmonek, ntobiraki kewan ilmonek likiutaa tadamu oleng ina oitoi kitok, ina oitoi apa naa ninye iima. Tushukunye, na selenkei e Israel tushukunye wou kuna anas inono.

English: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.
Masaai: Neinosaki Haman ninche esikar o enkarsisisho enye, esiana oo layiok lenyena o enkitoo pooki naishoo ninye olaiguanani o ina nailepieki ninye aaitalang ilkituaak o laisiaayiak lo laiguanani.

English: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
Masaai: Naa ore tenkaraki olminong linyi pooki, kaitaas intae eneitu aekata aitaas intae, anaa enanyaanyukie enemaitoki aikata aas aigil.

English: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee imbonishe te nkarna o Laitoriani, ijo, ‘Keyooki ena aji atiu anaa Shilo ore ena anasa neaku olmuaate memanya toki’?” Ore iltung'ana pooki neiturrurrokino Yeremia tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
Masaai: Amaa nkilejilej e Nkai a kutiti te iyie, oo ilo rorei likirorie iyie te mborron?

English: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir aram Meremot olayioni le Uria, olayioni le Hakos. Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Meshulam olayioni le Berekia, olayioni le Meshesabel. Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Sadok olayioni le Baana.

English: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yafan naa Elisha, o Tarshish o Kitim o Rodanim.

English: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Intayu olasar le nashe; eina naisuijieki nimbalie inkishorunot e mpiris nilikioo ninche amu inyorrinyorro aaikuna neijia, lo tung'ana le Israel!” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
Masaai: Ninye otuuruo nkitoriat o loogol pooki o masaa o larrabal neitoduaaya te neibala, nerik aitaa iarunot etigilua ninche.

English: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Anaa enitejo intae, nchoo etiu neijia.” Neisho ninche meshomo, nepuo ninche, neeniki ninye enkarasha nanyokie oldirisha.

English: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
Masaai: olayioni le Obed, olayioni le Boas, olayioni le Sala, olayioni le Nashon,

English: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
Masaai: Nemurat Olaitoriani Enkai ino oltau lino o ltau le ishoi ino, pee itum atonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki; pee itum atopuaa.

English: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: O emukate ai sii, aaishoo iyie, aitotio iyie te nkurma napuyiapui o eilata o enaisho irragie te dukuya ninche metaa olgusil orropil, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
Masaai: Ena bae intae entaas, ore intae ilapolosak o Lawi oopuo aing'uaa esiaai te nkolong e Sabato, ore ematua inyi e uni neaku ilarripok loo nchomito.

English: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
Masaai: Neya ilo oiboni oji Hanania nena keek naatii emurt e Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai, negil ninche,

English: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe nairirikino esupatisho enye, naranyaki nanu te nkisisa enkarna o Laitoriani, Ilo otii shumata Aisul.

English: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
Masaai: Kebaa esidano natum ina kop! Ore lelo barnot naa kabul tenkaraki entapa enye tenebo enaisho o sabibu.

English: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
Masaai: Iyanyita nkolia naara te dede.

English: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
Masaai: Meeta ake sii oleitu eisho te pooki lenye inkilani ng'ejuko kake eishoo Benchamen shekeli iip uni e nkosholai o nkilani imiet ng'ejuko.

English: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
Masaai: neme te mbaunoto enye ake, kake o te nkitagolo nanoto ti atua intae. Etolikio iyiook ina niyiewu intae naleng nidolidolo, neliki iyiook olkiyioi linyi, nitaa intae ilaamitu nanu. Ina bae naaitishipa oleng.

English: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, mikilam iyie nanu; iyie Enkai, tasioki taretuoki nanu!

English: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
Masaai: Ore enkang nijing'ijing'i nemeitoomon intae, enchom inkoitoi enyena naalala nijojo,

English: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan naa Elisuri olayioni le Shedeur, olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Ruben.

English: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
Masaai: Aing'asia nanu eji intae lelo oosioki aaing'uaa Ilo oipoto intae te mpiris e Kristo aaibelekenyakino kulikae omon oopaashari ooji supati.

English: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
Masaai: nigelulu naa nkanas naaku nkanas naasaruni te nkaraki intae, pee etum pooki ng'ae oitayu loikop, oar oltung'ani metua eitu eotiki atasaru.

English: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: Te neeta oltung'ani nkiyiaa naaning'ishore toning'o.”

English: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana enetii Musa, nejoki, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, amu kiroro iyiook mbaa torrok ti alo Olaitoriani o tialo iyie; toomono Olaitoriani pee eiwuang'ie ninye ilasuriaa te iyiook.” Neaku etoomonoko Musa iltung'ana.

English: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
Masaai: netiu inkejek enyena anaa suya oosika te nkima, netiu oltoilo lenye anaa ltoilo loo nkariak kumok;

English: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
Masaai: Tenaa keetae aekata enkai nashomo ayaki kewan olosho aitung'uaa empolos e likae osho, too ntemat, o too nkitoduaat, o too mbaa enking'asia o to larrabal te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o too ntabo sapuki, te risioroto e nena pooki naataasa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te nkaraki intae te Misiri te dukuya nkonyek inyi?

English: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
Masaai: Metoponari empiris o sotua te intae te yiolounoto e Enkai o Yesu o eno Laitoriani lang.

English: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
Masaai: Kake eiyuko ninye ninche te nkaina metigirata, neibalakinye eneikuna Olaitoriani pee esaru aitung'uaa korokoroni. Nejoki, “Entoliki kuna baa, Yakobo nilikiki sii lalashera.” Nelo ninye, dikai wueji.

English: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
Masaai: Ore ilo orrip enkutuk enye neitobikoo enkishui enye; ore ilo obol enkutuk enye oleng neidaaya.

English: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ogil enkitanapata nabo e kuna kutiti, hoo te naa enkinyi, neitayiolo ilkulikae metigila, naa keipoti ninye aajo olkini te pooki te nkitoria e keper; kake ore oloas nena neitayiolo sii ilkulikae metaasa, naa keipoti ilo aajo olkitok te nkitoria e keper.

English: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.
Masaai: Ore enaidipie enkitayunoto o lasar opejori, ng'ura, nelotu Samuel; neipang Saul alo anang'are ninye neng'asaki ninye.

English: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
Masaai: Nimiboitare ake eng'ues pooki aisarkionie kewan te ninye, nemeisho enkitok kewan eng'ues metaboitare, entaboi ina.

English: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
Masaai: Ore enabaiyie ilalashera, kiaata ae toki nikinkilikuan intae nikisai ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu, ore anaa enitayioloito te iyiook enaishiaakino te nitiuwu to lkuaak o te nkitishipata e Nkai, anaa eniaasitata, entaas ina oleng oleng.

English: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
Masaai: Te nkirukoto eitatala Enkai Noa nena baa apa neton melioo nening ninye neitobir esafina pee esaru enkaji enye; te na bae etudong'oko enkop enkiguana neaku ninye olajung'oni le supatisho natumi te nkirukoto.

English: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
Masaai: Ore inkitamoot eilo ng'en naa enchorro enkishui, pee eidim oltung'ani atapaasha irresheta le keeya.

English: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
Masaai: Kayau nanu shumata ina kop lelo rorei laainei pooki apa latejo nanu tialo ninche pooki toki naigero tiatua ena buku apa naibonoko Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai nkuapi pooki.

English: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
Masaai: Mme neijia pae! Kaji iyiook kinko ilootuata ti alo ng'ok ti nikintoki aaenikino atua?

English: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
Masaai: Ore pee eilep, nebel emukate, nedaa, neitoki ake airorie kata naado, o mekenyu, nelo taa aing'uaa.

English: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Te naa kolarruoni mayiolo nanu; nabo ayiolo, inchere kara apa modooni nadolisho taata.”

English: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
Masaai: Olaitoriani eanyu enkishui ai; ninye eretoto ang naa elong'o.

English: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
Masaai: Eng'orutu Olaitoriani o engolon enye, eng'orutu entasho te dukuya ninye anaake!

English: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo otapalakaki ing'ok enyena, ilo oimulumulayioki ing'ok enyena.

English: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.
Masaai: Ore tiatua ina palai neigero, ajo, “Etolimuoki tiatua iloshon, netejo sii Geshem neijia, nchere ore iyie o Lyahudi nintobiritata pee iseriser ina pee ishetitata esuntai, naa ijo pee iyaku olaiguanani lenye te risioroto eina limunoto.

English: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye ilalashera, lelo ayiok le Yehoshafat: Asaria, o Yehiel, o Sekaria, o Mikael, o Shefatia. Ore apa kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
Masaai: nepuo ninche tenkiesies neiterriarri anaa lamerak, neiting eng'eno enye.

English: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
Masaai: Neibalunye, neitu emiki, neibalunye ajo, “Mara nanu Kristo.”

English: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
Masaai: Neisho ninye nchorroi oo nkariak metupuku te ndapidapoi, neisho enkare meturukoyu anaa olkeju.

English: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Masaai: Mikisudorie nanu enkomom ino. Mirriny iyie osinka lino te ngoro, iyie apa otaa eretoto ai. Mikinturraa nanu, miking'uaa nanu, Na Ai e njeunoto ai!

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Entudumunye enchom, intae o lelo tung'ana apa liyaua ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, meshomo ina kop apa naa ninye ainosie olmumai pee aisho Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, ajoki ‘Eishoi inyi aisho ninye.’

English: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
Masaai: neitu aainepu ninche aishankarrarre likae tung'ani aashu aing'oling'ol esiamo, te nkaji e Nkai, aashu too nkajijik e ntumo aashu te ina anasa.

English: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en, neisudoo eng'eno enye, kake ore ilmoda neibalie emodai enye.

English: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
Masaai: Eipotutuo doi ninye iltung'ana meetu tenelakua, ilo oirriwakaki olkilikuai, naa ng'ura eetuo ninche. Amu tiatua ninche isuja iyie kewan, niyel inkonyek inono, nikus kewan too masaa;

English: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo kipaareta aaimaa nkanas pooki, te nkop e Efraim pooki o Manase, nepuo o metabaiki Sebulon, kake etakueniyie iltung'ana ninche nesurdaany, neikordod ninche.

English: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, lo aiguanak, entaa ng'eni; nchoo eikok intae lo aitoriak le nkop.

English: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

Masaai: Eirriwayie apa Hiram olaiguanani le Turo olkilikuai enetii Daudi, o ltarakua, o laguetak loo soito sii o laguetak loo mbaoi, pee eshetaki enkaji.

English: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
Masaai: Kaidim ataa kaata enkishoroto e naibon o eyiolounoto oo nkisudorot misili pooki o eng'eno pooki, kaidim ataa kaata enkirukoto nadotu ldoinyio, kake te nemaata enyorrata mara toki.

English: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata enkolong adoyio te iyie, nemeigil olapa aaku enaimin, amu Olaitoriani ole aaku ewang'an ino oo ntarasi, ore nkolong'i inono e nkishirata neishieki.

English: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
Masaai: Beser tiatua ina kop naitoriori too ltung'ana le Ruben, o Ramoti tiatua Gilead too ltung'ana le Gad, o Galan tiatua Bashan too ltung'ana le Manase.

English: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
Masaai: Natipika nanu irorei laainei enkutuk ino, naaisudoo iyie ti atua oloip le nkaina ai, neisalaash oloing'ang'e naitobir olkitamanyunoto le nkop, najoki Sion, ‘Irara intae iltung'ana laainei.’ ”

English: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
Masaai: Neipotu Yesu ninche enetii nejoki, “Iyiololo aajo ore lelo ooitaa ate ilaitoriak loo Loreren neitoreisho te ng'olon, negilu iltung'ana lenye kituaak ninche.

English: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
Masaai: olayioni le Elkana olayioni le Yoel, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Sefania,

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ejo,

English: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
Masaai: Neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani, ejo, “Nchiunye ninye, Na Ai, aatasayia.”

English: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
Masaai: Metobikoi enkitoo o Laitoriani ntarasi, metishipayu Olaitoriani too siaitin enyena,

English: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Naftali Ahira olayioni le Enan.”

English: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho naitaa ninye eng'ape ti atua enkaji e Enkai ai, nemeitoki ae kata aipang aing'uaa ine, naa kasiraki ninye enkarna e Enkai ai, o enkarna e nkanasa e Enkai ai, ina Yerusalem nadou eing'uaa Enkai ai te keper o enkarna ai kewan ng'ejuk.

English: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
Masaai: Amu ena nalo aaku te mpolos e nkop, ti atua loshon, ore anaa enaigusugusieki oloirien, o anaa enasotuni ilng'anayio to sabibu.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
Masaai: Neaku, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nairriwaki nanu ninye lelo oopiku pee epikuni ninye, neitoroki empirbil enye nebelibel mpirbili enyena aaitaa mbelibelat.

English: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
Masaai: Eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata nikimpirta iyie: “Meigili aekata aadumu enkarna ino; kaiwuang'ie nanu te nkaji oo nkaitin inono, kitanyaanyukoto e nkai naguetuno oina nasholuno. Kaitobir nanu enkurare ino amu ira iyie arruoni.”

English: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
Masaai: “Amu ayiolo nanu isiaitin enye o ndamunot enye, naa kalotu nanu aiturrur iloshon pooki o lng'ejepa; naa kepuonu ninche nedol enkitoo ai,

English: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
Masaai: Netum ninche eigeroki tiatua nkitanapat nchere, eitanapa apa Olaitoriani Musa pee etoni iltung'ana too lng'oborri to sirua to lapa liopishana,

English: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.
Masaai: Ore apa Yoab olayioni le Seruiya nemusu ajo Absalom edamu oltau lo laiguanani.

English: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaagilunore nanu iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kadumu nanu olkila lino lirrotianita apik enkomom ino, naisho nanu iloshon metoduaa emasipaisho ino, nedol nkitoriat enkurruna ino.

English: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
Masaai: “Oi lekua ooirrag too ndapashi naaikodo too lala loo lkanchaoni, neitoriori too lorikan dapashi, nenya ilkuoo le kerra too luaat nenya ilasho to lale;

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa ti ong'ata e Sinai,

English: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.
Masaai: o Maasia, o Bilgai, o Shemaia. Kulo apa ninche ilapolosak.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: itaasa ingok, lo kituaak le Israel! Ewuang'ie enkikonya o enkitorogonyare, nimbalilie esipata o esinyatisho; entapal eyararoto oo ltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
Masaai: Neisinanuo oleng neikilikuana moo obo, “Ai nanu sa Lo Kitok?”

English: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
Masaai: Ore olong'amaa oltung'ani supat te nkaraki naa supat, netum olerrinyore lo ltung'ani supat.

English: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
Masaai: nchere ore kuna olong'i e Purim neishiaakino neibung'i too nkatitin naatudung'okoki, anaa enaitanapa Mordekai ilo Yahudi o Esta enkitok o laiguanani Ilyahudi, o ina sii nairuko aaibung ninche maate o nkera enye mbaa naaipirta eenata o enkishirata enye.

English: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Lotan: Hori o Homan, ore apa enkanashe e Lotan naa Timna.

English: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the LORD, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
Masaai: Ore ilo ayioni le nkitok oo Siraeli nemor ina Arna nedek. Neyau ninche ninye enetii Musa. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Shelomit, entito e Dibri, oloshole Dan.

English: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
Masaai: ore too layiok le Merari, naa Asaia ilo kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena iip are o tikitam.

English: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
Masaai: ore ake pee eilep, engoro o laiguanani, ore ake pee kijoki iyie, ‘Kainyoo intae pee ishomo aataaniki enkang oleng to larrabal? Keitu intae iyiolouu aajo kengorisho te suntai.

English: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
Masaai: ng'ura kop te shumata toduaa, te ine wueji ino e nkitoo nesinya. Koree olokiyo lino o enkidimata ino? Ore eyieunoto ino o lng'ur lino neiboori te nanu.

English: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
Masaai: Amu kaarrinyoki nanu embiotisho, ore ilbaa linono naishiunye, Olaitoriani ojo, enkaraki nikitejo ninche iyie, ‘Oloiturrayioki, Sion ina, nemeetae oloshilaa!’

English: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
Masaai: Nimiyiololo enayooki atiu taaisere; anaa ainyioo enkishon inyi? Itiuwu ake anaa enkinuku naliooyu enkiti kata, kiti neishunye.

English: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field is man's life) to employ them in the siege:
Masaai: “Teniman amuat iyie enkanasa te nkata naado. nintayunye ninye olarrabal pee iya, mindaikie iyie ilkeek lenyena aiteleiki entolu shumata ninche; amu ndimidimi aainosa ninche kake midung'udung'u ninche aauroo. Ketaa ilkeek tiong'ata iltung'ana metaa imanimana intae aamuat?

English: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
Masaai: Teninos olmumai te Nkai ijo intayu toki, mimutie ake eitu ilak; amu meeta ninye enchipai too lmoda. Talaa ina ninosa olmumai.

English: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
Masaai: Naa keaku endama enaado oleng (Olaitoriani oyiolo ena), ime endama neme enkewarie, amu ore enoshi kata nikijo iyiook emuto, eton ake etii ewang'an.

English: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore emuro e tatene nincho olapolosani anaa enkishoroto naing'uaa olasar lino loo nkishorot inono e seriani.

English: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
Masaai: “Ena aaitaasa Olaitoriani te nkata natoduaa naaoru esulare te dukuya iltung'ana.”

English: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
Masaai: Iyie apa eisiliga loo papa; kisiliga apa ninche, nitokordua iyie ninche.

English: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
Masaai: Nejo Israel, “Ainyoo doi pee kinkuna inji aitamuoi aaliki ilo tung'ani aajoki iatata likae alashe?”

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni tomoni uni o are o iip are.

English: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
Masaai: Aainyo paa nanu inkilikuan? Inkilikuana ilaatoning'o enatiaaka. Eyiolo ninche enatejo.”

English: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
Masaai: Te neitu apa alotu airorie ninche, anaata meeta eng'oki; kake meekure taata eeta eneitolonyaki te ng'oki enye.

English: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.
Masaai: Neaku lalashera laainei, totona ake pooki tung'ani te nebo Enkai te mpukunoto apake niaata pee kimpoti.

English: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
Masaai: Neigilie ene uni ajoki, “Ainyoo kaa torroni eitayio? Eitu atumie nanu ninye entiyoto nairirikino keeya; metaa kaitame nalak.”

English: And they could not answer him again to these things.
Masaai: Nelaikino aatawaliki ina.

English: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku einyo olopeny enkaji aiken kutuk aji, ninteruru aaitashoo te boo ioshiosho kutuk aji ijojo, ‘Olaitoriani, tabolu iyiook.’ Newaliki ninye ntae ajoki, ‘Mayiolo nanu ajo kaji ng'uaa.’

English: We love him, because he first loved us.
Masaai: Kinyor iyiook ninye amu ninye otang'asa anyorru iyiook.

English: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
Masaai: Kaing'ae te intae olng'en neeta endamunoto? Nchoo eitoduaaya te nkishon enye sidai o to lkuaak lenye inkiaasin enyena te mborron e ng'eno.

English: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
Masaai: “Ore te ilo oisiligayu nintodol kewan ajo isiligayu; ore to ltung'ani le meeta eleyiata nintodol kewan ajo miata eleyiata;

English: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
Masaai: Neishooyo Olaitoriani Yohoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda apik atua inkaik enyena, te nebo embata oo masaa e nkaji e Nkai, neyau ninye ninche enkop e Shinari atua enkaji e Nkai enye, nepik nena masaa e wueji neshumieki ntokitin e tipat e nkai enye.

English: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge: for he taketh a man's life to pledge.
Masaai: “Meetae oltung'ani oen osoit oidong'ishoreki liabori aashu le shumata; amu keaku enkishui e teena.

English: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
Masaai: naa pesho aaserem ninche nanu, aa nkitanapat oo ltung'ana eitudupaa anaa ae ninche enkiteng'enare nasipa.’ ”

English: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
Masaai: Neiturrur apa Daudi Israel pooki ebaiki Shihor e Misiri o meetu enejing'ieki Hamat, pee eyau osanduku le Nkai te Kiriat-Yearim.

English: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
Masaai: Kepuo iloshon aaureyu enkarna o Laitoriani, neureyu ilaiguanak pooki enkitoo ino.

English: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
Masaai: Neiturrurro Ilfilisti nepuonu aaitayu olng'obor te Shunem; neiturrur Saul Israel pooki, neitayu ninche olng'obor te Gilboa.

English: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
Masaai: Kekilo pooki tung'ani nemeeta eng'eno, eitukurruaki pooki aitobirani le sahabu too nkitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin; amu ore nkitanyaanyukot enyena naa ine lejare, nemetii enkiyang'et atua ninche.

English: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
Masaai: Nebuaku to ltoilo le ngolon ejo, “Eturori, eturori Babilon kitok! Etaa emanyisho oo loiriruani, orrumat le pooki kiyang'et torrono orrumat le pooki motonyi torrono naibaisho.

English: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
Masaai: Ore teneitoriti entadekenya o enteipa nemuti; neish ninche intarasi meeta hoo oloyiolo.

English: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu nkitarruorot aainei, netii ing'ok aainei anaake dukuya nanu.

English: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu ninche eing'uaa ing'ok e nkaji e Yeroboam, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli. Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie lenye, neitobik Asher te Samaria.

English: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
Masaai: Emiaku naa taata iloosho murto anaa apa enatiu iloo papaai linyi, kake embelekenyakinoto Olaitoriani, nipuonunu ewueji enye sinyati, apa naitisinya ninye ntarasi, nisiayiayia Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee etum ina goro enye napi aibelekenyayu atapaasha intae.

English: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
Masaai: Ore te lelo torrok, naa keitashaiki nkuk e nkima o enchan oo soito; o lkutati opejisho olo aaku erubata e nkikompe enye.

English: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?
Masaai: “Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, imbonoki Gog tiaki, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong etoni iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli te seriani, aimiyiolouu intae?

English: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aishooi nkishorot o lasar opejori, nejoki Yehu olarriponi o lkituaak, “Entijing'aki entaar metuata; emincho oltung'ani obo eimisho.” Ore ake pee eidip aatar ninche too lalema, ore ilo arriponi o lkituaak nenang'aki ninche boo, nepuo olgilata li atua te nkaji e Baal.

English: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
Masaai: Keisilenisho oltung'ani torrono, nemelak ninye esile, kake keleng ilo supat neishooyo;

English: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche ninye to lpolosie le njung'ore enye te Timat-heres, ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, te moikuape oldoinyo le Gaash.

English: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu te nelakua, nekuet aserem ninye.

English: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
Masaai: Neitayu olaiguanani Solomon iltung'ana oas esiaai te Israel pooki; ore lelo tung'ana naa nkalifuni tomoni uni.

English: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
Masaai: Neitemer menye te naisho oo sabibu ina kewarie nasuju, nedumunye entito kiti aisiap menye, neitu eyiolou Lot enkata naisiapa ninye o enkata natudumunye.

English: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
Masaai: Ore Sikri ilo tung'ani magilani le Efraim, nesesekuan Maaseia, olayioni lo laiguanani, o Asikam ilo kitok le nkaji e nkitoo, o Elkana ilo osujaki te nkitoo o laiguanani.

English: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
Masaai: nchere meeta kata apa nemeitamei Kristo, o sii nchere ninye ong'as apiu to lootuata, pee eibalakinye ewang'an iltung'ana o loreren.”

English: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
Masaai: Neyiolou nabo kata ninye, nejo, “Olkila lo layioni lai; einosa eng'ues entim ninye; maing'ash tukul ajo etumuta Yosef ing'uesi.”

English: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
Masaai: Eikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino tubula oleng, te siaai oo nkaik inono, o too lng'anayio lo sesen lino, o too lng'anayio loo nkishu inono, o too lng'anayio le nkop ino; amu keitoki Olaitoriani ashipakino pee kintubul iyie, anaa apa enatishipakine loo papaai lino.

English: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
Masaai: Ore ninye apa to ldoinyo le Horeb nintagoro intae Olaitoriani, negorokino intae Olaitoriani oleng eyieu eidaikie intae.

English: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore taata anaata atudumua enkaina ai naaosh iyie o ltung'ana linono to lmeitai naa anaata kiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa enkop.

English: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura, ilo iyie adol teina olong, tinilo iyie olgilata liatua aisudori.”

English: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
Masaai: Pee eitabari ororei apa oiroro, ajo, “Ore te lelo likinchoo maata olaiturrayie.”

English: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
Masaai: pee itilitili kuldo leme ile ncholuek inyi, nemeitoki aaku oltung'ani ingarakinono.

English: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
Masaai: Ore apa olpisiai obo lo losho le Manase neishoo Musa enkop te Bashan; kake ore olikae pisiai eishoo ninche Yoshua enkop te mbata oo lalashera lenye te nkop natii o loo ntoluo le Yordan. Ore ake pee eisho Yoshua ninche meshomo nkang'itie enye nemayian ninche, nejoki,

English: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
