English: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
Masaai: Ore naa taata Enkai e seriani nanyaaka ashuku Olaitoriani Yesu aitung'uaa ilootuata, ilo shekut kitok loo nkerra, te ilo sarge lo sotua loo ntarasi,

English: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Mintoki aiko neijia! Ara nanu osinka te nebo iyie o lalashera linono lelo oibonok le Enkai, o lelo ooibung irorei le na mbuku. Enkai teserema.”

English: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
Masaai: Entudumu nkonyek inyi eng'ura shumata, nirrugogo aaing'or enkop ti abori; amu keish shumata anaa empuruo, neish enkop anaa olkila, ore lelo oomanya ninye naa keye anaa lojong'a; kake keaku enjeunoto ai enoo ntarasi, ore ina kordunoto ai nemeish ae kata.

English: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
Masaai: Metaa, oi iyie Oholiba, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kadumakino isanchan linono limbelekenyakine te ngoro mikitigilunore iyie eing'uaa nkaloli pooki.

English: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Masaai: Amu etujurruo neibelekenyunye aing'uaa ntorrok pooki naataasa, meeta nchere peyie meton eishu, meye ninye.

English: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
Masaai: Neitu ninche eshilaa ina, nepuo pooki nkolati enye, nelo likae enkurma enye, nelo likai emirare enye.

English: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
Masaai: Etabolo Olaitoriani ewueji enye neshumieki imasaa o larrabal, neitayu imasaa o larrabal engoro enye napi, amu eeta Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani esiaai naas tiatua enkop oo Lkaldayo.

English: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
Masaai: Ore te nkishui ai e pesho, natoduaa pooki toki; eetae oltung'ani supat orrorri te sipata enye, neetae oltung'ani torrono oitoodor enkishui enye te yasata enye torrono.

English: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore enkiborra inyi oo nkonyek naa keitalakuni te intae, ninapinapa elaakinoto tenkaraki eng'oki oo inkitanyaanyukot inyi oo nkaitin nemeishu; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore iloshon kumok o loreren oogol naa kepuonu aaserem Olaitoriani loo lororani te Yerusalem, neomonu omom to Laitoriani.

English: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
Masaai: Iyie nanu asaru, Olaitoriani; mikincho ae kata nanu maaitukurruni!

English: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
Masaai: nejoki Isaak ninche, “Ainyoo peyie ietuo enatii nadolita ajo aikimbaba intae nanu, nikitaaraitie aitung'uaa ate?”

English: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
Masaai: ‘Aing'ae ele oisudoo enkikoo meeta eng'eno?’ ore enkaraki ina atejo imbaa neitu aning'u, intokitin enking'asia te nanu, neitu apa aidip atayiolo.

English: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
Masaai: Ore te ina kop nagum naa Eshtaol, o Sora, o Ashna,

English: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie te Babilon olaunoni, o ilo oibung olalem le nkisampuare te nkata enkisampuare; ore te nkaraki ilo alem lo loitorogonyani, keibelekenyakino pooki ng'ae iltung'ana lenye maate, neisikaki pooki ng'ae enkop enye makewan.

English: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Neijia aiko ainyal olwuasa le Yuda o ilo owuasa kitok le Yerusalem.

English: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
Masaai: Ore akenya teina kata nejokini kulo tung'ana o Yerusalem, “Osiwuo oirowua oing'uaa inkisiajat naaika to lpurkel eing'or enkalo entito oo ltung'ana laainei neme pee ekut arashu esil.

English: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
Masaai: ore to losho le Asheri naa Setur olayioni le Mikael;

English: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
Masaai: Anaa apa too napa olong'i nitupukunye te Misiri, kaitodol nanu ninche mbaa e nking'asia.

English: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naapishana neye ina kerai. Neureyu isinkan le Daudi eliki ninye nchere etua enkerai; amu etejo ninche, “Ng'ura ore apa eton eishu enkerai, nikirorie iyiook ninye, neitu ninye ening iyiook; kaji naa kinko ti nikijoki ninye inchere etua enkerai? Eidim ninye aitaasa kewan ae torrono.”

English: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
Masaai: Keikurrukur iloshon anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok, kake kelo ninye aisikong ninche, neilanyisho ninche aaisik, nepuo ninche anaa suut too ldoinyio netiu anaa enterit nakutita olkutati.

English: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
Masaai: “Naa intorioki enkomom ino ina manata namuati Yerusalem, metii toki enkaina ino; nimbonoki ina anasa.

English: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
Masaai: Itipika iyie ilpolosien lemegiroo ninche, pee meigil ninche aaiput enkop.

English: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
Masaai: Ore peyie aidip nanu atadotu ninche, naitoki nanu aing'urrie ninche, naitoki nanu ayau ninche pooki ng'ae enjung'ore enye o pooki ng'ae enkop pooki.

English: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
Masaai: Ore enaba anaa enayieu Olaitoriani neas ninye te keper o te nkop, ti atua inaaiposha o too neegut pooki.

English: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, entoning ena, intae kulo ooinosa osina, kulo ootemerate neme te naisho:

English: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajoki iltung'ana, “Entisinya ate; amu ore taisere naa keas Olaitoriani inenking'asia ti atua intae.”

English: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Sakai, naa iip naapishana o ntomoni ile.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Masaai: ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o lkineji imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai.

English: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
Masaai: Ore ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo nejo, “Ng'ura, ekaitaa intokitin pooki ng'ejuko.” Nejo sii, “Ngero ena, amu ore kulo rorei naa keisiligayu nesipa.”

English: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
Masaai: nepik ilkeek aaitobiraki enkima; ore lelo ayiok le Aron apolosak nepik nena rubat enkima elukunya, o eilata aaitobiraki te nchumata lelo keek ootii enkima te nchumata olperere lo lasar;

English: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.
Masaai: Ore eitayu ninche nena pisai apa naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani, netum Hilkia olapolosani embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani apa naaishoruaki aaimunye Musa.

English: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
Masaai: ore kulo ooipotoki nkarn ninche apa ilkituaak too lmareita lenye, ore nkajijik oo loo menye nebul oleng,

English: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
Masaai: Ilo tung'ani otorikuo, eidipa ataasa ine nking'asia o nkitoduaat te Misiri o te naiposha nanyokie, o ti ong'ata, larin artam.

English: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Parosh era esiana enye nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
Masaai: Amu kayiolo ajo, metii entoki supat namanya atua nanu, aa taa osesen lai, amu ore hoo naata eyiolounoto naasie esupat, maata enkidimata.

English: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
Masaai: Ng'ura kayau nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e moikuape. Naiturrur ninche aitung'uaa ilubot enkop naalakua, ore tiatua ninche netii olmodooni o lmaima, o enkitok nairoshiwuo o enasaisai, tenebo; olturrur kitok, keshukunye ninche ene.

English: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii, shomo tiaaki ile Lawi, ‘Ti niyaya too ltung'ana le Israel ina matua e tomon naishoo nanu intae te ninche pee eaku enjung'ore inyi nintokiki naa sii intae aaitayu olasar te ina aaisho Olaitoriani, ematua e tomon napukunye ematua e tomon.

English: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
Masaai: “Kitapong'ori iyiook nikitogolong'utua, neitu iyie ipalaki iyiook.

English: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
Masaai: olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Merariot,

English: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
Masaai: Esipa ketaana enjeunoto enye te lelo ooure ninye, pee etum enkitoo atobiko te nkop ang.

English: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
Masaai: Ore oyarata pooki loo lmeneng'a o nkuruon, o nkong'at pooki naalakua aabaya ereyiet e Kidron, ometabaiki olpijata le nkishomi oo mbartan te nkalo enkilepunoto enkolong naa keiteng'elakini Olaitoriani. Meigili ae kata aadotu aashu eibelekenyi aanang'aa ntarasi.”

English: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
Masaai: (kulo apa ilayiok le Lea ootoikio ninye Yakobo te Padan-aram, tenebo entito enye Dina; neaku pooki ilayiok o ntoyie enyena iltung'ana tomoni uni o kuni).

English: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
Masaai: Ajoki ntae, te nemeisho duoo te nkaraki naa olchore lenye, kake ore enkaraki naitirrishaka olikae, einyototo ake aisho naaba anaa naayieu.

English: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
Masaai: Ee inchoo ina kewarie eaku olupi; emincho oltoilo le nchipai ening'i tiatua.

English: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
Masaai: Ore te nebo ninche etii Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo o Yosef, o ng'otonye layiok le Sebedayo.

English: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
Masaai: Amu ore too lapaitin oopishana, eaku keturoo ina aji e Israel ninche peyie etum aaipoo ina kop.

English: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
Masaai: “Emisarkionie ate tiae nabo e kuna baa, amu te kuna pooki eisarkionie ate lelo oshon pooki laaraa nanu te dukuya intae.

English: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
Masaai: Neaku taa, ore hoo naigeroko nanu intae, eitu aigeroki intae te nkaraki ilo oinyalishe, neme sii te nkaraki ilo oinyalaki, kake te nkaraki pee aitodol intae te dukuya Enkai nchere irowuarere ijing'ijing'i enkalo ang.

English: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
Masaai: neaku kaitaas nanu ina aji naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, naa ninye isiligigi, oine wueji apa naishoo nanu intae o loo papaai linyi anaa enaitaasa Shilo.

English: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
Masaai: Imbung'a osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, anaa apa enaaitanapa, ninya imukateni neitu eisuijieki too nkolong'i naapishana te nkolong natudung'oki olapa le Abibu amu te ninye apa itupukutuo aaing'uaa Misiri. Meetae oltung'ani olotu dukuya nanu too nkaik naarook.

English: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
Masaai: Ee, aimeitashe enkaji ai aiko neijia te Nkai? Amu eitobira ninye te nebo nanu osotua loo ntarasi, eishiaakino too ntokitin pooki netagolieki. Amu aimeidimie ninye metubula eretoto ai pooki o eyieunoto ai?

English: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
Masaai: Kake eitu ening'u ninche ina natejo, neureyu sii eikilikuan.

English: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
Masaai: Tawaliki olmodai te risioroto enaikununo emodai enye, pee meng'enu ake too nkonyek enyena makewan.

English: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
Masaai: Kake eibelekenya Enkai neishooyo ninche meteserema lakir le shumata anaa enatisiraki aajo te mbuku oo loibonok le Enkai, ‘Ei nanu nchoo ng'uesi naayieng'i o, te lelo arin pokira artam ti ong'ata, na aji e Siraeli?

English: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Nedumunye lelo tung'ana apa ootii olnukata, neisarisaru aakuetiki Gibea, nepuo lelo tung'ana ootii olnukata aar enkanasa tenepi o lalam.

English: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
Masaai: naa kaomon nanu Papa, naa keisho intae likae Autaroni metobiko te nebo intae intarasi;

English: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Masaai: o Eber o Peleg o Reu;

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar opejori;

English: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
Masaai: Etoliyiote nkoitoi sapuki meekure eetae olalotoni. Etigile olning'o, netemenayioki ilchakenini, meetae oltung'ani oshilaa olikae.

English: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Teneishunye ilarin ntomoni naapishana te Babilon, namutan nanu intae, naa kaitabaya nanu te intae enkisiligata ai narrinyu intae ayau ene wueji.

English: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
Masaai: Anaata iyiook kinchiunye Babilon, kake eitu ninye eishiu tung'uai ninye, maape iyiook oltung'ani ake enkop enye makewan; amu ore endung'okinoto enye e nkiguana netabaikia shumata netudumuaki aailepie omeitabaikini nkatampo.

English: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o are apa Amon pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oare te Yerusalem.

English: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
Masaai: enkong'u te nkong'u, olalae to lalae, enkaina te nkaina, enkeju te nkeju,

English: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
Masaai: inaa ninche apa ipuoyieyie isujitata olkerreti le na kop, nisujitata ilo kitok le ngolon o loing'ang'e, ina kiyang'et naisiaaisho taata ti atua nena kera naagolong'u.

English: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
Masaai: Neinyototo arik enkerai o ng'otonye nepuo enkop e Israel.

English: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Kohas: Amram, Ishar, Hebron o Usiel, era ilarin le nkishui e Kohas iip o tomoni uni o okuni.

English: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Masaai: O Amasai olayioni lenye, o Asaria olayioni lenye o Yotan olayioni lenye,

English: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
Masaai: Amu ore ina rubata e tomon oo ltung'ana le Israel naitarasaki ninche Olaitoriani anaa olasar, aishoo nanu ile Lawi metaa enjung'ore; metaa atejo nanu ti alo ninche nchere metum enjung'ore ti atua iltung'ana loo siraeli.”

English: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
Masaai: Eetae apa olarrabal ogol too Lfilisti too nkolong'i pooki e Saul, naa ore ake pee edol Saul oltung'ani ogol, arashu oltung'ani opi, neitinyikaki ninye kewan enye.

English: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, naa ketiu ile Misiri anaa ng'oroyiok, neikirikira te dukuya ina aina naikirikirie Olaitoriani loo lororani ninche.

English: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
Masaai: Entoning ena lo oreren! Enchoru nkiyiaa, intae pooki oomanya enkop,

English: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo te keper aashu te nkop aashu tiabori enkop oidima atabolo ilo piyayati aashu aing'ura atua.

English: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
Masaai: Netamanya ninche atua, nikiteshetakita ninche ewueji sinyati, tenkaraki enkarna ino, ejo,

English: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
Masaai: Metaa aaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto e supatisho ai, te risioroto e ina nemaiduruk nanu too nkonyek enyena.

English: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing ninche atua naa kejing olkitok atua tenebo ninche; naa teneipang ninche boo neipang sii ninye boo.

English: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
Masaai: Etigila Olaitoriani eng'udi eilo torrono, ina ng'udi e nkitoo oo looitoreisho,

English: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
Masaai: netum nkerra inono emanyisho ti atua ninye; te supatisho ino, na Ai, intoti iyie ilaisinak.

English: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
Masaai: Ore olasar leilo torrono naa olminong, kebaa elusoo eitayio to ltau torrono?

English: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: “Ore kenya teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaaku nanu Enkai oo lmareita pooki le Israel, neaku ninche ilaainei.”

English: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
Masaai: “Netiooyo ina kata olayioni lenye botor te nkurma; ore pee elotu anyikaki ina aji, nening'oo osinkolio eranyishoi.

English: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaji enye naa keimis adoiki keeya, ore inkoitoi enyena nepuo enetii ilootuata.

English: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
Masaai: ore ene uni neeta imbartan naaibor, ore eniong'uan neeta imbartan pusi naata iltipot.

Masaai: Neitoki Esta airorie olaiguanani, nebatata too nkejek enyena nesai ninye too lkiyio pee eiwuang'ie entorroni apa naitobira Haman Olagagi o nena naaiguanua te nkaraki Ilyahudi.

English: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
Masaai: Ore olpolosie loo Lamori nelo te nkilepunoto e Akrabim ebaiki Sela neilep.

English: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;
Masaai: Neipotu Samuel iltung'ana meiturrurrokinoto Olaitoriani te Mispa.

English: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Masaai: Keaku eishoi enye magilani te nkop; ore eishoi e lelo supati naa kemayiani.

English: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
Masaai: Neisarrisar Abigail, nedumunye neked osikiria, neisiaai ninye nkaisiaayiak enyena imiet; nesujaa ninye lelo kiliku le Daudi, neaku enkitok enye.

English: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
Masaai: Nejoki olkitok lenye, ‘Ee osinka supat laisilig, itaa oloisiligayu too nkuti, kaaisho intoria kumok; tijing'a eng'ida o lkitok lino.’

English: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Idolita esiamo kinding'akino, nintoki ajo, ‘Ai ng'ae laaiseyie?’ ”

English: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
Masaai: Ilarin artam iyie ntotio ninche tiong'ota, neitu elau toki neitu emuta nkilani enye neitu ejeyu nkejek enye.

English: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
Masaai: Ae Lhebrania ninche? Ara sii nanu. Ae Siraeli ninche, ara sii nanu. Ae leishoi e Abraham ninche, ara sii nanu

English: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Masaai: naa kaitame nanu nena kitarruorot enye te ng'udi; naitame entorroni enye te nkitamioto nairoua;

English: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Minos iyie osarge pee eitobirari mbaa inono pooki o noo nkera inono itulusoyie. Tenias iyie esidai too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
Masaai: naa kaun nanu ninye, aunoki kewan ti atua ena kop. Naa kaing'urrie nanu ilo leitu eing'urrieki, naa kajoki nanu lelo leme iltung'ana laainei, ‘Irara intae iltung'ana laainei,’ nejo ninye, ‘Ira iyie Enkai ai.’ ”

English: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
Masaai: Ore te ilo shaat nintodol iyie kewan ajo ira sii iyie shaat, ore ilo lemeitoriori nintodol iyie ajo ira olo larrabal.

English: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
Masaai: Ore ilo leeiking'a indim iyie aitalaa; kake ore entoki ino naba anaa enaisilenoyie olalashe lino tapalaki.

English: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
Masaai: Kepuoi aaibalunye ina masipaisho ino, nepuoi aadol enkurruna ino. Kaitalaku nanu elap, nemaleku oltung'ani.

English: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: “Ore pooki ng'ae opurroo oltung'ani, pee emir arashu etumi ninye ti atua imasaa enyena, neari metua.

English: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.
Masaai: Kake atoning'o nanu nchere indim iyie atolimu nkibalakinot niwuang'ie enyamali. Ore naa taata ti nindim iyie aisoma ele kigeroto nikintayiolo nanu enkibalakinoto, nikinchopokini olkila sintet, nikipiki olpisiai le sahabu aaitaman emurt ino, niaaku oliokuni oitoreisho te nkitoria.”

English: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Esau naa Elfas, o Reul, o Yeush, Yalaam o Kora.

English: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo tung'ana leilo kerenket ooetuo te yararoto eing'uaa lelo apa ootarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon arik eenata te Babilon. Etorrinyunye ninche aapuonu Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki tung'ani enkang enye makewan.

English: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
Masaai: ore to lapa liopishana, te nkolong e tomon o naapishana o lapa, nedou esafina airrag te nchumata o ldoinyo le Ararat.

English: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
Masaai: Neaku etegelutua ltung'ana aare: Yosef oji Barsabas (neji sii Yustus), o Matias.

English: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
Masaai: Nearaa ninche iloiriruani kumok, neelie eilata iltamueyia kumok neishiunye.

English: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
Masaai: Ena ejo Olaitoriani tialo Ammon: “Aimeeta Israel ilayiok? Aimeeta ninye oloyooki ajung? Kainyoo naa pee ewa Milkom Gad, ore iltung'ana lenyena netamanya nkanas enyena?

English: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak aajoki olaiguanani, “Nchoo ele tung'ani metaari metua, amu eitashalita ninye nkaik e lelo sikarini oo tung'uayioki tiatua ena anasa, o nkaik oo ltung'ana pooki, tena kiroroto nairorie ninye ninche kulo rorei. Amu ore ele tung'ani mme olmabarishoi le kulo tung'ana eing'oru, kake enkitamioto enye.”

English: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
Masaai: laa olomoni te nkaji e likae oji Simon, olaitobirani loo lonito, omanya embata e naiposha.”

English: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
Masaai: Ore papaai lenye, neirriwaki kuna; isirkon tomon naairoto too ntokitin sidain e Misiri, o lipong'a tomon oo sirkon naanapita entapa, o imukateni, o ntokitin naanya papaai lenye te nkoitoi.

English: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
Masaai: Neriku ninche enkaji enye, neisho endaa, neshipa oleng o enkaji enye pooki, eiruko Enkai.

English: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
Masaai: Eliaba le Shaalbon, olayioni le Yashen, Yonatan,

English: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki ote nkishui ino pooki o te ng'eno ino pooki.

English: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
Masaai: Mme iyiook, Olaitoriani, mme iyiook, kake enkarna ino nchoo enkisisa, te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno o sipat inono!

English: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.
Masaai: Netii apa imisai are atua, netii imisai ong'uan oriong, te nchoto e ina kishomi, imisai isiet, naa te nchumata enye eyieng'ieki ilasarri.

English: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
Masaai: Metaa atubukoko nanu engoro ai shumata ninche te nkaraki osarge oibukoitie ninche te nkop, te nkaraki nena aitin nemeishu naisarkionie ninche.

English: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aiguana iltung'ana, negelu lelo oopuo aaranyaki Olaitoriani neisis ninye eishopito ilkilani sinyat, nepuo ninche te dukuya enjore, nejo “Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi.”

English: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
Masaai: Naa eikimpotipoto intae nanu nikipoununu aaomon nanu, naa kaning nanu intae.

English: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
Masaai: Ore apa too nkonyek oo loo menye neas ninye enenking'asia, tiatua enkop e Misiri, ti ong'ata e Sion.

English: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
Masaai: ore te siadi ina neipang'aki Yakobo, neitoki ilkipaareta pooki;

English: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
Masaai: Nejoki Agripa Festo, “Kayieu o nanu nainining ilo tung'ani.” Nejoki, “Taaisere iyiooki aning ninye.”

English: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
Masaai: ore te nebo ninye netii iltung'ana enkalifu ooing'uaa Benchamen. Ore Siba osinka le nkaji e Saul, te nebo ilayiok lenyena tomon o imiet, o sinkan lenyena tikitam, nekuet aadoyio aapuo Yordan dukuya olaiguanani,

English: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
Masaai: Nesesekuan Abija o ltung'ana lenyena iltung'ana kumok oleng; neaku etuata too Siraeli iltung'ana gelunot nkalifuni iip imiet.

English: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
Masaai: Neipang'u ti atua ina aji e Enkai lelo malaika oopishana ooata ilmeita oopishana, eishopito nkilani nemeiduruk naawang oleng neenita too lgooitie lenye inkimeitani e sahabu.

English: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto the LORD.
Masaai: Kake eitu eitiship ina bae Samuel ina kata pee ejo ninche, “Nchoo iyiook olaiguanani pee eitore iyiook.” Neomon Samuel Olaitoriani.

English: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
Masaai: Enchom, enchom, empang'a enchom idie, eminyikaki ake entoki nemesinya; empang'a entung'uai ninye, entisinya ate, intae lelo oonapita imasaa o Laitoriani.

English: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
Masaai: o Elishama, o Eliada, o Elifelet.

English: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
Masaai: meigil ae kata ninye ashukokino enkaji enye nemeitoki ewueji enye ayiolo ninye ae kata.

English: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house.
Masaai: Neisho Hesekia ninye enkosholai pooki apa nanotoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o tiatua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:

English: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Te neme olaasani loo ntorrok ele tung'ani, anaata eitu kirikoki iyie.”

English: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i kumok, netumo Lyahudi aaiguana peyie ear ninye metua;

English: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitanap olapolosani Yehoida ilarikok le njore laa ninche apa ooitasheiki esikari ajoki, “Eyau ninye eimunye erishata oo ltimito naa iariara pooki tung'ani osuj ninye to lalem.” Amu etejo apa ilo apolosani, “Mincho eari ninye metua tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Neitayu Enkai ing'uesi e nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye o nkishu te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop te risioroto empukunoto enye. Nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

English: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
Masaai: Naa tenepolos ake ninye oltung'ani olasar le seriani apolosaki Olaitoriani, pee eitabaya olmumai aashu tenaa olasar lo lpela, oing'uaa eluaata oo nkishu aashu eluaata oo ntare, naa pooki ake pee eng'amaroyu naa tenaa bayaroti nemetii entioto atua ninye.

English: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
Masaai: Netum Yosef enkidetidet, ore peyie eliki ilalashera lenyena neibayu ninche ninye oleng'.

English: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
Masaai: Kebaa elus lelo oomanya inkajijik esarng'ab laa ore olkitamanyunoto lenye netii atua enterit, lelo oorrarri anaa olasai.

English: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
Masaai: Neitanapisho Daudi pee eiturrurri tenebo iltung'ana pooki omon ootii atua enkop e Israel, nepik iladung'ok loo soito, pee eitobir isoito oogueta ooshetieki enkaji e Nkai.

English: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu lelo tung'ana enetii Yesu nejoki, “Yohana Olaibatisani oirriwua iyiook enitii ejo, ‘Aa iyie doi apa olotu anaa ai kianyu likae?’ ”

English: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoida olapolosani ayau lelo kituaak le njore apa oitasheiki enjore, ejoki ninche, “Iyau ninye mpang'unye erishata oo lturrurri. Ore pooki ng'ae osuju ninye neari to lalem metua.” Amu etejo apa ilo apolosani, “Emiar ninye metua tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
Masaai: Eibala ng'ok e kulikae tung'ana neutu edungokinoto e nkiguana, kake ore kulikae te siadi eyooki aaibalayu.

English: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
Masaai: Kimbalie iyiook entorroni ang, iyie Olaitoriani, o entorroni oo loo papa lang, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki tialo iyie.

English: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
Masaai: Neeta apa Shaharaim ilayiok te nkop e Moab ina kata eidipa ataarai nkituaak enyena, Hushim o Baara.

English: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
Masaai: Neitoki te siadi aapuonu nekua toyie aajo, ‘Lo kitok, Lo, kitok, tabolu iyiook.’

English: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
Masaai: Netii sii lelo oojo, “Kisilenoitie mpisai te kodi o laiguanani te nkaraki nkurman ang o nkurman ang oo sabibu.

English: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ena, eng'urai airriwaki intae iloibonok o ltung'ana ng'eni o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat; niariara kulikae, metuata nisheshe, niariara kulikae too nkajijik inyi e ntumo, niaraa kulikae too nkang'itie aaisikie;

English: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
Masaai: Amu ore enkop naok enkare nashaiki nkatitin kumok, nebulaki endaa naret lelo ooturokini, netum emayianata naing'uaa Enkai.

English: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;
Masaai: Ore ina kata neshomo enkitoo e Nkai e Israel aing'uaa lelo kerubi laa ninche etotonie teine nejing'ieki ina aji, neipot ilo tung'ani oishopito enkila napuyiapui, ilo oota entoki naigerishoreki te matua enye.

English: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
Masaai: Ore ilo orora pooki ooetuo enking'urare, pee edol enatotiwuo, nerrinyo nkang'itie enye eoshiosh ilgooitie eisina.

English: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
Masaai: ore hoo netem aitoipoo enkiba enye te nkeleekisho, ekeibalunyeki intorrok enyena to lturrur.

English: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu engorikinoto oo ntokitin pooki sidain, kake meeta inkitanapat inono eng'orikinoto.

English: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
Masaai: kake ore pee ebau Roma naalilitu o maanoto.

English: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
Masaai: Neyau Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia nena pooki eitasheiki Mitrehat ilo ashumani, laa ninye oikenaka ninye pooki Sheshbasa ilo kitok le Yuda.

English: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore to losho le Ruben neishori Beser te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Yahas te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
Masaai: negilunore lelo doinyo adoru pooki, negilunore nena doinyo naaitokoos pooki;

English: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
Masaai: pee etum iltung'ana aatodol neyiolou, nedamu neyiolou te nebo, nchere enkaina o Laitoriani nataasa ina, ilo Obo Osinya le Israel oitobira ina.

English: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
Masaai: Kulo ile ishoi e Shem. Ore peyie eaku Shem oloo larin iip nabo, etaa ninye menye le Arpakashad ilarin aare anaa neishunye oloirrag le nkare,

English: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
Masaai: Neisum ninye ina kitanapata eing'orita olkurroto eipirare kishomi e Nkare eiteru tadekenya enasirie o metabaiki dama eipire enkolong, te dukuya iltung'ana lelo lewa o ng'oruo o ltung'ana pooki ooidim aatoning'u nening'u lelo tung'ana too nkiyiaa enye ina buku oo nkitanapat.

English: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kagil nanu enkaji e nkata enkirobi o enkaji enkata enkirouaj; ore nkajijik naaikodo too lala loo lkanchaoni nerruoyo, ore nkajijik kituaak neidaaya,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.
Masaai: Ore taisere, ina kata elaku Pashur Yeremia aitayu too lpisia, nejoki Yeremia ninye, “Mikintoki iyie Olaitoriani ajo enkarna ino Pashur, kake enkuretisho te pooki shoto.

English: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu enkilashilash enye, Olaitoriani ojo: ore enkitoo enye naa elejare, ore nkiaasin enyena naa elejare.

English: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
Masaai: “Nchoo iltung'ana le Israel eibung Pasaka te rishata enye nategeluaki.

English: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore ilkilang'ilang'eta pooki le shumata na kaitomisimis te shumata iyie, napik enaimin shumata enkop ino ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua,

English: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiruk Enkerai e Nkai neeta shakeni ti atua kewan. Ore ilo lemeiruk Enkai neitaa ninye olalejani, amu eitu eiruk shakenisho naitadedeyie Enkai te Nkerai enye.

English: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
Masaai: Ore ilo siwuo olotu te nkitanapata ai naa kegol oleng te nanu. Naa Nanu ilo oiro tendung'okinoto e nkiguana enye.”

English: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
Masaai: Tasioki tawalikiaki nanu, Olaitoriani! Amu eiterria oltau lai! Mikisudorie nanu enkomom ino, matiu ake anaa lelo oopuo aajing engumoto.

English: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
Masaai: nemeyookini aajo, ‘She, nena natii ene!’ aashu ‘Neidia!’ amu ng'ura, etii enkitoria e Nkai atua intae.”

English: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

English: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

English: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
Masaai: Neeta apa ltung'ani oji Mika enkaji oo nkaitin. Neitobiru ninye nkitanyaanyukot o enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak; neput olayioni obo loo layiok lenyena aitaa olapolosani lenye.

English: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

English: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
Masaai: Iyie oishoo ilmang'ati laainei meibelekenyata aailanyisho, ore lelo apa laaiba naidaikie nanu ninche.

English: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

English: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
Masaai: Neitanap pee meliki likae tung'ani; kake ore anaa pee eitanap ajoki melikioo, neitulus ninye eitadaraa ina.

English: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

English: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
Masaai: Ninye doi ele oewuo te nkare o to sarge, Yesu Kristo, leme te nkare ake eewuo kake te nebo enkare o sarge.

English: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Najoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna?” Naawaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore kuna mowuarak naa ninche naaidapasha Yuda, o Israel o Yerusalem.”

English: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

English: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

Masaai: Kake ore iyie, intasho tene te mbata nanu, pee aaliki nkitanapat pooki, o nkikoot o nkiguanat nilo aiteng'en ninche, pee epuo ninche aas teina kop nalo nanu aisho ninche.’

English: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
Masaai: Ore apa olning'o lai lo sotua o ninye, naa olning'o lo osotua le nkishui o eseriani, naishoo apa nanu ninye kuna peyie etum ninye aturia; naaureyu ninye nanu, neitashe te nkanyit euriata e nkarna ai.

English: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

English: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

English: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.

English: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.
Masaai: Near olaiguanani le Babilon ilayiok le Sedekia te Ribla; metuata te dukuya nkonyek enyena; near olaiguanani le Babilon ilkituaak pooki le Yuda metuata.

English: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children, saying,
Masaai: Eeta apa Ahab ilayiok ntomoni naapishana te Samaria. Neiger Yehu mpala airriwaa Samaria, airriwaki ilaitoriak le nkanasa, o lpayiani, o laing'urak loo layiok le Ahab, ejo,

English: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it, and performed it, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kapik nanu atua intae enkiyang'et ai, nipiuu intae, napik intae enkop inyi maate; ina peyie iyiolouu inchere Nanu ilo Aitoriani, oiroro, nataasa ina, ejo Olaitoriani.”

English: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
Masaai: Kake etiaka Abram olaiguanani le Sodom, “Ainosa olmumai to Laitoriani Enkai natii shumata aisul, oitobira shumata o enkop,

Masaai: Nelotu ninye ataaniki ninye; nejo ina kitok, “Ira iyie Yoab?” Newaliki ninye, “Ara nanu.” Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Toning'o irorei le sinka ino.” Newaliki ninye, “Aning'ito nanu.”

English: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

English: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
Masaai: Ore engoro napi o laiguanani netiu anaa olkilikuai le keeya, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en naa keitiship ninye.

English: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
Masaai: O ilo moti obo, o lelo mong'i pokira tomon oare ootii abori enye.

English: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

English: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

English: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
Masaai: Naa kakua einosaka olmumai ajo, mejing enkiyeng'iyeng'ata enye ntarasi, ei kulikae leme lelo ootogolong'akita?

English: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

English: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.

English: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

English: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
Masaai: Neitagol ninye nkejek aainei anaa entarakuet, naagolie ninye mabatata too neeika.

English: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shimei naa: Yahat, o Sina o Yeush, o Beria. Ilayiok apa le Shimei kulo pokira oong'uan.

English: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip airorie Saul, neibung'a oltau le Yonatan oltau le Daudi, nenyorru Yonatan ninye anaa oltau lenye kewan.

English: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki ninchoo elo too nkaik inono, ilo tung'ani apa laiteng'elaka enkidaaroto, ore enkaraki ina, keinosieki enkishui ino enkishui enye. Neinosieki enkishui oo ltung'ana linono enkishui oo ltung'ana lenyena.’ ”

English: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Ore pee edol lelo airukok Lyahudi neing'asia, lelo taa ooiriamunore Petero, te nkaraki natubukokoki sii ninche Loreren enkishorunoto e Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
Masaai: Ore taata te naa ketumoyu apa bayaroti te mpolosare oo le Lawi, amu te ninye etang'amutua ilo orere nkitanapat, ainyoo eitokini aayieunye likae apolosani olotu to lkerreti le Aron?

English: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
Masaai: ‘Esipa meetae hoo obo le lelo tung'ana apa ooileputua aapuonu te Misiri, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep olo adol ina kop apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, enkaraki neitu ninche aaunokino aasuj nanu;

English: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
Masaai: Ng'ura roruat enyena too ldoinyo, eilo oyau ilomon supati, ilo olimu eseriani! Imbung'a isiruai linono iyie, Yuda, intabai ilmuma linono, amu mikingil aekata olarruoni agilunore iyie, eiwuang'ieki ninye tukul.

English: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
Masaai: amaa adolita ajo ore Abraham naa keaku olosho kitok magilani, ore iloshon pooki le nkop kemayian ate te ninye?

English: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
Masaai: Nejo Yeremia, “Elejare ina: maisik nanu alo enkalo oo Lkaldayo.” Kake mening Irija ninye, neibung Yeremia neyau ninye enetii ilkituaak.

English: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu endoinyo, neya nena tokitin too nkaik enye, nepik ninche atua enkaji enye, neisho lelo tung'ana meshomo, nedumunye ninche aapuo.

English: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
Masaai: Ena doi ajo nanu; ore nena Kitanapat naaetuo enyaakita aalusoo larin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni, nemeidim ninche aaiwuang'ie osotua oidipa Enkai atuno, nemeidim aaibooi enkisiligata enye pee meaku.

English: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
Masaai: Neyiolouni ina bae te Yopa pooki, neiruk ilkumok Olaitoriani.

English: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
Masaai: Nedumunye ina kitok alo te risioroto o rorei leilo tung'ani le Nkai. Nedumunye ninye o lmarei lenye nelo amany enkop oo Lfilisti ilarin oo pishana.

English: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
Masaai: Ore pee eitaai Galio olbalusui loo Roma te Akaia, nedumakino Lyahudi pooki Paulo te nebo, nerik olorika le nkiguana,

English: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
Masaai: too lng'anayio sidain le nkolong o te nena kumok oo lapaitin,

English: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
Masaai: Neeta nkutukie kake meiro; neeta nkonyek kake medolisho.

English: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
Masaai: ina olong naikirikira ilarripok leina aji ore iltung'ana oogol neirrugo, neitirring'a lelo ooidong'isho amu etaa kuti, ore lelo oing'orisho too lusien neiliilaa nkonyek enye.

English: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Masaai: Torikoyioki nanu te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono, amu ninye ashipakino.

English: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
Masaai: Ore pee ashomo ina kata, Enkai naataboloko mashomo. Anotore te nkilepata, lelo apa oitaaki larikok naibalakinye ninche kulo Omon Supati alikioo nanu ti atua Loreren; mayieu nanu neaku esiaai ai nataasa apa o ena naasita taata ene pesho.

English: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
Masaai: Etaa apa iltung'ana laainei ntare naaimina, etorikoitie ninche ilairritak lenye aaitapong'oo, aaibelekeny ninche too ldoinyo nepuo ninche oldoinyo o endoinyo, etorikine ninche eluaata enye.

English: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shefatia, nera esiana enye, iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yakobo alo arrinyo enkop enye, nenang'are ilmalaika le Nkai ninye.

English: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ooyieu neaku karsisi naa kedoiki ntemat, atua orreshet, nedoiki atua mbaa kumok e modai, naaitameisho neitadoiki iltung'ana atua enkitarruorroto o enkidaaroto.

English: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
Masaai: Ore engarri e dukuya neeta imbartan naanyokie, ore eniare neeta imbartan naarook,

English: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
Masaai: Elihoref o Ahija ilayiok le Shisha ninche apa ilaigerok; Yehoshefat olayioni le Ahilud apa olashumani loo mbaa;

English: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani ninye olarishani lang Olaitoriani ninye olo aitore iyiook, Olaitoriani ninye olaiguanani lang; keitajeu ninye iyiook.

English: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
Masaai: Neilep Solomon alo ine netii olperere lo lasar lo suyai te dukuya Olaitoriani. Atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo apa etii ilo perere lo lasar, neitayu Solomon ilasarri oopejori enkalifu nabo te nchumata enye.

English: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
Masaai: Keitu iyie inturraa iyiook, iyie Enkai? Miloito iyie, iyie Enkai, tenebo njorin ang.

English: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia aitanapisho pee eitobiri olasar opejori te nchumata olperere lo lasar. Ore ake pee eiteruni ilo perere lo lasar, neiteruni sii osinkolio oranyakini Olaitoriani, neitusuji eoshoto oo ntarumpetani, o nkinantani e Daudi ilo aiguanani le Israel.

English: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
Masaai: Ing'ura pooki ng'ae owuasa, nintadou ninye, nintunyoki enkop lelo torrok te pooki neitasheyie.

English: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo eewuo ninye pee etum aawa ng'ok, nemetii ng'ok atua ninye.

English: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
Masaai: Naaitoki ninye ajoki nanu, “Miureisho iyie Daniel, amu ore ebaiki ina olong apa e dukuya nitipika ndamunot inono ijo pee ining'u nintobor kewan te dukuya Enkai ino, etoning'oki irorei linono, naewuo nanu te nkaraki e lelo rorei linono.

English: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
Masaai: Kake ashe te Nkai amu ore intae oora apa rrindiki loo ng'ok nitaa ilooning'isho too ltauja, aaning ina kiteng'enare naishooki intae.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ekenyu neton Musa arish iltung'ana, neitashe iltung'ana aaman Musa ebaiki tadekenya o metaa teipa.

English: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
Masaai: Nadol ajo ore eekenyata pooki o enkarriyiano pooki esiai nelotu aimu olom oata oltung'ani to le latia enye. Ore ake sii ninye ena naa empesho naa enkijape ake emirareki.

English: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Saul nchere enoto ninye dupoto sapuk, neureyu ninye.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Iwa kuna pala pokira, ena namishira e nkinyang'unoto o ena tashati enye nememishira, nipik ninche atua emoti oo nkulukuok, pee etum aatobik te nkata naado.

English: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
Masaai: Ore apa pee errinyu Olaitoriani lelo ootaarayioki le Sion, nikitiu iyiook anaa ilooidetidet.

English: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Barnaba Tarso aing'oru Saulo.

English: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
Masaai: Nemanita ilo orika ilorikan tikitam oong'uan le nkitoo. Netonita te lelo orikan le nkitoo ilpayiani tikitam o oong'uan ooishopito nkilani naaibor, neeta too lukuny enye nkopiyiani e nkitoo e sahabu.

English: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
Masaai: Mbalunye ena tiatua enkaji e Yakobo, ntudupai tiatua Yuda.

English: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore kulo oik naa enkaji pooki e Israel. Ing'ura ajo ejo ninche ‘Etoito iloik lang, neiting'o iyiook osiligi; etudung'oyioki iyiook katukul.’

English: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
Masaai: Ore Andrea, obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena, olalashe le Simon Petero, nejoki ninye,

English: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
Masaai: Ore ilo keju le Kishon onang'ari neya ninche, ina are naisarrisar, olkeju le Kishon. Lo tau lai, shomo dukuya te ngolon.

English: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
Masaai: Ore apa irara rrindiki loo ng'ok, nemeeta enabaikinore intae esupatisho.

English: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
Masaai: Neaku ilo te nkoitoi ino iserian, nemerrorro enkeju ino.

English: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand,and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
Masaai: Neitobir sii ilmotio tomon ooitukuoreki, nepik imiet enkalo e kopikop nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape. Kuna apa eitukuyieki irubat eng'ues naitaae olasar opejori, ore ilo moti naa oloo lapolosak pee eitukuore.

English: David said furthermore, As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kear Olaitoriani ninye; arashu elotu enkolong enye pee eye; arashu elo ninye atua olarrabal neari metua.

English: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
Masaai: Naa teneikilikuan likae ajoki ninye, ‘Ainyoo doi kulo baa ootii enkoriong ino?’ Naa kejo, ‘Ilbaa laatipikaki tiatua enkaji oo lchoreta laainei.’ ”

English: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
Masaai: pooki ake pee eng'amaroyu naa tenaa olbung'ae lemeeta entioto aa oloo nkishu aashu oo loo nkerra aashu o loo nkineji.

English: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
Masaai: “Ing'ura, meany Enkai oltung'ani lemeeta entioto, nemeng'amaa enkaina oo laasak loo ntorrok.

English: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Nenap ninye aya lelo shumat pooki le nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat le nkaji o laiguanani, nedung aitaa mbelibelat imasaa pooki e sahabu naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naaitobira Solomon olaiguanani loo Siraeli, anaa apa enatolimuo Olaitoriani.

English: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
Masaai: Amu eitobiraki olng'obor li oriong, laa atua ninye etii olkilang'et o emesa omukateni e nkitoduaaroto; neji ine Ewueji Sinyati.

English: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
Masaai: Eitomijoonoki enkanasa, etigilaki nchomito aainyal.

English: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
Masaai: Neaku etushukokine Yuda nejoki, “Eitu alo atum, netejo sii iltung'ana le ine, ‘Metii emulayoi natii ine.’ ”

English: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
Masaai: Etua ninye te nkaraki pooki, paa ore lelo ooishu nemeishu te nkaraki ate ake kake te nkaraki ilo otua nenyaakaki aaitopiu te nkaraki ninche.

English: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
Masaai: Neaku Yakobo, Kefa o Yohana, lelo ooitaai ng'apeta e ina sirit ootoduaa kirotetisho naaishoo Enkai nanu neng'amaa Barnabas o nanu eitodolu aajo king'ar ena siaai. Neaku kipuo iyiook Iloreren nepuo ninche enetii Iloomurata.

English: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
Masaai: Aishiraka nanu Olaitoriani te mbuakunoto nabuaki Enkai pee aatum atoning'o nanu.

English: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore too nkakeny pooki naa kaidaikie nanu lelo pooki torrok te nkop, aiwuang'ie lelo pooki torrok te nkop aitung'uaa enkanasa o Laitoriani.

English: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi oltung'ani ng'en neilepie arik enkishui, pee etum atapaasha enemeneng'a tiabori.

English: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
Masaai: Pesho lelo pooki apa ooitobira nkitanyaanyukot, ore nena tokitin naang'idare ninche nemeret ninche. Ore ilchakenini lenye nemedolisho nemeyiolo, pee etumi aaitukurru ninche.

English: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
Masaai: “Teneitoki ina keeya aigil ajing ina aji, eidipa ninye aitayu isoito neyutuuto ina aji neitoki amur le nturoto,

English: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
Masaai: Ore efa tenebo e bati naa erisiori nabo, ore bati neeta ematua nabo e tomon e Homa, ore efa ematua nabo e tomon e Homa; neaku ore Homa ninye erikorieki enkiroishi pooki.

English: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
Masaai: Ore ti atua kulo pooki netii iltung'ana iip naapishana gelunot kedienyiaa; laa keidim ake pooki lenye atanang'a oleinyuaa to soit le nkopito nemediak.

English: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
Masaai: Nebik Yuda o nkanas enyena teine tenebo, o laramatak o lelo oopuopuo tenebo nkerrai enye.

English: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
Masaai: Ore iyiook iloogol neishiaakino nikinap enchalan oo looshal, pee me ate kintiship.

English: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
Masaai: Etanyaita apa nemenaa iltung'ana ninye, oltung'ani loo sinaitin ninye netamoo osina; ore anaa obo lemeyieu iltung'ana neing'or, netemenayioki, neitu iyiook kishilaa ninye.

English: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
Masaai: Ore lelo aiguanak pooki loo loreren neirrag te nkitoo, olaiguanani ake ti atua enkurare enye.

English: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche embata o sarge, nepik ntaloishin pokira are e kutuk aji o emolinka e kutuk aji enena ajijik naainosie ilkuoo le kerra.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ene wueji, o shumata lelo oomanya, lelo rorei pooki leina buku ooisuma olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Metaa embung'a enkitanapata ai nimiasiasa aikata ae nabo e kuna tabo oo lkuaki apa ootaasaki te dukuya intae, nimisarkionienie ate te ninche: ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Anak: Dishon ore ilayiok le Dishon naa Hamran o Eshban, o Itran o Keran.

English: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
Masaai: ore to losho le Efraim naa Hoshea olayioni le Nuni;

English: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee agilaki kung ilo Papa,

English: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
Masaai: Ore pee eiteru Yesu enkisiaayiare enye naa oloo larin oobaya tomoni uni. Ore ninye anaa enajo iltung'ana, olayioni le Daudi, olayioni le Heli,

English: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
Masaai: Naa kaitobir nanu emanyisho ai tiatua intae, nemeibelekenya oltau lai aibayu intae.

English: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
Masaai: o nkitotoneta naamanita ina dung'oroto o nkitotoneta e kishomi e ina dung'oroto, o ncheito pooki o lng'obor le Nkai, o ncheito pooki naamanaa te dung'oroto.

English: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
Masaai: Oi ele shekut lai lemeeta tipat, ilo olo aing'uaa intare! Metara olalem enkaina enye tenebo enkong'u enye e tatene! Inchoo enkaina enye eikaolo pooki, ore enkong'u enye e tatene nemodoku tukul!”

English: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
Masaai: Nepik olanyor lai enkaina enye enkikenet e kutuk aji, neng'idayu oltau lai tiatua nanu.

English: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
Masaai: “Iyiolo iyie enkata naisho nkineji oo ldoinyio? Itodua iyie enkolii eisho?

English: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
Masaai: o Adaia, o Beraia o Shiurat naa ilayiok le Shimei.

English: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
Masaai: Entiaaki olturrur pooki loo Siraeli nchere ore te nkolong e tomon ele apa naa keitayu ake pooki tung'ani olkuoo le ker te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye olkuoo le ker ake te nkaji;

English: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Saul, “Ng'ura, easita iltung'ana eng'oki to Laitoriani, aanya nkiri te nebo osarge.” Nejo ninye, “Itaasa te nkaldaroto; embeleleng'u osoit sapuk ene natii nanu.”

English: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana aajo, ‘Enkaraki natung'uaitie ninche olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, apa oitobira ninye tenebo ninche ina kata apa pee eitupuku ninche te nkop e Misiri,

English: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
