English: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
Masaai: Nejoki Yosef papaai lenye, “Ilayiok laainei ninche, lelo apa laaishoo Enkai tene.” Nejo Israel, “Toriku ninche ene natii, aatasayia pee atum atamayiana ninche.”

English: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
Masaai: Aigeroko intae aabore osina kitok o emion atua oltau, o too lkiyio kumok, neme kajo pee aitame intae, kake kajo pee iyiolouu eneba enyorrata nanyor nanu intae.

English: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
Masaai: Mme naa Enkai oo lootuata, kake enoo looishu; amu ninye eishuyie pooki.”

English: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee indip atoduaa ninye, nintoki sii iyie alo eneiturrure iltung'ana linono apa ootuata anaa apa enashomo olalashe lino Aron,

English: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
Masaai: Amu etejo Enkai, ‘Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi; ore oloitarriki menye aashu ng'otonye, inchoo metua.’

English: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
Masaai: Naairriwaki ltung'ana te ina kata ake; nintobira naa iewuo. Ore naa etiu neijia, noolo iyiook pooki ootii ene te dukuya Enkai, pee kining nena pooki nikintanapa ninye tejo.”

English: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
Masaai: Ore iyie, nikitumuraki te nturoto e lejare irara intae pooki ilabaak le pesho.

English: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
Masaai: Neing'uari ninche pooki, meinosa nena taritik e ong'ata naatoni too ldoinyo, neing'ueikini ing'uesi e ntim. Neked ilmotonyi shumata ninche te nkata e nkirowuaj, netonie ing'uesi e ntim ninche te nkata e nkirobi.

English: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Abori keper pooki eimie ninye ina darata, ore enkiwuang'ata enye, neisho meshomo ilpijat pooki le nkop.

English: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oitalaku elap o sarge, nedamu ninche; merikino ninye olkiyioi le ilo oata osina.

English: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
Masaai: naa Amiel olayioni le ile, naa Isaakar oliopishana, naa Peuletai olayioni le isiet; amu etamayiana apa Enkai ninye.

English: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu omom lelo ooisiligayu te nkop, pee etum ninche aatobik te nebo nanu; ore ilo olo te nkoitoi nemetii entioto ninye laaisiaai nanu.

English: And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaya, etonita Eli to lorika lenye te mbata e nkoitoi nalala aing'orisho, amu eiputukunyo oltau lenye te nkaraki ilo sanduku le Nkai. Ore ake pee elotu ilo tung'ani atua ang nelimu ilomon, neyietu enkang pooki aishir.

English: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
Masaai: Metotiwuo anaa olkila oimulumulare ninye, metotiwuo anaa enkimeita naa ninye erretenare anaake!

English: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
Masaai: olayioni le Ishar, olayioni le Kohat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Israel;

English: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
Masaai: Tadamu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, amu ninye likincho iyie engolon niakunye karsis; pee etum aitudupa ilo mumai apa oinosie loo papaai linyi, anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
Masaai: Nedol olorere pooki eloito neipid eisisita Enkai.

English: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
Masaai: Neinyototo nebuaaki osiwuo, nejoki enaiposha, “Tigirayu! Ntirring'ayu.” Neish osiwuo, negira enkare oleng.

English: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
Masaai: Neitobir apa olaiguanani Belshasa osirua kitok te nkaraki ilkituaak lenyena enkalifu nabo, neok ninye enaisho oo sabibu te dukuya lelo enkalifu nabo.

English: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
Masaai: Neyau ninche iltung'ana oare oo kedito mbartan, neirriwaa olaiguanani ninche meshomo aasujaa enjore e Siria, nejoki, “Enchom entodol.”

English: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
Masaai: amu aayeng'iyeng'ie embaunoto enye ndamunot naa neijia itiuu sii intae. Entayioloito ake tipat oo ltung'ana laaijo kulo.

English: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
Masaai: Te netii oloyieu neishankarru kuna, najoki nanu intae, mikiaata likae kerreti, nemeeta sii ninche sirito e Nkai.

English: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
Masaai: “Aajoki, inyo, tudumu erruat ino shomo ang.”

English: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
Masaai: Ore lelo apa ooitera aaku ilapolosak netaa metii olmumai, kake ore ele netolimuoki to lmumai, “Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai nemeibelekeny enatejo inchere, ‘Ira iyie olapolosani intarasi.’ ”

English: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
Masaai: Amu ore te idie netii Ilmaleki o le Kanaan dukuya intae, naa ipuopuo intae aabatata to lalem, enkaraki nimbelekenyate intae aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani, meitoki Olaitoriani atii te nebo intae.”

English: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
Masaai: Kenkitanyaanyukoto e Nkai! ina naitobirua oltung'ani, ina namur olkunoni te sahabu, nepik ninye ilpisia le nkosholai.

English: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
Masaai: Metaa eilepa ninye oleng alus ilkeek pooki le ntim, ore ilng'osil lenyena sapuki nebul aasapuku; neado ilng'osil lenyena, te nkaraki enkare sapuk too ntona enyena.

English: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena bae, ebaiki apa paa aning enkirukoto inyi ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu, o enyorrata ninyorrinyorro lelo sinyat,

English: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
Masaai: Naa te nadamu nanu ajo ayiolou kuna, naa enyamali te nanu.

English: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
Masaai: Neya Musa ina ng'udi te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
Masaai: Kake ajoki intae, keikashieki Tiro o Sidon te nkolong e nkiguana aaitalang intae.

English: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
Masaai: Ore oltau oshipa naa olmairo sidai, kake ore oltau otigile neitoi iloik.

English: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
Masaai: Keishari ninche, kake ibik ake iyie, kemusanu ninche, kake ibik ake iyie, kemusanu ninche anaa enkila,

English: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninye nena bartan naaitisinya ilaiguanak le Yuda te nkaraki eseremata enkolong, te nejing'ieki enkaji o laitoriani, te mbata e nkaji e Natan-Melek, laa ninye olkitok. Etapejoyie apa ninye nena garrin oo mbartan naaseremieki enkolong te nkima.

English: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
Masaai: Ainyoo nayau injorin, ainyioo nayau ilarrabali ti atua intae? Aime ng'uarrat inyi naara ti atua intae?

English: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
Masaai: “Tasayia ng'utunyi, tasayia amu mme enkitok ai ninye, nemara nanu olpayian lenye pee etum aiwuang'ie enkibor oo nkonyek te nkomom enye, neiwuang'ie eloloito enye to lki lenyena;

English: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
Masaai: tenebo enkosholai pooki o sahabu nilo iyie atum to lkerenket pooki le Babilon, tenebo nkishorot o lpela oo ltung'ana o noo lapolosak, naainosaki olmumai pee eishoruni tenkaraki enkaji e Nkai enye natii Yerusalem.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho loo ltung'ana le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
Masaai: paa ore nena kera enye nemeyiolo ena kitanapata, netum aatoning, neyiolou aatureita Olaitoriani Enkai, te nkata naba anaa eninchu teina kop nilo alang'aki te lido kekun le Yordan alo aya.”

English: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
Masaai: Tigila iyie enkaina e ilo torrono o eno larruoni; tusuja entorroni enye o metaba anaa neishunye.

English: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
Masaai: Nerikino ninche ina nataasa ninye, o ina apa e nking'asia naitoduaa ninye ninche.

English: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye nkituaak iip naapishana, o nkapiak iip uni, ore nena kituaak enyena neibelekenya oltau lenye.

English: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
Masaai: Iyang'a kake mibuaku; minchiraki ake lelo meneng'a. Teena enkarasha ino elukunya, nipik inkejek inono inamuka; niminuk ake enkutuk ino, arashu inos endaa e lelo ooishir.”

English: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore too usin pusi o morijo o mpilei neitobir ninche te nkarriyiano ilkilani sidain, pee eisiaaishoreki te wueji sinyati; neitobir ninche lelo kilani oosinya te nkaraki Aron; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
Masaai: Etii sii apa Ilnefilim enkop te nena olong'i, ore peyie epuonu ilayiok le Nkai aajing'aki aayiolou intoyie oo ltung'ana, neiki ninche inkera. Naa kulo apa iltung'ana magil liopa laa aiyiolot oleng.

English: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
Masaai: Neitayu sii olkarasha le kutukaji te nkaraki kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor, too nkarash naaripuno too usin pusi, o morijo, o mpilei o enkatani napuyiapui napiyaya, naikodo te siaai o ltidu;

English: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
Masaai: Neipang ninche aapuo nkurman, nesotu ninche isabibu te nena kurman enye oo sabibu, neirony ninche, nenya osirua, nepuo atua enkaji e nkai enye, nedaa neokisho nedek Abimelek.

English: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
Masaai: Nchoo enkomono ai meeu dukuya iyie, irrugu enkiok ino toning'o enkishirata ai!

English: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
Masaai: Ewuapaa ninche too ntateniaa, neton ake eisumash, nedaa ninche too nkedienyaa, kake eitu eraposho; neinos ake oltung'ani nkiri e ilo le latia enye.

English: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
Masaai: Neaku toning'o enkitobirata naitobira Olaitoriani tialo Edom o eyieunoto naipirakinye ninye lelo oomanya Teman: Keing'irtitori ninye lelo ooti le luaata aaya; ore iluaat enye neiputukuny teina.

English: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oas ntorrok naa keiba ewang'an, nemelotu enewang pee meibalieki iasat enyena,

English: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
Masaai: Neaku eyuko olmalaika olalem lenye oololo te nkop nesotu isabibu le nkop. Nenang'aki ninche atua enkironyet e ngoro e Enkai.

English: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu eimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, ejo,

English: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Itaasa te modai; eitu iyie imbung enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai ino, apa nikintanapa; amu ore taata anaata eitubulayie Olaitoriani enkitoria ino te Israel intarasi.

English: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
Masaai: Naa kabukoki engoro ai shumata Pelusium ilo sempewuet le Misiri, nadung'oo olorora le Tebes.

English: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.
Masaai: Netiu nkonyek enyena anaa ine nturkulu, te mbata oo nchorroi enkare, naaisujaki te kule, naaitobirakino entonata.

English: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
Masaai: o Hukok tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Rahob tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
Masaai: Neitoki alo enetii olikae nejoki neijia. Neng'amaa ilo ajoki, ‘Alo Papa’, kake eitu elo.

English: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitaa ninye endapidapoi neisik to lkirutoto, ore lelo kituaak lenyena neilanyisho aaing'uaa inankan enye te nkiputukuny,” neijia ejo Olaitoriani otii enkima enye Sion netii olkokuet lenye atua Yerusalem.

English: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Yoab, o Obadia olayioni le Yehiel, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip are o tomon oisiet.

English: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
Masaai: Ore pee edol lelo oopeny ine eililio ina ng'ues te nkaina enye nejokino maate, “Meeta nchere mme olarani ele tung'ani. Ore hoo netajeuo te naiposha, meeta esipata naishuyie.”

English: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
Masaai: “Ore tena kata nakerai e tung'ani tudumu enkishirata nchiraki Turo nijoki ninye,

English: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
Masaai: Amu aata apa esumash neitu kintotiti; naata enkure neitu kinchosho enaok.

English: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
Masaai: Eing'oru ilkumok omom o ltung'ani aminin, ore pooki tung'ani naa olchore le ilo tung'ani oishooyo inkishorot.

English: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooipiru entorroni neas entorroni too rruatin enye! Ore ake pee ekenyu neas ina naiguanutua, amu engolon oo nkaik enye etii.

English: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
Masaai: Ing'urrie iyiook, Olaitoriani, ing'urrie iyiook, amu kinoto iyiook nkisilisilot naalus.

English: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
Masaai: Ore pee edol lelo aiguanak pooki apa laa isinkan le Hadadesa ninche etimira Israel neitayu ninche osotua te nebo Israel, neaku isinkan te ninche. Neaku etureita Isiria eitoki aaretu Ilamoni.

English: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem neitaa Ahasia olayioni lenye oti olaiguanani terishata enye. Amu ore ilo wuampa apa loo ltung'ana ooetuo tenebo Ilmarabu atua ilng'oborri, netaara metuata lelo ayiok pooki botoro. Neaku Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram olaiguanani le Yuda ninye oitoreishe.

English: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
Masaai: Teneiu oltung'ani nkera iip nabo, nebikoo ilarin kumok oleng, metaa ore inkolong'i oo larin lenyena naa kumok oleng, kake meshipakino ntokitin sidain e nkishui, nemetum sii enukaroto, ajo nanu enaikash olkibiroto alang ninye.

English: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye aing'uaa Elisha, nelo aikenoo kewan o layiok lenyena. Ore ebukoki ninye eilata, neyau ilayiok lenyena nena kulie masaa aaitinyikaki ninye.

English: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?
Masaai: A-a, kake kitaasa iyiook te nkuretisho nchere ore te nkata nalotu neidim nkera inyi aatiaki nkera ang, ‘Kaa intae iporokiki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel?

English: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neishooyo Musa ina laakinoto, naa ninye olasar to Laitoriani, neisho Eliesa ilo apolosani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii ninye ti atua enkaji e Nkai ilmodook o lng'ojiniaa; neishiunye ninye.

English: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Masaai: Atiaaka nanu Enkai, endapidapoi ai, “Kainyoo pee mikidamu nanu? Kainyoo nanu pee alo aishirita, te nkaraki enkitorogonyata naaitorogony olmang'atinta?”

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Kelotu olmang'atinta airin enkop neibung imasaa nimitunyenye ate neraya intokitin naatii isempewueti linyi.”

English: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong nintasho aitirring'a, ore apa te ina olong nawaita iltung'ana leiking'a imasaa enyena, neimu ilmang'ati nchomito enyena, neoshoki enkukuo Yerusalem, nitotiwuo iyie anaa obo lenye.

English: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kaisudorie Abraham embae netaa kaas,

English: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Naa intunyokiki enkop iltorrok. Amu keaku nkuruon tiabori ndapi oo nkejek inyi ina olong naas ina Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Isiraeli, neishooyo ninche apik nkaik e Hasael olaiguanani le Siria, o nkaik e Benhadad olayioni le Hasael.

English: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
Masaai: Ena taa taata enkata e uni eipang'aki Yesu lelo ooiteng'eni eidipa atopiu too lootuata.

English: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku kedoiyo enkolong, nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena enetii nejoki, “Intanapa olorere meshomo kuna kurman o nkang'itie naataana aairrag neing'oru endaa amu ong'ata ene nikitii.”

English: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche te Midian nepuonu Paran, neshoru kulikae te Paran nepuonu Misiri, enetii Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, laa ninye oishoo Enkaji, neikenaki ninye eorikinoto endaa, neisho ninye enkop.

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ngoki,

English: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
Masaai: Ore enkirukoto naa ninye naitadedeyie intokitin naaisiliguni, naa ninye enkitisipata e nena tokitin nemelioo.

English: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
Masaai: Amu epuoito iltung'ana pooki, oltung'ani ake te nkarna e Nkai enye. Kake eikipuo iyiook te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook pooki inkera e wang'an o nkera e ndama, metaa imikira ile nkewarie aashu ile naimin.

English: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
Masaai: Neaku eishoo Olaitoriani Israel ina kop pooki apa nainosie ninye olmumai nchere keisho loo menye; ore ake eibung ina kop, nemany ninche ine.

English: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
Masaai: Amu ore ltung'ana leeijo lelo mme Olaitoriani lang Kristo eisiaaita ninche kake ng'uarrat enye maate, naa nkutukie eitamelon too rorei le nkisisa pee etumoki aatelej lelo oomaae.

English: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Atoning'o inking'unyung'unyat oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli; tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore te nteipa ninosinoso inkiri, ore tadekenya neiputakini intae imukateni, ee iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.’ ”

English: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
Masaai: Neipot isinkan lenyena tomon, neisho ake obo empisai e sahabu nejoki, ‘Etaasishore o maeu.’

English: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
Masaai: Kake kaitasheyie olning'o lo sotua lai o iyie, naa aijing iyie e safina, iyie o layiok linono, o enkitok ino, o nkituaak oo layiok linono tenebo iyie.

English: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
Masaai: Herber apa menye le Yafet, o Shomer, o Hatam, o enkanashe enye Shua.

English: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaraki naa oltung'ani obo oyaka enkop enkeeya, oltung'ani obo sii oyawua empiunoto oo lootuata.

English: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
Masaai: Kake te neany menye enyorraa ilo mumai ina olong apa pee ening, nemeitoki atii olmumai te ninye, nemetii eenata e kewan nauno, naa kepalaki Olaitoriani ninye te nkaraki naa menye otomitikio ninye.

English: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Entoning ena kidetidet naidetidetua.

English: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
Masaai: Ore lelo aisikak le Hala laa ilo lorere le Israel neya Foenike o metabaiki Serefait; ore lelo ooibung'aki le Yerusalem ootii atua Sefarad nepuo aaya nena anas e Negeb.

English: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooata lkituaak ooidipa aairuko nemepal enkanyit enye amu ejo lelo ilalashera, kake peyie, easisho oleng amu ore lelo oodupore ena siaai enye naa ile tipat, amu lairukok nenyorri. Inteng'ena nintudup ninche kuna siaaitin.

English: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
Masaai: o kulikae ayiok loo lapolosak oata ntarumpetani: Sekaria olayioni le Yonatan, olayioni le Shemaia, olayioni le Matamia, olayioni le Mikaia, olayioni le Sakur, olayioni le Asaf;

English: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Ara sii nanu oloiboni le Nkai anaa iyie, naairorie nanu olmalaika to rorei lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Torrinyu ninye meeu tenebo iyie enkaji ino pee etum ainosa endaa neok enkare.’ ”

English: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye, ‘Ira iyie alo?’ Nawaliki, ‘Ara nanu Olmaleki.’

English: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu, Enkai ai, nchere, ijur oltau, nishipakino enkishui sidai; ore te sidano oltau lino naishorua nanu kuna pooki te nyorrata, natoduaa nanu taata kulikae tung'ana linono, ootoni tene, neishoru te nyorrata o te ng'ida.

English: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ore to sina niking'oru ninche iyie, nebuku ninche enkomono, ina kata etii enkitamioto shumata ninche.

English: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Masaai: “Imayianana intae te nesukeny ninche intae, neisilisil, neiteeniki intae imbaa pooki torrok e lejare te naa nkaraki nanu.

English: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
Masaai: Emimitikino naa, meteleku ti nining'okinono te rishata naje pee itumokiki enkomono nintokiki ake aatumo. Emincho ake Sheitani erishata meyaki intae intemat enkaraki nemeidim oltung'ani aitoria kewan.

English: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
Masaai: Tining'uaa intae Olaitoriani aapuo aaisiai nkaitin omon, naa keibelekenya sii ninye neitaas intae entorrono, nemut intae, eidipa aitaasa intae esidai.”

English: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
Masaai: Kilanyishote iyiook anaa emotonyi te ilo rreshet lo larreshoni etigile orreshet, nikilanyishote iyiook.

English: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Isiraeli pooki aajo eitu ening olaiguanani ninche, newaliki olorere olaiguanani, aajoki, “Kaa rubata iyiook kiata te Daudi? Mikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese. Enchom ilng'oborri linyi intae Israel! Ng'ura naa taata enkaji ino makewan Daudi.”

English: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
Masaai: Negorokino Asa ilo aduaani, neikenoo ninye te korokoroni, amu eibayie ninye te nkaraki ena. Neitoki Asa aitaas mbaa e ngogong'i kulikae teina kata.

English: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
Masaai: Ore wuejitin inono apa naaidaikieki nesheti; naa ilo iyie adumu olkitamanyunoto loo ishoritin kumok; nikipuoi aajo olaramani too lusien olaitobirani loo nkoitoi naalala enkanasa.

English: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.
Masaai: Kake te nelo ninye airrag, tisipu ewueji neirragie ninye; nilo taa abolu nkejek enyena nirrag te ine; naa eikiliki ninye enias.”

English: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
Masaai: Neinepu oltung'ani ninye egira alilita too nkong'at; neikilikuan ilo tung'ani ninye ajoki, “Ainyoo doi ing'oru?”

English: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:
Masaai: tanapa sii enchata napi tenebo iyie; peyie tenilo atonie enkop, niturunye engumoto, nintoki anukaa nena kik inono.

English: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
Masaai: Ataa kereek te nkitok ai, naatonyimo ilayiok lang'arie kina.

English: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
Masaai: Kake eitu earaa iltung'ana le Benchamen Ilyebusi apa oomanya Yerusalem; neaku etobiko apa Ilyebusi te nebo iltung'ana le Benchamen te Yerusalem ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
Masaai: Itegelua sii iloibonok pee eibalie aalimu mbaa naaipirta Yerusalem, ‘Etii olaiguanani Yuda.’ Ore naa taata kelikini olaiguanani te risioroto e kulo rorei. Ore naa taata wou matoning'oto.”

English: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Natan Daudi, “Taasa ina pooki natii atua oltau lino, amu etii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie.”

English: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
Masaai: Nchoru enkiok, toning'o oltoilo lai; toning'isho, naa toning'o enajo.

English: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
Masaai: Neyieu kulikae neibung ninye, kake metii oloitabaikia ninye enkaina.

English: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
Masaai: Entodol ate; te neitarruoo olalashe lino, irorie, ore pee eirridua, tapalaki;

English: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
Masaai: Nebuaku Yesu oleng, nedung'o tau.

English: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
Masaai: Kake etejo Yesu, “Entapal ena!” Neiseyie enkiok enye neishiunye.

English: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
Masaai: Ena esiana oo ltung'ana oowa Nebukadresa eyararoto: ore to lari liopishana, naa Ilyahudi nkalifuni uni o tikitam oo kuni.

English: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
Masaai: Ntunyoyie iyie aimaa enkop te mpushuna, ntunyoyie iyie iloshon te ngoro.

English: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
Masaai: anaa oloba anaa oloiseyie entoki naikurtutari naidim aidurukie ninye, aashu oltung'ani oidim aitasuroki enkiduruk, naba ake duoo ninye anaa enaata,

English: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
Masaai: Te risioroto e siana oo nkolong'i apa nikinkitalana enkop, nkolong'i artam, te nkolong ake to lari, inapinapa intae entorroni inyi, ilarin artam, naa ipuopuo intae aayiolou engoro ai.’

English: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Abijam neye anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Asa olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
Masaai: Ara nanu olchekut supat; nayiolo inaainei, naayiolo sii nanu inaainei,

English: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
Masaai: Neisiaai ninche nyaanyukie o loip le ine wueji sinyati te shumata; amu ore pee eaku keun Musa olng'obor, netuutaka Enkai ninye nejoki, “Toduaa taa ntobira pooki toki nturubare lelo sirat likintoduaaki to ldoinyio.”

English: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
Masaai: Nening'okino Abraham o Efron ina laata. Neikenaki Abraham Efron inkoshola naaipotuo ening'ito Lhiti, shekeli iip ong'uan e nkosholai anaa enkinyiang'a oo lamirak.

English: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tenaa eiteseriani eetuo ninche, eyau ninche eishu, naa tenaa eitolarrabal epuonu iyau ninche eishu.”

English: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
Masaai: Neibalunye keper ing'ok enyena pooki, nedumakino enkop aarare ninye.

English: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
Masaai: Oi naaji duoo tenaa kaata obo laaning nanu! (Nena entukunyata olkimojino lai! Inchoo Olmagilani aawaliki nanu! Oi naaji tenaa kataa enesirare imbaa aainei naaigero ilo mang'atinta lai!

English: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
Masaai: neishori likae engolon naasie mbaa naagol e nking'asia, neishori likae engolon nalikiorie lomon te naibon, neishori likae enkidimata nayiolo aitirisha ltauja, naishori likae enkidimata naasishore lng'ejepa oopaasha, neishori likae enkidimata nawalunye nkutukie;

English: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Kish naa Yerameel.

English: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
Masaai: Eng'urai, kijo emayiana lelo oongiri. Itoning'o eng'iriata e Yoab, nitoduaa enaitaasa Olaitoriani ninye te nkiting'oto, amu kenana Olaitoriani enkoshoke neeta olng'ur.

English: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
Masaai: nimidamishosho aajo keikash te yiook te nenang oltung'ani obo olosho pee meidaaya olorere olulung'a.”

English: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
Masaai: Eing'ura iltung'ana pooki ninye; neing'or oltung'ani ninye te nelakua.

English: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
Masaai: “Naa kegiroo iloreren kumok ena anasa, nejoki ake pooki ng'ae olelatia enye, Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena anasa kitok?”

English: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te nena katitin naa kedumunye ilkumok aarare ilo aiguanani le kopikop; ore lelo tung'ana lo larrabal ti atua iltung'ana linono naa kerup ate pee etum aaitabai ina apa natolimuoki kake kepuo ninche aabatata.

English: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche, neisis Enkai. Nejoki ninche ninye, “Olalashe, idolita eneba nkalifuni oo Lyahudi ooiruko; neeta pooki olokiyo too nkitanapat.

English: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Masaai: Nchoo Israel eshipakino ilo oitobira ninye, nchoo ilayiok le Sion eshipakino Olaiguanani lenye!

English: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
Masaai: Ore ninye o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninye, nedaa neokisho, neirrag ine. Ore pee einyototo ninche tadekenya, nejo ninye, “Entushukoki enetii olkitok lai.”

English: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
Masaai: Amu eibung'a olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki kituaak, o eumata pooki natii Yerusalem enkiguana, pee eibung pasaka to lapa liare.

English: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
Masaai: ore Gehasi ilo sinka le Elisha, nejo, “Dol ajo etapala olkitok lai ele tung'ani oji Naaman le Siria, neitu eng'amaa te nkaina enye nena tokitin naayawua ninye. Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kasujaa nanu ninye pee atum toki te ninye.”

English: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiro esipata neishoru enduaata nasipa, kake ore olchakeni olejisho, nelimu elejare.

English: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
Masaai: Neserem ina umata pooki, neranyisho ilaranyak, nebuaku ntarumpetani. Neranyisho nena pooki o metaba anaa neishunye ilo asar opejori.

English: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
Masaai: Eitu ninche eibung olning'o le Nkai, kake etanyaita epuo te risioroto e nkitanapata enye.

English: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
Masaai: Neok Noa enaisho oo lsabibu nemera oleng neirrag to lng'obor lenye meishopo.

English: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
Masaai: Niminos olmumai te ndukuya ino, amu mindim aiborrie olpapita obo anaa aitoroka.

English: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
Masaai: Kake ore toki nara, nara te nkaraki empiris e Nkai, naa ore ina piris naaishoo ninye neitu eaku pesho ti atua nanu. Ore enatiu nanu otaasishe alang lelo kulikae pooki, kake mme nanu ilo kake ina piris e Nkai natii atua nanu.

English: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
Masaai: Netejo ninye ena eutu ajo kaa keeya eye ninye.

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loti oing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori,

English: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
Masaai: Etejo neijia eutu enkeeya nayaki Enkai enkitoo. Ore pee eidip atejo neijia nejoki ninye, “Tusujuaki nanu.”

English: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Saul tenkaraki ina nemeisiligayu; meisilig apa ninye o Laitoriani amu eitu ninye eibung nkitanapat o Laitoriani nelo aikilikuanishore iloiriruani, eingoru eutaroto

English: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
Masaai: Aimedumunye lelo lintalak isilen nabo kata, ore lelo oodumunye nikinkirikirie iyie? Nilo iyie aaku oloyaruno te ninche.

English: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
Masaai: Atonyorrayie nanu te nkurruna nchere atashala oshi. Kake te neetae oloyieu nenya kutuk ti ai toki (kairorita taa doi anaa olmodai), kaidim sii nanu ainosa kutuk.

English: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol olmishire le okuni, naning ina ng'ues e uni naishu ejo, “Wou!” Ng'ura, nadol nanu, embarta narok, ore ilo okedito neeta entemet te nkaina enye.

English: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
Masaai: Ijurru iyie enkoitoi ai o enkirragata ai, niyiolo iyie oleng nkoitoi aainei pooki.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Neaku, nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kayau nanu enkitamioto shumata olaiguanani o enkop enye, anaa apa enaitame nanu olaiguanani le Asiria.

English: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.
Masaai: Ore naa taata tudumunye, shomo auluo irorie te supato isinkan linono; amu anya nanu olmumai to Laitoriani, ti nimilo iyie, meton ninye oltung'ani obo te nebo iyie ena kewarie; naa keaku ena torrono oleng te iyie alang entorroni apa naewuo shumata iyie ebaiki kitisho ino o metabaiki taata.”

English: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
Masaai: Nedumu taa Yesu nena mukateni, neishooyo enashe neoriki lelo ootoni; neikunaki sii neijia isinkir anaa naatayieutua ninche.

English: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.

English: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
Masaai: Amu meeta enepaashare Ilyahudi o Lgiriki; ilo Aitoriani obo Olaitoriani le pooki naa ninye oitadoiki enkarsisisho enye lelo pooki ooipot ninye.

English: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
Masaai: Tinintanyamal intoyie aainei, anaa tiniyam kulie kituaak neme intoyie aainei, ore hoo nemetii likae lee ine oyiolo, tadamu, ajo, Enkai ninye shakeni terishata ai o iyie.”

English: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
Masaai: Kake ore pee eikirnyanya kulikae neitagol onyek, nemor ena oitoi te dukuya olorere, nelo aing'uaa ninche, negelu ilooiteng'eni, nelo aiteng'enisho anaa ake te nkaji naisumareki.

English: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
Masaai: Neisho iloreren meikordodo, near, too nkeenta, neshei neitopiuni te nkolong e uni.”

English: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
Masaai: peyie etumi aaitoborro ina kitoo nemeitoki ailepie kewan shumata, neaku teneibung olning'o lenye neidim aitasho.)

English: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le meeta enkibooroto e kewan, netiu anaa enkanasa natigilaki neing'uari meeta isunta.

English: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
Masaai: Tenkaraki ina olong nalotu aidaikie Ilfilisti pooki aiwuang'ie te Turo o Sidon pooki aretoni oing'uari amu emutita Olaitoriani Ilfilisti, ilo pisiai lo lmanie le nkare le Kafto.

English: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

Ore inkedeta e ilo perere lo lasar neipirare enkalo o loosaen.”

English: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Kainyoo idia kurare, nadolita nanu?” Nejoki iltung'ana leina anasa ninye, “Enkurare o ltung'ani le Nkai apa oing'uaa Yuda, nelotu aibonu kuna baa niyewuo iyie aas tialo olperere lo lasar te Betel.”

English: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
Masaai: Eiroroki intae Aristakos oloena te nebo nanu, neiroroki intae Marko le nkanashe e Barnabas (Iindipa aanoto olkilikuai loo mbaa enyena - te neewuo ninye enitii, entang'amu),

English: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Sebulon, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo naa Gad, erubata nabo.

English: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo pee iasiasa kuna baa? Amu atoning'o nanu iasat inyi torrok too ltung'ana pooki.

English: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Entagolie ninche, ning'oring'oro ninche ometaba anaa nimpimipimi ninche te dukuya ilapolosak kituaak o Lawi o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te Israel te Yerusalem, tiatua ilgilat le nkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
Masaai: Aikenayie ntokitin pooki aitaa pesho te nkaraki nemeeta endutet katukul, eyiolounoto e Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lai. Ore te nkaraki ninye, naiturrayie ntokitin pooki naikenaa ajo etiu anaa nkik, pee atum Kristo.

English: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Masaai: Neitayu ninye iloom lo lerai, iloom imiet too rubat te nkalo nabo e ilo ng'obor le Nkai,

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Tudumunye, kainyoo iyie pee itabatate aiko nji te nkomom ino?

English: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Lfarisayo aaikilikuan ninye eneikuna pee etodolishe. Nejoki ninche, “Esarng'ab aaelie nkonyek aainei, naisuja, nadolishoyu.”

English: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
Masaai: neaku ore te kuna olong'i atipika endamunoto peyie eitaas esidai Yerusalem o enkaji e Yuda; metaa emiureisho.

English: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aibelekenya nemayian ina umata oo Siraeli, eitashe ina umata pooki oo Siraeli.

English: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaimzophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani obo le Ramataim, le ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, oji enkarna enye Elkana olayioni le Yeroham, olayioni le Elihu, olayioni le Tohu, olayioni le Sufi ilo le Efraim.

English: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
Masaai: Nerisioroyu nkaloli pooki, netasha, entemata e ndap enkadoro o entemata e ndap endapasho.

English: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
Masaai: Nelotu oltung'ani oji Yairo naa olkitok le nkaji e ntumo; nebatata too nkejek e Yesu nesai meshomo enkaji enye,

English: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
Masaai: naa kayau nanu shumata Elam ilkutat pokira oong'uan eing'uaa imatuan ong'uan e shumata naa kaidapashaki nanu ninche lelo kutat pooki, nemeitoki atii olorere lemepuonu lelo ooterewa olkutati te Elam.

English: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
Masaai: Anaa enaikununo oltung'ani lo loirirua onang'aa ilkeek le nkima ooyupuyup, o mbaa o keeya,

English: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
Masaai: Entoki nabo nanu atoomono Olaitoriani naa ninye nanu aing'oru; nchere pee abik nanu ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ai, pee aaing'or enkishiaa o Laitoriani, naikilikuanisho ti atua enkaji enye sinyati.

English: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
Masaai: Neing'or osinka ninye aitirring'a meiro, ajurru tenaa keitudupo Olaitoriani elutunoto enye anaa keitu.

English: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
Masaai: “Keton ake sii mejing'aa intae?

English: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
Masaai: incho ilo apolosani loo Lawi lolmarei le Sadok, ilo laanyikaki nanu aisiai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oloing'oni meitainyie olasar le ng'oki.

English: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, kitoning'o iyiook enkishirata o enkirutoto enkuretisho, neme eseriani.

English: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
Masaai: “Neinyiang'ua ele tung'ani enkurma to lerrinyore le nkarrueisho enye, naa ine etanang'a etusulari neng'era adanya neitiakunye enkoshoke pooki.

English: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
Masaai: Neitoki aitobir olmoti le sekenkei natosholaki, naa intemat are olpisiai enkaina endapasho, naa ntemat ong'uan olpisiai e nkaina endapasho naa ntemat tomon ookuni e nkaina enkamanaa enye. Naa kepurupurana apa.

English: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Gideon elimunoto e ina kidetidet o empukunoto enye, neserem; neshuko alo ilng'oborri le Israel, nejo, “Entudumunye, amu eishorua Olaitoriani ilo orora le Midian apik atua enkaina inyi.”

English: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
Masaai: Taasa iyie ena, ewaita eng'irra e nkima, Kora o encholiek enye pooki,

English: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
Masaai: Nesujaa Ilmisiri ninche, mbartan pooki e Farao, o ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan o enjore enye, neinepu ninche too lng'oborri te mbata e naiposha, te mbata e Pi-ha-hirot, te dukuya e Baal-sefon.

English: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu naa kaaranyaki iyie, karanyisho nanu te nkisisa e nkarna ino, iyie Olotii Shumata Aisul.

English: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Eber ilarin tomoni uni oong'uan, etaa ninye menye le Peleg.

English: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
Masaai: Neaku Arpakashad menye le shela, neaku Shela menye le Eber.

English: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
Masaai: Neirorie Solomon Isiraeli pooki, neirorie ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maaip, o larishak, o larikok pooki loo Siraeli, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
Masaai: Ore te ina rishata eoshoto pooki narere oltung'ani imemelok; ore te siadi neiu ilng'anayio le seriani e supatisho te lelo ootarerioki te ina.

English: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

Masaai: Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Yeremia eipirta olameyu:

Masaai: Iyie Enkai, nturrayie iyie iyiook, nitigila iltimito; itagore iyie, tokordu siaake iyiook.

English: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

English: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yeremia airorie iltung'ana pooki kulo rorei pooki lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninche eirriwayie Olaitoriani Enkai enye meshomo enetii ninche,

Masaai: tenatoduaa nanu obo lenye eidaa, te nkaraki meeta inkilani o sesen, arashu oltung'ani aisinani lemeitoipo,

English: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

Masaai: Naajoki nanu ilo tung'ani, “Enkerai e tung'ani ing'ura, too nkonyek inono, nining too nkiyiaa inono, nipik indamunot inono nena pooki naaitodol iyie, amu kitorikuoki ene peyie aatum aitoduaa iyie ninye; imbalakinye nena pooki nidol enkaji e Israel.”

Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i, neilep alo oldoinyo aomon, neton enkewarie pooki eomonito Enkai.

English: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:
Masaai: kake ilepunye kewan nigilunore Olaitoriani le shumata; ore nena masaa e nkaji enye neitijing'uaki aayau dukuya iyie, ore iyie o lkituaak linono, o nkituaak inono o nkapiak inono nitookie ninche enaisho oo sabibu, nirrepirrepe intae nena aitin e nkosholai o nesahabu o nosuyai, o nesekenkei, o nenchata, o nosoit, nena nemedolisho aashu ening'isho aashu eyiolo, kake ore ina Ai naa enkaina enye etii enkiyang'et ino netii inkoitoi inono pooki neitu iyie iyanyit.

English: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
Masaai: Nejo Lot, “Oi mme neijia Olaitoriani lai.

English: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
Masaai: amu ilooiteng'eni lenyena eiteng'enita, ajoki, “Eitarasakini Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo ltung'ana, near ninche ninye metua; ore pee eidipi aatar metua, neishari nkolong'i uni nepiu.”

English: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
Masaai: Tinilo niton, nimiata enkuretisho; tinirrag airura, naa kemelok injo inono.

English: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ti nimiyieuu intae nisiayiayia Olaitoriani, entegelu ena olong olisiayiayia tenaa ai nena aitin apa naaisiaayia iloo papaai linyi te lido kekun Yordan aashu tenaa ai nena aitin oo Lamori naa enkop enye itii; kake ore nanu o olmarei lai naa aikisiaai Olaitoriani.”

English: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

English: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
Masaai: Nejoki Samson ninche, “Ore tena kata maaitokini nanu aailap ti alo Ilfilisti te naitaas ninche entorrono.”

English: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

English: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

English: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
