English: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata neiteru Yesu alikioo ororei le Nkai nejo, “Erridutu amu etinyikua enkitoria e shumata.”

English: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu ajoki nchere, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, ara nanu kishomi oo nkerra.

English: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho neikodi aaiko neijia too nkilani naaibor, nemajut enkarna enye te mbuku e mpuaan; naishakenoki enkarna enye te dukuya Papa lai o te dukuya lmalaika lenyena.

English: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
Masaai: Kake elotu enkolong o Laitoriani anaa olapurroni. Ore teina olong neishieki keper to ltoilo kitok. Ore wuejitin e shumata nepejori aaidaikie, ore enkop o pooki toki natii neishieki.

English: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
Masaai: “Eng'oru Olaitoriani eton etumoyu, empoto ninye eton etaana;

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye intorrok too nkonyek Olaitoriani, neibung orrekie le Yeroboam teina ng'oki natorikoko Israeli metaasa.

English: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
Masaai: Eyaki enkare ilo oata enkure, entanang'are lelo aisikak endaa, intae kulo oomanya enkop e Tema.

English: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: “Esipa aitoki ajoki intae, te nining'okinono oare linyi embae ake pooki te nkop niomonunu, naa keitaas intae Papa lai otii shumata.

English: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
Masaai: Amu eewuo Enkerai e Tung'ani aing'oru pee eitajeu ilooimina.”

English: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Napthtuhim,
Masaai: Misiri apa menye le Ludim, o Anamim, o Lehabim, o Napatuhim, o

English: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
Masaai: Tadamu Olaitoriani ena bae natadoikio iyiook; ing'ura nidol enkurruna ang.

English: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
Masaai: “Kake ore naa taata toning'o enkiroroto ai iyie Yoab, nining'u irorei laainei pooki.

English: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
Masaai: “Metaa ilo iyie ayiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo obik te Sion, to ldoinyo lai sinyati. Naa keaku Yerusalem sinyati, nemeigil aekata iltung'ana omon aaim atua ninye.

English: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
Masaai: Neyau ninye isoito le nchan anaa ilbelibelat, kalo oidim aitasheiki enkirobi enye?

English: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
Masaai: Te netii oloata esumash, nenya endaa ti ang, pee meaku entumo enapukoki endung'okinoto e nkiguana. Kalotu aitanap intae kulie baa te nalotu.

English: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
Masaai: “Neaku ore lelo oomanya nena anas e Israel naa kepuo dukuya neitobiru inkimaitie too masaa olarrabal nepejoo ninche, ilong'oi sapuki o long'oi kutiti, o inkai o mbaa, irinkan o mperria. Naa keitobiru inkimaitie te ninche too larin oopishana;

English: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani te intae leitu aiwuang'ie aitung'uaa olperere lai lo lasar nelekuni pee eishir nkonyek enyena neisinanuo oltau lenye; ore emponaroto pooki e nkaji ino neye to lalem loo ltung'ana.

English: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
Masaai: Etootikio Olaitoriani aitomijoon isunta e ina tito e Sion; etudung'uo olpolosie lenye apik olkereri eitu ninye eibooyo enkaina enye pee meidaikie; eyawua ninye oloputukunyi o enkishirata nena sunta, neishunye engolon enye nabo kata.

English: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
Masaai: Eitukurruaki ninche pooki netusulaki, ore lelo aitobirak loo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nepuo to lmilo te nebo.

English: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
Masaai: Neya Manoa olkuoo le kine te nebo enkishoroto e ntapa, neitaiki te nchumata endapidapoi Olaitoriani olasar, ilo laa ninye oas inenking'asia.

English: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
Masaai: Nelotu oloitaakaki talanta are nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok, kintaaka talanta are, ing'ora, anotie kulie are.’

English: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: naomon pee aa ore ing'arie ilkulikae enkirukoto ino, neitubulaa eyiolounoto enena pooki supati naara nkunaang ti atua Kristo.

English: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
Masaai: Metaa ore peyie edol Esau ajo eitu eitiship nena kituaak oo Lkanaan papaai lenye Isaak;

English: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, olwuasa ninye osaei lenye le murt, olarrabal oimulumul ninche anaa olkila.

English: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
Masaai: Neeta te nkaina enye enkiti piyayati e mbuku nabolo. Neroro te nkeju enye e tatene enaiposha, neroro te ne kedianye enkop natoyio.

English: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo netii ilkituaak lenyena Soan nepuo ilbalusuni lenyena aabaiki Hanes,

English: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon Shimei, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Shamgar olayioni le Anat, apa laa ninye otara metuata iltung'ana iip ile loo Lfilisti te ng'udi nareyieki lmong'i, netokordua sii ninye Israel.

English: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji neroro iroruat oo nkejek inyi aishoo nanu intae, anaa apa enaisiligie nanu Musa.

English: My face is foul with weeping, and my eyelids is the shadow of death;
Masaai: Etodoro enkomom ai te nkishirata, netiu inkonito aainei o nkonyek anaa enaimin nagut;

English: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki iltung'ana, “Nanu ake openy taata otelekua too loibonok lo Laitoriani; kake ore iloibonok le Baal naa iip ong'uan o onom.

English: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
Masaai: Nesiokisioki aitayu ina arasha natii olpura le nkomom, neyiolou olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo obo loo loibonok le Nkai.

English: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu iasat supati e kulikae tung'ana, keibalayu aasioki, naa te nemeibala nemeidim aaisudori o akenya.

English: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:
Masaai: ti nipukokiki intae maate lelo ooisumash, nintaraposhosho eyieunoto e ilo oata osina, netum taa ewang'an inyi ailepu te naimin ore emisimisi inyi netiu anaa enkipirata e nkolong.

English: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
Masaai: kulo ninche ilayiok le Shamai: Maon: naa Maon apa menye le Betsar.

English: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
Masaai: Neishoru ninye ilaiguanak lenye apik nkaik inyi, nimisie iyie enkarna enye aiwuang'ie te nkop; meetae hoo oltung'ani obo likindim ashomo aipirakinore, o metaba anaa nindaikie ninche.

English: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
Masaai: Naa embae kiti ena too nkonyek inono, iyie Enkai; niroro sii aimaki enkaji osinka lino te nkata sapuk nalotu, nikitoduaa iyie nanu iishoritin naapuonu, Olaitoriani Enkai!

English: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
Masaai: itaa intae enkitanyaanyukoto too lairukok pooki ti atua Makedonia o ti atua Akaia.

English: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
Masaai: Eitu emera kulo tung'ana anaa ina nijojo, ene uni ena saa anaa pee ekenyu.

English: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neiko ninche neijia; neitorioo Aron enkaina enye o eng'udi enye neosh enterit e nkop, nelotu enkojong'ani ajing'aki tung'ani o eng'ues; neaku enterit pooki e nkop enkojong'ani te nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
Masaai: Te ng'eno eshetuni enkaji naa te ning'unoto eitasheyieki.

English: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
Masaai: Ore too lalashera laainei o le ncholuek ai, ajo nanu, “Metijing'a eseriani atua iyie!”

English: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben nejoki Musa, “Keas isinkan linono anaa enaitanapisho olkitok lai.

English: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eilepunye oltau lenye neitagol oltau metaa keasisho to lwuasa neiwuang'ieki ninye te ilo orika lenye le nkitoo, neyae enkitoo enye aaitung'uaa ninye;

English: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkong'u ino, tukurtu; enaikash ti nijing enkitoria e Nkai iata enkong'u nabo alang ti nikinang'akini Gehanum iata inkonyek pokira are;

English: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
Masaai: nemit meitoki oltung'ani anap toki aitudung enkaji e Nkai.

English: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
Masaai: Nepuku te ina wang'an natii dukuya ninye nkuk e nkima naayupuyup.

English: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel pee eipang'unye ti atua ilng'oborri pooki ng'ae ake ninye oata enkeeya oolbolot, o pooki ng'ae oata olbae loo nkimek, o pooki ng'ae lemesinya oiseyie oltung'ani otua;

English: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
Masaai: Imbelekenyunye, aatasayia, mincho entorrono easayu, imbelekenyunye tena kata amu eiting'o osiligi lai.

English: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.
Masaai: Neitoki Mordekai ashuko alo kishomi o laiguanani. Kake eisarisara Haman alo enkaji enye eishirita neimulumula elukunya enye.

English: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
Masaai: Neaku etimira Olaitoriani ile Etiopia te dukuya Asa o te dukuya Yuda, neilanyisho ile Etiopia.

English: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
Masaai: Neikini Enok Irad, neiu Irad Mehujael, neiu Mehujael Metushael neiu Metushael Lamek,

English: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
Masaai: Kake aainyo pee impang'a aapuo? Ko ltung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui ishomo aadol? Ng'ura, ore ilooishop inkilani naapuyiapui nkajijik oo laiguanak etii.

English: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore sii oltung'ani ojing ina aji eton eikeno neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa;

English: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
Masaai: Ore te naimin netur inkajijik; ore dama neikenoo ate, nemeyiolo ninche ewang'an.

English: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
Masaai: Ore ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, nelo abaiki shumata, ore esupatisho ino nelo abaiki nkatampo.

English: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
Masaai: Ore nkariak e ilo keju le Nail neitoi, ore ilo keju netoyu;

English: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
Masaai: Etoyu oltung'ani torrono te mion enye too nkolong'i enyena pooki, tiatua lelo arin pooki ooirragieki, te nkaraki ilo lemeeta olng'ur.

English: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo tung'ana laa atua iyie etii engolon enye, lelo oata too ltauja lenye, nena oitoi kituaak naapuo Sion.

English: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Masaai: Ore lelo oosujaki ninche too lng'oborri naa olosho le Asheri, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Asheri naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran,

English: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki ayau iltung'ana apa ootii atua ina anasa, nepik ninche esiaai oo nkaik, too musumenoni o sekenke o ntoluo. Neiko Daudi neijia too nkanas pooki oo Lamori. Nerrinyo Daudi o ltung'ana pooki aapuo Yerusalem.

English: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
Masaai: Neidikidik aas ina te rishata oo larin aare; o metaa ore lelo pooki oomanya Asia aa Lyahudi o Lyunani, nening ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Ina natung'uayie olaisampuani ake naleku, anaa te neisampu olaisampuani ilng'anayio neing'uaa oare anaa okuni ootii shumata oleng, aashu oong'uan anaa imiet too lng'osil lo lchani loo lng'anayio, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel ojo.

English: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nelo Musa o Aron enetii Farao nejoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, pee aatum aaitaiki osirua ti ong'ata.’ ”

English: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
Masaai: Ng'ura kira iyiook irrindiki ena olong; tiatua ena kop apa ninchoo loo papa pee eshipakino ilng'anayio lenyena o nkishorot enyena sidain, ng'ura, kira iyiook irrindiki.

English: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
Masaai: Ore apa to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria enye, eidipa aipoo ina kop o enkaji e Nkai, neirriwaki Shafan olayioni le Asalia olkilikuai, o Mesai ilo balusui le nkanasa o Yoa olayioni le Yoahas, ilo aigeroni, pee etum aaitobira enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa kaitaa Yerusalem osoit oiroishi too loreren pooki le nkop tenetem ninche aadumu ninye, naa keitame ate oleng. Naa kedumakino ninye iloreren pooki le nkop aarare ninye.

English: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
Masaai: Entajeu ilkulikae entawuapu ninche ti atua enkima eng'urrie lelo kulikae to lturiaki nimbayuyu ebaiki ninye enkila naidurukie osesen.

English: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
Masaai: Nji etiaka Olaitoriani ilo otubukoko eilata, aput, ilo oji Sairos, ilo laibung'a nanu enkaina enye e tatene, pee elo ninye aitore iloreren te dukuya ninye neoru ilaiguanak imasaa enye, nebol nkutukie oo nkajijik te dukuya ninye pee meitoki nkutukie oo nkajijik aaikeno:

English: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatasotuoki endiati aapejoo te nkima, nejia sii etiu te nkiting'oto e nkop.

English: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
Masaai: o Dana, o Kiriat-sana (aa taa Debir),

English: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD'S anointed is before him.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau ninche, neing'or ninye Eliab, nedamu ajo, “Esipa etii ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput dukuya.”

English: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
Masaai: Eishua apa Sara ilarin iip o tikitam o naapishana, lelo apa larin le nkishui e Sara.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitorian, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa papaai lenye Usia.

English: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
Masaai: Ore te nelotu ninye te ina olong pee eitaai kitok ti atua isinyat lenyena pee eing'asiakinoi ninye te atua lelo pooki ooiruko, amu ore shakenisho ang te intae neirukoki.

English: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
Masaai: Naa kairriwaa nanu olalem, o lameyu o lmeitai shumata ninche, o metaba anaa neidaikieki tukul teina kop apa naishoo nanu ninche o loo menye.”

English: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
Masaai: Nejoki Abraham ninye, “Toduaa ake mirriny olayioni lai ine.

English: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
Masaai: Tayiolo, ele omoda aisul! Lo moda, kanu akenya ingenunu?

English: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Metudung'oi Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie too lng'oborri le Yakobo tenebo oltung'ani oas ina, o loishakenoki, anaa olowal anaa oloyaki olasar Olaitoriani loo lororani!

English: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
Masaai: Entodol ake pee meetae hoo obo olau empiris e Enkai; inchere pee metumi “entonai e nduaran” nabulu neyau entorroni, neaku te ina ilkumok te ina eisarkionieki ilkumok;

English: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
Masaai: neitu eirorie metii enkitanyaanyukoto, kake ore pee eaku ninye ake o looiteng'eni lenyena neibalakinye ninche pooki toki.

English: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.
Masaai: Nchoo ake pee kinang'are iyie kulo monek, taasa enaba anaa enatum nkaik inono aataas, amu etii Enkai te nebo iyie.

English: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkaraki enkitanapata o Laitoriani neisho iltung'ana le Israel lelo le Lawi kuna anas o neeirritishoreki metaa enjung'ore enye.

English: Quench not the Spirit.
Masaai: Nimisiorogogo Enkiyang'et,

English: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
Masaai: Neaku eikintieu aatejo, “Olaitoriani olaretoni lai, maureishoyu, kaa aaidim oltung'ani aitaasa?”

English: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
Masaai: Iyanyita Olaitoriani too ntokitin inono, o too lng'anayio le dukuya le nkurma ino.

English: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu ajo ore nkisilisilot ena kata meitorisiokini ina kitoo nayookini aaboloki yiook.

English: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
Masaai: Neaku keaku taata ninche ile dukuya te lelo oopuo eyararoto, ore isiruai linyi o sikarri inyi neishunye.”

English: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
Masaai: Kake ore Herode ilo balusui pee eisikong ninye te nkaraki nayama Herodias enkitok o lalashe lenye, o sii te nkaraki kulie bususi naataasa Herode,

English: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Kaaitajeu nanu Olaitoriani, naa eikipuo aaranyisho too nkinantani oo usin too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ang te nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oyamishe naa mbaa e nkop enyamaliki, neyieu neitiship enkitok enye,

English: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
Masaai: (enemeye lkuru lenye nemeye enkima.)

English: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
Masaai: Neitu eidimu lelo ang'eni le tung'ana oitasheito te dukuya Musa te nkaraki iltuduta, amu etijing'a iltuduta lelo ang'eni le tung'ana loo Lmisiri pooki.

English: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nena baa naaitureishore nikiteleja iyie, oilo wuasa lo ltau lino, iyie oton too lbaat le ndapidapoi oibung entopij oldoinyo. Ore hoo nipik enkaji ino shumata oleng anaa olkurragos, kaaitadou nanu iyie aitung'uaa ine, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

English: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo osho o enkitoria nimikisiai iyie neidak; ore lelo oshon naa keidaikieki katukul.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii, aajoki:

English: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
Masaai: Ntobira ewueji tiauluo nepuoyieki ntonat,

English: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
Masaai: Kaa dupoto eeta enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai, teneidip olaitobirani lenye aitobiru, enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai e sekenkei, olaiteng'enani le lejare? Amu keisilig oloasisho ina kitobirunoto naitobirua ninye, nemeitobiru ninye nkitanyaanyukot nemeiro!

English: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
Masaai: Aaitaa ninye nanu entoki naimakini too loreren; nara obo le lelo oonotaki iltung'ana.

English: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

English: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

English: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
Masaai: Kake etigirate ninche aamor lelo sinkan le Nkai, nemenaa irorei lenyena, nesurdaay iloibonok le Nkai, o metaba anaa nedumunye engoro o Laitoriani too iltung'ana lenyena, ometaba anaa neaku meetae olmairo.

English: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Paulo nabo olong kewarie eirura, “Miureishoyu, iroro, nimigira;

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu te yieunoto e Nkai, o lalashe lang Timoteo, esirit e Nkai natii Korintio aigeroki o lelo sinyat ootii pooki wueji te Akaia.

English: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
Masaai: Neikuna ninye neijia pee kisipu iyiook nikiyiolou eneba enkishorunoto enye naikishiaan naishoo ninye iyiook pesho ti atua ilo Inoti lenye.

English: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
Masaai: “Naa keas olaiguanani anaa enayieu; kerup ninye kewan neilepie kewan aitulus te pooki ai, naa keiro ninye mbaa esulare ti alo Enkai oo nkaitin. Kedupayu ninye o metaba anaa neitabari engoro; amu ore ina apa natudung'oki kepuoi aas.

English: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

English: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
Masaai: Neaku etorikoyie ninye iltung'ana lenyena te ng'ida, nerikoo lelo gelunot lenyena to sinkolio.

English: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

English: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
Masaai: Amu kalo malaika etiaaka Enkai ae kata nchere, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai latoiwuo te le kekun?” Aashu sii, “Kaaku nanu menye lenye, neaku ninye Oinoti lai?”

English: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
Masaai: Amu eyieuta oshi neduaare intae pooki, nenoto osina oleng amu itoning'o aajo esipa etamuoyia.

English: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni neetae apa enkiyama te Kana e Galilaya: netii ng'otonye e Yesu ine.

English: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

English: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

English: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

English: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
Masaai: Eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei aanyita enkisiligata ino; naikilikuanu ajo, “Kanu kenya kintagol nanu?”

English: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
Masaai: Amu iutata apa olng'ur too looena, nitonyorraitie te nchipai meishang'itieki masaa inyi, amu eiyiololo apa aajo iatata intae maate entoki nalang naa enabikoo.

English: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
Masaai: Metaa atoduaa ina ng'eno nagut ajo kelus te sidano emodai anaa enalus ewang'an te sidano te naimin.

English: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
Masaai: Kaing'ae ilo linguranienie intae? Kaing'ae ilo libolokiki nkutukie aakueniki, nintarasusu ilng'ejepa? Aimirara intae nkera e nkitarruoroto, eishoi e lejare,

English: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

Masaai: Ore lelo karash pooki ooisiong'a oomanita le ndung'oroto naa ile nkatani napuyiapui napiyaya.

Masaai: Ore anaa nemoruau Solomon eibelekenya nkituaak enyena oltau lenye metusujai nkaitin enye; neitu eibung'are oltau lenye oleng Olaitoriani Enkai enye, anaa enatiu apa oltau le Daudi papaai lenye.

Masaai: Najo to ltau lai tenena naaipirta nkera oo ltung'ana inchere Enkai natemita ninche pee eitodol ninche nchere ing'uesi ninche.

English: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
Masaai: Ore ilo ojoki oltung'ani torrono inchere, “Miata iyie entioto,” naa kedek iloreren ninye, neibayu iloshon ninye.

English: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

English: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Tenkaraki entorroni pooki oo ilayiok le Israel o layiok le Yuda apa nataasa pee aaitagor ilaiguanak lenye o lkituaak lenye, ilapolosak lenye o loibonok lenye, iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ianyianya akenya imbungubungu nkitanapat o nkirorot aainei o anu?

English: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
Masaai: Niya sii imotonyi oloing'ang'e maare naapishana, oloing'oni ake o elipong peyie eitubulaa impukunot enye tioriong enkop.

English: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
Masaai: kake amaa taata itayioloito Enkai, aashu doi taata eewuo Enkai ayiolou intae, kaji etiu pee intokiki arrinyokino nkiyang'eta aisinak nemeeta tipat neshal, eji niyieuwu intae nintokiki ake aaku rrindiki lenye.

English: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

Masaai: Naa ore tenkaraki ena kaitame nanu eishoi e Daudi, kake mme ntarasi.’ ”

English: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

English: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
Masaai: Nelotu erubata e uni te nkaraki olosho le Sebulon, te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena. Ore ina kop e njung'ore enye nelo abaya Sarid;

English: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
Masaai: Neitanap ninye ninche ajoki, “Ng'ura, irragirraga intae aanuka aaishiaakinore enkanasa, aaimu ninye ti oriong; emipuopuo intae aalamari oleng te ina anasa, kake enterretenata pee irasakiki.

English: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
Masaai: “Ting'idayu te nebo Yerusalem, nishipa te nkaraki ninye, intae pooki oonyor ninye; tishipayu te nebo ninye te ng'ida, intae lelo pooki ooishiraki ninye;

English: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
Masaai: Naaiteng'ena ninye nanu, naajoki, “Inchoo oltau lino eibung akurraki irorei laainei tushuma inkitanapat aainei pee iton inchu.

English: One shall say, I am the LORD'S; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
Masaai: Nejo ake oltung'ani, ‘Ara nanu olo Laitoriani,’ ore olikae neipotie kewan enkarna e Yakobo, ore olikae neiger te nkaina enye ajo, ‘Olo Laitoriani,’ nedung'oki kewan enkarna metaa keji Israel.”

English: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye aidaikie tele doinyo ina kimulumulet apa natanang'akaki shumata iloreren pooki, ilo karasha apa oidapashakaki shumata iloshon pooki.

English: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Eitobira apa sii Hiram imotioo, o nchempei naata ilala, o ngirran. Neaku eidipa apa Hiram esiaai pooki nataasaka Solomon tialo ina aji Olaitoriani:

English: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
Masaai: Ore naa taata aata embae nabo naomonu te iyie, nimikianyaki iyie nanu.” Nejoki Betsheba ninye, “Tolimu.”

English: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
Masaai: Neaku etobiko naleng te ine eshirraki aairo ti atua Olaitoriani, neitadedeyie ninye ilo rorei le mpiris enye, neishoru metaasi ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia too nkaik enye.

English: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
Masaai: nirikuku papaai linyi o pooki tung'ani loo lmareita linyi, nipuonunu enatii, naa kaisho nanu intae enkop naisul ena kop e Misiri te sidano, naa ainyanya empiron ena kop.’

English: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninche too olchalai neing'usilu enkop.

English: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina nedol Siraeli aare ooara, nejo aitaiki osotua. Nejoki, ‘Loyie, irara doi lalashera, ainyoo iorrorro pokira?’

English: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
Masaai: nelimu ninye aibalunye ina ngoki nataasa, neitobir ninye elaata nalulung'a te ina kitarruoroto enye, aponaa erubata e imiet te ina, neisho ilo laa ninye einyala.

English: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
Masaai: Ore Ishpan, o Eber o Eliel,

English: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu nena nelo Yesu, nedol oltung'ani osotu kodi oji Lawi, eton te wueji nesotunye kodi; nejoki, “Tusujuki nanu.”

English: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD'S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the princes of the people.
Masaai: Naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et shumata, naayau nanu kishomi oloosaen e nkaji o Laitoriani, ina naipirare oloosaen. Naa Ng'ura, ore te kutuk aji e ina kishomi netii iltung'ana tikitam o imiet; nadol tiatua ninche Yaasania olayioni le Asuri, o Peletia olayioni le Benaia o lkituaak loo ltung'ana.

English: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
Masaai: Amu idamumu intae enyamali ang o esiaai nagol, ilalashera, kitaasishote dama o kewarie, pee mikiek hoo likae te intae, kiliki intae Ilomon Supati le Nkai.

English: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
Masaai: lelo tung'ana apa ooyautua olkilikuai torrono le ina kop, neye ninche to lmeitai te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: And he must needs go through Samaria.
Masaai: Kake meeta kata nemeimaa Samaria.

English: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
Masaai: Eishutua ninche nena pisai apa naanotoki te nkaji o Laitoriani, netipika ninche nkaik o laigerok o laitasheikinok.”

English: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
Masaai: Eituruk enatoning'o nchere ketii eoro atua intae ti nitumomo irara esirit, naa kairuk kulie e nena.

English: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
Masaai: Neipotu osoit dapash neiger ajo, “Keji enkarna Yohana!” Neingasia pooki.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
Masaai: Naa ore teina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, ekajutoo aiwuang'ie nkarn oo nkitaanyaanyukot oo nkaitin teina kop, ometaa meigili aekata aadamu; naiwuang'ie sii iloibonok o nkiyang'eta torrok.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kapik intae atua nkaik e lelo limbaba, atua inkaik e lelo limbelekenyanya aaing'uaa te ngoro;

English: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law:
Masaai: Kitoosho sii enkukuo, ilapolosak, o Lawi, o ltung'ana, te nkaraki nkiri olasar loo lkeek, pee eyauni atua enkaji e Nkai ang, te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo papa, too nkatitin naategeluaki, te pooki ari. Pee einoki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang anaa enaigero too nkitanapat.

English: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
Masaai: Etii eng'eno nagut atua emoruo, ore ening'unoto netii atua enkadori oo nkolong'i.

English: He shall break also the images of Bethshemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
Masaai: Naa kegil ninye nena ng'apeta naasinya e Heliopolis naatii atua enkop e Misiri; ore nkajijik oo nkaitin e Misiri nepejoo te nkima.’ ”

English: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Masaai: Meibung'a olng'ejep lai enoret e nkutuk ai, te nemaadamu nanu iyie, te nemapik nanu Yerusalem aitulus te nchipai ai pooki!

English: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
Masaai: Ee neijia etiu Papa amu ina nikintishipa iyie.

English: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
Masaai: Neranyisho ilkeek le ntim te ng'ida, te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu kelotu ninye aiguanare enkop.

English: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
Masaai: Ore emayianita ninye ninche, neilep aing'uaa ninche.

English: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
Masaai: Metaa kaitaraposh engoro ai te iyie, neiwuang olom lai te iyie; kaaku nanu olobor, nemaitoki aigil agoro.

English: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
Masaai: Ore ejo neijia nedou enkatampoi neitoip apik oloip; neureishoyu pee ejing atua ina atampoi.

English: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
Masaai: Nebaya lido kekun loo Lgeraseni, oipirare Galilaya.

English: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
Masaai: Netii apa Olaitoriani tenebo ninye, ore pooki wueji neshomo, ninye nedupoyu. Etapong'ori ninye olaiguanani le Asiria neany eisiaai ninye.

English: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
Masaai: Ee, kedol ninye nchere, ekeye sii ninye ilo ng'en, ore ilo modai o lkiminchali naa keidak te nebo neing'ueiki ina arsisisho enye ilkulikae.

English: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie lelo torrok te dukuya olaiguanani naa keitasheyieki olorika lenye le nkitoo te sipata.

English: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: naikirikirie nanu iloreren pooki, ore ilchumat lenye neyauni ene neiput enkaji e Nkai esikar, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
Masaai: “Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa ntoyie tomon, naatudumutua ltaai lenye aapuo aanang'are oloyamisho.

English: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena naing'orisho, ore enkaji e Enkai o lng'obor le nchakenisho ti atua shumata neboli.

English: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
Masaai: Toning'o oltoilo le sayiata ai, enkata naaishiraki nanu iyie te nkaraki eretoto, ina kata ailepie nanu nkaik aainei, aing'orie ewueji ino sinyati aisul.

English: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore ilo orrip Israel nemeimug nemeirura.

English: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nena neisho ninche larishak o metabaiki enkata e Samuel olapa oiboni le Nkai.

English: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.
Masaai: Ore lelo apa ooiputakinote neisilenoitie ate pee etum endaa, kake ore lelo apa ooisumash nemeekure eisumash. Etoiuo ina apa olupi nkera naapishana, kake ore ina apa naata nkera kumok nemeekure eeta.

English: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkolong nasujita ina nelotu Agripa o Bernike eisikarrate, nejing ina aji e nkiguana te nebo lkituaak loo sikarini o ltung'ana kituaak le ina anasa, neitanapisho metorikuni Paulo.

English: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu aishir to ltoilo sapuk, nedung'o tau.

English: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
Masaai: O mbokishi o nchempei oo lala, o masaa pooki naaitobira Huram to suyai oidong'o, aitobiraki olaiguanani Solomon, tenkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
Masaai: Etoduaa ninye ajo keidim Enkai aitopiu iltung'ana ebaiki ilootuata; te ina kitanyaanyukie aajo, enoto ang'amu.

English: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
Masaai: naajoki nanu Olaitoriani,

English: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa Daudi o lpayiani, o lkituaak loo nkalifuni, aayau osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani te nkaji e Obed-edom te ng'ida.

English: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
Masaai: Neaku, ore anaa ina naisho iyiook Enkai ena kisiaaiyiare to lng'ur lenye, mikidukenya iyiook.

English: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Masaai: Mbaa naapi o lang'oroni, naaitagoloki too nkuk naaishu o lchani!

English: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?
Masaai: Ore naa taata ti niterretenate, ti nining'ining'i oltoilo le mowuo o le ndule o lwulul loo usin o enkinanta nanyaanyukie olwulul, o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o lbene okuti te ndule, o pooki pukunoto o sinkolio, naa nibatatata aaserem ina kitanyaanyukoto e sahabu naitobira nanu, naa aisidai ina. Kake tinimiserememe intae, nenang'akini intae nabo kata atua olkokuet oyupuyup; naa kaa ai ina naidim atokordu intae aitayu too nkaik aainei?”

English: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
Masaai: Enukari aa osesen le na kishon, neitopiuni aa ole nkiyang'et. Eetaeosesen le na kishon, kake eetae sii likae sesen le nkiyang'et.

English: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
Masaai: Ore Malkija olayioni le Harim o Hashub olayioni le Pahat Moab neitobir aaram enkae rishata tenebo oltalet lo lkokuet.

English: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Ilfarisayo ina nejo, “Mearaa ele tung'ani iloiriruani mme te ngolon e Beelsebul olkitok loo loiriruani.”

English: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
Masaai: Oi apa tenaa itoning'o nkitanapat aainei, amu anaata etotiuo eseriani ino anaa olkeju, netiu esupatisho ino anaa lopir le naiposha;

English: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
Masaai: Ore peyie ebulu lelo ayiok, neaku Esau olang'oroni padan naa oltung'ani sii liong'ota. Ore Yakobo, naa oltung'ani obor ogira aton too lng'oborri.

English: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Asa aya Yuda pooki, nenap ninche lelo soito le Rama o mbaoi enyena, apa naa ninche eshetishore olaiguanani Baasha, nelo ashetie ninche Geba o Mispa.

English: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
Masaai: kake ore amu Olaitoriani oiguanare iyiook, ina pee eitamei iyiook, pee medung'okini iyiook enkiguana aairiamaa o enkop.

English: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
Masaai: Ore enkiguana o Laitoriani neitashe ntarasi, ore ndamunot o ltau lenye nebaiki iishoritin pooki.

English: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Ore taata nituputo ate te nkisiayiare o Laitoriani, pooki ng'ae te nkinyiang'a o layioni lenye o eno lalashe lenye, pee eisho ninye Enkai ntae emayianata ena olong taata.”

English: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
Masaai: Ore shumata enkishomi oo mbartan neitobir ilapolosak aaram, oltung'ani ake enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye makewan.

English: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
Masaai: Kake etabuaa Paulo to ltoilo sapuk, nejo, “Miar kewan, kitii pooki ene.”

English: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Ilawi pooki laa ninche apa ooiteng'en iltung'ana loo Siraeli, naa sinyat ninche to Laitoriani, “Entipik ilo sanduku sinyati atua ina aji apa natesheta Solomon olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani le Israel. Meeta tipat pee intokiki aanap too loilila linyi. Esiayia naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai inyi o ltung'ana lenyena le Israel.

English: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,
Masaai: Ena ninye eishoi e Peres: Peres apa menye le Hesron,

English: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
Masaai: Neaku ebore impechen inono enkumoi, neiput imalasin inono enaisho oo sabibu nedooyo.

English: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
Masaai: Keitayu ninye lelo ootii orreshet lenye, near ninye iloshon metuata nemeing'urrie ntarasi?

English: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
Masaai: “Naa keaku osinka lai Daudi olaiguanani lenye oitore ninche; naa keaku ninche ololchekut obo. Naa kesuj ninche inkitanapat aainei, neing'or oleng aasuj inkiguanat aainei.

English: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Israel atara metuata lelo pooki apa oomanya Ai ti atua ina ong'ata naisiaja apa natusujakitia ninche ore ninche pooki o metabaiki olobayie lenye netabatatate te nepi o lalem, neshukunye Israel pooki aapuonu Ai neosh ninche te nepi o lalem.

English: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
Masaai: Naa te neinos ninye olmumai ti atua enkaji olpayian lenye e, aashu een kewan enye to lmumai,

English: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
Masaai: To loiboni le Nkai eilepunye Olaitoriani Israel aitung'uaa Misiri; naa to loiboni le Nkai eitagolieki ninye.

English: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.
Masaai: Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, naa tenenoto osinka lino omom too nkonyek inono, pee kirriwaa nanu mashomo Yuda, ina anasa natii nkuraren oo loo papa, pee alo ashet.”

English: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Entanang'aki orreshet tatene e mpout, naa itumutumu.” Nenang'aki orreshet ore te nkaraki enkumoi oo sinkir eitu eitoki aaidim aateyietu.

English: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
Masaai: Nara omoni neitu kirikiriki ang; nemaishopo neitu kinchopishopo; namuei, naena neitu kibaikiki.’

English: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
Masaai: Nejoki olayioni menye, ‘Papa, ataasa eng'oki te Nkai o te dukuya iyie; meishiaakino naaji kara enkerai ino.’

English: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
Masaai: Neaku kemir masaa enye o ntokitin naata neorikino pooki mpesai, anaa enaatayie oltung'ani enkolat.

English: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
Masaai: Eirrapirrapisho ninche te naimin metii ewang'an neesiesari anaa olamerani.

English: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
Masaai: Enaikash tinimany olpijata le nchumata enkaji, alang tinitii enkaji e nkitok naata ororei.

English: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu aishaki nena baa nkiyiaa enye, nejing Kapernaum.

English: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
Masaai: pee ayiolou nanu ninye o engolon e mpiunoto enye, nang'arie olosilisili lenye, atiu anaa ninye ti atua enkeeya,

English: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
Masaai: Ke nkishu o nkerrai eyieng'i te nkaraki ninche, pee eitaraposhi ninche? Arashu keisinkir pooki le naiposha eiturrurruni te nkaraki ninche, pee eitaraposhi ninche?”

English: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
Masaai: Mikisisi iyie Enkai, aaitulusoo te keper! Nchoo meibulu enkitoo ino enkop pooki!

English: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
Masaai: nejoki ninche te Shilo ti atua enkop e Kanaan, “Eitanapishe apa Olaitoriani aimunye Musa nchere pee eishori iyiook nkanas nikimany te nebo ineeirritishoreki te nkaraki nkishu ang.”

English: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Samaria aibung ina kop pooki, nelotu Samaria, ore too larin okuni, neman Samaria agadu.

English: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
Masaai: netoning'o Yakobo menye o yieyio lenye nelo Padan-aram.

English: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
Masaai: Amu einyo apa ai kata Teudas, neitaa kewan likae taani kitok, nesuj iltung'ana oobaya iip ong'uan. Neari ninye, o lelo pooki ootoning'o ninye, neisardakieki, neaku pesho.

English: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
Masaai: Toosho tarerioi enkerai ino tuutai naa aikincho ninye enkiyeng'iyeng; naa keisho enchipai oltau lino.

English: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani oishopo too nkilani naapuyiapui, ilo otii shumata nena ariak e olkeju nedumu enkaina enye e tatene o enkaina enye e kedienye aipirie shumata; naning nanu ninye einos olmumai teilo oishu ntarasi nchere te nkata, o inkatitin are, o lpisiai le nkata; naa te neidip ninche aatigil engolon e lelo tung'ana sinyat aaiting'ie ore kuna baa pooki neaku eitabayioki.

English: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo kituaak ninche, “Enchoo ninche epok.” Neaku ninche ilaiperrak loo lkeek neoku enkare te nkaraki olturrur pooki, anaa enatiakitia lelo kituaak ninche.

English: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
Masaai: Amu ore oloyieu neitajeu enkishui enye, neiminie; kake ore pooki oiturraa enkishui enye enkaraki nanu neitajeu.

English: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so she may be healed.
Masaai: Etabatate nabo kata Babilon negila; teyietu nchiraki ninye! Ewaita olchani te nkaraki emion enye. Eidimayu pee eishiunyeki ninye.

English: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
Masaai: Naa ena enkishoroto ning'amu te ninche: sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai,

English: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
Masaai: Ore enkitanapata o Laitoriani naa keikishiaan, neitopiu oltau; ore enchakenisho o Laitoriani naa kedede, neiteng'en olmodai;

English: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
Masaai: Ore te kulie kumok nereiki aikok olorere eliki lomon supati.

English: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
Masaai: Eyieu taa ena eng'eno nagut, nchoo ilo oata ening'unoto eikenisho atum esiana e ina ng'ues. Amu esiana e tung'ani. Ore esiana enye naa iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.

English: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
Masaai: Ing'ura, ore apa eton elulung'a ninye, nemeeta ae naitaasi; kebaa meeta tipat etumuta enkima ninye, keitoki aata tipat tiae toki.

English: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
Masaai: olayioni le Maat, olayioni le Matatias, olayioni le Semein, olayioni le Yosek, olayioni le Yuda,

English: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.
Masaai: “Ene nkoshoke endaa, naa ene ndaa enkoshoke” — kake keiwuang'ie kenyake Enkai pokira are. Ore osesen pee eetae mme ole nkiborra oo nkonyek kake olo Laitoriani: naa olo sesen Olaitoriani;

English: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
Masaai: Tenipalakiki oltung'ani ingok nepalakini, tenimipalakiki oltung'ani ingok, nemepalakini.

English: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yehoash etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te Samaria, tenebo ilaiguanak le Israel; neitoreisho Yeroboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
Masaai: Nejoki taa ninche ninye, “Kaa kitoduata ias, pee kidol nikiruk iyie? Kaa iasita iyie?

English: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
Masaai: Naadumakino nanu ilewa le Gibea, neman aang'adu ina aji natii kewarie; keyieu apa ninche naar nanu matua, neikony enkapiani ai, netua ninye.

English: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
Masaai: Eng'ura Sion, ina anasa gelunoti nikipolosishore iyiook! Kepuo nkonyek inono aadol Yerusalem, ina manyisho naitirring'a, ilo ng'obor lemeigusugus, lemedotunye ae kata nena sheito naaunore, nemedung'o nena keenta naaenare.

English: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.
Masaai: Neitobiraki sii kewan nkanas, o luaat oo nkerra, o nkishu kumok, amu eishoo apa Olaitoriani ninye imasaa kumok.

English: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
Masaai: “Eetae nkitanapat e Musa o loibonok o metabaiki Yohana; ore ebaiki ina kata nelikiori lomon supati le nkitoria e Nkai, nediding'akino pooki ng'ae te ngolon.

English: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
Masaai: Mincho oltung'ani laaijo ilo edamu ajo ketum toki to Laitoriani,

English: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
Masaai: Kake ore ina kop nang'uar ninche pee eshukokino, meshukokino ninche.”

English: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
Masaai: keaku ninye olasar opeji anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te ine natumore nanu intae, pee airorie nanu intae te ine.

English: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
Masaai: Entadedeyie naa enkirridunoto inyi too lng'anayio lenyena; nimintokiki ake ajo, ‘Kiata Abraham aa papa lang.’ Ajoki intae, keidim Enkai ainyeyieki Abraham nkera te kulo soito.

English: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
Masaai: Eishir ninye te mion kewarie, etii ilkiyio ntakul enyena; ore tiatua lelo sanchan lenyena pooki meetae hoo obo oitagol ninye eibelekenyate ilchoreta lenyena pooki etaa ninche ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
Masaai: Woi ilo tung'ani torrono! Kerruoyo mbaa te ninye, amu ore enaba anaa enataasa nkaik enyena, ina eyookini aaitaas ninye.

English: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
Masaai: “Ore ake pee eish isinaitin le nena olong'i, neitomisimisi enkolong nemeitoki olapa awang'u, nesulunye ilakir to loing'ang'e, neigirigiro engolon o loing'ang'e.

English: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the LORD said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu, naaku oltau le lejare too nkutukie oo loibonok lenyena.’ Nejo ninye ilo iyie alej ninye, naa ndimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.

English: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
Masaai: Neipang'u Ehudi boo, neiken nkutukie oo nkajijik e ilo gilata le shumata, neen.

English: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
Masaai: Etubula inkera enye te dukuya ninche, netodua ninche iishoritin enye too nkonyek enye.

English: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo payiani laa larikok supati, nchoo edamuni neigilieki aaisho enkanyit, neisulaki lelo oonyok te likioroto o te nkiteng'enare.

English: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
Masaai: Te nadamu nanu kuna baa nelepori oltau lai ti atua nanu, amu ashomo nanu arikoo olorora nikipuo e nkaji e Nkai, too mbuakunot e nchipai o sinkolioitin le nashe, neitobir ilo orora osirua.

English: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:
Masaai: “Misilenoki iyie te dupoto olalashe lino, te dupoto oo mpisai, aashu te dupoto e ndaa aashu te dupoto e pooki toki ake ninye.

English: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
Masaai: Ore apa aa kuti ninche nemedupa ninche, naa ilomon,

English: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
Masaai: Ena enkitanapata ai, inchere tonyorra olikae anaa enatonyorra nanu intae.

English: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
Masaai: Neaku etobiko apa iltung'ana le Israel ti atua Ilkanaani, o Ilhiti, Ilamori, Ilperisi, Ilhifi o Lyebusi;

English: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
Masaai: Nchoo kulo rorei laainei, laa ninche atasaishore te dukuya Olaitoriani, etaaniki Olaitoriani Enkai ang dama o kewarie, naa nchoo ninye meisula osinka lenye, neisulu iltung'ana lenyena Isiraeli, anaa ake enaishiaakino te pooki olong.

English: But Solomon built him an house.
Masaai: Kake Solomon oteshetaka enkaji.

English: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eisilenoko oltung'ani aisilenoni ltung'ana aare indinari enyena, neisho obo indinari iip imiet, neisho olikae onom.

English: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
Masaai: Etoiwuoki intae aaigil neme te mpeu narruoyo kake te nemerruoyo, kake to rorei le Enkai oishu nebik intarasi.

English: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.
Masaai: Ore teine nishetu olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, olperere lo lasar loo soito, neminteleiki ninche esekenkei.

English: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
Masaai: “Ena ninye naishoruno teilo oar olikae te sesekuan, tenesaru ninye ine neidim aitopuaa enkishui enye. Tenear oltung'ani olelatia enye eitu eotiki meatakinore

English: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
Masaai: Amu eyawua eng'oki o ltung'ani obo enkitoria e keeya, te ilo tung'ani obo. Kebaa elusoo empiris e Nkai ayaki olning'o o ninye neidimie lelo oong'amu ina te mborei pooki meitoreisho te nkishui ti atua Yesu Kristo.

English: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
Masaai: o ematua nabo e tomon te pooki ake ninye sitima le ker le lelo oopishana;

English: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Manahem, nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
Masaai: Neaku etejo ninye, keidaikie ninche - keitu ninye eitashe Musa, ilo gelunoti lenye, te dukuya ninye, pee eibelekeny ina goro enye napi pee meidaikie ninche.

English: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
Masaai: Ore ewang'an oo nkonyek neitiship oltau, naa ore ilomon sidain neitagol iloik.

English: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Amu ore te nkaraki engoro o Laitoriani, etabawua e rishata te Yerusalem o te Yuda, naiturrayie ninye ninche aitalam kewan. Negolong'aki Sedekia olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninche ilapolosak ilturrurri lenye nepik Ilawi irishat enye e siaai, tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e Nkai te Yerusalem anaa enaigeroki te mbuku e Musa.

English: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Kaji doi iloito iyie?” Naajoki ninye nanu, “Kalo atem Yerusalem, pee ayiolou eneba endapasho enye o eneba enkadori enye.”

English: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
Masaai: Kanyor lelo laanyor nanu, ore lelo laaing'oru nanu te nyuaata naa kaatum.

English: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
Masaai: Tenaa keitoduaaki ilo torrono olng'ur, meyiolou ae kata ninye esipata; ore ti atua enkop oo sipat, neas ake ntorrok, nemedol enkitoo o Laitoriani.

English: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e nkikoo e Daudi papaai lenye, etegelua ninye ilturrurri loo lapolosak tenkaraki enkisiaayiare enye, o Lawi tenkaraki isiaaitin enye e nkisisa o enkisiaayiare te dukuya ilapolosak metaasa esiaai te pooki olong nayieuni; o ilarripok loo nchomito loo lturrurri lenye too nchomito esiana naje; amu ina apa eitanapishe Daudi osinka le Nkai.

English: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
Masaai: olaa ti atua ninye eruba osesen pooki, neidikidikokino atua ninye pooki rubata naishoro, easisho nena rubat pooki aaitobiraki, neitubulu osesen neitubulu kewan ti atua enyorrata.

English: Then Judas, which had betrayeth him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
Masaai: Ore Yudas ilo oitarasayie pee edol ajo eidipaki aaiguanare, neitoki ainosu neshuku nena pisai tomoni uni e nkosholai ashukoki ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani,

English: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
Masaai: “Etii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani atua nanu, amu aatubukoko ninye e ilata, aput, naairriwua matoliki laisinak ororei supat, nalaku te sinkaisho ilooena, naliki lmodook emboloto oo nkonyek enye, nalaku aisho epuo, lelo ooitorogonyaki,

English: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
Masaai: Aning nanu nchere iata iyie ilabarnok; etii oshi ilchekuti linono te nebo iyiook, neitu iyiook kintaas ninche entorrono, neitu ninche elau toki, ina kata pooki etii Karmel.

English: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
Masaai: Ore iunishosho to lari le isiet ninosinoso endaa musana; ometabau olari lioudo olotunye endaa enye, inosinoso endaa musana.

English: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
Masaai: naisho nanu ina palai e nkinyiang'unoto Barak olayioni le Neria olayioni le Mahasia, te dukuya Hanamel olenkapu lai, te dukuya ilchakenini ootimishira ina palai e nkinyang'unoto, o te dukuya Ilyahudi pooki apa ootonita to lgoriet le rripore.

English: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
Masaai: entodol ate minyalinyala ate aaitobiru nkitanyaanyukot naagueta, te nkaraki intae maate, te mpukunoto e ae toki, te mpukunoto olee aashu e ng'oruoi,

English: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Simiri, oina natarreshishe, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Iyie otejo nchere ara nanu olaiguanani. Aatoiwuoki nanu enkaraki ena, naa enkaraki ena pee aewuo enkop pee aishakenoki esipata, Ening ole sipata pooki oltoilo lai.”

English: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
Masaai: Eibung'a olng'atuny engues nainos neyiataa ina ngues neyaki ilkuoo lenyena, negor ina meinosa iliponga enyena. Neiput enkapune enye inguesi naatara ninye neiput isanagi lenyena nkiri.

English: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
Masaai: Aitisip ena nchere, kayiolo ajo katon naa kabik aret intae pooki, te nkaraki enkitubulunoto inyi o eng'ida ti atua enkirukoto,

English: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
Masaai: Nchoo enkop meitumurru dupoto, neyau ndoinyo esupatisho!

English: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etii ltung'ana aare modook ootoni te mbata e nkoitoi, ore pee ening inchere Yesu ilo oimita ine nebuak aajo, “Lo Kitok ara Daudi, ing'urrie iyiook.”

English: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
Masaai: Netii enkitok naata oloirirua le lepori too larin tomon o isiet; neaku keirrugori meidim ataraposhunye.

English: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
Masaai: Ntaa iyie iyiook isuut o ntokitin e pesho, tiatua iltung'ana.

English: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
Masaai: Ore eidipa Boas ainosa endaa neokisho netishipe oltau lenye nelo ninye airrag te bayie o sototi le nkurma. Nelotu Rusi akiti nebolu nkejek enyena, neirrag.

English: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
Masaai: Nenap ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai te ngarri ng'ejuk, neyau ninye aaipang'unye te nkaji e Abinadab apa natii enchumata e ndoinyo; ore Usa o Ahio lelo ayiok le Abinadab nereu ina garri ng'ejuk,

English: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
Masaai: “Ekaitoki airura penyo, kaimug penyo,” ejo ninye “Ekashuk inkaik aainei ayeng'iyeng'a penyo.”

English: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
Masaai: Neitoki aliki ninche ae kitanyaanyukoto ajo, “Etiu enkitoria e shumata enaa enkantererai naji karadali natuuno oltung'ani te nkurma enye.

English: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
Masaai: Ore te nkitorogonyata e ndung'okinoto e nkiguana, newaki ninye; naa ore to lporror lenye aing'ae otishilayie, nchere eiwuang'ieki ninye te ina kop e lelo ooishu, etooshoki te nkitarruoroto oo ltung'ana laainei?

English: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
Masaai: Emilakie entorroni enkae torroni, kake ore enaishiaakino te pooki ng'ae entipik intae indamunot.

English: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
