Masaai: Mating'idata nikiosh olkerempe, nikincho ninye enkitoo, amu etabawua enkiyama o Lkuoo le Ker, netukuso kewan ina nayami.

English: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
Masaai: Amu ore pee eng'amu enchunet e nkisisa e nkitoo eing'uaa Enkai Papa, neewuo oltoilo enetii eing'uaa Enkitoo e nkisisa nalus, nejo, “Oinoti lai ele lanyor, natishipe oleng te ninye.”

English: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: te ngolon oo nkitoduaat o too ne nking'asia e ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, metaa ore ebaiki Yerusalem o metamanai alo Ilirikum, atolikioyie tukul ororei supat le Kristo.

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak olfarisayo isunkuro! amu imanimana naaiposha o enkop natoyio aaing'oru obo osuj intae, ore pee eibelekenya, nintaa ninye ololmoti le nkima katitin are alang ninye intae.

English: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
Masaai: Ore embae pooki nitejo ntae te naimin neyookini aalikioo te wang'an, ore nena nipuopuo aaing'omingo'makino too lgilat loo nkisudorot neyookini aalikioo too nchumarot oo nkajijik.

English: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
Masaai: neijia sii etiu ilo rorei lai oimu enkutuk ai; maarrinyokino nanu erok, kake kelo aitabaya inaipirie, nelo aitubul ina toki apa nairriwaka.

English: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
Masaai: Ore te nkoitoi epuku Yesu alo, nekuetiki oltung'ani negilaki kung, neikilikuan ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani supat, kaji aiko pee ajung enkishui nemeish?”

English: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
Masaai: Etarrarra ninye ilala laainei to sinyai naaimulumul nanu too nkuruon.

English: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
Masaai: Amu Enkai shakeni lai, naa ninye aisiaai te nkishui ai ti alo ilo rorei supat lo Inoti lenye nchere eitu apal maimaki intae anaa ake te nkomono ai,

English: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Meishiaakino te nenang'akini ildiein endaa oo nkera.”

English: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
Masaai: Neirrag ninye airura to loip lo lchani, naa ng'ura neiseyie olmalaika ninye nejoki ninye, “Tudumunye inosa endaa.”

English: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
Masaai: o Anab, o Eshtemo, o Anim,

English: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo e kopikop naa enanka oo lng'oborri le Ruben too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Ruben naa Elisur olayioni le Shedeur,

English: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
Masaai: Midotu ake entoki naitodolu olpolosie musana ina apa natipika iloo papaai lino.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Asheri te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena - kuna anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
Masaai: Neisikong Yesu nejoki, “Tigirayu! Tupuku tung'uai ninye.” Nebatat ilo oirirua torrono te dukuya ninye nepuku aing'uaa meeta enaitaasa ninye.

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika ninye, “Ng'ura ajo inuta, naa iiu enkayioni, nimpot enkarna enye ajo Ishmael, amu etoning'o Enkai osina lino.”

English: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
Masaai: kake ore ina kine natooshokoki enkukuo te nkaraki Asasel nepuo aaitarasaki eishu te dukuya Olaitoriani pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, pee etumi aaishoo meshomo adung ong'ata alo Asasel.

English: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
Masaai: Nepik ninche oloing'ang'e le keper peyie eisho ewang'an enkop neitore endama o enkewarie.

English: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
Masaai: Naa tenepuonu ninche ine, neitayu tiatua ninye intokitin pooki torrok o pooki toki olminong.

English: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina olong apa napuonu loo papaai linyi aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri ometabaiki ena olong, aitirrishaka nanu airriwaa isinkan laainei pooki lelo oibonok le Nkai enetii ninche te nkolong ake o te nkolong,

English: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
Masaai: Amu inchiamishama enanai e oshoke o Laitoriani.

English: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
Masaai: naiwuang'ie nanu esakutore te nkop inyi, niming'iligili aekata aata esakutore.

English: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
Masaai: Neigilieki ina bae katitin uni: neito ilo karasha keper.

English: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.
Masaai: Ore apa ina gumoto natanang'aka Ishmael impopoki e lelo tung'ana ootasesekuana naa engumoto sapuk apa naitobira olaiguanani Asa arripore ina kata egilunore olaiguanani oji Baasha le Israel; neigany Ishmael olayioni le Netania impopoki oo lootuata.

English: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
Masaai: Meetae oloilepa shumata, leme ilo otadowuo aing'uaa shumata.”

English: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
Masaai: Ore etii nena, eitoki sii aaku kintaikitia iyiook Enkai shakenisho e lejare amu kinchakenikito aajo Enkai naitopiwuo Kristo; kake eitu naa eitopiu ninye te netaa meitopiuni ilootuata.

English: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:
Masaai: Ti niureyuyu intae Olaitoriani nisiaiaya ninye, nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye, nimipaashaa aarare enkitanapata o Laitoriani, naa ti nisujaa intae tenebo olaiguanani oitore intae, Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nisidanunu

English: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
Masaai: Metaa eidapashate ninche, amu metii apa olairritani; neaku ninche endaa oo ng'uesi pooki e ntim.

English: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
Masaai: Nejoki Abraham osinka lenye otobiko oleng te nkaji laa ninye oitasheiki imasaa enyena pooki, “Tipika enkaina ino abori enkupes ai,

English: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Esion-geber nepuo aaun ilng'oborri tiong'ata e Sin (aa taa Kadesh ina).

English: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
Masaai: Ore eidipa aashom ilooirriwuaki le Yohana neiteru Yesu ainosaa Yohana to lorere nejo, “Ainyoo nawa intae enchom entodol ti ong'ata? Kolperesi oyuk enkijape?

English: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
Masaai: Neaku ore ake pee edumunye iltung'ana too lng'oborri lenye ejo pee elang Yordan to nebo lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua te dukuya iltung'ana,

English: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Masaai: Entaranyaki ninye, entaranyaki ninye enkisisa entolimu isiaaitin enyena pooki e nking'asia!

English: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
Masaai: intanapa ninche, meshomo nkurman o kuna ang'itie naamanita ene aainyang'aki ate entoki nanya.”

English: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata enkaji e Hasael, naa kemut ninye isempewueti le Benhadad.

English: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
Masaai: Keiput intae o lorora loo ntamesin, nena tamesin kutiti e Midian o Efa; kepuonu nekua pooki naaing'uaa Sheba. Keyau ninche sahabu o enkorropil, neibalunye ninche enkisisa o Laitoriani.

English: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
Masaai: Kiteleja lelo pooki lining'ore, kitimiraitie ninche aareu olpolosie; ore apa lelo liatayie eseriani nikitimira ninche; ore lelo shoreta linono lisilig netipika orreshet abori iyie embae nemeyiolounoyu ina.

English: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
Masaai: Emisarkionie naa ena kop nitii; amu keisarkionie osarge enkop, nemeetae entoki naitobiri naidim aipoo, amu ore ilo sarge otubukokine enkop, meteleku ake osarge le ilo oibukoyie.

English: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
Masaai: o Uria le Hiti, o Sabad olayioni le Ahalai,

English: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
Masaai: Te near oltung'ani ake olikae metua, ore ilo oitayio loikop neari metua te nchakenisho oo lchakenini; kake meetae oltung'ani oari metua te nchakenisho olchakeni obo.

English: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
Masaai: Ore ina kutu enye naa olduruk le nkiborra ino oo nkonyek. Amu anaata apa aaitukuo iyie neitu eitukuori olduruk lino. Mikintokini aaituku iyie aaigil o metaba anaa naidip aishu engoro ai te iyie.

English: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
Masaai: “Naa tenelotu oltung'ani loo loreren, ilo leme oloo ltung'ana linono loo Siraeli eing'uaa enelakua tenkaraki enkarna ino kitok, o enkarna ino magilani, tenelotu ninye aomon eing'or ena aji,

English: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
Masaai: Etopolosa ninye ilmong'i, o ntokitin naapir o nkerra kumok, neitoomono ninye ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani, Abiata ilo apolosani o Yoab olarikoni le njore, kake ore Solomon osinka lino eitu eitoomon.

English: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore teneishunye inkolong'i naapishana, kairriu enchan shumata enkop too nkolong'i artam o nkewaritin artam. Metaa ore pooki toki naitobira, kajutu tioriong enkop.”

English: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Ishmael anaa enaikunakino te inoto enye: Nebaiot aa ninye olkikau le Ishmael o Kedar, o Adbeel, o Mibsam,

English: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
Masaai: o enetii Yesu, ilo Aitutumoni lo sotua ng'ejuk, o enetii ilo sarge oisuaayioki neiro te mpiris nalang eno sarge le Abel.

English: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Masaai: Eishira ele tung'ani aisinani, nening Olaitoriani ninye, neitajeu Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa ingolikinot enyena pooki.

English: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
Masaai: Amu ijo iyie, Kara nanu karsis, atudupe, malau toki. Nimiyiolo iyie ajo ira menati, ira tolut, nira olaisinani modooni niminchopo.

English: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore lelo oogiroo nemejo ninche, “Meeu emayianata o Laitoriani shumata iyie! Kimayian intae te nkarna o Laitoriani!”

English: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
Masaai: Neitoki airriwaki kulikae sinkan kumok oolang lelo le dukuya, neiko sii ninche neijia.

English: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
Masaai: Lo doinyo le Nkai, lo doinyo le Bashan; lo doinyo loo mowuarak kumok, lo doinyo le Bashan!

English: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku, neitu eidim airorie ninche, neyiolou ninche aajo eeta enatoduaa te neinokieki olasar. Neitodol too lmonek meidim airorie.

English: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
Masaai: “Te naa aikinyorrinyorro nanu nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei;

English: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, Enkai ino, otii empolos ino, olmurrani oishoru enkishuroto; eikishipakino ninye iyie te nchipai, eikintang'ejuk ninye iyie te nyorrata enye kepik ninye shumata iyie embuakunoto o sinkolio

English: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
Masaai: Naa sii erotoki Paulo embarta naked, entorikoki olbalusui Feliks.”

English: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
Masaai: Kaae, nelotu olaisiaayiani aliki olkitok lenye nena. Negoro olopeny enkaji nejoki olaisiaayiani lenye, ‘Tasiooi shomo nkoitoi oo nkaulele e ina anasa, toriku laisinak o ltarrushi o lmodook o lng'ojiniaa.’

English: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
Masaai: Naa eikincho iyie Olaitoriani tudupoyu te karsisisho o too lng'anayio lo sesen lino o too lng'anayio loo nkishu inono, o too lng'anayio le nkop ino tiatua ina kop nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai lino pee kincho iyie.

English: The LORD hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te nkaraki olwuasa le Yakobo: “Esipa maarikino ae kata hoo nabo oo nkiasin enye.

English: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
Masaai: Kake etimira Yoab o Abishai Abna; ore edoyio enkolong nepuonu ninche oldoinyo le Ama, laa ninye otii dukuya Gia te nkoitoi nalo olpurkel le Gibeon.

English: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
Masaai: Ijojo aa?” Newaliki aajoki, “Keiririkino ele tung'ani keeya.”

English: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
Masaai: Ore olikiaraki, shomo kilomita nabo, shomo are.

English: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
Masaai: e sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o sekenke. Entudumunye entaasisho! Metaa Olaitoriani tenebo intae!”

English: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
Masaai: Neaku etushuke Saul eitu eitoki asujaa Daudi, nelo aarare Ilfilisti; neaku etejoki apa ine wueji Endapidapoi e nkisikata.

English: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
Masaai: Neyau ninche too nkaik enye embata oo lng'anayio leina kop neitadou aayaki iyiook, neitoki aayaki iyiook olkilikuai, nejo, ‘Enkop sidai ina naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’

English: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Wootu”, maatook enaisho, maitaraposho ate enaisho napi; ore taisere naa ketiu anaa ena olong, keaku kitok alus.”

English: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, lido Sinai te dukuya Enkai e Israel.

English: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootoduaa ina nelikioo nena naatotiutuo te ilo apa otang'asa aata iloiriruani o too lbitiro.

English: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Masaai: Amu etiaka Olaitoriani ninche, “Kepuo ninche aaye tiong'ota.” Eitu apa eleku oltung'ani te ninche, Kaleb ake olayioni le Yefune o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
Masaai: neiteleiki shumata ninye nena masaa pooki o lperere lo lasar, naa ninche easishoreki te nkisiayiare te ine, o motioo e nkima o njipeta, o lkurteta, o ngirran, nena masaa pooki o lperere lo lasar; neisalaashaki shumata ninche nena endapana e nkine, neisuroki nkeek enyena.

English: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Yoab ajo eimua ninye olarrabal te dukuya o te siadi, negelu iltung'ana arriyiak le Israel, neitobiraki olarrabal too le Siria.

English: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
Masaai: nejoki meikilikuana papaai lenye meishoo enkop, nedou ninye to sikiria lenye, nejoki Kaleb ninye, “Kainyoo iyie iyieu?”

English: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
Masaai: enkaraki neitu ninche ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, kake etogolong'akita ilo sotua, o nena sii pooki apa naaitanapishe Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, neitu ening anaa eibung.

English: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
Masaai: Kake keure apa nena aitoyiok Enkai, neitu eas anaa enaitanapa ninche olaiguanani le Misiri, kake eishoo inkayiok etoni eishu.

English: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
Masaai: Newaliki Paulo ajoki, “Kara nanu Olyahudi, oing'uaa Tarso e Kilikia, metaa mme misil enkanasa naing'uaa; aatoomono naa nchooki mairorie ele orere.”

English: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
Masaai: Nerik ninche Yesu aaitung'uaa Kaiafas, aarik enkaji o Lbalusui; naa enasirie. Eitu ejing ninche maate enkaji o Lbalusui pee meidurukieki. Amu kejo pee etum aainosa Pasaka.

English: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Masaai: Menye le lelo okishin, naa olamitunoni loo nkolia, Enkai te ine wueji enye sinyati.

English: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani, nemeetae likae Aitajeunoni leme nanu.

English: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
Masaai: Keaku olalem lino ninye inchuyie, niaku oloisiaai olalashe lino, naa tinigelunye te nkitoria enye, nigil enchata oo lmong'i natii emurt ino.”

English: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
Masaai: “Kake etopiro Yeshurun, neroisho too nkejek; itopiro iyie nisapuku, nisipayu; neitoki ninye aing'uaa Enkai naa ninye naitobirua ninye, nesukeny endapidapoi e njeunoto enye.

English: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
Masaai: Kake ore pee eku lanterera, neitayu oltung'ani olalem adung'u amu etabawua enkisampuare.”

English: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
Masaai: Neyietu Yehu enkawuo enye te ngolon enye pooki, neng'or Yoram erishata oo ronyi, nelo embae ang'or oltau lenye, neimis ninye tiatua engarri oo mbartan.

English: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika le ile olbakuli lenye olkeju kitok le Freti, netoyu enkare e ilo keju, pee eitobiri enkoitoi naimu ilaiguanak ooing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong.

English: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
Masaai: Naa inji etiu lelo ootuunoki te nkop oo soito, lelo laa, ore pee ening ororei, neng'amu nabo kata te ng'ida;

English: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
Masaai: Keinyiang'uni nkurman tena kop nijoitoto intae, olmuaate, metii oltung'ani aashu eng'ues; eishooyioki aapik atua nkaik oo Lkadayo.

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: o sitima obo sii le kine te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki oishori Olaitoriani; keitayuni ninye te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
Masaai: Neiturrurro iltung'ana pooki aatiu anaa oltung'ani obo to lkurroto ooipirakinore enkishomi e Nkare. Nejoki ninche Esra ilo aigeroni pee eyau embuku oo nkitanapat e Musa, apa naishoo Olaitoriani Israel.

English: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
Masaai: okeshisho neilepie kewan eiba pooki toki ake ninye naji enkai aashu ina naseremi, neitoton kewan to lorika te nkaji e Enkai, nelikioo kewan eitaa kewan Enkai.

English: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
Masaai: Keitoduaaya aajo keigero nena naajo nkitanapat ti atua iltauja lenye, neaku too nkorroki enye shakeni, ore ndamunot enye eiguanare ti ai kata, ore ti ai kata nemitu ninche,

English: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Ore ilo omoni likindurraka naa keyooki atiu anaa oinoti tiatua intae, naa tonyorra naa ninye anaa kewan. Amu irara sii apa intae ilomon te nkop e Misiri: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
Masaai: Neitaa olaiguanani lelo keek irishinani enkaji o Laitoriani, o ne nkaji o laiguanani. O lwululi loo usin o nkai oo sinkolioitin tenkaraki ilaranyak. Eitu aekata eitokini aayau lelo keek, anaa aadol ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Asheri naa: Imna, o Ishfa, o Ishfi, o Beria, tenebo Sera enkanashe enye. Ore ilayiok le Beria naa: Heber o Malkiel

English: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
Masaai: Ina pee eisho ilalashera meshomo, ejoki ninche, “Mayieu ake ninchankarrarra te nkoitoi.”

English: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
Masaai: Yoel o Yehu apa ilayiok le Yoshibia olayioni le Seraia, olayioni le Asiel.

English: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
Masaai: Kake eipung'o nepuo aaibulunye ilomon lenyena ilo kerenket pooki.

English: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
Masaai: Etununukoyie ninye osiwuo too naipuko enyena, naa kekurru ninche te nkaraki ilperereni lenye loo lasarri.

English: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
Masaai: Ore te ina olong ake neitanap Farao ilaitasheikinok le siaai o lkituaak le siai,

English: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
Masaai: Eitodolu keper enkitoo o Laitoriani; ore oloing'ang'e neitodolu esiaai oo nkaik enyena.

English: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
Masaai: Neirriwaki Solomon Hiram olkilikuai ajoki,

English: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
Masaai: Neaku ore eton te ina aji enye ainos endaa, ng'ura, nepuonu ilasotok le kodi o laing'okok kumok netoni te nebo Yesu o looiteng'eni lenyena.

English: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
Masaai: amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaikirriwaki lmalaika, mikitorripo,’ netejoki sii,

English: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
Masaai: kake eitu nanu aning Balaam; neaku etamayiana ninye intae; neaku atokordua nanu intae aitung'uaa enkaina enye.

English: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche olkilikuai aaipotu ninye; ore Yeroboam o eumata oo Siraeli pooki nepuonu aajoki Rehoboam,

English: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
Masaai: Eeta apa Solomon enkurma oo sabibu te Baalhamon; neishooyo enkurma oo sabibu aisilenoki ilaramatak; ore ake pooki lenye te lelo ng'anayio mpisai enkalifu nabo enkosholai.

English: And if the latter husband hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and giveth it in her hand, and sendeth her out of his house; or if the latter husband die, which took her to be his wife;
Masaai: ore ilo likae nemenu ninye neigeroki empalai eoro nepik enkaina enye nearaa ninye te nkaji enye, tenelo neye ilo moruo le siadi apa oowa ninye aitaa enkitok enye,

English: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
Masaai: apa nintanapishe aimunye isinkan linono, iloibonok le Nkai, ijo, ‘Ore ina kop nipuopuo aajing, pee iyaya metaa eninyi, naa enkop nemesinya, naata olduruk loo loreren le kuna kuapi, tenebo ilo minong oiputa ninye, ebaiki enkiting'oto o metabaiki enkiting'oto teilo duruk lenye.

English: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Olapolosani Kitok Yesu mbaa oo looiteng'eni lenyena o mbaa naaiteng'enishe.

English: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
Masaai: “Toning'o iyie Israel, ilo taata iyie alang Yordan, pee ilo aiwuang'ie nimany lelo oshon kituaak naa magil te intae, nena anas naateshetaki aaitabaiki shumata,

English: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
Masaai: Kaa nalelek, te najo, ‘Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono,’ ana te najo, ‘Inyo shomo?’

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore kishomi o lodung'oro liatua oipirare oloo saen naa keikeni te nena olong'i ile naasishoi; kake ore teina olong e sabato naa keboli o enkolong nadoli olapa.

English: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
Masaai: Nebuak Yesu ajo, “Ore olaairuk nanu mme nanu eiruk kake lido laairriwua eiruko;

English: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
Masaai: amu mayiolo nanu atusukenyisho, pee maapik ake Olaitobirani lai enkiting'oto.

English: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
Masaai: Ore pee elai ilkeek neye enkima; naa ore enemetii olaing'oming'omani neish enchankar.

English: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni; o eng'irra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;

English: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
Masaai: Ekamany nanu enkaji ai arrip, pee metii ololotu nelo; nemetii olaitorogonyani oitoki aitunyoo ninche. Amu ore taata, adolita too nkonyek aainei.

English: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
Masaai: Ninye tenebo iltung'ana lenyena, inkuapi torrok oleng too loreren, eyauni ninche meidaikie ina kop; naa keshurtu ninche ilalema lenye aarare Misiri, neiput ina kop lelo meneng'a.

English: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
Masaai: Neaku etapala apa Olaitoriani lelo oshon, eitu earaa ninche aipang'ie nabo kata, neitu ninye eishooyo ninche apik atua engolon e Yoshua.

English: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naaudo o lapa liong'uan nerasu olameyu teina anasa, amu meekure eetae endaa too ltung'ana leina kop.

English: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
Masaai: Ore hoo nebaiki ninye olalem nemedung ninye; arashu eremet, o embae o empere naado, naji mataarie naaijo eremet.

English: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye eilep Hana alo, amu etiaaka ninye olpayian lenye, “Te neoruni enkerai lke, nayau nanu ninye, pee etum ataliooyu te dukuya Olaitoriani, neton te ine ntarasi.”

English: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: Amaa te neeta kulikae esipata natumie toki te intae, aime iyiook ooata enalusoo te ina? Kake eitu king'orunye iyiook intae ina. Kiting'iria pooki toki, pee mikintarru ororei supat le Kristo.

English: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon ajoki Enkai, “Tenaa eikordu iyie Israel te nkaina ai anaa enitejo,

English: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
Masaai: Ore pee eiwuang'ie ninye, neitasheyie Daudi metaa olaiguanani lenye, oloitaikia Enkai shakeni, nejo, ‘Anoto Daudi ole Yese, oltung'ani onyor oltau lai, oas nena pooki nayieu.’

English: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
Masaai: Toduaa naa kewan minturraa ilo tung'ani loo Lawi otii atua te nkata pooki naba anaa enitii atua enkop ino.

English: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
Masaai: Amu te neeta apa ina nang'ishari enkishiaa enye, kebaa naa elusoo oleng enkishiaa e ina nabik intarasi?

English: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
Masaai: Ina peyie ilotu adamu inkoitoi inono nikurru tenaya nkanashera inono, nkanashera inono botoro o nkutiti, naaisho ninche iyie anaa ntoyie, kake mme te nkaraki ilo sotua tenebo iyie.

English: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.
Masaai: Amu keyieu apa pooki neiture iyiook, edamu aajo, “Keidim nkaik enye aatalepori neitiak esiaai, nemeitokini aas” kake ore iyie na Ai ntagolo iyie nkaik aainei.

English: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
Masaai: Ebaiki netoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino irorei le ilo kitok le njore, oirriwua olkitok lenye, ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu asukeny Enkai naishu, nesurdaanyisho te lelo rorei ootoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino; ore enkaraki ina ilepie enkomono ino te nkaraki ilo pisiai otelekua.’ ”

English: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
Masaai: Kaidapashaki nanu ninche iloshon leitu apa eyiolou ninche arashu loo menye; naitoki nanu airriwaa olalem aitusuj ninche ometaba anaa namut nanu ninche.”

English: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
Masaai: Enkaraki nena, ore apa pee elotu Kristo enkop, nejo, “Ore ilasarri o nkishorunot imiyieu iyie kake osesen kintobiraka nanu;

English: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
Masaai: Neguetu Musa mbaoi dapashi are oo soito naanyaanyukie inapa e dukuya, nedumunye ayooki tadekenya neilep alo enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye, neya te nkaina enye nena soito naagueta dapashi.

English: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
Masaai: kake eming'oruru intae Betel, nimijing'ijing'i Gilgal aashu idung'udung'u aapuo Beer-sheba; amu meeta nchere melo Gilgal eyararoto, naa keaku Betel entoki nemeetae.”

English: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Keidim oltung'ani aisudoi kewan too wuejitin oo nkisudorot pee madol nanu ninye? Olaitoriani ojo. Eimaborei nanu shumata o enkop? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
Masaai: “Neaku ore iyie te retoto e Nkai ino, tushukunye, mbung'a enyorrata o esipata tukurraki nibik aanyu Enkai ino.”

English: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Lea ninye, “Ijo doi kembae kiti tinikioru olpayian lai? Iyieu sii nintoki aya tunkuja olayioni lai?” Nejo Raheli, “Inchoo naa meirraga enitii ena kewarie te nkaraki tunkuja olayioni lino.”

English: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
Masaai: neitoki ake sii olaiguanani ajoki Shimei, “Iyiolo iyie to ltau lino ina torroni apa nintaasa Daudi papa lai; neaku kerrinyu Olaitoriani entorroni ino shumata endukuya ino.

English: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Misiri aaraa ninye te Yerusalem, nepikaki iltung'ana leina kop kodi e talanta iip nabo e nkosholai o talanta e sahabu.

English: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Shafan olaigeroni ajoki olaiguanani “Aishoo nanu Hilkia olapolosani embuku.” Neisumaki Shafan olaiguanani.

English: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
Masaai: Nebol Esra ina buku te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, amu etii apa ninye shumata iltung'ana pooki. Ore ake pee ebol ina buku neitashe iltung'ana pooki.

English: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
Masaai: “Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil, te mpolos o larrabal! “Eirrag Yonatan etasesekuanaki te nchumata oo wuejitin inono neeika

English: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Na kitok, aisapuk enkirukoto ino, metotiwuo te iyie anaa ina niyieu;” neishiu entito enye te ina kata.

English: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
Masaai: Tinikilo iyie aorore nanu taata nitum iltung'ana oare te mbata e nkurare e Raheli te nkop e Benchamen pee etumo o Selsa, nikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Ore ilapa sirkon lishomo iyie aing'oru nenotoki; ore taata papaai lino etapala enadamu isirkon neaku intae edamu, ejo, “Kaji aiko to layioni lai?” ’

English: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
Masaai: Amu mira iyie Enkai nashipakino entorroni; meton entorroni te nebo iyie.

English: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
Masaai: neiriamunore Onesimas olalashe onyorri neisiligayu, laa obo linyi. Ninche oopuonu aainosaki intae mbaa pooki naataasate te ne.

English: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
Masaai: o pee etum sii ninche Loreren aaisisa Enkai te nkaraki olng'ur lenye. Anaa enatisiraki aajo, “Ore te nkaraki ina kaaisis iyie ti atua Loreren, naranyaki enkarna ino;”

English: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.
Masaai: naa, ore hoo nenyor apa Hana neisho ninye erubata nabo ake, amu eikeno Olaitoriani enguset enye.

English: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
Masaai: Neipotu Musa Mishael o Elisafan, ilayiok le Usiel olenkapu le Aron, nejoki ninche, “Entinyiku, entanap ilalashera linyi ewuang'ie tiatua ewueji sinyati ewaita auluo ilng'oborri.”

English: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Masaai: Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto enye naa ninye elong'o enye.

English: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
Masaai: Kebaa eleleki nilotie iyie, mbelekeny enkoitoi ino! Eikipik iyie Misiri enkurruna anaa apa enikitipika Asiria enkurruna.

English: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
Masaai: Amu eyiolo ninye enkitobirunoto ang, edamu ninye ajo kira iyiook enterit.

English: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,
Masaai: Ore te siadi keeya e Musa ilo sinka lo Laitoriani, nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua olayioni le Nuni ilo sinka le Musa,

English: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
Masaai: Emelok ewang'an, naa keitiship inkonyek tining'or enkolong.

English: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
Masaai: Nejoki ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyieu nikidol olmonekie te iyie.”

English: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
Masaai: Kalo otetema enkare te ndap e nkaina enye netem shumata te nkitorioroto e nkaina enye, neishaki enterit e nkop pooki te ntemet neineneng ildoinyo o ndoinyo to orrantili

English: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
Masaai: Eyautu ti atua ntae enkishoroto eyaki Olaitoriani; ore pooki ng'ae oata oltau le leng'on nchoo ninye eyaki Olaitoriani enkishooroto; sahabu, o enkosholai o suyai;

English: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
Masaai: Ore naa taata irriwakaki nanu oltung'ani arriyia te siaai e sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o sekenkei, o too muain pilei o naanyokie o nkilani pusi oltung'ani oiteng'enaki te nguetare, pee elo aaku tenebo lelo aisiaayiak arriyiak ootii tenebo nanu te Yuda o te Yerusalem, lelo apa ooishorua Daudi papa lai.

English: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Masaai: Ore ilo oishakenoki kuna baa, “Ejo kalotu asioku!” Esai. Wou, Olaitoriani Yesu!

English: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
Masaai: tumuta ninche te ngoro ino, tumuta ninche o metaba anaa neishunye, pee etum iltung'ana aatayioloito nchere Enkai naitoreisho ti atua Yakobo o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.

English: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nelotu Olkushiti; nejo ilo Kushiti, “Ilomon sidain to lkitok lai olaiguanani! Amu kitokordua iyie Olaitoriani ena olong aitung'uaa engolon e pooki apa likitudumakinote iyie.”

English: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
Masaai: miureyu ninche amu Olaitoriani Enkai ino oarisho te nkaraki iyie.”

English: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
Masaai: neikilikuan embae nabo, aajo, “Olaiteng'enani, etisiraka iyiook Musa nchere te neye olalashe oltung'ani, oata enkitok nemeeta nkera, neya ake ilo tung'ani ina kitok pee eiki olalashe nkera.

English: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
Masaai: nesesekuan iltung'ana le Ai iltung'ana oobaya tomoni uni o ile lenye, nemiraa ninche te kishomi o meitabaiki Shebarim, nesesekuan ninche to loshong'ishong'i nelepori iltauja loo ltung'ana netiu anaa enkare.

English: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Ti nikijoki oltung'ani ae toki, iyau ninye enatii nanu, nimikingil ae kata ninye aibung.”

English: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
Masaai: Nepuonu kulikae payiani le Israel enatii, netoni te dukuya nanu.

English: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
Masaai: Enkai doi naitagol indung'ot pokira are, iyiook o intae ti atua Kristo. Enkai doi natubukoko iyiook eilata,

English: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, amu Yudas apa onap olbene loo mpesai, eji ketiaaka Yesu, “Inyang'u ntokitin nikiyieu to sirua,” aashu etiaka meishoo laisinak toki.

English: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye olo te dukuya iyie; keaku ninye tenebo iyie; mikintiak ninye aashu king'uaa; miureishoyu nimishalu.”

English: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: Sihon, olaiguanani le Amori, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ing'urrie iyie ina aitubului neitu iasaki esiaai, neitu iyie intubulu ninye, ina naaku kewarie neidaaya te nkewarie.

English: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.
Masaai: Etaasa Israel eng'oki; etigila ninche olning'o lai apa laitanapa nanu ninche, ewaita ninche embata oo ntokitin apa naaiteng'elaki, etupurrishote ninche nelejisho, nepik ninche atua imasaa enye.

English: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiturrur aiken ninche te Besek, nera iltung'ana le Israel nkalifuni iip uni, ore iltung'ana le Yuda naa nkalifuni tomoni uni.

English: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
Masaai: Amu eitu nanu aarare ena anasa aarare te ntorroni neme te sidai, Olaitoriani ojo; keishoori ninye aapik atua enkaina olaiguanani le Babilon, naa kepejoo ninye te nkima.’

English: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
Masaai: (amu ore ilng'anayio le wang'an naa ninche etumieki nena pooki sidain neitoriori nesipa),

English: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
Masaai: Amu keishu ororei le Enkai neeta engolon, nepi ninye alang olalem ake pooki opi mbat pokira, neimisho enarish oltau o enkiyang'et, neim irubat o ntolo, neyiolou ndamunot o nkiguanat o ltau.

English: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
Masaai: Netolikioki apa Abimelek nchere eiturrurrote iltung'ana pooki to ltalet le Shekem te nebo.

English: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
Masaai: Neitoki aiteru aiteng'enisho te mbata e naiposha. Neiturrurrokino olorora kitok oleng, o metijing'a atua empeut aton ti atua te naiposha; neton ilo orora te nkop natoyio te mbata e naiposha.

English: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
Masaai: Metaa te naa eikinken ajo kira nabo, tang'amu ninye anaa naaji eniking'amu nanu.

English: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
Masaai: Neliki Mordekai nena pooki naataasate, o esiana oo mpisai naatonyorrayie Haman alak apik olchumati lo laiguanani te mutata oo Lyahudi.

English: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
Masaai: Kake eitirrishaka Absalom ninye o metaba anaa neisho ninye Amnon o layiok pooki lo laiguanani meshomo te nebo ninye.

English: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
Masaai: Nelotu Daudi Nob enetii Ahimelek olapolosani; nelotu Ahimelek anang'are Daudi eikirikira, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo paa iyie openy, nemetii hoo obo te nebo iyie?”

English: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
Masaai: Emining ororei le lelo oibonok oojoki intae, ‘Misiayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon,’ amu elejare ina naibonoki ninche intae.

English: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo olaiguanani, ore enkaji enye pooki nesujaa ninye. Neing'uaa olaiguanani nkapiak tomon pee eing'or enkaji.

English: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
Masaai: Naitoki aning likae toilo oing'uaa shumata ejo, “Entupuku entung'uai ninye lo tung'ana laainei, pee mimbung'arere ake ninye ti atua ing'ok enyena, pee ming'arierie ake ilmeita lenyena.

English: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aaram ilalashera lenye; Bafai olayioni le Hanadad, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo o lkerenket le Keila;

English: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
Masaai: ilmoda lemedamisho, ilemeisiligayu, ilooiba ilkulenye, ilemeeta olng'ur.

English: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
Masaai: Nepolosaki ninche Olaitoriani olasar teina olong, te nena masaa apa naataarutua ninche ilmong'i iip naapishana, o nkerra nkalifuni naapishana.

English: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
Masaai: Nimilekuku ake ae toki enye o mekenyu, ore pooki toki naton o mekenyu nipejoo.

English: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
Masaai: naaewuo nanu aitayiolo ina nayooki adoiki iltung'ana linono too nkolong'i e siadi. Amu ore ina duaata naa enoo nkolong'i e siadi.”

English: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong; nejing empeut ninye o looiteng'eni lenyena: nejoki ninche, “Ematalang aapuo lido kekun le naiposha,” nedumunye aapuo.

English: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oitopiwuo Enkai eitu etum ninye erruorroto.

English: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
Masaai: Nairriwaki nanu olkilikuai ajoki, “A-a, ore nena baa nijoito netaasate, amu iyie oipirua ninche too ndamunot inono.”

English: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
Masaai: Neraposhu Abraham inkonyek enyena aing'orisho nedol te siadi ninye olmeregesh otaasha entim imowuarak enyena, nelo Abraham aya ilo meregesh, neitayu ninye aitaa olasar opejori te rishata e nkayioni enye.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nipuonunu atua ina kop nayau nanu intae,

English: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo nena olong'i, neiroshiu enkitok enye Elisabet, neisudoo kewan ilapaitin imiet, ejo,

English: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:
Masaai: “Mincho ake olkitok ilo rrindik lenye apa oisika aing'uaa ninye nelotu enetii;

English: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Peres naa: ile Hesron, olmarei loo le Hesron; ile Hamul, olmarei loo le Hamul.

English: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
Masaai: Ahitub menye le Sadok, Sadok menye le Ahimaas,

English: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
Masaai: Neito ninye Nasaret ine netubulaka, nejing enkaji e ntumo te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaa enaiko apake, neitashe aisoma.

English: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
Masaai: Naa keiputukuny ninche. Nejing ninche emion naikununo anaa ene nkitok nasaisai. Neing'ura ninche maate to lkirutoto; neiput enkurruna nkomomi enye.

English: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
Masaai: nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Kitamayianaki iyie too nkituaak, nemayiani eishoi e ng'uset ino!

English: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore oltung'ani obo loo ltung'ana le Israel, nelotu ayau enkitok e Midian atua olmarei lenye, too nkonyek e Musa o too nkonyek e ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel ina kata apa eishirita ninche te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
Masaai: ore pee etiu inji enkirukoto inyi eji pee etemi nenyorrarri aajo eeta tipat alang sahabu narruoyo netetemaki te nkima nitumutumu enkisisa, o enkitoo o enkanyit te mbolunoto e Yesu Kristo.

English: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
Masaai: Amu ore ina anasa nasheta netomijoono emanyisho apa naidurrieki nepuoi aaing'uaa, etotiuo anaa ong'ata, te ine edaa lasho, neirrag te ine negil ilng'osil lenyena.

English: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
Masaai: “Iyiololo aajo inkolong'i are naatiooyo pee eaku Pasaka, naa keishoori Enkerai e Tung'ani metashei.”

English: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening, kake etogolong'akita anaa apa loo menye, amu eitu apa eiruk Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
Masaai: ning'iriri oltung'ani ake te likae, naa teneeta ake oltung'ani enkigunyung'uny to likae, nepalaki olikae anaa pee kitapalaka sii iyie Olaitoriani, neaku eishiaakino sii iyie pee ipalaki.

English: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
Masaai: Aime enaimin enkolong o Laitoriani neme ewang'an, o emisimisi nemewang?

English: Israel was holiness unto the LORD, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Eisinyati apa Israel to Laitoriani, ilng'anayio le dukuya le nkisampuare enye. Ore pooki ooinosa netum enkitarruorroto; eewuo entorroni shumata ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
Masaai: Etegelua ninye Daudi osinka lenye, neya ninye aitung'uaa eluaata oo ntare;

English: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Neitayu enkurriny enye pooki, anaa enaitayuni ina kurriny to lasar le seriani, nepejoo olapolosani te nchumata olperere lo lasar metaa esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; neitayu olapolosani olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki ninye, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
Masaai: Emenaa olmodai enkiteng'enata e menye, kake ore ilo oinining'u iutarot naa ng'en.

English: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
Masaai: Anaa nkishu naadoyio aapuo oerata, eishoo ninche Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng'ata. Neaku itorikoyie apa iyie iltung'ana linono, pee intobiraki kewan enkarna e nkitoo.

English: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
Masaai: neiterua enaiposha ailugo, amu etukutua osiwuo kitok.

English: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei oloji, Apolos o kewan ai aimakinye kuna baa peyie aretu intae te nkitanyaanyukoto. Entuutarie ate iyiook pee iyiolouu enoshi naji, “Lkigerot turubare iyie.” Ayieu napaji ning'enunu pee miwuasasa aaku lo ltung'ani obo nimbayuyu olikae.

English: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
Masaai: “Eima atua enkang oo lng'oborri, nintanapapa olorere, ‘Entobira ndaiki inyi; amu ore te rishata oo nkolong'i uni naa ilang'ilang'a intae Yordan, pee ipuopuo aaibung ina kop apa naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee iyaya.’ ”

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Iyau olorora taarare ninche, nintaa ninche entoki naitureisho naaruno.

English: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
Masaai: ore ninye enaimin nememisimis te iyie, kewang enkewarie anaa endama; amu etiu enaimin anaa ewang'an te iyie.

English: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
Masaai: Kerrorro ilo wuasa nebatata, nemeetae olodumu ninye aitasheyie, naa kainok nanu enkima too nkanas enye naa kemut pooki toki namanita ninye.

English: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
Masaai: Neishooki ninye meishopo ilkarash oopuyiapui ooibor newang,” nemetii olduruki. Amu ore lelo karash sidain naa iasat supati e lelo sinyat.

English: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
Masaai: Etotiwuo enjung'ore ai te nanu anaa olng'atuny tiatua entim, eilepunye ninye oltoilo lenye aarare nanu; neaku kaiba nanu ninye.

English: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
Masaai: “Tenebau ena palai enitii, amu iatata ilayiok lo lkitok linyi tenebo intae, niaatata ngarrin oo mbartan, o mbartan, o nkanas naasheta sunta, o masaa o larrabal,

English: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
Masaai: o Ibar, o Elishua, o Elpelet,

English: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
Masaai: Amu te nkirukoto etonyorrarrie Enkai iltung'ana li apa.

English: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
Masaai: Tishipakinoyu enkishui tenebo enkitok ninyor, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino e pesho nikinchoo ninye iyie tiabori enkolong, amu ninye erubata ino tena kishui te ekenyata niekenya tiabori enkolong.

English: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Aidetideta duoo, netanyamala oltau lai eyieu neyiolou ina kidetidet.”

English: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
Masaai: Ina kop pooki ake oo layiok le Amon eitu inyikakiki, aa taa, inkiyopat o lkeju le Yaboko o nkanas eina kop oo ldoinyo, o pooki wueji neitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang ajoki emipuo.

English: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
Masaai: Nedumu ninche soito pee ear, kake eisudori Yesu, nepuku to nkaji e Nkai.

English: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enkolong e inoto e Herode, neranyisho entito e Herodias te mpolos o lorere, neitiship Herode.

English: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
Masaai: Entoning olkiyioi le lelo shekuti; amu eiwuang'ieki aaoru enkitoo enye! Entoning, enkikurrukur e lelo ng'atunyo ore entim natii embata e Yordan, netumutaki aaidaikie.

English: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
Masaai: Ing'ura ajo aitaa elukunya ino enagol anaa ilukuny enye, naitagol elukunya ino anaa ilukuny enye.

English: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
Masaai: Enchoo naa ilo oiro to lng'ejep oje, eomonu meishori enkidimata e walunoto.

English: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
Masaai: Etarruoyie apa enkop oleng too nkonyek e Enkai, neiputa ninye o larrabal.

English: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
Masaai: Ore to lwuasa neishankarra lelo lemening'isho, kake ore lelo ooibung enkikoo netum eng'eno nagut.

English: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata enkolong aaku ewang'an inyi te dama, anaa eaku ewang'an o lapa itum kewarie; kake Olaitoriani olo aaku ewang'an ino oo ntarasi, naa Enkai ino naaku enkitoo ino.

English: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
Masaai: Ore ena Ai naa enkisudoroto ai nagol, netaseriana ninye enkoitoi ai.

English: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ororei lo Laitoriani ele oewuo enetii Mika le Moreshet, too nkolong'i e Yotam, o Ahas, o Hesekia, lelo aiguanak le Yuda. Etoduaa apa ninye kuna baa naaipirta Samaria o Yerusalem.

English: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
Masaai: Amu keeta nkatitin naadoiki olmalaika ilo turoto neing'oling'ol enkare. Ore oloiteru ajing aa enaing'oling'olieki enkare neishiunyeki emueyian ake ninye pooki naata.

English: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
Masaai: Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie lo tau lai, o pooki natii atua nanu, isisa enkarna enye sinyati!

English: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
Masaai: Amu esipa ajoki intae, ore o metaba anaa nelusoo shumata o enkop, melusoo osirata obo anaa oltipoto obo loo Nkitanapat eitu eitabari.

English: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Sebulon te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni ntomoni ile o iip imiet.

English: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul Ahija, “Iyau ene ilo Sanduku le Nkai.” Amu kelo apa ilo Sanduku le Nkai ina kata te nebo iltung'ana le Israel.

English: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yafet naa kulo: Gomer, o Madai, o Yafan, o Tubal, o Mishek, o Tiras.

English: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
Masaai: Ore te nkitanapata ino neitashe ntokitin pooki o metabaiki ena olong; amu ore ntokitin pooki naa iyie eisiaai.

English: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
