Masaai: Neitoki Esra alo te nkaji e Nkai nelo olgilata le Yehobadan olayioni le Eliaship, naa ine eshomo airrag. Neitu einos endaa anaa eok enkare; amu eishiraka apa ninye lelo ooshomo eyararoto lemeisiligayu.

English: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani ina kiroroto o ltung'ani le Nkai, naishiraka ilo perere lo lasar te Betel, neitorio enkaina enye teilo perere lo lasar ajo, “Embung'a ninye.” Ore ina aina enye duoo naitorioyie aimbung'ie ninye, netoyu, ometaa meekure errinyo.

English: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilpayiani, “Entaanyu iyiook tene o metaba anaa nikintoki aapuonu enitii, naa ng'ura, etii Aron o Huri te nebo intae; ore pooki ng'ae oata enyamali nchoo elo enetii ninche.”

English: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
Masaai: Te naa kemurata oltung'ani arashu memurata neme toki; ore enatii naa te naa keitaaki enkitobirata ng'ejuk.

English: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.
Masaai: Ore nanu makewan, natisipua ajo eitu eas ai bae nairirikino keeya, kake ore pee ejo ninye lido Aiguanani Kitok ake olo aiguanare, najo kareu naa.

English: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya enetii esiamo nelotu oltung'ani obo agilaki kung nejoki,

English: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
Masaai: o nkisiong'at o lgoriet, o enkikenet e ine nejing'ieki olgos lo lgoriet omanita ine wueji sinyati o lperere lo lasar, o nkeenta enyena, o masaa pooki e nkisiayiare; naa keas ninche nena pooki naaishiakinore ninche neas.

English: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
Masaai: Naaitayiolo nanu Olaitoriani nayiolou nanu; nikintoki iyie aitodol nanu nkiaasin enye torrok.

English: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
Masaai: Neaku keing'unyung'unyaki Lyahudi ninye, enkaraki natejo, “Ara nanu emukate natadowuo aing'uaa keper.”

English: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
Masaai: Enaikash oltung'ani aisinani olo too sipat enyena alang ilo oitadiak too nkirorot enyena naa olmodai sii.

English: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
Masaai: Naa ore apa enkiroishi e sahabu nayakaki Solomon to lari obo naa ntalantani iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile e sahabu,

English: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejoki ninche Daudi, “Eitu edoyio Uria alo enkaji enye,” nejoki Daudi Uria, “Keitu iyie ilotu aing'uaa enkop naado kainyoo pee eitu idoyio alo enkaji ino?”

English: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
Masaai: “Entasiooi esarisara enchom enetii papaai nijokiki ninye, ‘Inji ejo olayioni lino Yosef, aitaa Enkai olkitok le nkop pooki e Misiri; wou ene natii, mayieu nimutie.

English: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
Masaai: nepik ninche te nebo imasaa enyena pooki neimulumuli te ndapana e nkine nepiki ninye shumata nkeek enyena naanapieki.

English: When a man hath taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: but he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken.
Masaai: “Ore enayamishore oltung'ani, nemeishiakino ninye nelo enjore aashu ae siai; nchoo ninye eton tiang olari obo, pee eshipa tenebo oina kitok enye nayama.

English: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
Masaai: Amaa anaa enatabaikia enkaina ai nkitoriat oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, naa ore nkitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno naa eikituaak aalang nena naatii Yerusalem o Samaria,

English: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
Masaai: Neinosaki ena kitanyaanyukoto: “Eeta apa oltung'ani olng'aboli ouno te nkurma enye oo lng'anayio nelotu aing'orunye lng'anayio neitu etumie.

English: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
Masaai: Neilep ninche shumata, nedoyio aapuo enguton; nelepori iltauja lenye te nkaraki osina;

English: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
Masaai: Metaa eshomo Hamor tenebo olayioni lenye Shekem kishomi enkanasa enye neirorie ilewa le nkanasa enye ejoki,

English: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
Masaai: Neya Saul iltung'ana nkalifuni uni oogeluno ti atua Israel pooki, nepuo aaing'oru Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena te dukuya ndapidapo oo nkineji oo soito.

English: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
Masaai: Naa teneyieu ilo oiteng'ela enkurma nekordu, neponaa naa erubata e imiet e tomon oo mpisai, neaku taa enenye.

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
Masaai: Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, naa kepalakini ninye, amu enkitapong'oto apake, neyautua ninche olasar lenye, ilo asar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani, neyau ilo asar lenye le ng'oki dukuya Olaitoriani, te nkaraki ina kitarruoroto enye.

English: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
Masaai: Ore olonya osesen lai neok osarge lai, eeta enkishui nemeish, naa kaitopiu nanu ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, eitu ninche aaning nanu iltung'ana loo Siraeli; kaji naa eiko te naaning nanu Farao, nara oltung'ani leme arriyia te nkiroroto?”

English: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
Masaai: “Teneitayu enkitok osarge too nkolong'i kumok, neme te nkata enye enkiduruk, teneeta erukoto naitogiroo inoshi olong'i e nkiduruk enye, neton ninye tiatua enkiduruk; anaa ake too nkolong'i enyena enkiduruk, keiduruku ninye.

English: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
Masaai: O intae, ildoinyo, pee ntigiranana anaa ilmeregeshi? O intae, ndoinyo, pee intigiranana anaa ilkuoo le kerra?

English: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo neyiolo ltung'ana aajo ining'ishosho intae, o metaa kang'idare nanu intae, kayieu ning'enunu aayiolou nena supati nemetii elejare, niyiolouu sii nena torrok;

English: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
Masaai: Ore enya endaa te nebo ninche, nedumu emukate nemayian, negil, neisho ninche.

English: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
Masaai: Kake pee ore ti atua nkolong'i naaoshi ina tarumpeta, naosh kenya ilo malaika li oopishana, o enkisudoroto neitabari enkisudoroto e Enkai anaa apa enatolikio ninye, sinkan lenyena lelo oibonok naa eitabari.

English: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
Masaai: Nejoki entito botor enkanashe “Etamorua papa, nemetii oltung'ani te nkop oboitare iyiook to rrekie le kiyama.

English: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
Masaai: Amu etalakua Olaitoriani Yakobo, nelaku ninye aitung'uaa nkaik naagol oleng te ninye.

English: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
Masaai: ore te nkanasa neya olkitok apa laa ninye oitasheiki enjore, o ltung'ana oopishana le nkiguana o laiguanani, ooinepuaki tiatua enkanasa, o laigeroni lo lkitok le njore laa ninye apa oiger iltung'ana leina kop, o ltung'ana ntomoni ile loo ltung'ana leina kop ooinepuaki te mpolos eina anasa.

English: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
Masaai: “Keetae oltung'ani omit enkare ajo meibatisai kulo ootang'amutua Enkiyang'et Sinyati anaa enikitang'amutua apa sii iyiook?”

English: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
Masaai: Ore ilo oisho olaunoni lanterera neisho emukate olonya, ninye oisho intae ilanterera neitubul; ninye oponaa esotore e nkaminino inyi.

English: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
Masaai: ilo oitanap enkolong, meitoki ailepu; ilo oitoip ilakir,

English: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
Masaai: Ore lelo arreshok loo sinkir neitashe te nkiyopata enaiposha; eiteru te En-gedi, ometabaiki Eneglaim, keaku ewueji neidapashieki irresheta; ore isinkir lenyena naa keaku iloompukunot kumok, anaa isinkir le naiposha kitok.

English: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD'S anointed.
Masaai: Ekelaaki Olaitoriani pooki tung'ani te supatisho enye o te nkisiligata enye; amu kinchorua iyie Olaitoriani apik atua enkaina ai taata, nemadumu nanu enkaina ai aarare ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aaput.

English: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
Masaai: Ore embata e ine wueji naa ninye etii olopololi lo laiguanani oitore ilo lemankale, neji ninye Publio, neng'amu ninye iyiook aitoomon osupatei inkolong'i naara uni.

English: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
Masaai: anaata naaji atejo, “Kaidapash ninche meshomo oleng, kaisho nanu ninche metaa meitokini aadamu tiatua iltung'ana.”

English: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
Masaai: kake ore pooki ng'ae oibung ororei lenye, naa ti atua ninye eitabayioki enyorrata e Nkai. Te ina kintisip inchere kitii iyiook atua ninye:

English: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
Masaai: Neya Daudi aitung'uaa ninye enkalifu o iip naapishana o sikarini ooked mbartan, oo sikarini nkalifuni tikitam oopuo too nkejek nedung Daudi irrisheta mbartan pooki oo ngarrin, kake etelekua inaaidip ngarrin iip oo mbartan.

English: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
Masaai: Eisiligayu ilbaa likipik olchore, naa kumok ing'ututat olmang'atinta.

English: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
Masaai: mejo ake ina kop nintupukunye iyiook, “Enkaraki apa nemeidim Olaitoriani ayau ninche atua ina kop apa naisiligie ninche, naa ore enkaraki naibayie ninye ninche eitupukuo ninche pee elotu aar ninche tiong'ata.”

English: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
Masaai: Ore oshi enkata pooki nadamu intae naisho Enkai ai enashe,

English: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
Masaai: “Teneidurru oltung'ani omoni alotu amany enkop ino mintaas ninye entorrono.

English: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
Masaai: Ore taata, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, ntisipa ntarasi ilo rorei liroro iyie oipirta osinka lino neipirta enkaji enye, nias anaa eniroro;

English: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
Masaai: Neas iltung'ana esiaai aaitobiraki. Ore apa oloitasheiki ninche naa Yohat o Obadia loo Lawi, loo layiok le Merari naa Sakaria o Meshulam, too layiok le Kohat. Naa Ilawi pooki, naa arriyiak too nkinantani o sinkolio.

English: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
Masaai: aajo, “Kineputua korokoroni eikeno osupatei, neitashoo larripok too nkishomin: kake kitejo matabol, metii oltung'ani otii atua.”

English: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
Masaai: Keeta enjore enye esiana? Aing'ae meilepaki ewang'an enye?

English: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Osarge ele; esipa etumutakinote ilaiguanak maate, netaarate maate. Ore naa taata, Moab nalo aya iyarunot.”

English: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
Masaai: Ore naa intae, ilanyor, iyiololo ena eton eado kop, entorrip ate pee meshoroo ake aaya intae te nkitapong'oroto oo ltung'ana lemeshilaa inkitanapat, neitiakieki intae enkitashoto inyi nauno.

English: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
Masaai: Nerrarri ilo oshal, neimisieki te nkop, nebatata te ngolon enye.

English: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninye nkariak e naiposha anaa enkare natii atua oltulet; nepik ninye enguton atua ilaleta oo shumishoreki.

English: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Elihu ajo:

English: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
Masaai: Amu ime taa ake ti atua Makedonia o Akaia etoning'e ele rorei lo Laitoriani na intae eing'uaa kake ore enkirukoto inyi ti atua Enkai neshomo neibulaa pooki wueji, neaku meeta tipat pee kijo ae.

English: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
Masaai: Naa kaponaa ilng'anayio naitubul enkurma ino peyie mintokiki ae kata aatum enkurruna o lameyu tiatua iloreren.

English: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
Masaai: ile Yashub, olmarei loo le Yashub; ile Shimron, olmarei loo le Shimron.

English: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eibukoyie Manase osarge sapuk oleng lemeeta entioto, omeiputa Yerusalem ebaiki enchoto nabo ometabaiki enkae shoto. Eeta ake sii eng'oki eina apa natorikoko Yuda metaasa ing'ok, neaku etaasa mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ena ake aewuo atum, inchere eitayu Enkai oltung'ani meitasho te nkitashoto sidai, kake eing'orutua inkoitoi kumok nemesipa.

English: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
Masaai: Iomonunu intae nimitumutumu, amu iomonunu te nkoitoi torrono, pee itumokiki aaishang'itie too ng'uarrat oo seseni linyi.

English: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
Masaai: nikiaanyu osiligi lang omayiana, ina lotunoto e nkitoo e Enkai ang kitok o Laitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo,

English: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
Masaai: Ijo kebaa elusoo enkitamioto nayaki kewan oltung'ani oany Oinoti le Enkai, neisarkionie osarge lo sotua laa ninye eitukuyieki neitagor ina Kiyang'et e mpiris?

English: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
Masaai: Nelo sii apa ninye enetii Pilato neomonu osesen le Yesu. Neitanapisho Pilato pee eishori.

English: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
Masaai: Ntobir iyie enaimin neaku kewarie, ina kata eikurtutari ing'uesi entim aapuo.

English: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
Masaai: Iltung'ana ooitureisho ninche; ore isipat enye o nkiguanat enye naa ninche maate epukunye.

English: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
Masaai: Isiraeli ninche, naa ninche eitaa nkera enyena, neisho enkitoo, ilkulenye isotuaitin, ninche eishooki Nkitanapat, o esayiata e Nkai o nkisiligat enyena;

English: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
Masaai: Neomon ninye Olaitoriani nejo, “Aatoomono nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, aime ena apake nanu atejo eton atii enkop ang? Enkaraki ena apa pee aisarisara nanu aisikaki Tarshishi; amu atayiolo apa nanu nchere ira iyie Enkai o sotua naata olng'ur, nemegoro asioki, nikibore enyorrata nauno, nirridu entorroni.

English: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
Masaai: ‘Ara Enkai oo loo minyi, Enkai e Abraham o Isaak, o Yakobo.’ Neikirikira Musa meitieu aing'ora.

English: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
Masaai: Kake etorikine ninche nabo kata isiaaitin enyena; neitu ninche eanyu enkiguana enye.

English: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
Masaai: “Ore te nkiting'oto, e pooki ari liokuni nkatitin pooki niyauu intae ematua ina rubata pooki e tomon enkisampuare inyi to lari obo, aairragie aashum too nkang'itie inyi;

English: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
Masaai: Toning'o te nkiok ino enkomono ai, na Ai; nimisudoo kewan te nkomono ai!

English: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
Masaai: Etoosho ninye isabibu o lng'abolo near ilkeek le nkop enye.

English: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
Masaai: Entukuo ate, entobira ate; ewuang'ie entorroni oo nkiaasin inyi, te dukuya nkonyek aainei; entapal entorroni,

English: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yeriko naa iip uni o artam o imiet.

English: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
Masaai: Etumito olaisampuaani olmushaara, neiturrurrito lng'anayio oobaiki enkishui oo ntarasi pee eshipa te nebo olaunoni o laisampuani.

English: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
Masaai: Olmonekie ele le nkiguana nasipa e Enkai, pee etumi aaitaa intae ilooishiaakino enkitoria e Enkai naa te ninye eisilisilitoi intae

English: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
Masaai: Amaa enkishirata ino aikindim aitayu tiatua osina, arashu engolon enkidimata ino pooki?

English: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?
Masaai: Neas Samuel ina naitanapa Olaitoriani, nelotu Betlehem. Nepuonu ilpayiani le nkanasa eikirikira aanang'are ninye nejo, “Ilotu iyie te seriani?”

English: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
Masaai: Nipalaki iyiook isilen ang, anaa ti nikipalaki iyiook ilooata isilen ang.

English: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

English: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

English: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

English: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
Masaai: Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani, amu aaitaasa ninye nanu ine supatisho te nkumoi.

English: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
Masaai: Amu eturupate ng'ok enyena oleng aabaya shumata. Netadamua Enkai intorrok enyena.

English: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
Masaai: Eshomo embata enaiposha too melin, aas biashara ti oriong nkariak kumok;

English: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas naasheta sunta naa Sidim, o Seer, o Hamat, o Rakat, o Kineret,

English: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
Masaai: Ore etaa kejo pee eya Olaitoriani Eliya ailepie shumata, to lkutati, negira Eliya o Elisha aairiamari te nkoitoi eing'uaa Gilgal.

English: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
Masaai: nemeenikino ilo ora Elukunya, olaa ninye etumie osesen pooki oladakite neruburuba to morlooshi o sinigi lenyena, nebulu te mbulunoto naa Enkai eing'uaa.

English: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
Masaai: meaku ninye karsis, nemebikoo karsisisho enye nemetum intona tiatua enkop.

English: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki Solomon ilo ayioni lenye, “Ntagoluoyu nintagol oshoke, niaas ina, miureishoyu, milepori nimishalu; amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai ai, ee Enkai ai, netii tenebo iyie, mikintiak ninye iyie nimikinguanare ometaba anaa neidipayu esiaai pooki e nkisiaayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani. Naa ng'ura, ore ilturrurri loo lapolosak; o loo Lawi, teina kisiaayiare pooki enkaji e Nkai, netii tenebo iyie, ometaba anaa neidipayu esiaai pooki e nkisiaayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani.

English: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
Masaai: Naa kainok nanu enkima te suntai e Raba, naa kenya isempewueti lenyena too mbuakunot e ina olong o larrabal to sina teina olong olemua te ilo arrabal oikununo anaa osiuo.

English: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
Masaai: nejoki ninye ninche, “Embung'a too ltauja kulo rorei laliki intae ena olong, pee itumutumu aaitanapa ninche nkera inyi, pee etum ninche aaing'ura neas irorei pooki lena kitanapata.

English: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Lo Kitok, Aainyo pee maaidim atusuju taata? Ekaitayu enkishui ai te nkaraki iyie.”

English: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
Masaai: Neaku etang'amua Hanan isinkan le Daudi, nebarn ninche, nedung'oo nkilani enye aitoritie too mpolosi, neisho ninche meshomo;

English: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
Masaai: Ore inkutukie naalejisho naa olminong to Laitoriani. Kake ore lelo oisiligayu naa ninche enchipai enye.

English: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
Masaai: Kake shomo enkaji e papa lai, o ltung'ana lang torikoki olayioni lai enkitok.’

English: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Anatot naa iip nabo o tikitam o isiet.

English: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
Masaai: Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, o isinkan lenyena, o lkituaak lenyena, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki,

English: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee.
Masaai: “Shomo naa tiaaki Ebedmelek ilo le Etiopia, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: ng'ura kaitabaya nanu irorei laainei tialo ena anasa te ntorroni neme te sidai, naa keitabari kenya te dukuya iyie teina olong.

English: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
Masaai: Ore te siadi keeya e Yoshua neikilikuanishore iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani ejo, “Kaing'ae ong'as aituruk alo te nkaraki iyiook pee earare Ilkanaani?”

English: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: apa oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri pee aaku Enkai inyi: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae olkarkar loo soito ewueji nemetii enkulupuoni sapuk, nebulu nabo kata, amu metii enkulupuoni sapuk.

English: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
Masaai: Ore Israel pooki too nkolong'i e Serubabel o too nkolong'i e Nehemia, neisho erubata e anaake lelo aranyak, o larripok le kishomi; neiteng'el ninche ina rubata oo Lawi; neiteng'el ile Lawi ina rubata oo layiok le Aron.

English: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
Masaai: Ore ina suntai naa osoit oji yasper eshetare. Ore ina anasa naa ene sahabu nasila, newang anaa kiook.

English: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aning oltoilo loo rorei lenyena; ore ake pee aning oltoilo loo rorei lenyena, nabatata nanu te nkomom too njo kumok naitabaiki nanu enkomom ai enkop.

English: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
Masaai: Isilig iyie ninye ajo keshukunye, neyau entapa ino olkurroto oidong'ishoreki?

English: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
Masaai: Boas le Obed, Obed le Yese

English: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
Masaai: nebulu ninye neaku osabibu oti oisalaashari, nerrinyokino ninye ilng'osil lenyena, ore ntona enyena nebik teine neitasheyie ninye. Metaa etaa ninye olchani lo sabibu, neiu ninye ilng'osil kumok neitayu ntapuka.

English: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
Masaai: Ayieu naa neomon ilewa too wuejitin pooki, neilepie inkaik naasinya nemetii engoro aashu enchankar;

English: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
Masaai: “Te nepurroo oltung'ani olkiteng arashu enker, neyieng arashu emir, nelak ninye ilmong'i imiet to lkiteng obo, o nkerra ong'uan te nker nabo.

English: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
Masaai: Nelotu obo loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat nening eishankarra, ore pee ening ajo etawalikia aitobiraki, neikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Kaa kitanapata naituruk?”

English: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
Masaai: Maitoki ajo intae isinkan, amu meyiolo osinka enaasita olkitok lenye; kake atejo intae ilchoreta, amu atolikio intae pooki natoning'o te Papa.

English: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
Masaai: Mme taa doi ena siaai ang ake etarrikio eyookini aamenaa; kake taaisere doi neaku ore ninye enkaji e nkai ng'oruoi kitok naji Artemis neitaai pesho, nebaiki doi ninye nesuluni te sikar enye, ina naa ninye eserem Asia neserem enkop pooki.”

English: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena, o iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, Ena bae eitanapishe Olaitoriani.

English: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
Masaai: Amu ingok inono naaiteng'en enkutuk ino, nigelu olng'ejep le lejare.

English: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
Masaai: Ore apa ilo otang'asa aitayu olasar lenye te nkolon e dukuya naa Nashon olayioni le Aminadab, lo losho le Yuda;

English: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
Masaai: Ore eitayu Absalom olasar, neirriwaki olkilikuai meipotuni Ahitofel ilo le Gilom olaikooni le Daudi meeu te nkanasa enye Gilo. Neponari enkarruoisho e Absalom ore iltung'ana ootii te nebo Absalom neponari.

English: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie osesen leilo tung'ani oata osupetai neituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare neton eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
Masaai: Meitajeuni olaiguanani te nkaraki enjore enye kitok; mejeu olmurrani te nkaraki engolon enye kitok.

English: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
Masaai: Intobira too nkeek, nintugum anaa apa enikintoduaaki to ldoinyo, neitobirunye atiu neijia.

English: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
Masaai: neya nena pooki naatarutua, aa iltung'ana o nkishu.

English: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
Masaai: Nejo Enkai “inchoo metaa keetae iwang'aritin to loing'ang'e le keper peyie erishu endama te nkewarie, neaku sii ilooitodolu ilmonek too nkatitin oo nkolong'i o larin.

English: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, laa ninche etipika ilaitasheikinok le Farao meitasheiki ninche, neari, neikilikuani aajoki, “Kainyoo pee eitu iasiasa esiaai inyi aaitobir ilmatofali taata anaa apa?”

English: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
Masaai: Ore teipa, ng'ura, nelotu olkirutoto! Ore eitu eaku tadekenya meekure eetae ninche! Ena ninye erubata e lelo ooibung iyiook aaraya, elaakinoto e lelo ooisim iyiook.

English: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
Masaai: “Niya ilo meregesh oputishoreki niyier nkiri enyena te wueji sinyati.

English: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee intashalishala iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel, aamitiki elang aapuo ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani ninche?

English: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
Masaai: Neinining lelo tung'ana Paulo o metejo ele rorei; nejo ake neijia, neilepie pooki ltoiloishi nejo, “Ewuang'ie ele tung'ani te nkop! Amu meishiaakino neishu!”

English: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
Masaai: Ore te Israel: too layiok le Parosh netumi: Ramia, o Isia, o Malkija, o Mijamin, o Eleasa, o Hashabia o Benaia.

English: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
Masaai: Etolimuo apake Enkai too nkutukie oo loibonok lenyena pooki ajo, meeta nchere meitamei Kristo lenye; netaa te kuna naatasate eitabayie.

English: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
Masaai: kake kayau endungokinoto enkiguana olosho pooki oisiaaita, ore tesiadi, nepuku ninche teina kop etudupote.

English: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
Masaai: Netaa sii ore lelo ootuata etii atua Kristo neimina ntarasi.

English: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:
Masaai: nijoki ninye, inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Ng'ura, ore ilo tung'ani oji enkarna enye Olng'osila: naa kebulaa ninye teine netii, naa keshetaki ninye Olaitoriani enkaji e Nkai.

English: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Enkai Abraham, “Mincho kintagor ororei le nkerai o tenkaraki enkitok ino rrindik, ore pooki nikijoki Sara, taasa ina. Amu Isaak eipotieki eishoi ino.

English: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilayiok lenyena, “Erotokoki nanu esikiria” neaku eirotokoki ninye esikiria,

English: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche aarasaki Yuda, neibung ninye, nenap ninche aaya ntokitin pooki naanoto te nkaji o laiguanani, neya sii ilayiok lenyena o nkituaak enyena, neaku meetae olayioni otung'eikiaki ninye, meteleku ake Yehoahas ilo ayioni lenye oti te pooki.

English: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyie nanu asaru; ntajeuoki nanu te lelo pooki laasujita, nikikordu nanu,

English: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.
Masaai: Neitanapisho olaiguanani ina metaasi; neitayuni enkitanapata te Susa, neilili ilayiok pokira tomon le Haman.

English: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Enchom.” Ore pee eipung ninche, nepuo aajing ilbitiro; naa ng'ura! nekuet emboo pooki, nesulari te marti aajing enaiposha, neye ti atua enkare.

English: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Ore enkitoria ai mme ene na kop. Te naa napaji ke ne na kop enkitoria ai anaata aatang'oro ilooiteng'eni laainei, pee maapiki nkaik oo Lyahudi; kake ore enatiu, mme ene ne enkitoria ai.” Nejoki Pilato ninye, “Metaa ira iyie olaiguanani?”

English: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Entobira ilolan linyi pee isikisiki, intae iloomanya Misiri! amu keaku Memfis olmuaate o enkidaata, meetae olomanya.

English: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kaa kibatisare naa apa eibatisaki intae?” Nejoki ninche, “Enkibatisa e Yohana.”

English: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
Masaai: Nelotu ina kata obo le lelo ooitore enkaji e ntumo, oji enkarna Yairo; ore pee edol ninye, nebatata too nkejek enyena.

English: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
Masaai: Amu ore ake anaa enairo nanu, naishir, nabuaku ajo, “Olarrabal o enkidaaroto!” Amu etotiwuo ororei lo laitoriani te nanu anaa emoroto o enkitang'oroto! endama pooki.

English: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Amu ore enkitoria e Nkai mme endaata o eokore kake esupatisho o eseriani o eng'ida naaing'uaa Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
Masaai: Nelo aing'uaa aton tenelamita te wueji neba anaa engororoto e mbae. Amu etejo, “Mincho aduaaki keeya enkerai ai.” Ore eton tenelamita ninye, neilepie enkerai oltoilo aishir.

English: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
Masaai: Neitagor ninche ninye too nkariak e Meriba, netum Musa enyamali te nkaraki ninche;

English: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
Masaai: “Ilepa shomo taarare enkop e Merasaim, nilo aarare lelo oomanya Pekod, taara metuata, tusujai indaikie ninche katukul. Olaitoriani ojo, naa taasa nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie.

English: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Ore lelo oretu Misiri naa kebatata, ore olwuasa lenye le ngolon enye nedou; eiteru te Migdol o meshomo Siene kebatatakino ninye to lalem, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche ninye aajoki, “Eishopito enkila oo lpapit neeta enkimeita o lchoni te mpolos enye.” Nejo ninye, “Eliya le Tishibit ilo.”

English: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
Masaai: o Meshulam, o Abijia, o Mijomin,

English: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ore Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, kelo airriwaki esaso lelo morran lenyena oopir, ore ti abori enkitoo enye neinoki enkiyupuyup, neeijo enkiyupuyup e nkima.

English: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bani naa Meshulam, o Maluk, o Adaia, o Yashub, o Sheal, o Yeremot.

English: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
Masaai: o lapolosak, Eliakim o Maaseia, o Miniamin, o Makaia, o Elioenai, o Sekaria, o Hanania, eeta ntarumpetani;

English: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
Masaai: Kiyiolo aajo mening Enkai ilaing'okok; kake ore oloserem Enkai neas enayieu ninye, kening Enkai ninye.

English: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
Masaai: Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore emanaroto enye neikununo anaa enkikompe, netiu anaa entapukai sidai; neeta mboreitin nkalifuni uni o ltulet enkare natii.

English: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
Masaai: Nejoki taa Ilyahudi, “Artam o ile ilarin eshetitai ena aji e Nkai hekalo, eji nijo iyie intasheyie too nkolong'i uni?”

English: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo te ninche olau toki, amu ore lelo apa ooata masaa oo nkurman aashu inoo nkajijik, nemir neyau mpesai naainosieki nena masaa,

English: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
Masaai: Etoopishote loreren, kake neewuo engoro ino, neewuo enkata naiguanareki ilootuata, nilaaki ole koisiaayio isinkan linono, iloibonok sinyat o lelo ooure enkarna ino, ilooti o lkituaak, o enkata namuti lelo amutak le nkop.”

English: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
Masaai: o layiok le Yaala, o layiok le Darkon, o layiok le Gidel,

English: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
Masaai: Kemir ninye isintan lenyena, kake meinepu; neing'oru ninche, kake metum ninche. Neitoki ninye ajo, ‘Kalo nanu narrinyokino olapa moruo lai le dukuya, amu keikash apa ina kata te nanu alang taata.’

English: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
Masaai: Neaku lchoreta Herode o Pilato ade ina olong, amu ore eton eitu ebau ena, neeta apa ninche mang'atisho pokira.

English: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
Masaai: Ore te shumata keper etarate ilakir, ore epuoito ninche nearare Sisera.

English: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Rimon-peres, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Libna.

English: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
Masaai: Mbelekenya iyie empijan o lalem lenye, neitu ncho ninye meitasho to larrabal.

English: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
Masaai: Amu kedorropu endapash te neitorioo oltung'ani nkejek, naa ronkai olkarasha te nejo oltung'ani aitoipore.

English: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
Masaai: Enchakenisho ino ninye enjung'ore ai ntarasi; ee, ninche eng'ida o ltau lai.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
Masaai: Ore oloata enkiok inchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho naisho meinosa ilng'anayio te ilo shani le mpuaan natii atua emparadiso e Enkai.’

English: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Aikiji ng'ae enkarna?” Nejo, “Yakobo.”

English: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
Masaai: Nelo apa Abimelek olayioni le Yerubaal Shekem, enetii ilalashera ng'otonye nejoki ninche o lgilata pooki lo lmarei le ng'otonye,

English: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
Masaai: Keiu ina kop ilng'anayio lenyena, ninosinoso intae aaraposho nitonini tiatua ninye te seriani.

English: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu te Musa eishoruaki Nkitanapat; nelotu empiris o esipata te Yesu Kristo.

English: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
Masaai: nimikipalaa entumo, anaa enatiu olkuaak le kulikae, kake intagolo olikae olikae neisul idolitata aajo etinyikua ina Olong.

English: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorita ilo, nejing'u likae nejo, “Eitayutuo Ilkaldayo iltimito okuni, nepuonu aarare iyiook aaikonyaa intamesin nereu, near isinkan te nepi olalem; metaa nanu ake oisikua peyie aalotu aliki.”

English: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo apa likiyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri. Tang'a enkutuk ino pe aiput nanu.

English: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
Masaai: Kuna baa etaasa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, netum enkarna ti atua lelo tung'ana okuni magil.

English: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
Masaai: Nelamari iltung'ana aaitashe te nelakua, etaa kenyikaki Musa ina aimin nairrusha te ine netii Enkai.

English: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejoki “Mikintokini aekata aajo Yakobo, kake Israel, amu itekeshare Enkai tenebo iltung'ana nisulie.”

English: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu atejo neijia, nenyamalu to ltau nejo, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi nanu.”

English: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
Masaai: Ina kata pee eitasheyie oloing'ang'e le shumata, ina kata pee eitayu nchorroi e ng'uton.

English: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
Masaai: Aatamana nanu nkeenta e keeya, naaiputukunyie nanu olairrag le nkare e ntorroni.

English: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
Masaai: Neipang iltung'ana le Benchamen aapuo aarare lelo tung'ana nerrumori aaitalam enkanasa. Ore anaa oshi too nkulie katitin neiteru aaoshisho near embata oo ltung'ana metuata, too nkoitoi, aa ore enkoitoi nabo nalala naa enailep alo Betel, nelo enkae Gibea. Ore te ina kisiajata near iltung'ana oobaya tomoni uni o are loo Siraeli.

English: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
Masaai: ore to loshal natiu anaa oloshal peyie ariku sii ninche, ataa pooki toki too ltung'ana pooki, peyie atem too nkoitoi pooki aitajeu ematua enye.

English: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
Masaai: Nejoki olkitok ilo aisiaayiani lenye, ‘Shomo nkoitoi sapuki o nkutiti, o lkirinen taaru ltung'ana meetu, o meiputayu enkaji ai.

English: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
Masaai: Nerrinyu ninye imasaa pooki naawaki tenebo sii oltung'ani lenye le mudong Lot, omasaa enyena, o nkituaak o ltung'ana.

English: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
Masaai: “Tenatomito nanu ae toki nayieu olaisinani, arashu tenaishirie nanu enkoliai,

English: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yona enkata e are, ejo,

English: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye to ltoilo le ntarumpeta; meisisi ninye te ndule o te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin!

English: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
Masaai: Afiim, o Para, o Ofra,

English: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.
Masaai: Neshukunye olaiguanani eing'uaa ina kurma e nkaji e nkitoo elotu ewueji duoo neokie enaisho oo sabibu, ore Haman ina kata ebatata aomonu olng'ur, nebatatakino ina rruat natii Esta; nejo olaiguanani, “Keyieu neikony enkitok o laiguanani te dukuya nanu ti atua enkaji ai, Ore pee epuku ilo rorei te nkutuk o laiguanani neimulumuli enkomom e Haman.

English: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
Masaai: “Ore tenebo nena, tenelotu oltung'ani loo loreren, leme o loo ltung'ana linono Isiraeli, oing'uaa enkop nalakua, nelotu tenkaraki enkarna ino,

English: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
Masaai: Tagolieki nanu anaa enerok e nkong'u; isudoyioki nanu to loip loo naipuko inono,

English: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
Masaai: aisiaaita Olaitoriani te mborron pooki o te ng'eno, o too lkiyio, o too ngolot nanoto te nkaraki losekin loo Lyahudi.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
Masaai: Paulo olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo te yieunoto e Enkai, o Timoteo olalashe lang.

English: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
Masaai: eeta enkitoo e Enkai, naikununo enkitiil anaa eno soit lemetumoyu aashu osoit oji yasper, owang anaa oltotoi.

English: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edung'i ilo meregesh aarishirish, nepejoo Musa endukuya o nena rubat o enkurriny.

English: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
Masaai: Naa ele olmonekie te intae: itumutumu elooyo naishopokino nkilani e keraisho, neirragita te mpeut oo nkishu.”

English: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
Masaai: Eitoduaa ninye iltung'ana lenyena isiaaitin enyena, aisho ninche enjung'ore oo nkuapi.

English: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
Masaai: “Atorat, o Dibon, o Yaser, o Nimra, o Heshbon, o Eliele, o Sebam, o Nebo, o Beon,

English: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
Masaai: ore apa Tokshan naa ninye menye le Sheba, o Dedon. Ore ilayiok le Dedan, naa Asshurim, o Letushim, o Leumim.

English: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
Masaai: Ng'ura, kebaa esidano o enchipai te netoni ilalashera to lning'o!

English: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “A-a, eikirrinyo iyiook te nebo aapuo enetii iltung'ana linono.”

English: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kushi naa Seba, o Hafila, o Sabta o Raama o Sableka. Ore ilayiok le Raama naa Sheba o Dedan.

English: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
Masaai: Tapala nena kera inono nemeeta menye, kaitopok nanu; nchoo maaisiliga inyi nkolia nanu.”

English: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
Masaai: Ore pee epuku te mpeut neyiolou iltung'ana ninye te ina kata ake.

English: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
Masaai: Eing'oru olomenisho eng'eno nagut te mpesho, kake elelek eng'eno to ltung'ani oota ening'unoto.

English: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
Masaai: Enkai e Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, Enkai oo loo papa, naishoo Osinka lenye Yesu, enkitoo, Intae ooitarasaitie ninye aaisho lelo ooitoreisho, nitanyaita intae ninye te dukuya Pilato, etejo ninye alaku aisho elo.

English: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
Masaai: Ore ina umata nekordu ilo oitayio loikop te nkaina e ilo oitalaku osarge, ore ina umata nepik ninye atua ina anasa enye nasaruni, naa ninye elo aisikaki, nelo ninye aton te ine o metaba anaa neye ilo apolosani kitok apa otubukokoki eilata nasinya aaput.

English: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
Masaai: “Nintoki sii aitayu eilata o lmeregesh, o eilata o lkidong'oe o enkurriny e nkoshoke, o lkina le monyua o lairakuj pokira are eeta enkurriny enye o emuro e tatene (amu olmeregesh oputishoreki opikieki Aron o layiok lenyena esiaai sinyati),

English: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak lenyena neitayu nkishorot te nyorrata aaisho iltung'ana, o lapolosak, o Lawi. Ore Hilkia, o Sakaria o Yehiel lelo kituaak le nkaji e Nkai, neisho ilapolosak to sirua le pasaka anaa nkishorot oo lkuo le kerra, nkalifuni are o iip ile eshula o lkuoo le kineji. O loing'ok iip uni.

English: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.
Masaai: Naa neijia apa etiu kulikae linyi, kake eitukuoki intae, eitisinyaki intae, eikenakakaki intae esipata, te nkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, o te Nkiyang'et e Nkai ang.

English: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
Masaai: Ilkigerot kulo le Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, ina kata apa etamueyia ninye nenyaaka aishiu:

English: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
Masaai: Aigeroki intae ena ti alo lelo oojo pee elej intae;

English: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani Sedekia, “Ng'ura, etii ninye atua nkaik inyi; amu meidim olaiguanani ataasa ae toki napaashare intae.”

English: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
Masaai: Kaji eiko Shetani te neoro aara makewan, keitoki enkitoria enye auno? Amu ijojo naa te ngolon e Beelsebul aaraa loiriruani?

English: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.
Masaai: Neaku kayietu nanu te nkaraki Moab; kaishir nanu te nkaraki Moab pooki; ore te nkaraki iltung'ana le Kiheres naishir nanu.

English: Where they crucified him, and two others with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
Masaai: Neshe ninche ninye te ine, o kulikae aare te nebo ninye, atii ake obo enkae matua netii olikae enkae netii Yesu erishata.

English: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
Masaai: Netum taa Olaitoriani aitobira te shumata o ldoinyo pooki le Sion o te shumata ilturrurri lenyena pooki enkatampoi te ndama, o empuruo o enkimerlel e nkima te nkewarie, amu ore te shumata naa kelo atii enkitushurata o lng'obor.

English: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
Masaai: neidak iseseni pooki tenebo nerrinyo tung'ani atua enterit.

English: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebol nedol enkerai, dol, eishirita ina looyo. Neing'urrie ninye nejo, “Enoo nkera oo Lhebrania ena.”

English: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
Masaai: nenyaaka aponaa ajo, “Nele nanu, aewuo paa aas enyieunoto ino.” Keiwuang'ie ninye idia e dukuya peyie etum aitasheyie eniare.

English: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
Masaai: Naa Yehiel apa, o Asasia, o Natan, o Asahel, o Yerimot, o Yosabad, o Elieli, o Ismakia, o Mahat, o Benaia, ninche ilaitasheikinok ooretu Konania o Shimei olalashe lenye. Ninche etegelua olaiguanani Hesekia o Asaria ilo kitok oitasheiki enkaji e Nkai.

English: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shela ole Yuda naa: Eer menye le Leka, o Laada menye le Maresha, o lmareita le nkaji oo laitobirak oopuyiapui te Bet-ashbea.

English: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
Masaai: Naa keripaki apa ng'otonye oloti kila neyaki ninye te pooki ari, te neilep alo te nebo olpayian lenye epuo aaitayu olasar lo lari.

English: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
Masaai: Nerratany ninche iltungana linono, Olaitoriani, neisilisil enjung'ore ino.

English: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
Masaai: Mitum iyie enkuretisho kewarie, nimikitum embae nang'oruni dama,

English: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
Masaai: Eibibi ninye esayiet, olng'ejep le nturbubua olo aar ninye.

English: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
Masaai: Ore ina tapa inyi e nkiterata ninchooyoyo emukate naaku olasar; ore anaa olasar oing'uaa osoit oituutishoreki, ninchooyoyo.

English: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Etiu enkitoria e Nkai anaa te neisuaaki oltung'ani lanterera enkop.

English: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
Masaai: Kaisuaaki nanu intae enkare nasila niakuku sidain too ntorrok inyi pooki, o too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi pooki ekaisuj nanu intae.

English: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Entapal inkera kutiti emimitiki epuonu enatii, emimitiki amu enoo naatiu anaa kuna enkitoria e shumata.”

English: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
Masaai: Nemutan Olaitoriani Sara anaa apa enatejo, neitaas ninye anaa enaisiligie.

English: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
Masaai: Neisik ninye o nena masaa pooki naata, neinyototo alang olkeju le Frati, neitoriokino oldoinyo le Gilead.

English: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
Masaai: Salmon Olhohi, o Maharai le Netofa,

English: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
Masaai: Ore apa ara enkiti kerai nanana atii tenebo papa lai, naa nanu ake eeta yieyio.

English: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, enkaraki oltung'ani obo pee etijing'a ng'ok enkop, neitijing'u ng'ok enkeeya. Neaku eibulua enkeeya enkop pooki amu eitarruoitie ltung'ana pooki.

English: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
Masaai: Ting'idakinoyu iyie ninye na shumata o intae isinyat, o lkipaareta, o loibonok le Enkai, amu etudung' oko Enkai ninye enkiguana te nkaraki intae.”

English: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
Masaai: Nejoki Laban Yakobo, “Kaa ena nikintaasa peyie kilotu alej aiko nji, niya intoyie aainei anaa iyarunot o lalem?

English: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
Masaai: Keureyuni intae neponari sii oloputukunyi te pooki ng'ues natii enkop, o pooki motonyi oloing'ang'e o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, o pooki sinkirri le naiposha, keaku inkaik inyi etii.

English: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
Masaai: Te naa eituata te nebo Kristo te nkalo e nena kiyang'eta o loing'ang'e, oo naa pee eton ake ipuopuo anaa leton era ile nkop? Oo pee inchosho eitore intae irrekiei leeiking'a?

English: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
Masaai: Nepuonu ilmalaika oare Sodom teipa, ore Lot egira apa aton te kishomi e Sodom. Ore peyie edol Lot ninche, neinyototo alo anang'are, neirrugo aitabaiki e nkomom enye enkop,

English: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
Masaai: Kearaa intae aaipung'ie too nkajijik e ntumo: ee kelotu enkata naa kejo pooki ng'ae oar intae entuata nedamu ajo ke Nkai eisiaita.

English: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
Masaai: Metaa keibung iltung'ana loo Siraeli sabato, neing'or sabato ti atua iishoritin enye pooki, anaa osotua loo ntarasi.

English: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
Masaai: Naa ing'ura inutayu, niiu enkayioni, nimpot enkarna enye ajo Yesu.

English: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
Masaai: Inteng'enaki nanu ina nemadolita; tenataasa nanu entorroni, nemaitoki aekata aigil aas?’

English: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

English: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
Masaai: Niyauu intae tiatua imanyishoritin inyi imukateni are pee eyuki, naaitobirunyeki irubat are tiatua e tomon e Efa, naa ine ntapa napuyiapui, naa kepeji ninche tenebo enkisuijoi, anaa ilng'anayio le dukuya ooishori Olaitoriani.

English: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
Masaai: Netejo ninche nji, aa entemata etem, pee etum aaitang'oro Yesu. Kake eirruge Yesu nesir enkop to lkimojino.

English: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

English: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquility.

Masaai: o Ashan tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Bet-shemesh tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

English: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip ainosa endaa neokisho neirotoki osikiria ilo oiboni duoo otorrinyuo ariku.

English: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
