Masaai: Ore pee etumo ninche te nebo, neitanap Yesu ajoki, “Emipuo aaing'uaa Yerusalem, kake entaanyu enkishorunoto natejo Papa keishoru, anaa enatiaaka intae.

English: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
Masaai: ina kata apa pee eas ninye nkitoduaat enyena te Misiri, o mbaa enyena e nking'asia naataasa ti ong'ata e Sion.

English: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
Masaai: “Ore pooki tung'ani le nkaji e Israel aashu o le lelo tung'ana omon ootoni tiatua ninche, te nenya osarge, naing'orie nanu enkomom ai te ngoro ilo tung'ani oinosa osarge, naiwuang'ie ninye tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
Masaai: Naa kaitayu sii olosho tiatua enkayioni enkitok rrindik, amu ole ishoi ino sii ninye.”

English: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
Masaai: Netumo ilpayiani te nebo ore pee eidip aaiguanata, neisho isikarini impesai kumok aajoki,

English: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
Masaai: Ore moikuape o kopikop iyie oitobirua ninche; ore Tabori o Hermon neisis enkarna ino te ng'ida.

English: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Neaku kadanyidany nanu kulo tung'ana o ena anasa anaa enadany oltung'ani entoki oo nkulupuok, o metaa meigili ae kata aaram. Nenukaa iltung'ana ninye te Tofet amu meitokini aata ewueji nenukarieki.

English: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
Masaai: neyiolou iltung'ana pooki aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani otushutua olalem lai te nchashur; nemeitokini aaigil aashukoki olalem enchashur.

English: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
Masaai: Amu eitisinya apa ilapolosak o Lawi ate tenebo; etaa apa pooki ilemeiduruk. Neaku eteyiang'a ninche olkuoo lenye le pasaka tenkaraki lelo pooki ootorrinyunye te yararoto, te nkaraki lelo apolosak alashera lenye, o tenkaraki ninche maate,

English: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
Masaai: Neipotu Musa Yoshua, nejoki ninye te dukuya Israel pooki, “Tonyua nintagol oshoke; amu ilo iyie o ele orere atua ina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo menye pee eisho ninche; naa iyie olo aisho ninche.

English: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eeta ake enkitotonet nabo nkejek e ngarri o ng'uan o suyai o ltidii lo suyai, ore ilpijat pokira oong'uan naa ineeirisharieki ilo moti. Ore nena rishinani neikodoki too lmarisiani te pooki shoto.

English: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Yeriko; obo, olaiguanani le Ai aa ninye natashare Betel, obo:

English: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
Masaai: Enaikash tinilo ina aji nabore olkiyioi, alang tinilo ina aji o sirua, amu ena enkiting'oto e pooki tung'ani. Neshum lelo ooishu ina too ltauja.

English: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas oo le Lawi ti atua ina kop oo ltung'ana le Israel naa nkanas artam o isiet pooki te nebo iwuejitin enye neeirritishoreki.

English: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
Masaai: “Ntemera ninye, enkaraki nailepie ninye kewan aitorisioki Olaitoriani; neaku kelo Moab aiperipera tiatua irrugumat enyena, naa keaku sii entoki nakueniyieki.

English: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Masaai: Eshomo ninche pooki aapong'ori, enyaanyuk pooki; meetae hoo obo oas isupati, meetae, metii hoo obo.

English: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
Masaai: Tishipayu iyie lo barnoti, tiatua kitisho ino, nincho oltau lino kinting'id iyie too nkolong'i pooki e kitisho ino; shomo too nkoitoi oltau lino o too nduaat oo nkonyek inono. Kake tayiolo ajo ore te kuna baa pooki naa aikiyau iyie Enkai atua enkiguana.

English: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
Masaai: Shimei olayioni le Ela te nkop e Benchamen;

English: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Nchoo Abishag e Shunam meishori Adonija olalashe lino meyama.” Nejoki olaiguanani Solomon ngotonye, “Paa kainyoo peyie aa Abishag e Shunam iomonu meishori Adonija?

English: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya nintayuyu eumata sinyati, nimiasiasa esiaai nagol.

English: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita loo le Gershon neun ilng'oborri ti oriong olng'obor le Nkai te nkalo o loo ntoluo,

English: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani likindim aitasheikinore too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino. Ore apa anaa enatii nanu te nebo Musa, neijia aiko kaaku nanu te nebo iyie; maaitiak nanu iyie nemaaing'uaa nanu iyie.

English: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Masaai: kake ti nikipuoyie ewang'an, anaa pee etii ninye ewang'an, nikiata enchula olikae o likae, neisuj iyiook osarge le Yesu Kristo, Oinoti lenye aoru ng'ok pooki.

English: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
Masaai: ‘Aimetumito neorita nena naataarutua, neya ake oltung'ani entito nabo aashu are; ore te Sisera naa inkilani oomuain kumok, inkilani naaikodo, mpukunot are oomuain naaikodo te murt ai anaa iyarunot?’

English: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
Masaai: o lasar le ntapa te nebo olmeregesh neaku e efa, te nebo olasar le ntapa tenebo ilkuoo keaku ake duoo anaa enaidim, tenebo eilata te pooki efa.

English: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tipika enkaina ino olgoo lino.” Nepik ninye enkaina enye olgoo lenye; ore pee eitayu, ng'ura, etijing'a enkaina enye enkeeya oo lbolot, neibor anaa enturoto.

English: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
Masaai: “Etoning'e olkiyioi te Horonaim ‘Eyararoto o enkidaata sapuk!’

English: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
Masaai: Miureyu ilo sina olotu. Ng'ura, etaa enajo pee enang'aki sheitani lkulikae te intae atua korokoroni pee etum atetema intae, naa ore too nkolong'i tomon nitumutumu intae osomit. Taa oloisiligayu o tabaiki keeya naa kaaisho iyie enkopiyia e nkitoo e nkishui.

English: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
Masaai: Ninkilikuanu ajo, “Ainyoo doi pee meng'amaa ninye?” Enkaraki nataa Olaitoriani shakeni lo lning'o te rishata eina kitok niyama te kitisho, itaa iyie olemeisiligayu te ninye hoo duoo naa enkitok ino te naboisho o to lning'o.

English: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
Masaai: Aikok pooki ng'ae oning irorei le naibon e na buku: te nepon ake oltung'ani, neponiki sii ninye Enkai lelo meita ootolimuoki ti atua ena buku.

English: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
Masaai: kake ore ilo oimu kishomi ninye olchekut loo nkerra.

English: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
Masaai: Nkaik inono naaitayutuo nanu naaitobiru; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto pee atum aiteng'enuo too nkitanapat inono.

English: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
Masaai: Etii lelo oodol aajo meeta ntiot too nkonyek enye maate, neitu eisujari ilduruki lenye.

English: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku etejo ninye, “Kaji eikununo kuna anas nikinchoo iyie nanu olalashe lai?” “Neaku etejoki apa ninche, enkop Kabul o taata.

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii nanu ejo:

English: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
Masaai: Ore pee ening inchere emuei, nebik nkolong'i are te ine netii;

English: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
Masaai: Enting'idata tiatua enkarna enye sinyati; nchoo iltauja le lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani meting'idata.

English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
Masaai: Anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neiko neijia Aron airragie te dukuya Enchakenisho, metushumi.

English: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
Masaai: Neshipa Yuda pooki tenkaraki ilo mumai; amu einosa ninche too ltauja lenye pooki, neing'orutua ninche ninye te yieunoto enye pooki, nenoto ninche ninye, neishoo Olaitoriani ninche enkiyeng'iyeng too nkaloli pooki.

English: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kayau nanu ninche apik atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye, atua enkaina e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o lkituaak lenyena. Ore te siadi nemanyi Misiri anaa apake, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
Masaai: Tinidol to lkerenket lelo aisinak eitorogonyi neoruni esipata naishaakino te ng'olon, ming'asia ake teina bae; amu ore ilo kitok neing'orita likae kitok alang ninye, neetae ake sii kulikae ooilep te ninche.

English: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
Masaai: Eikenayioki nena pooki aajo keipima, ore enkiroishi e pooki toki neigeri.

English: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
Masaai: Ore ina kikurrukur o lng'atuny, o ilo toilo lo lng'atuny pushati, o lelo ala le lelo ng'atunyo ooti negili.

English: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:
Masaai: Nemetumi apa olkunoni hoo obo te nkop pooki e Israel; amu etejo Ilfilisti, “Pee meitobiraki ate Ilhebrania ilalema arashu iremeta.”

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
Masaai: neaku einuakaki engoro o Laitoriani tenkaraki ena kop, neyau shumata ninye ildeketa pooki ooigero tena buku;

English: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Ninche apa ooirorie Farao olaiguanani le Misiri eimaki enkitayunoto oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli metung'uai Misiri, kulo lelo Musa o Aron.

English: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: ninye oisho endaa ntokitin pooki naaishu, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD'S house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
Masaai: Nedumu ilkerubi inaipuko enye aailep aapuo to loing'ang'e aaing'uaa enkop adolita epuo, ore epuo, etii nkejek emurte enye; neitashe te kutuk aji enkishomi enkalo oloosaen enkaji Olaitoriani; netii shumata enye enkitoo Enkai e Israel.

English: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
Masaai: Neijia ajo Olaitoriani. Neaku ore ina kiroroto oo lng'ejepa mme olmonekie te lelo ooiruko kake te lelo leitu eiruk, kake ore elikioroto o rorei mme ene lelo leitu eiruk kake enoo looiruko.

English: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
Masaai: Embung'a intae enking'odiata ai o eutaroto; eng'ura, kabukoki intae iutarot oo ndamunot aainei naa kaitayiolo intae irorei laainei.

English: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
Masaai: Nelo Yuda te nebo Simion olalashe lenye, nemir ninche Ilkanaani apa oomanya Sefat, neidaikie tukul. Neaku keji apa enkarna e ina anasa Horma.

English: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
Masaai: Etabawua enkata, etinyikua enkolong. Mincho ilo oinyang'isho eshipa, arashu olamirani eishir, amu etii engoro napi atua olorora lenye pooki.

English: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
Masaai: Kake eirorie Hamor ninche ejoki, “Etayiewua naleng oltau lo layioni lai Shekem entito ino; aatasayia, enchoo ninye meyama.

English: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
Masaai: Aikijo aa naa iyiook? Iloreren leitu eing'oru ninche esupatisho ninche oonoto, naa to rrekie le nkirukoto;

English: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
Masaai: kake eibelekenyate ninche neas mbususi anaa apa loo menye; nemerregela ninche anaa enkawuo torrono.

English: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa Yoash olaiguanani le Israel, netumo ninye o Amasia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, netumo to larrabal te Betshemesh, e Yuda.

English: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
Masaai: Anaa enkurlee naiturrur nkera neitu edanyu, neijia eikununo ilo otum karsisisho kake mme te sipata; ore te mpolos oo nkolong'i enyena neing'uaa ninche ninye, ore te nkiting'oto enye neaku olmodai.

English: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te nkure enye naitobiraki nanu ninche, naitemer nanu ninche o metishipata neirura ninche nkolong'i pooki nemeigil aainyototo, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
Masaai: Eidaikieki iltung'ana laainei te nkaraki emodai nemeeta eng'eno enkaraki nitanyaita intae eng'eno, aatanya nanu iyie pee miaku olapolosani te nanu. Naa ore anaa enikitorikine enkitanapata e Nkai ino madamu sii nanu inkera inono.

English: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
Masaai: Na kera aainei, emimenaa naa taata, amu etegelua intae Olaitoriani pee ipuopuo aaitashe te dukuya ninye, pee isiayiayia ninye, niakuku ilaisiaayiak lenyena nipejokiki ninye enkorropil.”

English: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata e nkeeya oo lbolot to lkila loo lpapit loo nkerra aashu le kitani, aa oloripuno aashu oloo ntokitin naapiyaya, aashu enaripuno aashu ae toki oo ndapan, pee eutu tenaa keeta olduruk aashu tenaa meeta olduruk.

English: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
Masaai: Ore oloiboni oibonu eseriani, ore ake pee ebaya ororei leilo oiboni, neyioulouni taa aajo esipa Olaitoriani oiriwua ilo oiboni.”

English: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
Masaai: Amu etupurda ninye neing'uaa lelo aisinak, eibung'a ninye aikonyaa enkaji neitu eshet.

English: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
Masaai: Aimeeta ninche eng'eno, kulo aasak loo ntorrok pooki, ooinos iltung'ana laainei, anaa enainos ninche endaa, nemeserem ninche Olaitoriani?

English: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i kumok eitu ae kata eliooyu enkolong anaa lakir, neme kiti olkutati opetita iyiook, neish iyiook osiligi nikijo ebaiki ake neitajeuni iyiook.

English: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
Masaai: Ilo ninye olo aton too wuejiitin e shumata; ore ewueji e nkirrita naa isempewueti too soito; nepuoi aaisho ninye endaa o enkare.

English: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
Masaai: Naa te ilo rorei ake sii etushumaki keper taata natii o nkop aaitanyu enkima, nepali o metabaiki enkolong e nkiguana o mutata oo ltung'ana lemeure Enkai.

English: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
Masaai: Ore olanyor lai naa olalai nara nanu enenye, eirrita ninye ntare enyena tiatua ntapuka.

English: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Kohat: Aminadab olayioni lenye, o Kora olayioni lenye, o Asir olayioni lenye.

English: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
Masaai: Naa keyaki ninye olapolosani olasar lenye le nkitarruorroto, aisho Olaitoriani olmeregesh lemeeta entioto aitayu tiatua eluaata enye, litudung'oko iyie enkinyiang'a nchere keiririkino olasar le nkitarruorroto;

English: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Tenaa iyaku iyie osinka le kulo tung'ana ena olong, nisiaai ninche, nirorie iyie ninche te supatisho tiniwaliki ninche, naa keaku ninche isinkan linono ntarasi.”

English: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
Masaai: Ekeidim ninye ainosa emukate e Nkai enye eine wueji sinyati aisul o enoo ntokitin sinyat,

English: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
Masaai: Enkerai ai inining'u tukurraki irorei laainei, irrugu enkiok ino inining'u inkikoot aainei.

English: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
Masaai: Kake eewa apa Yael ina kitok e Heberi encheitoi o Lng'obor, neya enyuntu te nkaina enye, nelo ninye aakutiti, neoshoki encheitoi eseder enye nepudaki enkop, kaae neye ninye te nauri.

English: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
Masaai: Amaa papa lang Abraham keitu eikenakini sipat te nkaraki siaitin, pee eitayu oinoti lenye Isaak to olperere lo lasar?

English: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
Masaai: Nchoo enkop pooki eureyu Olaitoriani, nchoo lelo pooki oomanya enkop meitasho te nkanyit te dukuya ninye!

English: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
Masaai: “Amu meetae olchani sidai oiu lng'anayio torrok; aashu olchani torrono oiu lng'anayio sidain;

English: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
Masaai: Kake tenaa enkoliai ina tito olapolosani aashu etung'uayie olmoruo lenye, nemeeta nkera, neshukunye alotu enkang e menye, anaa apake te keraisho, neidim ninye ainosa ina daa e menye; ore ake eyia meetae oltung'ani leeiking'a oidim ainosa ina daa.

English: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
Masaai: enkop engoro o longolingoli naa ore ewang'an netiu anaa enaimin.”

English: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
Masaai: Ming'asia te naajoki iyie, ‘Meeta nchere pee miking'ili aaiu.’

English: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
Masaai: Kake aikuti apa ilapolosak oleng nemeidim aaitobira ilasarri oopejori pooki, neaku eitisinya apa ilapolosak ate, neretu ninche ilalashera lenye, o metaba anaa neidipayu esiaai. Amu kedupa apa Ilawi too ltauja aalang ilapolosak.

English: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltung'ana abori ilarikok le njore teina anasa. Neiturrurroki ninche kewan to lkurroto te mbata e kishomi, neirorie ninche aitagol ejo,

English: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo ooidapashakinote nena kuapi nepuo ninche aalikioo ilo rorei.

English: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore king'orutua ilooiteng'eni, nikibik nkolong'i naa pishana te ine. Nejoki lelo Paulo te Nkiyang'et nchere pee melo ake Yerusalem.

English: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
Masaai: Ore enyorrata nemeru ae toki ntarasi. Te neetai enaibon ekeiting'ieki; te naa lng'ejepa keiting ore eng'eno naa keishari.

English: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
Masaai: Keitiko oltau lai, neishunye engolon ai; ore ewang'an oo nkonyek aainei - neishunye sii te nanu.

English: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Abigail, “Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, laa ninye nikirriua iyie ena olong pee kinang'are nanu!

English: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
Masaai: anaa enaikunaki Sodom o Gomora o nkang'itie naamanita naatusuja sii ninche ng'uarrat oo loirerioni torrok, neitamioki ninche te nkima oo ntarasi pee eaku enkitanyaanyukoto te pooki.

English: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
Masaai: Ore pooki lemenap osalaba lenye naairukurukore, nemeidim ataa oloiteng'eni lai.

English: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ena naituruk, ‘Toning'o iyie Siraeli; Enkai ang Olaitoriani; obo Olaitoriani;

English: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
Masaai: Neitu iramatata intokitin aainei sinyat; kake itipika ilomon meing'ura atua ewueji ai sinyati.

English: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
Masaai: Nelo Filipo enkanasa oo Samaria neinosaki ninche Kristo.

English: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: Embung'a sabato amu eisinyati te ntae; ore pooki ng'ae oisarkionie neari metua; ore oltung'ani oasisho te ina olong neiwuang'ieki ninye ti atua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.
Masaai: Netem ninye ina dung'oroto, intemat e nkaina iip nabo enkadori, o ntemat iip nabo endapasho, nerisio inkaloli pokira ong'uan; netii olperere dukuya ina aji Enkai.

English: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
Masaai: Neitanap kulikae tung'ana magil le njore enye meteena Shadrak o Meshek o Abednego, nenang'aki ninche atua ilo kokuet oyupuyup le nkima.

English: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
Masaai: Eyooki enkaiguanani e kopikop adumunye te nkiguana oo ltung'ana lena ishoi nedung'oki ninche enkiguana, amu eewuo ninye too neeiting'ie enkop elotu ainining eng'eno e Solomon, naa ng'ura, etii ene olkitok olang Solomon.

English: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae tiatua intae iltung'ana lenyena pooki, metaa Enkai enye tenebo ninye, naa nchoo ninye eilep alo Yerusalem, te nkop e Yuda, nelo ashet enkaji o Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli ninye ilo otii Yerusalem;

English: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, tiaaki ina aji e Israel, Inji itejo iyie: ‘Ore inkitarruorot ang tenebo ing'ok ang netii shumata iyiook, nikiishunye iyiook pesho te nkaraki ninche, kaji naa kinko tinikinchu?’

English: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
Masaai: Neureishoyu pooki oomanya ina latia, nelikiori nena baa pooki to ldoinyo le Yudea.

English: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
Masaai: Ore ilo ojing'aki olarrabal lemenyikita, netiu anaa ilo olo aibung inkiyiaa o ldia ogiroo.

English: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Emisarkionie naa ena kop nimanyanya naa ninye sii nanu atii atua; amu ore nanu Olaitoriani namanya atua iltung'ana le Israel.”

English: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
Masaai: Neirorie Yesu ina kata siamon o looiteng'eni lenyena ajoki,

English: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: “Nintoki aitayu olikae meregesh, neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya o lmeregesh,

English: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Tabuaku taranya, na tito e Sion; tabuaku Israel! Ting'idayu nishipayu to ltau lino pooki, na tito e Yerusalem!

English: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, mimenaa enkitamioto e utaroto nikiosh Olaitoriani; arashu inauru te rerioroto nikirere,

English: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
Masaai: Kake ore tialo iyiook, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai ang, neitu iyiook kipuo aaing'ua ninye. Kiata iyiook ilapolosak ooisiaaita Olaitoriani laa ilayiok le Aron, o Lawi te nkaraki enkisiaayiare enye.

English: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
Masaai: Amu ore peyie eidip aateyieng inkera enye te mpolosare too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu, ore teina olong ake neetuo ninche atua ewueji ai sinyati aaisarkionie ninye. Naa ing'ura ena etaasa ninche te nkaji ai.

English: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
Masaai: neaku eitu eing'uaa nkera pokira oopishana. Ore te nkiting'oto neye ina kitok.

English: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu, Olaitoriani, nchere ore nkoitoi e tung'ani nemetii atua ninye kewan, nchere mme atua tung'ani etii pee elo neutaa iroruat enyena.

English: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam aikilikuanishore ilpayiani kituaak apa laa ninche ooitashe te dukuya papaai lenye Solomon, apa eton eishu, nejoki, “Kaa kiutakiki matawaliki ele orere?”

English: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Ilfilisti nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye te ine, nenap Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena ninche aaya.

English: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, neliki ninche ena kitanyaanyukoto:

English: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
Masaai: Te naitaa nanu ilkuniyiani nkilani aainei, naaku nanu entoki naimakini te ninche.

English: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
Masaai: Ore endaa neitobiraki te nkaraki enkuenia, ore enaisho oo sabibu neitiship enkishui, newal impisai pooki toki.

English: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
Masaai: Eming'unyung'unyakino, ilalashera laainei pee meiguanareki ake intae, eng'urai eitashe Oladung'oni le nkiguana too nkutukie oo nkajijik.

English: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.
Masaai: “Airridua nanu nchere aitaa Saul olaiguanani; amu eibelekenye ninye ashuko aing'uaa esujata ai, neitu eas inkitanapat aainei.” Netagore apa Samuel neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani enkewarie pooki.

English: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
Masaai: ina kata eidipa Olaitoriani aitukuo olduruk too ntoyie e Sion neitukuo iltipot lo sarge le Yerusalem, aiwuangie te mpolos enye, to ltau le nkiguana o to ltau le mpejoroto.

English: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
Masaai: Neiger Mordekai kuna baa, neitoki airriwaki mpala Ilyahudi pooki ootii iloshon lo laiguanani Serser, ilootaana o loolakua,

English: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
Masaai: Itonyorra iyie esupatisho nimbayu engogong'i ore enkaraki ina nikitubukoko Enkai ino eilata aput, nikiela te ilata e ng'ida nalang ene sirit ino.”

English: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;
Masaai: Entorrinyoto enchom, ntoyie aainei, shomo ake oltung'ani enkoitoi enye, amu atamorua nanu meekure atum olmoruo. Amaa naaji ninye te najo kaata osiligi, anaa napaji ninye tenaa katum olmoruo ena kewarie naiu ilayiok,

English: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
Masaai: Amaa tenaa kashomo nanu tenebo iloolejisho, neisarisara enkeju ai alo alejisho.

English: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
Masaai: Etum oltung'ani supat mbaa supati too lng'anayio le nkutuk enye, kake ore iyieunot oo lairrikinok naa olarrabal.

English: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
Masaai: Tadamu nimincho kirikino ina apa nintagoro Olaitoriani Enkai ino to lpurkel; ebaiki ina olong apa nitupukuo iyie te nkop e Misiri ometaba anaa nilotu ene wueji, igolong'aki oshiake Olaitoriani.

English: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
Masaai: Eng'ura, kelotu enkata, neewuo taata, naisardakieki intae, nelo pooki tung'ani enkang enye, naaing'uari aa nanu ake; kake mme nanu ake, amu aaboitare Papa.

English: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
Masaai: ore pee einoki enkima te mpolos o lgoriet netoni te nebo, neton Petero te nebo ninche.

English: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
Masaai: Entemata nabo enkadoro naa entemata nabo endapasho. Nerisioroyu nkaloli pooki, naa intemat are enkilepata; ore mowuarak enyena naa entoki nabo o lperere.

English: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, ore ina apiani naji enkarna enye Reuma, etoiwuo Teba, o Gaham, o Tahash, o Maaka.

English: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee emiri aaishu impisai pooki te nkop e Misiri o te nkop e Kanaan, eetuo Ilmisiri pooki enetii Yosef nejoki ninye, “Inchoo iyiook endaa; ainyoo pee kiye te dukuya nkonyek inyi?

English: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
Masaai: Nimikitem iyiook Olaitoriani, anaa enaikuna apa kulikae lenye, nemut ilasuriaa lelo.

English: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
Masaai: Edumu iloing'ok lenye nkishu nemedung; eisho nkishu enye, nemeiturraa ilasho.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Ahab, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o ina aji oo lala loo lkanchaoni apa natesheta ninye, o nena anas pooki apa naatesheta ninye, neigero tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.
Masaai: Nelotu Nebukadnesa anyiku enkutuk e ilo kokuet le nkima nayupuyup nejo, “Shadrak o Meshak o Abednego, isinkan le Nkai natii shumata aisul, wootu elepu, naa wootu ene!” Neipang'u Shadrak o Meshek o Abednego ti atua enkima.

English: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
Masaai: Neiken sii kutukaji eine wueji sinyati, near iltaai, neitu epejoki enkorropil anaa eishooyo ilasarri teine wueji sinyati, aaisho Enkai e Israel.

English: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana li abori naa enkijape ake, ore iltung'ana le nkitoo naa elejare; te nejing ninche orrantili ore ninche pooki naa keneneng aalang enkijape.

English: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Lfilisti nkaitin enye teine neitanapisho Daudi pee epejori.

English: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing corn.
Masaai: Tenilo iyie atua enkurma eilo tung'ani le latia ino, indim atigilu e ntapa te nkaina ino, kake midung te nkalem ina kurma oltung'ani le latia ino naitashe.

English: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
Masaai: Nedoiki ilayiok le Yakobo aar enkanasa, near iltung'ana metuata neya ntokitin te nkanasa amu einyalaki enkanashe enye.

English: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
Masaai: e ematua nabo e tomon te pooki sitima le ker le lelo oopishana:

English: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
Masaai: Ore tenaa kenkesha engolon, ng'ura ninye! Naa tenaa kembae naipirta esipata aing'ae oidim aterewa ninye meshomo?

English: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
Masaai: Nemir Olaitoriani Benchamen te dukuya Isirael. Neidaikie iltung'ana le Israel iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam o imiet o iip nabo oo ltung'ana le Benchamen te ina olong; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana loo lalema.

English: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
Masaai: “Miloloito.

English: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
Masaai: Newal ajo, “Ekaairriwaki olkuoo too ntare aainei.” Nejo Tamar, “Amaa aikincho entoki ino naibung naarreshunye o terewakaki ilo kuo?”

English: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i neiteru Olaitoriani airriwaa Resin olaiguanani le Siria o Peka olayioni le Remalia meshomo aagilunore Yuda.

English: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
Masaai: Naa airriu nanu ninye metushukunye enitii, airriu oltau lai kewan.

English: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
Masaai: Naa tenaa neijia, ore Enkai ang naa ninye kisiaai naa keidim atokordu iyiook aitayu ti atua ilo kokuet oyupuyup; naa kekordu ninye iyiook aitung'uaa enkaina ino, laaiguanani.

English: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Yafet naa Gomer, o Magog, o Madai o Yafan, o Tubal o Meshek o Tiras.

English: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
Masaai: Nesiooyo Haran aye te dukuya Papaai lenye Tera teina kop natoiyeki ninye e Uri oo Ilkaldayo.

English: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ninche ajoki, “Ilo laaishiunye nanu laatiaaka, ‘Tudumu erruat ino shomo.’ ”

English: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
Masaai: “Maing'uaa intae irara okishin; kalotu enitii.

English: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
Masaai: Amu meetae entoki naisudoro, nemeibalunyeki; nemeetae enoo nkurrat nemeibalunyeki te wangan.

English: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
Masaai: “Ewueji ai nayeng'iyeng'are ena ntarasi; ene nanu abikie amu atonyorra nanu ene.

English: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Masaai: Etapong'ori pooki, netaa te nebo: nemeetae obo oas isupati, meetae hoo obo.”

English: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
Masaai: Ore to losilisili lenye pooki, neisilisiloki ninye, naa ilo malaika otii te nebo ninye oitajeuo ninche; te nyorrata enye o to lng'ur lenye eitajeuo ninye ninche; etudumua ninye ninche nenap ninche nkolong'i pooki ti apa.

English: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
Masaai: Neinuaa isinkan o larripok enkima oo nkuk amu keirobi, naa ore eitashoo te ine, eijito enkima, neitashe Petero o ninche, eijito enkima.

English: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Ke Musa aa ninye ake eirorie Olaitoriani? Keitu sii ninye eirorie iyiook?” Nening Olaitoriani ina.

English: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD'S people; between the king also and the people.
Masaai: Neitobir Yehoida olning'o te rishata o Laitoriani o laiguanani o ltung'ana, nchere eaku ninche iltung'ana lo Laitoriani; neitobir sii olning'o te rishata o laiguanani o ltung'ana.

English: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
Masaai: Ena ninye esiana oo lmareita loo layiok le Gershon, lelo pooki apa ooisiaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani.

English: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata neomonu olaiguanani Ahas eretoto to laiguanani le Asiria.

English: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
Masaai: Amu ore olaitasheikinoni te nkaji e Nkai, naa olaisiaayiani le Enkai, meishiaakino neeta eleyiata; nchoo eaku mme ole kewan aashu olosieku engoro asioki, aashu emera, aashu arruoni aashu eeta olorok le dupoto.

English: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
Masaai: Neya ninye ina shakenisho nepik atua osanduku, nepik nkeek ilo sanduku nepik ilo orika lo lng'ur enchumata e ilo sanduku;

English: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
Masaai: paa ore oltung'ani le Enkai neitabari te nkiaas pooki sidai.

English: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Amaa kaa anyit anaa kaa kitoo eishooki Mordekai tena bae?” Nejoki ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani ooisiaita ninye, “Meetae enaitaasaki.”

English: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
Masaai: Nchoo emesa enye te dukuya ninche metaa orreshet; nchoo lelo siruai lenye loo lasarri metaa entoki narruesh ninche.

English: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. English: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

Masaai: Neitashe ake ilng'atunyo tomon oare teine, neitashe ake obo te nkalo e bayie e pooki kedet enena kedeta pokira ile, eitu aekata edoli entoki naaijo ina te pooki kitoria.

Masaai: neaku, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekaitaas intae anaa enatiu engoro o enkiba nintodolua te nkaraki enkiba aarare ninche; naa kaitayiolo nanu kewan tiatua intae, ina kata naiguanare intae.

English: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
Masaai: Amu eng'as ake Kristo aitoreisho o metaba anaa nepik Enkai lmang'ati lenyena pooki abori nkejek enyena;

English: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Amaa, kasujaa nanu ele wuampa Kamir nanu ninche?” Newaliki ninye ninye, “Tusujai, amu esipa imir, nesipa imitu akordu.”

English: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee eitagoloki ltauja lang. Neme lkulalang ake eilejilejaki kake eikiting'idate naleng te nchipai e Tito. Iyeng'iyeng'ie intae pooki indamunot enyena.

English: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
Masaai: Neibung ninche ninye near, nearaa meeta toki.

English: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, eiturrurrote laiguanak, nepuonu te nebo.

English: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atoning'ore ilaisiaayiak pee elaaki dinari te nkolong, nerik enkurma enye oo sabibu.

English: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
Masaai: “Papa, ayieu netii, lelo likinchoo enatii nanu, pee edol enkitoo ai nikinchoo iyie, amu kitonyorra iyie nanu eton etioyo enkitamanyunoto e nkop.

English: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
Masaai: Ajoki ntae mme neijia; kake te neitu irridudu sii ntae nindaayaya aaiko neijia.

English: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
Masaai: Neibulunyeki ororei lo Laitoriani ilo kirine pooki.

English: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.
Masaai: Amu te nkima edung Olaitoriani enkiguana, naa to lalem edung'oki enkiguana pooki tung'ani; ore lelo oar Olaitoriani to lalem naa keaku kumok.

English: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
Masaai: Te nejo ninye, ‘Sidai!’ nesidanu to sinka lino; kake te negoro ninye, nitum atayiolo ajo eitobirita ninye entorroni.

English: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani iltung'ana pooki ajoki, “Embung'a osirua le ngiroroto oji pasaka tenkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, anaa enaigeroki tiatua ena buku o sotua.”

English: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
Masaai: Neiturrurru taa ninche, neiput nkikapuni tomon o aare ilmong'oitie loo naduoo mukateni miet e shairi ootelekutua lelo ooinosa.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina, nji ejo Olaitoriani ti alo ilo aiguanani le Asiria. Melotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, anaa engoroo embae te ine, aashu elotu anyikaki eeta elong'o aashu eng'adu ninye.

English: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
Masaai: Neitoki Shemaia oloiboni le Nkai alotu enetii Rehoboam o lkituaak le Yuda, apa ooiturrurro te Yerusalem tenkaraki Shishak, nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kitung'uaitie intae nanu, atung'uayie naa sii nanu intae napik intae enkaina e Shishak.’ ”

English: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
Masaai: Ore ilpala lenyena le nkoshoke netiu anaa mbelibelat e moti oo nkulukuok, ekur ninye enkop neitaa esarng'ab.

English: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
Masaai: Kaing'ae limikiureyu iyie, Iyie Olaiguanani loo loreren? amu erishata ino ena; amu ore tiatua lelo pooki ng'eni loo loreren otiatua nkitoriat enye pooki meetae likae likinyaanyukie.

English: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
Masaai: Ore peyie eaku Esau oloo larin artam, eyama Yudit entito e Beeri loo Lhiti tenebo Basemat entito e Elon oo Lhiti.

English: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.
Masaai: Neliki Samuel ninye pooki toki nemeeta entoki naisudoyie te ninye. Nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani, nchoo ninye eas ina naishaakino te ninye.”

English: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Tamar enkaji o lalashe lenye Amnon, ine apa neirragie. Neya ninye enkurma, neipurj, neitobir imukateni too nkonyek enyena, nepej imukateni.

English: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
Masaai: Enyeito intae kuna kituaak naaisikarra, entoning oltoilo lai; natoyie kuna nemeshilaa toki, entoning enkiroroto ai.

English: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu enkiguana sidai o eng'eno, amu airuko nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
Masaai: Etaasa Yerusalem eng'oki torrono ore enkaraki ina etaa ninye olminong; ore apa pooki ooyanyit ninye netemena, amu etoduaa ninye emasipaisho enye; ee eishirita ninye makewan te mion, neibelekeny enkomom enye aing'or idia alo.

English: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
Masaai: Eitashe nkejek aainei te wueji neitoriori; ore ti atua eumata kitok naisis nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
Masaai: Amaa taata iloo papaai linyi koree taata ninche? O loibonok, kebikoo sii ninche intarasi?

English: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
Masaai: Asaf apa olkitok lenye nesujaki Sakaria, o Yeiel, o Shemuramot, o Yehiel, o Matitia, o Eliab, o Benaia, o Obed-edom, o Yeiel, laa ninche oowosh nkai oo sinkoloitin, o lwululi loo usin; naa Asafowosh enkinanta oo saanini dapashi,

English: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
Masaai: Ore Yudas o Sila amu loibonok le Nkai sii ninche maate, neinosaki lalashera nkumok neitagol.

English: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
Masaai: Ore teneponari intokitin neponari sii lelo ooinos ninche; naa kainyoo dupoto to lopeny aime pee edol ninche too nkonyek enyena?

English: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
Masaai: Naa kepuoi aaitubul intae te sipata; nipuopuo aalakuaniki olosilisili, amu mintokiki intae aaureishoyu; ore too ntabo, nemenyikaki ninche intae.

English: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
Masaai: Keitaas ninye olpayian lenye isupati neme entorrono, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye.

English: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
Masaai: Ebaiki nemara jartan to rorei, kake ajo sii ayiolo naaba anaa nayiolo likae ake pooki. Kimbalakinye intae ina bae too nkoitoi pooki o too ntokitin pooki.

English: And it came to pass, while the ark abode in Kirjathjearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina olong apa nairragieki osanduku lo Laitoriani te Kiriat-Yearim, netulusoyie enkata naado, enkata oo larin tikitam, ore enkaji pooki e Israel neishiraki Olaitoriani.

English: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana pooki enkaji e Baal, nepuo aadung aauroki enkop; ore ilperereni lenyena loo lasarri, o nkitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin nebel aaitaa mbelibelat, near ninche Matan ilo apolosani le Baal metua, te dukuya lelo pereren loo lasarri.

English: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki, “Ara nanu Enkai, Enkai e papaai lino; miureishoyu ilo Misiri; amu kaalo aitaa olosho sapuk teine.

English: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore pooki matua e tomon e nkop, aa lanterera le nkop aashu ilng'anayio loo lkeek naa ilo Laitoriani; kesinya ninche to Laitoriani.

English: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom entung'uayioki too nkolong'i uni, nintokiki aashukunye enatii.” Neaku eshomo iltung'ana.

English: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.
Masaai: “Tenilo iyie aarare ilmang'ati linono nijing atua ilng'oborri lenye, nigolie naa kewan te pooki toki torrono.

English: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
Masaai: Nebol enkutuk enye emorisho, nemor Enkai, amor enkarna enye o emanyisho enye. Aa nchere lelo pooki oomanya shumata.

English: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kainyoo tung'ani lishilaa ninye, anaa enkerai e tung'ani eji nidamu ninye?

English: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
Masaai: Ore pee ening iltung'ana lenyena le sotua, nepuo pee epuo aaibung, amu kejo, “Etarruoyie elukunya.”

English: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
Masaai: Kaa nanu aaitaas iyie Efraim? Kaa nanu aaitaas iyie Yuda? Etiu enyorrata ino anaa enkatampoi o sina, anaa enkoileelio nasiooyo aishunye.

English: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
Masaai: Amu nanu eimaki ilmang'ati laainei, ore lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai neiguana te nebo,

English: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
Masaai: Nedumunye olkutati kitok, nedam ilopir le nkare ina peut, o metaa keiput enkare.

English: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
Masaai: Ore te nincho iyie ninche, neiturrur ninche, te nilak iyie enkaina ino neiput ninche ntokitin sidain.

English: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
Masaai: nchere Enkai ena, ninye Enkai ang ntarasi o ntarasi. Ninye oaku olarikoni lang ntarasi.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntisinyakaki nanu ilkikaunot pooki;

English: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani lo lkilikuai Daudi, “Enotokitio iyiook iltung'ana, neipang'u aapuonu aarare iyiook ti ong'ata; kake kiterewa aashukoki enejing'ieki kishomi.

English: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
Masaai: Naa ainyoo lng'anayio linoto te ina? Inoto mbaa naaitukurru taata intae amu keeya eiting'oki.

English: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
Masaai: Naa kepuku iloibonok kumok le lejare neiminie lkumok.

English: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
Masaai: Amu eitu erriu Enkai Enkerai enye enkop, meeu aiguanare enkop, kake pee etum enkop atajeunye.

English: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
Masaai: Neng'utut Yakobo Raheli eishir abuaku te nchipai.

English: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
Masaai: Ena ninye eitanapisho Olaitoriani ti alo nena toyie e Selofehad, ‘Nchoo ninche meyama oloba anaa oladol aajo sidai, kake nchoo ake duoo eyami ti atua ilmarei lo losho loo loo menye.

English: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
Masaai: Te kulo Omon Supati aaitaaki nanu olaisiaayiani te risioroto e nkishorunoto e mpiris e Enkai naaishooki nanu te ngolon enye.

English: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
Masaai: Ore Hanam o lelo oomanya Senoa, neitobir aaram enkishomi o erata; neshetu ninche ninye nepik nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena, neram ntemat e nkaina e nkalifu nabo e suntai, o meitabaiki kishomi e modioi.

English: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
Masaai: atii nanu atua ninche nitii iyie atua nanu, pee eitaai ninche ilooiputakinote o metaa nabo, pee etum enkop atayiolo nchere iyie likirriwua, nitonyorra ninche anaa enikitonyorra nanu.

English: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
Masaai: Te netii enkairukoni naata inkolia too lmarei lenye, nchoo enap ninche; Mincho esirit eiteleikini olola, peyie etum ataretu nena olia te dede.

English: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
Masaai: Nadol nanu ina ng'ues o lelo aiguanak le nkop te nebo o njorin enye eiturrurrote pee earare ilo okedito ina barta nearare enjore neye.

English: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Masaai: o Meraiot olayioni lenye, o Amaria olayioni lenye o Ahitab olayioni lenye,

English: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
Masaai: Nerrinyo enkitok e Yeroboam alo Tirsa. Ore ake pee ebau embata enkaji enye, neye enkerai.

English: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
Masaai: “Kake meetae oloyiolo ina olong anaa ina saa, aa ilmalaika le shumata anaa Enkerai, Papa ake oyiolo.

English: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
Masaai: Amu ore olodol isora te naaimaki nanu aashu ororei lai tena ishoi oo ng'ok naloloito nedol sii ninye enkerai e Tung'ani isora eimaki ninye te ina olong elotu te nkitoo e Menye eiriamunore ilmalaika sinyat.”

English: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Irara intae nkaitin, nkera e ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, intae pooki;

English: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
Masaai: enkaraki nitogolong'aka ororei lai ti ong'ata e Sin, ina kata apa eing'unyung'uny eumata maayanyit aaitisiny nanu te nena ariak apa naatii dukuya nkonyek enye. (Nkariak kuna e Meriba e Kadesh tiong'ata e Sin.)

English: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ilgiso oong'uan ilpijat pokira oong'uan o lpijat le ina ng'esherrie o suyai pee eibung nena ong'uan oo lpijat le ina ng'esherrie o suyai pee eibung nena bokishi;

English: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
Masaai: Ore to rorei lo Laitoriani neitobiruaki apa keper, o lorora lenye pooki te nkiyang'et e nkutuk enye.

English: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
Masaai: nenotito ilalashera kumok enkitagoloto ti atua Olaitoriani te enata ai neaku kelimu ororei le Enkai te nkitieunoto metii enkuretisho.

English: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
Masaai: Oi iyie Kapernaum, eijo shumata kilepieki, kintadouni shomo enemeneng'a.”

English: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nelo ewueji neliyio; kake eing'oru olorere ninye. Nepuonu enetii, nejo maiboo neing'uaa ninche;

English: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi o Abishai enetii ina jore kewarie; neirragita Saul te ine airura ti atua olng'obor, neunokino empere enye enkop te mbata e ndukuya enye; ore Abna o enjore neirrag aaman ninye.

English: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
Masaai: “Kake teneiu ele tung'ani enkayioni nadol nena ng'ok pooki naataasa papaai lenye, neureishoyu, nemeas nena naataasa

English: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
Masaai: Entagoluoto niminchosho iltauja linyi epalari, intae pooki oanyu Olaitoriani!

English: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake enoto Noa omom too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
Masaai: Naitoki ake araposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, ing'arrin ong'uan oo mbartan naatupukutuo te rishata oo ldoinyo aare, naa ore lelo doinyo naa ildoinyo lo suyai.

English: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
Masaai: Newal iltung'ana pooki te nebo nejo, “Ore nena pooki naatejo Olaitoriani eikiaas.” Nelikioo Musa irorei loo ltung'ana to Laitoriani.

English: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
Masaai: olayioni le Matat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Matat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Melki, olayioni le Yanai, olayioni le Yosef,

English: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
Masaai: Neirragie ninye ina kila enye tembata enye o meeu olkitok lenye ang'.

English: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel neibung iltung'ana nkalifuni iip are e lelo tung'ana lenye, nkituaak o layiok o ntoyie. Ewaita sii iyarunot kumok te ninche neya Samaria.

English: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
Masaai: Nelo Musa adoyio enetii iltung'ana neliki ninche.

English: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
Masaai: negiligili imbartan o lakedok, negiligili ingarrin oo mbartan o larewak lenye.

English: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
Masaai: neitoki airriwaa iltimito le njore ilpolosien lenye, neaku ile Siria isinkan le Daudi neitaiki ninye kodi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi meisula te pooki wueji.

English: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.
Masaai: Neipoti ilaigerok lo laiguanani te nkolong e tomon ookuni o lapa le dukuya, neigeri anaa enaitanapishe Haman neigerokini lelo ang'eni o lelo kituaak ooitasheiki iloshon, o laitasheikinok pooki loo ltung'ana, olosho ake to rorei lenye o ltung'ana te nkutuk enye; neigeroki apa te nkarna e Serser nepiki olmishire te ilo gisoi lo laiguanani.

English: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
Masaai: Ore ake sii nainosa olmumai te nkaraki ninche to lpurkel inchere mayau ninche ina kop naishoo ninche, enkop naruko kule o enaisho, enkop naisul te sidano,

English: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
Masaai: Tenepik oltung'ani ole latia enye olbae, ore anaa enataasa keitaasi sii ninye,

English: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
Masaai: Kake aikijo, ‘Ltung'ana eing'uaa?’ ” neureyu iltung'ana, amu etonyorraitie pooki inchere oloiboni le Nkai le dede Yohana.

English: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo le rrindik netoiwuoki to loshi ake rrekie loo ltung'ana, ore ole sayunoti nalakuno naa enkisiligata e Enkai eitabayioki.

English: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
Masaai: Neaku etorrinyunye Naomi o Rusi ina oo Lmoabu nara entito o layioni lenye. Etorrinyunye ninche eing'uaa enkop e Moab. Nepuonu ninche Betlehem te nkiterunoto e nkisampuare e shairi.

English: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
Masaai: Netumore Olaitoriani Balaam, nepik ororei enkutuk enye, nejo ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu Balak, naa nji shomo tiaki.”

English: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
Masaai: Etara sii apa metua Olmisiri, ilo tung'ani apa sapuk laa ntemat e nkaina imiet enkadoro, eeta ilo Misiri empere enye naba anaa embokishi; kake eshomo Benaia enetii ninye eeta eng'udi ake, newuapaa empere te nkaina e ilo Misiri near ninye metua te mpere enye makewan.

English: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
Masaai: Nedumunye olorora pooki, nerikokini Pilato.

English: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa kelo ewang'an o lapa atiu anaa ewang'an e nkolong. Ore ewang'an e nkolong neaku katitin naapishana, anaa ewang'an oo nkolong'i naapishana, te ina olong kenya nalo Olaitoriani aen olbae too ltung'ana lenyena, neishiunye lelo baa apa le oshoto enye.

English: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, naa ninye kirriwakita nanu mayaki enkomono inyi dukuya ninye:

English: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
Masaai: Nedou Olaitoriani aing'or ina anasa o ilo talet otesheta inkera oo ltung'ana.

English: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
Masaai: Tenairorie ninye naawaliki nanu, mairuk ajo keinining'ito ninye oltoilo lai.

English: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;
Masaai: Nelotu Yoab atua aji enetii olaiguanani, nejo, “Imulumula iyie taata te nkurruna nkomomi oo sinkan linono pooki, laa ninche ooitajeutuo ena olong enkishui ino, o enkishui oo layiok linono o ntoyie inono, o enkishui oo nkituaak inono o nkapiak inono,

English: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
Masaai: Ore lelo apa ooji kituaak neme hoo ainyoo ina te nanu etiu o mme, amu meeta ninye Enkai olkep, netalaita hoo toki najo maanyaaki aaponiki.

English: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
Masaai: Kaing'ae apa oishooyie Yakobo meibung'i aaya, neisho Israel ilapurrok? Aime Olaitoriani, laa te ninye kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, laa nkoitoi enyena etanyaita ninche, ore nkitanapat enyena neitu ninche eiruk?

English: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
Masaai: Ore ake sii ebaiki ina kata apa naageluni mataa olbalusui te nkop e Yuda, ebaiki olari le tikitam o metabaiki olari le tomoni uni o are le nkitoria e Arteserses ilo aiguanani, ilarin tomon o are, eitu nanu o lalashera laainei aainos ina daa o lbalusui.

English: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
Masaai: Naa keitore ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei anaa te nedanyi motioo oo nkulukuok metaa mbelibelat, anaa sii ninye nanu enatang'amua engolon eing'uaa Papa lai.

English: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye olaiguanani, “Ekesipa ilomon apa latoning'o nanu te nkop ai makewan, ooipirta mbaa inono o engeno ino.

English: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
Masaai: pee mikitiu anaa Kain le ilo torrono otara apa ninye olalashe lenye metua. Naa ainyoo pee etara ninye metua? Enkaraki naa torrok nkiasin enye naasidain ino lalashe lenye.

English: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ore ngarrin ong'uan o lmong'i isiet neisho ilayiok le Merari, te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye erikoo Itamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.

English: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
Masaai: Enkai ninye elong'o ai, ninye oitajeu ilo supat to ltau.

English: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
Masaai: Ene tipat te dukuya Olaitoriani keeya oo sinyat lenyena.

English: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
Masaai: Entodol ate mewuapaa intae likae te ng'eno oo losekin o elejare e pesho, nasuj inkoon e tung'ani, anaa inaajo nkiyang'eta o loing'ang'e, neme anaa naajo Kristo.

English: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Neomon Hesekia te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, iton iyie to lorika le nkitoo te shumata ilkerubi. Ira iyie Enkai, naa iyie ake Enkai, tiatua nkitoriat pooki e nkop. Iyie oitobira keper o enkop.

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam ajoki Balak, “Teshetakaki nanu ilperereni oopishana lo lasar tene, nikincho nanu iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana.”

English: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
Masaai: Neesek ilo olorere lang, nearaki te ngolon iloo papa metanang'ai nkera naaini ong'ata peyie eye.

English: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
Masaai: Metaa eitaituo ninche olning'o te Beer-sheba. Nerrinyo Abimelek tenebo Fiko olkitok lenye le njore enkop oo Lfilisti.

English: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
Masaai: Ing'aeng'ae akenya o anu iyie na selenkei nemeisiligayu? Amu eitayio Olaitoriani entoki ng'ejuk te nkop; enkitok namitu olee.”

English: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
Masaai: Kejoki ilo otii aji, ‘Mikintanyamal, amu eikeno kutuk aji, neirurate nkera, kirurate pooki. Meekure aidim ainyo pee aaisho?’

English: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
Masaai: Neaku eipoto olaiguanani Ilgibioni. Ore apa Ilgibioni neme iloo ltung'ana le Israel, kake ilo lpisiai loo Lamori; hoo neinosa iltung'ana le Israel olmumai pee eleku ninche, etonyuaa Saul ear ninche metuata te ina nyuata enye te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel o Yuda.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
Masaai: Neas mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa papaai lenye Daudi.

English: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie lelo le ncholuek ai maaitiaa nanu, kintaa iyie nanu entoki naitureisho te ninche. Aaikenoyioki nanu metaa maidim atuluai,

English: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.
Masaai: Niput Yehu olayioni le Nimshi metaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Ore Elisha olayioni le Shefat le Abel-mehola, nibukoki eilata aput metaa oloiboni le Nkai te rishata ino.

English: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
Masaai: Etoyu nkariak negolu anaa soito, ore oriong eng'uton netoyu agolu te nkirobi.
