English: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
Masaai: Ore to lpura le nkomom enye neigero enkarna e nkisudoroto: “Babilon kitok, ngoto mulayoni o ilo minong le nkop.”

English: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
Masaai: aatabolokoki empaash e siaai nadupa, naa kumok ilmang'ati.

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalunye nkiaasin enyena ti atua iloreren!

English: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
Masaai: Nedou kulikae tung'ana ooing'uaa Yudea neiteng'en ilalashera, aajoki, “Te nememurati intae anaa enaitanapishe Musa, nimindimidimi aatajeu.”

English: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi lelo tung'ana apa ooitashe te mbata enye, “Kaa eitaasi oltung'ani oar ele Filisti metua, neitayu emoroto te Israel? Amu kaing'ae ninye ele Filisti lememurata, metaa keidim atamoro njoreitin e Nkai naishu?”

English: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
Masaai: Ore ake sii, teneirrag aare tenebo, naa keirowuaju; kake kaji eiko obo teineirowuaju aa ninye ake?

English: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nintaa Olaitoriani esarunoto ino, nintaa Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul emanyisho ino,

English: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
Masaai: Manyorraki hoo enkitok meiteng'enisho aashu meitoria ilewa, inchoo ninye metigirayu.

English: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
Masaai: Ore ake ina kata pee eitubulari ina kitanapata, neishooyo iltung'ana le Israel te nkumoi, ilng'anayio lenye le dukuya le ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata, o enaisho oo lotorok o ntokitin pooki naanotoki te nkurma. Neyau ninche te leng'on erubata e tomon e pooki toki.

English: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Efraim ninye, “Kainyoo ena nintaasa iyie iyiook, eitu impot iyiook te nilo aarare Midian?” Neilepilepaki ninye oleng.

English: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
Masaai: Neaku, lalashera laainei, ti nitumomo te nebo pee inosinoso, entaanyunoto.

English: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
Masaai: Ore pee ening kulikae te lelo ooitashe te ine nejo, “Eliya eipoto.”

English: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.
Masaai: Neilejilej Daudi enkitok enye, Bet-sheba, nelo enetii ninye, neirrag te nebo ninye, neiu ninye olayioni, nejo enkarna enye Solomon. Naa kenyor apa ninye Olaitoriani.

English: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.
Masaai: Eitu ninye elimu Esta iltung'ana lenye o lorere lenye amu eitanapa Mordekai pee melimu.

English: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
Masaai: Neyauni elukunya enye te mbesen neishori entito, neyaki ina tito ng'otonye.

English: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
Masaai: enyor duoo naa Noa otii, o Daniel o Yob atua ninye, ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, meitajueu hoo nkayiok arashu intoyie, enkishui enye ake eitajeu te supatisho enye.

English: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki nasasha loisotok neinyaku eng'amurai, tiatua ing'uesi indimidimi aainosa.

English: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
Masaai: Ore enkaji enye naa enkoitoi nalo enemeneng'a, nedoyio alo ilgilat le keeya.

English: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
Masaai: “Ena erubata oltung'ani torrono te Nkai, naa ina enjung'ore nang'amu ilooitorogonyisho te ilo Magilani:

English: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
Masaai: Nekuet aaman ina kop pooki, neiteru aariku ltung'ana pooki oomuei too rruatin enye aaya ewueji ake pooki nening'oki aajo etii.

English: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
Masaai: Nerisioro apa nkaloli pooki; ore apa ina kila o lgoo naa katitin are, entemata e ndap enkadoro naa entemata e ndap endapasho katitin are.

English: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aitanapare esiamo, neilepaki oldoinyo alo aomon; ore pee eaku teipa neaku ninye ake openy.

English: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
Masaai: ore ake sii kaashet iyie, naa eishetayu, na selenkei e Israel! Ore ake sii einkod iyie kewan too ntarumpetani naa e ilo dukuya to sinkolio le lelo ooshipa.

English: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Nabot Ahab, “Too loo papa nanu atujung'o ena kurma, oo lng'anayio. Metomito Olaitoriani tenaa kaaisho nanu iyie.”

English: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya saa naaudo, neishir Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Naa inchere, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, aainyo pee kitung'uayie?”

English: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, mine honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata ake naarrinyokino nanu endamunoto ai; ore te nkaraki enkitoo e nkitoria ai naarrinyokini enkisisa o enkishiaa. Naaing'oru ilaikook o lkituaak laainei, naapiki nanu atua enkitoria ai, naaponikini nanu enkitoo sapuk.

English: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
Masaai: Nejo, “Aatasayia tolikioki ajo ira entito e ng'ae? Ketii olgilata likirrag enkaji e papaai lino?”

English: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia iltung'ana pooki o nkituaak pooki, “Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae pooki le Yuda ootii atua enkop e Misiri,

English: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
Masaai: Eikirorie ninche pooki iyie aajoki, ‘Itashala sii iyie anaa iyiook! Itanyaanyukie sii iyie iyiook!’

English: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
Masaai: oipang alo dukuya ninche, nejing'u alotu te dukuya ninche, orikoo ninche aipang'ie neriku ninche aitijing'u; pee metiu eumata o Laitoriani anaa nkerra nemeeta olchekut.”

English: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
Masaai: Neaku, ng'ura, kagilunore nanu iloibonok, Olaitoriani ojo, lelo oopurro to rorei laainei te ninche maate.

English: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
Masaai: Neinyototo nelotu enetii menye. Kake ore eton elakua, nedolu menye neing'urrie, nekuetiki aibung ang'utut.

English: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
Masaai: Kitotiutuo iyiook pooki anaa oltung'ani oiduruk, ore esupatisho ang pooki netotiuo anaa olkila loo lkereu. Kitoito pooki anaa embeneyoi netiu entorroni ang anaa osiuo, nekutaa iyiook aya enelakua.

English: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.
Masaai: Ore tenejing ilapolosak ine wueji sinyati, nemeipang auluo teine aapuo ina dung'oroto e auluo eitu eitayu te ine nena kilani enye a enkisiaayiare, amu aisinyat kuna; neishop ninche kulie kilani eton eitu epuo aanyikaki ina oo nara ine tung'ana.”

English: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ng'oru ntemeta nemetii elejare o entemata e nkiroishi nemetii elejare, o soito le nkiroishi leme le lejare efa nairirikino o hini nairirikino. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri.

English: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aas entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Ashtarot, nena aitin e Siria, o nkaitin e Sidon, o nkaitin e Moab, o nkaitin oo Lamori, o nkaitin oo Lfilisti, neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani, neitu eisiaai ninye.

English: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
Masaai: Ore Benchamen, naa osuyiani otang'arase, neyooki enasirie aar eng'ues, ore teipa neor iyarunot.”

English: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
Masaai: Eeta apa ilo orika le nkitoo nkedeta ile, ore tioriong olorika le nkitoo netii endukuya o lashe, ore ake enkalo nabo olorika netii ineeiteleikini nkaik, olng'atunyo oare ooitashe tembata oo neiteleikini nkaik,

English: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
Masaai: Enkaraki nikitorikine iyie Enkai e njeunoto ino, neitu iyie idamu ina dapidapoi e sarunoto ino; enkaraki ina pee ituno iyie nkaitubulu sidain, nipik iyie ntokitin oo nkaitin omon,

English: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
Masaai: Inchoo enkitok eiteng'enuo te ngira neaku enaning'isho.

English: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
Masaai: Nebuku nkatampo enkare; neitayu oloing'ang'e enkikurrukur; neimerlel mbaa inono te pooki shoto.

English: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
Masaai: Nejoki Solomon Enkai, “Ntodolua iyie enyorrata kitok nauno te papaai lai Daudi, nikintaa nanu olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie olmeneng'ani, ilo sesen ake ninye lo ltung'ani otua, nemeituku kewan, neiduruku olng'obor lo Laitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie ti atua Israel; enkaraki neitu eisuakini enkare enkitisinyata shumata ninye, keaku ninye mesinya eton olduruk lenye te shumata ninye.

English: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
Masaai: Nemor iloogiroo eipirripir ilukuny, aajo,

English: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ilusien naaitobiruaki te nkarriyiano

English: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Simeon, nkalifuni tikitam o are o iip o are.

English: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
Masaai: pee itum aing'oru enjurrunoto tiatua embuku oo mbaa oo loo papaai lino. Itum iyie tiatua embuku oo mbaa, niyiolou nchere ore ena anasa naa aikiserut, naa enkaitooshoni too laiguanak, o too lkerenketi, netipikaki apa ninye enking'oling'ol ebaiki moitie, enkaraki ena apa pee eitaaki ena anasa olmuaate.

English: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
Masaai: Ore eng'eno naa enkong'u enchorro e nkishui teilo oota, kake ore emodai naa enkitamioto oo lmoda.

English: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
Masaai: Te naa kanya ake kutuk, nanya too mbaa naaipirta enchalan ai.

English: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
Masaai: Neliooyu entoki sapuk enking'asia te shumata, enkitok naishopokoki enkolong netii olapa abori inkejek enyena. Ore te ndukuya enye, neeta enkopiyia e nkitoo oo lakir tomon o aare.

English: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
Masaai: Neisina Olaiguanani, kake ore enkaraki lmuma lenyena o lelo ooboitare neitanapisho meishori.

English: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibung enkawuo nemeitashe, ore ilo oneneng too nkejek nemeitajeu kewan, nemeitajeu ilo oked embarta enkishui enye;

English: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
Masaai: Neitashe Esra ilo apolosani nejoki ninche, “Itigila intae inkitanapat niyama nkituaak oo loreren, nitoponaitie enkitarrurroto te Israel.

English: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
Masaai: Ninye apa eyioloi oleng te lelo tomoni uni, neaku olarikoni lenye; kake eitu eaku te lelo okuni.

English: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
Masaai: Ore enjung'ore oo ltung'ana le Israel nemeibelekenyi to losho obo aaya olikae osho, amu ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana le Israel neibung'are enjung'ore o losho loo loo menye.

English: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae isinyat pooki neisulaki lelo le nkaji e Kaisari.

English: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
Masaai: Ketumurataki pee eaku ina olponoto anaa olmishire le supatisho naata apa te nkirukoto eton memurata. Eikonaki neijia pee eaku ninye menye le lelo pooki ooiruk memurata laa te ina eikenakini esupatisho,

English: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
Masaai: Ore eton to ldoinyo loo loirienito eipirare enkaji e Nkai, neikilikuan Petero o Yakobo o Andrea too nkurrat aajoki,

English: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
Masaai: Eeta sii ninye apa ilayiok oopishana o ntoyie uni.

English: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
Masaai: Neisho elo ang, nejoki, “Nimirrinyo ake ajing ena ang.”

English: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
Masaai: Yudas olayioni le Yakobo o Yuda Iskariot laa ninye otaa olakaldoroni.

English: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e imiet olapa (naa olari le imiet le yararoto olaiguanani Yehoiakin),

English: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Meiputaki intae Enkai osiligi o enchipai pooki o eseriani ti atua enkirukoto, paa te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati ebul nedooyo osiligi linyi.

English: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa Yehoiakim pee eiteru aitoreisho neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem. Neas ninye ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai enye.

English: While the word was in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.
Masaai: Ore eton epuku kulo rorei te nkutuk o laiguanani, nedou oltoilo oing'uaa shumata, “Olaiguanani Nebukadnesa, kirorieki iyie: Kishomo enkitoria aing'uaa iyie,

English: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,
Masaai: Ejo Olaitoriani: Atonyorra intae. Kake itejo intae “Kaji doi inkuna tininyorru iyiook?” “Amaa Esau aime olalashe le Yakobo?” Olaitoriani ojo. “Natonyorra nanu Yakobo

English: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
Masaai: Ore nkitanapat inono pooki naa kesipa, naaisilisil nanu iltung'ana te lejare; taretuoki nanu!

English: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
Masaai: “Keputoki intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi oloiboni leeijo nanu tiatua intae, tiatua ilalashera linyi, ilo intae entoning

English: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
Masaai: Ore te kulo meita pokira okuni near metuata ematua e uni oo oltung'ana te nkima, o te mpuruo o te nkima e nkibirti, naing'uaa nkutukie enye.

English: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.
Masaai: Neitoki Boas ajoki lelo payiani o ltung'ana pooki, “Irara intae ilchakenini ena olong nchere ainyang'ua nanu te nkaina e Naomi nena pooki apa naara ine Elimelek, o pooki naara ine Kilion o Mahalon.

English: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ategelua nanu te nebo ninye Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak, lo losho le Dan; naishoo nanu iltung'ana pooki oodupa enkidimata, pee etum aaitobira nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie:

English: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Daniel, tunuka lelo rorei; nimishir aiken ina buku, o metabau enkata e nkiting'oto Keyooki ilkumok aakuet nekuetu, naa keponari eng'eno.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Entayutu mboreitin oo nkaik oo nkurruon to lkokuet, ninchosho Musa metanang'aki shumata te dukuya Farao.

English: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
Masaai: o Sora, o Ahijalon, o Hebron, nkanas naasheta isunta naatii Yuda o Benchamen.

English: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
Masaai: Kelej pooki ng'ae olelatia enye, nemeetae oloiro esipata; eitamoo ninche ilng'ejepa lenye meiroro elejare neas ninche ntorrok neshal oleng te nkirridunoto.

English: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir aram Melatia le Gebeon o Yadon le Meron, o ltung'ana le Gebeon o le Mispa, apa ootii abori enkitoria o lbalusui leilo kerenket te lido kekun o lkeju.

English: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
Masaai: enyorrata ino te dukuya esirit. Embae sidai ina teneitobiraa ninche epuo anaa, enaishiaakino esiaai e Nkai.

English: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
Masaai: eipirutua kulo aiguanak olarrabal aarare Bera olaiguanani le Sodom, o Birsha olaiguanani le Gomora, o Shinab olaiguanani le Adma. O Shemeber olaiguanani le Sibooiim, olaiguanani le Bela aa ninye Soar.)

English: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
Masaai: Ore oloiruk neibatisae nejeu; ore olemeiruk nedung'okini enkiguana.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neibung orrekie le Daudi papaai lenye, neitu eibelekenya alo enkalo e tatene anaa ene kedienye.

English: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
Masaai: Kake etejo, “Meidimayu te nanu mataasa ina! Oltung'ani ake onotieki enkikompe ninye ake oaku orrindik lai; kake ore intae, enchom te seriani enetii papaai linyi.”

English: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
Masaai: Neishori ninche meisilisilo ninche too lapaitin imiet, kake pee mear metuata. Netiu enkitamioto enye anaa emion e nkolopa, te neng'or oltung'ani.

English: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pee eiturrurrokino Ilfarisayo enetii Yesu, eboitare ninche ematua oo lasirak, ooetuo eing'uaa Yerusalem,

English: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
Masaai: Lalashera laainei, eyieu niyiolouu nena baa naanoto iloo papa. Etoriko lelo pooki enapa atampoi, neima pooki ina Aiposha Nanyokie eserian,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni artam o iip imiet.

English: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
Masaai: Ore ilo lemesioki agoro neeta eng'eno sapuk, kake ore ilo osioki agoro neitasapuk emodai.

English: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
Masaai: Naa keishop ninche inkarash e kitani too lukuny enye o surualini e kitani too mpolosi enye; merrotian ninche ae toki naitaar ninche enkima.

English: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: “Naa te kuna iakuku intae ilo lduruk, ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie mpopoki enye neiduruku ninye o metaa teipa,

English: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.
Masaai: Ng'ura, nelotu apa olpayian kitok eing'uaa esiaai enye ti atua enkurma teipa; ore apa ilo tung'ani naa o leina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, neidurraka apa Gibea amany; ore apa iltung'ana le ine wueji naa ile Benchamen.

English: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
Masaai: Neitoki Ilmaleki o Lkanaan apa oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo aadou aapuonu, nemir ninche, nesujaa ninche, o metabaiki Horma.

English: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
Masaai: Etisiraki kuna dung'eta e rashe pee etum iltung'ana aatayiolo eng'eno o enkiteng'enare, nening'u irorei oogut le ng'eno,

English: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
Masaai: Aashu doi elimu ninche kulo maate aajo kaa torroni apa aanotie pee aitashe te dukuya olkiaama,

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, te neitu inyanya osesen le Nkerai e Tung'ani niokioko osarge lenye, miaatata enkishui ti atua ate.

English: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
Masaai: Netum taa ewang'an ino atotiuo anaa enkakenya, ore enkishiunoto ino nelotu asieku; ore esupatisho ino nelo te dukuya ino, ore enkitoo o Laitoriani neaku ninye nikirrip te siadi.

English: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
Masaai: neiu Salmon Boas; neiu Boas Obed te Ruti; neiu Obed Yese;

English: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Ilfarisayo nejoki, “Ng'ura enaasita ilooiteng'eni linono, nemebara te neasi te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.”

English: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore iltung'ana linono, aa lelo alashera, lelo yarunot linono, ina aji pooki e Israel, ninche pooki, naa ninche lelo ootejo iloomanya Yerusalem inchere, ‘Eshomo ninche aalam Olaitoriani; eishooki iyiook ena kop metaa enaang.’

English: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
Masaai: Kaya nanu ilo pisiai le Yuda ooibelekenya inkomomi enye pee epuonu enkop e Misiri aatonie naa keidaikieki ninche pooki; tiatua enkop e Misiri epuo ninche aabatata to lalem, o to lameyu eidaikieki ninche; ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok, keye nincheto lalem o to lameyu; naa keaku ninche enking'asia o enkuretisho o ldeket o enkurruna.

English: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin oopishana, eidipa ina kitok atushukunye te nkop oo Lfilisti, nelo asai olaiguanani te nkaraki enkaji enye.

English: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?
Masaai: Nejoki Absalom Hushai, “Kena enkanyit ino to lchore lino? Kainyoo pee eitu ilo te nebo olchore lino?”

English: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo oopuo aasuj too ltauja lenye intokitin torrok o mbaa olminong, ekayieu isiaaitin enye too lukuny enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
Masaai: Amu ore aa intae napaji taata ilaiteng'enak, neton eiririkino te nelotu likae aigilie intae nkiterunot o rorei le Enkai. Eton aa kule naairirikino intae, mme endaa nagol;

English: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
Masaai: “Amu ai ng'ae doi otayiolo oltau le Nkai amu ai ng'ae otaa oloiguen ninye?”

English: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
Masaai: Neisum ninche ina buku, natii nkitanapat e Nkai, aaibalie, neitobiraki neaku etoning'utuo iltung'ana enkisumata.

English: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena nabo kata meshomo nejing empeut neituruk aapuo lido kekun, aapuo Betsaida eitanapare ninye esiamo.

English: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
Masaai: Metaa airuto nanu te dukuya ninye, ore peyie adamu, naa kaure ninye.

English: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
Masaai: Lo payiani, entonyor inkituaak inyi, emisomit.

English: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
Masaai: Eidaayie oltung'ani le Nkai te nkop, nemeetae oltung'ani supat too ltung'ana eirragita pooki aanyu embukoroto o sarge, nerresh ake pooki tung'ani olalashe to rreshet.

English: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
Masaai: Ore too neeiting'ie enkop nikining'oo isinkolioitin le nkisisa, le nkitoo te ilo Obo Osipa. Kake atejo nanu, “Aibiitiari nanu, aibiitiari nanu. Woi keon ai! Amu ore lelo aitang'orok netarasutua, etarasutua ilaitang'orok oleng.”

English: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilo oiboni apa otorrinyuo ninye te nkoitoi ina, nejo ninye, “Oltung'ani le Nkai ilo; leitu ening ororei lo Laitoriani; neaku eishooyie Olaitoriani meinosa olng'atuny, neinos olng'atuny ninye aar metua, terisioroto eilo rorei oirorie ninye.”

English: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
Masaai: amu eyiolo Enkai ajo ore tininosinoso ninye nebolo inkonyek inyi, nitiuu anaa Enkai, niyiolouu isupati o ntorrok.”

English: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neisho Farao Yosef enkarna oo Lmisiri ajo Safenatapanea; neisho ninye meyama Asenat, ina tito e Potifera olapolosani le Oni. Metaa eshomo Yosef enkop e Misiri.

English: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore apa aa enkerai Israel atonyorra nanu ninye, ore te Misiri naipotuo nanu enkerai ai.

English: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
Masaai: “Enchom naa embung'a kuna kitanapat pooki naitanapa nanu intae ena olong, pee itumutumu aatagol, nipuopuo aaya ina kop nilang'akiki aapuo aaya,

English: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
Masaai: nien impolosi enye too nkimeitani, ninchopoki imaupen; neaku enenye empolosare te nkitanapata nauno. Inji nkuna iput Aron o layiok lenyena apik esiaai sinyati.

English: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
Masaai: enkaraki nemeeta ninche enkirukoto te Nkai, neitu eisilig ina golon enye naitajeusho.

English: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
Masaai: Te neitu etumi olapurroni, ore ilo openy e nkaji nelotu ataaniki Enkai, aitodolu tenaa ketipika ninye enkaina enye atua intokitin ole latia enye arashu eitu epik.

English: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilalashera nebatata te dukuya ninye nejoki, “Ng'ura, aikira iyiook isinkan linono.”

English: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
Masaai: Nejo Saul, “Ntasho maishoo nanu ninye, pee etum ataa orreshet te ninye, pee etum sii enkaina oo Lfilisti ataarare ninye.” Metaa etiaaka Saul Daudi te nkata e are, “Iaku taata iyie olaputani lai.”

English: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
Masaai: Ntushura sii esafina, ning'uaa erishata e ntemata nabo e nkaina, pee eyau ewang'an. Nipik sii kutuk aji e matua. Nipik atua iorot oo nkajijik e abori, e empolos, o neshumata.

English: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
Masaai: Wootu eng'ura isiaaitin o laitoriani, eneikuna ninye pee eitomijoon e nkop.

English: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
Masaai: neitashaiki Olaitoriani Sodom o Gomorra isoito o oyupuyup o oishu o enkima, eing'uaa Olaitoriani eimu keper.

English: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e Hebron naa keji Kiriat-arba, ore ele Arba naa ninye apa oltung'ani kitok oleng ti atua Anakim. Neitirring'a taa enkop to larrabal.

English: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.
Masaai: Naa ore nkolong'i pooki nelo Mordekai te dukuya ina aji oo nkituaak pee eiyiolou Esta eneikununo, tenaa keserian.

English: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
Masaai: Nerik isikarini lo lbalusui Yesu atua enkaji o lbalusui naji Praitorio neiturrurrokinote oltim pooki.

English: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
Masaai: “Etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa olchumati oisudoyioki tiatua enkurma, netum oltung'ani neturoo aisudoo, ore te nchipai enye, nelo amir pooki toki naata nelotu ainyiang'u ina kurma.

English: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore inapa masaa nikinchooki tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai ino, nilo aitayu te dukuya e Nkai e Yerusalem.

English: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
Masaai: Ng'ura, nkitanapat inono nanu aanyita; ore te supatisho ino nchooki nanu enkishui!

English: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
Masaai: Ore ilo oure ororei lo Laitoriani ti atua ilaisiaayiak le Farao neisikie isinkan lenyena o nkishu aaya atua nkajijik;

English: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
Masaai: Kashipakino nanu nkitanapat inono; maarikino nanu ororei lino.

English: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
Masaai: Nelo tung'ani esiaai enye neas esinkaisho enye o memuto.

English: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
Masaai: “Tenelotu olameyu enkop, anaa olmeitai, anaa enkidaata oo ndaiki, anaa olmaati arashu olkurto; teneman aamuat ninche ilmang'ati lenye tiae anasa nabo oo nkanas enye; to lmeitai ake ninye pooki, o te muoyian ake ninye naba anaa enatii;

English: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
Masaai: pee kitarresho intae pooki nanu? Meetae hoo obo laaliki nanu enkata naibung'are olayioni lai olayioni le Yese, meetae obo te intae laaing'urrie nanu arashu aaliki nanu nchere eisisa olayioni lai osinka lai maataara nanu, maatarresho, anaa enatiu ena olong.”

English: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
Masaai: neikilikuan ninche aajoki, “Kele ayioni linyi litejo apa etoiwuoki aa modooni? Kaji etiu taata pee edolisho?”

English: And now the wise men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:
Masaai: Etorikuoki taata ilang'eni o loo ntalengo meetu dukuya nanu pee eisom ele kigeroto naaitayiolo nanu enkibalakinoto enye; kake meidim ninche aaitodolu enkibalakinoto ena bae.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Yesu nejoki, “Entorrip ate meitapong'oo intae oltung'ani.

English: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie irreshie Olaitoriani? Eikindaikie ninye iyie, meetae hoo obo ogilunore ninye katitin are.

English: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
Masaai: Ore intae, lalashera laainei, elakunoto eipotokoki intae; nabo emiaas, emincho elakunoto inyi eaku enakurore osesen; kake tareto olikae olikae te nyorrata;

English: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
Masaai: “Nikintokiki intae aawalaki nanu nijojo, ‘Kitasa eng'oki to Laitoriani, eikilep iyiook aapuo olarrabal, anaa enaitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’ Nerretena ake pooki tung'ani too masaa enyena olarrabal, ejo tenaa kelelek eilepakini ina kop oo ndoinyo.

English: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
Masaai: Nintoki ariku Aron o layiok lenyena kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nintuku ninche te nkare.

English: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
Masaai: “Irara intae ewang'an e nkop. Meisudoroyu enkanasa natii oldoinyo.

English: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
Masaai: Neishir ninye to ltoilo sapuk too nkiyiaa aainei ejo, “Entinyiku, intae oopuo aar enkanasa pooki ng'ae ake te ntoki nalo amutishore te nkaina enye.”

English: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
Masaai: Eironyitai iyiook te pooki oitoi, kake eitu epurdi iyiook, neimagitai iyiook kake eitu kipalari; nenang'ieki iyiook enkop, nebatati iyiook kake eitu sii emuti,

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong pooki wueji netii apa isabibu enkalifu nabo oata enkinyang'a e shekeli enkalifu nabo enkosholai, naa keaku entim oo lkiku.

English: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
Masaai: Te nkirukoto, etanya Musa, etubulua, eipoti aajo ole ntito e Farao,

English: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
Masaai: ore too Lawi naa Hashabia olayioni le Kemuel; ore too le Aron naa Sadok;

English: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
Masaai: Ore pee eaku saa naaudo nebuak Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” eji, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, ainyoo pee kitung'uayie?”

English: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
Masaai: neyam sii oli okuni, neiko neijia pokira oopishana neitu eing'uaa nkera neye.

English: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Manoa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Aatoomono, nchoo iyiook maiboo iyie pee kintobiraki iyie olkuoo le kine.”

English: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
Masaai: Ore epuku aapuo neinepu oltung'ani le Kirene oji Simon nearaki ninye pee enap osalaba.

English: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
Masaai: Kake ore amu atolikio intae kuna baa, eiputa iltauja linyi osina.

English: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;
Masaai: Naa ore iyie, olayioni lenye, Belshasa, eitu intobor oltau lino hoo niyiolo kuna pooki,

English: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
Masaai: “Eitadowuo ninye enkima te shumata; nereu apik iloik laainei neisalaashaki nkejek aainei orreshet; naaibelekeny ninye nanu, aatung'uayie ninye aidang'ita naiterre endama pooki.

English: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
Masaai: Kake etomikio ejo, “Mayiolo nemaning'u enijoito.” Nepuku ninye alo kishomi.

English: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
Masaai: Ore imasaa enye sidain naaishopo te nkisisa e pesho, neitobiru inkitanyaanyukot oo loipi lo lminong o ntokitin enye pooki torrok metaa kaitaa entoki naiduruk te ninche.

English: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
Masaai: Amaa enkitoo enye aimikinture iyie, o engoro enye tinikibatatakino iyie?

English: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
Masaai: Nebulu ninye oleng o metabaiki olorora le shumata, ore embata o lorora loo lakir nesulaki ninye enkop, neituny ninche.

English: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eshomo ninye aitobir iwuejitin neeika teina kop oo ldoinyio e Yuda, neitapong'oo lelo oo manya Yerusalem metapaasha Olaitoriani, neitapong'oo Yuda.

English: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, inchiraki ilo orora le Misiri nirriwaa ninche abori, ninye tenebo nena toyie kituaak oo loreren, ine olodo le nkop, enetii lelo ooshomo abori enemeneng'a ijoki ninye:

English: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
Masaai: “Miyamisho aashu iiu ilayiok aashu ntoyie tene wueji.

English: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.
Masaai: Ina pee airriwaki intae Timoteo. Enkerai ai nanyor ninye neisiligayu ti atua Olaitoriani. Ninye olotu aitadamu intae nkoitoi aainei ti atua Kristo anaa oshi enaiteng'enisho ti atua sirito pooki.

English: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
Masaai: amu ejo ninye: “Aime ilaiguanak pooki ilarikok laainei?

English: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
Masaai: Ore lelo apa ootii olnukata nedumunye nabo kata aapuku te ine wueji apa nenukare, nerisio ake eitorioyie ninye enkaina enye, nekuet ninche nejing atua ina anasa neya ninye; neisarrisar aapik atua ina anasa enkima.

English: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
Masaai: netum taa ilo tung'ani atabarno kewan kake mebarn ilo pepedoi; neitoki olapolosani aikenoo ilo tung'ani oata olpepedoi kulie olong'i naapishana

English: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
Masaai: Nikisai intae ilalashera, enkoo ilturua nipikipiki enyuaata ilootapalari niretutu ilooshal, enting'iria te lelo pooki.

English: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni onom o opishana o iip ong'uan.

English: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Masaai: Naa te netii olinyi otong'orikia eng'eno, inchoo ninye metoomonu te Enkai naisho iltung'ana pooki te leng'on metii enkisikong'akinoto naa keishori sii ninye.

English: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
Masaai: Ore pee eipung alo entaloishi e kishomi nedol ai tito ninye nejoki ilootii ine, “Eiriamariyie sii ele tung'ani Yesu le Nasaret.”

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
Masaai: Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, tenenutayu enkitok, neiu enkayioni, neaku ninye enaiduruk too nkolong'i naapishana anaa te rishata enye o lapa, neiduruku ninye.

English: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
Masaai: “Miok ake enaisho aashu ae toki naoki napi, iyie aashu lelo ayiok linono ootii tenebo iyie, tenilo atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, pee miyeye ake; keaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, oo ltung'ana magil yiolot, naa nkalifuni are o iip ile.

English: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Yesu Oldoinyo loo Loirienito.

English: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
Masaai: Ore pee eishunye ina liman, neipotisho Paulo aiturrur ilooiteng'eni neikok, neitanapare, nelo aing'uaa eyieu Makedonia.

English: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
Masaai: Nepolos Adonija ilkerra, o lmong'i o ntokitin naapir te ndapidapoi oo lasuriaa, te mbata e Norogel, neitoomon ninye ilalashera lenyena pooki, lelo ayiok lo laiguanani, o lelo tung'ana pooki kituaak le Yuda.

English: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ebuakita ilmang'ati linono; neilepie lukuny lelo likimba iyie.

English: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
Masaai: Entoning ena, intae ilarikok le nkaji e Israel, intae ooibooyo esipata, nimbelekenyenye enkiguana nasipa.

English: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
Masaai: Ekesipa ena kiroroto, neishiaakino neng'amari nenyorrarri katukul inchere, eewuo Kristo enkop aitajeu ilooata ng'ok. Naa nanu oituruk too looata.

English: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
Masaai: Nesai oladuoo oishiunyeki meturubare, kake eitanapa ajoki,

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron to ldoinyo le Hor, to lpolosie le nkop e Edom,

English: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie endoron ti oriong e nkosholai, netum olkunoni entoki naitainyie entoki sidai.

English: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
Masaai: Neibelekeny ninye olpurkel aitaa nchorroi oo nkariak, neibelekeny enkop natoyio oolbaat aitaa nchorroi oo nkariak.

English: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
Masaai: Kake etanya ninye elo aapaash neaku etaremo Abna ninye enkoshoke to lng'urrat le mpere enye, neaku eipang'ua empere te nkoriong enye, nebatata ninye te ine, neye te ine apa netii. Ore lelo apa pooki ooetuo ine wueji netabatatare Asahel neye, neitashe aaitirring'a.

English: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
Masaai: Eitorioo olaguetani olkereri, nesir te nkalamu; neitobiru ina naguetu too ntokitin naaguetishoreki, nesir te ntoki naipimishoreki neitobiru entoki naikununo anaa oltung'ani, nepik enkishiaa e tung'ani, pee etum atipika enkaji enye.

English: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
Masaai: ore olobayie te pooki, naaipang'aki sii ninye nanu, atiu anaa ilo ini te nkata neme enenye.

English: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
Masaai: Etii enkaji olasipani olchumati kitok, kake edoiki enyamali tumoto eilo torrono.

English: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ishboshet, olayioni le Saul, nchere etua Abna te Hebron, neiropijaa empijan enye, ore Israel pooki neiputukuny.

English: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
Masaai: “Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too ltung'ana le lejare, te ilo ng'ejep olejisho.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore irrinyo alo Misiri, toduaa nchere itaasa te dukuya Farao nena pooki enking'asia natipika nanu engolon ina kake kaitagol nanu oltau lenye, pee meisho ninye iltung'ana meshomo.

English: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
Masaai: Kake etoikioki oltung'ani enyamali anaa enailep iltiil le nkima shumata.

English: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilooiteng'eni lenyena eloito too nkejek ti oriong enkare neureishoyu nejo, “Oloip doi!” nebuak aaishir te nkuretisho.

English: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
Masaai: Aaishoo nanu iyie olaiguanani te ngoro, naiwuang'ie ninche te ngoro ai.

English: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD'S people to transgress.
Masaai: A-a, ilayiok laainei, ime lomon supati lelo laning iltung'ana eidapashaa.

English: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
Masaai: Naa ore lelo le ishoi e Lawi oong'amu empolosare neetae naitanapaki ti atua nkitanapat meishoo olorere ninche ematua e tomon, naaton lalashera lenye, hoo naa le ishoi e Abraham sii ninche.

English: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
Masaai: Neton ninye aishiaakinore eneitadoikini mpisai e nkaji e Nkai, nejur olorere epik mpisai ilo sanduku. Nepik iltung'ana kumok karsisi te nkumoi.

English: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani leina anasa enye, neipotu ninye, neirorie ninye: naa teneuno, ejo, ‘Mayieu nanu naya ninye’,

English: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
Masaai: Aaitaa nanu iyie kitok te nkop; aitabayie esiaai nikinchoo mataasa.

English: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
Masaai: Naawaliki ajoki, ti nidaa aashu ti niokisho aashu ti nias ai ake bae pooki, taasa nena pooki te nkaraki enkitoo e Nkai.

English: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
Masaai: Naa ina pee etiaakinote, “Emikipolos, ematooshie ole nkukuo, pee kitum oloya,” pee ebaya ilo kigeroto ojo, “Etoorikinote nkilani aainei neoshie ole nkukuo olkila lai.”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Enchom entoliki Yohana imbaa nining'itoto o nidolitata.

English: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
Masaai: Shomo enetii enkalaoni, iyie lo tashalai; ing'ura inkoitoi enyena, nitum eng'eno.

English: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
Masaai: Katitin uni apa to lari eitayu Solomon ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te nchumata ilo perere lo lasar apa oteshetaka Olaitoriani. Nepej enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku eidipa apa ninye enkaji.

English: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
Masaai: Amu etooko iloreren pooki enaisho oo sabibu, oo ng'uarrat enyena torrok. Ore laiguanak le nkop neloloito te ninye, netaa karsisi ilbiasharani te nkop te nkiborra enye oo nkonyek.”

English: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
Masaai: Amu oltung'ani supat ninye obore Enkiyang'et Sinyati o enkirukoto. Neponikino Olaitoriani olturrur sapuk.

English: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
Masaai: Ore apa nkiaasin e Rehoboam ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too mbukui oo nkatinin e Shemaia oloiboni le Nkai o ne Ido oladuaani. Ilarrabali apa lemeish kulo te rishata e Rehoboam o Yeroboam.

English: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
Masaai: Ore o taata eton eitu iomonunu toki te nkarna ai; entoomonu, naa itumutumu, pee eboreyu eng'ida inyi.

English: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
Masaai: Nejo Arauna, “Kainyoo pee eewuo olkitok lai olaiguanani enetii osinka lenye?” Nejo Daudi, “Pee ainyiang'u ene wueji neidong'ishoreki te iyie pee atum ateshetaki olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, pee etumi aaiwuang'ie olmeitai too ltung'ana.”

English: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
Masaai: Naa inji entejo: ‘Papa lang otii shumata meitisinyi enkarna ino

English: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
Masaai: “Mintoki adamu mbaa e apa, niminguanare mbaa musan.

English: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ore Israel nemeisiligayu neitodolua kewan ajo aikiti enkitarruorroto enye alang Yuda nemeisiligayu.

English: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
Masaai: Neikirikira olkitamanyunoto le Nkaji e Nkai te nkaraki ina buakunoto, neiput ina aji empuruo.

English: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
Masaai: Eitomisimisoki enkolong o lapa netajaaitie ilakir ewang'an enye.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Aikilikuan sii nanu intae embae nabo, naa tinikiwalikiki, naliki sii nanu intae enkidimata naasie kuna baa.

English: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
Masaai: Ketaa ina apa naji aaret naanyaaka aar matua? Mme ninye. Ore enatiu, eng'oki, pee elioyu naa duoo eng'oki, nataasishore embae naji apa pee aaret aa nanu ear matua eji, eng'oki nataasishore enkitanapata pee etum aitodolu entorroni enye nemeeta eneiting'ie.

English: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
Masaai: meishoo intae Enkai Magilani olng'ur te dukuya ilo tung'ani, pee etum aishoo intae entushuku olikae alashe linyi o Benchamen. Tenaa apa kaiturraa inkera aainei, inchoo aiturraa.”

English: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Mbelekenyau, ntasho tene.” Neaku eitasho ninye te mbata, neitashe aitirring'a.

English: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa ninche aapuo aaikitalan enkop ebaiki ong'ata e Sin o metabaiki Rehob; embata e nejing'ieki Hamat;

English: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
Masaai: Neitayu Besalel osanduku loo nkeek o lerai, intemat are o lpisiai enkadoro, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho enye, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai enkilepata enye.

English: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
Masaai: Ore te kuna pooki neitu eas Yoab eng'oki arashu eipotoki Enkai entorroni.

English: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilala oo lolo onom le sahabu, neitutumie lelo karash te nebo te lelo gameta; metaa ore ina aji e Nkai naa nabo.

English: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etung'uayie Enkai ninche neisho ing'uarrat oo ltauja lenye oonyor iloirerioni, o metaa kelaiki enkanyit iseseni lenye maate,

English: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
Masaai: Neya ninye teilo turrur loo ltung'ana le Israel isitiman oare le kineji te nkaraki olasar le ngoki, o lmeregesh obo te nkaraki olasar opejori.

English: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
Masaai: Neaku ore pooki tung'ani onya ina mukate neok ina kikompe meishiaakino keaku eeta eng'oki e ilo sesen o ilo sarge lo Laitoriani.

English: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
Masaai: “Metaa miomonoki iyie kulo tung'ana, arashu ilepie enkishirata arashu enkomono te rishata enye, amu mainining nanu tenaaipot ninche nanu tenkata enye enyamali.

English: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
Masaai: “Kitudumunye apa iyiook te Horeb, nikipuo aaim ina ong'ata sapuk nagol nitoduaa, kiimita ina oitoi eina kop oo ldoinyo nalo Amori, anaa enaitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang; nikipuonu Kadesh-Barnea.

English: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Kake kaisho ilkuti lenye eilanyisho aailany ilo alem, aaing'uaa olameyu o lmeitai torrono, peyie etum aaisirayia olminong lenye pooki tiatua lelo oshon oojing atua, netum aatayiolo aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
Masaai: Elepie nkaik inyi te ine wueji sinyati, esisa Olaitoriani!

English: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
Masaai: Nepuonu Yerusalem. Nejing enkaji e Nkai neiteru aaraa lelo oomirisho o looinyang'isho te nkaji e Nkai, neibeleleng'oo mesai oo laitawalak loo mpesai o lorikan le lelo omir nturkuluni;

English: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
Masaai: Naa te neigeroki metawalu enkishui enye nelak ninye meitajeu enkishui enye esiana pooki naba anaa enatudung'okoki.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
Masaai: Metaa, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitokini aajo Tofel, arashu oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, kake oyarata le sesekuanare amu te Tofel ninche enukaa ilootuata, enkaraki metii erishata dikae.

English: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
Masaai: Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani anaa naishu; arany nanu enkisisa e Nkai eton aata enkishui.

English: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
Masaai: Ore pee elikioo ororei supat te ina anasa, neitaa lkumok ilooiteng'eni, nerrinyo aapuo Listra, o Ikonio o Antiokia,

English: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
Masaai: Neitaa pesho nkitobirat e lelo loo losekin, metaa metum inkaik enye hoo dupoto.

English: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
Masaai: Aimetiu kulo anaa Karkemish? Aimetiu Hamat anaa Arpad? Aimetiu Samaria anaa Dameski?

English: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
Masaai: Ena iyiolounyenye Enkiyang'et e Nkai; ore enkiyang'et ake pooki naibalunye Yesu Kristo nchere eewuo to sesen naa ene Nkai;

English: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatua osesen te nemetii enkiyang'et neijia etiu enkirukoto nemetii siaitin etua.

English: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
Masaai: Ore hoo duoo naata sii nanu makewan esipata pee ang'idare osesen, te netii likae tung'ani ojo keeta esipata pee eng'idare osesen, nanu olusoo:

English: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neirridu Olaitoriani ena bae; Meekure eaku, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
Masaai: Ore te nkata nainosi endaa nejoki Boas, “Wou ene, pee inos endaa nintadoiki oldung'oti lino engirra atua enaisho oo sabibu.” Neaku etotona ninye te nebo nena aisampuak, neitarasaki ninye emukate natapejoki; neinos ninye o metaraposhoyu, neleku.

English: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
Masaai: koree naa teine osiligi lai? Aing'ae odol osiligi lai?

English: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo obo lenye abol olbene lenye pee eisho osikiria lenye endaa te wueji neirraga, etodua impisai enyena te nkutuk olbene lenyena;

English: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
Masaai: Etipika esuntai enkoitoi ai, metaa maidim aima, netipika enaimin inkoitoi aainei.

English: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorie ninche, nebau Raheli ereuta ntare e papaai lenye aa ninye nairritita.

English: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
Masaai: nikimpot nanu te nkata e nyamali; kaakordu nanu iyie, nikiisis iyie nanu.”

English: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku keetae enkoitoi kitok nadumunye te Misiri alo Asiria. Nepuonunye ile Misiri Asiria, nepuo ile Misiri aaseremisho te nebo ile Asiria.

English: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
Masaai: Kake ore te ninche, netiu anaa enaibon elejare; einosa ninche ilmuma oogol; kake eyau ninye eng'oki enye metadamuni, peyie etumi aaibung'a.

English: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
Masaai: Keitu iyie iaraa aipang'ie ilapolosak lo Laitoriani, ilayiok le Aron, o Lawi, nintobiraki kewan ilapolosak anaa iltung'ana le kulie kuapi? Ore pooki ng'ae olotu aitisiny kewan to loti oing'oni anaa too lmeregeshi oopishana neaku olapolosani le nena neme Nkaitin.

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, te lelo oing'ok o lelo meregeshi o lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
Masaai: enoshi kata naiguenare iyiook iltauja lang, amu kitok Enkai alang iltauja lang, neyiolo pooki toki.

English: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
Masaai: Amu meituraa Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena; meing'uaa ninye enjung'ore enye;

English: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki intae, eming'aeng'ai aashu iureyuyu ninche.

English: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
Masaai: “Eitayu ninye oltoilo leijo olasurai elotu te ngolon; amu eisarisarutua ilmang'ati lenyena te ngolon, nepuonu aarare ninye too ntoluo, anaa loshi oouroo ilkeek.

English: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
Masaai: Kebaa elilituni Esau, neing'oruni ilchumat lenyena!

English: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
Masaai: Meidim olchani sidai atoiu ilng'anayio torrok, nemeidim sii olchani torrono atoiu ilng'anayio sidain.

English: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kaiwuang'ie sii Yuda too nkonyek aainei, anaa apa enaiwuang'ie Israel, nanang'aa nanu ena anasa apa nategelua, Yerusalem oina aji apa natejo nanu ninye etii enkarna ai.”

English: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Iyiolo iyie ajo enaai apa enkitoria, naa nanu apa eisiligita Israel pooki pee aitore ninche; kake eibelekenye enkitoria neaku eno lalashe lai, amu enenye apake eing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani.

English: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
Masaai: Ore pee eitashe, neitashe sii kuna, ore pee edumunye aailep, neilep sii ninche tenebo, amu etii apa atua ninche enkiyang'et e nena ng'uesi naaishu.

English: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Oi anu, Olaitoriani?” Nejo ninye: “O metaba anaa nemijoonu nkanas memanya toki, o nkajijik metii iltung'ana, ore enkop neliyioyu tukul,

English: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
Masaai: amu eyiolo Olaitoriani enkoitoi e lelo supati, kake ore enkoitoi e lelo torrok naa keidak.

English: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
Masaai: Neishiraki ilo tung'ani le Nkai olperere lo lasar to rorei lo Laitoriani ejo, “Lo perere lo lasar, lo perere, nji ejo Olaitriani: ‘Ng'ura, keikini enkaji e Daudi enkayioni, naa keji enkarna enye Yosia, naa kepolos ninye te shumata iyie lelo apolosak loo wuejitin e shumata, lelo oopej enkorropil te shumata iyie, naa kepuoi aapejoo iloik loo ltung'ana te shumata iyie.’ ”

English: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
Masaai: “Neaku embung'a intae nkitanapat aainei nimbung'ubung'u nkiguanat aainei niasiasa ninche; pee itonini tiatua ina kop te seriani.

English: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
Masaai: “Mbalie tiatua loreren nintudupaa, entipik enanka nintudupaa, emisudoo, naa entejo: ‘Ewaki Babilon neitukurruni enkai enye naji Bel, Etapalari Merodak eitukurruaki nkitanyaanyukot enyena ore nena kitanyaanyukot neme enkai neitapalari.’

English: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
Masaai: Keitu idol iyie enduaata namilisho, nimbalie te nkutuk ino enaibon e lejare, te pooki kata nitejo, ‘Ejo Olaitoriani, hoo neitu nanu airo?’ ”

English: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
Masaai: olaa ninye eisiligita lelo oshon pokira tomon o aare ejo pee etum, naa ina pee eitirrish aaserem Enkai dama o kewarie. Naa te nkaraki ele siligi, Olaiguanani, pee aaitang'oro Lyahudi!

English: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
Masaai: ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi, o ndapan oo nkineji, imbaoi oo lera,

English: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo oounisho too lkiyio eisampu too mbuakunot e ng'ida!

English: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
Masaai: Ee kake aiyia ntae Ilfarisayo! Amu inyorrinyorro lorikan sidain too nkajijik entumo, ninyorrinyorro lng'asak too wuejitin neemirishoreki.

English: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Eliab naa: Nemuel, Datan o Abiram. Kulo apa, Datan o Abiram etegeluaki te umata, ootekeshare Musa o Aron to lturrur le Kora, ina kata apa pee ekeshare ninche Olaitoriani,

English: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
Masaai: o Hasar-shual, o Beer-sheba, o Bisiotia,

English: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
Masaai: Amu eiroro apa ninye, netabayie ina natejo; neitanapishe ninye, netuune ina.

English: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
Masaai: Ng'ura ajo ore enatodua aa sidai neiririkino naa pee idaa niokisho ning'oru enchipai te ekenyata pooki naekenya oltung'ani tiabori enkolong te nena kuti olong'i enyena e nkishui enye naaishoo Enkai ninye, amu ninye erubata enye.

English: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
Masaai: Iishu e wiki ena, naa aikintoki aaisho iyie enkae tinikisiaai kulikae arin oopishana.”

English: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
Masaai: Eibelekenya ninye ilkejek lenye aitaa osarge, pee meitoki ninche aaok nena Shorroi enye.

English: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
Masaai: tenebo ineeitasheyie enyena, intemat are enkaina; ore olgoriet le kishomi netii enkalo enkiting'oto e atua e kishomi.

English: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
Masaai: Idolidolo ena too inkonyek inyi maate, nijojo ina kata; “Aikitok Olaitoriani negiroo enkitoo enye ilpolosien loo Siraeli!”

English: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
Masaai: Neme doi ina ake, ketegelutua sirito ninye meisiritore iyiook neaku ninye oya ena kishoroto nikiramatita te nkaraki enkitoo o Laitoriani kewan, neitoduaaya sii enyuaata ang maate.

English: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?
Masaai: Kake etejo olaiguanani, “Kaa nanu aabaikinore iyie, olayioni le Seruiya? Te nedekisho ninye te nkaraki natiaaka ninye Olaitoriani, ‘Tediaa Daudi,’ kaing'ae naa ojo, ‘Kainyoo pee itaasa iyie ena?’ ”

English: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
Masaai: Neitoki ina kitok anutayu neiu entito. Nejoki Olaitoriani Hosea, “Tejo enkarna enye Enemeing'urrieki, amu maigil nanu aing'urrie enkaji e Israel, mapalaki ninche katukul.

English: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
Masaai: Nejing'aki Ilbabilon ninye tiatua endapash enye enyorrata, neidurukie ninye to lng'uarra lenye; ore peyie eidip ninche aaisarkionie ninye, nelo ninye aing'uaa ninche te ngoro.
