English: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, maitobira iyiook olning'o lo sotua o Enkai ang, aaiwuang'ie kuna kituaak pooki o nkera enye, te risioroto e nkikoo o lkitok lai, o ene lelo ooikirikira te nkaraki enkitanapata e Nkai ang: naa nchoo easi ina te risioroto e nkitanapata.

English: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
Masaai: Etodua nchere ore te nkiborra enye enkong'u nemeeta enkirukoto, Israel, nadung'oki nanu enkiguana eyararoto, ore eyia ore ina anashe enye Yuda nemeisiligayu neitu eureyu, kake eshomo sii ninye aaku emulayoi.

English: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
Masaai: Nguanaki te sipata ilo omena o ilo okishi; mbung'a esipata e ilo oata osina o ilo okishi.

English: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
Masaai: Tadamu naa eneba enitusulunore, irridu niaas isiaaitin niaasita apa te dukuya. Naa ti nimiaas, naa kalotu enitii naiwuang'ie olkilang'ilang'et lino te wueji enye, te neitu irridu.

English: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.
Masaai: Nelo ninye airriwaki olkilikuai Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki, “Eisero olaiguanani le Moab tialo nanu; aimikiriamariye nanu olarrabal le Moab?” Nejoki ninye, “Kalo nanu; atiu nanu anaa enitiu iyie, netiu iltung'ana linono anaa iltung'ana laaainei, netiu mbartan aainei anaa mbartan inono.”

English: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji nelo ilokeju ore pooki toki naishu nalo tiatua neton eishu, naa keaku ketii isinkir kumok; amu ine wueji elo ina are, peyie etum nena ariak enaiposha aatisilata; metaa etii pooki toki ine nelo ilo keju.

English: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
Masaai: Aiyia naa, lo karsisi, enchira nibuakibuaka amu kelotu shumata intae osina.

English: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellow workers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
Masaai: neiroroki intae Yesu oji Yusto. Kulo tung'ana ake le lelo oomurata oora laisiaayiak le ncholiek ai kisiaai enkitoria e Enkai, naataretutuo ninche.

English: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
Masaai: etipika nkejek aainei ilpisia aen neing'or inkoitoi aainei pooki.’

English: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
Masaai: ore olapolosani nejur ine, naa teneliooyu egut alang olchoni lo sesen ore ilpapit leine neibelekenyate aaiborru neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo olo lduruk, enkeeya oo lbolot ninye nayopua ilo tudutai.

English: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
Masaai: Ore to ltoilo le mbatatata enye neigirigiro enkop; ore oltoilo le nkishirata enye nening'i te naiposha nanyokie.

English: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
Masaai: Neing'ode areiki nereu nabo kata,

English: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Ebenezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.
Masaai: Nelotu ororei le Samuel enetii Israeli pooki. Nepuo Isiraeli aarare Ilfilisti; neitayu ilng'oborri te Ebenesa; ore Ilfilisti neitayu ilng'oborri te Afek.

English: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
Masaai: Neilep Abimelek alo oldoinyo le Salmon, ninye o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye; nedumu Abimelek entolu te nkaina enye, nedung'u olng'osila lo lchani, nedumu aiteleiki oloililai lenye. Nejoki lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Ore ina nikitoduaa nanu aasita, esarisara entaas, anaa enataasa nanu.”

English: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
Masaai: “Teneibelekenyakino oltung'ani ltung'ana oirorie iloiriruani o lasakutok, aiborrie onyek te ninche, naibelekenyakino nanu ilo tung'ani aarare naitayu nanu ninye aiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenye.

English: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
Masaai: Naa kashuku nanu lelo ootaarayioki le Yuda o loo taarayioki le Israel, naitoki ashetu ninche metotiwuo anaa enatiu apake te dukuya.

English: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, neipang'aki Musa o Eliya aairorie ninye.

English: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
Masaai: Neetae ake sii apa olarrabal o Lfilisti te Gob; neari Elhanan olayioni le Yaareoregim, le Betlehem near metua Goliat le Giti oba enchata e mpere enye anaa embokishi o lashetani.

English: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
Masaai: Emayiana oltung'ani otum eng'eno nagut, oltung'ani otum eyiolounoto.

English: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ina umata oo Siraeli, “Tenidolidolo intae eishiakino, naa tenaa eyieunoto o Olaitoriani Enkai ang, mairriwaki olkilikuai lelo alashera lang apa ootung'uaiyioki te nkop e Israel, o tenebo lelo apolosak ootii atua nena anas naata ndaat oo nchoo pee etum ninche aaetu tenebo enikitii.

English: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
Masaai: ninye ilo oitobirua iltauja lenye pooki, nejurru nkiaasin enye pooki.

English: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu eneba nkitarruorrot inyi o enaba esapuko oo ng'ok inyi, intae ilooibooki enkop olasipani, niyaya ntokitin e ropare, nimbelekenyenye ilo omena aarriny te kishomi.

English: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
Masaai: Ore tialo eoroto oo larripok loo nchomito: ore too ltung'ana le Kora naa Meshelemia olayioni le Kore, obo loo layiok le Asaf.

English: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
Masaai: Neya Yuda imatuan e tomon e ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata aaya nena ajijik naashumishoreki.

English: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
Masaai: Eitorioki ilaisinak nkaik enyena enyena, neitoti too nkaik enyena ilaisinak.

English: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
Masaai: Enyaaka sii ashet Bet-horon e shumata o Bet-horon e abori, nkanas naasheta isunta, o nchomito, naatii isekenke.

English: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
Masaai: Naishir oleng amu eitu etumi oltung'ani hoo obo oishiaakino pee edol ilo piyayati arishu eing'or atua.

English: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.
Masaai: “Ewaita ninye eng'ura ninye oleng nimintaasiasa ake entorrono, kake entaasa ninye anaa enajoki intae.”

English: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
Masaai: Naata sii kulie kerra, neme ine na muatata. Meeta kata nemareu sii ninche naa kening oltoilo lai, naa keaku emboo nabo, o lchekut obo.

English: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?
Masaai: Nejoki Saul Mikal “Kainyoo pee kiteleja aikonji, nincho olmang'atinta lai meshomo neaku etajeuo ninye?” Newaliki Mikal Saul, “Aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Ntasho mashomo; kainyoo pee aar nanu iyie tua?’ ”

English: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
Masaai: pee mincho ake enkisisa ino ilkulikae, nimincho ilarin linono lelo le meeta olng'ur,

English: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
Masaai: Aibalunye nanu entorroni, aainosua nanu eng'oki ai.

English: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
Masaai: Kake esipa tukul nchere eitopiwuoki Kristo too lootuata. Olng'anayioi le dukuya te lelo ootuata.

English: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.
Masaai: Ore to lari lioudo le nkitoria e Sedekia, olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le tomon, nelotu Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o enjore enye pooki aarare Yerusalem nemuat aman ninye,

English: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, kashipakino nanu Olaitoriani, kang'idakino nanu Enkai e njeunoto ai.

English: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
Masaai: Neyau lelo apolosak lenye pooki aitupuku too nkanas e Yuda, neisarkionie ninye wuejitin neeika apa naapejie ilapolosak enkorropil, ebaiki Geba o metabaiki Beer-sheba; neitoki ninye agil auroo nena wuejitin neeika oo nchomito apa naatii enejing'ieki kishomi e Yoshua ilo balusui le nkanasa, apa naatii enkalo e Kedienye teina kishomi e nkanasa.

English: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
Masaai: Yuda, aikisis iyie ilalashera linono; Neibung inkaik inono imurto oo lmang'ati linono; ore ilayiok le papaai lino naa keirrugo te dukuya iyie.

English: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
Masaai: Amu esipa enkaina o Laitoriani apa naarare ninche, pee eidaikie ninche te lelo ng'oborri, o metaba anaa neidak ninche.

English: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
Masaai: Inining'u tukurraki irorei laainei, nincho embae nalimu aibalie ejing'u inkiyiaa inono.

English: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Atishipe pee aajoki ninche, “Maape enkaji o Laitoriani!”

English: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
Masaai: Neaku etayioloito iltung'ana pooki o Israel pooki ina olong nchere mme eyieunoto apa o laiguanani pee ear Abna olayioni le Ner.

English: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
Masaai: naisho nanu, olalashe lai Hanani o Hanania meitasheiki Yerusalem. Amu oltung'ani apa oisiligayu neure Enkai alang ilkumok.

English: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai aliki kulo rorei pooki Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, tiatua Yerusalem ejo,

English: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
Masaai: “Ore hoo naaji ninye te netur enkop aapuo enemeneng'a, naa keitayu ake enkaina ai ninche te ine, ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keilep aapuo shumata, naa kaitadou nanu ninche te ine.

English: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Imbonoki enkiyang'et, imbonoki, enkerai e tung'ani, nijoki enkiyang'et, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Wou too nkaloli pokira ong'uan enkijape, iyie na kijape, niyang'aki kulo ootuata, peyie etum ninche aatopiu.”

English: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
Masaai: Keishiaakino pae duoo niking'ida, nikishipa amu ketua apa ele alashe lino, neishu taata, eimina apa nenotoki.’ ”

English: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eirura ninche, neilepu ninye alotu enetii ninche te nchumata e nkaji,

English: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
Masaai: Neitoki Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana anyiku neosh Mikaia eseder, nejoki, “Kaji eimua enkiyang'et o Laitoriani pee epuku te nanu nikilotu airorie iyie?”

English: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato, “Aimikirorie nanu? Ai miyiolo ajo kaata engolon naalakie naata engolon naasheyie?”

English: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
Masaai: “Ntayu erubata e lelo anterera linono ooing'uaa enkurma to lari ake ninye pooki.

English: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
Masaai: Ore tiabori ilgilat le kopikop netii enejing'ieki te nkalo oloosaen, teine nejing'ieki ina oitoi, ore te nkalo e kurum netii esuntai narish esuntai.

English: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
Masaai: Nejo lelo kituaak le Sukot, “Keidipa Seba o Salmuna aatijing atua enkaina ino metaa eji eikincho iyiook endaa enjore ino?”

English: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
Masaai: Tumuta pooki tung'ani to ndamunot inono tayiolo entoki ninchooyo inyor metii olng'ash; ilo oishoru te nchipai enyor Enkai.

English: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
Masaai: Metaa nelotu ilo kitok enetii nejoki, “Tolikioki sii iyie japa, eji ira doi oloo Roma?” Nejoki, “Ee.”

English: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
Masaai: ejo, “Miseyie ele lai ootubukokoki eilata aaput, minyal iloibonok laainei!”

English: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani enkikapu too nkaik inono neirragie te dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
Masaai: Ore ina kata, neibayu Esau Yakobo enkaraki emayianata natamayiana papaai lenye ninye. Nejo Esau to ltau lenye. “Etabautua inkolong'i naishiraki papaai, ore peyie eishunye natum ataara metua olalashe lai Yakobo.”

English: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
Masaai: Kebulu ninche anaa nkujit naatii atua enkare, anaa iseyia oobulu too reyieta naaruko

English: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
Masaai: Neitanap esiamo metotona te nkop;

English: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
Masaai: Aikijo aa iyiook? Aikijo mme asipani Enkai te nkiguana enye? Mme neijia pae!

English: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Toning'o oltoilo lenye, nigelaki ninche olaiguanani.” Neitoki Samuel ajoki iltung'ana le Israel, “Shomo pooki tung'ani enkanasa enye.”

English: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
Masaai: Ore lootoning'o pooki neiteng'el too ltauja lenye ejo, “Keaku pasa ena kerai keniaa pukunoto?” Amu eiriamunore enkaina e Nkai ninye.

English: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
Masaai: Ore ilamirak le nena masaa ootudupore enkarsisisho naing'uaa ninye neitashe te nelakua te nkuretisho e mion enye, neishir neyietu abuaku ajo,

English: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak ootii atua ninye netiu anaa olng'atuny oikurrukur opolos engues, etumuta enkishui oo ltung'ana; ewaita ninche ilchumat o ntokitin naagol enkingang'a; eitaa ninche inkituaak kumok inkolia.

English: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
Masaai: Ore enalusoo te ina, eiking'ida o ti atua sinaitin lang, kiyiolo aajo osina oiu eng'iriata,

English: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
Masaai: Ore ade pee epuonu aaiyiolou aajo ninye oloshi aomononi oton te Kishomi Sidai e Nkaji e Nkai, neing'asia pooki, neiputukuny te ina naitaasaki ninye.

English: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
Masaai: Neshet Musa olng'obor le manyisho e Nkai; neirragie nkitotoneta enyena, nepik irubat oo sunta enyena, nepik imbokishi enyena, neun ing'apeta enyena;

English: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
Masaai: Tenaa keewuo apa aa ninye ake, nelo ninye aa ninye ake; te neewuo apa eyamishe nelo enkitok enye te nebo ninye.

English: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
Masaai: Meing'ura tukul enkishorunoto e Nkai o nena naayawua enkitarruorroto e ilo tung'ani obo, amu ore enaiguanaka Enkai ina kitarruorroto nabo naa mutata, kake ore enkishorunoto enye e mpiris neitayio inkitarruorrot kumok neyau empalakinoto.

English: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
Masaai: Kake ore pee elotu Osamariyiai olo sii ninye nkang'itie, ore pee edol neing'urrie.

English: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
Masaai: neya ninche aitalang enkare, tenebo pooki toki naba anaa enaata,

English: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
Masaai: Ore pee eishunye nkolong'i ile nerik Yesu Petero o Yakobo o Yohana, neilepie enchumata o ldoinyo oado aa ninche ake; newala emua enye edolita ninche.

English: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Enkai, “Ti nimilo iyie te nebo iyiook, miya iyiook aituang'uaa ene.

English: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
Masaai: Nejing ninche Yerusalem nepuo aailepaki olgilata le shumata le nkaji apa natijing'a: Aa Petero, Yohana, Yakobo o Anterea, Filipo o Tomas, Bartolomayo o Matayo, Yakobo le Alfayo o Simon loo olkirowuai, o Yudas ole Yakobo.

English: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie lelo lewa le nkisiaayiare e seremare enkiborra oo nkonyek apa naitobira loo menye.

English: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.
Masaai: nejoki Paulo olkitok loo sikarini o sikarini lenyena, “Te neitu etoni ltung'ana ti atua emeli meitajeuni intae.”

English: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
Masaai: Eton ake ijukaa kewan too ltung'ana laainei, nimincho ninche meshomo.

English: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nji ejo Hesekia, ‘Ore ena olong naa enkolong o sina, enkolong e nkisikong'ata naa enkolong e sulare, etoiwuoki nkera nemeeta ninche engolon nabulunye.

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Nebaya ina kata ororei oiroro oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia etejo,

English: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eikoo apa Olaitoriani Israel o Yuda te pooki oiboni le Nkai, o te pooki aduaani, ejo, “Embelekenyata entapaash nkoitoi inyi torrok, nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei, o nkikoot aainei, te risioroto e nena kitanapat apa naitanapa loo papaai linyi, o nena nairriwaka intae too sinkan laaainei, lelo oiboonok le Nkai.”

English: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing olkitok, nejing'u atua eimu ilo goriet le kishomi, naa ina oitoi ake naimua eitoki aim.

English: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku oloo larin tomon o aare neilep aapuo anaa entipat e ilo sirua.

English: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
Masaai: “Esika entung'uai empolos e Babilon, nipuopuo aaipang te nkop oo Lkaldayo, nitiuu anaa iloroi te dukuya iluaat oo ntare.

English: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
Masaai: Nemetii apa enkare naok ina umata; neiturrurro ninche maate aarare Musa nearare Aron.

English: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
Masaai: neijia etiu oltung'ani olej olelatia enye, nejo, “Ekaiguran taa ake!”

English: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aitanap Ebedmelek ilo apa le Etiopia ajoki, “Iwa iltung'ana okuni tene nipuopuo aailepunye Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai aaitayu tiatua olchorro eton eitu eye.”

English: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
Masaai: To lkutati lenye eitisidanaki keper; nerem enkaina enye olasurai oilanyisho.

English: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
Masaai: Kake kintayio iyie Olaitoriani, nikintupuku aitung'uaa olkokuet le sekenkei oyupuyup, aitupuku te Misiri, pee iaku olorere lenye kewan, anaa enatiu taata.

English: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
Masaai: Migoro asioki, amu ore engoro neirrag to lgoo loo lmoda.

English: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
Masaai: Ore pee eishankarrarre too mbaa naaipirta enkiguana oo sipat o enkibooroto naaibooyo oltung'ani kewan arishie ntorrok, o enkiguana kenya nalotu, neureishoyu Feliks nejo, “Shomo taata; ore pee atum erishata naaipot.”

English: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
Masaai: Ore ina mudong naimua erishata oo nkejek enyena, o nkera enyena naatoiwuo ninye, neisudoo pee errinyokino ainos, amu kaa naa easi teina namani aamuat enkang o to sina likisomit iyie ilmang'ati linono too nkang'itie inono.

English: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

English: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
Masaai: Magilani ninye alang indarat oo nkariak kumok, kitok alang ilopir le naiposha, Ore Olaitoriani otii shumata naa magilani.

English: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Efraim te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ile Shutela, olmarei loo le Shutela; ile Bekeri, olmarei loo le Bekeri; ile Tahani; olmarei loo le Tahani.

English: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.
Masaai: Kake etawala Hana ajo, “A-a, Olkitok lai, ara nanu enkitok naata emion to ltau; eitu nanu aok enaisho naitemerisho, agira nanu abukoki Olaitoriani enyamali oltau lai.

English: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche atua enkop e Misiri, amu eitu apa eiruk oltoilo lo Laitoriani. Nebau ninche Tefahes.

English: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
Masaai: Ore eipung aapuo, nesai menyaaki aaigilie lelo omon te nkolong e sabato nasuju ina.

English: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
Masaai: Nenutayu Lea neiu enkayioni neipot ninye enkarna ajo Ruben, amu etejo, “Enkaraki natoduaa Olaitoriani enkisilisiloto ai, nesipa taata ajo ekaanyoru olpayian lai.”

English: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
Masaai: Ore olonya osesen lai neok osarge lai, neton ti atua nanu naton nanu ti atua ninye.

English: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
Masaai: Neinyototo, nedumu nabo kata erruat enye, neipung te dukuya ninche pooki; o meing'asiata pooki neisis Enkai, ejo, “Eitu ai kata kidol embae naaijo ena!”

English: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
Masaai: Ilo oatae apake te nkiterunoto. Ilo likitoning'o iyiook, nikitoduaa too nkonyek ang, niking'ura nikimbung'a too nkaik ang, ilo rorei le nkishui

English: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:
Masaai: Ng'ura, ena nanu anoto, ejo olaikooni, intushulaki entoki enkae peyie itum esiana enye,

English: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
Masaai: Ore iloibonok pooki neibonu ina, nejo, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead pee ilo amirisho; aikincho iyie Olaitoriani apik enkaina o laiguanani.”

English: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pee eishunye nena olong'i nikinapa pee kilep aapuo Yerusalem.

English: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
Masaai: Netii apa oltung'ani otii Maon, otii esiaai enye Karmel. Eikarsis apa ilo tung'ani oleng; eeta apa ninye nkerra nkalifuni uni o nkineji enkalifu nabo. Nebarnu apa ninye ilpapit loo nkerra enyena te Karmel.

English: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
Masaai: Usi menye le Serahia, Serahia menye le Meraiot,

English: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Naa te neiro oltung'ani inchoo eiro anaa enatiu Ororei le Enkai; naa te neisiaaisho oltung'ani, inchoo eisiaaisho anaa enkidimata naishoo Enkai: pee eisiaai Enkai te pooki toki ti atua Yesu Kristo, laa enenye enkisisa, o enkitoria ntarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
Masaai: Kake etasayia Musa Olaitoriani Enkai enye nejo, “Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee eyupuyup engoro ino airowuaju te nkaraki iltung'ana linono laa ninche apa iyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri te ngolon sapuk o te nkaina e nkidimata?

English: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ore oloata nkilani are, inchoo eisho nabo ilo lemeeta, ore oloata endaa neng'arie olemeeta.”

English: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Serak naa: Yeul o lalashera lenyena, iip ile o ntomoni naaudo.

English: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
Masaai: Etii enkitamioto eutaroto name ilo otapalayie ina oitoi; ore ilo oiba iutarot naa keye.

English: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
Masaai: Nejo Laban, “Enaikash te naaisho iyie alang te naisho ninye likae lee; totona tenebo nanu.”

English: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
Masaai: naa kadotu nanu Asherim inyi aiwuang'ie tiatua intae naidaikie nkanas inyi.

English: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
Masaai: Naa aikinang'aki ake iyie nanu engumoto, ore ninye inkilani aainei naaibayu nanu.

English: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:
Masaai: Neas Asa imbaa supati naa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
Masaai: eminchosho eirrirri indamunot inyi aasioki aashu eituria neme te nkiyang'et to rorei aashu te mpalai naji iyiook eing'uaa eji etabawua Enkolong o Laitoriani.

English: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
Masaai: Neaku ore amu imololong, mirobi nimirowua, ekaanotu aitayu te nkutuk ai.

English: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Masaai: Tenaa napaji ninye kalo aim oerata lo loip le keeya, nemaure entorroni; amu itii iyie te nebo nanu; eng'udi ino o rinka lino ninche naaitagol nanu.

English: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
Masaai: Oo naa pee mikiaas ntorrok pee epuonu isupati? Amu ina doi eiteenikitia kulikae iyiook aajo neijia kijo. Ore endung'okinoto e nkiguanan natum ninche lelo naa keishiaakino.

English: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
Masaai: Najoki nanu lelo kituaak, o larikok, o lkulikae tung'ana pooki, “Aisapuk esiaai, netalala oleng, neidapasha iyiook esuntai, kitalamate maate.

English: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
Masaai: Ore ena buku oo nkitanapat mincho epuku te nkutuk ino, kake mbirribirra mbaa enyena dama o kewarie, pee itum atujurru ataasa te risioroto e nena pooki naaigero ti atua ninye; amu ina kata ake ebul enkoitoi ino, naa ina kata itum enkisulata sidai.

English: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
Masaai: Te neibung'i olapurroni egilita enkaji kewarie neari metua; ore ilo otaara ninye metua nemeeta iloikop. Kake tenaa dama ekenyua neeta ninye iloikop.

English: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
Masaai: Kening inkerra aainei oltoilo lai, nayiolo ninche, naa kaasuj ninche,

English: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
Masaai: Neinos Yakobo olmumai ejo, “Tenaa keaku Enkai tenebo nanu, naarrip nanu tena lototo, naaisho sii endaa nanya o nkilani naishop

English: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
Masaai: Kake etusujaitie apa enjore oo Lkaldayo olaiguanani nepuo aainepu ninye too nkisiajat e Yeriko. Neidapasha enjore enye pooki aaing'uaa ninye.

English: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
Masaai: Neibung nena ng'apeta pokira are apa naatii empolos enkaji, naa ninche apa naairisha e nkaji, neirishakino te ngolon enye pooki shumata ninche, neibung te nkaina enye e tatene nabo ng'ape neibung tene kedienye enkae.

English: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: nepik ilkererin aare le sahabu o lgiso aare le sahabu, nepik ilgiso ilpijat pokira aare le ina kila olgoo;

English: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
Masaai: Amu eidimi ainyiang'u enkitok naibor onyek te mukate nabo, kake eishu enkitok naloloito entonata e nkishui o lee.

English: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
Masaai: Aibung'a nanu enkirukoto ai, hoo ninye te natejo, “Aaisilisiloki nanu oleng”;

English: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani inosa endaa ino to lkirutoto, niok enkare to lokirikiri o te nkuretisho;

English: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
Masaai: Ore nkishorot pooki, o ntokitin pooki naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel, nena naayaki ninche ilo apolosani neaku inenyena;

English: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloinos pooki sarge, neiwuang'ieki ilo tung'ani too ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
Masaai: Ore ilo oti te ninche naa kelo aaku olmarei kitok, ore ilo oti aisul neaku olosho magilani; ara nanu Olaitoriani; ore te nkata enye naa kaitasieku nanu ina.

English: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
Masaai: Eyiolo Olaitoriani nkolong'i e ilo lemeeta entioto; ore enjung'ore enye nebikoo ntarasi;

English: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
Masaai: Netasotuo Paulo looti keek nepik enkima, nepuku olasurai te nkaraki enkirowuaj neirinakino enkaina enye.

English: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
Masaai: Tarasaki ninye te pooki shoto; tabolo ilchumat lenyena le ndaa; tasoto ninye anaa isotot le nkano, nindaikie ninye tukul; mincho eleku toki te ninye.

English: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
Masaai: “Amu ore enkishui e pooki toki naishu naa osarge lenye etii. Neaku atiaaka nanu iltung'ana le Israel, Eminos ake osarge li ae toki ake ninye pooki, amu ore enkishui e pooki toki naishu naa osarge lenye etii; ore pooki ng'ae oinos osarge neiwuang'ieki ninye.

English: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i neiturrur Ilfilisti njorin enye te nkaraki olarrabal, pee earare Israel. Nejoki Akish Daudi, “Tayiolo nchere ore iyie o ltung'ana linono naa impang'ipang'a aapuo te nebo nanu ti atua enjore.”

English: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
Masaai: Neirriwaki iltung'ana le Israel olkilikuai iltung'ana le Ruben o le Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase te nkop e Gilead, Finehas olayioni le Eliasa olapolosani,

English: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
Masaai: inkisilisilot aainei, sinaitin laainei, nena naaineputua te Antiok, te Ikonio o te Listra, eneba inkisilisilot nating'iria nanu; kake ore te nena pooki naatokordua Olaitoriani.

English: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
Masaai: Amu ore intae loo lalashera intoduaarie ate isirito e Enkai ti atua Kristo Yesu naatii atua Yudea. Amu inoto sii intae olosilisili too ltung'ana lo lorere linyi anaa enanoto sii ninche too Lyahudi,

English: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
Masaai: “Neijia etiu, keaku ile siadi ile dukuya, neaku ile dukuya ile siadi.”

English: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
Masaai: Kashuku nanu emunyani oo ltung'ana laainei Israel naa keshet ninche nkanas apa naaidaaitie nemany ninche; keun ninche isabibu neok enaisho enye; naa keitayu ninche nkurman neya ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
Masaai: Nenyorraa kulikae lenye nena neaku ile nkalo e Paulo o Sila, naa neijia etiu Lyunani kumok ooserem Enkai, neme kuti sii ninche nkituaak arikok naairuko.

English: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
Masaai: Eturu ineimi too ndapidapo, nedol enkong'u enye pooki toki sidai.

English: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki ina umata, “Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.” Neisis ina umata pooki Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neirrug ninche ilukuny enye, neserem Olaitoriani, neisho enkanyit aaitaa Olaiguanani.

English: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
Masaai: Kake ti nikijoki, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang iyiook kingarakino,” aime ilo otii ilperereni lenyena loo lasarri shumata, eiwuangie Hesekia lelo perereni, ejoki Yuda o Yerusalem, “Ipuopuo intae aaserem te dukuya ele perere lo lasar”?

English: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
Masaai: Entaranyaki enkisisa Olaitoriani, ilo oton te Sion! Entolikioi ti atua loreren nkiaasin enyena!

English: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
Masaai: Entukuo ilkilani linyi te nkolong e naapishana, niakuku taa sidain; ore te siadi ina nipuonunu taa atua ilng'oborri.”

English: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
Masaai: Nejoki looiteng'eni lenyena, “Rabbi king'oru det Ilyahudi aar too soito; nintoki ake aito ine?”

English: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
Masaai: Kegolong'u ninche pooki, nepuoopuo too nkiteenikinot; osuyai ninche o esekenkei, eas ninche pooki ine ntorroni.

English: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
Masaai: Nintayu ilkiintani onom te matua e nkila ti oriong e ntukus nabo, o lkiintani onom te matua e oriong e ntukus e are e nkila.

English: And all the elders of that city, that are next unto the slain man, shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley:
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani pooki leina anasa nataaniki ilo tung'ani otasesekuanaki neituku nkaik enye te nchumata eina ashe natigilaki emurt to erata;

English: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
Masaai: o mukateni neitu eisuijieki o mukateni naamelok neitu eisuijieki naatipikaki eilata, o nkaukau o mukateni neitu eisuijieki naaelieki eilata. Te nkano sidai napuyiapui intayu ninche.

English: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
Masaai: ore ake sii, eitu doi ninye edol enkolong arashu eyiolou toki; netum ake enkiyeng'iyeng alang ninye.

English: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
Masaai: Amu ore taata ategelua nanu, naitisinya ena aji pee etum enkarna ai atobiko tene ntarasi; ore nkonyek aainei o ltau lai neaku ine etii nkatitin pooki.

English: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i, etadoyie Yuda alo aing'uaa ilalashera nelo aitaa elatia oltung'ani obo le Adullam oji enkarna enye Hira.

English: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
Masaai: Ore too wuejitin pooki nashomo nanu tenebo Isiraeli pooki, neitu airo ororei te pooki tung'ani le lelo arishak le Israel, apa laitanapa pee eirrita iltung'ana laainei, ajo, “Kainyoo pee eitu intae kishetakiki enkaji oo ltarakua?” ’

English: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
Masaai: Amu kelo Olaitoriani aitagol Sion; nelo aitagol nene wuejitin pooki apa neeinyalaki, neitotiu ilo purkel lenye anaa Eden, netiu ilo purkel anaa enkurma o Laitoriani; keaku eng'ida o enchipai etumi ti atua ninye, o enkishooroto e nashe o ltoilo lo sinkolio.

English: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip airorie ninye, nelo Enkai aing'uaa Abraham.

English: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
Masaai: Metaa eipoto ine ajo Gilead, ore engape nejo Mispa, ketejo, “Inchoo meing'ura Olaitoriani erishata ai o enino, tinikipuo aalama,

English: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai le lelo ooibor onyek apa ootelekutua too nkolong'i e papaai lenye, neishie ninche teina kop.

English: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Olkitok le nkolong e sabato doi Enkerai e Tung'ani.”

English: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
Masaai: Tinimbung'ubung'u intae nkitanapat aainei, na aitonini ti atua enyorrata ai, anaa enaibung'a nkitanapat e Papa naton ti atua enyorrata enye.

English: And the elders of that city shall take that man and chastise him;
Masaai: Neibung lelo payiani leina anasa ilo lee nepuo aar aaitame,

English: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
Masaai: Ore apa anaa enikitoning'o Musa too mbaa pooki, neijia sii kinko aaning iyie; metaa ake duoo ninye Olaitoriani Enkai ino te nebo iyie, anaa apa enatii te nebo Musa!

English: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
Masaai: Ore pooki arruoisho enye netii Gilgal; teine apa nanu atang'asa aibayu ninche. Ore te nkaraki entorroni oo nkiasin enye aaraa ninche aaitung'uaa enkaji ai. Maigil nanu anyorru ninche; ore lelo kituaak lenye pooki naa larruok.

English: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
Masaai: Amu ninye Enkai ang, nikira iyiook iltung'ana le nkirrita enye, o nkerra e nkaina enye. Te nining'ining'i taata oltoilo lenye!

English: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
Masaai: Kake etukurrakita ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani lolorere metoomonu Barabas, neishooyo Yesu metaari.

English: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
Masaai: Ore pee eyae ilo orora, neng'idayu oltau lenye newuasayu, nenang'ie ninye enkop iltung'ana nkalifuni maa tomon, kake melo ninye amirisho.

English: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Esipa ajoki intae, meetae hoo obo otung'uayie enkaji anaa lalashera anaa nkanashera anaa ng'otonye anaa menye anaa nkera anaa nkurman, te nkaraki nanu o te nkaraki kulo omon supati,

English: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: kake ti niaanyianya nigolong'ung'u, nemuti intae to lalem; amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro.”

English: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
Masaai: neme too ltung'ana pooki, kake te lelo apake ootegelua Enkai te dukuya metaa lchakenini, naa iyiook lelo ootang'arie endaa kiokisho te nebo ninye eidipa atopiu too lootuata.

English: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
Masaai: Olalem olo ashurt nena anas enye, neidaikie ninche tiatua nena wuejitin enye neegol.

English: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu isinkan le Absalom enetii ina kitok ti aji, nejo ninche, “Koree Ahima-as o Yonatan?” Nejoki ina kitok ninche, “Eshomo ninche aalang ereyiet.” Ore ake pee esujaa ninche neitu einepu ninche, neshukunye ninche aapuonu Yerusalem.

English: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
Masaai: Neirragie ninche o metaba anaa nekenyu, anaa enatasayiaka Musa ninche, neitu eng'uoyu neitu ejing ilkuru.

English: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
Masaai: Neeta ilo orika le nkitoo nkedeta ile o ewueji neiteleikini o nkejek e sahabu, neitatashakini ilo orika le nkitoo, ore ake enkalo nabo eilo orika le nkitoo netii ineeiteleikini Nkaik, o lng'atunyo oare ooitashe too mbat nena wuejitin neeiteleikini nkaik.

English: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Masaai: ore to losho le Yuda, naa Kalebu olayioni le Yefune;

English: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
Masaai: Nebuak pooki aaitoki aajo, “Mme ele tung'ani, kake Barabas.” Naa olaisimani apa Barabas.

English: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye te risioroto e nkikena oo lewa ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni ile o iip are.

English: For ye are our glory and joy.
Masaai: Amu irara intae enkitoo ang o eng'ida ang.

English: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
Masaai: Kabolu nanu lkejek le nkare too ldoinyo, o nkonyek oo nkariak ti atua ierat; kaisho nanu ong'ata metaa olchorro le nkare, ore enkop natoyio neruko nkariak.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, shomo, tabaiki enkaji e Israel, niro too rorei laainei airorie ninche.

English: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok lenyena naa kepuo aaitayu isiruai too lmareita lenye, meeta ake olemeeta enkolong enye. Neipotu inkanashera enye pokira uni meetu aadaa te nebo neokisho te nebo.

English: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD'S house.
Masaai: Neitu eidim ilapolosak aatijing atua ina aji o Laitoriani.

English: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
Masaai: Nebau enkiting'oto oo larin oopishana le nkumoi;

English: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
Masaai: neton enkitoo e Nkai to ldoinyo le Sinai neitoip enkatampoi inkolong'i ile; ore te nkolong e naapishana neipot ninye Musa ti atua ina atampoi.

English: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Masaai: Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna baa, Olaitoriani ojo; naa aimaitalaaki nanu kewan to lorere laaijo ele.

English: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
Masaai: Neyau ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani ntokitin apa naaitisinya menye o naaitisinya ninye makewan, enkosholai, o sahabu o masaa.

English: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu lelo ooitorogony intae meinosa nkiri enye maate, nemera eok isargeta lenye anaa ilootooko enaisho oo sabibu. Netum taa pooki toki naishu atayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani, Olaitajeunoni linyi, nara ilo Okordu intae, Ilo Magilani le Yakobo.”

English: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninche, “Te nelang ile Gad o ile Ruben, pooki ng'ae otanape alo enjore te dukuya o Laitoriani, nelang te nebo intae olkeju le Yordan neisulieki ina kop to dukuya intae, ninchosho taa ninche enkop e Gilead metaa enenye;

English: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
Masaai: Ore tembae pooki natii enchankar, neaku ninche ilarishak te risioroto oo nkiguanat aainei. Keibung ninche inkitanapat aainei tenebo inkiguanat too siruai laainei pooki gelunot, neitisiny isabatoni aainei.

English: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
Masaai: Kake eitaa apa Yoshua ninche ina olong ilaiperrak o laokunok le nkare te nkaraki ilo turrur o te nkaraki olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, pee emooki ninche aas ina o metabaiki ena olong, te ine wueji netegelua ninye.

English: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
Masaai: “Neitayu oltoilo le ndarata nkejek oo mbartan, engorori, aang'orori mbartan o larrabal.

English: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Abigail Daudi, neisarrisar ninye, nedou to sikiria, nebatata ninye te dukuya Daudi te nkomom enye, neirrugo abaiki enkop.

English: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.

English: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
Masaai: Neitasheikinye apa lelo tung'ana le Dan ate ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno; naa Yonasan ilo ayioni le Geshom, olayioni le Musa, o layiok lenyena apa ilapolosak lo losho le Dan o metabau ina olong apa natarayoki ilo osho.

English: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina entoning naa, neme enkaraki ake naa iurere engoro e Nkai kake te nkaraki oltoilo lo ltau.

English: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
Masaai: Kake te nabik ti atua ele sesen naa ina naata tipat te intae.

English: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
Masaai: Nejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa ninye nanu aisiaai, teneme napaji Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, anaata maashilaa iyie nemaaing'or iyie.

English: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
Masaai: Neliki taa Yesu ninche aibalakinye nejoki, “Etua Lasaro,

English: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Ulam naa ilmorran magil, oata nkai, neeta nkera kumok, o nkera oo nkera enye, iip nabo o onom. Ore kulo pooki naa ile Benchamen.

English: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
Masaai: Kake kadung'oki enkiguana ilo orere oisinkanishore ejo Enkai. Naa ore te siadi neidurru te ina kop naapuonu aaserem nanu tene wueji.’

English: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
Masaai: Eikitum iyie kuna baa pokira, te nkata nabo, te nkolong nabo; ore keeya oo nkera inono o enkoliasho naa eikitum iyie te nkiputakinoto hoo niata iloibonok kumok o engolon kitok oo lasakutok.

English: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
Masaai: Amu eyau Enkai pooki siaai atua enkiguana, o pooki toki oo nkisudorot, aa sidai arashu torrono.

English: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
Masaai: Ee, inok iyie oltaa lai; Olaitoriani Enkai ai oitawang enaimin ai.

English: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
Masaai: Neirrag ninye aanyisho anaa olaisimani, neponaa ilewa kumok aitaa ilemeisiligayu.

English: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nena anas neitomijooni, neaku ina kop enememanyae; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
Masaai: Iyiololo intae olapa rorei oirriwaka nkera oo Siraeli, otolikioyioki lomon supati lo sotua te Yesu Kristo (olaa ninye Olaitoriani le pooki),

English: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
Masaai: Nerreten Daudi olalem lenye ti oriong olkila lenye lo larrabal, nejo pesho ajo alo, amu eitu apa emoku ninche. neitoki Daudi ajoki Saul, “Maidim nanu ashomo te kuna; amu eitu nanu amoku ninche.” Neitayu Daudi ninche airragie.

English: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ng'ura, etotiwuo oltung'ani anaa obo lang etayiolo isidain o ntorrok; ore tena kata, neidim ninye aitorioki enkaina enye olchani le nkishui ainosa, neishu ninye intarasi.”

English: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
Masaai: Neng'asunye oloitaakaki talanta imiet ayau kulie talanta imiet; nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok kinchoo talanta imiet; ng'ura anoto kulie imiet.’

English: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani osiligi le Israel, ore pooki liking'uaa iyie netum enkurruna; ore lelo likimbelekenya aaing'uaa iyie, neigeri tiatua enkop, too kulukuok amu etanyaita ninche Olaitoriani, ina ong'u enkare naishu.

English: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
Masaai: Entadamu isiaaitin e nking'asia naataasa ninye, mbaa enyena e nking'asia, o nkiguanat naairoro ninye.

English: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
Masaai: Naa teneibelekenya ilo torrono aing'uaa entorroni enye, neas ina naishaakino neas nasipa, neton eishu teina.

English: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
Masaai: Neitadou neirin to lkarasha le kitani, neirragie te nkurare naguetuno to soit, neitu ai kata epiki likae.

English: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
Masaai: kake enchom enetii ntare kiminat e nkaji e Siraeli.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
Masaai: Metaa, ina ejo Olaitoriani, atushukokine Yerusalem to lng'ur sapuk; naa ekesheti enkaji ai tiatua ninye, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani nepiki enkopito e nkitorioroto shumata Yerusalem.

English: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
Masaai: Neipung alo aishir te mion.

English: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
Masaai: Kake ore olayioni lenye kaisho nanu olosho obo, pee etum Daudi osinka lai ataa keeta oltaa te dukuya nanu anaake te Yerusalem, teina anasa nategelua nanu apik enkarna ai.

English: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
Masaai: Kake te neitashe oltung'ani auno to ltau lenye, nemeeta ae naitirrishita, neidim ninye aitoria enkorrok enye makewan, netaasa esupat te neitu eyam ina tito neisho eton meyama.

English: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
Masaai: Ore etii olarrabal erishata e nkaji e Saul o enkaji e Daudi, neitagolito Abna kewan ti atua enkaji e Saul.

English: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.
Masaai: Atataanikia nanu obo le lelo ooitashe te ine naikilikuan esipata naipirta kuna pooki, neaku aatolikio ninye, naaibalakinye nanu enkibalakinoto e kuna tokitin.

English: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.
Masaai: Neilili ninye ilo aiguanani le Ai to lchani o metaa teipa; ore pee eaku kedoyio enkolong neitanapisho Yoshua, neitayu ninche aaitadou osesen lenye to lchani nenang'aki enejing'ieki kishomi e ina anasa nepik shumata ninye osototi kitok loo soito, leton eitashe te ine o taata.

English: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
Masaai: Atonyorrayie nanu openy intae, ilalashera laainei, nchere ebore intae esupatisho, nebore intae eng'eno pooki, naa indimidimi aatuutai olikae olikae.

English: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
Masaai: Neitobir sii ine wueji nesinya aisul, nenyaanyuk enkadoro enye o endapasho eina aji, naa ntemat e nkaina naaudo ake enchoto nabo, nemur ninye te sahabu nasila oo ntalantani iip ile.

English: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
Masaai: Nipolososo ositima obo le kine metaa olasar le ng'oki, o lkuoo oare le kerra lo lari obo anaa lasarri le seriani.

English: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field, and the man force her, and lie with her: then the man only that lay with her shall die:
Masaai: “Kake teneinepu olee enkitok natasayiaki tiong'ata nemir ilo lee ninye neyiolou, naa ilo lee ake otayiolo oye.

English: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
Masaai: Embalie tiatua Yuda, nintudupaa tiatua Yerusalem, nijojo, “Toosho entarumpeta tiatua enkop pooki; nchira tabuaku nijo, ‘Enturrurroto, maape iyiook atua nena ang'itie naasheta sunta!’

English: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
Masaai: Kake mang'amaa nanu shakenisho naing'uaa tung'ani, kake kairo nanu kuna baa pee ijeuu.

English: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Kaitodol nanu esupatisho Hanan olayioni le Nashash, anaa apa enaaitaasa papaai lenye nanu te supatisho.” Neaku eirriwayie Daudi isinkan lenyena pee eitigir ninye ti alo papaai lenye. Nepuonu isinkan le Daudi atua enkop oo Lamori.

English: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
Masaai: Metaa entoning, intae iloshon, niyiolouu, intae ilturrurri, ina nayooki atiu te ninche.

English: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.
Masaai: kaae niyau oltidu niud enkiok enye aipang'ie apudaki enkikenet e kutukaji, naa keaku ninye osinka lino ntarasi. Ore ina aisiaayiani ino ng'oruoi ninko neijia.

English: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
Masaai: omashomo nanu apaashare ninche nayau nanu ninche atua enkop oo lmang'ati lenye; teneitobor naa lelo tauja lenye lememurata neibelekenya teina torroni enye;

English: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
Masaai: Nepuonu iloo loreren naairr ugokino nanu; ore ake pee aaning'oo nanu, naairuk ninche nanu.

English: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika le Nkai apa orikito te dukuya e njore oo Siraeli aiwuang'a nelo siadi ninche; ore ina atampoi naikununo anaa eng'ape neiwuang'a te dukuya ninche neitashe te siadi ninche.

English: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
Masaai: Lo Galatia oomoda, aing'ae natasakuto intae? Amu eibalakinyeki intae tukul enchoto natashoki Yesu Kristo metotiwuo anaa itoduaa too nkonyek inyi maate.

English: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
Masaai: Eidipa ninye aisula ilmalaika amu ore enkarna nanoto naa ninye nalusoo te nenye.

English: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
Masaai: Kuna iishoritin oo layiok le Noa, Shem, o Ham o Yafet, netoikioki ninche ilayiok te siadi olairrag le nkare.

English: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
Masaai: Naajoki ninche nanu, “Ore lelo lekunot ootii olkerenket, apa ooimishote te yararoto, neeta enyamali sapuk o enkurruna. Etuurori esuntai e Yerusalem, ore nchomito enyena netumuta enkima.”

English: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
Masaai: Neitanapi ninye olola le nkaji e papaai lenye pooki, eishoi pooki o nkera, ebaiki nkikompeni o metabaiki nkukurto e nkare.

English: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
Masaai: Kaae nedumunye ninche nepuo te siana enye, tomon oare ile Benchamen o Ishboshet ilo ayioni le Saul, o tomon oare loo sinkin le Daudi.

English: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
Masaai: Neureishoyu ninye neinyototo aisik, nelo Beer-sheba e Yuda neing'uaa osinka lenye teine.

English: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
Masaai: Eroroki Filologo o Yuliaa, Nerea o enkanashe enye, O Olimpa, o lelo sinyat pooki ootii te nebo ninche.

English: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Emintobirakiki intae ate nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nimishetishete nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuno aashu e ng'ape, nimintasheyieyie intae osoit le nkitanyaanyukoto tiatua enkop inyi, pee irrugokinono ninche; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
Masaai: Meetae oloata enyorrata sapuk nalang ena, eji aitayu oltung'ani enkishui enye te nkaraki lchoreta lenyena.

English: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
Masaai: Oltoilo lo Laitoriani oibirunye ing'uesi, near entim aisiajayie, naa ti atua enkaji enye sinyati eishir pooki aajo, “Enkitoo!”

English: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
Masaai: Nikiked emeli te Filipi eishari osirua loo mukateni Nemeisuijieki, nikibau Troas too nkolong'i miet; nikibik nkolong'i naapishana te ine.

English: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu iyie entoki nadung'ishoreki, ng'ejuk, nepi, neeta lala; naa eilo iyie adung ildoinyo niuroo ninche, nintotiu iyie oldoinyo anaa suut.

English: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak lenyena neirriwaa isinkan lenye meyau enkare; nepuonu ninche nchorroi nelau ninche enkare, nerrinyo ninche too imotioo naarook, etukurrutua ninche neidang'a neimulumul ilukuny enye.

English: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
Masaai: peyie atem iloo minyi, nedol isiaaitin aainei too larin artam.

English: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

English: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

English: Then came in all the king's wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.

English: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

English: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
Masaai: Tipika nkoitoi inono Olaitoriani; isiliga ninye, amu eikintaas ninye.

Masaai: Naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et ailepie shumata naayau nanu te nduaata Enkiyang'et e Nkai atua Ilkaldayo, enetii lelo yarunot. Ore ina duaata natoduaa naalo aing'uaa nanu.

English: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

English: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

Masaai: Neitoki Yehoahas aishiraki Olaitoriani, nening Olaitoriani ninye; amu etoduaa ninye ina kibookinoto naibookoki Israel enkop, oina naibooko ninche olaiguanani le Siria enkop.

English: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
Masaai: ebaiki Ekron o metabaiki enaiposha ina apa pooki natii embata e Ashdod, te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.
