English: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
Masaai: Neaku etaarayie Solomon Abiatar pee meitoki aaku olapolosani lo Laitoriani, neitabaya ororei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro ninye eipirta enkaji e Eli te Shilo.

English: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
Masaai: Keitu iyie kibuku nanu anaa kule nikimposhu nanu anaa eng'orno?

English: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
Masaai: Ore apa ilo tungani o enkitok enye meeta apa entoki naishopito nemedol enkurruna.

English: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etubulakita ninye ilkiku; ore enkop nebore entamejoi; ore esuntai enye o soit neturori.

English: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa Abram anaa enatiaaka Olaitoriani ninye, neiriamariyie Lot ninye, eshomo Abram aing'uaa Haran aa oloo larin ntomoni naapishana o imiet.

English: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
Masaai: nejing empeut e ine aapuo Antiokia, enapa wueji neisiligieki ninche empiris e Nkai te nkaraki ina siaai naitabaitie.

English: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
Masaai: Ororei lo Laitoriani ele oirriwaka Yoel olayioni le Petuel.

English: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai aning'ito too nkiyiaa aainei: “Esipa kemijoonu nkajijik kumok, nena ajijik sidain sapuki nememanya.

English: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
Masaai: Ore ninye makewan neton te nkiputakinoto, ore nkera enyena nejung enkop.

English: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
Masaai: Emiaas ae bae to nkesha te nkitokoos. Kake te nkitadounoto e kewan meetae olemeitulusoo olikae aitalang kewan.

English: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
Masaai: Neitaas intae kuna baa amu eitu eyiolou Enkai aashu nanu.

English: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
Masaai: Aaitobirua nanu enkiyang'et Enkai naaisho nanu enkiyang'et e ilo Magilani enkishui.

English: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
Masaai: Neibalunyeki taata te liooroto o Laitajeunoni lang Kristo Yesu, oiwuang'ie keeya neyau puaan o enkiishata e keeya.

English: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
Masaai: ile Osini, olmarei loo le Osini, ile Eri, olmarei loo le Eri;

English: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
Masaai: “Amu etabarnoki pooki lukunya nedung'i pooki munyei; netii nkaik pooki indung'ot ore mpolosi neishopokino ilkuniyiani to sina.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, itodua enaasita ilpayiani le nkaji e Israel tenaimin, pooki tung'ani ake tiatua olgilata lenye too mpishai? Amu ejo ninche, ‘Medol iyiook Olaitoriani, eibayie Olaitoriani enkop.’ ”

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
Masaai: “Metaa, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitokini aajo, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani laa ninye oyaua ailepunye iltung'ana le Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’

English: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
Masaai: Ore ilayiok loo sinkan le Solomon, ilayiok le Sotai, ilayiok le Soferet, ilayiok le Persida,

English: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:
Masaai: “Ore aipotisho nanu nemaaning ninche nanu, ore pee eipotisho sii ninche, nemaning sii nanu ninche” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Masaai: Neaku ilanya naa ng'uarrat e lelero, ning'oru esupatisho o enkirukoto, o enyorrata o eseriani, te nebo lelo ooipot enkarna o Laitoriani to ltau owang.

English: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
Masaai: Nelo Efraim ayiolou enkitok enye, nenutayu ninye neiu enkayioni, neisho ninye enkarna ajo, Beria, enkaraki natijing'a entorroni atua enkaji enye.

English: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
Masaai: Kedemot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Mafaat tenebo ndaat enyena, oo nchoo.

English: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.
Masaai: “Ore te nkiting'oto ake ninye oo larin oopishana nichooyoyo empalakino.

English: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, kaing'or Olaitoriani naanyu nanu Enkai e njeunoto ai; kaaning nanu Enkai ai.

English: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yafet: Pasak, o Bimhal, o Ashfat. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yafet.

English: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn oo looiteng'eni lenyena pokira tomon o aare; ole dukuya Simon oji Petero, o Andrea olalashe lenye; Yakobo le Sebedayo o Yohana olalashe lenye;

English: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
Masaai: Ore eiturrurro te Galilaya nejoki Yesu ninche, “Etaa epiki Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo ltung'ana;

English: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
Masaai: Eibalakinyie ninye Yakobo ororei lenye, eibalakinye inkiguanat o nkitanapat enyena Israel.

English: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
Masaai: Kake ara nanu olkurto, mara oltung'ani; naaikordod iltung'ana, naailap iloreren.

English: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
Masaai: Kalo linyi laatoduaaka ng'ok? Omaa te nairo esipata aainyo pee mikirukuruku intae nanu?

English: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
Masaai: Aaitanap iyie te dukuya Enkai o Kristo Yesu, laa ninye oyooki aiguanare ilooishu o lootuata, o te ina liooto enye,

English: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
Masaai: Neya ilo kitok le rripore Seria olapolosani kitok o Sefania ilo apolosani liare, o lelo arripok le kishomi pokira okuni;

English: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
Masaai: “Kaji nanu aiko tenaapalaki iyie? Aatung'uaitie nanu nkera inono neinosa olmumai te nena neme nkaitin ore aidipa nanu aitotio ninche aitaraposho, neloloito ninche neiturrurrokino nkajijik oo mulayioni.

English: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
Masaai: Kake ore ninye Feliks, amu ketiu anaa ketabaraka ayiolou ena Oitoi, neilitilit, ajoki, “Ore pee edou Lisia, olkitok loo sikarini naadung'oki enkiguana.”

English: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eibalunye Olaitoriani aitabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop: Tiaaki ina tito e Sion, “Ng'ura, eewuo enjeunoto ino; ng'ura, eeta ninye olerrinyore lenye te nebo ninye neeta olekoisiayio lenye te dukuya ninye.”

English: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
Masaai: Ore te neitamei oloikordodisho, neng'enu olmodai ore te neutari oltung'ani ng'en, netum eng'eno.

English: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Finehas ilo apolosani o lelo kituaak lo lturrur o nena lukuny oo lmareita le Israel apa naatii te nebo ninye, lelo rorei ootejo ile Ruben o le Gad o le Manase, neitiship ninche oleng.

English: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.
Masaai: Eng'ura, intae iltung'ana le Israel, intae pooki, enchoru enkikoo inyi o eutaroto inyi tene.”

English: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
Masaai: tenaitaa nanu nkatampo olkila lenye, naitaa enaimin enkimulumulet enye,

English: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
Masaai: neiu Eliud Eleasar neiu Eleasar Matan; neiu Matan Yakobo;

English: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
Masaai: Neitisiny ile Lawi ate aalam ingok, neituku nkilani enye; neishooyo Aron ninche anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitobir Aron osotua lo lningo te nkaraki ninche eituku ninche.

English: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
Masaai: Ti nikijo mikiata ng'ok, ate kilej, nemetii esipata atua iyiook.

English: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
Masaai: Amu mikintanyamal isoito te wueji nitur, nimikintanyamal ing'uesi entim.

English: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
Masaai: Amu kepuonu imelin e Kitim aaitainye ninye olarrabal, naa keureishoyu ninye nerrinyo nelo aigorokino ilo sotua sinyati. Kerrinyo ninye aning lelo ooany ilo sotua sinyati.

English: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
Masaai: Nijoki ina aji kiserut, ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Naaji e Israel, incho eish ilo minong lino pooki,

English: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Wootu oopeny emaape eneliyio, eyeng'iyeng'ata enkiti kata.” Amu aikumok iloopuonu epuo, neaku meeta ninye erishata nainosie endaa.

English: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
Masaai: Neng'amaa sii ninche aajoki, ‘Kanu kitaduaa iyie iata esumash, anaa enkure, anaa ira omoni, anaa minchopo, anaa imuei anaa iena neitu kisiai iyie?’

English: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
Masaai: Eitoreishe apa Solomon te Yerusalem neitore Israel pooki ilarin artam.

English: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
Masaai: “Tasioki toning'ore olintarrikinore eton iriamariri te nkoitoi; pee mikirik enetii oladung'oni le nkiguana nikirikoki oladugoni le nkiguana esikari, nikinang'akini korokoroni.

English: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
Masaai: Ore ilo otiu neijia netabaikia ina aa kenoto earata naba neijia too ltung'ana kumok.

English: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:
Masaai: ore teina anasa neya ilo kitok apa oitasheiki iltung'ana le njore, o ltung'ana imiet lo lkiama lo laiguanani apa ooinepuaki te nkanasa; o laigeroni lo lkitok le njore laa ninye apa oipotuo iltung'ana leina kop, o ltung'ana ntomoni ile loo ltung'ana leina kop apa oonotoki teina anasa.

English: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
Masaai: Mikimbung ildeketa iyie arashu te naa iyata enikiporoki, etiu anaa motonyi naapuo to loing'ang'e nemedou aekata aaitirringa.

English: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Musa, “Ng'ura, eikindaaya iyiook, kiisha iyiook, kiisha iyiook pooki.

English: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
Masaai: neye Abraham etaa olpayian kitok etamorua amitunye, nepiki ninye eneiturrurrorre olorere lenye.

English: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: ore pooki ng'ae oinos nenap entorroni enye, enkaraki naisarkionie ninye entoki sinyati o Laitoriani; ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenye.

English: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kapik nanu ninye enkiyang'et nelo aning olmarenke, nerrinyokino ninye enkop enye makewan, naa kaisho nanu ninye metua to lalem oibung'ita ninye te nkaina enye makewan.’ ”

English: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
Masaai: ajo oi kenya eishoru Enkai te yieunoto enye manoto erishata nabaikinye intae.

English: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee kitupurroitie iyie ilalashera lang iltung'ana le Yuda, neyau olaiguanani o enkaji enye aaitalang'u Yordan, o ltung'ana pooki le Daudi te nebo ninye?”

English: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
Masaai: neibung olkerreti le lelo oreren apa ootarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel, neibung lelo kerreti ooiteng'enishote ilaiguanak le Israel.

English: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
Masaai: Ore naa amu iyiololo aajo meetae oltung'ani oishankarru kuna baa, keishiaakino naaji nigirara, pee miwuapakinono ake aas ai bae namurtana.

English: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.
Masaai: otarayioki apa te Yerusalem te nebo lelo ootarayioki te nebo Yekonia olaiguanani le Yuda, otaarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
Masaai: Nejo likae, ‘Enayamie enkitok, nemaidim naa aeu.’

English: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
Masaai: “Eiyie doi ogil enkaji e Nkai nishet too nkolong'i uni, intajeu kewan; te naa iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tadou to salaba.”

English: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaaitaa iyie kiti ti atua iloreren, eikipuoi aamenu iyie oleng.

English: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
Masaai: Kake ore ilapa tung'ana le njore ootorrinyo Amasia, amitiki epuo olarrabal tenebo ninye, nedoiki nkanas e Yuda ebaiki Samaria o metabaiki Bet-horon, near iltung'ana nkalifuni uni tiatua ninche, neya iyarunot kumok oleng.

English: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
Masaai: Neaku ore apa enkop enye naa ebaiki Aroer, aa ninye apa olomanaa lo erata le Arnon, o ina anasa natii empolos oerata, o ina kop pooki naluaa te mbata e Medeba;

English: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
Masaai: Gibeon, o Rama, o Beerot,

English: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai naa enkolong naa elong'o; naa keishoru ninye omom o enkitoo. Meetae entoki sidai namit Olaitoriani te lelo oopuo too ltauja sidain.

English: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
Masaai: Newal oltung'ani le ine wueji ajo, “Naa kaing'ae papaai lenye?” Metaa etaa endung'et e rashe eji, “Ketii sii ninye Saul atua iloibonok?”

English: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
Masaai: Te neoro enkitoria ti atua, nemeidim ina kitoria aitasho.

English: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
Masaai: Ore lelo asurdaanyak naa keinuaaki enkanasa enkima, kake kerriny iltung'ana ng'eni engoro napi.

English: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
Masaai: nedumunye neim enkalo o loo saen aing'or eneilepunye enkolong o metabaiki Gad-hefer, o metabaiki Et-kasin, nelo o metabaiki Rimon neloja aing'or Nea;

English: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
Masaai: Keitu iyie ining nchere aitobira apa nanu moitie? Ina taata nalotu aas, eji nipuopuo intae aaitaa nkanas naasheta osototi loo mauti.

English: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
Masaai: Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, nchoo nanu maaishori mpala nayaki ilbalusuni le lido kekun otii lido kerenket olkeju, pee aaisho ninche nanu maima ina kop o matabai Yuda;

English: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
Masaai: Ore erubata oo lukuny oo lmareita, ina kata pee epuonu enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem, neishoru nkishorot olpela te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai, pee esheti ninye te wueji enye;

English: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
Masaai: Amu ena shakenisho ake oo ltoiloishi loo ltauja lang kingidare, nchere ore ti atua ltung'ana, neisul ti atua intae, kintoriokito iyiook aairo sipat naaisho Enkai iyiook, naa te mpiris e Nkai mme te nkarriyiano e ng'eno e tung'ani.

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: olkine obo oaku olasar loo ngok.

English: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
Masaai: o Ebron, o Rehobu, o Hamon, o Kana o metabaiki Sidon Kitok;

English: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
Masaai: Nemany apa Israel enkop oo le Amori.

English: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
Masaai: Iya iyie ilanterera kumok aun te nkurma, naa ilkuti ake ilo aisampu tiatua; amu kelotu olmaati nemut ninche.

English: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
Masaai: ore ninye te nebatata nemepetikino enkop amu Olaitoriani oibung enkaina enye.

English: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
Masaai: nedumunye iltung'ana pooki oopi, nepuo enkewarie pooki, neitayu osesen le Saul o seseni loo layiok lenyena aaitung'uaa esuntai e Bet-shan; nepuonu ninche Yabesh nepejoo ninche te ine.

English: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
Masaai: Ore pee einosaki nena pooki naatotiwuo neirriwaa ninche Yopa.

English: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore nena girran e kulo tung'ana ootaasa eng'oki aainosie enkishui enye, nchoo ninche eidong'unyeki ngirran naaiteleikini olasar, amu eishorutua apa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani; metaa kesinya ninche. Neaku kepuo ninche aaku enkitanyaanyukoto too ltung'ana le Israel.”

English: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
Masaai: “Ilalashera laainei o loo papa, entoning'oki te kuna namitunye kewan te dukuya intae.”

English: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
Masaai: Entalang enchom Kalne entodol; nidumunyenye te ine aapuo Hamat kitok; nintokiki aapuo Gat oo Lfilisti. Keikash ninche aalang kuna kitoriat pooki aashu aisapuk enkop enye alang enkop inyi.

English: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
Masaai: “Kaing'ae ele, oilepu anaa olkeju le Nail, anaa ilkejek ooilugo nkariak?

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Miomon tenkaraki olmabarishoi le kulo tung'ana.

English: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Darias aigeroki iloreren pooki, o nkuapi pooki o nkutukie pooki naatii enkop pooki ajo: “Metoponikini intae eseriani.

English: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.
Masaai: ng'ura ore taata, kaalaku nanu aitung'uaa lelo pisia ootii nkaik inono. Tenidol eishiaakino te iyie pee ilo tenebo nanu Babilon, wou, anaa kaalo nanu agolie; kake tenidol ajo meishiaakino nilotu tenebo nanu Babilon, nimilotu. Ng'ura ajo etii enkop pooki dukuya iyie; shomo eneba anaa enidol ajo sidai neishiaakino nilo.

English: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD'S anger.
Masaai: Eng'oru Olaitoriani, intae pooki oobor lena kop, lelo ooas nkitanapat enyena; eng'oru esupatisho, eng'oru emborron; eidimayu neisudori intae te ina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani.

English: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
Masaai: Amu eibalunye enkutuk ai esipata; ore intorrok naa olminong te nkutuk ai.

English: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
Masaai: ning'orishosho, naa tenepuonu ntoyie e Shilo aaranyisho to sinkolio, nimpang'ung'u tiatua enkurma oo sabibu, neibung ake pooki lee enkitok enye aya, te nena toyie e Shilo, nelo enkop e Benchamen.

English: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
Masaai: Nikimbung iyiook nkanas enyena teina kata nikindaikie tukul pooki anasa, ilewa, o nkituaak, o nkera; meetae hoo obo otung'uayioki eishu.

English: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aatisira nanu too ndapi oo nkaik aainei, etii isunta inono anaake dukuya nkonyek aainei.

English: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kaleb olayioni le Yefune naa: Iru, o Ela, o Naam; ore ilayiok le Ela naa Kenas.

English: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
Masaai: Ore pee edol neserem ninye; kake eing'asha kulikae.

English: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
Masaai: nikitumutumu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaitopok nanu intae naiturrur intae aitung'uaa iloshon pooki o wuejitin pooki apa naterewa intae, Olaitoriani ojo, narrinyu nanu intae ayau ine wueji apa naterewa intae enchom eyararoto.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Tiaaki ninche, Emilep aapuo olarrabal amu matii nanu atua intae, pee memiri ake intae te dukuya ilmang'ati linyi.’

English: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
Masaai: Nikiyautua iyiook olasar lo Laitoriani, entoki ake ninye nanoto oltung'ani, ntokitin e sahabu, ilkataarri o mankek, o ilgiso, o sakankarri, o saen, pee kipuonu aaitobiraki ate osotua lo lning'o te dukuya Olaitoriani.”

English: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ninchooyo ninche te dukuya Olaitoiriani, naa keisuaaki ilapolosak emunyan shumata ninche neitayu ninche anaa olasar opejori aitaiki Olaitoriani.

English: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu ina kitok oldoinyo ine netii oltung'ani le Nkai, neibung ninye nkejek enyena, nelotu Gehasi aiwuang'ie ninye. Kake etejo ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Tapala ninye, amu etii ninye atua osina ogol; neisudoyie Olaitoriani tialo nanu. Neitu aaliki nanu.”

English: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu, netumo ilapolosak pooki o lpayiani lo lorere neiguanare pee ear Yesu metua.

English: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani ewaita kulo tung'ana inkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin nemeishu aapik iltauja lenye, nepik entoki narrueshisho oo ntorrok enye dukuya nkomomi enye; kaisho kewan maikilikuanishore tukul ninche?

English: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
Masaai: Aing'ae oshal paa nanu lemeshal? Eimang'arie sii nanu ina shalan enye? Omaa te nebatata likae, eimaanya osina?

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina olong naa keramat oltung'ani enkashe o nkerra are;

English: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ruel, Nahat, o Serak, o Shama o Miisa.

English: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
Masaai: te nebau enkata nairirikino; ore barakinoto enye naa keyooki aiturrur pooki toki naitayioki metaa nabo tiatua Kristo, ntokitin naatii shumata o naatii enkop.

English: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
Masaai: nejoki Aaron, ‘Ntobiraki iyiook inkaitin naarik iyiook; amu ore ele oji Musa, otorikuo iyiook aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo inaanoto ninye.’

English: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu ajo te ina kata, “Aaisho iyie enashe, Papa Olaitoriani le shumata o enkop, amu isudorie kuna baa iltung'ana ng'eni niboloki nkera.

English: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
Masaai: Ore eton ake meiruk te nkaraki eng'ida e nking'asia nejoki ninche, “Iatata tene toki nanyae?”

English: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.
Masaai: Nemeetae apa olakordunoni amu kelakuaniki apa ninye Sidon, nemetii apa kulikae tung'ana ooata enabaikinore ninche. Etii atua oerata le Bet-rehob. Neitoki apa ninche aashet ina anasa nemany atua.

English: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
Masaai: Kake eshomo olmoruo lenye te nebo ninye, eishir asujaa ninye te nkoitoi pooki o metabai Bahurim. Nejoki Abna ninye, “Shomo, torrinyoyu;” nerrinyo ninye.

English: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia etarayioki ninye neyae, eshomo ninye eyararoto, ore nkera enyena neitaaki ndung'udung'ot, te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi kitok, amu etooshoki enkukuo oo ltung'ana lenyena ooyanyiti, ore iltung'ana lenyena pooki kituaak eteenaki too lpisia.

English: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
Masaai: Neibung ninche nkanas, ore te pooki kop sidai, nenang'aki pooki tung'ana osoit, ometaba anaa neiput isoito. Neibooyo pooki ong'u naruko enkare, neuroo ilkeek pooki sidain, ometaba anaa niaaku isoito ake ootelekutua te Kiharet. Neng'adu ilang'orok loo soito te nkopito ine neisulie.

English: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel's father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan nedumunye ninche tadekenya nenapa ninye pee elo; kake etiaaka menye ina tito olaputani lenye, “Ntagolo kewan inosa endaa, ore te siadi ina nitum taa ashomo.”

English: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.
Masaai: Neyau Delila lelo goso ng'ejuko neen ninye te ninche, nejoki ninye, “Kipuonu Ilfilisti aaibung, Samson!” Ore apa iltung'ana ooisudori netii olgilata ti atua aji, nedung lelo goso too nkaik enyena anaa eusi.

English: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
Masaai: Ore ilng'oborri loo laikonyak neeta eseriani, ore lelo ooitagor Enkai neserian, lelo ooen Enkai enye aapik enkaina enye.

English: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Amu eikitok enyorrata enye nauno ti alo iyiook; ore esipata o Laitoriani mebikoo ntarasi. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
Masaai: Kake iatata olkerreti lalaakinye intae oltung'ani obo te Pasaka. Iyieuu nalaaki intae olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?”

English: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Metaa atubukuo nanu engoro ai shumata ninche; atumuta nanu ninche te nkima engoro ai napi; ore enkoitoi enye eitalakua too lukuny enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu Petero, “Inyaaki olalem lino enchashur. Amaa enkikompe naaishoo Papa, ai ninye maok?”

English: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
Masaai: Eikilang iyiook olkeju le Yordan kitanapate te dukuya Olaitoriani aapuo enkop e Kanaan, ore ina jung'ore ang niking'uaa te lido kekun le Yordan.”

English: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
Masaai: Ore eomonito Esra neirridu, neishir, nenang'ie kewan enkop te dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani, neiturrurrokino ninye eumata sapuk oo lewa, o nkituaak o nkera, eing'uaa Israel, amu eishira lelo tung'ana te mion.

English: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo tung'ana, lelo lewa le Israel eitagoluote, neitoki aaluaakino olarrabal te ine wueji netoluare te nkolong e dukuya.

English: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, eetuo iloreren pooki le nkop Misiri enetii Yosef aainyiang'u ilpaek, amu aitorrono apa olameyu te nkop pooki nalulung'a.

English: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu olkitok obo, nejoki, “Iyau nabo kata Mikaia olayioni le Imala.”

English: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo tung'ana ooyiolo embuakunoto o sinkolio lo sirua, lelo, Olaitoriani, oopuo te wang'an e nkomom ino,

English: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Neitanapa Yeremia Baruk, nejoki, “Aateenaki nanu pee malo enkaji Enkai;

English: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
Masaai: Tushumu nkonyek inono toduaa lelo oopuonu ooing'uaa moikuape. Koree ina luaata apa nikinchooki iyie, ina luaata ino sidai?

English: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
Masaai: naa kashukoki Misiri entonata enye e apake, nashukoki ninche ina kop e Patros, ina kop naa ninye apa eing'uaa; neaku ninye teine enkitoria nashal.

English: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
Masaai: Ayau ninche aitung'uaa Misiri o Asiria enkang enye nalotu aitamany ninche enkop enye. Ekaitamany sii ninche enkop e Gilead o Lebanon, o metaa meekure eeta enkop enemanyi te nkumoi o lorere.

English: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hephzibah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomon oare apa Manase pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin onom o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Hefasiba.

English: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
Masaai: Neaku itobiko intae te Kadesh nkolong'i kumok, te nena olong'i apa nitobiko intae teine.

English: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
Masaai: Kake etanya Yesu nejoki, “Shomo ang enetii ilchoreta linono, toliki ninche eneba enikintaasa Olaitoriani, o eneikuna pee king'urrie.”

English: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
Masaai: Nabatata te nkop naning oltoilo laajoki, ‘Saulo Saulo aainyo pee kisilisil?’

English: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
Masaai: kake ore ilo tung'ani oibung ninche neeta esekenkei o enchata e mpere, nemuti ninche tukul te nkima.”

English: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Eisidain mbaa ti alo ilo barnoti Absalom?” Newalu Ahimaas ejo, “Ore pee eirriwaa Yoab osinka lino, nadol enking'oling'ol sapuk, kake mayiolo nanu ajo kainyoo.”

English: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata eirrag olaiguanani to lorika lenye dapash, neitorropil esonkoyo ai ine.

English: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Masaai: Noa, o Shem, o Ham o Yafet.

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam araposhoki, nejo, “Inyo, Balak, toning'o; toning'oki nanu ara Sipor:

English: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo, ore apa miyiololo Enkai, nkitanyaanyukot nemeiro erikokini intae, te na oitoi o ti ae.

English: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
Masaai: Ore ine nemetii enaibon e Nkai nebatata iltung'ana amu meeta enasujita. Kake emayiana ilo oibung enkitanapata.

English: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Etobiko sii apa te nkalo o loo saen ometabaiki olpolosie lo lpurkel tena shoto e Frati, amu etoponari apa nkishu enye te nkop e Gilead.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu te yieunoto e Nkai, enetii lelo sinyat ooisiligayu tiatua Kristo Yesu:

English: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
Masaai: Neiteru enchankar tiatua ninche maate ejo kalo lenye olkitok te pooki.

English: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat netum omom to Laitoriani, kake ore oltung'ani oipiru intorrok naa kedung'okini enkiguana.

English: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
Masaai: Ira iyie Olaiguanani lai o Enkai ai, naa iyie oisho Yakobo metimirisho.

English: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
Masaai: nimiaatata ororei lenye eton ti atua intae, amu ore ilo oirriwua ninye nimirukuruku.

English: And she said, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Eshomo enkitoo aing'uaa Israel, amu eibung'aki osanduku le Nkai.”

English: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani, ntayioloki nanu enkiting'oto ai, o eneikununo enkikenata oo nkolong'i aainei; ntayioloki nanu enkisarrisar e nkishui ai!

English: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nipik iyie olbani osila tenebo ake olkereri, pee etum atupudare ina mukate anaa erubata nadamuni napuoi aaisho Olaitoriani te nkima.

English: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Aha, iroro taata aibalie, neme te nkitanyaanyukoto iroro.

English: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
Masaai: Amu kamitu nanu ena anasa aitajeu tenkaraki kewan ai o tenkaraki o sinka lai Daudi.”

English: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu te na oitoi eishori intae esipata te leng'on entijing atua enkitoria oo ntarasi o Laitoriani lang naa Olaitajeunoni Yesu Kristo.

English: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
Masaai: Mme apa loo papa eitobirie Olaitoriani Enkai ang ele ning'o lo sotua, kake iyiook, kulo pooki ootii ene ooishu ena olong.

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, te nebo ilo asar lenye le leilo sotua lo lning'o o ilo asar le anaake opejori, o ilo asar lenye le ntapa, o lasarri lenye ooki.

English: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
Masaai: “Keipiru ilayiok lenyena olarrabal neiturrur olorora kitok le njore laa keilepu alotu neimisie neim atua, nereu ninye olarrabal o metabaiki osempewuet lenye.

English: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
Masaai: Nening olaiguanani oji Herode ina; amu etayioloki enkarna e Yesu. Nejo kulikae, “Eitopiwuoki Yohana Olaibatisani too lootuata; ina pee easisho ena golon ti atua ninye.”

English: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
Masaai: Anaa enaibalunye enkare enkomom ino tining'or, neija etiu endamunoto oltung'ani eutu ilo tung'ani enatiu.

English: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
Masaai: Ekaisho iltung'ana kumok meing'asiata te nkaraki iyie, ore ilaiguanak lenye neilanyisho te nkaraki iyie, ina kata naiwul olalem lai te dukuya ninche; naa keikirikira pooki kata, pooki ng'ae te nkaraki enkishui enye, teina olong' embatatata ino.

English: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
Masaai: Ore ake sii apa te nena olong'i, eirriwaitie ilkituaak le Yuda mpala aairriwaki Tobia, neirriwaki sii ninye Tobia ninche mpala.

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Mepuonu iltung'ana aailepu oldoinyo le Sinai; amu iyie enkorrok ino oitanapa iyiook, ajo, ‘Entayu ilpolosien to ldoinyo, nintisinyinyi ninye.’ ”

English: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
Masaai: Neitashe enkolong aitirring'a, neuno olapa, o metaba anaa neitalaku ilo osho elap too lmang'ati lenye. Aimeigero ena ti atua embuku e Yashar? Eitasho enkolong te mpolos e shumata, neitu eitasim adoyio te ndama pooki.

English: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
Masaai: Ore sii iltung'ana le Yuda naa keara emitu Yerusalem. Naa kearu ninche enkarsisisho oo loshon pooki oomanita sahabu, o enkosholai tenebo inkilani te nkumoi.

English: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
Masaai: Kake ore pee mikintagor, shomo iyie enaiposha tanang'aki erreshet nintayu osinkirri ling'as aibung; nibol enkutuk, nitum shekeli, niya aitainye kodi ai o enino.”

English: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
