English: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani lemeeta tipat neitobiru enkarruoisho, ore ilomon lenyena netiu anaa enkima nadalisho.

English: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore ilo tung'ani torrono nedamu entorroni, nenuta ninche ntabo, neiu elejare.

English: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
Masaai: Eiputa aadooyo to ltau lai ilomon supati; naliki nanu olaiguanani irorei lo sinkolio lai; eikununo olng'ejep lai aanaa enkalamu o lasirani arriyia.

English: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
Masaai: Nebulu ina ayioni Samuel to sesen netum omom to Laitoriani o too ltung'ana.

English: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
Masaai: Neaku etamanya apa Isaak Gera.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu intaa ing'ok inono inaadamuni, te ina nemeekure eisudoroyu intorrok inono, neaku ore too siaaitin inono pooki naa keibalayu ing'ok inono; amu ieuo iyie adamu; naa aikiya ninche iyie.

English: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
Masaai: Eirriwayie Olaitoriani olkilikuai lo larrabal te nkaraki Yakobo, naa kelo aitawang'aki Israel.

English: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
Masaai: Neitoki ake aomon, neishoru shumata enchan, neiu enkop ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
Masaai: Maton nanu te nebo iltung'ana torrok, nemashulare nanu isunkuro.

English: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
Masaai: o lmong'i tomon oopir, o nkishu o lokeri tikitam naapir, o nkerra iip, ore tenebo nena, ng'uesi naanyanyukie nkoliin, o ronkon, o motonyi naapir.

English: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
Masaai: Mepalaa Olaitoriani aisho meshomo ajing engolon enye, aashu eisho metudung'oki ninye enkiguana te neyauni aaiguanare.

English: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
Masaai: Nikiyen iyiook ate aaitupukoo, nikisai Enkai ang tena bae, nening ninye esayiata ang.

English: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
Masaai: Metaa meitoki enkishui enye ang'uar endaa ore enkoshoke enye nemeitoki aayieu endaa.

English: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
Masaai: “Amaa keiriamari iltung'ana oare te nebo te neitu ening'o?

English: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
Masaai: “Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, imbonoki tigilunore Gog, nijoki: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, ekaarare iyie, iyie Gog, ilo arikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal;

English: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
Masaai: Neitoki ayau ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki; ore Aron o layiok lenyena neiteleiki nkaik enye endukuya eilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki.

English: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ninche ina, neing'asia, neirut ninche, nedumunye aaisik;

English: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
Masaai: o Abdon, o Sikri, o Hanan,

English: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
Masaai: Tenining iyie kuna kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino naaitanap nanu ena olong, anyorru Olaitoriani Enkai ino, alo too nkoitoi enyena, nimbung nkitanapat enyena o nkikoot o nkiguanat nitum taa atopuaa nibul, nikimayian Olaitoriani Enkai ino tiatua ina kop nijing'ita alo aya.

English: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
Masaai: “Tuuno iyie enanka te nkop, toosho entarumpeta tiatua iloreren, ntobiraki nkuapi olarrabal tialo ninye, mpotoki ninye nkitoriat meetu aarare ninye, Ararat, o Mini, o Askenas; Entegelu olarikonile njore oarare ninye. Eyautu mbartan naaba anaa olmaati.

English: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
Masaai: Ore ina sabato ena kop naa keisho intae endaa intae maate, o rrindiki linyi loo lewa o loo ng'oruo o sinkan lo lmushaara oilo omoni oton tenebo iyie;

English: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
Masaai: Nchoo naa taata eyiolou olaiguanani nchere, teneigili aashet ena anasa neidipayu isunta, meitoki ninche aalak kodi; anaa mpisai olpolosie anaa ine nkoitoi, ore mpisai enkitoria nengoroo.

English: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
Masaai: Te neinosieki iyiook osina keji pee eilejileji intae neitajeuni; naa te neilejileji iyiook kejo Enkai pee eilejilej intae ti nintasheshe to sina leeijo ele likitii;

English: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.
Masaai: Kake itanyaita intae ena olong Enkai inyi, ilo oitajeu intae ti atua isinaitin linyi pooki o loisilisili; nitejo intae, ‘A-a, kake tipika olaiguanani shumata iyiook.’ Ore naa taata eyautu ate dukuya Olaitoriani too loshon linyi o too nkalifuni inyi.”

English: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
Masaai: Kake ti niomon iyie, tijing'a olgilata lino, ore pee indip aikeno kutuk aji niomon Papa lino too nkisudorot, ore Papa lino odol too nkisudorot naa aikilaaki iyie.

English: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eng'or enkiti kata eton atii te nebo intae, pee aitoki alo enetii ilo laairriwua.

English: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
Masaai: “Iakuku intae iltung'ana ooitisinyaki te nkaraki nanu; metaa eminyanya inkiri oo ng'uesi naatara lowuarak, enchoo ildiein.

English: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
Masaai: Tadamu isinkan linono, Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo; mishilaa engolon enkong'u ele orere, aashu ntorrok enye, aashu eng'oki enye,

English: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
Masaai: Naa ninye likintotio iyie tiong'ata teina mana apa nemeyiolo loo papaai linyi; pee kitum aitoborro nikitem iyie, pee kitum ninye aitaasa esidai te siadi.

English: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
Masaai: Ore ilo otoduaa neyietu ajo: “Te nchumata oltalet orripishoreki nanu aitashe, anaake te ndama iyie o Laitoriani. Ore te siaai ai natii nanu nkewaritin pooki.

English: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
Masaai: Neewuo ninye te ntorroni enkiseroto agilunore inkitanapat aainei alang iloreren, negilunore ninye inkitanapat aainei alang nkuapi naamanita ninye, te anyata natanyaita inkitanapat aainei neitu epuoyie nkikoot aainei.

English: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
Masaai: Ore enkurma naikenoro naa enkanashe ai, esiankiki ai, enkurma naikenoro enchorro naripa.

English: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani naa olasipani; etudung'o ninye nkeenta e ilo arruoni.

English: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
Masaai: Ketotiwuo enjung'ore ai anaa emotonyi narreshitoi, kemanita ninye motonyi naareshito too nkaloli pooki? Shomo inturrurro ing'uesi pooki e ntim iyau ninche meetu aapolol aainos.

English: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo loo papaai linyi naa keaku ilayiok linono; naa ilo iyie aitaa ninche kituaak te nkop pooki.

English: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
Masaai: Nimipuopuo intae boo aaipang te kutukaji ele ng'obor le ntumo, pee miyeye ake; amu ore eilata o Laitoriani naputishoreki netii shumata intae.” Neas ninche te risioroto o rorei le Musa.

English: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
Masaai: Keibelekenya olosho nkaitin enyena, hoo duoo ninye neme nkaitin? Kake eibelekenya iltung'ana laainei enkitoo enye, teina nemeretisho.

English: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Wootu enatii nanu, entaretuoki nanu, emataar iyiook Gibeon; amu eitobira ninye eseriani o Yoshua o te nebo iltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.
Masaai: Eing'orua apa ninye Olaitoriani, too nkolong'i e Sakaria, laa ninye oiteng'ena ninye te uriata o Laitoriani; naa ore anaa enaserem Olaitoriani neisho Enkai ninye metubula.

English: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Ore pooki ng'ae ong'amu ena kerai te nkarna ai, nanu etang'amua, ore oloisul te nkitisho ti atua intae, naa ninye oisul te nkitoo.”

English: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
Masaai: Kake etegelua ninye Paulo Sila, nepuo, neitanap ilalashera ninche neomonoki empiris e Nkai.

English: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ajoki ninche, “Ore pooki aitubului neme Papa le shumata otuuno kedotuni.

English: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
Masaai: Ketaa naa iyiook ooibelekeny nekua kitanapat te na kirukoto? Mme neijia! Ore enatii, nkitanapat kintudupaa.

English: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
Masaai: Ore apa peyie eaku Isaak moruo oleng metaa eiliilaitie inkonyek metaa meekure edolisho neipotu Esau olkikau lenye, nejoki ninye, “Enkerai ai” neng'amaa menye ajoki, “Nele nanu.”

English: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
Masaai: Nepik Daudi enkaina atua olbene lenye neitayu osoit, nepik enkopito, neyuk ninye, nenang ilo Filisti olpura le nkomom enye; neimis ilo soit ti atua olpura le nkomom enye, nebatata ninye te nkomom enye aosh enkop.

English: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
Masaai: neeta apa ninye emaupe o suyai neishopito olkila lo lgoo lo suyai le shekeli nkalifuni imiet.

English: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Abraham, “Ore Sarai enkitok ino, mintoki aipot ninye ajo Sarai, kake keaku keji enkarna enye Sara.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Mipuopuo intae aarare ilalashera linyi. Torrinyoyu pooki tung'ani shomo enkang enye, amu ore ena bae naa nanu eing'uaa.” Neaku etoning'o ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, nerrinyo neitu epuo aarare Yeroboam.

English: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ore endaa ai naa te naas eyieunoto e lido laairriwua, naidip esiaai enye.

English: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
Masaai: o te nena sidain naaimu lelo doinyo oina borei naing'uaa nena doinyo musan oo ntarasi

English: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
Masaai: Neitoki ake olbalusui ajoki ninche, “Kaing'ae te kulo pokira aare iyieuu nalaaki intae?” Nejo, “Barabas.”

English: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
Masaai: Neing'oru ninye aitobiru inkilani too lpapit loo ntare tenebo o enkatani neasisho too nkaik to ltau le nyorrata.

English: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
Masaai: “Tenisampu enkurma nituturo te nkop ino, nimisampu aitabaiki ineebayie nimishuko alo agilu lelo ng'osil ootung'uayioki.

English: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
Masaai: Eturrumoyioki iyiook kiaata enchata oo murto nanapishoreki too murto. Kinaurate iyiook neitu eishori iyiook enkiyeng'iyeng.

English: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
Masaai: Neaku eishoo apa Hiram Solomon mbaoi pooki oltarakuai o lerai naaba anaa inaayieu,

English: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Keeta oltau lai osina kitok oba anaa keeya; entotoni tene enchololoto.”

English: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
Masaai: Ore Ishmael, aatoning'o iyie, ng'ura, kamayian nanu ninye naitubulaa naponaa oleng. Naa keaku ninye menye ilaiguanak tomon aare, naa kaitaa ninye olosho sapuk.

English: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
Masaai: Naa ore tialo iyie, tenilo te dukuya nanu, anaa apa Daudi papaai lino, nias te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa nanu, nimbung nkikoot aainei, o nkiguanat aainei,

English: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari liare le nkitoria e Yoash olayioni le Yoahas, olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru aitoreisho Amasia olayioni le Yoash, ilo aiguanani le Yuda.

English: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
Masaai: Ntaraposho iyiook anaake tadekenya te ina nyorrata ino nauno, pee kitum aating'idata nikishipa too nkolong'i ang pooki.

English: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
Masaai: Ninye oirriu ororei lenye, neshol lelo soito; neisho osiuo lenye metukutunye, neruko nkariak.

English: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
Masaai: Ore pee eigutaa penyo nedol kulikae alashera oare. Yakobo le Sebedayo, o Yohana olalashe lenye, ti atua empeut eboitare papaai lenye Sebedayo, eripita irresheta lenye neipot ninche.

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
Masaai: Ee kake aiyia ntae! amu itiuu anaa nkuraren nemelioo, naaitunyoo ltung'ana meyiolo.”

English: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
Masaai: Ore iyiook, pooki nikitaa ilemeimula nkomomi, nikiwariwaru anaa kiok teina kishiaa o Laitoriani, eibelekenyitai iyiook matotiuo anaa ninye eponari ake ina kishiaa. Enkias o Laitoriani, ena naa Enkiyang'et ninye.

English: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
Masaai: ejoito, “Keyiataki ele tung'ani olorere pee eserem Enkai te nkoitoi nemeishoruno too nkitanapat.”

English: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
Masaai: Netumo lkipaareta o lpayiani te nebo aaimaki ena bae.

English: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
Masaai: neyau olkitok lenye enetii Enkai, neyau ninye kutuk aji arashu ntaloishin e kutuk aji neud olkitok lenye enkiok enye to ltidu; neisiaai ninye te nkishui pooki.

English: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
Masaai: Kake te nerasaki ologol alang ninye nemir, neoru masaa o larrabal duoo naawuasare, nelo aor iyarunot naatarua.

English: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
Masaai: Nebatata aosh enkop nening oltoilo ojoki, “Saulo, Saulo, aainyoo pee kinosie osina?”

English: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooikirikirate too rorei le Nkai e Israel, tenkaraki nemeisiligayu lelo ootorrinyunye te yararoto, neiturrurro naaman nanu, ina kata aitashe aiputukuny ometabau olasar le nteipa.

English: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
Masaai: Nimisarkionienie ake enkarna ai sinyati, kake kaayanyituni nanu tiatua iltung'ana le Israel: Ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny intae,

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa ina kata,

English: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
Masaai: Etabawua taata enkiting'oto shumata iyie, naa kabolu engoro ai meeu shumata iyie naa kaaiguanare iyie anaa enaikununo inkoitoi inono; naa kaaitame iyie to lminong lino pooki.

English: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
Masaai: o Hanan olayioni le Maaka o Yoshafat le Mitini,

English: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
Masaai: tenemedaa too ldoinyo arashu edumu inkonyek enyena aing'or nena aitin nemeishu enkaji e Israel, nemeisarkionie enkitok olelatia enye arashu elo enetii enkitok te nkata enye oloirerio,

English: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Emiureishoyu; enchom entoliki ilalashera laainei meshomo Galilaya naa kaadol te ine.”

English: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.
Masaai: Osinkolio loo sinkolioitin laa ole Solomon,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
Masaai: Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, “Teneiduruk ake ninye oltung'ani tiatua intae, anaa olayioni le ishoi inyi, eiseyie oltung'ani otua, ana elakua te lototo enye apa nashomo, naa keibung ake pasaka.

English: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
Masaai: Ilmoda ninche, le ishoi oo larruok, etaarayioki ninche aaipang'ie te nkop.

English: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
Masaai: “Kemayiani olbene lino oina tapa ino naipurjaki.

English: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
Masaai: Etii apa te nkata naado olarrabal te rishata enkaji e Saul o enkaji e Daudi; neponari Daudi agolu edoyio enkaji e Saul ashalu.

English: And they shall say unto the elders of his city, This our son is stubborn and rebellious, he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton, and a drunkard.
Masaai: nejoki ninche lelo payiani leina anasa enye, ‘Ore ele ayioni lang kegolong'u naa marmali, mening iyiook, olalotoni naa olamerani.’

English: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
Masaai: Kaa kenya iasiasa teina olong o sirua, o teina olong o sirua lo Laitoriani?

English: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
Masaai: Amu etiaakita Ilkigerot Farao, “Nanu laailepie naa kajo paa te iyie aitoduaaya engolon ai, nelikiori enkarna ai tiatua enkop pooki.”

English: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
Masaai: Neipotu Olaitoriani Musa, neirorie ninye teilo ng'obor le ntumo, ejo,

English: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
Masaai: Mimputukuny te nkaraki ninche; amu etii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi empolos inyi, ina Ai kitok naitureisho.

English: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron o Miriam, “Entupuku wootu, intae pokira uni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.” Neipang'u pokira uni aapuonu.

English: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
Masaai: Etii likae laaishakenoki, nayiolo ajo ore ilo laaishakenoki kesipa shakenisho enye.

English: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ‘Embung'a Sabatoni aainei amu olmonekie ele te rishata ai o ntae ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere, nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny intae.

English: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia; Aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e keper, nkitoriat pooki enkop, naaitanapa ninye nanu pee ashetaki ninye enkaji te Yerusalem, te nkop e Yuda.

English: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
Masaai: Meyiolo apa menye o ng'otonye nchere Olaitoriani eing'uaa ina; amu keing'oru apa ninye erishata naarie Ilfilisti. Ore apa ina kata naa Ilfilisti ooitore Israel.

English: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
Masaai: Ore olonyor enkishui enye neiminie, ore oloibayu enkishui enye te nkop nerrip ti atua enkishui nemeish.

English: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
Masaai: Te nkiririkinoto iyie intamio ninche, airreu ninche meshomo eyararoto; iwuang'ie ninche te ngoro ino napi, te ina olong o lkutati lo loo saen.

English: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
Masaai: Neitoki ake te siadi aiu entito neipot enkarna enye ajo Dina.

English: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
Masaai: Naikilikuanu naa ajo, amaa, amu etabatatate Ilyahudi teine metaa meekure esarunoyu? Mme neijia pae! Kake enkaraki natagolo onyek pee eewuo enjeunoto Loreren, peyie epiki Siraeli olom.

English: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu naikirikira, naaonyo enkutuk, teilo toilo latoning'o. Neng'ueyu iloik laainei tiatua nanu, neikirikira nkejek aainei. Kaitirring'a nanu aanyu enkolong e nyamali, pee elotu shumata lelo oorasaki iyiook.

English: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
Masaai: Kake etiaka ninye ilo, “Etii apa oltung'ani oitobira osirua kitok, neipot iltung'ana kumok,

English: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
Masaai: nincho inkiyiaa inono einining aasipu eng'eno, nirrugu oltau lino aaku oloyiolou;

English: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
Masaai: laa ninye eipotieki olmarei ake pooki te keper o te nkop,

English: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana apa oata imasaa o larrabal nepuo te dukuya lelo apolosak ooshito imouarak ore lelo ootii siadi nesuju ilo sanduku, eoshito imouarak.

English: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
Masaai: Netii enkoiboni naji Ana ene Fanuel, o losho le Asheri: naa entasat moruo, naa larin oopishana ake etotona eeta, olmoruo.

English: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
Masaai: Tenaipang nanu alo ong'ata, ng'ura, lekua ootaraki to lalem! tenajing nanu enkang, ng'ura ilootara olameyu! Amu ore pooki oloiboni o lapolosani neas biashara enye te nkop pooki, nemeeta eng'eno.’ ”

English: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
Masaai: Ele tung'ani eibung'a Lyahudi, naa anaata etara metua, neaku ainepua aata sikarini nasaru, atayiolo ajo oloo Roma.

English: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki nemeinos enkima, niimiemie atua enkima naa kesinyayu ninye asidanu. Ore ake etiu neijia, keitukui sii te nkare e nkitisinyata, ore pooki toki nemepikayu enkima, niimiemie atua enkima.

English: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
Masaai: Meeta ololo enetii ninye oitoki ashukunye nemeitoki aatum inkoitoi empuaan.

English: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
Masaai: Kake eiroshiwuo apa ina kitok, neiu enkayioni te rishata naaijo ina, te rishata o loirujuruj anaa apa enatiaaka Elisha ninye.

English: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae to lmarei le Baasha oye tiatua enkanasa, neinos ildiain. Ore pooki ng'ae oye tiong'ota neinos ilmotonyi lo loing'ang'e.”

English: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu aaipirare Misia, netem aajo matijing Bitinia; neitu eisho Enkiyang'et e Yesu meshomo;

English: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
Masaai: Etaara apa ninye iltung'ana le Edom nkalifuni tomon metuata to erata le munyan, neya enkanasa e Sela to larrabal, neisho ninye enkarna ajo Yokteel, naa ninye enkarna enye o taata.

English: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
Masaai: naa ore ina kata kigiroo enkitoo ai naapik iyie olbaata le ina dapidapoi, naaimulumul nanu iyie te nkaina ino o metaba anaa nalusoo,

English: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Oloo larin isiet apa Yehoiakin pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilapaitin okuni o nkolong'i tomon te Yerusalem. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
Masaai: Kake ore pee edol siamon neureishoyu neisho Enkai enkitoo naishoo ltung'ana engolon naaijo ina.

English: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.
Masaai: Neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani, nejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki amu kitung'uaitie iyiook Olaitoriani, nikisiaayia iyiook Baal o Astarot; kake ore taata tokordu iyiook intung'uai atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lang, naa eikisiaai iyie.’

English: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:
Masaai: ‘Shomo enetii kulo tung'ana, tiaaki, ining'ining'i doi kake mejing'aa hoo intae, ning'oring'oro doi kake midolidolo hoo intae,

English: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore ina kima olperere lo lasar nepali meyupuyupo, meishori metua, nepik olapolosani ilkeek e nkima ine anaake tadekenya, neirragie ilo asar opejori aiteleiki aitobiraki, nepejoo te nchumata enye enkurriny eilo asar le seriani.

English: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
Masaai: Atimira nanu ilmang'ati laainei nainepu ninche; neitu nanu arrinyo o metaba anaa neidak ninche.

English: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
Masaai: neiu Yuda Peres o Sera te Tamar; neiu Peres Hesron; neiu Hesron Aram;

English: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yoshua tadekenya enasirie, nedumu ilapolosak osanduku lo Laitoriani.

English: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
Masaai: Nejo, “Kalo rorei ele ojo, ena ‘kiti kata?’ Mikiyiolo iyiook enajoito.”

English: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
Masaai: Naa kulo ninche ilayiok le Shutela; ile Erani, olmarei loo le Erani.

English: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
Masaai: Maing'oru nanu enkitoo ai makewan; kake etii oloing'oru naa ninye oladung'oni le nkiguana.

English: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
Masaai: “Kake ore too naaipirta empiunoto oo lootuata, keitu isomama enatiaaka intae Enkai pee ejo,

English: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
Masaai: Ore te nabo alo, eiwuang'ieki enapa kitanapata naituruku te nkaraki nashal nemeeta dupoto,

English: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
Masaai: Neaku keishankarra Lyahudi aaitirrishakino maate, ejo, “Kaji eiko te neidim aishoo iyiook ele tung'ani osesen lenye mainosa?”

English: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Masaai: entaasishore enkata, amu torrok inkolong'i.

English: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ina pee elotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki:

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura ajo kitiaaka nanu, ‘Toriku kulo tung'ana ilepunye,’ kake eitu kincho nanu matayiolo ajo kaing'ae irriwaa te nebo nanu. Ninyaaka ajo, ‘Kaayiolo nanu iyie enkarna, ninoto sii kirotetisho too nkonyek aainei.’

English: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
Masaai: Oi te naa ketii obo linyi oidim aikeno kutuk aji peyie mikintokiki aainuaaki enkima e pesho to lperere lo lasar! Mashipakino nanu intae, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, nemang'amaa sii olasar linyi too nkaik inyi.

English: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Tola, Usi, o Refaia, o Yeriel, o Yahamai, o Ibsam, o Shemuel, ninche ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, aa taa Tola, Lmurran magil too lporori lenye. Ore esiana enye too nkolong'i e Daudi naa nkalifuni tikitam oare o iip ile.

English: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
Masaai: Neiteru ninye ashet to lapa liare to lari liong'uan le nkitoria enye.

English: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
Masaai: Etaa ninye oloisiligayu ti alo ilo otegelua ninye, anaa apa sii ninye Musa otaa oloisiligayu ti atua enkaji e Enkai.

English: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
Masaai: amu ore oloiroroki netang'arie esiaai enye torrono.

English: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
Masaai: Metaa nepuo nabo kata aalam lelo apa oojo pee epuonu aajur; neureshoyu sii ninye ilo kitok loo sikarini amu etayiolo ajo oloo Roma Paulo neidipaki aateen.

English: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
Masaai: Aning'ito elap aasukenyita nanu, ore te ning'unoto ai naawaliki nanu enkiyang'et.

English: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eikununo ninche anaa suut, neinos enkima ninche; meidim ninche aaitajeu ate te ina golon o lng'ejep le nkima. Mme inoshi kuk kuna naaiji, neme enkima nanyikakinoyu!

English: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
Masaai: Neye likae te mion oltau, eitu aikata eishamisham esidano.

English: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitore ninye ilaiguanak pooki ebaiki olkeju le Frati, ometabaiki enkop oo Lfilisti, o metabaiki olpolosie le Misiri.

English: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitayu tenebo ninye olasar le ntapa tenebo ninye anaake tadekenya, ematua nabo e ile e efa, o ematua nabo e uni e hini e eilata peyie eitashal ina tapa, anaa olasar le ntapa lo Laitoriani; ena ninye enkitanapata naipirta ilo asar opejori le anaake.

English: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
Masaai: Neirowuaju olarrabal ina olong, neigarakino olaiguanani engarri enye eing'or enkalo oo ltung'ana le Siria. Ore pee eaku teipa neye ninye, ore osarge leina ng'oroto neiput oltiren leina garri oo mbartan.

English: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
Masaai: Ore taata, lalashera laainei, ayieu naitadamu intae lelo Omon Supati latolikio intae natuutaka intae enejo. Nitang'amutua intae, nintasheito ti atua,

English: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
Masaai: nemayiana ilo tung'ani lemeikenaki Olaitoriani eng'oki enye.”

English: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
Masaai: Ine pesho ninche, esiaai e lejare, ore te nkata enkitamioto enye naa keidak ninche.

English: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, What shall we do to the ark of the LORD? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place.
Masaai: Neipotu Ilfilisti ilapolosak o lasakutok nejo, “Kaa kintaas ele sanduku lo Laitoriani? Toliki iyiook entoki nikiyayie ewueji enye.”

English: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
Masaai: Etoni te nkishui oo nkolong'i enye eeta enkarsisisho nalulung'a, nedoyio aapuo enemeneng'a te seriani.

English: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
Masaai: kaipirakinore nanu intae aarare, naa keari intae te dukuya ilmang'ati linyi, ore lekua ooiba intae naa kepuo aaitore intae, naa ilanyishosho intae meetae oltung'ani omirta intae.

English: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kora naa Alir o Elkana te nebo Abiasaf; kulo ninche ilmareita loo Lkorati.

English: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kagil auroo ina suntai nitumurakita enturoto nauroo ninye te nkop, metaa ore olkitamanyunoto lenye neirrag metii toki; ore tenesulari, terishata enye; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake teilo ari, te nkiterunoto e nkitoria e Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le imiet lo lari liong'uan naairorie nanu Hanania olayioni le Asuri, ilo oiboni oing'uaa Gibeon, tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, te dukuya ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki, ejo,

English: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nemir Daudi Ilfilisti neitore ninche, neya Daudi Metegama aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.

English: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
Masaai: Naa kaitodolu ine nking'asia te ntaiya e shumata, o sapiipiyieti ti abori te nkop. Nedoli osarge o enkima, o empuruo nairrusha:

English: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
Masaai: “Aaishoo Papa pooki toki, nemeetae hoo obo oyiolo ina Kerai leme Papa ake, nemeetae hoo obo oyiolo Papa leme ina Kerai ake o pooki ng'ae ogelu Enkerai aboloki.

English: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
Masaai: Nyaaki mbelekenyunye, Na Ai oo lororani! Ing'ura kop itii shumata, nidol, tishilai ele sabibu,

English: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
Masaai: Irrugumu nena belat pooki oo mukateni nindipa ainosa, neimin lelo rorei linono oo melook.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ekenyu, nedumu ninye olkarasha le dapash, neitadoiki enkare neisalaashaki enkomom enye, ometua ninye. Neaku Hasael olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
Masaai: naa ninye oinosaka iyiook eneba enyorrata naishoo Enkiyang'et intae.

English: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
Masaai: Ina peyie ajo, “Aha, Olaitoriani Enkai! eitu aekata aisarkionie kewan; ina kata eton ara olbarnoti o matubulu taata eitu aekata anya entoki natua openy arashu enataara ing'uesi e ntim, arashu etijing'a enkutuk ai endaa torrono.”

English: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
Masaai: Ataa nanu olalashe loo mbariak nataa olecholiek oo sidain.

English: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
Masaai: kake melotu ninye ataaniki olkarasha lo lodung'oro le wueji sinyati aashu ataaniki olperere lo lasar, amu keata ninye eleyiata, pee melotu ninye aisarkionie iwuejitin aainei sinyat; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.”

English: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
Masaai: Eiliilaitie inkonyek aainei te nkaraki olkiyioi lo sina, ore irubat o sesen lai netiu anaa oloip.

English: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
Masaai: neitayiolo nkera e tung'ana nkiasin inono e ngolon, o enkishiaa kitok e nkitoria ino.

English: For many are called, but few are chosen.
Masaai: “Amu kumok ilooipotoki kake ilkuti oogeluno.”

English: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
Masaai: Amu ore Haman ilo Agag olayioni le Hamedata, olmang'atinta loo Lyahudi pooki, eitobira pee ear Ilyahudi; neidaikie ninche, netoosho Pur aa nchere enkukuo pee eparripar neidaikie ninche.

English: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
Masaai: Ore anaa enapa natanang'ayioki Sodom o Gomora, o nkanas naatashare, Olaitoriani ojo, meetae oltung'ani oitoki alo aton teine, meetae oltung'ani omany atua ninye.

English: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
Masaai: Ore oloibooki enkop olaisinani pee eponaa enkarsisisho enye, arashu eisho lelo karsisi ake, naa kelotu ake sii ninye aaku olaisinani.

English: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
Masaai: Niminturaa iyie ilo tung'ani loo Lawi otii atua nkang'itie inyi, amu meeta ninye erubata aashu enjung'ore tenebo iyie.

English: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
Masaai: Nebatata ninye too nkejek enyena nejo, “Shumata nanu ake, olkitok lai, nchoo elotu entorroni; aatoomono nchoo esinka ino eiro too nkiyiaa inono, nining irorei le sinka ino.

English: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
Masaai: Ekaaiteng'en nanu iyie enkipirta enkaina e Enkai; ore pooki natii atua Olmagilani nemaisudoo.

English: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
Masaai: Nepuku ninche te korokoroni, nepuo enkaji e Lidia: ore pee eidip aatodol ilalashera, neilejilej ninche nepuo.

English: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
