Masaai: Kake te neleku ae kirring'o naputishoreki arashu emukate o mekenyu, nipejoo iyie te nkima ina natelekua, meinosi ninye, amu eisinyati.

English: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
Masaai: Entorripoto, entasheito oleng te nkirukoto, nipijuju, entagol.

English: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
Masaai: Ore kuna anas pokira ile naa keaku inaasaru iltung'ana le Israel, o ilo omoni o ilo otamanyishe ti atua ninche, pee etum pooki ng'ae oitayu loikop, oar oltung'ani metua te eitu eotiki atasaru.

English: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
Masaai: naairriwaki Sanbalat o Geshem olkilikuai ejo, “Wou manototo tenebo te nkang nabo e nkisiajata e Ono.” Kake keyieu apa ninche naaitaas entorrono.

English: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
Masaai: Kake nijojo intae, ‘Te nejoki oltung'ani menye aashu ng'otonye, Ore entoki duoo nikitumie nanu etaa korban (aa taa enaishori Enkai)

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, ng'ura kayaki nanu shumata ena anasa o shumata nkang'itie enyena ina torroni, pooki natejo kaitaas ninye, enkaraki naitagolo ninche lukuny enye, eany ening irorei laainei.”

English: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.
Masaai: Tejo olalashe lino, “Iltung'ana laainei,” nijo enkanashe ino, “Enanoto olng'ur.”

English: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
Masaai: Ore lmang'ati lo ltung'ani keaku lelo le nkaji enye.

English: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
Masaai: Ore tialo Abiatar olapolosani, nejo olaiguanani, “Shomo Anasot, enkop inyi amu keeya nikiririkino iyie. Kake maar nanu iyie tua tena kata, amu itanapa apa osanduku lo Laitoriani te dukuya Daudi papaai lai, o enkaraki sii nitang'arie apa papa isinaitin lenyena pooki.”

English: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
Masaai: o Yaela, o Sebadia, lelo ayiok le Yeroham le Gedor.

English: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
Masaai: Kintanap iltung'ana anaa lelo nikinkok te nkarna o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo metaasa esiaai enye te ngira nenya endaa naisiaayu oopeny.

English: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore dama o kewarie nemeye ina kima; neilep empuruo enye alo shumata ntarasi. Ore too ishoritin pooki neaku ina kop mijooni; nemeitoki oltung'ani aim ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
Masaai: Neureishoyu ninye oleng, amu enkanasa kitok apa Gibeon, anaa ake duoo ae anasa e nkitoo, o enkaraki naa eikitok apa alang Ai naa magil iltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
Masaai: Ore eyieunoto oltashalai naa kear ninye, metua amu keany inkaik enyena eitayu esiai.

English: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
Masaai: “Irorie iyie ninche ele rorei ijoki, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, “Keiputi pooki siang'au e naisho oo lsabibu.” ’ Naa eikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Eimikiyiolo iyiook aaitisip aajo keiputi pooki siang'au e naisho oo lsabibu?’

English: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:
Masaai: Ore naa taata, enosakaki olmumai to Laitoriani nchere ore anaa enaitaasa nanu intae te supatisho, naa eikintaasiasa sii intae te supatisho o enkaji e papa nikinchosho nanu olmonekie osipa,

English: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Naa kelotu ninye atua ina kop e nkishiaa. Ore nkalifuni maa iip tomon nebatata, kake ore kulo kekorduni aaitayu te nkaina enye: Edom o Moab o erubata kitok oo Lamori.

English: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.
Masaai: Nelotu Olaitoriani aitashe te ine, aipotisho anaa too nkulie katitin, ejo “Samuel! Samuel!” Nejo Samuel, “Iroro, amu ening'ito osinka lino.”

English: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nilotu iyie Gibeat-elohim, ine netii oltim loo Lfilisti; ore te ine, ilotu ina anasa, ninang'are entukus oo loibonok edou aapuonu eing'uaa ine wueji e shumata eeta enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o ntampurini o endule, o lwulul loo usin, te dukuya ninche, eibonisho.

English: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
Masaai: o Siklag, o Mekona, o nkang'itie enyena,

English: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
Masaai: Neing'ueiki Daudi intokitin olaing'urani loo lolan, neipirri alo enetii iltimito, nelo neiroroki ilalashera lenyena.

English: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
Masaai: neishooyo ti atua iltung'ana pooki ina siamo pooki e Israel, ilewa o nkituaak, o ltung'ani ake emukate napurupurana, o ldung'oti le nkiring'o o emukate oo lng'anayio ooitoyioki. Nepuo iltung'ana pooki le Israel, oltung'ani ake enkang enye.

English: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
Masaai: Amu keyiolo ninye olaiguanani kuna baa, naa ninye ashirraki airorie; amu majo keeta hoo embae nabo e kuna nemeyiolo ninye, amu mme too nkurrat etaasaki kuna.

English: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
Masaai: Nelotu ewueji neje neirrag ine ina kewarie, amu etadoyie enkolong nedumu osoit obo teine airishunye elukunya enye neirrag teine airura.

English: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninye neshet Iltung'ana le Yeriko. Ore enetashare ninche neshet Sakar olayioni le Imri.

English: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Dan naa: Hushim.

English: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
Masaai: ore tenebo ninche netii ilalashera lenye te ntukus e are e Sakaria o Yaasiel, o shemiramot, o Yehiel, o Uni, o Eliab o Benaia o Maaseia, o Matitia, o Elifele, o Mikneia, o larripok le kishomi, Obed-edom o Yaeil.

English: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
Masaai: Ore eton meetae ineegut aaitobiruaki nanu, ore eton meetae inchorroi naatii enkare.

English: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
Masaai: netaa enkerai e tung'ani olaitoriani le nkolong e sabato.”

English: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
Masaai: “Naa kuna naara olduruk te intae tiatua nena tokitin naaikurtutari tioriong enkop: olmaima, enderoni, olmokua te risioroto oo mpukunot enyena,

English: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
Masaai: Ketoosho ninye ninche anaa apa enatoosho lelo mang'ati lenye? Anaa ketasesekuana ninye ninche anaa apa enatasesekuanaki lelo asesesekuanak?

English: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
Masaai: Neng'idayu apa iltung'ana enkaraki eitayutuo kulo te nyorrata, amu to ltau pooki eishorutua ninche to lpela aaisho Olaitoriani; neng'idayu sii olaiguanani Daudi oleng.

English: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
Masaai: ore ake te pooki osho loo loo menye irriwai oltung'ani, ore ake oltung'ani naa olarikoni ti atua ninche.”

English: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
Masaai: Kake eitu ening Yonatan eitanap papaai lenye iltung'ana ilo mumai; neaku eisuroko eng'udi apa natii enkaina, nepik atua lukuny oo naishi nepik enkaina enkutuk; newang'u nkonyek enyena.

English: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
Masaai: Ore lelo apuayak neing'uaa inkoitoi enye, nepuo ninche olpurkel, neidak.

English: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil,

English: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
Masaai: Neikod iltung'ana te nkosholai o te sahabu; neitirrishi ninye te nyuntu o too lmushumaani, pee mepuku ashurtunye.

English: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
Masaai: Neitobir ninye engarri enye oo mbartan nedumu enjore enye,

English: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
Masaai: Kake tenilam enkinosata o lmumai, nemeitoki aaku eng'oki te iyie.

English: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
Masaai: Keseed, o Haso, o Pildash, o Yidlaf o Betuel.”

English: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening inchere etaa Arkelaus olaiguanani le Yudea, te rishata e papaai lenye Herode neureyu errinyo ina alo; neikoki te nkidetidet neboina alo olkerenket le Galilaya.

English: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
Masaai: “Keiput entapa ilkurrot ooidong'ishoreki, nedooyo enaisho oo sabibu o eilata too lbenia.

English: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Aron kuna pooki e nking'asia te dukuya Farao. Neitagol Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo aaipang te nkop enye.

English: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
Masaai: kake te nelotu ninye, ina Kiyang'et e sipata nerik intae atua esipata pooki, amu melotu airo anaa makewan, kake enaning pooki elimu, neliki intae imbaa naapuonu.

English: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Masaai: Kake etushutua obo le lelo ooitashe te ine olalem, neosh osinka lo lapolosani kitok nedung'u enkiok.

English: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
Masaai: Ore ninye Elnatan o Delaia o Gemaria pee esai olaiguanani pee mepej olpiyayati, mening duoo ninye ninche.

English: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
Masaai: “Keitu iyie iyiolou enajeito kulo tung'ana, ‘Etanya Olaitoriani ilmareita oare apa ootegelua?’ Nji eikuna aamenu iltung'ana laainei ometaa meekure ninche aa olosho te dukuya ninche.

English: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
Masaai: Ore ilkitamanyunot le suntai e ina anasa neikodoki te pooki soit oata tipat; ore ole dukuya naa yasper, ore oli aare naa soito pusi ooji safire, ore oli okuni naa soito ooji agate, ore oli oong'uan naa soito oonyori ooji emerald,

English: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore oo le Gad te risioroto oo lmareita lenye, o nkanas enye o nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
Masaai: Ore ina muro naishoruaki oilo oikulu oyuki keyau ninche tenebo lelo asarri e nkima oina kurriny, pee eyuki anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa olino o loo layiok linono tenebo iyie anaa erubata inyi ntarasi, anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani.”

English: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
Masaai: Atetema kuna pooki te ng'eno nagut; najo, “Ekaaku ng'en”, kake ekaalakuaniki apa nanu.

English: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
Masaai: o Beser, o Hod, Shama, o Shilsha, o Iltran, o Beera.

English: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye olkurruk, neloolo to loing'ang'e ometoito nkariak eishunye enkare.

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eyamisho neishoori meyami nkera e na kata;

English: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
Masaai: Neitoki aibelekenya netem enkalo e moikuape, intemat enkaina iip imiet te ntiyiani natemishoreki.

English: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
Masaai: Ore peyie eikilikuan ilewa leine imbaa naipirta enkitok enye, etejo ninye “Enkanashe ai ninye.” Amu eturia ninye ejo, “Enkitok ai” edamu ajo, “keidim ilewa leine ataar ninye metua tenkaraki Rebeka,” amu aisidai ninye oleng te nidol.

English: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo enikimanya, ine etii olorika le nkitoo le sheitani; nimbung'ita enkarna ai akurraki, neitu imiki enkirukoto ai ebaiki inkolong'i e Antipas olchakeni lai, airukoni lai, otaraki metua ti tua intae te ine nemanya sheitani.

English: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
Masaai: Nitiu anaa oltung'ani oirragita te mpolos e naiposha, anaa ilo oirragita te nchumata e ng'ape e meli.

English: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Masaai: o Seraia, o Asaria o Yeremia,

English: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
Masaai: Ekamayian lelo likimayian ore ilo likidek naa kadek. Te iyie emayian ilmarei pooki le nkop ate.’ ”

English: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
Masaai: Ore te pooki olong e sabato neirragie Aron aitobiraki te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake terishata oo ltung'ana le Israel anaa olning'o lo sotua ntarasi.

English: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
Masaai: “Ti nimbelekeny iroruat inono apaash sabato, nipaash isiaitin inono te nkolong ai sinyati, nintaa iyie sabato enkolong e nchipai o enkolong sinyati o Laitoriani nayanyiti; ti niyanyitu iyie ina olong, nimilo too nkoitoi inono makewan, anaa ing'oru enchipai ino makewan, anaa iro mbaa e pesho;

English: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Seir loo le Hori iloopeny enkop: Lotan, o Shobal, o Sibeon, o Ana,

English: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
Masaai: eimaki ena anaa enajo too mpala enyena pooki. Amu etii atua ninche kulie naagol eyiolounoto naaboin iltung'ana lemeiteng'ena, nemeeta enkitashoto nauno nemerregel te nkidaaroto enye maate, anaa enaiko ilkulikae kigerot.

English: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu matung'uai nkitarruorot aainei pooki. Mikintaa nanu olorojareki te lelo oomoda!

English: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
Masaai: naitasheyie ninye metaa enkitanapata te Yakobo, metaa olning'o lo sotua te Israel,

English: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
Masaai: Nintisinyinyi olari lionom nilimumu aaibalunye elakunoto tiatua ina kop pooki aaliki lelo pooki oomanya; naa keaku osirua te intae, ina kata errinyokino ake oltung'ani te ntae ntokitin enyena o lmarei lenye.

English: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
Masaai: Iwaki nanu tenebo iyie matasiooi aaipirri, Aayawua nanu Olaiguanani atua ilgilat lenyena, aikishipa niking'ida tenebo, nikishipakino enyorrata ino aaitalang enaisho oo sabibu, ina pee kinyor ninche pooki!

English: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
Masaai: loo layiok le Kora, o Uriel ilo kitok, tenebo lelo alashera lenyena iip o tikitam;

English: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
Masaai: “Entoning'oki lo tung'ana laainei, nikinchosho nanu enkiok, lo orere lai; amu kelotu enkitanapata naing'uaa enatii, o esupatisho naaku ewang'an too ltung'ana.

English: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
Masaai: Aboitare intae anaa ake te nkaji e Nkai, neitu kimbung'ubung'u. Kake esaa inyi ena, o engolon e naimin.”

English: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
Masaai: Ore epuo aaing'uaa Yeriko nesuj olorora kitok.

English: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani karsis neeta nkerrai kumok o nchoo;

English: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.
Masaai: etejo ninye, ‘Nchooki nanu mashomo; amu eeta olmarei lang olasar ti atua enkang, naaitanapa nanu olalashe lai pee atii ine. Neaku taata, te nanoto nanu omom too nkonyek inono, nchooki mashomo, pee adol ilalashera laainei.’ Te nkaraki ena eitu ninye elotu emesa o laiguanani.”

English: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
Masaai: Neyakini Solomon mbartan naaing'uaa Misiri neing'uaa nkuapi pooki.

English: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
Masaai: nintadowuo pooki toki meeu abori nkejek enyena.” Netipika pooki toki abori enkitoria enye, nemeetae ae toki natelekua nemeitore ninye. Ore anaa enatiu, eton mikidol iyiook pooki toki, tiabori enkitoria enye.

English: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Ruben o layiok le Gad na keeta nkishu kumok oleng, nedol ninche enkop e Yaser o enkop e Gilead, naa ng'ura, kenyor apa ine wueji nkishu.

English: And sitting down they watched him there;
Masaai: Netoni ninche aarrip ninye te ine.

English: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
Masaai: Ainyoo peyie mikipalaki inkitarruorrot aainei niya aitalamaa intorrok aainei? Amu ore tena kata naa kairrag tiatua enkop; aiking'oru iyie nanu nematii.

English: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
Masaai: Emunyak nkituaak inono, nemunyak isinkan linono, ootii dukuya iyie anaake nening engeno

English: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
Masaai: Nejo Yoab, “Anaa enaishu Enkai, te neme iroro, esipa anaata etapala iltung'ana esujata oo lalashera lenye tadekenya.”

English: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo neijia, nepuku empong'o oo Sadukayo o Lfarisayoi, neoro olkiaama.

English: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
Masaai: eitu apal maishooyo enashe te intae, nadamu intae te nkomono ai,

English: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
Masaai: Kulo ninche irorei leilo ning'o lo sotua oitanapa Olaitoriani Musa pee eitobir oltung'ana le Israel te nkop e Moab, tenebo ilo ning'o lo sotua apa oitobira ninye tenebo ninche te nkop e Horeb.

English: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
Masaai: Naa keishiraki Isiraeli pooki ninye, nenukaa ninye; amu ore ilo laa ninye eeta Yeroboam naa kenukari te nkurare, amu atua ninye ake enotieki entoki naitiship Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, tiatua enkaji e Yeroboam.

English: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaibelekenyakino iltung'ana le Benchamen neshurt ninche te nepi olalem, iltung'ana o ng'uesi o pooki naanoto ninche. Ore nkanas enye apa pooki naaitobira nepejoo te nkima.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu ejoki intae iltung'ana, ‘Inyanya intae iltung'ana, nioruru olosho linyi inkera,’

English: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
Masaai: nedol ninche nkiaasin o Laitoriani, isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia ti atua enguton.

English: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
Masaai: Emut oltung'ani lemeure Enkai te nkutuk enye ole latia lenye. Kake te ng'eno elakuni lelo supati.

English: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
Masaai: Naya nanu Yaa-asama olayioni le Yeremia, o layioni le Habasania, o lalashera lenyena, o layiok lenyena pooki, o enkaji pooki e Rekabi.

English: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
Masaai: Neirragakinye Yoshua ninche olmumai te ina kata, ejo “Ediaa te dukuya Olaitoriani ilo tung'ani odumunye neigil ashet ena anasa e Yeriko; te nkinyang'a o lkikau lenye epik ninye olkitamanyunoto lenye, naa te nkinyang'a o ldung'oret lenye epik ninye nchomito enyena.”

English: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Ruben o le Gad o lpisiai lo losho le Manase ootii lido kekun olkeju le Yordan naa iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o tikitam oota imasaa pooki olarrabal.

English: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni aidipa atoisho, neitoki sii ninye ena kitok aisho; naa iyiook ake, metii hoo likae tung'ani tenebo iyiook tiatua aji, iyiook ake pokira are naatii atua aji.

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, tenipuonunu kenya ina kop naisho intae, neibung ina kop sabato te nkaraki Olaitoriani,

English: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
Masaai: Kairrugoki nanu enkiok ai endung'et e rashe; nawalu nanu oloyiote lai te oshoto e nkinanta.

English: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo torrono naa kedung'ori; ore lelo oanyu Olaitoriani naa kejung ina kop.

English: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo owuasa oata emaupe e nkitoo oo lamerak le Efraim, o ina tapukai natoyio oshi nara enkishiaa enye; naa ninye natii endukuya e ilo erata oleng le lelo ooidimua enaisho!

English: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana ninye neisis enkai enye; amu etejo ninche, “Eishorua enkai ang olmang'atinta lang apik atua enkaina ang, laa ninye apa otumuta enkop ang, netasesekuana ilkumok lang.”

English: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
Masaai: Ore ilo ojurru enkijape nemeunisho; naa ore ilo oisilig inkatampo nemeisampu.

English: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
Masaai: Nejoki Sedekia Yeremia, “Mincho hoo oltung'ani eyiolou kulo rorei aashu iye iyie.

English: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.
Masaai: Ore te Susa te ina ang kitok ake near Ilyahudi metuata neidaikie ilewa iip imiet,

English: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
Masaai: ore apa pee aajoki oltung'ani obo nanu, ‘Ng'ura, etua Saul.’ Nejo ninye keyaua ilomon sidain, naibung ninye naar ninye metua te Siklag, aa ilo apa olerrinyore laishoo nanu ninye too lomon lenyena.

English: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
Masaai: natudung'oyie enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaji e Daudi, naaisho iyie; neitu ake sii itiu anaa osinka lai Daudi, apa oibung nkitanapat aainei naasuj ninye nanu to ltau lenye pooki, aas ake nena sidain too nkonyek aainei,

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: Te nebo sii ositima obo le kine to lasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.

English: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ina doi eitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani, ajoki. ‘Aaitaa iyie ewang'an oo Loreren, peyie iyau iyie enjeunoto o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.’ ”

English: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
Masaai: Neisho Solomon enkaiguanani e Sheba nena pooki naayieu ninye, pooki toki ake ninye natoomonuo metii ntokitin naayaka ninye olaiguanani. Nerrinyo ninye alo enkop enye tenebo ilaisiaayiak lenyena.

English: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
Masaai: nipuopuo naa aaraa lelo pooki oomanya ina kop aaiwuang'ie te dukuya intae nindaikiekie nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo soito, nindaikiekie nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaipurjuno, nigiligili nene wuejitin neeika naaitainyeki lasarri pooki;

English: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
Masaai: “Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai tialo Ilamoni, neipirta sii enkurruna enye; tejo, Olalem, olalem etushurtuaki peyie eyieng'ishoi, netisikaki meimerlela anaa enkiwuang'ata,

English: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
Masaai: Ore kulie kiyiaa naapishana, netoito, naa sasin, neitoi olkutati lo loo saen.

English: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
Masaai: nedol ninye neibalie ninye; neitasheyie ninye, neing'oru ninye.

English: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
Masaai: Etuata kulo pooki etii atua enkirukoto, neitu eng'amu ninche enapa naisiligieki, kake etoduaa neirorokita, te nelakua, netolimutuo inchere ilomon ninche naa inkisikat te nkop.

English: I saw the LORD standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eitashe te mbata olperere lo lasar, nejo ninye: “Toosho lukuny oo ng'apeta, o meikirikirata ntonat oo ng'apeta, tebelibelaki ninche inchumat oo ilukuny oo ltung'ana pooki; ore ilooleku lenye naar nanu ninche to lalem; melo ninye obo lenye aisik nemeimisho ninye obo lenye.

English: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Galilaya, neng'amu Ilgalilaya ninye; etoduaa pooki naataasa te Yerusalem, to sirua; amu eshomo sii ninche ilo sirua.

English: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
Masaai: Neing'uari apa iltung'ana oare too lng'oborri, neji obo Eldad ore o likae neji Medad, netonie enkiyang'et ninche; neaku ninche te nebo lelo ooigeroki kake eitu ninche eipang aapuo ilo ng'obor, neaku eibonishote ninche ti atua ilo ng'obor.

English: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
Masaai: Ime tenkaraki iyie peyie aas ina, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; inchoo ina eyiolounoyu te iyie. Tukurru nimilo too nkoitoi inono, iyie na aji e Israel.

English: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
Masaai: Nemor obo le lelo wushuush ootashoki te nebo ninye, ejo, “Ai mira doi Kristo? Intajeu kewan o iyiook!”

English: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
Masaai: Ore iyie, intae iltung'ana torrok lemesinya, olkitok le Israel, ilo oewuo enkolong enye, erishata enkitamioto ino nabayie,

English: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
Masaai: Emishoroo sahabu anaa mpesai too nkimeitani inyi,

English: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
Masaai: Aatudumakitia ninche olom teina neme enkai aaitagoro ninche nanu too nkitanyaanyukot enye. Neaku kadumaki nanu ninche olom te lelo leme iltung'ana, kaitagor nanu ninche teilo osho omoda.

English: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
Masaai: Nelotu ina siamo neiter aaikilikuan Pilato meitaasa enoshi ake naitaas.

English: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
Masaai: Kake elotu embae pooki te nkata enye: Kristo oituruko aitadedeyie, ore kenya, te neshukunye, neitoki lelo lenyena;

English: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
Masaai: pee mejo ake olmang'atinta lai, “Aisula nanu te ninye”; pee meng'ida ake ilo mang'atinta lai tenkaraki embatata ai.

English: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
Masaai: Ore teneaku irorei kumok, neaku empesho sapuk, naa ainyoo eikashie oltung'ani?

English: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
Masaai: Ore ake apa enaigeroko intae naa nchere emisiritore ilo tung'ani oji olalashe, leton ake aa eibor onyek, iloota olorok, esai nena kitanyaanyukot naaitae nkaitin, nemorisho, nemera aashu aa olaisimani. Eming'arie tukul endaa oltung'ani laaijo ilo.

English: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:
Masaai: Ore pee etiu nejia, ore lkulikae tung'ana pooki le ilo lemankale ooata mueyiaritin, nepuonu sii ninche meishiunyeki.

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
Masaai: o lairakuj pokira oare oina kurriny naimulumulita ninche, oilo kina lemoinyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj;

English: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Netofia naa onom o ile.

English: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
Masaai: Kake ore enkaji e Israel netaa kiseruti te nanu to lpurkel, eitu ninche epuoyie nkiguanat aainei kake etanyaita nkitanapat aainei, naa tenesuj oltung'ani ninche neton eishu; ore isabatoni aainei neisarkionie oleng. “Ina peyie adamu ajo kabuku engoro ai abukoki shumata ninche to lpurkel peyie atum aishie ninche tukul.

English: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ekairriwaki enkima Magog, tenebo lelo ootoni te seriani to lomanaa le nkiyopat e naiposha; naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
Masaai: Itejo iyie, “Ing'oru iyie enkomom ai.” Nikijoki oltau lai iyie, “Enkomom ino, Olaitoriani, ninye nanu aing'oru.”

English: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
Masaai: Ore apa Nadab o Abihu, lelo ayiok le Aron, meetae ake oleitu eyau emoti enye e nkima, nepik enkima atua, nepik enkorropil atua, neishooyo ninche enkima nemesinya te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu eitu eitanap Olaitoriani ninche meishooi.

English: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
Masaai: Midamu iyie ing'ok e kitisho ai, anaa nkitarruorot aainei; ore te risioroto e nyorrata nauno, tadamuaki nanu, te nkaraki esupatisho ino Olaitoriani!

English: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
Masaai: o soito barrikon ooji oniks o lkulikae soito oopiki olkila lo lapolosani kitok o ina bene enye o lgoo.

English: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
Masaai: Aimeiba iltung'ana olapurroni te nepurrisho, pee eitaraposh enkoshoke enye eeta esumash?

English: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
Masaai: O pooki muoyian sii o pooki meitai le meigero tena buku oo nkitanapat, eikirriwaki iyie Olaitoriani ometaba anaa nindaaya.

English: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
Masaai: Pee eipiru nkitobirat e nkarriyiano, neasisho te sahabu o te nkosholai o to suyai,

English: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
Masaai: Nikiked emeli e Adramitio nairoto pee edumunye alo nena ang'itie e mbata e naiposha te Asia, nikipuo, neiriamariyie iyiook Aristako Olmakedoniai le Sesalonike.

English: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
Masaai: o isiaaitin e nking'asia ti atua enkop e Ham, o mbaa naaitureisho te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
Masaai: Nejoki Mariamu ilo malaika, “Kaji eiko pee eaku ena nemayiolo olee?”

English: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
Masaai: Amaa te nang'arie likae endaa etii enashe, oo pee aaitokini aapik esulare te ntoki naishoorie enashe?

English: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
Masaai: Metaa tejo, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaiturrurru intae too loreren, naiturrurru ntae aitung'uaa nena kuapi naaidapashakaki ntae, naa kaisho ntae ina kop e Israel.’

English: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche aaipot ilarripok loo nchomito e nkanasa, neliki ninche aajoki, “Kishomo iyiook ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria, ng'ura medoli nemening'i hoo oltung'ani obo teine, meteleku ake mbartan naaena o sirkon ooena, netiu lelo ng'oborri anaa apake.”

English: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Masaai: Keirriu Olaitoriani imayianat shumata ino tiatua ilchumat linono o leina pooki nias iyie; nikimayian iyie teina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
Masaai: Amu intaa iyie ina anasa osototi le nkidaata ore ina anasa nagol nintaa olmuaate; ore apa ina aji e nkitoo oo ltung'ana leeikinga meigili ae kata aashet.

English: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
Masaai: Amu ore olosilisili neme enterit epukunye, ore enyamali neme te nkop ebulu.

English: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
Masaai: aa ore hoo neeta empukunoto e Nkai, neitu ninye eiken ina narisiore Enkai anaa ae toki naaji najo apidilakino,

English: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entobira enkirridunoto to Laitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi, niasiasa eyieunoto enye. Entegelari maate entung'uai iltung'ana lena kop, ning'uaa nkituaak enye.”

English: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
Masaai: Keitu ejo lkigerot eishoi e Daudi eimu Kristo, apukunye Betlehem, enkang natii apa Daudi?”

English: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.
Masaai: nejoki, “Lo kituaak, kadol ajo keaku kearisho ena lototo e meli neimin intokitin kumok, kake bata sii enkishui ang iyiook maate.”

English: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
Masaai: Taramata iltung'ana linono te ng'udi ino, ina luaata e njung'ore ino. Oobik maate tiatua entim, te mpolos e nkurma eina kop. Nchoo ninche edaa te Bashan o te Gilead, anaa apa too nkolong'i e apa.

English: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
Masaai: nchere, ore oltung'ani oar olikae metua eitu eotiki aashu eitu ebaraki neidim akuetiki ine; keaku ninche te intae enesaruni te nkaraki ilo oitalaku elap to sarge.

English: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
Masaai: nchoo ninye meitasho te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani o ina umata pooki, nintanap aisho enkitoo te dukuya ninche.

English: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata neitaa ninye olaitasheikinoni le nkaji enye o pooki toki naata etamayiana Olaitoriani enkaji e ilo Misiri tenkaraki Yosef, ore emayianata Enkai nejing pooki toki naata, tiaji o te nkurma.

English: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
Masaai: “Miureishoyu amu mikipuoi aaitukurru; ming'aing'ai amu mikintukurruni; amu mingil ae kata adamu enkurruna e kitisho ino, ore ilo sina lino apa ira enkoliai nimingil ae kata adamu.

English: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
Masaai: Meeta ninche eng'eno nemedamisho, nepuo ninche aamanimanaa te naimin; eikirikirate ilkitamanyunot pooki le nkop.

English: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-Bethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i e Peka olaiguanani le Israel nelotu Tiglat-Pilesa olaiguanani le Asiria neibung nkanas e Ijon, o Abel-bet-maka, o Yanoa, o Kadesh, o Hasor, o Gilead o Galilaya, o enkop pooki e Naftali; neya iltung'ana eararoto te Asiria.

English: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
Masaai: Kake engoru olmabarishoi leina anasa apa naterewa intae te yararoto, niomonono Olaitoriani te rishata enye, tialo ninye amu ore tiatua olmabarishoi lenye nitumutumu intae olmabarishoi linyi.

English: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;
Masaai: Nejoki Samuel iltung'ana, “Emiureishoyu; itaasa intae ena torroni pooki, ore eyia emimbelekenya intae aany isujusuju Olaitoriani, kake esiaiya Olaitoriani too ltauja linyi pooki;

English: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Naa Segub apa menye le Yair, laa ninye apa oata nkanas tikitam ookuni te nkop e Gilead.

English: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Olkitok lai! Ore anaa eninchu, Olkitok lai, ara nanu ina kitok apa naitashe tene te dukuya iyie, eomonito Olaitoriani.

English: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
Masaai: Eng'ura nchere mme ene nkiyang'et naiturukuo, kake ina e na kishon, neitoki taa ina e nkiyang'et.

English: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
Masaai: Neiu enkayioni naa ninye oyooki aitore iloreren pooki te ng'udi e sekenkei, kake etawuapayioki ina kerai enye aailepie enetii Enkai o enetii olorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Yeremia airoro ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani ninye pee eirorie iltung'ana pooki, neibung ilapolosak ninye, o loibonok, iltung'ana pooki ejoito, ejo, “Iye iyie!

English: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
Masaai: Ore teneas ninye inenkiborra oo nkonyek meeta enkuretisho neboloo emasipaisho enye aaibelekenya te ngoro aing'uaa ninye, anaa peyie aibelekenya aing'uaa enkanashe enye.

English: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
Masaai: Ore ina kata pooki atii atua intae kashal apa, naureisho naikirikira.

English: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aaisikong iyie te nkaraki ilasarri linono; ore lelo asarri linono oopejori netii anaake dukuya nanu.

English: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the LORD for ever:
Masaai: “Meetae oltung'ani Olamoni aashu ole Moab olo ajing eumata o Laitoriani ore ninye ebaiki eishoi e tomon meetae obo lenye olo ajing atua eumata o Laitoriani ntarasi;

English: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye “Tadoi shomo pee ilepu ayau Aron te nebo iyie; kake mincho ilapolosak o ltung'ana elang'u olpolosie aailepu enetii Olaitoriani menang'are ake Olaitoriani ninche.”

English: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
Masaai: Aamanita nanu imbaa enyena naatang'oruo te pooki shoto, etangoro apolol ilairakuj laainei, nemepal nebukoki olodua lai enkop.

English: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
Masaai: Ore ina kitanyaanyukoto e nkai naitobira ninye nepik atua enkaji e Nkai, naa ninye apa etiaka Enkai Daudi o Solomon olayioni lenye, “Ore tiatua ena aji, o te Yerusalem, naa ninye ategelua too loshon pooki le Israel, kapik enkarna ai ntarasi.

English: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
Masaai: Metaa itum omom o enkisisa sidai te dukuya Enkai o tung'ani.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkiaasin e Baasha, o naataasa, o enkidimata enye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
Masaai: Ore aa kitok olkiyioi eishirita ltung'ana nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eminchir amu eitu eye, keirura.”

English: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
Masaai: Naing'orisho nanu naning emanita olorika le nkitoo o nena ng'uesi naaishu o lelo payiani oltoilo loo lmalaika kumok. Ore esiana enye naa iip nkuyu iip nkuyu, iip nkuyu, nkalifuni o nkalifuni.

English: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
Masaai: Kitokordua iyie nanu aitung'uaa enkesha oo ltung'ana, kintaa iyie nanu endukuya oo loshon; ore iloreren apa lemayiolo naaisiaai nanu.

English: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi olmodai nelioo aa sidai too nkonyek enyena makewan, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en nening enkikoo.

English: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Anaa isoito ooishu, pee iakuku inkasisin e mumuaisho sinyati ooitayu ilasarri sinyat le Nkiyang'et oong'uarrayu te Enkai te Yesu Kristo.

English: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
Masaai: Etonyorrayie tukul inchere keidim Enkai aitabai ina naisiligie.

English: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
Masaai: Amu kaaisho nanu iyie nkolong'i esiana oo nkolong'i iip uni o ntomoni naaudo, naarisiore esiana oo larin lenkitamioto enye; metaa erishata naba neijia imbung ina kitamioto enkaji e Israel.

English: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
Masaai: Naa keitobir ninye olning'o ogol te wiki nabo; ore to lpisiai le wiki naa keisho ninye ilasarri o nkishorot meishunye; ore te ina rishata nepiki olkirutoto torrono entopij e nkaji e Nkai, naa keton ninye teine, ometaba anaa neitabaya ilo otipika ine ina naitobiraka Enkai.”

English: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
Masaai: Kitoning'o iyiook too nkiyiaa ang, iyie Enkai, etolikitio iyiook iloo papa, nena kiaasin apa nitaasa iyie too nkolong'i enye, apa moitie:

English: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
Masaai: Aiwuang'a nanu too ndamunot anaa oltung'ani otua; atotiuo nanu anaa entoki natebele.

English: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Eikumok kulo tung'ana ootii te nebo iyie te nanu, te naishoru ile Midian apik atua nkaik enye, mewuasayu ake Israel ti alo nanu, ejo, ‘Enkaina ai makewan naatokordua nanu.

English: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.
Masaai: Naa kainyoo epon Daudi pee kijoki iyie? Amu iyiolo iyie osinka lino, Olaitoriani Enkai!

English: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?
Masaai: Neserem ninye, nejo, “Kainyoo ninye osinka lino, metaa ing'or iyie oldia otua anaa nanu?”

English: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.
Masaai: Kake etejo Musa, “Meeta nchere peyie mincho iyiook maitayu ilasarri o nkishorot naapejori, peyie kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
Masaai: niyaya ina kop aaitaa eninyi nimanyimanya, amu aishoo nanu intae ina kop pee iyaya.

English: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore apa enkata naitoria ninye Israel naa ilarin artam; eitoreishe ninye ilarin ile te Hebron, neitoreisho ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni te Yerusalem.

English: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
Masaai: Nintayu imbokishi o lerai nimur ninche te sahabu.

English: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
Masaai: Ina pee eipotu Herode ilang'eni too nkurrat, netem asipunye oleng enkata apa nataliee ilo akira.

English: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
Masaai: Imayiana iyie Israel, Oo Israel! Kaing'ae likinyaanyukie, olorere oitajeu Olaitoriani, ina long'o e retoto inyi, o lalem le nkisulata inyi! Kepuonu ilmang'ati linyi aasai intae naa ipuopuo intae aaituny iwuejitin enye e shumata.”

English: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
Masaai: Keirrita ninye eluaata enye anaa olchekut, neibung ninye ilkuoo too nkaik enyena, nenap ninche to lgoo lenye, nerikoo maakutiti nena oijoo.

English: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
Masaai: “Ore tialo kulo tung'ana tiaaki iyie: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, Kapik nanu dukuya iyie enkoitoi enkishui o enkoitoi e keeya.

English: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
Masaai: Newaliki Yonatan Adonija ajoki, “A-a amu eitaa olkitok lang olaiguanani Daudi Solomon olaiguanani;

English: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
Masaai: Neipoti ine aajo, “Enemetii enkitoria”, ore lelo kituaak lenyena pooki neaku pesho.

English: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Olaitoriani; nelotu emus kitok oo lojong'a atua enkaji e Farao o atua nkajijik oo laisiaayiak lenyena; ore atua enkop pooki e Misiri nerruoyo enkop te nkaraki oo lojong'a.

English: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
Masaai: Neisuaaki ninye embata eina ilata enchumata olperere lo lasar katitin naapishana, nebukoki ilo perere lo lasar tenebo imasaa enyena pooki, o lmoti oitukuoreki o enkitotonet enye, pee eitisiny ninche.

English: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
Masaai: Eewuo apa enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Asaria olayioni le Oded,

English: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.
Masaai: Neaku etanapa Sadok o Abiata osanduku le Nkai aashuk Yerusalem; nebik ninche te ine.

English: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
Masaai: Amu ore olotejo, “Miloloito,” netejo sii, “Miaar metua.” Metaa te neitu iloloito, kake itaara metua, itaa naa olagilani loo nkitanapat.

English: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
Masaai: Neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani nejo, “Kaa aitaas kulo tung'ana? Etaa ninche kejo pee aanang too soito.”

English: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
Masaai: Nerrinyo ninche aapuo Yerusalem te ng'ida sapuk,

English: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: “Entoning intae Laaiguanak, enchoru enkiok, lo kituaak; Olaitoriani nanu aranyaki, kaoshoki nanu olkerempe, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
Masaai: Toning'oki, Olaitoriani, niking'urrie nanu! Olaitoriani, taa iyie Olaretoni lai!”

English: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
Masaai: Keirriu Enkerai e Tung'ani ilmalaika lenyena, meitayu ti atua enkitoria enye inkitadiaat pooki o loas intorrok.

English: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata eilo sarge lo lasar le ng'oki to lkimojino lenye nepik imowuarak olperere lo lasar opejorieki lasarri, neibukoo olikae sarge te ntonata olperere lo lasar opejorieki lasarri.

English: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
Masaai: Ore ilo oishakenu embae nemesipa te nkaraki ole latia enye, netiu anaa orinka lo larrabal arashu olalem, arashu embae napi.

English: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
Masaai: Nemor ninche ninye nejoki, “Ira iyie oloiteng'eni lenye; kake kira iyiook ilooiteng'eni le Musa.

English: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ebore enkanyit o enkitoo isiaaitin enyena, nebikoo esupatisho enye ntarasi.

English: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
Masaai: Amaa taata kainyoo dupoto nitum tenilo Misiri, aok nkariak e Nail? Arashu kainyoo dupoto nitum tenilo Asiria, aok nkariak e Farite?

English: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eing'orisho, nedol olaiguanani eitashe tembata e ng'ape te wueji nejing'ieki enkaji e Nkai, neitashe ilarikok le njore o laoshok loo ntarumpetani te mbata o laiguanani ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop neshipa neosh ntarumpetani. Ore ilaranyak neeta nkinantani enye oo sinkolioitin, erikoo osirua. Nepolos Atalia nkilani enyena, nebuaku ajo, “Enkarruoisho! Enkarruoisho.”

English: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, kaji eiko enchata olchani loo sabibu tenegiroo te nkadori likae shani ake pooki, olng'osila lo sabibu otii atua ilkeek le ntim?

English: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
Masaai: Newal olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo, “Entiaaki ninye, ‘Mincho ilo orreten imasaa enyena o larrabal ewuasa anaa ilo olaku.’ ”

English: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
Masaai: Amu makurru nanu te lelo Omon Supati; amu ninche engolon e Nkai nayau enjeunoto te pooki ng'ae oiruk, neituruk too Lyahudi neitoki too Lyunani.

English: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki le nkop oo Lgeraseni o neemanita, nesai metung'uai ninche amu etureishote oleng. Nejing ninye empeut ashuko.

English: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
Masaai: Kake etii Olaitoriani atua enkaji enye Sinyati; nchoo enkop pooki eitirring'a te dukuya ninye.

English: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
Masaai: neya ninye engolon enye atua eyararoto, neya enkitoo enye atua enkop oo lmang'ati.

English: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
Masaai: Neinyototo ilapolosak o Lawi aamayian olorere, nening'i oltoilo lenye, nelotu enkomono enye ine wueji enye sinyati te keper.

English: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
Masaai: Itukuta te nkijape ino, neitemoo ninche enaiposha; neimis anaa osoit ti atua inkariak kituaak.

English: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
Masaai: Neirriwaa oltung'ani meshomo adung'u elukunya e Yohana te korokoroni.

English: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
Masaai: Ore to lapa li are te nkolong e tikitam o naapishana o lapa, netoyio apa enkop.

English: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
Masaai: Nimbalunye iyie ena olong ina nikintaasa nanu esidai, te ina neitu kiar matua ina kata pee aapik nanu Olaitoriani atua nkaik inono.

English: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
Masaai: Ng'uraki nanu Olaitoriani, nining olkiyioi lai.

English: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
Masaai: ore oliare, Kileab, le Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel; ore oliokuni, Absalom olayioni le Maaka ina tito e Talmai olaiguanani le Geshur;

English: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
Masaai: “Nintayu enchili e sahabu nasila niguetaki oriong enye, anaa isirat lo lmishire, ‘Sinyati to Laitoriani.’

English: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
Masaai: Ore naa, ng'ura, kalo nanu enetii iltung'ana laainei; wou, pee aaliki nanu enepuo kulo tung'ana aaitaas iltung'ana linyi, too nkolong'i e siadi.”

English: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
Masaai: Toduaa naa pee miaku ewang'an niata enaimin.

English: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.
Masaai: Nelo Hatak aliki Esta ina natejo Mordekai.

English: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
Masaai: Tejo, ‘Ara nanu olmonekie te iyie: anaa enataasa, neaku ina eitaasi ninche ekepuo ninche eyararoto aaku ilooena.’

English: But sought to the LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
Masaai: Kake eing'orua Enkai e papaai lenye, nelo too nkitanapat enyena, neitu eibung irrekiei loo Siraeli.

English: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ues, o pooki toki naiserpepiari, o pooki motonyi o pooki toki nalo tioriong enkop nepuku pooki anaa impukunot enye aaing'uaa e Safina nepuo.

English: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aipotu Yohanan olayioni le Karea o Larikok pooki loo njorin apa ootii tenebo ninye, o ltung'ana pooki ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok,

English: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
Masaai: Amu kalo osho kitok oata enkai nataaniki anaa enataana Olaitoriani Enkai ang te iyiook, enkata pooki naba anaa enikimpot ninye?

English: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
Masaai: Ore to lari li okuni le Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia nebolokini ororei Daniel, ilo oji enkarna Belteshasa. Naa kesipa apa ilo rorei, naa olarrabal kitok. Nesipu ninye ilo rorei netum eyiolounoto e ina duaata.

English: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
Masaai: Aata mbaa kumok naimaki ti alo intae, naiguanare; kake olaairriwua ninye osipa, naa inatoning'o te ninye, ninche ajoki enkop.”

English: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
Masaai: Netolikioki apa olaiguanani le Yeriko aajoki, “Ng'ura, etii kulikae tung'ana le Israel ooetuo ene duoo kewarie pee ejur enkop.”

English: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
Masaai: neitu epik olgelati arish iyiook o ninche, neituku ltauja lenye te nkirukoto.

English: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

English: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

Masaai: Ore eloito Obadia te nkoitoi, ng'ura, nenang'are Eliya ninye; neyiolou Obadia ninye, nebatata te nkomom abaiki enkop, nejo, “Kaiyie ele olkitok lai Eliya?”

English: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

English: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

English: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Na kerai, kinchiunye enkirukoto ino; shomo te seriani, ninchiu emuoyian ino.”

English: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
Masaai: amu eiteng'ena ninche anaa oloata enkidimata nemetiu anaa ilaiteng'enak lenye loo nkitanapat.

English: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
Masaai: Nesai ninche ninye oleng pee mearaa teina kop.

English: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.
Masaai: Toning'o naa taata, iyie Yoshua olapolosani kitok iyie tenebo ilchorueta linono ootoni te dukuya iyie, amu iltung'ana supati ninche ooitodolu imbaa naapuonu. Ng'ura, ekayaki osinka lai ilo oji Olng'osila.

English: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
Masaai: Enkop naitubulu openy, neng'asunye mbenek, neitoki ntapuka neitoki lanterera aajing elukunya.

English: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
Masaai: Ore eidur ninche nedoiki enkuretisho naing'uaa Enkai inkanas naamanita ninche, metaa eitu esujaa ninche ilayiok le Yakobo.

English: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

English: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?
Masaai: Kairo pee aitukurru intae. Ketaa doi meetae oltung'ani ng'en ti atua intae ooidim atirisha oltung'ani o lalashe lenye?

English: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

English: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

English: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

English: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
Masaai: Neirishakino olgoo le Yesu nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, aing'ae?”

English: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

English: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

English: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nenyorru enkitok apa natii oerata le Sorek, naji enkarna enye Delila.

English: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

English: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.

English: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

English: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ina kibor oo nkonyek eina mulayoi, ina kitok nasakutisho naata esulare, ina nakaldaa iloshon enkibor enye oo nkonyek, nekaldaa iloreren too ntaleng'o enyena.

Masaai: o Hashem, le Gison, o Yonatan olayioni le Shagee le Harari,

Masaai: Enkiterunoto oo lomon supati le Yesu Kristo Enkerai e Nkai.

English: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
