Masaai: Neinos olaiguanani olmumai, ejo, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye laatokordua oltau lai te pooki mang'atinta,

English: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
Masaai: kake etudumunye nejoki ninche, “Kaitoki ake ashukunye, te neyieu Enkai.” Neked emeli alo Efeso.

English: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
Masaai: Kedoli doi kuna etiu anaa ine ng'eno etukunyaki ltung'ana esujata enye neitadou ate neitupukoo iseseni lenye kake, meeta hoo eneret te nkibooroto oo ng'uarrat o sesen.

English: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
Masaai: ti nigiligili olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, apa oitanapa ninye intae, nipuopuo aaisiai kulie aitin, nirrugokinono ninche. Netum taa engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyupo te nkaraki intae nindaayaya intae aaing'uaa ina kop sidai naishoo ninye intae.”

English: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei, iyiololo intae enkaji e Stefana ninche naaitera aaibelekenyakino Enkai te Akaia netasheikinote aaisiaai isinyat.

English: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche irorei pooki, neibelekenyakino maate te nkuretisho; nejoki ninche Baruk, “Meeta nchere mikiliki olaiguanani kulo rorei pooki.”

English: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
Masaai: Naa kaibelekenyaki intae engoro ai aarare intae, peyie atum ataarare intae te ngoro napi. Kedung'oo ninche inkumeishin inyi o nkiyiaa inyi, ore ilekunot linyi nebatatakino olalem. Naa keibung aaya ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi, ore ilekunot linyi nemutite nkima.

English: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
Masaai: Toning'o, iyie keper, ninchoru enkiok na kop; amu eiroro Olaitoriani: “Aitotio nanu nkera naitubulu, naatogolong'akitia ninche.

English: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana Yoshua, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang iyiook kisiaai, naa oltoilo lenye iyiook kining.”

English: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
Masaai: Keirriu sii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi olmeitai atua ninche, ometaba anaa ore ninye lelo ooleku eisudori eure intae neidak.

English: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the LORD.
Masaai: netum taa aisiaaisho te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai enye, anaa ilkulikae tung'ana loo Lawi ooitashe aaisiaisho teine te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana aajo eimutie Musa eitu elotu adou to ldoinyo, neiturrurro iltung'ana aasotokino Aron, nejoki ninye, “Inyo, intaiki iyiook nkaitin naapuo te dukuya iyiook, amu ore ele Musa, ele tung'ani laa ninye oyaua iyiook ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo iyiook enataase te ninye.”

English: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ai lemeng'amaa intae, anaa olemening ororei linyi, ore pee ipukuku aaing'uaa ina aji, anaa ina ang, nimpiripiroo enterit natii nkejek inyi.

English: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
Masaai: Entayiolo ena lalashera laainei lanyor. Inchoo pooki tung'ani metaa olosioki aning, nemesioki airo, nemesioki sii agoro.

English: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
Masaai: Nejing'u lbarnot, neirin osesen lenye, neipung'ie, nepuo aanukaa.

English: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
Masaai: Kake ore irorei le Esau ilo ayioni lenye botor etolikioki Rebeka; metaa eirriwayie Rebeka lkiliku meipoti ilo ayioni lenye oti, Yakobo nejoki ninye, “Ingura, ore olalashe lino Esau, eitagolito kewan oshoke pee kitum atara tua.

English: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, ara nanu oleme arriyia te nkiroroto, kaji naa eiko Farao te naaning?”

English: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.
Masaai: Nelotu olkilikuai enetii Daudi, ejo, “Eshomo iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel aasujaa Absalom.”

English: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooisilig Olaitoriani netiu anaa oldoinyo le Sion, lemeidimi aaigusugusie, kake ebik ninye ntarasi.

English: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Nejing enkaji e ntumo neshirraki airo te rishata oo lapaitin okuni, neishankarrarre nesayieki ninche mbaa naaipirta enkitoria e Nkai.

English: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak loo Siraeli o laiguanani neitobor ate nejo, “Olaitoriani olasipani.”

English: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
Masaai: Amu aatalakutua nanu nkitanapat e Nkiyang'et e nkishui natii atua Kristo Yesu aaitung'uaa nkitanapat oo ng'ok o enkeeya.

English: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
Masaai: Ore lelo mang'ati laaiba nanu metii emporeet, naa eimagil, naa ilkumok laaiba nanu too mbaa nemesipa.

English: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata naning'oi o ninye neasisho ninye te lejare; nelo ninye agolu eeta ilkuti tung'ana.

English: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
Masaai: neng'a enkop enkutuk enye neijoo ninche te nebo Kora, ore ake eye ilo turrur, ore ake pee emut enkima iltung'ana iip are o onom, neaku ninche enkikoo.

English: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
Masaai: Kake entaretunoto anaa ake, anaa neton ejoitoi, “taata ena olong,” pee megolu likae linyi lukunya te nkaraki elejaroto oo ng'ok.

English: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
Masaai: Ore olayioni omoda naa enkidaaroto te menye, ore enkitok enchankar netiu anaa enkirujuruj e nchan.

English: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu erubata e imiet te nkaraki olosho le Asheri te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
Masaai: Eetuo nkolong'i enkitamioto, eetuo nkolong'i e nkitalaata; naa keyiolou Israel ina. Kemoda ilo oiboni, ore ilo tung'ani le nkiyang'et neeta oloirirua, te nkaraki ina arruoisho ino kitok o enkiba kitok.

English: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Huram ninye too sinkan lenyena imelin o sinkan ootamoo enaiposha, nepuo ninche Ofir tenebo isinkan le Solomon. Neyau teine ntalantani iip ong'uan o onom e sahabu nayaki olaiguanani Solomon.

English: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Besai naa iip uni o tikitam o okuni.

English: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.
Masaai: Kake tenelo neitayu enkishooroto aitaiki obo loo sinkan lenyena neaku enenye o metabaiki ilo ari le lakunoto; nerrinyokino aaku enolkitok; keaku ilayiok lenyena ake ooidim aatushum enkishooroto te njung'ore enye.

English: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
Masaai: Kake aminin, olonyor esupatisho, oloata tonata, oloitoriori, sinyati neibooyo kewan.

English: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day; (for he that is hanged is accursed of God;) that thy land be not defiled, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance.
Masaai: Nemeton osesen lenye enkewarie pooki te nchumata olchani; kake tunukai ninye ina olong ake, amu ore oltung'ani oililioki naa kediaa te Nkai; misarkionie ina kop ino nikinchoo Olaitoriani Enkaiino metaa enjung'ore.

English: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
Masaai: Amu aikuti apa imasaa inono enalotunye, netoponari aaku kumok, nikitamayiana iyie Olaitoriani te pooki wueji naibelekenyakine. Paa amaa kanu kenya nanu agolie olmarei lai makewan?”

English: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
Masaai: Olaitoriani engolon ai naa osinkolio lai; etaa ninye enjeunoto ai.

English: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
Masaai: Ore pee elau entoki nalakie, neitanapisho olkitok lenye metimiri ninye o enkitok enye o nkera enyena o ntokitin pooki naata, aalakie ina sile.
